Very, very nice box chain - so it's strong and has it's own mirror sparkle - additionally it's super adjustable and has a lobster claw clasp with a heart weight at the adjust end - so it will stay in place.  In all honesty, this is just my favorite right now.  I love to travel with these pieces - so I am looking forward to a world of travel again soon!  Having said all of those things, it is plated.  I hope that it will last a long time - and I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: battery operated warming jacket
text: My husband is a 5x and the 5x fit him like a glove - not too snug - but cozy.  The battery unit charged up fairly quickly - however - they power is a bit short running - 2 1/2 hours on high.  There are 3 warming settings - high - medium and low.  The REAL bummer is that you apparently cannot wash this jacket!  For nearly two hundred dollars and you cannot wash it?  I am afraid that while it sounds really cool to have a warming jacket - as my husband was really looking forward to - it loses some of that luster when you realize that it will be dirty (100% cotton) and you will not be able to safely wash it.  Eh.  He should have more carefully read the ad page - there is not a single mention of cleaning - but he's a dude and cleaning wasn't the top of his list. In the end he decided to return it. Probably a good choice.

title: gold plated cross over ring
text: I was really bummed that the stones are soooo small they have next to zero sparkle.  They are just cz so why are they so small?  The setting is a bit rough - might snag clothing - but I've had rougher rings.  The sizing was fairly accurate.  Just wish that they would have enlarged the stones so there would be some sparkle - right now, there isn't even a tiny bit of sparkle.

title: silver sapphire ring
text: Wow.  I am surprised that no one else has noted the sizing.. but I usually wear a 6 1/2 - 7.  I purchased the 8 because the ring is sort of wider... the ring I received SAID "size 8" but it measures just barely over a size SIX (6) on a ring wand!  I am really disappointed.  I ordered a size 9 to compare and then I will decide if I will return them both or not.  I am hoping this was just a mismarked/mistake.  The ring itself is really beautiful in person.  I really hope I can get one that fits.  At this price you would hope the sizing would be more accurate.

title: Set of 3 bracelets
text: I purchased these as a gift for a friend who lives near my daughter - my daughter's wrist is shown in the photo.  Her wrist is small to average.  Daughter was doing the wrapping for me.  I am disappointed at the HUGE, chunky charm.  It really overwhelms the bracelet and I think looks a bit trashy.  I purchased more delicate, pretty bracelet for this person and my daughter is going to throw these in with it  - but against my vote.  In all honesty if I were there in person, I would not.  The charm is just so junky.  They are stretchy, pull on style.  They appear to possibly be actual stone, but it is hard to tell.  On the other hand, always remember that you usually get what you pay for and these are fairly inexpensive. I won't talk about the shipping delays because in this time of virus and shipping issues - but they were seriously missing for a long time before arriving just in time.

title: turtle necks
text: I purchased a red and a green one.  These are plus sizing... be sure to review the size chart before ordering.  The red is a christmas red and the green is a pine green.  The sleeves are good (one of my pet peeves is too short sleeves).  The neck is loose, but fitted.  Another pet peeve - too tight turtle necks.  They washed and dried nicely, I didn't notice any shrinkage. The body is nice and loose... definitely not form fitting - comfortable.

title: acrylic christmas sweater
text: Ok.. I don't think this sweater is super ugly... I like it.  But it is SUPER scratchy.  I am hoping a good wash will help it.  The colors are bright and christmasy.  It is men sizing... I like a loose sweater so I went xx - the sleeves are long.. but the body sizing is not too tight over my chest (38DDD) I'll update my review if new info seems useful.

title: Burgundy lace sleeve cotton robe
text: I purchased this to go with some pajamas that I got earlier to wear on Christmas morning - they have a lace trimmed neckline and it's the same color (slighty different lace but close enough) and matches the pajamas perfectly.  Machine washed and dried nicely.  Very lightweight... but comfortable and will be delightful for Christmas morning.

title: burgundy pajama set
text: I purchased this set to wear with a robe and slippers for Christmas morning... it is a lovely rich burgundy color.  The lace is soft.  Machine washed and dried nicely.  I am 5'7"... 38DDD.. usually wear a 14/16 or 0x/1x - but I sized up just in case to the 18.  That was a good call.  But I don't like things tight across my chest.  The pants are a bit loose at the waist, but I don't like tight pajamas!

title: slipper socks
text: Purchased these to go with some pjs and robe of the same color for Christmas morning.  They have little rubber pieces on the bottom for no slipping.. the socks are a velour yarn knit and they are very thick.  Toasty.  I probably am not going to wear them everyday, but for christmas morning.. perfect.

title: light up christmas tree headband
text: I wanted some fun pieces for when we all video chat this holiday... and this fit the obvious bill.  There are lights.. 3 different settings... some flash and one solid on (which is the one I will be using as flashing lights are no good for most people).  The wires for the lights are black and wiry - so you need to sort of move them around a bit to hide, but after that... it's a great headband.  It comes loaded with a tabbed battery, remove the battery for use.  It will be great for one season.  2021 I am hoping we will all be TOGETHER after this awful virus.  Stay safe and well!

title: Velvet/velour burgundy with gold thread tunic
text: I was hoping the actual tunic would be as lovely as the photos and I was not disappointed.  It's a rich burgundy color and lots of gold thread, a few old gold sequins.  I am 5'7", 38DDD and usually wear a 14/16 or a 0x/1x.  I did size up to 2x because I am really more comfortable if it is looser over the bust area, and the 2x is perfect - for me - especially with the buttons - which are functional.  It is machine wash/dry... delicate.  And it did great!  It is a longer length, tunic like.  I am trying to find a darker burgundy legging to pair with it - but it works with jeans... or black leggings too.  I really like this tunic - perfect for the holiday and the all video chats to come.

title: Mens timex watch
text: This is a very simple, inexpensive watch.  It is my husbands GO TO watch.  He has a collection of very expensive watches.  But this is the watch he wears for work -  They last for about 3 or 4 years of heavy abuse.  He keeps buying and buying them.  Because they work - simple as that.  He particularly loves the ones with the bright orange band.  To each his own!

title: acrylic poncho - red and green
text: I purchased with Christmas in mind... the photo comes off burgundy and green - but in person it is very much a green and orange/red.  It still works but I would have preferred the burgundy!  Washed and dried beautifully (delicate wash and very light tumble).  It will be nice and cozy for winter days and nights. The material is soft and a little fuzzy.  I am 5'7"... 38DDD and usually wear a 14/16 or 0x/1x.  It long... draping below my knees in front because of the style and maybe just above the back of knee in the back.

title: wine turtle neck
text: I am 5'7".... 38DDD, usually wear a 14/16 or 0x/1x.  I sized up because this shirt is listed as "fitted" and prefer a looser fit - was a good idea.  The sleeves are nice and long... washed and dried nicely without obvious shrinkage -  I washed on delicate and tumbled on extra low for about 20 minutes and hung the rest.  It's soft and comfortable.  The neck is fitted but not super snug.  It's a rich burgundy - some call wine - it's not orangish.  I like it.

title: Slouchy knit santa hats
text: I purchased these for my husband and I to wear in video chats with family... trying to step up a little fun as we cannot gather this year...  These are a loose knit... very cute.  I think with careful use they will last for several seasons. They are a christmas red with soft white trim.  In my opinion one of the cutest versions of santa hats out there.

title: v neck long sleeve tshirt
text: This tshirt is really thin.  It is a rich red and has long sleeves.  I sized up as I prefer a looser fit, I would definitely recommend sizing up.  It is longer (tunic like) and I like that.  It does wrinkle terribly.  I haven't washed/dried it just yet but I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  I would just say this blouse isn't nearly as "hearty" in person (the photo looks thicker - heartier to me) - very thin, but soft material.

title: burgundy long sleeve shirt
text: I was really disappointed at how thin this blouse was - wrinkled.. looks really cheap.  I am going to wash and hang dry it - but I think this blouse is headed for the trash bin.  The color is rich and burgundy -ish.  The neckline is small V. I sized up because I did see the rayon content and I like a looser fit - I would definitely recommend sizing up - if you really  want it.  I had high hopes for this blouse, but eh.

title: tiedye shirt
text: I am on the fence about this shirt... I like a looser fit so I sized up - that was good call.  It is a nylon material - that is sort of soft - but not really cozy.  The colors are soft and the "tie dye"  is well done... the colors are bit odd - I can't explain beyond that, but I don't rate for my personal opinion of colors.  I think their photos are not really showing the coloring accurately.  Always a challenge.  The sleeves are long.. I consider that a positive. I machine washed and then tumbled on low - seems ok.  I don't think it's gonna be my fav - but I will wear it while it's cooler. I kinda wish there'd been a darker color palate to choose from - jewel tones?

title: eyeglass chains
text: Ok.. this is my first purchase of the eye glass leashes for myself... so there is apparently a learning curve.  the corded leashes are a little better but maybe not as "cool" as the beaded ones... But I have had one of the beaded leashes on for less than an hour and already I've had to replace the silicone loop on one side and there are wires sticking out of the beaded leash portion that are pokey.  Eh.  Now, on the plus side, they send a little bag of spare parts - good thing - but nevertheless, the beaded, more stylish leashes may just go in the trash and I'll use the the cords - no pokey wires.  The other thing... they could be about 6 inches longer...  but then, I'm learning.  Maybe there is a good reason they are so short.  All in all, I would skip the cool beaded leashes and stick to the more boring cords - in my opinion.  OR... this could also be a case of "you get what you pay for" thing.  Perhaps I should try some more expensive beaded leashes.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: snowflake shirt
text: I believed I was purchased a women's shirt, this is clearly sized for a man, so while I sized up (because of the cotton content) - it is HUGE.  Very disappointed.  The sleeves are 4 to 6" too long.  The body is like a tunic on me and I am not a small person - 5'7" - 38DDD.  Just swims on me.  The snowflake is print is really sticky...  Overall, I would not purchased this again.

title: full coverage undies
text:
UPDATE BELOW...........After reading other reviewers reports and reviewing the sizing chart, I purchased the xl. I usually wear a 14/16 or 0x/1x. I am 5'7". They fit comfortably snug. If you're a loosey goosey undie wearer, I would size up. I went out on a limb and ordered the black, the gray and the beige (or nude - it is a very yellowish beige). It was risky for sure. They are mostly cotton with a little spandex for comfort. They washed and dried nicely. They are interestingly sewn, where some thought was truly given in construction. There is a 1/2" elastic waist - which is zig-zag sewn to keep it in place. The crotch is a wide, but possibly a little short. They are high waisted, over my belly button and fit snugly - maybe a slight bit of flattening, but they are not meant to be girdle undies. The older I've gotten the more I am into comfort and the so called "granny panties." Whatever works. The black is a deep, true black - the gray is heathered and the beige/nude is a little yellowy or buttery to me - just a little. Overall, I like these undies. I included some pics of the gray pair because it seemed to be easy to see the stitching, etc... Having said all that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful!
UPDATE: 11/30/2020.... Ok.. after wearing these for a while I am back to purchase more. I wear the gray the most so that is what I buy. I am not very fond of the neutral/nude/beige color.... it's yellowish to me. So I am sticking with mostly gray and black - but that is personal choice. They have washed and dried beautifully multiple times. Snug, but comfortable. Holds your tummy in just a little. Stay up. Honestly, these are some of the best cotton undies I've purchased in a while!
UPDATE: 12/4/2020... purchased a few more. These are really good so far. Hope they last as well as they fit!

title: tunic top
text: I purchased this shirt to go with some holiday leggings I just got... I am 5'7"... 38DDD/E - I sized up when I saw the cotton content as I like a looser tunic top - that seems to have been a good idea.  I have not washed yet, but I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  The colors are soft - not overly bright.  The t is thinner material and soft.  I love it.

title: holiday leggings
text: I purchased the red plaid and black/white snow flakes... my adult daughter (who lives in Arizona) chose the red plaid and the turquoise reindeer colors.  They are a thinner tshirt material.  Very comfortable.  Very holiday!  I purchased some tunic-like tops to wear with mine - we are both choosing to wear them inside for lounging and not "out."  They'd be great pajamas because they are so soft and comfy.  I would also say that the sizing was spot on.  So get your waist measurements and use their chart.  They are pretty thin material, so I'm hoping they don't pill and wear too thin - time will tell and I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: crossover phone purse
text: Ok.  I've left my cell phone in the cart TWICE.  I'm done doing that.  So I purchased this purse in hopes of avoiding that whole scenario again.  It is faux leather.  Comes with 2 handles... one crossover body style (I'm using that one) and the other is a really short one I can't imagine ever using.  The handles have swivel hook attachments.  There is a pocket for your phone (the clear side) so you can technically touch and use your phone (I have a samsung S10+ and fit and worked.  I don't really think I will be "using" the clear side much... but it WILL keep my phone ON me.  *sigh*  There is also another slot that you could slip a few dollars, your drivers license and maybe a credit card.  In these days of virus I have taken to sticking my drivers license and a credit card in my bra rather than having to carry a purse that you have set down or on something.  I just think, IN THEORY, this purse should really help with a lot of things.  Time will tell and I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful!

title: wired brim hat
text: I purchased this hat for a friend going thru chemo.  With winter arriving, I thought this looked warm and cute.  She loved it.  I purchased one for myself after seeing the one I purchased for her.  The brim is lightly wired so it stays out - where it should be - adds to the style.  Felty material.  Cute flowers on the side. Black accented with gray - just as shown.

title: no show socklettes
text: I purchased 2 different types and these are my favs of the two.  they come up way higher on the top of my feet, which works for the shoes I wear and the fit.  I have a size 7 foot and an 8 1/2 (womens) foot due to a deformity.  There are 3 little zig zag silicone strips that help to keep the sock in place on your heel.  I purchased the black and they are a dark black.  The sock is fairly thin, but not see through.  The socks are very stretchy.  I find them comfortable.  I probably will buy more of these.  Oh, and as for washing, I have a delicate bag and I wash them in the bag and then lay them flat to dry in my dryer closet.  Having said all of that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: no see socklettes
text: These work well... but I have to report that if you have a size 7 1/2 or smaller foot, these will easily slip off.  Due to having had polio when I was a child, I have one foot that is a size 7 and the other that is an 8 1/2.  So I am uniquely able to discuss this discovery.  They fit perfectly on my 8 1/2 foot... but with my smaller foot, I just can't keep the sock on.  There is a silicone heel back - which will help if the sock fits your foot.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: wacoal bra
text:
Ok..I made a mistake. This bra is NOT thinly foam lined. It's just 2 pieces of nylon. I wear a 38DDD. This is a front loader - so there are not back hook adjustments. It cuts pretty hard - so I would NOT consider this bra "all day comfort" as the tag says. On the upside, the underwire is lifting. But, the cup was not enough for my bust. I went back and ordered the 40DDD to see if that helps with cup and comfort. The do offer a 38G - but I worry about the tightness. Listen, you do want a pretty snug fit - because the elastic will stretch. And in this case there are no tighter hooks to go to. But it was so uncomfortable I didn't think I could take the wait to a stretched out band. The straps are about 3/4" wide and are adjustable. I do wish there was a thin foam lining. Wacoal is a good brand and it appears well made. There is a slight decor of stretch lace at the cleavage V - so it gives a bit of feminine edge. The lace lays flat and I didn't notice it under my T shirt. The back strap is NOT terrible wide. So if you're afraid of "back fat" this might not be the bra for you. It hit ok under the arm for me but I can see that some may have issues with fat there too. All in all it's not my least favorite but I can't wear my size. U really like a front loader, but it is SUPER hard to find one built for my bust size I guess. Even harder doing it all online. I will check in after I get the 38G to compare the fit and update my review with that info in case if might be helpful.
UPDATE... The 38G rib cage fit was a slightly more comfortable feel and the cups were deeper... but... the way the underwire is sewn it pushes down on your cleavage creating a very big cleavage bulge.. Eh. While I really tried to make this style work, it doesn't for me. I am returning both. I would say that if you are DDD or larger, I would pass on this style. Having said that.. Wacoal is a very good brand and well made. I would try some other styles. I plan to.

title: vanity fair bra
text:
I purchased the 38DD - REALLY needed the DDD or E/F (which is not offered). There really isn't any "separation" and I did miss the part where it didn't have an underwire.
PROS: I like the neutral color. The straps were wide at the right spots - IF you criss/cross them. A nice wide back strap, four hooks. It looks very well made.
CONS: The material snags really easily. If you don't criss cross the straps - the wide part of the strap is too far down your chest - thus cutting into your shoulder (I get that I don't have small boobs - but this hurts after a while). No underwire for better lift. While it looks well made, it is VERY --- not feminine. Looks like a battle bra - which I was willing to go with if it would have just given me the right fit.
Most of my stars are construction. One star for snaggy material and straps that aren't wide where they need to be. This LOOKS like a bra meant for women with larger busts - but honestly, it's not really made very well for that - in my opinion.

title: rubber bottomed socks
text: I purchased these to wear over the top of my plastic "spa" bags I put on my feet.  It never fails I need to run around - lotions and plastic bags  while walking around is a recipe for disaster.  Now.. you shouldn't walk around a lot but I have found these socks really help keep the bag in place, minimize the slide around inside the bag and are washable.  I set them out to dry after washing - otherwise the rubber bottoms stick to everything else in the dryer.  Mainly gray with black  - the black is mainly the top of the foot - and the rubber pieces on the bottoms.  Oh.  And I wear a women's regular size 8 1/2".  They fit perfectly - not too tight at the ankle and not loose. If you have a long foot, they might not be as comfortable.

title: slouchy knit hat with flowers
text: I purchased 2 of these.. one for me... one for my friend/neighbor who is going through chemo.  With winter coming I thought she might like this.  It's warm, but lightweight.  The flowers are really a pretty touch.  I pull my down to my ears - but the hat has an edge that you wear sort of beret?  I am happy with it and I think my friend will love hers.

title: tie dye baseball cap
text: My friend, who is going through chemo, has chosen baseball caps as her hat choice right now... this one is very cute.  The photo kinda makes the hat look a little purpley... but the one I received is predominately pink.  They are all probably a little different. She will like it.

title: fleece hat
text: I purchased this hate for a friend going through chemo.  I thought it was really cute.  The brim is actually wired.  So it stays out.  Really cute.  I hope she likes it and it gives her a little spring in her step. God bless her.

title: Rabbit Fur knit cap
text: I purchased this for a friend who is going through chemo and lost her hair.  She has a wonderful strength and sense of humor so I thought she'd enjoy this hat.  I will give it to her soon.  But I have to say, I LOVE this cap - in fact, I'm thinking about ordering one for myself.  It's simply glorious.  The inside is a poly knit - The rabbit fur outer is really beautiful and lively.  It's soft and beautiful.  I was so pleasantly surprised.  I think my friend is going to love it as much as I do.

title: chemo turbans
text: I purchased these for a dear friend who has lost her hair due to chemo.  They are thinner than I thought.. but she reports they are comfortable.  I purchased the wine and dark gray set.  I think she likes them. Hopefully we can just throw them out when her hair comes back.  Period.

title: Vote tshirt
text: Tshirt material is nice and soft... but I would size up (I actually sized up 2 sizes to the women's 3x because I like a looser fit across the chest - 38DDD) Washed and dried nicely - no noticeable shrinkage.  The print patch is not too stiff.

title: mens slide on sandals
text: I purchased these for my husband - who has a bit of a wide foot.  I did size up for that and it seems a good choice.  He reports they are comfortable.  He uses them for house slippers.

title: long sleeve biden/harris tshirt
text: Really nice quality, long sleeve Biden/Harris 2020 tshirt.  I would say size up if you like a looser fit.  Washed and dried well, not much shrinkage, if any.

title: stretch shoe laces
text: I wanted to replace some regular laces with stretch laces for convenience.  They are a bit of trick to do, but there are directions are just ok.  The last piece that you have to press together to "lock" into place takes quite a bit of finger strength.  I ended up using some wide pliers I had to achieve the lock.  They are adjusted by the pinch and slide piece at the top of the shoe.. They are ok. I'm probably not going to this again - but I will say these were WAY better than the corkscrew stretch laces - those looked terrible.  These look far better.

title: Curly laces
text: Eh.  Was thinking it would be nice to just be able to slip on my shoes and not have to tie the laces.  These were awful. They twisted and looked really awkward in the shoe - and weren't long enough to be actually helpful.  I pulled them back out and they would not properly recurl.  I actually tossed them. Lesson learned.

title: under armor boys shoes
text: Purchased for my grandson who live in Arizona.  I have 2 grandsons who are 6 and 9.  Mom reports they fit well and I would say the sizing is accurate - meaning you don't need to size up or down.  Quick and easy with velcro (like) closing.

title: Men's science tshirt
text: This is a men's t... so it hard to fit properly over my bust area. Because its 100% cotton I went up 2 sizes. Good thing (im a 38DDD) because while I didn't notice a lot if shrinkage - but I dont like tight across the chest. Honestly I love the sentiment of the shirt- but I need to find a women's version.

title: vote orange stain out tshirt
text: This shirt is 100% cotton, so I am really glad I sized up to the 2x - I don't like tight tshirts across my chest (38DDD).  Turned out to be a good choice, however, after washing and drying, I didn't notice any shrinkage.  Even though the t shirt lists as 100% cotton, it is not stiff at all - very soft and fairly lightweight.  It will be around longer than I need it to be.

title: diversity t shirt
text: I purchased a number of different T's and this one of my favs.  The material is very soft, comfortable and lightweight - but not see through.  I usually wear a xl or 1x.  I chose to size up the 2x after reading the measurements and because I do not like a tight tshirt over my bust (38DDD).  Plus, the material is 50/50 - it's possible there could be some shrinkage, but I didn't notice any.  I machine washed in cold - dried on extra low - no problem.  I really like the t's and happy with my purchase - they arrived really quickly too (I do have prime - but in this day and age of the virus - that sometimes doesn't really matter).

title: rise up and vote t shirt
text: I purchased a number of different T's and this one of my favs.  The material is very soft, comfortable and lightweight - but not see through.  I usually wear a xl or 1x.  I chose to size up the 2x after reading the measurements and because I do not like a tight tshirt over my bust (38DDD).  Plus, the material is 50/50 - it's possible there could be some shrinkage, but I didn't notice any.  I machine washed in cold - dried on extra low - no problem.  I really like the t's and happy with my purchase - they arrived really quickly too (I do have prime - but in this day and age of the virus - that sometimes doesn't really matter).

title: Nike boys shoe
text: Purchased these for my grandson (9 years) in another state.  Mom reports they fit as expected and he loves them.

title: under armour sports shoes for boys
text: I purchased these for my grandsons after making the mistake of purchasing some other non-name brand shoes.  Mom reports they fit as expected and the boys like them.

title: boys swim trunks
text: Purchased these for my 6 year old and 9 year old grandsons... they appear to accurate in sizing and look really well sewn.  Washed and dried well.  Material dries rapidly when worn and wet.  The legs are a bit longer - which is the style currently.  The boys like them - but they aren't super particular regarding clothing.

title: boys rain jacket
text: For a name brand like Columbia - I expected a better quality.  The sizing runs a little small and the zipper is very temperamental.  I probably wouldn't purchase again due to the zipper failure rate.  I end up having to do the zipper for my grandson because it is so troublesome more often than not.  The inner lining zips up into the zipper and the zipper head often doesn't pull up properly - won't grab the start teeth.  Eh.

title: pirate treasure
text: Ok.. If you're buying the box because it's filled with pirate booty - Eh.  They are really, really cheap plastic items that are truly just garbage.  There is a paper map - on thicker paper - might be the only thing that is of some quality - but not really useful in any way.  The only thing I left in the boxes (I purchased 2) was a plastic skull and cross bone ring.  There are some really thin plastic coins that are truly ugly - threw those in the trash too.  I separately purchased some metal gold coins, glass jewels, faux pearl necklaces and some other trinkets.  I then buried them in my sandy front yard.  The box is a fairly good size.. and will work- has base metal pieces on the outside. The slide hook closure sometimes closes, sometimes you have to really wrank on it to make it work.  Eh.  As any empty box and 1/2 the price - maybe?  All of these things together, I would not purchase again.

title: big boys jeans
text: These are a great, worn color.  Have the adjustable button waist which is what my grandsons need.  Skinny legs, but NOT tight.  I like them. True to size in my opinion.

title: boys adjustable waist jeans
text: I have thinner, smaller grandsons and the adjustable button waist is just a necessity.  These are great.  Washed and dried beautifully and fit perfectly.

title: stretchy jeans
text: I purchased these for my grandson because it had the adjustable waist buttons - they work great.  The denim is stretchy and he likes these.

title: boys sunglasses
text: These fit my 6 and 9 year grandsons perfectly.  They come with croakies - which they don't care for - and a nice drawstring case.  They wrap slightly around their faces which I think is a good thing.  Blue and yellow plastic and blackish lens.  They are polarized.  They both seem to be very comfortable wearing them and I don't notice them slipping or falling off either.  All good.

title: big boys pajamas
text: Daughter reports these fit perfectly - my grandson is a smaller, thinner guy - they are meant to fit snugly but not too tight and they do.  Daughter also reported that they washed and dried nicely without any visible shrinkage.

title: new balance dial shoe
text: My grandsons LOVE this dial shoe the most.  I was afraid I wasn't going to be able to get them again for a while - was very happy to see they brought them back.  A bit of a trick to learn about how to tighten and loosen the "shoe strings" but once you do it - it's totally a breeze.  They love the look and colors. There are two grab handles one on the top and one the side of case. The outer wheels are multi-directional... and stick out quite a bit and I'm not sure they are as 'sturdy' as the rest of the case. If there is an 'Achilles heel' on these bags... the wheels may be it or possibly the pull handle.. but we as I said, time will tell and I never hesitate to update. I have this problem frequently but felt that "Roamans" might be a good option as they are a plus size retailer.  However... not so much.  The search for a button down blouse that fits across the bust and isn't HUGE elsewhere - continues.  Meh.  The material was crisp.. a bit stiff maybe.  The white of the blouse was bright - not greyish or yellow... The sleeves were snug, but not too tight.  I donated it.

title: faux pearl necklace
text: I purchased this for a 50's costume... and it is perfect... a bit large in pearl size.... but I wanted them to be a bit exaggerated - so it's perfect.  It's a nice touch that they are knotted... looks like more quality... the clasp is a bit wanky... but it will work for as few times as I will be wearing them. The color is a very nice ivory/pearl color.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  Hopefully this info was helpful to you!

title: spider pin
text: I purchased this pin to go with my spidery costume... The pin is actually quite beautiful.  The body looks like a Tahitian black pearl.  Looks very much like the photos provided in the ad.  It's larger than I expected... about 2 1/2"...  It's weighty... not thin and flimsy.  The clasp is sturdy looking - the usual type clasp you would expect on a costume jewelry pin.  It's perfect for my costume..  and maybe when I am feeling a bit sassy. Ha!  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: black short wig
text: So... I purchased this wig for a costume... so I am not super worried about how "real" it looks... for my spidery costume... it's perfect.  It stands up in the back... there are adjustable bands in the back.  It came with a fish net wig cap.  I did trim the bangs just a bit so it works better for me.  It will work for the few times I will use it.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: stretch belt
text: I purchased this belt in red and black.  I usually wear a 14/16 or 0x/1x.  Just the right about of stretch and give...  you don't want it to be loose.  I my opinion they fit perfectly. It doesn't roll when I sit... it's about 3" wide... Just a note:... the red one shows a gold tone clasp in the picture... both the red and black belt I received have silver tone clasps... which is what I was hoping for.  But... just in case that matters to you.  Now... they are pretty cheap... the clasp and the belt... but I am using with a costume.. so I am ok with that.  If you're looking for a real "quality" nice looking belt with a quality clasp... this one probably isn't for you...  But if you just need a cinch belt for a costume or for fun.. this belt is great!  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  And I hope this review was helpful to you!

title: retro red polka dot dress
text: I have a 57' chevy golf cart and it's fun to dress up when i ride around in it.... I will wear this with white bobby socks and saddle shoes or white keds.  I have lots of fun accessories - probably will wear it with my white scarf tied around my pony tail and cat eye sunglasses.  It's really about fun.  About sizing... I am 5'8"... 38DDD and usually wear a 14/16 or 0x/1x.  I read other reviews and decided to size up to an 18.  I feel that was a good choice, especially in terms of length.  There is a left side zipper, however, I am easily able to pull it over my head without using the zipper at all. The arms are VERY comfortable, NOT tight at all.  The material is stiff and starchy - which is good. Helps it to keep it's shape. BONUS:  It is stretchy!  There is a wide tie-on belt included.  The collar stands up and is a little odd... but will work.  NO pockets. The top wraps across your chest but it is not a wrap around dress... I like that that it is very modest.  NO cleavage showing.  The dress falls well below my knees - to what I consider the perfect length for this type of dress... ALSO... I did buy and am wearing a full petticoat under the skirt. There are many to choose from, I chose white and the xl worked perfectly. This really doesn't look like a true 50's retro dress, but it's close and it cute.  The red is a very slightly orange red.. and the dots are bright white and large. (See pics I have included)  This is really a "costume" but it the quality of the material and shape is such I believe with proper care, it will last a very long time.  My inclination is to take it to the dry cleaners to be sure it is properly starched and pressed.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seems useful.  And I really hope that my review has been helpful to you.

title: mock turtle neck
text: Sizing was accurate... I am 5'7"... 38DDD.. usually wear a 14/16 or 0x/1x.  The one thing about this, and most mock turtle necks/turtle necks I have ever purchased... the sleeves are always too short.  This one is no different.  *sigh*... It washed up nicely... but did shrink a bit... in the arm length!  Dang it.  The color is black... but not a deep black... so I would carefully launder as it will probably fade some.  I use a delicate wash for dark items and I like to think that helps.  The neck is loose, as you would hope... and the arms were not too snug on me.  It will work.  I just wish we could get sleeves that would be actually long... and not 3/4's after one wash/dry.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I hope that my efforts at my review were helpful to you!

title: short tiered swim top
text: Purchased for sunbathing on my deck with turquoise skort I have... or black shorts.  I am 5'8"... usually wear a 14/16 or 0x/1x.  38DDD.  The straps are very skinny/narrow... and are adjustable.  The two flutters/tiers fall to about mid chest on me.  It machine washed and dried beautifully.  It could be hung to dry if you prefer of course.  I find it comfortable and more forgiving than a "bikini" top.

title: red big guy sweatshirts
text: Ordered sweatshirts with print... got plain, no print sweatshirts. Orange/red sweatshirts.  Husband is a big guy... the 4x was a little big.. but he normally wears a 4x.  Sweatshirts should not fit tightly.  So I think the fit was good. Obviously I have returned them as they were NOT what we paid for.  Disappointing to say the least.  Still waiting for refund.

title: 3/4 sleeve pull on maxi dress
text: The material is very, very thin and when stretched you can see through it... honestly... I would not recommend it for that fact alone so I am not going to go through the whole "providing all my stats" ...  It's sort of nightgown-isk print... or at least that's what stuck me as I looked at it on..

title: Purple clip on earrings
text: I can no longer wear my pierced earrings and wanted to still occasionally have some fun, so I am collecting a few fine pieces.  These are just stunning. Surprisingly rich, quality looking.  In fact, I am going to go back and look at other color options.  On first blush, they are heavy.  I was concerned... but I put one on... They are VERY comfortable.  Probably the most comfortable pair I have tried on today even though they are the most heavy pair I have tried as well.  I have included a couple of pics I hope will help.  They came individually wrapped in cello with a lovely red velvet like draw string bag for storage or gift giving.  The lovely, heavy blue box would also make a lovely gift presentation in my opinion, even with the BriLove logo on the top.  The metal portion is a gold like/colored metal.  They also include a EXTRA set of little rubber comfort stoppers... they improve the comfort AND help the earrings stay in place.  They have a nice subtle movement to them, catching the light.  These are just a really nice pair of costume jewelry clip on earrings.  Having said all of that... I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  I hope my review and pics were helpful to you.

title: CZ clip on earrings
text: I can no longer wear my pierced earrings and so I wanted to collect a few classic clip ons... these are WOW.  They look like about 1 ct in each ear, surrounded by tiny smaller cz's around the single center carat.  A lot of sparkle for faux.  Rich and believable. I've added a couple of pics, but they do NOT do these earrings justice. They are WAY better in person.  They are silver color metal.  They come with little white rubber comfort stoppers in the back... really adds to the comfort but also helps to keep them on your ear.  In all fairness.. it takes a bit of getting used to wearing clip ons.. but I only wear them for a few hours and they don't seem to bother me.  I also am sensitive to several different metals. The box they come in is... "eh"... I wouldn't gift them in this box.  It's just a kind of an ugly box with their name on the outside.  So far, so good here.  I never hesitate to update my review should new info seem useful and I hope my review was helpful to you.

title: snowflake clip on earrings
text: I can no longer wear my pierced earrings... on occasion I would like to wear a pair of earrings so I have had to pick up a few pairs... these are very cute... I have short hair so this size works for me.  I have included a few pics so you can see size and real time shots.  There are a little rhinestones in the tips and center - adds to the sparkle.. although they are NOT super sparkly... I just wanted the shape so I am ok with that.  They are a silver metal of some sort.. I am sensitive to a variety of metals, but so far they don't bother me.  They came in a cute pink cloth cinch bag - about 2"x 2" bag... They also included TWO pairs of rubber comfort stoppers - a useful add.  They do pinch... that's how they stay on your ears - having said that... they were comfortable - in all fairness - I where them for just a few hours... not all day.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  I have also included some pics.  I hope my review was helpful to you in some way.

title: 2 ct clip on earrings
text: I can no longer wear my pierced earrings so, I am collecting a few small pieces that I can wear if I need to.  I thought this was a classic look.  As they are platinum plated... they should stay nice looking for a while with good care.  Added a few pics to for you to better see.  The little rubber stopper in the back definitely helps with comfort.  I don't even feel them on... however, they are secure.  I've tugged on them a couple of times and keep checking them... they are solid. I needed to move the earring on my right ear just slightly for better comfort - apparently the "sweet spot" and all is well.  It does take some time to get used to wearing "clip on" earrings after a lifetime of pierced... but for the few times I actually wear earrings... it's ok. These do appear to me to about 1 ct each stone.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  And I hope this review and pics helped you in some way.

title: womens santa costume.
text: I am 5'7"... wear a 14/16 or a 0x/1x... 38DDD.  It is loose... but wanted it to be. I will wear sort of as a tunic... NOT a dress... The white fur is disappointing... it's flat and kinda cheapy looking.  The red is a deep burgundy... nice... and stretchy.  As shown... it's sort of empire waisted.  I guess at this price point I should not have been surprised at the sort of overall cheapness of the look.  It's "ok" in my opinion. It IS just a costume... not a long term item of clothing.  I have not tried to wash it yet.  I will update my review should new info seem useful.

title: navy and white print dress
text: I am 5'7", 0x or 14/16 38DDD... and the dress fits as I expects... maybe a bit smaller than you expect.  The colors are bright white and navy.  It does have pockets and is a "mock type wrap."  Meaning... that the "wrap" is just over the chest... and there is no tie in any place.  It creates a bit of a "v" neck. I will be tacking the V a little higher so I don't have so much cleavage because that's what I like.  The sleeves are short, as shown in the photo on the ad page.  The dress hits at the top of my feet, so it's long.  I love navy and white... the flower print is lovely.  I purchased this because I travel and I love to bring things that don't wrinkle and are easy to wash and wear.  I washed on my machine's hand wash cycle and then hung it to dry.  I am going to pop in the tumble dryer on low and see how it does.  I think it will be fine. Now... the down side... anywhere the material "stretches"... it thins... and becomes see through.  Ugh.  Fortunately I don't see any sensitive parts where that is an issue. The issue for me is two spots under each arm because my bosom pushes the front out and the area under my arm is where you see the stretch.  When I saw this, I stretched the main part of the skirt and was unhappy to see it thins right out and becomes mostly see through...  So... I won't be wearing this dress for anything more than a lounging in the privacy of my hotel room and possibly be ok to answer the door for room service... but I probably would not wear this dress out on a sunny day... or night with lights showing through me?  :)  Everyone has a different comfort level.  I just want you to be aware.  It's ALMOST wrinkle free.. but not the best I've seen or have.  But for the price point... for me, it's going to work for private lounging. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  I hope my review has been helpful to you!

title: leather croc print purse
text: I am pleasantly surprised by the quality of this purse - especially for the price.  It comes with a tag that says it is genuine leather.. however, I am not a leather expert... it LOOKS like its leather... The bag construction is very stout.  It's thick.. stiff/sturdy - but not too heavy.  The straps are about 1" wide.  I did provide some photos so you can get a better look.  That little bump on the front is a croc head... very cute.  The flap, which has a magnetic clasp that works well and without much effort, hides a zippered closure.  Great for security and to keep things in your purse, in your purse.  The bottom is slightly rounded and even when loaded it doesn't really stand on it's own without being leaned up on something.. so that inner zipper is great.  The interior is lined with a brown satin like material - see photo.  Inside you'll find a large, wide zippered compartment and an wide slide in slot.  On the outer back of the bag there is another zippered compartment.  The straps configure to use as a backpack OR just pull up on the strap and VIOLE! it's a shoulder strap that you can actually do cross body on if you want - and I am NOT a tiny person.  The top of the strap is slightly padded - a nice thought in useful design.  There is also, as you can see in the ad photo, a sewn grab handle at the top - great for grabbing and going.  I was also pleasantly surprised at how much I could get into it.  I forgot to add a pic showing the width... it's about 3" but with a fold spread that makes it about 4 1/2".  The outer part of the bag has a new leather "sheen" to it... a little shiny... but if it is really fine leather, it will dull with use and age and take on a nice worn patina.  We'll see about that.  Honestly, if this bag had a designer sponsor, it would be a $500-$1500 bag. I have some LV - so that would be the top in number... :)  Of course it would then have their logo all over it. I should also mention it comes with a white, thin woven type dust cover bag.  I really love this bag right now. This is no junk bag. It's rich looking quality... fine, thoughtful details and price make it a trifecta of bags.  That is WIN WIN WIN. It arrived quickly (I have prime) and in excellent condition.  Having said all of that... I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seems useful.  I hope this info and the photos were helpful to you in shopping!

title: shag wig
text:
I am a total wig virgin... NEVER even tried on a wig... I just like this cut .. I grew out my bangs - it took about 6 months.. but every once in a while... I feel like bangs... this is a really cute option... obviously I am no cutie - just an old grandma... but honestly... this is fun. So much fun my sister bought one too. Hahaha! I can't get over how real it looks. I took it out of it's hair net... shook it once... ran my fingers through it once I put it on and Voile! It's VERY easy to put on... lots of adjustment - I must have a smaller head as I have it set on the tightest setting and it's still kinda loose.. (?) not sure about that... Even though it is synthetic... I still think it's passable.. even outside. I've included a few pics for you to judge yourself. Please be kind... I didn't blur out my face this time as I think its harder to evaluate the wig - :) I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful... and I definitely will update with how it goes to wear it over time... I'm new to all this. I did buy a gentle shampoo.. a special de-static styling brush and a "head" to store it on... Also... to be fair... a few of the wisps around my face are actually mine... I have blonde hair naturally, and it looks like more highlights - I just love the overall "wispyness" of the shag like cut. It's adorable. But then I am old and a child of the 70s. I tried provide you shots of all round and the top... honestly, it looks real to me. Like a really good hair hair cut... even in the sun! Best to all of you!
UPDATE: 9/9/2018.... Just FYI.... I like this cut so well, I thought I would try to the "blonde" version... Eh. not so much. For some reason the brown with highlights is still the best looking in my opinion. The blonde one was too monotone.. and seemed to fit more on the small side... I think the look of the brown one is the highlights... it seems to accentuate the layers and adds to the more "real" look. Now... the black version was really cute on one reviewer...and it did not have highlights. Being a natural blonde I don't think I could pull off the black version... but the blonde one looked so.... fake... Just my thoughts..

title: 3/4 sleeve tunic medallion print
text: I am 5'7"... 38DDD and usually wear a 14/16 or 0x/1x.  This is a loose fitting top - as you can see from the photos and it does have a handkerchief bottom edge. I was a bit disappointed with the colors... It shows a predominent blue color scheme... but the orange-red was really the most area.. I didn't care for it.. It feels like an autumn/Fall colors.  Which is fine.. but I was really hoping for more like the photo... I shared it with my neighbor and she likes it. The medallions on the print are really big.  It does feel a bit loose... probably could have gone down one size... but the arms might have been too tight then.  This is why I reported it as "fit as expected."  Would be cute with jeans.. and in the Fall.

title: tankini set
text: Sizing is WAAAY off.  But according to their sizing info, this SHOULD have worked.  Eh.  I knew it ran small.. but this is ridiculous.The 3x (thats right TRIPLE X) was too small for my neighbor who is about a size 8.  SUPER cheap too. title: mini backpack
text: I purchased this for my 33 year old daughter who is always trying to find an "easier" purse.  After a trip to our local zoo and using a more "utility" backpack, she and I found that backpacks are actually really handy and much easier on our backs.  This backpack was her choice.  She really liked the design and size.  The measurements given are accurate.  There is a zippered pouch in front and zippered top. The straps are comfortable and lightly padded.  I will update my review should she give me more.  To date she is still using it exclusively and is very happy.

title: SO easy and comfy
text: I own several pairs of these shoes... SO easy and comfy.  Also, due to a deformity, I must order 2 pairs... one 7 1/2 and one 9.  I believe the sizing is accurate, so no need to size up or down. The price on these shoes makes that so much less painful.  The beige is a warm beige... not too light, nor too dark.  I have included a couple of pics so you can see for yourself.  I have both the "cutout" (these) and the un cut versions.  I like them both.  They do appear to be leather and they do stretch and give just bit as you wear them.  The bottoms are as shown... a bunch of round tabs... grips the ground and I have not found them to be slippery at all.  At this price point, even if they last one season, I think it's a bargain.  They arrived quickly (I have prime) and in a plastic bag... then inside clear zipper closed bags with the size stickers on the outside.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  I hope this info was helpful to you in making your decision.  It's the only reason I bother to take the time to post honest, unbiased reviews!

title: LeSportsac Classic backpack
text: LeSportsac items are beautiful.. feather weight - and yet super tough.  This backpack is no exception.  The bag is fairly small compared to other "styles" of LeSportsac.. perfect for my use.  The straps are nylon - no padded, however they are very comfortable.  The top is zippered and there is a zipped pouch on the outside.  The best part for me is that the inside lining is a lovely light beige.  This makes it so much easier to find things at the bottom.  The stitched/quilted design on the outside of the bag is beautiful. The photographs shown are accurate.  There are two handles on the top of the bag so you can easily grab the backpack like a purse if that is more convenient at the moment.  One note:  You will want to keep the top zippered closed. As the backpack doesn't really have a stable flat bottom, so when it lays down, if you have the bag open, things will fall out.  I love the convenience of backpack style bag and even though I have a substantial collection of other bags "snobby bags"  like Louie Vuitton, etc... I always come back to function. Guess that happens with age and experience! :)  LeSportsac has me hooked.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  Hope this info was useful to you!

title: lightweight foldable duffel
text: The color is a sort of a metallic gold tan/beige. Very light in color.  The straps are a very light gray. The material does feel waterproof. More flexible than others I have tried. It is smaller, which is good for me because my roller bags are very small.  Any larger and it would hang over the edges too far.  There is a nice loop for the roller bag handle.  I bought 2 to keep in one in each of my bags to be sure I always have a little extra room.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: Black leather backpack
text: Ok.  This is tough... because I love the front of the purse/backpack... but HATE the woven cotton straps!!  If they were real leather to match the loveliness of the bag, it would be a home run.  So now... I have to find a leather worker to have appropriate leather straps made.  I just hate the cheap look and feel of the black cotton straps.  Beyond that... on the "up" side for me.... the interior is a lovely turquoise - nylon like material.  Win/Win.  Wipeable and easy to find things in the bottom.  If it's dark interior it's harder - or at least for me.  There is a zipper top under the stylish flap.  Good for security.  There are two room pockets inside and on the other side a zippered patch.  The outside, under the flap there is another zippered pocket... it is lined with a dark gray cotton/blend - or at least that's how it feels. I love the brushed metal studs that line the outside flap with a loop and leather strip for flare.  I just don't understand why they stopped with all the fine leather and made really awful cotton straps. .. Also it sort of "converts to a cross-over by pulled the back pack straps up, making a cross body length loop.  Eh.  Not really my fav.  And they sewed a cotton hand strap to the back/top - for a hand grab... that's "ok" and more useful than the crossbody conversion.. However,  I am going to see if there is a way to replace that the hand grab with leather too.  All in all... for the price of the bag... it should have had fine leather, wide straps.  Just disappointed that in order to really love the bag I need to invest more money and time to get it to look and function better.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: comfort nude bra
text: I purchased several different "brands" of these types of bras and you should know, they are all EXACTLY the same - so if you like this type of bra, go for the cheapest.  They literally are the same.  I am a 38DDD.  I really need and usually wear a severe underwire.  I was looking for a soft, wireless, weekend like bra - These offer little to NO support... but the straps are really comfortable and of course, NO underwire.  Just to be fair, they are in NO WAY  a "sports bra"  Unless yoga is the only thing you'll be doing.  They offer NO support for jossling the girls about.  I do leave the pads (which are removable) in  - wash in a lingerie bag and then dry flat in my dryer closet.  The pads are a bit of a pain to take in and out - so I don't.  But they do offer "nip" coverage if that matters to you and tiny bit of shape help. These are really comfy - but are really just sleep or weekend at home bras for me. Definitely chose the least expensive offer - they truly are exactly all the same.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: weekend like bra.
text: I purchased 3 different sets of this "type" of bra... I am a 38 DDD, wear 14/16 0x/1x.  I was looking for a comfy, weekend like bra... these are really soft... and ALL three sets were exactly the same bra - the only difference 2 or 3 dollars... so if you're going to try them definitely go for the cheapest set... they are literally exactly the same. Just make sure to get the 3 set and not the 2 to get the most bang for you buck. They do have removable pads.  I personally leave them in - wash on delicate, in a lingerie bag and the dry them flat in my dryer closet.  So I don't have an issue with the pads.  They are a pain to take out and put back - but while in they cover "nips" for modesty. There are obviously no underwires so there is little to no support... but I wear battle bras with severe underwires all week.. sometimes you just need a break.. however... I was hoping a little more.  The bottom does roll up as you're wearing them.. BUT the wide straps are super comfortable. These are are in NO WAY "sports" bra - but possibly a yoga bra -  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: modal spaghetti strap nightgown
text:

title: batwing filmy top

title: new vanity fair front close bra
text:
UPDATE BELOW 6/26/2018....
If you HAVE been using the Vanity Fair front closing - 75339, BUT you have been WISHING for more coverage - THIS version is slightly better. I've been wearing the other version for many, many years. I keep asking for and WISHING for a 38DDD - but to no avail so I buy the 38DD. Why? Because I find it comfortable and NOT over padded. I like a thin lining for comfort, but don't desire additional "size" with the filling. This version gives you ALMOST 1 more inch in the cup at the small size... at least on the 38DD. If you wore the 38DD in the "lighter" version, I would recommend buying the same size of this "fuller" version. I still really need a 38DDD, but I can definitely make this work. This version IS convertible to a racer back, just like the older version - although I rarely use that option, it's nice to have. Other improvements include - slightly wider - different material straps. FAR less "cutting" into the top of your shoulder - further - the back strap is slightly wider.. The front closure is still plastic - but I have yet to have one "fail." The down side of front closure bra is that as you wear it, as with ALL bras, the elastic "gives" and with the front closure, there are no adjustments. Still I get a fair amount of wear out each one - more than a year. For the price, I think this good. Camel Camel these so that you can grab them when they are an even better price - which has always beat what they are offered to me locally. There is a thin fiber fill - but it doesn't add bulk - just modesty. And the cup is smooth - there is some strategically placed lace that doesn't create lumps and bumps on the bra - a pretty touch. The other think I notice is that this newer version "feels" more supportive. I think there is a visible lift - meaning more support. The straps are adjustable, and as I said above, much more comfortable that the older, smaller version. Bras are SUPER personal and every one of us is different, but I was hoping to share enough details and comparisons to be helpful. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seems useful. Honestly, I think this bra is worthy of shot if you liked the older version but were wishing for a bit more cup.
UPDATE 6/26/2018..... I just wanted to say that I ordered the 40DD. As I have mentioned above, I'd prefer a 38DDD or even an E... but that isn't offered in this style... so I decided to "try" the 40DD. I had feared it would be too big around, but it is actually fine... SLIGHTLY larger, but not significantly around... the "UP" part is that you get at LEAST 1/2" more in cup coverage. To me, that's worth while. Every woman is built uniquely and bras are SO hard, especially mail order. If you prefer a front loader... are full size.. and prefer an underwire for support, these are worth a try. I recommend possibly trying one size around "up" if you'd like a bit more cup.
I have had no issues with poor performance in wear or otherwise, however, I DO wash in a lingerie bags, on delicate and hang them to dry in my dryer "closet." Hope this helps you in some way!

title: Knit mink
text:
Sadly, this jacket was ruined by the terribly sewn inner lining, especially around the tag. It's so awful It would be hard to sell at an super cut outlet. Further the seller appears to have known this when they sent it out stating that it didn't seem to effect the wear. Seriously? Not for this price. I have included pics for you to see. I did return the jacket immediately. I do feel compelled however to share my thoughts about the jacket
1. The fur appears to be mink. It is not very soft.. but that is because the mink has not been sheared, so the stiffer, longer hairs are still present. I own several very high quality minks and I usually choose the sheared pelts as they are so much softer. The color is good. Fairly deep and rich looking. The pic I included was with full sun on it to show the pelts and the knit better.
2. This jacket is "knitted" using remnants of mink pelts. The "knitting" means there is a slight "give" or stretch to the jacket. The sizing to me appears to be spot on. I did go one size larger in order to accommodate sweaters underneath. I had considered traveling with this jacket.
3. The inner lining is a very, very cheap crepe. After consulting with my furrier*, the quality of the crepe was so inferior in order to "repair" the lining sewing it would necessary to completely remove the lining and start over. Far more cost than the value of the jacket. He also advised me that the low quality of the lining material is such that it will tear and not bear up to regular wear. *Furrier is my storage, care and alteration specialist - NOT a fur salesmen.
4. The sleeves are extraordinarily long. I actually liked this, however, you should know you cannot fold the sleeve over as to the lining and sewing construction of the jacket. So the sleeves fell almost down to my finger tips. You can kind of see this on the model wearing the jacket.
5. The "crush" collar does in fact create a floppy hood of sorts, but is sticks out in odd angles because of the "shoulder" humps that keep the collar down around your shoulders when it is not a hood.
6. The jacket has fur hooks for closures down the front and at the neck if you decide to pull the hood up and use as a hood.
7. It claims to be, and SORT of is, a semi swing coat... meaning wider at the bottom than at the chest... sort of A shaped... HOWEVER.. the hem is so horribly sewn that it is terribly uneven all around. In fact, the hem looks as though it is longer at both hips and then shorter in the front and back. One side being longer than other. Further, it was quite long. Falling well below my knees and I'm 5'7".
Over all, it was just horrible construction. Dealing with this seller has been challenging as well. I will not be a return customer. Amazon had to step in to help facilitate the return. Shouldn't have been necessary as it was a straight up, immediate return.
Because I personally use verified purchase reviews when I purchase items, I do my very best to provide an honest, verified purchase review and include pictures when I can. I respond to all questions/comments. I never hesitate to update a review if new info should seem useful. As I returned the item, there will likely not be any additional information.

title: Leather jewelry box
text:
UPDATED REVIEW BELOW
The jewelry box = about 4 stars
The musty, moldy STINK that permeates this entire box inside and out.... negative 5 stars... So 2 stars is very generous.
Honestly, I REALLY wanted to love this box. It has nice, handy drawers... they are softly lined and the dividers can be removed if you would like to use the drawers differently. It looks nice. The side flaps have nice pockets to hold longer necklaces in as you close the flaps. The mirror works if you are putting the box on top of a taller dresser... I was going to set it on my really big bathroom counter, so the mirror was really not useful for me. The top mirror flap is opened by lifting and then sort of held open with a thin ribbon. It does NOT lock - in case that matters you. There is a handle for lifting and moving the box if you desire - make sure the side flaps are snapped shut before moving. I noticed that having the side flaps open helped the top lid stay open.
Here is the bottom line... when I opened the box an OVERWHELMING musty, moldy odor nearly knocked me over. I don't consider myself to be overly sensitive to odors, however, this odor lingered in my living room for days. Now, this is supposed to be "leather." It does have a very, very faint smell of leather... but it is easily overtaken by the must and mold. :( I am attempting several strategies to remove the smell... but if you put anything in it, it is going to envelop that awful odor. First I opened it all up, removing drawers and dividers and let it set in the sun for an entire day. For the last 2 days I have been spraying it with a Febreeze like antibacterial spray 3 times a day. I don't really think I am making headway.
It is likely going to the closest donation center... OR... perhaps my husbands tool shop. Pretty fancy for nuts and bolts, but who cares if they stink? I always update my reviews if new info would be useful. In this case and at this time, I just cannot recommend it for purchase.
UPDATE: 11/13/2016.... Ultimately I was not able to remove the overwhelming odor emitted by the box. I felt it was so bad that I couldn't really take it to a donation center either. Husband said "No thanks" for use in his shop...so to the dumpster it went. I am disappointed. However, I will say that while I cannot recommend this box, the seller immediately contacted me following my review. They did refund my money in full, after first offering a replacement or $15.00 credit. The seller did also honestly communicate with me that the source all of the colors (3 to choose from) from the same manufacturer (so could be an issue with all of their stock) and the sellers were very fast with responses. While I still cannot recommend this particular product, I would say that the seller was very apologetic and actively sought a way to make me happy so the seller gets a higher rating that the product. I did also suggest that they check remaining stock, not sure if they plan to do or the ability to do so as the case may be stored and shipped from a location out of their immediate position. Sometimes is obviously wrong though. I will not likely update this review further as I no longer have this case.

text: Well... I clearly OVER estimating the sizing... haha... I am 5'8" and usually buy a 14/16.  For some reason I was under the impression this ran really small reading other reviews and looking at photos.. well... The blouse is so large it's a dress!  There is no tightness at the bottom...  It's very soft and so it's now become a nightie, which is fine too.  The tag is 95% rayon, 5% spandex.  The only wash directions say to wash with like colors.  I would recommend delicate cycle and line or flat dry due the content.  I always update with any issues.  In this case I would carefully research sizing!

title: very nice ruana
text: I buy ruanas for traveling... lightweight but warm and easy to carry or rollup.  I am 5'8" and usually buy a 14/16.  This ruana fits very loosely as ruanas generally do.  The back of the ruana falls below my rump in the back.  There is a fringe, as shown in the photo, which I generally avoid, but I liked the pattern so I tried it.  The fringe is about 3 1/2" inches long and each strand appears to be 2 strands twisted together.  The tag says 100%  acrylic and spot clean only.  I think it may be because of the fringe... although it is acrylic which technically you can wash... I always update if there are any issues.

title: nice travel ruana
text: I like ruanas for travel.... lightweight, but warm. Easy to carry or roll up and store. I am 5'8" and usually buy a 14/16.  This ruana is very soft... there is a fringe around the bottom...about 1 inch long.  When wearing it it hits me at about mid rump in the back, so it's a shorter ruana. I did have to clip quite a few threads - caused one star in rating.. It is a dark charcoal, a nice color for jeans or slacks. The fabric content tag says: 100% acrylic...so it's not as warm as wool, but not scratchy either.  care says: hand wash, lay flat to dry, low iron if desired.  I always update with any issues.

title: Love
text:
I am 5'8".. 38DDD and usually buy a 14/16, 0x or 1x. I have purchased this brand before and know that a 2x works best for me. This blouse was no exception in sizing. I read the the other reviews and I've included a picture. I took the pic with natural daylight coming from behind me. I have a "nude" bra on. Honestly, it is a little see through, but I don't feel inclined to have a wear a cami underneath. I think it is a personal choice. The blouse is well designed to be flattering on a lot of different body types. A few words on the design... the strip under the breast portion is very snug... but it is positioned in such a way that it is too empirish. The bottom of the flutter panel in the front of the blouse is actually sewn down, so that reduces the look of a maternity top. I also like that the v front is not too low. You can actually manipulate the v a little to make it even less revealing... or more... your choice. The sleeves are nice and loose and hit me at the elbow, as shown on the model. The material is very soft. Fabric content: 95% rayon 5% spandex... wash instructions say: hand wash cold, with like colors. Do not bleach. Lay flat to dry, low iron when needed. I wash in my machine on delicate/handwash and I have a dryer "closet" that I actually hang it to dry with a "shake" cycle... so I don't need to iron. I also bough this blouse in black. I am really glad I did. Both could be dressed "up" or worn with jeans. I think they will both be good, versatile pieces. I always update with any issues that might be helpful.
UPDATE: I LOVE these blouses. Very, very well designed for the larger woman. They washed up perfectly and I've worn the black one on a plane trip I recently took. Heavenly comfort and yet.. with style. Love love love.

title: just right for me
text: I am 5'8" and usually buy a 14/16 ... This brand runs a bit large, however, I have big thighs so I ordered the "large"....  fits me perfectly.  The drawstring is "working" and there are pockets. The navy is a sort of lighter navy.  The material is soft and very comfortable, machine wash/tumble dry.

title: bifocal sunglasses
text: I missed the part that said these were "bifocals" and not full lens correction.  So I am disappointed.  I will keep them, but probably pass them to my husband.  I use the full lens for when I am not wearing my contacts, so it matters to me.  The glasses themselves seem pretty good quality... there are rubber tips on the area that rests over the ears for comfort... I have an average size head and they fit nicely, not loose, but they would "stretch" to fit a larger size head... but they are not hinged.  The actual bifocal area is quite small. You need to be looking way down.The lens are a medium gray/black and have a sticker that says UV400 on them.  Also note that the word "Aloha" is on the top left lens in script - in case that matters to you. They come with a large, black hard case with an orange zipper and a cleaning cloth... a nice plus.  I always update with any issues or other useful info.

title: will work
text: I normally buy a 38DDD but that was not available so I ordered this one at 40D... it is bigger around, obviously but can work at the tightest hook point.  The cups are large enough... there is rubber stripping on the top of the cups to help keep the cups in place as they are not foam cupped, instead there are double material layers to form the cup.  There is a pretty strong wire on the under cup. It will work for a strapless bra but it is not as comfortable as I would like and I would have preferred the cups be slightly foam filled so the cups would hold there shape better. The "nude" is a lighter nude if that matters to you, about the same as most of my "nude" bras.  I always update if there are any issues or other useful info.

title: nice blue
text: I accidently ordered 2 sizes bigger than I'd planned, but it actually is ok... the shorts themselves are wide legged... the top is high waisted which is good for a flattering, no muffin top look.  The tie is functioning too.  I wish I could have purchased in black, this blue is a bit deeper than the photo shows in my opinion, however I found a couple of swimtops with blue and black in them I think will work. Machine washed and tumble dried nicely.  I do recommend using a lingerie bag so the tie doesn't get tangled with other items or inside your machine if you have an older top loader.  I always update with any issues or other useful info.

title: love
text: I love this top.. although I have to say that I needed the 18... The cups are not quite big enough for me.  However, it is a very flattering cut and style for a lot of different body styles.  It's fairly loose on the bottom portion of the top and I think it's a bit longer than shown in the photo.  The straps are adjustable.  Could be worn with some capri pants I think.  Not too low in the front, although there is a little cleavage visible if that matters to you.  If you're not as full chested, probably won't be much.  Machine wash and tumbled dry beautifully.  I always update with issues or other helpful info.

title: just as shown
text: These are my husband's favorite cotton blend short.  He wears them all the time.  From my perspective, they wash and wear well.  Machine wash, tumble dry - color fast. They hit him just about exactly as they do on the photo model, just about at the knee.  They are what I would say are a medium weight... not terribly light or heavy.  I always update with any issues.

title: cooool
text: I purchased this as a gift for my son in law, but in eyeballing it, it appears to be a pretty average size large in men's apparel.  The print is nice and the tshirt felt soft to me.  I always update with any issues and I will with this too.

title: good length

title: good price for the set
text: These are a little bit of a hassle to use initially as you are fighting to quickly slide your card inside of them... but once you've used them a few times, it's way easier.  My husband over stuffed his passport sleeve and it tore.  So I highly recommend not to force too much in them.
