I always update if there are any issues.

title: Have paid more for much less
text: I purchased 2 of these to wear together on my thumb.  I have to admit that I wasn't expecting much... but honestly these bands are pretty awesome. And strong.  The rhodium plating really makes them look like white gold or possibly even platinum - which I think rhodium is part of (?).  I pinched them between my fingers with a pretty good amount of pressure and they didn't budge. So they seem pretty solid and strong.  It appears they will be able to take the "pressure" that thumb rings get!  Even though these rings have "texture" it is smooth and did not snag or catch when I tested them.  They arrived quickly and in good condition.  I will be updating if there are any issues in wear or other to report.  In my opinion, well worth the $7 (ring + shipping - more than ring cost itself).

title: Bummer
text:
UPDATE: 6/20/2016.... Sadly, a stone popped out. Had hoped this would last at least 6 mos. :( It was very comfortable to wear... BUT it did snag things on the settings... and of course, with the stone gone, it's a cheap looking piece of junk jewelry - no longer "believable" in way shape or form. Eh. I HATE to update reviews when it's no good. I do NOT recommend this piece any longer. Sorry....
On first blush, this ring seems very worth the less than 10 bucks (ring + shipping - actually more than the ring cost). It is comfortable to wear so far. I was nervous that the double band effect would be uncomfortable between fingers, however, I quickly got used to the ring and don't notice it at all now. The back of the ring narrows just the right amount to make bending and clutching your hand easy, comfortable. Also, the bands themselves seems strong... able to take a bit of pressure without bending - although I don't recommend a stress test to try the theory. Just pinching them between my fingers with some pretty good strength didn't do anything to the bands. The stones are surprisingly sparkly considering how tiny they are. I have to say, however, it is a bit rough over the stone area due to the stone setting, so I would use caution wearing it with fine silks, sweaters and other snaggy material. The plating seems bright and I think it looks like a lot more than the price paid in my opinion. Definitely "believable" as white gold and real diamonds - however, it is plated silver and CZ's just to be clear.
I will be updating should there be any wear or other issues to report. It arrived quickly and in good condition.

title: small head
text: I was very surprised to get this brush and how small the head is ... about 1 1/2 inches... the handle makes it easy to use.  I have used the brush side and worked well.

title: work perfectly
text: Holland America Cruise tags works perfectly with these.  Shared with family members also taking the cruise.  They will be able to be reused and definitely better than stapling paper to your bag that could be easily torn off.  I recommend these if you cruise!  If there are any issues to report I will update.

title: love love love
text:
This purse is nearly an exact replica of my favorite I've had for about 15 years. As my old one has aged I keep saying, I just need a couple more inches all the way around and this bag would be perfect. (Ha - that's what she said - I know)... My old bag looked like a huge balloon ready to pop after I have everything I need in it - I've reduced as much as I can.... It says that it is genuine leather and removable tags on the bag also say this. The texture is very smooth... To be honest, it doesn't really feel like real leather... but who knows? The texture is so perfect, not usually the case with leather - there is always a flaw somewhere... on the flip side, perhaps this is just a really fine quality. I am hoping that it is real and will become as supple as my old bag with some wear and use. The stitching seems really good. I also hated the skinny strap of my old bag... the new bag has a lovely strap that is about an 1" in width... for me, just right - and so much more comfortable.... but everyone has a personal preference. I like that I can shoulder it or crossover, which I do when I need my hands free - doesn't bother my back as much as just shouldering it. There is plenty of adjustment on the strap for the hang length as well... I am about 5'8" and there was spare length at about low belly/high hip. When you open the flap there are a couple of magnetic envelope pouches, the largest fits my new LG G4 perfectly, three slots and a zippered area. In the main body of the bag there are two zippered organizers and a couple of side slots, that would hold a very small cell phone, keys fobs or other things you want to reach quick - too short for reading glasses, though... The bag itself isn't terribly heavy which is good. When I "load" it with everything I need it's still reasonably weighted... 3-5 lbs (?) It came with a storage/dust bag, a nice touch, although it will probably not spend much time in it. It arrived quickly (I have prime) along with some other things I had ordered. I will be updating with any wear or other issues as necessary. I will try to include some pics if they get past the censors and they include my old bag for reference as well as a 12" ruler for comparison.
8/27/2015... I have been using this bag exclusively for a few weeks. It's STILL my fav. I should also add that if you wanted to you could slide in a kindle or an IPAD if you wanted to. I have the larger Kindle and when I am going somewhere I know I will be waiting, I slide it in. I am seriously considering buying a second one to have a backup when this one gives out, hopefully years from now. :) Could go with a different color... but honestly I usually buy the black as it goes with everything, all year. But that's just me. I did get a like smudge of something grayish/white. I used a little leather cleaner and wiped it off, a very slight amount of black come off too, but didn't leave any noticeable trace. So I am ok with that. It has NOT left any color on my clothing. And I have been in damp area with rain/mist and/or sweaty humidity - so... I think that is good. I will continue to update with any issues or other thoughts.

title: hope they are as good as the old ones!
text: I have several old eagle creek travel shoe bags (5+ ? years old) and I was so excited to get some additional bags!  As is often the case with "new" versions, there have been some changes... sadly the new ones (these) seem to be thinner, less durable material, feels less rubbery to me than the older version.... and the handles are thinner, more narrow, less heavy duty braid as well.  We'll see. I love this style and will use them. Initially I thought they were a tad smaller, but when I flattened them out and compared with an old style, they may be slightly smaller, but not really enough to notice.  There is enough room for one pair of larger style shoes (big heels/wedges) or three or four pairs of flipflops or maybe two pairs of flats with shoe tops...depending on the size of your shoe (mine are generally 8 to 9) There is a zipper, which, again, seems less durable but I remain hopeful. I like that my shoe bottoms don't touch my clothes as I am traveling. And with the zipper, the shoes stay in the bag as opposed to drawstring style.  If color is important to you, they are a darkish gray, zipper and handle is black.  They arrived quickly (I have prime) and in great condition with some other items I ordered. I will update if there are any wear or other issues to report.

title: Pretty thin for a robe
text: First things first.... I am about 5'8".. usually wear a 14/16, 38DDD and my body shape is a curvy hour glass.  This robe is a beautiful, rich, deep navy and very, very thin. The tie is sewn on.  There are pockets on both sides.  There is an inside tie as well to help keep the robe closed.  However, I will say that it is very, very low cut even when tied, in case that matters to you.  The material is very soft... however, SUPER thin... glad I didn't go with one of the lighter colors. You kind of want a robe to be a bit more coverage - or at least I do. I bought it to take when I travel because it's lightweight (and it is) and easy to wash, which it appears to be.  I gentle washed it and very low temp dried it.  I would say that it is a bit smaller than I would like particularly on the top, but that is usually a problem I have and don't necessarily hold that against the robe.  Wish there was a bit more material on top and that it stayed closed a bit better.  Probably would not buy again.

title: I am hopeful
text:
I have plantar fasciitis. These have a slight heel which is better for those of who suffer from this condition than a purely flat flip flop. I wear an 8 1/2-9 in regular shoes... Usually an 8 in crocs. I also have two different sizes of feet due to polio - almost 2 sizes. What I am going to say is that it may be a good idea to size up on this style. with the rubber top and the toe separator it does "pull" a bit at the toe and the top of the foot. The foot bed is wide... but I am ok with that. I don't like my foot to slop over or my toes to curl over the top of the end of the shoe. The strap is adjustable and that helps with the tightness over the top of the foot... but with the nature of the rubber type material, it still tends to "grab" your skin on the top of your foot. I like the look of the shoe. I like the slight heel. I am not so fond of the pulling between the toes. I am going to see if I get used to it. The size 8's I ordered came from a different seller of the size 9's or location and came in a USPS envelope. If there are any wear issues or defects, I will update.
8/27/2015... Ok... after trying for several weeks to wear these, I am donating them. The toe center just pulls too much and is uncomfortable between my toes. I am not reducing my stars... because I think it is a personal choice... some may find it just fine. Everyone's toes are different.

title: will work
text: I bought this for my Mom to wear with an evening gown on a cruise.  She is sensitive to "tight" things around her head, like headbands, etc... so I thought this might be a good alternative. It's is not stretchy, so therefore not tight and adjustable at the back in regards to drop and fit.  It is a silver color metal...made in china. As others have noted, you probably don't want to sweat too much wearing it as it may turn your skin green or other color?  It is an unknown base metal.  The rhinestones are a slightly sparkly, but not like a quality cz would be..  I think appropriate for the price point.  This is NOT a high dollar item, nor does it look like one at close inspection, however, I believe it will work for the one time wear planned. The photo represents the style and what I received well. It arrived in a bubble pouch via usps in good time and in good condition. I will update with any issues.

title: Awesome coral/pink.  Love
text: Ooo.. these are beautiful... black base with a coral/pink pink/design.  I love them.  I do recommend ordering a full size larger than you ordinarily do with all Ipanemas.  In fact, I think they recommend it on their sale pages.  In any case, I usually wear an 8 1/2 -  9.  The 10 in the Ipanemas is perfect.  As flip flops go, these last several seasons.  And I usually wear them exclusively through the season, granted I own several different color options.  If you haven't tried a pair, I say roll the dice and try just one pair.  Everyone is different, but honestly these are the most comfy/stylish flips I own.  Dress up or down.  You choose.

title: Ipanema fan
text: I own many Ipanema flip flops and I was looking for a black/silver print to replace one they don't make any more.... These are ok... they are black and silver... however, the base (the foot bed) of the flip is a bit slippery with a slight texture.  Not the grabby "cush" style of my other pair. Different material I guess...  I have to look more carefully at the pics to be sure I am buying the type I like.  These will be ok.. but not the "go-to's" of my other pairs.  The other thing to know is that you must go up one full size when ordering Ipanemas.  I normally wear an 8/12 -9.  The 10 in the Ipanema fits me perfectly - I don't like my heel to hang over the edge on my flip flops, nor do I like a lot of space behind when when wearing a size too large.  And the 10 is perfect match.  I wear my Ipanema's almost exclusively during the season and they have lasted 3 or so seasons.  I think that is impressive for a flip-flop. I will of course update if there are any issues.

title: so comfy, my favorite brand
text: I own a number of Ipanema flip flop and have been trying to find a black/silver replacement for a print they no longer make... This one is close.  Not as bright silver on the straps, but it's pretty.  The top of the flips is sort of a dark chocolate bronzy color on top of a black bottom... I was expecting something more totally black.. but they aren't bad.  The bases are similar in "cushion" and I like that.  I will say that you definitely want to buy a full size up from what you normally buy.  I usually wear an 8 1/2 -9... the 10 in the Ipanema is the perfect length.  I don't like my heel right on the edge of of the flip flop, but I don't like a huge space at the back of my foot either.  I believe they even suggest you size up on their pages.  I wish my previous print was still available, but these will be ok for now.

title: you'll wear them ALL day
text: I own so many pairs of these slipon Skechers.  I love them all. For the review I would say that they fit to size... not too small or too large.  I will say that they do tend to stretch a bit after you've worn them for months.. I find this only makes them easier to put on.  I have an average width foot and find this very comfortable across the top - not too tight, not too loose.  However, everyone's foot is different, so I would honestly suggest you try on a pair to find just the right fit.  It was easy when there was only one "type"... now they have so many different styles and I find they each fit differently.  This particular style features "memory foam" soles and they are particularly comfortable because of that.  They feel like you're wearing a really high quality slipper around.  Very lightweight.  Very soft.  I am waiting for them to come out with a really lovely coral color!  I do like that these black shoes do not have the light gray stitching as accent.. they are all black, including the soles.  Now the inside is a really vibrant neon red/pink.  But you don't notice that when your foot is in.  Hope this helps in some way.

title: good quality.
text: Bought these for my Mom when she purchased the same shoe in red at a local store.  She liked the shoe well enough (and that is NOT easy) that she wanted other colors and chose this silver.  Mom has an average foot, maybe even a bit to the more narrow in my opinion.  These are nicely adjustable and are comfortable enough for her to wear all day.  The quality is good and I believe she will have these long past the time she would want them.

title: eh
text: As reported by many others, this robe runs very small.  I normally order a 14/16, 1x.  I ordered the 3x which fits like a 1x... sort of. The under arms are really huge.  Also, it's like it was a "second".... there was a "tie" on one side of the robe (meant to secure to another tie on the inside, keeping the robe closed) BUT the inner tie was not there. I am going to keep it as I plan to use as a swim suit cover up but it is not a really awesome robe.

title: bright white
text: This style of Birkenstock is my fav.  But I have to admit I missed in the pic that it was patent "shiny" white and not leather tops.  :(  Was hoping for a matte leather.  I am not sending them back as white is difficult to get in this style.  But I will be much more careful in examining the look of each in the photos, ask questions if I am not sure.... I will update if there are any issues.

title: Perfect
text: I actually purchased these at my local Nordstrom's because I must buy 2 different sizes and they will split them at NO cost to me. Having said that, this was my first purchase of Gentle Souls and I have to say that I LOVE them.  I purchased this style in black and the silver/white as a dressier but no heel shoe.  They are perfect.  My feet are super hard to fit, not just because I have nearly 2 size difference between my feet... always a challenge and mostly I end up disappointed.  They are soft, cushy, but not too foamy and are soooo comfortable I can wear them ALL day.  Nothing rubs... nothing pokes out.. nothing snags....In a word... perfect. They are stylish without looking like old lady shoes and go with a casual dress or a pair of jeans or capris as easily.  Honestly, I am eager to begin exploring other styles they offer.  I am TOTALLY sold on this style and on this company.  I did NOT find that they ran "large" or wide or narrow.  I have an average foot and found them to be perfect in length and width - but everyone's feet are so unique.  I think that if you're looking for a pair of flats and really NEED them to comfortable, don't hesitate to at least try these.

title: Very nice
text: Ok... I am 5'8" usually wear a 14/16 and buy an 18 in swimwear.  On a hunch, I decided to go up one further size and I it was the right hunch.  The waist fits perfectly... not too loose, not to snug.  The waist band is wider than I have had on other swim shorts (about 1") and I find this very comfortable. Overall I believe they are well made and one of my favorites.  I will update my post if there are any wear issues as I use them.

title: perfect travel and fun

title: Perfect travel pant

title: nice match for special luggage

title: loose and comfortable legs

title: Mostly dry wear

title: gift for a friend

title: easy to use and work wonderfully

title: Purchased for best friend

She reports these are large and easy to see... making it easy pick out on the luggage conveyor.  Cool and functional.  Awesome.

title: gift for best friend
text: Purchased as a surprise gift for my best friend of 30 years... we are taking a trip to Maui this year and she loves red.  She reported that she was THRILLED with the color/print and that it arrived in very good condition, all pieces packed inside the next so initially she didn't realize there were so many pieces! title: Love these
text:
I ordered two. Shipping is a little slow, but they arrived in good condition. First, these bags are huge. I weighed them with my luggage hook and it said 9 pounds, just as advertised. Lots of neat features. The wheels are protected by little edges and reinforced corners, so they may last a bit longer when battered by the baggage handlers. There is a extender zip, but honestly they are so huge inside I can't imagine using it. As I was unpacking them I discovered there is a handle on the bottom where the wheels are! What a brilliant idea. This means you can grab this suitcase just about any way it lands. SUPER handy when you're chasing your bag around the carousel because it landed wheel side toward you. There was a bit of chemical smell when I opened them, but I just aired them out and it is greatly reduced. I might lightly mist them with some Febreeze. But only if the smell lingers. The zippers are very heavy duty and the main zips do have the lock loop. Inside there is a flat, top zip area and two adjustable straps on the bottom main compartment with a small side, mesh zip bag that is attached. Pretty standard confirguration inside. There is a limited warranty for manufacturer defect only and NO airline or consumer abuse and/or normal wear issues.
I did purchase the basic black because they were cheaper, but here's a tip: I use permanent sharpie pens (gold, silver and copper - sold on Amazon for about $5.99 a set of three) and a stencil (also on Amazon and themes to fit everyone out there... at about $7.00 a sheet) to personalize my suitcases so they are quick and easy to spot on the baggage carousel.. even at a distance. Because they are uniquely decorated, no one ever confuses my bag for theirs. Win/Win.
Tag inside one bag said "Designed in the USA, made in China" Thought about docking one star for that part....
I travel a lot and will update if there are any wear or other issues.
UPDATE 6/15/2014: The chemical smell is a bit more than I'd like... doing the Febreeze and I think a day out in the sun. Some might consider a "new car" type smell, however, I am sensitive to chemical smells in general.

I bought a super large one because I wanted it to be really baggy and it is. The jersey material is heavy and feels high quality. The logo print is centered and crisply done. I washed and dried it per instructions and it looks great. I expect to get years and years of smiles and wear out of it.
On shipping, it arrived as promised and in great condition.

title: Know before you buy
text:
BEFORE BUYING you should know:

1. They are in Thailand. If you have to return the item for any reason, it will cost YOU approximately $20. (Mine was $18.95 from Oregon) They (Koh Koh) will also ask you to declare the value of the return as $10.00 so they do not get charged tax for the item being returned. No where in the Amazon posting does it indicate these dresses are shipping from (and returned to) Thailand. It does says "FREE SHIPPING WORLDWIDE"... but that doesn't tell you anything really. I will say that it arrived relatively quickly. Too bad it was the dress was such a terrible mess. ** UPDATE** 9/25 After a long communication "battle" a full refund, including my shipping has been processed.

2. I actually really like the design of this dress. However, when the dress arrived (I ordered the red and white), the red part of the print had bled into the white and in some areas there were big red sploches on the white area of the graphic print. The bleed so bad that what should have been crisp, clean lines of the graphic design where "blurred" over the entire dress. I can't believe they actually shipped it to me in this condition. I would have liked to have ordered other colors (the navy/white and the black/white), but I will not risk they will be color bled or worse. What if it is a cleaning issue? Possibly a bad dye batch? Who knows? The dress I received should never have been sent out.

DRESS DESIGN INFO: I will say that I found the sizing to be acurate per their provided info. The material hangs well and SHOULD be machine wash/tumble or hang dry, although I am not able to atest to that as it was immediately returned. The dress material is very thin but not see thru. To be honest, since it was such a hot mess I did not really inspect the sewing quality. The dress (design and material hand) does not look like a million dollar dress, but it would work nicely for casual wear or casual evening wear in my opinion. I also believe the design of the dress is one that would be flattering on a wide range of women and it is nice they offer some larger sizes. The red is sort of a brick and the photo is fairly accurate as to the color, and the white was a little more ivory/pink, but that is probably due to the ink bleed of the red onto the white. I did not find the "V" neck too low for me, but it would be possible to wear a cami under for modesty.

I strive to provide honest and geniunely helpful reviews each time I do so. I hope it has been helpful to provide this info.

title: a perfect fit for me
text:
It's been a long time since I've had a front loader... but this one fits me perfectly. Keeps the girls up. Just the right about lining (light foam forms and smooths and helps to hide the "headlights"). I think one of the best things about this bra is that it is VERY comfortable! Honestly, I've got several of these. I'm picky and tough to fit. This bra really works.
UPDATE.... 6/2016.... I am STILL buying this bra. Honestly I wish they would make a 38DDD... but I make the 38DD work. One thing you should know is these are front loaders... so this means that you will not be able to adjust the body once it has been worn and "relaxes"... I can usually get about 18 months out of one... I use a lingerie bag to wash on the "hand wash" cycle in my machine.

title: my go-to bra
text:
I love love love this Torrid bra. I sure wish they would do a true "nude".... this one is actually PINK with a nude lace overlay... pretty, but predominately PINK, not nude. Dang it. Would have done 5 stars if it was really "nude"... all that said, this bra is fully lined and padded to give the girls the BEST lift. The great thing is that it LIFTS the girls and doesn't push them under you armpits. Hate that with a minimizers... (this bra is NOT a minimizer). It looks great under clothes and does a great job lifting. It's super comfortable for hours and hours. Additional bonus: the padding also protects the dreaded headlights. I find the sizing to be true. Just be prepared for the amazing, youthful look you're going to achieve with this bra!
Torrid, if you're listening.... a TRUE NUDE please!! The black is great, the white is true white. Lose the TOO pink back to the nude!! :-)

title: will work
text: This is my first and probably last purchase from this vendor, Carol Wright Gifts. There are a couple of things to note about this jumper. First, as other reviewers note, DO ORDER AT LEAST ONE SIZE UP.  Glad I did.  I am not a huge person, but my bust is. Secondly, the material is more of a "velour" terry, in case that matters to you. It is softer than full cotton terry, but thinner.  AND there is only ONE pocket, on the right hand side, so lefty's should know.  Why wouldn't they do two pockets?? Obviously to save money, but I probably would not have purchased it if that had been properly noted in the product description. In fact, pockets are not even mentioned in the outline. I "assumed" there were two pockets with the model putting her hand in one... I considered returning them, but honestly the return postage would be more than I paid for the jumper, so I will be not returning. Also, they are NOT kidding when they say it will take F O R E V E R  to get to you after purchase... I honestly didn't believe it would take that long. Believe it.  While it arrived as estimated, holy cow it was a LONG time. If you're in a hurry, look at some other vendor.  I will probably not consider things from this vendor again due to the low quality and slow shipping. I can only imagine the refund process.

title: multi purpose
text: I bought this for a quick-to-pull-on lounger in the morning while I enjoy coffee on the lanai...  The material is soft, silky and thin, as rayon is.  It does require a gentle hand wash and a line dry... The "sparkles" they reference is actually sparkle glue, not beads.  I handwashed and the sparkle glue remained intact. It would also work comfortably as a swimsuit coverup.  The tie that at the waist is alittle chinzy.. wish they would have used the same rayon material for the tie instead of a cheap cotton, but it works.. would have been 5 stars with a better tie. With the tie, the style lends it's self to many different body sizes without looking like a sack.  I am very happy with it and will consider possible other colors!

title: Awesome cool

These look soooooo cool on!! One word of advice, it is necessary to ORDER ONE FULL SIZE UP. They run very short. Other that, these are my most favorite flip flops (or as in my generation, we called these "thongs"). I also will say that even though these are a rubber/rubber like material they do not rub the area between my toes raw as the ones of my youth did. They are comfortable and very stylish. Love them! title: although, sizing is a struggle
text: For color, I would it give 5 stars...AWESOME with a tan. It is a darker coral than shown in the photos... more like a neon coral. But I like that. AND let's all support MADE IN THE USA!!! However, I continue to struggle, trying to figure out is Ujena sizing... I have ordered several different suits... Reading other reviews, I ordered 2 sizes bigger on top, to achieve that looser look shown on the model.. I am a 38DD and the 3x fits in the bust area nicely, however the bottom portion of the top is about 4 -5 inches too long, more like a form fitting swimdress, not a tankini.  The inner lining, meant to be a miminizer, is almost as loose as the outer top, so I wouldn't count on that to help hold you in.  I don't need it so I will probably remove it and possibly hem the top. Another note, if you're super modest, you should know the bust portion, while lined, is thin. "Nips" are visible. As for the bottom, I normally order a 1x however with Ujena I have learned the bottoms need about 1 size up...usually, however, these are so large I couldn't wear them in a pool without a "wardrobe malfunction." Plus, the little ties on the side are cute and are functional to scrunch the sides. They draw attention to your thighs. So if your confident in that area, go for it.  I am ordering a different style bottom as I am not really thrilled with my thighs.  :-)  Listen, no woman's body is exactly the same, and so, I will continue to shop Ujena because I can buy the larger top and smaller bottom.  One day, I will figure out the mystery of their sizing and I will share it!!

title: Order carefully
text: Ok... These are nice slippers with rubber bottoms which is good if you have to run outside for anything... the BIG downside is that they run REALLY small. I used to buy expensive jewelry in 14-18 kt when i could afford it.  Im not saying this will last for years...it might? I order lots of metals to make my own and plated and filled if it has a 9.25 base.  This product has nailed it for me.  I wish they made more findings to create your own. The color of the "Nubuck" shoes that I actually received is MUCH darker than the light colored shoes depicted in the online photos. What I received looks more like the "Brown Oily" color. Why not post photos that match the reality of shoe color options and save all of us some time and frustration.

That said I own a pair in black and they are indeed VERY comfortable.

Being lazy, I put previous ones in the dryer (not following the directions on the clothing), and they did shrink at least one dress size.

-can with 2 sets of laces for color match
-midsole soft but outsole not soft enough in heel region
-Nice looking, but not the best.
Let me add, I am 6’1 weigh 220 and had a left below knee amputation.
I purchased these not for running but for walking as I needed a soft shoe for my low back pain and left knee stump sensitivity.
I enclosed photos wearing Brooks gts adrenaline 21 gts on the left prosthesis, reebok royal nylon on the right foot, and an Athletic Work (very inexpensive shoe from Walmart) that I wear around the house.
The Brooks gts 21 are the most roomy and comfortable. The Reebok Royal Nylon are a bit shorter and much narrower than the others; so narrow that my forefoot began to hurt after wearing them.
I was also upset I had to pay an automatic $10 fee (which may increase depending on condition of product return) when this was not indicated during the initial purchase.

Bilateral cargo pockets w "firmer" material would be better. Will buy again !!
If you like comfortable shorts, w elastic waist and drawstring, zipper back and side pocket, and one cargo pocket on R side w velcro closure and no belt loops, these are for you- they are definitely for me !!!!
I love, love , them.
Only thing I would change is bilateral cargo pockets and bit firmer material.

title: Fantastic soft quick dry non-wrinkle cotton  material but pockets have no button or velcro closure
text:

Biggest downside is cargo pockets have no velcro or button closure and items easily fall out. Cargo pockets are also a bit too small to fit a 6.5” smartphone. The whole point of cargo pockets is to securely store larger items. If there is no closure and they fall out, this defeats the purpose.
PROS- have drawstring and elastic waist so stay up easier. Have cargo pockets. Nice soft quick dry light non-wrinkle cotton material. Very inexpensive.
CONS-come very small. I wear a 42 waist (2XL) and had to order a 5XL.

CONS-ar a 42, and ordered a 44, and they fit just right. Normally I like clothes on the looser side. Ad on amazon says cotton, but label indicates 95% something in chiwhich is good since should not shrink as much). Side pockets could be a bit deeper for phones.Zippers would be perfect.

CONS-all labels in chinese so cant read them. Sized a bit small so order 1-2 sizes up. I wear a 42, and ordered a 44, and they fit just right. Normally I like clothes on the looser side. Cargo pockets could be a bit deeper for phones, my Pixel 4XL JUST fits. Side pockets could be deeper also, and zippers would be perfect.
My only concern is how they will wear/shrink in wash. Will buy again if do not shrink / damage in laundry.
Will give update if possible.

They don’t do an amazing job at smoothing or tummy control but they also aren’t advertised to do that at all.

I typically go for black suits because I am self conscious of this but got the white floral top with the teal bottoms and am happy I went out on a limb to stray from the black, it looks just like the picture.

As for the top, I’m a 40D and it’s a bit snug. It fits fine but is a tiny bit tight through the armpits. I don’t think it’s a size issue though, that’s more to do with the fact that I’m carrying some extra quarantine weight right now. I can’t remark on durability or how well the color holds up with use yet since I just got it but if it seems to start fading really quickly or any other issues, I’ll update my review. Overall I’m pretty happy with it, it’s a step up from a boring old mom suit but I still feel pretty secure and covered up in it.

If you are right between sizes, or are tall, have long arms, bigger chest, etc... then I would consider sizing up if possible. But I think you might also be ok with getting your normal size, just depends on your build really.

title: Great sandals
text:
I didn't get to keep these due to them being too small but am still rating them based off of my experience with them. The sizing isn't an issue with the shoes, I'm really more of an 11.5 or even a 12 in some styles but wanted to try my luck with an 11 and they were just a bit too short.

Super comfortable though and I got them for a great price, wish I could keep them.

title: Nice for wide feet
text: I'm actually an 11-11.5 in shoes, sometimes even a 12 in some styles but this size 11 fits me well. The shoes are really comfortable and I got them for a good price, any higher though (I paid around $25) than I don't think they would have been as great of a deal since the heel is made out of some cheapish feeling foam. I have wide feet, I could see where the fit at the toe strap could be an issue for anyone that doesn't have wide feet as well. The sole is nice and squishy.

title: Love them
text:
I love the Oalka brand leggings. I have several pairs now of both the leggings and capri length and I've been impressed enough with the quality to buy about 6 pairs now.

I'm 5'10" and about a 16, I got these in XL and they fit very well. The fabric is nice and sturdy, really smooths you out while staying opaque. I'm pear shaped, so have a big butt and thighs but don't have problems with these sheering out and showing underwear underneath. I have purchased the black and also the space dye camo purple, space dye camo black and space dye charcoal. The solid colors do seem to be a thicker fabric than the prints but the prints are still great. The capri length come down to the same point on my leg as its pictured, so they don't run too short.

title: Great bag, bought it twice
text:
This bag is great, holds a ton of stuff and is sturdy. When you aren’t using it, it zips down into this compact size so it’s super easy to store. I bought one a couple of years ago and have used it multiple times. Was needing a second bag for a trip and came back to buy the exact same one.

Really handy for travel, overnight trips, the gym etc...

Only thing I would suggest is to have more colors, maybe a dark purple, dark green, etc...

title: Perfect after nearly a year
text:
I've now had this ring for almost a year. It has held up well, still shiny and has zero scratches. I wear it every single day and can be rough on my hands. It fits very comfortably. Was coming back to see if it was still available so I could order a smaller size due to losing weight so that should be a testament to how much I like it.

I had purchased a few different rings last year and this is the one I kept due to the nice, pure silver/white color it had. It wasn't yellowy or a darker gunmetal type color at all. Just a bright silver.

title: OK but needs some improvement.
text:
I ordered this in the navy blue, mostly because I really liked the contrast of the white buttons that it has in the photos. Well it came with matching buttons.

For the pros: It does fit well and pretty accurately. I'm 5'10 and a 16/18 in clothing right now, ordered this in an XL. It buttoned up fine and technically it does fit. The fabric is ok. It could stand to be a little thicker, but its not so thin that it will cause issues with sheerness. If needed, you can always just put on a light slip for the bottom.

Cons: I'm not sure how I'm going to make the bust area of this dress work. But it's really cute so I'm going to keep it and try. I'm a 38C and not very large at all. I have a broad chest but not particularly full. The point that I'm getting at is that I don't necessarily have a ton to cover, but there just needs to be a bit more fabric in the cups. Anyway that I tie it, I either get boob coming out the bottom near where it ties or out the top. I just wasn't expecting it to be quite so revealing. I'm going to work with it though and see if I can find a sticky bra that works or something like that. Also, if you aren't naturally pretty perky, its going to be a challenge to find a bra option that will get you sitting high enough for the chest to look flattering. There is no real support in the fabric. I think a big improvement would be to add some type of sewn in cups to the top, that would really help.

title: Fits large
text: I'm a 16/18 and usually am an XL in tops but tend to size up if its long sleeved due to having long arms. I did that with this top and its huge. Super wide and arms are almost too long. I could have gone down 1 or maybe even 2 sizes in this.

title: Great leggings
text:
I came across these as a lightning deal and decided to take a chance while on an ongoing search for good, OPAQUE, black leggings that aren't super thin. These are great. I got them in and could immediately feel a difference in quality between them and previous pairs I've purchased from other companies. The sizing is accurate, they hold their shape really well throughout the day and do a great job of feeling sturdy and secure. I've tried others before that are marketed as being "buttery soft" and whatever, and they are useless if you are someone that needs a pair to actually feel like something you would be comfortable walking outside of your house in. They don't stretch and sheer out across the butt and they aren't so thin that they show whatever you are wearing underneath. After wearing and washing once, I came back and bought another pair right away.

I would buy them again at full price. I'm 5'10" and the length on these is fine, not too short at all. A size 16/18 in pants and an XL fit. They are a bit tight (which is my fault) but they still fit. If they had a size up, I would buy them again in that size, but the current size does work well enough for me.

title: Just as expected
text:
*UPDATE* I've washed these twice and they have gone crappy. Pilled up like crazy, fabric isn't opaque at all. Like bad enough that you can't wear these in public. And this isn't a matter of being delusional about my size and trying to stuff my body into too small clothes. These are plus size leggings and the fabric is just bad and not thick enough. These are fine still to wear around the house or for layering under jeans since they fit close enough, but that's about it really. Knocking the rating down to 3 stars from 5.

--These are exactly what I was wanting. I'm 5'10" and a size 16/18 and they fit well. Have a big butt and thighs but they still fit well enough to be relatively high waisted on me, they are high enough to help smooth out a baby gut at least. They are long enough for me as well. The fabric is thick and feels comfortable to wear under a long top since it helps to smooth things out. If these wash well, I'm going to buy a few more pairs for sure. My one complaint is that I wish the fabric was just a bit thicker so it was a tiny bit more opaque. But they are fine right now. If they shrink or don't wash well, then I will update the review.

title: If they were a thicker fabric, I'd be happy.
text:
I'm 5'10" and a size 16/18, this review is from someone who doesn't have much experience wearing leggings as pants, so my standards of what I feel comfortable in are pretty high.

Pros: these did fit, they were long enough on me which I was surprised by. I'm not sure if there would be any shrinkage after washing because I am returning these. The fabric was pretty soft and relatively opaque. No hanging strings, holes, etc... good enough quality for the price.
Cons: the fabric is too thin for me to feel comfortable enough in to wear out in public personally. Now this is due to the fact that I've got a big butt and thighs, and these offer zero control or smoothing really. They don't advertise to be smoothing/slimming/control etc... so this isn't exactly a complaint against the product, it is just the reason that I am returning them. Even with a long top on that covers my backside, I still feel kind of exposed in these.
If I had a use for them, these would be great for layering on a cold day, they are smooth and thin enough to fit under jeans, or I would be fine with bumming around the house in them. But that isn't why I bought them.

title: Cute shoes, runs narrow though.
text: I love the color and got a great price in my size, but something about New Balance shoes always has them run super narrow on me. I can wear a size 11-11.5 normally in other shoes, I ordered this in a 12B (was cheaper than smaller size) and they are really tight. I think I can stretch them out though and I like the style and color enough to want to make them work. If you have relatively wide feet though, I would consider that when choosing your size.

title: Nice suit, accurate sizing
text: I will rank this 5 stars because the sizing was accurate and it looked just like the picture. I am returning it though, I just didn't like how it looked on my body. I ordered my clothing size in this and it was pretty spot on. I'm typically an XL top and 16 in pants. The bottoms especially fit great and came up high enough to contain that lower belly pooch and were comfortable. My one complaint would be that the bust runs a tiinnny bit small, in my opinion. It would have been fine if I kept it but just a bit tight. I'm a 38C/40D (depending on my current weight) and it fit and I was contained well, but I would be hesitant if your chest is larger than that.

title: Beautiful suit
text: I took a chance on ordering this suit because there were no reviews yet on the sizing and quality, but it ended up great. We all know how swimsuit sizing can go when ordering online, but this one was spot on. I'm 5'10" and right at a size 16 and the length was just fine. The color matched the picture as well. I am going to be returning it though, the style in the picture is pretty but it just isn't my style. Plus I ordered another one at the same time that makes me look smaller (if I'm being honest with myself) that I like just as well. If I swam more or wasn't working on trying to lose weight, then I would have kept this one too though.

title: Love these.
text:
Due to the great price I found in my size, I ended up buying three pairs of these shoes. I returned one, that was just due to me not liking the look of black patent on them though. I kept the pairs I ordered in blue and white though to go with spring and summer dresses and skirts that I have, trying to dress up my wardrobe a bit so I dont rely on flip flops all the time.

I rank these as running somewhat small, but not terribly so. I am about an 11.5 in shoes, kind of wide. I bought these in a 12 because they were available (which is not super common for this size) and I didn't want the issue of my toes possibly going over the front (not a cute look), and I'm glad I did because they fit perfectly for me. So I would say maybe go half a size up and order direct from Amazon or a seller that has free returns so you can easily send back if the sizing doesn't work out for you.

My one negative, and this is due to my weird toes more than anything, is that my second to last toe has a habit of poking out the side of one of the straps. But not a big deal .

I haven't worn these for an extended period of time, but then I typically don't wear dressy shoes for long. I just don't have many occasions that call for it. But for the short amounts of time that I have worn them, they've been pretty comfortable for me.

title: Nice flats
text: Not much to say about these, they are nude flats. The sizing is very accurate and I got them for a great price. If I wore flats more often, then I wouldn't hesitate to come back and get these in other colors. My one negative is that in the picture, the nude shade has a bit of a pinky tone to it. But in real life, it leans more warm, has more of a yellowish tone. Not a big deal, its just one of those issues that comes up with buying a nude shade like this and the differences in computer screens. They still work for what I need them for.

title: Works, but some concerns about sizing
text:
For reference, I am 5'10" and currently a size 16, a 38C cup. I bought this in a 2x and it just barely fits me. Well I should clarify, it does not fit me like it should, but I can make it work for what I need it for.

If you are above average height or have a long torso, I would be wary of this, its runs kind of short. I have to yank it up to get it to come high enough for me to cover my bust, and even then it still isn't quite high enough to look great at the top. I bought it for a wedding dress though that has a pretty structured top with cups built in, so it wasn't going to be an issue for me. But for others, it definitely would. I agree with others that say the cups run small also. I spill out the sides of it.

Now for the positive, this really sucks you in. Without it, I have a small amount of extra fabric along the waistline of the dress. With it, it almost works too well for me, I would say I have about 3-4 inches of loose fabric now. Like it borders on making me wish I had the extra time to see if I could get the dress taken in a bit, it works that well. With the way that this bodysuit is designed, it really helps to pull me in right at my natural waistline and does a nice job of smoothing in other places. I just wish I could get it in a size up to possibly rectify the length issue.

title: Great ring, especially for the price
text: This ring is beautiful. Great amount of sparkle without seeming like its too much. The texture of it isn't super rough, doesn't snag on fabric. I ordered 4 different titanium and tungsten carbide bands and this is the one I chose to keep.

title: It's OK for the price.
text:
I'm 5'10" and wear a size 16, 38C cup. I ordered this in a size 2X just to make sure that it wouldn't be too small, thinking that I might have to return it for an XL since that is my usual size, but I'm glad I went with the bigger since it just barely fits. It will work for what I need it for and I am in the process of losing weight, so I will keep it.

The only downside for me (other than it being a bit too tight) is that it is short. I think that is pretty obvious in the picture though, but since I am tall, it is REALLY short on me, it comes to about mid thigh, and it has slits in the side that go up to right below the butt almost. I actually think the deep slits though will work out in my benefit. Since it is kind of tight, I can imagine that this will wiggle and migrate up on my legs and cause me to have to pull it back down and arrange it. But since the slits allow some freedom with leg movement, I think it will actually help with that.

Overall I am pleased with it. I don't have any prior experience with wearing slips under dresses but I figured it was time for me to mature up my wardrobe a bit and for the price that I paid, which was around $9, I will use it.

title: Nice dress for the price
text:
This dress was on sale as a lightning deal for about $18 and now I am regretting not buying it in green also. I ordered it in XL and it fits well. I am 5'10'', 38C cup and 36in waist and the fit of this was pretty accurate.

The length is nice on it, it comes down to about an inch above my knee and the fabric has a nice weight to it, that causes it to drape and swing well. It is a tiny bit shiny, but I'm not too concerned, I don't think it makes it look cheap or anything.

The only thing that I would change about this dress is the v neck on it, it is really quite deep. But that is apparent in the photos so it wasn't a surprise. I tend to wear camisoles under dresses anyway, so unless you want to have a lot on display, layering it or just pinning it works well.

I think the usual price of this is pretty good too, it seems to be between $20-26. If I had a shortage of dresses or was wanting to build my wardrobe, then I would be fine paying full price for it. That isn't the case for me though. If it were to drop again, I would definitely pick it up in the green and black color for sure.

title: Better than I was expecting
text:
I was fully expecting to have to return this due to it being too small, but I love the style of these button up shirt dresses, and with it being Prime, I figured I would take the chance on it.

I am 5'10" and a 38C, my waist is about 36 inches. I ordered this in an XL and thought that it would probably be too short on me and too small in the waist and across the chest, but the cut and elasticized waist in this dress is surprisingly forgiving. It fits just right on me. The chest and arms fit well, there is no pulling or gapping in the buttons and there isn't any exposure of bra straps or the side of a bra in the arm hole area. The length is nice on me as well, it came down to about an inch above my knees.

The only cons about this is the fabric, it is pretty thin and a tiny bit on the sheer side. But as long as you aren't wearing contrasting underclothes it shouldn't be an issue, or stick a slip under it and it will be just fine. The print is a bit iffy, but it was not misrepresented by the picture, it does look just like the close up photo that shows the details, so that was my overlook by not checking the other pictures available. The belt that comes with it is your usual run of the mill, cheapy belt. But if you don't have many belts and want to visually pull in your waist, then it is a nice addition.

Overall I think the price could come down a few bucks. It was $20 when I purchased it and I'm OK with paying that since I am really happy with the fit of it. I don't think I would buy more though unless I catch one of the other colors on sale. If it was around $10-$15, I would pick up another color or two.

UPDATE: 6/7/17 Part of me wants to knock a star off after I washed it, but I feel like that may be a mess up on my end. Especially for letting someone else do the laundry when there was a new item in it, not sure if it got washed on cold or warm. But it shrank. I technically can still wear it, it fits. But it really is too short for me to comfortably wear it out. It went from about an inch above my knee to like 3 inches, so it is a significant difference. Especially on me since I'm so tall. On someone more of an average height, this might not be a problem. Part of me wants to re-purchase in another color and make sure to handwash it or something since I do like the dress. But I don't want to drop more money on it if there is a chance of it shrinking again. Too bad I can't size up to account for shrinkage. So it's still a nice dress, but keep the shrinkage in mind and make absolutely sure to follow the care instructions.

title: Love it, want to buy more
text: Just got this in today and I'm impressed. I'm always hesitant to order stuff this like online because of sizing issues but this was spot on. I ordered an XL and am a size 16 right now and the fit was great. Not too clingy through the stomach and the top fit well. I'm 5'10" and it came about 2 inches or above my knees. Nice weight to the fabric, doesn't feel overly cheap. Now I'm wanting to buy a bunch of others in lighter colors, which I am typically very cautious about since I'm self concious of how clothes look across my mid section, but this isn't too tight at all.

title: Runs very small
text: I purchased these for my 9 yr old. She is about a size 3-4 in kids still, but can wear a size 5 in womens in flip flops. So I bought her a size 5, thinking she could wear these next summer also and they are really small. She can't wear them at all now.

title: Nice, sizing iffy though
text: If you are a between sizes, I would personally size up on these. Im a size 11-11.5, depending on the shoe and have a relatively wide foot. I don't require wide width shoes, but they are nice to have sometimes. I have another pair of crocs sandals in a size 11 and they fit great so I figured these would be the same. They just ended up way too small for me. I'd say a half size-whole size too short and the foot bed was too narrow. Having your feet overhang your sandals is never a cute look, so I gave them to someone who wears a size 10. The quality of them was nice and I got them for pretty cheap when Amazon had a sale on Crocs. They were cheap enough that I wasn't worried about returning them.

title: This is nice, if the price is right.
text:
I was looking for nightgowns that had a defined cup area/something to keep a chest in check and I decided to give this a try since it looked decently supportive. I lucked out by finding a color variation in my size that was much less than the rest. I paid $11 and change for it and honestly? the gown is just fine, but I wouldn't pay more than that for it.

The Pros: the chest section is made out of this stretchy, relatively soft lace. Im actually a size 16-18 right now and usually get an XL in nightgowns, I took a chance on a Large in this though since it was pretty cheap and the sizing worked out great for me. Im a 38C cup, and the fabric does a good job of keeping things front and center. If you have boobs, you know what I mean by that. This was the main thing I was looking for in a nightgown, so for that alone, I will rate this 5 stars. If you are wanting something with coverage though, this isn't for you. It's very sheer.

The Cons: This just looks cheap. I got it in pink and the material is very shiny. I saw that the other colors are ranging from $35 to about $48 and I can't believe that anyone would pay that much for this nightgown. No way. The material in the body of the gown is also pretty sheer as well, but you can see that from the picture. It is kind of a weird combination, between the see through lace on the chest and sheer, shiny fabric and the length of it, its like it can't decide what style it wants to be. Its a demure length with sexy elements to it. I'm 5'10" and it comes to the bottom of my kneecaps, so it's pretty long. It just seems like it should be shortened a bit or something. There is just an odd feeling about the style. But overrall I am happy with it. If the other colors were as low as the first one I bought, I would pick up a couple more. But not unless the price dropped significantly.

title: This suit is awful.
text:
Whoever is manufacturing and calling this a "swim suit" should be ashamed of themselves. It's bad. All of the reviews that mention that this is not made of your typical swimsuit material are dead on. This is made out of some thin, super cheap feeling polyester type fabric. It has none of the typical stretch or snap back that a swimsuit has. I have no doubt that if I were to get this wet, it would get real droopy. The reviews that say that it is made out of swimsuit material either must be getting product from a different seller or have no clue what swimwear is normally made out of. Mine came from the seller Prograce, I don't know if there are other suppliers or not.

I saw the negative remarks but still ordered, hoping that I would luck out, but this is going to have to be returned.

The top is cute. But not wearable. I think the only way that I could make the top work would be to insert some bra cups into it (it has zero support built in and it's not stiff or stretchy enough to do much either) and I would probably also have to use tape as well because it is open enough in the middle that if your boobs shift at all, you are going to have some serious exposure problems. Without any alterations to it, there is no way that I personally could wear this.

The bottoms are bad. The strap attached to it is much thinner than what is pictured. You have to arrange it to get it to lay flat and then don't move. Once you start moving, it will shift around and roll up. And it isn't too small for me either. The strap and material are just too thin to lay right.

Really the only positive I can say about this is that the color was good. It closely matched the picture.

For reference, I ordered the 2x in army green. I'm 5'10 and wear a size 16 and am a 38C. The top was a tiny bit big, I could have sized down on that but have a big butt and hips, so the bottoms were a good fit.

title: Great dress
text: This dress fit as expected. I am 5'10" and it came right to my knees. I returned it just because I found something else I liked more and had no reason to keep this as well. If I had an occasion to keep a white lace dress to use in the future, I would have had no problem with doing that.

title: ... and got this in an XL and it fits great. It comes a few inches above my knees ...
text: I'm 5'10" and wear a 16/18 right now and got this in an XL and it fits great. It comes a few inches above my knees but since it's a nightgown, I don't think its too short. I haven't washed it yet so hopefully it doesn't shrink too badly.

title: this is surprisingly nice. I'm 5'10" and wear a 16/18 right now ...
text: For as cheap as it was, this is surprisingly nice. I'm 5'10" and wear a 16/18 right now and got this in an XL and it fits great.

title: I physically could get it on but it didn't look good at all
text: I would say that this fits as expected, maybe runs a bit small but not by much. It was wishful thinking that I could fit my body and D cups into this anyway. I physically could get it on but it didn't look good at all. I'm 5'10 and a 16/18 right now and it was just too tight, I got it in an XL. If you are not in that large of a size and have a smaller chest, i'd say it would work fine.

title: Five Stars
text: A great ring, its very thin and dainty and light on my hand, I love it

title: I wanted to love these sandals
text: I wanted to love these sandals. I liked the design and the straps hold them to your feet so they don't make that constant slapping noise that flip flops usually make. And as far as flip flops go, they are comfortable. But the issue is that for some reason, they don't hold to my feet right so they are constantly getting pushed out the back and I'm having to stop every so often to scoot my foot back in it. It's frequent enough that I don't even really consider wearing them for anything that would take more than an hour, its that annoying to have to constantly readjust them.

title: They are easy to clean too and so far have been holding ...
text: I got these for my 8 year old and she loves them. Has been wearing them all the time since we got them and hasn't had any issues with blisters or the straps rubbing in spots. They are easy to clean too and so far have been holding up pretty well.

title: Unless you are below average height, this is NOT a dress
text: Ordered this on sale, took a chance because there were no other reviews and shouldn't have wasted my time. I'm 5'10" and this just barely covered what it needed to in the back. Unless you are relatively short, this is more of a tunic. I'm a size 16, 40D cup and ordered the 1x/2x and the chest was tight. The band that is supposed to hit right below your bust, like an empire waist, really came mid bust and just looked and felt  awkward. If it was long enough though, I would have kept the dress and made it work because it is really pretty. The only reason I am giving it two stars is because it was a beautiful green color, looks just like the picture and the embroidery is nice. It would be a great dress for someone really petite.

title: This arrived and it looked just like the picture
text: This arrived and it looked just like the picture. The quality was good for the price, however when I opened the plastic bag it was stored it, it had this horrible smell. It was almost like rotten fish or something. Thankfully I got it a day earlier than when I needed it, I stuck it in a grocery bag with a bunch of baking soda overnight to absorb the scent and shook it out the next day and it was fine.

title: Very nice
text: Put these on a birthday wish list and was pleased to receive them. They are a great size, not too big or small and have nice sparkly to them. A VERY light green color, more of a green tint than anything, looks very close to the picture

title: Better than I was expecting
text: I was really hesitant to purchase these due to the iffy reviews on the other styles that are carried by this company, seemed that the sizing was very "off" for them. So after about 2 months of sitting on my wishlist I decided to go for it. I'm normally a size 8 in underwear or L/XL, depending on the style and ordered an XL on these. Like I said, I was really hesitant since they said to order a size up and i'm pretty much on the cusp between L and XL, but these actually fit pretty well. The material is a lot better than I was expecting and they aren't too tight. It does not cover as much of the back as I was expecting, but that is due more so to my butt size than the undies, lol. Only real complaint is the color variety. I got 2 pairs of dark pink/purple. 1 pair of BRIGHT yellow, 1 pair of a lighter hot pink. 2 pairs of a turqiouse blue, 2 pair of heather gray, 2 pair of white and 2 pair of this peachy color. The color's are ok, just wish it had more variety and not so many repeated colors, maybe a pair of black, red and green mixed in or something. But really for the price, it's a pretty good deal

title: Great deal
text: Just ordered these when it was a lightning deal for about 8 bucks, got them the next day. Nice size, not too big to be overly showy or too small to be unsubstantial and they look very similar, a nice match and color. Put them in immediately and I can't even feel them, really comfortable after wearing them for a few hours

text: Dress was gorgeous but the top was  huge. Daughter is not small chested and it was still crazy big

title: Cute

I ordered a large and I'm 5'7" tall and about 135lbs. if that helps with the sizing, I'm not big in the chest 38" around and a C cup.

title: Nice suit
text: Love the colors, it's pretty much just like the picture and the size runs true. I'm 5'7" 140lbs and a c cup, I ordered the large, it fits just fine.

title: Love These
text: I love love these shoes, so comfy, slip on and go, cute with dresses, jeans, shorts and cropped pants. I ordered a pair and as soon as I got them and wore for a day I came home and ordered another pair in a different color.

title: Comfy
text: Love these socks, so comfy. Not too thick, not too thin. wear them all the time. Good value, will buy again, arrived pretty quickly too.

title: Comfy
text: It's a nice sleeveless top, not fancy, but comfy. I am 5'7" tall and about 140 lbs. bought the large, it is a little loose but I prefer loose clothing.

title: Cute!

title: Good Looking & Reliable Eco-Drive Gold Watch with Bling
text: This is a really attractive watch.  Has a gold dial and the center circle has a subtle polka dot appearance.  The dial face is approximately 1 3/8" wide, so it is slightly oversized, but not huge.  I love the eco-drive solar energy function; being free of batteries and the need to replace them is wonderful.  This watch features both date and 24-hour dials and they are easy to set.  The watch is a little heavier than a regular Citizens women's watch and weighed 2.7 ounces as compared to 2.3 ounces for my other watch (Citizens EW1854-57D.)  The watch face case is also slightly deeper at 3/8" versus 1/4" (again compared to the Women's Citizens EW1854-57D.)  The crystals that surround the dial add some bling without being too over the top.  All in all a lovely watch.  I would have given it five stars if it had been thinner and not quite as heavy.

title: Front Close Bra with Good Support and No Underwire!
text: I am full-figured and usually always wear an underwired bra - have for years.  I purchased this 6-hook front close support bra after tearing my right rotator cuff.  Trying to fasten my regular bra behind my back was near impossible and painful!  I have to say, this Glamorise MagicLift bra does the job!  It is super easy to put on and fasten and has two sets of hooks for some tightness control.  There is a built in support strap at the bottom of the cups which does a good job of supporting the ladies.  My one complaint with this bra is the elastic strap at the bottom.  It makes the bra longer, has a tendency to roll up and I think the bra would have been fine without it.  That being said, I would both recommend and purchase this bra agaion.

title: Great for narrower feet!
text: I find the Birkenstock Gizeh style overall runs a little small as compared to the Arizona and Florida styles.  I have medium width feet, (not wide) but on me, the Gizeh are definitely narrower and I had to size up one size for length also.  I take a 39 in Arizona and Florida but needed a 40 in the Gizeh and even then, I have them buckled on the last hole in the strap.  If my feet were any wider, they wouldn't fit at all!  This is my first pair of Gizeh and they are comfortable (although I haven't worn them out of the house yet) but I probably would not purchase this style again.  These are great looking sandals, the oiled leather is really nice and I would say these are 5 star Birkie's if you have a narrow-to-normal foot.  If your foot is a little chunky, I'd try a different style.

title: Good looking and very comfortable sandal!

title: Runs Large
text: Ordered these in an 8-1/2 for my mom who wears an 8-1/2 or 9.  They are very nice slippers and seem to be good quality and well made, but they were much too large for her ... at least 1/2 a size too large (could fit an entire finger behind the heel.)  I have returned them and the vendor promptly issued a refund (which I appreciate.)  However, it cost over $12 to return ship these slippers (about half of the entire cost) and, in addition, this vendor charges a 20% restocking fee, so I definitely lost money on this purchase (and she still has no slippers.)  I rated these four out of five stars because the slippers seem to be a good product.  Received them fairly quickly and the vendor promptly refunded my purchase (even before receiving the slippers back), but I am not a fan of restocking fees and actually would have just liked to exchange them for a smaller size.  I would rate the vendor slightly less than four stars.

title: New life into old glasses
text:
It's too early for me to write about durability, but these lenses get 5 stars for price and installation. They fit perfectly in the Oakley frames. It's like having a new pair of high quality glasses for 1/5 of the price. These lenses cut glare, while keeping colors natural.

My original lenses were badly scratched and started bubbling around the edges after 7 years of use. At first I was looking at replacement glasses, but then I saw these. Why throw out a perfectly good designer frame? These lenses solve the problem for the same price as a pair of cheap glasses that will break within a year. Also, the original lenses I had were a dark brown that gave everything a sepia tone. The new ones are black, and I actually prefer that.

text: This is reasonably priced for what you get, but there are better sets that you can get for about the same price that come in wooden storage boxes.  This is packed in cardboard, so makes it look cheap, so maybe not something you would want to use for a nice gift.  If you are getting it to use for yourself, it should be okay, but I would suggest getting a nicer set that will hold up better and last longer.  There are plenty of cheap silver sets available; this one is probably no better or no worse than any other.  The spoon sizes were a little weird; didn't seem to be standard sized, so that could be bothersome to you.  My wife took a quick look at it, but did not like the set very much.

title: VERY COMPACT AND THIN; LIMITED ON NUMBER OF CARDS IT WILL HOLD
text: This is indeed a very thin wallet, but I might not have ordered it had I realized that it only holds 8 credit cards.  I need a wallet that holds more than that, as I bank at 2 banks and that's 2 debit cards; then I have 2 primary credit cards and a backup card, my AAA membership, my national parks pass, my VA Card, driver's license, insurance card and a couple other cards that I need to carry.  That is well more than 8.  Also I like a wallet with a loose change "purse", which this does not have.  For most people, this might be adequate and it is nice that it is so thin, even with 8 cards and some cash in it.  The RFID blocking is a big plus too and almost a necessity these days.  If you have no more than 8 cards, including ID that you need to carry, don't need a change purse and you don't want to stuff your pocket with a big wallet, this is ideal.

title: Gorgeous Watch; good price; too heavy for most people; inadequate documentation
text: This is an absolutely gorgeous watch that looks much more expensive than it is.  It has a nice large, readable dial and I especially like the fact that it has actual numbers for the hours; not just tick marks as many watches do.  The looks and features make it hard not to like this watch.  It has a day of the week dial, a chronograph and a 60 second dial in addition to the large second sweep hand, which you can shut off if you want just the smaller dial.  There is also day of the month.  The crowns screw down in place to make the watch waterproof.  Unfortunately the watch comes with a very thin manual that doesn't tell you much about how to set it.  I couldn't quite figure out the function of the two push button crowns above and below the main setting crown.  I had to go online and do some searching and finally found the instructions for setting the day of the month.  I have not yet been able to find out how to set the day of the week; instructions I found online did not seem to work.  Other than lack of documentation, the only other problem with this watch is the weight.  It weighs in at 9 ounces.  That may not seem like much, but it is over 1/2 a pound and it feels very heavy on your wrist.  It's just too heavy for me.  If you are a big husky person, it might not be a big deal, but if you are average size it is a big, bulky watch.  It is not a watch for wimps.  Comes in a nice case.  Probably well worth the price and an otherwise wonderful watch if you can find instructions on setting it and can deal with the weight.  Would make an elegant gift.

title: Nice Wallet, but limited space and no change pouch
text: This is a very thin and quite attractive wallet that appears to be all leather.  The quality looks good.  This only holds about 6 credit cards and one ID; that's okay if that's all you have or less.  The RFID feature is a big plus, because apparently these days they have equipment that can read your credit card information just by walking by and aiming at your pocket. The RFID prevents this.  I have always liked wallets that included a change pouch, but this one doesn't have it.  I only gave it 3 stars because of the limited number of cards you can carry in it and the lack of a place for change.  This might be ideal for you if you want a credit card only wallet with the RFID protection.

title: Quality built suitcase with really good wheels
text: This is a somewhat expensive suitcase at around $200, but if you travel a lot, it is probably well worth it.  Why?  The wheels are the number one thing.  I have used a lot of different wheeled suitcases, but the cheaper ones have wheels that don't work that well or sometimes can break.  The quality wheels are the first thing I noticed about this suitcase.  They spin around so they go the direction you want to go, which is far better than "fixed" wheel models.  The wheels are substantial and sturdy too.  The zippers on the suitcase are also very sturdy and large, unlikely to jam or break, as less expensive zippers might.  The retractable handle also appears to be well made.  I have had suitcases where the handle was very wobbly once it was fully extended.  That's not a problem with this suitcase.  Roomy inside with several zippered pockets.  Overall a very well made suitcase that should last a long time, unless you get baggage handlers that really beat up on it.  Even with rough handling, it does look like it would handle quite a bit of abuse.

title: Gorgeous Luxury Watch that Looks Expensve; a little too heavy for me
text: This is an absolutely gorgeous luxury watch and would make a wonderful gift.  It appears that at the moment the price is just over $100, marked down for $695.  I would hate to pay $695 for this or any watch, but it is a luxury watch and well worth $100 or more.  It came running with the battery installed, so all I had to do is set the time and date, both which are easy to set.  Good instructions are included.  Comes in a nice case too.  I knocked off one star on my review for the weight of the watch.  On my scale it weighed 6.2 ounces.  That doesn't sound like much, but it is a very heavy watch.  Just 1.8 ounces more would be 1/2 pound. Imagine carrying 1/2 pound weight on your wrist all day.  Of course the weight makes it a very durable watch.  It looks very well constructed and could not be easily broken.  It is supposed to be water resistant too, which is a plus too.  These days with so many electronics devices available, a watch just isn't all that necessary, so this is really more of a piece of jewelry than a necessity for telling time.  Of course it does also have a stop watch on it with several functions.  The day of the month also appears on the watch, but no month or day of the week.  If you want a showy watch without spending a fortune, this will do the trick.  It is expensive looking, without being overly expensive to buy, as long as the price is stays at just over $100.  If you ever wanted a really nice luxury watch, I wouldn't hesitate to buy this, as it is not cheap looking in any way.  As long as you can deal with the weight, you'll like the look of this watch.

These will fit well for someone who is 5'10" to about 6'2" or so.  Also the shirt seemed a bit too roomy as well, so if you are a large person, it should fit perfectly.  Even though the pants are long, they could probably be easily shortened without compromising the integrity.  The only real problem is the care instructions.  You have to wash this in cold water.  Instruction also say "dry only".  I don't what that means, unless it means "dry clean only", but then it wouldn't say wash in cold water.  Maybe it means to air dry it, rather than in the dryer.  Hardly anyone washes by hand these days, so it depends on whether you want to deal with caring for a delicate fabric.

text:

In the original sets I purchased there were no quitter elastic bands here, these things are wonderful and stay on well, and they don't become loose or misshapen from all the laundry cycles, nor do they shrink.

Well, I just bought four packs off Amazon, excited to bring more of these soft undies into my collection and rotate old undies out. Except, these are MUCH smaller than the other ones I already own, which is really strange. You can see the printed information on the inside of the underwear, same size and everything lines up. Then why do I feel like a blood sausage when wearing them? Side by side these new ones are considerably smaller.

I am being squeezed by them so badly that my hips feel pinched and uncomfortable as the fabric shifts lower during wear (constantly, despite my tugging back up). The front rides even lower on my abdomen and the thick waist band does not hold them up very well. I am not sure why they changed their template and the amount of fabric they use for my size, but they definitely changed something. I would return them had I not washed them all and worn some. If you buy them, consider going a size up and make sure to try them on before washing in case they don't fit.

title: Two tone shoes are true to size- confirmed!

The only downside is that the true fit also means you can't wear thicker socks with them, only thin ones which are less absorbent. Because of this, I think you would need to provide maintenance to your shoe to keep them from getting sweaty inside if you sweat a lot when running or walking in them.

When I first received mine, I went on a hike for an afternoon and it was an amazing experience to be able to be so much more in connection with the ground and steps and such. My feet never get hurt or tired in these, or worse, feel pinched or compressed. Perfect fit. I will definitely be buying another set just for comfort, because they are that cozy! Like walking on little pillows that let you feel the earth below you.

-------------------
A new update! I am back over a year later and these are still my favorite walking shoes. I repurchased the purple and black ones, and also bought the solid black ones. Zero negative things to say, but one thing you will need to watch out for is that tiny loop which the velcro strap slides through can break, and once that is compromised then the shoes will not stay on well at all. I plan to reinforce mine with some hand stitching this time around because that was the only defective part on my last pair. Love these shoes!!! I can confirm that both solid and duo tone are true to size. (9.5)

Update: In my earlier review (Below) I did not know how long they would be functional after they started to pucker. Today the back clip simply fell out of the back connection point when the connection point and stitching failed, making the suspenders useless (See photos). I would revise the rating down from 2 stars to 1 star.

Original Review:
These suspenders would be OK for a special purpose event, but they do not stand up to normal extended use. The straps began to pucker along the back side edges almost immediately when not under tension. I cannot recommend them for normal everyday use and I cannot say how long they will continue to be functional.
