title: I highly recommend this tote for personal use or as a gift!
text:
Recently I received this Baggallini tote bag to review. I have purchased three Baggalini purses over the last few years but this is my first tote. This bag has much to recommend it, a great tote for work or travel. The fabric is a nice quality water-resistant nylon (yes, I did spray water on it and it beaded up). This fabric is much more practical than regular cloth bags which get wet in the rain and don’t necessarily protect the contents. The nylon fabric can be wiped clean with a damp cloth, another advantage. The metal bumpers on the bottom of the tote save the fabric, a small detail missing on many totes and purses.

The bag itself is well designed. You have a choice of using the 11” drop length handles or the removable, adjustable cross-body strap which helps to customize the fit. The inside of the bag offer RFID protection with credit card slots to keep your information safe.

If you carry electronic devices with you, you will appreciate the cell phone pocket and another zippered compartment that can accommodate an iPad. The only recommendation I would make is to make the cell phone pocket a bit longer; my large phone does fit but would like a bit more room so that it isn’t so close to the zipper.

The baggage handle sleeve is a great addition to this tote. When the zipper is closed you have an additional pocket with a magnetic clasp. When unzipped, it allows the tote sleeve to slip over the luggage handle, one less article for you to juggle on your way to work or through the airport.

This is my favorite Baggallini so far, thanks to a practical design and size (approximately 15” W, 12” H, 5” D) and quality components.

title: Fantastic bag for travel or overnights
text:
I frequently travel for work and pleasure, and am always on the lookout for lightweight yet roomy bags as I travel by train and storage space is limited.

I've been using Vera Bradley totes for at least 20 year, but most were over-the-shoulder style. So I loved the idea that this can be worn as a messenger bag, but also includes a sewn-on loop for sliding over a suitcase handle, for which my shoulders are grateful!

The bag looks small from the outside, but you are able to accommodate enough clothes easily for an entire weekend. It includes a phone pocket, 2 zip pockets, and 2 slip pockets. The interior has a mesh overlay with a pocket to keep your valuables organized. It's also carry-on compliant, measures 18. 5 inches Wide, 12. 5 inches high, and 6. 5 inches deep with a 6. 5 inch strap drop and an additional 52. 5 inch removable, adjustable strap.

And I love that the exterior is weather-repellent, meaning if you accidentally spill on it, you can easily wipe it off and have it looking good as new. This has become my new favorite travel gear and looks and feels great!

title: SUPER narrow - not for those with wide feet or arthritis!
text:
I am a longtime Brooks wearer, so when I was offered the chance to try out Mizuno's Women's Court Tennis Shoe, I jumped at the chance. I have a lot of foot issues including severe arthritis and overpronation, so was looking for a shoe that would offer stability and comfort. (Sometimes I am able to wear shoes in a regular width, like Reebok, so I was hopeful that the Mizunos would fit).

Out of the box, the shoes looked and felt great in the hand, with a striking purple and white color theme.

Unfortunately, from the moment I put them on, it was instant discomfort. I have hallux rigidus as well as tailor's bunions on both feet, which means my bone spurs protrude quite a bit. Not only was the shoe too narrow through the toebox, but through the entire middle as well. It was uncomfortable even having them on for just a couple of minutes. There was no mention of the shoe being narrow on the box - only 8.5 (and looking on their website, it does not appear that they manufacture this model in wider widths, or I would be willing to give it another try).

Too bad, as the shoes looked and felt very promising on initial inspection.

title: A great investment for frequent travelers.
text:
I frequently travel long distance by train on the weekends, and was looking for an easier way to get more bang for my buck as far as packing. So when I had the opportunity to review the Solo New York rolling duffel bag, I was thrilled.

Upon first glance, the fabric used is durable, as are the zippers and wheels. There is plenty of storage in the main compartment and side compartments, and I appreciated that there is a separate shoe/laundry compartment. My only nitpick was I wish they had used a stronger material for the black vinyl that covers the bottom/ends of the bag, it feels much cheaper and less sturdy than the main fabric.

I love that the bottom of the bag is reinforced; you can fit 40L worth of stuff into this, and even when fully loaded, the bag rolls smoothly and has a very sturdy feel. The telescoping handle makes it a breeze to travel quickly and easily from point a to B, and you will look stylish doing so. And best of all is the fact this is small enough to qualify as a carry-on with most major airlines; win-win.

All in all these pants are great and so comfortable, I liked that they are not as thin as other brands or just normal pants they are a bit thicker but without being uncomfortable or hot, they are super breathable and stretchy and the material is awesome imo, it is soft and easy to wear and perfect for lounging at home doing yoga or exercising even because they are stretchy enough to exercise with as well, I think these are the perfect pants I may buy another two pairs in fact I loved them so much! I just have to check if they shrink after washing them a while just in case. But overall these pants are the best!!! Again they do run a little bigger specially at the bottom so make sure to order your usual size or even a size down they also run big at the top as well they are very stretchy and come up pretty high as well. I like the price too I hope they don't up the price because of my review because I'd like to keep purchasing these the material is just great!

title: The calf opening measurement is a bit deceiving
text:
The boot overall was very good, and I can tell it would be a warm boot. I actually did not buy this because the calf measurement ended up quite deceiving.

I have very wide calves, about 19" and I thought THIS IS IT, I FOUND THE BOOT! But it's the 20" opening plus the removable liner (8mm x2 is approximately .62", so slightly larger than 1/2" SMALLER for the opening. Also, the 20" is not what was measured, it's slightly smaller, so I could not fit my calf in with the liner.

Well, why not take the liner out? Turns out, you NEED the liner for the proper fit for your FEET. If you take the liner out, you would need multiple layers of socks to fit the boot right AND your ankle support is basically nonexistent.

Overall, I think the boot is a good boot, good price too, not sure about durability. But I feel like the specifications are slightly deceiving as they are presented.

title: Already wearing down with approximately 6 months of use
text:
UPDATE: There is no way these last a year. They maybe will make it to 6 months. I'm about to hit month 5 (I bought these in may) and the inside behind my heel is completely worn down even though I'm wearing the right size. Any smaller and my toe would be constantly pressed against the steel toe portion. Definitely would no longer recommend, even at this price, you might as well get something cheaper that will last less than 6 months.

I've had steel toed boots before but this is my first pair of steel toed sneaker-type of shoe. I expected some wear but am disappointed in some of the rips I've seen (pointed out in my photo) since I haven't been as rough on them as I usually am with boots. They are far more comfortable than my boots hands down though, I can wear them all day, normally with my boots I start getting tired after about 6 hrs.

Would recommend these for the price, we'll see if they last the year.

title: Update: Sturdy and they look nice
text:
I prefer steel toe boots over shoes, but, as a woman, it's always been hard to find a snug fit that doesn't hurt or isn't too heavy. My shoes are marginally lighter. But, I prefer the boots. They have great ankle support, no squeaking on shop floor, and they feel like a perfect fit all around. I've had them for about 2 months, most of my days being 8-5 but wearing them 6-6 and yesterday I wore them for over 12 hrs (I was tired, but definitely not because of the boots).

Update: I had bought a different pair of sneakers for $125 and they were ripped to shreds on the inside and loose within 6M. I came back to these, especially for the winter, and wow, they're still holding strong.

They are definitely worn and a bit looser than before, but I can't complain. The price is good, I am replacing the insole (~$45 for a custom one) and they're solid for snow boots too. Fairly lightweight, still would 100% recommend over other brands and shoes.

title: New go-to bra
text:
This is my new go-to. My previous go-to was also a natori bra, similar to this one in the sense that it had the base bra and then some sort of thin and semi-loose fabric around the outside of the cups. My other natori was a 36DDD and I do vary in sizes with the bras but being amazon wardrobe, I just went with the fit of my other bra and estimated based on reviews.

The bra has 3 clasps, but still pretty thin back strap. The overall feel is comfortable but supportive. It doesn't feel right but there's support by side boob. The front feels "flimsier" but again supported. Very sexy looking but still conservative in a way.

title: Too small. Definitely size up 2x on band AND cup.
text: I had ordered this twice now, once in the past and once recently. And both times the sizing was wrong. I did two sizes up on the cup size since the first time it was way off. But the second time the band was way too small. I was insanely annoyed. I think that the bra is definitely no bounce and would be GREAT if you find your size. Personally, not going to bother a third time.

title: So comfortable! Well made!
text: Beautiful leather! Reminds me of when I would buy my Huaraches in Laredo! Softened up by using coconut oil (attention to heels of shoe) and was able to wear all day the first time I wore them! My daughters want some now!

title: Very cheaply made.
text: The tongue of the shoe folds inward when the shoe is put on.

title: Wrinkles
text: T-shirts look fine before washing but after they look terrible. Neck is a mess wrinkled and hanging down. Really disappointed. Amazon should be aware how bad they look.

title: Good dress shoe
text: Good shoe. Nice looking and fits well

title: No good
text: Too tight.  Circulation is cut off and my feet then hurt.

title: Top look
text: Great look, great great prices and great service. A perfect 5.

title: Comfy
text: Good comfortable socks

title: Weak model
text: Not comfortable

title: Five Stars
text: The most comfortable and no hood to bother with.

title: Hood less
text: Best of the sweat shirts:/jackets.

title: Great jeans
text: Perfect fit and a good buy.

title: Not comfortable
text: Rough cheap poly fabric. Returned the shorts

title: Easy to Use
text: This is a simple & easy to use product. I watched the video before it arrived. Then when it did get here, all I had to do was read the instructions that came with it and it worked like a charm.  The ring stays in place well and hasn't come off while wearing it. This is a neat way to change the look of an outfit.

title: Comfortable!
text: These Columbia pants are light weight and comfortable. The fit is as expected. They will be perfect for summer outdoor activities. The moisture wicking feature will be greatly appreciated! They would also make very good travel pants.

title: Easy to Use
text: I've had other packable totes similar to this one, but this one is easier to use. I'm the person who can never fold something back to it's original package or shape. I was able to figure this one out on the first time and it doesn't look bad at all! The bag is made of a water resistant type material. It's very light weight. The straps are sturdy and seem to be attached well. This will be perfect for traveling!

title: Nice Fit
text: It's January where I make my annual attempt to get in shape. I have some exercise equipment in my home and I'm trying to get into a routine. Usually I wear a cotton blend t-shirt while exercising but these are better. They don't get all sweaty feeling. The wicking feature works very well. I like the assortment of colors. It has a very nice fit. It's more fitted than the usual boxy t-shirts I wear for working out. I am very happy with these.

title: Very Nice
text: These earrings are very nice. They look more expensive than they are which is always a good thing. I am usually nervous wearing real diamond earrings, so I feel much more comfortable wearing costume jewelry. They have a great sparkle and they don't irritate my ears.

title: Comfortable Fit
text: I ordered these Tretorn sneakers for my husband. He wasn't familiar with the brand, but I was. He liked that they are somewhat subtle with their branding versus other athletic shoes. He found these to be a comfortable fit. He usually wears an 11.5, but there are some brands that run small so he has to order 12's. I ordered the 11.5 for him and he is pleased with the fit.

title: Cute Earrings!
text: I hate spending lots of money on jewelry. One reason, is that I often lose earrings. These are cute and look like high quality ones without the worry of something happening to them. They also don't annoy or irritate my ears.

title: Not Very Flattering
text: The fact that these are called mom jeans should have warned me that these would not be flattering jeans! I ordered these for my daughter. They were snug in the waist and baggy in the legs. As a mom, I have never worn jeans that looked like these. My daughter doesn't love them, but she has worn these a couple of times. They seem to be well made.

title: Pretty
text: I don't feel comfortable wearing expensive jewelry. These look really nice and don't have that "cheap" look to them. I don't feel like I'm being judged for wearing fake diamonds because they look pretty real. They are small and don't irritate my ears. I am happy with them.

title: Looks Good!
text: I ordered this TruFit shirt for my husband. I immediately noticed a difference when he put this on. It's a little more fitted than standard t-shirts. Tees usually are somewhat baggy on him in some areas. The material is very soft and light weight. He could easily wear this alone or as a layer. The quality seems to be good. He says it's comfortable and that's what counts!

title: Nice Jacket!
text: I ordered this denim jacket for my daughter. She wears a size Large in most tops. This is an XL. It does fit her, but she would prefer if it was looser on her. She likes wearing oversized clothing. The jacket looks just like the pictures. It is well made. Overall it's a nice denim jacket.

title: Too Narrow in the Legs
text: I was excited to try these Gap pants. They looked very comfy and casual. I found them to be too narrow in the legs, especially in the calves. The quality seems to be fine. I think the size would be true fit everywhere else.

title: Comfortable!
text: I wear Croc flip flops all summer long, but these are my first non-flipflop Crocs. I love Vera Bradley, so I was excited to see this collaboration. The fit is pretty good as long as I wear thin socks or go barefoot. When I wear white, cotton crew socks, my heel rides up on the back edge. When I wear the appropriate socks, they are super comfortable. The Harry Potter designs are fairly subtle. At first glance, it's hard to tell that the images are Harry Potter! Overall, I am very happy with them.

title: Good Casual Belt
text: This is a good, casual belt. The size fits as expected. The quality is good, but not great. I also find it to be a bit pricey for the quality. My daughter is pleased with how it looks.

title: Great Jacket
text: This is a great jacket. First of all, the tie-dye pink color is gorgeous! The jacket is light weight but well insulated. It is considered an active wear garment, but it can definitely be worn other times. There are plenty of pockets. The zipper glides easily. I ordered this for my daughter. She usually wears a size large in tops, but we ordered a size larger so she could wear layers underneath.

title: Soft
text: My daughter is a fan of dickey turtlenecks. It adds the look of layers without the bulk or extra heat. She has a couple and has declared this to be her favorite. It's very soft, which is one reason she really likes it. She says that her other ones are either a bit itchy or they feel stiff. It seems to be well made. It looks just like the picture.

title: Fun Assortment
text: This is a fun assortment of Christmas themed earrings. The variety is nice. They are costume jewelry quality. There are plenty of earrings that I can share with my daughter.

title: Festive
text: I wanted some holiday earrings and I am quite pleased with these. They are very festive looking. They don't look cheap at all. They're a little larger than I expected, but not in a bad way.

title: Cute!
text: This is a cute Minnie Mouse headband.  The gold sequins seem to be well attached. The details are quite nice. The headband is a little tight on my head, but it fits my daughter better.

title: Good Fit
text: This swimsuit has a good fit. I am a size 18 in jeans, but I have found that size 18 swimsuits just don't work for me. For that reason, I usually order size 20. This one fit as I expected. The shirred front is flattering. I think a dark solid color would make it even more flattering. The busy print draws attention to things.

title: Did Not Fit
text: This is a cute swimsuit. I like the style of it. It also seems to be made well. Unfortunately, it didn't fit me. I wear a size 18 jeans. The legs of this swimsuit were too tight around my thighs. I could pull it all the way on, but the leg openings were very uncomfortable and there's no way I could wear it. The rest of the suit fit okay. They were so tight in the thighs that I don't know if the next size would have been much better.

title: Great Beanie!
text: What a great beanie! It's well made and it looks wonderful. It fits as expected and has adequate stretch. The Yosemite patch is securely sewn onto it. This would make a great gift!

title: Comfortable!
text: This is a comfortable maternity dress. The fabric is light weight and very soft. The length is pretty long, but if you're above average in height, it may not be long enough. The fabric is slightly see through, but not to the point where it's obscene. It's definitely a nice addition to one's maternity wardrobe.

title: Good Belt
text: This is a good web belt. I ordered this for my husband. It easily fit. It reminded him of the belt he wore in his Boy Scout days. The logo isn't super noticeable because it's black on black. He actually prefers that. It keeps his pants up, which is what a belt is supposed to do!

title: Sleeveless Windbreaker
text: Sometimes, all you need (or want) is a windbreaker and not a thicker jacket. This one goes a step farther and is sleeveless. It is designed for activities such as hiking, jogging, and other outdoor activities. The vest is well made. It includes pockets which are pretty much mandatory these days. I ordered an XL for my husband. He wears size Large in most tops, but without knowing how this fit, I ordered a size up. It's a good fit and allows him to wear a thick flannel shirt underneath.

title: Great Quality!
text: These maternity jeans are a great quality. The material is soft and silky. There's some stretch, but not what you would traditionally expect from maternity wear. Instead of having the stretchy, elastic part cover your belly, it has wedge shaped elastic on the sides that expand to accommodate the growing belly. These jeans are very black. I am concerned about dye transfer. I like dark rinses when it comes to jeans and I've had issues with color transfer on furniture! These are skinny jean style. I found it a little difficult to calculate the sizing. The size chart uses the Hatch sizing which is 1,2, 3, and 4. However the jeans sizes follow the waist sizes such as 25, 26, 27....Go with your jean size and consider sizing up if you are in between.

title: Light Weight
text: This is a light weight polo shirt. The fabric is soft and comfortable. The sizing is as expected. I was unfamiliar with the brand, but at that price point, it must be a high end brand. Overall it's a decent shirt that's perfect for warm weather.

title: Beautiful Wallet
text: This is a beautiful quilted wallet. There's plenty of room for all kinds of stuff. It seems to be a very nice quality. I love the floral print. It definitely reminds me of Vera Bradley. I am interested to see what other products they have.

title: Nice Quality
text: My husband is a huge Star Trek nerd. I ordered these shirts for him in a size XL. He's on the border between Large & XL. It's a little roomy but not baggy. The shirt is a nice quality. The images look terrific!

title: Good Fit!
text: This holiday shirt is a good fit and fits as expected. The design is nice, however, the vinyl image is fairly stiff which I find to be annoying. It looks good, but the stiff vinyl makes noise when wearing and just feels weird to me.

title: Plenty of Storage
text: I like to swap out the bands on my FitBit to coordinate with my outfits. This is a great case for that. There's plenty of storage for the bands. I have a little room left to acquire more bands! It's a thin case which makes it easier to store.

title: Beautiful Bag
text: This bag is much nicer than I expected. It is beautiful! It has some weight to it which gives it a sturdy feel to it. At the same time, it's not too heavy that you won't want to use it. This will be perfect for dressy occasions.

title: Great Color
text: This is a light weight t-shirt. The color is great! The quality seems to be good. It will be perfect for summertime!

title: Pretty Print!
text: This quilted crossbody purse has a very pretty print. I like the color combination of the floral design. The quality of the bag is very good. It has an adjustable shoulder strap. There is a slip pocket on one of the outer sides and a larger pocket on the other side that has a magnetic snap closure. The snap closure doesn't close on its own with just the magnetism. You need to line up the sides of the snaps and press together in order to get it to snap into place. It made me question whether or not it was actually magnetic, but it does seem to be. It's just not a strong one. This pocket has credit card slots and an ID window. There's a hidden zippered pocket behind the larger pocket with the flap. The zipper works fine, but it's a bit awkward to access. Plus that pocket is very thin so I will have to be careful as to what I put in there because my hand cannot easily fit down to the bottom. The main compartment has a zipper closure. It's fairly narrow. If I insert my wallet into it, the whole bag bulges for an unattractive look. Fortunately, I can skip the wallet and use the card slots instead. Overall, it's a nice bag.

title: Stylish!
text: I ordered these shoes for my daughter in a size 9. I personally wear a size 11. The size that I received is a 10 which won't fit either of us. For that reason, I can't really comment on how they fit. They look quite stylish. I like the chunkier heel for stability. The straps that go across the feet are very narrow, but they seem to be securely attached.

title: Great School Uniform Dress
text: This is a great school uniform dress. The quality is excellent and the brand is reliable. It is true size fit. I like the dark navy color as it wears better than the khaki ones.

title: Cute Floral Print
text: This is a good size tote bag. It's not oversized or huge, just a regular sized tote. It has a very cute floral print. There are zippered pockets and slip pockets. The straps seem a little thin, but there's no indication that they will not last. There's some cardboard or something sewn inside on the bottom to give it a firm and sturdy base. The contrasting/coordinating fabric inside is nice, too.

title: Cute Shorts!
text: I don't usually wear shorts, but we recently got an elliptical machine so I thought shorts might be comfortable to wear for that. These are cute shorts. It took me a little while to figure out how to use the elastic drawstring. It's one piece instead of having 2 separate ends to tie. I actually had to look online and watch a couple of videos to see how it's done! The fit in the seat/rear is very good. I wear a size 18 jeans and ordered the 1XL. It's loose in the waist. It's loose enough that I must tighten it with the drawstring or I will be constantly messing with it & pulling it up. The material is flowy and comfy. Now I must find a cute exercise top to go with it!

title: Flowy
text: This Hatch maternity shirt is comfortable and flowy. The arms are a little snug, but not tight. The material is very soft. The quality seems good. It will go well with black pants or leggings. I like that it's designed for the pregnancy as well as the early stages of motherhood.

title: Disappointing
text: I am a big Disney fan but I found these earrings to be a little disappointing. They just feel and look cheap. I had higher expectations for them. They are definitely costume jewelry. It's kind of neat that they light up, but I think I would have been happier if they were higher quality instead.

title: Nice Style
text: These pants have a nice style. I like that the material is a little thicker. A lot of times I have to deal with thinner material on my khaki's which either rips easily or is a bit see through. Those aren't problems with these pants. They fit pretty well in the legs, but the waist is too big. I usually have the reverse problem. I wear a size 18 jeans, usually a curvy fit. My calves are problematic when it comes to fit because they're on the thicker side. I'm going to try these with a belt to see how that looks and if it looks okay, I will be able to wear them.

title: Nice Slippers
text: These Nine West slippers are nice. They have a good cushion. The material is soft. The construction seems to be fine. Unfortunately, these did not fit me. I wear a size 10W. I often find that size 11's will work well. I ordered the 11/12 slippers. I could not even get my foot into them. The slippers are not open like a lot of other slippers, instead they are designed like shows where you have to insert your foot into them. Consider sizing up if you have wide feet or if you're on the top end of the size.

title: Good Compression!
text: I ordered these compression shorts for my daughter. The sizing fits well. They definitely provide compression. They're not too tight, but they are snug. The dark color isn't see through. The length is good. My daughter says they are comfortable and they allow full range of movement.

title: Camisole Shaper
text: I have been wearing camisole shapers daily for the last couple of years. I buy mine from Ruby Ribbon, but I was excited to give these a try because they are much cheaper.I followed the chart for sizing. I wear a size 18, so I went with the 4XL as suggested. It fits well. There is some compression, but not as much as the level 4 Ruby Ribbon ones that I wear. There isn't as much support on top either. The RR camis have a band just below the chest area which lifts nicely. It also doesn't separate well either, creating more of a uni-boob look. For the first few hours, I didn't have any problems with this rolling up, but throughout the day, I did begin to have that issue. Overall, I do like this. It was comfortable to wear and it was definitely more supportive than wearing no-bra at all. I think I would be more likely to wear it on lounging at home days.

title: Very Comfortable!
text: These pull on pants are very comfortable. They are great for hanging out at home. I don't think I would wear them in public, but that's just me. The fit is good. They're a little loose at the waist, but not enough that I'm having to pull them up all the time. The material is a little thin, but they're not see through. I do wish they had pockets!

title: Comfortable!
text: These men's slippers are comfortable, but they're also a little weird looking. My husband has been wearing them around the house since getting them which means that he likes them. They are a better slipper for the times when he has to go outside on the sidewalk or driveway. These fit him very well and as we expected.

title: Soft!
text: This Star Wars themed fleece jacket is really cute! I ordered the 2XL. The sizing is good, but it could be better. There's not a lot of extra room, so if I was wearing something thicker such as a sweater or sweatshirt, I think this would be too tight. It is fine with a thin shirt underneath. The zipper works well. The arm sleeves are not too short. There are 2 zippered pockets. It kept me warm today when I was running my errands.

title: Cozy!
text: I'm loving this cozy pullover Vera Bradley! I didn't think I would actually be wearing it this soon, as it's not even Thanksgiving yet and I live in Georgia, but due to Global Warming, it was in the low 30's last night. I was thankful this arrived! It's even better than I expected! I ordered the 3X size because of my previous experience with VB clothing. I'm currently an 18/20 or 2X, but when I have ordered anything from VB with long sleeves, I have found them to be too tight in the shoulders. This fits loose (but not baggy) and isn't tight at all. I even wore this over another shirt without any difficulties. It's very soft. I find myself "petting" it. I love the pockets. They are actually connected so it's a kangaroo style pocket. It kept me very warm yesterday which I greatly appreciated.

title: So Soft!
text: My daughter loves these shorts! They're super soft, like butter. They fit her quite well. They're not tight or snug. They are white, so she does need to be careful as to which underwear she wears. She really wants a pair in another color!

title: Great Kit
text: I have been very pleased with this shoe cleaning kit. It comes with brushes as well as a cleaner. There's also an eraser to help with cleaning suede shoes. I have tried everything. The cleaning spray did a good job of whitening the edges of some sneakers. It didn't completely whiten it, but it was significantly cleaner afterwards. If I had spent more time on it, it may have gotten them whiter. The suede kit did a good (not great) job. It was gentle on the shoes and didn't hurt them. It seems like there was some improvement. Overall, I would recommend this.

title: Comfortable!
text: My daughter does a lot of hiking. These socks are comfortable for her. They're padded. They have been good at preventing blisters. They keep her feet dry. All the things that are necessary when wearing hiking boots. They seem to be well made. She likes the look of them, too.

title: Better Than Expected
text: With Gap being an affordable mall brand, I wasn't sure if I would like this or not. I am pleased to announce that it is better than expected. My daughter is usually a size Large in tops, though she often sizes down for a fitted look. I ordered this in a large. She said it's slightly snug, but that's the way she likes it. It's a long length that doesn't rise up when stretching. It's a basic wardrobe staple!

title: Great Support
text: My daughter loves a good sports bra. She is very pleased with this one by Fabletics. She's a size 34D and the large size fits her very well and offers great support. The sides are longer and go past her rib cage which makes it good for wearing as a top for exercising or lounging. It has good compression and shape. It's a winner!

title: Runs Small
text: This breastfeeding bra either runs small or it's just not intended for women who have more up top. It's wearable, but because of the sizing, there's a lot more spillage than preferred. The material is super soft. The color is a nice neutral one.

title: Cute Christmas Top!
text: I get into the Christmas spirit as soon as Thanksgiving is over. I try to wear holiday shirts as much as I can. This is a very cute Christmas top.  The shirt fits pretty well, but could be better. The arms are a tad snug, but not so much that I can't wear it. I am very pleased with the length of this -neither too long nor too short. This will definitely make it into my holiday apparel rotation!

title: Snug
text: During the month of December, I enjoy wearing holiday themed shirts. I liked the look of this one. It's very different from all of the other ones I own. The colors are bright. The printing is good. I found it to be a little snug in the arms. It's not so much that I wouldn't wear it though. It isn't an uncomfortable fit. What I don't like about it is the material. I never realized how picky I am about fabrics until recent years. It's similar to athletic fabrics. I have had some that I really like, but not this one. It's unnatural feeling to me. It's not breathable.

title: Good Fit!
text: This is a nice looking button down shirt. The fit is good and as expected. The fabric is soft, but thin. It's not sheer, but it is slightly see through. It does wrinkle a little, but throwing it in the dryer on the wrinkle setting works well on it.

title: Pretty!
text: I am a huge fan of Vera Bradley items. This Bella Taylor wallet reminds me a lot of VB. The floral fabric print is pretty. The construction of the wallet is excellent. There are lots of pockets for organizing your cash or receipts. This is a lot prettier than using the envelope method for your cash budgeting! I'm very impressed with this and I am very interested in learning what other products they carry.

title: True Sizing
text: These Super Mario Brother's t-shirts are cute! They have true sizing. The quality of the shirts are very good. They're soft & comfy. I do think the grey shirt is harder to see. The pink doesn't show up well on the grey. I would prefer either a lighter grey or a darker pink. Overall, these are fun shirts and great for Mario fans.

title: Awesome Mickey Mouse Cap
text: This is an awesome Mickey Mouse ball cap. It's much nicer than I expected. Mickey is embroidered nicely. I love the little embroidered Mickey glove on the back.  I am going to have my husband wear this to our upcoming Disney trip!

title: Cute Hate & Glove Set
text: This is a cute hate & glove set. I like that it's reversible. It seems to be well made. I had my 12 year old nephew try it on and it was too small on him. It stretches a little, but not enough. I think it would fit better on 8 & 9 year olds. The sizing is 8 to 16 and I don't think it would fit most 16 year olds!

title: Maternity Wardrobe Staples
text: The items in this maternity clothing set are wardrobe staples. You get a tank, leggings, long sleeve top and a short sleeve dress. The items are all super soft and stretchy. The fabric is slightly see through when stretched a lot. The pieces can be worn in various combinations or individually with other pieces in your closet. This is definitely a good start to your pregnancy wardrobe. The set is a little on the pricey side. It's not terrible when you break it down to 4 separate pieces. When you look at it that way, the price per item isn't that bad at all. Have you priced maternity clothes lately? If you buy anything from a specialized maternity store, $50 per item is quite reasonable.

title: Cute & Comfortable
text: My daughter needed some new shoes that she could wear to her college professional events. She had a black pair of flats, but thought brown ones would be a nice change. Sometimes she has multiple events in one week, so this also allows her to space them out so one pair doesn't get worn down too quickly. These are cute and comfortable. She loves that these are synthetic and not leather. She also really likes the stitching around the top. The sizing fits as expected. She is very happy with these.

title: Love the Material!
text: I didn't read the description thoroughly before ordering, so I was expecting this to be a cotton fabric that required ironing. I was thrilled to learn that this is a knit and doesn't require as much ironing! If you take it out of the dryer and hang it up promptly, you don't need to iron it at all! The fabric is soft and very forgiving. The rocket design is fun. The buttons are securely sewn. The sizing seems to be accurate. Overall, it's a great, low maintenance shirt!

title: Fun Socks!
text: These are fun socks that remind my husband of our family trip to California where we visited Yosemite. The socks are a good thickness, neither too thick nor too thin. The sizing is good. They are comfortable. My husband really likes the scenery on them. These would make a great gift!

title: Light Weight
text: I don't usually have good luck with Levi's fitting me. I wear a size 18 jeans. These size 34 almost fit me perfectly. I have been losing weight lately under my doctor's guidance and I feel confident that they will be just right after a few more pounds. They are currently a little tight around my lower mid section. Although slightly tight, they are actually comfortable. The fabric is lighter weight than I expected for which I am glad. I was a little worried they would be heavy canvas ones like my husband often wears.

title: Super Cute!
text: This is a super cute rain jacket. It's light weight so I won't get too overheated when wearing it. The floral print is lovely. I really like that it has a long length. It doesn't stop at the waist. It goes to my mid thigh in the back. It's a bit shorter in the front. It's got to be the prettiest rain jacket I have!

title: Cute!
text: I live in the South and in the month of December, there are often warm enough days where I wear short sleeves. This shirt is great for those days, but it still leaves me feeling in the holiday spirit. It's light weight. The sizing is good and as expected.

title: Good Fit
text: In the month of December, I like wearing various holiday themed shirts. It just feels festive to do so. This Christmas Gnome shirt is cute. It's a cross between a sweatshirt and a long sleeve t-shirt. It is light weight like a t-shirt, but the cuff around the bottom and sleeves make it feel more like a sweatshirt. Either way, I like it. I'm in my 50's and I live in the South. So between menopause and mild winter weather, I don't want anything too heavy, so this is just fine for me. The fabric feels good. The decoration isn't too stiff. Overall, I like it.

title: Lovely Dress
text: This is a lovely dress. Even pregnant women deserve to wear something beautiful. I'm so glad the fashion industry has gotten rid of all the cutesy and ugly maternity outfits from years ago. The fabric of this dress is amazing! It's soft and stretchy. The dress goes through the multiple stages of pregnancy. It's flattering and universal. It can be worn casually or dressy depending on your accessories. I do think it's a bit pricey, but it's really nice!

title: Cute Design
text: My daughter is an outdoorsy person and was happy to get this new shirt. She likes her shirts to either be super baggy or a bit snug fitting. In my experience with Levi's, the sizing runs small. With that prior knowledge, I decided to order her regular size since a cropped shirt shouldn't be baggy. On her it is a slightly snug fit, which she likes. The design is cute and very outdoorsy.

title: Cute & Cheery!
text: These earrings are cute & cheery! They look just like the pictures. They're not too big. They add some sunshine to your day!

title: Soft Tee
text: This Vera Bradley tee is pretty soft. I am usually a 2X, but I ordered this in the 3X because of some previous experience I have had with Vera Bradley clothing. It fits quite nicely, but it's not as big as I would expect a 3X to fit. It's loose, but not baggy. I do like it. It's comfortable to wear and it's well made.

title: Great Jeans!
text: These are great jeans! There must be some truth to "you get what you pay for"! These are definitely more expensive than my usual jeans, but they also feel and look better than my usual jeans. They have a nice stretch. There a little lower rise than I prefer. They are very flattering.

title: Looks Nice When Wearing
text: This coat is a pretty good one. It looks really nice when I'm wearing it. Of course it's not cold enough to wear it outside, but I am excited to have it when it does turn colder. The coat is a bit light weight. I have had other wool coats that felt heavier. It's not a bad thing, lighter is very appropriate for Georgia winters. I did order a size larger just because I don't like tight coats. It's not as loose as I had hoped, but it does fit comfortably. I just don't think I can wear a big bulky sweater or sweatshirt underneath it. Luckily I don't usually wear bulky sweaters and sweatshirts! I'm not crazy about the buttons. They feel and look a bit cheap. I love the length. It almost reaches my knees (I'm 5'6"). Overall, I am happy with this.

title: Durable!
text: Earlier this year, I lost the luggage tag on my suitcase. It was one of those buckle style ones and it must have come undone in transit because when I picked my bag up at the baggage claim, it was gone. The next time I flew I had a similar Vera Bradley luggage tag. It is super durable! There's really no way that it will come off unintentionally. I wanted to order one for my daughter, so she is getting this one. Not only is it sturdy, but it's beautiful too! I wish Vera Bradley offered luggage tags in more prints!

title: Nice Cushion
text: These are not only cute slippers, they are also comfortable. The cushion is more than adequate. I did find them to be a bit snug. I have wide feet and they may not be intended for that.

title: Cute Jeans!
text: These are cute jeans. They have a really nice stretch to them. Unfortunately not enough stretch for me! The pant legs were too skinny for me. I knew that could be a problem for me, but I risked it anyway. And for the record, I have thick calves. I really like the raw edges.

title: Cute!
text: My daughter is in college and likes wearing beanies in the cooler weather. She also is a fan of Timberland products. She squealed when she saw this! It fits pretty well. The color looks great with her dark hair. I really think she wears beanies for fashion rather than warmth, but at least in doing so, she is keeping warmer! The hat is well made without any flaws.

title: Great Fabric!
text: This is a light weight, ribbed shirt. The sleeves go to the elbow so they cover my arm flab! The color is just like the picture. It's a comfortable shirt.

title: Comfy Foot Bed
text: These are simple but cute boots. They have a comfortable foot bed and great traction. There's a loop on the back to help get your foot into the boot. I have a wide foot and I could fit into these boots, but it was too tight in the toe area. They would be good for the cooler fall and winter weather.

title: Great Casual Socks
text: I love these socks! They are great casual socks. They're thin and perfect to wear with loafers. I like the assortment of colors/designs. As far as sizing goes, I am very happy with the way they fit. I wear a size 10W. My calves are also pretty thick. These fit nicely. They're not tight at all. I don't wear my socks all the way up, so these are just gathered around the tops of my ankles. There's adequate stretch to these. I also think they're reasonably priced enough that I am considering ordering another set in a different color/design.

title: Cute Image
text: This tee shirt has a cute, Peter Pan image. The image is done well and isn't stiff. The shirt size fits as expected. I like most things about this shirt. What I didn't care for was the neckline. I think a slight scoop would look better. While it's not tight, the neckline looks unnaturally placed high. I know this is a personal issue for me and others may not feel the same way, that's why I did not give it a low rating.

title: Unisex Adult Sizing
text: I ordered these pajamas for my daughter. She's in college, but loves to wear Christmas pajamas! Usually, she'll open a pair on Christmas Eve, but I did make her try them on so I could review it now. I was impressed with the material. It's 100% organic cotton. It has a nice heft to it. It's definitely a quality set of pajamas. The sizing was good. They were a little loose, but that just makes them more comfortable. I would definitely recommend these.

title: Good Quality
text: This is a nice quality, outdoor activity shirt. The material is light weight and well suited for adventure. The sizing is way off, but I'm not surprised. I find Levi's jeans to run small, too. I ordered the 2XL. I could get it on and still move, but it was definitely tight on me. Funny thing is, I didn't hate it! I started thinking, "if I loose some weight.....". I actually may see if my daughter wants it, though I suspect it would be a little big on her.

title: Soft & Stretchy
text: I ordered these jeans for my daughter. The fit was a little snug, but not bad enough that she can't wear them. They have a good stretch to them. The fabric is also very soft. It's a dark wash, which I like a lot. My daughter is neutral about that. They are really a nice pair of jeans.

title: Comfy!
text: I love wearing holiday shirts during December. I am usually a 2X, but I've had difficulties with some similarly styled shirts not fitting me well and being too tight. This shirt is a 3X and it fits well. It's a little loose, but not baggy. It's actually very comfy. It's kind of flowy which I like. I am excited to be able to wear this soon.

title: Cute Christmas Top!
text: I like wearing holiday shirts around the holidays. I have gained weight since last year and feared that many of my shirts from last year would not fit. This 2X fits pretty well. The arms are a little snug, but not tight or restrictive. It should be noted that my upper arms are a bit thick and this is often a problem area for me, so it might not be a problem for others. The image printing is good. I'm picky about fabrics and this one doesn't bother me.

title: Well....
text: When I ordered these jeans, I did not realize they were maternity jeans. The short description that I read did not mention that not so little fact. So I ordered these for my daughter. Well....she doesn't need maternity clothing. The jeans seem to be fine. As someone who did wear maternity clothing 20 some years ago, I like the style of these. I really hated the large stretchy material that completely covered my belly. These have side panels that stretch as you grow so it looks nicer. I like that they don't look like typical maternity pants. I can't comment on the fit, but the quality looks to be good. If I had looked at all the pictures, I would have known right away that they were maternity jeans, but from the description, it wasn't clear.

title: Great Purse!
text: I am a long time fan of Vera Bradley bags and purses. This one is a new design for me. I like the shape of it a lot. It seems like a lot of the bags that go on your shoulder are over sized or also a crossbody. This one is sized well for someone like me with grown children and no need to carry a ton of stuff with me. The performance twill material is durable. The interior is a new floral print. I have several performance twill items and they used a different floral print prior to this one as far as I know. There's good storage inside. The zippers are sturdy and glide well. The shoulder strap is easy to adjust. Overall, it's another good purse by Vera Bradley!

title: Comfortable!
text: These are comfortable slippers. They have a good cushion. They're slightly narrow, but that's not really a problem. It helps the slipper to stay on better! I like the leopard print a lot!

title: Cute Shoes!
text: These are cute shoes! The heel isn't too high, so it is easy enough to walk in. I like the design a lot. The quality is on par with other shoes in this price range.

title: Good Fit!
text: The fit of this bra is good. The bra is nice looking. There's no lining, just the lace. I think I would benefit from some kind of lining. I could purchase some inserts or something like that.

title: Cute Fall Shirt
text: This is a cute fall/Halloween shirt. I love the kitty on it!! It's a soft, comfy shirt. I ordered the 2XL and it fits really well in the body, maybe just a tad big. It's a little longer than I would like. That says a lot because I like my shirts to be on the longer side so I'm not showing skin when I bend or reach. Of course I can tuck it in if I'm feeling confident. Overall I am pleased with it.

title: Cute Shoes!
text: My daughter has been wanting a pair of basic black low heels. She is thrilled with these! She says they are comfortable to wear. The fit is great. As much as she loves a gorgeous pair of tall stiletto heels, they're impractical for her on most occasions. These are much better suited for her needs. Of course, she does have a similar pair with heels almost double these which she wears for special occasions!

title: Perfect Fit!
text: As a plus size woman, I have found that not all plus size shirts are created equally! Well I am here to tell you that this is a perfect fit for me! The sleeves are a good length and they are not tight or restrictive. The length is long enough that  I won't be showing any skin when bending over or reaching up. It's light weight which is important for this menopausal woman. I am very pleased with it. I just might be checking out the other colors and ordering a second one.

title: Comfortable
text: These Levi's Maternity jeans are comfortable. The fabric that covers the belly has a great stretch to it to accommodate the growing size. The jeans fit as expected, but it should be noted that in my opinion and experience with the brand, their sizes run small. This was accounted for at the time of ordering so the sizing was as expected. They look hip and modern compared to a lot of other maternity clothing.

title: Nice, Thin Sweater
text: This is a nice, thin sweater. I like wearing sweaters in the winter months, but I don't like heavy or bulky ones. This one is perfect for me! I love the light green color. It seems to be well made. It is a low scoop neck sweater, so I need to make sure that I'm wearing an undergarment that pairs well with it.

title: Great Fit!
text: My daughter needed some black flats to wear. She is a college student and is an ambassador for her school. She needs to dress professionally at some of the events. These shoes are perfect for her. They have a great fit. They seem to be well made. She says they're pretty comfortable, too.

title: Comfortable!
text: I like sleeping in night gowns like this. The leopard print fabric is cute. The fit is great and as expected. The material could be softer, but it's fine. It's a comfortable night gown!

title: Fit is Okay
text: I really don't like this blouse. The fit is okay, but that's where it ends. There are a couple of things I don't like about it. First, the product description says it's polyester. It's not. The tag on it says 100% cotton. I am a fan of cotton products, but in tops, they wrinkle easily and don't flow as well as polyester or polyester blends. Also, I don't iron very often. I don't buy clothes that require regular ironing. Secondly, I don't like the sleeves. Their length is good. They just start about a quarter down the arm. It makes it look super puffy. I felt like a pirate in this shirt! I'm a plus size woman and I don't need a lot of extra puff! I am giving it 3 stars. I don't feel like I could go lower because it is my taste in shirts is personal to me and others may like it.

title: Great Basic Black Pump
text: As my daughter nears college graduation, she has been wanting to buy some classic and basic shoes so she's prepared for various occasions. These are great basic black pumps. The sizing is good. She wears a 9. Her feet are just a teeny bit wide. They're not wide enough for wide widths though. These fit her well.

title: Cute No-Show Socks
text: These are cute no-show socks. They are thin and light weight. I wear a size 10W shoe and there is adequate stretch so they fit fine. I like the cute Alice in Wonderland theme!

title: Great Star Wars Sweater!
text: I really didn't know that this was a sweater before ordering. I assumed it was a sweatshirt. So I was surprised to see that it is really a sweater! It's not too heavy. The length is great! It is long enough that it covers my back side when bending or stretching. My husband and I couldn't agree on whether or not the Vader image was printed or actually stitched. I really think it's stitched. This is really a great Star Wars sweater!

title: I Wish There Were More Colors!
text: I ordered this black top in the 2XL size. It fits very well and as expected. My arms aren't particularly long, but the sleeves fit more like a 3/4 sleeve rather than a long sleeve on me. I do have to be careful as to what undergarment I'm wearing because of the square neckline. I know it's also available in white, but I wish it was offered in more colors, too! It's really a cute top!

title: Adorable!
text: These little Under Armour baby booties are absolutely adorable! The quality is very good. They will keep your baby's toes nice and warm!

title: True Size Fit
text: This is a cute top. The size is true fit. I wear a size 18/2XL and this is a 2XL. It's not tight in the shoulders or bust. The length is good, too. It's long enough that it covers my lower back area when bending over or reaching. The sleeves are very flattering. They conceal my flabby bat wings! I'm not crazy about the material, but it's okay. It's a little stiffer than I prefer. Overall, I am satisfied with this new top.

title: Soft!
text: I was surprised at how soft this sweater was! It's well made and it fits great! This will be perfect for the cooler fall weather.

title: Darling!
text: This lemon purse is absolutely darling! There's no doubt as to what it is. The actual body of the purse is well made and seems durable. I do have some concerns about the chain strap. It is very light weight and I don't have a lot of confidence in it. However, should it break, the strap is an easy replacement.

title: 2 Pack Minnie Ears
text: My daughter and her friends are planning a trip to Disney. She wants everyone to wear mouse ears on the trip. This is a set of 2 different mouse ears. They are well made. I have not noticed any shedding of sequins. The headband fits my large head and is comfortable to wear, at least for a while! These are much more affordable than the ones you can purchase at the theme parks!

title: Great Key Chain!
text: This is a great key chain! Not only is it made with beautiful Vera Bradley fabric, but it's also durable and sturdy. The metal hardware is nice and strong. The key chain can be worn on your wrist, too. I have large wrists and I can put it on my wrist and remove it, but there's not a lot of room. I am really happy with this new key chain!

title: Cute Mouse Ears!
text: What a cute pair of Minnie Mouse ears! I love the pink and iridescent look. The ears fit my large head fine, though I'm doubtful that I would be able to wear them all day. I tend to get annoyed with headbands after a while. The sequins are securely attached. I haven't noticed any shedding of them. There is a small black mark on it. I've included a picture. It's not super noticeable, but it is there.

title: Nice Looking Shoes!
text: These are nice looking men's dress shoes! I ordered them for my husband. He doesn't have to dress up very often, but I thought it would be convenient to have slip on shoes rather than tie shoes. He has a couple of pairs of tie dress shoes already. The shoes are comfortable and offer good support. The sizing fits as expected.

title: Great Purse!
text: I love Vera Bradley! I have been a "collector" of VB purses for several years now! This is a new style to me. It has 2 different types of straps, plenty of pockets, and the whole thing zips up so you can keep your stuff from spilling out. The outside of the purse is a quilted black material. The interior is a gorgeous black & white floral print. The purse is an excellent quality as I would expect from Vera Bradley. It is a little larger than I anticipated, but if you look at the picture of it being worn on someone's shoulder, that will give you a good idea of the size.

title: Cute!
text: My college aged daughter and her friends are planning a Disney trip. I ordered these cute Minnie ears for that trip. The design is very cute. There are rose gold, black, bronzy or gold and pink sequins. The headband is comfortable. I tried it on my large head and it fit fine. Though I think I would have problems after wearing it or any headband for hours. The ears seem to be securely fastened to the headband. This one does shed a bit. After having it out for a little while, there were lots of black fuzzy pieces all over my desk.

title: Cute Cardigan
text: This is a very cute cardigan. I really like the scallop design around the neckline. The stripes are also nice. The sweater fits as expected. It will be great for extending the seasons of some of my summer dresses and blouses!

title: Packing Cube
text: This is more of a packing envelope than a packing cube. It's definitely not compression. My husband used it on a recent business trip. The instructions are easy to follow. My husband was able to get all 3 of his button down shirts in it. Then when he got to his hotel, he hung them up. He did feel the need to iron them, but had his room not come with an iron/ironing board, he says he would have been okay without ironing.

title: Deep V- Neckline
text: I wear a size 18, but lately I've been wearing my tops in size 2XL. My upper arms are large and regular XL or 1XL shirts have been tight in the shoulders or upper arms. This 2XL is slightly snug in the arms, but not in the way that it's tight and uncomfortable. I like the deep V-neckline. It's definitely a deep V and shows cleavage. The shirt color is true to the picture. Overall, I like this shirt.

title: True Size Fit
text: My daughter is a server at a restaurant. She quickly learned the importance of wearing special no-slip shoes on the job. She has another pair of work shoes, but she can be careless (and messy) when she's getting undressed and often misplaces one or both of her shoes. Then when she's getting ready for work, she's in a panic and gets stressed because she can't find her shoes. These shoes are a true size fit. She likes that they are slip on so she doesn't have to worry about tying them. They have a good foot bed and support. Their no-slip feature is excellent. She says they are very comfortable to wear at work, especially on long shifts.

title: Good Fit!
text: These hiking/golf pants are a good fit. I ordered my usual size. They're ever so slightly snug in the calf area, but my calves are thick so that's not unexpected. I do like them, but they are noisy when the fabric moves. I personally wouldn't wear them to work or casual events because of the noise they make.

title: Beautiful!
text: These are not only beautiful earrings, but they're definitely unique, too. I ordered these for my daughter. She's studying wildlife biology in college. One of her favorite classes so far was one on birds. These are realistic looking turkeys and not cartoony. The quality is good. I know she will have fun wearing them.

title: Confusing Label
text: I ordered this shirt for my son. When it arrived, I was looking at the label to see what the fabric was and I became confused. The label said that it was only to be worn by dogs. I know that you can get a matching one for your dog, but this is definitely not a dog cut shirt. We put a people shirt on our dog once, and the belly/front side dragged and hung down a lot. Dog shirts tend to be cut in a curve so they don't hang down like that. I ordered the 2XL (human) shirt. The shirt says it's a 2XL and when I hold it up to other 2XL shirts, it seems to match. It fits my son fine. The material is like a dry-fit or athletic material. The image looks good.

title: Cute PJs!
text: I am a long time fan of Vera Bradley products. These pajamas are super cute! I wear a size 18/1XL in most clothing. I do purchase some shirts in 2XL because I have thick upper arms and I hate for tops to be tight in the arms or shoulder area. Because of my personal experience with Vera Bradley clothing sizes, I ordered this in the 3XL. The shirt fits wonderfully! It's not tight in the shoulders. The buttons don't gape. I think that's the correct size for me. The shorts, though, are too big. They do have an elastic waist band and a draws string closure, but I find that I have to retie them frequently as they loosen up as I am wearing them. I think a 2XL in the bottoms would be better, had I been able to mix and match sizes. The quality is very good. The fabric is cotton, but it's not very soft. It did soften a little after washing it, but I would prefer a softer material. They are comfortable enough for sleeping and I am super picky about what I will sleep in!

title: Good Quality
text: I am a size 18. I ordered this Vera Bradley zip up hoodie in the 2XL. While it does fit, there's not a lot of extra room. I was wearing a short sleeve t-shirt fitted tee when I tried it on. I don't think I could have worn anything bulkier underneath it. I wish I had ordered the 3XL. I will definitely be able to wear this, but I will have to be aware of what else I am wearing. I love the floral print with the color block. It's a good quality garment. I love seeing Vera Bradley prints on clothing!!

title: Soft Sleep Shirt
text: This is a very soft sleep shirt by Vera Bradley. I love the pretty floral design. I wear a size 18, but lately I have been getting 2XL shirts because I like them to be loose. I ordered this in the 3XL because I have found that Vera Bradley shirts can sometimes run small and I didn't want that to happen. I am pleased with the fit. It's loose and comfortable, just like I wanted it to be. It doesn't look oversized or sloppy. I have the matching pants and I have to tell you, this is a super cute lounging outfit/pajama set!

title: Cute Umbrella
text: This is a cute umbrella. It also seems to be a good quality one as well. It opens smoothly & easily. It is fairly compact and easy to travel with.  It's kept me dry in the rain. I haven't been able to test how well it works in strong winds, but it if lets me down, I will definitely come back and up date my review.

title: Runs Small
text: I am a size 18. My shoulders and upper arms are problematic with some clothes, so I usually go with a 2XL. This 2XL is a 20-22 according to the product description. A 20/22 would normally be perfect! That wasn't the case. I could barely get the dress over my head. My husband helped me and then when I had it on, it was so tight and uncomfortable! He joked about cutting it off of me! I was able to get it off okay, but my estimate is that it's at least one size if not two sizes too small. The dress itself looks cute. The floral pattern and color is nice. The fabric is light weight, but definitely one that wrinkles easily.

title: Can't Wait for Cooler Weather!
text: I am so excited that Vera Bradley has included plus sizes in their clothing options. I remember many year ago when they kept to the standard sizes and nothing ever fit me! This pullover is adorable! I can't wait for cooler weather so I can wear it. I am probably closer to a size 2XL, but I ordered this in the 3XL. I was afraid if I didn't order up a size, I would be disappointed and it would be too tight in the shoulders and arms. I'm so glad I went up because it fits perfectly! I love the floral print. It reminds me of Florida!

title: Easy to Wear
text: The first thing that came to mind when I was trying this one was that it was easy to wear. I vaguely recall that being a clothing category back in the 1970's. It's easy to wear! It doesn't require a lot of fuss. The material is light but not see through. The dress fit as expected. The length grazed the floor when I was barefoot. (I'm 5'6"). There's a belt or sash included, but there are no belt loops of any kind, so I wasn't really sure how I was supposed to wear it. Overall, it's sort of cute. The fabric doesn't wrinkle, so it would make a nice travel dress.

title: Nice Jeans
text: These jeans didn't fit me. However, I'm not totally surprised. In my past experience with Levi Jeans, I have had to order a size up. I think they must not use vanity sizing like a lot of other companies do. I wore size 18 jeans in high school (1980's). I weigh about 60 pounds more now and I still wear size 18 jeans. So maybe I'm not really ordering a size up with Levi jeans, but rather ordering my true size. Oh well....... I could get this up and on, but I couldn't zip/button. I have decided to keep them because I am feeling optimistic with my current weight loss journey. The quality is nice. They have a good stretch to them. The length was a little long on me, but I like that. I'm 5'6" and they grazed the floor when I was trying them on barefoot.

title: Great Sparkle!
text: I haven't worn my wedding ring set for years. It's not just because it doesn't fit anymore. I was also getting annoyed by my diamond getting caught on things because it extended so much. This fits nicely. It has some great sparkle to it. It also doesn't protrude out too much so I haven't had any problems with it catching on things. I've worn it non-stop for over a week and I have been very pleased with it.

title: Cute Night Gown
text: This is a cute night gown. It's true size. I like the length a lot. The fabric is just okay. I like a lot of cotton/polyester blends, but this one isn't very soft. It's not scratchy or rough. It's just lacking softness.

title: Lovely Color
text: This shirt is a lovely color. The green looks just like the pictures. The image screen print is well done. The shirt is a decent quality. My only complaint is that it runs small. I wear a size 18 or 1XL. I ordered this in a 2XL and it is too snug on me. I like it though and will keep it around in case I'm successful with my weight loss.

title: Runs small
text: This is a decent quality shirt. It's not too thick or too thin. The color is beautiful. It seems to be well made, however it does run a bit small. I ordered a 2XL and it was very snug in the shoulders. I could put it on, but it wasn't comfortable. That's a shame because I really thought it was a nice looking shirt.

title: Nice Looking
text: This is a nice looking clear bag. I like the way it looks a lot better than the typical clear bags available. The size is just right for what I would need to take with me to any event. In fact, there's probably more space than I would need, so I could easily carry my husband's wallet and or phone, too. It comes with an adjustable strap. I found it a little difficult to adjust. It wasn't as easy as some other adjustable straps, but it does work. The clips seem to attach it securely to the bag.

title: Cute Shoes!
text: My 21 year old daughter thinks these are super cute shoes! They fit her well and as expected. The heel is stable and not too difficult to walk in. The straps were a little tight at first, but they've stretched enough that they're comfortable.

title: Great Lounge Pants
text: These are great lounge pants! They are soft and very comfy. I love the pretty floral design. The pants fit very well. It has a drawstring for a perfect fit. It even has pockets!

title: I Don't Hate It
text: I don't hate it. I know that sounds like an odd way to start off, but it's true. I actually rather like it. It fits nicely. The fabric is soft and reminds me of pajamas. If the material was a little more "professional" like in texture and touch, I would probably love it. But when I put this on, it's like I"m wearing lounge wear or pajamas. That's fine, but it would be nice if it was something I could wear out and about.

title: Great Shirt!
text: I'm picky about my shirts. This one is a great one! It fits great. It's long enough that it doesn't show my backside when I reach or stretch, but it's not too long like a tunic either. The shirt itself while not super soft, it is soft and comfortable. The daisy is done well. I hate it when I get a shirt with an image that has a large stiff decal on it. This one is screen print so that's not a problem. I would definitely consider ordering another one!

title: Nice Material
text: I don't have to dress business casual very often, but every now and then it's necessary. I was excited to try these pants. I wear a size 18 jeans and I ordered these in the XXL. They are a little too loose in the waist and crotch area. I think I could have gotten by with the XL. There are no belt loops, so I can't easily remedy the loose waist. I like the material. It isn't going to wrinkle badly so it would be great for travel. The length was fine. I really liked how the legs look in them. Front pockets are real, but the back pockets are fake.

title: Comfortable
text: I normally don't wear leggings, but I couldn't resist these because they're Vera Bradley! They are a sturdy fabric with a decent amount of stretch. I wear a size 18 jeans and I ordered the XXL. My calves are pretty thick, so I was concerned about the fit, but they fit perfectly. They don't stifle movement or activity. I like the Vera Bradley print!

title: Cute Design
text: I am a long time Vera Bradley fan. I got my first VB tee shirt this past spring from their Star Wars collaboration line. This shirt has a good fit, though I wish it was a little more feminine in its shape. It's kind of boxy. I love the blue color. The floral design is cute. The overall quality of the tee shirt is quite nice.

title: Great!
text: My daughter is in college and likes to attend the football games. She needed a new clear bag to use on game day. She's been using stylish fanny packs lately, so she decided to go with a clear fanny pack. It seems to be a decent quality. The zippers work fine. The belt is adjustable. It meets the school's bag policy.

title: Good Fit!
text: I'm always looking for cute tops to wear. I like the non-traditional colors of this leopard print. This shirt fits as I expected. I ordered the 2X and I currently wear a 2X or 18/20. I'm not crazy about the fabric. It's 100% polyester and definitely has an artificial feel to it. It's not scratchy or anything. I think I have been lucky to find a lot of super soft tops lately made from bamboo or viscose. This will look cute paired with black jeans.

title: Really Big!
text: I ordered these shorts for my 24 year old son. They either run a bit large or I should have ordered a size down. They are really big on him. He wore them to mow the lawn today and he had to stop and retie them a couple of times because they kept creeping down. The fabric is soft. The quality seems to be fine.

title: Beautiful!
text: This is a beautiful watch. I was so excited to get it. I have large wrists and since this uses a traditional watch strap rather than a band with links, I was hopeful that it would fit me. Unfortunately, it's too tight. I can get it on my wrist and fasten it, but then it is very tight and it doesn't look good because my wrist is squeezed too much. The quality of the watch seems to be good. I will probably give it to my daughter.

title: Snug Fit
text: This is a cute cropped denim jacket. The color is cream or ivory, not white. I ordered this for my 21 year old daughter. I selected her usual size, but it's a little snug. I should have sized up for a more comfortable fit. The quality of the jacket is good.

title: Comfortable Bra!
text: While this bra is called a lounge bra, it does offer a little support. The fit is as expected. It's a very comfortable bra. There is a brand logo on the front.

title: Good Fit
text: I followed the size guide that was in the product description. I found that to be a pretty good fit. The suit bottom is a good quality. Construction seems fine. Overall, I am satisfied with it.

title: Good Construction
text: As with most of the Vera Bradley items I've owned, this bag has good construction. It's well made and durable. As a travel bag, I think I would use it for additional items and not as my main luggage. There's barely enough space for a weekend's amount of clothing and toiletries. But for laptop, planner, note pad, & books, it is plenty roomy. I think it would also work well as a diaper bag. It just has that feel to it. There are plenty of pockets and storage for all kinds of stuff.

title: Great Fabric!
text: This shirt is made from a great fabric. It's soft and doesn't seem to wrinkle much. It's also light weight. The fit of the shirt is as expected. I like the scoop neck. The shirt is much longer than I expected. I had not checked out the additional product photos which show how long it is. In the first picture, the front of the shirt is tucked in so it doesn't show the full length. Overall, this is a good shirt and will be great for fall.

title: Really Cute!
text: I ordered this Adidas lounge bra for my 21 year old daughter. She thinks it's really cute. I ordered the Large size for her without even looking at the size chart. She's a 36C. The fit is pretty good, maybe a tad small, but she is pleased with the look. Because of the deep plunge, she thinks it looks more like a swimsuit top than a bra. It's definitely not a sports bra. It gives her a lot of cleavage and if she wore it for sports, there's the worry that her girls would pop out! Plus there's just not a lot of support. But for lounging around the apartment, it's great! It's lined, but there are no cups and it does show nips. She likes this bra a lot!

title: Comfortable
text: These are beautiful casual dress shoes. My daughter has been wearing them with sundresses and is very pleased with how cute they look. The foot bed is pretty comfortable. They're stable and easy to walk in. The raffia material is a little scratchy but not unbearable. The sizing fits as expected.

title: Cute!
text: This mini pouch wallet is made well and is an excellent quality. It's what I would expect from the Vera Bradley name. The floral print is delicate and pretty. This wallet would be great for a college student or for travel. It doesn't have a lot of space for cards, but it can contain the basics. I used it on a recent vacation and it held my drivers license and 2 bank cards. That's really all I needed. There's a sturdy clip on this so you can attach to a larger bag if needed.

title: Good Fit!
text: This shirt has a good fit. It's cute. The length is good - I dislike shirts that are too short and show my skin when I reach over and this does not. I'm not in love with the fabric. It's okay and I will wear it. It's just not very soft. It doesn't seem to wrinkle, so that's good.

title: It Fits!
text: As a plus size woman, it's always exciting when I order clothing online and it actually fits! This fits nicely and as I had hoped. The shirt is a little low cut and it requires that I arrange my bra a little bit so it doesn't show. It's a cute, flowy top. The criss cross design adds a little fun to the look.

title: Great Fit!
text: I like wearing dresses, but my thighs chafe which can be painful. These are a good solution. They're thin so they're not adding a lot of extra bulk. They're also light weight, so they're okay to wear in the summer when I am more likely to wear a dress. I followed the size chart and they fit great! I do want to mention that they did not arrive in any kind of poly bag or anything. Instead the label was stuck to the actual item bag, so the contents were visible. Plus, the bag they come in has a zipper style closure that would have been easy for someone to open.

title: Good Fit!
text: It makes me happy when I can order a pair of shoes online and have them fit! I have wide feet and most of the time, I'm unlucky. These fit well. It probably helps that they're open on the sides and have adjustable straps. They are comfortable to wear. The soles are cushioned a bit, but they have minimal arch support. They have more support than what basic flip flops have, but not a lot. I probably wouldn't wear these hiking but for kayaking or walking on the beach they would be fine.

title: Easy to Use
text: I wear Croc flip flops all the time. I have several pairs. I used a 5 gallon bucket. I started by adding about a gallon or so of warm water. Then I started thinking about water displacement and decided to stop until I knew how much room I had left AFTER my shoes were in the bucket. I was able to get at least 5 pairs of my flip flops into the bucket plus a pair of my son's athletic slides. Then I added more water. I probably ended up closer to 3 gallons of water, maybe a little more. I only used 2 tablets. I put the lid on the bucket to keep the shoes submerged. The next morning, I removed the shoes and rinsed them in the sink. The remaining water was gross! I really couldn't see much difference in my shoes, but they did smell better!  I do like that these are plastic free. I do think it could add up, depending on how often you clean your shoes. I should have used at least 3 tablets which is half of what I got. I was only able to fit about half of my flip flops in the bucket at a time.

title: Snug in the Arms
text: I used to wear blazers all the time, back in the 1990's. I was excited to try them again. This is a nice quality blazer. It is lined and has pockets. The overall fit is good. However, the arms are a little snug on me. I have thick arms which can be problematic, so it wasn't a complete surprise. If I tone my arms a bit, the problem may be resolved.

title: Stylish!
text: These sunglasses are quite stylish. The oversize frames are fun! The glasses arrived flat which concerned me at first since they arrived in a poly bag, but they were fine. They don't feel cheap. It's nice to have new shades!

title: Works in the Pool!
text: My son has been wanting a watch that he can wear swimming. This one works fine in the pool! The face is pretty big and easy to read. It works well and looks sporty!

title: Great Purse!
text: I am loving this crossbody purse by JW PEI. It's a great, smaller bag which is all I need these days. The flap on the front uses magnets to stay closed. The bag comes with a storage bag to keep it clean and dust free. I am very impressed with this bag!

title: Super Cute!
text: These Sperry slip on shoes are super cute! The sizing fits as expected. They seem to be made well. I am expecting them to get dirty quickly, but they are washing machine friendly!

title: Gorgeous Heels!
text: These are gorgeous heels! Not only are they beautiful, but they are comfortable (for heels!). The fit is pretty good. Since the heel is wide, they're pretty easy to walk in.

title: Very "Punny"
text: I ordered this shirt for my 24 year old nerdy son. He found it very "punny". The shirt is a good quality. It's fits as expected. The graphics are printed well.

title: Sheer!
text: I love this swimsuit cover up! It's so simple! There are sleeves, but they are not traditional sleeves. The fabric is connected in just a small piece. There is no belt or sash. . It's basically a sheer, light weight open front poncho. I love that there's no production involved in putting it on, yet it provides coverage when you're wearing your swimsuit. This has got to be one size fits all! Or at least one size fits several!

title: Comfortable!
