text: My son almost always wears a white undershirt underneath whatever he's wearing. These shirts are comfortable. They're not too thick so they work well under his polo shirts. The fit is as expected. They seem like quality shirts.

title: Pretty Shoes!
text: These are pretty shoes. They are sturdy for being heels. I wear a size 10 wide in women's and sometimes I can get by in 11's. Unfortunately the foot bed was too narrow for me. I could wear them, but I don't want to be that person with the sides of my feet hanging off the shoe! I am not totally surprised. I knew it was a gamble. Even though they didn't fit my wide feet, they were comfortable to wear.

title: Nice Looking Skirt
text: This is a nice looking skirt. The length is great. It's a good fit. I don't love the fabric. It's okay, but I would prefer something a little softer. It does seem to be flowy and have good movement.

title: Stretches a Bit
text: These slip on shoes were  pretty snug at first. However, they do stretch a little and now they fit perfectly. They are comfortable to wear. There's adequate support. I am pleased with them so far.

title: Modern Denim Shirt!
text: I ordered this modern looking denim shirt for my 21 year old daughter. I wasn't sure if she would like it, but she does. She is a fan of cropped tops already, so this was a fun way to incorporate denim tops into her life. The sizing fits as expected. She's gotten several compliments from it.

title: Adjustable Chain
text: This is a pretty necklace. The moonstone is more of a milky/clear color than bluish as I expected. It takes on the color of whatever it's up against. The chain is adjustable for different lengths. It has a standard lobster claw clasp.

title: Pretty!
text: These are pretty moonstone earrings. The setting is very nice. The stones are not really that blue at all as I was expecting. They're milky/clear stone that takes on the color of its surroundings.

title: Love!
text: I love this robe! I took it with me this past weekend when I went to visit my sister. I used it as a swimsuit cover up to her backyard pool and as a robe in the morning before I got dressed. It's light weight and very comfortable. There are even pockets!! I ordered the 2XL/3XL. I probably could have gotten away with the previous size, but this definitely worked. I didn't even mention how cute it is! I am very pleased with it.

title: Cute, Basic Skirt
text: This is a cute, basic skirt. The fit is good and as expected. It's comfortable to wear. It could be both casual and dressy depending on your shoes and top.

title: Comfortable
text: My son loves this brand of underwear. He says these are very comfortable. He likes the style. The material is slightly cooling.

title: Great Black Tees!
text: I love these black tees! They are great! The fabric is slightly stretchy and very comfortable. They fit as expected. The scoop neck is flattering. It's not too deep of a scoop. I like that this comes with 2. I tend to wear black tees a lot, so it's great having multiple ones.

title: Cute Top!
text: This is a cute, casual top. I ordered it in the 2XL. It fits pretty well, though the little buttons/snaps gape a little, which implies that it's a little snug. Though it doesn't feel snug or tight at all. I like the ribbing in the fabric. The shirt is a good length with not being too short nor too long. It's a nice variation of the basic black tee.

title: A Wardrobe Staple!
text: These basic v-neck tee shirts are a wardrobe staple! They are soft and comfortable. The fit is perfect. I like that they are a little long so when I reach or bend over I am not showing skin. I am very pleased with these and will probably order more!

title: Snug in the Top
text: I like the length of this dress on me. I'm 5'6" and it goes to the top of my foot. The fabric is light weight and very wrinkly. I'm not one who irons, so this fabric is not for me! The cut of the dress is cute, but I found the neck and chest area to be a little snug and not flattering in the way it looked in the upper arm/chest area.

title: Nice Looking!
text: These are nice looking pants. I was pleasantly surprised with how well they fit. I wear a size 18 jeans. I ordered these in the 2XL. They fit perfectly! I was a little unsure which side was the front. The tag is on the side and there is a small zipper on one side. The other side has a single crease down the middle of the legs. I went with the zipper in the back because of the crease. It looked right when I have them on. I just thought the zipper in the back was weird. I've had zippers in the front and on the sides, but never in the back. The pants are very flattering looking. I really like the fabric.

title: Decent Quality
text: My daughter will be graduating from college next spring. She wants to decorate her cap, but wanted a spare just in case she messed up. This one is a good quality and comparable if not better than the one she can get through her school. It's also pretty affordable in case she needs another one!

title: Cute Swimsuit!
text: This is a cute swimsuit. It fits as expected. I like the sarong skirt a lot. There's plenty of support where support is needed. The color is gorgeous! It's what I would call a "hot tub" suit or something I would only wear in private or with a few close friends/family. I wouldn't feel comfortable wearing any kind of bikini in public at my age! But I can't fault the swimsuit for that!

title: Nice Watch
text: My daughter is working at a camp this summer. The camp staff needs to know what time it is and they aren't allowed to have their phones with them. She also didn't want to take her Apple Watch in case something happened to it. She just finished her first week and she says she really likes this watch. First, she really likes the pink color. It was very easy to set the time. She's gone kayaking in it without any problems. It also survived a week in the outdoors, which is a good testament to the quality. She said it does seem to get bumped easily and change the time. She said she's going to start wearing it so the face is facing the other way. Overall, she is very pleased with it.

title: Great Fit!
text: I am very happy with these shirts. They are soft and comfortable. They are a great fit and fit as expected. I like that the length is long enough in the back (and front) that I'm not showing skin when I reach up or bend over.

title: An Affordable Option
text: My son just graduated from college. He ordered his cap & gown from the school sanctioned vendor. It was over $100. There were some nice touches that were for his school such as gold piping and school crest on the chest. My daughter will be graduating from college next year. Her best friend just graduated from the same school and their cap & gown was plain black. There were no special touches that made it stand out. So as long as that holds true, she is going to use this set instead of ordering the expensive one from the school. This one seems to be a good quality. It doesn't look or feel cheap. It's definitely an affordable option. It comes with a 2022 & a 2023 charm for the tassel.

title: Very Soft!
text: This skirt is very soft. I like the style with the slits on the sides. I ordered this in the XXL, but I think I could have gotten away with the XL. I wear a size 18 jeans. They are loose on me, but not to the point of falling down. This will be great for summer!

title: Love Love Love!
text: I love this case! It's perfect! It is very well made. I haven't used it on an actual trip yet, but I did try it out and test all the zippers, pockets, etc. There's a surprising amount of room. I am hopeful that it will fit under the seat on the airplane. Just from eyeballing it, it seems like it will. Though of course, foot space will be limited. It rolls very nicely. The telescoping handle is probably the easiest one I've ever used. It pulls up without any hitching or stopping. I like the floral interior. I do have a few Vera Bradley luggage pieces and they all have had issues with the wheels. There's a cover on them that tends to pop off easily when using it. I don't know if it will happen with this one, but it has happened on 3 other similar pieces of mine.

title: Cute!
text: This black, flowy blouse is better than I expected. When I first saw it in person, I wasn't really impressed. It sat on my dresser for a few days before I even tried it on. When I did try it on, I noticed it was just slightly tight going over my head, so I expected it to be tight on me, but it really wasn't. I love the way the sleeves look and feel! They are very flowy! This will look super cute with a long maxi skirt! I only wish it was a tad longer. I fear that if I raise my arms up, it will show some skin.

title: Pretty!
text: This is a pretty bar necklace. It has a good clasp that I found easy to use. Some necklaces have difficult to use clasps and every now and then I have to ask my husband for help. This one was no trouble to put on and take off by myself. I would prefer if the chain was just a little bit longer, but it's okay. The quality seems to be nice.

title: Good Tread
text: These Saucony shoes are a size 11.5. In some brands, that size works for my husband. These were a little snug on him. He says that they're not too tight, just a little snug. They may stretch a bit over time. They have good tread. There is adequate arch support. They look nice.

title: Supportive Shoes
text: These men's Saucony shoes are supportive and comfortable. They fit as expected. My husband wears a size 11.5 usually, but these are a size 12. They are a little large, but there's no problems with that. Good arch support. Excellent traction. He likes that these are mostly black with no bright colors adorning them.

title: Comfortable
text: These shoes are great for kayaking. My husband is very happy to have these. They fit as expected. They are very comfortable. The foot bed is adequately cushioned and supportive. The lace lock - bungee system is easy to use and stays in place well. The bottoms have very good traction.

title: True Fit
text: I have been wearing Saucony shoes for a few years now. They're one of the few shoe brands that I can order without trying on first. I can count on their shoes being true fit. This pair is no exception. I have wide feet and it's hard to find shoes that fit period! Let alone being able to order them online. These are running shoes and I am not a runner. I do find them to be less cushiony than I am used to. Maybe it's because they are running shoes. They are still comfortable to wear. I like the black and silver colors.

title: Great Fit!
text: This 2 piece tankini swimsuit fits great! I followed the recommendations for sizing and I am very pleased with how it fits and looks. It's actually nice enough to wear in public! It's very flattering and comfortable to wear.

title: Great for Travel!
text: These Vera Bradley pouches are great for travel! I hate it when my travel bag gets full of loose stuff. Keeping items in pouches gives me the organization that I need. I love the little clear bag! It's always helpful when you can see what's inside without opening. The bags are in different sizes and each one looks different, yet they all coordinate and look good together. The quality is very good and what I have learned to expect from Vera Bradley. This would make a great gift!

title: Surprised By How Cute It Looks On Me
text: I am a plus size middle aged woman. I currently wear a size 18 jeans, but 2XL tops. I say currently because I'm trying to lose weight now, but we'll see......I ordered this in a size 20. Not only does it fit well, but I was surprised by how cute it looks on me! Of course it doesn't change the fact that I am overweight, but it is kind of flattering. I would actually wear this in public! That there says a lot. There are a lot of swimsuits that I would only wear to our backyard hot tub. The cups were a good size - not too large or small. I am very pleased with this.

title: Supportive Shoes
text: I have wide feet. I discovered several years ago that Saucony shoes have a great selection of wide sizes! I've been wearing them ever since! My shoe size is a 10.5 Wide, but not all 10.5 wides fit the same. Saucony is the only brand I can order online without trying them on and know that they will fit. These are just ever so slightly snug across the top of my foot. I do feel confident that they will stretch a little. The toe area is just fine. These shoes offer good support. They are very comfortable. I like the grey and raspberry color combo.

title: Cute!
text: My daughter needed some new dressy sandals. I saw these and ordered them for her. The size is good and they fit as expected. The shoes are well made. She wore them to her brother's college graduation which involved a lot of walking on our part. She said they were comfortable to wear and didn't annoy her. Plus, they look cute!

title: Thin & Light Weight
text: These men's pajama pants are thin & light weight. That could be good or bad. If you're looking for warmth, keep looking. The material is not very soft. The fit is fine. My husband wears pajama pants in the mornings when he comes downstairs for his coffee. For his purpose, it's adequate. He doesn't love them, but he says they're okay.

title: As Described
text: This is not my first clear bag of this size. However, I noticed that my previous one had developed a cloudy appearance over time and did not look good any more. I needed a new clear bag. I used it yesterday at my son's college graduation. The size was more than big enough for the items I needed to take. I had a small wallet, my phone, a few face masks, and my elderly father's insulin & blood sugar reader in it. There was a little more space available had I needed it. The outer zippered pocket was big enough to hold my phone, but I found that my phone would kind of stick to the plastic surface in it, so I kept it in the large section. The straps were easy to adjust. I wore it as a crossbody bag. The zippers glided easily. Overall, I am satisfied with it.

title: Nice Wallet
text: My son's wallet had seen better days.  I ordered this as a replacement. It's very nice looking. It has a good feel to it. It doesn't feel cheap at all. It has enough space for his ID and cards. It arrived in a small gift box.

title: High Quality Shirt
text: This plain tee shirt is very high quality. It's not thin or light weight. The fit is as expected. I ordered it for my son who likes to wear white tees under his polo shirts. He does think it might be too heavy to wear under his shirts in the hotter months. It does have the CK logo on the chest.

title: Cute 3 Piece Outfit
text: This Shrek themed baby outfit is pretty cute. The set includes a hat, onesie and pants. The material is soft and doesn't irritate the baby's skin. The sizing seems to be good. It would make a nice baby gift!

title: Great Fit!
text: My daughter and I were unfamiliar with shirt jackets or shackets. She was very intrigued with the idea. The style is definitely like a shirt, but the material is heavier like a jacket. The fit is good. She's 5'7" and wears a size medium/large. It's slightly over sized, but not baggy. She likes it a lot!

title: Cute!
text: When deciding on what size to order, my daughter went with XL. She is usually a medium/large, but she really likes her clothes to be baggy. These are baggy on her, but not in a bad way. They actually look cute on her. She did have to adjust the straps a lot for a good fit. She is working at a camp this summer and she plans to wear these once a week at camp. The length is appropriate for the camp environment.

title: Flattering!
text: My 20 year old daughter is 5'7". These are just a tad long on her, but not too much that she can't wear them. I ordered her usual size and they're a little snug. Fortunately, they have some good stretch to them, otherwise she wouldn't be able to fit in them. They are very flattering on her. She is happy with them.

title: Cute Bag
text: This purse is cute. It's divided into 3 compartments. In the center, there is a zippered pocket and a slip pocket. Prior to ordering this, I was unfamiliar with Tom Clovers. I'm still pretty clueless. I tried looking online, but I didn't find anything helpful. The bag has no markings that indicate that it's a Tom Clovers product. The interior lining says beibooboo all over, whatever that means. I just found that to be very odd.

title: Cute Slippers!
text: I wear casual Clarks all the time. I wear a size 10 Wide, but I find that with Clarks, I need to go with 11W. These are not wide, but I was hoping there would be wiggle room since they're slippers and not shoes. Unfortunately, they did not fit me. The foot bed is too narrow for me. Even with the Velcro, it didn't work. They are super cute though. And they are well made as far as I can tell. I'm going to pass them along to my sister. I know she will be thrilled with them!! They are perfect for taking the dogs out in the early morning!

title: Cute Little Purse
text: This is a cute little purse. It's a crossbody style. The strap is easy to adjust. I was a little confused with the metal chain. Until I looked at the product description again, I thought it was just an alternative handle, but from the pictures, it's purely decorative. I like the color. I would call it a rose pink. There's a slip pocket on the exterior front of the bag which easily fits a cell phone. The bag has a zippered closure and the zipper works well. It doesn't stick.

title: It Fits!
text: I am a plus size mom. I currently wear an 18/20. I'm a 42DD. This bikini top does fit. I wouldn't call it full coverage. Or at least I'm not fully covered. That's okay. My husband likes it! I wouldn't wear this in public, but it's fine for the hot tub. I have had difficulties getting it to feel comfortable around the neck. When I loosen it, "the girls" aren't up as much. When I tighten it, it hurts the back of my neck. I suppose it could be the style. Overall, it;s okay.

title: Adjustable Velcro
text: These slippers are beautiful! I was so excited to get them. I wear several different Clark shoes, so I was already familiar with the brand. These slippers are super cute! Unfortunately they didn't fit my wide feet! I wear a 10W. I can wear 11's in a lot of shoes, but with my other Clarks, I wear 11W. These weren't available in wide for me, so I went with just an 11. The foot bed or insole is just too narrow for me. I was hoping since the slippers have the adjustable Velcro, it would be okay, but it wasn't.

title: Comfortable
text: I followed the sizing guidelines and went with the 4XL size. I would say it fits pretty well. It's comfortable but not very supportive. It would be perfect for lounging or sleeping. The straps aren't adjustable which if they were, you would be able to lift a little. I did have some issues with the pads getting messed up. There is a large access point where I was able to straighten them.

title: Batman Romper
text: This Batman romper & hat set is great for summer! Sizing is good and as expected. The fabric is soft and comfortable. It seems to be made well. There are no obvious defects.

title: So Comfortable!
text: My first reaction to these shoes was that they looked a bit odd. But after trying them off, who cares! They are the most comfortable shoes ever! Then when I learned about all the recycling and sustainability efforts, I  was even more in love with these shoes. I wear a 10 wide in women's shoes. I ordered the 11's. They're a tad long in the foot, but the width is perfect. Often when I purchase 10's, they're too tight in the width. I am very impressed with these shoes.

title: Cute!
text: This Tigger themed outfit is really cute. It is a set of shortalls, shirt, and bucket hat. The material is soft and comfortable. The sizing seems true size. This will be perfect for summer playtime.

title: Versatile
text: I love how versatile this crossbody bag is by Chums. It's easy to switch positions on the straps. Once in place the straps are secure. The zippers glide easily. It is a small bag but there's enough room to carry important essentials.

title: Comfortable
text: I was surprised with how comfortable these sandals are! I wear a size 10 Wide. I often order a size up if there is not a wide option. Usually about half the time, the 11's will work. These 11's work just fine! They are very comfortable. There's plenty of arch support. The straps are easy to adjust. These will be perfect with a long flowy maxi skirt!

title: Good Shirt
text: This is a good shirt by Columbia. I like that it looks like a regular shirt and not like a lot of those sun-protective shirts. The shirt doesn't have any stretch to it. I wear a size 18/1X and if there was good stretch to it, I would probably be able to wear it, but unfortunately it doesn't fit. The brand name is on the sleeve. On the lower front is "omni shade" to indicate that it's specifically a sun protective garment.

title: So Sweet!
text: This baby set is so sweet! It is all princess themed. It includes pajamas, headband, blanket, and burp cloth. The pieces are all soft. Construction is good. This would make a great baby gift, but please be aware that it comes in a clear poly bag. There are no tags on any of the items like you would get from a purchase at the store in person.

title: Nice Hiking Shoes
text: These are nice hiking shoes. These are my 4th pair of Eddie Bauer hiking footwear. Two pairs fit perfectly, and two do not. These are one of the ones that don't fit. They're all Eddie Bauer and they're all the same size. Just goes to show how different shoes can fit from shoe to shoe. I wear a 10 Wide shoe. I've ordered these in size 11. This pair and the other one that didn't fit feel too tight across the toes. From examining these, they are nice shoes. They have great traction. The insole is comfortable and supportive. They're super cute!

title: Cute!
text: I recently had success with another pair of Trish Lucia chunky heel mules, so I was excited to give these a try. I normally wear a size 10W. The band on the other pair was large enough to accommodate my foot. In fact, I even commented that they may not work for narrower feet. The band on these is snug, but I thought they were fitting. But that was until I noticed my heel was hanging off the back. These are pointed and thus they are more narrow. My foot was stopped at least an inch if not more from the toe which caused my heel to hang off by that much. Oh  well...... they are cute. They seem sturdy and well made.

title: Arms Too Short
text: I am 5'6" and wear a size 18. I ordered this shirt in the 2XL. It wasn't as oversized as I expected, but it's definitely a loose fit. However, the arms are way too short! I'm average height and have average arm length. My upper arms are fat, but that wasn't where the fit was off. I would estimate the sleeves to be at least 2 inches too short. It was enough that it was noticeable and uncomfortable which is such a shame because I really liked the shirt. The fabric is super soft. It's not stiff like some flannel plaid shirts. I was looking forward to wearing it.

title: Interesting Fabric
text: This Columbia shirt has really interesting fabric. It's light weight and it has a sheen to it. It's soft and slick. The sheen/sparkle reflects sunlight which helps keep you from getting too warm. It's a true to size fit. There are thumb holes on the sleeve cuffs. The color is a light pinkish orange.

title: Cute Outfit!
text: This is a cute outfit by Disney. The screen printing is good. The fabric is soft. There are 3 pieces in this set - a bucket hat, short overalls and a t-shirt. I did find a lot of loose threads on the pieces, pictures included. If I was ordering this as a gift, I would feel compelled to get that all cleaned up first. Also, if you are going to be gifting this, be aware that it comes in a clear poly bag with no tags attached.

title: Easy to Put On
text: These slip on boots are easy to put on. I ordered the size 12 for my husband. He usually wears an 11.5 but I often size up for him to be on the safe side. It is a loose fit, but he says he will be able to wear his thicker socks with it and that should solve that problem. The quality seems to be good. Excellent traction. They look like they will be very easy to clean on the bottoms because the traction is large and chunky without little nooks and crannies.

title: So Comfy!
text: These wool shoes are surprisingly comfy. It's like walking on clouds! Or how I would imagine it to be. I wear a women's size 10W shoe. I ordered this in the 11 and they fit quite nicely.

title: Great Looking Hiking Boots
text: These hiking boots are great looking. I love the lavender trim! Unfortunately for me, these do not fit. I wear a women's 10 Wide. I will often try 11's and have success. I have other pairs of Eddie Bauer hiking boots (low ankle) that are 11's and fit wonderfully. (Roseberg & Thielsen styles are the ones that fit well in case you're interested). My toes felt squished in these. I could technically wear them, but with my little toes rubbing against the sides, I would probably wind up with a blister. Plus there's no way I could go on an actual hike with the way they feel. Aside from the fit, they are nicely made.

title: Darling!
text: This Star Wars baby layette is absolutely darling! I love that they're designing Star Wars themed stuff for girls and not just boys! This is a 4 piece set that includes pajamas, head band, blanket and a burp cloth that is worn around the neck, sort of like a bib. The fabric is soft and the images are silk screened well. This would make a wonderful baby gift!

title: Stylish
text: I wear a size 10 Wide in women's shoes. I ordered these in an 11. Often if I size up, the width issue is solved. But because of the style of these, I really expected them not to fit since there are no laces that you can loosen up. Surprise! It was a great fit! They are not snug or tight at all. That makes me wonder if they would not fit someone with a narrow foot. They're cute and stylish. They give the look of boots but you don't have to deal with the calves! I am very pleased with them.

title: Unique
text: The design of this Vera Bradley coin purse set is unique. You have the ID sized wallet which seems to be similar to their other ID wallet items, but it comes with a round zippered coin purse and a coordinating fabric. In the wallet part there are spots for a couple of cards and plenty of room for bills. The wrist strap is easy to remove. You can also remove either of the items and just use one if you prefer. The quality is good and as expected from the Vera Bradley brand.

title: So Cute
text: This Star Wars 3-piece outfit is so cute! The set includes overalls, t-shirt, and a bucket hat. It is perfect for any Star Wars fan!

title: Good Fit
text: These Eddie Bauer hiking boots are comfortable enough to wear all day. They have great support as well as good cushion. I ordered these for my husband who wears a size 11 and 1/2. I ordered these in 12s since there are no half sizes. The fit is good and there's enough room for him to wear thick hiking socks. These are much more affordable than some of the other options out there!

title: Summer Tote
text: This Vera Bradley morning shells tote bag is perfect for summer. It's made from recycled cotton. The tote bag is a good size. There are some slip pockets and pen pockets inside. The tote bag is sturdy and durable just as I would expect from Vera Bradley products. The handle is long enough to comfortably rest on my shoulder. It's just a nice tote bag.

title: Not For Wide Feet
text: These braided strap slip on sandals are very modern looking. They will be perfect for sandal season! I wear a size 10 Wide, so I took a gamble at ordering these in an 11. A lot of shoes will fit me in an 11, but sadly these did not. It's not a total surprise and I definitely can't blame the shoes for it! It's something I have learned to accept over the years. They seem to be well made. There's not a lot if any support, but there is a little padding.

title: Soft & Comfy!
text: I ordered this robe for my 20 year old daughter. The size fits as expected. I'm plus size and it's not a one size fits all, so it didn't fit me. It fits my daughter just fine. The material is a soft fleece. The robe has pockets and a hood. The pattern is a fun and colorful one. It's a great robe that's soft & comfy!

title: Easy to Clean
text: I am a long time Vera Bradley customer. My mom used to get new Vera bags and purses at least once a year if not more. I would get one every once in a while, but since my mom's passing several years ago, I have gone full Vera Bradley. It makes me feel connected to her. This bucket bag is a pretty new style as far as I know. I like the size and style. The stripes are nice, but I like the floral interior print better. The canvas material is durable and easy to clean. There are 2 slip pockets and 1 zippered pocket inside. The quality is good. As nice as it is, it's probably one of my least favorite bags. It's almost too plain and simple for me. However, it will probably appeal to those who think the florals and prints are too much!

title: What a Cute Outfit!
text: What a cute outfit! This has 4 pieces - the skirt, leggings, tee shirt and body suit for mix and match attire. The pieces are well made with no noticeable flaws. Items are tag free. Would make a great baby gift!

title: So Cute
text: This Harry Potter short overall set is so cute!! It's a great quality outfit. The 3 piece ensemble is perfect for warmer weather. The sizing appears to be accurate. The items are tag free. The items come in a poly bag and they do not have any of those tags that are attached with plastic. If you are gifting this, it would look nicer if you removed it from the poly bag.

title: Adorable!
text: What an adorable little bag!! This is a mini-sized Utility backpack by Vera Bradley. It's one of the solid print ones that has a cute coordinating floral print inside. The bag has adjustable straps. There is a zippered pouch on the front of the bag and a zippered pocket inside. This would be great for a teen/young adult who doesn't have a lot to tote around with them. I could also see it working for a mom with child/children on short outings when you don't need the full diaper bag. You could easily fit a couple of diapers, a travel size wipe container and some snacks.

title: Rugged!
text:
*Updated 9/22: My husband has had these for about 6 months. He has worn them less than once a week. He's a computer guy and would wear these on weekends when doing projects around the house or just as regular pants. Yesterday he noticed what he thought was the sound of Velcro through out the day. He thought maybe there were Velcro pockets and didn't think much about it. Then in the evening, he heard the sound again, but this time he realized that the pants were ripping. The rip was down the side, but not on the seams. It was about a half an inch away from the seam. It's really a shame because he really liked these pants. I have higher expectations from the Levis Brand.

Original review: These pants are rugged and durable. They seem like they will offer some protection from scratches. I ordered these for my husband. I thought they would be good for weekend projects around the house. They are a little snug in the waist. He wears a 34/34 pant size, so that's what I ordered for him. There's no stretch in the waist band at all. He's hoping they will stretch over time. He usually wears Dockers pants and the 34/34 is usually a perfect fit.

title: Comfortable
text: I wear a size 10 Wide in women's shoes. Sometimes I can wear a regular (non-Wide) size 11 shoe. I am excited to say that the 11's in this hiking shoe by Eddie Bauer fit nicely! They are very comfortable. There is a good arch support. My toes don't feel crushed. The laces are not pulled tightly. If they were, the shoes probably wouldn't fit very well. Because they are not tight, there's not a lot of excess lace. I can't double tie them if desired. They have excellent traction. I like the grey color with a little pop of pink/coral!

title: Unique Style
text: This beach tote by Vera Bradley has a very unique style. It doesn't scream "I'm a beach bag". It's like a grown up version of a beach bag. It has handles as well as a removable shoulder strap. There are 3 slip pockets on the outside of the bag - one on the front and then one on each end. The interior has a drawstring closure that keeps everything inside from spilling out. It feels pretty durable. It looks gorgeous! This is the bag you need for your summer trips to the pool!

title: Awful!!
text: What awful shoes! I thought they would be cute and fun to wear this summer. And they probably would be if it wasn't for the shoddy construction. The sparkly jewels are glued onto the shoes. The shoes arrived in a plastic bag. They were attached to one another with an elastic string as well as one of those shoe hanging pieces that you see at the store for shoes that don't come in boxes. Well, the shoes touch one another. The glue from the sparkly jewels caused the shoes to stick together. They weren't stuck to one another enough that they became one. They easily separated. I don't even recall it being a problem at all. But when I looked closer to inspect them, the jewels on one shoe were missing in an 1 inch area and stuck in a mound on the other shoe. I've included pictures. It's April, and the weather isn't even hot yet, so I would not expect something like this. Very disappointing! As for fit, they didn't fit me, but I was expecting that. I have a wide foot and the band was a little too snug on me. They did seem to be supportive enough. My daughter would have claimed them if they hadn't been stuck together. Instead they're going in the trash! They're not even acceptable for donating!

title: Great Fit!
text: My 20 year old daughter has seen similar "flowy" shorts on TikTok. She asked me to find some for her. She absolutely loves these! They are super soft and comfy. The rose color is beautiful. They are a great fit on her. I ordered her usual size and it was just fine. She wants more of these in different colors!

title: Easy to Travel With
text: This is a cute rain poncho. It's larger than I expected. I thought it would fold up into a small pouch the size of your fist, but it's much larger than that. It's a thin and light rain coat. The pouch is attached and connected to the jacket. There were no instructions on how to fold it back up into the pocket. I figured it out, but it wasn't a pretty job! It will be great for traveling!

title: Good Little Bag
text: The Vera Bradley microfiber bucket crossbody purse is a good little bag. It's large enough to accommodate the items you need such as a wallet, cosmetic bag, and more. It's not too big that it's overwhelming. I like the classic black design. My favorite feature is the almost hidden little pocket on the outside corner. My phone fits perfectly in it but it still easy to access. The inside is a nice black and white floral design. The straps are easy to adjust. Overall I am very satisfied with it.

title: Nice shirt
text: This is a nice men's shirt. My husband is 6"2 and is really between a Large and an XL depending on the shirt. I ordered this in the XL for him and it's a little baggy. He says it's okay though. The shirt looks great. The buttons are securely fastened. It will be great for summer!

title: Darling!
text: I love this new Vera Bradley print. It's very spring-like. The bucket style crossbody is new to me. I really like that outside pocket. It's almost hidden and I didn't see it for a few days after using it. The interior is just open space but it does have two slip pockets. The straps are adjustable. It's a good size for a wallet, your phone, and a few other items. It's not too bulky. The quality is good and what I would expect from Vera Bradley.

title: Light Weight
text: My daughter works at a camp in the summer. The required uniform is khaki shorts with the official t-shirt. These are a good length for her, as she can't wear shorts that are too short. They're light weight which is perfect for hot summers at camp. She likes that these have cargo pockets. Women's shorts don't seem to have the same pockets that men's shorts due, so she is pleased with that. We may be ordering another pair for her.

title: Great Fit!
text: These big girl shoes have a great fit! It's definitely an "as expected" fit. The shoes are easy to slip on. They have excellent traction and support. The pink color is just as pictured.

title: Great hiking boots
text: These women's boots by Eddie Bauer are great hiking boots. They also look beautiful. I'm almost afraid to let them get dirty. They offer excellent arch and ankle support. There is adequate cushion. The fit is good and as expected. They have great traction.

title: Good Stretch!
text: It can be difficult ordering clothes for my daughter. She's a college student and can be very picky. Sizing can be tricky too. I ordered these in size 10. When she saw them, she thought they might be a little small. It turns out they fit just fine. There's plenty of stretch which gives some leeway. She loved the way they looked on her. I liked that they weren't too short. All around, she was very happy with them.

title: Comfortable
text: My husband likes these new sneakers. They are comfortable and supportive. I like that they are affordable. Great traction. We have learned that with this brand we order a size or rather a half size larger for the best fit.

title: True Size Fit
text: These girl's tennis shoes are so cute! They're also pretty comfortable. The slip-on feature is easy and the shoes stay on. Traction is good. They are true size fit. And they're very affordable.

title: Great fit
text: I ordered this pair of shoes for my husband. He usually wears about an 11 and 1/2 size shoe. However we have learned that this brand runs a teeny bit small on him and the size 12 works much better for him. The fit is great and as we expected. The shoe offers excellent arch support. The shoes are comfortable to be worn all day plus the color is awesome.

title: Nice Fit
text: I wear a size 18 and the product description said to go with the 2XL. It has a nice fit. It's not tight across the chest or in the arms. The color name says Rust Red, but in my opinion, it's more of a mauve or light plum. I don't like the color rust, but the picture looked more mauve, so I gambled and took a chance on it. I'm glad I did because in person, the color doesn't look like rust red!

title: Good Quality
text: I wear a size 10 W in women's shoes. A lot of times if I just go up to a size 11 (not wide)  I can find a good fit. That wasn't the case with these. It's my first time trying the brand myself. They seem to be a good quality. I like the color scheme. This line of shoes is priced well, so I will have to check out their wide sizes.

title: Nice Fit!
text: This women's t-shirt has a nice fit. I'm a size 18 and the XXL fit loosely (not baggy). This will be a good basic top to wear in the warmer months. The v-neck is perfect - it's not too deep or too high.

title: Great Fit!
text: I ordered these hiking boots for my husband. They fit perfectly. They aren't loose or tight. They are supportive at the ankles as well as the arch. The traction is excellent. Plus, they look great!

title: My Daughter Loves These Pants
text: I ordered these yoga pants for my 20 year old daughter. She's had difficulties finding the perfect pair of yoga pants. Well, the search is over. She loves these! The material is a silky soft athletic type fabric. She says they have a snug but not tight fit. They've got a good stretch to them. She's 5'7" and wears a size 10 in pants. I ordered these in large for her and she's pleased with the fit. They are very flattering. She also likes that they are long. Being 5'7", she has issues with pants being a little short on her. These graze the floor if she's barefoot. She says these are super comfortable and she loves them!

title: Comfortable
text: I ordered these shoes for my husband. He's worn this brand before and likes the brand. He found the 11.5 ones to be a little tight, so I ordered this pair in size 12 and he's much happier with the fit. The shoes are comfortable. They are adequately supportive.

title: Nice Looking Hiking Boots!
text: My daughter is studying wildlife biology at college. She loves the outdoors and this major allows her to spend a lot of time outside. She likes wearing comfortable boots to her outdoor labs which she has several times a week because they are often traipsing through the woods. These are comfortable and they offer good arch support as well as ankle support. They're really nice looking, too. She has been careful about wearing these only on days when she's confident there won't be mud!!! The sizing is good. I ordered her usual size and they fit as expected.

title: Sweet & Dainty!
text: These earrings are sweet and dainty! My 20 year old daughter was wanting some tiny stud earrings. These were just what she wanted. They don't cause any irritation. The backs stay put. They look nice and professional.

title: Great Fit!
text: I am so pleased with these new hiking boots! They have a great fit. I wear a size 10 Wide in women's shoes. I sometimes have luck with 11's fitting so I took a chance and ordered these. It was my lucky day! They fit perfectly. They are very comfortable and have a nice cushion support. Plus they look great!

title: Dainty
text: These earrings are cute and dainty. I have not had any irritations from wearing them. They are perfect to wear everyday.

title: Keen Utility Shoes
text: These shoes are perfect for industrial work and more! They have a true fit and fit as expected. The soft toe protection is excellent. I personally found it difficult to distinguish from hard toe protection. Regardless, your toes will be well protected! The shoes are comfortable to wear and have nice arch support and padding.

title: Cute Earrings!
text: My daughter likes wearing tiny stud type earrings in her secondary ear piercings. She also has sensitive ears, so she needs ones that are hypoallergenic. These fit the bill. They are very cute. The backings seem to stay in place well. They are great for work or other situations where you want something small.

title: True Fit
text: These Keen work sneakers are true fit shoes. They have a nice and comfortable foot bed with adequate arch support. They offer excellent toe protection. The traction is excellent.

title: Perfect!
text: My daughter recently got second ear piercings. She likes wearing small studs in them and if she's wanting to wear something larger, she wears them in her primary ear piercings. These are perfect! They are small and dainty. They don't irritate or annoy her. They seem to be very high quality.

title: Cute
text: This swimsuit is very cute! It's a bit tight on me, but it still fits and it looks okay. I mainly wear swimsuits at home for use in the hot tub. It may not look good enough for me to wear out in public. For the record, I am a size 18 in clothing and I ordered this in the 2X.

title: Great Fit!
text: I wasn't sure what to expect with this shirt, but I am loving it! It has a great fit. It's not too heavy or too light. It's long enough to cover my back side when I reach or stretch, but it's not so long that it's like a tunic. I am very happy with it and plan to check out the other colors so I can order another one.

title: Great Uniform Shorts
text: These khaki uniform shorts from French Toast are great. They have an adjustable waist. There's a little stretch to the waist band as is. The length is modest and school appropriate. They're a great wardrobe staple for kids who have to wear school uniforms.

title: Good Fit
text: This vest has a good fit. It's just as I would expect a 2X to fit. It's also got a good length and goes just below the hip/waist a little bit. The color is pretty. It washes well. I do find it a little pricey. I was able to buy a Columbia brand vest for less and that's a name brand.

title: Runs A Little Bit Small
text: I ordered these shoes for my husband. His usual size is 11.5 so that's what I ordered. These are just a little bit small. His toes reach the end. He is able to wear them, but in the future, he will order 12's in this brand. The shoes have adequate arch support. He likes the color combo a lot. Plenty of traction on the bottoms.

title: Comfortable
text: My husband wears khaki pants almost all of the time. Dockers are his preferred brand. These are comfortable. They fit well and as expected. There is a slight stretch to the fabric, which is ideal.

title: Great Fitting Pants
text: My husband hasn't worn jeans in years. He thinks he's too old for them - he's in his mid fifties. Instead, he wears primarily khaki pants. If he's doing work around the house he will wear carpenter pants or something similar. But mostly, he wears khakis. Dockers are his preferred brand of pants. These are great fitting. Everything about them is good and what he would expect from Dockers pants. They're comfortable and they look great!

title: Very Soft!
text: This throw blanket is very soft. It's absolutely gorgeous! I love the pink roses scattered all over!  It's light weight. It seems a little longer than most throw blankets which is nice for those of us with long legs. It's made well. It would make a lovely gift.

title: Love!
text: I just love this rash guard shirt! I followed their suggestion with the sizing. I'm a size 18. I've gained weight from the holidays & pandemic, so I've been wearing 2XL shirts. It was recommended to order this in the 3XL. I did cringe at first, but I'm glad I ordered it. I was afraid it would be too big on me, but I am very pleased with the fit. It's loose but not baggy. I have fat upper arms and a lot of times a shirt will fit in the body fine but not in the arms. These arms are loose and very comfortable. The shirt even has thumb holes! It looks great! I like wearing rash guard shirts for kayaking. Now I just need to wait for the warmer weather!

title: Runs Small
text: I ordered this cute peeking cat shirt for my son in the 3X size. It's not a 3X! I wear a women's size 18 and it's snug on me. I usually wear a 1X or XL in brand name items or a 2XL in unfamiliar brands. The shirt quality is pretty basic. It's not particularly soft, but it's not scratchy either. The cat is cute, but it is a decal so it's a little stiff feeling and noisy.

title: Soft Fabric
text: We've been lounging around a lot this Christmas break because of illnesses. These pajamas arrived just in time. The fabric is very soft. The sizing is as expected and fits pretty well. The sleeves are just a tad shorter than I would like, but it's not awful. The pants have pockets which is greatly appreciated!!

title: Very Snug
text: I followed the recommendation to order a size up, but that really wasn't enough. I'm a size 18 and the 2XL is very snug on me. The material is light and a bit see through. I would suggest wearing a black bra underneath.

title: Comfy!
text: I ordered these pajamas to wear on Christmas morning. I could not have been happier with them. They fit perfectly and as expected. I'm a size 18, so I ordered the 18. The buttons didn't gap. They looked great on me! They were a tad long, but I just pulled them up higher above my waist. For the record, I'm 5'6". The fabric is soft. They were very comfortable. I don't usually wear pajamas to bed. I'm in my 50's and in menopause so I get overheated easily. But these are perfect for lounging or when I have company.

title: Cute Colors!
text: I am a size 18 in women's. With the holidays near, I was looking for comfortable pajama pants to lounge in that were appropriate to wear in front of company. The first time I tried one of these on, I was very pleased with the fit. The next day I put a pair on to wear since I was planning to just stay home and clean. While yes, they did fit, they were a little snug in the rear which I didn't notice when I was trying them on. They don't "move" with you. I was a afraid they might rip if I were to bend over or do anything that required a big range of motion. If I lose a little weight, I'm sure that will help.

title: Great Fit!
text: I am a size women's size 18. I wanted a flannel shirt to wear over t-shirts. I ordered this in the 2XL and I am very pleased with the fit. It's an oversize fit on me, but not too big or baggy. The sleeves are a little long (like I wanted them to be). The green plaid looks nice. The material is a little stiff right now. I'm hoping that it will soften up after a few tosses in the washing machine. Overall, I am satisfied with this order.

title: One Touch Open & Close
text: This umbrella is so cute! I love the flower garden design. The umbrella folds up in a manner that keeps any water tucked in and doesn't get everything else wet. I've tried some of the larger inverted umbrellas, but the design of this one simpler. It opens and closes with one touch which makes it easier to use than the other style. It's also smaller so it's easier to tuck into a bag whereas you get stuck having to tote the larger ones yourself. I am very impressed with this umbrella!

title: Good, Basic Hoodie
text: This is a good, basic hoodie. It's light weight. The fit is as expected. It washes well.

title: Cute!
text: These cat socks are cute! I was a little unsure that they would fit me, but there's plenty of stretch to accommodate my wide size 10 feet. It's a little snug above the ankle area leading up to the calves, but I have thick calves and that's pretty typical for me. Rather than pulling them up all the way, I have them scrunched at the ankles. I usually prefer that anyway.

title: Great Fit!
text: I was very pleasantly surprised to find that this dress fits like a glove! I followed the sizing recommendations and it is a great fit. I am unable to zip it up in the back by myself, but that's what husbands are for, right!?! The length is a tad long for me (I'm 5'6") so I will probably have to wear a slight heel with it. The dress is made well and I think it's priced appropriately, too.

title: Light Weight
text: I wear a size 18 in women's. I have several sleeveless maxi dresses, but I hate my upper arms so I won't wear them without a shrug or sweater. This is light weight and very comfortable. I ordered this in the 2XL and it fits perfectly. I can usually wear a 1XL, but with unfamiliar brands, I tend to size up just to be on the safe side. I'm glad I did! I fear that the 1XL would have been tight or snug.

title: Great Fit
text: I am 5'6" and wear a women's size 18. I ordered this in the 2XL. I am very pleased with how it fits. It's not snug at all. It's loose enough that I can easily wear a sweater or sweatshirt underneath it. The zipper works fine. The pockets are deep enough. I really like the thumb holes in the cuffs. Those will be great when the temperature drops. The hood is not removable. It seems to be made well. It will definitely keep me warm this winter.

title: Great Little Purse
text: I like wearing small crossbody style wallet purses. This one easily fits in the console of my car. There's plenty of card slots. There's an interior zipper pocket that can hold coins. The outside pocket holds a regular size cell phone securely. The snap closure could be improved upon. I would prefer a larger, magnetic closure instead of the small snap. The snap works, but it's not always easy to fasten it. Sometimes it takes a second or third attempt. Other than that, I am very satisfied with this purse.

title: Nice Color
text: These grayish blue pants are a great color! It's nice to see my husband wearing something other than his usual khaki colored pants. The fit is great and as expected. The quality is excellent and what we expect from Dockers.

title: Runs Small
text: I can't say for sure how the smaller sizes fit, but the 2XL in this cute Christmas shirt runs small. I would say it fits more like an XL. I am 5'6" and currently wear a size 18 in women's. Usually a 1XL will work for me, but with unfamiliar brands, I have been ordering 2XL shirts and have been pleased with the fit. This shirt is just too snug. The arms were surprisingly okay as far as the fit. I have fat arms and a lot of times that's where I run into problems. This shirt was too snug in the shoulders and upper chest area. For reference, I am a 40DD.  I was able to get the shirt on, but it wasn't comfortable enough to wear. The shirt looks like the pictures, though the grey looks a little lighter than the description shows. The graphics are printed well. It's cute, just know that you might need to size up.

title: True Size Fit
text: These sneaker boots are true to size fit. They are half a size larger than what my daughter usually wears, but they aren't really that loose on her. If she wears thick socks, they're not loose at all. They are comfortable and have adequate support. The toes are fully protected. You can't go wrong with Keen footwear!

title: Nice Pants
text: My husband mostly wears khaki pants. He does have a few pairs of carpenter/work pants too. He stopped wearing jeans about 10 years ago saying that he was too old to wear them. (He's in his mid 50's). This pair of pants fits perfectly. I ordered his usual size, so they're definitely true size. They are comfortable to wear. They are made well. Overall, these are just what he would expect from Dockers.

title: Warm!
text: This is a good, warm winter coat. It's true to size and fit as expected. It's a good thickness and should be more than enough for winter. Inside has fleece. There are plenty of pockets. The hood is removeable. It did take nearly 2 months for it to arrive though.

title: Supportive & Comfortable
text: These work boots are both supportive and comfortable. The sizing is pretty true to size, though my husband found them to be just a tad large. He plans to make sure that he's wearing thick socks with these and hopes that will solve that. I ordered these in his usual size of 11.5. One thing he wasn't expecting from these is that they make him even taller! Without these, he's 6'2". These add at least in inch if not more to his stature. The quality seems to be good and what we would expect from Keens footwear.

title: Excellent Shoes!
text: My daughter loves these shoes! They fit nicely. There is enough room to wear thick socks, but if she is wearing a regular thickness pair of socks, they're not too loose. They have great traction and toe protection. They aren't too heavy when walking. They really are excellent shoes and she is thrilled with them.

title: Cute Onesies!
text: These are such cute onesies! They will be perfect for Stars Wars and Mandalorian fans. They are true to size. The fabric is soft and not scratchy. I think these could easily be unisex.

title: So Comfy It's Hard to Believe That They're Work Pants!
text: My daughter is a food server and has to wear black pants to work. She has been rotating between 2 pairs but it's hard to keep up with the laundry. After most shifts, they're kind of gross looking and need to be washed. This pair will make it a little easier for her. The pants are really nice and super comfy. They are so comfy it's hard to believe that they're work pants! Of the 3 pairs she now has, these are her favorites. She loves the fit. They hug her in all the right places. They are also very flattering. For the record, she's 5'7" and currently wears a 10/12 in pants. I ordered this in the large.

title: Better Than Expected
text: My daughter had a nice faux leather jacket that was very similar to this one that she loved. The faux leather was beginning to crack and she wanted to replace it. She is very happy with this new one. The size fits perfectly. She wears a size medium in shirts. I ordered this in the large. I probably would have gotten an XL had it been available at the time of ordering, but this fits very well. Of course, she probably won't be able to wear thick sweaters underneath. The jacket looks super cute. One thing that we didn't realize when ordering it, is that the material on the underside of the arms in stretchy and not the faux leather. She says that makes this jacket easier to move around in which she hardily approves. The arms aren't tight or binding at all. The overall construction is very good and it's better than expected.

title: Sizing Chart Is Accurate
text: The sizing chart is accurate and led me to the right pair of tights for my daughter. She likes wearing skirts, but with the changing seasons and cooler weather, she was wanting some tights to over her a little more warmth. They fit fine. They seem to be durable. She's worn one of the pairs a couple of times already. She's washed them without any problems. She's hoping that they will last through the next couple of months.

title: Good Fit!
text: My husband is 6'2" and weighs 220. I ordered this in an XL for him and it fits as expected. The sleeves could be a tad longer, but they aren't bad and he isn't tugging at them. The garment is a little thicker than I anticipated and it's very warm. He's worn it on its own and has been very pleased with it. It seems to be made well without any noticeable flaws.

title: Nicely Made
text: My husband surprised me recently by noticing the trend of men wearing padded vests with long sleeve button down shirts. I was not expecting that at all! So I found this. I ordered the XL for him. It's just slightly large on him. He's 6'2" and weighs about 220. While large, it's not baggy. The zipper works as it should. It's nicely made and it looks good.

title: Comfy Work Shoes!
text: My daughter is a food server and spends a lot of time on her feet. She has work shoes, but their a little tight on her. These shoes fit much better. They have adequate cushion. There's a lot of traction on the soles so they keep her from slipping.

title: Good Tights
text: My 20 year old daughter wanted some tights to wear under her skirts for the cooler weather. These are pretty good. They have a decent stretch to them. She says the fit is good and as expected. They are comfortable to wear.  They do give a little more warmth than exposed legs.

title: Great Fit
text: My 23 year old son likes wearing sweatpants when at home. He finds them to be more comfortable. He is really liking these pants. There are 3 pairs of pants, in different colors. One thing that he likes about them is that they aren't baggy fitting like many of his sweatpants. The have a drawstring at the waist and pockets.

title: Nice Shape
text: This faux leather purse is a nice shape, especially for a crossbody style purse. I don't like them to be too thick. This envelope style is thin and not bulky. The zippers are really good and feel very durable. They work well. The interior is lined with a leopard print fabric. The straps are attached to the body rather than to metal rings that are attached to the body. I don't know if that's better or not. The strap length can be adjusted. The strap isn't too thin either. I always worry about super thin straps not holding up well. Overall, this is a good purse.

title: Cute!
text: My 20 year old daughter loves the current tennis skirt fashion trend. This is her second one. The first one became dingy and there were some stains that she couldn't get out, so she wanted a new one. This fits well and looks cute. The fabric is comfortable. There are built in shorts as well as a few specific pockets. She is pleased.

title: Roomy
text: This Vera satchel is roomy and can hold plenty of stuff. I used it today for a several hour Christmas shopping excursion. My usual bag is pretty small, but I wanted to be able to carry a spiral notebook that I was using to keep track of the gifts. Plus, I thought it would be good to throw in a snack and bottle of water, too. The bag is very cute. I love the fabric! There are plenty of pockets. I wish the handles were just a little longer so I could wear it over my shoulder rather than using the additional strap. I used the strap to wear it over my shoulder. I'm a plus size woman and I was afraid it would look to bulky as a crossbody since it's a larger bag than I'm used to. I may give it a try next time. The bag is made well, as I would expect from the Vera Bradley company.

title: Great Fit!
text: My daughter loves these black pants! She currently works as a waitress. She's had difficulties finding good black pants to wear to work. The supply chain problems have left little inventory when she has gone pants shopping. These fit great! And she says they're very comfortable. Because they have the belt loops, they look more like regular pants rather than stretchy pull on pants. The fabric is a little thicker than I expected which also makes them look like work pants. There are pockets in the front. The rear ones are fake. Now she has 2 pairs of pants to switch between on her work days. She may be asking me to order another pair!

title: Dinosaur Coat
text: This dinosaur coat is pretty warm. It's not too thin and has a good thickness to it. The dinosaur print is cute! There are pockets (zippered). The inside is a soft fleece. I would say that the sizing is pretty accurate.

title: Excellent Winter Coat
text: There are a lot of "just okay" winter coats. This one is excellent! I was very impressed with how nice it is. It's a true to size fit. The construction is very good. The zippers zip well. It's plenty warm enough for a cold winter. I really can't find anything negative about it. It's that good!

title: Warm!
text: I've been on a quest to find a new winter coat. Unfortunately, this one isn't it. I'm a size 18. I like my coats to be a little loose. This one fit nicely in the body, but the arms were too snug. I could put the coat on and zip it up, but the tightness in the arms wasn't comfortable. This is an issue that I have had with other coats, so I am getting used to it. The zipper is durable and works well. The hood is removable. I did think the outer pockets were a little weird. Instead of the opening being at an angle, they go straight. It feels weird to walk with your hands in them. They're also very wide and do not close. The coat is a good thickness and will keep the wearer warm.

title: Stylish
text: This is a stylish Gothic/Punk skirt. The quality is a little better than I expected. The length is very appropriate for young girls. There are no pockets nor are there built in shorts. The pockets on the front are fake. There's a hidden side zipper. The waist band does not have any stretch to it.

title: Fun Masks
text: I ordered these masks as a last minute Halloween costume, but they didn't arrive in time. The masks work well. They're a little small on adult faces, but not too small where it would not work. Uses 2 AA batteries per mask, not included.

title: Warm!
text: If you need an affordable winter coat, definitely check this one out. The sizing is good. I'm 5'6" and the length of the arms and coat are fine. The cuffs aren't elastic which I would prefer, but it's okay. The interior is fuzzy fleece and very arm. The hood is attached with a zipper and it's easy to remove. I'm not crazy about hoods, so that was one of the first things I did. There are large zippered pockets that easily hold mittens or gloves. The overall thickness is pretty good. It's a very warm coat and will be perfect for the cold winter.

title: Great Fit
text: I am so pleased with this shirt! I am a plus size mom. I wear a size 18. Sleeves, especially long ones are frequently a problem for me. They end up being too tight, often to the point where they're uncomfortable and unwearable. I ordered this in the 2XL. Usually the 1XL will fit in the body, but lately they've been more snug than I would like. I put the blame on the pandemic weight that I need to shed. Also, a lot of unfamiliar brands tend to run small. Well, this is a great fit! The arms aren't tight at all. The body is loose but not baggy. I am super excited for December to arrive so I can wear this! The fabric is soft. The image is clear.

title: Super Cute!
text: This Christmas shirt is super cute! I love it! I'm a size 18 and I ordered this in the 2XL. It's loose but not baggy. I am very pleased with how it looks. The arms aren't tight. The fabric is very soft. I'm glad we have warmer winters here in the south. I think this is going to be one of my favorite Christmas shirts this year!

title: Very Cute
text: This is a very cute coat for young girls. The outer material is a polyester/wool blend, with the majority of it polyester. The inside lining is 100% polyester. The coat is 2-3 shades of grey with some metallic gold strands lightly scattered around. The buttons are pink and match the faux fur collar and the interior lining. The faux fur collar is very soft. It's also removable. There are outer pockets. The label has a positive message on it - Believe in Yourself, Be the Best.

title: Runs Small
text: I've always wanted a red wool coat. I think they look smart! I wear a size 18 women's or XXL. The XXL coat was too snug on me. I could get it on, but the arms were too tight and I couldn't get the coat closed. It wasn't as long as I expected, which was actually good. I thought it might be below the knee, but really it was about mid thigh. For reference, I'm 5'6". The material felt pretty thin and cheap to me. I've had several wool pea coats and this definitely felt sub-par compared to them. The red color is nice and looks like the pictures. I like that the hood is removable. There's a belt, too. I didn't see anything wrong with the construction. Overall, it was just okay.

title: Cute Skirt
text: What a cute skirt! It's a heavier fabric - a wool/polyester blend. The interior is lined. A spare button is provided. There are no pockets, though there are 2 faux pocket flaps on the front. The skirt is pleated. It arrived slightly wrinkled and required some ironing. The fit is good and as expected. It will be nice for the cooler season.

title: Soft Fabric
text: The fit of this girls Adidas long sleeve hooded t-shirt is true to size. The fabric is very soft and comfortable. The Adidas logo/name is screen printed as well as the stripes along the arm. The printing is well done. The mint green color is beautiful! The shirt is light weight. Sleeve length is good.

title: Pleated Skirt
text: Pleated skirts are very popular right now. This one did arrive wrinkled and needed ironing. It's a cotton/polyester blend and has a good weight to it, meaning it's not too thin or lightweight. There's very little stretch at the waistband. There's a zipper in the back. There are no shorts built in or pockets. However, there is a separate pouch that is meant to be attached which can hold a cell phone. There's no closure to it, but unless you're doing flips or cartwheels, it's probably not a problem. There's also a black strap with grommets all across it that you attach to the skirt and pouch. There wasn't any picture of how it was supposed to look, so I had to look back at the product description. It definitely has a punk or goth vibe to it. It looks like something you might get at Hot Topic, but the quality is better.

title: Very Nice
text: This boys hoodie is very nice. It's lightweight polyester material. The logo screen print is done well and there's no peeling or other problems with that. The 3 stripes on the sleeves have some sheen to them. They're securely sewn on with good stitching. The kangaroo pocket in the front has a thin fleece lining. Overall, it's a great hoodie with a good fit!

title: Warm!
text: I was looking for some slippers that could  be worn to go get the mail or bring the trash out. These are great for those tasks. The exterior is some type of molded plastic material that is water proof. The inside is warm and fuzzy. I wear a women's 10W shoe. I often have to go larger because of the width. The width of these is pretty good, but my heel keeps rubbing against the little edge that comes up on the back which makes me think these run a tad small. I find it annoying, but I have been putting up with it. This was the largest size, so I may be out of luck when it comes to finding the perfect fit.

title: Toasty Warm!
text: This blue jacket looks almost periwinkle or more of a grey blue in some lighting.  There is a good thickness to this coat and it will keep the wearer  toasty warm! The interior is lined with faux fur that is very soft. There are small pockets on the front. The hood cannot be removed. There are cuffs on the sleeves. The zipper is sturdy and works well.

title: Cozy!
text: This pink winter coat is very cozy! It's thick and will keep your baby warm & toasty. The coat has both a zipper and snap closure. There's a small piece of fabric at the top of the zipper to keep the zipper from scratching. The hood is attached and cannot be removed, but the fur is attached with a zipper and can be easily removed. There are cuffs on the sleeves that help keep the cold out. The inside is lined with a soft material.

title: Cute Skirt But No Shorts
text: The title of this skirt says "pleated plaid skirt with lining shorts". There are no shorts. That was pretty disappointing.  The built in shorts makes girls feel less conscientious when wearing short skirts! The fabric is a little stiff which makes me think it will retain the pleats well. The length is good and not too short. The instructions call for hand washing which is another strike against it. There is a generously sized pocket. I like the little piece that adjusts the waist if needed.It looks pretty much like the picture.

title: Very Nice Quality
text: This light weight boys jacket is a very nice quality. The Adidas logo is embroidered and looks good. The zipper glides easily. It's a true size fit.

title: Heavy Winter Coat
text: This is a heavy winter coat. It will keep you warm, for sure! The coat is a wool blend and has the feel of wool. It was a little tight on my arms, but the fit was fine everywhere else. I often have difficulties with my arms, so it was not unexpected. The quality of the coat is good. The snaps are a little weird. Okay, a lot weird. They do work, but they were a little tricky to line up sometimes.

title: Very Soft T-Shirt
text: I am a size 18 in women's clothing. I ordered the 2XL in this shirt. It's roomy and very comfortable. I don't feel that it's too big or loose on me. The material is very soft. Construction seems good. Image is done nicely.  I have a feeling that it will become my favorite holiday shirt this year!

title: Well Made
text: This Adidas outfit is well made. For a 2 piece outfit, it's pretty easy to put on/take off. The sizing is accurate and as expected. The fabric is pretty soft, too.

title: Cute Shirt
text: This 3/4 sleeve baseball shirt is really cute. During the month of November, I like to wear Christmas shirts as many days as I can, so this one is a nice one for the collection. The fabric is neither soft nor scratchy. The design is on there well. I found it to be a little snug on me. It's still wearable. I wouldn't call it tight, just snug or close fitting. Just a few more weeks until I can wear it!

title: Packable!
text: This packable coat is very nice. It's soft to the touch. The blue/gray color is gender neutral. Some of the stitches seem a little crooked, but overall it looks fine. There are no cuffs on the sleeves, just a small stretchy elastic type bias tape (or something similar). The same goes with the waist. The zipper works well and seems to be a sturdy one. It does provide adequate warmth.

title: So Soft!
text: This jacket/coat is so soft! I live in the South and I can get by with something like this for most of the winter. Sleeve length is good. Pockets are deep. I ordered this for my daughter. It looked big, so I tried it on. I'm a size 18 in women's sizes. It nearly fit me! It didn't, but it was closer than I expected! The construction is decent. There were some loose threads, but nothing major that I could tell. It will keep you cozy!

title: Slim Cut
text: This coat is very nice. I would call it a slim cut. It's probably true to size, but if you're in between sizes, I would recommend going up for a better fit. It's a nice, long coat so it will keep you nice and warm. The hood is attached by zipper so it can be removed without any difficulty.  The arm length is fine. It's definitely a thicker coat and definitely suited for colder temperatures.

title: Gorgeous Coat!
text: This faux fur coat is gorgeous! And it's super soft! I ordered this for my daughter. The fit is good, but slightly tight in the shoulders. As long as she doesn't wear bulky clothes underneath, she'll be fine. It seems to be made well. We haven't noticed any flaws or imperfections. I wasn't sure if it would be warm enough, but it's thicker than I expected and for the mild winters we get in the south, it will be fine.

title: Shiny!
text: This is a very shiny coat. The purple color is very fun. The coat is packable and compresses down in size so it would be good for traveling. The zipper works fine, so far. The sizing fits okay, but if my daughter wears anything with any amount of thickness, such as a sweater or sweatshirt, it will be too snug. I personally like my coats to be a little loose fitting.

title: Gender Neutral
text: This gray Adidas romper is gender neutral. It is super cute! It's not super soft, but I would still categorize it as soft. The zipper works easily and has a little flap at the top so the zipper pull won't bother baby. The sizing is as expected.

title: Decent Winter Coat
text: I am 5'6" and wear a size 18. I like my winter coats to be roomy, so I ordered this in a 2XL. The body of the coat fits very nicely. I could easily wear a sweatshirt or sweater underneath it and it wouldn't be too tight. The problems that I had with the coat are in the arms. First of all, they are much shorter than I like. I think it would annoy me greatly because I would be tugging on them constantly. I also found them to be tight in the upper arm area. My arms are thick and that's a common issue that I run into, so that wasn't a complete surprise. The coat is nice and long so it will provide lots of warmth this winter. It has a hood, but it can't be removed.

title: Nice Winter Coat
text: This is a nice winter coat. It's a good thickness and offers lots of warmth. The zippers and snaps all work well. The hood is lined with a Sherpa type material. The rest of the coat is lined with nylon (?) material. The hood can be easily removed. The fit seems normal and as expected. The coat length is good and reaches a little past the waist. Overall, it's a good coat.

title: Warm Winter Coat
text: This is a warm winter coat. It's thick enough to offer plenty of protection from the cold. The zippers work very well without any difficulties. The sizing is good, but if you tend to layer, you may need to go up a size to  accommodate bulky clothing. The construction is good.

title: Nice Jacket
text: This fuzzy jacket is nice. It's made well as far as I have been able to tell. It's very soft. It seems to be true size and fits as expected. We live in the south and will probably get worn for most of the winter, especially if layered underneath.

title: Packable
text: This puffer jacket is truly packable. It can compress down quite a bit so it's great for traveling! The jacket seems to be made well with no noticeable imperfections. It's very soft and comfortable. I love the pink color!

title: Good Winter Coat
text: I am 5'6" and wear a size 18. I ordered this in the XXL. Unfortunately it doesn't fit me. The fabric reaches across the chest area, but there's no way I can zip it up. That's too bad. It's a good winter coat. The arms were a little snug, but I think they would have been okay. I'm not crazy about the hood and the faux fur. It's a bit weird looking, but that can easily be detached. The length of the coat was another thing I liked. Zippered pockets. Adequate thickness. It seems to be made well. I didn't notice any major construction flaws. This should keep you warm this winter!

title: Built in Shorts
text: This tennis skirt fits as expected. The waist is stretchy so it can give you some flexibility. There are built in shorts -Yay!! The material is light and wrinkle resistant. There are 2 pockets on the shorts. One is designed for a tennis ball. It's easy to wash.

title: It Has a Pocket!
text: When I asked my daughter what she thought of this pleated plaid skirt, all she said was "It has a pocket". The all important phone storage! The skirt is a light weight fabric. I'm guessing it's a polyester blend or something similar. It doesn't wrinkle. There are black shorts built in to the skirt. The length is good. I think it came to about 2 inches above the knees. It's not too short. She is very happy with it!

title: Great School Uniform Shirt
text: This is a great boy's school uniform shirt. The material is very child friendly. It's a polyester blend which is light weight, doesn't wrinkle, and washes well. It's made well, too!

title: Sizing True Fit
text: I wear a size 10 Wide in women's shoes. Often, size 10's don't fit because of the width. My last slippers were 10's but because of the raised edge around the back of the foot, they didn't fit well. I made them work, but it wasn't super comfortable. These are 11-12's, I think. They're plenty big and I have no issues with my heels hanging over the edges. There is a nice cushion in the foot bed. Memory foam? The color is lovely. They seem to be made well. I am happily enjoying my new slippers!

title: Nice Jeans
text: These are nice jeans. I would say that they are sized correctly. However, they aren't quite right for me. I had to keep pulling them up at the waist. I'm probably more of a curvy size than regular. I also prefer a little longer pant. I'm 5'6" and these are tapered at the ankle. The quality of these is fine. I just took a gamble and lost. It's so hard to buy jeans online, but I liked the brand and wanted to give it a try.

title: True Fit
text: My husband wears his slippers every morning until he showers. He recently lost his slippers so I ordered some cheap ones in case he found his. He still hasn't found them and the cheap ones are..... well, cheap. These are nicely made. They are comfortable to wear. He can take the trash out in these or other outdoor tasks as long as it's not dewy outside. They're a true fit size.

title: Comfortable Fit
text: My husband and I are almost empty nesters. With the kids in college and on their own these days, we have a lot more free time. With the beautiful fall weather, we've been going on hikes at nearby parks. My husband usually wears sneakers, but when I saw these, I thought they would be better. They have a comfortable fit. The sizing is true to what we expected. There's plenty of support and traction, both which are helpful when navigating rugged terrain. We haven't had to experience the waterproof feature yet, but I would expect that to perform well, too. Now I think I need a pair!

title: True Fit Size
text: I ordered this shirt in a 2XL. I usually wear a size 18 or 1XL. Recently, I've found that the 1XL size has been more snug than I would like, especially in unfamiliar brands. When I tried it on, it was a little over sized on me. Then I remembered that I ordered up a size, so that made sense. The 1XL may have worked for me after all. However, I'm not swimming in this shirt (let's blame pandemic weight gain!). It fits loosely on me but doesn't look baggy. The shirt itself is soft to the touch. The decal is actually quite good.
