I'm picky about the decals. I have gotten some that are super cute, but are a bit stiff and feel annoying. Or they are noisy when you brush up against something. This one flexes nicely and quietly. It doesn't annoy me at all. I really like this shirt a lot!

title: Hoping These Stretch a Bit
text: My daughter is a waitress and needed some appropriate work shoes. We ordered her regular shoe size but she found them to be a little tight. We're hoping these stretch a bit. They do have good support. And in her words, "they aren't too ugly".

title: Comfortable
text: My husband recently misplaced his slippers. It's been a couple of weeks and they still haven't shown up. I ordered these as a quick replacement. They fit fine and as expected. They have adequate padding and support. He can wear them outside. So far, they seem to be good.

title: Dainty
text: This is a beautiful and dainty ring. The stone is small as well as the little faux diamonds on the side, but it's pretty. The fit is good. It isn't raised up very much, so I haven't had much trouble with it snagging on things. It's a simple and affordable ring.

title: One Touch Open & Close
text: If you're like me, you need to replace your umbrella regularly. I don't know if I'm too hard on them, or they're just not long lasting. My last one that I used the most, won't stay closed any longer. So it was time for a new one. I also tend to have different sized ones for different needs. I keep full size ones in the car, but when traveling, or out and about on a possible rainy day, I prefer a more compact one that I can slip in my bag. This one is compact, but not one of those tiny ones. It will fit in a bag, but not my purse. That's okay because I'm not sure I would want it in my purse. This opens with one touch of a button. The same button (one touch) will close it, but you still have to lower the shaft. The ribs seem sturdy. The camouflage dinosaur print is fun. I would have preferred more girly options, but this is fine.  The quality seems to be very good. Only time (and use) will tell!

title: Snug
text: My daughter is starting a waitress job and needed a black button down shirt until they are able to give her an official shirt. The fit is a little snug on her which she didn't expect. The fabric is thick and heavy. She says it's not soft at all and she found it to be a little scratchy. It did require an initial ironing to remove all the fold creases. It's also very long. My daughter is pretty tall. Because she has to tuck it in, there's an awful lot of fabric bulk around her middle. So she says this will do until she gets her official shirt, but she probably won't be keeping it after that.

title: True to Size
text: This is an almost complete baby set! The pieces coordinate together.  There are rose print items, solid white, and solid pink. They are really beautiful pieces! They are made from a soft organic cotton. The items seem to be true to size. They are well made and wash well. This would make an awesome baby gift!

title: Good Quality
text: This hat is a good quality, especially for the price. It's not the super cheap ones that you get at the party store and they're a far way from the expensive ones that you will find at the specialty stores. It's a good in between hat. My daughter has been wanting a cowboy hat and I thought this was a good one to try out. She found it to be a little tight on her head. I don't really think of her as having a large head. She says she'll probably still wear it. It's not too tight. It looks very nice.

title: It's a Bargain!
text: This is a pretty ring. It's very shiny and sparkly. I was hoping it would look nice next to another ring that I wear, but it's not as shiny and sparkly, so there's a contrast between them that I don't like. By itself, it looks great. The size fits as expected. It's a bargain at $6.99.

title: There's So Much Room!
text: I am a long time Vera Bradley fan. I've only recently started using some of their travel bags. I have been very impressed with them. This one has so much room! I can easily fit in everything I need for a weekend. My packing cubes fit very nicely inside. The main compartment is just a big spacious area. There are mesh slip pockets on one side. There's a large outer pocket that has a buckle closure. There are pockets on the ends that can hold water bottles or umbrellas. I recently traveled by plane with another Vera Bradley bag and I loved (and utilized) the feature it has where you can slide the whole bag over the handle of the suitcase. I was so excited to see that this bag has that feature, too! It really is a lifesaver! The bag is durable and well made. There's sturdy straps as well as a longer and adjustable shoulder strap that you can attach. The grey print fabric is classy! It's really a useful bag for traveling!

title: Great Quality
text: My husband and I recently traveled to a trade show out of state. While waiting at baggage claim for our luggage, we saw so many similar black suitcases. I remembered that my dad used to use a luggage strap on his suitcase when he traveled, so I thought it might be a good idea. I chose the bring pink because. I'm not sure my husband will be thrilled with that, but even he will have to admit that it's easier to identify our suitcases now! These straps are sturdy and a good quality. They adjust just like a belt. I'm ready for our next trip!

title: Lots of Storage
text: This is a new Vera Bradley style purse for me. I don't think I've ever seen it before. The bag is a good size for me, but it is a smaller bag. It would not have been enough for me if my kids were young. I think I like it better over the shoulder than as a crossbody. That's my personal preference. My full size wallet (VB Turnlock) barely fits in the center section and doesn't fit in the 2 outer ones. The 2 outer compartments don't seem to have anything to distinguish them apart from one another. That's resulted in me having to work harder to locate things. If one of them had a different pocket on the outside, I could tell which one was which without having to open them. If I grab my purse and switch the orientation of it, it is easy to mix those up. One of them does have an interior zippered pocket which is helpful, but I do have to open that compartment to see it. The quality of the bag is good. I do like it, but it's not my favorite style of purse.

title: Modest & Cute!
text: My daughter is in college. She's active in her school ambassadorship program and needed something to wear with her official polo shirt. She wanted a skirt instead of pants, but it was hard to find one that wasn't too short. This one is modest but still cute. She's 5'7" and it hits her mid thigh which is pretty respectable these days. It's a very forgiving fabric and doesn't need ironing. The elastic waist is comfortable. She is very pleased with it and wants me to order another one in a different color.

title: Great Pants!
text: Dockers are my husband's favorite brand of pants. These are true to size. The material isn't heavy or stiff. The pants are comfortable to wear. My husband is very happy with them.

title: Did Not Fit My Wide Feet
text: These are really cute and comfy sandals. I really like the faux snake print. They have adequate cushion and support. The strap near the ankle is adjustable, but the one by the toes is not. I have wide feet and since I couldn't adjust the one strap, they didn't fit me.

title: True to Size Fit
text: These Docker pants are true to size fit. They have a good amount of stretch in them that makes them different from most pants. My husband is very happy with them.

title: Love This Purse!
text: I love this purse! First of all, the red floral print is beautiful! The Indiana logo is embroidered front and center. There are 2 zippered pockets on the front. One of them as a couple of slip pockets inside. The main compartment has an interior zippered pocket. All zippers glide easily. The shoulder strap can be adjusted. On the back side of the purse is a slip pocket which is the perfect size for a mobile phone. The purse is lined with a coordinating solid red fabric. The construction of the purse is very good. It's perfect for any Indiana University fan!

title: Comfortable
text: My husband found these Docker pants to be comfortable. The fabric is a bit stretchy, so he commented that they would still fit if you gain a little weight. The fit was as expected. The brand is one of his favorites when it comes to pants. The quality is on par with the Docker brand.

title: Lots of Fun Designs
text: This set comes with 15 different and fun colors and designs of wristlet key chains/lip balm holders, and faux fur pom poms. My daughter has been passing these out to her friends. They've been a big hit! She picked out hers, first, naturally! The items are a decent quality. The key chains and lip balm holders are neoprene material. Everything seems to be sturdy and durable.

title: College Must Have Item!
text: The Vera Bradley Zip ID case is a must have item for college students. It has enough room to hold your student ID, a little cash, and bank card. There's a key ring for your room key. The Indiana logo is on one side while the other side sports a clear vinyl window for your ID. The item is sturdy and well made. I love the new floral print!

title: Cute!
text: These Guess sunglasses are cute and stylish. The arms don't seem very sturdy and I worry about the longevity. They provide adequate protection from the sun. They aren't too snug or tight. It comes with a decent storage case.

title: Such a Cute Shirt!
text: This is such a cute Georgia shirt! My daughter loves it! The material is a corduroy type fabric that's soft and has a texture to it. The size fits just as expected. My daughter really likes the shorter length. It comes to just at her waist. She has worn it a couple of time already and has been asked by several friends where she got it from. It's different from the shirts available at the campus bookstore!

title: So Cute!
text: My daughter is thrilled with her Georgia wristlet wallet by Vera Bradley. It's a full size wallet with plenty of storage for everything she needs. It's sturdy and well made. The wrist strap is secure and does not show any indication that it would fail. The floral print is very cute. The Georgia logo is sewn on. It's really a great wallet!

title: Great Fit
text: My daughter is very happy with her new sweatshirt. The cut and style is very modern and trendy which she liked. It's a shorter, almost cropped length. It hits her just above her waist. She is excited for the cooler weather to arrive so she can wear it!

title: Snug Fit
text: I wear a 10 Wide shoe. I was hopeful that these would fit after reading other reviews stating that they were too loose. I thought that there might be enough room for my wide feet. Unfortunately they are a little too snug on me. Plus, the upper edge leaves a mark on the top of my foot and is a bit uncomfortable. The length is good, but would be better if they weren't too snug. As it is, my heel is right up to the edge, but there's a little more room in the toe area. If it was a tad looser, I think my foot could utilize some of that toe area for a better fit. I really do like the faux snake pattern. I think these would look great with a black outfit!

title: Good Variety
text: These beaded bracelets come in a good variety of colors. The bracelets look cute. The elastic string doesn't seem super durable. I've already broken one, so I have been trying to be more careful with the remaining ones. I'm thinking about adding a drop of clear craft glue where these are joined together to see if that helps.

title: Great Fit!
text: It's not quite time for long sleeved shirts, but fall will be here before we know it. My husband likes casual long sleeve button down shirts and he likes Tommy Hilfiger apparel, so I thought this would be perfect. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 210. This shirt fits great! The sleeves are long enough (and not too long). The buttons don't gape or pucker. It's not too heavy of a material, so it will be comfortable to wear in the milder winter months. The color isn't red or pink, it's somewhere in between. It looks really nice on him.

title: Beautiful Frame
text: This Kate Spade frame is beautiful. It looks elegant and fancy. The wavy design is unique. The frame has a good feel to it and doesn't feel cheap. It would make a great gift!

title: Best Lanyard!
text: This Vera Bradley lanyard is the best lanyard! It has the beautiful and subtle Vera Bradley print fabric. The lanyard is sturdy and durable. The hardware is strong, too. These really are the best lanyards out there!

title: Good Fit
text: My husband had only one pair of sunglasses. He kept them in his car, but when we are in my car, he was without. I ordered this pair for him to leave in my car. He likes the style. The provide adequate cover from the sun. The arms feel pretty sturdy and not cheap. They are a good fit and not too tight on his temples.

title: Snug
text: I wear a size 10W in women's shoes. Unfortunately these are too snug on me to wear. I could get them on my feet, but my toes were pushed up against the sides and it wasn't comfortable to wear at all. The shoes look really cute. I love the color combination. There's adequate cushion. There's good traction on the bottoms.

title: Great Bag!
text: Another great bag from Vera Bradley. This bag is the perfect size for my needs on a typical day. The bag is an excellent quality item and what I would expect from Vera Bradley. I am loving their new recycled cotton material. I really can't tell the difference between it and their former cotton materials. I love the print of this fabric!

title: Flattering T-Shirt
text: This is a flattering t-shirt. The fabric is soft. The shirt length is good and doesn't ride up when I bend over. The size is perfect. It's slightly fitted, but not what I would call a truly fitted t-shirt. I like it so much, I'm going to check out the other designs they have!

title: A Little Smaller Than I Expected
text: I am terrible about reading the measurements for things. So this was a little smaller than I expected. However, it's more than adequate. There's plenty or room for me to display and organize the jewelry I wear most frequently. It comes ready to use out of the box. It's sturdy and doesn't wobble. I like the way it looks.

title: Compact
text: The Deluxe All Together Crossbody Purse by Vera Bradley is essentially a large wallet on a string. It's very compact and will be perfect for an upcoming business trip. I'll be in a large urban setting, so I like that I will be able to keep this across my chest and close to my body. I will definitely feel safer. On one side, there's a section with card slots and a removable checkbook cover. The only ID window is on the front of the checkbook cover. I think I would prefer the ID window to be somewhere that is more permanent. Plus, I rarely use my checkbook these days. The large center compartment has card slots on both sides. There's a zippered pocket in the middle which I use for coins. There are also a couple of areas that could be used for bills or receipts. Then on the back side (or front, depending on which way you hold it) is a good sized zippered pocket. My Pixel 4 phone fits in it nicely. The shoulder strap is thin, but adjustable. The floral print is gorgeous! I love the gray! It goes with almost everything! This is a good bag and it's made well.

title: Beautiful Backpack
text: I'm a long time fan of Vera Bradley bags. This is my first Utility Backpack. It was a little smaller than I expected, but it's not a small bag. I think I have grown used to the Campus XL bag which is huge! The bag is made well. There's plenty of storage. This bag is solid on the outside and then lined with a monochromatic floral print inside. I personally love the traditional Vera Bradley floral prints, but it is nice to have other options.

title: Decent Robe
text: This is a decent satin robe. It doesn't feel super cheap, but it doesn't feel high end either. The robe fits as expected. It has an interior tie as well as a matching belt. The length is good and not too short. There are no pockets. The fabric feels silky.

title: Easy to Adjust
text: My 20 year old daughter loves wearing anklet bracelets likes these. She was very pleased with the assortment of colors. They are easy to adjust. She's selected a few of her favorite ones and plans to share some with her close friends.

title: Light Weight Robe
text: I love this robe! I have a few different robes and they're all too warm to be used during this summer heat. This one is doable. It's lightweight and very comfortable. The blush color is lovely. The pockets are a good size. The only thing I don't like about it is that it doesn't have a traditional robe belt. Instead, there are ties that wrap around. It reminds me of the robes that they use at the women's health center when I get my mammograms. So basically it takes me a moment to figure out how to tie it each time I wear it! Other than that, I love this robe!

title: Slightly Snug
text: This is my husband's first time wearing Reebok shoes, so we were unfamiliar with how they fit.  He wears an 11 to 11.5 in shoes. With Adidas, the 11's are fine. These are slightly snug on him, but they're not tight or uncomfortable. He says if he was to order another pair, he would probably try an 11.5 if they have it. He's pleased with the arch support and overall comfort of the shoes. In a time when so many shoes are bright and colorful, he is happy to have a pair that don't call a lot of attention to him.

title: Comfortable Fit
text: These men's Timberland socks have a comfortable fit. The socks have a good arch support. The heels are reinforced. They stay in place well. My husband likes his new socks a lot!

title: Sturdy & Stylish!
text: These sun glasses are sturdy and stylish! The have a good feel to them. I really like the plum/mauve color of the frames. I have a large head and they are comfortable to wear and don't squeeze my temples.

title: What a Nice Shirt!
text: My husband was in need of a wardrobe update. I don't think we got any new shirts for him last year since we were in the pandemic, so now most of his shirts were faded and worn. This was the first shirt I ordered for him this season. What a nice shirt it is! The fit is perfect. The buttons don't gap or pucker. The classic fit looks great on him. I even found some solid colored Tommy shirts in the classic fit and ordered them since this one was a winner. One thing he does like about this shirt is that the logo is not the star of the shirt! It's a modest one. He is very happy with his new shirt.

title: So Pretty!
text: My 20 year old daughter loves snakes and wearing rings. She has a snake ring, but it's more of a Gothic style. This is a pretty, feminine snake ring. The ring was just a tad small on her ring finger. So either it's a small size 7 or my daughter's fingers were retaining water or something. However, she likes wearing rings on other fingers, too, so it's all good. This could be worn with casual attire or dressy.

title: Great Fit!
text: These ankle socks are a great fit. My husband wears a size 11 and they fit him fine. When I asked him how he liked them, he replied "they cover my feet". They have some arch support. The toes and heels are gray. He likes them!

title: Another Great Bag By Vera Bradley!
text: This is another great bag by Vera Bradley. The description says the size is acceptable for airline carry-on bags. Yay! The bag is made from the new Vera Bradley recycled cotton. The material is soft and I personally can't tell the difference between this recycled cotton and the original cotton. They feel and look the same. I think it's great that the company is making this effort. This bag is roomy and can easily hold a weekend's amount of stuff. I am very pleased with the overall workmanship of the bag. I love that this bag can just slip over the extended handle of your checked luggage!

title: Lightweight
text: This is a good lightweight robe. My fleece robes have been too hot to wear lately, so I needed a lighter one. I am a size 16/18 and this L/XL robe fits fine. There are pockets - yay! The length is fine. The color is okay. I would have preferred something a little prettier, but this is fine. I am satisfied.

title: Huge Bag!
text: This Grand Weekender Travel bag is huge! This easily holds everything I need for a weekend, including toiletries, hair dryer, make up, clothes, and shoes. It has straps that go over the shoulder, but there's also a detachable and adjustable shoulder strap as well. There are slip pockets and zipped pockets aplenty. It can even be hung on your luggage's pull handle! The bag is made well and is very sturdy. I love that you can throw it in the washing machine if needed! This bag is all you need!

title: Not for Large Cup Sizes!
text: I was excited to get a new swimsuit! I followed the sizing chart and ordered accordingly. The bottom fits perfectly. The top, not so much. When I first held it in my hand, I thought it was a child's size by mistake! It is labeled correctly, but it didn't fit at all. I wear a size 40DD. The bra part didn't even cover half of my breasts! It was comical as to how little it covered. It's definitely not for large cup sizes!! So much for having a new swimsuit!!

title: Pretty!
text: This simulated opal necklace is very pretty. The stone is very sparkly and shiny. The chain seems to be sturdy. I prefer a little longer necklace personally. The chain does not have an extender. Plus, I found the clasp was very difficult to do on my own. The ring part that the clasp hooks on to is very small. Usually that piece is a little larger than this. The quality is nice and as I said it is pretty.

title: Well Made!
text: This medium duffel bag by Vera Bradley is well made. The stitching is even and good. The zippers are sturdy and glide easily. It comes with handles that are long enough to go over your shoulder, but there's also a separate adjustable padded shoulder strap as well. There are a couple of mesh slip pockets that are see through in the interior. On the exterior, there are large pockets on both ends of the bag and a zippered pocket and slip pocket on the front of the bag. I am pleased that the company is making a recycled cotton now. I really can't tell the difference!  The butterfly fabric is whimsical and fun. My daughter loves this bag!

title: Nice Hanger!
text: This is a good size hanging travel organizer. It is made well and it's very sturdy. I do wish all of the compartments had the vinyl lining which makes it easy to clean, rather than just a couple of them. The compartments are not very wide, so that will limit what you can take with you, which is not necessarily a bad thing. I often end up packing too much in the way of toiletries! I love that Vera Bradley is now using recycled cotton!

title: A Quality Bag
text: This sling backpack is a quality bag. It is made well and very durable. The butterfly fabric is fun and cheery. The backpack is perfect for those times when you don't need to carry a lot of stuff with you, but you need to be hands free. I like to use this style of bag when I go hiking. I can carry my phone, a snack, my keys and a few other items.

title: Quality Shoes
text: These are quality shoes. They're made well. They have excellent traction. They have adequate cushion and support. I wear a women's 10 Wide shoe. I often size up to an 11 because of the width. These men's shoes fit in the length just fine, but they were too narrow in the front of the shoes and my toes felt squished. The width in the rest of the foot was fine.

title: Gorgeous Wallet
text: This is a gorgeous wallet that comes with a bonus wristlet! The wristlet strap can be removed easily if you desire. The wallet zips around 3 out of 4 sides of the wallet. When it is opened fully, it expands like an accordion, hence the name. There are 8 card pockets, a clear ID window, a couple of places for bills and receipts. There's also a smaller zippered coin pocket and an outer slip pocket. The wallet has RFID protection. The quality is excellent and what I would expect from Vera Bradley.

title: Great Quality!
text: This is a cute little wallet. It has a key ring on it so you could attach a lanyard to it. For its size, it has a lot of storage. I really like that it has the RFID protection. It's a great quality and what I would expect from Vera Bradley.

title: Ultimate Backpack!
text: The Vera Bradley XL Campus backpack is the ultimate backpack. It's a durable bag that can hold everything! There's plenty of room for textbooks, laptop, lunch and more. There are lots of pockets and compartments. All the zippers glide easily. The construction is excellent! The straps are comfortable. You could easily use this as a weekend bag if you wanted! The rainforest canopy print is gorgeous and has a summer vibe to it.

title: Great Storage
text: I just recently went out of town for the week. I used this cord bag to carry my laptop charger and a power strip. There was enough room that I also put an extra phone charging cable in it as well. It kept things organized and tangle free! Plus, my luggage looked so much nicer because I didn't shove these things in loose! This bag has a zippered pocket and mesh slip pockets. It's made well and seems to be quite sturdy. The bag is zippered so everything stays put.

title: Great for Traveling!
text: This jewelry case by Vera Bradley is great for traveling! I love it! It can easily hold  almost all the jewelry I need for the week or so. It has a super soft faux suede material to keep your jewelry from getting scratched. There's space for rings, necklaces, bracelets and earrings. It holds a lot, but if you have a bunch of chunky jewelry, you may find it won't accommodate all of it. The quality of this organizer is excellent! The butterfly print is adorable!

title: Perfect Size!
text: I don't use a lot of coins these days, but I do like keeping some handy for the parking meters when I go downtown. I find it easier than dealing with my debit card on those machines! This has to be one of the simplest Vera Bradley bags ever! At least I thought it was until I discovered it actually as a little slip pocket inside! How cute! I can hold a lot more coins in this than in my wallet. It's durable and well made. It's a must have item!

title: Cute!
text: I recently went out of town for a few days. I used this little bag for my phone & smart watch charging cables, as well as a spare cable and a power brick. I liked being able to locate it easily compared to the times when I just tossed it in my bag. The size is pretty small, so it can't hold a lot, but it keeps them safe. The bag is durable. There's a slip pocket on one side and a zippered pocket on the other side. There is also some elastic pieces that you could slip a cable behind. When I was unpacking at my destination, I knew immediately where my charging cables were and I appreciated the organization.

title: Cute Design
text: I have several Vera Bradley purses, but this is the first time I have seen the Glenna Satchel. One thing that I do like about it is that the bag is a bit wider than many of the other ones that I have. The interior space can easily accommodate more bulk than the crossbody styles I usually get. There is a zippered pocket and a few slip pockets inside, too. The outside has a slip pocket on each of the two faces of the bag. On the ends of the bag are cinches so you can tighten the bag. The bag has a zippered closure so things won't fall out if it tips over. There's also a secret hidden zippered pocket on the front! I do wish the straps were just a tad longer. It does fit on my shoulder, but then the bag feels like it's up too high on my body. It would feel more natural to me if it was just an inch or two longer. The overall quality of the bag is excellent.

title: Love This Wallet
text: I have several different Vera Bradley wallet styles but this Turnlock one is my favorite! First of all, it has the RFID protection which is important to me. Then there's plenty of room for everything I need and want to carry around with me. There are multiple card slots for credit cards and reward cards. There's plenty of space for cash and receipts. I use the outer zippered pocket for coins. The wallet is very durable. The zippers are high quality and work well. It's really a great wallet!! Plus, the Butterfly print fabric is so much fun!

title: Roomy
text: My first impression of this Vera Bradley trifold wallet was how roomy it is. It has plenty of room for everything I need to keep in my wallet. There's a vinyl ID window and 14 card slots. There's also a couple of full size pockets for cash or receipts. There's an interior zippered pocket which I use for coins and an exterior zippered pocket, too. The wallet has a snap closure with 2 snaps available depending on how full you stuff the wallet. The material is a cute butterfly print. There's RFID protection which I appreciate.  The wallet is constructed well and seems to be very durable.

title: Comfortable
text: This lanyard by Vera Bradley is not only cute, but comfortable, too! The material is silky and soft. There's a buckle type clip that allows you to quickly and easily remove whatever it is you have hanging on the lanyard. At the end of the removable piece is a small but sturdy mini carabiner style clip. The lanyard is a little wider than the typical Vera Bradley ones that allow you to actually see the beautiful print on the fabric.

title: Comfortable
text: My 23 year old son wears a size 15 shoe. I have to buy him the Big & Tall socks, but they're not always easy to find. He says these are very comfortable. They arrived at a good time because I recently threw out a bunch of his socks because of holes. These are a mid-thickness. The cooling feature isn't really noticeable (according to my son), but because they're not too thick, they are definitely a cooler temperature sock. The sizing fits as expected.

title: Nice Quality
text: I ordered these Columbia sandals for myself. I wear a women's size 10W. I often get a size 11 (not Wide) and that will work. The length of these men's sandals is fine on me. The sandals do fit, but they can't be adjusted on my foot. They come at the maximum adjustment so all you can do is pull the strap and make it slightly tighter. Plus you can only adjust them at one point and where I needed adjusting, there was no way to do that. The quality is nice. They look good, too.

title: Great Fit!
text: These biker shorts have a great fit! I ordered my daughter's current size and she was pleased with the overall fit. She says they're comfortable to wear. The Reebok brand is large on the side as shown in the pictures. My daughter doesn't mind, but if you don't like large visible logos or names, this may not be for you.

title: Great for Running Errands
text: The Vera Bradley Zip ID Case & Lanyard set is great for running errands. You can put your license in the ID window and your credit card or a small amount of cash into the zippered section. The lanyard is sturdy and strong. There's no risk in it falling apart while in use. It's constructed well. It is really a must have item in my opinion!

title: Great Storage!
text: This jewelry travel case has some great storage! Plus, it keeps your jewelry safe and protected. This easily accommodates the amount of jewelry that I might take with me on a trip. It's not big enough to contain a lot of bulky, chunky jewelry, but it will definitely work for regular necklaces, bracelets, earrings, and rings. The zippers all work well. The pieces that have snaps are sturdy. I'm very impressed with this little bag!

title: Cute!
text: This is a cute towel wrap. I love the butterfly print fabric. The towel is a good thickness. It's not thin at all, but not too thick that it won't wrap around you easily. I am a size 16/18. My towel wrap is an L/XL. I feel that I'm at the maximum size for this. It's ever so slightly tight in the band that goes around the upper chest area. It's not uncomfortable, just snug. If there was a larger size, I would probably be happier with that. The wrap does close so I'm covered adequately. I do like the addition of the shoulder straps. I used to have a strapless towel wrap back in college and I would worry about it staying up all the time. I like the security the straps provide.

title: Perfect for the Weekend!
text: I'm from Indiana. where the Vera Bradley company originated from there. My mother was a huge fan and always had several Vera Bradley bags and items. She often gifted me purses and accessories over the years.  Mom passed away a few years ago and to this day, Vera Bradley items remind me of my mom. This small duffel bag is perfect for the weekend. I've had a couple of the larger duffel bags before, but this is my first small one. It would also be a good size for a child. The construction of the bag is excellent and what I would expect from the brand. It comes with sturdy handles that are long enough to be worn over your shoulders. There's also an adjustable shoulder strap that can be clipped on to it. Inside along one of the longer sides, is a mesh slip pocket that's about the size of the whole length of the bag. Then there are padded slip pockets on the exterior of the bag on the ends. The butterfly print is whimsical. I love that the fabric is made from recycled cotton!

title: Nice Variety
text: This is a good variety of costume type jewelry. The quality is okay, but they have a cheap look to them. I thought I would be able to easily bend one of the metal pendants, but it was sturdier than it looked. So they're not as cheaply made as they look. I like the styles. I do wish that some of them were longer or had one of those adjuster pieces at the clasp. Some of them hit me just below the chest and it looked awkward. I prefer for them to hang a little lower than that.

title: Sturdy
text: I have used many Vera Bradley bags over the years, but this Grand Hanging Travel Organizer is a new one to me. My immediate reaction to it was how sturdy and large it is. The main compartment is deep enough to hold full size shampoo and conditioner bottles. I've had other hanging travel bags and that wasn't always the case. There is a clear vinyl lining that will be easy to keep clean. There are mesh pockets too. There is no doubt that you can carry everything you need - skin care, hair care, and make up. The only thing I don't like about the bag is the tie fastener at the top. While it looks nice, it would be faster to have a different type of closure. But since that's a personal issue, I can't fault the bag for that!

title: One of My Favorites
text: As a long time fan of Vera Bradley bags, I have a few favorites. The Hipster Crossbody is one of them. The size is just right to carry everything I need. The straps are durable and easily adjustable. The interior has a zippered pocket on one side and two slip pockets on the other. The slip pockets are so easy to access! On the outside there's another zippered pocket and a slip one on the front side and a hidden zippered pocket on the back. The blue butterfly pattern is whimsical and makes me happy. The bag is very well made. Stitching is straight. No loose threads. Zippers are sturdy. Another great bag by Vera Bradley!

title: Easy Wipe Interior
text: I love that this Vera Bradley bag is specifically for carrying your essential oils!! The interior fabric has this in mind. It's an easy to wipe vinyl fabric so just in case your oils leak, your bag won't be ruined. You can hold 12 small bottles of essential oils. The quality of the bag is excellent and just what I would expect from Vera Bradley. This butterfly print is whimsical and fun!

title: Unique Design
text: I am a longtime fan of Vera Bradley bags. This utility sling bag has a unique design. The straps are padded and adjustable. There's a hidden zippered pocket on the underside of the bag. The bag has two main compartments. Then in addition to those, there's a large pocket on the outer front of the bag that closes with one of those squeeze type buckles. The compartment closest to your body has a slip pocket and a zippered one. The other main compartment has no pockets. All parts (zippers, buckles) work well. The whoel back is durable and sturdy. The Rainforest Canopy print is summery. I love that Vera Bradley is using recycled cotton now!

title: Cute Party Corset!
text: My daughter is in college. She's a fan of corsets and other current trends. This one fits fine and as expected. She wears a size medium to large in clothing. Her bra size is a 34D. It fastens like a bra, so there is some flexibility. The rhinestones feel heavy when you pick up the garment, but the weight is distributed nicely so it doesn't feel heavy when she's wearing it. The straps are a bit thin and she does worry that they might not last too long. She's hoping that they prove her wrong. She is very excited to have this in her wardrobe.

title: Great for a Small Wallet
text: This Vera Bradley Petite Zip Around wallet is great for a small wallet. I was pleased to see that there are a few compartments inside. On the outside you have a clear ID window. In the inside, you have slip pockets on both exterior sides. Then there are 3 divided compartments as well as a zippered pouch. The compartments are wide enough to fit credit card type items. If you have dollars, you will have to fold them in half. I personally ended up doing that a lot of the time anyway, so that's not any different for me. The exterior main zipper is pretty durable. There's a key ring, too. You could put a lanyard on it and have everything you need when on the go! I really like the pretty floral print inside. This is a great alternative to the other ID wallets!

title: Comfortable
text: My 20 year old daughter is working with middle school kids this summer. She is not allowed to wear popular  name brand shoes or clothes while working. She needed some comfortable but basic sneaker type shoes. She has been wearing these daily for a week now. She says they're pretty comfortable. They don't offer as much arch support as some of her other shoes, but it's decent. She likes how they look. She got the all black ones. She says that she will probably wear them at other times, just not while at work.

title: Great Function!
text: This Utility Small Crossbody Purse by Vera Bradley is a great bag! First of all, it's made from recycled cotton which makes it very Eco Friendly. The material is padded which gives it a quilted look and feel to it. There are two outer pockets, one is open and the other has a flap with a magnetic snap closure. My Pixel 4a phone fits snuggly in either pocket. The interior has 2 slip pockets about half the size of the bag and one zippered pocket which is about the full size of the bag. Zippers works well. The stitching on the bag looks great. There's a durable shoulder strap that can be adjusted. The cheery print is perfect for summertime!

title: Comfortable Tote Bag
text: This small Vera tote by Vera Bradley is a comfortable tote bag. The straps are long enough to go over your shoulders. There's a slip pocket on the outer front of the bag with a zippered pocket in front of that. The bottom of the bag is very sturdy and has a rigid bottom. There are six interior slip pockets for organizing your belongings. The entire bag zips close so you don't have to worry about losing anything if it tips over. The blue butterfly print fabric is charming. The quality of the bag is excellent and it should last a long time.

title: Great for On the Go
text: During the pandemic, I became quite fond of using the Vera Bradley Zip ID wallets. It was easier to deal with a lanyard and small wallet than a larger purse. This one is a beautiful turquoise blue with embroidered sea stars (I think - or flowers?) on one side. The other side has the clear ID window. The interior has a complimentary black & white sketch print with a hint of the blue and coral colors of the previously mentioned embroidery work. Once I removed the item tag, the zipper glided quite nicely. This could be used with a lanyard and worn around your neck or because of it's small size, it can be put into a pocket. There's not a whole lot of room, but you can definitely fit a credit card, ID, and some cash. This is made well and has proven to be useful. These are also great for work and college students.

title: Great Size!
text: This backpack is a great size for traveling! The backpack as a large main compartment with mesh slip pockets on one side. There's a slim, padded compartment in the back (near where the straps are) that easily accommodates a laptop. There's a zippered compartment that's about half the height of the bag with a clear ID window and card slots, pen slots and more. Then on the front of that is another slightly smaller zippered pocket. There are bottle holders on both sides of the bag. The zippers work well. They have ribbon pulls on them. The shoulder straps are padded and can be adjusted. This bag can also be slipped onto a suitcase pull handle. The Rainforest Canopy print is cheery and perfect for summer traveling!

title: Sturdy Tote!
text: This Vera Bradley Utility Tote bag is very sturdy. The construction of it is excellent. It's padded and looks almost quilted. The pink material is vibrant and cheery. I absolutely love the coordinating pink floral print. I wish there was some of that on the exterior of the bag. There is plenty of room to carry everything you need for an outing. It would actually make a nice diaper bag in my opinion. It has thick handles that can easily fit over your shoulder, or you can use the included shoulder strap if you would like it to be worn longer on you. It's not my favorite Vera bag, but it's definitely a good one. And I can't fault it for my own opinions!

title: Keeps Checks in Nice Condition
text: I don't write a lot of checks these days, but when I recently got my checkbook out to write a few checks fro graduation gifts, I noticed that the corners were getting bent. It wasn't affecting the actual checks, but the corners of the duplicate parts were all bent up. This checkbook cover is keeping everything in a nicer condition. It has a vinyl piece that you can use to prevent bleed through writing with the duplicate checks. The cover has a slip pocket on both interior halves. It's made well as I would expect from Vera Bradley.

title: Fun Shirt!
text: This is a fun shirt! I love the cat on it. It reminds me of 3 of my 4 cats who behave just like that!! The shirt is a  good quality. The fit is perfect. I ordered the 2XL. I'm a size 16/18. The shirt is a loose fit, but not baggy. The t-shirt is not too heavy or thin. I am very pleased with it.

title: Works So Well
text: I absolutely love this glasses holder. It works so well! I have it on my nightstand and put my glasses in it when I go to bed. It offers lots of protection to my glasses and keeps them safe. It's so much better than just keeping them on the nightstand. Plus, I think it's very cute!

title: Awesome Backpack!
text: This Vera Bradley backpack is awesome! I love the beautiful blue color. The inside floral lining is gorgeous. I wish that there was just a little bit of the floral print on the outside as well. The backpack is very sturdy and well made. The stitching is good. The zippers are sturdy and they glide well. There is lots of room and storage. It's really a great all purpose backpack.

title: Great Fit!
text: My daughter loves her new steel toe boots! We tried out the steel toe feature and she was quite impressed with it. My 200 + pound husband was able to put all of his weight on her toe area and she couldn't feel it at all! She does a lot of outdoor lab work at school and likes the added protection. These are true to size fit. She likes that they're not too high at the ankle so she can get by wearing lower socks. These are a great quality.

title: Generous Storage
text: This hip pack by Columbia has generous storage. At first glance, I thought it had the 2 outer pockets on the front and the main compartment. But upon further discovery, I found even more storage! On one of the side pieces, there's a small zippered pocket. You could keep money or a credit card & ID in there. Then on the webbing strip on the sides, you could hang things off of them. I don't know if that's the purpose (or if it's purely decorative), but there are 3 small loops (not sure if that's the best description) on each side. Each of those loops is about an inch wide. The pack is easy to adjust and comfortable to wear. The nylon material is durable.

title: Nice Size
text: This glasses case is a nice size. It consists of 2 attached pockets separated by padded fabric. You can store 2 pairs of glasses in this case. There's a little (tiny) metal clip on the end, but I don't really understand the point of it. It's too small to grab it. A thin lanyard clip might be able to clip onto it. I love the Rainforest Canopy Print! It's recycled cotton which is Eco friendly! The quality of the item is excellent and what I would expect from Vera Bradley.

title: Nostalgic Shirt
text: This is a nostalgic t-shirt! My daughter is a big fan of Queen and was quite excited to have a t-shirt of the band. I ordered her the XL size because she prefers oversized t-shirts. The shirt is a good quality. It's not too heavy or thin. It's not scratchy or rough. The graphics are printed nicely.

title: Comfortable
text: This shirt is true to size. It's slightly loose on me, but not baggy. It's longer than I expected and more like a tunic on my 5'6" frame. The material is soft and comfortable. The color is more of a purple-red than I anticipated. I'm not in love with how it looks on me. It looks kind of boring. There's nothing wrong with it!  I just have a "meh" feeling about it. If I was trying it on in the dressing room, I probably would put it back.

title: Comfortable!
text: I really like this light weight rain jacket! It's thin and easily packs into your suitcase. The fit is perfect! I am a size 16/18. I don't like my jackets to be tight or restrictive. I ordered this in the 3XL. There's enough room that I could easily wear a thick sweatshirt underneath it. Because of the light peachy pink color, it is a bit see through. I was wearing a blue striped shirt under the jacket and you could see the stripes through it. Because it's light weight, it's also breathable which is important to me during the hot summer months. Overall, I am very pleased with this.

title: Runs Small
text: This looks like a cute shirt, but it's not for me! First of all, it runs small. I couldn't even get it over my head! I ordered a size larger than I usually wear just to be on the safe size, but that was not enough. Secondly, I don't like the fabric. It feels synthetic. It wrinkles easily. It isn't soft at all. In all fairness, it's not scratchy or rough either. I just don't like it. The color is more peachy than pink.

title: Flattering
text: This women's swimsuit is very flattering. The ruched design conceals a lot! The sizing is true and fits me nicely. I thought that back was a little weird. I couldn't figure out if it was decorative or functional. The buckles or whatever they are were a little annoying when I was sitting in the hot tub with my back against the seat.

title: Lovely Costume!
text: It's that time of year when the Renaissance Fair is in town. My son has already been once, but he's planning to take his sister later this month. I ordered this for her to wear. She's 5'7" and currently wears a size 10/Large. This dress fits her nicely. She thought it might be a little big at first, but it can be tightened and adjusted easily. The costume is in two parts. The under dress is one piece and doesn't really adjust. The over dress laces up in the front and the back. There are also strings at the shoulders that be tightened, too. The length is good on her. The quality of the costume is better than I expected. I had a similar costume years ago that I wore for Halloween. It was just one of those Halloween bag costumes that you buy at the store in October. This is way better than that. The fabric is nicer and the workmanship is better. We're very happy with this costume.

title: Beautiful Bag!
text: This Vera Tote by Vera Bradley is a beautiful bag! It's well made, too. The straps are securely sewn. The zippers are sturdy. There's plenty of room to hold a lot of stuff. I am very pleased to see that Vera Bradley has a line of recycled cotton now.

title: Travel Organization!
text: I like using packing cubes when I travel. It really makes everything nice and neat inside your suitcase. This is a set of 3 cubes. I thought there was only 2 sizes with 2 of one style. However upon closer inspection, there is a slight difference so there really are 3 different sizes. I watched the video and loved how they perfectly fit inside the Lay Flat style backpack. I may have to get that! Everything is a good quality. The pink rainforest print is fun! I am looking forward to traveling soon so I can utilize these.

title: Roomy!
text: The Hipster crossbody bags by Vera Bradley have been one of my favorite styles. Though this triple zip style is new to me. There are 2 zippered pockets on the side and the zipper on top for the main compartment makes zipper #3. I usually don't wear these as a crossbody style because they are a bit bulky, but I do wear them on my shoulder. And when I've felt the need, I have worn them across my body for security. The Rainforest Canopy print is sunny and bright. It reminds me of Florida. The bag is constructed well. All the hardware is durable and sturdy. This is another great bag by Vera Bradley!

title: Wonderful Bag to Have!
text: This large Vera Tote by Vera Bradley is a wonderful bag to have! It holds so much stuff! This would make a great teacher bag or work bag. It's large size easily accommodates your teacher plans or mom planner and files. There are a few slip pockets and zipped ones. The entire bag zips closed so you don't have to worry about items spilling out in the car. The quality is excellent and what I have come to expect from Vera Bradley. I love the recycled cotton and the Rainforest Canopy print is lovely.

title: So Many Pairs of Fun Earrings!
text: There are so many pairs of fun earrings in this set. They are so cute! The quality is good. I hesitate to say great because I'm not sure of the longevity we'll have with them. They remind me of what you might find at Claire's Boutique.

title: Small But Mighty!
text: This Vera Bradley wallet is small but mighty. I was pleasantly surprised to see that there's a large zippered compartment which you could use to hold coins. There are plenty of card slots, a bill slot and and ID window. It has a double snap closure so if it's full, you can still snap it closed. The small size will fit into just about everything!

title: Lots of Room!
text: I like the idea of using a wristlet wallet. That allows you to carry it alone or in your purse. This Vera Bradley is made well. The hardware is sturdy. The zippers work nicely. There's lots of room! The zippered pocket on the outside can easily hold coins without affecting the wallet. I have one wallet that when I have too many coins inside, it develops an unsightly bulge. The interior has RFID protection. There's room for bills, cards, and there's an ID window, too. The Rainforest Canopy print is perfect for summer!

title: Fun!
text: These pom pom keychains are very cute! They seem to be made well. All pieces are attached securely. The actual metal keychain feels sturdy enough, though I suspect with lots of handling, it may have troubles. If it's hung from a book bag or purse it should be okay. This would be fun for a party favor.

title: Great Quality
text: This utility crossbody purse by Vera Bradley is bigger than I expected. It's also padded and has a quilted feel to it, though it's not quilted. The bag is a great quality and what I would expect from Vera Bradley. The stitches are straight. There are no loose threads. Zippers glide easily. There are several slip pockets and zippered pockets to help organize your belongings. This would be great for traveling!

title: Adorable Day Pack!
text: This Vera Bradley backpack makes an adorable day pack! The ECO friendly bag is made from recycled cotton. The Rain Forest Canopy print is perfect for summer! There are plenty of pockets and storage. The bag is sturdy and excellent quality. It's what I would expect from Vera Bradley.

title: Fun Assortment!
text: This is a fun assortment of braided bracelets. The quality is okay. They don't seem to be flimsy. They were a bit tangled up though when I opened them. They were just clumped together and many of the loose ends were intertwined. The description says that these are waterproof, however the instruction book that was included says to not wear them swimming or bathing. I think my daughter will be wearing them swimming. At this price, it's a no-brainer. I just thought it was odd that there was a contradiction.

title: So Cute!
text: We're always misplacing the bottle openers. These magnetic ones are a little more difficult to lose since you can stick them on the refrigerator. The cat paw design is adorable! I only wish there had been a black/white tuxedo cat paw! The material is durable. They do flex a little, but that's normal for silicone. These would be great for any cat lover!

title: Great for Quick Outings!
text: The Vera Bradley mini sling bag is great for quick outings. There's enough space for the basics. The straps are sturdy and adjustable. There are 3 zippered compartments. Zippers zip easily. I love the colorful fabric!

title: Sturdy
text: This luggage tag is very sturdy. It's the recycled cotton, but laminated. It's slightly stiff, but I found it not too  troublesome to attach to my bag. The only thing I didn't like was that there's a tag/label inside the vinyl window. I found it tricky to slide the info card in without getting caught on that label. And when I did finally get it inside, it was creased and bent. Other than that, I am pleased with this.

title: True Size Fit
text: These men's sandals are have a true size fit. The shoe bed is cushioned and makes for comfortable walking. The straps are easy to adjust. My husband is pleased with them.

title: See Through Pocket
text: This pencil case from Vera Bradley is made from recycled cotton and covered in an easy to wash PVC vinyl or similar material. It wipes clean! It has a large see through pocket so you can see the contents. There are loops on one side to go in a 3 ring binder. Zippers work well. It's sturdy and should be long lating.

title: Nice Jacket
text: This is a cute and nice light weight jacket. I wear a size 16/18 and I ordered this in the 1XL. It's a little snug in the arms on me. I should have ordered a size up like I usually do with jackets because I like a looser fit. The quality is good and it seems to be constructed well.

title: Just the Right Size
text: This Vera Bradley Little Hipster Crossbody purse is just the right size for running errands. There's an outer zippered pocket with a bill slip pocket and credit card slots, as well as an ID window. The main compartment has a large zippered pocket. The whole main compartment has a zip closure, too. Then on the back side there is a large slip pocket. The strap is adjustable. The hardware and zippers are sturdy. The fabric is colorful and perfect for summer! The quality of the bag is just what I would expect from Vera Bradley.

title: Cute
text: I really like this style of shirt. I wear similar shirts all the time. This one is cute but I  just found it to be oddly shaped. It's really wide. It's wider than it is long. It's a little short on me, but not to the point that I wouldn't wear it but every time I bend over or stretch, skin is visible. The arms are a bit snug. It seems to be made well.

title: Fitted Tank
text: I'm 5'6" and wear a size 16/18. I ordered this tank in the 1XL. It's a fitted style, but it fits. It's not tight at all on me. It has a racer style back so I have to pay attention to what bra I wear underneath it. It's comfortable. The construction seems fine.

title: Quick Drying!
text: This men's swimsuit is really quick drying! My husband has tried several that claim to be quick drying, but they weren't really. When he got out of the hot tub last night, he grabbed his towel and started to dry off. When he got to the trunks, there was no dripping water. The fit is good. He's 6'2" and weighs about 210 pounds. I ordered this in the large for him. It's a longer length which I think looks better than short ones. Overall, they're great swim trunks!

title: Decorative
text: This apron is beautiful, but it's really more decorative than functional. I am a longtime fan of Vera Bradley and this one was kind of a let down. The fabric is gorgeous. It's a vibrant print. However, it's just cotton fabric. It seems to be the same type of fabric that they use with their face masks except it's a single layer not double. (I should know because I bought a lot of their face masks during the past year!). I have 4 non-Vera aprons hanging in my kitchen. All of them are a thicker more durable fabric. Some of them seem to be canvas or something similar. I think that some kitchen spills could easily seep through the fabric which defeats the purpose of wearing the apron in the first place. I was excited that VB has added some new products to their line, but I think this one needs to be reconsidered or at least tweaked.

title: Cute Design
text: This wristlet has a cute design. It's small yet mighty. My Pixel 4a phone fits securely in it with plenty or room to spare, so if you have a larger phone, you'll be covered. The zippered wallet section has plenty of room for the basics plus another zippered pocket which can hold coins. The wristlet strap is comfortable when worn. The whole wristlet thing is taking some time getting used to, but I like the freedom of carrying less with me. The fabric is beautiful. The quality is excellent!

title: Way Too Short
text: I would say that I'm average as far as how long my torso is. This shirt is practically a crop top on me. The description says that it's fitted at the waist. This shirt doesn't even reach my waist. The shirt is a little snug on me which isn't a surprise. I'm probably right on the border of this size and the next one up. It's not uncomfortable though and if I loose some more weight, it might fit better. I like the color a lot. It seems to be made well. Because of the shortness on me, I probably won't wear it out in public.

title: Great for Traveling!
text: This maxi dress is great for traveling because it doesn't wrinkle! I  am 5'6" and currently wear a size 16/18. I ordered this in the XXL and it fits pretty well.  I feel that I need to tug at the empire waist a little so that the black top of the dress covers my chest area and the skirt area doesn't start until under the girls. The length is good and goes to about my ankles. The fabric is lightweight and comfortable to wear in the hot weather.

title: Well Made
text: My husband and I just got back from a street fair. I used this instead of my regular purse. I feel safer when using a crossbody in crowds. The bag was just the right size for the outing. There's a window for the ID, a few credit card slots. There's a zippered area and a slip pocket. I put my face mask in the slip pocket so I could access it easily if needed. I kept hand sanitizer and my coin purse in the larger zippered area. My cash and cards in the outer pocket with magnetic snap. A couple of times I noticed that the magnetic closure wasn't closed and I had to fix that. I kept my cash in that pocket since it was with my cards, but I wasn't completely satisfied with that. The bag itself is a good quality. I like the printed fabric. Overall, it was the perfect size for our outing.

title: Cute!
text: This night gown is very cute. On a softness scale, it's soft, but not as soft as bamboo or modal fabrics. I wear a size 16/18 in women's clothing and I ordered this in the XXL. It fits fine, but not as loose as I would expect from XXL. I do like it and it is great for spring/summer/fall sleeping.

title: Great Shirt!
text: This is a great shirt! It's a true to size fit. The actual t-shirt is a good quality. The image is clear and well done.

title: Comfortable
text: Let me begin by saying that I will never wear these in public. But you should also know, I would never wear any type of leggings in public. I'm in my early 50's and plus size. I wouldn't feel comfortable wearing these out and about. However, for home, they are fine. I am 5'6" and wear a size 16 jeans. I ordered the XXXL as suggested and they fit fine. They're snug, but not tight. The waist band has a grip feature so they don't slip. They are ever so slightly see through. I was only able to see through them at a super close distance in front of the mirror. I was able to see some of the pattern of my undies, but I couldn't see the colors or my skin. There are no problems when I bend over. Overall, I am pleased with these.

title: Good Fit
text: My son is a big guy. He wears side 15W in shoes. Regular men's socks don't fit him. These socks fit well. He finds them to be comfortable. He hasn't really noticed them to be cooling. The socks are reinforced where they should be. He likes them.

title: True Fit
text: This t-shirt is a true fit. The material is light weight and soft. The image is clear and nicely printed. It's a fun retro shirt.

title: Great Size!
text: My mom always had Vera Bradley purses and bags. She gave me a few over the years. She passed away a few years ago, but when I see Vera Bradley bags, it makes me happy. This new Rain Forest Canopy print reminds me of Florida. This bag is a great size for running errands. It's basically a wallet with some extra space. The center compartment has 8 credit card slots, an ID window, and pockets. On one side of that compartment is a compartment with 2 card slots and has sides that expand open. The sides aren't sewn all the way on the corners, so you do need to be careful what you store in there. Coins would fall through for sure. Luckily there's a zippered pocket on the outside which you could put coins. Then on the other side of the main compartment, is a pocket which a cell phone easily fits in. There's a wristlet strap as well as an adjustable crossbody strap. The purse is made well.

title: Roomy!
text: I've been buying Vera Bradley purses and bags for years! I love this new "Cotton Imagined" line. Recycled cotton is definitely a step in the right direction for our environment! This bag is pretty roomy, at least for me. I guess that all depends on your needs. My kids are grown so I'm not having to carrying all that mom stuff any more. There's plenty of room for my wallet, small cosmetic bag, coupons, phone, and more. The strap length is adjustable. The fabric is light weight and feels like it would be water resistant, or at least not absorbent.. There are 2 slip pockets inside and a zippered pocket on the outside. The solid coral color is cheerful. The floral interior fabric coordinates nicely. The quality is good and what I would expect from the Vera Bradley line.

title: Soft Fabric
text: These men's underwear come in a nice variety of colors. The fabric is soft and comfortable against the skin. They are a little on the snug side, so I would suggest considering going up a size if you prefer a looser fit. They launder well.

title: Snug Fit
text: I just threw out a bunch of my son's boxer briefs due to holes and tears. He likes the material of these. They're very soft. The fit is a bit snug on him though. He says they're okay, but not his favorites. They seem to be made well and they launder nicely.

title: So Much Storage Room for Jewelry!
text: My daughter is a college student and moving into her first apartment in a few months. She had a similar jewelry organizer on her wish list and was delighted to get this one. It comes nearly all ready to hang up. You can hang it over a door or attach it to the wall. After examining it, my husband has decided we should hang it on the wall. We're concerned that frequent shutting of the door could be noisy or lead to some damage. Inside there is so much storage room! My daughter is thrilled with all the space for her jewelry. The light is a nice feature. You do need to provide your own batteries. There's also a lock. It's sturdy and it looks nice, too!

title: Fun Colors!
text: My son is a big guy. The fit on these is a little snug, but wearable. They're comfortable to wear. He likes the fun colors/prints these come in.

title: Love!!
text: My 19 year old daughter loves these no-show liner socks! When I first told her that I ordered her some socks, she gave me the speech about how she didn't need any more socks. I showed them to her and she decided that she liked the way they looked. She was already a fan of the Timberland brand. I later noticed that she was wearing them around the house. She has decided that these are the best no-show socks ever!! They don't slip off at the heel. They are thick enough to have some padding, but not too thick to interfere with the fit of the shoe. Now she wants me to buy more for her!

title: Soft Sleep Shirt
text: This is a cute, muted leopard print night shirt. The fabric is soft. I would say that the sizing is accurate and it's a true to size fit. It washes well. The overall quality is very good.

title: Comfortable Fit
text: My daughter loves Weezer and was excited to get this pullover hoodie. She's usually a size small, but I always order her adult mediums because she likes over sized shirts and hoodies. It's a comfortable fit. The screen printing is good. The hoodie itself is pretty basic, but she likes it.

title: The Perfect Wallet!
text: I used to use the Vera Bradley Zip Around Wallet, but I don't think they make them any more. I've been searching for a new style of wallet and after using this one for a few days, I've decided it's the perfect wallet! I love it! It's basically got two parts. There's the turnlock section that has 2 ID slots and 6 credit card slots. There are also 2 full length pockets. Then there's the zippered compartment that has 6 more credit card slots, and 3 divided sections. I keep bills in one and receipts in another. There's also a zippered pocket on the outside which I use for coins. The print has a vintage vibe that reminds me of South Florida. I am very happy with this wallet design!

title: Cute Nostalgic Pattern
text: I am a longtime fan of Vera Bradley. My mom always had a Vera purse and all kinds of bags and accessories. They remind me of her. This one has a cute nostalgic pattern called Rain Forest Canopy. It has a summer/Florida vibe to me. I absolutely love that this is made from recycled cotton! In recent years I've been more aware of textile recycling but I haven't really done much other than donate unwanted clothing instead of throwing it away. The fabric seems pretty durable and it's washable which is always a plus. The interior fabric coordinates nicely. There an outer zip pocket and another one inside. The strap is adjustable. There are slip pockets on the outer ends of the bag and a couple inside, too. All zippers work well. This is going to be my summer purse!

title: Awkward Fitting Top
text: This 2 piece swimsuit is cute, but has an awkward fitting top. The leopard print bottoms are fine and luckily I can wear a different black top with this so I can use it. The top has a twist in it. It makes for an interesting look, but it was very difficult to get on properly. Once it was on, it just looked weird. I'm a 40DD and my chest spilled out of the cups. I wear a size 16/18 and followed the size recommendation. I do think the sizing was accurate.

title: Runs Small
text: I am a size 16/18. I can usually wear a size XL in t-shirts, however, with unfamiliar brands, I will often order 2XL  shirts to be on the safe side. This 2XL fits me like an XL. I am so glad that I went with the larger size! It's a slightly loose but form fitting fit on me. If I had gone with the XL it would have been skin tight or worse. It's comfortable in the arms and allows a full range of motion. My husband and I like to kayak and hike so I like to wear quick dry fabrics. The color is true to the picture. The quality is good.

title: Too Narrow in the Legs
text: I am 5'6" and wear a size 16 in jeans. These light weight hiking pants fit everywhere except in the lower legs. They were too narrow, specifically in the calves. I was able to put them on, but the legs were so tight that they looked like leggings. I do have thick calves and have issues with some pants being tight in the calf area. The fit in the waist and thighs was fine. Moving past that, the pants are light weight and seem to be constructed well. There are plenty of pockets. These would be great for hiking.

title: One of the Greatest Inventions!!
text: Pants tend to be loose in the waist on me if they fit everywhere else. I hate wearing belts. This has got to be one of the greatest inventions ever! It works perfectly! And as a middle aged woman who has to go to the bathroom a lot, this belt doesn't interfere. You don't have to unbuckle and buckle up. This comes with 3 different colors of faux belts. I love these!

title: Love the Message!
text: My 20 year old daughter loves the message of these hats. She's already started wearing the dad hat one. The "Make Racism Wrong Again" message is actually a patch glued onto the hats. However, it wasn't very secure on the beanie and was hanging on at just one of the corners. I am going to have to sew it on to keep it there. The actual quality of the hats is fine. This one just got past quality control!

title: Decent Quality
text: This Weezer t-shirt is a decent quality. It's definitely better than the thin shirts you get at concerts! The image is clear and well printed. It doesn't say Weezer on it so only people familiar with the logo will know what it means. Sizing is accurate. It could be softer, but it's not a rough or scratchy fabric. Overall, my 20 year old daughter like it.

title: Cute Sunglasses
text: These are cute and stylish sunglasses. They are very light weight. The lenses aren't too big, but they are over sized. There's a pattern on the arms which looks nice. They do a good job of protecting my eyes from the sun.

title: Soft!
text: I am 5'6" and currently wear size 16/18. I usually order 2XL when it comes to unknown brands online, but I looked at the size chart and it suggested the XL. I wish I had ordered the 2XL! The XL fits, but it's a little snug under the arm pits. It's not a deal breaker, but I think I would have liked the 2XL better. The material is very soft. The length is good. It seems to be well made.

title: Soft Fabric
text: I am 5'6" and currently wear a size 16/18. I ordered this in the 2XL out of caution because my personal experience with buying unfamiliar brands online has led me to order a size up in most garments. The fit of this shirt is slightly loose as described in the product description. The length is long which I do like because it covers my rear side when I bend or stretch. While the fit is fine, it's just okay as far as how it looks on me. I don't love the look, but I don't hate it either. The arm cut outs are different than the usual cold shoulder look. I'm not sure how I feel about them. The shirt would be perfect for shoulder vaccinations! The material is soft and comfortable. The product description says to hand wash, but it also says machine wash is okay, thank goodness! It also says to air dry. Had I noticed that when I was ordering it, I probably would have passed on it because that's too high maintenance for me.

title: Fits Nicely
text: This is a very soft shirt. It fits nicely, too. I wear a size 16/18 and this shirt is not snug or too loose. It is very comfortable and doesn't restrict movement. The quality is good without any noticeable flaws.

title: Cute Outdoor Adventure Pants
text: My husband and I bought a pair of kayaks recently. I have one pair of quick dry hiking pants to wear when we go. I saw these capri style ones and thought they would be perfect since the weather is getting warmer. I am 5'6" and currently wear size 16 jeans. These fit pretty good. They're not as loose on me as they are on the picture of the woman in the description, but they're not tight. My calves are pretty thick and the bottom of the pant leg is a little snug but not tight. Basically, I won't have to use the adjuster piece. They're very light weight and they dry super quick! Perfect for Outdoor Adventures!

title: Excellent Quality!
text: These furry paws are outstanding! The quality is excellent. They are very well constructed.  The details are amazing. They have claws ( soft - not sharp at all) and toe beans! The cotton candy colors are really neat. The paws are basically 4 finger gloves. I have large adult hands. These fit me but I think they fit my 19 year old daughter's small hands much better.  Since there are only 4 finger places, you do have to double up on fingers. It took some trial and error for me to find the most comfortable combination.  These paws are perfect for anyone who enjoys the world of furries!

title: Comfortable Shoe
text: These slide sandals are very comfortable. There's plenty of support that they don't cause lower back pain or cause my plantars faciitis to flare up. I wear a size 10W in women's shoes. I ordered these in 11s. They fit well. The width of my feet is often problematic. There is no way to adjust the show if needed, just so you know. I was a little disappointed with the color. I was expecting a true bright red color, but it's more of an orange-red. I'll still wear them, but it's not what I expected. I am looking forward to the pop of color this summer!

title: Comfortable!
text: I wear a women's 10W shoe. Sometimes I have to get 11's  because of the width. These men's water sandals fit nicely on me. They're surprisingly comfortable. I got them specifically for kayaking. There's adequate traction on the bottom to prevent slipping. They're easy to adjust. I like them!

title: Good Fit
text: These pajamas are really cute! They are a good fit though the pants are almost too big at the waist, but because they're elastic, they're okay. I wear a size 16 in jeans and I ordered the 2XL. They are comfortable to wear. The material is fine, but I really expected something really soft. It's not rough or scratchy, but it's not silky soft like some fabrics either. These will be perfect for wearing this summer!

title: Slightly Snug
text: This Henley top is a cute blue color. It's slightly snug, but not tight. The snuggness causes a small amount of gaping at the button area. I wear a size 16/18 and wear a 40DD. I ordered the 2XL.  The length is adequate. I prefer a little longer, but it does cover my backside when I bend over which is important. The sleeves aren't tight on me which is sometimes an issue I have.

title: Great Fit!
text: My college student son lives at home. He often just wears white t-shirts with shorts around the house. He takes more pride in his appearance when he leaves the house for class or work. His white shirts aren't so white any more. I got him these black ones. The fit is great! They're long enough that they don't ride up when he bends over or stretches. He's a big guy and this size is a slightly loose fit. They wash well. There is brand name on the lower edge of the shirt so it's not obviously placed. The quality is good, too.

title: Great Fit
text: I recently noticed that the sunglasses that I keep in the car were scratched and hazy. These are small (as opposed to oversized). They protect my eyes from the sun. They have a great fit. The small size allows them to fit in my car storage that is designed for sunglasses. The oversized ones are too big and never fit in there. Keeping them in there will help prevent future scratches!

title: Cute Short Sleeved Top
text: This is a cute short sleeved top. I ordered the 1X and it fits nicely. I currently wear a size 16/18. The length is long enough to cover my rear side when I raise my arms or bend over. The blue color is beautiful. The arms aren't tight which is often a problem for me. The v-neck isn't deep. The fabric is soft. Overall, I am very happy with it!

title: Cute Dress!
text: I love to wear maxi dresses. They cover up my legs which I am not a fan of! This dress fits well. It's comfortable to wear. I'm 5'6" and it comes to just above my ankles. The skirt of the dress is not see-through. I am very happy with it.

title: Durable Tote Bag
text: This is a durable tote bag. It's a good size, too. I used it to hold towels, sunscreen, water bottles and more on a trip to the park today. The interior fabric seems to be water resistant which is nice. In addition to the long handles, there's also a removable shoulder strap. There are a few slip pockets on the outside, but there are no zipper pockets, although the product description said there was a zipper pocket. If it's there, it's well hidden because I couldn't find it! Overall, it's a great all purpose tote bag.

title: Cute!
text: I wear a size 10W shoe. These darling no-show socks are a little snug on me. They do stretch to fit a bit and I can fit them on my feet. However, once on, they tend to roll down a little on the sides. There are 3 pairs of socks in this set and they are cute and colorful.

title: Snug Fitting
text: My daughter is a frequent hiker. As the weather warms up, I thought she might like some hiking shorts as an option. These are snug fitting on her. She is 5'7' and weighs about 155. I ordered her usual size. They're not the most flattering looking in her words. She likes that they are light weight and quick dry. The pockets are good sized. The belt is removable.

title: Tight Fit
text: I am a plus size mom. I currently wear a size 16 in jeans. The quality of the pants is good and comparable to other hiking pants. The fit is okay, but not great. These have a tight fit in the thigh area. The length is a little long on my 5'6" body, but they can be cinched which helps.

title: Generously Sized
text: The Vera Bradley duffel bag is generously sized. The main compartment is large. The bottom is firm and reinforced. There are some mesh slip pockets inside. The outside has another slip pocket with a smaller zippered pocket in front of it. There are also slip pockets at both ends. The handle is sturdy and well attached. There's also a shoulder strap. The material is quilted black with a black and white floral pattern. The Vera Bradley logo (name) is pretty subtle. Overall, this is the perfect weekend or overnight bag.

title: Plenty of Storage
text: I am thrilled with this Vera Bradley travel jewelry case. There's plenty of storage for whatever jewelry you take with you. Plus, it keeps it safe and protected from getting damaged since it has soft, velvety fabric in addition to the nice Vera Bradley fabric. There are spaces for rings, earrings, necklaces and more. There's zipper pouches and slip pockets, too. It's an excellent quality item. Stitches are secure. Zippers work well. Snaps easy to work. Overall, it's a beautiful necessity for your travels.

title: Great Travel Bag!
text: This Vera Bradley Lay Flat Backpack is a great travel. It opens up and lays flat, like a suitcase. There's plenty of room for an overnight and possibly a weekend depending on how much you take with you on your travels. There are pockets and pouches galore.
