I love that this bag is made from recycled bottles! All the zippers are sturdy and work well. You can slide it over an extended suitcase pull handle if you're taking larger luggage. I am very impressed with all that this bag offers! And of course, it is lined with a beautiful floral print!

title: Great for When Losing Weight
text: I've been working on losing weight over the past few months and many pairs of pants are loose. I don't want to start buying new ones until I'm where I want to be or until I just can't get by with what I have. These help a lot! I was a little confused and thought I was getting 2 pairs because it says it's a 2 pack. That means one pair. Both are used at the same time. I have a similar buckle-less belt that's one piece and goes all around the back. This one you just use one on each side. I found that the single unit works better for me. This one does work, but my belt loops are spread far apart and to get this to close, the loops are getting pulled so much that I worry that they may rip out. The other one that I have doesn't pull on the loops like this one. I have this one adjusted to the max and it still pulls. I do love the concept. I hate wearing belts. Since I'm dieting, I'm drinking a lot more water and that equates to more trips to the bathroom. It makes me happy that I don't have to deal with a belt buckle! Also, I love not having to constantly pull up my pants because they're too loose. Great idea!

title: Cute Thong Flip Flops
text: These are cute thong flip flops. I wear a 10W in women's shoes and I ordered these in 11's. They fit nicely. There is some overall support, but not much in the way of arch support. I sometimes get plantar fasicitis flare ups if I don't wear good shoes. They do have more support than the cheap, thin flat ones. I tend to wear good flip flops all spring and summer. I don't think I could wear these all day, but I could wear them for short periods of time. They are cute enough that I will wear them.

title: Practical
text: This Vera Bradley bag is quite practical. It has plenty of room for the basics you might need on an outing. You can wear it a couple of different ways. The straps are sturdy and have metal hardware. The zippers are durable and glide easily. Inside the main compartment, there is a zippered pocket and a slip pocket. There's a large zippered compartment on the back of the bag. There's also a zippered pocket on the front as well as a buckled pouch. The material used for the bag is water resistant. The interior is a nice floral print. Overall, this is a well made quality bag.

title: Comfortable Fit
text: My son is a big guy. In the last year he's started wearing boxer briefs instead of regular briefs. He says these are some of the most comfortable boxer briefs ever! The fabric is soft and has some stretch to it. The sizing is good and fits as expected. They help prevent chafing. He is more than satisfied with them.

title: Perfect for Travel!
text: This Essential Oil case is perfect for travel! It holds 12 small bottles of oil, securely with elastic. The inside has a laminated covering so if any oils do spill, it won't damage the bag. The outside of the bag is a traditional cotton fabric in a cute blue geometric design. The case zips around 3 of the 4 sides to allow easy access to your oils. The zipper glides effortlessly. The overall quality is exactly what I would expect from Vera Bradley.

title: Great Weekend Bag
text: This is a great weekend bag! It's huge! I can get a couple of outfits, toiletries and a pair of shoes in it with room to spare. The bag has a zippered storage area on the bottom which is a couple of inches deep and the size of the whole bottom of the bag. The main interior has slip pockets all around the perimeter. There is a zippered pocket on the outside. There's also some fabric for the purpose of hooking over the handle of a suitcase so it can piggy back onto your luggage. In addition to the cloth handles, there's a removeable padded shoulder strap, too. The bag is sturdy. The stitching is good. The zippers work well. The bag is exactly what I would expect from the Vera Bradley brand.

title: Cute Purse!
text: This is a cute purse. I didn't realize that it was a retro design, but I have since seen many other similar purses and they are called 90's retro. Regardless, I think it's a good looking purse and it doesn't seem retro to me! I did find it to be smaller than what I needed. Yes, the measurements were provided as well as a picture of it being worn by someone. But I wasn't expecting it to be as small as it is in person. I need something just a little bigger. My wallet does not fit inside. However, my college aged daughter said it's perfect for her, so she's claiming it as her own. The quality of the purse is pretty good. I had a little trouble getting the zipper to move at first, but once I got it started, it hasn't had any problems since and I zipped it at least a dozen more times. There's an open pocket inside. The rings that the strap connects to are sturdy.

title: Snug Fit
text: My husband and I started kayaking recently. I thought this shirt would be good for it since it's quick dry and SPF protection. I'm currently a size 16/18. An XL shirt is usually okay on me, but with unknown brands ordered online, I often go with a 2XL. This 2XL is a snug fit. The arms are a little too tight. The length of the shirt and sleeves is fine. The quality seems to be good. I'm hoping the shirt will fit better as I make some more progress on my weight loss.

title: Very Soft!
text: These Vera Bradley socks are very soft. I thought they might be thicker, fuzzy socks, but they're not, which I am glad since the weather is beginning to warm up. They are more like thin, fuzzy socks, but not cheap thin. They are not bulky and could easily be worn with shoes whereas the thick fuzzy ones would be better suited for wearing around the house instead of slippers. There's no visible branding. I wear a size 10W in women's shoes. These have plenty of stretch that they fit me easily and aren't tight at all. I am going to see if they have these available in other designs!

title: Quality ID Case and Lanyard
text: Vera Bradley ID wallet/cases and lanyards are always such a nice quality. This one is no exception. The metal pieces are sturdy and strong. The zipper glides well. There's a window for your ID and space to hold a credit card or a small amount of cash such as a twenty dollar bill. The neutral color gives you lots of options. The inside has a pretty floral print.

title: Interesting Design
text: This Vera Bradley bag has an interesting design. It has 2 parts that can be worn together or separately. I'm not sure I like the design, but it's growing on me. The quality of the bag is excellent and on par with the Vera Bradley brand. One of the parts has credit card slots while the other does not. The bag can be worn as a waist pack or a cross body. The print is a fun, tye-dye like pattern. I really like the Reactive line and that it's made from recycled bottles.

title: Useful Organzier!
text: I am a longtime Vera Bradley fan. I love this mini-tech organizer! It's an excellent quality and what I would expect from Vera Bradley. The size is perfect! It is just big enough for a couple of phone cables, earbuds, and my watch charger. I have had larger tech organizers before and they've been larger than I need. This bag fits easily into my laptop bag. There's a mesh zippered pocket inside as well as some elastic strips that you can slide items underneath. The inside pattern is a blue floral one that goes nicely with the modern blue Ikat print. Zippers work well. I'm so glad I have this and look forward to being able to travel soon so I can use it!

title: Lots of Card Slots!
text: This is a slim full size wallet. I really like the delicate pink color. There are lots of card slots. In fact, even after putting in a lot of my loyalty and reward cards, there are still several slots left over. The slots are a little on the snug side. I guess that's good so cards don't slip out too easily, but it does interfere just a little with putting them back in, but it's not too bad. It's not bad enough that I wouldn't use it. There are 2 zippered compartments. I'm using one for coins. I haven't decided on the other one yet. I keep bills behind one of the sides of card slots though I'm considering moving them to the other zippered compartment. The wallet looks nice. The zippers work well.

title: Snug Fit
text: I have jeans from the same brand that are the same size and they fit perfectly. These pants are a snug fit. The quality of the pants is very nice. They're what I would consider to be somewhat dressy. I do like that they resist wrinkles pretty well.

title: Nice Looking Purse
text: This is a nice looking purse. It's thin and not bulky. There's a zippered pocket inside as well as a non-zippered one. There's also a zippered pocket on the outside. The purse is lined well. The exterior has a quilted look to it. The zippers on the pockets work well. The zipper for the main compartment of the purse is sometimes troublesome and requires multiple attempts to fasten. Overall, I like it.

title: Soft Fabric
text: This is a great t-shirt! The fabric is soft. The fit is perfect and as expected. The lettering seems to be done well but only time will tell how it holds up after multiple washings. I love the wording and it's perfect for a trip to Disney!

title: Adorable!
text: I love this sea turtle wristlet. It's so cute! I have the matching tote bag and I can't wait for pool season to use them. The inside is a cute aquatic themed print fabric. There are a few credit card slots inside. The zipper glides well. The overall quality is what I expect from Vera Bradley.

title: Supportive
text: These hiking shoes fit as expected. They are supportive and comfortable. The soles have excellent traction. They are perfect for rugged terrain.

title: Great Vera ID Wallet
text: This is a great Vera ID Wallet. It is the high quality that I expect from the Vera Bradley company. The ID wallet/case has a sturdy key ring. There's a clear vinyl window and a zippered pouch. The zipper glides easily. This will be perfect for summer!

title: Cute & Comfy!
text: I like wearing nightgowns like this to bed. The fabric is soft. I love the floral print and color design. It washes well. I'm 5'6" and wear a size 16/18. I ordered this in the 2XL and it's loose fitting but not baggy. The length hits me just above the knees. Overall, I am satisfied with it.

title: Comfortable
text: Boxer briefs are my husband's preferred style. He finds these to be very comfortable. It's true to size fit. The elastic band does not bind or pinch. Movement is not challenged. He would definitely consider ordering more of these.

title: Comfortable
text: My husband and I have been going hiking a lot with the onset of spring weather. We've got hiking shoes, but we didn't have hiking socks. This 3 pack of socks by Hanes came with 2 pairs of black marl socks and 1 pair of red marl. I claimed the red pair and my husband has the black ones. I wear a size 10W in women's shoes and he wears a men's 11.5. The socks fit both of us fine. They have a little bit of stretch. The material is slightly soft, but I wouldn't call them soft if that makes sense. They are definitely not rough or scratchy. They are noticeably thicker on the bottom of the socks which gives extra cushion. When worn with the hiking shoes, they provide a snug fit with minimal friction.

title: Comfortable
text: I wear a women's size 10W shoe. It's difficult to find women's shoes that fit and often I end up having to get 11's.  I ordered these men's shoes in 9.5. They aren't as big as I thought they would. I do have some toe wiggle room, but not a lot. The fit is actually pretty good. I can't say for certain that they run small, but that may be something to keep in mind. The shoes are very comfortable. They offer adequate arch support. I haven't had a chance to go hiking in them yet, but I've been wearing them out on errands and around the house. They have great traction and that will be a huge improvement on my next hike!

title: Decent Pads
text: These are decent pads. They fit my cup size (DD) fine. I didn't look at all the pictures before ordering, so I didn't realize that they were a bit thick and padded. I personally don't need the extra padding - I'm already a DD cup! I wear full body camisole shapewear most days and I use similar (but flatter) pads to create a smooth shape. These make my cup size larger which is not the look I'm going for. They didn't have any strange smell to them. As I said, they're decent. They just don't work for me. It's my fault for not noticing that they're thick.

title: Great Lanyard!
text: Lanyards with ID wallets are a convenient way to bring the minimum necessities when I run errands. I am a long time fan of Vera Bradley and I believe that they make the best (and prettiest) lanyard/ID wallets! This one is made from recycled bottles which is great for the environment. It has an ID window and a zippered pouch. The hardware is very sturdy. The zipper glides well. The entire unit is very well made. It's really a great combo!

title: Cute!
text: My 19 year old daughter has a running joke with her BFF about Pi. She is thrilled with this ring. It's well made and very nice. It's nicer than we expected. The numbers are etched into the ring and they're legible. The ring is adjustable by squeezing the sides a bit. This would be great for any Math nerd!

title: High Quality
text: During the pandemic, I became a lanyard girl instead of a purse one. It's a lot easier to deal with a lanyard than a purse when at the grocery. I prefer the Vera Bradley ones because they're such high quality. This one is no exception. It's sturdy and durable. Plus, it's good looking too. This one is a quilted black material, but the inside is a black on white floral sketch design. There's an outer window for your ID and a zippered interior. It can hold my bank card, some cash and my driver's license which is all I need when I'm at the store.

title: Gorgeous Bag!
text: This Vera Bradley bag is gorgeous! It's not at all like the typical Vera bags. This one is a straw tote. The outer color is a light blue green. The interior is a water resistant ocean scene that matches the blue green. There's a large zippered pocket inside. The handles are sewn securely to the bag. It's really just darling! This is going to be my new pool bag! I may use it for more than just going to the pool because it's so cute!

title: Nicer Than I Expected
text: My 19 year old daughter has started wearing rings. I thought this would be a good way to give her a large assortment. They are nicer than I expected. They have some weight to them. I really thought that they would be light weight and bendable, but they're not. They're fairly sturdy. They don't look to be high quality, but decent costume jewelry quality. I probably wouldn't wear them, but they're perfect for my daughter! There seems to be a wide assortment of sizes. I tried on a few. A few fit my pointer finger right above the knuckle, but many did not. I could get some on my pinky finger up to the knuckle. I do have fat fingers, so that's not a surprise. With 103 rings, it's easy to find something you'll like!

title: Fits Okay
text: I am a size 16/18 in clothes. I ordered this in the 4XL after reading some of the other reviews and looked at the sizing chart. It fits okay. The fabric is softer than I expected and does not scratch or itch. The bottoms fit lower on me than the picture shows. There's an obvious tag which I had in the back, but it felt like it was on backwards. I wanted to keep pulling it up in the back. The top is adjustable. There's not a lot of support for my 40DD size, but they fit alright. I don't think I could comfortably wear this underneath clothes, but for at home, it's fine. My husband did like it!

title: Cute Shorts!
text: My 19 year old daughter absolutely loves these shorts! They are really cute. As her mother, I was a little unsure how they would look, but they don't look trashy at all. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears a size 8/10 or mediums in pants. We weren't sure how the sizing would be, so we ordered this in the large. The fit is perfect! She likes the cut out on the sides a lot. She's not sure if she'll wear them to the gym for workouts, but for lounging around her dorm room they're perfect!

title: Nicer Than I Expected
text: I am 5'6" and wear a size 16 jeans and an 18 in tops. I am a 40DD. I really hesitated on this because of the sizing. After reading some of the other reviews, I decided to give it a try and go with the 4XL. The size ended up fitting okay. The straps on the top are adjustable. It doesn't offer a lot of support. The bottoms felt a little weird. I don't usually wear bottoms like this, so I'm sure it's just because I'm not used to it. The sizing seemed fine. The material was much softer than I expected. It's not itchy or scratchy at all. I wouldn't wear this under clothing because it's not comfortable. This is something I would only wear at home and it would probably be removed rather quickly. I forgot to mention, that my husband liked seeing me wear this.

title: Love!
text: I am a long time fan of Vera Bradley. I like the blue/black print of this fabric. The quality of this wallet is on par with what I would expect from the Vera Bradley line of products. The construction is excellent. I wasn't familiar with this wallet style. I don't know if it's a new style or not, but I really like it. My favorite thing about it, which you can't tell from the pictures, is that on the back side (if the front side is the one with the Vera Bradley name on it) has a clear vinyl window. You can put your ID or license in it so you can easily show it when needed without removing it from the wallet. I think that's pretty handy! Inside is another clear vinyl window so if you have another card that you have to show regularly, it can go there. There are 5 other card slots inside. There's also a zippered pouch that has the RFID protection as well as a large zippered area for cash and another little slot between the cash area and the previously mentioned pouch. The wallet has a zipper closure. The whole wallet can open up, but it doesn't quite lay flat when opened. The zippers are all smooth and sturdy. I love it!

title: So Cute!
text: In recent years, I've started carrying a smaller purse because I really don't need to carry much with me. Then during the pandemic, I stopped using a purse altogether and started using an ID card case and lanyard such as this. This set is primarily pink. It has a floral print. I really like that the ReActive line from Vera Bradley because it is made from recycled plastic bottles. It's quite durable. This wallet has an ID window, 3 credit card slots and a small zippered compartment. The lanyard is coordinated to go with it, but is not the same print. This is perfect for the spring!

title: Fits Great!
text: These denim jeans fit great! I was actually surprised! It seems like more than half the times when I order jeans online, they don't fit. My 19 year old daughter complimented them when I was wearing them which doesn't happen often. The pants are slightly snug in the calf, but my calves are fat and this is common. With that being said, they're not tight. The waist doesn't gape. They are a mid rise fit and don't bother me when I bend over or reach.  They are very comfortable, too. I am very happy with these! I may have to order another pair.

title: Great Fit!
text: I really didn't think these pants would fit, as that happens a lot to me, but I was pleasantly surprised. They are a great fit! I'm currently wearing a size 16 jeans. The XXL fits fine and looks good, too. They allow movement without me worrying about ripping a seam. They're light weight. I ordered these after seeing another reviewer getting them for kayaking and I thought that was a great idea! The last time I went kayaking, I capsized. I was wearing jeans and they were heavy with water afterwards. These pants dry quickly and don't feel heavy! I recommend them!

title: Love!
text: I am a long time fan of Vera Bradley products. I used to buy the lanyards and ID cases for my daughter, but now I have started using them. They're perfect for those times when you don't want to mess with a purse. You can stick your ID, some cash, and debit card in it and transport it easily and safely. This one is just as expected. The stitching is good. The hardware is sturdy and secure. The fabric print is lovely. I love it!

title: Cute Crossbody
text: I like using crossbody style purses when traveling. I feel safer with them. This crossbody purse is cute. The color is a good neutral that goes with everything. The straps are awfully thin. I wish they were a little thicker. I fear that they won't last as long as thicker ones. Plus, thin ones are easier to be grabbed and stolen. The straps are adjustable. I have them at the maximum length and that's perfect on me. The zippers function well. There are 3 different compartments. One of them has credit card slots, but they go down into the bag and the lower ones are difficult to access. The compartments don't open all the way up which makes it challenging to reach the bottom of them. Overall the bag is okay.

title: Improved Design!
text: My daughter was recently looking for a "fake collar shirt". I had no idea what she was talking about. Then she described them. I remembered these from my youth but we called them "dickeys". These have an improved design compared to the ones I grew up with. The biggest improvement is the strap that goes under the armpit. With that, there's no worrying about keeping it in place. The straps on these are adjustable like a bra strap. Genius! The collars are well made. My daughter loves these! I ordered a black one and a white one. Evidently the fake collar look is super trendy right now and my daughter is very pleased with them.

title: Just What I Wanted
text: This black headband is just what I wanted. The buttons on securely fastened to the headband. It's easy to put my mask on to the buttons. It's so much more comfortable than having the elastic straps of the mask on the headband rather than my ears!

title: Very Cute Skirt!
text: My 19 year old daughter loves this skirt. It's very cute. We ordered her usual size and it fit nicely. The elastic waist gives you a little flexibility. The material is thin and a little see through. My daughter says she'll definitely have to wear shorts underneath it. The skirt has a nice flow to it. It's light weight and she is looking forward to warmer weather so she can wear it!

title: Pretty Necklace
text: This is a pretty necklace. The chain has a small extender piece which I had to use in order for it to fit. I did find it a little difficult to clasp by myself. The little piece that you hold down to hook onto the other side of the chain was a challenge to hold open long enough to get it fastened. I did get it to finally clasp, but it did take a few attempts to do so. The gemstone is not loose on the chain so it doesn't slide up and down, which I like. It's color is beautiful. I think it's one of those colors that will go with everything and change ever so slightly depending on what you're wearing. I wore it with a dark red shirt and it looked great! But when I held it up to a pink shirt, it suddenly looked more pink than it really is. The necklace comes in a sweet drawstring bag and that comes inside a little box.

title: Cute!
text: My own kids are in college, so I often dote on my sister's young children. This shirt is perfect for when I visit. The shirt fit as expected. I'm a size 18 plus and I anticipated that I would need the 2XL just from experience with other sight unseen shirts I have ordered. The 2XL fits perfectly! It's neither loose or baggy. The material is light weight and slightly see through when wearing dark under garments. I first tried it on while wearing a black bra and it was very visible. The next time I wore it, I was wearing a nude colored one and it was fine. The sentiment is fun and perfect for Aunts! The letters are vinyl iron-on. While they appear to be securely attached, I do wonder how it will do over time. Overall, this is a really cute shirt!

title: Comfortable Fit
text: These pants have a comfortable fit. They're a true to size fit. They're light weight and don't wrinkle too badly. The construction of the garment seems to be adequate. It's nice to find a decent, affordable pair of pants!

title: Good Fit
text: I have not worn leggings since the 90's. Plus, the ones that I wore back then were more like knit stirrup pants. These are an athletic material and have a decent thickness to them. They are not see through. I am 5'6" and currently wear a size 16 plus jeans. My calves are thicker than I would like. I ordered the 3XL in these and they are a good fit. They are not tight or restrictive. I have full movement in them, well, as much movement as my overweight 50 something year old body can do.  I have been wearing them for exercising. I don't think I would wear them in public, but that's due to my own insecurities. The waistband tends to roll a small bit but that doesn't effect anything. Construction seems fine, with no obvious flaws. I'm not too picky about minor ones. They are comfortable enough to wear. I did wear them all day recently, and finally changed out of them because my legs were too cold. I am glad that I got the black ones. I would be afraid that any other color would draw even more attention to my legs.

title: Cute Variety of Earrings!
text: My 19 year old daughter just recently started wearing gold tone jewelry. She's always been more of a silver jewelry kind of girl. She wanted a variety of earrings. This set has a fun mix of earring designs. They don't irritate her ears, or at least they haven't yet. The assortment is geared toward a younger audience (than me) and she is very pleased with them.

title: Finally a Set with Pairs!
text: I am so happy with this set of epoxy resin molds. Finally, a set with pairs of earrings, not singles! My daughter and I made some earrings over the holidays with molds that only had single earrings. It was challenging to get the second one to match the first one when it was days later. Plus, there were a few ones that we haven't even made the second ones because so much time has passed. With these molds, you can make both earrings at the same time which ensures that your colors are the same! The quality of the molds is comparable to other silicone molds. This set also comes with jewelry hardware and some resin accessories. It's really a great set!

title: Lovely Pink Color
text: I live in the south plus I'm approaching menopause. Because of those two factors, I don't like heavy sweatshirts. This light weight one is the perfect weight for me! It's heavier than a t-shirt, so it gives me the warmth I need, but it's not so heavy that I'm sweating. I am currently a size 18 in tops, so I went with the 2XL. It's a little tight in the upper arms for me to the point that it's not comfortable. It's not uncommon for clothing to be tight in the arms on me, so I'm not completely surprised with that. If you don't have that issue usually, I think you'll be okay. The body of the shirt fit nicely and was neither tight nor baggy. The color is light, so darker undergarments do show through a little. I'm hoping that it will fit a little better as my weight loss journey progresses.

title: Soft Fabric
text: I love leopard print, but don't have the courage to wear it. I don't usually wear yoga pants out in public, so I thought why not get the leopard print! The fabric is very soft. These pants are comfortable. I wear a size 16/18 in pants so I ordered these in the 2XL. They fit well, though a little snug in the calf area. I have wide calves and that is often a problem. It's not tight there, but I personally don't like the way that looks on me. However, since I don't wear yoga pants in public, that's really not an issue. They allow full movement. And they have pockets! I can actually fit my phone in them! The length is good. I'm 5'6" and reach below the ankle, but not too long that they get in the way when I'm exercising.

title: Cute!
text: My daughter has recently started wearing gold tone jewelry. She is considering getting some more ear piercings, but hasn't made up her mind yet. She likes the idea of ear cuffs as an alternative for now. These snake ear cuffs are very cute. They have good details on them. Having never worn cuffs before, it did take her some time to get them where she liked them. She really likes these snake ones!

title: Perfect!
text: My daughter is a college student and has a weekly outdoor lab. She wanted a raincoat that she could wear that was functional yet stylish. This one is perfect! We ordered a size up so she could still wear warm layers underneath it since it's still winter. The fit is roomy but not baggy. The waist can cinch to give a good overall shape to it. There are pockets which she can use to carry her field notebook, compass, phone and pen. Water repels off it nicely. She loves it!

title: Cute Boots!
text: I have never owned hiking boots before. I wear a size 10 Wide shoe and shoe shopping (or boot shopping) is always a challenge. I ordered these in a size 11, expecting them not to fit. So I was pleasantly surprised when I tried them on. They fit! And they're comfortable, too! Oh, and they're so cute! I am so happy with these. I feel that I need to buy a new outfit to wear with them!

title: Comfortable
text: This is a comfortable top. The material is light weight and reminds me of athletic moisture wicking fabric. The description calls this a sweatshirt, but in my opinion it is not. The sleeve cuffs fit nice over my Fitbit with room to spare.  I've got some long sleeve shirts that are a tight enough on the cuffs that I can't easily access it. The length is long so it covers my rear side so nothing is exposed when I lean over or stretch. I would say it's a true to size fit. I'm currently a size 18/20 and the 2XL fits nicely.

title: Perfect Fit!
text: I am currently a size 18. I ordered the size 20. It's a perfect fit! I am very pleased with how it looks. The material is mid to light weight. The white stripe is a little see through. I was wearing a black bra underneath and I could see it in some lighting. I don't love the fabric. It's neither soft nor scratch, it's just plain. I am very tactile and love soft fabrics, so that was a little disappointing. The shirt looks just like the pictures.

title: Good Fit
text: These men's pants are a good fit. They fit my son nicely. The quality is what I would consider to be average. They're not cheap, but not high end either. They're a good, basic pair of pants that are budget friendly and offered in a wide variety of sizes.

title: Pretty Earrings!
text: These created opal earrings are very pretty. The size is dainty but not tiny. They don't feel cheap. I personally don't feel comfortable wearing expensive jewelry but at the same time, I want my jewelry to look like good jewelry. This meets those requirements for me.

title: Very Comfy!
text: This is a very comfy bra. The material is so soft! I am a 40DD and this bra fits nicely on me. There is no spillage out of the cups. The straps are adjustable so it provides a decent lift. I would feel fine wearing this at home or to run errands.

title: Comfortable
text: This is a cute and comfortable bra. However, it's not very supportive. The straps aren't adjustable either. If they were, then that might have helped some with the support issue. I didn't have any cup spillage. I would definitely wear this around the house, but probably not out in public because I need more support.

title: Stylish
text: These stylish sunglasses are more red than purple, which I like more than if they were heavier on the purple color. They fit well and aren't tight on my temples. I like the design that's on the arms of the glasses. I like that they're not too big either. I'm not a fan of super oversized sunglasses. They do a good job of blocking sunlight.

title: Good Fit
text: My husband and I recently purchased a couple of kayaks. We're new to this new activity, but tried it out a few months ago before we bought our own. I wore waterproof hiking type sandals. Well, I capsized and had to walk a lot on the bottom of the river and the sandals proved to be a poor choice. My feet kept slipping out of the toe straps. Since then, I have been searching for something better. I wear a women's 10 W shoe. It's hard to find women's specialty footwear, so I went straight to men's shoes. Because of the width issue that I have, I went with the men's size 9. They're a good fit. There's not much extra toe room, but my toes aren't squished. They are also surprisingly comfortable. It's still winter, so we haven't been out on the kayaks yet, but I subject these shoes to some water to test them out. I found all the claims to be true. I have noticed my husband eyeing these now and may have to get him a pair!

title: Comfortable
text: When I saw this, I was hoping that it would be an affordable alternative to the Ruby Ribbon camisoles that I have been wearing. Unfortunately, it is not However, I do like it. I ordered the 3XL size. I am a size 18/40DD.  I think the sizing was pretty good. It's a comfortable and snug fit. It does not have the bra support that the RR does. It does compress the girls, but doesn't do much for lifting. I will have to wear a bra with this. The straps are not adjustable. There is compression in the stomach area where it's needed. I did have problems with the bottom of the camisole/tank rolling up when I sat down. The RR ones have medical grade silicone to help keep it in place. I will probably wear as a tank top and layer with it.

title: Cozy!
text: It's been pretty cold here lately. My husband and I take evening walks and it didn't take long for us to realize that we needed to dress warmer. I have never been a hat person, but last year I grow out my bangs and that's all it took! Now I find hats cute and practical! With bangs, they messed up my hair too much. I have a large head for a woman. This hat has enough stretch to it that it fits nicely without being too snug. The mittens fit well, too. They're both lined with fleece and do a great job of keeping me warm. I am very happy with these.

title: Comfortable
text: This light weight outdoor shirt is comfortable. It's true to size and fits me as I expected. The length is good and doesn't ride up on the back. The sleeves are a good length. It washes well. I am looking forward to the weather warming up a bit so I can wear this.

title: Cute Necklace
text: This is a cute, paper clip style necklace. I was expecting 2 necklaces of different lengths as shown in the picture, but I only received one. When I went back to reread the description, it states that this is just one item. A little disappointing, but nothing earth shattering. The necklace is very tight around my neck. Fortunately, I ordered this for my 19 year old daughter who has a much smaller neck. This chain is 14 inches plus a small extender. The clasp seems sturdy enough. My daughter is happy with it!

title: Comfortable Fit
text: I like the comfortable fit of these gloves. They fit without having to stretch them too much. The palm side has a grippy feature to them so you hold on to things better. You can text with them, too!  I love the snowflake design on the back of the gloves. And they do a good job of keeping my hands warm on my cold walks around the neighborhood!

title: Warm!
text: I wasn't prepared this winter for the sudden change in temperatures we've had. Usually our Georgia winters are pretty mild and I can get by without too much winter gear. This year, because of the pandemic as well as my attempt to get in shape, I've been outdoors a lot more. This is a 4 pack of knitted headbands. They have adequate stretch to them and easily accommodate my large head. The add a good amount of warmth when wearing them. And they look cuter than hats!

title: Great Fit!
text: I am a night gown kind of woman. I like short, sleeveless ones such as this one. I'm in my early 50's and I tend to get overly warm at night, so I don't want a lot of extra fabric on me. Speaking of fabric, this fabric is super soft!  It does cling a bit. The gown has a great fit, too. It isn't constrictive or binding.  It's just a nice, simple, comfortable night gown!

title: Soft Fabric
text: My husband needed some new winter pajamas. He doesn't wear them to sleep in, but wears them in the morning while he putters around before getting ready for his day. He's 6'2" and weighs about 220. The large size fits him nicely. The buttons don't gape. The length is fine. The fabric is very soft. They wash well. He likes them!

title: Warm!
text: After several months of pandemic eating, I am at my heaviest weight ever. My winter coats are too tight and uncomfortable to wear. The temperatures have been pretty cold lately and now that I'm trying to lose weight, I'm not wanting to go outside for my walks. I ordered this in a 2XL. I wasn't sure it would fit, but some of the other reviews mentioned that the sides had zippers which could open up the sides a bit. I am happy to say it fits! The arms are a little snug on me, but not tight. I can move them without difficulties. In order to zip it up, I did unzip the sides, but once I got the front main zipper up, I noticed that there are snaps next to that main zipper that I undid and that helped enough with the fit that I could zip the sides back up. The jacket is very comfortable to wear and provides a lot of warmth. It's not the prettiest coat, but it is functional. It's also light colored. My other coats all tend to be black. With it getting dark so early, it's usually pretty dark out when I go walking with my husband. That will help with visibility. For size reference, I am 5'6" and wear a 16/18 size pants and currently a 2XL in tops.

title: Perfect!
text: This is a great cardigan and just what I wanted. The gray color is soft and goes with everything. The sizing fits as expected. The sweater looks like it's a chunky knit, but it's actually a tight knit so it's smoother looking and not scratchy. This is perfect for layering during the winter months.

title: What a Great Costume!
text: I ordered this for my 19 year old daughter. She's always looking for clever and unique costumes for Halloween. This one is awesome!! My daughter wasn't familiar with the ensemble. She has heard of Breakfast at Tiffany's, but this outfit isn't usually the one that comes first in a search for it. I showed her pics from of Audrey Hepburn in the outfit and then she started to get excited because this costume is spot on! Plus, now she wants to see the movie. This past Halloween didn't really happen because of the pandemic, but she's ready for the next one. I ordered her the size large. She typically wears mediums, but I thought a slightly looser fit would be good and more accurate to the character. It fits nicely and does look like she's wearing a men's dress shirt. She wishes the fabric was softer. The eye mask are ear plugs are great accessories. I am very excited for my daughter to have this costume!

title: Very Cute
text: My husband and I have a hot tub which we like to use a few times per week. I saw this swim suit and was hopeful that it would fit. I followed the sizing chart that was provided and I was pleased with the fit. The straps can be adjusted, like a bra strap. I did have difficulties getting the bottoms in the right position. I didn't have a picture of how it was supposed to look and the decorative tie part is not entirely attached. Basically all it took was for me to rotate it a few times to make sure that the waist was up and the legs were down! Overall, I am very happy with it. It's not something I would probably wear in public, but I would prefer not to be wearing swimsuits in public at all! For my home hot tub, it's perfect!

title: Runs Small
text: These black yoga pants run small. I'm a size 16/18 in pants. The XXL is snug all over and tight in the calves. The material is thin and not flattering because lumps and bumps are very visible. The pants do have pockets which is a plus.

title: Love!!!
text: My 19 year old daughter was very involved in the recent presidential election. She's definitely more politically aware than I ever was at her age. When I told her that I had ordered a t-shirt for her, she rolled her eyes at me and said she didn't need any more t-shirts. Then I showed her this and she literally squealed! She absolutely loves it!! I ordered it in the large size. She usually wears mediums in shirts, but when in doubt, I ordered her larges. I'm glad I did. It's a little loose on her, but it's not baggy at all. I'm pretty sure it's a women's fit as opposed to a unisex/men's fit. The quote is securely on the shirt. It looks cute on her!

title: Cute!
text: My daughter is in college and puts a lot of thought into what she's wearing lately.  She likes to follow fashion trends and  has wanted a faux leather skirt for a while. She's 5'7" and usually wears a medium in pants. We did size up with this and ordered it in large. It's just every so slightly loose on her, but not problematic. The length hits her just above her knees. She would have preferred to be a little shorter.

title: Comfortable
text: My husband doesn't wear pajamas for sleeping, but does like to have pajama pants to wear around the house in the mornings. I haven't gotten him any new pajama pants in years, but recently he commented that his only pair were a bit worn. He has been wearing sweatpants instead lately. I saw these and thought they looked nice. The material is slightly slick, but not silky. The fit is great. I ordered the 36 inch waist. He is usually a size 34x34, but since we've all gained some weight during the pandemic, I thought the 36 inch would be a safer bet. He's 6'2" and the length is fine on him. It's definitely a nicer look than the baggy sweat pants!

title: Form Fitting
text: I am a size 18 in women's sizes so I ordered the 2XL. It's form fitting, but not tight. I have started to increase my daily activity and thought a long sleeve dry-fit shirt might be useful for the winter months. The arm length is good - not too short, not too long. It hangs long enough that I'm not tugging it in the back. I am satisfied with it.

title: Good Mask
text: My daughter was working in a restaurant over the holiday break. She finds it difficult to wear masks that go over your ears for extended periods of time because she has to constantly adjust them. She has several tie masks that she wears when she's working. This is a cuter version of the tie mask. She can put the bow up top near her bun. The face size is a snug, but workable. The fabric print is cute.

title: Trendy
text: My 19 year old asked me for a tennis skirt recently. I asked her if she was taking up tennis. The answer was no. Evidently tennis skirts are very trendy right now. They're worn with white collared shirts underneath a crew neck sweatshirt. My daughter has been very happy with this tennis skirt. It has the built in shorts. The fabric is thick enough that it's not too see-through. My daughter is in between a medium/large with bottoms. We went with the large because it has a tie at the waist so you can adjust the fit if needed. She felt that she could have gotten by with the medium, though the large works. It does have the pocket for the tennis ball which totally confused my daughter!!

title: So Cute!
text: My 19 year old daughter is in love with these Jessica Simpson shoes. They are so cute! They are a lot higher than we expected. My daughter is 5'7" and with these she is nearly as tall as her father who's 6'2". She's not accustomed to wearing such high heels, but she's been practicing around the house. In addition to the high heels, they're also on a platform. The back of the heels have a small zipper which makes it easier to put on the shoes. The quality seems to be good.

title: Cute!
text: I recently wore a sweater like this and my daughter liked it so much, that she wanted one for herself. This is not quite as cute as mine. The stitches aren't as chunky as my daughter would have liked. Regardless, it's well made and warm. The length is good, too. Overall, this is a necessity for one's winter wardrobe!

title: Lightweight
text: I wanted a swim shirt to wear kayaking. I'm a size 18 woman and ordered the 2XL. It's loose and roomy which I like. The shirt is just what I wanted! It's light weight. The color is gray with blue trim. The sleeves are a tad long, but that doesn't bother me. It will do a fine job of protecting me from the sun without additional weight.

title: So Comfortable!
text: I wear a women's 10W shoe. I have found that men's socks are often more comfortable and have a better fit. That is the case with these socks. They are so comfortable! They are similar to compression socks as far as the snug fit, though they stretch and give more than compression socks. They are very supportive in the arch. I ordered gray ones and I am very pleased.

title: Cute!
text: I'm in my early fifties and this pajama set would probably be too much for me to sleep in, but perfect for lounging around the house in the mornings. I am a size 18 and this XXL fit well. There was no gaping or puckering at the buttons. The sleeves were an appropriate length. The waist band is comfortable and has a good stretchiness to it. I love the blue color! It washes well, too.

title: Nice Stretch to the Fabric
text: This shirt is a little snug fitting, but it has nice stretch to the fabric and is not tight or restrictive. I'm a size 18 and I ordered the 2XL.  It's great for layering. I like the scoop neckline.

title: Cute!
text: These slippers are cute and comfy. I love the purple color! I am having a slight issue with the fit. I wear a size 10W shoe. My feet fit fine in these. However, when I wear them, my heel always ends up sitting on the rear edge and crushing it down. I will then adjust my foot so it doesn't do that, but it always manages to do it again. I've been just dealing with it. It doesn't bother me when I am walking. I just don't like that the edge is crushed. There's plenty of cushion in the foot bed. They're great for running out to the mailbox without having to put regular shoes on!

title: Very Pretty
text: These slippers are very pretty. They have a retro vibe going for them. They remind me of something a glamourous movie star would have worn in the 60's or 70's. I have a 10 W foot. These did not fit me. I'm not sure it was the width or the length. When I put my feet in them, my heel hung over the back. I think if the band was slightly wider, my foot would slide in more and that wouldn't be an issue. They have a nice comfortable foot bed. I like the pink color a lot. My daughter has been wearing them around the house and they fit better on her size 9 feet.

title: Great for Sensitive Ears!
text: I rarely wear earrings any more. It seems that when I do, they will start to irritate or annoy me after a few hours. I wore a pair of these over the weekend for over 7 hours and had no issues at all. I was thrilled! I completely forgot that I was wearing them. This set has 6 pairs of CZ earrings. They came in a little individual baggies and were in a slightly larger cello bag which was inside a small jewelry box. They look nice and I don't worry about losing a precious diamond when I wear them!

title: Cute!
text: This sweater is really cute! I wanted something that I could wear with t-shirts this winter. I'm in my early 50's and I have issues with body temperature. I'm probably at the early stages of menopause. If I wear long sleeves around the house, I often get overly warm. If I am wearing short sleeves and I get chilly, I end up putting on a zippered fleece or jacket. That does the job, but I feel sloppy and frumpy. This sweater makes me feel a bit more stylish. The sweater is a good weight - not too heavy or too light. I love the color! My 19 year old daughter has complimented it multiple times and that means a lot. She NEVER compliments my wardrobe. So that alone means everything to me! I may need to check out other colors!

title: Fits As Expected
text: I was happy that this swimsuit fit as expected. I'm about a size 18 right now and this 2XL fit well. I always tend to go up a size when it comes to swimsuits. I feel that the XL would not have fit. There's not a lot of support or coverage in the chest area, but my husband liked that. We have a hot tub that we use at least a couple of times a week, so it's perfect for that. I'm not sure I would feel comfortable wearing it out in public. But to be totally honest, I probably wouldn't feel comfortable wearing any swimsuit out in public!

title: So Cute!
text: My 19 year old daughter loves wearing bralettes. This one is so cute! It has a lacy back and a ribbed front. The sizing is good. She's a 34D and I ordered her the Large. It fits well. She says it's more supportive than she expected, which is good. It's very comfortable. I ordered her the set of three. The black is her favorite but she is excited to have all of them.

title: Soft
text: I tend to go barefoot as long as I can, but once the weather gets cold, I'm a slipper kind of girl. These slippers run a little small. I wear a size 10W women's shoe. My heel hangs off the back of these. I was also expecting them to be super comfortable with a squishy foot bed, but there's no padding or cushion at all. It's like walking on the floor. The furry part of the slipper is very soft. I like the way the look. They're just not the comfy/cozy slippers I need.

title: Comfortable Fabric
text: I enjoy wearing Christmas shirts during the month of December. This one is a light weight long sleeved one. The image of the pickup truck with the tree in the back is darling! the vinyl decal/image is attached securely with no visible loose edges. The size of the shirt is good. I ordered the 2XL in hopes of a slightly loose fit and I am pleased with it. The arm sleeve length is good - not too long, not too short. It washes well. I am very happy with my new shirt!

title: Cute Shirt!
text: I ordered this cute Christmas shirt in a XXL size. It's a pretty good fit on me. It's more fitted than loose which could be because of the size not the cut, I'm not sure. The 3/4 sleeves are snug on me, but not tight. The white part of the shirt is very thin and see through. I had to change my bra to a nude colored one when I first wore this. The image is securely fixed onto the garment. It washes fine.

title: Another Cute Holiday Shirt!
text: Another cute holiday shirt for me! This one is long sleeve and more of a sweatshirt type shirt. I ordered the 2XL and it fit loosely on my everywhere except the cuffs. The cuffs were a little snug. It was difficult to access my smartwatch while wearing it. The rest of the shirt fit fine. The decal/image is good and clear. It is securely on the shirt with no curling edges. It washed fine without any noticeable shrinkage.

title: Cute Christmas Shirt
text: I'm all about wearing holiday shirts in the month of December. This one is very cute. I like the use of the buffalo plaid. The decal or image is done well. All of the edges are secured. The size of the shirt runs a bit small. I wear a size 16-18 or XL in regular sizing. I always buy a size up when it comes to unknown brands such as this, ,so I got this in the XXL. It's snug in the arms and shoulders. It's not too restrictive, but it's just slightly uncomfortable. The body also has a fitted style fit and it's okay. The sleeves are a little short, too. I wasn't sure if it was a 3/4 sleeve or long sleeve, but the description says long sleeve. Hopefully I will have some success with weight loss next year and it will fit better then.

title: Cute!
text: My daughter follows style trends and recently requested this type of sock. It is exactly what she wanted and she's very pleased with them. They are long enough that they fold over adequately. They're light weight and not bulky so they can be worn with dressier type shoes. The assortment of colors is great!

title: True Fit Sizing
text: This is a really cute Christmas shirt! It's true fit sizing. The sleeves are a good length. The material is very soft. The white part of the shirt is bit see through. You just need to be aware of that with what you wear underneath. The image is printed nicely and securely. I feel festive wearing it!

title: Satisfied
text: My 19 year old daughter mentioned that she wanted some fishnet stockings when we were out shopping recently. Being the cool mom that I am, I refrained from raising my eyebrow and then later I ordered these for her. I have never worn fishnet stockings myself, but according to my daughter, they have been popping up everywhere lately on social media and such. First of all, she was pleasantly surprised to discover that this was a set of 2 pairs. The fit was good. She's 5'7" and weighs about 155 pounds. They were neither tight or loose on her. They do have some stretch to them so there is some flexibility with the sizing and fit. They seem to be made well. They didn't rip or tear when she's worn them so far. She is satisfied with them.

title: Soft Tee
text: This is a soft long sleeved tee. The shirt fits well and is neither baggy or clingy. I did order a size up because I have gained some weight during this pandemic and my usual XL size tends to be a bit snug these days. The 2XL is not oversized like it should be, so it's possible it may run a tad small. The sleeves are too long, but I would rather deal with that instead of being annoyed because they're too short. I don't think I have particularly long arms. I don't really care for the pocket. I would prefer if it wasn't there. I love the green color. It's almost a jewel tone color.  Overall, I am pleased with it.

title: Cute Shirt, Good Fit
text: This is a cute holiday shirt. I'm in my early 50's and I'm in perimenopause so I don't wear a lot of long sleeves. If I do, it must be freezing! So I was happy to have this cute short sleeved Christmas top. I ordered a size up and it fits as expected. If I had ordered my true size, XL, I think it would have been too tight. The shirt washes well. I am very happy with it.

title: Great Traction
text: I wear a women's size 10W shoe. I scanned through reviews for other Reebok shoes and from what I gathered, they run true to size. So I thought this  9 should have fit. The problem I had with them wasn't the width, it was the length. My toes were touching the tip of the shoe and were crushed. It was such a shame because the shoes are exactly what I was looking for! They have great traction on the bottom.  They had a classic look with the navy and white colors. The cushion is good as is the arch support.  I guess I have to keep looking!

title: Excellent Accessory for Furry Cosplay!
text: The overall quality of this fur tail is excellent.  It's very well made.  It comes with belt that slides through a wide belt loop attached to the tail. I am 5'6" and wear a size 16/18. It fit me fine, My daughter is 5'7" and wears a women's medium or 6/8 and it fit her fine, too. My 11 year old niece tried it on.  She's about 5'2" and very thin. If she wore the belt on her hips, it was a good fit, but it would not tighten enough for her waist. This is perfect for costumes and cosplay!

title: More Silver Than Rose
text: I am a longtime fan of Vera Bradley. This key chain is sturdy and the quality is what I would expect from the Vera Bradley company. The fabric part is more silver than rose, but it's pretty all the same. I do wish it had some of the signature Vera Bradley printed fabric which I have grown to love. It's very sparkly, but just not what I am used to from them.

title: Super Soft
text: These headbands are super soft. In fact, they're the softest headbands that I have ever had. They fit fine. I have a large head and they fit without being tight. I like the assortment of colors.

title: Great Fit!
text: These men's pants have a great fit. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 215 pounds. We ordered his usual size of 34x34 and the fit is perfect. The material is light weight and has a good range of motion. He has already worn these a couple of times. He likes wearing pants with lots of pockets when he's working around the house on weekends.

title: So Soft!
text: My daughter loves these pajamas! They're super cute and very soft. They're true to size and fit as expected. They can be worn for lounging or sleeping. The tye-dye fabric is cute.

title: Great Shirt!
text: Finally! The perfect shirt for my son. He's a big guy and a lot of big and tall shirts just aren't long enough on him. They're more big than tall. He's not super tall, but whenever he bends or stretches, his shirts pull up a lot and expose his belly or backside. This is a true big and tall fit. It looks great on him and covers him where he needs coverage. I am going to order another one for Christmas!

title: Fancy Laptop Case!
text: I love this rolling work bag. It's basically a fancy laptop case, or at least that's what I'm using it for. I have a 17 inch laptop and it fits securely in this bag. There's also enough room for some books, my planner, and assorted cables and such. The telescoping handle is very sturdy. I was impressed with how nice it is. It's thicker and sturdier than my carry-on bag. I love the floral print fabric inside. I am a longtime Vera Bradley fan and their floral patterns are wonderful! I am very pleased with my new bag!

title: Soft Material
text: My husband is a fan of shirts with beer logos on them. This t-shirt is soft and has a vintage or distressed feel about it. The shirt fits as expected. It washes well without any noticeable shrinkage or fading.

title: Snug Fit
text: I am a fan of the red/black buffalo plaid. I saw this Christmas shirt with gnomes and had to have it! It's really a cute shirt. It's well made. The images are clear and secure. I wear a size 16/18. I ordered this in the XXL. It's a little snug across the chest. I'm a 40DD and there's no room for anything. I prefer my shirts to be a little roomier. Though I will say that my husband said he likes the fit! Well, he's not the one wearing it! I will probably still wear it this holiday season because it's cute, but unless I lose some weight, it's not going to stay around for long.

title: One Size Fits All
text: I'm a plus size mom and this fits me, but it also fits my 19 year old daughter who wears a size 6/8. I personally felt that it was a little snug at the neck area and not super comfortable. A smaller neck would probably like it better. The fabric is light weight and vibrantly colored. There's a little elastic for you to slide your finger through so you can flap your wings. I'm 5'6" and it almost reaches the ground, so if you're a lot shorter than that, it may drag. It's definitely an easy costume to put together.

title: Soft Nightgown!
text: This is a cute, soft night gown! It's a true to size fit. The fabric is not see through. I like the fun spaghetti straps! It's a little tricky putting on because you have so many thin straps to work with. I am very happy with it!

title: True to Size
text: It's always a risk ordering swimsuits online, but this one is true to size and it fits as expected. It doesn't have a lot of support, but it's comfortable and covers things. It's low cut, which my husband liked. I probably wouldn't feel comfortable wearing it out on public, but it's perfect for our hot tub.

title: Comfy!
text: This long sleeve t-shirt is very comfy! It's true to size. The sleeves aren't tight or binding. The length covers my back side when I raise my arms or bend over. The material is soft and has a good stretch to it. I may have to check out the other color options!

title: True Fit Sizing
text: My daughter was wanting some new slippers. She's going through a pink phase, so she had her eye on these. She is absolutely thrilled with these. They're very comfortable and plush. It's like walking on clouds. She has decided that they're better for walking on single floors rather than on stairs. She didn't get hurt, but the potential is there if she's not careful next time! The color is lovely.

title: Good Quality
text: My daughter saw the picture of this costume and thought it would be a fun one. We weren't sure what about sizing, so we ordered a size up just in case. She's 5'7" and weighs about 155 pounds. She usually wears mediums, but with the uncertainty, we ordered the large. It's better to have something too big than too small. Well, it's a little too big. The cape is obviously not an issue. The dress is a bit baggy. However, since the costume involves wearing the cape, my daughter has decided that she can pin or clip the back of the dress so it fits better and that will be hidden by the cape. She likes the length of the dress on her.  The quality is good and better than most costumes that you would buy at Target and Wal-Mart.

title: Awesome!!
text: These furry hands are awesome! They are very well constructed. The fur is soft. I really like the streaks of white and gold that run through it. The details are amazing from the gold toe pads to the claws. It's basically a 4 finger glove. I have large adult hands. They're probably more fat than large. These fit me but I think they would fit better on a smaller hand. Since there are only 4 finger places, it took me a little while to figure out the best combination. I decided that my pinky and ring finger could share a space for the best comfort. Perfect for any Furry fans!

title: Flattering
text: My daughter is thrilled with her new dress. She's 5'7"/155 pounds and wears a size medium or a 6/8. We ordered this in the medium and she's very pleased with how it looks. It's very flattering. You can adjust the length of the dress by tightening or loosening the drawstrings on the sides. The color matches the photo on the description well. She is super happy with it!

title: Cute Christmas T-Shirt
text: This is a super cute Christmas t-shirt. I love the wine glass reindeer design! The shirt is a heathery green. I really like that the image is not thick and stiff. I've gotten some shirts where the decal is really stiff and annoys me, but this is not. I am currently a size 16/18 and the 2XL is a bit snug on me. It's not tight, but I prefer my shirts to be a little looser.

title: Cute!
text: This light weight t-shirt is very cute. The fit is pretty good and as expected. The sleeves are snug but not tight. The decal is printed well and securely attached to the garment. It's perfect for the Thanksgiving season!

title: Decent Socks
text: These are decent socks. The quality is good. They're not too thin. I have thick calves and found that they are too tight to pull them up all the way. They fit my husband much better, so he is the new recipient of them.

title: Cute!
text: I am 5'6" and wear a size 16/18 or XL. I ordered this in the 2XL to be on the safe side because of experience with other shirts I have bought here. It's a tad snug on me which surprised me. It's not tight, just snug. The quality of the shirt is good. The image is secure. It's an iron on (I think) and because it's a large image, it feels stiff when wearing it. It's not the end of the world, but if I had my choice, I would prefer one that wasn't so stiff. It's a cute shirt and perfect for fall.

title: Great Fit!
text: I get caught up in the holidays and love wearing Christmas shirts during the month of December. This one is perfect for the warmer days since it's short sleeved. It has a great fit and fit as I expected it to. The material is a little heavier than I would prefer, but it's fine. The image is clear and securely affixed. It washes well without any peeling of the  design.

title: Works Well
text: I usually wear face masks that have elastic straps that go over my ears. When I get to the car, I have to completely take the mask off. I've tried just taking it off one ear and letting it hang, like I have seen many others do, including my husband, but it doesn't work on me. This is perfect! The length is good. The clips work well and securely hold onto the mask. It looks a bit fancy, but I do like it.

title: Decent Quality
text: When you get so many individual pieces of jewelry for such a small price, you don't expect the pieces to be high quality. As expected, these aren't. However, they are decent and they allow me to play around with multiple fashion looks because I have a good assortment of pieces. I was most excited about the layered necklaces. There are 2 different sets. They aren't too flimsy. I don't feel that they're going to break. At the same time, you're not going to mistake them for quality jewelry either. I've worn them each once so far as well as the earrings and some of the rings. None of them have turned green, which I take as a good sign. For the price, I feel that this is an inexpensive way to accessorize.

title: Cute & Comfy!
text: These tennis shoes are not only cute, but they're comfy, too! I wear a size 10W shoe. Size 11 shoes often offer enough extra room for my Flintstone feet. I am pleased with the fit of these. I did have to loosen the shoe laces quite a bit, but that wasn't a problem. There's adequate arch support and padding in the foot bed. The peachy pink and black look great together! I am glad I took a chance on these.

title: Runs Small
text: I think they run small. I wear a women's size 10 Wide shoe. This size should have fit fine, but my toes were smashed in them. I was able to pass them on to my sister who wears a 9 wide and they fit her nicely. The shoes have some cushion, but they're not super padded liked memory foam. There's adequate arch support. The blue color is gorgeous! Overall, they're good shoes if you get the right size.

title: Compact!
text: I'm usually a purse type, but with the pandemic, I started using just a lanyard and small wallet to simplify what I take with me when I go to the store. This is a compact crossbody that allows me to take just a little more than what I can carry in the wallet/lanyard combo. It was easy to remove the belt strap for the fanny pack option. It's sturdy and well made. The teddy bear material is super cute!

title: Adorable!
text: This tote back is absolutely adorable! I love the Teddy Bear Fleece! The tote has a lot of room for a small size. There are pockets inside as well as a zippered one on the outside. The handles are long enough to fit over your shoulder nicely. I love that the bag has a zipper closure. I think that all totes should have some kind of closure. The floral print interior is beautiful and goes well with the grey color. I had all kinds of plans for this tote until my daughter came home from college for the weekend. She loves it! She can be pretty picky about things, but this is something she said she would definitely use. I don't think I even mentioned the quality. It's well made. The straps are sturdy. It's what I have come to expect from the Vera Bradley company.

title: Cute Fleece
text: I was so excited when I saw this in person. It's a super cute fleece and will be perfect for the upcoming winter. It's soft and cozy! It's a little snug on me, but not to the point of being uncomfortable. I ordered my usual size. I wear a 16/18 or XL in most things. I ordered this in a 1XL because I had hoped for it to be a little big so I can layer with it. As it is now, there's no room for layering. The arms are a little tight, but not unbearable. The body of it fits fine with just a camisole under it, but no room for another shirt. In all fairness, I think I would have been happier with the 2XL in regards to fit.

title: Strange Fit
text: These shoes are much darker looking in person. The photos in the description look almost purple with pink, especially the picture showing the bottom of the shoes. In person they are more of a dark blue with orangish red. The fit was a bit strange, too. They did fit me, but the shoe has a lot of stretch to it and it's almost like putting socks on your feet. The sole doesn't extend as far as my heel goes. Though it felt like my foot was on the shoe bed. It's really hard to explain. I did order my usual size, so perhaps going up a size would have been better. There is adequate cushion and support. It was a little tight in the toes, but not painful or irritating.

title: Comfortable
text: I wear a size 16 in most pants.  These XL yoga pants fit pretty well. The length is just a tad long on my 5'6" frame, but if I pull them up just a bit, then it's no too bad. And if I wear shoes, that helps, too. The material is not too light. I was worried that it would highlight the dimples on my thighs, but it doesn't. There is a pocket, at the waist which can kind of hold my phone. My phone (Pixel 4a) fits about 2/3rds of the way in, so it does poke out. It may not be designed for a phone, but that's something that I need, so I am making it work. The pants are comfortable.

title: Comfortable Fit
text: My daughter is pretty athletic and was in need of new shoes. She wears a size 9 shoe and these fit her as expected. She finds them to be comfortable to wear. She is taking volley ball as a college class right now, but she doesn't really see how these are especially for volley ball. She says they have adequate support and a squishy bed. She likes the simple black and white design.

title: Great Wardrobe Staple!
text: This long sleeve shirt is a great wardrobe staple! It's comfortable to wear. I usually wear a 16/18 or XL in clothing, but I ordered this in the XXL. It's a loose, but not baggy fit on me. I think I would have been uncomfortable in a XL. The sleeves are a little long, but not comical. The overall length is long (but not too long) which I like because it covers my backside when I raise my arms. I also like the scoop neckline. Now that I've seen in person, I will probably order another one in a different color.

title: Very Pleased With These!
text: I'm in my early 50's and on the cusp of entering menopause. I get very warm at night, so I wear very light sleepwear. However, when we have company or if I go to my sister's house for a few days, I want something that covers more of me so I don't have to put on a heavy robe. These are perfect for those times! I currently wear a size 16/18, XL, 40DD. A lot of button down tops will gape open and I didn't want that to happen, so I ordered the XXL. The fit is perfect! No gaping! The length of the pants is good, too. I'm 5'6" and it's not too long or too short. The fabric is soft and lightweight, so if I did sleep in them all night, there's a chance I won't get overheated. And I really like the leopard print! Overall, I am very pleased with these.

title: Great Size
text: This wallet is a great size if you don't have to carry a lot of cards and stuff in your wallet. It has 4 card slots plus an ID window. There's a place for bills and another one, albeit quite small, for coins. I like it, but I've been having issues with the snap.  About one out of every three times I try to snap it closed, it won't snap. I have to end up using both hands and applying a lot of pressure and then it usually snaps. I do think that I discovered the problem. The part of the snap that's on the wallet part (not the flap) is loose and rotates easily. If it's lined up a certain way, it snaps fine. If it's not in the right position, then it won't snap closed. One shouldn't have to work that hard to get it closed. I hope that this is just a faulty wallet and it's not happening with others.

title: So Cute!
text: We are waiting on the delivery of our new hot tub, so I wanted to get some new swimwear ahead of time. I'm a plus size mom and I currently wear a size 16/18. The top of this tankini fits great. The bottom is a little too small. Luckily, I have other swim bottoms that will work instead. These bottoms have less coverage than I feel comfortable with wearing. The top has padded cups. The top has a nice flowy look. The description implies that it has some kind of tummy control feature, but I didn't notice that. It's a loose, flowy style that is flattering on its own, but since it flows, it's not right up against the stomach area, so it can't compress anything. I have purchased many clothing items with some kind of tummy control feature, and I would confidently say that this doesn't have that. With that being said, I am pleased with how it looks on me. With a different pair of bottoms, I would feel comfortable wearing this in public and not just in my personal hot tub!

title: Great Mask!
text: I have quite a few masks now. Most of mine are cute and colorful, so I decided that I needed some more neutral ones. Black goes with just about everything, so it was a good choice.  The mask is made well. It has the nose bridge piece which helps when I'm wearing my glasses. The elastic ear straps can be adjusted to fit better. They're light weight, but still have adequate layers. I am very happy with these masks!

title: Cute But Runs Small
text: This is a very cute swimsuit, but it runs small. I currently wear between a size 16 and 18 or an XL. My bra size is a 40DD.  I did order a size larger by getting the XXL. After a lot of tugging and pulling, I was able to get it up over my hips and waist, but there was no way I was getting it up any higher. I was disappointed because it looks even better in person. The straps on the back side are modern looking and adjustable like a bra strap. The construction of the garment looks good, too. If I was ordering it again, I would probably go with the 4XL.

title: Great Color!
text: This is a really cute long sleeve top. The red color is great and perfect for fall. It seems to be made well. The material is soft. It's really a cute shirt. I ordered the XXL and it fits fine. I currently wear a size 16 or sometimes an 18 or XL. But when ordering unfamiliar brands, I often size up, which is what I did here. The sleeves aren't tight and the length is good. While it's a cute shirt,  I have decided that it's not a flattering style for me.

title: Great for Cooler Weather
text: I grew out my bangs last year so for the first time in probably 40 years, I am able to wear a cute headband like this one. With bangs, they just never looked right on me. This fits fine. I have a large head and often have issues with hats or headbands fitting well. It's not tight. There's enough stretch that allows it to be a little flexible. The color I got was darker than the picture. It's okay, but I was hoping for more of an ecru color. It could be the lighting, but mine is closer to tan. My hair is brown so a lighter color would have been a better contrast. The yarn is soft and has a chunky stitch. It's really great for cooler weather!

title: Comfortable Shoes
text: My husband has hiking boots, but sometimes that seems to be just a little overboard for casual hiking. These look like plain ordinary tennis shoes with the soles/traction on steroids. As far as looks go, they're a bit boring. But they are very comfortable. They offer great arch support. The traction is excellent. My husband doesn't care about the looks when it comes to most footwear. The sizing is great. He wears 11's and these fit true to size.

title: Cute Face Masks!
text: I am a longtime fan of Vera Bradley. I have actually placed 3 orders with the company for face masks during the pandemic. I was excited to see them here! As much as I like them, they are not the best masks out there in my opinion. I love the prints and fabric choices. I enjoy selecting my mask each day to coordinate my outfit. The first several that I bought directly from VB did not have any labels on them. Only in my last order did some of them start having the VB label. In this set, 2 of the 3 have a VB label. They do have the pocket for the filter. They seem to have just 2 layers of fabric, so the filter counts as the 3rd layer. I haven't had any problems with the ear elastics not fitting, but my daughter has so I bought some of those silicone toggles for her and that solved that. There are no nose pieces in this style so they do cause some fogging of my glasses. I have some adhesive metal strips that I have used on them and that helps, but more often than not, I don't add it and just deal with the fogging. They're other style of mask does have the wire built into it. I've ordered a few of those for my daughter. My biggest issue with the VB masks is that they always wrinkle. If I was motivated, I would iron my masks. I have other brands of masks that I like better, but I'm still a sucker for these VB ones.

title: Cute for Fall!
text: This is a really cute shirt. It's perfect for all. The fit is good. I wear a size 16/18 or XL, but I ordered this in the 2XL. It's a little bit loose, but it's not baggy. The sleeves aren't tight at all, which is often an issue with this style of shirt. It's a good length, too, and hangs enough below the waist that when I stretch or bend over, my backside doesn't show. While I really like the image, it's vinyl and not screen printed. So the image feels pretty stiff. I really don't like that. It's annoying. Besides that, I like the shirt. I have washed it once and the image didn't fade or come up on the edges. There also wasn't any noticeable shrinkage.

title: Great Fit!
text: I ordered these snow bibs for my 19 year old daughter. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears a size medium and 6/8 in clothes. I wasn't sure how sizing worked for snow bibs, so I did some research online. What I found was to go a size larger to allow room for bulky clothing underneath, so I ordered a large instead of her usual medium. I'm really glad that I did! The large wasn't that big on her at all. If I had gone with the medium, I'm afraid it would have been too tight. There's enough room in these large ones for her to wear leggings or long underwear, but nothing really bulky or multiple layers. She can move and bend easily. The length was good. Unfortunately due to the pandemic, we've had to postpone our ski trip. However, she'll be ready when we are able to travel again.

title: These Work Well!
text: I recently purchased some Ruby Ribbon camis. Basically, they're camisoles with some support so you don't have to wear a bra. While they do offer enough support and lift, they're thin and parts are visible through your clothing. I'm in my early 50's and that's really not appropriate for me. I am happy to say that these covers work well! They're super thin and kind of like a band-aid. There is adhesive that is around the edge of the circle shape. When I have these on, the problem is solved! Even with the cooler weather we're starting to have. They stay in place nicely. And when it's time to take them off, it isn't painful. If you have ever had a mammogram and had to wear those little stickers  before getting your picture taken, you'll be happy to know that these hurt a lot less than those do when taking them off. I am very pleased with these. You get 40 pairs, so that should last a while.

title: Cute Prints!
text: These masks are light weight, but still 2 layers. The prints are cute and appropriate for the recommended ages. The ear loops do not have an adjusters on them, so you may need to add them to it for smaller faces. They are made well.

title: True Size Fit
