text: These men's sandals are a true size fit. My husband found them to be comfortable to wear. They're easy to adjust the tightness, though even at the tightest position, he was able to slip out of them with minimal effort. . The soles have excellent traction. They feel sturdy and well made.

title: Baggy
text: My 19 year old daughter loves to wear sweatpants for lounging. She thought these were cute. Unfortunately, they weren't what she wanted. She was hoping for sweatpant style pants. She says these are more like joggers and then proceeded to educate me on the difference between the two. These sag a lot in the crotch and bottom area. The legs are tapered. The overall fit is as expected and are not loose. They are comfortable, but they're not something she would wear out in public.

title: My Husband is a Fan!
text: My husband is a fan of these new Keen open toe sandals. This style is his preferred sandal style. He has a similar pair by another nice brand and says that these are comparable in quality.  They fit as expected, so they are true to size. They have a good arch support and comfortable foot bed. These are great for outdoor activities.

title: Cute Holiday Shirt
text: My family likes wearing fun holiday shirts at Christmas time. This dinosaur themed Christmas shirt is funny and cute! I got this one for my 19 year old daughter. The length is a little on the long side, but if it were me, I would like it that way. The shirt fits as expected. The image is a good print. Overall, it's a fun Christmas shirt. I like that it's available in sizing for the whole family, though I doubt I would be able to convince my family to all wear matching shirts!

title: Comfortable Fit
text: My son is a big guy. He used to be uncomfortable wearing swimsuits, but he has recently gotten over that and proudly wears one when hanging out with his friends at the pool or in the hot tub. These trunks have a functioning adjustable drawstring which he really likes. There are several swimsuits out there that have decorative drawstrings so he was glad that this wasn't the case with these. It has a mesh liner. The swimsuit fits as it should. He likes the fun, floral print, too.

title: Nice Sandals
text: I wear a size 10 Wide in women's shoes. These were too snug on me. My daughter wears a size 9 regular width and they did fit her well. She liked them, so she adopted them. They have a comfortable foot bed, but there's no arch support. For me, that would have been a problem, but she's young and doesn't have foot issues. The elastic straps have a nice stretch, but it wasn't enough to work with the width of my foot. The quality of the shoes is great! Overall, these are nice sandals.

title: Nice Quality
text: This is a nice quality student uniform skirt. The skirt is pleated. It is true-to-size and it has an adjustable waist. It washes well and there has been no noticeable shrinkage or fading.

title: Easy Care
text: This is a nice looking, easy care blouse. The material washes and wears well. It's true to size and fit my 19 year old daughter as expected. She's wears mediums and size 6/8's in clothes. She isn't crazy about the sleeves. They are very wide at the cuffs. They can be rolled up and there's a button and fabric strip for keeping them in place. But she needed this for a business casual look for one of her college classes so she's learning to deal with the sleeves. Overall, it's a good work blouse.

title: Quality Uniform Dress
text: This is a quality uniform dress. It's true to size though possibly a tad on the long side. The dress washes well with no noticeable shrinkage or fading. It doesn't have the usual Tommy logo which is good in my opinion because it keeps kids on the same level regardless of economic background.

title: Excellent Quality
text: My 19 year old daughter started working on her Halloween costume and wanted this for the ensemble. It surpassed our expectations as far as the overall quality. It's very well made. It comes with an adjustable nylon belt that slides through a  wide belt loop attached to the tail. My daughter is 5'7" and wears a women's medium or 6/8. The belt could easily adjust for a larger waist.  My 11 year old niece tried it on. The belt does adjust a little smaller than my daughter, but not quite enough for my niece. She's not as tall as my daughter (probably about 5'2" and very thin. If she wore the belt on her hips, it was a good fit, but it would not tighten enough for her waist. Though she said it was comfortable at the waist and not too loose. This is perfect for costumes and cosplay!

title: Love the Color!
text: I only recently started wearing hats. I used to have bangs and just didn't like the look of bangs with hats! Now that I no longer have bangs, I have started wearing them when deemed necessary. This one has a wide brim. It is adjustable, but on the max setting, it's snug on my large head. I do like it enough that I do wear it.  It folds up easily. I  love the color!

title: Sweet Bracelet!
text: This bracelet is so lovely! It has a unique fastener. You can adjust the size by gently pulling on the ends. I do wonder how long that will hold up though and if it does come apart, can it be fixed.  The stones are dainty and have a wonderful sparkle. It's prettier in person!

title: Nice Quality
text: This mask is a nice quality. I adore the sweet floral print. The mask has 2 layers of cotton fabric. The ear straps are made from the same floral print fabric. They are adjustable with slide toggles. This is one of my teenage daughter's favorite masks!

title: Cute Masks
text: I like wearing cloth masks over disposable ones. I take my time selecting ones to coordinate with my outfit when I need to wear one. These are soft and very comfortable, They're also very cute. The elastic straps don't annoy me.  These cover my face adequately. I would recommend them.

title: Beautiful Earrings!
text: These are beautiful earrings. The stones are a good size. The prongs are strong and securely holding the stones. Garnets are my birthstone and I have a few earrings with them, but these are by far the nicest. I would definitely consider purchasing Nicole Miller jewelry in the future.

title: Cute!
text: This is a cute head scarf. It's a soft, polyester material. The edges are smooth. It does loosen up over time, but that's not the end of the world. It's a little shorter than I expected, but I am still able to wear it in my hair.

title: Soft Night Gown
text: I am really liking this night gown. I was afraid that I would feel like an old lady in it, but I don't. I am currently a size 16/18 or XL in most clothing. The sizing for this recommended the XL for 14/16 and the XXL for 18. I don't like my night gowns to be too restrictive, so I went with the XXL and I am pleased with the fit. It's roomy & flowy without looking oversized. The material is very soft and light weight. It's not see through, but it does cling around the chest area little. A darker color might look better, but I do like pink! The color in the product description looks more like a peachy-pink, but it person it was more like a true pink or baby pink. I've had another night gown this style and it was way too short on my and I didn't care for that. This one goes below my knees a little bit which I like better.

title: Cute Mask!
text: I have really gotten in to the whole face mask thing. I like picking ones to coordinate with my outfit. This cloth one is cute. The elastic straps are adjustable as well as comfortable. It has a nose bridge piece which helps with the foggy glasses issue, but I found that it's not foolproof and that I have to keep bending it in place to work. There's a pocket if you want to add a filter. It's 2 layers of fabric. It doesn't interfere with breathing too much. Overall, a nice mask.

title: Cute Choker Necklace
text: My daughter likes to wear jewelry, but even at 19, she can be a bit careless with it. This choker is pretty cute AND it's not expensive. So....if she misplaces it, it's not the end of the world. The necklace fits nicely at the base of her neck. It's adjustable a little bit. It looks really nice on her.

title: Great for Layering!
text: My husband is cold natured, so he's always layering clothing in the cooler months. Plain, long sleeved t-shirts are a must for him. This one has a true fit. I ordered his usual large size and it fit as expected. The sleeves are long enough. The material is pretty soft. It will be perfect for the fall and winter seasons!

title: Cute!
text: I recently discovered that my current purse has begun to show worn spots, so I have been in the market for a new one. This one is quite cute! It is a crossbody style, but I shortened the strap and wear it on my shoulder instead. I'm a plus size woman and crossbody purses just aren't flattering on me. The purse has plenty of room for everything I need. My kids are grown, so I don't carry all the mom stuff anymore. The drawstring feature does work, but I am having to be aware of what I keep inside it so I don't have small loose things in it, because the bag doesn't close completely and if tipped over, things will fall out. There are 2 interior pockets - one zippered, the other is a slip one. I like the details such as the outer stitching and the skeleton key. The purse is a very nice quality. I really like it!

title: Comfortable and Cute!
text: I really like this shirt. It's both comfortable and cute. The material is light weight and flowy. I wish I had gotten a size smaller. I'm in between sizes - 16 & 18. I went with the 18 and it's just a tad too big. I'll still wear it, but I am following WW right now and if I continue to be successful on it, then it will be way too big shortly. I can't get the neckline to stay open like the picture! It keeps flipping back into place. I bet if I iron it that way, it will stay put. It washes well. I like it!

title: Cute!
text: This is a cute, casual necklace. It's a reasonable price. The layered necklaces are not attached to one another, so you can wear them all together or separately. The chains are okay and don't look super cheap. With that being said, they definitely don't look high quality either. They can be adjusted to find the right length. I especially like the hammered disc.

title: Cute & Comfy!
text: I just love these socks. Not only are they cute, but they're comfy, too! I'm kind of picky about my socks, too. They're not too thin and they have a good amount of stretch in them. I wear a women's size 10 wide shoe. I was worried that these wouldn't fit me. They're not tight or restrictive at all. I only wish that they were a color other than white. I tend to wear socks around the house and white socks just show dirt well.

title: Sporty!
text: This crop top is cute & sporty. It pairs nicely with a pair of name brand athletic pants that also has white stripes along the sides. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 155 pounds. She wears tops in size smalls and mediums. She wanted this in a size small so it was a fitted look. She is very pleased with the way it looks and fits. One of her school colors is red and she is excited to wear this to fall sporting events.

title: Comfortable Fit
text: My 19 year old daughter was looking for some new denim shorts recently. She was excited to give these a try. She likes high-waisted clothing such as this. She is 5'7" and weighs about 155 pounds. She wears mediums or size 8's in pants. We ordered this in an 8 and it fits as expected. The waist is very comfortable and has a lot of stretch to it. The length satisfies me (mom) as well as my daughter.

title: Comfortable
text: My daughter isn't crazy about boyshorts, but wanted these to go with a bralette she had in the same wine color. She is 5'7" and weighs about 155 pounds. She wears mediums in most bottoms, but asked me to get this in the large. She finds that underwear is more comfortable when she goes up a size a lot of times. She was satisfied with the fit. When they're on her, they really don't look like typical boyshorts, but rather traditional bikini/hipster ones.  Overall, she likes them.

title: Comfortable
text: This is a cute bralette. I ordered it for my 19 year old daughter. She wears a size 34C/D. We got this in a large and it fits well on her. The material is soft and comfortable. It offers some support, but not a whole lot. The straps aren't binding.

title: Great for Traveling
text: My kids bought me a nice designer purse a couple of Christmases ago and I've noticed that it's beginning to show wear. I used to use Vera Bradley floral purses all the time, but after several years, I got tired of looking mismatched. While I love the floral patterns, they didn't always go with my outfits. I'm not the kind of person who changes purses every time I go out. This solid colored one is a great compromise. It's everything I love about Vera Bradley, but it's a solid, neutral color on the outside. There's still a pretty floral print inside. This crossbody purse is a little larger than I had anticipated. It would be great for traveling! The side pouches are large enough to hold compact umbrellas and water bottles. Or you can keep you sunglasses case in it. The purse has slip pockets as well as zippered ones. The construction is good and it's what I would expect from the Vera Bradley line.

title: Great Quality
text: Since the whole Covid pandemic, I stopped using my purse. I keep my ID, debit card and a couple of other necessities in a small wallet like this and keep it on a lanyard. I figure that I'm holding less while out and about. My other wallet is a different style. This one opens up and has a clear ID pocket inside as well as 2 other slots. There's another clear ID window on the outside. These are perfect for college students! You can keep your college ID and driver's license in the 2 clear windows. This is great quality and what I would expect from Vera Bradley. It's quilted navy on the outside and a pretty floral print inside. The snap securely fastens, though you can't fill the wallet with too much stuff or it won't be able to close.

title: Cute Face Masks!
text: These are cute and stylish face masks. They run a little small and would work best with average or smaller face sizes. They fit my 19 year old daughter best. They were too small for my husband and son. They did fit me, but it was close. They have little pieces on the elastic so you can adjust the fit as needed. They also have the small metal bar in the nose area so you can bend it to create a seal so you're glasses don't fog up. They're a good weight, too. Not too heavy, but still a double layer. I would recommend these.

title: The Perfect Tee!
text: I love this shirt. It's the perfect tee! The size is true to fit. I ordered my regular size and I couldn't have asked for a better fit. It's long enough that I can raise my arms or bend over and not have to worry about showing some skin. It washes well without any noticeable fading or shrinking. I like wearing black t-shirts with jeans. I have several ones that are just okay, but I keep them around. I am going to get rid of them and order more of these in black and other colors. I wish they had more than just a few colors!

title: Nice Quality
text: This sling bag is a very nice quality. It has sturdy zippers that glide easily. The outer material has an almost linen or tweed  look to it which is nicer than just plain solid canvas. The interior is a grey floral print. There are 3 separate compartments. The strap is easy to adjust. The sling style is quite flexible and can be worn several different ways. I love that VB has a line of items made from recycled bottles!

title: Good Backpack
text: This is a good and practical back pack. It's pretty basic looking and lacks the charm of Vera Bradley in my opinion. I like the plain black look to it because it goes with everything, but this black material is just like canvas. There's no texture or quilting to it. Someone who is not a fan of the VB line might like it more. The interior is lined with a floral print, but that's hidden from view unless you're opening up a pocket or section. The zippers are sturdy. The drawstring opening works well and is very easy to operate. There are some hidden pockets so there's room for everything. I do love that it's made from recycled plastic bottles!

title: Cute Crop Top
text: This is a cute crop top! My 19 year old daughter likes to wear her crop tops fitted, so we ordered a size smaller than usual. A baggy or loose crop top can look sloppy. This fits her the way she likes it. The shirt snaps in front. The snaps seem to be attached securely to the garment, though time will tell. The shoulder straps are wide enough that she can wear her regular bra with it. Overall, she is happy with it.

title: Room for Everything!
text: This is a huge but manageable backpack. It has room for everything! There are 3 full size zippered compartments plus a 3/4ths size one as well as an outer zippered pocket that is about half size. And if that's not enough, there's a hidden 3/4ths size zippered section behind the other 3/4ths sized compartment AND two generous water bottle pockets on the sides . I am wowed by how much storage there is inside this backpack! Now back to the full sized compartments - the front one is the widest of the 3 and has no interior pockets or storage. The middle section has a couple of netted pockets which are large enough to hold a good sized mobile phone. There's also a pocket that is about half the size in height. The full compartment closest to the back straps is well padded which would be great for a laptop. It is the narrowest of the 3 compartments and has no interior pockets. Let's move forward to the 3/4ths sized compartments. The hidden one goes all the way to the bottom of the back and has no interior storage. The outer 3/4ths one has multiple pockets, pen slots and a see through ID pocket. There are no pockets in the half sized outer pocket. All compartments have sturdy zippers that glide effortlessly and half ribbon pull ties. The bottle holders are large enough to accommodate the large liter size bottles which is nice. The whole thing is wider than a traditional sized backpack. The outer material is water proof and a nice black quilted fabric. The interior also seems to be water resistant and is a pretty black, white, grey and pink floral design. This is an amazing backpack!

title: Handy
text: This set of key chains and lip balm holders are handy. There are 10 different designs. They are fairly bright and colorful. The edges of key chains are raw and I've noticed a couple of them have very mild fraying. The lip balm holders are have stitching which gives it a more finished edge. Clips are provided so you can attach them both together or hang it from your bag. It is a nice assortment. I shared them with my daughter and sister. It would make a nice stocking stuffer.

title: Perfect Fit!
text: This is a cute crop top with a perfect fit! The neckline is different and unique. My 19 year old daughter is absolutely in love with this top! She is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She usually gets her shirts in size medium, but she likes her crop tops to be more form fitting so we ordered the small. The color is just like the picture.

title: Cute!
text: This has been the summer of crop tops for my 19 year old daughter. She is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears a 34D bra. She normally wears a size medium in most tops for a looser fit, but with crop tops, she wants a more fitted look, so we ordered a small size in this top. She is very happy with the way it fits. And as her mother, I am okay with it. It does look cute. The straps are wide enough that she can wear a bra underneath it easily. The color is not quite as bright as expected, which is good. She didn't want a day-glo look! So overall, it's been a hit!

title: Cute!
text: This is a cute crop top. My 19 year old daughter likes it. It has a built in bra, but it doesn't offer a whole lot of support. The sizing is fine. She likes her crop tops to have a snug fit. It's not tight or binding, so she's pleased. The color is pretty. The fabric is light weight, but not see through.

title: Great Support & Comfort!
text: These running shoes have great support and comfort. They have a memory foam type bed that is very comfy. The traction on the soles is good. The fit is as expected, but if you prefer a little more toe room, you may want to go up a half size. I like the neutral look of them.

title: Roomy!
text: My 19 year old daughter usually wears skinny jeans, so I was surprised when she said she wanted these. We ordered a size 8 which is her usual pant size. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. They fit very well. They are slightly loose in the waist and body of the jeans, but not too loose that they have to be pulled up all the time. They don't gap in the back. The length is good on her. She likes her jeans to be long, but she has been rolling them up a bit like the picture in the description. They have a few "worn" spots as pictured, but no holes. She likes them and I think it's good to have something different in her wardrobe.

title: Light Weight!
text: I was excited to find out these are fairly light weight. My last sunglasses (which I just discovered have been scratched!) are heavier and that causes headaches after wearing for a while. I can wear these for long periods of time (like driving) without any problems. They are oversized and quite trendy looking. And did I mention that they're cute?

title: Cute!
text: My 19 year old daughter loves to wear crop tops. She's 5'7" and wears a size medium or 8 in most clothing. When buying similar crop tops, she goes with a size small instead. She is very pleased with the fit. It's stretchy and clingy, the way she likes it. She likes that the straps are wide enough so she can wear a regular bra underneath.

title: Good Wardrobe Staple!
text: This v-neck shirt is a good wardrobe staple. It's available in several different colors, so I may even order more. The shirt has a true to size fit. I ordered my current size and it fit as expected. It's long enough that it covers my back side if I lean over or stretch. The fabric doesn't seem to wrinkle as easily as some others which makes it good for traveling.

title: Adjustable Fit
text: I probably wear flip flops for more than half of the year. I can't wear just any pair these days. They have to have some kind of support in them or they cause back pain as well as foot pain. These have an adequate base with enough support to be comfortable. As they arrived, they were too snug on me, but the strap that goes over your feet has velcro so it can be adjusted to fit comfortably. The silver is very shiny which gives it more of a dressy look to it. They would also look cute with white pants, but that's something I probably wouldn't wear. Overall, I am pleased with them.

title: Plenty of Room!
text: This is a lovely jewelry book with plenty of room. It has storage for rings, watches, earrings, bracelets, and necklaces. There's even a small travel box that fits inside that you can take with you. The whole thing has a sturdy handle so you can take it with you if needed. If you were going to be away for an extended vacation, then it might be feasible for taking the whole thing. I personally wish it had more space for necklaces, but I was able to make this work for me. Overall, it's a good quality and does a great job of organizing my jewelry.

title: Great Fit!
text: My 19 year old daughter is waitressing this summer and is required to wear black pants. She has some similar pants that she bought at a department store. She is 5'7" and weighs about 155 pounds. When we first saw these, we both thought they were going to be way too long on her and require hemming. However, once on her, the length is just about perfect. And when she's wearing shoes, it is perfect. No hemming required! There's plenty of stretch in them. The zipper doesn't gape or pull. She says they are very comfortable, even more so than her other pair.

title: Cute!
text: This is a cute beaded necklace. The necklace was slightly tangled upon opening it, but it didn't take too much effort to untangle. The gold beads look a little cheap which makes the whole thing more like costume/casual jewelry as opposed to something more formal or dressy. It's a good length and does have a little extender,. The clasp is easy to open and close. Overall, I like it and it does look nice.

title: Snug
text: I am a plus size mom. I usually wear a size XL in women's t-shirts. This probably is more of a junior fit. It was a snug fit on me, especially in the arms. The picture in the description shows it pretty loose as far as fit goes. It's a cute shirt though the fabric is really light weight. I wish it fit better.

title: Excellent Quality!
text: These men's dress shoes are an excellent quality. They are well made and quite handsome, too. The shoes fit my husband as expected. He found them to be comfortable with adequate arch support. He has been very impressed with how nice these shoes are!

title: Comfortable
text: I find it nearly impossible to find the perfect bra. I even went to one of those stores in the mall that does the bra fitting and sells expensive bras. As far as comfort goes, this is pretty good. The straps are stay in place well. The band fit me on the smallest setting. I have found that the band rolls up in the front. While that doesn't impact the appearance when wearing clothes, it is annoying. While it is a minimizing bra, it doesn't compress very much like some others. Construction seems to be fine. I'm not impressed with the shape it gives. It does not separate the girls and is not flattering at all. There's also not a lot of support and no lifting.

title: Great for Summer!
text: These Columbia men's shorts are great for summer. They're very light weight and comfortable. The pockets are mesh lined, but there is not mesh lining in the entire garment. The back pockets have a plastic snap closure. The material is supposedly stain resistant, time will only tell with that claim. They are water repellent and they offer UV protection, which are more reasons that these are great for summer. My husband is 6'2" and the length of these comes to a couple of inches above the knee. This size is his usual size and they fit as expected.

title: Great Pants!
text: My husband wears khaki pants almost all the time. He's in his early fifties and a few years ago, he decided that he would stop wearing blue jeans. He has some khaki pants that are more casual than others. He does wear cargo style pants, when he's working around the yard. These are great pants. The pants fit my husband well. They do have some stretch to them, but not enough that you can size down. The stretch keeps them from fitting snug. or reference, my husband is 6'2" and weighs about 210. He wears 34x34 pants. They wash well. Wrinkles are minimal which makes these good for travel. Overall, my husband is quite happy with these.

title: Cute Casual Bralette
text: This is a cute, casual bralette. My daughter likes to wear bralettes. It fits well on her. She's a 34D (though she is probably barely a D, closer to a C).  It doesn't really offer a lot of support, but she's young and isn't in need of a lot of support yet. She finds it to be comfortable. The straps can be adjusted which is nice. It washes well.

title: Soft Shirt
text: This is a great shirt. It looks like a regular button down shirt, but it feels like a knit polo shirt! It is a 100% cotton knit material. It doesn't wrinkle much which is a huge improvement over a lot of button down shirts. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 205 pounds. He wears a size large in shirts and this fits as expected. It washes well. It's a soft and nice looking shirt that will be great for travel or casual wear.

title: Great Fit!
text: My college aged daughter loves wearing matching undies/bra sets. She has the matching bralette and was pleased to see that there is coordinating underwear. It's made from a soft cotton material. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She can usually wear medium underwear, but finds the large size to be more comfortable. This pair doesn't ride up and it has good coverage.

title: Soft!
text: My nearly 19 year old daughter loves the comfort of bralettes. While this doesn't provide as much support as a traditional bra, it does provide some support. And it provides more support than some other ones. She wears a 34D bra and the large size fits quite nicely on her. She's really right between a C & D cup, but too often, she has spillage in some C cups. The straps are adjustable which is something that a lot of bralettes don't have. The fabric is very soft and the garment is comfortable to wear. She is very happy with it!

title: Quality Backpack
text: This is a quality backpack. It's standard backpack size with a telescoping handle and wheels. The handle pulls out pretty easily and when it is extended, it's an appropriate length for my 5'6" height. There are feet on the bottom to prevent it from toppling over. There's a padded laptop pocket inside the large main compartment. There is an outer full size zippered compartment with a variety of pockets. Then there is a smaller zipper compartment about half the size of the backpack on the outer front. There are mesh bottle holders on both sides. The exterior is a water resistant black material while the interior is a sweet grey, black, and white floral print. I really like how the fabric is made from recycled plastic bottles.

title: Great Fit!
text: My 18 year old daughter is a fan of Adidas slides, so I wasn't sure what she would think of these. First of all, the sizing is spot on. She wears a size 9 women's shoe. Her feet are just a tad wide, but doesn't need to wear wide width shoes. These fit great. The sole/bottom portion of these slides are fairly rigid. The band that goes across the top is a bit flexible. When she compared them to her Adidas ones, she liked the band better on these. The Adidas band is more rigid and firm.  There's adequate traction on these. The comfort level is good. She says there perfect for hanging around home or her dorm.

title: Outstanding!
text: This lanyard is outstanding! It's just what I would expect from the Vera Bradley company. It's sturdy and well made. It's perfect for all sorts of situations. The break-away clasp is a nice feature.

title: Cute!
text: This mini backpack is cute! It's a little smaller than I expected, but it does easily accommodate everything I need. My kids are in college and long gone are the days where I have to carry a huge backpack with me when we go out, but there are times when I need to carry a little more than what I can fit into my purse. The quality of this bag is excellent. The outer material is a black, quilted waterproof fabric. The interior is a cute black, gray, and pink floral print. Inside there's one zipper pocket and one slip in pocket. My cell phone cannot fit into either of those pockets. There is an outside zipper pocket that my phone does fit inside. Zippers work well. The straps can be adjusted.

title: Best Lanyard!
text: Vera Bradley makes the best lanyards! They're sturdy and durable. I like the basic black fabric because it will hold up better over time as opposed to light colored prints that often get dirty. The ring is very strong and attached securely to the lanyard.

title: Easy to Clean!
text: I wear a women's size 10 Wide shoe. I ordered this in a men's 9. The length of the shoe is good on me. The straps are adjustable and I was able to loosen as needed. The arch of the sole is a little different than in shoes that I usually wear. It's not uncomfortable, but it is noticeable. They're kind of ugly as far as looks go, but they do serve a good purpose. And they don't do anything for making your feet look nice. They're easy to slip on so I've been keeping them by the door. They're easy to clean which makes them good for wearing when it's wet outside. I found that they are comfortable for basic walking, but they weren't comfortable when wearing them to walk the dog. I

title: Nice Wristlet!
text: This is a nice wristlet. It's more like a wallet with ID pockets and credit card slots inside. There's also place for bills and receipts. My phone also fits inside. The interior is a cute floral pattern in gray, black, white, and pink colors. The exterior is a quilted black material. The inside has RFID protection. The outside is water proof. The wristlet can be removed if needed. There's a zippered pocket on the back side. All zippers work well. It's a very nice quality and what I would expect from the Vera Bradley name.

title: Practical
text: This is a practical bag. It can be worn as a wristlet or a crossbody. The outer material is a water proof black performance type material. The interior is a black, white and grey floral print. There's room for a few credit cards, with RFID protection. There's a clear ID slot. There's room for cash and a zippered compartment for coins. There's even room for your cell phone. My phone is an LG-G6 which is a little on the large size, but it fits easily in it. Overall, it's a great little bag!

title: Beautiful!
text: I never feel comfortable wearing real diamonds. I always worry that I will lose them. This necklace is beautiful and looks real, but I don't stress out when wearing it! The solitaire is a good size. It's in a nice setting with extra sparkles. The prongs are sturdy. It hangs on the chain rather than being attached directly to the chain, so if the chain should break, you can easily just replace it. The chain is kind of short, but it does have an approximately 2 inch extender piece. The clasp is a traditional one.

title: Best ID Wallet!
text: I have a daughter in college. She loves using an ID wallet and lanyard for her ID and other important items. She's had a couple of different Vera ID wallet styles, but this one has become her favorite! There are 2 ID windows so she can have her college ID and her driver's license visible. There are a couple of credit card slots with RFID protection. There's also a zippered pouch for cash. It's well made and very durable. The outer material is a quilted, weather resistant black material and the inside of the zippered pouch is a black,grey, white, and pink floral print. She's very excited to transfer her items into this one!

title: Cute & Sparkly!
text: These stud earrings are cute and sparkly. They don't look cheap at all. I found them to be comfortable enough to wear all day and non-irritating.

title: Comfy!
text: This knit pants are super comfy! They are perfect for  lounging around the house. They are elastic pull up pants with fairly wide legs. I'm 5'6" and the length is fine on me. I wear a size 16 jeans and the XL of these fits well, though slightly baggy. The material is soft and comfortable. Unfortunately there are no pockets. Even though I have been wearing them around the house, I do like at least one pocket for my cell phone. I personally wouldn't wear these out in public, but they are a step above traditional sweatpants.

title: Nice!
text: I have been a fan of Vera Bradley products for many years. I do like that they now have a lot of solid colored items now. This is a basic black zip ID case. It's perfect for the times when you need just your ID and debit card/cash. The interior has a black, white, and grey floral print. The zipper glides well without any hitches. It can be used as a key ring or on a lanyard.

title: Gorgeous!
text: I inherited my grandmother's diamond necklace. I rarely wear it because I'm afraid something is going to happen to it. This necklace is absolutely gorgeous and looks like the real thing. I am able to wear this and be worry free! The stone hangs on the chain and is separate from it. I like that feature a lot because if the chain breaks, you can wear it on another chain. Speaking of chains, this one is nothing fancy. It has a traditional clasp. It does have an extender built in otherwise I probably wouldn't be able to wear it. When it's fully extended it sets a couple of inches down from the base of my neck.

title: Cute Socks!
text: I wear a women's size 10W shoe. Usually I don't have any problems with socks that are similarly sized, up to women's size 9 shoe. These however, don't have enough stretch to fit. They are really cute and I was sad that they didn't fit me. However, my daughter who wears a size 9 women's shoe was able to wear them. I like that these are grey instead of white because white socks always end up getting so dirty! These are very thin and are definitely no-show.

title: Lots of Room!
text: I've had similar hanging toiletry bags, but this one is wider and has lots of room inside. You can easily fit regular full size bottles of shampoo, conditioner and more in the center section. The interior is lined with a black, white, and gray floral print. Then it's got a clear vinyl layer that allows you to wipe the inside clean quite easily. There are two small zippered compartments on the inside flap. Then there are 2 separate zippered pockets on the sides. Each one is about the size of a hairbrush. The zippers glide easily. The stitches are nice and secure. Overall, this is a beautiful and well made hanging toiletry bag.

title: Easy to Clean!
text: We've had a lot of rain this spring, so it's a good thing that these shoes are easy to clean! You literally just run some water over them and they are clean. My 18 year old daughter has been wearing these a lot lately. They're quick to slip on when she takes the dog on a walk or into the backyard. They have a comfortable molded surface that cradles your feet. The color is a lot brighter than she would normally wear in a shoe, but for dog walking it's fine. The green would be difficult to match with a lot of her clothing. The sizing is accurate. She wears a size 9 shoe and these fit as expected. These are her first Chacos and she likes them.

title: Cute Sports Bra!
text: This is a cute sports bra. The sizing is pretty accurate and it fit my eighteen year old daughter as expected. She really likes the fun strap design on the back side of the it. It provides adequate support for lower impact activity. It has removable pads. Overall, a comfortable item.

title: Good Sizing!
text: My daughter would wear leggings every day if she could. Well, at least until short season. These leggings fit and are true to size. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears mediums in leggings and these mediums fit as expected. The scallop decoration is pretty subtle, which is good, because my daughter wasn't crazy about it. I think it's darling, but what do I know? There are pockets which are always a plus. They are thick enough that they're not see through. The quality is fine.

title: Nice Variety of Sizes
text: My 18 year old daughter has been wanting some silver hoops, but she wasn't sure how big or small she wanted. This has a nice variety of sizes so she can try them out to find out which ones she likes best. The quality is okay. Most of them open/close without any difficulties. They aren't has shiny and silvery as silver ones, but they're okay. They don't irritate my daughter's ears.

title: Great Smartwatch!
text: My husband loves this Fossil smartwatch! Over the years, this is his third smartwatch. His first one was a Fossil one, but it wasn't a touch screen. Then he got a touchscreen Galaxy smartwatch. He wore that for a while, but then went back to the Fossil one. This one has replaced all other smartwatches! He's happy with the size. I think that's one of the reasons he didn't like the Galaxy was that it was a smaller watch face. The battery lasts about two days before it needs to be charged. That's comparable to the Galaxy one. Heck, even my Fitbit had to be charged approximately every other day. The touch screen works well. He loves Googlewear! You can actually take phone calls on this watch! My husband's phone is a Google Pixel 3a. He recently had problems with one of the speakers on it not working and had to get it repaired under warranty. So he actually used his smartwatch multiple times for phone calls without any problems while waiting for the parts to come in for the repair work. The sound quality was more than adequate for him. This watch does the heart rate monitoring and step tracker, as well as many other features. He did have to take it to a jeweler to have a few of the pins removed, but that was well worth it.

title: So Soft!
text: These socks are so soft! I wasn't expecting that at all. The size is good. I wear a women's size 10W and they fit fine without being tight The heel lined up correctly on my foot. They are a bit sheer though not as much as stockings. I like the different prints that are in this set of socks. They are great for work!

title: Comfortable Fit
text: This is a nice performance top. The XXL size is a comfortable fit on me. I usually wear a size 16 in women's or an XL, but I ordered the XXL just in case it ran small. It's loose, but not baggy. I think the XL would have been tight. The upper arm is slightly snug, but not uncomfortable or restricting. The material is light weight, but not see through. When I wore this the first time, I was wearing a black lace bra. I was surprised that I couldn't see my bra through it. It may have been different had it been sunny and I was outside. It has thumb holes. The overall length is good and covers my backside when I stretch.

title: Comfortable!
text: My eighteen year old daughter loves to wear sports bras. This one is comfortable and offers adequate support and compression. She wears between a 34 C/D. She was pleased with the fit. She didn't have any spillage with it. She also likes the ombre look!

title: Great Lanyard!
text: My 18 year old daughter is in college. She wears a Vera Bradley lanyard with the campus ID wallet with her all the time. She keeps her room key, student ID and a few other pertinent items with it. When she's home, she puts the car keys on it, too. I really like the performance twill fabric. It's durable and doesn't show stains or dirt like some of the other Vera prints. The clips/rings or whatever they're called are very sturdy and strong. The only reason she ever replaces them is because a fabric may be dingy or she just wants a new look. This is just what she expects from the Vera Bradley lanyards!

title: Very Nice!
text: I've been looking for the perfect purse organizer for a while and this one is one of the nicest that I've seen. Unfortunately it's a tad too long for my purse, but that's my fault for not checking the measurements ahead of time. Stitching is nice. There are lots of interior pockets. It even has a key finder type chain. I am very impressed with this and would definitely recommend it! Just be sure to measure first!

title: Great Fit!
text: My 18 year old daughter loves to wear leggings. She would wear them every day if she had enough. These are a great fit on her. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She wears a size 6/8 or medium in pants. Pockets on leggings are always a bonus! These are thick and are not see through at all. As a mom, that's pretty important to me when it comes to her leggings! She loves the angled waist, too!

title: Cute Sweatshirt!
text: This is a cute sweatshirt for cat lovers. It's light weight. It's long enough to cover me when I stretch or raise my arms. I'm currently about a size 16 in women's. I ordered the 2XL because my experience with online ordering is to go up a size. It's loose fitting without being baggy, so I think it's the correct size for me.

title: Great Earrings!
text: These are great hoop earrings! They are light weight, but not cheap feeling. The clasp works well. They don't pull on my ear lobes. In fact, I can barely feel them when I wear them. I am really pleased with them.

title: Beautiful Shades!
text: These sunglasses are beautiful! They have some pretty details on the arms of them. They fit comfortably and aren't too tight on my temples. My last pair of sunglasses would pinch after a short while of wearing them causing me to have to take them off for a while. These do not and I can wear them as long as I need to. I am quite happy with them!

title: Cute Shirt!
text: This is a cute shirt! It looks great with jeans, but I think it would be absolutely adorable with white pants! The shirt fits very nicely. The sleeves aren't tight at all. The length is long enough to cover my backside when I lean over or stretch. The fabric is light weight and soft. I am very happy with it.

title: Dainty!
text: These silver earrings are cute and dainty. They are light weight enough that they don't pull on my ear lobes. I can wear these pretty much all day without any discomfort. The backings do a good job of keeping them and are easy enough to remove to take them out. They also don't seem to bother me when talking on the phone.

title: Well Constructed
text: This purse organizer is well constructed. There are several pockets to organize everything inside your purse. Unfortunately, it is too large for my Coach Shoulder Zip bag, so I am unable to use it for the time being. I really like the key strap which is a much needed addition to my current purse situation.

title: Nice Casual Pants
text: These khaki pants are pretty casual as far as khakis go. My 22 year old son prefers khakis over other types of pants, so he pretty much wears them every day. Every once in a while he'll wear jeans, but it's not very often. These are made well and seem comparable to other well known khaki brands. The sizing is as expected. My son has no complaints!

title: Very Comfortable
text: I wear a size 10 Wide in women's shoes. These fit me very well. And they're very comfortable. There's enough arch support for me. You have to be aware when putting them on or you may end up with one of the straps in the wrong place. (yes, this happened to me). I do worry what will happen with the straps over time. I would imagine that they will stretch out a bit and there doesn't appear to be any way to tighten them when that happens.

title: Great Fit!
text: My eighteen year old daughter participates in an independent winter guard. They have to wear all black to their practices, so she was needing some more tops to wear. She loves this! She's a fan of crop tops. This is a form fitting top without binding. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears a 34D bra. I ordered this is in the large. It fits nicely on her.  I think a medium might be too snug and limit her movement. It has the thumb holes, which I really like, but she's not a fan. She told me that she liked them years ago when they first started appearing in clothes, but not so much anymore.

title: Sturdy
text: I was super excited to get this, but even though I measured my purse before ordering this, it just didn't fit well. I have a Coach Shoulder Zip bag and is a little too wide for it. As for the organizer, it's well made for the most part. There's a removable divided insert that attaches to the main part with Velcro. I could not get it to fit inside properly. When attached to the Velcro, it would not open up fully and remain in a squished manner. I took it out and retried to get it in multiple times without any success. It was almost like it was just a tad too big for the compartment. There are plenty of storage options in it. I just wish it would have worked for my purse!

title: Sturdier than I Anticipated
text: Since the majority of the sports world has gone to a clear bag policy, I've purchased a few different ones to meet that requirement. This one is sturdier than I anticipated. The clear poly vinyl material is thick yet flexible. The zipper is heavy duty and glides easily. The straps are durable, too. I'm just impressed with it! It has to be the nicest clear bag that I own!

title: Cute!
text: This is a very cute swimsuit! I ordered this for my eighteen year old daughter who has recently become a fan of leopard print. I used to dress her in leopard print all the time when she was a toddler, so I'm pleased to see this new found interest again! The swimsuit is made pretty well. The sizing is a little big, but that worked to our advantage. I thought I was ordering a size large, but it ended up being a small. My daughter actually wears a medium, so since it runs a little big, it fits her fine. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. I personally think she could get by with a larger top, but she likes the way it fits. She's a D cup and she's young! The bottoms fit perfectly. They provide adequate mom-approved coverage. She also likes that she can mix these with black swim separates, too, if desired.

title: Light Weight and Comfortable
text: These hoop earrings are larger than I expected. I'm not good about reading measurements before hand! They're large hoops, but surprisingly light weight and comfortable to wear. They have a good feel to them and feel like quality pieces. Overall, I am impressed with them.

title: Soft Fabric
text: I don't wear dresses very often, but when I do, it's usually a maxi-dress. I'm not happy with my legs, so the longer style dresses cover them. This dress is made from very soft fabric. It's a knit, so it's pretty forgiving and doesn't require a lot of care. It's perfect for traveling because it doesn't wrinkle. I ordered the XXL size. I'm 5'6" and wear a women's size 16. It fits well and doesn't look baggy. As with other similar style dresses, it does emphasize my stomach area, so I will probably wear a shaping garment under this. It's light weight but not see through. It's really a cute dress!

title: Pretty!
text: My daughter loves to wear lacy bralettes. This one is very pretty! My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears a 34D bra. She used to wear medium bralettes and sports bras, but she moved up a size recently because she started to have overflow issues. This large is a little too big on her. The cups are sized well, but the band was too large for her. She can pinch about a inch of the band. She can pin it though. The color is gorgeous and so is the lace detail. This also has less support than some bralettes.

title: Cute!
text: I love to use tote bags and this one is really cute! I like the see through quality of it. While the product description says that this can be used for sporting events, it's too large for most of the sporting events that I've been to which require bags to be no larger than 12x6x12. With that being said, just using this would probably speed up wait time when going through other security lines. The tote and its straps are sturdy. The printing on it is well done. It really is a nice bag.

title: Cute and Stylish!
text: My eighteen year old daughter asked me recently for a belt that she could wear primarily with jeans. This one has worked well. It's cute and stylish. It fits well with some flexibility. It doesn't seem to be the kind of quality that will last forever, but it's more than adequate for occasional wear.

title: Perfect Fit!
text: I absolutely love these pants! The fit is perfect. I'm 5'6" and wear a size 16, or XL in most items. I do have to jump to 1XL for some items. These pants fit perfectly! It's like they were custom made for me. They hit me about mid-calf. I have thick calves and a lot of pants are either snug or too tight in the calves. These are a tad loose in the calf area. The pants are very comfortable, even when exercising. And did I mention the pockets! Not only are there front pockets, but back pockets, too. That's something I don't see in most of my exercise clothes. These really are the best fitting work out pants that I have ever owned and I may have to order another pair.

title: Cute!
text: My eighteen year old daughter has been wanting some simple, silver stud earrings. She loves dinosaurs, so I thought she might enjoy these. She loves them! They're cute and dainty. They're not too small that they look funny. They're actually sized pretty nicely.

title: True Fit Sizing
text: These Tommy Hilfiger undies are true fit sizing. They are pretty basic, but comfortable. They don't ride up when wearing them. The set comes with 3 pairs.

title: Weird Fit
text: These Tommy Hilfiger pajamas are very soft. They're also very cute. However, they have a weird fit. I don't know if the sizing is off or what, but the pieces don't fit well. My daughter is 5'7" and wears size mediums in most clothes. She has many Tommy Hilfiger pieces in size medium and she hasn't had any problems with the brand fitting before. The pants are really short. The waist is baggy. The shorts are baggy and loose.  The shirt is tight in the shoulders. She may be able to wear the pieces individually, but not together as a set.

title: Watch the Band Size!
text: I wear a 40DD/42DD. This is a 40 band. It barely fit me, so if you are in between band sizes like I am, go with the larger one. The cup size fit well. Once it was one, it was comfortable. I've never worn an underwire sports bra. It gave lots of support. It's a compacted fit, so there's minimal bouncing or jiggling. Overall, I like it.

title: Comfortable!
text: These undies are accurately sized. My 18 year old daughter wears mediums and these mediums fit as expected. They are comfortable and don't ride up when she wears them. She says that they're not really seamless and do show a slight panty line.

title: Cute!
text: My eighteen year old daughter loves dinosaurs. She thought this dino shirt was very cute! It's a good fit - true to size. The shirt quality is good. The material is soft. The image print is clear. It washes well with no shrinkage or fading.

title: Cute!
text: This is a cute, Tommy Hilfiger sleep t-shirt. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears mediums in t-shirts and this fit as expected. It is made well. I decided to order the matching shirts for her too.

title: Larger than Expected!
text: I wear a women's size 10 Wide shoe. These socks were a little larger than I expected. I'm usually on the top end of sock fitting. The heel mark on these is a little higher up on my heel than it should be. That's not a problem, though. They are very comfortable and I'm happy that they're not tight or stretched to the max. They are thin, but not too thin. The colors are vibrant. I am pleased with them!

title: Comfortable Fit!
text: These socks are not only cute, but they are a comfortable fit, too. The colors are bright and true to what the picture shows. The sizing is good and fits well. They are not too thin and seem to be made well.

title: Love!!
text: This is one of my new favorite tops! The material is super soft. I was surprised by how soft it is. The sizing is good. I'm 5'6" and wear a size 16 or XL. This is 1X is a little loose on me, but it's not baggy. The arm length is good and the thumb holes line up well. This is light weight and very comfortable! I love it!

title: Cute Shirt!
text: I am 5'6" and wear a size 16 or XL. I wasn't sure how the sizing would work for this, but in my experience, I've learned to go up a size so I went with the 2XL. It fits nicely. It's fitted/form fitting, but it's not tight. The printing is good and the shirt seems to be a good quality. The material is mid-weight and soft.

title: Does the Job!
text: I have recently started wearing prescription reading glasses. I hate that I am so dependent on them to read anything! These chains make it easy to keep track of them. I was putting them up on my head, but it gradually stretches the glasses out over time. They work as they should. Easy to figure out how to use them. Overall, they do the job!

title: Sparkly!
text: The setting of this ring is much larger than I expected. The setting size makes it a little too flashy for me to wear everyday, but it's fine for dressy occasions. The sizing is good and fits perfectly! The stones are secure. It's really pretty and sparkly!

title: Good Sizing!
text: These flip flops fit nicely. I wear a size 10 wide shoe, but usually with flip flops, I can get by with a regular 10. That was the case here. The sandals are nicely cushioned. They aren't the most comfortable things, but they are comparable to other similar shoes that I have gotten before. I find that the toe separator piece isn't very comfy. I have the same issues with other shoes that are made similarly. I personally can wear them for a while, but would not be able to wear them all day when a lot of walking is required. These are fun and sparkly!

title: Soft and Comfortable!
text: This shirt is so soft and comfortable. I love it!! Sizing is good. I am 5'6" and wear a size 16 or XL. The 1X size is loose enough but not baggy. The material is so soft. It has adequate stretch. The arm sleeves are a good length and the thumb holes line up appropriately. It's perfect for wearing around the house or for exercising.

title: Cute!
text: My 18 year old daughter loves to wear bralettes. She is between a 34 C and D. I have found that larges usually fit her better without any cup spillage. This fits nicely and as expected. The bralette is really cute and comfortable. The lacy racer back is darling!!

title: comfy!
text: I am 5'6" and wear a size 16 or XL in tops. I ordered this in the XXL size since sizing often runs small. It actually fits me very well. The arms are not tight or snug. It's loose fitting, but not baggy. The fabric is soft. The shirt is a little longer than I would prefer, but it is labeled as a tunic. There are pockets in the side which I found surprising. I'm thinking about using my vinyl cutter and putting something on the front. It seems like it would be perfect for that!

title: Flattering!
text: This is a cute and flattering shirt. I am 5'6" and currently wear a size 16 or XL. The shirt probably runs a little small because the 2XL size fits nicely. It's a fitted shirt and hugs my curves, but it looks nice on me. The image print is good.

title: Cute!
text: I don't wear a lot of jewelry, but it does create issues when traveling. This should solve those problems. It's small and it is the right size for taking a little bit of jewelry with you. There's not enough room for larger, chunkier pieces. The dividers weren't attached well and slide around a bit. The Paris design on the outside is pretty cute.

title: Super Cute!
text: This seal onsie is super cute!! It fit as expected. The material is soft. It's comfortable to wear, too. The seal character is pretty unique as far as similar onsie pajamas go!

title: Nice Socks, But Not Big Enough
text: My 21 year old son has been wanting some fun socks for a while, but we have not had any luck finding them in his size. I was really excited to find these specifically for big and tall. My son is a big guy and wears a size 15 Wide shoe. The actual foot length seems to be fine, but he had a lot of troubles getting the sock to fit. There's not a lot of stretch to accommodate his width. So be warned if you have wide feet! The socks are nice and seem to be a good quality.

title: Wish I Had Found Them Sooner!
text: I absolutely love these rain boots!! I wish I had found them sooner. I have been on the lookout for good, comfy rain boots for a couple of years. I was working at a school and had bus duty, rain or shine. I bought a pair of ankle slip on boots as well as taller rain boots. Both of those were uncomfortable to wear. Sizing is an issue, too. I wear a size 10 wide, but usually end up with 11's because of the width. I have thick calves, so that complicates fit, too. These size 11's fit nicely. Because they are lace up boots, there's no problem with the lower calves. The actual boots (soles) are comfortable and I don't feel that I need to buy inserts for them. I am very happy with them!

title: Accurate Sizing
text: I'm 5'6" and wear a size 16. I followed the sizing in the product description and it was accurate. It's a little loose fitting, but not sloppy or over sized. The sweater is nothing special and looks rather basic. I will definitely need to pair it with a scarf or jewelry. The construction seems to be fine.

title: Sturdy!
text: I love these sunglasses! They are very sturdy and not light weight. They feel like quality eye wear. They fit well. I like the leopard/tortoise shell frames. They are comparable to ones that I have gotten in the $20 range.

title: Nicer Than Expected!
text: This is a cute key chain. It's nicer than I expected. It has a sweet sentiment engraved onto it. It's sturdy and well made. It would make a good gift!

title: Nice!
text: My son needed a new belt recently. I presented this one to him and he was pretty happy to have a new one. He's at the top of the size maximum, but it still fits well. He has about 2 holes that aren't used. The buckle is solid and attached securely to the rest of the belt. The color is a pretty tan color. Overall, it's a good belt.

title: Cute Design!
text: My daughter loves to wear fun socks. She's a big fan of avocados, so I thought she would enjoy these. The unisex size fits her nicely. She wears a size 9 shoe with average width. There's plenty of stretch that they could easily accommodate larger feet. They're made well. They're thin, but not too thin. These would make a nice gift.

title: Neat Idea!
text: The Morse Code bracelets are a neat idea. I don't know the code, so I assume the code of the bracelet I received is correct. The bracelet itself is very thin, but seems to be sturdy enough. It is adjustable. It's a bit pricey for what it is though. Overall, it's okay.

title: Good Fit!
text: This long sleeve turtleneck has a good fit. It's a true turtleneck, not a mock one. The sizing is accurate - I'm 5'6" and wear a size 16/XL. It has plenty of stretch. It's thin, but not see through. I wear a DD bra size and will need to wear a better bra underneath it for a smooth shape because of the thinness. The neck is a tad snug which is good - I hate turtlenecks with loose necks! The length of the shirt is long enough that it doesn't show skin when arms are raised. The arm length is good too, and I don't feel that I need to keep pulling at them.

title: Cute!
text: This is a cute, casual top. However, it wasn't a great fit on me. I'm 5'6" and wear a size 16 or XL  in most clothing. I wear a DD bra. In general, I would agree that it's true to size. I've tried similar shirts the same size and couldn't even get them on! The XL did fit, but it was too snug in the arms. The chest area wasn't snug, but the style of the shirt wasn't flattering across the bust. The material is thin and when I was taking the shirt off, I thought I heard some stitches rip, but I couldn't find any tears.

title: Warm!
text: This jacket is very warm. The faux fur is super soft. The zipper glides easily. The jacket seems to be made well. Sizing is as expected. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears mediums in most things, but I ordered this in a large so it would fit over layers. It's a very cute jacket!

title: Cute!
text: This rain coat is too cute!! The kitty faces are priceless! The coat isn't too heavy. It's actually soft and pliable (not stiff). This would be perfect for any young fan of cats!

title: Soft Fabric
text: This vintage Life is Good shirt is sweet and simple! The picture on the front of the shirt is pretty small and what I would expect from the Life is Good brand. Then there's an even smaller logo on the back near the neck. The fabric is a good mid-weight and very soft. It fits my 18 year old daughter very nicely. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears mediums in t-shirts and this medium fits as expected. I would definitely consider purchasing other shirts in this line.

title: Size is Fine
text: I was excited about getting this key ring. I like the idea of slipping it on my wrist, however, in reality, it isn't comfortable to wear. It slips off easier than I would like, so I have to grasp it when wearing it. When I put it in my purse, it is easy enough to find quickly. I don't keep a lot of keys with me, but it easily accommodates all that I need. The bracelet portion feels like plastic. It looks like the print is just a sticker that covers it and the seams aren't lined up very well. Overall, it's okay.

title: Comfortable Fit!
text: In the winter, I wear slippers around the house. These slippers are very comfortable. They're padded nicely with memory foam. The soles are firm and allow you to wear them outside if needed. The sizing is good. I wear a size 10 Wide shoe and these fit me fine. They are very nice and I am very happy with them!

title: My New Favorite T-shirt!
text: This is my new favorite t-shirt! It's a good mid-weight shirt and it's very soft! I'm 5'6" and wear a women's size 16 or XL with a DD cup size. This shirt is a 2XL, so I was afraid it might be baggy. However, it's not. It is slightly tapered or fitted. It does fit loosely on me, but it's not sloppy or over-sized. I am thrilled with this shirt!

title: Great Vest!
text: This is a great vest for times when the weather is all over the place! It is water proof and offers adequate warmth. You can easily layer it or wear it alone. It's made well. Sizing is as expected.

title: Geared Toward a Younger Audience
text: My husband has been in need of a new suit, so I happily ordered this one for him. He's a 44L and those are a little harder to come by. The jacket fits perfectly. It looks good on him, too. The material is very different than most traditional suits. It has to be since it's machine washable. The only thing he didn't like about the jacket was that there is bright orange thread used to attach one (of three) buttons on the sleeve/cuff. At first I thought it was meant to be removed, but if you do that, the button falls off. If it was a spare button, I would assume it would be sewn inside the jacket which makes me think it's supposed to be on the outside. The pants are way too big. After some quick research, the sizing is typical when it comes to pre-bundled suits. I just wasn't aware of that. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 200 pounds. His pant size is a 34x34 where the waist of these is a 38. My first thought was to get them altered, but my husband isn't too crazy about them. They have a zippered pocket and overall they look super casual. It could just be an age thing. He's in his early fifties and expects a certain look when it comes to suits. So this suit is definitely geared toward a younger audience. It does seem to be made well.

title: Soft and Comfortable!
text: This is a cute long sleeve t-shirt. It would make a great gift for any animal lover! The sizing runs true to size. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears mediums in most tops and this medium fits as expected. Though for a looser fit, you may want to consider going up a size. The material is very soft to the touch. I love that a portion of the sales goes to help animal causes!

title: Arrived Just in Time!
text: If you asked me what I thought about heated vests before receiving this one, I would have laughed and probably said it was just a gimmick. But now that I have one, I think it's one of the greatest inventions ever!! It's easy to use - just charge the battery and attach the charged battery to the jacket. You turn it on or off by pushing a button on the front chest area. It doesn't take too long before it's nice and warm. The vest isn't too bulky, so you can wear it underneath another coat or jacket. The XL size fits my husband (size L) and me (women's XL) fine. We're going tailgating this weekend and we plan to take this for warmth.  Watching a football game in cold weather can be miserable!! We plan to share this as needed. My husband wore this around the house the other day to test out how long it works. It kept warm for over 6 hours. I am a fan!

title: Not Impressed
text: This necklace doesn't look as nice in person as it does in the pictures. It's really basic and plain. It looks like something a teen or child would wear rather than an adult. The chain is so-so. It doesn't feel like it's going to break right away, but it doesn't seem like it's going to last either. The overall design of the charm is cute, but it looks unfinished. I'm fine with a simple, non-flashy piece of jewelry, but I still want it to be a good quality. This just feels like something you would get a discount store.

title: Sweet & Dainty
text: This is a sweet, dainty necklace. It is nicer than I expected. The chain is a decent quality. It's not super cheap looking and it doesn't feel like it's going to break easily. The star is simple and understated.

title: Decent
text: For the price, it's a decent necklace. It's obviously not a high quality one, but it's more than adequate especially for a tween or teen wearer. The chain seems to be sturdy, but it has a somewhat cheap look to it.

title: Warm & Cozy
text: My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears mediums in most tops/shirts. This medium fits nicely. It's fitted so it follows her shape. She can wear it over a thin long sleeve shirt, but there's not enough room to wear a thicker shirt such as a sweatshirt underneath. It offers a lot of warmth, which has been greatly appreciated with the recent temperature drop. It looks nice, too!

title: Snug Fitting
text: This is a snug fitting sports bra. It has a definite compression quality. My daughter wears a 34D and found that this was a tight fit. Looking at the brand specific size chart, the medium was the right size. She says it's comfortable, but not the most comfortable bra she's ever worn. The straps don't dig into her shoulders. Overall, it's good, but she says she would like to try the next size up.

title: Soft Material
text: My husband loves these new boxer briefs. They are soft and cool. The material doesn't retain warmth like cotton. The fit is great and they look good, too. He finds them to be very comfortable as well.

title: Soft T-Shirt
text: This is a super soft long sleeved t-shirt. It says that it's a boys shirt, but it could easily be worn by girls, too. The mango color looks like the picture. The sizing seems to be accurate. Overall, a good t-shirt.

title: Cute Print, But Unflattering on Me
text: I have ordered a few different tops from this brand. Pay attention to their size chart! They run about a size smaller. If you follow their chart, you'll be fine. I'm a size 16 and ordered my usual size, XL. Unfortunately for me, their XL is more of a 14. I should have ordered the next size. If I had looked at their size chart in advance, I would have known. Regardless of the sizing issue, which is my fault, the shirt is just okay. The fabric is soft. The baby doll style is very unattractive on me. I would prefer a little longer shirt. This one goes up too much when I raise my arms up. I found the arms to be a bit tight, which is probably because I ordered the wrong size. I wasn't a fan of the lace up neckline either. It was very unflattering on me. The quality seems fine. I liked the print of the fabric.

title: Thin Straps
text: These tween bras are light weight. The material is soft and comfortable. The straps are very thin and not adjustable. The Tommy name and logo is on the band. There are removable pads. They do cover everything. Sizing is good, possibly a little snug, but within the correct size range.

title: Adjustable Straps!
text: This tween bra is adorable! It's provides great coverage. The straps are adjustable which was unexpected in a tween bra. It has removable pads. The garment has a nice stretch to it which helps make it comfortable to wear. It has the traditional Tommy striped elastic band, but without the Tommy name or logo.

title: Cute & Comfortable!
text: Not only is this tween bra cute, but it's comfortable too. The sizing seems to be pretty accurate. The band is comfy. The straps don't dig into the shoulders. There are removable cups. It provides good coverage. It's cute without being overly girly.

title: Great Fit!
text: These boxer shorts fit great! They are true to size and fit the way boxers should (a little roomy, non-binding, etc.) . The assortment of colors/prints is nice. They are soft enough for my husband. He is very pleased with them.

title: Excellent Quality Jacket!
text: This is an excellent quality jacket. It's thin and not very heavy, but it does a great job of keeping the wearer warm. My husband isn't crazy about big, bulky outerwear, so this is perfect for him. The body of the coat is quilted, but the sleeves are not, so it gives the illusion of being two separate pieces. In fact, my husband wore this to get his hair cut last week and the stylist told him that he could put his vest over there. It fits well and as expected. The zipper is heavy duty and glides effortlessly. Overall, my husband is very happy with his new coat!

title: Good Light Weight Jacket
text: This is a good, light weight jacket. It is pretty thin and doesn't seem to be water resistant. It will block the cool wind. It is constructed well. Zipper glides well. Stitching looks even. The logo is not too obvious. The sizing seems to be accurate. Overall, a good jacket.

title: Small and Modest
text: I was pleasantly surprised with this necklace. It's nicer than I expected. The chain is pretty dainty and then, but it doesn't scream "cheap" like some chains. The infinity symbol is pretty. It gives a nice sparkle.  The whole piece is rather small and modest. I am in my early fifties and probably won't wear it. I think it would be better for a younger recipient. My daughter will be happy to claim it!

title: Nicer Quality Than Expected
text: This is a beautiful pendant. The quality of the actual charm is nicer than I expected. The chain is rather basic. It's a short chain and hits me much closer to the base of my neck than the pictures show. I will most likely replace the chain for this. This would make a nice gift!

title: Great Turtleneck
text: I love the look of black turtlenecks and dark blue jeans. This turtleneck is a good one! It follows the curves of my body nicely. The neck fits well. It's not too tight or is it loose and baggy. The material is soft and stretchy. The length is great. It covers my upper backside so I don't have to keep tugging on it.

title: Nice Pants!
text: I am 5'6" and wear a size 16. These 16's are a little small, but with all the sizing variations out there, that doesn't surprise me. They did fit me everywhere except the waist. It was about half an inch too small in the waist. However, I am currently dieting and shall try these again in a few more pounds. I love the boot cut leg! These will be great for date night with my husband! The pant material is a little dressier than what I would wear at home. They would also work well for work.

title: No Stretch
text: I have had many pairs of Gold Toe socks over the years. These are different from any other pair that I have had. They're really thin and sheer. The 3 pairs all have some shimmer to them. Each pair is different - a houndstooth one, a leopard print one and one with all over gray shimmer. I wear a size 10 Wide in women's shoes. I can usually wear Gold Toe socks without any problems. These, however, do not have enough stretch to fit me well. I can put them on without any trouble, but the heel doesn't line up correctly, plus they are very short. They're a good quality. They would be great for dressier occasions.

title: Sparkles!
text: This gold crossbody purse has a nice sparkle to it. It could be used for dressier occasions if desired. The strap is a bit thin, but it is adjustable. It adjusts like a belt buckle. There's one slip pocket in the interior of the purse. It is cute!

title: A Good Pair of Casual Pants
text: These pants are great! Not only are they a popular brand with kids, but they are made well, too. The legs are tapered and cuffed at the ankle. The waist can be adjusted with the drawstring. There are pockets which is always a hit! The sizing seems to be pretty accurate. There is an obvious logo on the pant leg. Overall, a good pair of casual pants.

title: Love It!
text: This is my new favorite sweater! It looks great paired with dark jeans. It's not super soft, but it is soft enough. It's true to size. It hugs my curves without being tight. It's thin enough that I can where my fitted jacket over it. I love it!

title: Too Tight in the Arms
text: Be sure to check the size chart before ordering! I am a size 16 and can usually wear XL shirts. This XL is equal to a 14. Their 1XL is closer to a 16. The shirt does kind of fit, but it doesn't look good on me at all. The biggest problem with the fit was the arm cuffs. They are very tight on me. I am afraid that if I were to stretch too much while wearing it, they might rip. The rest of the shirt fits okay, but this style just doesn't work on my curvy body type. The material is also very sheer. You will want to wear a camisole underneath it. I did like the length of it. The fabric print is cute.

title: Soft Jersey Material
text: This is the perfect staple for your fall wardrobe! The material is a soft jersey type. It's true to size. The length is long enough that it can be tucked in without pulling out all the time. The mockneck isn't tight or loose. I am really happy with this top!

title: Basic Cardigan
text: This is a basic, black v-neck cardigan. The sizing is accurate. I wear a size 16 and the 1XL fits as I would expect. It's very low cut, so I will probably wear a camisole underneath it, though my husband thought it was just fine! The material is not scratchy. Buttons are securely sewn.

title: Nice Looking!
text: I really like the look of these modern sneakers. They are a lot more appropriate for work compared to traditional sneakers. My husband is in his early 50's. He wears khaki pants most days and doesn't wear jeans any more. These go very nicely with his khaki pants! The sizing is good and these fit well. The memory foam and gel add comfort. My husband likes them a lot!

title: Good Basic Cardigan
text: This is a thin, light weight button down cardigan sweater. The material is soft, but not super soft. The sizing is good. I wear a women's 16 and this 1X fits fine. The buttons don't gape unless I'm stretching my arms up. Buttons are attached securely. Overall, a good, basic cardigan.

title: Great for School Uniforms
text: These aren't the highest quality polo style shirts, but they are good and perfect for kids. Especially since kids can be hard on clothes! They're not particularly soft, but they're not scratchy either. The sizing is good and true to size. These would be perfect for school uniforms.

title: Sizing Runs Small
text: I was surprised that I didn't love this! What's not to love about a comfy sweatshirt! I currently wear a size 16 in women's sizes. The arms didn't fit well at all! They were a little short on me, and I'm pretty average in height/arm length. They were also snug on me that made it uncomfortable to wear. On the plus side, it's soft and well made.

title: Accurate Sizing
text: This is a great lightweight sweater. It's thin enough that you can wear it under a jacket without adding a lot of bulk. The material is not scratchy. The sizing is accurate. I am currently a size 16 women's and it fits nicely. It's a little loose, but it also follows my curves. It's a good addition to my winter wardrobe.

title: Great Looking Belt!
text: I don't usually wear belts, but I've been losing weight and my jeans are getting loose. However, I haven't lost enough to fit into my smaller sized ones. This belt looks great. It fits my size 16 body well. There are 2 more holes that I can use as I continue my weight loss journey. The belt buckle is pretty sturdy. Overall, I am very happy with this.

title: Sleeves are a Little Short
