text: Men's shirts can vary a lot in sizing. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 205 pounds. He usually wears size larges in shirts. This does fit, but the sleeves are a little shorter than he prefers. Also, it gapes depending on his movements. The material is light weight and wrinkles easily. Overall, it's okay.

title: True to Size
text: This true to size cold gear shirt is great for layering! The fabric is moisture wicking and keeps the wearer dry. The brand logo is on the neck. The shirt is made well with even stitches and no loose threads. This is a great addition to the wardrobe of a young athlete.

title: Cute Fall Shirt!
text: This is a cute top! My 18 year old daughter was thrilled with it. One of her favorite fall outfits is to wear dark leggings with a black crop top. Then she wears a plaid flannel shirt around her waist. This is long sleeve so it's perfect on a slightly cool day. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. The medium fit her pretty well. It's a little shorter on her than the picture, but she likes it that way. Oh... to be young!! The shirt has enough stretch that it fits fine.

title: Nice, Loose Fit
text: My husband loves his new fleece pullover! He's 6'2" and weighs about 205 pounds. He is pretty broad and some pullovers are tight in the shoulders or chest on him. This one fits nicely. It's a loose fit, but not baggy. He has had some size large pullovers that are way too big. He is very happy with the fit of this! The snap feature is nice and allows the collar to lay flatter than a zipper one. During the cooler months, my husband wears layers and almost every day he puts on a fleece pullover. I will check out the other colors and order another one for him!

title: Love It!
text: This is a cute, fleece vest! The sizing is perfect. I'm a size 16 and this is not baggy or tight. I can easily wear something bulky underneath it. The length is good. The pockets have zippers. The fleece is soft. This will be perfect for the fall weather!

title: True to Size
text: These polo shirts are perfect for school uniforms. They are true to size. The polyester material is light weight and almost seems like a dry-fit shirt. They're pretty basic, but good.

title: Cute, But Not For Me!
text: This is a cute Sherpa jacket however, it I don't have the right body type for it. I am a 51 year old  curvy size 16 and this looks awful on me! It's too bulky and emphasizes my middle section. It might look better on a younger person, too. I'm not marking it down for that because that's my issue not a problem of the jacket. It's made well. The details are nice.

title: Cute Jacket!
text: I like the look of this jacket. It's perfect for lightly cool days. I'm 5'6" and size 16. I took a gamble with the XL. For the most part, this actually fit me. It's a little snug in the upper arms, but wearable. I can zip it up without any difficulties. I'm currently dieting, so it may actually fit better before I know it. I was able to wear a long sleeve shirt underneath it, but it was thin. I would not be able to wear anything with any bulk to it such as a sweatshirt or sweater.

title: Plenty of Stretch!
text: My 18 year old daughter loves to wear crop tops. She is 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds.She usually wears mediums or size 8.  I ordered a medium for her. After I ordered it, I noticed that the brand size chart seems to run a little smaller. They have mediums listed as 4/6, so I should have considered the large one. Fortunately, there's enough stretch in the material that it fits her fine and it looks cute on her.

title: Smooth Coverage
text: This is a super soft bra! It gives smooth coverage without any spillage. It fits as expected. I love that it can be worn as a strapless bra, too!

title: Very Soft
text: My 18 year old daughter squealed when she saw this! She absolutely loves it! She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She wears mediums in tops or size 8's in most things. It fits well. There's a little bit of space that she could wear long sleeves underneath it, but it's questionable as to whether or not she can wear bulky sweaters or sweatshirts with it. It's very soft and provides some warmth on a chilly day. It looks great, too! She is thrilled with it.

title: Great Looking!
text: This shirt looks great on my husband! He's 6'2" and currently weighs 208 pounds. He usually wears large shirts. The large fits him nicely. The buttons will gape if he pulls his arms behind him, but they do not gape otherwise. The arm length is good on him, which because he's so tall, it can be problematic. The fabric is soft. It stays tucked in well. He can be picky about clothing and he approves of it.

title: Little to No Stretch
text: I love the look and color of these jeans. I currently wear a size 16 , but since these are regular fit, I went with the 18. There is little to no stretch and because of that, they were just too tight in the calves. My calves are pretty thick and I've had this issue with other pants. They fit well every where else, but because of the tight legs, they looked like skinny jeans on me and it wasn't pretty!

title: Cute But Not High Quality
text: This is a cute necklace, but not a high quality one. The chain is flimsy and cheap feeling. It does allow you to adjust the length which I like. The rings are a little better as far as the quality goes. They are light weight. They don't make a lot of noise from hitting one another. There are 5 rings on mine, one for each decade. I may just try to find a different chain for them. At the listed price of $9.98, it's what you might expect.

title: Soft Material
text: This is a perfect hoodie for the cooler weather. It's not a true black color, but more of a heather black or even gray. It's not a super heavy hoodie. The material is soft and washes well. Sizing seems to be okay - maybe a teeny bit small, but for the most part I would say it's true to size. There was no shrinkage after washing.

title: Too Tight in the Calves
text: I was so excited to get these since it's finally jean season! I currently wear a size 16 and usually Lee jeans fit just fine. I don't usually go for petite, but at 5'6", the Lee brand has been a little long on me in recent years. The length of these was fine. I might prefer them to be a tad longer, but they didn't drag on the floor. The straight leg fit was just too tight on me. They fit like I imagine skinny jeans would. It was not a good look on me. I do have thick calves and have run into that problem with other pants before. I felt that this was excessive in the amount of tightness though. The quality of the pants seems to be pretty good. I'm just disappointed that I will not be able to wear them.

title: Nicer than I Expected
text: I was pleasantly surprised by this necklace. It is much nicer than I expected it to be. The size of the mandala is about the size of nickel. The chain looks like a quality one and not cheap. It's 18 inches long. I would personally prefer it to be a little longer. The detail on the mandala is lovely. It's a nice, casual piece of jewelry.

title: Beautiful and Soft!
text: I really like this scarf! Not only is it beautiful, but it's very soft, too. The edges are cut at a corner for a unique look. The variations of gray color are neutral and can be worn with many things. The length is good and the scarf can be worn in a few different ways.

title: Not Soft
text: I currently wear a size 16 or XL in women's clothing. This is a 2XL, but equivalent to an 1XL. It fits as I would expect an XL to fit. It's snug in the arms, but not tight. The material is thin and a bit rough. It's not soft at all. The boat neck line is interesting, but no matter how I position the neck area, my bra straps are always showing. The stripes look nice. It washes fine. Overall, I just find it to be okay.

title: Gorgeous!
text: This scarf is gorgeous!! It looks amazing with my charcoal colored wool coat! I can't wait for the weather to get cold so I can look stylish this winter! (Well....actually, I can wait. I'm not a fan of the cold!) The scarf is not only beautiful, but it's also very soft. It's not scratchy at all. It would make a great gift! I am very happy with it!

title: Super Comfortable!
text: These socks are thinner than I expected, but they're very soft and comfortable nonetheless. I wear a women's 10W shoe and I was a little worried that these wouldn't fit, but there's enough stretch that they fit fine without being tight. The heel spot lines up at the heel. They are so comfortable and seem to have some kind of arch support or other massaging type feature. The socks have cute prints and look great with jeans!

title: Well Made Jacket!
text: This is a nice, warm jacket. I ordered this for my daughter. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She wears mediums in most clothing, but I thought a large would be good for her because a lot of medium jackets are snug on her when worn over other clothes. It's a little large and she probably could have gotten by with a medium. The jacket is made well. The zipper works very well. It's what I would expect from the Columbia brand.

title: Light Weight Material
text: My 18 year old daughter loves cropped tops. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She usually wears a medium, but in some shirts she wears a small. This is a little snug, and when you look at the size chart, a medium is a 4-6 whereas most clothing it would be more of an 8 or an 8/10. It's not too tight though, so it looks okay on her. The material is a little on the thin side. A smooth, light colored bra would work best underneath it.

title: Cute!
text: This is a cute, contemporary top. I currently wear a size 16. I can wear some XL items, but with others I need the 1XL. This is a 2XL. It fits great! It's not tight or restrictive in the chest area or the arms, which can be problematic sometimes. The fabric is light weight and has a nice modern design. The shirt length is good and doesn't pull up when I reach up. It's a good addition to my fall wardrobe.

title: Nice Stretch
text: My 21 year old son is a big guy. These pants fit him pretty well. They have enough stretch that makes them fit comfortably. The material is a lighter khaki than some. The pants are made well.

title: Cute Shirt!
text: I didn't read the size chart before ordering. I'm currently 5'6" and a size 16 which according the chart is a 1X. Instead, I ordered the XL. The fit was good everywhere except in my upper arms. It was tight enough there that it wouldn't be comfortable to wear. The material is really soft, but doesn't have any stretch to it. The 1X would probably be better in the arms, but then I wonder if it would be a bit baggy everywhere else. For the record, I've had issues with other shirts fitting too tightly in my arms, too, so it's obvious due to my body type/shape. The shirt is very cute. It does seem like it wrinkles easily and will require some ironing.

title: Great Pants!
text: My husband primarily wears khaki pants in the cooler months. He stopped wearing jeans a few years ago because he felt that he was getting too old for them.  Dockers is a good, reliable brand. These fit perfectly as expected.  They are even more comfortable than his older Dockers. They look the same, but they move with him. He loves them!

title: Good Quality
text: My husband wears polo style shirts almost every day. It's a staple in his wardrobe. This is a nice, soft cotton polo. It does have a subtle logo on the chest - black embroidered DKNY. It's not obvious. The shirt length is good as well as the overall quality. It fits as expected. He's 6'2" and weighs about 210 pounds. The large size fits well and is not loose or tight. It's washes well and doesn't seem to retain too many wrinkles.

title: A Good Shirt
text: I've noticed that in this hot heat, my husband has been wearing his sports tek or moisture wicking type polo shirts frequently. Here's another one for the rotation. It's a solid, heathery gray shirt. The quality seems to be good. There are no logos on it whatsoever. The shirt fits as expected. Overall, a good shirt.

title: Love It!
text: I used to wear black turtleneck sweaters a lot many years ago. Eventually, the necks got too stretched out or I lost weight (or gained it) and they no longer fit, so I haven't had a good one for years. I've been on the look for a new one and this is it! I love it! I'm currently a size 16 and the XL fits quite nicely. It's not loose or baggy. The neck is perfect! It's a good medium weight and looks great with jeans! I love this so much that I plan to order another one in a different color!

title: Comfortable and Cute!
text: My 18 year old daughter is a recent fan of the Savage X Fenty lingerie line. She wears a 34D usually, but because of the style of this bra, the 34C fits fine.  Since the cups have an angle to them, the spillage doesn't occur at the top, but instead the sides which looks just like cleavage, not spillage. The bra is unlined and a bit transparent. It's comfortable and cute. She likes it a lot!

title: Good Fit!
text: This pair of undies has a good fit and is sized as expected. The front side has a subtle leopard print and the back is pretty sheer. They don't ride up or bunch up when wearing. Overall, they are pretty comfortable and very sexy!

title: Cute!
text: This is a cute and simple necklace. The quality is okay. While the chain is fairly sturdy, it has a cheap feel to it. Also, the clasp mechanism keeps getting stuck. This particular necklace is marketed to new moms. I'm not a new mom, but I do like the style. It comes on a card that has a new mom sentiment on it, but you could easily remove that before gifting. The chain can be worn at different lengths. I do like it and have been wearing it, but not convinced it will last long.

title: Nice Quality!
text: This is a nice quality wristlet wallet. It is well made and seems pretty sturdy. It has a fair amount of storage inside. There are 8 card slots plus an ID pocket. There are spots for bills and receipts as well as a zippered coin pocket. All zippers work well. My LG G6 phone did fit in it, but it could not zip closed. A smaller, thinner phone could probably fit in it. My phone also has an Otterbox case which increases its thickness. The wristlet strap is attached securely. I personally need more space in my wallet, but this would work well for traveling when I don't need to take everything in my wallet with me.

title: Nice Shirt!
text: This is a nice, men's polo shirt. It doesn't have any logo which is good. My husband owns a company and wants to get his logo embroidered on it, so this will work great for that! The shirt is a good quality. It is a medium weight. It's a great gray color that's not too dark or too light. Overall, a good shirt.

title: Beautiful!
text: This is a beautiful bralette. It's unlined, but offers some support. The lacy blue material is perfect for peeking through your outfit. Sizing is as expected.

title: Comfortable!
text: This bra is comfortable as well as cute! It's true to size and fits as expected. I love the back cut out designs which make it stand out from other bras. The band rolls up a little bit, which doesn't interfere with wear, but it does detract from the appearance. Overall, a nice bra.

title: Over-Sized
text: This sweater is slightly over-sized. It's also very long and fits like a tunic. It's a very soft sweater and also light weight. It requires hand washing, but I don't usually wash my sweaters. If I get a spot, I will wash just the spot. I air out sweaters as needed. It looks pretty nice and will look nice with leggings or jeans.

title: Great Fit!
text: These undies have a great fit! They are true to size. The pictures in the product description show these to be quite cheeky, but I found them to have adequate cheek coverage. They are comfortable to wear and don't ride up.

title: Runs Small
text: These undies do run a little small, so order accordingly. They are super soft though and worth checking out. They stay in place pretty well and don't require frequent readjusting.

title: Soft Fabric
text: The fabric of this bralette is very soft. The sizing is as expected. I ordered this in a large for my daughter because that's what I usually order her bralettes. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She wears a 34D bra. According to the size chart, she should wear a medium. A medium would probably work better on her. It was a little big on her, but the straps are adjustable and that helped. She did have a issues with her sides not being adequately covered, though when wearing a top, it doesn't really show. There's not a lot of support, but there is decent coverage.

title: Looks Nice!
text: There's no way I could get my husband to wear something like this, but I thought it might be a nice addition to my fall wardrobe. I am a curvy plus size mom who currently wears a size 16 or XL in women's. I'm able to wear several men's large items, but I found this large to not be too accommodating of my curves. I am able to zip it up, but it is a little tight. I am dieting right now, so hopefully it will fit better by the time the cooler weather arrives. I think it would look really sharp with a black turtleneck, dark jeans, and some brown loafers or boots. The construction is okay. It's not as soft as I expected, but it looks nice.

title: Nicer Than Expected!
text: Not only am I very picky about my jewelry, I also am very careful. I don't like to wear expensive pieces because I have lost some in the past. This looks pretty nice and doesn't have cheap vibes. It looks like a nice piece of jewelry. That doesn't mean it looks "real", but it looks nice enough that it doesn't scream "fake". I have been happy to wear this and don't worry if something happens to to. The chain is thin, but it doesn't feel like it's going t break easily. It has an extender so you can adjust where it hits your neck/decollete.

title: Accurate Sizing
text: These undies are sized accurately. The mediums fit my 18 year old daughter as expected. They are really soft and extremely comfortable. They are cuter in person than in the picture. My daughter wears a lot of Pink/Victoria's Secret undies and feels that this pair is comparable to them.

title: True to Size
text: This is bralette that runs true to size. It doesn't offer a lot of support, but it's comfortable and cute. The material is soft.  It's definitely geared toward older teens/younger women. The straps aren't adjustable, but the overall construction is pretty good.

title: Pretty!
text: My 18 year old daughter was excited to try some of Rihanna's Savage X lingerie line.  This pair of lace undies is not only beautiful, but comfortable too.  It has adequate rear coverage and doesn't ride up. The lace material isn't scratchy. I would say that these are comparable or better than what you would get at Victoria's Secret.

title: Comfortable Fit!
text: Let me star by saying that I am probably not the target audience for these Fenty undies. I'm a plus size mom in my early 50's. However, I am loving them! This is my second pair and both have been very comfortable. I'm currently a size 16. These XL ones fit well. They don't ride up nor does the waist slip down. They actually do a great job of staying put! The waist band doesn't bind.  I can wear these all day long without any problems at all!

title: Gorgeous!
text: This is a gorgeous, neutral bra! The lace details are really pretty. The bra straps are comfortable and don't dig into the shoulders. This fits my 18 year old daughter perfectly and as expected. She says it's comfy to wear, even all day!

title: Super Soft!
text: My 18 year old daughter has purchased similar seamless underwear from Victoria's Secret and is a big fan of them. These are just as nice. They are super soft and very comfortable. The color is perfect for wearing underneath light colored pants and they're thin enough to wear under leggings without showing.  The fit is as expected. My daughter loves this new brand!

title: Practical and Pretty!
text: This is a nice looking crossbody wallet/purse. It's both practical and pretty! It is sturdy and well made. There are 4 credit card slots, a zippered compartment, and a spot for your cell phone. It wouldn't work for me as an every day purse, but definitely works for events when you don't need to take everything in your purse. The phone pocket is generously sized. My LG-G6 (in an Otterbox case) fits in it easily, however, the strap isn't able to fasten when my phone is in it. It will still work for me. My daughter's iPhone 7, which is also in an Otterbox fits fine. The shoulder strap is removable if desired.

title: Pretty!
text: I'm in my early 50's and I still like wearing pretty lingerie! I usually wear a 42DD. I have been dieting and losing weight recently and I was hoping this D cup would fit well and it does!  I like the vibrant blue color. The cups are molded and give a nice smooth shape underneath clothing. The straps are a little thin, but adequate. I think it's designed with appearance in mind rather than comfort. While it's not uncomfortable to wear, it's not super comfy either. I can easily wear it all day without any troubles. It offers good support. Overall, I like it!

title: Great Fit!
text: I really like the idea of unisex socks! I wear a size 10 Wide in women's sizing. I have purchased other men's socks for sizing purposes, especially with no-show or low cut socks. Some women's socks will fit, but because they're stretched at their max, they don't always stay in place. These socks stay put and don't slip down when active. The socks are a good weight. They aren't too thick and hot, but they're also not so thin that there's no comfortable padding. I am very happy with these!

title: Beautiful!
text: My 18 year old daughter absolutely loves this bra! It's not only beautiful, but it fits perfectly! She was excited when she found out it was from Rihanna's lingerie line. The bra is a beautiful mint green color. The lace details on the back are so pretty! The push up feature is as expected and while it's cleavage enhancing, it doesn't produce unattractive spillage which means we got the right size! It's made well and comparable to other quality bras.

title: Great Quality!
text: The current trend seems to be for men to wear sports coats with dress pants rather than full on suits these days. My husband had a casual sports coat from the early 2000's that he recently got rid of. This sports coat is updated and looks so much nicer! Younger men can get away with wearing this with jeans, but my 50 some year old husband probably shouldn't. The jacket is a great quality. It's a very handsome garment. The fit is perfect. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 218 pounds right now. He can button it and it doesn't gape. He has the same brand in a slim fit and although he can button that one, it doesn't look good. He is very pleased with this!

title: Comfortable Straps
text: This bra fits well and as expected. Its adjustable straps are comfortable and don't dig into my shoulders. There are multiple "tags" (a stack of at least 3 strips that fan out) located near the hooks on one side of the band that really interfered with fastening it. I will definitely have to cut those off.  While I appreciate that the brand is being transparent, it's a bit excessive. The cups are a medium thickness and seem to offer adequate coverage.

title: Fits as Expected
text: These are good cargo pants. They fit my son as expected. The material isn't stiff and allows adequate movement. The pockets are located well. They are a good weight and not too light or too heavy. I would consider ordering these again.

title: Handsome Jacket
text: My husband recently cleaned out his closet and got rid of his dated sports coats. He was excited to get something new and updated. This sport coat is slim fitting. He's a little heavier than usual (and he's working on it) and found that while the jacket fits him pretty well, it's better to leave it unbuttoned. He feels confident that when he loses a few more pounds, that won't be an issue. It's not tight in the arms or shoulders which is important. He's 6'2" and currently weighs about 210. It's a handsome jacket and looks nice on him, even if it is unbuttoned!

title: Snug Fitting
text: My husband is 6'2" and currently weighs 210.This is a little more than he usually weighs and is currently working on that. He usually weighs between 190-200.  He wears a size medium in briefs and boxers. These are snug fitting on him. They're not tight, but not as loose fitting as other briefs. The material is light weight and pleasantly cooling. They are well made.

title: Comfortable Fit!
text: I am 5'6" and wear a size 16. I have another pair of leggings in the same brand that are 1X. Those were way too small, so I ordered these in the 2X and that worked much better. The length on me was longer than the capri style pictured, however, I think that with some adjusting, they probably will fit properly. They hit me more at mid calf than upper calf. The material is thick and has adequate stretch to it. They are not see through. The pocket is a nice feature, but will work better with smaller phones. My phone with case barely fit in the phone pocket. However, my daughter's iPhone 7 fit nicely. The construction of these is very nice.

title: Cute Print!
text: This shirt has a cute print. The material is soft and comfortable. I think the sizing runs a little small, but I expected it and ordered accordingly. I currently wear a size 16/XL. I ordered the 2XL in this and it fit well. It was a little tight in the sleeves, but that's a problem that I have with a lot of shirts. It's a nice length and doesn't reveal anything when you bend over. The shirt doesn't hide my middle section, but it is hard to find ones that do. It's a long sleeve shirt, but you can roll the sleeves up and there's a button/fabric tab to keep them in place. It washes well.

title: Wow!
text: Wow! These are super nice leggings! My 18 year old daughter wears leggings almost every day. These are a little thicker than most pairs that she owns. Therefore, they aren't see through. They have a quality feel to them, too. It doesn't feel like they will rip or get holes in them. The eyelet detail at the ankle is a nice touch. She really likes leggings that have the mesh sides. This looks a little nicer than the mesh. The sizing is good. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She wears mediums in other leggings and these mediums fit as expected. There's a pocket in the back at the waist. It says you can put a phone in it. I tried my somewhat large phone and yes, it did fit, but it was an awkward fit. My daughter's iPhone fit a lot better, however, she admits that she probably won't utilize it. Overall, these are really nice leggings!

title: Comfortable!
text: I wear a size 10W shoe. I found these socks to be a little snug, but not tight. The heel lines up pretty well with my heel. They are very comfortable and offer a nice arch support. They are low cut, but not no-show. They seem to be a good quality.

title: Nicely Made!
text: My son is a big guy. He's 6' and weighs close to 300 pounds. He has a belly that hangs over his waist band. He wears 42 to 44 waist pants or 2XL elastic waist pants. I've tried getting larger waist sizes but the way he's built and the way he wears them makes them baggy. With all that being said, because he wears his pants below the belly, these fit him fine. He hasn't been able to locate his previous swim shorts, so he's been wearing athletic shorts in our hot tub. He is happy to have a real pair of swim trunks! He got the khaki ones which is kind of funny because that's pretty much the only color of traditional shorts that he wears! So now his swim trunks mimic his everyday shorts. I'm sure his buddies will have fun with that! These are nicely made.

title: Great Protection!
text: This phone case offers great protection and more than my daughter really needed. It comes with a built in screen protector (which is attached to the phone case), but she quickly became annoyed with it. She found that she had to repeat a lot of the touches to get it to work. If you need a waterproof case, this may be a good choice for you. However my daughter decided that the preferred a case without the built in screen protection. She likes the separate glass protectors instead.

title: Slim Fit
text: These tank tops are a wardrobe staple. They are perfect for layering or lounging. The medium size fits my 18 year old daughter pretty well. Being a slim fit, they aren't loose or baggy which is great when layering under another shirt. She's 5'7" and weighs 145 pounds. She wears mediums in most tops, but can sometimes wear small sizes.

title: Comfortable Fit!
text: These leggings fit as expected. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She wears mediums in pants and these are a comfortable fit on her. They are thick enough that they aren't see through. She loves the pocket! They seem to be well made with secure seams and stitching.

title: Lots of Room!
text: I like everything about this wallet except the color. One place said it was light yellow.  Another said it was Rust. I saw someone else say that there's was apricot. I would say that that is the exact color of this one. There is plenty of room to hold everything! I got a new wallet a few months ago and it has been so frustrating because there weren't enough slots for my cards. The slots were on both sides when you opened it up, so I was always getting mixed up as to which side I needed. This is super functional and allows me to organize everything. Because of that, it's so much easier to keep it neat. My former wallet was a mess! I really do like this a lot. I may even go back and buy one in a different color. Another feature that I like, is that the pockets are lined with a pretty floral material. It really is pretty!!!! I'm going to go check out the other colors right now!

title: Nicer Than Expected!
text: Ordering jewelry online can be hit or miss. This infinity necklace is a hit. It's nicer than I expected. The stones are small and hard to see, but it does sparkle. The chain is sturdy and doesn't feel like it's going to immediately break. I think this is a good, piece of jewelry that can be worn for both casual and nicer occasions.

title: Comfortable!
text: My husband is a boxer guy at night, and a briefs guy during the day. He usually wears a medium in men's underwear, but he has gained a little weight lately and he has found that mediums aren't comfortable when sleeping. He's 6'2" and weighs about 210 pounds right now. The large size fits him quite comfortably. The cotton material isn't very soft. We're hoping it will soften after a few times in the wash. The construction of the boxers is fine.

title: Nice Looking!
text: This is a nice looking, men's shirt. It's long sleeved and button down. The material is a good thickness and is not see through. The fit is good. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 200 pounds. He wears Large in shirts and this fits as expected. The shirt is made well with even stitching and no loose threads. The Tommy logo is subtle. Overall, a good shirt.

title: Light Weight
text: These sunglasses are pretty basic. They're light weight. They are comfortable enough to wear, but they do feel a bit cheap. They do an adequate job of blocking sun. Overall, they're okay.

title: Flattering!
text: This black shirt is very flattering. I like it more than I thought I would. The side rouching is slimming. The material is light weight, but not see through. There is a Sketcher's logo in reflective ink on the top back at the neck area, which I'm not crazy about. Sizing is good. I wear a size 16 in women's and the XL fits as expected.

title: Great Fit!
text: My 21 year old son wears a size 15 Wide shoe. These Adidas extra large socks fit well. They stretch enough to accommodate his foot size without being tight. They're adequately cushioned and comfortable to wear. He is happy with them.

title: Good Basic Undershirt
text: My husband likes to wear white shirts underneath is button down shirts. V-neck styles are good because they are less likely to show at the neckline. These are good, basic undershirts. The size fits as expected. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 200 pounds. He wears large in most shirts. They have been washed and there has been minimal (if any) shrinkage.

title: Comfortable Fit!
text: My husband wears a lot of polo style shirts. This one has a comfortable fit. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 200 pounds. The length is good. The sleeves aren't too tight. His only comment is that the Tommy logo is a little large. He has other Tommy shirts and they have a much smaller logo on the chest. He doesn't really care about brands and logos. Overall, it's a nice shirt.

title: Cute!
text: This is a cute top, but it does run just a little small. I wear a size 16 and for the most part, this XL fits. It's just more of an off the shoulder top on me than the picture shows. The arms are just a bit snug. I've tried pulling it up, but that didn't work out. The cold shoulder is really cute. Overall it's a modern, fun top. I can't get away without a bra, so I do need to make sure that I'm wearing a pretty one since the straps will definitely show!

title: Larger than Expected!
text: This sack pack is larger than expected. It can really hold a lot of stuff in it. It's got 2 outer zippered pockets. All the zippers work well. The drawstring top seems sturdy. The overall quality is excellent and much better than most sack packs that I have seen.

title: Comfortable!
text: I wear a women's size 10W shoe. I've had issues with women's no-show socks running a little small on my feet. These are labeled as unisex. They fit me fine without being tight. They aren't exactly no-show on me. They do go above the shoe top and rest just under the ankle. Maybe on a larger foot they would be more of a no-show. They are very comfortable to wear.

title: Heavyweight Sweatshirt!
text: This Tommy Hilfiger hoodie sweatshirt is much nicer in person. It's a good, heavyweight sweatshirt. The sizing is as expected. I ordered it for my 18 year old daughter who likes wearing oversized men's sweatshirts with leggings. She is 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She could get by with a men's small, but usually wears men's mediums. This large is really big on her, but she likes it. My husband who is 6'2" and weighs about 205 pounds, was able to wear this without any problems, too. The Tommy name is actually embroidered which I wasn't expecting. It really is a nice sweatshirt!

title: Great Fit!
text: My son is a big guy. He is a college student who prefers wearing khakis over jeans. These have a great fit and he finds them comfortable to wear. There's enough stretch in them that they aren't constraining. They seem to have good construction. He's been very pleased with them.

title: Dainty!
text: This is a cute and dainty necklace. It's actually a little nicer than I expected. It doesn't feel too cheap. It reminds me of some of the special jewelry purchases that my local department store has on display. The chain is light weight but passed the tug test that I gave. There are some sparkles on one of the hearts. They're little chips of something, but they look nice. It's definitely something that's probably geared more toward older teens or young adults rather than a fifty year old woman such as myself according to my 18 year old daughter. She's very pleased with it.

title: Comfortable!
text: My 18 year old daughter is a Tommy fan and loves to wear leggings. She was very excited to try these. The description calls these leggings, lounge pants, and pajama pants. Well, those are all pretty different. They don't fit like leggings. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She wears a 6/8 in jeans or medium in pants/leggings. These are baggy in the rear on her which is not how you want leggings to fit, but pajama pants, yes. They are comfortable. She likes the look of them with the traditional Tommy stripe. These will be good for lounging around in the dorm.

title: Good Quality!
text: The first thing I noticed after opening this is the smell of leather! There's no question about the material of this belt! A lot belts we've ordered online are "leather" but when they arrive you realize that they're recycled leather or even faux leather. It's a very sturdy leather belt. Unless you're on the large end of the size range, you do need to cut it down to size. The instructions are very clear regarding cutting and my husband did not have any troubles with cutting it.  The belt is a very good quality. It has a classic casual look to it.

title: Beautiful Details!
text: This bra has beautiful details. The lace is really pretty. The bra fits as expected. It's comfortable enough to wear all day long. The color is light enough to wear under light colored shirts without showing through. I don't wear white shirts, but I imagine it might show through that. It offers adequate support which is important to those of us wearing these sizes! I would prefer if it offered more lift. There's a firmness where the wire would go, but it doesn't provide the same lift that wires do. Overall, it's a decent bra and I do like it.

title: Lacks Enough Support
text: By appearances, this is a beautiful bra. I realize that this is actually a bralette for larger busted women as opposed to a bra. My 18 year old daughter loves bralettes, me, not so much. I found that it lacks enough support. It felt like I was wearing a sleeping bra. After a few hours, I switched to a regular bra because it just didn't feel right. With all that being said, it's a beautiful bra. I love the color. The fit was fine and it was comfortable. I just need more support.

title: Super Soft!
text: This wireless and seamless bra is super soft! I couldn't stop touching it after I opened it from the package. It fits my 18 year old daughter perfectly. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She wears a 34D bra. The medium fits very well. It's definitely more of a casual/lounging bra because it doesn't offer a whole lot of support. My daughter loves it so much she's asked me to order another one!

title: Cute!
text: This bralette is cute, but doesn't offer a lot of support. My daughter wears a 34D bra. She is really in between a C & D cup, but finds that the D cups give her a smoother shape. She's been wearing this as a lounging bra. The design is cute and she does find it to be comfortable.

title: Snug But Comfortable
text: I wear a size 10W shoe. These socks have enough stretch to accommodate my foot size. They're snug, but comfortable. My daughter wears a size 9 and they fit a little better on her.  While they don't seem to have extra support in the arch area, they do feel good on the arch. The no-show style does actually show a little bit, but I've learned that to be the case of most no-show socks. This comes with a few solid black pairs and a few striped ones.

title: Great Fit!
text: These leggings are a great fit on my 18 year old daughter. She's 5'7" and currently weighs 143 pounds. She wears mediums in pants/leggings or a 6/8. These mediums fit as expected. She likes the high waist and finds them very comfortable. Her favorite feature is the phone pocket. These are not see through at all which makes me (mom) very happy. They are made well and seem to be a nice quality.

title: Lovely!
text: This is a lovely bra. It opens in the front. It was a little tricky to fasten at first, but after a few tries, it got easier. Now it's really quick & easy to fasten. The band was a little tight the first time I put it on. I adjusted the straps as far as I could and that made a huge difference. It's snug, but comfortable now. The bra offers adequate support and lift. I really like the details in the design. It's almost too pretty to be worn under clothing!

title: Cute Bag!
text: Clear bags are required at a lot of venues these days. I have a couple of clear bags, but this one is a different size. I figure between the 3 that I have now, I am ready for anything. I have a full size backpack which is too big for a lot of events. I also have a smaller shoulder strap tote bag. This one is the smallest of the three bags. I like that it can be worn as a backpack. My shoulder strap back slips off my shoulder a lot. When I attend events that have the clear bag policy, I usually don't have a lot of things to take, so this bag is more than adequate. The zippers seem to be okay. They  don't glide as easily as some zippers, but they don't hitch much either. The bag seems to be fairly sturdy. It doesn't give the impression that it will fall apart right away. It does have a visible Adidas logo which people either like or dislike. I think it's a cute bag.

title: The Fit is Good
text: The fit of these linen pants is good. I'm 5'6" and wear size 16 pants. The XL fits fine. They look slouchy and more casual than I expected. I can't find any top to go with it that makes it look dressier. The dressy tops that I own look odd with them. Constructions seems to be good.

title: Excellent Fit!
text: This is a beautiful bra that has an excellent fit. Several years ago, I went to one of those fancy bra stores. It was probably the first time I had ever had a proper bra fitting. I walked out of the store with 3 bras (and one pair of matching panties) and I had spent over $400! This line of bras reminds me of the quality bras that I bought then. This doesn't dig into my shoulders. It supports my DD's comfortably. I would definitely recommend giving these a try!

title: Orange Red
text: These red heels are more of an orange red than a true red. They are very attractive. While they did fit my daughter, she felt that the ankle strap was too low and felt odd. She's never worn ankle strap shoes before, so it may be that she's just not used to it. The ankle strap hits her a good inch or so below her ankle. She has a wide foot and the shoes do accommodate her width issue.

title: Great Fit!
text: I usually wear a size 42DD, but I thought I would try a slightly larger band with a smaller cup (44D) because I needed a nude bra. This actually fits as well as a 42DD which surprised me. The bra is comfortable to wear, even all day. I found the front closure a little tricky at first, but it's getting better the more I wear it. It nice looking and offers adequate support.

title: Perfect Fit!
text: This is a beautiful bra. I love the blue print. Not only is it beautiful, but it's a perfect fit! It offers excellent support and provides an attractive shape. It reminds me of a pricey bra that I bought at one of those special bra stores where all the bras in my large size ended up costing over $100 a piece! This is one bra that I don't mind if it peaks out a little bit!

title: Cute!
text: My daughter likes to wear bralettes with cute straps such as this with off the shoulder style tops. She doesn't like strapless bras and she needs the support of an undergarment. This is thin and light weight. It doesn't offer a whole lot of support, but it is enough for her needs. She wears a 34D bra and this fit her fine. C cups fit okay, but usually there's a little spillage, so she wears D cups for a smoother finish.

title: Nice Looking!
text: My daughter is a life guard at a water park. After the first few days of work, she found that she needed a time piece because several people asked her for the time during the day. She doesn't spend a lot of time in the water while on the job, but she does have to jump in now and then so she needed something that could get wet. This is a little larger than she would prefer, but it is nice looking. The turquoise blue stands out. A puma is the hands of the clock which is unique. So far, she is very pleased with it.

title: Nicer Than Expected!
text: I don't usually wear white pants because whenever I do, I end up spilling something on it and ruining them. So far, that hasn't happened, and if it does, it's not the fault of the garment. These are easy, pull on cropped pants. They do wrinkle and require ironing as one would expect with linen. They are comfortable and can be a bit dressy or casual depending on what you wear with it. They are thin and I do have to be careful as to what I wear underneath them. Overall these are nice than I expected.

title: Cute!
text: My daughter has been begging for a pair of overalls, but hasn't had a lot of luck with the sizing. She's 5'7" and currently weighs 143 pounds. She usually wears size 6/8 or mediums in clothing, but some small sizes fit her. The last pair of overalls that we tried didn't fit well, so I thought I would try a smaller size. These are smalls and they fit her really well. They aren't tight or binding. The length hits her right at her ankle. They are form fitting on her and very flattery. She needs to wear a form fitting shirt under it because it didn't look great with her oversized t-shirt. She is quite happy with these.

title: Runs Small
text: These are marketed as sunglasses for men or women, but they run a bit small. They didn't fit me or my husband. They fit okay on my 18 year old daughter, but after a while they hurt her temples. The arms of the glasses feel a bit flimsy, but the lenses feel pretty good. They do offer decent protection from the sun.

title: Beautiful Watch!
text: This is a beautiful watch. The bling makes it look too dressy for every day use in my opinion, so this has become my fancy watch. It seems to keep time pretty well. I'm not particularly picky if it's not to the exact second, but so far, so good. The watch band was a little large, so we had to take it to the local jeweler to have a couple of links removed. I've gotten to wear it a few times to special events and have been complimented on it each time I've worn it.

title: Soft Socks!
text: Although these socks are thin, they are very soft. In fact, I was impressed with the level of softness. The socks have a good amount of stretch in them. I wear a women's size 10W shoe. These socks fit me comfortably without any difficulties. They go about 2 inches or so above my ankle. The dog images are printed onto the socks and are fairly clear. There's no heel stitching, so there's no wrong direction to put them on.

title: Works Great!
text: This umbrella is beautiful and works great! I love how it opens out. It makes it easier to get it full extended and keep you dry while getting out of the car. The outside is all black, but the inside is a beautiful floral design. I think that makes great sense that you can see it while underneath it. When you're putting it away, the outer part that gets wet is inside the compacted umbrella so you don't get everything wet.

title: Comfortable!
text: These running shorts seem to run a little small. I ordered a size larger than my daughter usually wears and they fit nicely. She's 5'7" and weighs approximately 150 pounds. She usually wears mediums or size 6/8's in clothing. These shorts feel comfortable. The material is light weight and doesn't absorb a lot of sweat. There's plenty of room in the leg/thigh area but at the same time, they aren't baggy either. She's not crazy about the reflective dots design but that's a probably because she's not much of a runner and just likes to wear the style of shorts.

title: Nice Design!
text: This umbrella has a nice design. You open it in reverse which helps keep you dryer when you are opening/closing it. It is easy to open once I figured out how it worked. I thought all I had to do was push the red button, but when I did, nothing happened. You have to push the red button and push the base away from you to extend it to the open position. Once I got that figured out, it was simple. With traditional umbrellas, the pretty decorations are on the outside where you can't see them unless it's a double sided material. This one, the outside is solid black, but the inside is a beautiful purple flower. The handle is different, too. I can see how it's supposed to be better, it's just taking some time adjusting to it. I've used other umbrellas for over 50 years! Overall, I am pleased with my new umbrella!

title: Beautiful!
text: I was pleasantly surprised with these earrings. I've gotten a lot of inexpensive jewelry lately and most of it has been just okay. These exceeded my expectations. They are light weight, but not flimsy. They are sturdy enough that I'm not worrying that I will bend or even break them. They are comfortable to wear, which really surprised me. They don't tug or pull on my ear lobes. They don't irritate my ears either. Recently I've developed sensitivities to some earrings. The shape is  a little unique. One side has some sparkly fake diamonds while the back side is plain. The clasp works easily. Overall, I am very happy with these!

title: Adorable!
text: My daughter looks adorable in this. She's 18 and going off to college in the fall. It looks great paired with black pants or leggings. The size is perfect. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She tends to wear mediums in shirts or 6/8's. This is curve hugging but not tight.  The material is a medium weight knit material. She likes it a lot!

title: Light Weight
text: I've seen a lot of leather earrings advertised lately, so I am aware of the trend. I like them better in person than from photos. They look like hammered/dented metal, but they're super light weight. As someone who can't tolerate heavy earrings for very long, I think this is a nice alternative. I don't think they're gift worthy, but definitely worth wearing.

title: Handsome Jacket
text: This is a handsome jacket. It's got a retro vibe going on. The material is heavier and stiffer than I anticipated. It is soft to the touch. Water does just roll off of it which is nice. The construction of this garment is good. Stitches and seams are straight. The zipper glides well. It seems to be true to size.

title: Comfortable!
text: These denim capris are so comfortable! I am 5'6" and wear a size 16. These XL pants are a snug fit, but not tight. The length is longer on me than in the picture in the product description. They hit me about 5 inches above my ankle. I've tried another pair of pants by the same brand and they were way too long, so I think that the brand tends to run long. I have really thick calves and they are tight in the calves as are most pants I've encountered but it's something I can live with. I'm not crazy about the button up fly as I tend to misbutton every time since there are three buttons! Overall, I like these pants and the brand.

title: Snug!
text: My husband is 6'2" and currently weighs around 200 pounds. He wears 34 waist pants. These swim trunks say that they accommodate up to a size 35 waist, but they are really too snug for him at his current weight. He's one of those guys who can "diet" for a few weeks and loose twenty pounds, so we'll keep them around for a while and see if that makes a difference. Another thought is that he's noticed that his 34 pants are often a little loose on him. He attributes it to vanity sizing and believes that men's clothes are being made larger without changing the sizes, like a lot of women's clothing. If that's the case, then it's likely that Nike is not participating in vanity sizes and he's really a size 36. Putting that all aside, the swim trunks are well made. The length is appropriate on his tall frame. They really are nice. Just be mindful of the sizing when ordering.

title: Cute!
text: My 18 year old daughter loves this new swimsuit! She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears a size 6/8 in clothing or mediums. She's a 34B. She has learned over the past few years that swimsuits fit better on her when she goes up a size, so we ordered this in the large size. It fits her pretty well. It may be a teeny bit loose, but it's not too loose that she will loose it in the water! The interior of the suit is lined in white. In a couple of places, just some of the times, the suit rolls up a bit on the edge and shows the white. I'm guessing that's because it's slightly loose and that if it was form fitting, it wouldn't do that. Other than that, it looks really cute on her and she is happy with it.

title: It's Okay
text: This nightshirt didn't really do anything for me. It's kind of boring looking when wearing it. It reminded me of things my Grandmother used to wear. The material is not particularly soft. It's not rough or scratchy, just so-so. It's light weight and good for the summer, but it's almost see-through. The sizing is good. I usually wear size 16 and the XL fits fine. Overall, it's just okay in my opinion.

title: Snug Fit
text: My daughter has been wanting a denim jacket that's not oversized and baggy. So we ordered this in her usual medium size. It does fit her, but it's a snug fit and she can't really wear a lot underneath it.The arms are a little tight, but they still allow some movement.  She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears mostly mediums or 6/8's in clothing sizes. I think the large would have been a better fit on her.

title: Fits Better Than Expected
text: When I first opened this, I asked myself, "Why did I order a dog shirt?" It looked like something one of those little dogs would wear! However, I was pleasantly surprised. It fits better than I expected on my 18 year old daughter. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears mostly mediums and size 6/8's.  She wears a 34D bra. This has enough stretch that it easily accommodating her. It isn't tight or binding. It actually looks cute on her. She is thrilled with it.

title: Good Fit!
text: These linen shorts are light weight and thin. The material is see through, as many white clothing items are, so you do need to be careful regarding undergarments. They are a good fit. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears mediums or size 6-8's in shorts/pants. These are a little loose, but not to the point where they are baggy on her. They are less casual than most of her shorts, so they will work for times when she wants to dress a little nicer.

title: Great Fit!
text: This swim shirt has a great fit on my husband. He's 6'2" and weighs about 200 pounds. The large size looks nice on him and is perfect to wear when boating. Because of it being light weight and offering sun protection, he even wears it when doing yard work. The shirt is made well. Overall, he is quite pleased with it.

title: Flattering!
text: These jeans are very flattering. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She usually wears a size 8 in jeans, but some 6's fit. These stretch enough that they fit her, though going up a size would probably fit, too. She says they're comfortable and not tight on her. The length is good. She finds that a lot of pants run short, but these are fine.

title: Great Fit!
text: My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears mediums in most tops. This medium is a great fit and looks sharp. The material is soft and has some stretch to it. The length is good. It's light weight and can be layered.

title: Nice for Exercising!
text: These are nice, fitness shorts. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 200 pounds. They are a good fit. The length is good. The waist is comfortable. The shorts allow him to move without restriction.

title: Cute!
text: My 18 year old daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She usually wears mediums in tops, but she wanted to try this in a small because of the style. She is very happy with the fit. It's cute on her! She's not really into yoga, but has been wearing this as a crop top. It's a soft cotton, top.

title: Pretty Floral Print
text: This wasn't exactly what I was expecting, but it is cute. I like the pretty floral print. The sizing is good. I currently wear a women's size 16 and the XL fits fine. The bottom of the shirt is a little weird to me. It's just a younger, more stylish look than I wear. It doesn't look bad on me though. While I do like it, I don't love it.

title: Snug Fit
text: I wear women's 10W in shoes. I recently gave men's size 8 shoes a try and have had success with that. I have found that men's shoes are a little wider to begin with and I don't need the extra width. I've had luck with Adidas and Under Armour brands. This is my first time trying men's New Balance. I found these to have a snug fit. My first attempt to put these on was unsuccessful. There's no separate tongue, so I loosened the laces and was not able to get my foot in at all. I was wearing some thick athletic socks at that time. I tried again barefoot, and loosened the laces even more and I was able to get the shoe on. Of course, I will not wear these without socks, but I do have thinner socks that I can wear with them. Once on, the shoes have a nice arch support going on, but the interior of the shoe wasn't as cushiony as I expected. The outer soles of the shoe are pretty cushiony though. The outside of the shoe is a cloth type material that I have seen in other shoes lately. They seem to be made well. Overall, I like them.

title: Comfortable Fit!
text: My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 200 pounds. He wears pants with a 34 waist. These fit as expected. The light weight fabric has some stretch to it which comes him a comfortable fit. The length is good. Since they're light weight, he's been wearing these quite a bit this summer. They don't get damp from sweat like cotton fabrics would. The construction seems to be good. He is pleased.

title: Cute!
text: This is a cute swimsuit. It almost looks like something a life guard would wear. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears a 34D. Usually, she finds that she has to wear a size up when it comes to swimsuits, so we ordered this in the large. It fits, but it's a little loose on top. She probably could have gotten away with the medium. It's pretty flattering when worn. She likes it.

title: Love the Color!
text: This is a soft, cotton polo. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 200 pounds. The large fits him loosely, without being baggy. I love the heather blue color which looks great with my husband's graying hair. The Nautica ship is on the front pocket. The shirt is made well with good stitching and even seams.

title: Nice Casual Men's Shirt
text: This is a nice casual men's shirt. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 200 pounds. He usually wears large shirts, though he can sometimes get by with a medium. This large fits him well. The buttons lay flat and don't pucker or gap. The arms are a little tight IF he does stretches or other irregular movements (movements not usually done while wearing these kinds of clothing). The color is labeled black, but it's really a dark gray. The CK branding is on the front pocket and isn't over whelming.

title: Cute Yoga Top!
text: I think this is a very cute yoga top! I currently wear a size 16 in women's clothing. I have tried other clothing in this brand that ran small, so I ordered this a size larger. This is an 18-20. It fits loosely, but not over-sized. I am really pleased with the fit of it. The back is open, but it covers my traditional bras well. With some movement, it may shift a little and show a little bit of it, but never too much. I am very pleased with it.

title: Over-Sized
text: These over-sized sunglasses are very trendy looking. They frames don't feel very sturdy, but so far they've held up fine. They don't offer as much sun protection as I would like because of the lightly tinted glasses, but they do look good. I do find it a little strange because my eyes are visible when wearing them. They come with a little case and a cleaning cloth.

title: Soft Fabric
text: This shirt is so soft! The fabric drapes nicely. The shirt fits as expected. I'm currently a size 16 in women's and the XL fits well without being too loose or baggy. I'm not crazy about the sleeves, but I don't hate them either. They make the shirt look dressier. It will be great for work!

title: Great Fit!
text: My 18 year old daughter isn't too picky about athletic shoes. While she does like some of the more youthful and popular brands, she's definitely all about comfort and value. I personally think of New Balance as being more of a grown up brand. She saw these and immediately liked them. She thinks they're really cute. The sizing is good. She wears a size 9 in women's shoes with a slight width issue with some brands. These fit nicely on her without any tightness. They are very comfortable. She's a life guard and has to wear water shoes at work. She also is required to stand most of the day. As soon as she gets home, she puts these on because after working all day, she can't comfortably be barefoot. These shoes have been a life saver for her!

title: Pretty!
text: These are very pretty earrings. The silver plating is nice and shiny. They're a good size and look nice when worn. I found it very difficult to open one of the earrings in order to put them on. I had to use some tweezers to apply pressure. I must have bent it a little because it hasn't had any difficulties since then. They felt a little tight on my ear lobes. It also felt like they were pulling as well. The earrings are fairly sturdy and don't feel cheap, but they're not heavy. I would say they are a mid-weight. Because of the pulling and tightness that I felt, they aren't very comfortable to wear for extended periods of time. The earrings arrived in baggy style packaging. For myself, that's not a problem, but had I been planning to gift these, I would not be pleased.

title: Good Multi-Purpose Backpack
text: This is a good multi-purpose backpack. It has several different compartments including a separate one for shoes. The 2 small, outer pockets are lined with a soft felt-type material to protect your mobile phone or other important items. There's a padded laptop pocket inside. The brand logo is not over-sized, as I prefer. The zippers are okay. They don't feel cheap, but they're not as sturdy as some other zippers. Overall, I find it to be a good backpack.

title: Contemporary Style
text: This shirt has a contemporary style. It's a light weight, comfortable fabric. The sizing is accurate. I'm 5'6" and wear a size 16. The XL fits as I would expect. The knot in the front is different than any other shirt I have and it adds an interesting design element. It's actually more flattering than I expected. I really like the sleeve length. Overall, a cute addition to the wardrobe.

title: Snug Fit
text: My 21 year old son wears size 15 shoes. It's hard to find socks that are sized for Big & Tall guys. These are good in the length, but a little narrow. There's enough stretch to fit his feet. They're a snug fit, but comfortable enough for daily use.

title: Snug Fit
text: These women's socks have a snug, but comfortable fit. I wear a women's size 10W shoe. These have enough stretch to fit my feet without being tight or binding.  I really like the pop of color on each pair. They are a little too warm to wear now that summer is here, but I do like them.

title: Soft Fabric
text: This dress is really soft. It fits fine, maybe a little on the long side. I'm 5'6" and the dress grazes the floor when I'm barefoot. I personally think that's how long maxi dresses should be, so I'm good with that. I currently wear size 16 in women's clothing and the XL fits as expected.  The empire waist isn't that flattering on me. It makes me look pregnant, so I will have to wear a body shaper underneath it or else I will be fielding due date questions while wearing it which would be odd since I'm in my fifties. It's a comfortable, flowy dress.

title: Cute & Soft!
text: These pajama shorts are cute and soft! My 18 year old daughter loves them. They fit true to size on her. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She usually wears a size medium or 6/8. These mediums fit her perfectly. They're comfortable to wear. The elastic waist doesn't pinch or bind. They are perfect for the warm weather.

title: So Comfortable!
text: These jeans are so comfortable. They fit perfectly in the waist, hips, and thighs which really surprised me. I currently wear a size 16 in jeans. These are a 1X which is considered an 18-20. There's plenty of stretch.  They did not, however, fit in length. I'm 5'6" and these are several inches too long on me. I am also not a fan of the huge bell bottom. I love flared or boot leg jeans, but these are too wide. However, these fit so perfectly everywhere else, I'm considering taking these to get hemmed. The denim material is super soft, too.

title: Comfortable Fit!
text: These low cut socks have a snug, comfortable fit. They're not overly stretchy and probably won't accommodate feet much larger than the top of the suggested size. They are thin but nicely cushioned on the bottom. There's compression at the arch for added comfort.

title: Soft Fabric
text: I ordered this men's t-shirt for myself. I currently wear a women's size 16. The men's XL fits loosely, but not baggy on me. The fabric is very soft and light weight. The length is good and it doesn't ride up in back. It's really a good shirt for lounging around or working out.

title: Very Flattering!
text: My 17 year old daughter has been in search of a cute, black dress. This may be it! The dress is a stretchy, body hugging dress that is very flattering. It fits perfectly on her. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. The dress has slits and  is a little longer in the back. The dress goes a few inches below the knee on her. It doesn't wrinkle easily, so this would be great for traveling.

title: Fits Like a Glove!
text: I really expected this to be a little short waisted on my 17 year old daughter. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. Instead, it fits like a glove. It really couldn't have fit any better. There are snaps at the bottom. The material has a little stretch to it. My daughter absolutely loves it!

title: Good Fit!
text: I wear a size 10W in women's shoes. These socks stretch enough to accommodate my foot size. The heel marks fit in the right place. These socks are thin, but still comfortable. They don't slip very much. I think these would be good for daily use, but because of the thinness, I wouldn't wear them for physical activity.

title: Comfortable!
text: These are comfortable, no-show socks. They are on the thin side, but they do have adequate support. They stay in place and don't slip down which makes them good for exercise or athletics.

title: Love the Bright Color!
text: This is a beautiful looking duffel bag. I love the bright color. It has a retro vibe to me. The bag is a good size for a weekend getaway. The body of the bag is sturdy. The straps are strong. The zipper doesn't glide as smoothly as I expected. It hitches a little bit. I can deal with that as long as it doesn't jump tracks. The bag is well thought out and has storage for personal belongings.

title: Doesn't Slip!
text: These are pretty good as far as the no show feature. I really like that they don't slip when you're wearing them requiring you to tug them a lot. They are thin, but they do have a great compression feature. They're not very soft, but they aren't rough or scratchy either. They have a snug fit, but there is enough stretch to fit my size 10W feet.

title: Not for Me
text: I was very excited to get these earrings. They are larger and heavier than expected. They do look nice. I wore them to an event earlier this week. The clasp was very difficult to close. One of them kept popping back open. The event was only an hour and half, but I was so happy to take these off when we got home because of the weight of them. So while I was excited to get these, these are not for me.

title: Cute Assortment of Socks!
text: This is a cute assortment of socks. I wear a size 10W in women's shoes. These have enough stretch that they fit my feet. The heel lines up correctly. They fit just below the ankle on me. They are very thin for socks and would be best for casual wear, not fitness.

title: Super Soft!
text: This is a super soft cotton t-shirt. The octopus design is done in a water color style and looks exactly like the picture. It's a comfortable, loose fitting shirt. I'm very happy with it.

title: True Slim Fit
text: These pants are a true slim fit. They are probably geared for a younger audience, not my 50 some husband. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. He wears 34/34 in pants. These 34/34 pants are slightly snug at the waist. The length is perfect. The lower legs are a more snug than he would like. I'm guessing that they're designed for a less muscular body type. The construction of these pants looks good.

title: Nice Zip Around Wallet
text: This is a nice zip around wallet. It is has a TH design. The interior has a little pop of red inside along with black. There are 8 card slots, space for cash, and a zippered compartment. The zippers work well.

title: Great for Lanyards!
text: My daughter keeps her driver's license, debit card and other important items in a wallet attached to a lanyard. This little wallet/coin purse comes with a ring so it can be worn on a lanyard. The black color goes well with her new collegiate lanyard. The wallet doesn't have an ID pocket, but the IDs do fit inside the main compartment. There's a smaller zippered pocket on the side. I can't test the RFID feature, but the interior of the wallet does crinkle like other RFID wallets I have owned.

title: Cute Mini Backpack
text: My 17 year old daughter likes to use mini-backpacks instead of a purse. This one is a good size for taking what she needs. The white fabric appears to be nylon or something similar that will keep the contents fairly dry. The zippers are very sturdy and glide easily. The zipper pulls are a bit noisy when they hit one another. The straps are adjustable. And while the zippers seem very sturdy, the hardware on the straps doesn't feel sturdy at all. The rings and buckles are a thin plastic, especially the rings that hold the straps to the bag. There are 2 zippered pockets - one inside and one outside on the front of the bag. It's a cute, sporty little bag.

title: Soft Fabric
text: This dress is made from a very soft fabric. I wear a size 16 and this XL fits nicely. It isn't clingy or tight. It isn't see through. At 5'6", I find the length to be good and hits me slightly above the ankle. It's comfortable to wear . This is the perfect dress for summer weather.

title: Great Fit!
text: This Adidas socks fit well. My husband wears a size 11 1/2 to 12 shoe size. There's enough stretch they could probably accommodate a slightly larger foot size. They are mostly no-show, but they do peak out a little bit. They're light weight and don't add a lot of warmth to your feet when you're being active. This comes with 2 pairs of socks.

title: Snug Fit
text: These boxer briefs have a snug fit. My son is a big guy. He usually wears 2XL's when it comes to underwear. They are comfortable and do not restrict movement. A larger size (if available, might be better).  The material is light weight and slightly cool.

title: Nice Looking!
text: This is a nice looking duffle bag. It's a medium sized bag and can accommodate a weekend outing or trip to the gym. The straps are adjustable and very sturdy. There's a zippered pocket inside as well as a slip in pocket. The inside is lined with a nylon type fabric. The outer side is a cotton canvas.

title: Thin Material
text: I love wearing light weight quarter zips. This one is even lighter than I expected. The material is practically see-through. I ordered this for my self, but it was a little on the tight side. I wear women's XL, so often men's L will work fine. This is more of a fitted style shirt. It fits me, but it is too snug to wear. Overall, it's just okay in my opinion.

title: Snug But Comfortable
text: My husband prefers boxer brief style underwear over traditional men's briefs. These are a little shorter than the boxer briefs that he normally wears, but they are adequate. They are also longer than traditional briefs. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. They have a snug fit, but they are comfortable for all day wear.  They have a nice little stretch to them. He likes them.

title: Light Weight Shirt
text: This is a light weight, long sleeve shirt. It's light enough that my husband has been wearing it on 80 degree days! The sizing is as expected. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 190 pounds. He usually wears large shirts, especially if they're button down. When buttoned, it doesn't gap or pucker. The arm length is good on him. The Columbia name is on the front pocket and does not stand out too much. Overall, it's a nice shirt.

title: A Little Different Than I Expected
text: These leggings were a little different than I expected. My daughter loves leggings with mesh panels, but these are more like fishnet stocking material than what I think of mesh. Either way, they do have the fun look that my teenage daughter likes when it comes to leggings. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears mediums in leggings and these fit as expected. She loves the high waist feature and feels that is very flattering. Overall, she likes these.

title: Roomy!
text: This Adidas waist bag doesn't scream "fanny pack". It is roomy enough to hold your wallet (albeit a thin one), phone, and keys. There are 2 separate compartments. The bag adjusted to accommodate my plus size body. It wasn't as easy to adjust as some straps and bags, but I didn't have too many troubles doing so. It has a sporty look to it. I love the pink color!

title: Comfortable!
text: I wear a size 10W in women's shoes. However, because of the width issue that I have, I usually have to buy 11's and wide ones at that. These are 11/12's and they fit a little big on me. I probably could have gotten by with the 9/10's.  The strap slips down a lot when wearing them. They are cushioned well and very comfortable. The gray color is nice and neutral.

title: Not Wide Enough
text: These are nice water shoes, but unfortunately they don't run wide enough for me. They are a Medium width, but I was hoping because they are sized for men, that they would work. I wear a women's 10W. Usually men's regular width shoes work for me. My daughter was able to fit in them. She's a lifeguard and has to wear pool shoes, so she was excited that they fit her well. They have a little bit of support. They have great traction and are perfect on slippery pool decks. They can be tightened and adjusted easily. She's happy with them.

title: Comfortable!
text: My husband finds these socks to be very comfortable. The compression feature in the arch makes such a difference. These fit my husband well - he's a size 12 in shoes. They could easily stretch a little to accommodate a slightly larger foot size. He is very pleased with these.

title: Great Traction!
text: These sneakers have great traction. They are cushioned well and very comfortable. The black with coral/orange accents is pretty calm as far as athletic shoes go these days. They are true to size and fit as expected.

title: Great Fit!
text: My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears a medium or 6/8's in clothing. I ordered this in a 6 for her because recently size 8's have been a bit loose on her. I don't know if that's related to vanity sizing or not, but the size 6's have been fitting her so much better. This size 6 fits her perfectly! She would not have been happy with the 8. The dress is very flattering. The material is light weight and doesn't wrinkle which would make this great for traveling. I would love to see this exact dress in other prints or even solid colors.

title: Nice Looking!
text: My husband has a couple of similar slide type belts and really likes them. He likes that they don't have holes that wear out over time. This works as the other ones do. It doesn't slip out of place. The medium size doesn't allow for much room in case needed. Overall, it's a nice looking belt.

title: Great!
text: This is a great little bag! It's perfect for times when you just need your phone and a few other necessities. It's kind of like the little purse you take with you to formal events, but this one is more sporty and gender neutral. The strap is adjustable so you can fit it just right as a crossbody. If you need to take more with you, then you should go with a backpack.

title: Nice Backpack!
text: This is a nice, all purpose backpack. It's not as big as the standard, school backpack. My daughter is in high school and this would not hold all over her belongings. It might work better for a younger child. It's definitely larger than a mini sized backpack. It has a padded compartment for a laptop or tablet. My 17 inch laptop did not fit in it, but smaller ones shouldn't be a problem. The straps are comfortable. I really like the bright pink interior. It looks nice with the contrast of the black bag. Overall, it's a nice backpack and would work nicely as a day bag or for going to the gym.

title: Cute!
text: My teenage daughter thinks these camis are super cute! The lace looks great peeking out under layers. The shirts fit as expected on her. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. It comes with 2 camisoles.

title: Cute!
text: This is a cute, small wallet. It's perfect when you don't need a full size one. There are 2 separate zippered sections. It may take a little getting used to before you remember which zippered section is which. One section is designed for bills and a couple of cards. The other side is more for change or a small stack of cards. The zippers work well, so far. I really like the colorful design, which is only on one side. Overall, it's a cute little wallet.

title: Comfortable Shoes!
text: I wear a women's size 10W shoe. I often end up with size 11's because of the width. I recently discovered that men's shoes are made a little wider and they often fit better on me. These 10's fit really well. They are super comfortable! They are made differently than most shoes in that the top (where your foot goes in) is more like a sock. I found it easy enough to put on, but it does take a little longer than expected. Once they were on, I did find that I had to pull at that area a little bit to get them where they felt comfortable.  These shoes have lots of support. They feel like you're walking on air! The only issue that I had with these, is after wearing them all day to work, they were bugging me at the top and felt a little tight there. They didn't start to annoy me until several hours into wearing them. I'm not a runner, so I can't say how they work for running. These also have an app that you can download to track your running or something. That's another feature lost on me. But as far as comfort, I like these a lot!

title: Cute Swim Top!
text: This is a cute swim top. It has the look of a layered top, but it's one item. I'm a plus size mom and I currently wear a size 16. I always order a size up in swimsuits. I have found that they fit better when I do. Even when I'm in the stores trying on swimsuits, the larger sizes work better on me. This fit as I expected, maybe a little loose if anything. There are bra cups, though they only offer minimal support for my DD cup size. While this fits, it's not the most flattering swimsuit for me. I will wear this at home in our private hot tub, but I probably won't wear this in public. With that being said, at my age, I don't usually wear swimsuits in public anyway.

title: Nice Little Wallet
text: This is a nice little wallet. It's perfect for times when you don't need to take your full purse. It doesn't hold a whole lot, but it does hold enough to get by with it. There's a sturdy ring so you can attach it to a lanyard if needed. The zipper seems sturdy enough and glides well.

title: Fits Nicely!
