text: These men's sleep shorts fit nicely on my husband. He's 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. He wears mediums in sweatpants and boxers. These mediums are roomy, without being baggy. The legs are loose. He finds them to be comfortable for both sleeping and lounging. The material is soft and comfortable.

title: Comfortable Fit!
text: My son is a big guy. These shorts have a good, comfortable fit on him. They stretch and give enough which adds to the comfort. They have great pockets. The length is appropriate. He wasn't crazy about the drawstring feature at first, but he has enjoyed not having to deal with a belt when wearing these.

title: All You Need is a Lanyard!
text: My daughter wears a lanyard with a small wallet on it. She keeps her keys on it and keeps her ID and other cards. If she has cash, it goes in there, too. The one she had was cute and floral, but she's been wanting a more neutral one like this. It holds everything she keeps in her old one. She is very happy with it!

title: Strong Drawstring Bag
text: This is a strong and sturdy drawstring bag. It accommodates a lot more than I expected. When my daughter was in middle school, this was the only type of book bag they could bring into the classrooms. This is a lot better than most of the ones that were available at the time. We went through so many bags because they would break easily This would probably have lasted the whole year.

title: Nice, Basic White T-Shirt
text: My husband wears white t-shirts under his shirts every day. This one is moderately thick and could be worn on its own. It is a loose fit. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. He probably could have gotten by with a medium for a more fitted look.

title: Holds My Mobile Phone!
text: This is a roomy, yet elegant bag. It's larger than some other evening bags that I have. It comes with a heavy shoulder chain, but you can remove it and use it as a clutch if you prefer. There are lots of slots inside for your credit cards and ID. Even my cell phone (with Otterbox case) fit inside. I can also fit a lip gloss and compact, but that's about it.

title: Tight Fit!
text: My husband likes to keep sunglasses in his car as well as mine for the times he's driving my car. This is the pair he's keeping in my car. They have a nice, tight fit on his head. They offer excellent protection from the sun. He has had a premature cataract that was attributed to possible sun damage, so he is meticulous about wearing sun glasses now. He likes them and is pleased with them.

title: Great Duffel Bag!
text: This is a great duffel bag! It's made from a nylon type material that keeps your stuff pretty dry. The interior is padded so your belongings have extra protection. There are a couple of outer pockets on the ends, a zippered pocket on the outside,  and two interior zippered pockets as well. It comes with a shoulder strap and a set of handles. The construction of the bag is good. Zippers zip easily. Straps are sturdy. It's an all around good bag!

title: Good Size!
text: This is a good size backpack if you're looking for one that's not too large and not too small. It's larger than a mini back pack. It could be considered a smaller "full sized" one. My daughter is using a similar sized one for school this year. It is smaller than a lot of backpacks, but it does a decent job. She does find that with a bag this size, she can't keep unnecessary items in it! I was disappointed to see that this doesn't have any interior pockets. There is an outer zippered one, but none inside. I have a few other Tommy backpacks and I think they all have interior pockets. This bag is made of canvas. It's not very thick material. Overall, this is an okay bag, but not as nice as other Tommy bags I have seen.

title: Good Looking Shirt
text: This is a good looking shirt, albeit a little thin. It's not see through, but I think an undershirt would be best with it. The shirt seems to be made well. Unfortunately it doesn't fit. I ordered a large, but a medium was sent instead. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. He can wear some mediums in t-shirts or polos, but not in a button down, fitted shirt.

title: Cute Dress!
text: My daughter is graduating from high school next month and I've been on the lookout for dresses to wear to the many graduation related events. I'm so glad to have found this cute dress! It's casual enough that I don't feel like I'm wearing a dress, but it looks nice, too. It's long enough that it covers my calves. The fabric is light and flowy. This would be good for traveling because it doesn't wrinkle a lot.  I wear a size 16 and the Large fits great. I almost considered getting an XL, but I'm glad that I did not. I do wish it had pockets. I also would like if it had a little lower neckline. I don't want a plunge neckline, but maybe a little scoop neck. Overall, I really like this dress.

title: Comfortable!
text: My son wears a size 15W shoe. I was actually excited to see these in the larger sizes. The foot of the sock fits pretty well. There's enough stretch to accommodate his width. He found that the sock was snug, but not too tight, on his calves. They do stay up well. And overall, he found these to be comfortable.

title: Comfortable Fit!
text: My 21 year old son wears boxer briefs. These have a comfortable fit for the most part. He thought the edge that hits the thighs were a little tight, but not to the point that they were uncomfortable. He didn't really notice any cooling effect. Overall, he does like them.

title: Light Weight
text: This is a light weight hat and very different from most ball caps. The material is a gray color. The hat is not as stiff as some hats, which my teenage daughter really liked. It is adjustable and has the opening in back where she could put her ponytail. Overall, she likes it.

title: Love it!
text: This hat is absolutely wonderful. I love it! I have a large head and usually hats don't fit me. This one is adjustable and fits just fine. It provides excellent face coverage and protection from the sun. It rolls up easily for storage or traveling. And it looks great, too! I have gotten multiple compliments while wearing it.

title: Easy to Reverse
text: My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. He wears a size 34 in pants. I ordered this belt in a 36 after looking online about how to order belt sizes. What I read said to buy a size larger than what you wear. This belt fits him, but only on the last hole. Next time I order a belt for him, I think I will go with a 38. The product description says this is made of leather. It's not an obvious leather. I'm not saying that it's not leather, but it doesn't have some of the leather properties that I have gotten used to over the years. It is sturdy. The belt reverses very easily. However, unless you're in super good lighting, I found it difficult to tell which side was black and which one was brown. The brown is a very dark brown. The brand name is on the belt buckle, but it's fairly discrete unless you're specifically looking for it. Overall, this is okay. My husband has been wearing it and it holds his pants up!

title: Great for Casual or Dressier Occasions
text: These are pretty earrings. The silver has been styled in a diamond cut pattern which reflects the light well and in turn really sparkles. The earrings are fairly light weight. The backings are pretty worthless and I've used some larger, clear ones that I have instead. These are great for casual or dressier occasions.

title: Very Comfortable!
text: These women's panties arrived at a much needed time. I recently needed a little help with my muffin top. These do have a light compression type action going on. They are very comfortable and definitely improved my appearance. I've tried super restricting body shapers and while those do work, they are uncomfortable to wear for extended periods of time. I can wear these all day without any problems. They don't fix all of my problems, but they do help. As far as looks go, they are basically granny panties. They stayed in place for the most part, however, when I was trying out some over exaggerated movements, I did notice that they rolled down at the waist a bit. Overall, I do like them and will happily wear them.

title: Cute Tommy Bag!
text: This is a cute Tommy bag. The bag is made of a strong canvas. While the material is sturdy, it does attract pet hair!!  It is not a full size back pack, but it's not a mini-one either. It's really in between. You could easily carry around a good amount of items in it, just not large folders, text books and other larger items. The straps are securely attached and easily adjustable. There's a slip pocket as well as a zippered one inside. I love the Tommy red/white/blue stripes!

title: Simple But Classy
text: These stud earrings are very simple but also classy. The hammered silver looks very nice. The earrings aren't too heavy and don't pull on the ear lobes. They are pretty comfortable to wear as far as earrings go. The silver is shiny and the hammered marks give it a geometric look.

title: Dainty
text: This is a sweet necklace. The charm is smaller than I anticipated. It's approximately the size of a dime. The sentiment is nice and great for young girls. The chain is a good length and has an extender, too. I tugged gently on it and it seemed to be decent. It did not show signs to indicate that it might break right away. It's too dainty for an adult, but for a teen or tween, it's appropriate.

title: Full Size Back Pack
text: This is a full size Tommy Hilfiger back pack. It's made from a sturdy canvas material. The zippers are sturdy and work well. There's an outer zippered pocket on the front which is about half of the size of the bag. Inside there is a slip in pocket as well as a zippered one. There's also a padded compartment for your laptop or tablet. The adjustable straps are padded for comfort. There's also a handle on the top. I would prefer it if it had some kind of protective surface or small "feet" on the bottom to protect if if you have to set it on the ground. It's in the standard Tommy Hilfiger colors with a small Tommy brand label on the front.

title: Cute Bag!
text: This is a small, day bag sized backpack. It's made from a sturdy canvas material. Since it is canvas, it does seem to attract pet fur easily. There's a good size outer zippered pocket on the front. The inside has 2 pockets - one is a slip in pocket that's not particularly deep and then there's another zippered pocket, too. The zippers are sturdy and glide easily. The adjustable straps are very strong and well attached. Overall, it's a nice day bag!

title: Cute But Runs Small
text: I ordered these for my 17 year old daughter. They're cute and perfect for summer. She wears a size 9, average width shoe. These are super narrow and definitely not a size 9. I would recommend ordering at least a size smaller.

title: Great Fit!
text: My husband likes wearing moisture wicking shirts for doing yard work. They're light weight and he doesn't get too sweaty in them. This one is a nice, quality one. It's a loose fit on him, but not baggy. I like that it has sun protection as well. The length is long enough that it can be tucked in without coming out every time he extends his upper body. We are very pleased with it.

title: Nice Light Weight Tech Pullover
text: I ordered this nice, light weight pullover for my husband. While he does like the dry fit material, he wasn't crazy about this having a hoodie. But I totally realize that's his personal opinion and does not affect my review. The fit is good. It's loose, but not baggy. The arm length is good. My husband is pretty tall and some long sleeve shirts are too short on him. Even though he's not a fan of hoodies, he has worn this around the house.  It's made well. Overall, it's a good tech material garment.

title: Beautiful Dress Shoes!
text: My husband has been in need of some new dress shoes. These shoes are beautiful and well made. They are definitely a great quality. The fit is true to size. They are classic in design. He is more than happy to get rid of his old, worn shoes.

title: Nice Quality!
text: This Tommy Hilfiger cargo shorts are a nice quality. The stitches are even. They also look good. The fit is perfect. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. He wears a size 34 pants/shorts. These fit as expected. They hit him just above the knee for an appropriate length. The cargo pockets are nice sized. He is pleased with these.

title: Comfortable!
text: I don't wear earrings very often because they tug on my ear lobes and annoy me after a while. These silver hoops are fairly light weight and really don't tug very much. In fact, they are surprisingly comfortable to wear. They have a very faint design or pattern to them, which is difficult to see. The clasp works fine. They are appropriate for casual and dressy occasions.  Overall, they are a good pair of earrings.

title: Runs Small
text: These sandals run too small. You should order at least a size up. My daughter has a size 9, regular width foot. Since these are open, I expected them to fit regardless of any potential width issue. Unfortunately, they don't stretch or flex to allow any foot to fit unless they are smaller and extremely narrow. The shoe itself is made fine. The straps seem to be attached securely. The wedge sole does offer a little support.

title: Cute!
text: This is a cute, casual top. I wasn't sure what size to get. A lot of clothing items online run small, so I ordered a size larger. I usually wear a 16/XL. This XXL was a little big, but not overly large. I did feel that need to adjust the straps a bit so my bra straps were covered. The fabric is light weight and flowy. It looked especially cute with jeans.

title: Looks Nice!
text: This is a good looking shirt and looks nice on my husband. The fit is good and as expected. The branding logo is minimal. The shirt quality is great. Seams are straight. Buttons are secure. My husband is 6'2" and the length is good.

title: Surprisingly Comfortable!
text: This is an attractive bra. It's black lace, lined with pale pink. I usually wear t-shirt bras or molded cup ones to get a smooth shape, but this has pretty good coverage, especially for a lace bra. It was surprisingly comfortable, too. I wore it all day and not once did I have the feeling to get out of that bra!

title: Great Fit!
text: When my son was younger and in Boy Scouts, my husband used to wear a similar hat made from canvas or some other really heavy material when doing various Scout activities. While the canvas hat did offer adequate protection from the sun, it was very hot to wear. This hat is really light weight and allows air to circulate. It's a great fit on him. He's beginning to get a little bald spot on the top of his head, so this will offer some good protection to his scalp. I definitely recommend this hat.

title: Nice Sunglasses!
text: My husband had cataract in one of his eyes about a year or so ago. He's only 52, so the doctor said it was probably due to eye damage rather than age. He wasn't very good about wearing sunglasses. So now he's careful to wear them whenever outside on sunny days. He has a pair that he keeps in his car, but he often forgets to get them when driving my car. He is now keeping them in the console of mine. They fit well. The shape is nice and unique. And best of all, they do a great job of protecting his eyes!

title: Light Weight
text: I don't wear earrings very often because I find them to be uncomfortable. These are pretty light weight and don't bother me. They're actually quite comfortable. The length is good and not over-sized. They don't come with any type of stopper/backing. While they are nice looking, they don't look particularly high quality. There's nothing that gives the indication that they aren't a good quality, it's just the look/feel. Overall, I do like them.

title: Great Pants!
text: My husband is 52 years old and doesn't wear jeans anymore. He wears khaki pants for work and cargo pants if he is doing yard work or other type projects. Dockers is his preferred brand of casual pants. These Tech pants live up to the Dockers' name. They are a good quality. They fit as expected. He really likes the thinner, lighter fabric of these.  They wash well. These are great pants!

title: Nice Quality!
text: These Docker's shorts are a very nice quality. The 34 size fits my 6'2"/195 pound husband well. The length is not quite as long as some other shorts that he has, but they are still appropriate for his 52 years of age. The material is light weight and comfortable. There are plenty of pockets, with even a security one. Husband approves!

title: Generous Pockets
text: My 21 year old son is a big guy. He was happy to give these new shorts a try. First of all, they fit as expected.  The length is great and very appropriate. The fabric has a bit of stretch to it which makes it comfortable. The pockets were generous and easily accommodated his mobile phone. The construction of the shorts is very good with secure and even stitching. These are a nice quality clothing item.

title: Zip Around Wallet
text: This is a good zip around wallet. I like zip around ones because some snap wallets don't stay closed well. This one is average in size and if you stuff it too full, it does have difficulties zipping. There's a center zipper pocket for change. Both sides have a full size slip in pocket with 4 credit card sized pockets on each one. There's space on both sides of the center zipper pocket that could be used for bills and receipts. There's enough room for what I need.

title: Nice!
text: I don't usually wear earrings very often because they're often too heavy or they annoy my ears. These earrings are so light weight, they don't bother me. They are hollow, thus they don't weigh very much. They have a textured design to them. The clasps work as expected. I am very happy with these.

title: Great Umbrella!
text: This is the first double layer umbrella I've had. The outer layer is black while the inner layer in white or cream. The umbrella opens and closes easily by the touch of a button. It's noticeably sturdier than a lot of umbrellas out there. One of the ribs popped out of the little clip the first time I used it. I put it back into place and it seems to be staying and I haven't had any problems since that. Overall, it's a great umbrella!

title: Sturdy Duffel Bag!
text: This  duffel bag is perfect for a weekend trip. If you're going to be gone much longer, you'll probably need a larger bag. The bag is canvas with very sturdy straps which are the signature Tommy red,white, & blue. There's an outer slip pocket and two inside (one slip, one zip) the bag. The Tommy Hilfiger name is above the outer pocket and is fairly unobtrusive. Overall, it's a good weekender bag.

title: Good Size!
text: This is a good size crossbody purse for traveling. It holds the essentials close to your body. The bag is covered with the Tommy name. A lot of the lettering is upside down. The bag zips at the top. The zipper is sturdy and glides well. There's an pocket on the outside back of the purse as well as two inside. The straps are adequate, but not as sturdy as some other bags.

title: Cute, But Runs Small
text: These are cute, basic casual sandals. They don't have any support of any kind. The straps are thin, but attached well.  I was excited for my 17 year old daughter to have some new summer sandals. Unfortunately they run really small and narrow. My daughter wears a size 9 shoe. Normally, sizing wouldn't really be an issue with shoes like this because they're practically open all around. However, the straps are too tight on her and she couldn't slip her foot all the way in it. She might have had better luck if her feet were super narrow. As it is, her feet aren't particularly wide.

title: Great Fit!
text: The classic fit Tommy Hilfiger polo is a great fit on my husband. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. The shirt isn't too big on him as some large sized polo shirts end up. The arms are large enough that they don't bind. It's just a great fit! The shirt is made well, too. The Tommy logo is small and not over powering.

title: Comfortable!
text: These jogger pants are a cross between leggings and sweatpants. The mediums fit as expected on my 5'7" & 150 pound daughter. The pants part is like leggings, but the ankles are cuffed. My daughter finds them to be comfortable, especially for wearing around the house. The brand name does take up one leg.

title: Soft Cotton Fabric
text: My husband wears boxer-briefs during the day and makes the switch to boxers at night. These are made with a soft cotton fabric. The fit is good, but my husband felt that they weren't comfortable for sleeping. They were a little too restrictive for sleep positions. He is 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. He wears a 34 waist pants and mediums in underwear. They are made well.

title: Well Made
text: This is a very thin, light weight pullover. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. It fits okay, not great. He thought it was fine, but it looks a little tight in the shoulders. The length is great on his long torso. It's made well. The branding is pretty subtle.

title: Sweet Bracelet!
text: This is a very sweet bracelet. Unfortunately, it is way too small for me. It doesn't fit my teenage daughter either. The stones are a good color. The bracelet seems to be well made. The clasp is really nice and easy to fasten. It's really a decent piece of jewelry, just be sure to measure your wrist first. The bracelet is 6 inches long plus a 1 inch clasp.

title: Light Weight
text: These earrings are nice and light weight. They aren't heavy at all and don't pull on your ear lobes. They are more rounded than I was expecting. I thought they were going to be somewhat flat. They have nice, decorative details. They are a fairly neutral earring and could be worn with a variety of styles.

title: Excellent Fit!
text: My husband is very pleased with these Dockers shorts. They have an excellent fit on him. He usually wears a size 34 shorts and these fit as expected. The fabric is a little lighter than most Dockers pants that he has owned, which is perfect for the hot humid summers we have. These are made well and what we would expect from the Dockers brand.

title: Nice Casual Men's Shirt
text: This is a nice casual men's shirt. The material is light weight but not too thin that it's see through. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. The shirt buttons nicely and isn't baggy or tight. The buttons are sewn on well. The Izod logo is fairly discreet.

title: Comfortable Fit!
text: My husband isn't a golfer, but he does like the thin weight of these golf shorts. We live in the South and have hot humid summers. The lightweight temperature is comfortable and cooling for the hot season.  My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. He usually wears 34 shorts and these fit as expected. The waist band is very comfortable and has a nice elastic layer that gives when moving. The length is satisfactory to my husband. Overall, they're a nice pair of shorts.

title: Nice Quality!
text: With the coming warmer weather, my husband was in need of some new shorts. These casual cargo shorts are a nice quality. The overall construction is good. They fit well. My husband usually wears a size 34 and these fit just as expected. The length is good. He's 6'2" and these hit him just above the knee. Most of his shorts are variations of tan in color, so this gray color is a good addition to his wardrobe.

title: Comfortable!
text: My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears mediums/8's in leggings, pants, and jeans. These mediums fit well. The length is good and not too short. The waist is comfortable. She has worn this for lounging around the house and for winter guard rehearsals. In that capacity, she has not had any issues with the waist rolling down. She is very happy with them.

title: Pretty!
text: These are pretty earrings. They look like they were handcrafted and something you might find at arts and craft show. They sparkle nicely.

title: Comfortable Waist!
text: My husband is in his early 50's and these shorts are appropriate for him. The length is good. The flex waist is nice. The size fits as expected. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. The 34's fit like 34's. They are a good quality and what one would expect from the Dockers brand.

title: Comfortable!
text: I have been wanting a basic hoodie to wear around the house. This one fits the bill. It's just a plain, basic black hoodie. I wear a women's size 16/XL. This men's XL is roomy enough that  I can wear layers underneath it. It's a good mid to heavy weight jacket.

title: Lettering is Dull
text: I have a couple of other Tommy bags in the same print/design with the Tommy name all over it. The others are canvas material, but their lettering is much brighter. It's noticeable when the items are next to one another. If you didn't see the others, you wouldn't realize how dull it is. The bag is a good size, but could easily be bigger. There's no closure at the top, nor are there any pockets. It does have a cute matching wallet type item that is attached to the inside. The handles are securely attached, but they don't seem as sturdy as some other Tommy tote bags I've seen. It's a cute bag, but doesn't seem particularly sturdy.

title: Durable Backpack!
text: This mini backpack is pretty durable. The canvas material is substantial. The zippers are sturdy and move easily. The straps are very strong and securely attached. The Tommy name is printed nicely on the bag. I have another bag in the same print where the lettering is not aligned well between the colors. The lettering on this one is much nicer and very even. There's an outer zipped pocket as well as 2 pockets (one zippered/one slip in) inside. This size bag is too small for a school backpack but perfect for day trips or traveling.

title: Sweet Necklace
text: This is a sweet necklace. It's very dainty. I ordered it for myself, but because of the size, my teenage daughter gets it. It just looks better on a smaller neck. The diamonds are small, but they do sparkle. The chain is very thin, but seems sturdy enough so far.

title: Great Pants!
text: My husband is in his early 50's. A few years ago, he decided to stop wearing jeans and only wear khaki or cargo type pants. Most of his pants are in the brown/tan color range. These are his first black (non-dress) pants. They fit great on him. He's 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. He usually wears 34x34 and these fit as expected. They are exactly what you would expect from the Dockers brand. It's great seeing him in something a little different!

title: Nice, Gender Neutral Backpack
text: This is a nice, gender neutral backpack. A lot of Tommy bags look more feminine with the fancy zipper pulls and other details. This is a simple, canvas backpack. The logo is there, but not too big. There's also the traditional red/blue/white ribbon stripe. There's an outside zippered pocket on the front. There's a large padded laptop space inside as well as a small slip in pocket and a zippered one. Zippers glide well. Straps are adjustable. Good quality.

title: Good Fit!
text: My husband doesn't play golf, but he does wear shorts. These are light weight and perfect for the hot summer weather. The sizing is a true fit. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. He wears 34's and this 34 fits as expected. The length is appropriate and not too short.

title: Nice Shirt!
text: This is a nice men's shirt. The colors are pretty true to the picture. The large fits my husband fine. He's 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. He is usually right between medium and large. This large is not baggy or loose on him. The arm length is fine. The quality of the shirt is good. Overall, it's a good, casual long sleeve shirt.

title: Great Over-sized Tote!
text: This is a great over-sized tote! It's a sturdy canvas bag. It has a snap closure at the top. The handles are strong and securely attached. There's a zippered pocket inside. The Hilfiger name is embroidered instead of screen printed and looks very nice. I really like this tote!

title: Nice Crossbody Purse
text:
Update: 4/27/19 - I have a several different purses that I rotate, so I hadn't used this yet. I went to use it today and the zipper broke, the first time using it! It had seemed heavy and sturdy, so I was very surprised by that. Such as shame, since it's such a cute purse!

Original review:

When traveling, I always take a crossbody purse with me so I can get it close to my body. This one is pretty nice. The material is a heavy canvas with a leather-like bottom/strap. (I am assuming it's not real leather, but I'm not for certain.) The bag is large enough for my wallet, and a few other basics that I might need. The strap is adjusts with a belt buckle feature. There's an outer pocket as well as two inside pockets, with one of those a zippered one. The bag has a zippered closure which I did not have any problems with. I've zipped and unzipped it dozens of times without any problems. The zipper is heavy duty and glides well. The Tommy name is printed all over the outside of the bag. The lettering is half white and half red. Most of the letters don't match up correctly and are slightly off place. I am not sure that was intentional or not. Overall, it's a decent bag.

title: Dainty
text: I really wouldn't call this a wedding ring. I'm a simple person and wear just a gold band for my wedding ring, but this is so small and dainty it would get lost on most people. The pictures are misleading because they are greatly enlarged and show the details well, but in person you really can't see them. I think it is more appropriate to market this as a stackable ring, not as a wedding one. With all that aside, it is pretty. My 17 year old daughter really likes it. It is a good piece of jewelry for her because it is simple and dainty.

title: Perfect for Teens or Tweens
text:
Updated 5/2/2019: Necklace broke in half the second time it was worn. Would not recommend.

While it is a pretty necklace, it's really small. The pictures in the description must be enlarged. In person, you really can't see the individual diamonds at all. You can see sparkles, but not the stones. I wouldn't even call them stones because they're so small. It's definitely a dainty piece of jewelry. It seems a little fragile, too. It is perfect for teens or tweens. My 17 year old daughter really likes it and it looks nice on her.

title: Light Weight Shirt
text: This is a good, light weight shirt. It's a tad large on my husband, but not to the point of it being too baggy. He's 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. The buttons are sewn tightly. The seams look good. Overall, it's a good men's shirt.

title: Comfortable Fit!
text: My husband likes wearing polo style shirts in warmer weather. He's 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. The shirt is a comfortable fit. It's roomy without being baggy. Arms aren't tight. The length is good. The construction seems to be good.

title: Roomy!
text: This black polyvinyl Tommy Hilfiger bag is pretty nice considering the faux material. It doesn't look obviously plastic or cheap. It has handles as well as a shoulder strap. There's the standard navy, white & red ribbon stripe on the front and a TH logo, too. The inside is roomy. There's a zippered pocket on one side and a pocket on the other side, too. The zipper is sturdy and glides well. The zipper pull is nice and heavy. Overall, it's a nice satchel style purse.

title: Comfortable!
text: These shorts are comfortable and perfect for lounging about the house. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. These are a little baggy on her, but since she's wearing them at home, it's fine. The material is soft. They're made well. Overall, she does like them.

title: Light Weight Fabric
text: I really like the light weight fabric of these pants. I don't play golf, but I was hoping to wear these to work. The pants fit perfectly everywhere except the calves. They are too tight there. They don't seem particularly fitted, but they are a bit narrow in the leg.

title: Smooth Lines
text: I like a bra that has smooth lines such as this one. It does seem a little tight on me, but it does fit. It just can't be worn all day and into the evening. It does give adequate support. I usually wear bras with thicker, more molded cups, but this one is okay.

title: Good Fit
text: This is a nice, basic black dress. The fit is good. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She usually wears a size medium/8, but the 6 fits like a glove. The fabric is a little thicker than expected which might make it too warm to wear during the hot months. It was pretty wrinkly after it arrived and needed to be ironed , but it does seem to be a care free fabric for the most part. I think if you hang it up right after taking it out of the dryer, it won't need ironing.

title: Soft, Thin Fabric
text: This is a good long sleeved button down shirt. The material is soft, but thin. However it's not see through. The arm length is good. The shirt doesn't gap at the buttons. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. He wears mostly larges, but some mediums. This large fits him nicely. It's 100% cotton, so I have been letting it line dry so it won't shrink.

title: Excellent Fit!
text: My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. He can wear some mediums, but mostly larges. However, a lot of the larges these days are too big on him and look baggy. My guess is that he's really a size Large, but many companies have adopted the vanity sizing to make customers feel better about their sizes. This shirt fits as expected. The large isn't baggy. It actually has an excellent fit on him in the arms, chest, and length. The only thing he isn't crazy about is the logo. He has other Calvin Klein shirts that just have a simple CK on the chest. This one has full words and says "Calvin Klein Jeans". He'll still wear it, but at his age, logos aren't that big of deal.

title: Soft Fabric
text: My husband is 6'2" and weighs approximately 195 pounds. He usually falls in between medium and large sizes. Though lately, larges have been too big on him which we attribute to possible vanity sizing. This large fits very well. It's loose on him, but not bagging at all. The fabric is very soft. The shirt is made well, too.

title: Adorable Dress!
text: This dress is adorable! It's very flattering. It may run a little large. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She's usually a size medium/size 8. The 6 fits her perfectly. I think the 8 would have been too big. The fabric is carefree and seems to resist wrinkles. This would be perfect for traveling! My daughter loves it and is very pleased with it.

title: Nice Canvas Tote
text: This is a nice, canvas tote. The Tommy Hilfiger name is not too big and obvious. The bag is very sturdy. The handles are strong and attached securely. They are a good length and fit comfortably over the shoulders. There's a zippered pocket inside as well as a slip in pocket. There's a small pocket on the outside. The bag zips close so things will stay secure. This is a good, multi-purpose tote bag.

title: Sturdy Tote Bag
text: This Tommy Hilfiger tote bag is very sturdy. It has a canvas base with a vinyl or poly type body. The material seems water resistant. There's an eyelet/floral design. The handles are very strong and securely fastened to the bag. I really like the branding label on it. It's a "property of" square on the front, top center. There's a zippered pocket inside. The bottom of the bag is at least a few inches wide and the bag can easily accommodate a lot of belongings, including my 17 inch laptop. It's really a nice bag!

title: Unflattering
text: My daughter graduates this spring. Her cap and gown will be white and she has to wear a white dress underneath it. She is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds right now. She wears a size medium/8 in most clothes. I ordered a medium for her in this dress. It was way too large on her. I was had to grab several inches in back to bring it to where it looked good. The dress is pretty shapeless, unless you pull it even tighter. Even if the size had fit, I think it would still be very unflattering. It's boxy looking. The material is linen and it is lined nicely. It does wrinkle easily and would require ironing. The construction seems good.

title: Comfortable, But Not Very Cooling!
text: I recently threw out a lot of my 21 year old son's underwear because they were too worn and many had holes. He does like these. The material is light weight and they are comfortable to wear. They're not any more cooling than other similar underwear and they do get sweaty when physically active. The fit is good. The waist band is comfortable. They prevent him from chaffing. Overall, he likes them.

title: Great Fit!
text: We've had a lot of rain this spring and this has been quite handy at bus duty. I wear a size 16/XL in clothing. This is a 2X and fits well. There's plenty of room to wear a bulky sweater underneath. I think if I had gotten a 1X, I would be uncomfortable. The length is good. I was unfamiliar with the fishtail cut in the back, so I did look that up. I think this is more for a fashion look, than a functional fishtail as the fishtail has a military background. It does allow you to the longer length to be freeing and not restraining. The material lets the water just run off you, but it also doesn't allow air to circulate much either. Overall, it's a good rain coat.

title: Light Weight Shirt
text: This is a good, light weight men's shirt. It's perfect for hot summer weather. The large size is a little big on my husband. He's 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. He can wear some mediums, but when ordering online I always go with large because you never know. Some mediums can be too tight across the chest on him. While this is a little big, it's not overly baggy. The material is soft. The Izod logo (IZ) is on the chest. The construction of the shirt is fine.

title: Slim Wallet
text: This is a good, slim wallet. My husband doesn't keep a lot of cards in his wallet, so he was able to add all of his cards taking up about half of the slots. When more cards are in it, it does get tighter which affects removing and replacing the cards. So in my opinion, the capacity is less than the slots provided. The wallet smells like real leather. It looks good. I can't really test the RFID capabilities, but it's good to have.

title: Subtle Branding
text: This Tommy bag has a somewhat subtle branding. It's covered in the TH initials, but there's none of the red/white/blue striping on the outside that I associate with the label. There's a zippered pocket inside as well as outside on the front. There's also an interior slip-in pocket too. The zippers glide effortlessly. The bag is made well. The straps are a faux leather (I think) and are adjustable. Overall, it's a cute, nice mini backpack.

title: Cute Raincoat!
text: I've been wanting a nice raincoat to wear when I'm helping with bus duty at school. I am a size 16/XL. This 1X fits with a little room to spare, but if I was wearing a bulky sweater, it would be too snug. The material overall is heavier than I expected it to be. It repels water pretty well. It doesn't all much ventilation. Overall, it's a good raincoat.

title: Just Okay
text: I am a fan of the Tommy Hilfiger brand. I have ordered a few different bags in the past and this one has to be my least favorite. It's just okay. The bag just doesn't have the look or feel of the Tommy brand in my opinion. The quality of the bag is fine. The nylon bag is easy to clean. I don't care for the camouflage print but that's a personal issue. The straps are sturdy and seem to be secured well. I would prefer a little longer straps, but these do fit over my shoulder satisfactorily. I do like the inside lining. There are some inner pockets with one being a zippered one. There's a key strap so you won't lose your keys. There's an outer pocket as well. It's a good size tote, but my 17 inch laptop does not fit in it, though it was close. You could easily fit a tablet, magazine, book, and more inside. The only exterior branding is a TH tag clipped onto one of the straps. As I said, it's okay, I'm just not crazy about it.

title: Nice Size!
text: Crossbody style purses are great for traveling. I feel safer keeping my purse close to my body. This is a nice size and will hold a decent amount of items. My regular wallet is too fat for this, but I can swap out into a thinner one when using this. It will hold a thin wallet, a cell phone and a few other necessities. There's a zipper pocket and a regular pocket inside and both sides have an outer pocket. The strap is securely attached with sturdy hardware. I did have problems with the zipper at first, but found that the "tail" of the zipper was pushed inside the purse. When I pulled it out, it was easy to zip and unzip without any problems. It may not be the intent of the design for it to be out, but it works better that way. The "TH" monogram on a tag is pretty much the only telltale sign that it's a Tommy bag. Overall, it's a good bag.

title: Nice Casual Men's Shirt
text: This is a nice, casual men's shirt. The sizing is good. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. The large is roomy, but not baggy. The sleeves length is good. Some long sleeve shirts can be too short in the sleeves. The material is okay, not very soft, but not rough either. It seems to be made well.

title: Runs Small
text: I am 5'6" and wear a size 16  or an XL in women's sizes. I like my coats to be a little larger so they aren't restrictive or tight in the arms when I am wearing layers. The 2XL fits me fine. I would be afraid the 1XL would be tight in the arms and shoulders. The jacket is made well. It looks okay on me, but it does look a bit bulky which is usually not a look I'm going for! It's a good jacket for cooler weather.

title: Dainty
text: While this is a pretty and dainty necklace, it's still a bit disappointing. The measurements are provided, so it should not be a surprise to the actual size. There's some sparkle to it, but it's difficult to distinguish separate diamonds. The chain is on the short size, but it can be extended to another inch. It is made well as far as I can tell. I am a mom and if I was given this by my young child I would fuss over it and probably wear it at least once or twice. I'm a plus sized mom and the size of the letters is just lost on me.

title: Cute Wallet!
text: This is a cute wallet. The outer material is a thin, smooth leather. It's not the thick leather that I really like, so I am assuming it's the manufactured type that uses real leather, but it is not as durable. The wallet is a good size when it opens out, however, you can't stuff it with too much because it's not expandable. I have a lot of rewards cards that I keep in my wallet and I was able to get them all in, but it's tight to zip it up. I do like that the inside is a different color which makes it easier to find things. I am not crazy about the colors, but that's a personal preference. I really like the removable wrist strap.

title: Very Small
text: These are very small and dainty earrings. They're beautiful, but really too small for me or even most adults. They would be good for a tween or teen. They are smaller than a regular pencil erase - the ones that are built into the pencils, not the caps you put on top.

title: Cute Bag!
text: This is a cute crossbody bag. The material is black canvas, with a signature Tommy red, white, & blue strap and decor. The strap is adjustable so you can get it at the right length for you. There's an outside pocket that can easily accommodate a mobile phone. Inside the bag there is a pocket on each side, with one being a zippered one.  Overall, I do like the bag, but because it's a dark canvas material, it does show dirt easily.

title: Perfect for Teens or Tweens
text: I was a little disappointed with these earrings. They are pretty and dainty, but the pictures for the item must have been greatly enlarged. In person, I cannot see any difference between the diamonds and the silver. There's hardly any sparkle either. The actual size is just a tad smaller than my pinky nail. I think these would be perfect for a teen or tween. As an adult, I would be disappointed to receive these from my spouse. I do like that they are sterling silver. Don't get me wrong, they are nice looking earrings, but if you're looking for sparkly diamond earrings, keep looking.

title: Supportive
text: My 17 year old daughter loves to wear sports bras. She really likes the mesh back of this one. It offers adequate support and comfort for everyday wear or moderate activity. The medium size fits as expected. The straps are adjustable.

title: Great Fit!
text: These socks fit as expected. They are pretty thin and  light weight.  They are mostly no-show. If they were totally no-show, they would feel like they were coming off all the time. My husband likes them.

title: Runs Large
text: My husband is 6'2" and weighs 195 pounds. He can wear some mediums in shirts, but they are often a little snug on him, so I order larges. This large is a bit big on him. So either this runs large, or it's one of the "vanity sizing" garments where clothing items are intentionally sized to make us feel better. The shirt is made well. The color is a soft, pale peachy-yellow. It's light weight and will be perfect for summer weather.

title: Nice Grippy Feature
text: When I ordered these, I didn't realize that they were medium sized. I wear a size 10W women's shoe. These fit, but are snug on me. They are not uncomfortable, but the snuggness is noticeable. They have a nice grippy feature, though the grippy stripes are only at the top quarter of the socks near the toe area. They are marked with L & R. I ended up giving them to my 17 year old daughter who wears a size 9 shoe and they do fit better on her.

title: Great Pants!
text: My husband has been a band dad for the last several years which involves building marching band props and such. He likes wearing cargo pants when he's helping out because they are usually more durable and they have really big pockets to hold stuff. These cargo pants are great! They are everything he expects in a cargo pant. The material is thick and provides more protection from minor mishaps (such as splinters and scrapes) than regular khaki pants. They fit as expected.

title: Nice Leggings
text: These fit more like leggings than some athletic pants. It says they are cropped, but my were to my ankles (I'm 5'7"). The material is thick and not transparent. I wear a women's size 16 and the 1X fit me snuggly, but wearable. Because they are like leggings, I probably won't wear them out in public, but they will be great for exercising at home.

title: Not What I Expected
text: These shoes are not what I expected. They have a cheap feel and look to them. I was excited to try them because I have been looking for casual loafer type shoes. I remember wearing boat shoes many years ago and liking them. I wear a women's size 10 Wide shoe. This was supposed to be a men's 8 (which is what I wear in men's shoes) , but I couldn't even get them on my feet. There's also, no support at all in them, so even if they did fit, I probably wouldn't wear them much.

title: Attractive Scarf!
text: This is an attractive infinity scarf. The fabric is light weight and soft. It's a gauzy type fabric, so it's great for spring and summer months. It's on the transparent side, so you can see through it. The print goes through to the other side, but I can't really tell much of a difference between the two sides (front and back). It really dresses up an outfit!

title: Beautiful Ring!
text: This is a beautiful ring. It's dainty and not ostentatious. My 17 year old daughter has been wearing this and really likes it. I have no way to judge the quality of the diamonds, but from my point of you, they look nice.

title: Well Made Pants
text: These performance pants are well made. The ponte material is thick enough that they're not see-through which is important to me when it comes to activity/fitness pants. The length is a little long. I am 5'6" and they reach below my ankle a little bit. If I pull them up a little higher, they don't reach the floor. Wearing shoes helps, too. There are no pockets, but I have found that most performance pants don't have them. I currently wear a size 16 in women's clothing and the XL's fit as this style of pants should on me.

title: Good Basic Black Shirt
text: This is a good, basic black shirt. It has a fitted style to it, so it does show curves and such. I am currently a size 16 and the XL fit as expected. I would probably be fine in a size larger and since it's a clingy style, I don't think it would be baggy. The material is perfect for traveling because it doesn't wrinkle too much.

title: Nice Socks!
text: These are nice, thin white socks. The quality is good as I expected with the Gold Toe brand. I wear a size 10W shoe and these fit me, but I don't think they could stretch much more to accommodate a larger foot.

title: Great Casual Belt!
text: This is a great casual belt. The leather feels authentic. The decorative stitching is creates a nice look. The buckle is sturdy. The belt fits as expected.

title: Comfortable Fit!
text: My 17 year old daughter loves sports bras. She wears them whenever she can get away with it. This offers plenty of support. The sizing is accurate. She is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears a 34C-D bra size and usually wears medium sports bras. This fit as expected. There is a visible tag which impacts the reversibility of the item. I will probably try to remove it for her.

title: Comfortable Fit!
text: These boxer briefs look nice. In fact, they're a big improvement on what my husband was wearing. He likes the length of the shorts. They fit as expected on my 6'2"/195 pound husband. There are 3 pairs in this set.

title: Good Fit!

Overall, this is a good, casual men's shirt.

title: Nice Belt!

title: Great Jacket!
text: This is a great jacket! It's a true to size fit. It's made well. The zipper glides nicely. The seams are securely sewn. It's great for any young Adidas fan.

title: Comfortable Fit!
text: My teenage daughter loves to wear leggings. She especially likes the ones with mesh pieces. From a mom's point of view, these are acceptable. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. . Construction seems to be pretty good.

title: Comfortable!

title: Nice Length

title: Excellent Quality!

title: Cute Sports Bra!

title: Love!

title: Great Fit!

It's a good looking coat and provides lots of warmth.

title: Great Fit!
text: My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. The large size is comfortable on him and not baggy. The color is not a solid black, but more of a charcoal with a textured look. The logo is subtle. It's a nice shirt and perfect for casual wear.

title: Excellent Quality!

title: Cute & Comfortable!
text: These flip flops, although pretty basic, are cute and comfortable! My daughter wears a size 9 shoe and these fit her as expected. These look like leather and definitely could be worn with somewhat nicer outfits compared to the cheap plastic flip flops.

title: Great Fit!
text: My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She usually wears a size 8 in jeans/pants. These are a great fit on her. She usually gravitates toward lighter denim, so this was new to her. So be sure to wash them before wearing! She is very happy with these!

title: Plenty of Room

title: Great for Layering!
text: These tank tops are great for layering without extra bulk. They're too thin to wear on their own, but perfect under something else. They do run a little small, but they do stretch plenty. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds.  The mediums work for her. They hit her at the top of her waist, so they can't really be tucked in, but she's fine with that. The variety of colors is good.

title: Excellent Quality!
text: My college age son was in need of a new casual belt recently. He's been very pleased with this one. It's thick and sturdy, yet flexes nicely to go through the belt loops. It is an excellent quality belt and  fits as expected. This is much nicer than the ones that I have gotten him at the local discount stores in the past.

title: Really Cute Swimsuit Top!
text: This is a really cute swimsuit top!  It fits perfectly! It looks more like a baby doll style nightie item than swimwear. I personally would not wear it out in public, but it's great for the home hot tub! However, if I was younger (and more confident), then I could see wearing this out in public.

title: Soft Fabric
text: When I first opened this, I thought that there was no way that the XL would fit my size 16 body. However, it does stretch quite a bit and I was able to fit into it. It's not a flattering look by itself for someone my age, but I could definitely wear it underneath something. The description says it has a shelf support, but there's really no support at all. The fabric is soft. I would like something a little longer, but the length is adequate. I wouldn't want anything shorter.

title: Nice Material, But Does Wrinkle
text: I ordered my actual size rather than ordering up or down. I've had other Amazon Essential clothing items and their sizing seems to be pretty accurate. I currently wear a size XL or 16 in women's sizing. The sleeves on this shirt were too tight that I couldn't even get the shirt on to see about the rest of the fit. Other than the sizing, the shirts seems to be okay. The material is nice, but it does wrinkle as one might expect from oxford cloth. Buttons are securely attached. Seams are fine.

title: Comfortable!
text: These are really nothing more than basic sweatpants. They are a little larger than expected, but they are a comfortable fit. My son is 6' and weighs about 290 pounds. These 2XL pants are baggy on him. They're well made. My son's cell phone fits in the pocket.

title: Warm & Comfy Shirt
text: Usually flannel shirts are plaid, so I was thrilled to find a solid color one for my husband. He's 6'2" and weighs about 190 pounds. The large size isn't over sized or baggy as some large sizes are on him. The sleeve length is good, too. The shirt is warm and comfy. It's a good casual shirt.

title: Great Fit!
text: This shirt is soft and light weight. It has a great fit. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She normally wears mediums in shirts and this shirt fits just as expected. She has to wear all black to her winter guard rehearsals.  This is perfect for that. It's long enough to cover her back when she's stretching and dancing. She likes this shirt a lot!

title: Fun Assortment of Kids Socks
text: This is a fun assortment of kids socks. They are mid-weight and comparable to ones that you might pick up at the local store. They aren't  thick or cushioned, but they are soft. The designs are bright and colorful.

title: These Work Well
text: I ordered these for my teenage daughter. She's 17 and has average sized teenage girl hands. The men's small fit her just fine. They have a gender neutral look to them. I tried them on myself, and they were too small for my large mom hands. These work well as far as allowing her to use her phone. Every once in a while, she notices that she has to try again because it didn't recognize the motion, but most of the time it does just fine. They keep her hands warm enough.

title: Great for Travel!
text: This coat is not only cute, but it's warm, too. It's great for travel because it can squish and compact into the small bag that comes with it. The fit is as expected. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. The medium fits her perfectly, and even allows room for an extra layer if she needs it. It's well made. The zipper glides nicely. Overall, it's a wonderful winter coat!

title: Good Looking Shirt!
text: This is a good looking shirt! The sizing runs true. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. He wears shirts in sizes medium and large depending on how the sizing runs. This large fits well. There's no gaping or puckering at the buttons. The arm length is good on him, too. The shirt really is easy care which he is enjoying. I don't iron his shirts, so this saves him some time since he does his own ironing. He is very pleased with this shirt.

title: Great Fit!
text: A button down short sleeve shirt is a staple in my husband's warm weather wardrobe. He prefers solid colors such as this, which have been hard to find in the local stores lately. All he's been able to find are plaids and ginghams. This large fits him very well. He's 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. It doesn't gape or pucker. He is very pleased with it and since there is a nice selection of colors, I will be ordering him more in the future.

title: Nice Looking Shorts!
text: These are some nice looking shorts! They are a little dressier than my husband usually wears, but they look good on him. They are a tad bit large in the waist. I'm assuming they are "vanity sized" which I recently learned they do with men's clothes, too! My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. A size 33 pants/shorts would probably be best for him, but they're hard to find, so I usually end up getting him 34's. These are a little loose on him, but they are not baggy or sloppy looking. The shorts are made well. The color is more of a grey color than navy, in my opinion. Regardless, they're good looking shorts and my husband likes them.

title: Comfortable Socks!
text: These are extremely comfortable socks! They have the additional ribbing around the arch area that provides support and comfort. The dry wick fabric is soft and does a great job of keeping the feet dry. They fit well, as expected. These are perfect for casual or athletic wear. My husband likes these a lot.

title: Very Nice!
text: These are very nice dress pants. They are a soft wool, that doesn't scratch or annoy. There's enough stretch that allows movement. The construction is very good and I would say that these are very high quality. The size fits as expected. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 192 pounds. The 34x34 fit well on him.

title: Great Quality
text: My 17 year old daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears a size medium in most shorts/legging type pants. She loves the way these fit. The fabric is soft and comfortable. They stretch enough to allow her to move. They are made well, too. She made the comment that "Amazon Essentials has some really nice clothes!" Right now her favorite jeggings and now these shorts are both by the Amazon Essentials brand.

title: Fits Well
text: My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 192 pounds. He usually wears mediums and larges in t-shirts, but in button down or other fitted shirts, he wears larges. Though some larges end up being baggy on him. This fits well. The arm length is also good on him. The fabric is comfortable. It has a heathered look to it which is nice. Overall it's a good, casual shirt that he can wear to work.

title: Light Weight Fabric
text: These pull on pants are comfortable to wear. The fabric is light weight and a bit thin. I wear size 16 pants and the XL fits just fine. They are not tight in the seat or thighs. I am 5'6" and the length is good. They go past my ankles just a little and brush the top of my foot. These are perfect for lounging or exercise.

title: Comfortable Fit!
text: I wear a size 16 pants and the XL fit me well. The microfiber material is pretty soft and thin. There is some cotton type fabric at the crotch area. I wear a panty liner every day and they have been staying in place. The waist band elastic is very small/thin and I was worried that I would have to keep pulling it up, but it stays in place without any problems. They don't ride up either which is pretty important to me. I put them on and I honestly don't have to readjust them. They have a comfortable fit for all day.

title: Clips on Easily
text: My old glasses were transitionals and I loved them! But in an effort to save money, my new pair doesn't have that feature. I thought this would be an acceptable substitution and it is. While it doesn't look as nice as a pair of actual sunglasses, they do work as expected. They are easy to clip onto my glasses. They are a little larger than the lenses of my glasses. I'm not used to polarized lenses, so I'm having to get used to that, but they do provide protection from the sun and that's what I wanted them for!

title: Well Thought Out Piece of Luggage
text: This suitcase has just about everything you would need in a suitcase. There's a small garment bag for suits, there's a removable packing cube, and even a small pocket on the inside wall designated for your Swiss Army knife! I was very impressed with the TSA lock on the zipper. I had never seen one of those before. The wheels glide really smoothly. The handle escalates without any hitching. Overall, it's a well thought out piece of luggage with a very good design.

title: Comfortable to Wear
text: My husband had gotten lax about wearing sunglasses, so it wasn't a surprise when he developed a cataract at a somewhat early age. Of course, since his surgery last year, he has been very good about wearing sunglasses! He finds these to be quite comfortable to wear. The arms are fairly sturdy and the hinges operate well and are not loose or weak feeling. They provide adequate shading and allow him to drive or work without any complications. He was impressed with the glasses case that came with them.

title: Thick Material
text: This is a good quality, men's polo shirt. The material is thicker than a lot of polo shirts. Sizing is as expected. My husband may have been able to get by with a smaller size, but that's often risky, so we round up. He is 6'2" and weighs about 192 pounds. He is really right in the middle between medium and large shirt sizes. It is a little big on him, but not sloppy baggy. The length is good. Overall, it's a nice men's shirt.

title: Sharp Looking!
text: This is one sharp looking suitcase! It looks like a high end brand. The size is perfect for weekend trips, though I will admit to using a similar sized piece of luggage for a week in Spain last year! It can be done! It is easy to move and control directions. The handle pulls up without hitching. Inside it has pockets and separated compartments. Zippers glide well. I am very impressed with this suitcase.

title: Great Fit!
text: My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 192 pounds. His perfect sizing would be somewhere between a medium and a large. He's too broad for a lot of mediums, but larges are often too wide. This large polo style shirt is a little wide on him, but not excessively. It doesn't look baggie pr sloppy on him at all. It's definitely roomy and not form fitting. As with most white shirts, it is a little see through and he has to wear an undershirt with it. He tends to do that anyway, so that's not any issue for him. It's a light weight shirt and comfortable to wear. The company name is on the front chest. Overall, it's a nicely made shirt that's perfect for casual wear.

title: Handsome Sweater!
text: I ordered this sweater for my husband. I must say that I absolutely love it on him! It is such a handsome look. My husband is 52 and fairly gray. It has the classic look of a college professor and even has elbow patches. He personally isn't too crazy about the elbow patches, but I think it looks great! The sweater is made well. It's a mid-weight garment. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 192 pounds. The size large fits nicely and leaves enough room for an additional layer to be worn underneath without being too baggy on him.

title: Comfortable Socks!
text: I'm a fan of Gold Toe socks. My husband has worn them for years. I have gotten 2 packages before this. One I loved, the other was okay. These are ones that I love. They are great casual socks. They are comfortable to wear and look great! I wear a size 10W shoe and these fit me fine. I know that it says they are for up to size 9, but I don't have any issues. The heel lines up where it's supposed to. I don't wear them all the way up, I just fold them down at the ankle. They're well made and are a good quality.

title: Great Fit!
text: I was pleasantly surprised with how well these pants fit. They are comfortable and perfect to wear to work. They give a good shape, too. The only thing I would change would be the length. They weren't short by any means, but they were a little shorter than I am used to. I'm 5'6" and usually pants are either a little long or just right. It could have been because they are straight leg rather than boot cut so they hang closer to my leg. It really wasn't a problem, just an observation. I would definitely consider ordering them in another color.

title: Love it!
text: My daughter is going to New York this winter. I wanted her to have a good winter coat to take with her. We live in the South and our winters are pretty mild, so she doesn't really own the right kind of outerwear for her trip. This is perfect! She wears a size medium in most clothing. I ordered a size up because I personally find that with outerwear, you need to consider how bulky your clothing is and when you get the same size as you usually wear, it often is too tight or binding. I'm glad that I did size up. It fits perfectly over her clothing, even when she's wearing layers. It's not over-sized either. The coat is super soft. The length is long and on her it hits about mid-thigh. It packs down to fit in the little bag that comes with it. It won't take up much room in her suitcase at all! We've been having below normal temperatures this week, so she tested it outside and was very glad to have it. She said it kept her warm and she appreciated the longer length. Now I want one!

title: Effective!
text: The past week or so we have had a lot of rain. I work in a high school that has multiple buildings, so I have to walk outside several times a day. With all the rain, my shoes have been soaked which is not a good feeling! I've been able to come home and dry my shoes in a relatively short amount of time. In the past, we would set up a fan to dry our shoes which would take a while.  It was easy to set up and even easier to use. It does make some noise, so we have it set up in the garage on the workbench. The deodorizer feature is pretty nifty. We've tried that out on our stinky gym shoes. It didn't completely eliminate the odor, but it did make a big difference.

title: Adorable!
text: This is an adorable set for style savvy babies. It comes with 2 cotton onesies. One is black with a white branding name, and the other is grey with black name. There's a white and grey beanie with black writing. The onesies are sized 3-6 months, but when comparing them to other brand onesies, they do seem a little smaller. They are pretty basic, but for label conscious shoppers, it will be a hit!

title: Cute Sweater!
text: This is a very cute and youthful looking sweater. My 17 year old daughter likes it for the most part. The mock neck is a little too big in her opinion. She would prefer either a crew neck or a true turtleneck style. The length hits right at her waist and she would prefer something a little longer. If she raises her arms up over her head, it shows skin. She has worn this with jeggings and boots  and it makes a cute outfit. It's made well. Sizing is good. She is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She usually wears mediums in tops and this fits as expected for a medium.

title: Exactly What My Daughter Wanted!
text: With the colder temperatures we currently have, my 17 year old daughter has been wanting a good scarf. We've been looking at the local stores, but she hadn't found what she wanted. They were either not the right type (she wanted a knit one) or they were too expensive ($15 to $19 just for a scarf!). This is exactly what she wanted! And for the price, it comes with a matching hat. There is nothing fancy about the scarf - there's no fringe or decoration. It's just a plain, knit scarf and she loves it! The hat is cute, too. Her winter coat is black, so she wants me to order another set but in a different color now.

title: Long Length
text: I am 5'6" and wear size 16 pants. For length, I usually go with regular. These fit well in everywhere except the length. They are a bit on the long side. I even double checked the tags to make sure that I didn't accidently receive tall/long pants. If I pull up on the legs a bit, I can get it so they aren't dragging. The fabric is comfortable. These don't really wrinkle, so they're great for traveling. There are no pockets, so I have to find something to do with my mobile phone when I wear these. The quality is excellent and if the length was better, I would give these 5 stars.

title: Great Quality
text: I have recently discovered Gold Toe socks for myself. My husband has been a fan of them for years. I wear a size 10W shoe. These are for sizes 8 to 13. These fit fine, but maybe a little on the big side. I like the fit of some other Gold Toe socks that I have (size 6-9) better. When I wear shoes, it's fine, but when I am at home and I take my shoes off, I find myself adjusting them frequently. The quality is great. They're thin, but still comfortable.

title: Comfortable Fit!
text: These pull on pants are very comfortable! I wear a size 16, so I ordered these in the 14's. For the most part, the fit is good. I have thick calves and these are snug in the lower legs. It's to the point where they don't look as nice on me as they do in the pictures. They look more like leggings than pants. I will still wear them because they are so comfortable. There are no pockets which is pain. I prefer to keep my phone on my all day when I at work, so that's a potential issue for me. The pants are made very well. Overall, I like them.

title: Comfortable Fit!
text: My son is a big guy. He prefers boxer brief style underwear because it helps prevent chaffing. The material of this is soft and breathable. They feel dry even when he's been sweating. The fit is good as expected.  The waist band is comfortable and non-binding. He really likes these!

title: Excellent Quality
text: I got this for my 20 year old son. He had a cheap luggage set that was probably about $50 for 3 pieces. Those pieces are still around, but they are very poor quality. One has lost a wheel. The soft case is looking rough. A zipper pull has come off. It's really a mess. This one piece of luggage is so much nicer! The quality is excellent, especially when compared to his old set. It glides really nicely. The handle comes out without any snagging or hitching. The zippers are sturdy and open/close easily. The size is perfect for use as a carry on bag. There are storage areas inside which the other cheap bag did not have any. It really is a matter of "you get what you pay for". This bag should last a lifetime!

title: Super Soft!
text: I love this robe! It's super soft and comfy. It's longer than other robes that I have, which is great for the winter. It goes below the knee. The picture is pretty accurate regarding the length.  I ordered this in a large. I'm a plus sized mom who wears XL or size 14/16. This robe fits me fine. It completely closes without gaping. I love it!

title: Best Socks Ever!
text: I have never worn Gold Toe socks before. I get them a lot for my husband, so I am quite familiar with them.But this is my first experience with them and  I am absolutely in love with these socks! First of all, I was surprised that they fit me. I wear a size 10W shoe. They stretch enough to fit my feet without feeling tight. The heel lines up properly with my heel. They stay in place pretty well, too. They're  very comfortable. I've been wearing them to work. I may have to order some more!!

title: Great Quality
text: We're way past the stage of carrying a diaper bag (my kids are 17 & 20), but when we went to Disney over the summer, I still ended up carrying a big ole' backpack around with me. This is a great alternative to that. There's more room in it than what I have in my crossbody  purse. And since you wear it like a backpack, it's easy to bring with you. The nylon material is pretty durable. While I couldn't see anything about it being water proof, it's definitely an improvement over my quilted fabric purse. The hardware on this is very sturdy and has heavy feel to it (in a good way). There's a zippered pocket inside, along with some slip in pockets as well. This looks nice enough to be used for dressy or casual outings. The Tommy logo/branding is pretty subtle too. I am very pleased with this and plan to use it on our upcoming trips.

title: Nice Fit!
text: My daughter loves leggings and has just recently discovered jeggings. They fit like leggings, but they look like jeans! These black jeggings fit as expected. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She's a size 8/medium. These say that they are 8's on the tags, but the description says medium. Either way, they fit as expected. They're really tight at the ankle at first. She had difficulties pulling them over her foot. However, once on, they are not tight. They do slouch a bit at the ankle. The pictures on the description are accurate. She's 5'7" and the length is good. They do need to be washed once or twice before wearing them to get rid of some of the excess black dye. Other than that, she's been happy with these.

title: Fits as Expected
text: My 20 year old son is a big guy. It's hard to find good fitting pants for him. These fit really well on him. The fabric is a good mid-weight and has a little stretch to it. The waistband is comfortable. They do wrinkle easily. He probably won't ever iron them, so that's just something he'll have to deal with. The construction is good. Seams are straight. No loose stitching. Zipper is strong and glides well. Overall, we're pleased with them.

title: Great for Casual Dress
text: My husband loves these socks! They are great for casual dress. Now that he's over 50, he won't wear jeans anymore. So he wears khakis or carpenter style pants. The assortment of colors goes well with his wardrobe. They have a nice thickness to them without being too thick or too thin. He wears a size 11 1/2 shoe and these fit him well. The quality of them is what I would expect from the Gold Toe brand.

title: Runs a Bit Small
text: My 17 year old daughter wears mediums or 8's in pants. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She was able to get these on, but they were a bit snug on her, but not to the point that they were uncomfortable. They are looser, almost baggy in the thigh area. She likes these enough that she said she'll wear them at home or on weekends. I'm not a fan of lots of distressing in denim, but she likes it.

title: Darling Bag!
text: My 17 year old daughter loves the Tommy Hilfiger brand. She squealed (an actual squeal!) when I showed her this. While it's not large enough to be a regular backpack, it's the perfect size for her to use when going out with friends, or to carry her winter guard practice clothes with her after school. She doesn't carry a purse with her yet, but for someone who does, this is a great size for that. It doesn't have the traditional Tommy flag logo. There's a "TH" charm on the outer pocket. Inside, there is a leather tag that has "Tommy Hilfiger" spelled out. In addition to the outer pocket, there's a zippered pocket inside as well as another pocket.

title: Runs a Bit Small
text: I wear a size misses XL or 16 in clothing. I have a few Daily Rituals shirts, and they are all what I would call a generous fit, so I did not consider sizing up with this. Unfortunately for me, this coat runs small. It's not just an issue with wearing bulky clothes either. It's way too tight in the arms to the point where I can't even pull the rest of the jacket on even when wearing a thin t-shirt. Now regarding the quality, it's really nice. It's not too thick. The construction is good. Just think about ordering a size up!

title: Comfortable!
text: I am 5'6" and wear a size 16 in most pants/jeans. I ordered a size down as recommended by the seller and that worked perfectly. The pants are comfortable to wear. The fabric doesn't wrinkle, so they would be perfect for traveling. Because of the style of pants, these look more like leggings than pants on me. They're not tight at all. These would be good work pants.

title: My Teen's Favorite Jeans!
text: These are basically leggings made from denim with pockets, so they're called jeggings. My 17 year old daughter loves leggings, so I thought these might be a good match for her. They have quickly become her favorite jeans! It really surprised me. In some clothing, she's really into brands. She likes wearing the right labels. So the fact that these are the Amazon Essentials clothing line didn't matter because she loves them so much. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. The medium size fits her perfectly, even in the length. With most jeans, she complains that the length is too short in regular pants and if I get her longs, they're often too long. I think she's on the border between the two length sizes. She is very happy where these hit her on the ankle. The construction is good. They wash well. It looks like I may be ordering more of these in the future!

title: Great Fit!
text: My 20 year old son is a big guy. It's hard to find good fitting pants and shorts for him. These have a great fit on him. They length is longer what it looked like in the pictures, which is good. It's a fairly standard length, but the pictures make them look short, but they're not. The waist band is comfortable. The construction is good and they wash well. He is very pleased with these and I am pleased to see that Tommy Hilfiger makes good Big & Tall clothing for men.

title: Nice Quality!
text: My son is a big guy. He's 6 foot tall and weighs about 280 pounds. He usually wears 2XL sized shirts. This XL fits well, so it might be a bit over sized. It's not tight across the chest or stomach area. It's great for layering! He has to wear a white shirt underneath is work shirt, so this works perfectly for that. The shirt is made well and is a nice quality.

title: Thin, But Warm
text: I was hoping this jacket would fit me, but unfortunately it does not. It would be perfect for morning bus duty at school.  My loss is my husband's gain! I'm a plus size mom and I wear a size 16 in women's or an XL. Usually men's larges will fit me, but this was too tight in the arms/shoulders for me. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 192 pounds. It fit him well without any issues. The coat is very thin, but it does provide nice warmth. Temperatures here have dropped quite a lot over the past week or so, so this jacket has come in handy. My husband really likes the large inside pocket which is big enough to hold his phone and a portable power supply easily.

title: Cute Scarf!
text: This is a cute, light weight scarf. The fabric is sheer. The print images are seen on both sides. The colors are pretty accurate in the pictures. The edges are frayed and unfinished which gives it a shabby chic look. The fabric doesn't seem to wrinkle easily and any wrinkles that have developed are pretty well masked by the print.

title: Super Soft!
text: This is a nice, flowy top. The XL size is roomy and fits me pretty well. I could probably go a little smaller, but I would hate to risk getting a somewhat tight fitting shirt.
