The fabric is super soft. The shirt is a little longer than I usually wear, but it covers everything it should. It is nice enough that I can wear it to work (I work in a school).

title: Comfortable
text: My son is a big guy and prefers boxer brief style underwear. Because of his size, he tends to chafe, so that style helps prevent that. These are a little shorter than some of the other boxer briefs that he's tried, but they are more than long enough to prevent from chaffing. The waist band is comfortable and doesn't bind. He prefers these over some Calvin Klein boxer briefs that he has.

title: Comfortable Arch
text: My husband wears a lot of low cut socks. These fit his 11.5/12 size feet well with a little room that could accommodate a larger foot size. He really likes the arch support that's built in to them. He walks around in his socks at home, so I love that they're grey and not white! They are thick enough for comfort, but not too thick that they interfere with the shoe's fit. He is very pleased with these.

title: Comfortable Waist Band
text: My 20 year old son is a big guy. He has problems finding pants that fit him well. If he wears pants that fit his waist, they are too big everywhere else. He tends to wear his pants under his stomach, not at his stomach. These fit him well in that manner. The waist band is very comfortable and doesn't bind. He has to wear khaki pants to work, so he is pleased to have a new pair that is actually comfortable.

title: Comfortable Fit!
text: My 20 year old son prefers boxer style briefs such as these over other types of underwear. He found these to be extremely comfortable. The size fits well as expected. They look longer in person than in the pictures, but he likes that. He's a big guy and has chaffing issues sometimes, so the longer length helps prevent that. They wash well with no obvious shrinking.

title: Cute Retro Print
text: While I really like the cute retro print of this tankini, I was quite disappointed in the fit. I wear a size 16/38DD/XL.  I usually size up when it comes to swimsuits, so the 2XL is what I would go with. The bottoms were a little big, but they would work, except I didn't like the ruffles at all. The top was too small, not just in the cups, but everywhere. It was too tight in the middle and the material didn't stretch well. The cups were too small, I was pouring out of them which is not an attractive look. The construction seemed to be fine. It might be better if the pieces were sold separately. You might have better luck at getting the right fit.

title: Runs a Bit Small
text: I love the retro look of this halter swim suit. The floral print is very cute. Construction seems to be fine. I didn't notice any flaws. The sizing runs a little small, but I did take that into consideration when ordering it. I wear a size 16/XL. This is a 2XL. The fit is pretty good - not great. My swimsuit wearing is usually limited to our outdoor hot tub. I would definitely wear it there. I'm not sure if I would wear it in public or not. It's a little more revealing than I prefer.

title: Great Fit!
text: My 17 year old daughter wears leggings a lot. These have a great fit. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. They hit her at the top of her ankles which is acceptable for her. (She's picky about pant lengths!). The material is an average, mid weight fabric. They're not see through and they do allow her plenty of movement. My daughter is happy with them.

title: Nice Hawaiian Print
text: My husband enjoys button down shirts. He has a few Hawaiian style shirts, but he's picky about them. This fabric is linen and a little heavier than some similar shirts. It is a fairly breathable fabric. This print is subdued compared to others. He prefers calmer looking ones, so that's good. It fits well on him. He's 6'2" and weighs 192 pounds. The buttons lay flat and do not gape or pull. The overall quality of the shirt is pretty good, too.

title: Fits Well
text: My husband is 6'2" and weighs 191 pounds. This fits very well on him. He sometimes has issues with slim fitting shirts, so this regular fit works great! The aqua color looks really sharp on him with his graying hair. The shirt is made well. Buttons are securely attached. Stitching is good. The shirt does wrinkle so it does require ironing. He would definitely consider ordering this shirt in another color.

title: Excellent Quality
text: My 20 year old son is a big guy. This fits as expected. It's long enough and plenty wide.  He is a college student and likes wearing polo shirts to class. This one is very well made and an excellent quality. It's a good weight and not too light. My son does like wearing t-shirts underneath his polos and this has enough room that it's not crowded.

title: Easy to Put On!
text: I work in a special ed classroom. Last month our weekly lesson on our News to You was about the Tommy Line of adaptive clothing. While we enjoyed learning about this new line of clothing, we weren't exactly sure how the magnets worked in the clothing. When I showed the students and other teachers this cute shirt, it all made sense to everyone. This shirt is not only cute, but it really is easier for dressing. Several of our students need help getting dressed. One of the issues is definitely being able to pull shirts over their heads.  The magnets allow you to increase the size of the opening where the head goes to allow the shirt to go on easily. The quality of the shirt is excellent and what I would expect from the Tommy Hilfiger name. The heart image does have glitter, but the glitter isn't coming off and getting on things like some shirts. One of teachers has a little girl with Down's Syndrome. She was absolutely tickled with this shirt and loved being able to get dressed on her own. I am so glad to see clothing like this out there!

title: Great for Layering!
text: My husband likes to layer his shirts. This short sleeve tech shirt is great for wearing underneath another shirt. It is a dry-fit type material so it wicks away moisture, but it doesn't feel like usual dry-fit. It feels soft and almost like cotton. The fit is great! My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 192 pounds. He wears a medium to large depending on the shirt. The large is not over sized on him, and fits almost to his body. Some large shirts have so much extra fabric on him that it's ridiculous. There's a little extra, but not too much. He likes his new shirt a lot!

title: Order a Size or Two Up
text: This is a very cute swimsuit, but unfortunately it runs very small. I'm wear a size 16/XL in most clothing and a D-cup. I always order a size up in swimsuits. This is more than 1 size larger and it still doesn't fit. I have another swimsuit in the same size from the same manufacturer and it fits. It fit my torso, but I it wouldn't cover my chest area at all.  I love the fabric print. The swimsuit itself is made well. The back is darling! Overall, I am disappointed in the fit.

title: Great Fit!
text: When I was younger, I never wore a skirt or dress without a slip. The only undergarments like this at all have been slimming ones. I haven't seen a true slip in years, so I was pleasantly surprised to see this one. The size medium fits my daughter perfectly. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears a size 8/medium in women's clothing. She's s 34D. This stays put pretty well and doesn't ride up.  The fabric is soft and the garment is made well. I'm glad to see under garments like this again!

title: Light Weight Fabric
text: My husband is an active band dad. He helps with props which involves a lot of construction and lifting. These pants have been great this band season because they are lighter weight than most cargo pants that he owns. He prefers to wear long pants to work in because of safety around the tools and equipment. Even though it's October, we're still having 80 plus degree weather, so he's appreciating the light weight. They're a little big on him  but we expected that. A waist size of 33 would work better for him, but it's harder to find that size with the 34 length. They're comfortable. There are plenty of pockets. The construction is good. Overall, they're decent work pants.

title: Compresses Nicely
text: My daughter has been wanting a down vest. I showed her this one and she loved it! She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. The men's medium fits her well. She normally wears a women's medium, but she does prefer her outerwear to be a size larger so she can wear bulky clothing such as hoodies and sweatshirts. She can easily wear this over both of those and still zip it up and it doesn't look tight. The outer nylon material is so soft! The vest compresses nicely and doesn't take up a lot of room. There's a little sack or bag that is in one of the pockets. I'm not really sure what its purpose is. It's too small to accommodate the whole vest. It's really cute on her and is perfect for the upcoming cooler weather.

title: Not Big Enough for a Weekend
text: This is a nice bag, but there's no way that I could use it as my weekend bag. It's just not big enough. It's larger than a purse, but I would classify it more as an overnight bag. The bag is made well. The zippers glide easily. The straps are securely attached. There's an inner zipper pocket and some non-zippered pockets as well. There's also a place to clip your keys. The inside has the traditional Tommy navy/patriotic vibe to it, but the outside is pretty plain with a subtle logo.

title: Cuter in Person
text: This dress is so much cuter in person! The zebra is appliqued and has some 3-D qualities. From the picture, I thought it was just a transfer type image. The dress itself is a nice quality. It's a nice casual day dress. I ordered this for my 5 year old niece. She wears a 5T. This 6/7 is a little big on her, but fits as I expected. The construction of the dress is good. We've washed it cold water and put it in the dryer on low. It held up fine to the laundering without any fading or shrinkage.

title: Fits as Expected
text: My daughter likes over sized jackets. It's easier for layering over outfits. Because this is a men's jacket, she expected it to be larger on her. She would have preferred a slightly smaller size, but this will work. Because it's bigger, she has been rolling up the sleeves which she really likes. She would not be able to do that very easily with a jacket that was her own size. The jacket is made pretty well. The worn spots are authentic looking. It looks cute on her.

title: Adorable Shoes!
text: These shoes are adorable! They are cute but athletic - perfect for any little girl who loves to run and play. They are made very well. The traction on the bottom grips nicely, but looks cute, too. The insole is not very cushioned, but there's enough support/cushion that they are comfortable. The velcro strap is sturdy and is easy to adjust. The shoes have some silvery threads that run through the outer fabric that make it sparkle.

title: Great Fit!
text: We're fans of the Adidas brand. They are well made with nice stitching. These fit as hoped. They accommodate a wider width than some brands of shoes which is one of the reasons my family loves the Adidas shoes. These have a classic Adidas look. These shoes live up to the brand name in quality and comfort.

title: Cute Swimsuit
text: My 17 year old daughter absolutely loves this swimsuit! The fruit print  is darling. The suit is very flattering and fits well. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears a medium or size 8 in most clothes. This medium fits perfectly! We both agree that the string around the top of the bottoms is a bit strange, but it doesn't look bad. It does take a few times of adjusting it to get it looking right or else it hits the hips weirdly. The top would even look cute with denim shorts.

title: Great Pants!
text: These pants are fit great! My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 193 pounds. His waist is probably more accurately a 33, but these are a 34. But because these are slim fit, they aren't baggy or big on him. They actually look really good. He's 52 and would not normally wear skinny or slim pants because those seem geared toward a younger audience. The color is gray and it's a nice alternative to the tans and khaki colors he usually wears. They are made well and are what we would expect from Dockers. He is very pleased with them and is now looking into ordering another pair in a different color.

title: Looks Cuter in Person!
text: This shirt looks better in person than in the picture. In the picture it looks kind of boxy, but in reality, it hugs your curves and looks super cute. The 7/8 size fit my daughter perfectly. She's 5'7" and wears a size medium or 8. It's long enough that it doesn't show her belly or back when she stretches. The material is soft and washes well. My daughter did have to adjust the shoulders a lot more than she expected, but other than that, it's a nice top.

title: Great for Private Hut Tub, Won't Wear it In Public!
text: I am a plus sized mom who wears sizes 14-16 in women's (not misses) or size XL/1XL. I have always had to go up a size in swimsuits, so the 2XL is what I would usually go to first. This 2XL fits me pretty well, as I expected. The swimsuit is cute, but not a great look for me. We have a hot tub and I will wear this there in the privacy of my own home, but I would not wear it in public. My bra size is a 40D/40DD. This swimsuit provides adequate coverage, but it does give any lift or support which would improve the look. Also, I felt that too much showed on the sides of the cups which isn't flattering. I did like the mesh in the front which is sexy, but at my age not appropriate in public! I've had other swimsuits that tie in the back of the neck and this one isn't that uncomfortable. Construction of the suit is fine with no loose seams or stitches. It's cute and I like it, but just won't wear it in public!

title: My Husband's New Favorite Shirt!
text: My husband is not one to care about brands and logos, but this Under Armour shirt has quickly become his new favorite shirt. He's 6'2 and weighs about 193 pounds. He wears shirts in mediums and larges depending on the fit. This large fits well and is not over sized or baggy on him. It's made well with no construction flaws. The material is light weight and wrinkle resistant. He wears it tucked in with khaki pants and looks like one of the football coaches at the high school where I work at instead of a computer programmer!

title: Great Fit!
text: My husband wears a size medium to large in shirts depending on the brand. He's 6'2 and weighs about 192 pounds. He has long arms, so usually I have to go up a size in long sleeved shirts to accommodate his arm length, but short sleeves don't have that problem. This shirt fits perfectly! The buttons lay down flat and don't gape at all. If it was a slim fit, he probably wouldn't be able to wear it, but this is great! The color is a little more vibrant than the picture shows. It's made well and doesn't have any construction issues. Although it says it's wrinkle free, my husband still irons it. He's just super picky. If it were my shirt, I wouldn't bother with that since the wrinkles are minimal. If anything, I would just toss it in the dryer again!

title: Roomy & Sturdy
text: Not all drawstring bags are equal. There are a lot of cheap, flimsy ones out there that fall apart pretty quickly. This is one of the sturdier ones. It's well made and strong. The rope straps are thick and firmly attached. One problem we've had with drawstring bags in general, is that the ropes will often come unattached from the bag. These are connected to the base of the bag very well and it does not weaken or give when pulled on at all. This has a large outer compartment that can easily hold a pair of average sized shoes. The fabric that separates the shoes from the rest of the bag is mesh, so smells and wetness could transfer over. There are water bottle pockets on the outer sides of the bag. The logo is securely affixed and there's room for personalization if desired. Overall, this is a great quality bag!

title: Comfortable Socks
text: My husband is a fan of Gold Toe socks. These are his first athletic white pair of GT socks. His others have been dress or causal work type socks. These are a little thinner that I expected for the brand, but they are made well. My husband wears a size 11.5 shoe and these fit him as expected. There's enough stretch that they could easily accommodate a larger foot. They are comfortable enough for all day wear. They wash well and have not noticed any shrinkage. Overall, a good, quality sock.

title: Comfortable!
text: These shorts are not at all what I expected. The material is a firmer, athletic dry-weave type fabric, but the style is more like casual non-athletic. My husband found them to be very comfortable. They are light weight and a nice alternative to heavier fabrics, especially in this hot weather. My husband is 6'2" and weighs 193 pounds. His waist is closer to a 33, but these size 32 shorts were actually a little large on him. The branding is not obvious. The company name is written in a tone on tone color at the waist line. The fabric doesn't wrinkle and seems to be easy easy to care for. Overall, my husband likes these shorts.

title: Cute for Tweens!
text: These are a bright white, with silver glittery fibers running through. They're not bad looking, but they definitely have a tween look to them. It says they are one size fits most, but I am not sure that's even right. They don't have much stretch to them at all. I could get them on my hands, but it wasn't easy.  And once they were on, they weren't comfortable at all. The fingers are too short. I have large hands, so I thought maybe that was the problem. I had my 17 year old daughter who has small, thin hands and they were too tight on her as well. I will probably end up giving these to my 9 year old niece. There were also a few loose threads that had to be trimmed. Overall, these are just okay.

title: Really Cute!
text: My daughter will be graduating from high school in the spring. The girls have to wear a white cap and gown so they need to wear a white dress underneath. We started looking for end of the season sales on dresses last month without any luck. I saw this and thought we could give this a try and I am so glad I did! First I have to say that it looks so much nicer in person. The pictures don't do it justice. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. Her bra is a 34 C/D (depending on the bra). This fits her perfectly! I was worried that it would be see through but it's not at all. It looks super cute on her and dressy enough for graduation when paired with the right shoes. She'll have to wear a bra with it, but I think one with similar thin white straps will be fine. She can be really picky about her clothes, but she likes it, too! It's well made as far as we can tell. Overall, this was a surprise!

title: Sturdy Backpack
text: This is a well made, sturdy backpack. There are lots of compartments though it doesn't seem to have the small slots/pockets for pens, phones, and other small items. The straps are comfortable. Zippers are strong and glide easily. The  Adidas name is on the front as well as on one of the straps on the back. The usual 3 stripes are more subtle. There are 3 black on black stripes on both of the water bottle pouches. Overall, it's a nice backpack and would work well for school or traveling.

title: Too Tight in the Calves for Me
text: I currently wear a size 16 jeans, unfortunately for me these did not work for me. I have thick calves and some jeans just don't work for me. Usually a women's cut (as opposed to misses) will work for me because they are cut a little roomier, but these weren't. I think part of the issue is that they are straight cut. I was able to get these on, but they were just too tight for me to wear out in public. The waist, hips, and other areas fit fine on me. I like the dark wash color. The jeans seem to be made well.

title: Great Fit!
text: My 17 year old daughter has to wear all black for her high school winter guard practices. This tank top is perfect for her rehearsals. She is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds.  This size 8 fits her very well. It hugs her body and doesn't billow out when she's dancing.This is long enough that she doesn't have to tug on it to cover her back side. It's comfortable and wicks away moisture to keep her cool.  It washes well. She is very pleased with it.

title: Cute Skinny Jeans
text: These jeans look great on my 17 year old daughter. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She usually wears a size 8 in jeans, but the 29/30 fits her fine. Though she could probably go with a slightly longer length. They are a dark rinse color. They are skinny style. She's not crazy about the white label on the back side, but other than that she's really happy with them. They're made well with straight stitches and no loose threads.

title: Sturdy Drawstring Bag
text: My kids have gone through a lot of drawstring bags. When they were in middle school, those were the only book bags allowed. In our experience, drawstring bags usually only last a year if you're lucky. And if you are using them for heavy items such as text books, sometimes you have to replace them mid-year. As far as drawstring bags go, this one is pretty sturdy. The strings are thick and strong. The material is fairly tough when you compare it to similar bags. There's double stitching inside the top. One of the rows of stitching is pretty crooked and actually stitched onto the other row for about half of the width of the bag, but that's inside the bag and not visible. There's an interior pocket which is a nice feature that a lot of drawstring bags don't have. Overall, I think this is a pretty good bag and will last longer if it's not loaded up with heavy items.

title: Light Weight Jacket
text: My 17 year old daughter loves this jacket! She usually wears mediums in women's clothing. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. This is a large. It is roomy enough that she can wear a thick layer such as a sweater underneath it. The arm lengths are good on her. It's made well. The jacket is pretty thin and appropriate for fall and spring. The picture is pretty accurate as to the length of it and overall appearance. It's cute and perfect for the upcoming fall season!

title: Comfortable!
text: I ordered these for my husband, but the other day I was getting ready to go out and didn't want to run back upstairs to get some socks. These were sitting on the table, so I took a pair and put them on. They were so comfortable! I wear a women's size 10W shoe. These were not too long on my feet at all, but there was some stretch so they could accommodate a larger foot. There is a tight compression feature in the arch which is what makes these so comfortable. I was wearing these on a 90 degree day with sneakers and my feet were kept dry. They wash well and seem to be constructed well, too. My husband has been pleased with them, too.

title: Great for Any Harry Potter Collection
text: My children (now 17 & 20) were fans of Harry Potter when they were younger. The 17 year old still enjoys it. This key chain is a fun addition to any Harry Potter collection. It's more of a decorative key chain instead of a functional one. The size of it makes it a little difficult to keep your keys on it. I personally stuff my keys into my pockets all the time, so this would not work at all for me. I think this would be perfect clipped onto a bag or backpack. Mine did not work out of the box. I had to open up the battery section. It only took removing the batteries and putting them back in to get it to work. Luckily it did not require new batteries, but it uses some small button batteries that I don't keep on hand. I pressed the button about 20 times to see what happened. The intro is always the same, but it did rotate through the four different houses. It did seem to be random in the house selections. Anyway, it's cute and fun to play with.

title: comfortable Socks
text: My daughter loves these Adidas socks. She says they are comfortable enough that she doesn't want to take them off as soon as she gets home from school. She wears a size 9 shoe and they fit her well. There's enough room and stretch that a larger foot could easily wear it. They wash well. She is very pleased with them.

title: No Foul Smells
text: My daughter loves the look of leather, but tries to avoid the real thing. This faux leather jacket looks pretty good. You're not going to mistake it for real leather, but it doesn't scream that it's plastic material either. We have not noticed any strong odors or smells that often go along with manufactured leather. As far as the size goes, my daughter usually wears a size medium. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. This is a large and it fits pretty well on her. It's not tight or binding. There's enough room that if she's wearing a bulky sweater or layers underneath, it won't be tight on her. It's not oversized either. It seems to be made well. It looks a little dressy on her, almost like a suit jacket.

title: Light Weight Windbreaker
text: I have several light weight jackets, but I'm never satisfied with them. I have yet to find the perfect one. This one is pretty good. It's a light weight nylon jacket. It has a mesh lining and a nylon outer shell. I'm not sure if it's waterproof, but it has kept me dry in some recent rain. I couldn't find anything on the description about that. The zipper glides easily. There's a drawstring at the bottom so you can adjust it as needed. I personally would prefer this in the baby pink or navy that they offer it in, but the red is a highly visible color. As far as sizing goes, I currently wear an XL or 1X. I hate for my jackets to be tight at all, so I usually go a size up. That can often be an issue if you're wearing thick clothing or layers. This is a 2X and it fits fine. It's not as big as I might expect a 2X to be, but there's extra room and it's not tight in the shoulders or arms at all. Overall, it's a good basic windbreaker jacket.

title: Comfortable & Soft
text: My husband likes this shirt a lot because it's not only soft, but it's light weight and breathable too. The medium size fits well. He's 6'2" and weighs 190 pounds. It doesn't cling on him. It's quickly become one of his favorite weekend t-shirts.  It has a distressed retro look to it. Overall, it's a good quality shirt.

title: Great Fit!
text: Another great sock from Gold Toe! These are a bit more casual than some of their socks. My husband wears a size 11.5 shoe and finds that these fit him fine. They are not tight or snug. They fit his calves well and stay in place for the most part. They are great for casual wear. These live up to the Gold Toe brand.

title: Cute Cover Up
text: This is a cute and unique swimsuit cover up. My 17 year old daughter likes that it looks young and not "old lady" like a lot of cover ups do! It's definitely more suited for the younger crowd. It fits well. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150. She wears size 8 jeans and size mediums in tops and leggings. She doesn't love the fabric, but it's okay. It is easy to care for which is good.

title: Nursing Bralette
text: My daughter loves to wear Bralettes. The fit on this is pretty good. She has recently moved to a D cup size, but medium sports bras and bralettes still work for her without any spillage. This is cute and simple. There was a small issue that we came upon. There were some little hooks on the front straps that my daughter pointed out to me. She didn't know what they were. It took me a few moments before I realized what it was. It's a nursing bra! She's 17 and does not need a nursing bra at this point of her life, thankfully. I went back to read the description of what was provided to me and nowhere did it say anything about being a nursing bra! The actual product description hasn't gone up yet, but I hope it does reveal that in the description. This one is made well. The cups open up easily for nursing. It's a lot cuter than any nursing bra that I had 17 years ago!

title: Comfortable and Great Fit!
text: I have noticed that my daughter's bras weren't fitting as well as they used to, so I ordered a couple of bras in the next cup size. She was a 34C and we're trying the 34D's. This fits great on her! There's no more spillage!! She really likes the fit of this bra. It's a full coverage bra, but it still has a slight plunge so she can wear v-necks without any worries. The straps are comfortable. Overall, she loves her bra and the way it fits!

title: Nice Fit
text: I currently wear a women's size XL. I hate for my sweaters to be too tight or restricting, so I opted for the 2XL. It fits well without being too baggy. There's enough room for a layer if I wanted to wear something something under it. It's light weight, but not transparent. It is light enough that I need to make sure that I'm not wearing a dark bra with it. The arms are a good length. One of my biggest pet peeves with sweaters is too short of sleeves that have to be pulled at all day long. It's soft, but not the softest sweater I've tried on before. Overall, it's a decent sweater that will be perfect for home or work.

title: Cute Ombre Swim Suit
text: Bikinis are hit or miss with my 17 year old daughter. This one is a hit! She loves the blue ombre look to it. The sizing runs small (or maybe it's junior sizing), but I anticipated that so this large fits quite well. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds right now. She wears a 34 C/D cup bra depending on the bra. Her clothing size is usually a medium in women's.  She feels comfortable wearing this which isn't always the case with bikini or two piece swim suits. The directions say to hand wash, but I've been washing it in the washing machine in cold water and it seems to be fine.

title: Great for Work
text: My husband is a big fan of Gold Toe socks. This assortment is great for work. He wears a size 11 1/2 to 12 shoe and these socks fit perfectly. He says they stay up during the day and don't slip. They're a good thickness -not too thick or too thin. He would be very happy if I replaced all of this socks with Gold Toe ones!

title: Cute Back Design
text: My daughter is in her high school marching band's color guard. She likes to wear a supportive sports bra every day for practice. She recently started wearing a D cup because of spillage, so I ordered this in the D-F size. It fits well on her, but she's not crazy about the sides. I'm not sure if it's a little large on her, or if it's just the way it's made, but on the front sides, it gaps a little and has some side boob thing going on. Everywhere else it fits perfectly. The picture on the description shows a little bit of what I am talking about. So basically, she loves this bra, but because of the side gap thing she won't wear it without a shirt over it which is fine by me!

title: Love the Longer Length!
text: My daughter has to wear white tops with black shorts to marching band practice. The temperatures here are still in the 80's during her practices, so she likes to wear tank tops. Moisture wicking is a plus. This is long enough to cover her back side when she reaches out. As a mom, that's a feature I like! The size 10 is a little big on her, but it's doable. An 8 would probably be closer to her size and a better fit. She is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears mediums and size 8's usually. This washes well. She is pleased with it.

title: Stays in Place
text: The Gold Toe brand is known for high quality socks. These socks are exactly what I would expect from the brand. They are comfortable and stay put. My husband wears size 11.5 to 12 in shoes and these fit him well. They are not stretched to the max, so they could accommodate a slightly larger foot size. There are perfect for work or dress up. My husband is pleased with these.

title: Cute But Runs Small
text: This is a cute swim suit bottom, but unfortunately it runs on the small side. I ordered this for my teen daughter. She wears a size 8 in jeans, or medium in leggings/underwear/sweats. This is a large which should have been a little big on her. Instead it was too tight in the hips. The white is not transparent, which of course was a worry of mine. It's heavy enough that it's not see through at all. Construction is good.

title: Cute Cut Out Straps
text: My daughter is 17 and likes wearing 2 piece swimsuits. This one has cute cut out straps which she really liked. She wears mediums in women's tops and this fits okay, but when she stretches or reaches up, it rides up a little. The top is not adjustable either. The white material seems to be thick enough, but the pads are clearly visible which she did not like at all. One thought would be to remove the pads, but she doesn't feel comfortable doing that with her D cup size.

title: Cute Retro Look
text: Like most people, I can never have enough sunglasses! I keep a pair at work, in the car, and in my purse. These are light weight and comfortable to wear. They are sturdy enough but don't feel as sturdy and tight as some more expensive glasses do. They are a bit narrow and I was concerned that they wouldn't fit me, but they do. They have a nice, retro look to them. They are perfectly straight and do not curve at all which is a little weird in my opinion. I haven't decided if I like that or not. Most sunglasses that I buy have some sort of curving to them which makes sense because are faces aren't perfectly flat. I really like the case that comes with them.

title: Compact - Great for Traveling
text: My daughter's high school used to be a college, so it is more like a real campus than a traditional high school. Her classes are in different buildings so she is walking outside all the time. This jacket can be folded up tightly and kept in her backpack for those just in case times. The material doesn't absorb water so if she gets caught in the rain, she will not get too wet. I ordered the large size for her. She wears mediums in most clothes, but she does layer her clothing a lot. I was afraid a medium would be to restraining on her and not comfortable. I think I made the right choice because this fits well with room for layers, but it's not that big on her. It's well made and looks great!

title: These Stay Put
text: I can't wear most shoes without socks, just because my feet get sweaty or I don't like getting my shoes all stinky. But depending on what I'm wearing, socks don't look good, therefore I like to wear liner socks. These are a good mid-weight thickness. I've had some liners that are way too thin and some that are way too thick. These are perfect! They stay in place pretty well and I don't have to keep bending down to make sock adjustments. The size is good. I wear a women's size 10W shoe and these fit me fine. I would say that these are more for every day wear versus sports or fitness.

title: Light Weight & Comfortable
text: These are comfortable light weight glasses. They look a bit narrow, but they fit me fine. They are more comfortable than I thought they would be. They do a good job of protecting my eyes from the sun. I think they look a bit more feminine than unisex, but that's just my personal opinion. They do come with a nice storage case and a microfiber cleaning cloth which I appreciate.

title: Adequate Support
text: My teenage daughter prefers to wear sports bras and if she can, she'll always choose that over a traditional one. She is a 34C and this fits her fine. She was pleased to see that it has adjustable straps. That's not a feature she usually sees on sports bras. She does a lot of dancing and exercise in the marching band color guard and this has given her adequate support during practices. Sometimes she has to double up on sports bras to give her enough support, but not with this one. Overall, it's a good basic sports bra.

title: Cute Jacket!
text: My daughter loves the Adidas brand. She was very excited to get this fleece jacket. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She usually wears mediums in women's sizes. We got this in the small. Some of her other Adidas items have run large, so we were hoping that was the case with this one. Unfortunately for her it seems to be pretty true to size. She can wear the jacket without zipping it up, but zipping it is just too tight. Besides that, it seems to be made well. The logo is subtle, which I prefer. The material is soft. The zipper is sturdy and glides easily. This is perfect for Adidas fans!

title: Cute Basic Black Dress
text: This is a cute, easy care dress. The material is soft and doesn't wrinkle easily, so it's perfect for traveling. My daughter usually wears a medium in most things, but we got this in a large. It's not as loose as we thought it might be on her. It's a little longer than she prefers. She's 5'7" and it hits her just above the knee. It can be casual or dressy depending on what you wear with it. My daughter has been wearing it to school with tennis shoes.

title: Thin Fabric
text: I am a size 14 woman. I have been looking for a white men's button down to wear with jeans for a while and was excited to see this. It's a good looking shirt, albeit a little thin, but it runs small. Usually XL men's shirts will be oversized on me. I thought a slim fit might be a better fit. The arms are too tight. The shoulders fit okay, but with the tight arms, movement is extremely limited. However, it does fit my husband! He normally wears a size medium to large depending on the garment. He's 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. It is not as loose as most XL shirts would be on him, but it does fit his arms and shoulders fine. As I mentioned, it is very thin. He will definitely have to wear an undershirt with it. My family has many Tommy brand items and this one just doesn't seem to be as nice as the others.

title: Nice Looking Shoes!
text: I ordered these for me, but they were claimed by my teenage daughter. I wear a women's size 10W shoe. My daughter wears a women's 9. These fit me, but they were not as roomy as I expected since they are men's 9. They are a little big on my daughter, as expected, but not that much either. So they are running a little smaller than anticipated. I have another pair of Cloudfoam shoes and these are not as soft and comfortable as the other pair. For that reason, I wasn't too disappointed that my daughter took them. They do have a foam inset, but it's not as squishy as my other. It also doesn't have the arch support that the other pair has. They are really nice looking and well made. Other than the sizing, they are what I would expect from the adidas brand.

title: Smooth Wheels!
text: My daughter's suitcase lost one of the wheels a while ago. She's still been using it, but she's made it known to us that it's much more awkward to handle. This comes with 4 replacement wheels. She only needed one on her luggage, but because it's larger than her remaining one, we replaced the other one, too, so they were even and balanced. The holes lined up fine on her soft sided luggage, so the switch was pretty simple. The new wheels move nicely and smoothly. This was an easy fix!

title: Basic Sweatpants
text: These are pretty much your basic sweatpants. The material is thin and light weight. They are not particularly soft, though they aren't rough either. The fit is pretty good. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears mediums in leggings and sweatpants and these mediums fit her as expected. There are no pockets which is a disappointment. They seem to be made well with secure seams and stitches. They wash well. Overall, these are really just okay. They do the job, but they're not anything special.

title: Good Fit
text: This t-shirt is pretty soft and light weight. Although it is light weight, it does feel like a good quality garment and not a cheap one. I got the small size for my 17 year old daughter is loves the brand. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She usually wears a women's medium. It fits well, as expected.  The image is a bit large, but it does have a retro vibe to it. We've washed it once so far and I haven't noticed any fading yet. I wouldn't be surprised if there was some gradual fading in future washings. Overall, it's a decent shirt.

title: Comfortable Arch Support
text: I wear a women's size 10 Wide shoe. I didn't have any problems with the fit of these in the foot. The calves were a little tight, but not too uncomfortable. I decided not to wear them pulled all the way up, so it wasn't an issue anyway. The soles are reinforced which gives additional arch support and comfort. One thing that I especially liked is that they didn't leave behind any black fuzzies when I took them off at the end of the day!

title: Soft & Comfortable!
text: My son loves these shorts! The cotton jersey material is really soft and comfortable. The length is great on my 6' son. He wears these around the house, not for exercise. They may absorb sweat too much if you wear these for strenuous activity, but for video gaming they're perfect!

title: Comfortable
text: These are good, basic men's athletic shorts. The sizing is good. The mediums fit my husband pretty well. He's 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. They have pockets which makes it easy for my husband to listen to his pod casts since he can slip his phone into it. They're really just basic shorts and comparable to other brands of similar shorts.

title: Nice Fit
text: My 17 year old daughter loves the Tommy brand. The size small fits her nicely. She wears a medium in women's shirts/tops. It's not tight or form fitting, but there's not a lot of extra room. It's long enough to extend past her waist a bit.  The black iris color is not the standard black that I was expecting. It's got an almost navy blue cast to it in some lighting. The sweater is soft and thin and is not bulky at all.

title: Fits Well
text: These swim shorts are sized pretty accurately. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears size 8 jeans and mediums in leggings or shorts. These fit her pretty well, as expected. They are a little loose in the rear/leg area so she probably wouldn't wear them without a bikini bottom underneath just to be on the safe side. They are pretty short, too, but for swimwear, that's not a problem. They're well made and wash well.

title: Smooth Rolling Wheels!
text: This suitcase is much nicer than I expected. There are lots of pockets and compartments for separating your belongings. The main compartment is large enough for a week's worth of outfits.The handle telescopes easily without hesitation. The wheels roll smoothly and quickly.  I was impressed with how light weight the suitcase is when I first got it, yet it seems pretty sturdy. Those do not always go together. The only thing I wasn't crazy about was the interior lining. It doesn't lay flat down, instead it billows. I think that will get annoying after a while. The lining material seems fine and should be easy to wipe clean if needed. I was unfamiliar with the Ricardo Beverly Hills brand of luggage and I will definitely check their products the next time I'm in need of new luggage.

title: Accurate Sizing
text: Around the holidays, there are usually multiple events that have an "ugly sweater" attire. I don't like to stick out, so this sweater is perfect for me. It's mildly ugly. It's ugly enough for me to get credit for participating, but not ugly enough that I'm going to be attracting a lot of attention. The sweater sizing seems pretty accurate. I'm a women's size xl and my daughter is a women's medium. I would expect a unisex garment to be comparable to a men's large and this does. It's loose on my daughter, but not overly baggy. It's more form fitting on me, but I can still wear a layer underneath. The construction of the sweater is fine. I don't see any major flaws. This will definitely get worn this holiday season.

title: Sheer Fabric Pareo
text: This is a beautiful pareo. The material is a light weight, almost gauzy material. The label on it says 100% polyester, but the product description says it's 100% cotton. My guess is that it's cotton. It's pretty sheer and see through as shown in the product pictures. I personally would prefer a darker, less sheer material for modesty issues, but that is a personal preference. The shorter, side edges are raw and unfinished, but the longer edges are finished. The garment is generously sized and can easily accommodate different body sizes when wrapped. It looks like the floral designs are printed onto the fabric, but it's done well. Item is made in India.

title: Milder Ugly Sweater
text: This is a milder ugly sweater which is more my speed. The school I work at has an ugly sweater contest every year right before the holiday break. I can participate in it by wearing this, but without creating a lot of attention. As far as the sizing goes, I wear a women's XL and it fits me fine. I could probably wear a layer underneath if I wanted. It isn't tight anywhere.  My daughter wears a women's medium and it's a little big on her, but definitely wearable. She usually has multiple occasions for wearing ugly sweaters and she is happy to have options this year. The holiday decoration is only on the front of the sweater. The cotton is not scratchy. It seems to be well made.

title: Comfortable & Warm
text: This is a comfortable cardigan type sweatshirt. The sizing is generous in the body, but I found the arms (near the wrist/cuffs) to be a little tight. It's great for lounging at home or when you need another layer when walking for exercise outside. On one side there's a pocket inside a pocket. You could keep your keys or ID/money in the inside smaller pocket and your hands in the larger outer pocket. I have been known to accidently drop my money if I keep it in the same pocket that I warm my hands, so that makes sense. Overall, it's kind of basic and practical. You're not making much of a fashion statement wearing it. Or if you are, it might not be the fashion statement you want to make!

title: Great Fit
text: I really like that these come in a larger variety of sizes rather than just small, medium, large, etc. That allows more precise fit in my opinion. I ordered the size 8's for my teen daughter. She usually wears size 8 in jeans/pants. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds.  Normally I get her medium leggings.These fit perfectly! She really likes the fit. She loves the material. They're a combination of soft, rugged, and moisture wicking. They are what I would expect from workout apparel. The waist band is comfortable and doesn't need to be tugged or pulled at while wearing. So far they seem pretty sturdy and haven't shown any signs of ripping like many of her workout leggings. She participates in her school marching band's color guard and winter guard and does a lot of dance movements. She needs her clothing to allow her plenty of freedom while moving and these seem to be good for that. They are a little more expensive than what I usually get her, but they seem sturdier than the others.

title: Comfortable
text: I have been very pleased with these sleeveless v-necks. They are very soft and comfortable. The material doesn't wrinkle easily, so they would be perfect for traveling. The v-neck is modest and doesn't plunge. I usually wear a size XL, but thought I would give these a try. They are a little loose on me, but I think it looks fine and not baggy. The arm pits are not too big and even though I am personally not a fan of wearing sleeveless tops these days, I didn't think they looked too bad.

title: Super Comfortable!
text: I am a 50 year old woman with wide feet. I wear a women's size 10W, but sometimes have to go with 11's because of the width. I thought I would give these a try and I am so glad that I did. They are just a tiny bit big on me, For the most part, the sizing is really good. There's a little room at the toes, but not that much. They are super comfortable! I am a paraprofessional in a high school special ed classroom. I'm on my feet a lot during the day. These are nice enough that I can wear them to work and comfortable enough that they don't hurt. It has to be as close to walking on clouds as I can get. There's plenty of support, too. The branding is subtle. It has the familiar Adidas striping, but it doesn't have the name plastered on it. For my use, I prefer the subtly. I am really happy with these and will definitely consider men's tennis shoes in the future.

title: Soft & Comfy!
text: These are super soft and very comfortable. I wear a women's size 16 pants. I usually wear a 7 or 8 in undies. These are 9's. They are not as big as I thought they would be, in fact, as far as the size goes, they fit perfectly. They aren't snug or tight. They don't bind at the waist. They don't ride up. They are pretty much perfect. They are very light weight which is just what I need during the 90 degree weather we're having right now. Cotton undies get all sweaty in this heat, these don't. I'm 50 years old and I wear panty liners daily. These do have the cotton layer inside rather than the spandex/poly blend. Panty liners don't usually stick to the polyester underwear very well, so I'm glad these have the alternative material so my liners will adhere. These are so comfortable, I am considering ordering some more!

title: Cute & Stylish!
text: My daughter wears a size 34 C bra. This bralette not only fits well, but it looks darling! She won't go without a bra, but she likes to wear popular off the shoulder styles. She doesn't own a good fitting strapless bra, so she wanted a pretty bralette to wear with her new black, off the shoulder top. The lacy straps look really cute, so they were perfect for the job. It is a bralette, so it doesn't offer a whole lot of support, but it does an adequate job. And as her mother, I wouldn't let her wear it out in public if it didn't look alright. It's a racerback style. The straps are wide enough so they are comfortable to wear. My daughter is very pleased with this.

title: Great Quality, But Runs Small
text: These are really good looking jeans. They are made well, too. The seams are straight and stitching is good. They do run a bit on the small size. I followed the size chart. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She wears a size 8 in most jeans. She was able to get them on, but they were too tight and uncomfortable that she said she wouldn't be able to wear them. My daughter was so disappointed that they didn't fit as she has become quite the fan of the Tommy Hilfiger line of clothing.

title: Great Quality Long Sleeve Tee
text: I ordered this men's t-shirt for my 17 year old daughter who is obsessed with the Tommy brand. She wears a women's medium. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. It's loose on her, but it's not baggy. The slim fit hugs her curves and really looks cute on her, especially with a pair of jeans. I don't think a small would have fit her because of the bust. The shirt quality is excellent. The sleeves are nice and long and the body of the shirt is a long length on her, too, which she likes. For comparison, I did have my husband try it on and it was too snug on him. He's 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. He can wear some medium size shirts, but it varies from manufacturer. It was a little tight in the shoulders for him.

title: Comfortable
text: I ordered this for my 17 year old daughter. She's 5'7" and weighs 150 pounds. She wears size 8 pants. She found these to fit very comfortably. There's enough stretch in it that it could easily accommodate a size or two larger. They are thin and seamless which is important for her to wear under her marching band color guard costumes/uniform. They don't bunch up or ride up either. Her cheeks are fully covered. It's a nice, neutral color.  Overall, she is very pleased with them.

title: Super Soft
text: My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. This size large shirt is a loose fit on him, as described. The material is super soft, but it also has moisture wicking properties. The Under Armour Logo on the chest is very subtle. It's black on black. There's another logo on the back of the neck which is gray on black. Construction is good. It's really a great shirt!

title: Light Weight Button Down Shirt
text: My 17 year old daughter loves all things Tommy. She's 5'7" and weighs about 150 pounds. She wears a women's medium in shirts. This men's small button down shirt fits her fine. She's able to button it up without puckering. The shirt is very light weight and a little bit see through. She will have to wear a camisole or an undershirt under it. My husband would probably wear an undershirt under it, too, so it's not just a girl thing. Shirt construction is good. Stitches are even. Buttons are securely attached. The picture doesn't show it, but the inside of the cuffs are a chambray blue, like the inside of the collar.

title: Stays Much Drier Than Other Umbrellas
text: We've had a lot of rain these past couple of weeks and so I have had many opportunities to try this umbrella out. I was very intrigued with it's claims that water just rolls off it and it doesn't stay wet like most umbrellas. I hate dealing with a wet umbrella! Now many stores have plastic bags for your umbrellas when you enter. I have been pretty impressed with the Never Wet coating that is on this umbrella. It really does work. It's significantly drier than traditional umbrellas. It's not perfectly dry, but the difference is definitely noticeable. It's not dripping wet. The one push button works as expected. I really like the stretchy bungy type cord handle. I will have to look for the Never Wet feature the next time I need to purchase an umbrella.

title: Secure When in Place
text: The IdentiGrip makes a comfortable handle for your luggage. I do like that it hides your personal information, but I'm not certain that  someone would think to open it to find your information the bag was lost. Now that I have seen this, I would probably check a similar grip for identification if I were to find a bag. On a recent trip to Spain, my daughter lost her luggage tag. This does not risk getting lost since it's not loose. I received a black grip, so it does not make my luggage stand out, so I would definitely consider that if I were ordering another one. It's made well and once it's attached to your handle, it's pretty secure there.

title: Nice, Dark Jeans
text: These are a nice, dark wash men's jeans.  It's a true to size fit. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 197 pounds. The pants fit him well and he didn't have any issues with the legs being too slim, but someone with more muscular legs may have problems since it is a slim fit. My husband doesn't usually wear jeans, but these are great looking on him and look a little more dressy than lighter rinse ones. The pants are made well. My husband finds them comfortable to wear.

title: Cute & Easy to Care
text: This is a cute romper. It's definitely geared toward younger women. It looks nice on my 17 year old daughter. The fabric is a soft polyester and flows nicely. It's light weight and doesn't cling. The neckline plunges a little more than I would like. My daughter even suggested that she could wear a lacy camisole under it. The legs are a bit on the short side, too, in my opinion. It's easy to care for which is a big plus. If you're in the right target group, it would make a fun going-out outfit.

title: Great Mid-Weight Jacket, But Runs a Little Small
text: This is a good looking mid-weight jacket. Construction is excellent. The zippers are sturdy and glide easily. All stitches are perfect. There are 2 outer zippered pockets. There are no inner pockets as mentioned by some other reviewers. The fabric on the inside that others thought were pockets is just the interior of the outer pockets and they are secured with stitching to the inside of the jacket. There's a small logo on the front chest, but there is the large name on the back of the collar. Sizing runs a little small. My 20 year old son is a big guy and wears a size 2XL. This 2XL was too tight on him and he could barely get his arms into it. My husband is tall, but leaner and wears a size Medium to Large. It looked nice on him. It was a little loose on him, but not baggy. I wear a women's XL and it was snug on me. It was enormous on my daughter who wears a women's size medium. Overall, it's a high quality garment, but you may need to order a size up.

title: Comfortable & Soft
text: My husband prefers the boxer brief styles, such as these Hanes. They are noticeably softer than regular cotton underwear. The waist band is comfortable and not binding. My husband usually wears mediums and these size mediums fit as expected. These are well made and what you would expect from the Hanes name.

title: Comfortable & Supportive
text: My husband usually wears an 11 shoe. These size 11's were a little tight on him, but he is able to wear them. He thinks they'll stretch a bit over time so it won't be a problem. Although snug, he says they are comfortable. There's ample support and cushion. In a time where athletic shoes have gotten bright and colorful, these are a lot more subdued, yet the orange stripes and speckled soles add a modern flair. Overall, these are quality shoes and live up to the Adidas brand.

title: Doesn't Restrict Movement
text: My daughter is in her high school marching band's color guard. She has to wear black shorts for her practices. We have quite the collection of black shorts. She prefers the bike shorts style such as these over looser athletic shorts. These have quickly become her favorite shorts! They allow plenty of movement for her while doing her stretches, spins, tosses, and dancing. The high waist along with the compression feature helps her to stand straighter during practice. She says these are super comfortable, even after wearing them to an all day practice. The moisture wicking quality is appreciated during summer practices. They're thick enough that her underwear doesn't show through. The sizing is good. She's 5'7" and weighs about 155 pounds. All seams have reinforced stitching. There are pockets on the sides as well as a smaller one at the waist. Overall, these are great shorts for active athletes.

title: Comfortable and Cute!
text: These track pants fit very well. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 155 pounds. These look really cute on her. She usually wears mediums in pull on pants, so the size is pretty accurate. While the fabric is velour, it's not as soft as we are accustomed to with velour fabrics. The pants have an elastic waist band with a drawstring. Overall construction seems to be good. My daughter says these are very comfortable to wear.

title: Cute & Sporty Footwear!
text: These girls tennis shoes are a big hit. The bright colors are cheerful with a sporty edge. The bootie style fits snugly with still offering comfort. They have adequate support and cushion. The construction of the shoes is excellent. The soles have good traction. They are definitely geared toward athletics, but look stylish for every day wear, too.

title: Nice Fitting T-Shirt
text: My husband was pleased to have a solid t-shirt without any graphics for a change. He is 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds right now. He wears t-shirts in the medium to large range. This large shirt fits him fine. It's not baggy on him nor is it tight . The fabric is soft and not the typical dri-fit texture. He really likes it and I've noticed that it's already in his shirt rotation. It washes well and there was no noticeable shrinkage.

title: Comfortable Lounging Bras
text: These medium comfort bras fit my 17 year old daughter well. She wears a 34C bra. It doesn't offer a lot of support, but it is labeled as a comfort bra, not a sports bra. My daughter finds it to be very comfortable. She's been wearing them around the house and sleeping in them as well. The assortment that we received is just as pictured  - 2 black and 2 heather purple. The straps don't dig into the shoulders. It doesn't give a "uni-boob" look which is important. They wash well. My daughter wants me to order some more for her.

title: Light Weight Travel Scarf
text: This is an attractive travel scarf. The color is a little lighter and brighter than what the picture shows, but similar. It's light weight and a bit gauzy. The material is soft. It does wrinkle a little, but wrinkles are mostly camouflaged by the print. It is transparent, so I found that I could not wear it as a shawl over some printed shirts. It looks great with solid shirts. The long edges are seamed with nice stitches. The ends are delicately frayed. Overall, it's a cute and versatile accessory.

title: Sharp Looking Visor
text: My teen daughter loves the Tommy Hilfiger line. The visor is perfect for marching band camp. There's Velcro in the back so you can adjust the size. The brand name is embroidered on the front in large letters. There's an extra layer around the inside which adds to the comfort of it, plus helps absorb sweat. The construction of this visor is very good and it lives up to the Tommy Hilfiger brand.

title: Excellent Quality Jacket
text: This jacket is so nice! It's fairly light weight, but it's not at all thin. The material is similar to jersey in the way that it moves, but water repels off of it for the most part. It will probably absorb water if it's exposed to a lot. It's not a windbreaker or rain jacket type material. Sizing is good. My husband usually wears a large to XL in jackets. It's 2XL is definitely larger, but not  to the point where he couldn't wear it. My son usually wears 2XL and it fits him okay, but it would definitely be a little snug if he were wearing long sleeves or a sweatshirt underneath it. The zipper is heavy duty and works well. The quality of this jacket is excellent and what I would expect from the Tommy Hilfiger brand.

title: Soft & Comfortable Pajamas!
text: I find that there are a lot of pajamas that just aren't appropriate to wear in front of people! I like to wake up and go downstairs in the morning for a while before I get dressed for the day. These are very appropriate to wear around guests. It's a thin, soft material that's not see through. The pants have a drawstring waist. These aren't too hot to wear at night, as long as the AC is on this summer. That's an important feature for this 50 year old mom! I've washed and dried them without any problems. Sizing is good. I would love to see these offered in other colors or prints.

title: Not a Flattering Style
text: This shirt is made from a heavy cotton material. It's not very soft, but it's not rough either. The shirt itself is made well with secure and even stitches. I wear Large to Extra Large in shirts. This XL fits already, but it is much shorter than I would prefer. I like my shirts to be long enough to cover my backside if I reach up or sit down. The first picture of the shirt in the description makes it look like a regular t-shirt. The second one that shows the back side does a better job of showing the actual style. It comes in a bit at the waist, then flares out over the hips. I have other Dolman tops and are very different and are more fitted at the waist. The style reminds me of a 90's women's wedding suit. It's not a flattering look on me.

title: Adjustable Fit
text: This visor is cute & sporty. Without adjusting it, it fits my 17 year old daughter perfectly. I have a larger head and usually have problems wearing hats, so fortunately I can adjust it to fit me. It fits me with only moving the velcro about a third of the way, so there's still plenty of room for even larger heads. There's an extra layer of fabric around the inside of the band to help absorb sweat. I've never seen that in a visor before. The TH logo is embroidered directly on the front of the visor. The overall quality is good with even and straight stitches and no loose threads.

title: Soft Fabric
text: The "black iris" color of this shirt is really just a heather grey. The fabric is soft and non-irritating. The shirt has a true to size fit. The large fits my 6'2" husband nicely. It's not form fitting nor is it baggy. The shirt seems to be well made. There are quite a few tags inside on one of the side seams. There's a cluster of 4 tags and another next to it. There's multiple languages written on them. There's also the logo tags located at the back of the neck area. Overall, it's a comfortable, basic t-shirt.

title: Nice Looking Hat
text: I received the Navy Blazer hat instead of the Classic White/Navy one that I was expected. Nevertheless, it's a nice, hat and a big hit with my teenage daughter. The hat fits her well, but when I tried it on, it was a bit on the small size. I have a large head and always have problems with hats fitting me. There is a velcro strap for adjusting. The cap part is divided into 6 sections. The front two sections are a heavy, solid material with each one containing one stitched hole. That section is lined, so those holes are basically for decoration because air can't get through it. The remaining 4 sections are made from a lighter weight material and are covered in little ventilation dots. The flag logo is on the front section and is embroidered directly onto the hat. It's a nice looking hat and fits with the Tommy Hilfiger brand.

title: Appropriate Looking
text: It's hard to find shorts these days that my 17 year old daughter likes AND that are mom approved. These fit the bill. I ordered size 27 for her. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She usually wears 7/8 in jeans. These fit her well. She said they are just slightly tight in the waist, but not to the point where they uncomfortable. There's enough stretch in the fabric to work with. They are long enough to cover her rear side well. Nothing is hanging out! The picture of the length is pretty accurate. They do go past her fingertips by a couple of inches. They actually look very appropriate in my opinion, which says a lot because I tend to be a bit conservative when it comes to clothing. She wants me to order her the blue denim ones now.

title: Beautiful Lace Bra
text: I usually wear a 38DD. However, I've gained some weight over the last few months and have had issues with overflow in the cups. I ordered a larger cup size hoping that would make a difference and it did. There is complete coverage without any spillage now. The straps and band are comfortable. The only issue that I have with it is that I have to be careful with what I'm wearing this with. The lace doesn't leave a smooth shape and it does not hide the nipples. However, that is to be expected with any lace bra so I can't fault it for that problem. Other than that, I absolutely love this bra!

title: Thick & Nicely Cushioned, But Small
text: These socks are a bit smaller than I expected. I wear a women's size 10 shoe. They do fit, but I had to tug and pull them to cover my feet properly. There was no extra room. Once on, they are comfortable. They're cushioned nicely on the sole. They do seem to be well made. They are thicker than what I usually pick up at the local discount store.

title: Comfortable Straps
text: It's been a long time since I've worn a front fastening bra. There are definitely some advantages to that, but it was also a bit tricky to figure out. The bra is really beautiful! It's also pretty comfortable. The cup size fits perfectly without any spillage out the top. The band is nice and wide. The bra does a good job of lifting and creates a nice shape. The construction of the garment seems to be good.

title: Soft, Light Weight Shirt
text: This Retro Panther Logo t-shirt is a soft, light weight t-shirt. It has a true to size fit. My husband has been wearing this shirt around the house a lot lately, so it must be comfortable. It washes well without any special treatment.

title: Adorable Baby Boy Set
text: This is an adorable baby boy's set. It includes 3 pieces - 2 onesies and a pair of pants. They are made from a soft cotton polyester blend. The pants seem to be less stretchy and could be a little difficult to fit over a diaper. The onesies, in comparison, are very roomy and look like they will be more forgiving in the size department. The dino designs are super cute, but they are just iron-on, not embroidered or appliqued. You will definitely want to turn them inside out before washing. This would be a great baby gift!

title: Cute & Well Made Cap
text: This cap is so cute! It's perfect for the summer. It's adjustable in the back. There's space for your pony tail to go through. "Tommy" is embroidered on the front. On the back there's a tiny rectangle logo. Stitches are fairly even though there are a couple of loose threads that I had to snip. It fits as expected.

title: Cute & Comfortable Pajamas!
text: I love this pajama set! It's perfect for the summer. It's pretty true to size. I wear a size XL in misses. I thought this was so cute, that I decided to try the 1X size. It's a little big on me, as I expected, but it's not too big that I can't wear it. For wearing at home, it's fine. The shorts have a drawstring, so that works. The material is very soft. One thing that I really like is the length of the shorts. I'm 50 years old and I find that a lot of short pajama sets have shorts that are way too short! Even though I don't wear my pajamas in public, they are often too short for my own comfort level. These are a little longer without being long. I actually feel comfortable enough to wear these in front of guests. I am very pleased with these.

title: Cute & Well Made Hat
text: My daughter wears ball caps during marching band season. She likes have a variety to choose from. She's recently become a fan of the Tommy Hilfiger brand so I thought this would be a fun hat for her to wear this upcoming season. It's a nice looking hat and is made well. It's adjustable and has the open spot for her to put her ponytail through. The hat fits her head well, but she's a teenage girl. I tried it on my head and it was way too small. I usually have problems finding hats that fit me well, so that wasn't a surprise. It felt like it was just sitting on top of my head. It fit my husband a little better. But since it's a one size fits all hat, beware and if you have a large head, this likely won't fit.

title: Comfortable
text: These briefs are true to size. They are snug without being tight or restrictive. The wide waistband is comfortable. The material is not as soft as some other microfiber materials, but it's not scratchy. The logo is a little too large in my personal opinion. No apparent shrinking after being washed. Overall, good, comfortable briefs.

title: Adorable Baby Girl Set
text: This is an adorable four piece baby girl set. It says that the color is pink, but it's more of a pale, cream color with a touch of pink. I do love that it's not a girly girl outfit. The elephant design is cute, but I will admit that it took me a while to figure out what it was. The dress has a small bunch of bananas on the front which doesn't make a lot of sense. The name of the brand is Silly Apples and although elephants do eat bananas, it's not something I usually associate with them. All snaps are fastened securely. There are no loose threads or stitches. The fabric is soft. Overall, it's a cute baby outfit!

title: Much Longer Than Expected
text: My husband is a band dad for our daughter's high school. He builds props, loads equipment, and all kinds of things. I thought these might be a bit more heavy duty than his other pants. They're light weight, but they do seem heavy. Most of band season takes place in hot weather, so the light weight factor is a plus. The waist band has a slight stretch to it. He ranges between a 32 and 34 waist. These 34's aren't too baggy on him. The length on the other hand is off. They're supposed to be a 34 length, but the tag says 37. I wasn't sure if that was a misprint, but when he tried them on, they are a good 2 to 3 inches longer on him. He's 6'2" and always wears a 34 length. He does like them enough that he said he'll take them to get hemmed. They seem to be a good quality.

title: Great for Casual Dress
text: These fit great on my husband. They are pretty true to size as far as the fit goes. He finds them comfortable to wear for extended periods of time.  They offer adequate support for normal day to day activity. They're nice looking enough that he can wear them to work with a pair of khakis and a casual button down shirt. They are a little more trendy than what he usually wears, but it looks fine on him.

title: Thin & Lightweight
text: This is a thin, lightweight rain jacket. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds. The sleeves of the jacket are too short on him. The sleeves fit well on my 5'6" plus size frame.The body of the jacket fit both of us fine. It isn't bulky, so it can be folded up nicely for travel.  There are drawstrings to close the hood around your face if needed. There are two zippered side pockets that are roomy. Water doesn't roll off like some thicker (and slicker) rain jackets, but it does do an adequate job of keeping you dry.

title: Cute Ankle Cut Out!
text: These are really cute jeans! I love the embellished cut-out design at the ankles. However, they didn't fit me! I have thick calves and the lower legs of the pants are just too tight. I can pull them all the way up, but they're just too uncomfortable in the calves to wear for any period of time. The rest of the jeans are a little loose on me, but not overly baggy. The jeans are well made and seem to be pretty high quality.

title: Form Fitting Jogger Pants
text: My teenage daughter loves wearing these jogger sweatpants. They are a bit form fitting, but they are  soft and very comfortable. The medium size fits her well for the most part. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. They're cuffed at the bottom of the legs so they should work on various heights. The legs are a little slim, but not tight. They wash well. Construction is good. There are no loose threads or seams.

title: Generous Cut Denim Pants
text: These denim pants fit okay. I would say that they are a women's (plus) size not a misses sizes. They are a little larger than a regular misses size 16. Plus sizes are usually more generously cut. I am currently wearing misses sizes, but have worn plus sizes in the past. The pants are pretty comfortable. The stud design near the bottom of the leg is cute. I was afraid it might be too ornate, but it looks good. I really don't like the frayed hem. I don't mind mild fraying, but this is over the top. I felt like a scarecrow in these pants. I realize that's a personal preference and may not be what others think. It's possible it's an age thing on my end. The pants are made well other than that. Overall, I think these are just okay.

title: Comfy Sandles
text: I had high hopes for these shoes, but they don't fit well on me. I wear a size 10W. My width issue is usually taken care of with 11 regular shoes, but not in this case. They are narrower than I need. The strap barely fastened. Aside from that, the shoes are well made. The cushion is extremely comfortable and squishy. And when I stand in them without fastening the strap, they are super comfortable, like walking on air! There's a slight wedge heel. It looks like the sole is all one piece so it won't separate and flap around. There's a slight raised pattern on the bottom to help keep you from slipping. I do feel like they have an old lady vibe to them, so that makes it easier on me that they don't fit.

title: Soft Microfiber
text: I am a fan of microfiber panties. These are soft as expected. The fit is good and pretty true to size. The waistband is just lace, so there is no elastic in it. I hope that it doesn't stretch out too much over time. The underwear stays in place while wearing it and doesn't roll down, however, it does seem to get bunched up a lot more than other underwear when pulling it down to get undressed (or use the bathroom). The seem to hold up well to normal washing. There has been no unraveling of the lace yet. Overall, they are comfortable and nice looking.

title: Comfortable & Good Looking Briefs!
text: My husband's waist size is between 32-33 inches. The medium size fits him very comfortably. They aren't loose or baggy, nor are they tight or constrictive. They are made well with no loose stitches. The material is soft and silky feeling. These are the best looking briefs he's ever owned!  They have maintained their shape and color after a couple of washings. I would definitely consider purchasing more of these for my husband.

title: Looks Great! Feels Comfy!
text: My 20 year old son prefers this style of underwear. He also really likes the microfiber material. He's a big guy and the dry wick material keeps him comfortable even when it's very hot. These shorts are well made. The elastic waist is comfortable and non-binding. The sizing is pretty accurate. These are definitely nicer than the basic discount store underwear brands.

title: Nice Shorts, But Too Short for My Husband
text: These lightweight shorts are nicely made. The fabric is perfect for hot summer days. The waist sizing is spot on, but the length is way too short. My husband is 6'2" and doesn't usually have a problem with short lengths. These are way too short on him to the point that he won't wear them which is a shame because they are nice looking shorts. They are much shorter on him than the picture shows.

title: Gorgeous Rain Jacket!
text: This rain jacket is darling! My teenage daughter loves it! She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. The medium fits her perfectly with enough room to wear long sleeves underneath. The color is more peachy/orange/rust rather than rose in my opinion, but it's still nice. It has a kind of Aztec pattern on it. The exterior pockets have zippers. There's a drawstring at the waist. We've had a rainy spring, so my daughter has had many opportunities to wear it and she reports that it has kept her fairly dry. Water just rolls off. The quality seems to be very good.

title: Fits Nicely
text: This is a great light weight fitness shirt. I usually wear Large to Extra Large shirts and the XL one fits nicely. It's not too baggy or constrictive. It allows plenty of movement. With the open back, you will definitely see your bra, but that tends to be the norm with fitness wear these days. The shirt is long enough in the back that covers you when stretching or bending. The material is a nice, quick dry fabric that doesn't overheat you when working out. I wish it was offered in black.

title: Great Lace Lock System!
text: I ordered these for my husband. He wears a size 10.5 to 11, regular width shoe. These were too small on him and he was unable to put them on. I wear a women's 10 Wide. They are a little long on my feet, but the width is good and the overall fit is fine. It took me a little while to figure out the Boa System. It's easy to tighten, I just couldn't figure out how to loosen them. Once tightened, they could not just be slipped off. Once I figured out how it worked, it was easy peasy. The shoes are very comfortable. I don't run, but I do like to walk for fitness, so I've been wearing them on our evening walks.

title: Comfortable Socks
text: My husband finds these socks to be very comfortable. They fit well on his size 11 feet. The arch support makes a noticeable difference in the comfort these socks provide. The brown color is perfect to be worn with my husband's khaki pants. The toes are reinforced and the overall quality of these socks is excellent. The price of these is comparable to what one would find at the local department store.

title: Basic Pants
