text: My daughter is a fan of sweatpants. As far as fit, these fit well. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She usually wears mediums in women's sweatpants. The length is good on her. The legs are a little wider than she prefers, but that's just a personal preference. The shape is not very flattering.  The material is a cotton polyester blend and is just okay. There are a lot of sweatpants out there with softer fabrics. They're not bad pants and will be fine for lounging around at home or for exercising, but she says she won't wear them out of the house.

title: Cute & Comfortable
text: My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She usually wears mediums. The large size is a little big on her, but not to the point where they are falling off her, so I would say they are true to size. She doesn't mind that they are a little loose on her. They're super cute. The material is light weight and comfortable. They are pretty basic or average as far as the quality goes. Construction seems to be good with no loose threads or stitches.

title: Modern Take on a Classic Robe
text: This knit wrap robe is a modern take on the classic robe. The style is a little more contemporary with the tulip hem and wrap neckline. The material is soft and light weight. It's perfect for warmer weather when you need to cover up. I've been wearing it over my swimsuit when I go to and from our hot tub out on the patio. The length is respectable and not too short. The construction of the garment seems to be fine. All stitches are secure and seams are straight.

title: Cute Pajamas!
text: These pajamas are super cute! The material is soft and light weight. They are perfect for warmer weather. They are a bit see-through, so not only do I need to be mindful of what undies I'm wearing, I also am careful not to wear these when we have guests. They seem to be fairly true to size. I'm in between sizes, so the large is a little tight and restrictive on me. The XL would definitely be a better fit. I am in the 14-16 size range. They wash well and so far seem to be a fine quality.

title: Good, Basic Sweatshirt
text: This is a good, basic sweatshirt. I ordered a size medium for my daughter. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. The medium size is roomy and comfortable. The length of the sleeves is long enough so she doesn't need to tug on them. She would prefer if it was a little longer in overall length,  but it's okay and it's definitely not too short. It washes well and did not have any noticeable shrinkage or fading. It seems to be constructed well. My daughter plans to take this to her graphics class and silk screen something on it.

title: Good Job of Wicking
text: First of all, the sizing of these shorts is as expected. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 190 pounds. He wears size mediums in similar clothing and these fit him pretty well. I like the addition of the reflective strips. There is a small pocket meant for a key or ID. My husband doesn't like the look of just compression type shorts, but the top layer shorts are a little baggy so they look sloppy.  The inner layer is a good dri-fit material and does a good job of wicking. They wash well and seem to be constructed well.

title: Great Looking Shirt!
text: This is a beautiful casual men's shirt. It has quickly become one of my husband's favorite work shirts. It looks great with khaki pants. The material is a good weight. It's not stiff or heavy, nor is it thin or see through. It washes well and we haven't noticed any shrinkage. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 190 pounds. The large size fits him very well. There is a small, discrete logo on the pocket. My husband is not a fan of large logos, so that pleased him. It does wrinkle somewhat. It's not bad, but my husband is picky about that, so he does iron it before wearing it. If it was my shirt, I probably wouldn't. Overall, it's a great, casual shirt.

title: Good Basic T-Shirts
text: These are good, basic t-shirts. They are mid-weight cotton shirts. They are not see through or super soft, but they are good, basic shirts. The size fits as expected. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She usually wears mediums in t-shirt sizes because she doesn't like her shirts to be tight or constrictive. She has to wear all black to her winter guard practices and these are perfect for that. They allow her adequate mobility and movement while wearing one.

title: Soft, Flexible Material
text: These are comfortable, light weight t-shirts. They're performance polyester, but it's a soft, flexible fabric that allows plenty of movement. They are thinner than a traditional cotton t-shirt which makes them good for layering. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 190 pounds. He wears size mediums and larges depending on the fit of the shirt. These are size large and the fit is a little loose, but not overly so. He doesn't like form fitting shirts, so the large is probably the better option. This comes in a 2 pack and at the current listed price of $10.99, is a good value.

title: Comfortable to Wear!
text: My teenage daughter thinks these are some of the best sweat pants! They're a little large on her, but she likes the baggy fit and finds them perfect for lounging around the house. She is 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She wears pants in sizes 6 to 8 depending on the fit. These are 8-10 which accounts for the larger fit. The material is more of an athletic fabric, but it's soft and allows for easy movement. She likes the length of these a lot. They wash well and don't pill.

title: Cute & Trendy
text: This is a well-made, small purse. The inside is pretty basic with just one small zipper pocket. It can easily hold a small wallet, mobile phone, keys, and some lipstick. The guitar strap is thick and actually pretty comfortable on the shoulder. The strap is a little more ornate than I would like, but that's a personal preference, not a quality issue. The magnetic closure works well and does a good job of keeping the bag closed. It does come with warning regarding the dye which says that it may rub off on lighter colors. However, for the most part, the purse hits me at the upper hip level, so it mainly comes in contact with my pants and I don't wear light colored pants. Overall, it's a trendy, fun purse for times when you don't need to store a lot of things.

title: Soft & Comfortable
text: When I first showed these shirts to my teenage daughter, she made a face. She thought they looked ugly. But when she put it on, she changed her mind! It's a nice, long length so it doesn't ride up when she bends or sits. The arms aren't too tight. I don't think she was familiar with boat neck style, but she decided she likes it. The cotton is very soft. It's a mid-weight fabric that isn't see through. She is 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She usually wears a medium in shirt sizes, with the expectation that they will run a little big on her. These shirts aren't tight, but they're not super loose either as we would expect from a medium size. Overall, they're comfortable shirts and a great wardrobe basic to have.

title: Good Fit!
text: This base layer shirt is a bit thicker than other cold weather or thermal apparel. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 190 pounds. He wears shirts in sizes medium to large depending on the shirt. The large fits him well. It's not tight or constraining nor is it baggy.  The arm length is good. It does an excellent job of providing additional warmth under another shirt. It's nice looking enough to be worn casually on its own as well. It seems to be well made.

title: Comfortable Fit
text: These men's shorts look great on my husband. He's 6'2" and weighs about 190 pounds. He wears 32's and 34's pants as he has found that the fit varies among brands and manufacturers. These are 32's and fit him comfortably and that could be due to the stretch waist. The color is kelp and in the khaki family. They have a flat front, which is preferred by my husband. They are slightly above the knee, pretty close to what the picture shows. These will be perfect for the upcoming warmer weather.

title: Cutest Black Jeans!
text: These jeans are so cute! I ordered them for my daughter. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She wears jeans in sizes 6, 7, & 8's depending on the brand. The size 6 fits well all over. These are pull-on style jeans. The black is dark and solid as opposed to a washed look. I could definitely get away with wearing these to work if they were mine. In fact, I'm strongly considering ordering a pair for myself! My daughter is in high school and her first comment when putting them on was that they weren't skinny jeans. However, she did like the way they looked on her. They are slim fitting. There is a small slit on the side at the ankle which is really cute.

title: Comfortable Foot Wear
text: My husband has been very pleased with these shoes so far.  His shoe size is an 11, but depending on the shoe, he's had to wear larger sized shoes on occasion. However, these 11's fit him comfortably. He really likes the absence of shoe laces. The bungee cord laces does an adequate job of keeping the shoe tight, though it cannot be easily adjusted. Most sneakers come with really long laces and my husband always ends up cutting the excess off, so he's happy not to have to deal with that. These are a neutral looking shoe that he can wear with casual khaki pants. They are very comfortable to wear for extended lengths of time. It seems like most sneaker shoes are either brightly colored these days or plain black or white. It's nice to see an alternative to those.

title: Very Comfortable
text: I've had issues with my legs lately. I don't know if it's restless leg syndrome, or just old age, but when sitting for long periods of time, I feel the need to stretch or move my legs a lot more than I used to. I'm going to Europe this spring and I have been dreading the long flight. I recently tried these on an 8 hour car trip and I didn't have any problems with my legs during that trip. I have very thick calves and I have had problems finding travel or compression socks that fit. These fit my calves without any problems. They also stayed up and in place for the entire 8 hour car ride. I was very impressed with that. The socks were very comfortable to wear on my recent trip. I am a lot less concerned about my long flight now.

title: Comfortable, But Check Sizing
text: I ordered these for my husband who was in need of some athletic pants. He's 6'2" and weighs about 190 pounds. He usually wears mediums in sweatpants, but these were too tight on him, especially in the legs. A size large might work better for him. My daughter tried them on and had better luck. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She usually wears a size small in men's sweats or medium in women's. They fit her well in the legs, but it's a bit droopy/baggy in the upper area. She says they're comfortable and fine for hanging around home.

title: Great Spring/Summer Top!
text: This top is really cute! I was afraid it would be too short, but it looks fine. The medium shirt fits my 16 year old daughter pretty good.  She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She does pull it down a little further off her shoulders than the model in the pictures.The embroidery design is well done without any loose threads. It's a mid-weight top and is not see through which is often a concern with white tops.

title: Extremely Comfortable & Flattering
text: The sizing of these leggings is true to size. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She usually wears mediums in leggings and these fit as expected. They are described as shape wear and have some compression like features in the rear end area. They are visible by some stitching type designs which would seem weird if you were wearing them as regular clothing unless you have a long top that covers the rear. My daughter  has found the leggings to be extremely comfortable. She has been wearing them to her high school winter guard rehearsals. They allow her plenty of freedom to move and dance.

title: Super Soft Material!
text: These cropped workout pants are so soft! When I opened the package my sixteen year old daughter tried to claim them as hers, but fortunately for me, they weren't her size! I wear a size 14 pants and the large fits very well. I have thick calves and they aren't tight around them at all. They are comfortable to wear and are perfect for working out or just lounging about. I absolutely love these pants!!

title: Nice Slimming Look
text: These fit alright, but they are a little tight on me. I wear a size 14 pants and these are a 12-14. I think the 16-18 would be way too big though. I've worn these in the hot tub and I did have to pull them after sitting.  I like the control feature because it does give a slimmer look, especially when worn with a tankini top. I personally don't like the high waist look with just a bikini top, but with a tankini top you don't see the high waist. They are well made and have washed well.

title: Cute & Comfortable!
text: I have been very pleased with this. It's light weight and allows for movement. I am able to wear a thin layer underneath it if desired. At first I wasn't sure what to think of the sleeves. I didn't notice it when looking at the pictures, but the sleeves are gathered/ruched. I thought it looked a bit strange. But after wearing it, I've decided that I love it. It keeps the sleeves in place better and I don't have to adjust it at all. I wear this with jeans on weekends. And when the weather gets a little warmer, I will wear it with yoga pants or sweat pants for hiking or walking.

title: Great Fit!
text: I needed some new black pants for work and these are great! The fit is true to size. They don't wrinkle, so they will be perfect for traveling. The fabric has a slight stretch to it. I'm 5'6" and the length is a little long on me, but it doesn't touch the ground. I will probably order another pair in a different color.

title: Thin & Soft Material Makes it Perfect for Layers!
text: The sizing on this long sleeve shirt is generous. I ordered my usual size, a large and I was fearful that it would run small, but the fit is great. It's not tight at all. It's long enough that I don't have to keep pulling it down in the back. The material is soft, but very thin. I don't think I would wear this on its own, but it is perfect underneath other shirts. Since it's thin, it doesn't add a lot of bulk when layering.

title: Not Bulky
text: This rain jacket is not only super cute, but it does a great job of keeping you dry. The medium fits my 16 year old daughter well. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. It does not allow for a lot of bulk underneath, so if you wear sweatshirts or thick clothing, you may want to size up. There's a large reflective strip on the back. The material of the jacket is thick enough that it does provide a little bit of warmth as opposed to a thinner jacket. The wrist bands can be worn loose or tight. The inside is a coordinating plaid material. We've had a lot of rain lately, so my daughter has been able to wear it quite a bit. She says that she's gotten compliments on it.

title: Stays Tucked In!
text: This shirt is labeled a rib knit, but I did not see any kind of ribbing in it. I really like this turtle neck. It's very soft. The fabric is a bit on the thin side and slightly see-through, however, it's thinness is perfect for layering and wearing under other shirts. It's long enough that it tucks in well and doesn't come untucked. The turtleneck isn't too tight. Although I probably won't wear this alone by itself because of it being so thin, I really do like it. It's comfortable and not bulky.

title: Comfy & Soft!
text: My family had plans to go away for the weekend with another family and I didn't have any appropriate pajamas to wear around them. I usually wear a short night shirt or shorts and t-shirt and that just wasn't the look that I was looking for with our friends. These pajamas fit well and they are very soft. I was able to wear them around mixed company.

title: Love the Bounce Control!
text: I love that this sports bra can be adjusted for bounce control! I didn't realize that at first and when I was trying it on, I became very confused at the extra hooks in the front. I have never seen a sports bra like that before. How innovative! The bra is comfortable and supportive. It looks cute, too! I am very impressed with the quality. It even comes with a small lingerie bag for laundering. I would definitely recommend this.

title: Great Belt!
text: My husband used to be a Boy Scout leader and he wore an official canvas Boy Scout belt which operated the same way. He loved that belt and thought it was genius because it always fit. He was thrilled to find a traditional belt that worked the same way. This is a little larger than what he would normally wear, but it doesn't matter. He's been known to add extra holes to his belts when they are too loose, but he doesn't have to do that with this one. It's a great looking belt and it stays in place.

title: Slim Fit
text: The sizing of this is more of a slim fit. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 190 pounds. He usually wears mediums in shirts, but if they are slim fit, larges work better. This fits him, but it is a bit snug and he definitely can't wear another shirt to layer under it. It's made well and a nice quality. The knit is very tightly woven. The color is port, but it looks more like a dark brown when compared to a burgundy.

title: Excellent Arch Support & Comfort
text: These socks are awesome! I've never worn outdoor socks before, but I buy them for my husband. They are super comfortable and provide lots of warmth. They are well cushioned at the arch. I sometimes have flare ups of plantar fasciitis and I have not had any foot pain when wearing these, even without shoes. The socks are thick and tightly woven. So far they have washed well. I am very pleased with these socks.

title: Department Store Quality
text: This is a good assortment of men's socks. They are a mid-weight thickness. They fit well on my husband who wears a size 11.5 shoe. There's enough stretch that if needed. They look good and are comfortable. It comes in a nice assortment with 2 solid black pairs and 3 printed pairs. These are comparable to department store socks.

title: Really Cute But Arm Holes Are Way Too Big
text: This shirt is really cute! The medium size fits my 16 year old daughter very well. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She wears a women's medium, but can usually fit into a small. She just prefers her tops to be loose fitting. The fabric is thin and light weight and very soft. The arm holes are really big and it shows a lot. It looks cute on her, but because of the arm holes, she doesn't feel comfortable wearing it unless with a sports bra for exercise type activities. The fabric however, is nicer than workout apparel.

title: Love the Look, But Sizing Runs Small
text: Let me start with saying that I love these jeans!! I've been plus sized most of my life and I have never been able to find Levi jeans that fit me. It's just one of those things that I have learned to accept over the years. I lost some weight last year and finally moved out of plus sized clothing for the most part. I currently wear a size Large/14. These jeans are 16 plus (not just 16) and they fit really well on me. I usually wear Gloria Vanderbilt or Lee jeans in regular 14 just for a point of reference. The length is fine for my 5'6" body. They did shrink a small bit when I washed them. After washing them, they were just a little tight, but they did stretch after wearing them around for a little bit and they aren't uncomfortable. I love the boot leg look! The quality of the jeans is what I would expect from the Levi brand.  I really am happy with these, but I am afraid that if I had ordered the size 14's, I would not have been able to wear them.

title: Good, Basic Jacket
text: The Starter Men's Track Jacket is a basic, light weight jacket. It's a polyester spandex blend. There are 3 zippered pockets. The zippers function smoothly and are average quality. The sizing is accurate. I appreciate that the description said to size up for a relaxed fit which I did. The quality of the garment is good. There were no loose seams or stitches.

title: Tight in the Hip, But Well Made
text: My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 188 pounds. He wears a size 34x34 pants, but those are usually loose on him. These swim shorts were a little tight in the hip area.  They are still wearable though. Everywhere else the fit was fine. The waist is comfortable. He likes that he can tighten them as some swim shorts just have the string for decoration. There are plenty of pockets. The fabric is light weight and does dry pretty quickly. They are made well with secure seams and stitches.

title: Order a Size Up
text: This ugly sweater is bright and vibrant. The image is printed well and is very clear. I've washed it once and there was minimal fading if any at all.  The wording of "The Birthday Boy" isn't very visible when wearing it because it's at the bottom of the sweatshirt and that blouses a little. The sweatshirt itself, is light weight and runs small. I wear a misses large, so I thought a unisex large would be more than roomy enough, but it wasn't. I could get it on, but it was way too tight and then once it was on, I was not able to move freely. It's also shorter than I prefer. I like my sweatshirts to cover more of my back side and I felt that I had to keep pulling this down. Overall, it's okay, but you might have better luck at the local discount chain store.

title: Love These Jeans!
text: These jeans are beautiful! The dark rinse color along with the bootcut style could be worn as dressy casual. The jeans are generously cut in the legs without being too loose. They are very flattering and create a very nice silhouette. They are well made and are what I would expect from the Levi brand.

title: Great Fit
text: I ordered this as a present for my husband. He's 6'2" and weighs about 190 pounds. He usually wears a size medium in shirts, but because I knew he would want to wear this over another shirt, I ordered it in large for him. The arm length is good. It fits as expected. The blue color looks great with his salt & pepper hair color. It's well made and what you would expect from the Eddie Bauer name.

title: Beautiful Men's Shirt
text: This is a beautiful men's shirt! I ordered this for my husband. He is 6'2" and weighs about 190 pounds. He can usually wear size mediums in shirts, but since this is a slim styled shirt, I thought the large would be a safer bet. It fits him very nicely. Sleeves can often be a little short, but he was pleased with how these fit his arms. The shirt is well made and looks great. It is appropriate for either work or going out. The color is a soft, almost metallic blue gray.

title: Really Cute Jacket!
text: This puffer coat is super cute! It is short and hits me right at the waist. I wear a size 14 or Large in misses clothing. The size Large jacket fit me quite well. I was actually expecting it to be a little on the tight side, but it wasn't tight at all. I probably couldn't wear a thick or bulky sweater underneath it, but a long sleeve knit shirt wasn't any problem. The jacket seams are securely sewn. The zipper slides easily. It offers adequate warmth for mild winter weather.

title: Cute & Stylish
text: This puffer vest is great for the mild winters we have in Georgia. The medium fits my almost 9 year old niece pretty well. She is below average in size, so it may be a little small on average or above average kids. The jacket is constructed very well. Stitches are secure. Zipper glides smoothly. There are two exterior pockets. It provides adequate warmth and lots of style.

title: Good Basic Fleece
text: I ordered this for myself, but my husband has claimed it as his. He is 6'2" and weighs about 188 pounds. He usually wears a medium in shirts, but I get him larges in coats and jackets. This XL is a little large on him (as I would expect). He has been wearing it around the house for additional warmth. The jacket is mid-weight as far as sweatshirts go. The zipper works well. It's a good, basic fleece hoodie.

title: Thin Extra Layer of Clothing
text: The Fruit of the Loom thermal crew has gotten a lot of use during the past few days due to some below average temperatures. The medium size fits my 5'7"/145 pound daughter well. She normally wears a size small to medium in tops. It is long enough to be tucked in. The fabric is not scratchy or rough. At the same time, it's not a super soft shirt either.  It adds an additional layer without adding a lot of bulk. The color is cute and the shirt looks fine alone.

title: Comfortable
text: These fit well. I wear a women's size 14 and the large fit fine.They look more like regular sweatpants, than the pictures show. The pictures look almost like yoga pants, but thicker because of the fleece. It's possible that's just how they look on me, but I was a little disappointed. The cuffs are as wide as shown, which is nicer than regular sweat pants. They are comfortable and are for activewear.

title: Super Comfortable!
text: These socks are super comfortable. I don't think I've ever seen sport socks with so much padding! There's extra padding on the heel area and the soles. There's ribbing at the arch area for support. The unisex sizing fits both my husband and myself. He wears a size 11.5 to 12 shoe and I wear a 10W. I don't usually wear low socks, so he's claimed them for himself. I thought it was interesting that one is designed for left and the other is designed for right. I didn't really notice a difference in them, but I'm not always observant. The moisture wicking feature is great for athletics. My husband really hates damp socks! Overall, these are great quality socks and comfortable, too.

title: Great Water Repellent Jacket!
text: My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 188 pounds. He wears medium in shirts, but I usually buy him larges in clothing item that is worn over others such as jackets. This fits him quite well and doesn't look too large or baggy. The material is not the usual hoodie material. It's not the sport dry weave either. The polyester material is soft and does an excellent job of repelling water and keeping the cold out. Pockets are zippered. All zippers move easily. It's been perfect for the cool fall weather we've had recently.

title: Comfort & Protection
text: My husband works on prop building and the truck crew team for our daughter's high school marching band. At one of our last competitions, he made the comment about needing some steel toe boots for next season. His shoe size ranges from an 11.5 to a 12 - all depending on the manufacturer. He found the size 12's to be a little big, but not to the point where he couldn't work in them. They have adequate support and cushion. He's not used to wearing such heavy footwear, but he is pleased with the level of protection they offer. They are made well and seem to be a good, decent quality.

title: Nice, Dark Wash Jeans
text: I am 5'6" and wear size 14 jeans. I usually can't wear skinny jeans because my calves are too thick. I thought I would see if the size 16 worked for me. I also don't usually wear petites either, but I'm 49 years old and my height may actually be changing. Regular jeans are sometimes too long for me now. As far as length goes, it wasn't that bad. It hit me at the ankles and they looked okay. The jeans fit me just about everywhere except the waist. The waist was a little too loose on me.  With a belt, it works okay. There's enough stretch that they fit my calves without any problems.They are a nice dark, wash and live up to the Lee quality.

title: Soft Material
text: This is a cute, 1/2 zip fleece. The material is soft and similar to a regular sweatshirt. The arms are a little tight and binding, so I have to wear a tank top under it instead of a shirt or it's uncomfortable.

title: Love the Look of this Smartwatch!
text: First of all, this is a beautiful piece. My husband enjoys wearing a traditional watch and this looks like one. So as a watch, it's excellent. As far as the smart watch, it's proving to be good. Directions have been minimal. My husband has had to look up videos on how to set it up and use it. It's taken some trial and error. The first thing he was able to figure out was tracking his steps. So at the minimum, we figured it was a great looking activity tracker. Prior to this, he would have to use the Google Fit app on his phone. He has also gotten it to take pictures with his phone. That's been very handy. He's had some luck programming the buttons, but it's taken some patience. My husband is a very techie guy, so set up might even be more challenging for someone who is not tech oriented. Overall, he does like it. He would not wear a modern looking smart watch, so the traditional design is very appealing to him.

title: Quality Women's Wallet
text: This is a beautifully made leather wallet. It's a little smaller than I prefer, but it's perfect for my sixteen year old daughter. It's the perfect size for her small purse or backpack. The wallet has some decorative stitching and rivets on one side. The other side has a zipper coin compartment. There's room for an ID and 6 cards, plus when opened, there's a spot for dollar bills which is nicely lined. The pictures in the product description are very accurate. It is what you would expect from the Frye brand.

title: Interesting Fabric
text: I will start with the good - the fabric is really thin and light weight, but it's also soft. I'm a tactile kind of person and found the fabric to be very interesting. It has a lot of stretch and give to it. It's mostly seam free. There is one in the rear center, but you're not going to get the typical panty line on the sides and cheeks. The bad - sizing didn't work for me. I wear a size 14 pants, and a size 7 - 8 undies (large - extra large depending on the brand). These didn't provide enough cheek coverage for my liking. In all fairness, one of the pictures provided for the product showed an accurate cheek coverage picture. That's just not going to work for me.

title: Soft & Light Weight
text: This is a light weight, casual button down shirt. My 19 year old son is 6' and weighs about 270 pounds - he's a big guy. The 2X fit him nicely. He usually wears the 2X size in shirts. It wasn't baggie, but when buttoned up, it didn't gape either. Plus he wore it over a t-shirt and tucked in with a belt. The fabric is light weight and soft. It's not as thick as a flannel shirt. The fabric is softer than a regular men's cotton shirt. It's held up fine after being washed, too.

title: Sleeves Too Tight
text: The color is nice and vibrant. The quality is what I would expect from Hanes' clothing.  I wear a size 14. I've been buying size Large shirts lately. I ordered this in an XL thinking that would it would be more than large enough. I found the sleeves to be so tight and uncomfortable, that I couldn't stand to keep the shirt on. I was very disappointed that I couldn't wear it.

title: Cute Bodysuit
text: I ordered this for my 16 year old daughter. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. Her bra size is a 34C. The large was a little big on her. She normally wears a size medium. She had to tie the straps together in the back to keep it secured. She wore it underneath a jacket and it looked really cute. It was a little lower cut in front than I would like on her, but it wasn't too bad. The fabric is soft, but doesn't seem to be high quality.

title: Cute & Flattering
text: I ordered this for my 16 year old daughter. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. Her clothing sizes ranges from a 6-8 or a small to medium and sometimes large. The blazer fits pretty well on her. It's a little big on her but not as much as we expected it to be. The sleeve cuff is just a tiny bit on the short side, but not to the point where it looks bad. It has a flattering look to it. It has fake pockets on the outside.It's nicely lined inside.The fabric does wrinkle and requires ironing. There is no laundry care tag on it, so I had to look it up on the product description.

title: Great Fit!
text: This has become my daughter's favorite jacket. She loves the fit and look of it. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. The medium fits perfectly. The arm length is good. The jacket isn't too tight or too loose. The zipper glides easily. It's a soft polyester material. The overall construction of the garment is very good. All seams and stitches are secure.

title: Great Mid Weight Jacket
text: This jacket brings back lots of fashion memories from my high school years! My husband never owned a Members Only jacket back in the day. It looks just like the old ones from our youth, but it doesn't look a bit out of style. My husband is 6'2" and weighs about 188 pounds. He wears medium in most shirts, but I ordered this in a large. I wanted it to be roomy enough for him to wear it over his clothing and I was concerned that a medium wouldn't be tight. Plus, medium long sleeved clothing items are sometimes too short in the arms for him.  This fits him well without being baggy. It's made well. Zippers zip easily. Seams are secure. There's a little bit of stuffing inside the jacket to make it great for the cool fall temperatures and the mild Georgia winters.

title: Loose Fit
text: I ordered this for my teenage daughter. She is 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. The medium was a little loose on her, but not to the point where it was too big. The arm length is good. She loves thumb holes in her long sleeve shirts, so she was happy that it had that feature. The fabric is light weight and breathable. The upper back is a see through mesh material, so bra straps definitely show. The color is a light silvery gray. There's a reflective strip down the middle of the upper back, but if you have long hair and wear it down, that strip may be obstructed. Overall, it's a good, athletic top.

title: Soft Fabric
text: These short pajamas are super comfortable! I wear a misses size 14 and the large ones fit very well on me. I'm in my late 40's and I usually just wear a night shirt or shorts & a tank top to bed. I get too hot if I wear much more than that. These are just perfect for me. The fabric is much softer than I expected for a polyester blend. In fact, I didn't realize it wasn't cotton until I read the label. The elastic waist band is comfy and doesn't pinch or bind. They don't twist up during the night. The only negative comment I can come up with is that the charcoal gray ones are a little boring looking. There are some cuter choices available though.

title: Great Shirt for Active Lives
text: This blue long sleeve athletic shirt is very nice looking. The color is a vibrant blue with a white reflective stripe on one of the sleeves. I ordered this for my husband to wear. He's 6'2" and weighs 188 pounds. He wears a medium in short sleeve shirts. He finds that medium long sleeve garments are usually a bit tight or short in the arms. It's not too big in the chest area for being a large. The sleeves are a good length and are not tight at all. I tried it on myself. I'm 5'6" and wear a size 14/large in misses sizes. It fit me without being tight or restrictive. It's comfortable and allows movement. My husband likes to layer clothing in the colder months so he plans to add this to his rotation.

title: Smooth Spinning Luggage!
text: The two larger suitcases are great! They are roomy and sturdy. We tend to do most of our traveling by car, so we can take larger suitcases with us. The smaller of the two can be used as a carry on bag according to the dimensions. I didn't measure it to confirm that though. Both of the cases move easily and smoothly. I love the spinner wheels! The handles pull up and down easily, too. I've had some luggage that can be difficult to extend the handle, but this one isn't. The duffel bag is a good size, but it's very thin.  I was disappointed with it because it doesn't have a shoulder strap. The toiletry bag seems like it was a last minute after thought. It seems like it's covered cardboard that's folded in half. You can't get much in it at all. I don't think it will accommodate any of my family members' toiletries. Overall, I really like the two suitcases! The duffel is okay, but I don't like the toiletry bag at all.

title: Great Fit
text: My teenage daughter prefers to wear sports bras over traditional ones. She finds this one to be very comfortable to wear. It offers adequate support, too. The bra zips in the front. If the zipper pull is not locked in place, it will partly unzip with movement. She wears a C cup size and it fits well. There's a piece in the center front of the bra that can expand slightly to accommodate a D cup. It's easy to make that adjustment. The fabric of the bra is nice and soft. The straps are comfortable and don't dig into the shoulders.  So far it seems to wash well, in cold water.

title: Nice Mid-Weight Fleece
text: My husband is 6'2" and weighs 188 pounds. In short sleeved shirts, he can usually wear a medium. I ordered this in a large because of the sleeves. I thought it might be a little big on him, but it's not, so I'm really glad I went up a size. It's got the front pocket like a hoodie, but without the hood. My husband is 51, so I think it's more appropriate for him without the hoodie. It's a nice quality fleece and looks great. It's a great mid-weight and it's not bulky.  I'm thinking about ordering him another in a different color.

title: Comfortable Boxer Briefs
text: My 19 year old son prefers boxer briefs. He's a big guy and usually wears XL underwear. He is probably closer to a 2XL size, so I thought these would be okay for him. They fit him fine and are not too tight or too loose. The cotton fabric isn't scratchy or rough, but it's not as soft as I personally would prefer. My son said they're fine, but he's not into super soft fabrics. The waist band is comfortable and non-binding. These give him plenty of movement room, but supportive as needed.

title: Great Casual Watch
text: The Micah watch is a beautiful, causal time piece. It's got a light tan/beige leather strap  with rose gold metal. The strap is adjustable to accommodate different sized wrists. The leather has a fabric nap to it so it gets "scratched" easily. It's kind of like velvet where if you rub it one way, it looks darker, but if you rub it back the other way, it returns to the original color. Those scratches can be rubbed out without a lot of effort, but it does detract from the overall beauty. Also, since the strap is a light color, it's getting weathered looking sooner than a watch band that's darker. It seems to be keeping accurate time so far. It looks exactly like the picture in the description.

title: Lots of Zippered Pockets!
text: My teen daughter likes men's sweatpants because they usually have pockets (or more pockets) than women's sweatpants. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. The leg length is good, but the legs are tapered and were a little tight around the calf. Her legs are not very thick or muscular. The waist/hip area is a little baggy on her. The length is fine. There are cuffs at the ankle. The pants are thick and comfortable. There are plenty of pockets and they are zippered so items stay put. I had my husband try them on just for sizing reference. He's 6'2" and weighs 188. He usually wears size medium in sweatpants. He found the legs to be tight, too, which I expected since his legs are much thicker. He couldn't get the pants up enough to check the fit on the upper part of the pants. The length appears to be too short for him, but that was expected. The pants are a nice quality and seem like a more high end product compared to brands available at the local stores.

title: Excellent Quality
text: This girls' hoodie is an excellent quality garment. The material is mid-weight - not too thin, but not overly thick either. The zipper is sturdy and glides easily. The logo is a screen printed, solid image. I got this for my 8 year old niece. It's a little big on her, but she's fairly small and just beginning to wear 7/8 sizes. This is a great option for mild weather.

title: Flattering Style!
text: This dress is super cute and very flattering. I ordered this for my 16 year old daughter. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. Her dress size ranges between a 6-8 (depending on manufacturer), small in women's, or medium to large in juniors. She wears a 34C bra size. The medium sized dress fit very well. The fabric is heavier than expected. It is thick enough that it's not see through or clingy, both characteristics that I don't want my teenage daughter to wear. It also seems to resist wrinkles, so it would be good for traveling.

title: Comfy T-Shirt
text: I ordered this t-shirt for my husband, but after opening it and seeing it in person, I've claimed it for myself. It's a soft, light weight t-shirt with a classic design. It's great for lounging around or working out. I don't over heat when wearing it and exercising. It appears to be well made and a nice quality shirt.

title: Nice Thickness
text: These socks are a nice thickness, but not what I would call cushioned. They fit my husband's size 11.5 feet nicely. There is enough room for larger foot sizes without excess fabric to get in the way. The soles are grey which are great for walking around the house so the bottoms don't look dingy. My husband finds these to be comfortable socks.

title: Gorgeous!!
text: This is a stunning pair of earrings. They are a little smaller than I expected, but that is a good thing. If you look at the picture of the shadow face with the earrings, that's pretty accurate to the size in real life.  I had only looked at the first, close up picture before getting them. The Swarovski crystals are beautiful and look very expensive. The wires are made of sterling silver and don't irritate my sensitive ears at all. I have a few pairs of real diamond earrings and I rarely wear them. I have lost a few over the years and because of that, I choose not to wear them. I love having earrings that look expensive, but if I do lose one, I won't be that upset. However, the wire and earring back are pretty good on these, that I really don't think they'll fall off.

title: Flattering Sleeves
text: This chiffon top is cute! I wear a size 14 in most clothes and the large size fit me pretty well. The fabric is loose and flowy, but it does wrinkle more than I expected. I was hoping for a no-wrinkle material so I could take it with me when I travel. It irons alright, but I would rather not take anything that needs to be ironed. The sleeves are very flattering and do a nice job of hiding my arm flab.

title: Comfortable Cotton Undies
text: These cotton panties are comfortable to wear all day. They aren't scratchy or rough, but they are not particularly soft either. The waistband is comfortable. It doesn't roll or bind. The assortment of colors/designs that I received is different from what is pictured, but the description of the product says that colors and styles may vary.  They wash well. These aren't my favorite undies, but I do like them.

title: Comfortable & Well Made
text: My husband wears black socks a lot, so he was happy to give these a try. They are quite soft and comfortable. There's extra cushion on the bottom. This two pair set has one pair that is all black. The other is black with a grey toe and heel. The logo/name of the company is found inside the cuff and not noticeable unless folded over. These are a dressier, somewhat thick socks. They fit well and my husband did not have any issues with them being too tight in the calves. They are high quality and my husband really liked them.

title: Light Weight
text: These socks are more like ankle socks instead of lowcut socks, in my opinion. They are thin and light weight. I wear a size 10 W shoe and my daughter wears a size 9. The heel hits the correct spot on both of us. They are soft and non scratchy. Because they are thin, they don't offer the same comfort that thicker socks might offer which could be an issue if you are on your feet a lot.

title: Flattering Style!
text: I've been in need of some new work clothes. I work in a high school special ed classroom. I love this new shirt! First of all the sleeves are very flattering. It camouflages my 49 year old "bat wings". Anything that hides my arm flab is a near miracle in my book! The shirt is long enough that it covers my back side when I reach up or down. The front picture of the product has the shirt tucked in, but the other product picture shows the length. The fabric doesn't wrinkle so it doesn't need to be ironed. This would be great for traveling because of that. I don't have any issues with the neckline. It's lower in the front than the back. Depending on my movement, my bra strap does peak through, but that unfortunately happens with a lot of my shirts. I wear a size 14/Large misses and the size large fits very well. I am pleased with my purchase.

title: Stretch Feature
text: I didn't notice the "stretch" feature when I ordered this, but that was the first thing I noticed when I read the tags on it. It really does have some give to it and stretches a bit. My 19 year old son is a big guy and wears belts frequently to keep his pants up. He has found this belt to be very comfortable. The stretch feature is especially nice when his movement would normally be restricted by his belt.  It has an almost spongy feel to it. The belt is easy to switch from brown to black. The buckle is decent and solid. I am curious to see how long this holds up to wear and tear since it's not leather. My husband found it to be interesting and wants me to order one in his size.

title: Sweet Necklace!
text: I gave this cute bar necklace to my teenage daughter. When she was younger, we played the "love you more" game when I put her to bed. She thought this was so sweet! The necklace is a decent quality. The chain is average - not super strong, but it doesn't look like it's going to break immediately either. The length is adjustable so it works with various necklines.

title: Great Fit!
text: I ordered this for my teenage daughter. The medium one fits quite well on her. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She wears a 34C bra. I usually get her mediums in sports bras and this fit as expected. The material is a little rougher than she likes, but it wasn't uncomfortable or annoying while wearing it. It provides decent support. She loves the straps, especially the back view.

title: Comfortable and Supportive
text: This full figure bra has a nice fit to it. Sizing is good. There's no spillage. The material is light weight and somewhat sheer. The lace texture does show through tight clothing. The shoulder straps are comfortable and do not dig into the shoulders. It's an attractive bra and surprisingly comfortable. The product card says that it has a "no poke" underwire. I'm not sure how that works, but there's no wire poking through yet. It lifts nicely and has a flattering shape.

title: Great for Travels!
text: This is a great shirt! The fabric won't wrinkle, which makes it great for traveling. The sleeves are loose and flowy so they help hide my arm flab. The quality of the shirt is okay, but I did have to trim a couple of loose threads. I wear a size 14/large and the large in this size fits nicely. I am not a fan of animal prints, but I love this paisley print. The polka dot one is not available in my size.  I would definitely order more of these if there were some others to choose from.

title: Beautiful Gem and Setting
text: This is a very pretty necklace. The amethyst stone is a rich, purple color. I really like the setting of this stone. It's free moving and not locked down, so I find myself frequently recentering it. The chain is a bit thin and seems fragile. The clasp is really basic, but functional. I like the length of the chain - it isn't tight around my neck. I think it's a good value for a genuine amethyst necklace.

title: Fun Colors
text: I wear a 38DD bra. After reading some of the reviews, I ordered size 2XL instead of the XL. I am pleased with the way the 2XL fits. They offer a moderate level of support, but you may want more support depending on how rigorous your workout is. I don't work out very hard, so they are fine for me. I have a few sport tanks that I wear and I have been wearing regular bras under them. I am happy to have some fun, bright colored bras to wear instead. T

title: Soft Material, But Too Loose in the Waist
text: I have the Vassarette Sensational Stretch Bikini panties in the same size and I love them. The waist band on these hipster ones is much looser. They fit well everywhere except the waist. I had to readjust these several times during the day. It became really annoying after a while. That's not something I want to be doing when it comes to my underwear. Aside from that, I love the material that these are made from. It's very soft. I wear a size 14 pants and the size 7 fits well (except in the waist as mentioned above). They are a bit sheer. The bikini ones are super comfortable to wear all day, so I was a bit disappointed with these.

title: A Beautiful Delicate Necklace
text: This is a beautiful necklace! It's prettier in person. The heart is very small and dainty and looks a little lost on me, but it looks gorgeous on my sixteen year old daughter. The chain is only 17 inches, as listed in the product description. I prefer a little more chain length, but it is an appropriate length on my daughter. Around my neck, the heart doesn't always stay flat, but it turns up. The chain, although very pretty, does look a little flimsy. If the chain does break, the chain would have to be repaired in order to wear it because the heart is not free moving and is attached to the chain rather than hanging from the chain.

title: Soft & Comfy!
text: These panties are so soft and comfy! The fit is very good. I currently wear pants in size 14. I ordered these in size 7 and the fit is great. They don't ride up or bunch up. Some bikini style panties are too low and annoy me during the day, but these didn't. The product description says to hand wash, which I didn't notice until after I had washed them in the washing machine. They did fine. I washed them in cold water on the regular cycle without any problems. I personally don't have time to hand wash my underwear. The black pair has a pretty design on them, but they are a bit see through because of the design. The waist band is comfortable and doesn't bind. I really like that these are good for in between sizes. I've been losing weight and the last thing I need is saggy underwear.

title: Thinner Cups Than Expected
text: The sizing fits well. My only issue with these bras is that the cups are not as thick as other similar bras are so the look isn't as smooth. The thinness was the first thing I noticed. With that being said, it's still smoother than what you might get from a lace bra.  I started wearing this style bra so I would be smooth underneath my blouses and shirts. The straps are comfortable and they seem to be well made.

title: Nice Fit
text: This men's shirt is much nicer than I expected. It's light weight, but it's not see through. My husband usually wears undershirts under his shirts, but if he chose not to wear one underneath it, it wouldn't be a problem. My husband is 6'2" and weighs 187 pounds. The medium size fits him nicely. It doesn't pucker or gape. The quality of the shirt is nice. Seams and stitches are good. There are no loose threads. It's a good looking, casual men's shirt.

title: Cute & Comfortable
text: I ordered these shorts for my sixteen year old daughter. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She wears a size 6/7/8 in pants depending on the manufacture. She has the medium ones and they are comfortable, but not what we consider a compression garment. They do not restrict movement.  She really likes them and wears them for marching band practice on the days they're allowed to wear any color of shorts. She does have to be aware of what underwear she wears with these. She usually wears Victoria Secrets PINK bikini or boyshort undies, but most of them have been somewhat visible through the mesh panels.

title: Comfortable
text: This women's bikini underwear is pretty comfortable. It doesn't ride up or need to be adjusted during the day. It's average softness in my opinion.The elastic waist band is comfortable and doesn't pinch. I wear size 14 pants and the size 7 fits well on me.  They are tagless which is preferred these days.

title: Well Made
text: My teenage daughter likes to mix and match her swimsuit pieces. This swimsuit bikini bottom offers adequate coverage so I'm not worry about her showing more than she should. The material is thick enough that it's not transparent. The sizing fits well - I would say it's true to size. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds.  She wears size 6-8 in pants depending on the manufacture. The medium fit her very well with no sagging in the rear.

title: Cute Dress But Does Run Slightly Small
text: I currently wear a size 14 in pants and a size Large in misses tops. My bra size is 38DD. This dress is fits well in my hips and middle, but it is just a little too tight on top, to the point where I couldn't zip it up all the way. If I can loose the next ten pounds or so, I think it will fit fine. I was actually surprised at how much I liked this dress. It's very flattering looking. The side front ruffle is a little odd, but it actually creates a focal point and looks nice. The fabric resists wrinkles. The dress is lined with a satiny type fabric. Construction of the dress is good. There were no loose seams or crooked stitches. This will be great for work or evenings.

title: Fits Well
text: I wear size 14/large in most clothes and I found the fit of large these to be pretty good. It allows movement without being tight. It doesn't cling either. I could probably have gone with an XL might have given a little more room for my 38D chest, but this one is good. The material is nice and light. The back has a mesh type material that will show your bra.  The only thing I don't like about it is that the neck area is not sewn, it's just creased. So the excess fabric will poke up instead of laying flat and I have to push it back down. Other than that, I am very pleased with this shirt.

title: Slightly Smaller Than Needed
text: Well made, but just ever so slightly smaller than what we need. My husband has had to trim just about everything that he keeps in his wallet insert.

title: Cute Fitness Skirt
text: The Lioness Sport Skirt is cute and well made. I wear a size 14 pants and the large size fit okay. It was a little tight, but not constrictive. It's much shorter than I would like, but that's a personal preference, not a criticism of the garment. The fabric is pretty soft and dries quickly. There are little grippers on the lower inside of the shorts so they don't ride up during movement. The waist band can be adjusted if needed. There's a small zippered pocket that can hold a key and ID card.

title: Perfect for Dressy Occasions!
text: I ordered this for my 16 year old daughter. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She wears pants in sizes 6,7,8 depending on the manufacturer. She  is usually a size medium, but sometimes a small in the non-numbered sizes. This fit pretty well, but it's slightly snug in the waist. There is no elastic or stretch in the waist. The fabric is soft and seems to do a good job of resisting wrinkles. The slits allow some movement, but not enough that my daughter could wear this while playing the cello. It's a dressy skirt and looks very nice on my daughter. Construction of the garment is good with no loose seams or threads.

title: Cute, But a Little Baggy
text: These are cute, running shorts! I ordered a size medium for my teenage daughter. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. She wears pants in sizes 6, 7, or 8, depending on the manufacturer. She usually wears mediums in athletic shorts, but these are a little baggy on her. They fit in the waist pretty well, but are loose in the body. They have the built in panty which is a nice feature. The fabric is light weight and comfortable. It's a low waist short which she likes. She likes the small zippered pocket on the back. You can fit a key or ID in it, but that's about all. They are made well with no loose seams or threads.

title: Comfortable Tagless Undies
text: This cotton panties are pretty comfortable. The cotton material is not scratchy or rough, but it's not as soft as I would prefer. The waistband is a thin, covered elastic band that doesn't bind. I love that there's no tag to deal with during the day.  It has enough stretch to cover everything it should. I wear a size 14 pants and the size 7 fits very well on me. I've washed these in the laundry a couple of times and they've held up just fine. Overall, these are a decent, affordable product.

title: Great Fit!
text: This is such a cute swimsuit! I love the retro vibe it has. I've lost nearly 50 pounds in the past six months and have been in need of a new swimsuit. I've always had to get a size or two larger than the clothing size I wear. Before I lost my weight, I was wearing a size 18, but my swimsuits were usually a 20-22. I am currently wearing a size 14, and the 16 I ordered of this fits perfectly. The halter style is quite flattering. Since it has to be tied at the back of the neck, you do have some room to adjust it, more so than if it had bra type straps. The bust offers adequate support  without any underwires. Even though I have lost weight, I have not gotten rid of the tummy flab. The shirred design of this swimsuit does a good job of concealing that pretty well. Although it's called a swim dress, there is not skirt that hides your thighs. It's more like the pinup suits from the 1940's. The suit is a very good quality and made well. This is something I would feel comfortable wearing at the public pool versus something I would wear only at home.

title: Great Fit & Support!
text: I absolutely love the look and fit of this swim top. About six months ago, I joined Weight Watchers and have lost about 45 pounds so far. In a lot of clothing, I am currently in between plus sizes and regular sizes. I wasn't sure how this was going to fit me. My bra size is currently 40D. My shirt size is currently a misses regular large. I got this is in the 16W and it fits perfectly! There are 3 different places you can fit the back hook into, so it can be adjusted a little bit if the band is too small/large. Last year I ordered a swim suit bikini top that ended up not being adjustable at all, so I had to tie a knot in it! The underwire provides excellent support. Plus you can tie the straps at the neck as tight as you need to.  We have an outdoor hot tub and I will probably only be wearing this at home, but this is the first time I've ever considered wearing a bikini top in public and that's because it fits so well. I am very happy with this and now I need to find a swimsuit bottom that fits well, to wear with this!

title: Adequate Support
text: My daughter wears a 34C bra and a size medium in misses sizes. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. The medium size is a little small, but it's still comfortable to wear. She actually likes that it's a little tight because it's more like a compression/sports bra. It offers adequate support during exercise and physical activity. The straps are comfortable and she loves the back design. She will wear this for marching band practice or hanging around the house.

title: Cute Exercise Top!
text: I'm in the process of losing weight, so sizing has been an issue for me lately. Prior to losing weight, I had been a size 18 for years. I've lost enough that I'm wearing 14's & some 16's now. I got this in the 1X which is a 16W. It's a little big on me, but not overly loose.  It doesn't have the compression type fit I would prefer in an exercise garment, but that's probably due to the sizing. It seems like it would more form fitting on a slightly larger person. The built in bra doesn't offer enough support for larger cup sizes. My bra size is a 40D. I will probably need to wear a bra under it. I really like the style of it and how it looks. I love the longer length so I don't have to keep pulling it down in back. This top is well made and washes well. I love the bright colors! I do wish the Fit for Me line would consider adding 14's to their sizes. Standard sized workout clothes just don't fit me right now.

title: Comfortable Waist Band
text: These are really nice boxer shorts! My husband is 6'2" and weighs 187 pounds. The medium ones fit perfectly on him. The cotton material is not particularly soft, but it is a good quality. It reminds me more of what you would find in a men's button down shirt. They have softened up a bit after a couple of washings.  It has a wide, elastic waist band which is comfortable. The elastic is not encased in fabric, so it won't get twisted like some of my husband's boxers have become. The construction is pretty good. There are no obvious sewing flaws. Overall, these are nice boxers.

title: Sleek Looking
text: This watch is really sleek and beautiful. The monochromatic look is quite striking. It's easy to read and so far it keeps pretty accurate time. It was a little large, so my husband had to take it to a jeweler to have a couple of the links removed, but that's pretty standard for him with watches. The nobs are located on the left side, which is not what we're accustomed to. The face is slightly larger than my husband's other watches, but that seems to be the current trend. It's a good looking watch!

title: Quality Wallet
text: My husband has been using this wallet for a couple of weeks now. He went from a traditional, slightly larger one to this nice, slim one. It holds all of his cards easily. It doesn't have any room or space for photos, but realistically, my husband commented that he likes the slimmer style better. Plus, he doesn't usually peruse through his photos anyway. The RFID feature is a nice touch. We were on vacation this past week and my husband kept his hotel card key in one of the outer pockets. The key was one that you just have to hold up to the lock, you don't have to insert it, so he liked being able to do that without removing the card from the wallet. The wallet looks nice and is constructed well.

title: Comfortable
text: I've been losing weight and needed some smaller underwear. This is a great problem to have. They fit well and don't ride up at all. They are comfortable to wear and don't annoy or bother me at all. The fabric is soft, but not as soft as some microfiber products.  I was expecting the variety pack pictured in the description, but I received all solid colors with no patterns.

title: Fitted Not Loose Fit
text: This rashguard shirt is a nice quality. Seams are secure and straight. There are no loose threads. The fabric is soft and what I would expect from a rashguard shirt. My husband is 6'2" and weighs 187 pounds. He wears mediums in standard t-shirts. This shirt is very fitted on him. He doesn't mind the fit - it's not too tight where it's uncomfortable. He actually thinks this fit would be better suited for water activities because it won't get caught on things. However, it's described as a loose fit garment and it is definitely not a loose fit shirt.

title: Good Support
text: My husband is fairly new to running. About a year ago, he started the C25K program. His shoe size is an 11.5 to 12. These are a size 12. They're a little big on him, but not to the point where he can't wear them. There is adequate support and cushion. The shoes are well made and comfortable. He wouldn't normally select shoes in this color, but because they are bright and colorful, he's only wearing them for running, so they're not getting over used by daily wear. The laces are a bit long, so he does plan to replace them with something shorter. He is pleased with the quality of these shoes.

title: Great Quality
text: My teenage daughter is obsessed with ivory billed woodpeckers. She saw this hat and had to have it. It's just as described and pictured. We are pleased with the quality of it. She's been wearing it to marching band mini-camp and around the house.

title: Great Fit!
text: I have some of the Lee Women's Midrise Fit Pants and these fit just as well. They are true to size. These Bermuda shorts are a nice length and provide appropriate coverage for me. I'm 49 years old and I don't want to be wearing too short of shorts. The fabric has a little stretch to it. Pockets are roomy and can accommodate my cell phone easily. Construction of the garment is good. Stitches are secure and even.

title: Cute & Comfy!
text: I live in Croc Capri flip flops during the summer. I have occasional flare ups of plantar fasciitis. If I wear shoes without any good support or go barefoot too much, then I end up with painful feet. These flip flops offer enough support that I don't get any flare ups. Usually I wear neutral colors, but I love the whimsical print of these pink, floral ones. They are super comfortable to wear.

title: Cute, but No Support
text: I love the Crocs Capri flip flops, so I found these which were much more affordable. However, they don't have any of the comfort and support that the Capri ones have. These are comparable to plain old basic flip flops. They're cute, but not comfortable at all.

title: Very Cute!
text: This is such a cute jacket! I ordered it for my almost sixteen year old daughter. Of course, she doesn't realize the retro factor here. My daughter is 5'7" and weighs about 140 pounds. The medium was a little bit large on her, but the description does say that it's oversized with a longer fit. It really fits like a boyfriend's jacket would fit. The jacket is well made. There are no loose or sloppy stitches. The zippers are heavy weight and glide easily. The fabric is silky soft. It's a great light weight jacket for fall or spring.

title: Sturdy & Strong
text: This has turned out to be a handy & useful gadget. I thought it would be just for traveling, but I've started using it daily. I keep it strapped on my tote bag that I take with me to work and strap my empty lunch bag to it. The metal clip is very strong and sturdy. It has a carabiner style clasp. I'm looking forward to using it on vacation. It will make maneuvering through the airport a little easier. I do wish the strap could expand a little larger, but it looks like it should work with my bags.

title: Well Made Rashguard Shirt
text: This is not my husband's first rashguard shirt, but it is his first Speedo one. So far, we've been very impressed with this one. My husband is 6'2" and weighs just under 200 pounds. I ordered this in a large for him. He wears between a Medium and a Large in Men's shirts. This is a little loose on him, but not to the point where it looks baggy. It is not constraining or tight. The neck and sleeves fit well. The fabric is light weight and smooth to the touch. It actually feels softer and smoother than his other rashguard shirts. This is perfect for someone who wants extra protection from the sun or someone who feels self conscience and wants to wear a shirt while enjoying outdoor water activities. The construction of the garment is very good with secure seams and stitches.

title: A Good Inexpensive Belt
text: I've been losing weight over the last few months and I've been having to pull up my pants all day long. I ordered an XL based on the measurements provided and it fit fine. It's just a basic belt - nothing fancy, but it does do the job. I have finally bought some smaller sized pants, so I'm not wearing it very much, but it's there when I need it. For the price, I am very pleased with it.

title: Nice, Casual Men's Shirt
text: This is a nice, causal men's shirt. The large fits my husband well without any puckering or tightness across the chest.  He's 6'2 and weighs 200 pounds. The mid-weight fabric doesn't wrinkle very much at all. The construction of the shirt is good with straight seams and no loose stitches. My husband is pleased with the quality and appearance.

title: Great Fit!
text: My teenage daughter is a member of her high school winter guard team. They have practices 4 to 5 nights a week during the season. They have to wear all black for these rehearsals. These New Balance Accelerate capri pants are her new favorites. The moisture wicking fabric keeps her feeling dry throughout the entire rigorous workout. They are comfortable and allow her to move and stretch easily without needing to be tugged or pulled for adjusting. She really likes the interior drawstring feature inside the waistband. They fit well on her. She's 5'7" and weighs about 140 pounds. The construction is good and I will definitely look into getting her more New Balance workout apparel.

title: Sweet & Dainty
text: This is a cute, dainty necklace. It appears to be authentic sterling silver as my daughter has not had any irritations while wearing it. This necklace and earring set is perfect for tweens or teens. I gave this to my almost sixteen year old daughter and she loves it. The chain is sturdy enough, but we would love it if it was a little shorter or if it had one of those extension pieces at the end so it could be adjusted. The jewelry arrived on a card and although it was securely wrapped in bubble wrap, one of the earrings was slightly bent. It was easy to gently straighten it, but I feel that it should not have happened in the first place. I love the sentiment that is written on the card!

title: Comfortable
text: This is my second pair of Ryka shoes. I wear a 10W in shoes, but I often have to go to an 11 (not Wide) for fit. I ordered this in the 11. I had to unstring the shoelaces and put them back in a little less tightly, but once I did that, the shoes fit very well. They are very comfortable and offer adequate arch support.

title: Great Fit
text: My teenage daughter is in her high school winter guard. They have to wear all black to their practices. She prefers wearing leggings (as opposed to shorts) because it's chilly. She is 5'7" and weighs 145 pounds. These leggings fit her very well. They allow lots of movement which is perfect all the dancing she does. The fabric is thick enough that her underwear doesn't show through, but at the same time it's not too thick that it's too hot for her active rehearsals. The waist band is comfortable. She loves the "see through" mesh on the sides of the legs. The fabric doesn't get wet when she sweats which is another huge plus.

title: Great Support!
text: My fifteen year old daughter prefers sports bras to traditional styled ones. She's also very involved with marching band and color guard. She wears a 34C bra. Her first reaction when she put this on was that it was a bit tight, but after wearing it several times, she has decided that it's not tight, but more of a compression fit. She really loves it and feels confident wearing it during her long practices. Some sports bras make her feel a bit self conscious when she's warming up or dancing. The straps are comfortable and don't dig into her shoulders. It doesn't get sweaty feeling which is a huge plus for her. She also likes how it looks.

title: Fits well
text: It's a nice fitting and comfortable bra that overs adequate full coverage. It fits as expected. Straps are adjustable. Thick enough cups that cover everything for a smooth look.

title: Comfortable and Supportive
text: This Vanity Fair full figure bra is very comfortable. It seems more like an every day bra rather than a sports one. I don't usually wear sports bras, so it just might be that I don't know enough about them to notice the difference. It is a lot better & nicer than the last sports bra I had which was many years ago. That one gave me a uni-boob look which isn't pretty, especially with large breasts! The cups are a thick, foam material that has excellent nipple coverage and has no uni-boob! The straps don't dig into my shoulders. It doesn't completely keep my girls from bouncing which I would expect from a compression style sports bra. Construction of the bar is good and what I would expect from the Vanity Fair brand.

title: Size is Good
text: My 19 year old son wears a size 15 shoe. His issue is usually with the width. These socks fit him comfortably. These aren't very thick as far as socks go, but comparable to other Fruit of the Loom socks that we have purchased. As far as being cushioned, they aren't cushioned very much. The socks are not "no see" ones, as they do come up to the ankle. For the price, they are a good value. It's hard to find socks for Big & Tall sizes, so it's nice to have ones geared toward larger foot sizes.

title: Smooth Under Clothes
text: I ordered these for my teenage daughter. It's a thick enough bra that it gives her a smooth look under her clothes. The convertible straps are great because she can wear them under just about everything. She's in her high school winter guard/color guard and one bra (or two in the case) can be worn under all of her costumes.She likes fun colored bras, but with her costumes, she's required to wear a nude/tan bra or white one depending on what they are wearing.  She wears a 34C and the fit on these was as expected. The straps don't dig into her shoulders. The bras are comfortable and offer adequate support.

title: Easy to Use Velcro
text: I ordered these for my teenage daughter's Christmas stockings. She loves wearing boots, but hates tucking in her pant legs. She's had two other pairs of similar boot straps in the past, but has problems keeping track of them. I can't think of anything that would make them easier for her to find. These use velcro to fasten so they are easy to use.

title: Must Have for Portal Fans Who Love Cats!
text: I ordered this t-shirt for my son. The t-shirt is light weight and super soft. The shirt design was a big hit with my 19 year old son! The image appears to be "painted" on the shirt and not an iron on.  This is a must have for Portal fans who love cats!

title: Nice Looking Pants!
text: My husband turned fifty this past year and he's wearing fewer blue jeans and more khaki style pants now. These look more casual, like blue jeans, but are not denim material. I really like the way these look on him. The sizing runs a little bit small. My husband wears a 34x34 pant and these were a tad tight on him in the waist. In all honesty, though, it could be that he put on a few pounds over the holidays, but I'm not going to tell him that. They are not too tight that they are uncomfortable to wear. The material does seem to attract lint. We have a couple of cats and a long haired dog and the pet hair is noticeable on the pants. We've washed and dried them a couple of times and they have held up fine so far. Overall construction is good and what one would expect from the Dockers name.

title: Nice Sleep Shorts
text: My son needed some new sleep shorts, so I ordered these for him. He's a big guy, but the XL size fits nicely on him. He really likes the fabric - it's pretty soft and much more comfortable than his other sleep shorts. They are well made - overall construction is good. Seams are straight, no loose threads.

title: Good, Basic Black Socks
text: I was in need of some new black socks. These are just as expected. They are a good thickness - not too thick, not too thin. They fit my size 10W feet well. Good, basic black socks.

title: Great Fit
text: I usually have to try on several pairs of jeans (different brands/sizes) before I find one that fits well. I was pleasantly surprised that these fit me so well. I'm 5'6" and wear a size 18 in most things. The length is perfect. I usually get boot leg jeans, but these straight leg ones look nice.  The pants are just a teeny bit loose, but not to the point where I have to keep pulling them up or anything. My calves are thicker than I would like and they are my problem area when looking for jeans. A lot of straight leg jeans are too tight in the calves, but these are not at all.  The waist band is super comfortable. The denim color is nice and did not stain my hands like some new denim does. From the pictures, I thought they were a bit "mom jean" looking, but in person, I didn't get that feeling at all. I wore them on a casual day at work and a co-worker complimented me on my jeans. I never get compliments about jeans! I plan to buy another pair.

title: Elegant Watch
text: A couple of years ago, my husband decided that he wanted to start wearing watches again. In a world of cell phones, he had gotten out of the habit of wearing one. I bought him one for Christmas and since then, he's gotten a few more. This Armani watch has become his favorite wrist piece. He definitely prefers the stainless steel bands as opposed to the leather bands. This one was too large, so we took it to a jeweler and had two of the links removed. It's still a little loose on him, but he knows in the summer months he won't need to readjust it. We have a watch kit that we can use to remove links, but my husband felt better leaving it up to a professional. He found that it was very easy to set the time and date. Some of his other watches were inexpensive Asian watches and there was at least one of them that he could not figure out how to change the date. The clasp was a little challenging for him to open and close. I have a watch that uses a similar clasp mechanism, so I was able to figure it out rather quickly. Once he saw how it works, it wasn't a problem. The details on the watch are very nice and elegant. It's really a beautiful piece. In the few weeks he has had it, it's kept excellent time.

title: Easy to Handle
text: My daughter has an upcoming trip and we wanted a new, high quality suitcase for the occasion. This one is a good size - larger than carry-on, but not the largest either. The size will be perfect for her to handle on the trip. The outer surface is a hard plastic. It's a firm, but flexible material. It has a textured surface that should resist scratches. The handle moves up and down easily without catching or sticking. The wheels move nicely and pivot well. Overall, the movement is pretty smooth. The interior is beautiful! It reminds me of the old suitcases that my grandparents used to have with all of the storage options inside. The interior is a plastic material which makes for easy clean up. If your toiletries should spill, it will be easy to wipe up. I am very pleased with the quality of this luggage. It's well made and sturdy.

title: Just What I Wanted
text: My daughter is in her school marching band's color guard. It's football playoff time. The weather has gotten much cooler and I wanted something for my daughter to wear on her head to help keep her warm. This fleece ear warmer is the right color of blue to go with her uniform. The band director will let them wear hats, gloves, and scarves only if they match the school blue. This headband fits well. It has enough stretch to go over her head and cover her ears. It's constructed well. The fleece material is a good thickness so it doesn't feel too cumbersome. It's helped provide a little more warmth for my daughter during these late season football games.

title: Comfy & Pretty!
text: I've been having a bra "slump" lately. I've been very unhappy with the bras I've been wearing. First of all,  my bras need to be thick enough so the nipples aren't visible. At my age (late forties), it's not a pretty thing.  I also like my bras to provide nice shape. No uni-boob!
