I want my bras to be comfortable, too, so I don't have to rush home at the end of the day to take it off. This Playtex bra is very pretty. It's sometimes hard to find a bra that is pretty and meets all my requirements. The cups are padded enough that the nipples are not showing through, but it's also not too thick that I feel like I am wearing a padded bra. I wear a 42DD, I don't need padding! The bra gives a nice shape. I wish the band could be a little tighter. I think that would help with the lifting of girls, too. Or maybe in this brand, I need to go with a 40DD instead. It's pretty comfortable, too. The straps don't dig into my shoulders and I am not rushing home after work to take it off.  Overall, I am very pleased with my new bra.

title: Sturdy Luggage that Glides Well
text: My grandfather used to travel with Delsey brand luggage. He said it was one of the best luggage brands out there. He's long gone now, but Delsey luggage definitely reminds me of him. This is my first luggage by this brand and so far, I am pretty impressed. The hardcases are more flexible than I expected. I have always had soft luggage and the hard case surface of these is much sturdier than what I have used in the past. The wheels move extremely smooth. I had my teenager walk around the hard surfaces on the main floor of the house with the luggage to try out the wheels. They never glitched at all, even over the thresholds and transition pieces. The handle locks into place much better than my old luggage, but the locking mechanism could easily be unlocked because it's located on the hand grip and my hand would accidently press it. The interiors of the luggage remind me a lot of the nice quality that old fashioned luggage had. There are multiple compartments and straps that are non-existent or minimal in a lot of contemporary luggage. Overall, I am very pleased with this luggage set and would give it a 4.5 star rating if I could.

title: Nice Looking Jacket!
text: My husband is 6'2" and weighs 216 pounds. The XL fits him well. The arm length is long enough for his tall frame. I'm 5'6" and a women's size 18 and it fits me, too, though it hangs a bit large on me in the arms and shoulders. The jacket is quilted and pretty thick. We live in Georgia and my husband should be able to get by with using this as his winter coat for most of the season. The zippers all work well. The construction of the jacket is quite nice and stands up to the Tommy Hilfiger name. Overall, it's a good looking, heavy jacket that will work well for cold and wet weather.

title: Love My New Wallet!
text: I love my new wallet! I was using a zip around wallet for the last several months, and I was getting tired of zipping and unzipping. Plus, sometimes I got dollar bills stuck in the zipper. This wallet has been awesome so far!  I was worried that it might have difficulties snapping in place if it was full, but it hasn't been a problem. I have cards in every slot, plus a few extras inside one of the inner pockets. I keep my checkbook in it as well as whatever little cash that I have. My cell phone doesn't fit in it, but I don't think I would keep it in there anyway. My daughter approves of the faux leather. It seems to be pretty well made as far as  I can tell.

title: Smoother Look
text:
My daughter is in her high school marching band color guard. Their uniforms and costumes are very fitted this year. My beautiful daughter feels self conscious wearing them. She's 5'7" and weighs 135 pounds. I ordered her a medium and it fits well. Although I don't think she needs to wear one of these, it does give her a smoother look under her uniform and costume. In her words, it's "comfortable enough". Though she is glad she doesn't have to wear it all day. All the seams are strong and the overall construction of the garment is very good. It's not itchy or scratchy.

*I received this for free in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Nice Shape
text:
My teenage daughter prefers to wear sports bras over traditional bras. These have a nice shape. The padded cups separate and do not create a "uni-boob" look. They are comfortable to wear and are pretty true to size. The should straps don't dig into the shoulders. The fabric is soft and non-irritating. They offer a decent support, but not quite as much as a compression type sports bra would offer. My daughter really likes the assortment of colors and stripes.

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Cute Assortment!
text:
I ordered these for my teenage daughter. She is 5'7" and weighs about 135 pounds. I ordered her the medium size and she says they fit comfortably. They do not ride up or bunch up. The fabric is soft and moves with her. These are called boy shorts, but they are less like boy shorts and more like a combination between hipsters and bikinis. My daughter isn't a fan of traditional boy shorts, but she likes the style of these. The color assortment is pretty. My daughter is happy with these. The quality is good. All seams are straight and there are no loose threads.

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Runs Small
text:
I ordered this for my teenage son. He likes to sleep in tank tops and boxers. He's big guy, so I ordered the 2XL. It did not fit him at all. It's way too narrow. It does stretch, but not enough. It did fit my husband who wears a L to XL in shirts, depending on the shirt. The color is just as picture. It's a nice, vibrant blue. The quality is fine. There are no loose threads or crooked seams. The fabric is soft, but a little thin. This is not something my husband would wear out in public, but he would wear it at home or under another shirt.

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Cute Swim Suit!
text:
My teenage daughter wanted a high waisted bikini with a retro vibe to it, so I ordered this one for her. She's 5'7" and weighs about 135 pounds. She wears a Juniors medium to large or a misses small to medium. I ordered this in a medium. She's a 34C. The bottoms fit beautifully. She normally doesn't wear bikinis because she feels self conscious in them. This gives her enough coverage that she doesn't feel awkward in it. The top fits okay, but not great. It ties at the neck and at the back. If it's tied tightly, it gives plenty of support. If it isn't tight enough, she feels like it's going to fall off. It's a bit difficult to get it tied perfectly. If I had another hand, I could definitely do it! The suit is cute and looks just like the pictures. The quality is fine.

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Good Looking Watch!
text:
My husband still enjoys wearing watches, even in a time when many people don't anymore. This watch has a nice classic design and is appropriate for him to wear to work. The leather band is very nice and easily fits his wrist. The Roman Numerals are really elegant looking. So far it seems to be keeping accurate time. The date was easy to adjust after noticing that the day of the week was correct, but the numeral date was wrong. The watch face is a good size and it's easy to read the time as long as you know your Roman Numerals! My husband is very happy with his new watch.

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Beautiful!
text:
I love to wear jewelry, but after I nearly lost a precious diamond necklace that my grandmother gave me, I have been wary about wearing anything valuable. This is a gorgeous, solitaire necklace that looks like it might cost a fortunate, but it doesn't! The CZ stone looks real. This is a classic, beautiful accessory to dress up any outfit. I have not had any discoloration from this piece. The chain is adjustable so you can get the right look for you. The chain is sturdy enough, but it does not look quite as high quality as the pendant portion of this necklace. I have gotten compliments from my co-workers when I've worn this. It really is beautiful!

*I received this for free in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Nice Quality
text:
I love nice quality "costume jewelry". I feel much better wearing CZ or other inexpensive stones as opposed to real ones. That's because I have lots a few real pieces during my life. It makes me sick to even think about my grandmother's diamond solitaire necklace that I lost in the hot tub! I was lucky enough to find it, but I haven't worn it since. So with a nice, faux gem, I can dress my outfit up a bit without worrying about all the "what ifs". This stone has a beautiful setting. There are tiny little CZ stones intricately placed in the silver work around the larger blue stone. The stone is set securely. The chain is nicer than I expected, too. There's some extra chain so you can adjust the length a little bit. I am very impressed with how nice this necklace is and I am enjoying having a new piece of jewelry to wear.

*I received this for free in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Nice Display Case for Watches
text: My husband has several watches that he rotates through. He usually just keeps the ones that he's not wearing on his nightstand or in the drawer of his nightstand. I decided he needed a better way to store them. This allows him to keep all of his watches in a dust free, cushioned box. He can see them through the glass top. It really is a classy way to keep your watches organized.

title: Great Quality Shirt
text:
My husband is turning 50 in a couple of weeks and I thought this shirt might be a fun way to advertise that I am married to an old man! The printing on the shirt is clear and professional. It really is a good looking shirt. The shirt is a nice weight and not too thin. I ordered an XL for my husband. It's a little loose, but not baggy. He might have been okay in a large. His usual sizing is right in between a Large and XL, but when ordering online, I do tend to go up in size to be safe.

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Nice Looking Shirt
text: My husband likes wearing short sleeve button down shirts to work. He is 6'2" and weighs about 220 pounds. He wears Large to Extra Large size shirts. I ordered this in a large and the fit is perfect! It's not tight at all nor is it baggy. The twill material does have to be ironed, but it's a good looking shirt. The shirt is made well. There are no loose threads or weak seams.  The bottom is curved so he can't really wear it untucked, but for work he wouldn't wear it untucked anyway. He's a picky shirt guy and he likes this, so I will probably be ordered another one in a different color for him.

title: Great Support!
text:
As far as sports bras go, my daughter thinks this one is great! She wears sports bras on a daily basis. She is self conscious about her body and feels more secure wearing a sports bra. So if she can get by wearing one instead of a traditional bra, she will. Plus, she has marching band practice four days a week after school and she wants to change for practice as quickly as possible. What she likes about this one is that it actually offers her some support. She wears a 34C bra. A lot of sports bras really don't support much. This is also pretty comfortable. There are a lot of hooks to fasten, but because they are in the front, it's pretty easy to do so. I ordered the medium size for her and she is pleased with its fit.

*I received this for free in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Cute But Doesn't Cover Up Enough
text:
It's a cute swim suit cover up, but it doesn't cover up as much as I would like it to. I ordered this for my teenage daughter. She's 5'&7" and weighs about 130 pounds. The cover up is super wide and thus baggie on her but it's too short and doesn't cover her well. In the back, it hits her right at her rear end. On the front, it comes up shorter and doesn't even reach the bottom of her swim suit. She would prefer (and so I would I) if it covered the entire swim suit. The design is cute. It has a Bohemian look to it. It seems to be constructed well. The material is light weight, but not transparent.

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Pretty Lace!
text: I love this bra! It's not only cute, but it's comfortable, too. It offers enough support even though there is no under wire. There's no "uni-boob" either. The lace detail is pretty and feminine. The straps don't dig into my shoulders. I am very pleased with it.

title: Great Shirt!
text: I love this shirt! It's very flattering. I usually wear a size 18/20 in womens plus sizes or a 1X. I ordered this in a 1X. The neckline is a little big and my bra straps show a little too easily. I will most likely wear a black bra when wearing this and I don't think it will look too badly. The key hole tie can be tied tighter to help with that, but it's not completely foolproof. The fabric doesn't wrinkle which is perfect for traveling. It says to hand wash only, but I have machine washed in cold and didn't have any problems. I even threw it in the dryer. It's a polyester/spandex blend. The length is nice and not too short. I'm so glad that I found this!

title: Cute Top!
text: What a cute top! I love that it's made from a no wrinkle fabric. This would be perfect to take on trips. I usually wear an 18/20 in women's plus size clothing or a 1X. I ordered the 1X. It does fit pretty well. The neckline is a little large and I have to position my bra straps so they aren't visible. I can tie the key hole ties tight to help with that, but it's still an issue. The sleeves have slits in them that I didn't realize when I ordered. It says so in the title, but I was going by the pictures. The slits are very large and I think I should be able to wear this to work. It says to hand wash only, but it's a polyester/spandex blend which is usually pretty easy going. I machine washed it on cold without any noticeable problems.

title: Decent Fit
text:
I usually wear a size 18/20, so I ordered an XXXXL swim suit. The bottoms fit perfectly. The top was okay. I wear a 40DD and although it did fit, I felt that it wasn't really designed for large breasted women. There are round pads inserted in the front and they are smaller than my cup size. The only support at all is from tying the halter straps and that loosened up over time.The top just wasn't as flattering as I had hoped. The material is also on the thin side. My husband was the first one to make that observation. I ordered this with the intent of wearing it in our personal hot tub and I feel comfortable doing that. I would not wear this out in public, but I wasn't going to anyway.

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Great Storge
text:
I have a different styled cable organizer that just wasn't working for me. I didn't like how it was laid out. It had multiple "pages" and when you added cables and chargers to a page, it got thicker and was difficult to zip up. This one is better designed to accommodate the thicknesses of multiple accessories. There are different sizes of pockets and pouches so you can keep a power bank, wall chargers, cables and more. It's nice having everything handy in one place. The zipper works well and glides easily. I am very pleased with this.

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Great for Travels!
text:
I absolutely love this new shirt!!! I plan to order another one (or two) after my next paycheck. I wear an 18/20. For this shirt, I ordered the XXL and it fit nicely. I might have been able to get by with the XL, but this one is fine. Shirts that are too large for me are often too large on the shoulders and will slip and show my bra, but this one doesn't. I'm not having to readjust at all. The length is long enough that I am not having to pull it down all day to cover my backside. The fabric is light and perfect for hot summers in Georgia! It doesn't wrinkle so this will be great for traveling. Stitches and seams are good. I am really very happy with this!

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Fits Well, But Too Thin to Wear Out in Public
text: I ordered these for my 15 year old daughter. She's 5'7" and weighs about 130 pounds. The fit is fine. The fabric is a little on the thin side. I was hoping she would be able to wear these to marching band camp, but it is see through enough that you can see her underwear. So instead she's wearing them around the house and under skirts or dresses. They are made well and they are very comfortable.

title: Cute, Cheap Drawstring Bag
text:
My daughter wanted/needed a cheap drawstring backpack for marching band camp. She needed it to be somewhat waterproof, just in case it rains, so the polyester material fit the bill. We don't have huge expectations for this, but we're hoping it lasts through band camp. She doesn't have to carry a whole lot in it, so there shouldn't be too much strain on the grommets. The polka dot design is cute and preppy.

*Update 7/23/2016: It didn't last through band camp. The string broke after just one week of camp. I had to buy her a new bag for the second week of camp.

title: Very Cute!
text:
This is a cute, fitted t-shirt! I ordered a medium sized shirt for my teen daughter. She is 5'7" and weighs about 130 pounds. She might have been able to get by with the small shirt, but this is good. The eyes hit at a good location (not directly on the chest!). I was a little worried as to wear they would be positioned, but it's totally appropriate. The shirt is light weight, but still a good, cotton material. It's slightly see through, but as not to the point where I won't let my daughter wear it in public.

*I received this for free in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Pay Attention to the Sizing!!
text: I didn't pay attention to the sizing. I ordered my usual 1X which I assumed to be an 18-20, but it was not. I should have ordered a L. This is way too big on me. Beyond my mistake, the shirt is a nice quality. I love the longer t-shirt length. I hate it when I have to keep tugging my shirts down to cover my back side. This won't happen with this one. It's a soft, beautiful color. After reading other reviews, I won't even try to send it back.  I only paid $6 for it which is less than what others say the restocking/return shipping fees are!

title: Cute, But Doesn't Fit Well
text:
This is a cute swimsuit. Unfortunately it doesn't fit well. I ordered this for my teen daughter. She's 5'7" and weighs 130 pounds.She usually wears a size medium to large in junior sizing or a small to medium in misses. I ordered her a large after reading recommendations to order a size up. The bottom fit fine, but the top was too large. She wears a C cup bra and it ended up being too loose on the under side.It fastens with a traditional swim suit fastener and there's no way to adjust the circumference on it. Because the bottoms fit well, I'm not sure they would fit if we had gotten the medium. It's a good looking swim suit and it's made well.

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Cute Swimsuit!
text:
This swimsuit is absolutely darling! I ordered it for my 15 year old daughter. She is 5'7" and weighs 130 pounds. All of her friends wear bikinis to the pool and she prefers a little more coverage. Of course, that's totally fine with me! This tankini gives the look of a bikini with the coverage over her middle area. It was difficult selecting the size. We went with a medium and it fits perfectly. The swimsuit has good construction. The blue print "bikini" is really cute. The black "cover" has an elastic edge at the bottom so it won't float up when in the water.

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Beautiful!
text:
These are attractive, beautiful earrings. They're called "Exotic Garden" and that is an accurate name for them. They have a vintage/Asian look to them. They are relatively comfortable, though I found that after a few hours, my ears were ready for a break. This is an issue that I have with most earrings, not specifically for these. It's usually because of the weight of the earrings, not any allergic reactions. These are pretty light weight considering that they are long, dangling earrings. Construction on the earrings seems to be good and secure. They really do dress up your outfit!

*I received these for free in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Comfortable
text: My daughter prefers sports bras over traditional styled ones. She really likes this one. It's very comfortable and offers her adequate support. There are no pads to worry about. It's just a basic, no frills bra. I ordered her a medium for her 34/36 C size and it fits well.

title: Whimsical Socks!
text:
My teen daughter loves to wear fun, colorful socks. When she saw these, she was so excited, she squealed! Most of her fun, animal socks have the animal located on the front side, on top of the feet. These are unique because the dogs are on the back, above the ankle. There are even little ears that stick up from the dogs' heads. The colors are vibrant. Each dog is a different breed as far as we can tell. The socks are mid-weight and fit my daughter's size 9 foot. The construction of the socks is very good.

*I purchased these at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Fits My Son's Large Size 15 Feet!
text: My son needed new socks. His shoes are black and he prefers to wear black socks with them. When he wears shorts, then he wants to wear ankle socks. He's a big guy and wears a size 15 Wide shoe. These socks fit his feet comfortably. They are thick enough and seem to be well made.

title: Great No-Show Socks!
text:
My daughter likes to wear cute shoes, but wants the "no sock" look to go with it. Her feet get too sweaty to go sockless, so she ends up wearing socks that are visible. These socks are the best no show socks we have tried. It really looks like she is not wearing any socks! They are a good mid-range thickness. They are comfortable to wear. There are ridges on the back heal that help keep the socks from slipping down. My daughter thought that was pretty cool. The colors are muted and natural looking. They are really great socks!

*I purchased these at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Cute, But Runs Small
text:
I ordered this yoga shirt for my teen daughter. She is 5'7" and weighs about 130 pounds. She usually wears a size medium to large in juniors and a small to medium in misses. She wears a C cup size. I ordered the XL for her, but it was too tight on her. She could get it on, but it was too binding and restrictive. So unfortunately we will be passing this on to a friend. The quality of the shirt is very nice. It's solid material in the front, but the back side and front side sleeves are a see through. The fabric is a moisture wicking material, perfect for athletics. The construction of the shirt is good. There are no loose threads, edges and seams are fine.

*I received this shirt for free in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Husband Likes Them
text: My husband has worn Hane's tank undershirts for years. His old ones were looking worn and dingy, so I ordered these to replace them. They fit as expected. He likes the tagless feature. They are long enough that they stay tucked in all day and they are thin enough that they don't add too much bulk.

title: Great to Carry With You!
text:
If you think these are a substitute for regular shoes, you'll be disappointed. They are thin, cheap looking, slipper type shoes. I bought them for my teen daughter and her first reaction was "they're ugly". Then I went on to tell her that they would be easy to slip inside her purse or bag and then if she was wearing uncomfortable high heels, she could easily pull these out and slip them on instead. I see it as an alternative to going barefoot when you take off your heels. She actually agreed with me on that and decided to take them. They aren't something you could wear for long periods of time. They offer no support at all or minimal protection. They will keep your feet clean (as opposed to walking barefoot). She wears a size 9 shoe and these were just a tad large on her, but wearable. The material is vinyl. They really do look like some house slippers that I used to have. They fold up easily and fit into the zippered case.

*I purchased these at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Provides Nice Coverage
text:
My teen daughter is very self conscience when it comes to wearing swimsuits. She's 5'7" and weighs about 130 pounds. She wears a 34C bra size. Her clothing size ranges from medium to large in juniors and small to medium in misses. The fit is perfect. Although it has the mesh parts, she feels covered. She has had some issues with not enough coverage on top, but she is pleased with the coverage and support she gets from this swimsuit. The construction of this suit is very good. There are no loose threads or weak seams. It has removable pads. The style of the swimsuit is similar to suits that swimmers wear (swim team). My daughter loves her new swimsuit!

*I received this for free in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Very comfortable!
text: This is my first Playtex bra and I love it. It offers as much support as an under wire bra without the under wire! It is super comfortable and I can literally wear it all day without any discomfort. The band isn't too tight and the shoulder straps don't dig in either. I am very happy!

title: Cute Shrug
text: This shrug fits perfectly! It's everything I was looking for except for the color. I ordered the khaki green based on the picture, but it is more of an artichoke green.  Basically it's a dark, olive or army green. I knew it was a gamble when I ordered it. The fit was fine. I ordered the US 18-20 which is the UK 20-22. I wear a US 18.  It is nicely made. I have not seen any loose stitches or threads. I plan to order another one in a different color.

title: Super Comfy!
text: Crocs Capri Flip Flops are my favorite warm weather shoes! They are super comfortable and I can wear them all day. I get flare ups of Plantars Fasciitis so I cannot wear flat shoes any more. Most of the cute flip flops don't offer me adequate support which leads to my painful flare ups. I usually get a couple of new pairs each spring. I've still got my two pairs from last year, but they are beginning to show some wear. I am very happy with them!

title: Cute!
text:
This women’s shirt is very cute! I debated for quite a while on which size to order. I usually wear a size 18 or 1X in Women’s sizing. If it’s standard misses sizing, I get a 2X. Based on my height and other details, I compared myself to the model pictured. I am a little taller than her and weigh a lot more than her, but my other measurements were less than hers. I finally decided on the 1X. I think that size worked pretty well. It was a teeny bit tight pulling it over my head, but once it was on, it felt fine. It was not tight across the chest or the waist. It is a lower cut than I am used to, so I will either have to wear a camisole or a plunge bra with it. The fabric stretches and the cut is very forgiving. It’s not the highest of quality, but it’s decent and I liked it so that what counts.

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Adorable Necklace!
text:
My teen daughter has been wanting one of these name necklaces for a while. Whenever we find them at the stores, her name is always out of stock. When this arrived, she was more than thrilled. It's nice looking and seems to be well constructed. The chain is a little on the cheap side, but it seems sturdy enough and the length is perfect. We have not had any issues with the color or tarnishing. The font is cute, too.

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Comfy!
text: I have been searching for an affordable and comfortable bra for the past several months. I've been tired of wires poking out & uncomfortable bands. This bra is comfy and offers adequate support. I don't feel the need to take my bra off as soon as I come home from work anymore!!  It's not very pretty - it's just a basic bra, but I'm pleased with it nonetheless.

title: Cute!
text:
I ordered these shorts for my teenage daughter. I got a size medium for her. She's 5'7" and weighs about 125 pounds. She is in winter guard and marching band color guard and needs active wear that will allow her to move. These shorts fit her well. They are not too short that I would not let her wear them to practice. However, with that being said, they may be too short on someone my age! On her they are appropriate looking. They do have a fold over top. She doesn't like that feature on any of her clothes, so she actually wears it up which actually gives her a little more coverage. The shorts are well made & allow for plenty of movement.

*I purchased these at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Cute, but fabric is thinner than I would like
text:
I love wearing long maxi skirts in the summer! This one is made out of a very soft fabric. I wouldn't call it sheer, but it does allow some light to shine through thus showing the outline of your legs. The skirt is well made, but I found it to be just a little too large. I am a plus size 5'6" mom. I usually wear a size 18. I ordered the 1x and it was a little too big. It wasn't falling off by any means, but I would have preferred a slightly tighter fit. It does show all the curves and bumps and lumps. I would wear this during the evening time slot when the sunlight won't shine through the fabric and reveal my legs!

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Nice Assortment of Khaki Colors
text: I've been buying my husband Dockers socks for years and these are on par with what I have purchased at the stores. It's the first time I have seen a variety pack of  khaki colors. My husband likes to match his socks to his pants color and this set allows him to do so easily. The quality is no different than what we have purchased in the past. They are thicker than dress socks and offer more comfort, too. My husband is pleased with these.

title: Great Shirt for 1998 Babies!
text:
My baby boy turned 18 earlier this year so when I saw this shirt, I had to order it! The shirt is a high quality t-shirt with a nice thickness. It's not one of those thin, practically see through t-shirts. My son was amused with the design. The silk screening (or whatever process was used) is well done and securely on the shirt. We've laundered it once so far and the image looks as good as it did before it was washed. Also, there was no shrinking in the size. I ordered a 2XL shirt and it fit well. And it arrived nearly two weeks earlier than estimated!

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Beautiful Dress!
text:
What a beautiful dress! I ordered this for my teenage daughter who has a fascination with retro styles. She is 5'7" and weighs about 125 pounds. I ordered a medium for her based on the size chart and it fits well. The bodice is lined which you don't often see with dresses in this price range. The skirt is nice and full. She wants me to get her a petticoat or crinoline to wear under it. The seams are pretty straight, but we did see a few loose threads. The fabric is a good mid-weight. It was pretty easy to iron, but it was a little time consuming because of the fullness. There are no loops for the sash which is nice if you don't want to wear it.

*I purchased this dress at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Bright & Colorful Socks!
text: These socks are so cute! I ordered a set to share with my teen daughter. I wear a size 10W shoe and she wears about an 8/12. The socks fit both of us pretty well. The heel patch fit on the heel where it should. I hate it when the heel doesn't line up correctly because my feet are large! It fit my daughter, too, so it has a little stretch to it to accommodate our different sizes. I found the top of the sock to be a little tight. These are crew length so they only go up a little past the ankles. The material is thin, but not too thin. I have been wearing these with jeans and tennis shoes. They're bright & colorful.

title: Great Gift Idea!
text:
My husband is turning 50 later this year and when I saw this shirt design, I had to order it! It's a clever way to identify the big 5-0 without some silly "over the hill" shirt. In fact, I don't think my husband would even wear one of those. The silk screening is well done and looks great. I ordered an XL for my 6'2" husband and it fits well. I've washed and dried it once so far and I didn't notice any shrinking or fading.

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Nice Quality of Shirt
text: My teenage daughter participates in Color Guard & Winter Guard. I thought it might be fun to have a shirt supporting her. From the picture, I could tell it was a ladies cut shirt. So when selecting a size, I went a little bigger than I usually wear and it fit well. I usually wear an 18/20 so with Men's t-shirts I go with XL or sometimes a 2X. I ordered this in a 3X and it fits a little loosely on me. I hate shirts that are too tight in the chest area, but this one is not tight across the chest at all. The silk screen work is well done and has not faded or worn away at all. The shirt is a nice thickness and I don't feel like my muffin top is showing through the light pink fabric too badly! It also is long enough that it covers my back side when I bend over. I am very pleased with this shirt.

title: Cute shirt!
text:
This is a cute, spring shirt. I ordered the 3X size after reading the size measurements for the product. I usually wear an 18/20 size, but I also know that since it is imported, it's not going to be equivalent to American sizes. The 3X size fit well. It is a little large, but not too big.I may have been able to get by with the 2X. An American 3X shirt would be way too big. I am pleased with how it fits. The shirt is a beautiful mint color. It's a pretty combination of lace and solid material. It does say that it needs to be hand washed in cold water. I was a little concerned about how much my bra straps would show because of the lace yoke, but it isn't that noticeable. The length is nice - I like my shirts to come down a little longer than my pants' waist. The shirt is well constructed. All seams and stitches are secure.

*I purchased this at a discount for the purpose of trying it out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Cute Beanie!
text:
This beanie is adorable! I ordered the black "meow" hat for my teenage daughter and she loves it! The hat is well constructed. There are no long loose yarns or stitches. It fits her nicely with room to spare. After I ordered this, I saw a student at the school where I work at wearing a similar one. I liked the font on ours better. Not only is it fashionable, but it's useful during this cold weather.

*I received this beanie for free for the purpose of trying out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Beautiful Bracelet
text:
This bracelet is adorable! I ordered this for myself, but it has been claimed by my teenage daughter. The metal can be bent to adjust sizes. It fit my large wrist, but it could be adjusted to fit my daughter's thinner wrist. Because it's a think bangle, it does look better on my daughter's wrist. The inscription is not only beautifully done, but it's a great quote, too! This is a simple and beautiful piece of jewelry.

*I received this for free for the purpose of trying out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Cute & Roomy Purse!
text: I am loving my new purse! It's got enough room for everything that I need to bring with me on a regular basis. There are multiple exterior pockets which are nice for storing stuff like breath mints, headache relief, and other things I don't want to have to search all over for inside. I love the dark brown color. I put the longer strap on the bag thinking I would use it more, but the regular straps are long enough to go over my shoulder. I'll probably end up taking the longer strap off and storing it inside the purse. It's a great, inexpensive purse that meets my needs.

title: Love the Simple Design!
text:
I have tried several travel money belts in the past year and this one is one of my favorites. The reason I like it so much is that it's basic and not trying to look sporty. In fact, it looks so normal, I can wear it as a thin fanny pack and it doesn't stand out. A lot of times I just need something small to carry a few essentials and I don't want to carry a purse. This is perfect for those times. There are 2 different zipper compartments and in the back one, there are 3 little pockets. There's a hidden pocket on the back side that goes against your body. All the zippers glide easily. I like that it has the RFID blocking feature, but I don't have any way to test that out. The waist belt part is actually softer and smoother than a lot of the other ones that I have tried. It's still strong, but it feels nice! The belt is easy to adjust & the clips are secure.

*I received this product for free for the purpose of trying out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Roomy & Comfortable!
text:
This is by far the roomiest travel money belt I have seen. It's comfortable & easy to adjust. The zippers are strong & sturdy and glide easily. I love the addition of the key clip and the hidden pocket. The front hidden buckle release is pretty cool, too! The fabric that lays against your skin is soft and non-irritating. You can definitely hold a lot of stuff in this! I do not have any way to test to the RFID blocking abilities.

title: Great for Peace of Mind While Traveling
text:
I personally haven't any troubles with identity theft, but with improvements with today's technology, it's a good idea to be proactive so it doesn't happen to you. These RFID sleeves are sturdy & strong. They remind me of the sleeves you get with your hotel key card, but tougher. They are lined with a silver colored material. The passport sized sleeve fit both an older US Passport as well as the newer RFID styled passport. The credit card sized ones fit well for credit card sized cards. Cards are easy to remove from the sleeves, too. Now once in the sleeves, the credit cards still fit in the credit card slots of my wallet. They did not fit into the plastic photo style sleeves of another wallet that I have. I think these are definitely good for your peace of mind. I do not have any way to test their effectiveness against theft.

*I received these for the purpose of testing out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Definitely better than Wearing a Fanny Pack!!
text:
There have been many occasions recently where I don't really need a purse, but I have a little more than what will fit in my pockets. I really only need to take a few essentials with me, so at first I tried a fanny pack. I'm a plus size mom and I really don't care for the way fanny packs look on me. I especially don't like the extra attention to my waist line! The Hopsooken Travel Money Belt is a nice alternative. It easily holds my ID, credit card, lip balm, phone, and headache relief without adding too much bulk. I can wear it under my shirt comfortably. The back of it is a soft mesh that doesn't rub or chafe. The front of the money belt is nylon and although it is not waterproof, it does a nice job of keeping the items sweat free. I tried just putting money in my pocket, but in the hot Georgia temperatures, my money would get a bit sweaty. Yuck! The zippers glide very easily and are nice & sturdy. It's easy to adjust. I love the blue color! Most money belts I've seen are black or natural.

*I purchased this at a reduced price for the purpose of trying it out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Super Comfy!

So for the last few years, I have been searching for a more affordable bra that worked as well as the expensive ones. Well, I think I've found it! What I liked about the other bras and I haven't had luck finding, was a good lifting bra. The Glamorise Magiclift delivers! The girls are back up where they belong! It is very comfortable and I can wear it all day. I've had some bras that I just can't wait to take off. I am very happy and I will be checking out some of the other Glamorise bras.

It's made out a super soft fleece material. I love that it can be worn several different ways. It fit everyone in my family except my teenage son. He's a big kid & doesn't usually fit in "one size fits all" products. Fortunately, measurements are provided in the item description, so if in doubt, you can determine if it will fit before you order. The ear muffs are a nice bonus. The inside is lined with a very soft faux fur. They are snug & only fit from behind your head rather than over the top of your head. These were slightly smaller than the other pair. They fit well enough to wear them, but I feel like the back of my feet are hanging over the edge just a tad. I don't have that issue with the other pair. I expected them to fit the same since everything about them was the same except the color/print. With that aside, I really like the houndstooth print. The give nice arch support. I am still a fan of the Croc Capri Flip Flops. Though because of the sizing issue, I may hesitate before buying them online in the future.

The zippers are nice & strong, too. I have been zipping & unzipping them multiple times to make sure that they are strong and there have been no troubles. title: 5 M US I love the look of these shoes and the size was ...
text:
Nine West Women's Timewarp Leather Ballet Flat, Black, 7.5 M US
I love the look of these shoes and the size was correct, however, the heel was very narrow and the leather quite rigid so that it was uncomfortable. Even worse, the width across the ball of the foot (at the big toe joint) was as it should be, but pressed hard on the joints of the outside toes so that I couldn't wear them--possibly because the leather is so rigid. There was no arch support (some flats do provide enough to get by) and when I tried various orthotic inserts--like Spenco--the heel was so rigid and narrow that I couldn't get them in--so couldn't help the arch support problem. Even if I cut the toe part of the inserts to fit, putting anything more into the toe would increase the pressure problem.

Darn! the style is really cute, but back they go. I did find an alternative that works, although not exactly the same--the Tommy Hilfiger D'Orsay flats are much more comfortable.

title: I am so glad I discovered the Keen brand of shoe
text: I have problem feet:  narrow heel, flat and long arch, wide ball of foot, especially since my big toe has developed arthritis.  I also have arthritis in other toes and over-pronation.  I've been wearing custom orthotics for years for the over-pronation, but not always in the right kind of shoe.  Not only do these Keens come in a wide width to accommodate my widened big toe area, they don't pinch my toes or cause deformed toenails, as I've had with other shoes.  They not only have a wide toebox (in the wide width that I have bought), the toebox is also deep enough to fit in custom orthotics.  These shoes are the ones I wear all year (except in rain) for work around our ranch.  Excellent fit, support and comfort.  I now have other models for times when I wear an athletic shoe that isn't on the ranch (around town) and I just bought a pair of their 'sandals' for going to Hawaii--haven't used them yet.  I love Keen's durability and fit.  After 6 months of hard working wear on the ranch where I often wear these shoes for 8 hours or more, they are holding up well (just a little separation on the sides of the toe where the toe material gaps from the body fabric.  I'm going to try a good cleaning and Amazing GOOP II MAX Glue

title: Super sturdy (NOT TRUE-I wrote this review prematurely)
text:
Yes, this umbrella is a little heavier than the automatic Totes umbrella (17 ounces vs.13 ounces) but I think it will pay off in sturdiness. The vent will be helpful in strong winds and the deeper arc will help with heavy rain. The arc on this umbrella is 46" whereas the Totes is 42". I compared the other measurements as well: this umbrella is 12 " closed and the center pole opened is 21 1/4" long whereas the Totes is 11' closed and has a 17 1/2" center pole. Both handles are about the same- 2 1/2" and 2 1/4" respectively. The one area in which the Prostorm umbrella could be improved is the velcro strap. The Totes strap is about an inch longer and an inch wider which makes it super easy for one handed wrapping. The longer and thinner strap on the Prostorm tends to get twisted and requires a second hand to wrap it. Overall, an excellent umbrella.

***UPDATED REVIEW***I wrote the review above before using it. IT BROKE WITHIN 5 MONTHS OF PURCHASE. THE SECOND ONE BROKE AFTER ONE USE. The auto-open button wouldn't press so the umbrella would not open. I've never had an automatic umbrella just up and stop working so I only thought I would need to review the features, not whether or not it would continue to work. Too bad because it had a lot of good features, but not the most important one- it needs to work! Guess I'll go back to TOTES.

title: Sturdy Travel Tote
text:
I bought this tote to use on a trip to Europe; it was GREAT for these reasons:
1) At 15" wide by 13" tall by 4" at the bottom, it was perfect size for sightseeing. It was also the perfect size for EasyJet airline's allowance for a "personal item".
2) It has a zipper, which means nothing falls out in the airplane or gets wet if it rains.
3) It's good in the rain. The canvas-type material is water resilient and the shiny lining adds another layer of protection.
4) It's sturdy. I stuffed it full: raincoat, umbrella, souvenirs, etc. The straps stayed attached and the zipper held up.
5) It looks good. The shades of grey were perfect: I wanted something neutral that would not clash with my clothes, and the darker colors did not show dirt.
I highly recommend this tote!

title: Excellent Boots
text: I love these boots! We had our big snow storm here on the east cost a couple of months ago and they were perfect! We had 2 feet of snow and I was outside for hours each day; my feet were nice and dry. I will say that the first day I wore thick cotton socks and after a while my feet were feeling kind of cool. The next day I wore thick wool socks and they were plenty warm. I usually wear an 8 1/2 shoe, medium to wide, and ordering an 8 1/2 boot worked well. I measured my foot for this review and my foot is 10 inches long (standing on the measuring tape) and 9 inches around (wrapping the measuring tape around the widest part). I could have easily worn a second pair of wool socks if I had wanted to. Originally, I thought the boots would have been better if they were fur lined, but that is not necessary if you have good socks. Also I thought I might not like the lace up because I am used to zippered boots, but the lace-up allows for a custom fit that helps keep snow out. Finally, they are comfortable and well padded. Overall: Excellent boots!

Very flattering fit though and true to size so if colour and material doesn’t bother you that much then these are perfect for working out, dog walks, casual wear etc.

title: My Go-To Watch!
text: I love this watch! I’ve worn Timex since I was a teenager and they are my go to watch for standing up to everything you can throw at them. I’ve owned three in thirty years so that’s testament to how long they last. I’m an outdoors person so I put them through a lot. Love the backlight on this one so I can use it at night instead of checking time on my phone. This is a mini size so great for people like me with a small wrist that may find the others a bit too big. Even with a small face it is still super clear to read. Love this watch.

title: Better than my Uggs!
text: Literally I will never buy any other slippers than these. They are better than my Uggs and half the price. Super warm and hard wearing. I’m a size 7 and ordered my size and they fit perfectly. So comfy to wear all day. Wash well on a hand wash in the machine with delicate cycle. I love them!

title: Wonderful!
text: These dust bags are amazing! They are actually better than 99% of the original dust bags that come with the purse. I actually changed all my dust bags over to these as the quality is great, they are so soft so won’t scratch delicate leathers or hardware. They are wonderful.

title: Super Rain Mac!
text:
Absolutely super rain mac for the price. I have worn it numerous times in torrential rain and it’s kept me bone dry. I wish I’d found it sooner before forking out so much over the years on expensive jackets that didn’t work. I love how light it is and so it can be used even in humid weather when there’s a summer storm without making you sweat. It packs down super small and is so easy to throw in your bag and take with you.

It has a super flattering fit. Something I struggle to find when it comes to rain macs as an hourglass figure but this one looks amazing! I’m 5’ 2” and it comes to just above my knees. I wear a size 8 in clothes and am 150lbs with a 36DD bust and I went for a large in this jacket. Could have gotten away with a medium but I like the large size as means in colder months I could still wear it but with a sweater underneath. Highly recommend!

title: AWFUL!
text: I was over the moon when I found these online as I was looking for a cheaper slip-on shoe that I could put on when taking the dog out or doing the gardening. They arrived and firstly they were about an inch too big (and I am a true 7.5 and so ordered a 7.5), secondly, the lining kept falling out and so the shoe kept flying off. Absolutely awful so will be returning ASAP for a refund.

title: Bad zip!
text: I do badly wanted to love this bag and I did except for the awful zip. I had to return it because of that as I know trying to get in and out of a bag with a bad zip would end up driving me mad and I would never use the bag. Such a shame as everything else about it was great.

title: Best slippers!
text: These are above and beyond what I expected from a relatively cheaper slipper. Previously I have owned Ugg slippers and these ones are by far the best I’ve owned (no more Ugg’s for me). The memory foam is great for cushioning feet when wearing them most of the day. They are super warm now the weather is turning colder. The grip on the bottom works amazingly. We had a frost on the decking and they didn’t even slip when I went out to get the post in. Sizing spot on. This is going to be my go to slipper from now on.

title: Loved this bag!
text: I loved this bag and cannot say enough good things about it. It is great quality, super buttery leather and so versatile. It was a little on the heavy side even when empty so that is something to consider before purchasing, especially if like me you are used to something lightweight. This bag will help you build muscles just with the weight of it! Anyway I loved everything about it, it looked great, zippers were smooth (thats a big deal for me as I am fussy), looked expensive but unfortunately I had to return it because of the weight. So gutted as it was so beautiful.

title: The best nightie I own!
text: I love this nightie. I am not a nightie person as I find them too flimsy and fussy but this one changed my mind. It is so soft and comfortable that I practically live in it. I am a size 8/10 and I ordered both a medium and large. I ended up keeping the large for the super oversized fit but if you want one that is a bit more flattering on then a medium is perfect for a size 8/10. I just like the swamped look for my PJs.

text: These are great for work outs, walking, cycling. Super comfy and I love that they stay in place and that the waistband doesn’t roll down. Nice thickness and not see through. I purchased an XL (I usually wear a 10 bottoms). Could have gotten away with a L but after washing they did shrink slightly anyway and now fit perfectly. A little long on my 5’2” frame as almost down to my knee but honestly for working out and stuff who cares as it’s not a fashion show!

title: Great for women too!
text: Yes it’s men’s but I wear it as an under layer to keep me warm in minus temperatures and it is better than any thermal under layer I’ve tried. Originally got it for my husband but ended up using it myself and getting him another one.

title: Perfect for daily essentials!
text: This is a great everyday and travel bag. Fits all your essentials in it easily. Can be put in your carry on luggage for trips away and doesn't take up any space. Super lightweight and durable. My only complaint is it stated it was waterproof and it is not. My stuff inside got soaked after a light rain storm. Maybe waterproof if you spilt something on it and wiped off right away but will not stand up to much water. Otherwise great little bag!

title: Nice cheaper alternative to Tiffany
text: This is a great alternative to the original Tiffany design. I can't comment yet on tarnishing (which is something I find cheaper jewelry does) as I have not had it long enough yet. I have always wanted the original Tiffany heart necklace but it is was out of my budget, so when I found this dupe I was really excited. Design-wise it is like for like and have had a lot of compliments on it. One complaint about it though is the colour. I ordered yellow gold and it is too yellow (to the point that it makes it look cheap). If they could get the colour right then this would be a beautiful necklace. Chain is a little flimsy too and so I changed mine out as the clasp and chain broke after two wears. Otherwise for the price, it is a nice classy little purchase.

title: Great when it finally arrived!
text: This is a great strap for anyone wanting a replacement for their purse or if like me, you want to be able to change your straps out depending on what you are using your purse for. I got this to upgrade a flimsy chain strap on a little black leather Coach bag and it worked perfectly. Great quality. Adjustable (which is a must for me as I am only 5'2"). Sturdy and hardware so far has not chipped or tarnished. Really happy with it other than it took an age to arrive.

title: Too wide for boots

title: Best boots I've owned for the outdoors
text: I absolutely love these boots. I do a lot of outdoor work and these are my go to for construction work, being at the horse barn and I even wore them for work in the rainforests of Vietnam. Keep my feet safe, dry and warm. They have been through the ringer and they have held up. No rips or tears. Best pair of outdoor boots I've ever owned.

title: My Go-To Jeans
text: I am 5'2" and 150lb with an hourglass figure. I usually struggle to find jeans that fit me, are comfortable and flattering and so mostly live in leggings. That was until I tried these jeans and now I am a convert. They are as comfortable and easy to move in as leggings but with the appearance of smart jeans. I am in love! They look great dressed up or down and with their wide waistband, not being able to wear jeans out for a meal are a thing of the past. These don't dig in or cause a muffin like most other jeans. The pocket placement is perfect and really lifts your backside for a super flattering look. They make me look about two sizes slimmer than I am. I will be buying more pairs in the future and highly recommend!

title: Super Cute and Practical
text: I purchased this bag wanting something basic for everyday and evenings. Wasn't expecting a whole lot for the price so was over the moon with the quality when it arrived. The zipper is smooth and doesn't snag. Great quality material, I can see it lasting a long time. Perfect size for essentials and it looks great dressed up or down as there is no logo or anything garish on the bag. My only reason for giving it 4 stars and not 5 is that I am 5' 2" and find the strap a little long on me. This wouldn't normally be a problem if it was adjustable but it is not so I will have to order a shorter replacement strap for it. The good news is the strap is detachable though so easy to switch out. Very versatile little purse and great for everyday or evenings. Would highly recommend this bag.

title: Go-To Winter Sock!
text: These are my go-to winter socks. even in minus temperatures, they keep my feet toasty so that I can wear my normal riding boots that aren't insulated (nobody wants to live in big clunky snow boots all winter). I cannot say enough good things about them. They are warm but without the bulk. Great colours to choose from so also look cute when worn over leggings with ankle boots. If I could give them 10 stars I would.

title: Great quality and flattering fit!
text: I love this top so much I have ordered it in two other colours. I am an hourglass shape and usually, with tunics, they swamp me and make me look bigger than I am. This one tapers in at the waist for the most flattering look. I am a 34DD bust, 5'2" and 170lb and I ordered this in my usual MEDIUM and it fits perfectly. Great material quality and can be worn all year round. Love this tunic and highly recommend!

title: Amazing!
text:
I walking dogs and work outdoors for a living and have always dreaded the winter months with ice outside and slipping. I don't know how many non-slip boots I have tried and nothing worked. Then a friend recommended these treads and they are amazing!

I love Sorel snow boots as they keep my feet super warm and dry when working outdoors but they are terrible when it comes to ice and slipping. These ice grips have completely changed that and they fit my boots perfectly. I tried them out this week as we have had a cold snap and a lot of ice on the ground and I did not slip once. I could walk around with confidence and without fear of falling when out walking the dogs (and they pull the leads). Easy to get on and off the boots. Super durable. I will be getting a couple more pairs for my other boots. FIVE STARS!

title: LOVE these trainers!
text: I adore these trainers. Never again will I buy more expensive ones as these are so comfortable it is unbelievable. I am a EURO size 38 in shoes and ordered the size US 8 which fit perfectly. They are a bit narrow so probably not for someone with wide feet. They are so light you actually feel like you are not wearing any trainers at all. I walk daily in mine (6-10 miles) and so far they have held up perfectly. The soles show very little sign of wear and they are some of the only shoes I have been able to wear from new without getting blisters and walk miles in right off. Will definitely be ordering some more in the future.

title: Coziest slippers ever!
text:
These are the coziest comfiest slippers I have ever owned and I am thinking about getting another pair as I can see me wearing these out by time it gets to next summer. They are super soft and cozy. Only thing I wasn't sure about was the heavy beads on top of the foot (which can be heated in the microwave). I probably won't use that function as they are super warm without that but otherwise they are perfect.

I am a size EURO 38 and they fit really well. I would say if you were any bigger than that they may be tight on your feel so just be aware of that before purchasing. They may stretch over time I am not sure but I would say they do run a tad small.

title: Perfect for Organizing!
text:
I love this product! I change out my purses depending on my outfit and it was always a time consuming job moving everything from one purse to another. Then I found these! I just take the whole thing out and transfer into my next purse all in one go! Easy.

Plus they keep everything super organised inside and easy to find which is a bonus. All my purses are about the same size and so this fits all of them perfectly. Love this product and for the price and high quality, I cannot recommend enough!

Great quality for the price and really classy pattern. I am super happy with my purchase and will be getting some more in the future with a different pattern.

title: Great basic!
text: I am new to Amazon basics and I have to say I am impressed with the quality for the price. The sizing can be a bit off but overall I am happy with the purchase. What I love about these socks is they cover my heel which is something that not all low-cut socks do and so my heels do not get rubbed raw in my trainers. Also they are almost invisible when worn even with lower cut trainers. Will buy again!

title: Amazing fit!
text: These jeans are amazing! I hate buying jeans as I am a pear shaped body type and so trying to find something that fits my larger thighs and bum but doesn't gape at the waist is a big ask. My go to jean for so long has been NYDJ but they are very pricey and I was looking for a slightly cheaper alternative. I have tried so many and was about to give up until I came across these. They arrived today and the fit is spot on! These will be my go-to from now on as for the price and quality, I am one happy lady!

title: Best bathing suit I have ever owned!
text:
This is hands down the best and most flattering swimsuit I have ever owned. I have not been near a pool for the past five years as I hate what I look like in a swimsuit. Now I am accepting all invites to pool parties since finding this one!

I am 5'2" and a curvy build (160lbs) with a large chest (34DD) and so finding the right swimming costume that isn't too clingy and that has ample boob coverage and support has always been a problem. I just don't look good in a swimsuit. period.

I saw this one and thought I would give it a go and not only does it look great but it is also functional to wear in the pool (no more boobs falling out when you go down the waterslide). I am contemplating ordering a second one as I love it so much. It is great quality and has been washed a few times and still looks brand new. Great for lounging at the pool and great for actually swimming in, I would give this ten stars if I could.

title: The perfect bag!
text:
[[VIDEOID:a3f9b9c743687f0de34f4f6b418100d8]] This bag is perfection!

I can fit so much into it and it is so light and comfortable to wear. As you can see from video and photos I can fit all my daily essentials: card/money purse (black), small pouch for things like plasters and Advil (red), lip stick, sunscreen stick, iPhone 5, sunglasses and keys.

It doesn't bulge and isn't over full with all of the above in it and it isn't too heavy either. The zipper is great on it and is heavy duty but easy to access the bag. Comes with two removable straps so can be worn across body (long strap), on the shoulder (short strap) or how I had it in the video with neither strap and carried as a clutch.

The horse one that I have is a sturdy canvas with vegan leather accents. The straps are vegan leather with brass clips.

I literally have nothing bag to say about this bag as it's perfect for everyday to evening. Holds a lot of things and is great quality. Wish I'd found this years ago as it probably would have been my only bag and I wouldn't have wasted so much on others.

Five stars! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

title: Great Product!
text: Great basic short for wearing as lounge wear or for working out. Wash well and did not shrink even after throwing them in the tumble dryer as needed them dry ASAP. Super soft and comfortable to wear. Will be ordering another pair as for the price, the quality is great. I usually wear a size 10/12 and ordered size large, the fit was perfect!

title: Wanted to love these
text: I so wanted to love these but for the price, I felt the quality was just not that great. Unfortunately I returned them but what I will say if the fit was spot on. I usually wear a size 10/12 bottom and ordered a large and they fit great. I am 5'2" and 155lbs and the large was spot on for fit. In the photo they are up the calf but on me they hit my ankle which is to be expected as I am shorter. Really wanted to love them but just didn't like the quality.

title: Obsessed!
text: These are amazingly lightweight and comfy. Originally purchased as lounge wear for around the house but they look smart enough to wear out too. I am 5'2" and they are pretty long but because of the elastic cuff around the ankle, they don't drag on the floor. Did shrink a little when washed but that has made them fit better. I usually wear a size 10/12 bottom and so ordered a large. Fit perfectly! Will be ordering another pair.

title: Great Product but NOT cotton!
text: I love these shorts for wearing around the house and originally I purchased them as they were listed as cotton. They arrived and they are NOT cotton. I thought about returning them but they are a great fit and super comfy so will be keeping but I am annoyed with amazon yet again for another wrong listing. Would have been five stars if had been cotton as the listing states.

title: Sizing all off
text: I ordered these jeans in my usual size but when they arrived they felt almost two sizes too small. I reordered in the next size up and they were far too big. Just could not get on with these at all.

title: Great Product!
text: Great quality. Really thick felt and lots of storage pockets. Makes any bag more usable and organised. Fits perfectly. Really love this item.

title: Great Product!
text: Do exactly what they are supposed to do. Super light weight but so sturdy. Ideal for anyone like me that has a huge bunch of keys that doesn't want them to weigh a ton. Also used some of these key rings to fix new straps to my handbag that broke. Really great product.

title: Just OK
text: Unfortunately I couldn't get on with this bra. As a larger busted girl I find it hard to find a good sports bra to use for horse riding to minimize bounce. This one for the price did not do a very good job. It was pretty average. I have had cheaper bras that do a better job so unfortunately not what I was expecting.

title: Great Product!
text: These are the comfiest underwear I have ever owned. So soft and have a nice thick waistband on them so no more pulling the up. They come up to belly button and although I wouldn't say they are shapewear, they do smooth my belly pooch out so my clothes look more streamlined. Wash well, no shrinkage. Really love them and will be buying more in the future!

title: Obsessed!
text: These are some of the best slippers I have ever owned. For so long I lived in my Uggs and when I saw these I thought I would give them a go as they are much more affordable. I have had these almost a year and they have outlasted my Ugg slippers. I can chuck them in the washing machine when they get dirty and then into the tumble dryer to fluff them back up. They are so well made than even after all the washing and wearing they are still like new. These are now my go-to slipper and will be buying all my girlfriends a pair each this winter as they are so soft and warm. Five stars!

title: Obsessed!
text: I live in these leggings! They are the first ever leggings that are not only true to size, do not roll down and wash well, but also they are not see through! Hurrah! I have so many pairs of these as I use them for workouts and for wearing daily. I wear them in the winter as an under garment for extra warmth and I live in them through the summer with tunics as they are so much cooler than jeans or jeggings when its hot outside. Love these and cannot recommend enough! Five Stars!

title: Great Product!
text: Love this bra for travelling in. It is so comfortable and lightweight. No support whatsoever so don't recommend it if you are a larger bust and need to do anything other than travel or some light walking. But as lounge wear it is perfect! I own three of these as I do a lot of long haul flights and they are just so comfortable to wear.

title: Great Product but too expensive!
text: These are my absolute favourite jeans in the world. The fit is perfect (I am hour glass shaped) and these really balance my silhouette out. Also unlike so many jeans I have tried they do not gape at the waist if you are heavy in the bottom area and do not cling to your thighs if like me you are heavier in that area. My only complaint is the price. I would love to be able to own more than one pair of these but for the price I just cant justify it.

title: Obsessed!
text:
These are amazing! I am ordering a second pair for when these ones wear out as I am living in them at the moment. They are the most comfortable sneakers I have ever owned. I can walk miles in them without sore balls of my feet and no blisters. They are breathable enough to wear in the summer and are so lightweight that there is minimal sweating and therefore no blisters. Great arch support built in and so ideal for anyone that would normally have to add inserts to get that extra support. They look classy enough for the office as well as being worn casually at home and for the price they are an absolute bargain.

True to size. I am a Euro 38 and this is the size I ordered and they are a perfect fit. I wear wide fit most of the time (just so my toes can spread as I am on my feet almost all day) and even though these are not a wide fit there is plenty of room in the toe which is a must for me. Cannot recommend these enough. Five stars!

title: Great Product!
text: Fantastic quality and made the perfect gift for my friend that is going though a tough time right now. The engraving on the inside is really clear and the cuff itself is amazing quality. Highly recommend and a five star product!

title: The perfect jegging!
text: These are the perfect jegging. They fit like a legging. Super soft and comfortable to wear all day but with the look of a jean. My girlfriends were all shocked when I told them that they weren't a real pair of jeans! The only reason I am giving it four stars is that I ordered black and they are definitely blue. But if you are looking for something super comfy that can be dressed up or down, worn to work or casually at home then these are the jeggings for you. They wash really well and I must have washed these over twenty times now and they still look new. No fading and no shrinkage. Highly recommend!

title: Clip broke

The strap itself if so well made and I can see it lasting years but the clip is not the same quality and so unfortunately I will not be ordering any more.

title: Great shoe but too narrow!
text:
Unfortunately I had to return this item and I was so upset as they are gorgeous!

I found that they are true to size (I am a size 7 and ordered a 7) and although they fit perfectly length wise, I just found them too narrow in the toe area. I am thinking about ordering a size 8 but I think they will just be too long. The 7 was perfect but I wish they had just a 1/4 inch more width in the toe. Otherwise they were well made and just gorgeous and an absolute bargain for the price.

If you have really narrow feet I think they will be great but unfortunately for me they didn't work. Still giving them five stars though as they are a great product.

title: The Best Bra for Larger Bust
text:
As a petite person with a large bust, the bain of my life is finding a good bra that doesn't make me look like Dolly Parton. If you want a bit of lift you can never find anything that doesn't have padding and calling all bra companies...we don't need padding, we need support! On the flip side the other types of bra out there for larger busted ladies are ones that flatten our girls and make us look like we have uni-boob. Again, not flattering!

Then came this bra and it revolutionised my world! Not only does it give super-duper support, it also shapes AND lifts! Too good to be true right? For the first time in my life I feel like I am not carrying around two jiggling watermelons on my 5'2" frame as it is so comfy with the extra band around the bottom and the thick straps. The cups are full so no lumps, bumps or spillage which gives a super-smooth outline under even basics like tee-shirts and vests. No padding or underwire yet gives great lift up off your ribcage making even a larger bust look "perky", a word I thought I would never use. Runs true to size. I usually wear a 36D so ordered in this size and fits as if it was made for me. No digging in, no bra lines. Five star bra!

Love this bra so much and will be ordering more ASAP and throwing all the ones out I have at home.

title: Not The Best Value For Money
text: These were ok but not very long lasting. Mine pretty much fell apart after two washes. I do alot of outdoor work and wanted something to wear under layers to keep me warm. Admittedly I usually go for Cuddlduds but as they can be a bit pricey I gave these a try. They looked and fitted great when I first got them and did the job of keeping me warm. However after one wear I noticed they were rubbing thin and by time I had washed them twice (on a hand wash) they had fallen apart at the seams. Bit dissapointed. Will be gooing back to Cuddlduds.

title: LOVE IT!
text: I purchased this bag as a travel bag. I needed something sturdy and roomy to carry my 11 inch Chromebook laptop, a reading book, purse, girly essentials like make up, hair brush etc. Well this bag delivered above and beyond! Not only is it gorgeous to look and and well made, it is my favourite travelling companion. It fits perfectly under seats, can be used as one of my carry-on's when flying, it doesn't get too heavy even when full, doesn't show marks and held up in the rain. I absolutely adore it. Amazed at how roomy it. Along with my essentials I am able to roll my coat up and put in there or sweater and scarf which is so handy when travelling. It has a pocket on the front for easy access to things like paperwork, passport and phone and one large bag compartment for access to everything else. Love, love, love this bag and cannot recommend it highly enough!

title: Finally a bra that gives proper lift, shape and support to women with a bust bigger than a B cup!
text: Wow! Finally a bra that gives proper lift, shape and support to women with a bust bigger than a B cup! I am 5' 2" with 34 DD bust and I don't know how many bras I have tired over the years in search of the right support and shape as having a big bust on a small frame looks overwhelming. So often I have found that having a bigger bust means that if you want support you have to get something ugly and unflattering that makes you self conscious and unable to wear any top with a lower neckline or you get a pretty looking bra but get no support and end up looking like Dolly Parton as it's full of padding and pushes your boobs up under your chin. Well look no more ladies! Lilyette's Plunge bra is heaven sent! It is comfortable, gives amazing support, minimizes at least a cup size and gives you an amazing lift and shape with no padding. I went by their size guide when ordering and the bra fits as if I had it professionally fitted. I will definitely be ordering again.

title: Best leggings I have ever purchased!
text: I cannot stress enough that I never buy leggings online. Simply because I like to see them in person to make sure that they are not see through. You never know what quality you are getting online, but in this case after reading reviews I took a gamble and it paid off. These are gorgeous in real life and fit like a dream. I am an hourglass shape so I tend to stick to leggings and jeggings rather than true jeans as they are more flattering and these do not disappoint! Not only do they look like jeans, they take inches off my heavy thighs and give my bum an instant lift. Also being 5' 2" I found these were a good leg length on my and come just below my ankle bone. I usually wear a size 10 trouser so I ordered these in LARGE and they were perfect. Figure hugging but not tight and very flattering if like me you are a little heavy through the bottom and thigh. I will definitely be ordering more!

title: Amazing!!!
text:
I use four of these inside my eBags TLS Mother Lode Weekender Convertible Junior bag when travelling and they make life so much easier. I easily get the following in a cube (I am a US size 10):

10 tops/tees (in one cube)
3 pairs of jeans/trousers plus one pair of leggings (in one cube)
3 sweaters or cardigans (in one cube)
1 coat or 2 jackets (in one cube)

I just love these cubes. They make getting to clothes so much easier than traditional packing methods. I have always been a clothes roller-upper (military style) so that I can get more in my case so I was very dubious about these but honestly I can get just as much in using these as my rolling method so all round I am very impressed. Also stops clothes getting creased and I honestly cannot imagine ever travelling again without them.

title: Of the 50 travel bags I have tried this is the best!
text: I have searched high and low for the perfect travel bag and finally I have found it. Ask my husband about how many bags I have had for traveling and he will pull his hair out. I have just never found one that ticks all the boxes...until now. I travel a lot and all over the world and by lots of modes of transport so I need a bag that not only can hold clothes, accessories etc for the whole trip but also a bag that is easy to carry and store. I am 5' 2" and the Junior version of this bag is perfect for me. It is easy to lift over my head (even with 3 weeks worth of stuff in it) so I can put it in overhead storage, it has great access to get things like laptop out without pulling everything else out. It's front pocket is so convenient for stashing a book and any travel documents that you need to hand. It is a sturdy design and so comfortable to wear long hours on your back when walking between places. I travel exclusively hand luggage only and this is the perfect size, even when full to the brim. I have always been a clothes roller-upper when packing but actually with Ebags Packing Cubes plus this bag I am now super organised. I use 4 of the medium packing cubes inside this bag and they fit perfectly. I cannot recommend this bag enough. It makes travelling a pleasure!
