title: Perfect Pants for me! If you’re sensitive you have to try
text:
These pants are absolutely soft, comfortable, flattering, and they have pockets. I don’t have to worry about feeling something tight around my ankles, I absolutely abhore that feeling.

I’ve been searching for pants like these for so long. Hours and hours. I’ve bought others that just weren’t good.

I need black athletic type pants for work. I have fibromyalgia and sometimes my skin is very sensitive as is being pressed a certain way. Even none of the expensive pants in the sporting good stores worked. The fit was so awkward and they just didn’t feel good. It was so frustrating.

I am so glad I found these pants. I just bought a second pair, and I should probably buy more because these are gold.

They are a little long, FYI, but that’s not an issue for me. I work with kids and have to move around a lot, sometimes with bare feet, and I’ve never experienced any issue with tripping.

I ordered a large. It’s just a tad big on me but medium would be too small. I’m 5’4, 170 lbs. I think it shrunk a little bit in the dryer so I might air dry it. Using the dryer is bad for clothes anyway and these are so precious.

THANK YOU SO MUCH HEATH YOGA! I don’t know who’s responsible for this amazing design and fabric but you’ve helped someone with chronic pain be comfortable and happy 😃

A $130 watch can do that just as well as a $5,000 watch.

I own both Bulova and Invicta watches, and I prefer Bulova because of its more precise fit-and-finish. The clasp on my Invicta Speedway is difficult to unbuckle to the point of needing to wedge a coin to pry it open at times. title: Weak plastic case
text:
Watch died after taking a shower with it on. LCD display blank, no hand movement. Claim is water resistant to 10 bar, but shower resistant to 0 ft! Condensation due to temp diff / humidity may have caused internal moisture & short. Outside Amazon.com return window, so now I have the pleasure of dealing with Casio Warranty.

11/15/2010 UPDATE: Sent watch to The Time Machine in Montrose, CA for warranty repair per Casio's instruction. I got a bill for $91.14 to repair the watch. They said a small crack near the lower left screw in the case was the reason for the moisture leak. The warranty doesn't cover damage to case. I probably received the watch with this defect but never noticed this hairline crack. Thanks a whole lot Casio for a worthless warranty and a watch that only was good for 2 months.

11/16/2010 UPDATE: Amazon to the rescue! As a last resort I called Amazon.com and described the ordeal with Casio and their repair center deciding not to cover the watch under warranty after only 3 months of ownership. As a courtesy, Amazon to extended the return window, and they shipped a new replacement watch to me overnight which I now have. Thanks Amazon.com for stepping in and doing the right thing when the manufacturer would not and keeping me a loyal customer!

6/26/2011 UPDATE: Second watch case today completely separated with the band from the rest of the case (weak points near the screws on the plastic case). This is not a durable watch design as the plastic casing has cracked on two of them in less than 1 year. I don't recall hitting the watch on anything that would have caused this damage. I know Casio will not cover this under warranty, so I'm just going to cut my losses on this - and never buy a Casio watch over $10 again as this design makes it virtually a disposable watch.

title: A beautiful, well-made jacket
text: This puffer jacket was ordered for an active little boy, and while the weather has not been cold enough for him to wear it yet, I can tell some things about it already.  I ordered it in red, his favorite color, and the color is just as it looks in the description on Amazon.  The coat is extremely well made, as it should be for the price.  I expect that it will last several "generations" of hand-me-downs. The outside of the coat is the typical nylon-like material, and the lining is very soft fleece.  I always check the zippers on kids' clothing, and this one did not disappoint.  It is very high quality and easy to move up and down.  In case your child does not want to zip the jacket, there are snaps that he can use instead.  There are three little pocket zippers, and these are not quite as easy to pull up and down, but they are okay, and they did not dissuade me from recommending this jacket.  I like the fact that there are pockets, as many kids' jackets do not have them. The hood is fine, and it is detachable if your child does not like it for some reason. Though the price is a little high, the durability of the jacket makes it worth the investment. And it is machine washable!  Highly recommended.

title: An exceptional parka
text: For the price, I could not be happier with this little girls' parka.  Unlike most parkas for children, which are made with a shiny sort of rayon or nylon material, this parka has a beautiful matte finish and is incredibly soft.  While I did not order it for a child with sensory issues, the parka would be an excellent solution to that problem.  The lining is not as soft, but the collar is high and is of the same material as the rest of the coat, so it is soft against the child's bare skin.  The zipper is well made and smooth to operate, though it is not one of those super high quality zippers you see on far more expensive coats. One thing I wish were included is velcro fasteners for the child to use when she does not want to take the time to use the zipper.  I ordered the parka in white, and while it is a little impractical, it is just beautiful. One of the other colors would be more practical for everyday wear.  Highly recommended.

title: very nice summer caftan
text: I ordered this cover up to use during the summer for places that have too much air conditioning.  It is very lightweight, so it is easy to carry and not too warm; just a little protection against a chilly draft.  The color is neutral, so it can be worn with many outfits.  Don't expect a sweater or fleece, just a very light wrap, and you will be satisfied.

title: Child loved these shoes
text: These shoes seem well made and comfortable, and they come in a variety of colors made to appeal to kids of all ages.  I received the purple ones. and they were a big hit with the three-year-old purple-loving little girl who wanted them.  They are just a bit too big, but she loves them so much that she wants to wear them despite that.  I predict that she will be loving these shoes for a long time.  I also like the velcro fasteners, as they make learning to dress herself go a lot faster.  Highly recommended.

title: Kids love these shoes!
text: These shoes were a big hit with the child who received them.  Although they are a little more feminine than the photo indicated, that was more than made up for with this five-year-old boy, who loved both the lights and the roller skate aspects of the shoes.  They are relatively new, so I do not know how well they wear, but they seem well made, and the price is reasonable.  He has no complaints about fit or comfort.  So I give these shoes a 9.5 out of 10!  Highly recommended.

title: Very nice sweater for the price
text: This sweater arrived promptly and in perfect condition, except for a few wrinkles, which fell out as I hung it over a chair.  I usually wear a medium, but I thought that this sweater may run just a little small, and I was right.  I am glad I ordered it in large.  The fit is good across the chest and shoulders, although the sleeves are  just a tad long for my taste.  Still, that is easily fixed by pushing or even rolling them up, and I think that very long sleeves are the style today. I can see wearing this sweater in a variety of places; I have already worn it to a restaurant, to a play, and to church.  I know I will get a great deal of wear out of it.

title: An adorable sweater
text:
I love this beautiful red sweater, and so does my five-year-old niece. The color is attractive and versatile--great for the holidays, especially Valentine's Day--and the sweater seems well made and durable. The material is 100% cotton, very soft, not "scratchy" against the skin.

My only issue is that the sweater is very thin. You cannot really use it for warmth, except maybe in an air conditioned restaurant during the summer or on a cool summer evening outdoors. This sweater is more an accent piece, but a beautiful one, which I think would appeal to many little girls. Its bright red color will go with many other basic colors, especially black, gray, or white.

I really loved this sweater, and I recommend it, as long as you do not expect it to provide much protection against the cold.

title: A good watch, but not perfect
text: As I am not too tech savvy, I asked my teenage nephew to help me evaluate this watch.  He really liked the red color, but he said he'd have liked the black one just as well.  Apparently the setup is pretty simple.  First, you download an app to get the features to work.  Once you have the app, it guides you step by step through the setup.  It is an attractive watch that looks similar to a smart watch, but, according to my nephew, "isn't quite" a smartwatch.  I was hoping that it would help monitor his insulin, but I was expecting too much.  It can tell you the date and time, take photos, and play music, and it vibrates when you receive a notification.  In the end, he prefers his Apple Watch, but says that this watch is a close second--and far less expensive.

title: A very nice tank
text: This is a very nice sleeveless tank, but it is very thin.  I would say it is almost a cami rather than a tank.  I was expecting something a bit thicker.  But despite that, this is a great layering piece.  It would be excellent under a suit jacket or blazer.  Personally, I would not wear it alone, but that may just be me.  The cut is modest and appropriate for the office or other professional settings.  The cut is generous, but not overly so.  Recommended, as long as you keep in mind how thin it is.

title: Good socks, and very comfortable
text: These socks are very comfortable and soft, but they are extremely thin.  They are fine for summer or warm weather areas of the country, but I think they would not fare well in a Midwestern or New England winter.  I wear them with athletic shoes, so they really do not show at all, but if you had a lower cut shoe, I think they might.  The colors are attractive, but I would have preferred an all-white option.  I think the younger set would like these socks a great deal.

title: The best bra I've had in years
text: I have been using Vanity Fair bras for what seems like forever, certainly for the past thirty years, so you can see that I am a fan of the brand.  Lately, I have experienced issues with the straps falling down over my shoulders, and I hoped that this bra would address that.  It has.  Though the straps are not as wide as I had hoped, they do stay up very well.  I am not used to wearing underwire bras, so I was wondering if this one would be comfortable.  Well, it is by far the most comfortable bra I have ever worn.  I wear a 36C, so I do need more than a little support, and this bra is excellent for that.  I found the bra felt a little snug as I was putting it on, but once on, it was very comfortable, with no feeling of tightness at all.  I recommend this bra without reservation.

title: Great shorts!
text: I have never before worn NYDJ products, but I definitely will after trying these great shorts.  They fit well, are very comfortable, wash easily, and come out looking fine.  I do press them, but I probably wouldn't have to.  But I am at a loss as to what to say about size.  I usually wear a 10 or 12, but these are 14, and they fit really well.  I do not like tight fit, and these are petite, so perhaps that accounts for the difference.  But for whatever reason, I love these shorts and the way they fit.  Highly recommended.

title: An attractive, well-made shirt
text: My husband loves this shirt.  It is pure white and fits really well, but it is not a slim fit, so if you are looking for that, get one marked as such.  The collar is not button down, contrary to what one reviewer mentioned.  One thing I noticed is that I do have to press the shirt; it is not really "no-iron."  But it presses easily and looks great.  I have not had it long, so I am not sure about the durability, but the seams are straight and the shirt looks well made to me.  It is soft to the touch and very comfortable.  Highly recommended!

title: Great slacks for the price
text: I ordered these slacks for my husband mostly because of the light weight and the tapered fit.  He tends to wear his slacks very loose, I think out of habit more than anything else.  These slacks fit very well and look great.  The light weight is perfect for summer as well as spring and early fall.  They wash well and do not wrinkle much at all, though I do iron them after every wash.  Highly recommended.

title: Great for the money
text: For the price, these handkerchiefs are excellent.  Though not as soft as my husband would like, they are okay, and I am sure that after several washes they will be fine.  They do need to be ironed (unless very wrinkled handkerchiefs are okay with you), but they iron pretty easily.  I do recommend them unless you have extraordinarily high expectations.  In that case, spend more money and get a better product.

title: A superb shirt
text: I will definitely get more shirts of this type from Tommy Hilfiger.  First of all, the shirt is exceptionally well made.  The only thing is that the buttonholes are just a bit tight, but I expect that will resolve over time.  Second, I was not too sure at first about the color, but it is a very light lavender and very flattering.  Finally, I am always skeptical about "no iron" claims, but in this case, the shirt required only a light touch up with the iron.  I recommend this shirt without reservation and intend to purchase more.

title: Excellent product
text: My husband loved these slacks.  They fit well and are not too baggy.  They wash beautifully and require only a light touch up with the iron.  They seem to be very well made, and I would definitely get more pairs for him in different colors.  Highly recommended.

title: Excellent product
text: The main reason I purchased these slacks is that my husband hates lint on black slacks, and several of the reviews mentioned that they were lint free.  Well, not only are they lint free, they are also very easy to care for and maintain.  The few creases present when I opened them were easily erased with a steam iron.  The slacks fit perfectly and my husband liked them so much that we immediately ordered another pair in gray.  The gray slacks look equally attractive and easy to care for.  Both pairs are very lightweight, probably most appropriate for spring through fall.  I highly recommend these slacks.  Oh--one other thing:  The description (I think, or maybe it's the answer to one of the questions) says that the slacks are dry clean only.  However, the care label says they are machine washable.  I intend to go with the care label.

title: A great umbrella
text:
Like many people, I do not think about umbrellas unless it is raining. I tend to buy inexpensive umbrellas, and there is an assortment on the back seat of both our cars, as well as by the door we use to go out. However, I have often cursed the cheap versions when the rain is heavy or the wind is fierce, which tends to happen with some regularity where we live.

I loved this umbrella from the first time I used it. It looks rather small, but when you open it, you will be surprised at how large it is--not a golf umbrella, certainly, but larger than you expect. Then you will be impressed by how well made it is. You do not have to struggle to open or close it, and it is sturdy in the worst winds (so far, at least)

The umbrella is on the expensive side, but you get what you pay for. I expect this umbrella to last a lot longer than the cheap umbrellas at the discount store, and I definitely recommend it.

title: Great shirt!
text: As long as you keep in mind that this shirt is marketed as "slim fit," you will probably be delighted with your purchase.  The shirt is well made, and it has a pocket, which is a requirement for my husband.  But is runs very small, so if in doubt, order a size up.  For me, the best thing about this shirt is that it is no iron, and unlike many so-called no iron shirts, it actually looks very good if you take it out of the dryer right away and hang it up.  I actually take out my shirts and hang them when they are still a bit damp.  I also like the color (violet check), which looks great both close up and at a distance.  Highly recommended!

title: Beautiful piece of jewelry
text: This necklace is by far one of the nicest pieces of jewelry I have ever had from Amazon.  The blue is a delicate aquamarine, and the chain too is fine and delicate.  I think of this necklace as most appropriate for a younger woman, as larger, chunkier jewelry may overwhelm a more youthful shape.  I cannot imagine that you would not be pleased with this necklace.  Highly recommended.

title: Excellent earrings
text: These earrings are lovely.  They are very lightweight, which is fine with me, but some may want more substantial earrings.  The rose gold is there, but you have to look very hard for it.  Still, the earrings are attractive and you are almost certain to get many compliments.  The stones are shiny and may even fool a casual observer into thinking that they are diamonds.  They are small, however, so keep that in mind as you make your decision.

title: Sturdy and Attractive
text: This long shoe horn is exactly what my husband wanted.  He broke his former cheap plastic one and I suggested he get something more durable.  This is it!  It is so sturdy that it could almost be used as a weapon in the event of a home invasion.  It looks great and has a loop at the top so it is easily hung on a hook.  It fit comfortably over his heel and is exactly what he wanted.  Highly recommended, even though it is a bit expensive.  You will never have to buy another shoehorn (unless you lose it), so it is well worth the price.

title: Excellent product
text: This is a durable and well shaped shoehorn.  It is a bit larger than the ones you see at the shoe store, but you could still fit it in your pocket if you chose to.  It came well protected by packaging and in great condition.  I recommend it highly.

title: Very good hat
text: For the money, this is an excellent hat.  It is not wool or cashmere, but for an acrylic material it is very soft.  The main purpose for this hat is to protect my husband's ears on winter walks, and it works quite well for that.  I also like the color choices.

title: Attractive and Comfortable
text: I purchased this robe as a gift for my niece.  She loved it, and she used it the very day we gave it to her.  It is warm and very comfortable.  it has an inside tie that helps keep it closed in addition to the belt.  It runs somewhat large, in my opinion.  We bought the size S/M, and I think that if you are really small, say size 6 or less, you may swim in this robe.  My niece is about a size 10, and it seemed a bit large even on her.  Other than that, this robe is great.

title: Great Purchase
text: I purchased this wallet because I was going to Spain and I needed something with a number of compartments and enough space for a passport,  iPhone 6, and two kinds of currency. This wallet was the perfect solution.  It holds all of the above plus a driver's license and a few cards.  The fit is a little tight if you have a  great many coins, but if you keep the coins at a minimum you will be fine.  Baroque is one of my favorite Vera Bradley patterns, and I was thrilled to find this wallet.  It is well made with quality materials, like all VB products.  Highly recommended.

title: Lovely set of pearls
text: This set of pearl earrings and single pearl necklace is very lovely.  The pearls themselves are medium size--neither tiny nor large and imposing.  They are cultured pearls, but I do not have the impression that they are ultra-expensive--that is, they lack the luster of very expensive pearls.  The backing on the earrings and the chain on the necklace is gold, fairly thin, so that does not look expensive, either.  The chain is just under 18 inches long.  This set would make a very nice gift for a teenage girl getting her first "real" pearls--not cheap and fake, but not so expensive that it would be a disaster if she lost them.

title: great bra
text: This is the best bra I have ever worn.  The straps do not slip, and the back does not ride up.  It is comfortable and only moderately expensive. I usually wear a medium in bathing suits and the 8-10 fits well. The top could be a bit more supportive, but overall it is a decent suit.

title: Looks just like picture

title: Comfortable

I love the color and feel of it. The material is soft and very comfortable. Looking forward to wearing this when the weather cools off.

I’ll have to test them out on a hike, but also worried about ruining them. Might just save them to wear casually during the winter with jeans and a sweater. They are comfortable and seem well made and fit true to size.

title: Great!

Not too long and not too short and has good chest coverage and support. It seems well made and good quality.

title: Great underwear
text: Micro modal is the only way to go for underwear… I will never go back to regular cotton. These fit great and it’s almost like you’re not wearing anything.

title: Cute

title: Cute

Took off a star for not knowing exactly what they are.

title: Comfortable but hard to walk in

title: Great pants

title: Run small

title: Daughter loves it
text: My 11 yr old loves this top. Looks cute with a variety of bottoms. It fits her perfectly.

title: Cute

title: Great value pack of no shows
text: Just the right amount of thickness. Not paper thin but not way too thick. These work great for general wear but I wouldn't run in them because they do not have enough cushion.

title: Nice shirt but fits a tad big

title: Bright shirt, fits a tad big.

title: Great value pack of sunglasses

title: Better than expected

title: Nice

Color is nice, she likes tie dye. It’s more lightweight than some robes and doesn’t feel really expensive, but it does the job for an 11 yr old.

title: Look nice and are light weight

I have worn them a lot since receiving and they are really comfortable. I usually wear a small or medium and the medium fit perfectly. A little room to breathe but not falling off.

title: Nice but thin

title: Great sweatshirt hoodie
text: Very nice sweatshirt with medium thickness material. Fabric is soft and the size fits well. Quality zipper and no loose threads. The fit is not super tight or too baggy.

title: Fun game

text: Fits our 11 yeah old perfectly. Looks good and she says it is comfortable to wear. Quality seems good.

title: Too small
text: These may be better if you size up. The fit didn’t work in the size I got which is my usual size. They were too tight in the waist and didn’t cover as much of my bottom as I hoped.

title: Amazing value
text: These sunglasses look better than pairs I own that cost 8 to 10 times as much. Excellent value. Quality seem great and I’m a bit blown away at how there is any profit to be made off of these. Great looking glasses. Lenses are nice, not too dark. Overall very pleased.

title: Great for heal strikers
text: I run about 6-7 miles most days of the week and go through a pair of shoes about every 3.5-4 months. I’ve been using Asics for the past 5 years, primarily the Gel Nimbus. These have close to the same cushion as the Gel Nimbus but what I like about these more is the heal is somewhat curved. Perfect for how I run, kind of rolling my feet from heal to toe. The fit just right not too snug and not too loose. Very light weight and I should be able to get a good 500-600 out of them. Overall very pleased.

title: Great running shoes
text: Great looking shoe that fits well. Plenty of cushion and extremely light weight. I’ve been using Asics for over 5 years now and have never wanted to switch. These are comparable to both quality and performance. Overall very please. Will be using these for running as well as casual wear.

title: Look nice
text: These are nice looking well made sandals. They fit a bit tight but I think that is good to keep them in place. They seem slightly longer than other size 8 shoes I have but maybe they need to be that way for the square toe. These braided sandals are very trendy right now. Looking forward to wearing them this summer.

title: Very comfortable
text: I’ve put about 40 miles on these shoes already, walking, hiking and running and think they are very comfortable. I think the lacing is really smart and helps if you have a foot that needs a more customized fit. I left the laces the way they came and think it fits great. They seem really well made and durable and feel really sturdy while in them. They almost look more like a hiking shoe to me, but the traction isn’t that great for slippery dirt trails. Fit true to size. I like the way they look as well.

title: Very nice belt
text: Great belt for business wear or formal occasion. Very nice quality belt. Leather is very smooth and feels mush better that other belts I've owned. Buckle works great and I will never buy a normal loop belt again.

text: Great for more formal or business wear. Great stretch and very adjustable. I use for work but will also use for golfing next time I go. Great value.

title: Nice shorts
text: Nice shorts but I do not prefer to use them at the gym. The material is a bit more absorbent than I’d like. They are great for using to lounge around the house or to sleep in. Very comfortable. The back pocket is too loose to be useful. The zipper pockets on the side work great.

title: Great shirt!
text: Excellent shirt! Great material and perfect fit, plenty of stretch. Feels like silk. I just bought another one. perfect for business or casual wear and of course golf or tennis.

title: I was surprised by the quality
text: Strange name but great shorts. Quality board shorts that fit well and have a good amount of stretch. Coloring is not too bold and blends nicely with other clothes. Pockets and all side is great. Overall very pleased with these shorts.

title: Great board shorts
text: These fit well and are quality made board shorts. Nice pockets on side and back. Very nice design with a vintage type coloring. Very pleased with these shorts.

title: Strange name but excellent shorts
text: The fabric on these are great and the feel a look good. They don’t feel cheap like most off brand shorts do. I really like the side pockets and this is hard to find with board shorts. These dry quick and have good stretch.

title: Great glasses, look and feel is perfect.
text: A great pair of sunglasses. A lot of value for a low price with these. They fit perfectly and the design looks good. Lens aren’t too dark but provide the right amount of sun protection. Overall very pleased with these.

title: Nice hiking shoes
text: The best part of these shoes in the traction. It's almost too much, I'm confident you could almost walk straight up a wall if you wanted to. The do fit somewhat big and are probably best for larger wider feet. That being said I don't have any issues with the size. If you're looking for a luxury hiking boot this is not it. This boot has decent cushion but I would not do anything longer than 6-10 miles in these boots. They have a nice look to them and should hold up nicely to general wear and tear.

title: Easy 5 stars
text: Great pair of boxer briefs for working out or playing sports. Very nice smooth feel, not like cheap cotton. Nice tight support without being too tight. Very pleased with the performance and quality.

title: Nice material but too large
text: The material on this is quite nice but out of the bag there were a bunch of loose stings I needed to cut off, no big deal but the bigger issue is the large size I ordered a medium and it fits well around the chest but the arm are massive, you could fit an elephants leg through them. Also the bottom is quite loose as well. In the picture it looks much more slim. I’m not sure I will be able to wear it as I have quite muscular arms and this shirt make them look tiny.  Also I’m not talking a little loose in the arms its a lot loose. If that’s the look for going for this is your shirt.

title: Nice sport/casual shirt
text: Great shirt for hot weather. Business casual or sports wear. Quick dry material that feels good. Fits slimmer up top and slightly loose below mid section. I got medium, I’m 5,11 175.

title: Runs big

They have excellent traction, feet didn’t get sweaty, ample toe space so your toes don’t hit the front when going downhill. I normally wear a size 8 and while there is a good amount of extra toe space I felt like the next size down would have been too small. They aren’t the most cushioned sole but I didn’t have any issues from it. Another pro is that they look great and flattering.  For the price I would recommend these.

title: Great socks

title: Great tank
text: I really like the C9 brand of products of amazon. This tank looks nice on and is extremely comfortable. It fits perfectly and true to size. While wearing a sports bra there is no bra visible while wearing this tank. I like the color as well.

title: Nice fit and great value

Feels like a silk lining inside and has many pockets. Outside looks a bit woolly. Overall very pleased with the value of this jacket.

title: Great pants

title: Love it

It’s comfortable enough to sleep in. It has so many cute details to it as well, like the neck, sleeves, hem lines around the shoulders and back, and the cozy front pocket. C9 did a great job with this top. It also feels like great quality and like something you would find at lululemon. I really like all the other pieces of clothing I have tried from C9 as well. They are great versatile pieces to have in your wardrobe. Would recommend!

title: Nice long underwear

title: Cute leggings

title: Nice looking shoes

title: Nice pair of sneakers

title: Granddaughter likes them

title: Granddaughter likes them

title: Great leggings

title: Great for school presentations

title: Granddaughter likes it
text: Cute athletic tee. My 8yr old granddaughter was excited to receive this. She likes the feel and look of it. Fits true to size.

text: Cute girls athletic top. Fits true to size and has cute details to it that my 8 yr old granddaughter really likes. The material is soft and comfortable.

title: Great looking and feeling shirt

title: Great top, but uncomfrotable tag
text: Great shirt for boys. My 10 yr old grandson likes it. You need to cut off the stiff tag on the inside. Wish it was tagless since most boys hate the feeling of tags. Looks nice and appears well made. It is on the more fitted side and the material feels a bit thinner than similar shirts we buy at old navy and target, but overall a nice shirt

title: Perfect except for uncomfortable tag
text: These are great pants. I wish they would make them tagless or with more comfortable tags, otherwise it's necessary to cut off the huge stiff tag on the inside. Otherwise, these are great pants that my 10 yr old grandson likes. They fit true to size and appear well made and are comfortable once the tag is cut off. Color is nice as well and they look great on.

title: Longer mesh shorts
text: My 10yr old grandson likes these and says they are comfortable, once I cut off the stiff tag on the inside. The medium fits true to size. The length is on the longer side, but he still likes them.

title: Cute backpack
text: Will be perfect for my 4 yr old granddaughter when she goes to preschool and kindergarten. Backpack is big enough to fit the coordinating lunchbox that we ordered separately and a few other small items or papers. Appears and feels well made and durable.

title: Great, soft pajamas
text: My 8 year old granddaughter loved receiving these pajamas. She usually wears a size small, but is starting to outgrow that so these fit perfectly with a bit of room to grow. The are extremely soft, and comfortable. She likes the design on the pants. I could live without the words Calvin Klein across the shirt, but she doesn't mind. The feel and look well made. Would recommend.

title: Very soft and comfortable
text: Very soft and comfortable. They also stay up and don’t need to be pulled up constantly. I normally wear a small and sometimes medium and the medium fit perfectly. The material is thin and lightweight but feels durable and well made. I love the side cell phone pocket and the Small logo on the back of the calf is a nice detail. Looking forward to trying more apparel from this brand.

title: Fun shirt.
text: Definitely a shirt you'll need to iron. Size runs a slightly small but not enough to get a size bigger. Great shirt for wearing on vacation or to an barque type of party. It definitely stands out. Overall very pleased with this shirt.

title: Great looking sunglasses.
text: Great value for these sunglasses. I remember paying 5 to 10 times this for sunglasses that weren't as nicely made as these. The wooden box these comes in seems like it should cost more than the glasses themselves. Lenses are a bit dark but not by much. Fit works well for my larger head. Very pleased with these glasses.

title: Warm
text: My Granddaughter Usually wears a size small or 6x in girls. I got her the size 7-8 and it fit just right. I might suggest sizing up even more if you want more room to grow. The head hole is a bit on the smaller side too, but the length is good and is a cropped length style so it hits a little bit lower than the top of her pants. The material is soft and comfortable and it keeps her warm.

title: Nice quality
text: Nice basic piece. The material is soft, comfortable and has a good weight to it. It appears well made. It has a long tunic style fit with slits on the side. the length is a bit longer than I expected but still works well with leggings and perfect for layering.

title: Nice shorts
text: Great quality shorts that look just as pictured. The material is nice and thick, soft and stretchy. Everything you would want in a pair of athletic shorts. The pockets are also nice. Would recommend.

title: Ok
text: The color was more red than burgundy like the picture showed, material is a bit thinner than expected. It feels slightly less quality than Target. The fit isn’t as flattering as I hoped, but it still works for a basic summer dress.

title: Thin, but nice
text: This sweater is much thinner than I expected, but that makes it good for layering under a jacket. It fits true to size. The grey is a bit lighter than pictured. I normally wear a small and the small fits perfect. It is long so I tucked the front into my leggings. It is comfortable and could be dressed up or down. I like the detail of the zipper. There are some loose threads and not so perfect seams but not very noticeable and expected for the price. Overall an nice versatile piece.

title: Great looking hat
text: This is a great looking trucker hat. A good quality hat that has plenty of room for my larger head without fully expand the adjustable back.

title: Nice bathing suit
text: Good quality bathing suit that looks just as pictured and fits true to size. It looks nice on as well and my granddaughter likes it.

title: No credit card slots
text: I was hoping this could be used as a wallet, but there weren't any pictures of the inside. There are only two zippered compartments. It would work for when you just need something to put a few items in, like your phone, id, cash, credit card, makeup. It looks similiar to the picture, but it looks more masculine in person. The leather isn't very soft and reminds me of a mens toiletry bag. The zippers also aren't the smoothest.

title: Great looking sneakers
text: These look great and have a decent amount of cushion. Very nice quality sneaker. I've wear to work on more casual days. These go well with jeans or slacks.

title: Very soft and comfortable

The top is suitable for wearing out of the house but the bottoms look a bit more like pajamas. I like the style and fit of both and both fit true to size. Would make a nice gift.

title: great material
text: Great quality, oversized v-neck top. For a basic top it has a lot of nice qualities. It is made of great material that is soft and has a great thickness too it. Doesn't feel cheap. All the seams look good and well done. I also like the way it is stitched together with raw edges showing. It is a flattering fit and fits true to size. I personally don't like the crooked pocket, but it looks just like the picture so it is just as expected.

title: Quality pants
text: Great quality travel pants. Light weight and very flexible. Prefect paints for a variety of occasions. I wear to work and have used for dinning out. Very pleased with the quality.

title: Nice dance tights

title: Cute ballet skirt
text: Cute dance skirt that works great over a leotard. Fits true to size and granddaughter likes it. Quality seems great as well.

Not shoes I’d use for anything other than light work duty. I can easily wear these for 8+ hours and they still feel like walking on clouds.

title: Works with my Camelbak bottle

I took my chances and threw it in with my regular laundry and washed and dried it like normal and it came out looking great.

title: Not my favorite color

Also it has a bit of a sheen to it which makes it look a bit cheap. A noticed a couple pulled threads as well. But overall it looks like it would keep you warm and function well and I do like the fit of it, so maybe a different color would be 4 or 5 stars.

title: Size down
text: I have a couple other pairs of daily ritual jeans and learned after the first pair to size down one size, so instead of my normal 27 I ordered a 26 and they fit perfectly. They are great quality and fit perfectly and comfortably. I love the high waist. The dark blue color is a nice variation for my wardrobe. They wash well.

title: Great quality

title: Well made

title: Nice dress shirt
text: Nice dress shirt with French Cuffs. The French Cuffs make this shirt more dressed up than normal shirts. You will need cuff links in order to wear the shirt properly. Great quality shirt that fits nice. Perfect to wear for more formal occasions.

title: Great boots, very light weight
text: Very surprised at how light weight these boots are.  The fir is a tad big but not enough to be a big deal. There is a decent amount of cushion at the heel and the fit does a great job at stabilizing me foot. Very comfortable to walk around in compared to my Stanley works boots that have a steel toe and weight 2-3 times more. The material looks durable. I have used them for about a week now. Overall very pleased with these boots.

title: Looks just like picture
text: This is a nice patriotic tank. The medium fits true to size and has a loose fit. It has good length as well. The material is a good weight and isn’t thin. Reminds me of something you would get at Wal-mart to wear for a patriotic holiday. Looks just like the product image.

title: Great looking shoe
text: My favorite part about these shoes is how they look and I give them 5 stars for that. They are very comfortable for the most part, but my ankles are still adjusting the sides and back of the shoe. It seems to hit in a weird spot that my last shoes didn't. The foot bed is extremely comfortable and they appear well made.

title: Nice looking shirt, fit is slim
text: The fit is a bit small but it looks really nice. You basically need zero belly fat to look good in this shirt. So maybe some extra motivation to lose some lbs. Material is thin and soft. This can be used as casual dress wear, or in some cases casual business attire. The tag in the back is kind of annoying, most shirts I get these days are tag-less, and I’m afraid if I cut it off it’ll damage the shirt.

title: Nice hat
text: Very nice looking, basic hat, that fits my head nicely. Good quality material that should last awhile. I wear this for outside activities.

title: Nice underwear
text: I usually purchase my underwear from Costco as they have good quality at a good price. These are nice and fit well, a bit smaller than expected. But they are comfortable. They are low rise just as pictured.

title: Great dress shirt for work

I've used mainly for business meeting and for days where I go into the office. Works well with a tan or dark jacket/blazer.

title: Great looking shirt, very nice quality
text: Great quality shirt that I have receive many complements on at work. I really like the tailored fit and think it fits my medium frame well. The fabric is very breathable and it doesn't get too wrinkled after its washed, though I still run an iron over it anyways. Overall very pleased with this shirt.

title: Good value
text: Nice purse, looks just like picture. Smaller than expected but still a nice size purse. Seems well made. It doesn’t look super expensive. There are some creases in the material in the sides where it was folded, which wouldn’t be there if it was leather, but not very noticeable. Functional and good value for the price.

title: Good quality

They appear well made and have a good thickness to them and don’t feel cheap. I wouldn’t wear outside them out of the house or at a gym.  They are very short and almost like a bathing suit bottom.

title: Nice jacket.

title: Nice comfortable shirt

title: Comfortable

title: Great quality

title: Great looking shirt for work

Not horribly wrinkled but enough for me to have to run a quick iron over it. Overall a great shirt that I have recipes several compliments on.

title: Very nice blazer

title: Nice socks

title: Great hiking shoes
text: These are quite bright, not shoes I’d necessarily want to use to match well with anything regarding casual wear. They are excellent hiking shoes that fit great and provide great support and cushion. They are very light weight but feel like they are built with quality material. I did a 15 mile hike the other day and they broke in nicely. Nice tread that is a bit more on the aggressive side but fine as long as hiking on mostly dirt.

title: Excellent pair of sport pants.
text: Most comfortable paints I own, more comfortable than wearing sweatpants! Very lightweight and breathable. Quality material that very stretchable. I’ve been wearing to work but these would of course be great to play golf in. Great business casual wear. I’ve recorded several comments on how good they look.

I like the cut of the back in a v.

I am not a huge fan of the print with the grey inside the leaves and flowers and think it would look better with just black and white. But overall it is a nice quality dress.

text: This is a nice pajama set. Looks like better quality than a set from Target. The design is cute and flattering. The material is very soft and has a nice thickness to it. It doesn’t feel cheap at all. All the seams and stitching look great. The large was slightly bigger than what I expected.

title: Nice quality
text: Nice quality athletic type polo shirt. The seams and stitching all look great. My grandson loves the athletic material type shirts, so he was happy about this one. He likes the colors as well since red is his favorite. In the future, I’ll probably stick with a solid colored shirt that’s more versatile.

title: Light weight, perfect size for short trip
text: All the pockets you could ask for. Seems as though the airlines are cracking down on suitcases, AGAIN! This will surely pass the carry on size criteria. Not a full weeks worth room here unless you’re going to a place with a washer or say Hawaii, where only board shorts are needed. Also a good option for younger children, easy enough for them to wheel around on their own. Wheels and handle seem to be durable without adding too much weight.

title: Pretty necklace
text: Great quality necklace. Looks more expensive than it is. Sparkly with nice detail. The chain is just the right length with additional length if you need more.

title: Comfortable
text: Great fitting, comfortable, reasonably priced leggings. I like the mesh detail and they are very soft. Some of the seams bunch up, but even out while wearing. They also wash well.

title: Nice beanie
text: Nice quality knit beanie that looks just like the picture. Fits well and is comfortable. Looks well made. It looks a bit like black and white, because the navy blue is very dark.

title: Nice soft socks
text: Nice dress type socks. Very soft and warm. Seem well made except for a couple pulled threads on one of the pairs.

title: Great joggers
text: Pleasantly surprised by these Amazon brand joggers. I was expecting sweatpant type material but they are a really thin almost boardshort like material. They are soft and comfortable and they have a nice loose fit which is a nice change from super tight leggings. I am glad these are the new trend. Perfect for exercising, running errands or lounging around home.

title: Very cute but fabric sheds onto other clothing
text: I really wanted to give this sweater 5 stars because it fits perfectly, is the perfect length to wear with black leggings, is extremely soft and comfortable, and is a great twist on a basic grey sweater, but it sheds terribly. It leaves grey fuzz all over my black leggings and left fuzz on all my black clothing when I washed it. It says not to put in a dryer, but I tried drying it anyway in hopes that it would get rid of the excess fuzz, but it still shed onto other clothing. This is a moderately priced sweater so it shouldn’t have this problem. Pretty disappointed. (From my daughter)

title: Nice looking hat that fits perfect
text: This hat fits perfectly on my larger head. About a centimeter or two from my ears. Overall looks is vibrant and stands out. Looks to be made of quality material.

title: Nice set
text: Nice knit hat and glove set. Seems well made and fit my 9 YR old grandson perfectly. Color is nice and material is very soft and comfortable.

title: Great slim wallet
text: I couldn’t have this be my everyday wallet, not until more places take Apple wallet. I have too many cards and too many small bills. It works well for going out when I don’t need the lot. Perfect for date night, fitting easily into dress slacks.

title: Very nice Hawaiian shirt
text: Made with a very nice material, it has a silk like feel without looking like it. Nice green color that isn’t too loud. The fabric seems to be quality and should last awhile. XL was a bit large of a fit.

title: Nice looking belt
text: Belt fits right for its size. I like the barker brown color, it goes with almost all my pants. It does seem much lighter than my other quality leather belts, I’m not sure if that means anything in regards to the quality of the leather. Buckle is a good size without being too. Overall very pleased with it.

title: That hipster look
text: I really wasn’t a fan of the hipster look but it’s grown on me. Probably just in time to start going out of style. These aren’t as stretchy as I thought and the fit around the waist is a shade tight and the length is tad short. That being said they look really good. Let me clarify again,  these would have been a nightmare for me if I hadn’t finally come around to the slim fit hipster movement.

title: Nice but way too big
text:
Sizing is way off compared to other brands. I got these for my grandson who normally wears a size large and they were way too big. My daughter who is 5’5 and 125 said they fit her perfectly. But other than the sizing, these are nice quality pants. I did notice that there are already a few pulled threads typical of this type of material, but not too notible. They are comfortable and look nice. Here is the size chart from the adidas website for these pants.
S M L XL
SIZE 8 - 10 10 - 12 14 - 16 18 - 20
HEIGHT 50 - 57" 58 - 63" 64 - 67" 68 - 72"
WT 59 - 86 87 - 114 115 - 137 138 - 150

title: Nice gym bag
text: I use my gym bag for the whole week 3 days. This is a nice bag that offers a good amount of space. I did have to modify and actually cut out the sealed area for wet close. I wash the bag as well every week. Nice carrying strap for over the shoulder use. There’s a hard plastic separation for wet and dry clothes.

title: Comfortable
text: From my daughter: I normally wear between a size 7.5 -8.5 depending on the brand. The 7.5 fit perfectly in this shoe. There is a bit of stretch and I think the size 8 prob would have fit as well. They are comfortable and look nice. Great staple to have in my wardrobe as the last pair of black ballet flats I had I completely wore out.

title: Good fit
text: From my daughter:  These shorts fit great and are the perfect length and cut. They are also very comfortable and the white tie looks nice. I am just not a fan of the material. It doesn't look like typical terry material. I also wish it were a bit thicker, so that you could wear them outside of the house if you wanted to.

title: Grandson likes them
text: My 9 year old grandson really likes these and put them on as soon as they arrived. He normally wears a size medium and these fit perfectly. He commented on how comfortable they were and has no complaints. They also look nice and seem well made and should hopefully last.

title: Nice workout shorts
text: From my daughter: Great lightweight exercise shorts. They have just enough coverage and are really comfortable. They fit true to size. I normally were a small or size 4 and the small fit perfectly. Comes with lining which is nice if you are doing yoga and want some coverage. They feel and look like great quality, comparable to more expensive brands.

title: Nice basic tees
text: These are nice basic tees. I think there are more exciting basic tees out there, but these do the job and are soft and comfortable. They fit as expected and should be great layered under jackets during the winter. They wash well and don't shrink.

title: Nice top
text: Nice basic loose tee. The material is very soft and comfortable. The shirt looks well made and it fits true to size.  Can be dressed up or down.

title: Nice fit
text: They looked like they were going to be too loose when I took them out of the package, but they ended up fitting well and looking nice on. I would probably size down next time to get a snugger fit. I normally wear a small or medium, but would prefer a small in this shirt. The material is nice and has a nice thickness too it. Material is very soft and comfortable. Colors are nice and versatile. Can be dressed up or down.

title: Warm
text: Nice warm winter jacket. This is definitely a heavier type jacket with good insulation. I like the way it looks and it fits well and true to size. It appears well made and good quality. The khaki color is nice and better looking in person, although I would choose black over it since black is a classic color and matches everything. The fur lining is best kept on so that you can’t see the button snaps. They should have created a way to cover them when not using the fur. The fleece lining in the pockets and hood are nice and warm. Overall a nice, warm winter jacket.

title: Very comfortable but a bit large
text: These are extremely comfortable for sleep wear but a bit large from my experience. Even though they fit ok with the draw string they should still be a bit smaller. Nice pocket and look great.

title: Comfortable
text: Seem to be high quality leggings compatible to much more expensive ones. They are comfortable, and fit well in all the right places. I like the higher waistband and they fit true to size. They look well made and hopefully last a long time.

title: Somewhere between jeans and sweatpants
text: Fit seems a bit large but not by much. These kind of feel like sweatpants but are more rugged like jeans. Nice drawstring for perfect waist fit. They are comfortable but I think I will need to wash a few time to get them in perfect wearing condition. Working or relaxing these will fit both bills.

title: Nice Jeans but run big
text: I ordered a size down from what I normally wear and they fit perfectly. They are flattering and appear well made and good quality. I am 5’5 and the length is perfect. I like the grey color as well. My current favorite jeans are my high rise tommy jeans, but these are a good backup.

title: Grandson likes them
text: These are nice holiday pajamas. They seem comparable to carters pajamas. They appear well made and the cotton is very soft and comfortable. They wash well and should be perfect for the holidays.

title: Nice shorts
text: These shorts look and fit great. Nice pattern that’s not too loud. Comes with drawstring to adjust waistline in the front. Side pockets are a nice size that fit my larger phone.

title: Nice basic black hoodie
text: This is a nice basic black hoodie with pockets. Perfect for lounging or outdoor activities. Material is soft and comfortable and seems to be good quality. Reminds me of the Starter brand items that I have. I was hoping this might be a little more fitted and stylish, but it's just what you would expect from a nice black hoodie sweatshirt.

title: Cute beanie
text: Nice quality girls beanie. My 9 yr old granddaughter likes it, especially since it has small sequins on it that make it sparkle. It is is stretchy and has a good amount of fabric so it can fit a range of different sized heads.

title: Good but at this point could never be my all in one.
text: I really wanted this to be the wallet I could switch to, because the one I have is a pain in the rear, literally. This however wont fit the bill, at least the whole bill. Fit's about 4 cards and unfortunately that just wont cut it. Maybe when Apple pay works everywhere this would work but now not a chance. Medical/dental cards alone go over 4 cards. I know this isn't meant to be an every day so that's why I'm giving 4 stars. Perhaps I can figure out a way to go more digital and reduce, but for now it's not going ton happen.

title: Nice for colder running
text: Nice long sleeve exercise shirt. I've used a few times in the early mornings for jogging when is cold out. The fit is a bit small in the arms area, so you may want to get a size up. Very forgiving in the midsection. Nice athletic material that wicks the sweat well.

title: Nice watch
text: Nice looking watch without being "over kill" with too much going on. I like the simple classic design. Black color easily matches with just about everything. Quality seems to be good from a trusted brand. Great for everyday business/casual wear.

title: Awesome smart watch
text:
I like the look of this watch MUCH better than the Apple Watch. Very light weight and fits comfortably.

I use it with iPhone 7. Paired quickly and works well with notifications. It might work better with Android OS but I think it still work fine with Apple OS. I get text and email notifications. Awesome customizable face with many different templates. I’ve sync up to google assistant and all my google calendar. The health tracking is on par with other smart watches. Track heart, steps and send data to google fit. Overall I highly recommend this smart watch. Very good looking and functionality and performance are great.

title: Comfortable
text: From my daughter: Normally wear a size 27 or 4 and the small seems comparable. They are extremely comfortable since the material is soft and the waistband is elastic. Plan to wear these mostly around the house since they remind me more of leggings and sweatpants than jeans. Comfortable to lounge around in.

title: Cute but not my favorite
text: From my daughter: I like the style and seems well made, but it’s not the most comfortable for me. I am usually between and small and medium and the medium felt a bit tight at the bottom and could have been more snug up top. I also don’t like the removable pads because they shift around. But all in all it looks and and does it’s job.

title: Comfortable
text: From my daughter: Great quality jeans that are extremely comfortable and fit great. I haven’t owned a pair of light wash jeans in a while, but I like these ones a lot. I’m 5’5 and the holes are right over my knees and the ends touch my feet, so look a bit different than on the tall model in the pic, but still fit great and seem true to size.

title: Great looking pants
text: I really like the slim lol of these dress pants. My only concern is the waist seems a bit small and there is not give. I will need to lose some lbs to get into these. Definitely go a size up from normal in the waist.

title: Warm and stylish
text: From my daughter: Great winter coat. Looks nice and keeps me warm. Looks well made and not cheap.

title: Nice walking/hiking shoes
text: From my daughter: Great walking/hiking shoes. They are extremely comfortable and fit true to size. They have great grip on the bottom as well as a good amount of cushion inside. They also look nice and rugged. Look well made and like they should last.

title: Nice looking slacks
text: Nice quality slacks that fit well.  I’ve worn these to work a few times and look and feel great. A nice every day type of dress pants.

title: Nice pair of dress pants
text: Nice material. Feels like they are a quality pair of slacks. Seem to fit a bit small but not by much. Style is more of a modern look, which I think is nice.

title: Grandaughter likes it
text: Cute girls hoodie. Material is soft and lightweight. My 7 yr old grandaughter Iikes it and the designs on the sleeve. The fit it is a bit on the smaller side, but not too bad.

title: Nice golf/sport shirt
text: I own a bunch of Under Armor and Nike golf shirts. This shirt seems to be the same quality as both of those brands. I use mostly for work so I don’t sweat that much but after the gym (at work) I usually get a bit sweaty after taking a shower and this shirt, like the Nike and UA does a good job keeping me cool and dry. Fit was the same as my other shirts.

title: Very nice shoes
text: I really love the look of these shoes. The dark accents give them a very nice look. They fit perfectly and are fairly light weight.

title: Soft lounge pants
text: Nice pajama/lounge pants. They fit as expected. The material is really soft and comfortable. the pattern is nice with lots of small stars that look like polka dots from far away.

title: Great lightweight carry on
text: Great lightweight carry on suitcase. Looks and feels well made. Wheels glide smoothly and easily. Compact but roomy.

title: Nice polarized sunglasses
text: Nice polarized sunglasses. They come with a nice case and I thought the little picture that came with it to show you the polarization works was neatthey are very lightweight which makes them really comfortable to wear, but at the same time also makes them look a bit cheap since they are light. For the price these seem like a good pair of polarized sunglasses.

title: Nice swim coverup
text: from my daughter: Nice beach coverup. Sheer material that is probably only suitable for the beach or pool. Cute design that is loose fitting and comfortable. Would look better if the pattern was embroidered instead of printed on, but it is inexpensive this way and still does the job.

title: Very nice shirt, perfect fit.
text: Really nice shirt. Feels like silk and fits perfect at the large size, similar to Nike Golf shirt fit. A nightmare of a shirt for any video camera shoot with its moiré pattern. Quality shirt.

title: Nice looking cap
text: Nice quality cap. The S/M size fits a smaller adult head or teen size head. I really like the white color.

title: Nice looking shoes
text: Nice looking shoe. More look than function as I can’t see myself running 5-10 in these. They do feel good and are very light weight. I think best to get a half size up from what you where.

title: Nice pull over sweatshirt
text: The color has a nice texture and the material isn’t very thick. For a large the fit is a bit small. The inside of the hood is lined with workout type of fabric. Overall a nice sweatshirt.

title: Very lightweight
text: We own several starter clothing items and like them all. They appear to all be well made and hold up well to washing and wearing. They are all also very comfortable. This lightweight hoodie jacket is no exception. It looks nice and is very lightweight and fits well.

title: Good looking shirt
text: I have to say the look of this shirt is really nice. Very nice looking design compared to the majority of Nike and UA ones I have. Fabric is perfect work out material texture. An easy five stars.

title: Nice shirt
text: Nice shirt. The fit is a bit large for being XL. The fabric is not stretchy like most work out shirts which makes it feel comfortable but doesn't dry very quick. Overall a nice tank top I would recommend.

title: Very lightweight
text: Great lightweight suitcase. It rolls really smoothly and easily. Looks well made and has lots of space and extra pockets. Colors are nice and easy to spot at baggage claim.

title: Nice costume, runs a bit big
text: Quality costume that will definitely get a lot of use. My granddaughters love dressing up all year round. This comes with everything you need to look like Violet from The Incredibles movie. It is a bit big on the 3 yr old, but fits my small 7 yr old perfectly. I would say the size is closer to a 4t/5t but its nice that it runs a bit big because we can get more use out of it. The pants and sleeves can be rolled up to fit a smaller child. It also appears well made for a costume in the $20-$30 range.

title: Great looking sweats.
text: Nice sweats. Material is a bit thick but will last awhile. I didn’t think I would like the look but now that I’ve tried them I think they are the best looking sweats I have. Sides pockets and a zipper pocket. Overall very pleased.

title: Great classic sporty look
text:
Great classic sporty look. Several standard features, alarm, stop watch, etc. but lets face it this is more for looks than function. Sure it will give me the time an date but my phone handles the all that stuff and does a much better job. I like this purely for the classic look, and of course it tells time.
It does have button to light up in the dark.

title: Grandaughters love it
text: Cute, well made dress that both my grandaughters really like. I would say it runs true to size and fits like a 5t or girls xs. The materiel is nice and thick and the decorations are really cute.

title: Nice sweats
text: Nice sweats. More comfortable than I would have thought. Material is very soft. Perfect for either lounging or working out.

title: Nice no show socks
text: Good no show socks that fit as expected and stayed in place during the day. They fit my mem’s size 10 foot well. The seems appear well made and they are comfortable.

title: Nice basic polo dress
text: Well made, basic girls polo dress. Size xs fits like a 5t. Fit and length is nice and looks cute on.

title: Pretty dress
text: From my daughter: I was surprised by the quality of this dress. It has a really nice weight to it and doesn't feel thin or cheap. The seams all look good as well. It fits true to size. It is a very pretty dress with nice detail.

title: Nice sweats
text: Good sweatpants. Has front a back pockets. Definitely more for lounging that jogging or working out pants. The material is thick. A bit baggier in croch area than pictures show.

title: Nice exercise shirt
text: It's made of nice flexible material, with great compression. I wish it were a bit larger fit in the belly area. Great for all exercise activities.

title: Great dress shirt
text: I really like Van Heusen shirts. They seem to last me longer than other brands. This shirt has a great texture that isn't too thick and feels smooth. Fit is regular so a bit baggier in lower area, which I like. Over all a great dress shirt.

title: Grandson likes it
text: A great basic tee. Material is soft and comfortable and perfect for my grandson. Fit is true to size and the cut of it looks great. The graphics on it are nice as well.

title: Nice, but ride up
text: From my daughter: I normally wear a size small and the small in these seem to fit ok, but do ride up sometimes which is annoying. I’m not sure if a larger size would help. But other than that, these are really nice.

title: Great quality
text: We have several Starter clothing items from Amazon and have really liked them all. They all seem to be great quality including this item. It seems like it can be unisex since it is plain black and would look good on a girl or boy. It fits my granddaughter well and seems true to size.

title: Nice but bigger than I’d expected
text: Nice shirt but a bit bigger than I thought it would be. Material is nice quality and whrikle free. Good for someone very tall.

title: Quality shirt
text: Nice shirt but a but a bit longer than id expected. Quality material that is whrikle free. Color is a darker blue.

title: Nice basic denim leggings
text: Nice basic pair of girls denim leggings. They are s bit thicker than the ones I usually buy at Target, and appear well made. The color is nice and should go well with lots of different tops.

title: Great quality
text: These pants are much better than I expected. I The material is the perfect thickness and the legs are more tapered to give them a more stylish look. These will be perfect for my grandson when he needs to wear something more dressy than jeans.

title: Nice dress
text: Nice dress that appears well made. Fits true to size and is comfortable. The only downside is that the tie loosens on its own and needs to be retied. It looks funny if its too loose, because there is stiching across the waste that shows if the wrap hangs too low.

title: Nice socks
text: Comfortable socks that fit true to size. My grandson likes them and they look like they are well made and should last a while.

title: Nice socks
text: Quality socks. I recieved the yourh large and they fit as expected. They are comfortable and look like they are well made. Only downside is my grandson doesn’t like the compression part around the middle of the foot.

title: Nice socks, grandson likes them
text: I received size “youth large” and they are a lot smaller than I expected and according to the size chart. My grandson wears a boys size 1.5 shoe and these fit snuggly. He likes them a lot though and says they are comfortable and he is very particular about his socks. They appear well made and like they should last.

title: Nice shirt
text: Nice dress shirt. Standard fit. No pocket. Washes well and comes out of the dryer wrinkle free. Perfect for work.

title: Nice robe
text: From my daughter: Nice but elegant robe. Material is soft and comfortable. I think I would prefer a full length sleeve, but regardless it is still nice and looks good.

title: Nice casual shirt
text: Very nice shirt will cool anchor pattern. Not so wrinkle free but not bad either. Overall a good casual shirt.

title: Quality dress shirt
text: Very nice, quality dress shirt. Wrinkle free. Would be best to pair this shirt with a tie. Standard fit.

title: Nice trainers
text: Look is really nice. They fit well. The cushioning isn’t the best but I don’t mind that. I have used primarily for training (jogging). They are also nice for casual attire.

title: Fit well
text: From my daughter: These bottoms fit perfectly. I normally wear a small or medium and the small was the perfect fit. The back side has a little less coverage than I would have liked, but it is still somewhat modest. They seem to be good quality and should last a few seasons. The print is also nice and looks as pictured.

title: Nice shirt for work
text: Nice shirt, you will need to wash is a few times before it feels soft. When you open it up it feels like paper. The fit is classic so plenty of room.

title: Nice sweatpants. Good for around the house or trip ...
text: Nice sweatpants. Good for around the house or trip to the store. They fit comfortably. Really nice style and shape.

title: Comfortable
text: From my daughter: nice comfortable pair of black leggings. I thought they were going to be too short but they come to about an inch above my ankle which is perfect. I’m 5’5. I like the high waist and these can be worn for just about anything. Can be dressed up or worn for exercise or just lounging around. They fit true to size.

title: Great quality
text: From my daughter: Normally wear a small/medium and this fit a bit loose. It would fit better if it has adjustable straps. Since the straps are a bit loose it isn’t very supportive and requires extra support. But overall this is a great quality top and I would recommend it as well as going with a smaller size.

title: Soft
text: This dress is exactly as described. Super soft, perfect length, and can be dressed up or down. It is very comfortable to wear and fits true to size. I have other pieces from this brand and I like them all.

title: Cute but run big
text: Very cute onesies, but they do run big. They are soft and similar to carters ones which I usually by. I like all the prints. Would make a nice gift.

title: Comfortable
text: From my daughter: comfortable light/medium support. The medium fit is as expected. The fabric is soft but seems like it might not hold up well to washing since it is the type that easily snags, but we will see. The cups are removable.

title: Great shorts for summer
text: GReat shorts for summer. Comfortable and versatile. They dry fast as well. Usually purchase the Quicksilver Amphibion shorts and these ones seem comparable.

title: Very soft, comfortable dress
text: From my daughter: I have been happy with all the Daily Ritual items I have received. This dress is very soft, stretchy and fits true to size. Because the material is so stretchy, it will accommodate different body styles well. The color is also a very nice green.

title: Good pair of jeans
text: Nice pair of jeans. Very dark color. Not the best of cut to them (kind of old school boxy look). What I would expect for the brand and cost. Nice jean material, not too thick. Fit is right on the money.

title: Really cute nice cardigan, just a bit short
text: This cardigan would easily be 5 stars if it was about an inch or so longer. It falls right at the waistline of my granddaughters pants. It is very cute and my granddaughter loves it. It seems well made. It slightly thicker than a lightweight sweater. It washed well and I let it air dry. My granddaughter usually wears a size 5t or xs and she received the small. There is more than enough length on the sleeves.

title: Nice lightweight but warm winter jacket
text: Lightweight but warm winter jacket. The XL fit exactly like a women’s small. It is comfortable and looks nice. Pockets are zippered and there are pockets on the inside for pocket warmers as well as an elastic to hold keys.

title: Nice winter jacket
text: Nice boys winter jacket. My grandson likes it and says it’s comfortbale. Haven’t had cold weather to test it out yet, but it seems like it would hold up well to rain, snow and wind. Fit true to size.

title: Nice long sleeve tees
text: From my daughter: These shirts are nicer than I expected for the price. The material has a nice weight and softness to it. The material also has a slight sheen to it which make it looks nicer than just a plain cotton tee. I like that the white is thick enough so that it is not see-through. They also have a nice length.

title: Medium runs big
text: My 8 year old grandson likes these. They run a bit larger than another pair of Starter mesh shorts he owns in the same size, medium. Other than that they seem great and are his favorite type of shorts to wear.

title: Not for me.
text: Horrible shirt. Cut looks like a tent. I ordered XL and it’s huge. The texture feels like a rough rug. Pattern is ok, but design literally looks like a big box.

title: Nice modest suit
text: From my daughter: Nice modest bathing suit. I received a medium and it fit like a small. This style probably wouldn’t be my first choice as I am not a fan of the belt. I think it would look better without it. I really like how the top fits and the padding is perfect... not too much and not too thin. It has a nice neckline without being too revealing. I also like the cut of the bottom and legs. Just enough fabric in the right spots.  Looks well made and like it should hold up well.

title: Nice but not my favorite
text: From my daughter: The stitching color and denim color combination isn't my favorite, but the fit is good and the price is reasonable. I like jeans I have found at Costco better and at a better price, like the Calvin Klein jeans they usually sell. I prefer a more stretchy and soft jean. But these do seem like a well made pair of pants.

title: Quality roll top pack
text: Nice pack. Wish it were a bit more roomier. Other than that solid design, quality materials. Fits well and is adjustable just about everywhere. It's comfortable even fully loaded. Nice magnet on the top opening. Over all a good quality roll top  pack that should last a long time.

title: Quality product.
text:
Great value here with the Huey UA backpack.

Pros:
Quality build. Quality material.
Nice engineered design with plenty of zippable pockets.
Nice padded shell for your back
Side pockets convenient for water bottle or sport drink.
Fits well with padded straps and cross chest buckle.
Padded laptop pouch for small, medium laptop.
Bottom pouch for sweatshirt or small jacket.
Looks great with black, no flashy colored lining.
Great value at the $130.00 price range.
Great carry on size for travel.

Cons:
None hat I can think of so far.

title: Nice shirt
text: Ok shirt. Fit is all good up too but not a long as I'd like. Probably ok if untucked or for someone under say 5,9ish. Fabric isn't going to stay wrinkle free by any means but fine if ironed. Material is light weight so will be cooler to wear. Over all a nice budget white shirt. If you're taller I'd go with something else.

title: Nice boots
text: From my daughter: Great looking boots. The leather is soft and they look like well made boots. Also very comfortable. Looking forward to the winter so I can get some use out of these boots.

title: Nice shirt
text: Nice shirt, fits a tad big for XL. The color is a very close match to the image on Amazon.  Fabric  seems smooth and a bit stretchy.

title: Just ok
text: Shirt fit smaller than expected. Looks nice, but the quality of it doesn't reflect the price in my opinion. Prefer the look, feel, and fit Van Heusen brand dress shirts.

title: Great swim shorts
text: Great swim shorts. My 8 year old grandson says they are comfortable and loves how fast they dry. The size small fit him perfectly and they are pretty true to size, maybe just a tiny bit smaller than expected. They look good and washed without any problem. Would recommend.

title: Nice swim shirt
text: Nice swim shirt. The XX Large it bit larger but still fits ok. Nice blue color. Drys out quick.

title: Nice watch
text: Nice watch. Nothing that extremely flashy. It is somewhat are to see the hands because they a gold colored and also is the back, but it looks nice.

title: Nice slacks
text: Nice paints. They are a bit lighter colored than pictured. Nice wrinkle free material. Over all very pleased with the look and fit.

title: A bit baggy
text: These pants are a too baggy for me. Not very good cut to them. They fit around the waist as expected but just too large and baggy in the butt area. Color is nice.

title: Nice black flip flop
text: Fit is true to size. My favorite sandals are rainbows and havaianas but these are comparably nice. I think I prefer some of the other Sanuk styles.

title: Nice top
text: From my daughter: Nice dressy modest top. I received a medium in the dusty rose color. The color is really nice, however the medium is a bit too big on me. title: LED lights, attractive  & plenty of storage
text: This is my second purchase of the same product from the same brand. This one however was supposedly the newest version and while it’s still terrific, it’s not as good as the original.  But let me start with the good stuff. I absolutely love the LED lights inside, that’s actually my favorite feature because it makes the jewelry sparkle.  The LED lights are the primary reason I went back to the same brand. It was easy to install by myself and it’s very attractive. The dark wood is pretty and I love the full length mirror on the front. The little drawers inside are helpful and I love the storage for rings. The rings stay put unlike a jewelry armoire I had years ago where my rings constantly fell out.  I love the earring racks that include holes for post earrings and slots to hold earrings on hooks.  These twi jewelry armoire‘s are perfect to hold my extensive jewelry collection and I appreciate that they lock with a key for security.  On the downside… Unlike the original version, the bracelet bar on this one is not sturdy and in fact it broke immediately once I hung several bracelets on it. There is no reason it should have broken so quickly. Also the magnets that hold the door shut are much less syrong than the last one.  With my first armoire, I have to actually give the door a tug in order to open it. With the new one I frequently find it open, just a bit a jar. Therefore I have to keep the LED lights turned off in order not to run down the batteries. And part of what makes these armoires so enjoyable (and not just functional) is opening the door and immediately seeing the sparkle.  It was not worth the expense or effort to repackage this big armoire and return it so I have kept it and I’m using it. But if for some reason I was to buy a third, I would not buy the “new and improved version”, I would go back to the original.  But all in all, still the best jewelry armoires I have ever used and I’m happy to have them.  Some armoires are not laid out very well inside but this one seems to have been designed by someone who really understands jewelry.

Junk. I got the black matte frames and black lenses. Wore them for one hour on a sunny day and then threw them away. Facing the sun you're practically blinded. With the sun overhead there is LOTS of glare and reflections. Vision down and sideways is distorted. The only good thing is that it comes with a nice case and cleaning cloth which I will save for my next pair of sunglasses.

EDIT: Less than 24 hours after posting this review the company Duduma contacted me to say they were disappointed in my review, offered me a free new pair of sunglasses from their Amazon store, and they included instructions for how to delete or edit my review. Sorry guys but my review isn't for sale. The fact is the glasses were bad and I don't want new ones for free.

EDIT: One month after posting this review someone who claims to have a few pairs of Duduma sunglasses that he's happy with, yet has never posted any review on Amazon about them before, wrote a comment here disputing my review. Duduma marketing strikes again? Decide for yourself.
