title: 4X fits like a 2x, and no room for a big butt
text:
So I had really high hopes for these leggings. Ive moved to a much colder, northern state after ten years in the south US, and wanted some nice leggings. Mine were falling apart anyway, so why not these. Im usually a 3X, sometimes a 4X depending on the brand, so I went with the 4X. If they were too big, I thought I'd throw them in the dryer.

I was SO excited to try them on, but when i pulled them on, they barely went past my thighs. Half my backside was hanging out, and I still had five inches of legging hanging off my feet. I thought "well they must be caught on something" Nope. "They must be the wrong size..." Nope! All the tags, stickers and labels said 4X.

Long story short, Im returning them. If youre a size 24 or 26, and/or have a rather full butt, give these a pass. Two stars because like... the material is great. Its super soft. But god... I dont know on what planet a 4X fits like a 2X.

So I like these bras. Dont love them. But theyre okay. Ive been wearing the wrong size bra for over a year, very similar to this, and thought it time to live more comfortably.

I was really excited about how they looked, until I put a shirt on, and saw that the padding looked like little hats on top of my boobs. Just too small in relation to my boobs.

So I took the padding out, and of course, my boobs look... pretty compressed. Im a 46/48C, got the 3X, which adversizes 47-51DD, and thought there would just be more room in the cups, or that the cups would be more giving.

The bra itself is also a bit snug. Not too tight. but tight enough that it kinda feels like I'm wearing a sports bra rather than a comfort bra. Also the material isnt the softest. Its kinda... meh.

title: A huge value , must buy legging
text: These leggings are like buttah!  Seriously, these are so soft , so comfortable and although they aren’t thick ,they aren’t at all see through either . They are high waisted and give a little bit of tummy control but are far from compression control. If you expect them to hold you in firm like a pair of control top pantyhose you’ll be disappointed. I bought them, two pair now,  to wear under my torn jeans in the winter months ,so cute I need to buy more. I can’t keep up with washing them on delicate and hanging them to dry fast enough ,I want to live in them! I wash all my clothes ,other than jeans on delicate and hang my nicer stuff to dry to keep everything from pilling and shrinking I have a full seat and thighs and wouldn’t wear any legging in public unless my backside was fully covered by a tunic top or long sweater but these leggings give just enough support I know if I weren’t so self conscious I’d even wear them out in public to work out etc . I say for the price they are a must buy , must try legging . I’m almost 57 years old ,5’7 and 175lbs , hope this helps .

miles every morning and often 3-5 miles later in the day as well.

The pair I have liked is a DOUBLE FUSION by Nike that provides soft but firm support for the entire foot
from HEAL to TOE and Mid-Sole. The Fila's just feel 'flat' and do not provide the support or cushion
this user needs since I have no cartilage left in my knees and hips. Therefore, cushioning and support both are of prime importance (I'm a former long distance runner who averaged over 100 miles/week at one point).

The Saucony I read averages 'small' so best to order 1/2 size larger than one's usual (that is what I read in comments)...so that is what I did. Must say, size wise (width/length) of this shoe in doing so, couldn't be much better. My only complaint on this end is the mid-sole feels a bit 'flat or hard' as I'd hope it would be.
I did purchase at the Dollar Store (of all places) this extra thick insole to line along the bottom of the shoe
and that made a big difference.

title: Worked but not for long
text:
I used this product for this pair of Nikes, after using the adhesive left both shoes 'pressed' under a heavy end table
leg for 72 hours. All was well, though within about a week they slowly are coming'unglued', thankfully there's plenty more left in the tube to re-apply, which I've done twice now. Still, the shoes are at least wear-able which would not have been the case before.

title: Great Water Shoe
text:
I worse these shoes while on vacation on an island. They stood up well when walking around and had decent arch support. Not great for running, however, as they didn't absorb a lot of shock when more pressure and moment was applied. These shoes do an excellent job at draining water out of the shoe with the mesh on the bottom of the shoe. However, the mesh works both ways. I stepped in a puddle thinking nothing of it because I was wearing "tennis shoes" and water got into my shoes and got my socks wet. The water went out of the shoe as soon as I lifted my feet up, but my socks were wet for the next couple hours. Just be careful where you wear them and you'll be fine.

Overall, I am very pleased with these shoes and how they hold up!

title: Fantastic Golf Shoes
text: Fit fairly true to size, look great, and function well when out on the golf course. No complaints about them and they fit feet that are normally fairy arrow.

title: Shoes are heavy and have a chemical odor
text:
Two things about these boots warrant mentioning: they are very heavy (size 12, 5e), and they still have a chemical odor despite my use of foot powder and odor eater inserts.

The width in general is ok, but the toe box feels tight. (This problem for me may be caused by swelling in my feet from kidney disease.) I tried to compensate by ordering a size 12. Any other size would have turned out to be too small, as things played out.

My 4 star rating is an attempt to strike a balance between the shoe problems & my own apart from tbe shoes themselves.

title: SEE UPDATE MAY 2021 after removing mobey clip
text:
Perhaps I received a bad product. Here is what I mean: the money clip is soooo tight it prevents the use of a few of the compartments on the same side. The clip is meant to hold very very few bills - that is for sure. I removed the dollar bills I put into the clip, and then I was able to squeeeeeeze my fingers into the card slots. If I add any bills, the clip-side card slots are useless.

Note that there is NO place to put currency other than in the clip.

The wallet is tightly made and it displays craftmanship. But the execution of the design leaves a great deal to be desired. Low score on practicality.

I think I am creative enough that I will eventually find a way to use the wallet and not be as disappointed as I am right now.

UPDATE MAY 2021
This wallet has been sitting on my file cabinet collecting dust. I decided to perform needed "surgery" on it with my vise grip and Swiss Army knife: I removed the money clip and now I will finally be able to make use of what is otherwise a nice wallet. My cards and the like will now fit in ALL pockets and it will now start to fulfill its purpose. Allz well that endz well!

title: The Price is Right
text:
PROS:
A heavy watch -a lotta muscle. OK by me.
Easy to read analog face.
Fairly easy to set up - has the usual control settings found on this type of watch.
Nice looking color scheme and style.
Very nicely priced.

CONS
NOT the watch used by Denzel Washington in THE EQUALIZER. I looked for THAT ONE.
Numbers light up but not all that brightly.
Digital time is frequently hard to see because of analog watch hands.
NO user manual, so you are on your own.

title: Your jeans WILL stay put!
text: These braces bite into my jeans with a vice-like grip that allows me to carry all of my gear...wallets, mask, hand sani, and so on. If you have been looking for suspenders tough enough to hold your jeans wherever you set them, these are for you. I bought two pair. They are not too narrow nor too wide. They are, however, perfect.

title: Excellent value
text:
I have used these sweatpants now and in the past. And I have found them to be perfect for my needs. I use them in the winter and find they provide enough warmth. I get tge medium size fir a 38" waist. They hug my waist. I have no complaint in that regard.

Since I am often taking hospital tests, I am able to wear these pants in place of those detestable hospital gowns, because there is no metal on these pants. No buttons or zippers.

One flaw: whatever you put in the pockets will likely fall out - they are not deep and have no closures on them.

Still my favorite everyday pants fall and winter.

title: Great Pin
text: Since I received this combination flag & cross pin, I have worn it daily on my shirt collar. It is an attractive pin, and I have had no problems with the clasp. The pin blends faith and love of country. Other reviewers made that point. And I agree.

title: EXCELLENT replacement watchband!
text:
THIS is a watchband! Nothing flimsy about this one!

Be prepared: you WILL need to remove the metal strap posts from your,watch. You will NOT be able to slide this strap through them.

You do get a helpful tool for re-installing the posts. It comes with the strap.

I believe this strap is worth the money and will enhance any watch. It has given new life to my simple and inexpensive but very accurate watch!

title: Not heavy and plenty warm!
text: I was hoping my dog's hair would not cling to this jacket. It does not. That in itself makes it a winner for me. The color is true blue, pic makes it look a little darker, which I would have preferred. As for warmth, it gets a solid "A."

title: A Heavy Boot, good for snow
text: CAUTION: A very HEAVY boot! I will use thse primarily for snow when I want to be anchored down - these boots definitely hold me in place.  Color is great, as depicted in the description. Tread on them is deep.

title: Not a good buy
text: These straps are wearing out much too quickly. Initially they seem sturdy and the sliders hold position. Before you know it, the sliders do not stay put, the strap fabric thins out. The rubber grips on the eyeglass frames loosen very easily and do not stay put. I would not buy these again.

title: Great color, light weight. I am sold!
text: There is nothing to dislike about these boots. After my black pair fit so well, I bought these as well. Color matches perfectly what you see online, the red laces are old-man cool, they are lightweight and soft. With reasonable care, I expect they will last a hood while.

title: Blue Belt is TRUE Navy Blue !
text: These belts are in fact a bit long. BUT I am nowhere near a 54" waist and I don't think I will need to resize it. Yes, there are a few inches of slack, but I don't find that to be a problem. The belt itself is a little on the stiff side, again not a problem. The buckle is probably going to scratch easily and will probably tarnish before too long. But since I knew that going in, I can't complain. The main thing is this: I can cinch this belt up and my pants stay in place. It does what a belt is supposed to do.

title: More for the "farmhand" look than for dress
text: Don't get me wrong -- these suspenders will hold up your pants well enough. Keep in mind that they are wider than you would want to wear with dress clothes -- and a little thicker than dressier styles. BUT they keep your pants where they belong!

title: Does the Job!
text: These suspenders are sturdy and they do what they're supposed to. I carry a lot of things in my pockets -- the weight, combined with the weight of jeans, is considerable. Belts don't work for me, but these suspenders are up to the task. I highly recommend them!

title: Button Works, but Very Pricey!
text:
When I received this item, i was stunned to see that I paid a small fortune for ONE button. This was probably the result of my failure to pay close enough attention to the wording of the Amazon ad for this product.

Now the button does what it is supposed to do and remains pretty well out of sight behind a necktie. So I have no complaints there.

Just keep in mind that the advertised price on Amazon is for ONE of these buttons. For the price, I was expecting a 3-pack.

title: Decent Digital Watch, Excellent Price
text:
This Casio watch differs from a similar model in one major respect (which accounts for the much lower price): it is not solar-powered. If that feature matters to you, you need to get the "upgraded version" of this watch.

To keep this watch running with the correct time every day, you need to place it on a window sill overnight. It WILL link up with the satellite service (located in CO) and "reset" itself to the proper time during the overnight period.

If dial illumination is a key feature for you, please note that the watch does have a lighted dial engaged by pressing a button on the side of the watch. Be advised: it is NOT very bright. You can read the numbers, however.

The watch face shows the date (mo/day, full year), the time in decent-sized numerals, and the day.

If you want a decent digital watch that keeps accurate time and you don't want to spend a fortune, this is the watch for you.

title: Look nice, and that's it
text:
I picked these up when they were on sale. I needed some boots for riding and happened to come across these. I figured they would be fine while I learned and I'd upgrade to more expensive boots later on. They fit nice, have a zipper rather than laces (which is what I wanted), and look great. They seem to be decent quality for the price.

However, these boots are really only good for aesthetics. Once you feel the material, you can tell right away they will not protect your ankles, which is one of the primary reasons you'd want boots. The material is way too thin and soft, and bends easily at the ankles. I wouldn't trust these to protect me in an accident. So for that, I'm knocking off a couple stars. Might as well wear regular boots at that point.

title: Comfortable Jacket, would recommend
text:
I ordered this and wasn't sure what to expect. I don't order clothing online very often but I figured that a jacket wouldn't be as risky. I am rather short but slightly busty so I am used to getting a medium, or a large if the style is a bit smaller than usual. The previous comments were mixed, some saying it was slightly bigger with others saying it was snug. I decided to get a medium.

It shipped quickly and came in an air-tight package. It had a few wrinkles but a wash took them out easily. I made the right choice. The medium fit well with the sleeves slightly long (which is normal for me since I am short). The material gives the impression of fleece but slightly thinner. It is cotton and polyester and very soft. I am extremely please with this product. It is stylish, comfortable, and warm, and the hood is well-sized (I hate jackets with tiny hoods). The shoulders are a little squared but it's not very noticeable.

Keep in mind that it is machine washable but can't be tumbled dry.

Pros:
Warm, comfortable, soft and fits well. Definitely recommend to anyone looking for a decent jacket.

Cons:
The inside is not lined so it may lacking in warmth for much colder areas. I don't live in an area that snows, but I imagine it's not warm enough for snow.

Although The setting is nice looking.

When you look straight into these CZs it looks pretty good, but as soon as you move to the
Side or top of this stone, it’s just looks like glass to me. There is not any sparkle.

I wanted these earring for when I go on a vacations. I usually wear little earrings but I thought this might be nice.
The description on these earring where not too clear!
These are too big to be real looking for Everyday earrings.
On vacation I do not like taking real diamonds, and do not wear
Any other jewelry, but a simple eternity wedding band.

These earring are also too big which is a dead give away there fake, costume jewelry.
These look to be about 1 1/2 ct. each. Although it says there 2 ct.each.
If these where about 75 points to 1 ct each they might pass as real. Wearing CZ earring with your hair near then can look ok if there smaller.

The posts are thin, with tiny backings, but the holes are a little too big, But there are little rubber
Stoppers that came with these for a good reason, the backing will fall off, wear the stoppers.
This Said, there sterling with gold plating , then it says there Platinum plated!
No, there sterling and will Tarnish.

text:

Pair of these pants in a size 31, 32 for my husband who is usually not picky, but He does know good outdoor material , and a nice suit from not good.
He can wear the 32 waist or 31.

He tried this on and didn’t like the feel of this cheesy stick to your legs shiny material !
Then he unzip the legs off to
Make these shorts.
He Still didn’t like them.
The waist band looks like a older men’s cheap pair of dress pants!
Btw , my husband is not a young guy.

title: Very nice, fit good- not tight, waist abit stretchy. Size 33 waist.
text:
My son really likes these cargo short.
There comfortable , has allot of pockets, washed & dried good, all zippers work good.
Sewed good no loose threads.
The material is a little thicker that he likes, but said there hot. (Live in Ca. and was in the 90s today).

I got the cargo shorts for him in a 33 waist , he is 6ft, these fit him perfect, and not tight.
The length came a little shorter then the picture shows, almost to the bottom of his knees, but definitely not below his knees.
Hope this reference helped.

title: Fit good, look good for the price.
text:
Good looking black pants if you Need them for something special.
For the price you have to realize the pants are not high-end.
But will work if your needing to wear a pair of black slacks, or for work.

I got these for my older son, and they look pretty good, then I washed them!
Now there not as polished looking, but he said there very comfortable , and the waist
Is stretchy from inside the waist band.
The tuch fits good, and not bagy back there.

This is size 34 waist, 32 long, he is 6 ft. Fit him perfect. Fit good with loafers, a little bit
Long, but not touching the ground at all, Better to have a little long then short and you
Look like your going to a flood.

Made well.
For the price and fit, 5 stars

title: Nice looking and convenient mens Leather fold over wallet. Not cheesy.
text:
Very nice looking black Leather mans Wallet.
The Leather is soft, but sturdy, Not cheesy looking. Makes a nice gift.

This wallet folds over, convenient to put in your pocket.
This is not a skinny, skinny wallet, but depends how much you put in this.

It holds 5 cards, and had two places for paper money.
My husband is happy with this wallet, and he would buy another one. (He is picky)

title: Nice soft leather, handy anytime to wear purse
text:
I was on the fence about getting this leather purse, but glad I did, it’s a good size for everyday. Any time, Not too big, or too small, but bigger then I expected.
I don’t like purses that are too big, there sloppy and messy looking I think, and you can’t find what your looking for in your purse.

This is a cross body purse or make the leather strap shorter , and it’s a shoulder strap.

This purse is made well, all stitching is good.
Has a nice leather scent. The top zips closed.
The lining is all black material, with a big zipper pocket, and two open pockets , One a little larger then the other one. One pocket holds my iphone. These are on the inside.

On the outside is two zipper compartments, with the tiny medal bird logo, on the other side is one zipper compartment on the top I personally like that side better, it’s plainer, and I would have liked the tiny bird logo on that side.
All zippers work good.
I got the cognac color, and glad I did.
Think it’s a color to wear all year, not just for winter, and goes with anything.

I would recommend this purse.

title: Nice comfortable.
text:
About a couple of weeks ago I received other Izod PJ pants and sleeping shorts for my husband.
This is the only pair from Izod that is not as soft, and a bit too long.
Although these are nice and he will wear wear these.
He got the Medium. He wears a size 32. He is 5’9, about 145 lbs. he likes the way these fit.

Great for hot summer nights, to lounge around the house , and sit in the yard.

title: Nothing special for a Vera Bradley purse. Very common.
text:
This is not not like my other Vera Bradley purses!

I ordered the Ivy Green. It’s looks like a dark olive green to me, and
The color is ok. I like it, it’s non-described, blends with most anything I would wear.
The lining is white with dark green and grayish flowers, nothing special.

There is one zipper compartment on the outside front, I personally
Would rather have it on the inside, where the few things in there
Would not look bulky in the front.

On the other side under the top zipper is a opening For your iPhone., which is handy.
Inside there is two open pockets that are a good size, that would hold a iPhone also.
I would have liked One of those packets to have a zipper.

The main top zipper works good , like all Vera Bradley zippers do.
These two zippers are the same color as the purse is. and there plastic.

The purse is bigger then I expected , but I like that it is.
but it’s not huge, and does hold allot more then just
A wallet, keys , glasses, and other things, although not big enough To use for travel items .

The purse seems well made, the material thick, But I’m not a fan of this purse.
It looks cheesy to me. I realize it is made of recycle material , no harm to animals , etc.
and I love That idea, but it looks like something I would see at a Ross store for $20.00.

What country is this purse made in? and what country did this recycle material
come from?

I think if this purse was quilted it might be worth $60.00, but not this one.

title: Soft and comfortable, not a fan of the material.
text:
When I opened this package I was surprised about the color. Although there
Not bright, but a wine brown color!
There made well, and very easy to pull up. High waist.

I could of fit in a Medium, but I ordered large. Sizes of Clothes from China can be a hit or miss.
Maybe these run big, but there so Comfortable. Two back pockets, and two in the front sides..
I wear a size 8 or a 1O. I’m 5’2, 130 lbs.

I’m not a fan of the material it’s cheesy looking, and the style looks like
It’s for an older women, or it’s the color, or these should fit tighter!
I’m a older women, but it looks like my mother Might wear this.
I would not wear these to yoga, or the grocery store.
I’ll wear these around the house, there very comfortable and soft.
I’m short but have long legs, and There not too long.
These do not touch The floor without shoes on.

title: Sturdy socks for boots, and hiking. Padded.
text:
My son wears these sock with his boots for work, and for hiking,
We live near a national park in California.
The socks fit snug are sturdy, and should last a long time.
He wears a 12 to 13 shoes.

title: Wear with work boots, should last a long time
text:
My son wears these socks with his work boots.
He said there comfortable , fit snug. The material is not real soft, but
For what he wears them for they should hold up for a long time.
There is some padding in these socks.

title: Very soft, comfortable , great for summer sleeping.
text:
Very soft and comfortable for sleeping in the warmer weather.
Has two pockets , and will hold a iphone.
Also Nice to wear around the house for the summer.
The fly has a button, elastic waist with drawstring.

No tag, the size etc is printed inside.

My husband wears a size 32, medium , 5’9. These fit him perfect.

title: Good fit, great for warmer weather
text:
These izod are comfortable and cool to sleep in for the warmer weather.
Also nice to wear around the house, and sitting on the patio.

Elastic waist band with a drawstring.
Has two pockets that can hold a iPhone.
Washed and dry without shrinking.

My husband wears a 32, is 5’9, these where not too long, they fit perfect,
And there roomy.

title: Super comfortable for sleeping, or hanging around the house..
text:
My husband is loving these super comfortable Izod Fleece sleeping shorts.
Great for summer sleeping, hanging around the house ,and hubby also wears these outside on our property, (We live on a few acres in the mountains-Ca.
There is a fly front with a button, although my husband says nobody uses a fly front!
Has two pockets that can fit a iphone.

I ordered these in a Medium, he wears a 32 waist , and these fit him perfect, Not frumpy looking at all.

title: Comfortable for sleeping, and hanging around the house..
text:
These Izog sleep pants are nice and cool for the summer for sleeping, hanging around the house , or sitting outside ( we live on a few acres in the mountains) There casual, but Not for going to the market in..

I ordered a medium, my husband wears a 32 in jeans, is about 5’9, and these are super comfortable, and are not too long..
There is a tie waist, and also elastic..two pockets that your phone could fit in. The fly has a small button underneath the waist.
Although my husband said, why are they still making a fly in front, Nobody uses it!
These wash good, and I used a dryer sheet, did Not shrink, no wrinkles.

title: This is silent, works perfect, fits small wrist bands, and Large wrist band.
text:
This is my second review on this very nice accurate Watch winder. ( other review just disappeared !)

This watch winder is totally silent, and has two setting for movement For your watch.
The Winder is nice looking.

My Cartier self winding watch I have had ,for a very long time, and it never
Has kept the right time, or it would stop. This was a weekly or daily problem ,
And Cartier could never fix it right for very long.
I Finally found a Watch repair man that knows what he is doing in Santa Monica , Ca.

That said, I had a bad accident , and now I’m not moving around much to keep
This watch running right all the time.
This watch winder, is working perfect.

I have a very small wrist and this winder does fit with the band opened.
My husband put his watches on this, and it works well for him also.
But this winder will work for a small wrist band, and a larger wrist band.

Good price.

title: Soft very comfortable , these do not run big.
text:
Very soft material, actually feels like a nice soft cotton
light weight flannel For the summer.
These come with mint green color tie, not much elastic around the waist.
This is a medium, and my husband wears a slim 32, this Fits him perfect.
These shorts are not baggy, but do not fit tight.

These are sleeping shorts, and has the open fly in the front below
The tie. Doesn’t seem to stay open or anything.
My husband says, nobody uses the fly it should Be sewn closed.

title: Looks good, runs big, allot of pockets.
text:
My son likes these cargo shorts..
There is allot of pockets that he likes, the zipper works easy , and stays up.
This says there cotton, but to me they look and feel like polyester, and there shinny!

When I ordered these I wanted a size 34, as he is between a 33 and 34.
After I received these I went back to look at the size again, and now it says, 34 = 36! What!
These do run big, but there not close to 36, and I do not understand this type of sizing.
He had to wear a belt with these cargo shorts.
There made well and the material seems sturdy.

title: Soles are thick and hard, Not for a narrow foot. Size chart was off for me!
text:
I went by the chart that I do Not see here any longer!
I have a narrow foot, and these where huge on me.
My foot slid right threw the front of these slippers, and the front of the soles are not comfortable,
There Hard.
I also found the soles to be thick and heavy, not soft like my Uggs are.

If you have a slim foot, these are not for you. I also do not believe
The bottom of the inside of the slipper is shearing, only the cross top part is.

title: Comfortable, material looks a bit cheesy!
text:
Cute cut of the shirts neck line, and it’s not low cut.
If it’s to low you can button the 3rd button from the bottom.
The two bottom buttons stay closed or one side of the top will flop down.
I would have like the sleeves to fit a little tighter.

This shirt is comfortable but I think the material looks a little cheesy.
I washed this in my front loader, and put it in the dryer with a dryer sheet,come out
Looking like new, and No snags.

title: Fits good Not a sloppy mess.
text:
Great shirt, so comfortable.
I like how this shirt fits, its not a big sloppy mess, come in around the middle, although Not tight.
The length of the sleeves Are good and not baggy Around my arms.
The V neck is not real deep.

After I washed & put this in the dryer with a dryer sheet, it did
Not shrink, and so soft.
Got a medium, I’m 5’2, 130 lbs. fit perfect.
I like the material, does Not look like those cheesy poly material shirts.

title: Too Big, does not show size !
text:
This shirt is very soft and comfortable .

There is not any size in this shirt , And my order does not show a size , but I thought
I ordered a medium ! , and it is Huge.
Around the neck is too big, and the whole shirt is big.

I like the charcoal gray, and the bottom of the sleeves Are turned up, cuffed.

I’m 5’2, 130 lbs. ,36C. to give you a idea of how this fits. Tooo BIG.

title: Fit nice for yoga.
text:
These are made well, and I like the little tabs on the
bottom for my Yoga class.

I have very thin feet , wear a size 6 to 6 1/2 N.
and these fit well and where comfortable,
But the elastic bands did start to dig into my ankles !

title: True to size , wide waistband has draw string , comfortable.
text:
Fit nice.
This is Not sweatpants material.
There like a water resist slightly crinkly material!
All the zippers work easy. The two side pockets are deep,
As is the one on the leg. Although the zipper On the leg pocket is just for show,
but works.
The big leg pocket has a Velcro closure.
The bottom legs zippers work easy also.

The waist band is wide with a draw string, comfortable , and not tight.
My husband got a size 32, that is what he always wears.
I would say these are true to size. My husband is about 5’9, if your tall these might
Fit short !

I put the pants in the washed & dryer with a dryer sheet. Look like new.
Good price.

title: True to size, a bit see threw, sewn with pucker across the bust!
text:
When I received this shirt, cover-up, night gown !
This shirt can be anything you want it to be. Although it’s too long
For Jeans, Or legging unless your tall.

I tried this on before washing, and it fit good, and after washing also,
Although After taking it out of the dryer right away it was a bit wrinkled ,
I do Not iron .

I ordered the medium in white. Now that I have it, I should of
Ordered this in black. I could wear it around the house more or in the yard
Laying around cause in the white it’s see through.

I’m 5’2, 130 lbs and the medium is perfect for me. I would say it’s true to size.
It comes above the middle of my knees, the shoulders fit comfortable ,
And the rest is flowy and big.
The sleeves can be rolled up and there Are tabs to button to keep it up.

The only big Con I have is, at the bottom of the placket where it’s buttons up
Who ever sewed this , puckered the stitching and it looks bad , and caused
It to look like it’s pulling across the bust.
I’ll be taking a star off, although I should take off more stars!

I’m Not wearing this out of the house, more as a summer nightgown ,
And laying around.

4 stars.

title: Nice, but this shirt shrunk size up
text:
Nice looking shirt! Came with a extra button.
My husband tried this shirt on before I washed it and put it in the dryer
With a dryer sheet.
I took the shirt out of a still hot dryer, it was dry, but did not come out
Looking smooth.
It needs to be ironed, but I’m lucky my husband is not fussy, and retired
Last Feb when Covid started. Which means, he would not be wearing
This to his office.

Also this shirt Shrunk. It was a size large, but not anymore. Although my husband
Is a slim man, and can still wear this shirt.
I would say, size up for the shirt to be more comfortable.
Although this shirt is not suppose to be a big hangy type of shirt.
I would not consider this a T- shirt material , it’s a cotton linen.

title: Material is a loose weave can see threw this!
text:
This is a disappointment!
Although cute, and I like the length of the sleeves.

The material is a loose weave and you can see
Threw it! It does not show up in the pictures.
Where does it say it’s a beach cover-up, or wear a Bralette or a little top
Under this!?

I usually wear a Medium, This I ordered in Large, but I should have
Ordered a medium. It’s a hangy stretchy type of top.
I’m 5’2, 130 lbs, not big busted.
Also this is Not flattering.

title: Pants are sewed wrong, cheesy material.
text:
Ok for pjs, and laying around the house , but I would Not be wearing these
For jogging, or going to the market in these.

I got the gray top, red plaid pants, with knit bottoms , Cute.
Has pockets on each side of pants.

I can’t find the size in these and can’t remember what size I ordered
if there a medium, Or large! I’m 5’2, 130 lbs, wear a 8 or 10.
But I think they are sewed odd. The waist band is comfortable,
But around the middle there puffy big, and the top of
The legs there big in the thighs, but a bit short In the crotch!
very strange, never had a fit like this in Any pjs., or any thing,
but I can wear them.

The top fits, but tighter at the bottom , and it doesn’t hang down like PJs should.
I put these in the washer and dryer, and didn’t actually shrink, but a little at the
bottom.
These are not long, they came just under my ankle bone
Like the model. I’m not tall, but I have long slim legs.

The material for the pants are thin & Cheesy, and not soft.

Could I be the only one that received an odd pair!!
Then the sewing Is not consistent.

Under 3 stars!

title: Medium fits good, these are tailored looking PJs., stretchy.
text:
Update: The more I wear these PJ , and wash and dry them I notice the buttons on the
top are spaced far apart, And across the bust and the whole top between the buttons
this opens up and You can see inside the top. I’m not big busted and the top is not tight,
But this should not be happening. Had company spend the night in our guest bedroom
And it was embarrassing the next morning!
Don’t waste your Money, these are cheesy PJs.
I’m generous giving these a 3 stars.
——————
The material is soft.
These PJs have the star print on the outside , but are all white inside. Looks like the PJs are lined, but there not.
The material is stretchy , and I received the gray with stars.
Not a fan of the stars, and the gray has a shine to it, and has a cheesy shiny silver look to it.

I’m 5’2, 130 lbs, I got a medium , I wear a 8, or 10. and the top is comfortable in the shoulders and all, but the top is more tailored , Straight down. There is a pocket on the top, and no pocket on the pants.
The bottom of the pants hangs down and the hem is sewed on a machine and looks cheap.
The waist band is comfortable with a draw string.

title: Fit good ,comfortable, soft.
text:
I like these yoga, or lounge around the house pants. These are flowy.
The bottoms have a thick elastic that does not fit tight, fits loose. I have thin legs and ankles, but
I don’t think the ankles would be tight for anyone, they hang.
But the right leg on the pants is a bit smaller then the left! Although not tight, and I like the way it fits.
I’m sure nobody would notice it, except me, cause I’m wearing them.

These are comfortable and should be cool enough for the summer. It’s Not humid here. I live in Ca.
I got a Medium, 5’2, 130 lbs. I wear a size 8 or 10 in skinny jeans. the length is a bit below my ankle bone, and just right.
The waist could be a little bigger, not much give to the thick elastic. I like the pockets on both sides, and they lay flat.

title: Soft, comfortable, the waist is thick not much give!
text:
The material is soft and flowy, not thick, but these are tapered down a bit and I like that
The legs feel good, and do not fit tight or at the ankle cause I pull them up.
My legs are very slim, that I can put my fingers around my ankles.

I like the pockets on both sides.
The elastic around the waist is thick heavy with a draw string.

I’m 5’2, 130 lbs, I got the medium Size 8 - 10 that is the size I wear in skinny jeans.
That said the waist is a bit tight, without much give. I should have sized up for that reason.

title: Keeps perfect time, is not heavy, or clunky. Looks nice
text:
Keeps perfect time, is easy to read the time at a glance.

I got the white face, with dark blue metallic hands. The hands only show up blue when the light hits it, although I like it, and would get the metallic blue hands again.

This did not come with the tool to take out links. I Took this to a jeweler to have 4, or 5 links taken out. I have a small wrist.
This will fit a large or small wrist.
Does not feel heavy or clunky on my wrist.

I replaced this watch from a tank a 18k & stainless Cartier watch I wore everyday for years, but it never worked right, but it look good lol. Had it fix too many times from Cartier , and a watch repair.
At this time in my life, I’m so happy to have a watch I can depend on, with out having to look at my phone, and this watch is it, and it does look nice. Great price.
The date is small and hard to read, which I do not care about.

5 stars.

title: Comfortable , not see threw , nice for summer, exercising, hanging around the house.
text:
Love these for the summer.
These Capri pants are my summer go to pants. There comfortable And stay cool for summer.
Has 4 nice looking pockets. Two slash type pockets in the front side, that hold my iPhone , one on the butt,
And a small pocket on the front inside on the waist band.

I like the material , like a light weight cotton blend , a bit stretchy. Not see through. Do not fit baggy.
I do not feel confined wearing these like tight yoga pants. The bottom legs do not fit tight.
I’m 5’2, 129lbs. Size Medium. The length fits me above mid calf.

title: Look good but I feel thick seams on my legs!
text:
Wow, allot of pocket.
Two pockets on the side thigh legs, then two small on the outside waist band.
Only the larger leg pockets will fit my iPhone.

I ordered a Large, it fits ok, but the thick seams I do not care for, I feel them on the inside.
I’m 5’2, weight 129 lbs, I would usually wear a medium but I didn’t want to feel confined in these, and I do, but they feel like there slipping down, weird !
Good for yoga, walking, general exercising, hanging around the house.

You can put these in the washer, but I lay them on the dryer to dry.

title: Nicer then I expected , fabric thin, Not see threw. Hand wash.
text:
This outfit is nicer then I expected!
I Received this in black , a medium. I’m about 5’2, 129-130 lbs.,
and it fits me nice, not like PJs.
The top is much longer then I expected , but I think the top
From the pictures is loosely tucked into the pants like the new sloppy look is, which is ok with me. Or wear it out.
I would not sleep in this.
It is casual , and I would wear it for grocery shopping, Walking, hanging around the house,
Wear out for casual lunch, actually wear it anywhere,
Very comfortable.

I finally found in the website (don’t like that it’s hidden!) where it says the material is cotton, And polyester, but does Not say how much % each is!
As it says to hand wash in cold water, and lay out to dry!
Taking this out of the package, it had bad smell.

The material is thin, and will be nice for the summer. The legs
Run a bit big, especially below the knee, and the knit cuff at
The bottom is big. Comes to the top of my ankles, I have thin legs.
I did not find the top to come off the shoulder much,

Material is Not see through.
I Would have liked the sleeves being a little longer.

5 stars.

title: Keeps Hubby feet toasty for cold winter nights.
text:
Its been cold in the mountains in Ca.
My husband has been complaining that his wool sock are not keeping his feet
Warm at night laying around the house.
I got him one pair of these Warm soft , so comfortable socks that he now loves,
And went back to Amazon to buy more.
He doesn’t wear them in his boots cause there to thick for him.
There made well.
I put them in the front loader washer, and dryer, and they come out like new.

No complaints here.
5 stars

title: Fit good, feel the seams in these!
text:
These Yoga capris are well made.
I got the medium. I’m older, 5’2, 130 lbs.
They fit ok, but wearing sweats almost everyday as I’m
Mostly staying home cause of Covid I felt restricted in these, and can feel
The 3 thicker seams !
These look good on, but would a L have been more comfortable !
I’ll find out when yoga class starts again

I have not washed them yet, and tried them on for a short time.
I like that there shorter and I’ll will like them for the summer.

title: Cute for trendy teenagers, gold to shinny to be real.
text:
These two necklaces come in a nice gifting package together.
There to look like replicas of antique jewelry. Although Very light weight.
It says there 14k Plated.

I wear 14k and 18k, yellow and white gold (not altogether) and these do Not come close to the
Right color of gold, and there too shiny. I would not wear these with any real jewelry together.
The one that has the disc is a nice design , as is the shorter paper clip necklace.

These sizes and type of jewelry are popular right now and look good for casual wear.
I think these are cute for teenagers for everyday.

title: Made well, runs Small.
text:
Fruit of the loom has been around for a long time...
This runs Very small, and there is no way my husband can fit into it..
Thought i ordered a L, and recieved a M.

title: Heavy, hangy, runs big
text:
I received a M and this and it runs big.
The material is heavy , hangy , itchy and cheesy looking.

I’m not a fan of this top.

title: Nice thick at the bottom
text:
Nice quality socks.
Only received one pair!
These socks are warm, and nicely padded on the bottom , not as thick on the top.
The tops are short.
My husband likes to wear them around the house in cold weather.

Washed in my washing machine, and in the dryer , came out nice.
My hubby thinks there pricey.

title: Thick warm, not sweaty
text:
Nice warm socks .
These are thick all over and feel thicker in the whole bottom of the sock.
The inside is like a double layer of softness.
We live in the mountains in Ca. Where it’s cold.
My husband wears these around the house , and in heavy cold weather boots.

Put them in the washer and dryer, came out fine.
My husband feet do not sweat, and don’t with these socks either.

title: Size up, runs Small .
text:
Cute, and warm PJ, but I won’t be wearing them!
I ordered a medium, and they should fit me, but these run Small.
I’m a 8, 10 in jeans, and other Pjs , but these are also tight in the rear!
Never had that happen before.

I’m noticing that clothes from different countries can’t get the sizing
Right. They think we are heavy, or tiny, and some times just go by
S, M, L, and extra large. And there measurements are way off for
America.
Very disappointed needless to say, as this is the 4th idem
In clothes this week and last week that have been huge, and now
Too small.

That said, size up, and you will be happy with these.
Because the sizing is so off, I’m giving these only a 3 star. I was
Going to give a 2 star. These companies need to take notice!

title: Size down.
text:
Nice blouse.
I’m so disappointed that clothes from different
Countries never run the same size !
I ordered a medium, and it’s like a Large or Xtra large.
The sleeve are too long, and this is cut boxy.
I’m not tall but I have long slim arms, and long slim legs.
I’m 5’2, 129, 130 lbs, 36c, do not like a tight bra after my rib fracture after a accident,
I’m a older women.

Size down.

title: Love this comfortable blouse, soft , not see threw, runs true to size.
text:
This is now my favorite blouse.
The material is soft, very comfortable, light weight, and Not see threw.
Fits me perfect. I’m 5’2, 130 lbs, 36C. Size Medium. Older women.
This is not tight, it draped down nicely.
This is true to size, I would not size up.

Before wearing this blouse I put this in my front load washer on warm,
then the dryer, with dryer sheet,it come out perfect, Like new. Took it out of a hot dryer, No ironing.
I didn’t tuck this in, was not clingy.
I got the black. I want to order another blouse, but I don’t care for
The other patterns !
I thought the sleeves would be a little longer looking at the model, but still great.

title: Love these soft socks
text:
I had a pair of socks like this a few years ago, and now I was looking for
Them again.
I Love these socks.
These socks are easy to put on, and off, keep my feet warm , are SO Soft,
Keep from digging into to my thin ankles after my car accident
on my damaged legs, stay soft after washing, didn’t shrink.
I wear a size 7 shoes, and have thin feet, but these socks are stretchy. .

I can’t actually ask for more, but would like it if they where a little thicker!
I think there is 5 pairs of socks in this package. Great price
5 star.

title: Runs big, front at the buttons was puckered not sewed well.
text:
The material is very soft, not see threw, kind of clingy, and there is not any neck tags.

That said, when I took this shirt out if the bag the stitching where the bottom buttons in the front are,
Is gathered up, looked puckered. Not sewed good.
It looks like its too tight across the bust, and its not, and I had Not worn this yet!
I tried it on, and put it in the washer and dryer, it came out like it was new, and still had that pucker on the front.

The color green looks better when its not in a brighter light, it looks more olive..A brighter light its Bright, like
A different green color.

I got a medium, and I think this runs a little on the big side. Did not fit right, It was even big under the arms, but comfortable.
This shirt is nothing special, Ok with jeans. If I tuck it in a bit it looks big, if it hangs out its wrinkly, and clingy.
I’m a older women, Weight 129 lbs. 5’2. Bust 34-36 C. This was Not tight across the bust..I could have worn a small..

From what I see in the picture reviews, the other shirts do not have the pucker on the front that I recieved, and fit better.
But this is my honest review..

title: Runs boxy, and big under the arms, soft & comfortable.
text:
This is not what I would call a sweatshirt, or a blouse.
The material is soft like a tee shirt , but not as thin, and not
See threw.
This hangs loose, and runs big.
I received a Medium, and under the arms it is Big also.

The shoulder look , but when I put a light

I’m 5’2, 128 lb. 36C. Older woman .
Hope this helps.

title: Disappointed , baggy, big, did not shrink.
text:
So disappointed !
I didn’t expect these to be this baggy, and I’m a older women.

Which they didn’t.

And just long enough to come to the bottom of my ankle bone almost.
The material is like a cheesy polyester.
These will probably fit my husband!

That said since the Covid I’m home almost all of the time, and these pants
I can wear around the house.

title: Cute ,warm, one slipper is wider then the other! Where is Quality control?
text:
Cute warm slippers for a cozy winter.
Has a nice sole if you wear these outside to get the mail.
The slippers are cute, but more child like.

I live in the mountains and thought these are more rugged cutesy mountain
looking slippers, and would be warm. They are warm. Although not sure the
Lining will flatten , and The slipper will fit even Bigger.
Tried to walk in the house, and there flying off my feet!
That said these slippers are for wider feet, but
My left slipper is Allot wider then the right slipper!
And what is stranger is, I had a accident Recently (still recovering) and my
Left leg/foot now will always be bigger then my right , and still the left
Slipper is larger!!
These slippers are useless for me.

Where is quality control?
Giving a 2 star !

title: Could not get in my ears to hook it. One inch long
text:
I thought I would like these earrings for everyday cause the pearls are acrylic and I could wear them in the shower everyday without taking them off.
But it would be nice if I could get them on!

The picture shows a space in between the pearls, but mine did not have the space, Therefore nothing to even keep the earring from spinning around. and the hook is sharp and I could not work it to get them in my ears!
I do NOT have thick Ear lobes, and Never ever had a problem getting earring in my ears before.
I do not wear Heavy or big earrings, and the holes in my ears are small.

The pearls look pretty good as there not White-White, and being there in your ears you can get away with these although cheesy. Since the hook is sharp they came with little rubber stoppers covering the hooks.

Before ordering these It did not have any measurements , which to me is crazy since I do not wear large earrings, beside I would want to know how big and long earrings are. Also I would have liked smaller pearls, although there is not size!
These measure one inch. For me there bigger then I wanted them to be, but not large hoops.

They came in a black cardboard box , with the name printed in gold on the box.

Unfortunately since I can’t even get these in my ears there useless for me.
Going to try another few times to get these in my ears,
If I can and if it’s allot easier , I’ll be back for a UpDate.
My ears still hurt trying to get these in my ears and hooked.

title: Love this PJ set, runs big, washed and dried nice .
text:
Update—Still love these P.Js.,At first these fit BIG, after washing and put them in the dryer they fit perfect now, and still roomy.
The length now is a little above my ankles, as is the model, and I don’t have to keep pulling up the bottoms.
I woud suggest to buy a size larger then what you normally wear if you put them in the dryer.
———————-
I love this Very nice classic Pajama set.

This is very soft and comfortable PJ set for sleeping, and lounging around the house. It is not a heavy-weight.
On the collar, arm cuffs, and on the top of the leg cuffs, side pockets, chest pocket,and down the front there it is a well done small white piping, With elastic around the back of the pants.
Small white buttons down the front..looks very nice.

I’m 5’2, 130 lbs, wear a size 8 or 10. This size large is big on me, and long. I do have another pair of PJs from the same company that is 100% cotton in a medium, that runs alittle on the small side. But I do wear them..
So I figured this large should be more roomy...it is Allot more roomy, and is more for a taller women, but I’ll wear these.
PJs can always be a bigger maybe!! Actually one of my daughters is 5’9, slim but bigger then I’m and I think this set would fit her
Good.

These are made in India, and are Viscose, keep away from a flame it says.
It said wash in cold water, dry flat!
I washed these in my front loader washer in a zipper laundry bag on warm with other clothes, and after taking it out of the
Bag I put them in the dryer. They came out fine , barely wrinkled..

title: I love this PJ set..there a soft cotton, and the embroidery is lovely. NOT a cheesy set.
text:
The Annie embroidered Pajama set is Lovely, far nicer then I expected.

I had to try this romantic set on right away, and was Not disappointed.
The fabric is a fine 100% light cotton, that is more for cool weather. There is a fine thin white on white stripe in the material.
This is a classic style, with the round collar, and lapel, and small white buttons down the front.
The embroidery pattern of scallops on the bottom of the arms, and legs with feminine embroidered flowers, and a touch of
Embroidery on both sides of the top.

At first the top looked wide , but after putting it on it was good, but could have been a bit wider
I can move my arms, and the shoulders gave me ample room.
The bottoms only have elastic in the back, with a tie front.
The legs are roomy, and are flowy..I think the top part could be a little bigger.

I put the set in a mesh laundry bag, and washed them in warm water in my front loader, and took the
Set out of the bag, and put these in the dryer with nothing else in the dryer . These dried very fast.
I do Not think they shrunk .

This is a medium. I’m 5’2, 129 lbs. a older woman, they fit well, looked good, but I would buy a large.
I like my pajamas to be a little more roomy.
I’m not tall , but Not stocky, the legs came to the floor, but not where I would trip on them at all, and the sleeves came to my wrist.
I wear a size 8 or 10..
I hope this helped.

title: Good looking conservative tweed textured  black & White  jacket. True to size.
text:
This is a well made conservative jacket to wear with slacks, skirts, I wear this with skinny jeans, and boots.
Good for work, going to a play, a nice dinner. It is not the type of jacket to grab to go grocery shopping, although you can.
It’s not for a rainy or snowy days. Although it is not light weight, or cheesy looking.
The material is a black and white texture tweed, It has nice looking black lining.
Has two front pockets that are stiched. I’m not opening them, as it might start taking the shape away from the jacket over time.
The waist is taken in a little, and keeps the jacket from looking boxy.
The front has good looking bottons that look like a big pearl That looks like gray pewter buttons. Goes well with the jacket.

I wear a plain no collar shirt in black or red under the jacket, and do not button it.
I think the round neck could have been cut higher up! Not taking any stars off for that.

I wear a size 10, and this fits me pretty good except the sleeves are almost one inch too long. I push the sleeves up.
Just want to mention when you buy a jacket , remember to allow room for what your going to wear underneath.
Hopes this helps

title: Nice blue color, runs too  size, but  runs Long, no style straight sides, & slits.
text:

The trim around the neck and down the front , and arms is sewed on well. The neck line is cut ok for me. It does come

The dress fit nice in a medium and in the bust, and shoulders but was about 3 inch’s too long. It was draging on the floor, I was not wearing Shoes.
This is a casual dress to wear sandals with, its for the warmer weather. Not for dressy. Ok for BBQ. Beach.

The fabric is a blend, and is on the thin side, you can see through it if the light hits it, or your outside.
It feels like a thin crepe material, but was comfortable on.
I thought this would be good for the beach with a bathing suit underneath.
To me this is matronly looking. Its not a MooMoo but the same idea. Just straight down the sides, with the side slits.
And is not flattering. If it fit a little tighter maybe under the bust, or near the waist it would have more style!
I’ll shorten this, and wear it around the house, marketing, and at the beach.

I washed this in warm water in my front loader washer, and put it in the dryer with a dryer sheet.
Came out looking new, no wrinkles, perfect.

I’m giving this a 3 star. its ok, made well, too long, see through. Wear a short slip with this.

title: Love this bag, and that its hand made..holds allot of stuff.
text:
I wasn’t going to order this crossbody bag cause there usually too small for me, although I do not wear Large purses.
Needless to say this is a good size bag, and I’m surprised, very happy with this bag.

Has a Deep zipper pocket on the back, that lays flat. In the front there is a good size pocket, that the front closure flap comes over, and Has the good looking buckle that has a unseen magnetic closure in the corner.
The inside has two deep zipper pockets, with two open deep pockets, and the middle part is open .
I can put my mini ipad in this bag if I wanted to.
I could not ask for more.
The lining is a very soft type of very light green fabric.

The strap does adjust to make it shorter for a shoulder strap, but for me I would have to have more holes punched in.
The strap also adjusts to make it longer.
The hardware is a brownish looking color, that fits in with the color of the leather of the bag.

This bag is hand made in India, as with all hand made Leather its never perfect, but that is the charm of this bag.
Although I can’t found Anything wrong with this bag, and the leather is beautiful..

The only con I do have is the scent that I think is from some type of leather oil that they used..
My husband used Saddle soap on the bag, left it outside, and is putting on Montana Pitch-Blend leather dressing.
I hung the bag outside again, and the scent is getting better.
Now it has a sweet scent to it..

A cardigan is a type of a mans knitted sweater, that is consitered open cause it does not Have a collar, and has a V neck, but has buttons all the way down the front below the V.
And usually for a older man . In the 1970’s or before that time a cardigan sweater for men were popular.

The picture here looks good, but in person I’m not a fan.. my husband would not wear this.
We have a home in the mountains, and the beach. He is a casual california beach, and mountain guy, that wears casual clothes.
