That said, this is cute for the summer.

title: Looks better after washing and drying, Very comfortable, Love it.
text:
Didn’t know what to expect with this Tencel shirt!
But I LOVE it, it is So comfortable, and airy, besides looks good.

It does say to wash this before wearing it, as the dye can come off on you..I would never wear anything before washing it though.
I washed it in med cold water, with other clothes, and nothing from this came off, as I put in a white dish towel.
It came out of the dryer, looking better then when it went into the washer. and dryer, and still has a lite sheen.
It is so soft, So comfortable.
This shirt looks good with my tight leg jeans, and leggings.

Right now its summer in California, so its hot, but our evenings cool down. This is a nice shirt to put over a Tee on a
cool evening eating outside, or just hanging out .
Actually you can wear the shirt any place, hanging the shirt out, or tucking it in.

I’m so glad I got this shirt.
5 stars. I recommend this shirt you will not be sorry if you buy it..

title: Comfortable and cozy.
text:
I like this sweatshirt better then there Gray and Black large striped one, as that one runs small.
This is a Xlarge and fits a little big, but not sloppy.
The zipper works good, and the hood is large.

The arms are a little long.!
It says there Elastic , What?
There a regular knit cuffed sleeve.
I washed this, and put it in the dryer with a dryer sheet, come out very nice, and did not shrink.

Very comfortable, and cozy.

title: Nice gray and black wide stripes, size up..
text:
Nice looking sweatshirt with a gray and black wide stripes .
The zipper works good, and this did not shrink when I washed it and put it in dryer.
The material is like a regular sweatshirt, and the inside is cozy, with a nice size hood.

That said, I expected this to be much bigger since it is a XLarge, although the arms are long!
I’m 5’2, 130 lbs, and I can zip it up, but its fits a little tighter then I expected. as the black sweatshirt by this company is the same size and bigger.

title: This will hold a laptop Plus, and is good for traveling, flying etc.
text:
Not sure what I was expecting with this bag, as I thought it would be for a laptop! Although this has allot of space and pockets, and will hold a laptop plus.
The main top part unrolls from the top with a zipper, and its is big, with a zipper pocket inside,, and a divider in the middle, then on back side is another large zipper pocket, and the front has two snap closures with acouple more pockets, and a place for some pens..

This is good for a travel bag for a couple of days, or for me to travel with large bottle of shampoo, conditioner, hair brushes, hot irons,makeup, night clothes, tees..there is allot of room in this, allot more then I thought there was going to be.
You can use this to put over your shoulder, or has the top handle.
Good to use as a carry on for flying..

There is so many uses for this.
I still do not see a price here, which I do not understand at this point!

Not sure if you got this filled up, how heavy it would be, and if this could hold up to the load!

title: These fit my wide foot, are Comfortable, Well made..Love them
text:
My husbands loves these boots, and this is what he has to say about them.

The LANGBAO Men’s Hiking Boots Waterproof is an extremely well constructed pair of boots.
I have a foot that is measures a size 10eeee,to 10 1/2 eeee, and I’m a slim guy.
I have the worst time finding boots that run that wide.
My wife found these on Amazon in a size 11 and got them for me. I was skeptical about them not being wide enough, and that they would be to long!
I was Wrong on both. I have worn them for a long periods of time and my feet have not yet to fall asleep, and the length is just fine.

As for the construction of the Boots . It is basically waterproof, with the ability to breath.
The leather is a good grade, and has held up very well.
My feet do not perspire. They are made with a rubber piece in the front to protect your feet when perhaps you kick a rock.
The ankles height gives fine support without restricting movement.
I’am Very Happy with these boots for more reasons other then they are wide enough.
They are Very Comfortable.

If I could give more the 5 stars I would..

title: Perfect for my crystal collection, soft material, and can be adjusted.
text:
Just what I was expecting.
I collect small crystals etc. for meditation , and sometimes wire wrap them for pendants.
This is perfect. The top is a clear see threw, the inside has a soft gray material.
The dividers can come apart to make bigger spaces.
There is a latch on the front to keep it closed.

This is also a nice box for costume jewelry, as there is not a secure lock, and someone can walk away with this.
Although nice for an enclosed show case.

Good price.

title: Well made, nice sweatshirt .Wear a size 10, & this was tight!!
text:
XL.
Nice warm, cozy pull over sweatshirt with large hood.
This is made well.
The cord for the hood is thick and should not come out.
The arms where long, and fit good.

I wear a size 10, and this was tight on me!
I see where it fits people here that seem larger then me, so I’m not sure if I got the right size of a EXtra Large!

title: Big, and is plasticy!
text:
This is big, and large enough to hold Heavy items.
Has a few different compartments to put papers in etc.

That said, this looks ,and feels like cheesy plastic.
I would not put anything in this that cost allot of money, and could break.
All the zippers work good.

title: Good looking, comfortable, washed in warm water, dryer for 3 mins, hung to dry, perfect.
text:
What a great looking shirt jacket in a good beige color.
XIXVON Shirt is made well, All buttons are sewed down good..Has a pocket on the sleeve, two big pockets inside , and two side pockets outside, with
two pocket on chest that has a flap and buttons ..Has large black buttons for the tabs on the side, and down the front etc. The sleeves have tabs with a button, you can roll the sleeves one time also.
I do not think you will be disappointed with this shirt jacket.

This is 100% Cotton..
I washed this in warm water with other clothes, then put it in the hot dryer by its self with a dryer sheet for less then Five Minutes , maybe 3 mins.
Took it out of the dryer, pull the pocket flaps and collar into place, hung it up on a big wooden hanger to dry. When it dried this had that good looking not perfect look.
I do NOT Iron. If I had to iron it goes to the cleaners.
Even the leather loco still looked good.

My husband tried this on before I washed it..This shirt/jacket did NOT Shrink , and my Husband loves it, and it is very comfortable.
This is a large. My husband is about 5’9, 150 lbs, fits him nice, not tight. The jacket does not taper in the middle, just hangs straight down

Nice for cool nights, with or without a shirt underneath..We live in the mountains in California, and this shirt will get allot of wear.

I recommend this shirt jacket..
5 stars.

title: Comfortable,  can’t see threw.
text:
Comfortable yoga pants, with two side flat pockets.
You can Not see threw these pants.
I’m 5’2, 132 lbs, these came above my ankle bone, and are a high rise that gives you a flatter tummy.

These pants are good for yoga, or walking, or wear a long sweater , or shirt with them.

title: Fits good, comfortable, has small pocket.
text:
Nice comfortable board shorts.
The size 32 waist is right on, these fit my husband perfect, although These board shorts are not as long as his other ones,
the material is not as thick. And his other board shorts fit more baggy. He is about 5’9. 150 lbs..
The pattern looks good with the black background, and green looking Hawaiin leaves.
There is not any lining, has a Velcro closer in the front, and waist, with a draw string.
On one side of the leg is a small pocket with a flap and Velcro to close it. My husbands iphone 6+ (think thats what he has) fits in ,
But too tall for the pocket to close, but he can still keep his phone there. He can keep keys in the pocket, without his cell.

If your going swimming don’t put anything in the pocket.

title: Becoming my husband’s favorite, very comfortable.
text:
Very comfortable, and soft.
The padded heel and toes are in the right place, and give a good cushion feeling, and No rubbing.
My husband is a walker and these socks are becoming his favorite.
The back of the socks are a bit higher, but the socks do Not pull down in his shoes.

5 stars

title: Flattering bathing suit, crazy design..
text:
I was a little taken back by this bright sunset orange color, and Hawaii black big palm trees beach design all over. Its not the white
Back round it shows here.
I could see this design more on board shorts! The sleeves are black, as is the neck , and zipper.
The cups are sewn in, and one side has a big indentation in the cup, other side is ok.
You do not have to have this all the way unzipped, as the zipper locks in place good higher up.

I Can’t imagine what kind of tan or sunburn you would get from this bathing suit that comes up to the neck and has sleeves!
I live in California at the beach. I realize the sun all the time on our skin is not our friend, but this is strange.

I wear a size 10, and I’m 5’2. I think a medium instead of a large might of fit me better, but this L I can wear. The back was a bit big, or for a taller person. The tush looks cute.
This does NOT come up real high on the sides to almost your waist, and it is a flattering bathing suit.

title: Nice looking, very shinny, lite weight, nice dangle, will Not  pull ear down .
text:
These earring are nicer then I expected.
They look like sterling, but there not. They very light weight do not pull your ear down , and the wires are thin and go into the ear easy.
There very shinny, aren’t too long, and not cheesy looking.

Do NOT get hair spray, or spray perfume etc. on these as it says. I’m guessing, take these out when washing your hair also etc.
Not sure how long there going to last, as they do bend...but be careful, and these should last a good amount of time.
Don’t forget There costume jewelry.
My daughter likes these, and will be wearing them...

title: Not pink. Its a light beige with a hint of pink. Not a pretty color.
text:
Was excited to get this womens pink vizier hat.
The hat is ok, but the color was very disappointing.
It is not the pink that is shown, it is a light dull beige with a pink tinge.
Not was I was expecting.

The cap part is a thin nylon type of material, that I hope will keep the sun off my head, and the material lays flat.
I’ll wear the hat , but not often.

title: Run small, stretchy.
text:
I took my chance ordering these pants, as it did Not say the size, big mistake!
I wear a size 8 or 10.
These pants are a size 3 or maybe 5, and are stretchy. .
I have very skinny ankles, that I can put my fingers around, even though these are skinny jeans, that I do wear,
The legs are tight.,
My daughter is 5’9, wears a 5, and these pants fit her a bit tight!

The material seems nice but on the thin side.
I would say, size up.

title: Kids dino hat is too cute.
text:
I Don’t know if this could be any cuter. So darn cute
When you look at this dino kid bucket hat you see the dino, with smiley teeth, anf Big eyes, and spikies out the side.
Can be washed but I didn’t put it in the dryer, lay it on top.

My 5 yo grandson is proud to wear this hat. He knows he looks cute.
That said, this hat runs small..

title: Awesome outdoorsy river shoes, camping, hiking etc.
text:
These are great outdoor shoes for water sports, camping, fishing, hiking as the rubber soles cling to boulders, and the ground etc.
The material is tough, and the rubber soles go up the sides..

That said there too long for my husband. The rest of the shoe fits great, as it stretches to your feet, and is comfortable.
The good newes for us is, these fit one of our boys. He is outdoorsy . We live near in the mountains near Yosemite National Park, and now these are his new go too shoes..Also good for the rain.

title: Nice looking, well made, bill is longer.
text:
This is a nice well made trucker hat.
The bill seems longer then other trucker hats. The material is thick, and if your out in the sun this will
Protect your eyes, and head.
Has a inside band around the hat...the back of the hat has a material band to tighten or make it looser.
The front of the hat is Not soft, it has a stiff type of material, that keeps the hat from folding up.
Has a few vents to keep air flowing.

Fits my husbands head, but he prefers the softer hats

title: This hat will keep the sun off your head, it’s a thick material, stiff bill.
text:
Nice gray color trucker hat.
The band in the back is material, and Velcro's..Very nice.
There is a few little air holes in this hat to keep the head cooler..The bill of the hat is stiff.

I’m not sure what the difference is between a Trucker hat, and a baseball hat!?
This hat is a thicker material, and the hat is not soft.
My husband likes the softer ball hats, with a longer bill that can be pulled in on the sides.
This hat just didn’t do it for my husband.
But my Son likes this hat, and will be wearing it.
The Hat does Not have any Loco on the front , which is a plus in my family.
The hat is sewn well.

title: Cotton is not real soft, Son wears a 32 jeans these fit good.
text:
Size medium.

Fruit of the Loom has been around forever it seems. Although allot has changed over the years.

My husband would not wear these, he wears low rise underwear.
These fit with the longer legs, and my two boys wear this type.
One of the boys tried them on, and won’t wear these, there not comfortable. The cotton is not soft.( he wears designer silk briefs).
The other boy is slimmer, and wears a 32 in jeans, and likes these. Although Both wear a medium in briefs, the older one is
Bigger and wears a size 33 to 34 in jeans. That said my husband wears a 32 in jeans. These did fit him, but he
Doesn’t like this type of briefs!
Gave sizes to give a idea if they will fit others.

There is 7 briefs in the package, in gray, and black, and if you like these , there great for the price.
They seemed to shrink when I took them out of the dryer..I used dryer sheets, and still not real soft, but these do hold
You inn where it’s impotant at my son said. .There is No tags which is a plus. The waist band is comfortable. Sewed well.

title: Very good looking, comfortable,Great Red color..
text:
Great color of True Red..
Cute shoes in a suede looking fabric.
The cut of the shoes looks good. The inside of the shoes is padded, although I don’t think it’s in leather?
The heel was higher then I expected it to be, but not real high.The ankle straps are a copy of a up-scale shoes.

That said these shoes fit my daughter, but they run a bit big..I wear a slim, and there is no way these shoes could fit me.

title: Not big, Not heavy, did Not hurt my ears. Not child size.
text:
Cute, not big earrings, and Not heavy on my ears.
The filligree looks nice. The gold color on these is a little bright!

I do not wear heavy or big earrings, and I wear 14k, 18k, or sterling. Got these for my daughter.
I wore these for two days, and they Never bothered my ears, and I forgot they where in my ears, that is
How Comfortable they are.
One of my daughters wears these types of earrings and Loves them, also does not hurt her ears either.
These are Not child size earrings, there for a adult.

The earrings can be worn with long or short hair, casual.
They click together in the back. Actually I didn’t hear the click, but they stayed together.
There a copy of 14k pair of earrings, although if these where 14k they would be more delicate, and look finer.
These look heavier then what they are.

For costume jewelry, I’m giving these a 4 star.

title: Nice embroidery, runs small,  yellow gold as picture shows,
text:
Cute Boho blouse.
The embroidery is done well .
This is a size Medium , and I do wear a Medium or sometimes a large. This is like a size small to me.
I have thin arms, and this was not comfortable, and the sleeves are shorter then what shows on the model.
The V at the top came down low, and it was blousey in the middle, but Not roomy across the back shoulders.
The length was ok, and fit around me.

At this point, I think a extra large would have fit me!

title: Has allot of zippers, and is roomy. Not a fan of this faux leather.
text:
This purse is a nice color of Turquoise if you like that color.
The purse holds more inside then I expected.
There is a zipper on the front with a big tassel , and a snap large pocket.
On the back is another zipper pocket that is roomy, with a zipper pull.
Inside is another pocket zipper , and to large open pockets.
The middle of the inside is roomy.

On the bottom there is Not any little tabs for the purse to sit on.
Strap is long.
The hardware , zipers are in a gold color.

This is faux leather, to me, like a cheesy faux, that smells, although I think that scent will go away after it’s used..
The faux leather has a texture to it..
I’m Not a fan of this plastic look..but no animals where killed making this purse.

title: Cute, comfortable, size down.
text:
This top is cute, with a sewed in knot. You do not tie this.

I’m older and like that the sleeves are 3/4 length.
I’m 5’2, 132 lbs..The large I can wear, but if this was a medium, it would have fit much better/nicer.
The shoulders fit right, but under the arms its big, and Could have fit a little tighter through the
Body of the shirt. I know this is suppose to be lose fitting, but it is a little too blousey.
I would suggest to size down.

The fabric is the typical polyester type from china, not expensive...This is sewed well.

title: Look good for sparkly shoes, runs Big.
text:
These black dress shoes are sparkly, look nice.
If your looking for heels to go clubbing, or for dress, these could be your shoes. ( I don’t go cloubbing).
Came in a shoe box that is recyclable with each shoe in a type of soft bag.
The heel and arch of the shoes is lightly padded.
The shoes are heavy, not sure because it has a thick heels, or what! The ankle strap goes threw a black
Sparkly loop on the back of the shoe.

I wear a size 7, and not any bigger then a size 7. These are more of a size 8 for me.
The front of the shoes was ok, but the back part with the strap that goes around your ankle
was huge/ wide for me, And the shoes are too long! The heels are high.
All around the shoes are too big for me.
That said, I have a narrow foot, with small ankles, slim legs.

Do not know what these shoes are going to sell for, but I don’t think there going to be expensive!

title: Very comfortable , No Tag,  runs big.Better big, then too small.
text:
Nice soft sports shirt.
This shirt reminds me of a golf shirt cause of the material. My son said its Very comfortable. Great for the summer.
I Washed, and dried this , it came out of the dryer without wrinkles.
There is No tag in the back of the shirt which is what every shirt should not have, is the tag..
The color is made well, and the buttons are sewed in good.

I’m not a fan of this type of material, but my son loves it, as it is very soft.
This is a X large, and runs big, although he certainly can wear this shirt, and does.

title: Soft and comfortable. Good for the gym.
text:
There is some good points to this shirt.
There is NO tags to drive my husband crasy at his neck, as when he cuts tags out he has been known to put holes in his new shirts!
It’s a Moisture wicking shirt, and feels soft.

That said it’s not cotton, it is some type of synthetic material that is kind of clingy, and strange!
This is a large, and runs long, and a bit big.
Although My husband likes it, it looks cheesy to me.
He Said this is good for the gym, and around the house.
It’s not a going out to dinner type of shirt.

title: Very comfortable, not slippery in the river on boulders. Jet sking etc.
text:
My husband loves these Seabone river shoes to his surprise.
He wears a size 10 to 11 shoe , and has a wide foot, these fit him great. Our boys wear a size 12, or bigger and these fit them great also( but there not getting them).

The inside top part is very soft, and stretchy for his wide foot.yet fit snug for the river. The inside has a solid insert.
Very well made for a water sport shoe, and The sole has allot of grooves for walking on boulders in the river, the shoes are not slippery.
The soles are colorful, as is the shoes, but not gaudy., and the main color is black.

There so comfortable with the thick rubber sole hubby even worn them to get the mail.

We live on a river in California, with big boulders in the river, and all over. Also have a beach place. He gave these shoes a good work out, and these have held up good.
My husband has No complaint about These water sport shoes. They protect his feet, and dry fairly fast. Wearing them at the beach, he walks on the hot sand without Burning his feet, or getting them cut in the ocean, or getting bit from jelly fish.
Protected his feet when jet sking.
Worked out well for camping, and Fishing etc.
5 stars, and will be buying these for our boys, and daughter.

title: Love’em, Super Comfortable for the summer..
text:
These blue Chill crop pants are Super Comfortable, and feel good to wear.
The bottoms have a knit binding, just hang down on me med calf, and do not fit as the model shows. I like the way they look on me better then pulling them up. I have slim legs..
These are a large, I wear a size 10, or 8, 5’2, 133 lbs. I would get the L again.

There is a nice thick draw string cord that I tied A knot in the ends of the cord so it would not slip back in the waist holes, or come out when I washed these pants.

These feel like regular sweat pants material to me, Not cheesy ones. There Nice and soft that you want to come home from work and put something comfortable on, these are it.
Although I would wear these to the grocery store, gardening, walking, casual shopping, gym, laying around the house, any place I think is casual, and I want to be comfortable.

Has pockets on both sides, but not that big. My iphone would probably fall out going for a walk, unless I kept kept feeling
For it..if I was running the phone would fall out.

I washed , and put them in the dryer with a dryer sheet, came out like new.
I’ll be buying another pair of these when they come up for sale..

title: Warm cozy jacket, SIZE Down.
text:
Size Large.

Such a soft cuddly warm jacket, with a HUGE Hood.
The color is a soft pink.
Has large snaps down the front, you do not see.
The bottom of the jacket does not cover your tush, I wish it was a little longer.
Has two side pockets.

I’m 5’2, 133 lbs. I wear a size 10.
When I wear a jacket Its winter, and I have winter clothes underneath, and wear a Large, but this size large is Huge..it is more of a Extra large, Or even a 1X.!
The hood is Very large also, but you can turn the front over when it’s on, looks cute.
The shoulders fall too long over my shoulders. The sleeves are Not too long

One of my daughters is taller, heavier, and big busted , this jacket fit her, but still a little big.
Size down.

The lining is a slippery 100% polyester
Shell is 100% polyester.
Dry clean Only.
Made in china (of course)

title: Good looking, keeps head- ears warm, comfortable.
text:
Nice warm cozy Trailside knit hat.
This is made well, and isn’t comfortable, is Not itchy.

Live in the mountains in California, it’s still getting chilly at night, and expecting more rain and cold in April here.
This hat keeps my hubbys head, and ears warm ( he doesn’t have much hair).
My husband has a few of these knit hats, and he loves this Trailside hat .

title: Comfortable, all around shorts, mesh linning.
text:
The Trailside swim-shorts are a thin polyester, but not see threw, lite weight, that have a mesh lining, velcro to keep the front closed, with. 4 holes at the waist for the string tie.

My husband is about 5’9, and slim. 146lbs. (Was sick). The size 32 waist fits him good, and so do the legs. His legs are slim also and these are not baggy shorts, The legs come to His knees, as the picture shows.. The shorts are not short, there more of a board short,but not baggy, and not a cool pattern as most board shorts are.
The waist band does not have much stretch.
There is a covered pocket on the back.

These shorts can be worn for sleeping, swiming, walking, laying around, there versatile for hot weather, and comfortable.

Btw, I’m surprised by some people saying these shorts run big. The ones I got do Not run big, there kind of skimping made!

title: Feels like a crepe material, colors are vivid, very nice.
text:
I was on the fence about ordering this type of Kimono, but so glad I did.
With all the colors etc, this is different, and fun to wear.

Great for the summer over a bathing suit, over a sundress, tee with jeans, shorts, shopping, beach, ,etc.
It’s not long. The front is a little longer then the back. The back comes to the middle of my tush, and the front comes to
About the top of my thighs.
Front is open, but comes together.

I love the colors. This is so cheery but I would not call the background a pink!
It a goldy, pinkish color to me, not bright. I think if it was bright it would diminish the beautiful colors of the flower print.
Other then that the colors are vivid, and pretty.

It has like a wide Mandarin collar that goes all the way around and down the front to the bottom. It gives this a frame to the
Kimono, and it’s not sloppy.

I wear a size 8 or 10, I’m 5’2 if this gives you some idea of size. There is no seam for shoulders, so I think it would fit most.
The sleeves are big/ wide. One of My daughters is almost 5’7, and big busted, this fit her very good also.

This is a Polyester blend. I would Not call this a seersucker or chiffon as its Not flowy like Chiffon is to me.
This feels and looks like a crepe type of material, and does not slide off Your shoulders, or around...

Truthfully I would Prefer a more silky feel to this Kimomo, as it would feel softer against my skin.
That said I’m happy to add this to my summer wordrobe.

(Dont cook with those huge sleeve’s)

title: Good size does not pull ear down, gives alittle sparkel.
text:
Nicer looking then what I expected.

Are very comfortable l

title: Was not sewed good, had a two inch hole.

title: Junior size. Like it..Not cheesy looking.

this is great for the summer.

Fits my husband good, and gives him room to move around wearing this size Large.

title: Nice looking, snug on the bottom.
text:
Nice looking sweater XL. I think it looks better in person.

title: Nice looking casual white shirt.
text:
Nice looking casual white shirt with small button down collar.
I do not know how slim the model is here that is 6’2, and wears a Small !!
My husband was in the hospital for a month, now home and weights 142 lbs, 5’9. and the large is too small for him.
Although he does not like his shirts tight..
My husband said the XL he would wear. He felt the L is too restricting, and the sleeves where not long enough..Although he would probably roll the sleeves up a bit.

That said, this is a nice shirt, but I do not think its for dress. Casual for the summer or spring, with shorts, jeans to let the shirt hang out, as it shown here.
The material is not heavy.

This shirt fits One of my sons who does wear a Large, but he does Not have broad shoulders, and he is very happy to get this shirt.

title: Do not care for the pattern. Made well.
text:
Sterling earrings.
These earrings are larger then one inch hoops.
They have the bar closure that works good, and seem well made.

The pattern on the hoops looks cheesy to me, and I’m not fan of these earrings because of the pattern.
My daughters will probably wear these.

Do not know what these are going to sell for!

title: Too big, not classy looking!
text:
The earrings came a nice box..There Sterling silver with a coating so they not tarnished. A plus.
The closure bar is too big, and for me the earrings are also.
The pearl is big, and the earrings including the pearl are not Dainty and classy looking. .But I to not wear big earrings.

title: Look nice, has a crystal band in the middle looks good, not fake! Not real big
text:
Good looking earring to my surprise! Cause I’m picky.

I wear small light weight earrings, but not tiny. Shows a good presents to them.These are comfortable, not real heavy. Although a little heavier then I usually wear.
The front rim in the middle of the earrings has tiny crystals going all the way around, like an Eternity band, that I didn’t notice when I ordered these. There very sparkly.
Hope they do not Start to fall out!
Earrings are shinny, and filigree is cut nice, no sharp edges.
Has a bar closure in the back, snapped in tight, these should not fall out of your ears
I have been wearing them for a few days, in the shower , and sleeping. No problem

title: Soooo Soft, No tags in neck of shirt.

Don’t know why this says its for a Girl!

Put it in the washer and dryer looks like new.

5 stars

title: Cute, Small fit my 5’9 daughter, covers tush,
text:
Very cute Bikini, and the red is a real red, not a light tomato color.

title: Airy comfortable, long , color is soft.
text:
Nice long floating soft scarf. Its a light see threw.
The print is lovely and a soft green / blueish color. Almost a sea green..

This scarf is long that it can be wrapped around you in many ways.
The edges are sewed nice.
Good price for this scarf.

title: Like a Levi jacket. Although Its lined. Comfortable.No labels saying to wash, or dry clean etc?
text:
Very nice heavy corduroy mens lined jacket. Well made.
This sorta looks like a levi jacket, its that type. Its Boxy, tapers a little at the waist.
Two chest pockets with snaps. No inside pockets
The bottons down the front on plain silver color metal, that are punched in, not sewed which is better.
Sleeves have the same buttons .

My husband can wear a large or XL. The shoulders fit a little over his shoulders but fits good, and looks good,
My husband does not like tight jackets, or shirts.. He can move his arms and shoulders around , this is comfortable.
My older son wears a XL, and this fits him better then my husband, and is comfortable for him also. If this was a large it
Would be more my husband size I think!
My husband is 5’9, slim, my son is 5’11, to 6 ft, about 165, 170 lbs. wears in jeans 33, 34 waist.Just to give you a idea on sizeing for the jacket.
I would say this is true to size

There is Not a label anywear on the jacket, No info on the lining, No information on washing or cleaning the jacket.
It does say the corduroy is 100% cotton, but the lining I know is not?
Being this is a navy blue, When I wash this, I’m guessing the color is going to run. Washing it by its self, and wondering how
Much its going to shrink?
The jacket has a scent to it , that says Wash Me. That said, I wash everything new before we wear it.

Giving this a 4 star for no instructions, no label, and avoiding anything about the lining!

title: Light weight, comfortable, do not like the goldish color lense.
text:
Nice to have a light weight pair of sunglasses, that do not slide down my nose, or my husbands.
I and my husband do not have big heads, but these Olieye sunglasses fit both of us!
Very unusual for me, as most store bought sunglasses are always too big , wide for me.

At first I thought these sunglasses where cheesy cause of being light weight, and the arms are flexible. But they look good with
The square frames, and are very comfortable to wear.
There is not any wavyness looking through these.

I do have one problem with the color of the lenses. There a goldish color to look threw.
I live in the mountains in Ca. And have a beach place in Ca.
The color of the lense is goldish, which makes the green trees look dull, Not looking so green, and the same with the ocean!
For me its a false color, but these do protect our eyes.

4 stars

title: Husband likes this, Runs Big, pocket had two holes!
text:
Good looking Buffalo Dickics jacket.

It is a subtle olive beige type of green, and black buffalo checkered plaid. Looks good.
The inside is a black satin quilted linning, that my husband said kept him warm. Front buttons up.
This is not a heavey jacket, but warm, and cozy. I live in California which is usually not freezing here.
This is a jacket that will be worn allot for a winter that is not too cold, and for the evening for spring. It is comfortable, and not
Heavy. Just grab, and go.
Has two botton down chest pockets, and one pocket has the Dickies patch logo sewed on. Also has two side pocket to keep your hands warm .
The outside of the jacket is a thicker type of soft flannel polyester material, but looks good.

My husband can wear a X-large, or Large. This jacket is a size large, boxy jacket, and the shoulders hang down off his shoulders!
He also had a warm flannel shirt under this jacket.
I would say Size DOWN.
It was even a little big for my son that always wears a Xlarge jacket, shirt etc.
Although, better a jacket is too big, then too tight.

The Con I have about this jacket is, there is Two holes in the lining of one of the pockets, due to who
Ever sewed this jacket did a terrible job Not sewing the pocket together in two places!

I’m only taking off one star for the pocket, but should take off two...
Where is Quality. control for a popular brand?

title: Excellent padded socks, , Very Comfortable.
text:
The Toes&Feet ankle socks are Awesome.

One of my sons is a Chef, runs the kitchen. He stands all day, and many nights plus is moving around in hot kitchen.
These socks are Padded thick on the heels, and toes, which makes them Very Comfortable, plus thick socks.
Being there Antibacterial, absorbing , and do not get stinking is a Real Plus.
He wears a size 12 shoes, and these fit him well. There made well.
Btw he has a few pairs of theses socks. They wash and dry great.

There is One pair in this package.

title: Very cute, well made ballet socks with strong grippers.
text:
Nicely package with out any instructions how to put these on, as there a bit different.
When you unwrap these there is two pairs in each other together.

These are very cute, and I must admit I have bever seen these types before. They give the look of a Ballet slipper.
There is soft grippers on the bottom, for yoga, or to just wear these around the house to keep from slipping, or keep your feet warm!

When I go to a small class of about 15 people for yoga, everyone is bare foot on there yoga mats.
Wearing these slippers does not let my feet glide on my mat as the non-slip grips make it a little difficult for me.

I have very slim feet and wear size 6 to seven shoes. These fit good with extra room, they stretch, but the part across the top
Feels a bit tight! Maybe I have a higher arch!

title: Its large, nice cover up.

title: Small-thin, sterling, tiny but clear Diamonds .
text:
Cute thin bracelet, and light weight.
This is sterling silver, and looks like it won’t tarnish.
The wire is bendable but stays in place, which is great for my small wrist.
I have it bent on my wrist where the arrow, and feather are next to each other,but a 1/4 inch apart, and it looks good.
The diamonds on this are really Tiny. There is not any diamonds in the feather part, only in the arrow.

Do not know what this sells for?
Can be for a child or an adult.
Casual wear with jeans etc.

title: Very nice, well made, but chain is To Long & its silly looking.
text:
I was surprised how nice this Lotus necklace is.
The diamonds are sparkly and are not dull..

The Lotus is done nice with the fine chain connected on both sides of the Lotus flower.
It said it was a rope chain, It is Not a rope chain, which I would prefer it not to be a rope.
The chain is very fine, with a silly long extender

It is gold over sterling. The gold is on the side of looking like costume jewelry, but I used a old soft tooth brush, with
Simple green cleaner deluded with water, and it toned the gold color down to look more real.

That said, the chain is ridiculously too long for such a small pendant, beside then it looks very out of date.
This type of pendent should come to your throat. Probably the chain should be 15 1/2 inches to maybe 16 inches.
Because of this terrible mistake, I’m giving this 3 stars.
My jeweler would charge to shorten both sides, more then this is worth. And to me I cannot wear it.

title: Ok briefs,
text:

3 stars

title: Classy earring, not gaudy, very comfortable , lite weight.
text:
I was surprised how nice and classy these earrings are.
I have always worn smaller lever back earrings as there comfortable, but these are posts and comfortable also.
These earring are not for a small child. A teenager yes. They have a nice easy looking dangle, Not gaudy.

I wear 14k, 18k yellow or white gold earrings, also wear some sterling.These are a white gold over sterling. shinny , and look like white gold. There marked sterling silver.
Look good with jeans, or more dressy.
Very light weight, with a post backing that has notches and stays in place. The post should not come out till you take the earrings off.
The ascent diamonds are tiny at the bottom with a little sparkle. They do not look dull.

Lead free, Cadmium free, Nickel free, and Hyppaleigenic.

Do not know what the price is going to be on the earring, but I would buy these for the right price!

title: Look pretty good, theses errings are : Nickel Free, and cadmium, Lead, and Hypoallergenic Free.
text:
I like small dangle earrings, and these work for me. My hair ia almost to my shoulders, and these show up depending how
My hair moves around.
I took a chance on the Aria earrings, and I’m surprised the Aria earrings were nicer then I expected.
The diamonds are very small, and there Not CZs, but the diamonds on the lever back give off a little sparkle. On the starburst at first I didn’t know There was a Diamond in the middle, but its there.

I would have liked the front of earrings better if there was Not so much texture in the starburst. The back is smooth and shinny.

The picture shows the starburst is white gold. The earrings I received are all yellow gold including the starburst.
Where the diamonds are , there set in a white gold that looks nice.

It says there sterling, with 14k yellow gold over the sterling.
The yellow gold did not look real to me, as there Too gold like costume jewelry looks like.
I took the earrings and a soft old tooth brush, and cleaned the earrings using Simple Green watered down a little, then rinced.
This took the color of the bright yellow gold down a bit, and does not give such a costume jewelry look.

The earrings are, Nickel free, Lead free, Cadmium free, and hypoallergenic free.
I have not worn these earrings for long, but they do not bother my ears.

When you put them on, make sure the lever back closes over the back part.
One of my earrings snap in place, one does not..( where is Quality control!).

I have never warn earring with this type of gold over. I wear yellow 14k or 18k gold, or white 14k gold, and also sterling earrings .
This should be interesting for me to see if the gold comes off. If they do, then I have sterling silver earrings.

I do not know what these are going to sell for!
4 star for the type of earrings these are.

title: Well made, comfortable.

title: Love this floppy straw hat. Made well, So many uses.
text:
I opened the box, and there is this great looking hat that has a large floppy brim, with a nice looking large black embroidered handwriting on the brim that says, “Hello Sunshine”.
There is a black band around the hat that gives it a finished look.
Its a feel good hat, made well, and can be folded for traveling.
The texture looks like what a straw hats look like, and The beige sand color.

I live on a river in the mountains, and have a beach place.
This hat will be perfect for the river, gardening, walking, traveling, camping, and the beach to keep the sun off my face, and hair, and the reflection from the river off my face.

There is not anything I dislike about this hat, and I’m not a hat person!
I don’t think I look good in hats. My husband and daughter thought I looked good in this hat, but she wanted the hat!
I’m not ready to give my daughter this cute hat yet. Going to enjoy it for the spring and summer.

5 stars.

title: Very Comfortable, no stinky feet.

Very comfortable socks.

Very comfortable.

No stinky feet..

title: Comfortable, feels soft..Hubby loves it

Large.

Fits smooth, but not tight.
My husband is about 5’9, 150lbs. and has another Cashmeren sweaters in a size medium, it does fit, but the large fits

title: Love this top. Not sloppy but roomy, Comfortable

This is like a sweatshirt material, but not super heavy with a warm soft inside, and feels good.
Its not stretchy.
Well made.

One of my daughters is 5’9 allot slimmer then me, and this fits her good also..Although its shorter on her, but is not tight,
I’m 5’2, 132 lbs.. I Wear a size 10. Depending on how a top runs, I can wear a Medium, to a large.

I would buy this .
5 stars.

title: Nice, not very long,  Size Up.
text:

title: Pants are comfortable, washed great.

My husband and kids never have a problem with Goodthread clothes. There made well, and wear well.
These pants fit as expected for my son for work.
True to size. 34, 32.

title: Very  Comfortable, size up.
text:
Size Medium.

Has a wide elastic waist band.
There are side pockets that zip up, and zippers at the bottom on the outside of both legs for easy on and off.
My husband just lost allot of weight due to a illness, he is very slim now,( but gaining weight back) he use to wear a 32-32, although he still does wear a 32 waist for comfort.
These soccer pants fit him, if he was a true 32 he would have to size Up for the pants to be more comfortable.
They also run slim in the legs which is good when you play sports.

Pants are great not only for soccer, but jogging, walking, laying around the house etc.
Had no problem Washing, and drying using a dryer sheet.

title: Fits good, not real thick, good for the summer.

The material is thinner then jeans, and is cooler for the summer.

Fits good in the tush.

title: Fleece lined, soft, and warm.
text:
My family Love’s these ,Page One , fleece lined , cable knit hats. There warm and cozy. Fits everyone.
Also washes great, and lay on the dryer to dry.

This one is the only one I have that was advertised for a child, but now says for a women! It does stretch, but
The tall 5 yr. old Loves this hat also, and it fits her with her long hair.
We have been getting more snow here in California then usual, and this hat has been keeping her head and ears warm.
She’s not giving it up, and even wears it in the house also.
The faux fur on the top is too cute.

title: Made well, neckline is too wide!
text:
The sweater is ribbed, and put together very nice.

I find this a bit itchy, and a real 100% cashmere sweater should not feel itchy, although the sweater feels soft.
This sweater is a beige, camel color, very nice.

What I do not like is the wide neckline. It’s spread too far apart for me, and if I move the wrong way my bra strap will show.

title: Nice socks, but two pairs have been repaired!
text:
The Soxart socks come in a very nice gift box , good looking with the socks neatly folded each pair separate.
Ther patterns are very nice, and the socks fit mid calf, and are comfortable my husband said.

That said there are two pairs out of six pairs of sock that , what I call seconds, repaired , or damaged socks!
One sock of the striped socks had white threads sewed in, about a inch of the sock, the back of the same sock has a odd
Seam sewed into the back part of the whole sock , as it looks like this Co. is using every scrap of material to put the socks together!!
The second pair of striped socks are both sewn up from the toe to the top of the back of the sock, which leaves frayed seams inside of both pairs.
That is the reason for the 2 star.
If it was not for putting damaged, repaired socks in this box, this would have been a 5 star.

title: Looks good, comfortable, made well.
text:
My husband usually does not a sweater like this, so I was surprised how much he like this one, and it fit him nice, although
Alittle big.
Its light weight, has a nice zipper, and hood. It’s not for real cold weather but surprisingly it gets you warm wearing it.
The color is a nice baby blue..
Down the shoulders and arms is a darker blue stripe that I didn’t notice when I ordered this. Its not bad, but
I would have preferred this sweater without it..

Looks good with jeans, or most anything. Its casual.

If you prefer not to send this to the cleaners, you can hand wash this in woollite, then lay the sweater on a towel to dry.

title: Comfortable, and well made.
text:
Very soft , and comfortable to wear.

It’s made in china, maybe they call it something different!
It is a little darker then a baby blue color but a little itchy, although my husband will wear a shirt underneath this sweater.

This sweater is not heavy, but keeps you warm, dependind where you live, and Is well made.
Looks good with jeans or just about anything.
This is a large, and wide in the shoulders like it should be for a man, and Fits my husband good..

It say’s Dry clean, or hand wash, lay flat too dry...
I put the sweater into a laundry zipper bag, and used type of Woollite. Put my front load washer on a delicate cycle, layed it on a towel on the dryer to dry.
I have no complaints.
4 stars

title: Made well, comfortable.

Made in china

title: Looks good, tight in the middle of night shirt!
text:
