The shirt was Too Tight. Its more of a size Medium, and is Not soft, and Not comfortable.
Hubby is 5’9, and weights about 55 lbs.

I expected a warm nice looking casual shirt for after the gym, or for going to the movies, hunging out.
Instead to me it looks like a older mans shirt from the 70s or 80s, or its the color and Synthetic material.
If it fit my husband he could wear this around the house at least.

Made well. Zipper works good.
This is the reason for the 2 star!

title: So darn cute..Well made
text:
What a cute set.
The onesie is not a bright but kind of tomatoe color with a white trim, and the word Meow with whiskers on both sides, with white kittie ears above.
The snaps work good, and washes and drys good.
Onsies can be worn all year. By its self on hot weather, and in the winter under warmer cloths .

The light weight overalls is cute and different.
The front has the kangaroo pockets, and the back has a V neck.
The material is white, with black outlines of Kittys playing with black outline balls of yarn, and kiddies have Red noses.
Snaps work well, and washes and drys great.
In cooler weather put a long sleeve shirt underneath.

This set makes a great gift, or for your own, or grandchildren..

title: Very cute kitty’s with  Red noses.
text:
How cute is this jumpsuit...
This is black with White outlines of kitty’s playing with balls of yarn.
The kitty’s have little adorable Red Noses.
Elastic around the waist, but not tight.,
Little Buttons on each shoulder, that make it easy to get this off and on.
With a little long sleeve Tee undeneath to keep a baby warmer for cooler weather
Around the ankles is stretchy material.
Snaps work good, sewed good , no threads.
Very soft and comfortable.

title: Made well, cute.
text:
These 3 bodysuits are made well.
Cute onesie, but not exceptional in the design, although cute.
The snaps work good.they feel a bit stretchy there easy to slip over the baby’s head ., and put there little arms into.
The stitching is done well, and No loose threads.

What I have found is, if this says 6 M, its really fits 3 M..

title: Soft, comfortable..
text:
Nice looking sport shirt for the gym, or just hanging out.
This is sewed good. The back is a lite gray, and a little darker camo back.
Is Not tight around the neck.
The material feels soft.

I made the mistake and read this as a X Large, but it is XX Large, so its a bit big, very roomy, and comfortable,
And keeps you cooler in this hot California weather this summer!

Good price for this shirt.

title: Very well made, comfortable,cooler for the summer..
text:
Well made and comfortable Leggings if your a runner, walker, yoga , exercise etc.
The Mesh will keep you cooler, and these look nice..They do not come down to your ankles, which I like for exercising.
The waist is not low, and also Not mom pants, the waist is a bit higher, wider, and comfortable, does not ride up.
There is also a pull tie inside of leggings.
Also a little flat zipper pocket at the waist that is hard to notice..If you have a Small phone it could fit.
I have a iphone 7 plus, and it does Not fit unfortunately.
I’m disapointed about the small size of the pocket, the reason for Me to take a star off.

I wear a size 10, and somtimes a 12 in tight straight jeans.
These are Leggings These do not fit tight, but there not loose. I like that there not skin tight for yoga.
A Med, or large would have been a better fit, but its my fault, and these do not look big on me.

I can also wear these in the winter with boots, and long top..

title: Very niice and well made Tank top.
text:
Very nice Tank top.
This is sewed well. It is a size 16 which my daughter does not wear this size, although she is busty It is large on her, and roomy.
This summer is very hot in California and the top is very comfortable, and cool.

title: Plain, thin,  Basic looking vest. Runs Big.
text:
Light weight plain looking vest.

I didn’t expect a down looking jacket , and won’t buy a down jacket anymore, but this is thin , and very basic looking.
The outside of the material is To the point of looking cheesy to me.
My husband and my sons will not wear this, although my daughter likes to go fishing with her boyfriend and will wear it fishing.
Has allot of pockets, and one inside pocket..pockets are not very deep.
Zips up with snaps.

This is a size Medium, and it runs Big. My daughter wears a large or Xlarge in something like this, and The medium fits her.
She can zip it up ok. I wonder if this is miss-sized!
The arm holes are big, which is good if you wear a heavier shirt underneath.

title: Made well, don’t slide down, love the colors
text:
Love these Soft colors, of light gray, and soft pink, also a white.

At first the socks seem thin, and basically they are, but once there wash, and dried they are thicker.
Has a good wide elastic that is not too tight. Has a nice looking ribbing on the top of the foot, and these do not
Slide down wearing tennis shoes, and my gray loafers.

For a thnner but well made sock without any strings hanging out, I’m happy.
I’m going to love them for the the cooler weather to wear around the house.

title: Lose fitting in the back, everything shows.
text:
This really is a cute top for the right person!

I wear a Med, to Large. This seemed large on me. I wear a size 10. 5’2.
By going by the picture my top does not look exactly like that !
Its also a bit confusing with the lines, and colors of the pants the model Is wearing!

This did not fit me snug like the back of what the model shows .

The neck line came up higher.
The arm holes where to big. The back Criss-Cross hung down open, although this idea is cute .
I think You have to have a Firm body to wear this, as everything in the back is open and shows.
In the front of the top, If you have a tummy it will show..

title: This Rain jacket has everything to keep you dry..
text:
Outdoor Ventures thought of Everything to keep you dry and comfortable with this Jacket.
Plus it’s good looking.
Pockets on both sides, and chest with zippers. Inside small ziper pocket.
Velcro pulls on each wrist to keep you dry.
On large hood in the back there is an elastic pull to make the hood smaller and tighter, And Two more in the front of hood.
On both sides inside at the bottom there is two elastic pulls to keep the rain out.
Nice long zipper to zip this up to your neck.
All zippers have a nice , and comfortable tabs to zip up & down.

This jacket is black with a light purple logo on the chest pocket. Very simple .
The inside has two different types of lining. Some has very small holes to let this jacket breath, and you don’t get over heated.
The other linning is silky.

Shell, and linning is 100% polyester ..Amazing what can be done with polyester!

This is Wind Proof.
Water Proof.
Breathable.

Not a bulky jacket. I wear a size 10. I Tried this on with long sleeve summer blouse under. It ziped up. Was a little tighter around the butt, and the
Sleeves are long. I can move my arms around, but I would say to go one size higher, Once you have heavier clothes on etc.
The back covers my tush and is a little longer then the front.
A X Large would be more comfortable for me, but I love this jacket and will be wearing it when it rains, or looks like it will.

Machine wash cold water. Do not put in dryer. Hung to dry.
Do Not iron, do Not dry clean.
Keep away from fire.

title: Nice two colors of each pair of six pairs.
text:
Up-date..After washing two times the socks have gotten a little thicker, softer & more comfortable. 👍
———————-
If you need thin two color socks you will like these. There a bit different I think!
Nice for dress socks.
Every pair of socks are two different colors.
Gray with a lite blue stripe,
white with a powder blue stripe.
black with a gray/ brown stripe.
Then another set of three that are the same as this.

The socks wick away perspiration. Wash and dry well.

The inside stitching of the blend of both colors leave allot of the threads attached inside together.
You don’t feel it when you wear the socks, but is it going to unravel when these are washed, and worn allot!

title: Ok for hanging out. Washed and dryed good.
text:
Pull on pants for hanging around the house, or hiking.

Tan with brown strip down the sides. The back pocket does not have a zipper.
Two front sides pockets are deeper then most, but watch your phone or wallet does not fall out!
The bottom of the leg has thick elastic, with an elastic waist and draw string.

I washed these in a front load washer, and put them in the dryer with a dryer sheet. They came out pretty good.I do not iron..
Did not seem to shrink .

My son did not care for these pants, he is in his med 20’s. is over 6ft, . These where big on him, legs etc.

title: NIce, warm and Comfortable.
text:
Much nicer then what I expected.
There warm, Thick, ribbing at the bottom of the leg. Inside material is very soft, as is the outside.
There not a Fleece like a sweatshirt material.
Very comfortable to wear.
The back of the pants has one flat zipper pocket.
Two side pockets in the front.
Down each leg is a rubbery feeling ! strip almost a inch wide.

The waist seems a little big, as does the legs, but you can move in these easy.
The waist measures across the top, 19 inch across wide.There is a draw sting at the waist, which does not seem to stretch much.
The leg from the crotch is 29 inches long.
From the top of the waist down to the bottom of the leg 41 inches long.

My son is very happy with these fleece loose fit..

title: Nice shirt for sports, moves with you, drys fast..Seems to run big.
text:
Nice shirt for the gym, jogging, Yoga, hiking, or just to wear on a hot day etc.
As this shirt cools you off fast, and drys fast.
My son thinks the shirt runs a little big, but its very comfortable and moves when you do.

Made well. I put it into a front load washer, and put it in the dryer, came out great.
Now I notice not to use a fabric softner, or dryer sheet which I did!
I do not why you can’t use a dryer sheet etc!!

That said, nice shirt..

title: Love these, So soft., no negatives
text:
Love these sweatpants.
There warm, inside and out, So soft, and So comfortable.

The side pockets lay flat. I have a iphone 7 plus, and it fits in the pocket. Although I would not
Go jogging in these with the iphone in the pocket, it could fall out.

The bottom of the legs are a ribbed knit.
I wear a size 10, I’m about 5’2, these might be a inch too long, but do Not fall too long at all. I have long legs even though
I’m short. I honestly would not want these any shorter. I can bend my legs in comfort,and these do not look sloppy.

My daughter is about 5’9, slim. She tried these on, although there big on her, but she wears them much lower on the hip then I do,
The legs are long enough on her..If she had these sweatpants she would wear a small..Do not know how long the small is!

These are a large,but not baggy.

For the winter I want to cuddle in these..
These are not your grandma sweatpants.
You won’t be sorry if you buy these Sweatpants.

title: More like around the house. Its a hangy material, but soft !
text:
Nice as a tunic, and cropped pants to wear around the house ,I like this. Its very comfortable, and soft.
But it is not light , airy, and soft for pajamas I think.
The material is heavy and very stretchy, kind of hangy, and is good for traveling, as this can roll up in a flat ball.

To be fair this is big on me. I wear a size 10, and this is a extra large patite. I’m 5’2..36C, If your busty there is plenty
Of room in the top, & arms ,and tummy .etc.
This top hangs down long on me.
The top has a nice slit on the top middle, but is not low cut

The pants have a wide elastic waist band very comfortable,with a string tie, I didn’t need the tie,
The legs are wide, and big, the length is shorter then the model.more med calf.

This is sewed pretty good .
This is cute, too bad its not a nicer material.

title: Very Very comfortable, not itchy, no underwire, love it.
text:
Super comfortable, and Airy feeling.
I personally do not consider this a Braelette. Its not sexy, but feels So darn comfortable, the bottom elastic does
Not ride, or curl up.
There is not any adjustments on the straps, and there not needed. The racerback is not itchy as some are.
I wear a 36C, and the large fits me good, and I still have cleavage. I’m a older women, and starting to feel I don’t want a underwire
or tight bra to wear for everyday, And this fits the bill for me.

To wash this, I put it in a small zip up laundry bag, and wash in the washer with my regular clothes.
I don't put any type of bra’s in the dryer, I just lay it on top..drys from the warm dryer.

title: Looks more expensive, more for a slim women wearing higher cut pants, or skirt. Short top
text:
Was So nicely surprised when this arrived.
The fabric was thicker, the top is more dressy then it looks.
The top fits tighter on the the top then has this good looking pleat flare on the botoom of one side.

My Daughter is about 5’8, 5’9 slim. Not busty. The small fits her perfect.
Although she said you have to wear a higher waisted pants, or skirt with this, or
You skin shows, and even though she is slim it just doesnt look right with your skin showing.
This is a more Tailored top. Looks like it is from a more up-scale store.
Very nice, 5 stars.

title: Good looking boys cargo shorts, made well..
text:
Very nice boys cargo shorts. A little tight for a big 3 1/2 Yo.
Good color does not show much dirt for a day of playing.
The front pockets are deep enough he can put his small toys in the pockets, and they won’t fall out. Two back pockets with flaps.
Zipper works good, and the cute belt has a snap to close it.
No loose threads.

I can’t find anything I don’t like about these shorts.
5 star.

title: Runs big, not a cuddley fleece.
text:
This is not a Fleece cuddley sweatshirt. It is a stretchy heavy material.
I have a french terry sweatshirt, and it does not feel like this one!
This is stretchy,hangy, and runs big.
Zipper works good, large front kangaroo pockets.. nice size hood.

title: Is comfortable, made well..
text:
Well made Bra..
I have a few Bralettes, even though this is nice and I like it, its not sexy like my other bralettes are, and
Not nearly as lacy..

That said, it is comfortable. The straps where hard to adjust.
I’m older and would have liked a little more coverage on the sides, or to hold me in better.
The lace is not itchy, I like the lite beige it’s a very neutral color.

I wear a size 36 C, the size fit me good in the large.

title: Cute, it’s comfortable, Large would have fit better...
text:
I was surprised how cute this Tee is for the summer.
You cannot see threw it.
The back is cut out, and my new lacy Bralette shows through and looks good.
Sleeves are very short. Not sure I like the back so much longer then the front!
Material feels comfortable.

I wear a Medium or a large, this is a Medium, and looked to me that it is not suppose to fit as tight as it does.
A large would have fit me better ..I washed it but did not put this into the dryer. Laid it out flat on top of the dryer to dry.

title: Fit great, very comfortable.
text:
My husband is a early morning walker, and its been chilly in the morning.
These Velocity pants he is loving. There Very nice and comfortable with a good flat zipper Pocket in the back,
and two side front zipper pockets.
There is also two zippers one on each leg, that zips up pretty far to get these pants on easy.
Thick stretchy waist, with a draw string..( you don’t need the draw-tie )
I thought the pants would be tighter in the legs as the picture shows, but for my husband there Not tight in the legs.There a tapered leg.
He wears a 32 waist, 32-31 length. These are a perfect fit .he is now about 5’8, 5’9 If your taller the length will still fit. Although
I’m thinking if your 6’3 ,these might be two short!!
I tried these on, and I wear a women's size 10, good fit for me also.

Besides wearing these for walking or at the gym, these can be worn to go to the movies, or just hanging out.

title: Fits a big busted women, with some support, sexy.
text:
Lovely sexy, and still gives some support.
There are not any hooks on this Bralette, you can pull it over your head, or pull it up into place.

My daughter is very big busted, and she was surprised this fit her, and had some support.
Both front and back are sexy looking.
Lace looks good, and not cheesy, the straps are thin, but do adjust.
There are pads inside that can be taken out..

Good price for a Bralette .
Would buy again.

title: Well made, cute theme.
text:
Very cute, and soft onesies.
All 3 onesies have the same theme, but all are different .
There are 3 in a package.
The size says for 6 mos. I find that means for a 3 month old.

These make a useful baby gift, or buy for your little one.

title: Good comfortable fit, has more support then other Bralettes. Is sexy
text:
I have a few Barlette’s and this has more support then the others, and is still sexy.
This does not have any hooks, I put this on over my head. It fits very good, and is comfortable.
I’m not hunging out all over. I wear a 36 C and this is a large which was perfect for me, and I’m older.
The lace does Not itch. The straps can be adjusted.
. This comes with little pads inside that I left in to wash this in a lingerie laundry bag. When I took it out of the washer,
I took out the pads from the cups, and bralette to dry on top of cthe dryer. A hassle to put the pads back in!

I think this and all bralettes could have more support on the sides.
That said this Bralette does, but could be better!

title: Awesome fit, stretchy, Very comfortable for hubby,  and me. 5 star.
text:
Good looking T.H. Jeans.
These are slim, but the whole (legs also etc) Jears are stretchy, and Very comfortable.Fit the tush good.
The two Front pockets are deep, but fit smooth.
There slim but NOT tight at the ankles.
My husband is always a 32 waist. These are True to size. He use to be a 32 length, but now he is older, and the 30 length is good with sandels. If he Is wearing boots / shoes for the winter the length should be longer, or he might look like he is going to a Flood!

I tried on the jeans, and they fit me perfect also, but in a different way!
I’m 5’2, wear a size 10, the legs are longer like I like them, there med rise .
The new womens rise is a bit higher, but not grandma pants..

I’m impressed by how good these fit my husband, and me. That said he is Not sharing.
Says to wash with dark clothes.

5 star

title: Fit good, look good, are not baggy.
text:
Nice black pants that are not baggy.
Fit good in the tush..
My son needed black pants for work. This fit the bill and more.
Washed on cold, and put in the dryer with a dryer sheet. They came out without any wrinkles,
And the black did not fad.

These are well made, and can be worn for more then casual occasions with a sport jacket.

title: Comfortable, light weight for the summer, made nice.
text:
Nice clean looking mens shorts. Lite blue as picture shows.
55% Linen, 35% cotton. Strong zipper, with button at the top.
Two deep side pockets, and a very slim type pocket at the front near waist. I have no idea what that is for!
Two rear pockets with buttons .

My husband likes the more baggy shorts with big pockets to hold all his stuff, and it won’t fall out,
But he does like clothes from Goodthread, as there well made, and wash and try very nice.
I think there are cooler for the hot summers in California. I’m sure my husband will be wearing these.
As he said, there comfortable.

title: Great fit ,  not baggy but roomy . Washing and fast drying etc.
text:
Super comfortable, and light weight, not baggy, but feel roomy. Fits nice in the tush.
The wide elastic waist in Med measures 32 inch waist. Inside leg from crotch is about 33 1/4 long. At crotch is a stretchy type of cool material.
These do Stretch, with a inside pull string. Although not that stretchy at the waist so there not tight around the waist.
Two side strong zipper pockets are a airy tight mesh on the inside, and roomy pockets. Plus a little small pocket in the rear, which
I do not know what that is for!

Fits my husband very nice. I tried these on. I wear a womens size 10, or in tight jeans straight leg a 12, and these where really roomy on me.
These are good for a man for the gym, or to put over his shorts at the gym when leaving, and for running on cold mornings, or just
Hunging out. A women can wear these for sure also.

title: Great colors, wear it different ways..looks good.
text:
Great colors it can go with most outfits.
It feels kind of silky. 100% Polyester, hand wash cold water.
Has a wide elastic band in the back, that is covered in the same material so you don’t notice it. Fits secure.
You can wear this different ways, in the back tied, , on the side tied, , and also pull it down around you neck then just tie it
Over one time, it looks like a scarf its long.

title: Looks good, is not a boxy type of shirt.
text:
Good looking mans casual hanging out shirt.
This Is Not a boxy sloppy looking shirt. Its more tapered through the middle, with full shoulder room.
Has the bleached look. Is well made.

The large size is what my husband always wears. If your a big guy you might want to order a size larger then you normally wear!

title: Not your regular Levi Jean jacket, although nice.
text:
Nice Levi jacket, although not your regular Levi Jean material jacket .
The outside is quilted, the inside is not. Has a plain silky type of lining.
Has two outside chest pockets, and two side pockets to keep your hands warm. And one inside chest pocket.
The Xl fits my son good. Fits over a heavier shirt ,and is roomy..He does not like a tight fiting jacket. This gives him room to move around in,
But does not look sloppy or too big.
We live in the mountains , and this Is not for cold weather.

The color said, Heather Navy, to me it looks like a dark gray! Like the color.
This jacket would have been more useful with a larger inside pocket!
I think this jacket is more for a older more conservative man, not cool for the younger guys!

title: This Bralette has more support then most! But!!
text:
This is a pretty Bralette, although I have a couple that are more sexy looking, but this Mae has more support.
Has padded cups, that gives more support.
The straps adjust, but are Too Thin, and not pretty.
There is 4 hooks in the back, that make this difficult to hook. Two hooks are for the bra, and two hooks are for
The bottom lace! Very strange! But have to be hooked which is hard to do.
Since this is big for me, I turned it around in front, hooked it, then moved it to the back, put my arms in the straps.

I wear 36c, wear a size 10. This was big for me, but after adjusting the straps, and hooking this on the last row Of hooks
I can wear this..Although the thin straps are almost a deal breaker!

3 stars.

title: Stretchy, full XL.
text: This fits my grown daughter good. She is busty, Very comfortable fit, sewed good. Stretchy material, but this XL is roomy.

title: Roomy, Comfortable, soft,  do not shrink,  5 Star.
text:
Love these Neuburger PJs.
There Roomy, Soft, Comfortable, do not shrink , and are well made.
I wear a size 10,and some times a 12, if I want more comfort to wear around the house.
These are a Medium, and I’m happy.

I would not take any stars off for this, but I’m not a fan of the pattern. The way its painted, so to speak, is blurry looking, and the colors are big & bright.
That said I will be buying other Karen Neuburger PJs, and gowns.

title: Runs small, and low rise. Legs are short but roomy.
text:
The color gray is nice , the material is soft, and Thin, but good for summer.

These pants should have fit me with room to spare,.I wear a size 10, 5’2. And the Large is tight!
Short in the crotch, look at the model. unless you want a Low Rise. The legs are shorter on me then the
Model also. Kind of looks like I’m going to a flood!
Legs are not tight.
Guess these will be good to garden in.

title: Soft, comfortable for summer, sleeves are long!
text:
Medium.
A nice Karen Neuburger nightshirt, that is always soft, and comfortable, very well made.
Made in Cambodia .
I love these, but this material is thinner then others I have bought!
In nightgowns, Pjs I sometimes buy a large cause I like them comfy, but this medium runs big.
I’m 5’2, and the Arms are long, I have Never had that happen before, the length is to my knees, which is ok.
The top is even a little big! Maybe I should have got the M petite! I’m a older, and that could be the reason for it being a bit too big!

That said, this has a nice soft mint color, on white design. The top is a scoop neck , with a little lace around it, as does the
Sleeves. There is 6 small buttons down the middle that Can be un-bottoned, but you do not need too, its only for design.
I like the night shirt and will be great for the summer.

title: Did not shrink, made very good..
text:
Nice color gray, and made well.
I put these sweatpants in the washer and dryer, they did Not shrink.
I’m not sure what a size a Large is suppose to be for big kids! as these just about fit me! I’m about 5’2, and they almost fit me,but
Was too snug for me to wear. The length just about fit also.

These are long and for a slim child. My grandaughter is 4 1/2 slim, these almost fit her, but she can wear these now.
The waist is a nice thick elastic , Not thin and cheesy, but nice.
5 stars.
Great price

title: Fits nice, covers the tush.
text:
Good looking bikini bathing suit bottom.
Black backround with nice colorful flowers , Beige lining inside that is sewed in good.

My daughter is 5’9, wears a size 5. These are a size small, cover the tush and fit good.
The Double straps on the sides are a different look she likes. You can bring them up a bit.

title: Fit great, very comfortable, 5 star..
text:
One of my sons wears a size 34. He does not wear his board shorts tight, and these fit great.
There very comfortable, have a bit of stretch for boarding. Has a nice flat pocket with a zipper on the side, with a gray stripe down the
both sides. The fly is velcro , with a tie above, and are not lined.
Dry fast.

This is not my boys first pair of O’Neill board shorts. They wear well, wash well, take the ocean salt water good, and do not fall apart.

title: I’m a women. Love these for the summer. Comfortable, but run small
text:
Good looking mens slumber / lounger PJs. I’ll wear these in the summer, and I’m a women.
There comfortable, well made , and soft, but run Small
93% cotton, and 7 % polyester, made in India.
The Tee shirt has a V neck, that is not big, and sloppy looking.
The shorts have an elastic waist, with a pull string.

Size S, but would have fit better if it was a Medium for me.

title: Love this mans wallet for my cards, soft, 100% leather.
text:
Very nice 100 % Leather RFID wallet.
This wallet smells leather, is very soft, and well made. Great price.

I’m a women That wanted this mens wallet for my cards, and have not notice women card holders that have the RFID that could
Not get my card numbers.
This wallet is flater then womens wallets, and does not take up as much room in my purse.
There is allot of slots for cards besides the 8 slots when you open the wallet, there are four more places inside that cannot be seen.
I put more cards in one slot, then the one card. Leather stretches..

title: Soft material, looks worn looking after washing, or its suppose too!
text:
I like Goodthread shirts for my husband and son, they make great shirts.
But this is the first tee shirt.
The tee shirt is a soft material. I guess black cavier is not a deep black. To me it looks like a faded black!
After washing this shirt the bottom curled up in different places. The shirt did not shrink, but looked worn, or its
Suppose to look that way.
The large seemed larger then other shirts in this size, although I would Not size down.

title: Love’m, but not really a legging. There much nicer, hold in tummy.
text:
Love these pants legging. There as comfortable as leggings and so is the material, but different. But I would not call them leggings.
There not jeans, there nicer then jeans, and a little more dressy! There stretchy, but not pull on stretchy like leggings are.
I want to buy more of these pants, but they look all sold out!!

I wear a size 10, and these are a petite size 12. These fit more like a size 10..I would go one size up.
I’m about 5’2, 138 lbs..they hold the tummy in, and my tush looks good..
The bottom of the leg comes to the top of my ankle bone..
I’m not tall, but I have long slim legs.

These are definitely a 5 star. I recomend them.

title: Keeps my husbands pants up, and now he can play his sport without worrying his pants are going to fall down..
text:
Once my husband figured out how to make these shorter, he loves them. He wants me to order more.
My husband has a sport that he has to use two hands, and he was having a hard time cause his pants kept slipping down!
Ok, as he has gotten older, he lost his tush, and his pants slip down All the time. He is a slim man.
These Suspenders work perfect, and are Very comfortable.

title: Clingy material, did not drape in front like the picture showed! Come long.
text:
The two shirts are soft, a clingy material, not real thick.
Size XL, which I have never worn this large size before, but I figured it would shrink, as the two other shirts did that I got. Those
Fit large in a size L, but shrink to a small!
After washing these the neck was Big, the arms where long, but the body of the shirt did not drape like the pictured showed!
It fit more tight. (Btw I could not get in the model picture, just showed 2 shirts!)
I'm 5'2, about 138 lbs.
One of my daughters is 5'9, size 5, not busty, this shirt fit her long arms good, but too big. My other daughter is 5,6, busty.
The neck fit her, but the bottom part was tight also. Sleeves fit good.
These shirts come long, and good for leggings.

title: Fit good, comfortable.
text:
Nice jeans, very comfortable, feel stretchy, easy to move around in them.
Slim fit in the legs Fit good in the tush. True to a size 32 waist.

The length was too long, but After washing, and in the dryer these jeans have shrunk in length, and fit even better..

title: Nice & soft. Runs Big till washed , and put in the dryer. Shrunk fit  better.
text:
NIce soft material, although they do not feel like linen that is usually stiff, and has a larger weave then these do.
Has a draw strings, and elastic inside waist band.
The button On the waist band was hanging off. I had to sew it back on!

My husband has worn a 32 inch waist forever. These pants run Big in the waist, legs, and length.
Our son wears a 34, is taller, these pants fit him. But I don't think these pants are what a teenager wears!
That said after washing, and putting them in the dryer, the pants have shrunk, and now fit my husband..although the pants need to be ironed!

title: Nice pattern, very small !
text:
Update, I have not changed my thought how small this is, but I like the design so much I bought the larger purse with this fabric design
On it..happy with the handbag, but not how small this little holder is..Still cannot get all my cards in this!
------------------
Looks cute, and I like the pattern on the fabric,.
But So very disappointed in the size. The measurements were Never given, and looks bigger in the picture.
This is the Same width as My iphone 7 plus, but 1 1/4 shorter.

It is two piece sewed together in the middle. One part is a snap pocket for change. The other part is a zipper pocket with a divider.
Has a ring on one side to put your finger through.
I do not carry a large purse with me, but to walk out the door with this little type of change credit card holder, I would
Forget about it if I Took it to the grocery store, besides it would fall threw the cart.

I have bought Vera Bradley purses, and have been happy with them.

title: Fit good, and is roomy, comfortable, but nothing special.
text:
Material is soft, and stretchy.
A little cheesy.
I got a medium. I'm usually a size 10. I'm 5'2, about 138, a older women.
This gown fit me comfortable in the shoulders, and arms. the length came to the top or a little higher then my knees.
A large would have fit also.
I put this in the washer and dryer. Come out good.
This gown is good to travel with, as it takes up such a small space, less then one thick socks.
The gown is nothing special, but it will be good for the summer.
Probably can wear this around the house with a bra!

No pockets! I'm taking a star off for that, and maybe another one as I said nothing special about the gown.

title: Cute, fit a size 5, 5'9 good. Made well
text:
Cute ,ok, Rompers..
Made well.

My daughter is about 5'9, wears a size 5. The fit is good but the top looks better on the shoulders, not off for her.
Might look better if your bigger busted to wear it off the shoulder she thought..Or the top is too big for her. ( she is a grown women)
Cute and will be cool to wear for the summer.
Washed good, and I put in the dryer, took it out while still damp. Layed it on top of dryer to finish drying. Looked good.
I'm Not a fan of the little hanging balls on this!
4star

title: So comfortable, So soft I didn't want to take these off. Great for exercising.
text:
All I can say is, these work out crop pants are So comfortable I don't want to take them off, really.
The top of the pants come up high, but its supose to be folded down.
These are pull on pants, but not your mama pants.
There is two flat cute sown in pockets on the front.
Light weight. Not clingy, but tush looks good in these.
Made in Mexico, 62% Polyester, 33% Rayon, 5% Spandex. Machine wash cold, delicate, dry low
A gray/ blue.
I'm about 5'2, 136 lbs, older women. I got the large, but I think the Medium would have fit a little tighter, better, but would
Be just as comfortable as the large.
Great for exercising, and just going for a walk.
Oh yeah, a 5 star.

title: All fleece lineing, warm. So far, so good.
text:
I didn't know what to expect with these Trailside mens pants, but there more then my husband expected. He is very happy with them.
We live in the mountains in California, and it does get cold here & snow.(we need more ).
Pants are warm with a fleece lining., water repellent, but not water resistant..
All 5 pockets have zippers with nice pull tags, and that includes the one pocket in the back.
The waist has two snaps in front, with a nylon zipper, elastic on the sides, and belt loops, which my husbands needs with these pants.
The medium would be more his size..he can also wear thermals underneath when its snowing here, or on a snow mobile,
Although you have to tie shoe laces around the bottom, so the snow does not go up his legs.
These are not really snow pants.but good for doing chores outside , working in cold weather, and also laying around the house, they
Keep him warm, and cozy.

I don't know how these are going to hold up, as he has not wore them through the winter season yet.
(He usually wears LLBean that are allot more pricey then these)
I will be back if the pants do not hold up.,

title: Son loves it, Does Not look cheesy. No Complaints with this shirt. 5 star.
text:
Size M.
Great looking shirt..
Made very good, easy to button, no loose strings shoulders fit good.
Sewing is straight.

My son is 5’11, about 150lbs. The shirt looks the same on him, as the model.
He liked it so much, put it on over a tee he was wearing and went out for the evening wearing the shirt.
I wanted to wash it first, but he loves it and worn it..
We live in the mountains in California , and this shirt fits right in, but its also a cool shirt to wear anywhere..

No complaints about this shirt.
5 stars.

title: Warm socks, stay up, but not tight.
text:
I like these carhartt high socks.
There not real thick or thin. These are warm sock, part wool but are Not itchy.
My legs are slim to normal, about 2 inches under my knee..Are not tight up to my knee, but do not fall down. Do not leave
Any marks on my leg, These socks stay up.
My shoes size is 6 to 7, narrow.

Colors are better looking in person. Colors bend in with allot of other colors.

5 star for me.

title: Has nylon stiching around the waist band, cant wear them. Its poking me..
text:
I tried the pants on before I washed them. It felt like something around the waist band was sticking me!
I washed them, tried them on again, but the something was still sticking me!
Above the regular stitching is nylon curly stitching I see now, I, and two of my daughters cannnot wear these pants unfortunately,
As there so uncomfortble.

Around the top there is a second stitching of nylon thread that makes these pants Unwearable.
Other then that, there like jean leggings.
I'm 135 lbs, 5'2, the lengh was good, not short, not long either. Not tight at the ankles..I think a size larger wouldfit better, but this size
The front pockets are just for looks, but the back pockets are real.
I would wear these if the waist band didnt have nylon Stitching that is so uncomfortable. The reason for the 2 star, or
I would have given these maybe 4 stars.

title: Nice sweatshirt, not real thick, does shrink, order larger size.
text:
Mens, size Med.
Nice deep black color sweat shirt. Sewn good.

I tried this on before washing it , and it was Big in the shoulders, and under the arms, but I'm a women.
5'2 , 135lbs.
After washing, and I put this in the dryer with a dryer sheet, this Did shrink, and now shoulders ect. fit me good, not tight.
The fleece is nice, but this is Not a thick sweat shirt, although not real thin Either.

My husband is about 5'8, 162lbs, and felt it was too tight for him.
He does wear a shirt in a large, and sweat shirts should be roomy. When he wears a sweat shirt he usually is
Wearing another shirt under it.He just grabs a sweatshirt before running out the door to keep him warm.
That said, buy this sweatshit in a size or two larger then what you normally wear, cause its going to shrink also.

The sweatshirt is 52 % cotton, and 48 %polyester. Has more cotton!
The tag on the neck does not say what this is, only in the description on Amazon..
Would be nicer if this was Tagless.

4 stars, made good, taking a star off for shrinkage, and should be more stretchy at the bottom ribbing.

title: Nice and roomy for a smaller case, has allot of pockets, rolls on a dime.
text:
Nice piece of luggage for the price
There is 8 spining wheels, that spin on a dime.
The top handle can pull up twice for a tall person or shorter person.
Has 2 zipper that can expand the width about a good inch.
The front pocket is a good size with two zippers on both sides. Then above that is a smaller
Pocket that is handy for your passport, or things you need in a hurry.
Inside is a double pocket,and above that is a mesh zipper pocket.
Inside the deep part its nice, with a silky type of gray print lining, with 2 belts to keep your clothes in place.
I would prefur two stretchy belts instead, but this works..
Also inside the lining, is a hidden zipper down the middle.

For the price it is a good buy.
It will fit as a carry on, On the Plane.
Since its black, I tie a Red ribbon on the side handle, and the top carry handle. I can find it easier when it
Comes out on the conveyor belt at the airport.

For me this is a size for about 3 days, but if you Roll your clothes you will get allot more inside..( I always take too much).

title: Soft & comfortable, legs shrunk shorter  after washing.
text:
Update; I have now washed these jeans 3 times in washer & dryer.. I now notice the top of the legs are showing up a lighter color of blue,
With some white threads..
--------------------------------
These are a dark blue, and the color is good. the color did not come off or fade when I washed them on cool.
I wear a size 10, but I thought I would give the 12 a try. They are too big. But I can wear them around the house, and my butt still looks good.(hubby said!)
I think in the size 10 the legs would have been tighter like I like them!
These are not the Levi’s that are stiff.There soft, and when I put them in the dryer, and they come out softer.
The legs shrink a little too short for my taste, and I had to pull on the seams of the legs so they did not look wrinkled up a bit!
Bare-foot after being washed, they came a little above the heels of my foot.
Wearing shoes it might look like I’m going to a flood, cause these jeans are not the tight leg at the bottom, and shorter.
I’m older, and I’m 5’1, 135 lbs. The material is stretchy, and has allot of give. The 10 I think would have fit me perfect.
Giving 4 stars, cause the legs shrunk.
I like these jeans will enough to buy them in a size 10 in black.

title: Does not seem warm for snowy weather, not sewed well.
text:
I live in California in the Sierra's. We have had a lttle snow, and the nights have been cold.
I do not think this hat is going to be warm enough for the cold snowy weather!
My husband is not heavy, or even light in the hair department on the top of his head. The material in the hat is uncomfortable if your bald. Its a thin poleyester / acrylic. It is not cozy type of hat.
This trapper hat is not sewed good. One of the ear flaps is cut crooked, it is not round at the bottom as the other side is.
The flab buttons do not match up to the bottom or top button of the hat
I will not buy real fur of anytype, but this faux fur does not feel soft or thick to me.

It says this is water and snow proof. Has a snap closure under the chin, that is not tight. You will Not feel its chocking you.
If this is warmer when we get more snow, I will be up-dating my review.
Made in china

title: Very nice well made shirt.
text:
I was hesitant getting this nice looking Goodthreads shirt cause its a medium!
My husband tried it on but the back was a bit tight, and too tight across his tummy.
He is a older man, almost 5'9, 155 lbs. and unfortunately the shirt was not comfortable.
But it fits our son , and he Loves this shirt.. He is 5'11, 158lbs.
The material is NOT thin and cheesy looking.
I think these shirts are made in the Usa.
Washes very good.

My Son is Very happy with this shirt.

title: Nice warn mittens, with warm finger inside.
text:
Well made, with a nice soft but tough leather for the palms of your hands, and the thumbs are all leather.
The top seems like its a water resistant thick material.
The inside is a Warm fleece with separate fleece fingers. Great idea, keeps your hands really warm.
The Small was to small for my husband, but fit my son perfect.
We are going to have to water proof these glove to use them for the snowmobile .

The stiching thread is very Thick.

title: Cute, but runs very small . Buy 3 sizes up at least.
text:
This is a cute sweatshirt, although I don't know why this says it is for a girl! What is the difference of a boy or girl here?
Seems to be sewed good.
This is Not a French Terry. The outside is sweatshirt material.
I expected a warm soft fleece inside. It became soft after I wash it, but its not fleece, it is like a cotton knit inside.
Seemed warmer after washed and dryed with a dyer sheet.
After washing this it shrunk allot.. It now fits a slim tall 2 and a 4 yr old .

That said its cute, but if you order this , go at least 3 sizes bigger, even if it says Usa Sizing.

Giving this a 3 star cause it nice, but you cannot buy this by size. It runs so darn Small.
Taking two stars off for the very wrong sizing.

title: size Med. Big, Not flattering.
text:
I bought the Medium.

The material is heavy feeling, and clingy..I'm 5'2' about 136 lbs..older. This ran big on me. Looks cheesy.
For being short I have long legs, and I'm not stocky, but this top made me look Fat..It is not flattering, even if your a smaller
size small I Think.!
I returned this.

title: Made good, fits Huge, More for lounging around the house.Its warm.
text:
Mae womens pull over is well made, has a big hood, side pockets, the plaid is, white- dark green- mint blue- pink-gray plaid, & gray stitching.
I never know if clothes from china are going to run big or small.!
Not sure what this is really used for!
This runs BIG..This hood is big , and arms are bat wings.
I wear a large top cause I like it roomy, but this is Huge on me, and yes it is a X large.
I'm 5'2' 136 lbs, I think a medium might have been too big also. Although this is supose to be a big roomy top, I think!
The sleeve are long , & there supose to be .
The length came to the middle of my knee.

If it didnt have a hood with the pull string, I guess this could be a night shirt.! Or for the winter with PJ bottoms!

This is Not a french terry. Its a very light soft type of cotton flannel, but warm.

That said, my grown daughter is 5'6, and busty , this looks better on her ,although a bit big. Looks ok with black leggings.the length on my daughter is about 3 inch or more above her knees.

I think this would be better with a zipper down the middle, more like a jacket cause this is not a dress , or a long top I think.
Also warm and comfy could be ok for lounging around the house.

title: Good size luggage, spins on a dime, pull up  hande holds backpack also
text:
Great lightweight impact resistant suitcase. Can be used for a carry on. When walking through the airport etc the backpack can slide over the
Pull up handle, which makes it so easy not to have to carry anything.
The spinner wheels are a dream, they spin on a dime.

Good looking dark gray with the bright turquoise zipper in the middle that is easy to see when the suitcase comes
Out of the shoot.
There is a zipper that can expand the suitcase if you need added room inside.
Inside one side is a easy to use hold down criss-cross strap. Then a nice big size zip bag for your toiletries..
Other side for more clothes.
I was surprised how much this holds.

I really cannot find anything I don't like about this piece of luggage.

title: Huge, heavy But not warm, droops down. Color green is good.
text:
The color green is a nice winter color.

Not only does this run large, Big, but the material is like a nylon that clings to the body and is heavy.
I'm a almost 5'2, 130 to 135. Older women. The medium was huge, the neck drooped down, but not sexy.
If you notice in the picture, she is wearing a scarf around her neck!
The front did not hang like the picture at all, even though this runs Big.
The seam was sewed crooked.

I did get a refund. Thank you.

2 stars for the color.
I do not recommend.

title: One size does Not fit all. Too big, seams not straight. Not flatering.
text:
Don't know what all the 5 stars are about!
Yes there warm, but one size does Not fit all

I'm 5'2, 135 lbs, ans these are Too Big.
At the Ankles there loose, which makes them move up under boots, inside seam is crooked.
Definitely does not make your body look smooth,(cause there too big) .
The waist band is so wide it could cover my boobs!

I'll only wear these in the house
The two star is because there warm, and cheap.

title: Thick material, wide waist band that wanted to roll down!
text:
Up-date. Just received the size 7. Put these in the washer and dryer. They fit allot tighter then the size 8. Still a strange fit. The band on the top was not a flat fit!.
There are no seams on the sides, and seemed to not show when I wore jeans
--------------------
The cut is odd, and I do wear high leg panties.
I do not know where I read they are lace! Below the very wide thick waist band there is a printed on pattern of ugly looking lace that barely shows up.

The material is thick, I do not think these are a high cut leg.
There not tight,or there too big for me! Very stretchy.

In all fairness I'm 136 lb, and these are a size 8. I wear a size 7 in fancy panties since I gained some weight.
I did order a 7 also but have not recieved them yet. Should be interesting on how they fit, and I will be back with a update if they fit better.

The wide waist band that came to just below my belly button wanted to roll down, It was Not tight around my waist.

I did wear these under jeans, and they did not roll down. Thinking the jeans kept these from rolling!

It says to hand wash! I washed these in a new front loader washing machine, warm water with other clothes, and put them in the dryer.
Came out of the dryer like new.

$11.00 for One pantie in the package. (Pricey)

title: Looks good, is made well, and comfortable.
text:
This was large for my daughter. She is big busted, which the cup fit, but all around it was a inch on both sides too big that will have to be taken in.
The straps in the back can criss cross, or straight down. Like the criss cross in the back, it looks better, and gives better support.
There is one large hook in the back, that has a few slots to make it tighter or looser.
About a one inch elastic band under the bust that is comfortable.
The cups have a seam that runs down the middle of the top.
I washed this in warm water in a washer bag with zipper, laid it on top of the dryer to dry.

This is good looking to wear as bathing suit top, or under a see through open blouse, open top etc.

title: Sexy, and love this, lace is very nice.
text:
This is lacy sexy, and I love it.
I got the black large. I wear a 36c bra. I don't like a tight bra around me.
Has a lacy plunging neck line to the bottom. I would wear this for sleeping with my black silk lounging Pj pants, its sexy! or as a top around the house! Maybe a black sundress!!
This does not give any support.
The lace shoulder straps cannot be adjusted for a pick-up.
The elastic at the bottom does not roll up.
This has a black liner in 1/2 of the cup, but the top part of the liner is not sown in, and rolls down on one side.I'll hand sew both sides.
The reason for 4 stars and not 5.
There is a a double hook in the back. The bottom elastic does not roll down.

This is all black lace, and is Not trashy looking, its classy, and I really like it, and so did my hubby.

I washed this in a laundry mesh bag, and laid it out to dry on the dryer.

I would buy this in a different color.
Btw, I'm a older women.

title: Runs, big, is cheaply made, sleeves are Not good looking, no shape,
text:
Looking at the dress on the internet it look pretty good!
But not in person I think
It does run a bit big, but its just Not a good looking dress at all.
There is No shape, and the sleeves are from the 60’s..Some type of double big, double ugly big sleeves, that are not good looking.
Although with a belt this might look better!

What the other reviewer said about a halloween costume is a good idea.
This dress is also a very cheaply made dress..

title: Washed and dried good, feels comfortable.
text:
My husband usually does not wear a button down shirt like this, but liked this one.
Since my husband has a outdoor sport this shirt will stay cool for the summer, and keep the sun off his arms.
I washed it on warm, dried it on high temp. I took it out of the dryer while it was still hot. I don’t iron. I Had to straighten out the collar,, and
pull the sleeves down etc, On the hanger .It looks good, although not that crisp iron look.
The shirt does not have a faded look .
This is not a shirt to wear with a suit,it's a casual shirt.

Shirt is a size large..My husband is 5’10 , about 160lbs. Shirt felt comfortable across the shoulders, and he can move his arms without the shirt feeling Tight, length of sleeves are just right.

title: Soft and comfortable, washed warm, dried on high, come out thicker, like these socks.
text:
I received 6 pairs of low cut mens sock in the package, that are soft and comfortable.
Underneath each sock just before the toes, there is a gray strip. One side of the gray strip says L for the left foot, and the other sock says R for the right foot.
Never had socks before that where for the right or left foot!!
These socks feel thicker after there washed.I Washed them in warm water, and dried on high. Came out great.

My husband shoes are size 11, Wide . He is walker and said the socks kept his feet dry even though these are Not cotton!
There padded a bit in the toes and Heel. In the middle of the sock there is a different stitching, and when the socks are on,
you can see the mesh in the middle. I’m assuming that mesh lets the air in, and keeps your feet dry.

These are not the best socks my husband has , but for the price there a good sock.
Not sure how there going to hold up to his walking, but so far, so good.

title: Love these, soft, fit good.
text:
Love All Galiva socks, and I think I have all there different types.
There Soft, fit well, and Very comfortable. Do not slid down into shoes.

These come just to above my ankle bone.
I wear a shoe size, 7 narrow. Thin legs and feet.

title: Material is stretchy , clingy. Runs small, I look pregnant. If your preg its ok.
text:
The dress is a good length for me cause it is not so short that when you bend over your underwear and butt does not show.
The fabric is stretchy cheesy , that runs small.
I'm 5'2 about 135 lbs. got the medium that is clingy, shows underwear line, and my tummy looks like I'm pregnant !!! Which is not
A good look.
The color I got was a pinkish , not bad, but not great either.
Retuned this.

title: Love these, runs Wide, and a bit long.
text:
I liked these Ryka sandals, and the colors.
I ordered the size 7 , length was a little too long, and wide.
But I have a narrow foot, and these run wide. I thought with the velcro straps I could
Adjust them to fit me, but no way. I returned them, which Amazon made that very easy for me.

Btw, when I ordered these, it gives letters, besides size, but I, and the women from Amazon (called Amazon about the width?) did not
Know What it meant!? She had to looked it up,, and it meant the width! But it was still to wide for me.

title: Hard to read time when the light shines on watch, keeps good time, nice looking.
text:
My husband likes This Tommy Hilfiger watch. Its is a nice looking sport watch, But when my husband is outside,and the light shines on this watch its difficult to read the time On on it.
The second hand can be useful, but the rest of the watch is for looks!

The band is stiff, but looks good.
Keeps good time.

title: Very comfortable. No Annoying tags to drive you crazy.
text:
The Lecoste mens medium boxers Fit my son who is a slim, 5'11, 160 lbs very comfortable , and the material
Is soft.
The legs is not tight, and do not ride up.

No Annoying tags to drive you crazy..

title: Very comfortable. Stretchy material , Not Bikini.
text:
Great light weight comfortable panties .
I wear a size 10 in women's jeans , and these panties are a very comfortable size 7. The fabric is very Stretchy.
They do not shrink , and the color does not fad.
These are Not bikini panties.
I like these panties enough that I will buy them again.

title: Cute sandels for boys,but girls can wear them,made very good
text:
These cute sandels are for a Little boys, but a little girls can wear them also.
A little big for a 3 1/2 yr but By summer will fit , although can wear them now. These do not slip off, and the soles are not slippery. Made very good.
Step @ Stride makes cute shoes that do not wear out. I buy step @ stride shoes all the time for the children, cause they fit , good, and there not cheesy shoes that wear out fast .

title: Big heavy watch,  nice for the price.
text:
Update..Went from a 4 star, down to,a 2 star.
The picture of the watch looks better and easier to use ,but my husband has bern wearing this watch for a couple of months.
It keeps good time,(china, battery) but he now said, it is hard to read the time when you flash your eyes on it.
The two goodies in the center of the watch are basiclly useless, hard to read, There just for looks.
The price has gone down allot. If you want a watch for just the time, go for it.
--------------------
My husbands Watch bezel just broke and it needs a new crystal. ThisTommy Hilfiger watch came at a good time.
This Watch is BIG, and Thick. Believe me you would not want it any larger!
This is a heavy watch, although my husband cannot tell the difference as he usually wears a heavy watch.

Its has a quartz movement which is good.
It keeps good time and is easy to read.

The watch did not come with any directions!
(Took a star off for No directions)
My husband likes this watch.
The circler dial on the top shows the Day. The Date in the larger circular dial below.
Since this is not an Atomic watch, not sure when the day and time changes on this watch at first setting!

My husband wears his watch a bit loose but this is too big. This watch has to go to the jewelry to have a link taken out.
The Watch is water Resistant, Not water proof. You do not have to worry if it gets wet, but do not shower with the watch.

title: Fits good, does not cling on hot days. Stay cool
text:
Under Armour shirts keep my husband cooler to exercise in, and doing yard work .

The shirt is very comfortable . Does not cling on hot days. My husband is about 5'9, 165lbs. Size large, he always wears.
I like that this shirt is a bit longer, so when he bends over his tush does not show when he wears jeans!
Washed the shirt in warm water with other clothes, put it in the dryer, looks like new, and the color did not come off on other clothes or fad.

title: Disappointed, not my style, not easy to get to my phone.
text:
I Just received my Rebecca Minkoff phone case/purse.
I have to say for me, I’m disappointed, and here is why:

1. With the fringe hanging down its hard for me to get to my phone to open the magnetic flap, then get the phone out of the case inside before it rings out.
I’m not a fan of the fringe, and might like the look of this case better with out the fringe.
2. The fringe on the underside is more of a bright reddish color!
3. I have a iphone 7 plus, it is not in a thick case, but The pocket is tight, although
there is a cut out in the leather to push it out! Still not easy to get the phone out for me, and I do not have long nails, although manicured.
4.It is a deep redish brown. I like the rich brown color better that it shows in the picture. I notice the case color changes in different light!
5. The strap is a gold chain about 16inch long on both sides, then the top that goes over your shoulder is leather to match the case, and is 14 inch. The strap is a Total of 3 feet long, and heavy.
This hangs down to far for me.,although this is cross over strap that I do not like, as the chain is heavy, and cuts across the middle of the bust. (I'm Not big busted) You can take the chain/strap off. It hooks on both sides, then you have A small clutch wallet with fringe.
For me when I go shopping I put my small purse on the counter, take my card out to pay, the point is with this
Heavy chain strap, it's going to be fall off the counter, and is noisy on a glass counter.
I'm probably more picky then most here, but I'm a shopper, I have a big family.

The Inside of this case folds over. When open it has the pocket for your phone, below is a zipper for cash, or change.
Then you have 4 slots for your lic, credit cards etc..
I do Not carry a large purse but I cannot get my single car key with the remote car fob inside the case.

This comes in a box with the picture of the bag on the cover of the box. Then you pull out the inside box, like a Dvd to get this case out.
The top of the box has a hanger on the top. I personally have never seen a $100.00 case handing on a hook in a department store!

text:

text:

Has allot of useful pockets as others described..

I’m not a fan of faux leather, but the faux leather on this jacket is hard to see, and I wonder why they even sewed it on!
That said, this is still a 5 star warm, well made cole haan jacket.

It says, Dry Clean.

Even thought this is too small, I’m still giving this jacket a 5 star.

text:

title: FAST shipping , love this purse.Got Yellow.
text:
I just got this Purse in yellow . FAST Delivery. Ordered it may 29, got it June 1st...
The price is great. I do not see any problem with the stitching as some mentioned.
The Yellow on my screen looks brighter & deeper color then what I received, but it's NOT faded looking. I do like the color. Never bought a yellow purse before.
It seems to be a strong canvas. I usually wear leather bags, but this looks nice for the summer, & Lighter weight.

I'm not into big purses. This is bit bigger then I usually wear, although Not a big purse, but I can get my mini iPad in this , with all my other stuff, as this was one of the reasons I bought this size. Also I like a zipper across the top.

There are two short handles on the top of the purse, that I don't think are needed!! Then two longer handles fit over my shoulder.

I gave this purse 4 stars, as I don't think the zippers are very sturdy! There the cheaper nylon type, not medal.

title: Bag is Awesome, holds everything.
text:

The inside of the pockets are not leather. It is a satin type of black material with Kenneth cole logo on it, all black.
The seams seem to be tight, and stitched good.

Above that pocket is a larger pocket for what ever.

Holds your ipad very good, you can put other items in the smaller compartment by using the Velcro.

On the back, depending on how your wearing this, is a large pocket without a zipper.

I think this can be used for a Women or a Man.This also makes a nice gift. I'm thinking the price (over 100.00) on this is going to
go down! It seems a bit pricy to me!

That said, Love this. It has so many uses with all the compartments, but not so many that it would get confusing.

It looks like plastic to me!

The Stop Watch tells the seconds every 1 seconds. So you could not use this
if you where really timing any type of event.

The top stem you press in to start the stop watch. Then Push it in a
second time, it stops the watch with out reseting it.

The bottom stem resets the stop watch to zero.

The calender on the watch has a space to give the date.

Its a battery run watch.

I have not tested this for being waterproof, as my Husbands other waterproof watches all
have a screw Bezel which this one does not have!.

The band is a thick stiff leather type.It does not look like its real leather at all.

There is a Warrantee that comes with the watch , that you can buy for about $60.00 extra .Based on the tag price of $595,00 for the watch!!
This watch is only worth $60.00, and looks like a 60.00 watch!

I gave it to one of my Grandsons (23). He said it was not that comfortable (big and band is stiff), but would give it a try!

I really wanted this watch to look good, but I was disapointed!

"Up Date"
My Grandson has been wearing this watch for a couple of weeks. He said its more comfortable to wear, and does keep good time.
He now likes it.
That said, I still think it looks cheesy. For a young man of his age Its a good sport watch.
For a business man, I don't think its nice enough / appropriate.

title: Currently design but arm holes are awkwardly constricting
text:
This is super cute and looks like it is comfy but is strangely uncomfortable and awkward to wear. The arms are too tight at shoulders and hang in a weird uncomfortable spot several inches lower than normal. So it feels like you have a bra strap hanging down and cutting into your arm that you cannot adjust. I love the overall design but wish it was designed for ladies with substance and not stick figures. I put it on and immediately took it off to see where I could cut and sew to make it more comfortable so I could actually wear it. I’m a little chunky in the mid section - but overall, I’m an average size woman and feel like this is designed for a tall, thin person with small boobs and thin arms.

Love the cowl neck design but it’s too constricting and with the arm holes being so unforgiving, it makes me feel trapped in the top half of the garment. It is really long in back and will be great with skinny jeans and boots this fall.

I will figure out a way to alter it so it’s more comfortable. Will probably cut straight down front and stitch it so the cowl is more shawl like.

title: Best Christmas gift ever from husband who never knows what to get me!
text:
This was a Christmas gift from my husband that I ordered myself because he never knows what to get me. Best gift this season!

We live in Alaska and I needed some warm boots that are high enough that snow doesn’t get in. These are perfect! Easy to get on and off and really comfy! I wear size 8 in women’s boots and these are roomier than I thought - which works for me because I prefer wiggle room for my toes. title: Only Three Sizes; Less Than 20-30 Compression; No Copper Metal
text:
These HIRUI COPPER COMPRESSION SOCKS (3 Pairs; for Men Women, Medical/Athletic Fits) do NOT seem to be the equivalent of standard 20-30 mmHg compression socks. My disabled husband uses[[ASIN:B07GVPZQSS Nuvein 20-30 mmHg compression socks]] on a daily basis, and the Nuvein socks provide a tighter fit and are much harder to put on than these HiRui socks.

The HiRui socks are advertised as giving 20-30 mmHg compression at the ankle (and foot?) only. Supposedly the HiRui compression is 15-20 mmHg at the calf, and 10-15 mmHg at the top. I suspect that the compression at the ankle is more like 15-20 mmHg, and that the leg and calf compression is much lower than advertised. The HiRui socks seem to provide only slightly more compression at the calf than plain Starter crew socks.

The “copper” fabric is definitely made of woven thread (see my photos), but it is probably just “copper-colored” thread (without any metal). The copper color looks like it might be dyed on, but the socks are actually double-knit with copper-colored thread used in only the outside layer of the socks.

These HiRui socks are very inexpensive (about $4 a pair on Amazon). Although they don’t seem to be true compression socks, they may be somewhat helpful as “traveler’s socks” (socks intended for people who must sit during long airline flights).

Choosing the right size of these socks is pure guesswork. The seller recommends L/XL for women, and XXL for men. One wonders how the socks can be expected to deliver the advertised amounts of compression when they come in so few sizes. Standard compression socks generally come in a range of several sizes for both women and men, and the sellers suggest that you measure your ankles and calves to find the best fit.

title: Well-Thought-Out Compartments in Small But Capacious Bag
text:
This MULTISAC MINI FLARE CROSSBODY TRAVEL BAG (Black) is a beautifully made, fully lined nylon bag that’s great for travel or everyday use. It’s small but capacious, with well-thought-out interior and exterior compartments. Note that the strap on the front is mainly decorative, although it helps in lifting the velcro-closed flap over the “secret” unzippered front pocket.

The exterior of the bag has two zippered pockets on the front; an open vertical pocket on the back that is the right size for slipping in a cell phone; and the previously mentioned unzippered “secret” pocket. The top of the bag closes with a zipper, and the interior has one small zippered pocket.

The bag has more than enough pockets for organizing your stuff. If you have too many pockets, you forget what each pocket holds.

The interior does NOT have pockets for holding credit cards, which is great. (The inside credit card pockets in my [[ASIN:B005AIIPLS other everyday bag]] just get in the way when I’m trying to put my wallet back inside the bag.) The product page description (“interior includes 6 credit card slots, 2 front open pockets, and a back wall zipper pocket”) is in error, because the interior has only the one small zippered pocket.

This bag does NOT have RFID protection. RFID blocks the wireless broadcast signals from certain chipped credit cards, and the broadcast signals from most cell phones. RFID does NOT block the signals from auto key FOBs (which require a Faraday cage for blocking). Many wallets now contain RFID blocking for credit cards. A Faraday bag will block credit card, cell phone, and auto key FOB signals, but in my experience these usually stop working after a few months.

title: Full-Featured, Not-Too-Big, Lightweight, Capacious Crossbody Bag
text:
Wow! This BAGGALLINI NEW CLASSIC ON TRACK ZIP CROSSBODY BAG (with RFID Phone Wristlet; color Silver Shimmer) has all the features I want in a not-too-big crossbody-strap handbag. My favorite is the “wristlet” (a clip-tethered zipper bag with RFID protection).

The wristlet fits inside the bag, and is big enough to hold my cell phone and my Honda Accord key fob. The wristlet has interior pockets for credit cards, as well as a small D-ring for attaching keys or a lanyard. I use the wristlet mainly for the car key fob, because it’s easy to drop the fob in when I walk away from my parked car. (The RFID blocking doesn't prevent my car from starting, so I added a tinfoil lining to block the fob signal.)

The “Silver Shimmer” color is a light charcoal gray. The bag is made of nylon, and weighs just slightly over 1 lb. when empty. The back has a big exterior pocket with a magnetic closure--this pocket will open to carry a file folder or a sheaf of papers.

The front has a vertical zippered pocket, and a vertical unzippered pocket; both pockets will hold my Samsung Galaxy cell phone. The lined interior has a vertical zippered pocket and a vertical unzippered pocket beneath it. The whole bag zips closed at the top.

The bottom of the bag is 2” wide, and flat. (The bottom does NOT have metal feet to keep it off the floor.) The bag is very well made, and very capacious, and is just what I need for carrying (and keeping easily at hand) a couple of snacks, two wallets (mine and my husband’s), band-aids and a pillbox, purchase receipts, a power bank, a small leather notebook, and a cabled phone charger. After all that, there’s still room to spare!

title: Lenox Crystal Ring Holder Is Eligible for Lenox Breakage Program
text:
This KATE SPADE LARABEE DOT RING HOLDER (Clear) is much, much prettier than the product page photo suggests. The ring holder is actually clear Lenox crystal, with dots etched on the underside of the bowl for a subtle decorative touch.

The well-proportioned ring holder is exactly the right size. The central post will hold several rings, but the bowl and post are neither so wide nor so tall as to be unattractive. The ring holder has a small footprint, so that it can go almost anywhere (e.g., beside a kitchen or bathroom sink, on a bedside table or bureau).

The ring holder is exactly what I was wishing for, to hold my wedding ring from time to time. When I have to use hand sanitizer instead of my usual Pre de Provence Olive Oil soap, the skin underneath my ring becomes red and itchy. The only way to heal the area is to leave the ring off for several days. The ring holder makes it hard to misplace the ring, to inadvertently throw it out with a facial tissue, or to inadvertently knock it off the surface where it’s resting.

The ring holder is NOT overly expensive (about $40 on Amazon), considering what it actually is. It’s a Kate Spade item, and because it’s Lenox crystal, it’s eligible for the Lenox Breakage Replacement Program. The Program says that if you register the item, then you can obtain a replacement at one-half retail price, should the item break “under normal usage”. If the item is defective, Lenox will replace it at no cost to the purchaser.

Care Instructions. Handwash in warm, soapy water with a mild detergent. Finish with a rinse in warm water. Dry carefully with a soft cloth.

title: Pretty “Golden” Watch, Sized for Woman’s Wrist
text:
This TIMEX WOMEN’S CLASSIC DIGITAL MINI is a very pretty “golden” watch that is sized for a woman’s wrist. I love the way it looks.

It comes with the watch already running, so you’ll need to replace the battery sooner rather than later. You’ll also have to grapple with the instructions for setting the time, which are only available online. The instructions for the “Digital Mini” are the correct ones.

The instructions could be clearer, although they do work. They don’t tell you how to switch from 12-hour to 24-hour mode, if your watch gets switched to that by mistake (as mine did). I fumbled with the Mode button until I finally got the mode switched back, though I’m not sure exactly how I did it.

The buttons are hard to press--a real negative if you want to use the chronograph or calendar function a lot. The hard-to-press buttons also make it hard to set the time. You will probably find setting the time and date to be easier if you use something hard to press the buttons for you.

title: Smoothing Garment With Minimum Seams to Cause Chafing
text:
This VANITY FAIR WOMEN’S LIGHTWEIGHT SMOOTHING SEAMLESS SLIP SHORT (Size XL) is extremely comfortable, with a minimum of seams. What seams there are, are smoothly finished so that they won’t chafe.

The shapewear garment offers smoothing, but little actual “control”. The XL size is a okay for me (a women’s size 12), so I think that the sizing runs a little small.

title: Great Unisex Gardener’s Hat
text:
This 28 PALMS (Amazon Brand) MEN’S STRAW LIFEGUARD SUN HAT is actually a unisex, one-size-fits-all hat. It makes a great gardener’s hat. I liked it a lot, until I noticed a break in the straw fiber at the top of the crown. That break has now expanded into a noticeable hole.

The hat wasn’t mistreated at all--I only put it on a few times. It will still work as a sunshade when I’m working in the garden, but it doesn’t look great.

The hat has a useful cord that you can tighten below your chin. It holds the hat on in windy weather.

title: Versatile, Economically Priced Cowhide Belt (1” Wide)
text:
This MKPCW WOMEN’S LEATHER BELT (for Jeans Dresses; Medium, Black) is a very nice, simple 1” wide leather belt (cowhide). It consists of a smooth black strap with a gold-colored round buckle. The buckle will probably show scratches eventually, as it seems to have a lacquer coating. (The buckle arrives in a sheath of protective plastic.)

The buckle lies flat. It’s the type of buckle where you thread the belt up and down through it, so that the buckle itself helps to hold the end with the holes in place. The belt also has the customary leather loop for holding down the holey end.

The belt strap is nicely finished. The belt itself is sized exactly as advertised. The Medium size fits me (a women’s size 12) with the buckle prong in the third of seven pre-punched holes.

The price (about $14 on Amazon) is extremely reasonable. The belt is dressy enough for office wear, or looks perfectly at home on jeans. The 1” width will fit the belt loops on nearly all women’s skirts, slacks, and jeans.

title: Economically Priced Cowhide Belt; Beautifully Finished Strap, Buckle
text:
This SUOSDEY FASHION WOMEN’S BELT (Coffee Color, Medium, with Pin Buckle) is a “plain vanilla” genuine leather (cowhide) belt. It consists of a smooth, flat, red-brown leather strap that is 1¼” wide. (Do check the capacity of your belt loops.) It has a rectangular buckle. The buckle has a bronze-colored, brushed-metal finish.

The buckle lies flat. I prefer a square or rectangular buckle, rather than a D-shaped or “stirrup” buckle. With a rectangular buckle, you thread the belt up and down through the buckle, and the buckle itself helps to hold the end with the holes in place. The belt also has the customary leather loop that holds the holey end in place.

The belt is sized exactly as advertised. The Medium size belt fits me (a women’s size 12) with the buckle prong in the third of seven pre-punched holes. If the belt should be longer than you want, you can resize it. It comes with a hole punch, and the only additional tools you need are a screwdriver (to free the end without the holes), a hammer (to punch a new hole), and “power shears” or a sharp knife (to cut off the excess length of leather from the end without the holes).

The price (about $15 on Amazon) is extremely reasonable for such a nice belt.

title: Practical, Durable Carryall Leaves Out Space-Hogging Fittings
text:
Practical is the word for this VICTORINOX UNISEX WERKS TRAVELER 6.0 XL WEEKENDER BAG. It’s a big carryall, with just one large zippered pocket on the outside. The inside does NOT have any space-hogging fittings, pockets, or flaps. This bag is designed for serious travelers who know how to pack their carry-on luggage.

The whole bag is made of durable soft-sided suitcase fabric. The stitching is strong, and the zippers are tough. The bag is lightweight when empty, and it fits underneath an airline seat when zipped up.

The zipped up bag has enough interior space to hold all the clothing and supplies you will need for an overnight or weekend visit. If you end up with more stuff to take home, you can unzip the side zippers (near the bottom) and gain an extra 5 vertical inches of interior space to accommodate it.

title: Generous Cut, Great Hood, Unattractive Sleeve Graphic, Not Very Warm
text:
This women’s UNDER ARMOUR RIVAL FLEECE SPORTSTYLE HOODIE (Lc Sleeve Graphic; Medium) fits me (size 12) beautifully. It’s generously cut, but not “oversized”, so it fits over other clothing even when zipped. The big hood is especially nice--it’s NOT one of those afterthoughts that pulls at your shoulders when you wear it up.

The fabric is a cotton/polyester blend that isn’t very warm, despite the brushed fleece interior. The garment is the right weight for cool summer nights or fall days. It’s well made, as you would expect from Under Armour.

I really do NOT like the Under Armour graphic on the right sleeve. It probably makes the wearer more visible to cars, because the printing is bright white. However, I see the graphic out of the corner of my eye, and keep thinking that I’ve spilled something on the sleeve.

As a design element, the small “Under Armour” identifier that repeats from shoulder to wrist isn’t at all attractive. I’d like this garment much better if it had a great big “Under Armour” logo splashed across the front.

title: Small Key Chain Pendant With Attractive California State Map Design
text:
The “California” pendant on this stainless steel LDURIAN CALIFORNIA HEART KEY CHAIN is very small—it seems more appropriate for a charm bracelet than a key chain. However, the pendant won’t be overwhelmed if you only have 2-3 keys. I do like the design (a state map with a heart-shaped hole) quite well.

The key chain arrives in a square beige box, attached to a black card that shows off the silvery mirror finish. The mirror finish reflects the colors of nearby objects, and appears to change color in different lighting situations. (In one of my photos, the key chain appears to be gold, but it is actually silver.)

The presentation box is nothing special—just okay if you’re giving the key chain as a gift.

title: Excellent Zippered Card Wallet; Questionable RFID-Blocking
text:
This KONKIT GENUINE LEATHER CREDIT CARD HOLDER (Zipper Wallet With 12 Card Slots, RFID Blocking) is an excellent zippered wallet for credit cards. It really is “genuine leather” (NOT artificial PU leather, which is often advertised as “genuine leather”). The wallet has two ID windows, and an accordion-type insert with 12 plastic windows for cards and credit cards. I like it a lot.

However, the RFID-blocking feature is questionable. My Honda Accord is a keyless-entry model, and the car starts normally when the broadcasting fob is enclosed in the Kondit credit card holder. (In contrast, this [[ASIN:B07GDD35GH Faraday bag for blocking car RFID signals]] prevents the car from starting.) It’s possible that the car fob emits a stronger, harder-to-block signal than a broadcasting credit card, but I wouldn’t count on the RFID-blocking capacity of this wallet.

You don’t need RFID blocking to protect a credit card unless the card is actually broadcasting a radio signal. The ones that broadcast usually have a “wireless” icon printed on them (for examples, just Google for “wireless” images). Check with your credit card issuer to be sure.
