title: Drapes Like Cotton, Machine Washable/Dryable
text:
This HAVANA BREEZE WOMEN’S 100% SILK BLOUSE (Regular-Fit, Black Underpainting Pointed Flower; Size Medium) is made of sturdy silk fabric that feels something like raw silk. It drapes more like cotton than polyester or thin silk, but it looks really good.

The Medium shirt fits me (a women’s size 12) well. It doesn’t pull across the back, the neck opening stops just above my cleavage, and it reaches the top of my hips. However, it doesn’t allow total freedom of movement, as it pulls when I reach with my arms--this has something to do with the cut of the armholes.

The print pattern looks exactly like the product page photo. Thus the shirt isn’t as bright as the usual Hawaiian shirt. I love the fact that the shirt is machine washable and dryable.

title: Fun Snoopy Watch With No Extra Features
text:
This TIMEX WEEKENDER JOE COOL WATCH (34mm) is a classic battery-operated analog wristwatch. You buy it for the fun “Snoopy as Joe Cool” watchface, not for the features. It doesn’t have any features! It doesn’t glow in the dark, tell the day and date, or time your workouts. All it does is tell time accurately to the second, and make you smile when you check the time.

To set the time, you pull out the stem. If you want a complete owner’s manual, go to the Timex web site, choose the Manuals page, and search for the model number etched on the back of the watch case (TW2T65700).

The watch case also tells you that the replacement battery is SR626SW. You may need a replacement fairly soon, because the watch comes with an active battery (the sweep second hand is already running). You can replace the battery yourself--just look for a YouTube video on replacing watch batteries. To open the case, you will need a tiny Phillips head screwdriver.

Opening the case will terminate the water resistance feature (to 30 meters depth). Water resistance is of dubious value anyway, because “water resistant” is NOT the same as “waterproof”. You generally shouldn’t wear a water resistant watch when you go swimming or take a shower.

The 34mm size means that the watch looks nice on a woman’s wrist--unlike most watches sold on Amazon as “women’s” watches. The watch is fairly large, but it doesn’t cover my entire wrist, even though I have small wrists. The watchband is fabric, and slips through slots so that it covers the watch back. The band has enough length and holes to fit a very wide range of wrist sizes.

title: Warm, Fashionable, Fabulous Polyester Jacket
text:
This TOMMY HILFIGER WOMEN’S SHORT CHEVRON QUILTED HERITAGE PUFFER JACKET will keep you warm at 6 degrees Fahrenheit (if you’re moderately active). It’s really warm--almost too warm for where I live (northern California). When you put it on, it looks fashionable and fabulous!

The jacket has a zipper front, and two zippered side pockets. Sadly, it does NOT have any inside pockets. The jacket is 100% polyester (shell, lining, ribbed tricolor collar and cuffs), so it’s machine washable (gentle cycle, tumble dry low).

The Large size fits me (a women’s size 12) exactly right. I’ve found in the past that I need to go up a size from my usual Medium when I order Tommy Hilfiger outerwear. The jacket isn’t “packable”, it’s bulky and a bit weighty, as you would expect from a winter jacket.

Another washable TH jacket that I really love is this [[ASIN:B071GLX2NQ Packable Down-Filled Jacket]]. It’s incredibly lightweight, can be easily stashed in a tote, and always brings compliments when I wear it. (No kidding!)

title: Well-Made, Double-Belted Pouch Hugs Your Body
text:
This KIPTOP RFID MONEY BELT/ WAIST PACK/ FANNY PACK (with Headphone Hole; Waterproof; RFID Blocking) is a flat, well-made, double-belted pouch that hugs your body, so you can wear it under outer clothing layers. The two adjustable elastic belts allow you to get a truly custom fit, whether you wear it in front (as a money belt) or in back (as a running belt). The headphone hole in one of the two separate zippered compartments is a nice touch.

The pouches have RFID linings, so that a signal from a broadcasting chip credit card (much more common in Europe than the U.S.) cannot be read by nearby, properly-equipped thieves. The pouches are designed to lie flat, so there isn’t a lot of room in them, but they will hold a reasonable assortment of money, credit cards, IDs or passports, and a small cellphone. The elastic belts are fitted with plastic snap-in clasps on both ends that are NOT easily opened, except by the owner.

title: Styled Like Classic Jeans Jacket, Using Distressed Denim, Flat Pewter Buttons
text:
This DANNE MORA WOMEN’S DISTRESSED DENIM SLIM FIT JACKET is styled like a regular Levi’s jeans jacket, except that it uses distressed denim (lots of frayed areas and light blue streaks), and flat, round, pewter-colored buttons. The jacket is advertised as “slim-fit”, so I gambled that an XL would fit me. (I’m a women’s size 12.)

Indeed, the XL jacket is a perfect fit across my shoulders in back. The jacket body flares a little wide, but I doubt that anyone besides me would notice. Because XL is the correct size for me, I think it’s safe to say that this garment runs small. My usual clothing size is Medium, though I often go up a size in outerwear (raincoats, etc.) because I prefer a looser fit in outerwear.

The jacket is well made, and should wear well.

title: You Must Like Tailored Look to Love This Sweatshirt
text:
This AMAZON ESSENTIALS MEN’S TECH FLEECE FULL-ZIP HOODED SWEATSHIRT isn’t your ordinary sweatshirt. The cuffs and bottom are finished with black seam binding tape, instead of the usual stretchy ribbing. The fabric is a 67% cotton, 33% polyester blend, instead of 100% cotton.

Because the fabric is a cotton/polyester blend, the fabric is more durable than all cotton fabric. The fabric is also thinner, and lacks the fleecy interior that you expect from a sweatshirt. The decently sized, single-layer hood is very floppy. I think that this sweatshirt is less warm than an all-cotton sweatshirt, but of course cotton isn’t warm at all when it gets wet. (Cotton conducts heat away from the body, which is why it’s a good choice for summer clothing.)

You need to like the tailored look to really love this sweatshirt. (I’m not completely sold, because I like the way that ribbing holds sweatshirts in place.) The sweatshirt is sized okay, but maybe a little on the small side. Size XL fits like a very generously sized L. Considering the tailored look, a snugger fit is probably good.

The sweatshirt is well made. It has a sturdy zipper, and the stitching is tight, even, and generally unnoticeable. The sweatshirt is machine washable with like colors, tumble dry low.

title: Classic Ruana Goes With Everything
text:
This ORCHID ROW WOMEN’S BASIC GEO PRINT RUANA is a classic ruana--a rectangular, woven blanket with a neck hole cut from the center of one long side to the center of the blanket. To wear it, you center it around your neck, and let it fall down all around you to form “sleeves” at your sides.

The polyester/acrylic fabric is very soft and warm, and is machine washable. The geometric pattern appears to be woven in (not printed). The design in shades of gray goes with absolutely everything, and adds a look of casual elegance. The outer edges of the ruana are overcast with black blanket stitch.

title: Comfortable But Thin Anklets, No Cushioning
text:
These GOLD TOE WOMEN’S SUPER SOFT NON-BINDING QUARTER SOCKS (2 Pairs) are thin ankle socks that fit comfortably and stay in place. The best feature is that the toe seam is on the outside, so that it doesn’t rub against your foot or toes. (I really hate socks with lumpy inside toe seams, because my shoes are a snug fit.)

The socks are definitely “non-binding”, but that’s to be expected of any sock that ends at the ankle. The socks provide no cushioning.

title: Delightful Holiday Socks With Three Different Designs (Santa, Tree, Reindeer)
text:
These CHRISTMAS PATTERNED DRESS SOCKS (Women’s shoe size 6.5-11; red & green) are absolutely delightful! The socks are thin, smooth, and tightly knit; they come about halfway up my calves. They feel great (though there isn’t a lot of cushioning). They’re perfect for putting you in a holiday mood.

The socks are machine washable and dryable; I think I’ll wash mine in a lingerie bag on gentle cycle, and dry them flat to make them last as long as possible. The socks fit my shoe size 8 feet nicely.

My favorite design is the santa sock with the snowflakes on a green background. However I like the green Christmas tree design and the red reindeer almost as much!

title: Looks Great With Jeans; Needs Ironing After Machine Washing
text:
This Amazon-brand GOODTHREADS MEN’S STANDARD-FIT LONG-SLEEVE CHAMBRAY SHIRT (Denim Plaid, X-Large) is a very attractive, plaid casual shirt that looks great with denim jeans or navy blue chinos. The heavy chambray fabric is machine washable (100% cotton), but unfortunately requires ironing. (The shirt can be dry cleaned if you prefer.)

The shirt is well made, with perfectly matched plaids. The top stitching is small and even, with no loose threads. Goodthreads shirts run slightly small, and may shrink slightly with washing. You’ll probably want to go up a size if you’re at the top of your normal size range.

title: Longer, Heavier Version of Arabella Waffle Wrap Robe
text:
This ARABELLA WOMEN’S BABY TERRY KIMONO WRAP ROBE is made of thick cotton knit fabric. It is NOT made of Turkish towel fabric--it has a smooth surface with tiny, tiny loops on the wrong side that feel sort of fuzzy. In style, it’s a longer, heavier version of the [[ASIN:B079HK15Q7 Arabella Waffle Wrap robe]], which is the best summer robe I’ve ever had.

The Baby Terry Wrap robe is plain but functional. It’s heavy enough for warmth in winter, but the fabric is thin enough to allow for complete freedom of arm movement (unlike thick Turkish-towel robes).

The robe has an inside tie at the waist to hold the wrap style in place, and a long self belt that you can tie in loops or in a bow. It’s very comfortable, and exactly what I wanted as a winter wrap robe. The Large size works well for me (women’s size 10/12), because I prefer oversized robes.

title: Down-Filled Shell (Real Feathers) Is Light as Air
text:
Without the zipout hood, this down-filled TOMMY HILFIGER WOMEN’S SHORT PACKABLE DOWN JACKET (with Zipout Fleece Hood) is light as air. I really love it. The Large size fits me (size 10/12) perfectly. The hidden-zipper pockets fall at exactly the right place, and the jacket just covers my torso.

The shiny black shell is nylon. The jacket Is down-filled, with real feathers (allergy alert!). The down filling is supposed to keep you warm to 9 degrees Fahrenheit. The jacket is machine washable and dryable (follow the label instructions).

The zipout fleece hood is made of polyester and cotton. I don’t like the hood at all, because it’s a light gray color that makes the jacket look cheap.

The hood is secured by flaps that extend down next to the jacket opening on both sides. When the the hood (with flaps) is zipped in, you have a second front zipper inside the basic jacket zipper. When the inside zipper is zipped, it blocks cold air that gets through the zipped teeth of the jacket zipper. I don’t plan to use the hood, because it isn’t attached to a full jacket lining. Also, I don’t like fumbling with two separate zippers.

title: Thin, Silky Crew Socks Feel Great, But Tend to Bag at Ankles
text:
These AMAZON ESSENTIALS WOMEN’S CASUAL CREW SOCKS (6-Pack, Black Assorted, 6 to 9) fit my feet (size 8 shoe) well, come up about halfway on my calves (about 13.5” around), and are very comfortable. The lightweight knit fabric is a cotton/polyester/nylon blend, and feels quite silky. I like the variety of designs in this 6-pack.

Unfortunately the socks don’t stay up as well as other crew socks that I've tried. The socks tend to work their way down my legs, and then bag a little at the ankles. The socks are machine washable and dryable.

title: High-Quality, Heavy Cotton Tee Works as Casual Shirt
text:
This RUSSELL ATHLETIC HERITAGE MEN’S BASELINER T-SHIRT (Heavyweight Cotton) is a high-quality, heavyweight, generously-sized, cotton knit tee. It’s suitable to be worn for exercise, or as a very casual shirt. It’s machine washable and dryable.

In my experience, Russell Athletic tees and sweats hold their shape through many, many washings. They seem to last forever, or at least much longer than similar products from other manufacturers.

title: Reversible Belt With Square Chrome Buckle Looks Like Fine-Grain Leather
text:
This “casual” black/brown CHAPS WOMEN’S REVERSIBLE BELT (with Stretch Technology) has a silver-colored, double-side (square) buckle. (The belts without the “casual” label have tongue (elongated) buckles.) The “black/brown” belt looks like fine-grain leather; it is reversible, with black on one side and brown on the other. (The reversible “black/brown plus” belt looks like fine-grain leather on the brown side, and like reptile skin on the black side.)

The size medium belt is a generous length (34” from end of buckle to the third of seven holes). The belt has a stretch feature that can add as much as 2” if you eat an enormous meal or gain a lot of weight. (Hopefully I won’t need this!) As with any belt, the buckle marks the strap at the hole you use. I don’t know whether this belt will prove as durable as a leather belt.

I like this belt very much for wearing with everyday cotton chinos. It works as a plain belt with any garment that has belt loops.

title: Ginormous Watch With Hard-to-Use Stopwatch
text:
What were they thinking? This FOSSIL WOMEN’S ‘MODERN COURIER’ QUARTZ STAINLESS STEEL WATCH (Color:Gold-Toned (Model: BQ3378)) is absolutely ginormous. With its clumsy, heavy, metal watchband, it weighs 4.3 ounces; and at 1⅝ inches across, it’s slightly bigger than a U.S. silver dollar! What woman would want to wear this on her wrist?

And what woman who actually needs a chronograph would want to wear this one on her wrist? The analog watch has three dials with teensy tiny numerals--they show 30 minutes, 24 hours, and 60 seconds. The stopwatch numerals are too small and hard to read for serious use. Also, the start/stop and reset buttons are fumbly, which isn’t good if you need accurate splits.

The watch box does NOT include operating instructions, and the Fossil web site you are directed to for the instructions does NOT have any for this Model BQ3378 chronograph. Thanks to another reviewer here, who explained how the watch generally works, I was able to figure out how to use this chronograph.

Operating instructions: Press the top button (above the stem) to start and stop the stopwatch, and press the bottom button (below the stem) to reset the stopwatch. If the stopwatch gets out of whack and needs a complete reset, you do that by pulling out the stem and pressing both buttons at once so that the pointers advance until they’re both back at the 12 o’clock position.

Despite the crystals around the watch face and the gold coloring, this watch doesn’t look at all like a woman’s watch. It’s too big to look pretty on a woman’s wrist. For the price (about $115 on Amazon), you can do far better by searching for smaller, decorative women’s watches, or for good, accurate, unisex chronographs.

title: Well-Made Sweatshirt Is Difficult to Zip With One Hand
text:
This TOMMY HILFIGER ADAPTIVE WOMEN’S HOODIE SWEATSHIRT (with Magnetic Zipper Closure) runs a little small. I like a loose sweatshirt fit, so ordered a Large, and it fits like a Medium. (I’m a women's size 10/12.)

The magnetic zipper closure definitely works to align and close the bottom halves of the zipper, but it's difficult to zip the sweatshirt closed with only one hand. You have to coax the zipper carefully upwards with your fingers to start it; once you've moved the zipper up an inch, you can then close the zipper fairly easily by pulling the zipper tab. I was interested in the magnetic closure because my husband is one-handed. Having tested the magnetic closure out, I would NOT recommend this “adaptive” garment for strictly one-handed use.

The sweatshirt itself is well-made. It’s constructed from good quality, medium-thick fabric; it's very comfortable; and it has a generously-sized, wide hood. You must be willing to advertise the Hilfiger brand, because the letters across the chest really stand out--they are applied patches (not just letters printed on the fabric). The sweatshirt is machine washable.

WARNING: The sweatshirt carries a warning about the strong magnets: “Magnets are present and could cause DEATH or SERIOUS INJURY. Consult physician before wearing if you have an implanted medical device, including pacemakers. If a magnet is exposed, keep out of the reach of children and dispose of garment and magnets. If magnets are swallowed, seek immediate medical attention even if the person is not choking.” I suppose that you also need to be careful to keep credit cards with magnetic strips away from the magnetic closure.

title: Tote-Size Version of Hilfiger Item Shopper Bag
text:
This TOMMY HILFIGER CANVAS ITEM SHOPPER TOTE (Denim Color) is a large version of the [[ASIN:B07C5JRQC8 Hilfiger Item Shopper Bag]]--it measures 12¼” at the side seam and 14¼” across, instead of 11” at the seam and 12” across. I actually prefer the smaller bag, because it’s less awkward; however, this tote holds more and has a larger interior zipper pocket (easily large enough for a cellphone and a charger).

The bag’s magnetized snap closure works easily, and holds the bag closed. The blue and red color blocking is attractive; the striped straps are well-secured, and very strong. The stitching is even, and overall the bag is extremely well-made. The bag gives good value for the money (about $48 on Amazon). Shop around a little before you buy, because prices for these Hilfiger tote bags vary widely, apparently depending on the fabric selected.

One highly annoying feature of this tote is the leather label that says “Property of Hilfiger”. I usually like (or don't mind) designer labels on merchandise, but this suggests that the purchased tote is only licensed to me, or--even worse--that I’m such a Tommy Hilfiger fan that I “belong” to Hilfiger. I’d take the label off, except that there will probably be ugly stitching holes left behind if I do that.

WARNING: The denim tote carries the following warning: "The color of this product may transfer to itself or other objects. Avoid making contact with light-colored surfaces."

title: Less Awkward Version of Hilfiger Canvas Tote Bag
text:
This TOMMY HILFIGER CANVAS ITEM SHOPPER BAG FOR WOMEN is a slightly smaller version of the [[ASIN:B077H11RV9 Hilfiger Item Shopper Tote]]--it measures 11” at the side seam and 12” across, while the tote measures 12¼” x 14¼”. There is a substantial difference in the capacity of the two versions, but I like the smaller one best because it’s less awkward, and still big enough to hold a lot of stuff.

I do wonder whose bright idea it was to add a label that says “Property of Hilfiger”? I usually like (or don't mind) designer labels on merchandise, but it really annoys me to spend good money for something (this bag retails for about $48 on Amazon), and then to have it arrive with a label announcing that it belongs to someone else. I’d take the label off, except that there will probably be ugly stitching holes left behind if I do that.

The interior has a small zipper pocket that is large enough for a cellphone, and little else (except maybe a charger). The pocket zipper has a nice leather tab, and a small (also annoying) leather label that says “Tommy Hilfiger”. The bag’s magnetized snap closure works easily, and holds the bag closed.

The nautical design is attractive (though my bag is striped differently from the product page photo). The straps are well-secured, and very strong. The stitching is even, and overall the bag is extremely well-made. It seems to give good value as a designer shopping bag, except for the annoying labels.

title: Attractive “Genuine Leather” Wallet Holds 12 Credit Cards
text:
This PICCHIO MEN’S VINTAGE BI-FOLD FLIPOUT SLIM WALLET (With RFID Blocking, 2 ID Windows; Dark Brown) is very attractive. It’s stamped “Genuine Leather”, which means it is NOT fake leather (Pleather; PU leather). With that label, it could be very low-grade leather (even leather mixed with plastic bits). However, the product description says “Full Grain Wallet”, and Full Grain leather is the highest grade. To me, this wallet feels to me like it's constructed from a single piece of good quality cowhide.

The wallet does have a strong plastic odor, which could be from the plastic ID windows and/or the RFID-blocking lining. (The lining blocks wireless signals from RFID chips on credit cards; mostly there's no need for RFID blocking in the U.S. because U.S. credit cards with chips generally use an EMV system.)

The wallet has slots for 12 credit or ID cards. Four slots are hidden under a sideways flip-out flap that has an ID window and a credit card slot on each side. The wallet has two compartments for paper money. The ID windows are clear plastic.

title: Three Stripe Patterns; Fit Comfortably at Knee
text:
These STARTER WOMEN’S 3-PACK KNEE-HIGH STRIPED SOCKS (Prime Exclusive) really stay up! When I pull them as high as possible, they hit me mid-knee. However, if I treat them more like nylons, and pull them up slowly, they stop just below my knee. (My calves measure 13” at the knee, and 13¾” at the widest point.)

The socks fit very comfortably. They’re snug at the top, but not too tight. (Just don't try to fold the tops over, because of the strong spandex that makes the socks fit snugly. By the end of the day, a folded-over top will feel like it's cutting off your circulation.)

The knit socks are medium-thick, bright white except for the stripes. There are three different stripe patterns in a 3-pack (2 blue stripes; 2 red stripes; 1 red, 1 blue stripe). The socks have extra spandex at the arch for added support. Machine wash warm, no chlorine bleach, tumble dry low.

title: Roomy Toe Box, Lightweight, Sturdy Sole
text:
These NEW BALANCE FRESH FOAM WALKING SHOES (13501) are very comfortable. Size 8 (my normal shoe size) fits well--the shoes have a roomy toe box and excellent Achilles tendon support. The soles have a thick tread consisting of oval contacts that are good for walking on sidewalks/streets or on softer surfaces.

Like any serious power-walking or running shoes, these shoes require properly tightened laces to be comfortable. (There are two or three options for lacing them, using the grommets and loops in different combinations.) They’re designed for sports, so they’re different from leather walking shoes, and from your usual inexpensive sneakers.

These are sturdy yet lightweight shoes with uncomplicated gripper soles that remind me of boot soles. I think that they are suitable for day-trip hiking as well as for exercise walking. I like the dark brown color, especially since it doesn’t show dirt as much as lighter colors.

title: High-Quality Sports Socks Absorb Moisture Well
text:
As you would expect from the adidas brand, these ADIDAS ALPHASKIN HYDROSHIELD LIGHTWEIGHT CUSHIONED SOCKS (1-Pack) are high-quality sports socks. They’re left/right specific socks--a feature that I think is overrated, and that makes it necessary to sort the socks carefully after washing if you own more than one pair of these. The socks do have an “L” and an “R” woven into the toes to make sure you get them onto the correct feet (unless you get dressed in the dark).

The socks absorb moisture well, as advertised. They have loops resembling a terry cloth towel on the wrong side, and these loops wick up moisture. The cushioning bands make these feel like medium-weight knitted socks. The socks fit snugly around the arch of the foot. In fact, the socks generally fit snugly--the 9.5-12 size is too snug for my husband’s feet, which are shoe size 12-12½.

title: Dressy-Looking Knee Socks Fit Comfortably, Stay Up
text:
These COMFORT SOCK WOMEN’S COTTON KNEE HIGH BOOT SOCKS (TCS) are very comfortable--and they’re dressy-looking. The fabric is a smooth, compact knit like you see in men’s dress socks, slightly less than medium-thick. They’re knee-high, and opaque, so you never have skin showing when you sit and your pants legs ride up.

The socks are constructed to fit more snugly at the ankle, and they have a snug band at the top that ensures the socks will stay up all day. My legs measure 13” around below the kneecap, and I wouldn’t want the top band to be any tighter, but they don’t cut off my circulation. The socks hit me in the right places (5’3”, 126 lbs., size 8 shoe, large calves).

The socks are perfect for my needs. I wear knee socks to protect against biting insects that dwell in the lawn and garden areas around my house.

title: Tall, Shiny Boots Meet Gardening Needs
text:
I like these all-rubber, 100% recyclable KAMIK WOMEN’S RAIN BOOTS a lot, because they’re sturdy and shiny in the way that rain slickers and boots ought to be! The really great thing about these boots is that they’re tall--they reach to the top of my calves. They’re exactly right for my gardening needs, because I can tuck my pants into the tops, and avoid getting miniscule crawlers (e.g., mites, chiggers) on my socks and shoes.

However, I wish that I’d ordered a size larger than my regular shoe size (8 medium), because they’re a snug fit over a medium-thick sock. They hurt a bit going on over my high arch, because the ankles are narrow. Next time I’ll order at least a 9 medium. I would definitely want a larger size if I were wearing them all day long, rather than for an hour or less at a time in the garden.

title: Medium Size Is Larger Than Expected
text:
This “medium-sized” AMAZONBASICS SPORTS DUFFEL (Medium, Navy Blue) is much larger than I expected. It measures about 12” deep, 20” long, and 14” high. It’s beautifully made, with good zippers, piping-reinforced seams, and no sloppy stitching. The main fabric is dark navy blue with a textured honeycomb design woven in.

A feature that I really like is the zippered end compartment with heavy netting for venting that allows you to carry dirty workout clothing without stinking up the inside of the bag. The lining inside the end compartment expands into the bag’s main compartment as you fill the end compartment, but the two compartments are completely separated by a fabric wall.

The medium duffel is not only capacious, it comes with comfortable handles and with a separate clip-on shoulder strap. The dark fabric won’t show dirt easily. It feels silky, and it’s tightly woven.

title: Sized for Man’s Wrist, Not “for Her”
text:
Why do watch manufacturers advertise heavy, clown-sized watches like this SKAGEN HALD HYBRID SMARTWATCH (Gray Leather Band) as “for her”? The watch is ⅜” thick, and the dial is 1½” across. How can such a giant watch possibly look good on a woman’s slender wrist? It belongs on a man’s wrist.

If it really were a “thin” smartwatch, it would get high marks for beauty. The gray face, gold hands, gold case, and gold stems are very elegant. The watchband is real leather.

The watch tells time in traditional fashion (with watch hands), but also records steps, calories burned, sleep, etc., for use with the downloadable “Skagen connected” smartphone app (for Android and iOS). Like other wearable smartwatches, this one is essentially tethered to your phone through Bluetooth pairing. You’ll need your phone nearby if you want to receive filtered notifications through the watch, play music, take photos.

A nice feature is that the smartwatch functions run off the watch battery, so that you don’t have to charge the watch every day or two. However, you’ll have to replace the CR2412 coin battery every 4 months or so.

title: “Medium-High” Crown Makes Cap More Stylish
text:
This “high-crown” STARTER WOMEN’S MESH-BACK TRUCKER CAP (Prime Exclusive) has what I'd call a “medium-high” crown. However, the crown is high enough that the cap settles comfortably on your head, and doesn’t feel like a mild breeze will dislodge it. The medium crown also makes the cap a little more stylish for women.

The cap has a plastic “button band” at the back to adjust the size. It will adjust to fit even the largest heads, I think. I really like the white and black color-blocking, and the mesh at the back. The mesh makes the cap cooler for summer wear.

Overall, the cap is very well made. The fabric is 100% polyester, so you could machine-wash this cap in a pinch--but use the briefest, gentlest cycle possible, because the bill and inner crown are stiffened with something that appears to be cardboard.

title: Well-Made, Featherweight Pants Are Ideal for Outdoor Wear
text:
I really like these JACK WOLFSKIN WOMEN’S ACTIVATE LIGHT PANTS (Size 42 (US 32/33)). Size 42 fits my size 10/12 figure comfortably, and the regular waist hits me at the right spot. Unfortunately, the straight legs are at least 5” too long for a 5’ 3” person, and must be shortened before I can wear them.

The fabric is water repellant, so it makes a crinkly sound that some might dislike. However, it’s a featherweight fabric that is ideal for active outdoors wear. The garment is extremely well made, with two flat, hidden, in-seam zippered pockets (beautifully sewn). A flap back pocket closes with velcro. There are belt loops along the waistband.

The Midnight Blue (dark navy) color is practical, and goes with almost any top. The pants are machine washable, no ironing required.

title: Tighten Laces for Proper Power-Walking Fit
text:
Like any serious power-walking shoes, these NEW BALANCE WOMEN’S WALKING SHOES (669v1) require properly tightened laces to be comfortable. They’re designed for sports—for providing good, stable support for your feet during exercise—rather than for everyday casual wear. They’re different from leather walking shoes, and different from your usual inexpensive sneakers.

The shoes are quite stiff when you first put them on, but they soon begin to relax, so the “breaking in” period is minimal. I thought that mine were going to rub my ankles and cause blisters, until I adjusted the laces. Now they’re fine. They don’t have a lot of cushioning, so I wouldn’t recommend them for anyone who has to stand for long stretches.

The shoes are two shades of gray, with a rose-gold “N” logo. The logo only appears to be gold when the light hits it right, and it sometimes it appears to be silver. The shoes are well-made, and the size 8B fits pretty much as expected. The length is right for my size 8 foot; the toe box is a little wider than my other 8M shoes.

title: Tongueless Sneakers Are Short, Narrow; Velcro Straps Are Decorative
text:
These CALVIN KLEIN WOMAN’S IRAH SNEAKERS (size 8 medium) don’t have tongues—they’re cut like slip-on sneakers, except that the part replacing the tongue is NOT elastic. I don’t understand why the Velcro straps are even there, because the sneakers aren’t adjustable. They either fit you, or they don’t.

I wear a US size 8 medium in most walking shoes, but I cannot get these sneakers onto my feet without a shoehorn and a struggle. (Needing a shoehorn is a big negative in a slip-on!) Even then, the sneakers are too small to even attempt walking in them. I strongly suspect that the inelastic top would prove uncomfortable if I were to try to wear the sneakers all day.

These “size 8 medium” sneakers are very short, and very narrow. I think that I would have to go up at least a full size, to a size 9, for them to fit. The sneakers have a strong chemical odor when you open the box, though I’m sure the odor will disappear when the shoes are worn.

title: Repacking Rain Jacket Is Surprisingly Easy
text:
Much to my surprise, I was able to easily repack this TOTES WOMEN’S PACKABLE ANORAK RAIN JACKET into the zippered side pocket. The trick is to start with the jacket inside out, so that you can turn the jacket fabric into the square pocket (which has two zipper pulls for a reason). I simply shoved the fabric in—next time I’ll figure out how to fold the jacket so it won’t come out quite so wrinkled.

But who really cares about wrinkles in a sporty nylon anorak that’s intended primarily for protection from unexpected showers? The size L/XL fits my size 10/12 figure with plenty to spare. However, I like generously sized raincoats because they protect my clothing better.

The styling of this basic anorak is very nice. The elastic cuffs don’t fit snugly, so they won’t keep rain out, but the sleeves are long enough that this isn’t a problem. The hood folds easily into the collar pocket when you don’t need it, and creates a sort of stand-up collar. The drawstring at the hem does work for keeping rain out.

Overall, this is a great packable rain jacket. It’s well-made, as you would expect from the totes brand.

title: Huge Shirt for Truly Big & Tall Man
text:
This EAGLE MEN’S TALL SIZE SOLID POINT COLLAR DRESS SHIRT (Non Iron; Stretch Collar; Size XXL, 18-1/2” neck, 36”-37” Sleeves) is a huge shirt, a shirt designed to fit a really big (wide), tall (extra long tail), and long-armed man. Maybe a professional athlete?

The no-iron, 100% cotton fabric is beautiful—it has such a smooth finish, it feels like polyester. The fabric is bright white, very crisp. It’s really a “no iron” fabric—the folds just fall out of it when you unpin the brand new shirt to wear it for the first time. The construction is excellent, with perfect seams, well-secured buttons, and no loose threads.

title: Beautiful “No Wrinkle” Fabric Is NOT “No Iron” Fabric
text:
The smooth, tightly woven, “no wrinkle” fabric in this IZOD MEN’S BIG AND TALL DRESS SHIRT (size 2XL; Allover Stretch, Tall Fit, Blue and White Check) is gorgeous. I love the small-scale, blue-and-white check. Sadly, the fabric is “no wrinkle”, NOT “no iron”. The shirt looks pretty good when it comes out of the dryer, but for dress-shirt occasions you’ll want to touch it up with a steam iron (as recommended by the care label). Once this shirt is ironed, it won’t wrinkle easily.

The size 2XL shirt is very generously sized, and should make any big, wide, and tall man quite happy. The body is cut wide, and the tail of the shirt is extra long. The construction is impeccable, with small, even stitching, securely attached buttons, and no loose threads. Even the packaging is perfection—there are a gazillion straight pins to remove when you unfold the shirt to wear it for the first time.

title: Gorgeous “No Wrinkle” Fabric Is Almost “No Iron” Fabric
text:
This IZOD MEN’S BIG AND TALL DRESS SHIRT (size 2XL; Allover Stretch, Tall Fit, Slate) is very generously sized, for a very big, wide man. The smooth, tightly woven, “no wrinkle” fabric is gorgeous, and it’s almost a “no iron” fabric. You can wear the shirt straight out of the dryer as a dress shirt if you’re an Oscar Madison type; you’ll want to touch it up a little with a steam iron if you’re a Felix Unger type. Once this shirt is ironed, it won’t wrinkle easily.

The body of the shirt is also extra long, to fit a tall man. The soft gray slate color is tasteful and goes with almost everything. The construction is impeccable, with small, even stitching, securely attached buttons, and no loose threads. Even the packaging is perfection—there are a gazillion straight pins to remove when you unfold the shirt to wear it for the first time.

title: Beautiful Fabric, Wide Brim, Shallow Crown
text:
This TOMMY HILFIGER MEN’S CHAMBRAY MINI FLAG BASEBALL DAD CAP is constructed of beautiful chambray fabric (white weft, colored warp) that looks like mottled, faded blue denim. It’s a practical color that won’t easily show dirt. The cap’s bill is wide and long, to properly shade the eyes.

Unfortunately, the crown is shallow, so that the cap perches on the top of the head. (I think this is probably a “medium profile” cap, though it could be a “low profile” cap.) I find the shallow crown style to be both uncomfortable and unflattering. No amount of adjustment of the strap in back can fix this.

The back strap adjusts with a flat metal clasp. The strap end fits into a buttonhole that holds the end down and out of sight.

title: White Accents Aren’t Piping; Stretchy Fabric Makes Robe Difficult to Put On
text:
This MAE WOMEN’S FRENCH TERRY KIMONO KNEE LENGTH ROBE (Large, Navy Blue) was a big disappointment. The white accents seen in the product page photo are NOT white piping; instead they are white sewing machine thread applied in a seam-overcasting pattern. To my eye, this makes the kimono look very cheap.

The Large robe is generously sized—almost too large for me (a size 10/12) even though I prefer a big, loose bathrobe. The knit cotton/polyester/spandex fabric is thick and heavy, so the robe is soft, warm, and snuggly. (It almost feels like you’re wearing some kind of fleece.)

However, the fabric’s weight, coupled with the spandex content, makes the robe very stretchy, so that it’s hard to put on. Once it’s on, the robe feels good, but I don’t care for the daily struggle to get into it.

title: Perfect Wrap Robe for Spring Through Fall
text:
This ARABELLA WOMEN’S KNIT WAFFLE ROBE is a comfortable, lightweight, cotton/polyester wrap robe that is perfect for spring through fall. It has an inside tie (at the waist) to keep the robe closed and the hems even in front, and an outer self tie that you can tie in a bow or a loop.

The waffle pattern (right side of fabric only) adds visual interest to the knit fabric. The robe ends just above my knees, and is loose enough to allow total freedom of movement. I ordered a size Large (for my women’s size 10/12 figure), because I like a big robe—it fits with plenty of room to spare.

The robe has nice side pockets. I like the Navy color, because it doesn’t show coffee stains or other spills as easily as a light-colored robe. The robe is machine washable.

title: Boat-Neck Tunic Is Slimming; Fits Beautifully Over Hips
text:
This LARK & RO WOMEN’S BOAT NECK TUNIC SWEATER (Black, Medium) is incredibly slimming; I love the way it fits smoothly over my waist and hips! The fabric is viscose, which mimics silk crepe. Viscose—or silk crepe, for that matter—isn’t my favorite fabric, because it feels rough. However, it’s fine for a basic piece like this one that’s well -suited for layering.

The Medium size fits me (a women’s 10/12), but the armholes/sleeves are so narrow that the top becomes a drop-shoulder top. The black color hides this “defect”, but I think that a size Large might fit me better. (I do have fairly broad shoulders.)

title: Cute, Silky Pajama Set for Summer Nights
text:
This cute SPLENDID WOMEN’S SHORT-SLEEVED BUTTON TOP AND SHORTS CLASSIC PAJAMA SET runs small throughout the size ranges—be sure to check the size chart before ordering. Size Large (women’s 10/12) fits me, but the shorts don’t come up to my natural waist. Instead, they fit as hip-huggers (look closely at the product page photo).

The set has a lovely silky feel, as you would expect from rayon fabric. The white piping around the top’s collar, buttonhole band, and pocket is perfectly sewn. The set is really great for summer nights.

title: Print Fabric Has Tiny Stylized Flowers
text:
This KAREN NEUBURGER WOMEN’S SHORT-SLEEVE HENLEY NIGHTSHIRT (Ditsy/Peri, Medium) is made from printed cotton/polyester fabric. The print is an allover “William Morris” type design, made up of tiny stylized blue and pink flowers. The Henley neckline and front pocket have periwinkle blue satin piping for elegant finishing accents.

The medium size fits me (women’s 10/12) with plenty of room to spare. The nightgown is actually rather shapeless—it’s an everyday nightgown, not at all sexy. The fit is fine with me, because I prefer loose-fitting sleepwear. The lightweight fabric is good for spring and summer nights.

title: Texas-Themed Pair Includes Different Sock for Each Foot
text:
A pair of these UNDER ARMOUR MEN’S UNRIVALED “STATE PRIDE” CREW SOCKS (Texas) includes one sock for your left foot and one sock for your right foot, to give a great snug fit. An “L” and an “R” are woven in, right above the toes, so that you won’t get the socks onto the wrong feet. The sock tops hug the ankle and lower leg, and stay up when the socks are worn.

The “state pride” socks for Texas feature a lone white star on a blue square, next to red and white rectangles. Thus the socks are fine as plain “patriotic” red, white, and blue socks, if you don’t hail from Texas. They are very bright-colored, so they’re NOT for the conservative dresser.

The Large size fits my husband’s feet (shoe size 12), but I think that Extra Large would fit him better. Generally it’s better to choose the larger size when you’re at the top of the range for one size (Large) and at the bottom of the range for the next (Extra Large). These are high-quality, extremely well made, comfortable socks.

title: Nice Fabric, Construction; Odd Sizing
text:
This LEVI’S MEN’S SOFT SHELL CLASSIC TRUCKER JACKET runs small; the Large size is simply too small for my husband (who is normally a Large, sometimes an Extra Large). The jacket fits me fairly well as a “car coat”. (I’m a women’s size 10/12; in unisex tees, I wear a men’s Medium.)

The 100% polyester fabric is quite nice. It’s tightly woven, so it’s “water resistant” and provides some rain protection. The styling is traditional Levi’s “jeans jacket” styling, though it has both nylon zipper and snap closings. The overall construction is impeccable.

The cut is straight at the sides, NOT tapered the way it appears in the product page photo. I suspect—but don’t know for sure—that the jacket would be long-waisted on men that it fits in the upper body.

title: Well-Made Everyday Shirt Requires Ironing
text:
This Amazon-brand GOODTHREADS MEN’S STANDARD-FIT LONG-SLEEVE CHAMBRAY SHIRT (Blue, X-Large) is a well-made everyday shirt. The heavy chambray fabric is 100% cotton. The shirt is machine washable but requires ironing; dry cleaning is also acceptable.

The pale blue, slightly loosely woven fabric suggests “work shirt” (“blue collar”), but the button-down collar dresses it up for office wear. The top stitching is small and even, with no loose threads.

Goodthreads shirts run slightly small, so you may want to go up a size if you’re at the top of your normal size range.

title: Breathable, Cool, Attractive Summer Shirt
text:
This DICKIES MEN’S MODERN FIT YARN DYED PLAID SHORT SLEEVE SHIRT is a very attractive shirt for spring and summer wear. The lightweight cotton/polyester fabric is breathable and cool (and not transparent, unless wet). My husband wears this shirt over a white undershirt.

The generously proportioned shirt is cut straight at the sides, so that it fits over an older person’s broader waistline. The short sleeves are just the right length to look good. There’s a patch pocket on the front. The shirt is machine washable. The XL size fits my husband as expected.

title: Casual Watch With Crystals Isn’t Proportioned to Woman’s Wrist
text:
In my experience, Guess watches are good-quality watches that perform extremely well. However, I am very disappointed with this GUESS WOMEN’S STAINLESS STEEL CRYSTAL WATCH, because it is NOT sized down to the proper proportions of a woman’s wrist. Because my wrists are small, the watch covers the entire top of my wrist and looks clunky and clumsy. It’s also heavy, and slides around due to the weight.

Because the watch is so large, the crystals around the bezel have a lot of gold metal showing between them. This makes the watch look cheap. I’m puzzled as to why this casual crystal watch (about $130 on Amazon) is so much more expensive than the smaller, prettier [[ASIN:B06Y5P3C1Q Guess Casual Bangle Bracelet Watch]] (about $91 on Amazon). Both have crystals around the bezel, though the smaller watch doesn’t have crystals at the numbers on the face. The water resistance is the same on both watches. The watch bands are very different.

The heavy, solid watch band on this watch is quite beautiful, and is very generously sized. I need to remove several links to make the band fit, but it’s easy to do with an inexpensive watch tool (see, e.g., [[ASIN:B001F295SA Watch Band Link Remover]]). Each of the several links marked with an arrow on the back is removable.

title: Truly Outstanding Sweatpants!
text:
These STARTER MEN’S ELASTIC-BOTTOM SWEATPANTS (XL) are truly outstanding! Who’d have thought sweatpants could be so nice? The cotton/polyester knit fabric is silky smooth, thick and soft. The waist is elasticized, though you’ll probably need to use the waistline ties to get exactly the right fit. The sweatpants are pull-ups (no fly).

The elastic at the bottom of the legs is gentle enough that it won’t interfere with the circulation in your legs. There are pockets at the side seams. The XL size runs true, and fits my husband as expected. The sweatpants are machine washable with like colors.

title: Generously Cut Polyester Polo Shirt in Gunmetal Gray
text:
This RUSSELL ATHLETIC MEN’S DRI-POWER PERFORMANCE GOLF POLO SHIRT (Stealth, Large) is a well-made, generously cut, 100% polyester shirt. The thin silky fabric feels nice, and is comfortable in hot weather. The shirt is easy care (machine wash, tumble dry low setting).

The “Stealth” color leaves something to be desired. It’s a drab, matte, gunmetal gray. If reordering, my husband and I would choose black, white, or any of the other available colors.

The polo shirt is reasonably priced (about $20 on Amazon). Judging from our previous experiences with knit Russell Athletic clothing, it will wear well, and will hold its shape after many washings.

title: Beautiful Soft Leather Wallet With Anti-Theft Lining
text:
This LEATHER ARCHITECT MEN’S 100% LEATHER RFID BLOCKING WALLET WITH REMOVABLE CARD HOLDER is a beautiful man’s wallet. The leather is butter-soft, like an Italian leather couch. The color is exactly as it appears on the product page.

The wallet doesn’t come with a multi-card-window insert (e.g., [[ASIN:B00QK96WA2 20-Card Insert for Bifold Wallet]]), but you can add one if you like. You can also use the removable card holder to hold your insurance and other essential cards, but it will be thick if you add cards up to the holder’s 8-card capacity.

This is an RFID-blocking wallet, which means that the lining ensures that your credit cards with chips cannot be read (or the numbers stolen) by strangers standing next to you who are equipped with specialized wireless card readers. (This is NOT an issue unless you have chipped credit cards that broadcast wirelessly. The cards that broadcast will have a wireless broadcast symbol on them—it’s the same as the icon you see on a cell phone when wireless connectivity is on.)

title: Nice Shirt, But Fabric Not as Expected
text:
This 28 PALMS MEN’S RELAXED-FIT SHORT-SLEEVE SILK/LINEN HAWAIIAN SHIRT (White/Blue Hibiscus Leaf Floral; Medium) is a nice shirt, but I don’t care for the fabric. It’s definitely silk, but it’s textured, and the white background has a brownish cast. The turquoise blue hibiscus print seems a little too feminine.

The medium-size shirt is generously cut. The print isn’t matched in the front, but that’s a nitpick—the print is so busy, you don’t really notice. The coconut shell buttons are a fun touch.

title: Non-Bulky, Cushiony, Sporty Socks
text:
These ZENSAH UNISEX CREW TENNIS SOCKS (Black, Small) fit me well—I wear a women's size 7½ or 8 shoe. The socks are thick, without being bulky, and provide good cushioning. They have a seam at the base of the toes that may get lumpy (at the seam ends) with washing; however, they’re fine when they’re new. (Lumpy socks are the bane of my existence, because a lot of my shoes are a little tight.)

The socks stay up—no slouching—when worn all day. They keep my feet cool, and feel very good. The black-and-white design across the arches, and the different color areas make this sporty sock fun to wear.

title: Smoothing—Not Controlling—Panty
text: This VANITY FAIR WOMEN’S SMOOTHING COMFORT ILLUMINATION BRIEF PANTY (13263) features an extra spandex panel in front to help smooth the tummy.  The spandex does NOT offer firm control—what control there is, is barely there, and the smoothing or slimming effect is minimal.  However, it’s a nice panty.

title: Well Made Cotton Shirt Is Right for Warm Weather
text:
This GOODTHREADS MEN’S SHORT-SLEEVE LARGE-SCALE PLAID SHIRT (Standard-Fit, Blue/Navy, Small) is attractive, and made of nice cotton fabric. The simple blue and white plaid is great for everyday casual or student wear.

This shirt is well made, with small, even stitches in the top-stitching. Two extra buttons are included. The lightweight fabric is appropriate for a short-sleeve shirt intended to be worn in warmer weather. The size small fit is a bit small—go up a size if you’re close to medium size. Use and care: machine wash warm, tumble dry low, no chlorine bleach.

title: Extremely Well Made Jeans With Floral Embroidery in Pale Colors
text: These LILY PARKER WOMEN’S CLASSIC HIGH WAIST RELAX FIT JEANS (Size 25, Dark Blue) are extremely well made, and fit the way that jeans ought to.  (No hip huggers for me!)  The floral embroidery is well done, with no loose threads, although the colors are subdued (pale green and pink).  I was hoping for brighter-colored flowers.  The metal button at the waist is kind of hard to unbutton, but that should become easier as the fabric softens with washing.

title: Swimsuit Equivalent of “Little Black Dress”
text:
This JANTZEN WOMEN’S SLIM SOLID SWIM DRESS (One Piece Swimsuit) is the swimsuit equivalent of the “little black dress”. It covers a myriad of figure problems—especially for an older person—without being boring. The modest but interesting top is puzzling (at first, anyway) to get into, but looks good even on a relatively flat-chested person like myself.

The size 12 swimsuit fits me well. (I’m a size 10/12.) This well-made swim dress is an excellent choice for anyone who needs a swimsuit for recreation but is concerned about being seen in a swimsuit—it will make you look your best.

title: Silky Fabric Is Thin and Lightweight But Strong; Shirt Fits Perfectly
text:
This UNDER ARMOR WOMEN’S TECH GRAPHIC TWIST SHORT SLEEVE V-NECK SHIRT feels almost like silk—the fabric is thin and lightweight but strong, and it is silky smooth. The size medium V-neck hits me in the right places, and the shirt holds its shape. (I’m a women’s size 10/12.) I love wearing this shirt.

The “graphic metallic-silver” shirt has “Under Armor” written in outline block letters on the front. The letters are fluorescent pink, but aren’t all that noticeable (as can be seen from the product page photo). The garment is very well made.

This 100% polyester shirt is easy care all the way. Machine wash warm, tumble dry low, non-chlorine bleach as needed.

title: Crystals Dress Up “Casual” Watch That’s Sized for Woman’s Wrist
text:
This GUESS WOMEN’S STAINLESS STEEL CASUAL WIRE BANGLE BRACELET WATCH (Color: Silver-Tone (Model: U1009L1)) is a superb time-keeper. It surprises me that the company describes the watch as a “casual” model, because the crystals surrounding the watch face really dress it up, and the watch face uses roman numerals. (I suppose it’s the stainless steel case that qualifies the watch as casual, but it’s still a pretty silver-colored watch.)

What I love most is that the watch is sized for a woman’s wrist. The watch portion is slightly larger than a U.S. quarter. I also love the twisted cables in the band. The band is easily resized, by removing a link or two near the clasp. (You can resize it yourself with an inexpensive watch tool (see, e.g., [[ASIN:B001F295SA Watch Band Link Remover]]). I have a skinny wrist, so I needed to remove one link.)

Something that’s easy to miss: the watch has a band of tiny crystals that are set into the watch case, and an inner band of “crystal dust” on the watch face itself. The XII numerals are also formed from “crystal dust”. The “crystal dust” adds a lot of sparkle.

title: Zirconia Stones Sparkle Like Diamonds
text:
Topaz is the November birthstone, and this beautiful SWAROVSKI MISTY ROSE AND WHITE TOPAZ RING (PLATINUM PLATED STERLING SILVER) makes a lovely birthday gift. The Swarovski stones are zirconia (NOT natural topaz gemstones), but they sparkle like diamonds. (The ring is hard to photograph, because the stones reflect so much light.)

The large stone is a pale gold or brownish amber, with pink undertones—the color is quite changeable. The small stones are brilliant white. The large stone is cut with a fairly large flat surface on top. The ring is very dressy, and looks wonderful with cocktail party or evening wear.

title: Unadorned Wraparound Garment Constructed From Rayon Jersey Fabric
text:
This ARABELLA WOMEN’S SHORT ROBE (Black, Large Petite) fits my 5’ 3” size 10/12 figure perfectly. When I wear it, it looks exactly like it does on the model in the product page photo. (You do need to tie the inside waist tie—common on wrap robes—and thread the sash through the “belt loop” at the front edge, if you want the robe to hang properly.)

However, this robe seems quite expensive (about $32 on Amazon) for what it is. It’s a simple wraparound garment constructed from heavyweight rayon jersey (a knit fabric). The only seams are at the neckline and armholes. The knit fabric edges, including the lower sleeve edges at the wrists, are NOT hemmed, but are “finished” with loose machine overcast stitching. All it takes is one broken thread to start the unraveling of this stitching.

There is no embroidery or other decoration. There is no hanging loop. The robe is NOT particularly warm, and it’s complicated to put on (especially because the knit jersey fabric collapses into a heap whenever the robe is taken off your person).

title: Good-Looking Leggings Are Easy to Move In
text:
These MINT LILAC WOMEN’S PRINTED LEGGINGS WITH SHIRRING DRAPE (Peach, Size Medium) fit me beautifully. (I’m a size 10/12.) The understated “flowering branches” design on the legs looks really good—it distracts the eye, so that your legs don’t look thin or fat.

Made of a smooth, silky knit fabric, the leggings are extremely comfortable. They’re easy to move in, and the waistband holds snugly without binding or cutting.

title: Stretchy Neckline Ruins Effect of Pretty Knitted Lace
text: This TRUE ANGEL WOMEN’S V-NECK POINTELLE LONG SLEEVE PULLOVER is made of cotton fabric with a very pretty knitted lace pattern.  However, the neckline is so stretchy that the garment totally loses its shape when you put it on.  The vee neck distorts into something resembling a scoop neck.  The fit of this garment was extremely disappointing.

title: Well-Made, Stylish Cap With Easily Adjustable Band
text:
This ADIDAS MEN’S DECISION BASEBALL CAP has a touch of fashionable European styling, but retains a generous crown. Thus it feels pretty much like a standard baseball cap when you’re wearing it (not like you’re wearing a beanie).

The cap has an easily adjustable band in back that closes securely with Velcro, so it fits even larger heads comfortably. The visor is wide and long, so the cap shades your eyes even if you wear it toward the back of your head.

It’s beautifully stitched from a stiff cotton/polyester fabric, and has a nicely embroidered Adidas logo above the visor. Hand wash, no bleach.

title: Tight Cuff Band Requires Skinny Legs
text:
I love the way these K. BELL WOMEN’S SOFT AND DREAMY CREW SOCKS (3 Pack, size 9-11) feel on my feet, but I don’t have the skinny legs you need to wear them. The socks go about halfway up my legs, and the top cuff band is far too tight for comfort. I had to fold the socks down to make anklets, to be able to wear them at all. (I’m NOT overweight, but have sort of fat calves—12-1/2” around at the point where the sock cuffs hit.)

The 3-pack consists of one pair of navy socks with dots (very cute), and two pairs of jet black socks. They’re easy care socks—machine wash cold, no chlorine bleach, tumble dry low.

Aside from the circulation-strangling cuffs, this 3-pack contains no fewer than 6 of those horrid clear nylon hangtag-attachers that need to be cut off so carefully. It’s a challenge to NOT cut the sock fabric, and to keep from dropping a piece of the attacher on the floor (where bare feet will surely find it, painfully, if you can’t see where it dropped).

title: Perfect Top-Stitching; Launders Like Wash and Wear
text:
This GOODTHREADS MEN’S SLIM-FIT PLAID TWILL SHIRT is beautifully made—all of the top-stitching on the pockets, front placket, collar, and seams is absolutely perfect. The plaid is very pretty—there is a surprisingly bright yellow stripe running through the red, but the gray background prevents the shirt from being loud.

The twill fabric is the perfect weight for year-round wear. The fabric is 100% cotton, but it launders like wash and wear (machine wash cold, tumble dry low, cool iron as needed). If you take it out of the dryer immediately, it doesn’t need ironing (unless you want a really crisp look).

The fit of this Amazon brand shirt is as expected—about the same as my husband’s Eddie Bauer shirts. It’s unusual to see a nice shirt like this—long-sleeved, with two button-flap pockets on the front—at such a low price (about $30 on Amazon).

title: Generously Sized, Very Warm, 100% Polyester Outdoors Wear
text:
This 100% polyester HUNTWORTH MENS 2-TONE ANTI-PILL FLEECE 1/4 ZIP PULLOVER (oak tree print, charcoal gray) is generously sized, made of thick fleece fabric, and very warm. The stand-up collar leaves a gap around the neck, so it needs a scarf if you’re wearing it in cold weather for extended outdoor activities.

The “oak tree” print fabric at the collar, chest, and sleeves adds a decorative camo touch. The solid color portions are charcoal gray, almost black—not brown like they appear in the product page photo.

Size medium is about two inches wider and one inch longer than another pullover hoodie that I’d consider a standard men’s medium. However, the difference is not enough to require ordering a smaller size—it means the Huntworth fleece will fit comfortably over sweaters or other clothing layers.

Polyester shouldn’t shrink in the wash. Machine wash, cold water, tumble dry low.

title: Generously Sized, Silky Fabric, Looks Good With Hood Down or Up
text:
This MISSION MEN’S VAPORACTIVE GRAVITY PULLOVER HOODIE (Large) is generously sized (including the hood). The kangaroo pocket (with beautifully hemmed and finished pocket openings) is placed in the right spot to be comfortable for your hands. The hoodie is warm, the fit over clothing is terrific, and the garment looks great with the hood down or up.

The silky, permanently treated fabric removes sweat, traps odor-causing molecules, and provides added heat retention and insulation. The garment is machine washable (cold water, no chlorine bleach or fabric softeners) and dryable (low heat).

title: “Leopard Spot” Canopy Aspires to Elegance
text:
This TOTES “LEOPARD SPOT” AUTO OPEN CLOSE UMBRELLA aspires to elegance, and the leopard print actually achieves a dressy look (for a lowly umbrella). When you press the shiny silver button on the matte-silver, lozenge-patterned handle, the canopy opens automatically--with considerable force. You definitely want to look around and be sure that no one’s standing too close when you open it.

Unlike my older Totes”auto open” umbrellas, this one requires that you click the shiny silver button again when you want to close the canopy. Closing also occurs with some force, but it’s not really a concern because the canopy is contracting, not spreading out. After closing the canopy, you slide it down the handle until the umbrella handle resets with a loud click.

After resetting the umbrella, you can guard against accidental opening by wrapping an attached “leopard spot” fabric band around the canopy fabric and ribs. This band has a velcro closing. The entire furled umbrella then slips into a matching “leopard spot”fabric sleeve. The closed umbrella is quite compact, and fits into the deep pockets of my raincoat.

The umbrella canopy is made from Sun Guard fabric, which blocks 98% of UV rays, and keeps you cooler (up to 30 degrees F.). Rain runs off the fabric, so the umbrella stays fairly dry and doesn't drip when brought in out of the rain.

The umbrella has a lifetime warranty that sounds like Totes will replace it even if it is damaged by wind. I’ve never personally made a Totes umbrella warranty claim, because all of my Totes umbrellas have proved to be strong and long-lived. I’ve replaced them because I lost them, not because they broke. I’m definitely a satisfied Totes customer.

title: Lovely Costume Jewelry Watch Is Scaled Down for Women's Wrists
text:
This ANNE KLEIN WOMEN’S SWAROVSKI CRYSTAL ACCENTED ROSE-GOLD-TONED WATCH AND BEADED BRACELET SET (AK/2854RGST) is even prettier than its Amazon picture! Unlike many watches sold on Amazon as “women's” watches, it is sized down to look attractive on even a petite woman's wrist.

The watch is more costume jewelry than timepiece, even though it has a second hand, because the mother-of-pearl dial has NO numerals. I set my watch by positioning the hands at 10:30 am (aligning the minute hand with the “30 minutes” crystal at the bottom of the dial) and then setting an Alexa alarm to tell me when to push the Crown post in to start the hands moving.

I love this watch! The tasseled bracelet (pinkish-white beads--also Swarovski, I think--on a stretchy nylon band) is a perfect complement to the rose gold color and the shape of the watch. I was delighted to see that the first three links of the metal bracelet on each side of the watch face are set with Swarovski crystals (6 crystals in all). The watch face itself has four crystals (at the 3, 6, 9, and 12 o’clock positions).

Many women will need to remove some links from the watch bracelet, but the accompanying booklet explains how to release the “hairpin” links.

title: Quality of These Comfortable Shoes Has Remained Unchanged for Many Years
text:
For many years, I have worn these SAS WOMEN’S “SIESTA” LACE UP COMFORT SHOES, because they are made on American lasts and fit my feet properly. (I cannot wear Italian shoes at all.) The shoes are high in quality, made with real leather uppers. The synthetic “rubber” soles are really long-wearing.

One pair of these will last me for a year or two. Because I’m more interested in comfort than looks, I wear mine long after they’ve molded to the shape of my feet.

The astonishing thing about SAS shoes is that the quality of the shoes has remained unchanged since I first discovered them--25 or more years ago. The SAS “Siesta” shoes are still made by hand, and the pair that I purchased from Amazon in July 2017 looks and fits exactly like my very first pair.

title: Stylish Women's Shirt With Invisible, Odorless Permethrin Insect Repellent
text:
This EXOFFICIO WOMEN’S BUGSAWAY SEVILLA LONG SLEEVE SHIRT is made from a very pretty windowpane plaid fabric (white background, gray lines). The fabric is treated with “Insect Shield Permethrin insect repellent” that repels mosquitoes, ticks, ants, flies, chiggers, and midges. The medium size fits me perfectly--I’m a size 10 that doesn't like tight-fitting shirts.

The tag says that for protection of exposed skin, the garment must be worn “in conjunction with an insect repellent registered for direct application to skin”. Obviously the open neckline of the “Sevilla” shirt is an open invitation to bugs--I would wear this over a tee, at a minimum. But as one of the unlucky folk that bugs find particularly tasty and always bite first, I welcome any garment that promises any kind of extra protection from the listed bugs!

+++NOTE TO BUYERS: These “ex officio” treated garments should be washed separately from other clothing. They should NOT be dry cleaned, because dry cleaning removes the Permethrin that repels insects. The repellency is supposed to be effective for 70 washings. Worn out garments should be disposed of in the trash and not reused for other purposes.+++

I think these garments are kind of expensive for such limited-use items. It's cheaper to apply DEET or other insect repellents when going outdoors in insect-infested areas. However, the insect repellent in them is indeed “invisible and odorless”, and I like that a lot.

title: Lives Up to Expected High IZOD Standards
text: This IZOD MEN’S ADVANTAGE PERFORMANCE SLIM PIQUE POLO SHIRT lives up to the expected high IZOD standards.  The fabric is stretchy but firm.  The “slim fit” label is a bit puzzling, because the polo shirt is cut straight up and down from the armholes (no shaping or narrowing toward the waist).  The width in the Large size is comparable to the width of a men’s medium T-shirt.

title: Well-Made Black Knit Sleepwear
text:
The LACOSTE MEN’S BANDED BOTTOM JOGGER is a well-made pajama or jogging pant that looks very nice. (The attached hang tag says “sleepwear”.) The black knit fabric is lightweight but strong. There are pockets made of gray fabric; the gray peeks out for a contrasting accent. The bands at the ankles keep the legs from riding up.

The drawstring waistband is a disappointment. It's made well, but there is NO elastic at all in the waistband. The drawstring must be pulled tight and retied every time the pants are worn. The pants cannot be pulled on and off once the drawstring is tied to the correct waist size, because there is no elastic and the fabric is NOT stretchy enough to allow this. The pants have a faux fly.

title: Fashionably Chic, But Feels Like Beanie
text:
This CALVIN KLEIN JEANS MEN’S DENIM REISSUE LOGO BASEBALL DAD HAT is made from quality fabric, and it has a fully adjustable sizing strap that uses a clamp rather than snaps for sizing. The bill is fashionably shaped and provides good sun protection.

However, it has an extremely shallow crown, so that it sits atop your head like a beanie. When you're wearing it, it feels like a beanie, and like the slightest gust of wind will dislodge it. It may be fashionably chic, but it's not comfortable to wear for active sports or exercise.

title: Quality, Easy-Care Boxers; Compactly Packaged for Travel
text:
These TOMMY HILFIGER MEN’S UNDERWEAR 3 PACK COTTON CLASSICS WOVEN BOXERS (Blue Plaid/Solid Blue/Navy Plaid) are made of quality fabric (fine cotton thread, tightly woven). The colors and small plaids are attractive but muted--not gaudy like the fabrics used in some boxer shorts.

The boxers have good elastic waistbands, are sewn well, and are properly sized--as you would expect from a name brand like Tommy Hilfiger. The 100% cotton boxers are easy care (machine wash, tumble dry). The 3-pack consists of three tightly rolled boxers inside a zippered plastic pouch, making them easy to pack for travel.

title: Tank Suit With Strategically-Placed Stripes Is Flattering to Figure
text:
I love this SPEEDO WOMEN’S LONG SLEEVE ONE PIECE SWIMSUIT. It's a tank suit, intended for exercise (swimming classes or doing laps), so it doesn't have a built-in bra. Nevertheless, it's flattering to my figure, because the strategically-placed striped patterning disguises my underendowed top and overendowed tummy.

The suit fits my size 10/12 figure perfectly. The sleeves are maybe an inch longer than my arms, but that's normal for me. The sleeves fit snugly at the wrists (and I have narrow wrists). The cut of the legs is modest, but attractive. The bright neon orange zipper in the front make the swimsuit easy to step into. The long sleeves offer extra protection from sun and chlorine.

title: Cardinal Red Almost Glows!
text: What a nice summer shirt!  This DICKIES MEN'S REGULAR FIT SHORT SLEEVE FASHION POCKET PLAID SHIRT (Dark Navy/Cardinal, L) is made from crisp, lightweight, quality fabric that looks great.  The cardinal red contrasts with the dark navy to create a plaid that almost glows.  The sewing is carefully done, with even topstitching and no loose threads left hanging.

title: When You Wear It, You Hardly Know It's There
text:
This UNDER ARMOUR WOMEN’S THREADBORNE TRAIN TWIST V-NECK tee is made of featherweight, silky fabric. When you wear it, you hardly know it's there, except that it feels luxurious. It wicks up perspiration, as advertised. It's very comfortable--there's a lot of stretch in the fabric.

The tee is well-made, with a finished V-neck that hits me in the right places. The vee is NOT cut too wide or too deep. I wear a size 10 top (or a men's medium tee), and the medium Under Armour Threadborne Train Twist V-Neck fits me a bit loosely (before the first washing). However, it, certainly fits more snugly than a men's medium tee, and I actually like a loose tee.

title: Thin, Smooth Fabric Fits Snugly
text:
This MISSION RADIANT-ACTIVE BALACLAVA (One Size) fits snugly, leaving only your eyes uncovered. According to the manufacturer, the thin, smooth fabric is infused with thermal particles that hold heat, so that the balaclava can be warm but not thick and heavy. There are tiny laser-cut holes in the fabric area covering your nose and chin, so you can breathe almost normally.

Because the fit is very snug, and the eye opening is small, I don't think that this works well as a cowl or scarf. The balaclava is machine washable.

title: Really Are "Best Fuzzy Gripper Socks"
text:
These NON-SKID, NO-SLIP HOSPITAL SOCKS really are the "Best Fuzzy Gripper Socks". They are thick enough to add warmth, and the soles have both ridges and a rubberized gripper sole. The sole grips a bare floor so firmly, you can't easily pivot on one foot when you're wearing these.

As always, with "one-size-fits-all" socks, these aren't going to fit well if your feet are very large or very small. However, they fit my women's shoe size 8 feet very well.

title: Good Quality Knit Material; Unfeminine Wide Elastic Waistband
text: These TOMMY HILFIGER WOMEN'S BASIC LOGO PAJAMA PANTS (size medium) are made from comfortable, good-quality knit fabric.  However, the medium size is a little large for a 5' 3" size 8-10 like myself.  The waistband is too loose, and the legs need to be shortened by at least an inch to be wearable (even as pajamas).  Also, I don't care for the wide elastic band at the waist, which reminds me of men's boxing shorts, and doesn't feel at all feminine.

title: Well-Made, Featherweight Bag Holds Laptop, Notebook, Books
text:
This featherweight 2(X)IST MEN'S NYLON MESSENGER BAG has pockets that are large enough to hold a laptop, a notebook, and even a few books. Alternatively, the pockets will hold a lot of documents, if you work as a courier.

The messenger bag is well made, of durable nylon, and completely lined. (The lining is a loud, bold, black-and-white graphic print.) The stitching is solid and tight. The bag has a handle for carrying it briefcase-style, and a long, adjustable, NON-detachable, striped shoulder strap with shoulder pad.

The main interior pockets are closed with a big zipper-pocketed flap that buckles securely on the outside (using seatbelt-type, quick-release buckles). There is NO padding, so a laptop will NOT be protected from falls and drops (except by its own laptop case). Also, the lack of padding makes the bag kind of floppy, so that inserting papers or other items can be awkward unless you lay the bag on a flat surface.

title: Perfect for Times When You Want to Carry Minimal ID, Cards, Keys
text:
This FOSSIL EMMA MINI RFID WALLET is perfect for those times when you only want to carry only an ID, a credit/debit card or two, a few bills and coins, and a house key (e.g., when you're exercising outdoors, or when you're checking in for a proctored exam or an outpatient procedure).

The exterior is made of soft leather, and the interior is lined with RFID material that blocks the signal from wireless credit or ID cards equipped with chips that broadcast wirelessly. (Cards with broadcasting chips allow payments with a wave--without insertion in a card reader--and are marked with a wireless signal icon like the one you see on a cellphone or tablet. The RFID lining prevents nearby people with special equipment from scanning your cards for their information.)

The small zippered coin purse holds a key and a few coins. There is a full-size bill compartment. There is a windowed ID compartment, 3 other flat compartments (useful for folded spare checks), and 2 vertical credit card slots. The whole thing folds, and snaps solidly together into a compact 3-1/2" x 4" rectangle.

title: Snuggly; But Short-Waisted, Bulky
text:
This TOMMY HILFIGER WOMEN'S PLUSH ROBE WITH SHERPA TRIM, in the gray tweed color, is wonderfully snuggly and warm, but it won't win any beauty contests. The "plush" fabric has a loose, "shag-rug" type pile, is quite thick, and adds a lot of bulk. (Yes, it makes a size 10/12 like me look fat.)

The Large/Extra Large size is quite short, and surprisingly short-waisted (when worn with the waist tie threaded through the belt loops). There is an inside tie that holds the robe closed even without the waist tie.

title: Created Rubies Add Color, Sparkle to Beautifully Designed Pendant
text: What woman would NOT love this STERLING SILVER CREATED RUBY AND DIAMOND DOUBLE HEART NECKLACE?  Even though the rubies aren't "real", they add color and sparkle (along with the diamonds).  The beautifully designed, balanced pendant is dainty, but large enough to be noticed when worn with a plain black dress or top.  The extra-fine chain adds a note of elegance.

title: Minimalist Wallet With Lining That Protects Credit Cards With "Broadcasting" Chips
text:
This COLUMBIA MEN'S FOXFIELD RFID BLOCKING TRAVELER WALLET is a well-designed, slim, bifold, credit card wallet that is very suitable for those who want to "travel light". It has a single windowed slot (for a driver's license or other important ID); 9 slots for credit cards; and a compartment for folding cash. That's it--a minimal wallet. (If you want, you can add a slender insert with plastic windows for photos, etc.; there's a spot that will hold an insert tab.) The wallet has an attractive plaid lining.

But more importantly for the traveler, this wallet has an RFID-blocking lining. The lining protects your RFID credit cards--the ones equipped with microchips that allow "contactless" payment or charges by a wave of your card over a reader--from having their information captured "over the air" by thieves with portable radio scanners.

RFID stands for "radio frequency identification", and means that the RFID credit card chip holds a little antenna that broadcasts your credit card or security access information (similar to a Wi-Fi or Bluetooth broadcast). Not all credit cards with microchips are "broadcasting" cards. (RFID cards are much more common in Europe than in the USA).

To tell whether you have an RFID card, just check it for "Chase Blink", "MasterCard PayPass", or a "radio wave" logo. (The radio wave logo is the same as the "wireless" icon that you've probably seen many times, e.g., on your smartphone or tablet when you're connected to a wireless network.)

If you spot the radio wave logo on one or more of your credit cards, then you need a sleeve or a wallet (like this one) that blocks the RFID signal so it can't be intercepted by a thief with a scanner who will use the information to create a duplicate credit card.

title: Beautifully Sewn; Marvelous Tailored Fit; Looks Like Thin Leather
text:
This LEVI'S WOMEN'S FAUX LEATHER ASYMMETRICAL DIAMOND QUILTED MOTORCYCLE JACKET (Size Medium) is beautifully sewn, fully lined and insulated, and really looks like it's made of thin leather. The body-hugging, tailored fit is marvelous--medium is just right for a size 10 like myself. (The snug fit doesn't leave much room for layers of clothing underneath.) The zippered sleeves are a tad long for me (but that's normal when I'm choosing outerwear).

From the product photo, you can't see the "asymmetrical" feature, which is a zipper that is offset to the left of center and runs on a slight diagonal across the left front. The lapels have snaps to hold them in place when the jacket is open. Then the lapels fold up, and completely close the jacket at the front neckline when the zipper is zipped.

The jacket is very warm. I particularly like the quilting on the front and the back yoke, and the decorative shoulder straps. There are three zippered pockets, none of them very deep. The top pocket is wide enough for a smartphone, but NOT deep enough to hold a smartphone with the pocket zipped. All of the zippers are strong and heavy duty.

title: Leg Portion Fits Perfectly, and Socks Stay Up!
text:
These GALIVA WOMEN'S COTTON EXTRASOFT CREW CUSHION SOCKS (3 pairs) in women's medium size (8-10) fit my fat calves perfectly--and they stay up! (I'm 5' 3", and my calves measure 14" at the widest point. The socks reach to about 2-3/4" below my kneecaps.)

The medium size seems a little small on my size 8 foot, so I may go up a size with my next order. However, the legs are absolute perfection. The socks are very comfortable to wear all day long, or for moderate exercise (in my case, fast walking).

These socks provide some cushioning, without adding thickness, so they don't take up a lot of extra space in my shoes. The three pairs of socks arrive in a box that contains 3 sets of two socks folded together (eliminating the usual extra packaging for each pair). The price (about $17 for 3 pairs on Amazon) is very attractive.

title: Pretty Good Liner Socks With Tight Elastic Tops
text:
These GALIVA WOMEN'S COTTON LIGHTWEIGHT NO SHOW LINER SOCKS (3 Pairs) are pretty good liner socks. The rubberized inner heel works exactly as advertised, to hold the liners in place so they don't slip down into my shoes. (I tried them with Oxford-style walking shoes, which is a tough test of liners.) However, after an hour or so, the elastic band around the top of the liners cut into my heels, making the socks uncomfortable to wear.

The medium size fits my size 8 foot snugly, which is good in liner socks, but not when the socks have such strong elastic tops. Probably the large size would fit me better. The socks don't wick away moisture as well as I'd like, but the rubberized heel and superior "no show" cut of these liners make up for a lot. For the above reasons, I rate these socks at 3 stars ("It's okay" on the official Amazon scale).

title: Satisfactory Fit; Cushioning Without Thickness
text:
These GALIVA WOMEN'S COTTON EXTRASOFT LOW CUT CUSHION SOCKS (3 Pairs) are comfortable to wear. They provide cushioning without thickness, so they don't take up a lot of extra space in your shoes. The women's medium size (8-10) seems a little small on my size 8 foot. The gray color is a standard sweatpants gray.

Because these low-cut socks have no cuff, they have ribbing across the arch of your foot to keep them from slipping down into your shoes. Mine slide down a little anyway, but the overall spandex-assisted, snug fit is satisfactory. The 3 pairs of socks arrive in a box with 6 single socks inside. The price (about $15 for 3 pairs on Amazon) is very attractive.

Still, I strongly prefer my more expensive Wigwam cotton tennis socks with ribbed cuffs for everyday wear. (They stay up and absorb moisture better.) I rate these Galiva Extrasoft Low Cut Cushion Socks at 3 stars ("It's okay" on the official Amazon scale).

title: Fits Almost Like It Was Personally Tailored!
text:
On me, this ARCTIC WOMEN'S BLAISE SOFTSHELL JACKET fits almost like it was personally tailored. It looks very much like the jacket on the model in the product page photo.
