It's hard to choose a jacket size from a size chart that shows only pants sizes. I'm a size 8-10, but went with Small (waist 26-28, hips 36-38), and have few regrets. Maybe the jacket is a little tight across the back and a little too snug in the armholes, but it's comfortable to wear, and it looks terrific! (Probably if I were doing it over, I would order Medium, so it would be easier to shrug on, and would have more room for a sweatshirt over my usual t-shirt plus turtleneck.)

The deep, zippered pockets do keep my hands warm! I like the quilting on the front and shoulders, which adds textural interest. The fuchsia zippers add a fun pop of color. The high neckline doesn't bind when the jacket is zipped all the way up.

All of the non-quilted portions (at the underarms, on the underside of the sleeves, at the back) are stretchable spandex, which makes the tailored fit somewhat forgiving. However, the spandex is firm--it doesn't stretch a whole lot. There are two inner pockets, not zippered, made of thin, lightweight fabric that makes me wonder how soon the pockets will develop holes.

This is a lightweight, machine washable windbreaker. It's water resistant, and made of breathable thermal fabric. It's exactly the right weight for autumn weather, or for year-round weather in the San Francisco Bay Area. The "Steel" color is a dark charcoal gray that you'll probably like if you also like dark navy blue (as I do).

title: High-Quality Cotton Panties (Go Up at Least One Size)
text:
LOLLIPOP has long been a leading brand of 100% cotton underwear, and the quality is still very good. For everyday wear, I much prefer cotton over silk or nylon, because of cotton's superior comfort and absorbency. I've worn Lollipops since childhood. I slightly prefer the "cotton leg band" or "cuff leg" Lollipops over these “elastic leg” Lollipops, but there actually isn’t much difference.

The Lollipop package claims that "with a contour cut for a better fit, Lollipop panties keep their shape wash after wash without shrinking". Maybe that's true if you follow the recommendation to "machine wash cold, hang dry". However, my Lollipops are machine washed and machine dried with other whites (using settings for permanent press and low heat), and they ALWAYS shrink.

To allow for shrinkage, I go up one or two sizes when I buy ANY brand of cotton panties. For Lollipops, the package recommends: size 5 (hips 36-37"); 6 (38-39"), 7 (40-41"), 8 (42-43"), 9 (44-45"), 10 (46-47"), 11 (48-49"), and 12 (50-51").

I wear women's size 10/12 pants, my hips measure 39" over clothing, and I currently weigh 125 lbs. These size 6 panties provide a perfect fit (smooth and snug) when brand new out of the package. However, if they shrink at all, they'll be too small. Size 7 is my best size in Lollipops when I’m at 122-125 lbs., and size 8 is best when I go higher than 125 lbs.

VANITY FAIR WOMEN'S LOLLIPOP BRIEF PANTIES (3 pack, elastic leg, size 6)

title: Comfortable to Wear All Day, But Hard to Put On
text:
This GAIAM APPAREL WOMENS QUINN BRA TOP is very comfortable to wear all day. It doesn't bind or in any way restrict your movement. The knit fabric is thick, which makes me wonder whether it is really intended as a bra (to be worn under other clothing), rather than as a one-piece exercise top (to be worn by itself with pants or shorts). A pull-on swimsuit top (made of knit jersey rather than nylon, lycra, or spandex) is the comparison that comes most easily to mind.

The "small" size fits me (a 34B) comfortably, which was a surprise because I feared strangulation in putting it on and taking it off! It's complicated, fitting your neck through the halter, your arms through the "armholes" formed by the halter band and racer back netting; and then pulling the tight band over your head (without getting tangled up).

The "adjustable" part of the racer back is simply that the halter band goes through a casing at the top of the racer back netting. This means you can slide the netting left or right along the halter band until it's perfectly centered or otherwise feels best. The netting doesn't scratch, and you quickly forget that it's there. It holds the halter band perfectly in place at the back of your neck.

The bra top seems to absorb moisture very well. It is machine washable, and would be easy care if the bra cups didn't have to be removed before washing. Removing and reinserting the triangular bra cups is a bit of a pain, because they are much wider than the little openings they have to go through. (I get it that the openings are small to help hold the cups in place without shifting, but I'd prefer non-removeable, machine washable cups.)

Because it's so hard to get on and off, and not really easy care, I rate this Gaiam Quinn model bra top at 3 stars ("It's okay" on the official Amazon scale).

title: Terrific for Active Exercising, But Tight at Underarms (in Front)
text:
This LILY OF FRANCE WOMEN'S REVERSIBLE SPORTS BRA (2151801, Barely Beige/White, Medium) is terrific for active exercising--it absorbs perspiration, and there's NO bouncing. Size Medium is a snug fit for me (an average 34B), but the bra adjusts to my body and feels fine when I'm wearing it while power-walking or spinning.

Unfortunately, the bra isn't suitable for me to wear all day, because it's tight at the underarms (in front). It doesn't cut in and leave deep red marks, but it's not completely comfortable when I'm leaning forward over a tablet, or sitting at a desk. I guess it should inspire me to lift some weights to tone up the underarm flab!

The bra is made of good quality elastic fabric (polyester, nylon, spandex). Reversibility (beige or white with beige piping) is good, because it's a pull-on that gets turned inside out when you take it off over your head. The bra is machine washable (machine wash cold, colors separately, non-chlorine bleach only, tumble dry low). Because of the underarm fit, I rate this bra at 4 stars ("I like it" on the official Amazon scale).

title: Well-Made "Power Walking" Shoes Reduce Impact Stress on Knees, Hips
text:
This ASICS WOMEN'S GEL-TECH NEO 4 WALKING SHOE is a terrific "power walking" (exercise walking) shoe. The gel cushioning really reduces the impact stress on my knees and hips, as I walk on the sloped concrete sidewalks in my hilly neighborhood. When I change from these shoes to my favorite SAS leather walking shoes with thick rubber soles, it feels like I'm walking on wooden clogs!

The "sculptured" sole gives excellent traction when the sidewalks are wet from rain, or are covered with leaves and seeds from overhanging trees. The uppers are breathable, but are solidly stitched, reinforced, and padded, so that my feet have wonderful support. The shoes are more expensive (about $85) than other walking shoes sold on Amazon, but the performance and quality makes them worth the extra money.

I can always wear an 8 Medium shoe, and these 8Bs fit perfectly. When laced carefully, they hold my feet comfortably but snugly inside the shoes (no sliding forward or shifting around). The shoes appear to be very well-made, and I expect them to last me for quite a while--I walk for 1 to 1-1/2 miles per day.

title: Pretty Shoe But Memory Foam Cushioning Is Not Adequate for "Power" Walking
text:
This RYKA WOMEN'S SKY WALKING SHOE (Frost Grey/Aqua SKY/Iron Grey) is very pretty, and feels great when you put it on. However, it's not a good shoe for "power" (exercise) walking. The memory foam doesn't provide much impact cushioning, so the shoe does little to reduce the strain on my knees and hips that results from walking on the sloped concrete sidewalks around my neighborhood. I do like the sole very much, because it provides great traction when the sidewalks are wet or covered with seeds from overhanging trees.

I haven't used these shoes a lot, but my very first impression was that they were NOT well made, given the price (about $43). I believe the reviews that say the memory foam breaks down and that the shoes fall apart after a couple of months of serious exercise walking. The fit isn't bad for me--an 8B always seems to fit, in any shoe--as long as the laces are tight. If I fail to lace the shoes carefully, my feet slide forward and my toes bang against the ends when I walk. So maybe the shoes are a bit shorter than I expected, or maybe I don't need the narrow heel.

The exercise walking shoe that works for me is the [[ASIN:B00GXEFBYM ASICS Women's Gel Tech Neo 4 Walking Shoe]]. The ASICS shoe costs almost twice as much, but the gel cushioning takes a lot of strain off my knees and hips. I rate this RYKA Women's Sky Walking Shoe at a generous 3 stars ("It's okay" on the official Amazon scale).

title: Elegant Lines Go With Everything; Petite Case Looks Good on Woman's Wrist
text:
What I like most about Anne Klein's pretty watches--like this ANNE KLEIN WOMEN'S SWAROVSKI CRYSTAL ACCENTED GOLD-TONE OPEN BANGLE WATCH AND BRACELET SET (AK/2236GBST)--is that the watch cases are downsized to look good on women's wrists. The 26mm diameter cases are quite petite, compared to the 36-37mm diameter cases that are frequently marketed on Amazon as women's watches.

Since many women wear watches today as costume jewelry (because they have cellphones for checking the time), the idea of combining a petite bracelet watch with coordinating bangle bracelets is a terrific one! The watch bracelet in this set can be adjusted to fit your wrist exactly (by removing a link or two), but there's no need to adjust it unless it's so loose that it slips off your hand. Usually the two cuff bangles will be sufficient to hold the watch in place on your wrist, just above your hand.

This particular watch and bracelet set has a simple elegance, because of the openness of the wires that form the three bracelets. I love the Swarovski crystals on the X-shaped cuff bangle and on the bars of the watch bracelet. The mother of pearl face is pretty (shiny, but not too shiny!), and the glitter marking the hours is nice (although Swarovski crystals for the hours would be even nicer). Because of the simplicity of this jewelry set's overall design, I think that the set will go well with everything, from casual sportswear to evening clothes.

title: Good Value, Good Quality, But Too Bulky When Loaded With Cards
text:
This BUXTON HEIRESS DOUBLE CARDEX WALLET is a good quality wallet that affords excellent value for the price (about $23 on Amazon). However, when loaded with cards, it's so bulky and thick, it doesn't fit easily into my purse, and it is hard to handle when I need to remove a card (despite my large hands).

Although I carry only three credit/debit cards, I have a lot of shoppers' rewards cards (e.g., Safeway, Staples) that get regular use. Sadly, the slots don't work well for the rewards cards. The cards inserted into the two lower slots overlap (so you can't see what the card underneath is). Also, the slots are tight, so they hold only one card, and the cards are difficult to remove.

In fact, the extra "page" just adds extra bulk. In addition, the bulk from the cards makes it hard to insert paper money into the long pocket. The coin purse is capacious, and it has a clasp closure, which is good--coin purses with zipper closures tend to "leak" change, and the zippers always break long before the rest of the wallet needs replacing.

If you have a lot of cards to carry, you might want to consider a trifold wallet (e.g., [[ASIN:B01AS61VNK Access Denied Womens Trifold Wallet Slim Line]]). I like this one a lot, because the slots will accept more than one card (so I can group my rewards cards), and the cards are fairly easily removed from the slots. With this wallet, I place my extra cards in a windowed card holder (e.g., [[ASIN:B00QK96WA2 20 Card Plastic Wallet Insert]] (cut in half to reduce bulk and hold only 10 cards)), and put it into the paper money pocket.

Because it's a good quality wallet, but too bulky when loaded with cards, I rate this Buxton Heiress Wallet at 3 stars ("It's okay" on the official Amazon scale).

title: Beautiful Silver Ring, Simple Design; Gorgeous Presentation Box
text:
This WIDE OXIDIZED STERLING SILVER RING WITH DYED CORAL is just so pretty! I prefer silver jewelry to gold, and I love simple designs like this one that use metal "beads" as the main decoration. The presentation box for this ring is gorgeous--there is a black cover (with blue lining) that protects a black side-opening box (with blue lining), which in turn protects a traditional black ring box. The ring box opens with a blue silken tab, and displays the ring on a black velvety background.

The product photo doesn't do this ring justice! The dyed coral gemstones float in the middle of the wide silver band. (There are no trapezoidal silver decorations above and below the stones; instead there are empty spaces, which appear as notches in the center of the band, above and below the stones.) The product photo does show the color of the coral stones quite accurately.

Unfortunately for me, this ring--in size 7--is a half size too small for my ring finger (see my customer photos), and it's too wide to look good on my little finger. Probably it's not the best choice for a person with very small hands. However, if it fits you, it's a beautiful ring with a Southwestern design flavor.

title: Beautiful Watch for "Tailored" Person
text:
When I saw this STUHRLING WOMEN'S STAINLESS STEEL SWAROVSKI CRYSTAL-ACCENTED WATCH WITH BLACK LEATHER BAND on Amazon's Deal of the Day ($54.95), I really liked its looks. Now that I have it on my wrist, I like it every bit as much. The dial has exactly the right amount of sparkle (from the Swarovski crystals marking the hours) for a person like me who prefers tailored or informal sports clothes. The transparent portion of the dial appears dark gray when the watch is on my wrist.

The stainless steel case is perfect, because my body chemistry corrodes base metal or electro-plated metal no matter whether that metal is used for watches, rings, bracelets, or knitting needles! The dial seems large for a women's watch, but my more expensive Wenger women's calendar watch has the same size dial, and the large dial size does make it easy to read the time. The watch keeps very good time.

The leather strap has lots of pre-punched holes, and I don't have to go to the last one to be able to strap the watch firmly to my narrow wrist. I prefer watches with straps to watches with bracelets made of metal links and elaborate folding hinges, because metal bracelets are always loose on my wrist when there are enough links in the bracelet to go over my large hands.

The watch comes in a bright orange presentation case that is encased in a black cardboard protective sleeve. The case includes the warranty (in a little orange envelope), startup instructions, and a microfiber cleaning cloth. The watch is battery-powered. To start it up, you pull out the little plastic tab at the watch stem.

title: June Birthstone Set--Classic Pearls Surrounded by White Topaz Stones That Sparkle Like Diamonds
text:
This STERLING SILVER BIRTHSTONE/WHITE TOPAZ JEWELRY SET, with pearls for a June birthday, is even lovelier than its Amazon photos. The overall design with birthstones surrounded by heart-shaped settings is rather sweet, but the design acquires a simple elegance when the birthstone is a pearl. What could be more classic than pearls surrounded by white topaz stones that sparkle like diamonds?

This set comes in an attractive presentation box covered with silver paper. Of course, it would be even nicer if it were presented in one of Amazon's black suede jewelry boxes--how pretty the pearls would be, against a velvety black insert!

Before you order, be sure to look at the product page video, which shows all three pieces (earrings, necklace, ring) separately in three dimensions. That way you won't be surprised by how the settings look from the back. I like the way they look, but some people don't care for plain backs, and the back of the pendant is lightly stamped with "PAJ 925 China".

Also, note that the ring comes in a size 7. Usually a jeweler can resize a ring to make it a little larger or smaller, but it's easier for a jeweler to cut a ring down than to enlarge it.

title: Perfect Lightweight Summer Bathrobe
text:

The wrap in size medium is right for my size 10/12 figure; there's no extra fabric, but the robe hangs straight and stays closed. (There's an interior tie for holding it closed that doesn't absolutely need to be tied.) The bathrobe looks good on--the first time I wore it, my husband said, "That's cute!"

title: Knitter's Watch With Fun Glue-Ons
text:
What's not to love about this WHIMSICAL KNITTER'S WATCH with the glued-on, three-dimensional, watch face decorations? There's a shiny red sequin heart, and miniature knitting needles on top of cream and lavender bouclé yarn. This is my favorite design of the three basic Whimsical knitter's watch designs. The other two designs are [[ASIN:B001YQGK76 Whimsical Watches Unisex Knitting Watch]], and [[ASIN:B0017GZOV6 Whimsical Watches Women's Christmas Knitting Watch]]. (The Christmas Knitting watch appears to be available in both Unisex and Classic Women's watch shapes).

This watch keeps excellent time, and even has a second hand! The smooth, soft lavender, leather watch band is very comfortable. A nice feature is the two "strap-end holders". When the watch is buckled onto a small wrist like mine, the second end-holder holds the extra strap length down so it doesn't stick out and catch on things.

The smooth leather watch band is very comfortable. A nice feature is the two "strap-end-holders". When the watch is buckled onto a small wrist like mine, the second end-holder holds the extra strap length down so it doesn't stick out and catch on things.

Supportive without being tight. Hold up well after a wash. Air dry. Not sheer. Squat proof. Nice pocket size that is not obviously visible.
Fit as expected. Great price! 5ft 6. 114 lbs. size small.

title: Cute and Comfy
text: Theses are very cute. Super lightweight and soft. They offer no support-more like a lightweight pajama than a yoga pant. I am 114lbs and 5ft 6. I ordered a small. I carry my weight in my thighs, so this was a very UNflattering look for me. If you like to show it off, they are for you!

title: Feel like Lulus
text: Fit as expected. Supportive and workout safe, not sheer. Wash well. Pockets will hold your phone. Great price. I will buy again!

title: Long tails
text: Tails are hard to tuck as they are super long. Too long to wear out as it looks sloppy.

title: Perfect size
text: This is the perfect size. It holds my phone, keys, a lipstick, and if I squish, my glasses. The small zipper pocket inside holds my cash/credit card. The strap is adjustable. I wore it on a casual night out and it worked perfectly.

title: Perfect size
text: The size is just right. It holds my wallet, cell phone, keys, lipstick. Great for a night out without the bulk of a full-sized bag.Dressy.  Not crazy about the shiny gold chain.

title: Comfortable.
text: I think they are comfortable and fun! I like the pants/jeans look rather than legging look.  I wear them with sneakers, a white t-shirt and oversized black cardigan. They don’t have a lot of stretch, but they fit well. More of a charcoal grayish-black than a true midnight black. I am 5ft 6 and 114lbs (short-legged) and I got a small. If my knees touch while walking, there is some swishing sound, so be cognizant of what your body does as you move. If your thighs or knees consistently rub, and you will be self-conscious of a little swishing sound, these may not be for you.Can I get them in another color? :)

title: Thin
text: Very thin “sweater”. Buttons are a little dark for the light-colored sweater. It is a fairly short sweater. I partially tuck it in my faux leather leggings and wear another cardigan over. It will be cute with jeans, but not a high-end look.

title: Feel and fit like my LL’s!
text: Feels smooth and silky. Very lightweight and comfortable but not see-through. They wash well. I hang to dry. LOVE these! I ordered two more!

title: Run small
text: I have worn these for years. Finally broke and ordered again. I had to reorder a size larger. (?) Light weight. I wash in the washing machine to clean every few months as needed with jeans or similar fabric. Gentle cycle. Air dry. Look new.

title: Lightweight silky
text: Love these! Silky and lightweight with great support, but not sheer. Fit and feel like my high-priced trendy yoga pants. I ordered another set in both long and 3/4 length. Size S. My sister, sister-in-law, AND friend all love these as well! Keepers!

title: Runs small. Size up at least one size. Great material.
text: Great fabric. Super fitted, so size up at least one size.

title: A lot of coverage
text: Almost a full-footed coverage which is what I wanted.  They don’t show in my booties, but stay put all day.

title: Just enough stretch
text: I bought these as an interim shoe after a bunionectomy. They stretch just enough so I can get my foot inside without bending my toe too much. They act as a compression shoe and keep my swelling down all day. Cute and comfortable with moderate support for my aching feet. Very light weight. I will continue to wear for daily use, but not for true exercise.

title: Little compression.
text: Not much compression.  Foot still swells.  Feels like just a sock.

title: I like them…They’re a little too thick, but really comfy.
text: I am hoping after a few washes that they won’t seem quite as thick so I can wear them with my other pair of shoes. Well made. Not made in china.

title: Foot too small, calf too big, one zipper didn’t work
text: The pair that arrived had the outer zippers that didn’t function. The footbed ran really small, I could hardly get my foot in it. I had sized up, too. There definitely was no room for an orthotic. However, they are rather cute.

title: Not sure if it’ll hold up but works now
text: I’m not able to wear most bras so when I find one that doesn’t make me writhe with pain, I buy them. This one works. I’m not ready buy a heap of these yet. But this’ll do for now.

title: Very small in the neck.
text: I think this works for me but my neck is small for my size and this was rather small to get over the head for this turtleneck addict. It may not work someone with a thicker neck or bigger size head. The color is lovely Newport blue. Arm holes are too big, showing a bra, so I’d only use it as a layering piece.

title: Uncomfortable and irritating
text: No luck with this one. I need a true comfort bra. And way overpriced.

title: Better than the big bucks brands! Try ‘em.
text: Right off the bat (or out of the box) superior comfort with support. I’ll update you after 3 or more months to tell you whether or not they fall apart as easily or as quickly as the vionic ones do. At least these are a huge savings compared the Vionic. I think the support is actually a bit better than the Vionic’s are for my very high arches. The materials are great and soft without being slippery. The sole is a smidge higher than the Vionic. The strap with Velcro is better than the other brands for wider feet. Kudos! They’re a winner.

title: Yes 🙌  and I want another
text: Pretty, comfortable and perfect length I that it’s not too long nor too short. This washes so well, too. Zero shrinkage.

title: Smaller than I expected, but fine.
text: They are too small for my husband to use as a nose & mouth covering for CVD-19, so we’ll use them folded to line other masks 😷  But quality wise they wash up well, and are fine for a traditional handkerchief.

title: Gorgeous Gloves but Bad Smell
text: These gloves feel beautiful and look beautiful.  They are well made. Quick response from the company for sizing suggestions. Sadly, I can’t stomach the bad smell, though. I’ve been airing them out for days because of the smell and it hasn’t dissipated.  The scent differs from every leather gloves I’ve ever owned. Returning.

title: Sad that these don’t work for me.
text:
Positives: Buttery soft, beautiful gloves. Appear to be well made, surprised by the whole hand touchscreen abilities when I’ve been used to only a couple of digits with previous gloves. Pinky and ring fingers are adequate in lengths. These gloves make a lovely gift...thank you hubby!

Negatives: Runs small and tight around hand pinching top of hand, first 3 digits (thumb, index/pointer finger, and middle finger) all run short so nails would be a problem. They don’t offer a size up if you usually wear a 7.5.

Removing a star ⭐️ for the length issues.

Disappointed that I have to return them and find a better fitting pair.

If your fingers are shorter and you do not wear medium long nails, these may work great for you. You will want to size up.

title: Thumbs up 👍🏻
text: These were a hit with the ladies.

title: This reindeer made one little girl very happy!
text: Seems more quality than the other items that I got from different vendors. She loves it and looks great in it.

title: They need to move the tail up on the rear not between the legs
text: It’s cute, but the tail is so low that it could be misconstrued as something else.

title: I’m liking these a lot!
text: I’m wearing these for the very first time today. They are warm, but not too warm.  They are very comfortable and they stay up well. I think that I could use some additional colors. They would make a great gift for friends in cold climates to wear under their dresses or skirts.

title: Disappointed. Back they go.
text: I was looking for quality to wear with winter coat. These weren’t it. They weren’t fluffy like the pics. They’re not soft, but actually a very itchy synthetic feeling. I’m surprised that they are so big when most reviews claimed they ran small. I have a 7 inch wrist and these wouldn’t work even if all the other things were fine. Returning them.

title: I think it fits great and is really comfortable.
text: I love long sleeve polos. This one wash as well, and dries well too in the machine. I really like the color and may just have to order some additional shirts in some of the other colors.

title: Just what I was looking!
text: This bra is just what I’ve been looking for, perfect for hot humid summer days. Keeps the twins in check.  I’m ordering more.

title: I had high hope, but it’s a No Go.
text: These were the worst. Although the material feels good, the aren’t long enough by any means. They might be long enough for someone less than 5 ft. tall. It was a huge disappointment.  So, my search still continues to find a comfortable, durable, not too hot 🥵 brand of stockings.

title: Good size for my Rosary 📿
text: For my patriotic Rosary with all 50 states, this pouch is beautiful blue & white on the outside and a nice deep red velour interior. The zipper works smoothly. No complaints.

title: It’s cute + great size. Ready for light scarf season.
text: This is a nice gold toned scarf ring that matches some jewelry that I own.  It’s larger than another scarf ring that I received with a chiffon scarf/shawl also on Amazon. The ring size of this Luxiv I’m guessing, is about a 6.5 up to a 7, as the silver one is a size 6. This will work well with chiffons, silks, satin, and possibly lace.  I’m looking forward to wearing it soon. It fits well over my index finger as you may see in my pic, so it’s not that small.  I won’t work over a thick winter scarf or a thick pashmina. If you want a scarf ring for those, I’d recommend a stretchy bracelet perhaps in a tweens’ size. Blessings!

title: Nice, but I want it longer.
text: I bought it for modesty but it wasn’t quite long enough. I really wish it were 3 inches longer for modesty while seated in a wheelchair. It doesn’t work on my hips as it slid down. But I loved 💝 that it wasn’t tight nor binding on my true waist and hips when hanging from waist. It worked over my bust as well. It washed up well. The material is comfortable and not itchy 👍🏻 .Customer service is very knowledgeable, courteous and prompt about washing instructions that I was unclear of, and I so appreciate that 👍🏻 .  Almost a 5 ⭐️ for my body. Clearly it would be if it were longer and didn’t slip from hips.

title: Everything fits fine, but arms are too big for me
text: I sized down and the arms are still big on me. The rest fits fine (but I did note “Too Large” on the fit survey if you’re looking at that is something you are looking into. If you’ve had a tremendous amount of weight loss and have skinny but batwing upper arms similar to mine you’ll want to size down at least one size. I wish I had sized down 2 sizes. I’m not sure if the chest band will be too tight if I order the next smaller size, though, but I know the arms will be better. I’ll rewrite my review if I opt to get the smaller size.

title: Beautiful dress, but shrunk with dry cleaning.
text:
July 09, 19 I’m very impressed by the quality of the material. It’s not a flimsy dress! It has weight. I have small shoulders, so the shoulders don’t fit me very well, but I love the rest of it. If I choose to keep it I think I’ll have it altered in the shoulders.

Update: August 15, 2019:
I wearing it for the very first time. It shrunk from the dry cleaning. I’m really disappointed.

title: Great fabric but odd sizing.
text:
I wear a 22, so ordered the larger plus size. They’re too big. I hope the smaller size will work for me. The fabric feels fabulous. If I were 20 lbs. heavier or more, the larger plus size may have worked.

Update the smaller size was too small. If I were 20 lbs lighter the small may have fit me.

I removed one ⭐️ because there really should be an in between size.

If you aren’t on the cusp these may work great for you.

I was looking for a fitted pair of leggings with a bit of support to them.

title: Other than they’re too large, these are 👍🏻
text: I wear a 22, so ordered the larger plus size, per the chart. These were too large for me in the legs and looked a bit baggy on my fat legs. I was delighted that they seemed like a summer weight for leggings, though and thought you’d like to know.  I’m returning them and discerning whether or not to order the smaller size. They are soft and comfortable, which is a huge plus. They came up over my natural waistline which is what I was wanting.

title: The girls loved them!
text: I gave our grand girls these animal socks for a cutesy Christmas present 🎁 . They loved them! Score!

title: Nice, but a bit too big and long
text: Nice fabric. I’ve washed twice now. They’re an inch or two longer than what I was expecting but I like them enough that I kept them. A little big.

title: Way too long.
text: I really wanted this to work out as I need to replace some compression tanks that are past their prime. I’m tall for a woman and yet this is so long that it almost reaches my knees. The tag is also very irritating, just so you know. It was easier to get on that to take off.

title: It’s the perfect size!
text: I gave this as a gift. The recipient is quite pleased! It’s a good quality for the price. The clasp is easy to use and well made, too.

title: Comfortable but could be warmer.
text: It’s super lightweight, and not bulky at all and I like that. It’s not as warm as I’d like since I’m trying to replace a harsh winter coat for the snow belt. I think it will be fine for the 40’s, 50’s & 60’s, though. I bought up in size as other reviews said they run small.  I have plenty of room for layering without feeling like I’m swimming in it without multiple layers. I like the inside zipper pocket at the chest as my 5.5 inch phone fits nicely. The pockets on the outside are comfortable.  The zipper up the coat isn’t easy on arthritic hands , so I do wish that it also had snaps. But I’m really grateful that it doesn’t have Velcro!

title: Comfortable but they shed fuzz from the interior of the slippers.
text: He says they’re comfortable, so that makes them a keeper. They shed red fuzz everywhere, so if that would irritate you, you might pick a different brand. I only wish they came in narrow as well.

title: 2 compliments from strangers in 5 minutes
text: I wear a 22 & I bought the Christmas 🎄 Black in the 4x for a Christmas party. It’s really cute. I anticipate that I’ll wear this a few times before Christmas this year and again next year. I’m tall and it falls below my knees. Sleeves are the perfect length, too. I’m not sure how well that it’ll wash, but I’ll let you know if I find an issue.

title: They wear well, and they wash well.
text: My husband likes them.

title: I should have returned it.
text: I bought this in gray, and it irritates my skin. It’s super hot to wear, isn’t long enough and way too wide despite having measured correctly.

title: Protection From Hot Steering Wheel.
text: Nice for summertime. Let’s face it, who likes holding a super hot steering wheel when it’s  100° outside and car has been parked in the sunshine? These are nice enough for Church. Not all of the touchscreen tips work, but the thumb ones do. They snag easily on jewelry, maybe remove your diamonds or settle for slight snags.

title: Blue one floral, nice, but has a few minor creases
text: I bought the blue, and I was surprise when it arrived that it was actually a floral print hat that will look good with a variety of solid colors, including various shades of blue and green. The ribbon is lovely. The only issue I have is that it has some slight creases.  But what a wonderful design, to have a reasonably priced hat that folds into a small baggie for travel, and basically pops into place. I’m still working on minor adjustments that were recommended above.

title: It’s a keeper!
text: I love it! I wore it to Mass on Sunday for the first time under a dress that was my mother’s worn in her honor on Mother’s Day. I would usually wear a turtleneck. But with the 90+ temp it would have been unbearable. With this, I was comfortable all day. It’s soft, modest and not irritating to my sensitive skin. So great I bought another one, it washes up well and makes so many clothing items more modest. I think I’m going to be a Kosher Casual customer for life ❤️

title: A Buckeye Fan’s Favorite.
text: I really like the message! Go Bucks! Beat Michigan....again & again.

title: Comfortable Gold Toe socks.
text: He loves Gold Toe socks 🧦. I find them easy to match once washed. They are comfortable all day.

title: He and the family liked it. I’m not sure how white it has ...
text: We gave this to one of our Grands.  He and the family liked it.  I’m not sure how white it has remained, but boys will be boys ;-)

title: Nice shirt & tie 👔 set.
text: Lovely color, useful tie.  The shirt isn't the best quality, but it works. It washes up nicely.  Cool & comfortable enough for warmer weather.

title: Nice & comfortable fit
text: Comfortable and they don't cause any issues.  You really can't get better than Gold Toe. He prefers these.

title: Okay shirts, why the wrinkles?
text: We bought the red as well as the white shirts. They were super wrinkled upon arrival, and remained so even after washing. He hasn't worn them yet.

title: I need directions to return this.
text: The pic of this tunic looked so cute. I had wanted it to have the flirty hem that would look a little like a peplum over my pants.  The sizing is off...way off.  It clings to the hips and is way too tight to be considered modest.  I really dislike the unfinished edge at the cowl. With the material so thin, I doubt it will last.  On a good note, it's a pretty blue.

title: Needs different shoelaces.
text: The shoestrings do not remain tied, that's his only complaint. The shoes are comfortable and appear to be of good quality.

title: Super cute, she is excited about them!
text: They are really cute and well liked by our little grand. She's an 8 year old who really is into birds.  They seemed a little small, but she is still thrilled to have them.

title: Short Lifespan, Retired too soon
text: The wallet snap broke within two weeks. I did not last through my trip. The purse however  lasted about a month and a half before it started getting holes in it.  If you're getting it for a short trip for protection that's perfect.  But it isn't for everyday. The passport fits in the wallet perfectly, and the pockets are plentiful in the purse.  I like a little flashlight, and even though I no longer use the purse or wallet I keep a little flashlight in my purse that I use now.

title: Feels like an expensive cotton shirt!
text: I bought this for my husband, whose white shirts were getting a bit too worn-looking. I love the look of cotton, but it requires too much ironing to keep it looking crisp. This 60/40 cotton/poly blend looks great! Heavy, not sheer, with the hand feel of cotton, and none of that shiny polyester look. I may need to buy him another one…this would make a great tunic-length shirt for me!

title: Well made and great fun!
text: Well-constructed and very funny- the drooping claws are a great touch.

title: Good fit, great price
text: Great fit: not too tight around the legs, so it doesn't make a bulge.

title: Low waist, runs very large.
text: Fabric was good, and not too thin. But I thought the cut was all wrong: legs were really loose, and waist hit a couple of inches below natural waistline.

title: Not just for men: great womens tunic!
text: I am a female, and I love these shirts! The fabric drapes well without being clingy or too sheer. The tall size is tunic length, perfect with leggings or yoga pants. They are wonderful for travel: wash and dry easily, thin enough to layer. I wish this style came in a long-sleeve version, it would be perfect for layering under winter sweaters.

title: Wonderful, cozy shirt!
text: I bought a larger size than I usually would, thinking this would shrink like most cotton sleep shirts. But it doesn't! And really soft, compared to all cotton shirts. Tagless, and smooth seams- I love it. I've bought four!

title: great product, bad shipping
text: These are great..hold you in without being tight or uncomfortable. Opaque, but not thick or dowdy looking.They are so popular, they were out of my size locally. On Amazon, they were sold by Essential Apparel, in stock, free shipping. Great, I thought, ordered them December 2 to wear to a holiday party on Dec 12. Amazon said estimated ship date was Dec 6-11. Emailed company today, was told they would arrive tommorow, the 12th! I,ve ordered plenty of items on Amazon during this holiday season...10 days to ship one pair of tights?!? Bottom line for YOUR "bottom line" ladies, don't order from Essential apparel if you need something in less than two weeks.

title: Love it!
text: Great onesie for wintery nights, cold Halloweens, frosty Christmas morning! Super soft, durable, and very warm. I'm extremely happy with my purchase!

title: Pictures don't do it justice
text: I have purchased a couple of Travelambo wallets and love the soft leather quality. This wallet meets my needs far better than other brand wallets I have used. I love all the pockets and space for items. The light blue color is very pretty, the material is very durable. This was one of the best choices for a wallet I could have made.

title: Soft material, well made.
text: Rfid blocking is very important to me. This wallet is really well made. Simple design, plenty of room. Great quality. Really happy with my purchase!

text: Seemingly Great boot-  though I sent back for a different brand. They were comfortable at first glance. Good and fair seller

title: Not disappointed, can't imagine why anyone would be
text: Very pretty. I do believe it's great for all figures. The way it's designed it does flatter even people that aren't stick figures. I'm very happy for what I got and the price very very fair. Highly recommend

title: Face the fact, $20..price is appropriate. Fantastic Alternative to the $100+ Ray Bans. I feel at home in them☮♏️
text:
These righteous glasses are quite dark... Though, I read this many times in reviews. I knew... So it's my responsibility to admit I expected dark. They aren't small enough for a child, unless it's he/she is a large child. I'm 47 yrs old, and average size. Not big head, nor tiny.
Ideally, I would buy the Ray Bans in this style. Not in budget, and this is a Fantabulous ALTERNATIVE..... EVERYone that sees me in them says " Perfect! They are sooooo you! Deadhead until I'm dead🎼🎼🎼🎼

text:
Pretty, but stone fell off after 2nd wear... i used tweezers to adjust both pair so it wouldn't happen again. Give the product 3 stars, & me 5 stars.
Looong wait for shipping-- worth it for the $$$

title: Awesome
text: Quality at a rockstar price

title: good. Runs 2 sz sm
text: Good quality shirt. Runs very small. Pay attention to the sizing chart, which is different then US sizes. I ordered two sizes up

title: Love this!
text: Fun!!

title: Perfect
text: A silver chain, perfect, as described- and i'm very happy with it.  I like to change my pendants, this works for doing that

title: WOW!
text: This cost HOW MUCH!? Worth every damn cent,and minute you wait for it to arrive- Cannot be beat. Gorgeous, looks awesome on! It is large, though, so you must like large rings

title: Comfortable and flattering.
text: These were true to size and fit like a dream. The fabric feels a bit like swimsuit material, so took a little getting used to, but they do breath well and are very comfortable. Also very flattering (especially how they've worked the cut/seams in the back)! The cut-outs in the legs are a fun, sassy touch and elevate these leggings to something with a bit more style.

title: Some of the best plus sized jeans I've tried!
text: I am loving these jeans! Which I don't say very often as a size 22 pear-shaped woman. They have a lower rise than I prefer, but the awesome fit more than makes up for that. They fit close, but are flattering, and suuuuuuper comfortable. They aren't bulky at all, and almost feel like wearing yoga pants, but are really stylish. I love the darker wash with just the right amount of fading. The length is also perfect for me at 5' 6". As others have mentioned, the front pockets are shallow and mostly useless. But I don't tend to carry things in my pockets, so this is not an issue. Honestly, I'm off to buy another pair or two of these jeans!

title: Stylish and flattering.
text: Beautiful, simple, stylish. Fit true to size, and is very flattering. Warmer than expected, too, for being so lightweight. This is a well made jacket, perfect for times when you don't need to bundle up, but still need to ward off a chill.

title: A miss for me.
text: I like the Lee brand, but many of their products are hit or miss for me. These were a miss. They did not fit true to my size, and hugged in all the wrong places. They are also just too light for my taste (much harder to mask different "problem areas").

title: Cool, classic, and super stylish.
text: So excited about this jacket!! It fits true to size, and the cut (just to the waist) is very flattering. The color is fantastic - cool, old school denim. This is a classic piece, stylish and very well made, and an awesome staple addition to your wardrobe.

title: A simple, lovely necklace.
text: This necklace is lovely, simple, and goes with everything. I like that the chain is finer than most, but that means taking some caution in wearing and storing (ie: I won't wear this around my 6mo grandson, who tends to grab at jewelry). I also think the design is very clever, in that the smaller chain with the pearl easily slides along the longer chain. This is a really pretty piece that will become a staple in my wardrobe.

title: Fantastic length, comfort, and coverage.
text: So, so, so comfortable. Warm, great length, perfect inner tie and outer sash. The pockets are great. Love that it covers me up completely. I fall in between a 2x/3x and went up to the 3x on this one. It's quite roomy, but I don't mind (and it cinches down well with the sash). But I would say it runs a little big. Who cares, though - this is like wearing a favorite cozy blanket around the house!

title: Oddly sized.
text: I do like how soft and simple these are. But they are just oddly sized, running large overall, with incredibly long pants. Even for a plus size figure, you'd have to be very tall to have these fit properly. They are comfortable to sleep in, but not particularly warm, so not my favorite choice for winter.

title: Dressy, but comfortable. Perfect!
text: I was skeptical that these would work well for my 16yo son. They are a material and fit that he normally doesn't wear, but we thought we'd give them a try. He loves them! They are tapered, so almost look like a skinny jean at first, but are much more flattering than that. And the blend of synthetics makes them incredibly comfortable. He's not necessarily using these for everyday wear, but for activities like choir, theater, and ballroom dance - places where he needs to be able to move well. These have been been perfect for that, and they look so dressy and professional on stage.

title: Thumbs up (if you like high cut).
text: Turns out, I'm not a huge fan of the high cut - who knew! (I guess I'm more of a full coverage brief girl?) No fault of these panties, though. I like the understated designs on these, and love that nothing pinches or digs on the waist or legs. They fit well according to the size chart. And I've been using them while walking for exercise, and everything stays put. If high cut is your style, these are a great choice.

title: Stylish details, run small through the shoulders.
text: The details on this coat are so impressive, and make it a classy, stylish choice. It's a great length, and good, neutral color. I agree with other reviews in that this runs small. I was actually fine through the waist, but the shoulders were very tight, making it a bit uncomfortable. I would recommend sizing up on this coat (and cinching with the sash at the waist if necessary).

title: Lovely, everyday piece to wear.
text: This is a lovely watch that has become my regular, go-to piece to wear every day. The blue is really attractive, and neutral enough that I wear it with everything. I'm a plus-size girl with larger wrists, and I initially found the band too small for me, but I used some leather stretcher (https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B00NLM8EL6 - typically used for shoes), and got it to a length that fit just right. One frustration: the dials for date and day were laughably difficult to set. I still don't know how I finally got them set, which is a problem, because now I need to set them again because of February's short month. But honestly, I don't read those dials very often since they are so tiny, though they do add to the overall attraction in the design. I am genuinely pleased with this dynamic, but not gaudy, watch and would recommend it to others!

title: The perfect finishing touch for Homecoming!
text: We bought this for my daughter to wear under the [[ASIN:B012ADYUHI Miusol Womens Classy Vintage Audrey Hepburn Style 1940's Rockabilly Evening Dress]] for Homecoming, and it was perfect! She wears a size 8, and we ordered the small/medium, and it fit very well. The top portion was comfortable, and she could fluff out the crinoline or set it down a bit, depending on her mood. She could sit, stand, and dance comfortably, and the length was perfect for the dress. It really brought it to life and was the perfect finishing touch!

title: Mediocre style and value.
text: I love and prefer silver jewelry, so was excited to receive this necklace. I was underwhelmed by it, though. The pendant is much larger than I would consider "in style" these days, and certainly larger than I typically wear. I do like that it's quite a shiny silver, and the celtic-like design is pretty. I just wish it were smaller, or a little more delicate. The chain is on the short side, which I prefer, but it's a dull silver compared to the pendant, and has tiny links; it does not feel sturdy and seems like it will break easily. Considering I would likely change this pendant to a different chain if I were to wear it regularly, the $20 (for basically the pendant) is more than I would typically pay. Just a 3-star "it's okay" necklace/style/value in my book.

title: Stunning, modest, perfect fit.
text: My daughter's Senior Prom was last weekend, and right up until 2 days before the event, she STILL had not found a dress. I decided to see what was available on Amazon, and we stumbled upon this dress. We ordered it in 2 sizes, had it over-nighted to us, and IT WAS PERFECT!!! Pay close attention to the sizing chart they offer in the product description - we used that for ordering, and she fit their exact specifications. Normally she wears an 8, but she fit their "6," and even though we ordered both just to be sure, the 6 was perfect. (thank goodness for the free returns!) The dress came a little wrinkled, but took just moments to steam. It is gorgeous in person, and the green in particular is stunning. There were maybe only two or three others girls in green at her prom, so she felt lovely standing out. This is a wonderful combination of lace and chiffon, and I love that it's so modest & can easily be worn with regular undergarments.My daughter is about 5'7" and was able to comfortably wear flats with the dress. She had so much fun looking like a princess, and yet still being completely comfortable. She's worn the dress on one other occasion since, with a cropped silver satin shrug over her shoulders, and it looked just as lovely (she also brought a mesh silver shawl for the night of the prom, and it paired well with the dress, too - http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B001EOFC86/ref=oh_aui_search_detailpage?ie=UTF8&psc=1). This really was the PERFECT dress for our needs, and at literally 1/3 the cost of comparable dresses we were looking at in formal dress shops. So happy!!

I'm a plus-size, and the outer sash is not quite effective enough to keep the robe all the way closed at my chest and waist - I will probably add something to help with that (like a button, or safety pin maybe?). title: Comfortable, quality socks. Fits as expected
text: I like these socks. The size M/L size fits my size 12 men's foot well. The compression on the socks is good and they kept my feet dry all day. Each sock is marked L and R, so the fit is definitely more form-fitted, which I like. The toes and heels have extra cushioning that you can feel, but despite that they still fit as expected. The socks don't feel slippery in my shoes while wearing them, which is something I've noticed with other hiking socks I've tried. Given how they feel and have held up so far, I think these will be pretty durable going forward.

title: Great packing cubes!
text:
These were my first set of packing cubes, and I definitely see the hype. This set comes with 5 cubes of various sizes, which is perfect for packing in my carry-on (I refuse to check a bag). The cubes are pre-labeled with suggestions of what to put inside, which is a nice touch. There is also a clear cube for your toiletries (which I use for chargers because I have a toiletry bag already).

The cubes are water repellent, but I did not try to submerge them or anything. The cubes otherwise feel well-made and the zipper works easily on all of them. I expect these will hold up well over time.

Great cubes for a great price!

title: High quality socks!
text: These are good socks. They fit as expected, the elastic is good, and the colors are vibrant. They are lightweight, breathable, and they feel good on the foot (not only fit-wise, but also comfort). They stay in place while running and after a couple days of wear, they still look brand new. I expect these will hold up pretty well going forward. I'd recommend these!

title: A little underwhelmed. Started pilling within hours!
text:
I know of Merrell. It's a brand that makes high quality things, which was why I was surprised with these socks.

The good: the blue color of these is vibrant and the socks fit as expected.

The bad: they were pilling after only a few hours of wear (around the house, no-less!) See the pics to see what I'm referring to. Obviously not the end of the world, but if it's pilling after a couple hours around the house, I'm not sure about its long-term durability.

title: Beautiful! Looks very expensive
text:
I love watches. Everything about them. Digital, analog, quartz, automatic, complications, bands. I love it all.

This watch doesn't disappoint. It has a quartz movement with a date complication at the 6 o'clock. When you unbox it, the first thing you notice is the aesthetic--it looks very regal. It is black/gold/silver in color and has roman numerals on the dial (everything but the "12" is marked by 1's). I think this type of watch thrives in more formal settings. Not to say you couldn't rock this in an undershirt and shorts, but it really shines with a suit.

The default band size was a little bit for my small wrists, but it is perfect now after taking out a couple links. I've gotten a couple compliments on the watch already, too!

If you are in the market for a nice watch that won't break the bank, go for this!

title: Surprisingly good! Lululemon on watch!
text:
I've been really impressed with these leggings. Lots to love here. First off, they are squat-proof (i.e., not see-through), which is probably the easiest way to tell the difference between high- and low-quality leggings. Additionally, they don't pill after washing (washed 3x so far), another hallmark of lower-quality leggings.

These also are pretty supportive and have some compression. They feel slimming. These are high-rise leggings and they do not fall throughout the day, unlike the Lululemon Align leggings (which are also more expensive). These are also great for sweat absorption during workouts. These were great during 2 hours of tennis.

My only concern is that the Peloton branding might come off after repeated washes, but that's unavoidable given the Peloton logo isn't embroidered.

I definitely recommend these. Get them and don't look back.

title: Great vest! Fits well and has a nice heater!
text:
This is my first heated vest and I have been very impressed. There are three separate heating zones: the stomach, the neck, and the lower back, and each are controlled separately using buttons on the front of the vest.

The vest fits as expected. The battery pocket for the vest is a little bit smaller than I would have liked, as my rectangular, 7.5" long (I'm estimating) battery pack was too big for the pocket to zip. So you'll probably need a smaller/square shaped battery.

My biggest gripe with the vest is that it does not come with any battery, but I knew that from the outset. If you're going to be using a heated vest regularly, it might make sense to get a dedicated battery for it.

Overall, I'd recommend this vest!

title: Quality and comfort. Great for running!
text:
I got these sunglasses for running on sunny days, and they do not disappoint! I wanted polarized, UV 400 sunglasses, and these are great! The red lenses are low strain and great for increasing road visibility, which was important for me. Unlike other sunglasses (and eyeglasses), these don't slide down my nose, which is obviously very important while running. The arms of the glasses are not uncomfortably tight, but they are tight enough to ensure the glasses stay put on my head.

Another feature that I liked about these sunglasses are that they have adjustable nose pads (although the standard position was perfect for me). They came well packaged with a cleaning cloth and a zippered case.

This was my first pair of Zenni sunglasses, and I am very impressed by the product and the quality. Would definitely recommend.

title: Nice bag overall
text:
I've been using this bag for nearly a week now and wanted to share my thoughts. Overall it's a nice gym bag-- big enough for anything I want to take to the gym (usually a change of clothes/shoes, shower sandals, shower kit, etc.). The bag is also very lightweight, which I appreciate.

The zippers seem to be of good quality and the straps feel sturdy. My only complaint is that the bag itself feels a little flimsier than I would have liked. For example, it if its empty, it seems to just fall over/into itself vs standing upright. Not a huge issue now, but I hope that this issue isn't what brings the bag's downfall (I'd assume the zippers are what go first).

title: Not what you expect!!!

title: Nice stretchy shirt but it runs about one size too small & doesn't hang low enough

title: Lightweight comfortable headbands that provide a little ear warmth and look good too
text:
There are five very-thin headbands in this set in black, gray, pink, red, and blue. The headbands are soft and sized well. They even fit my boyfriend (but tightly). They look great on and there is a solid color that will go with most outfits.

However, since they are very thin, they are not overly warm. They just provide the ears with enough warmth when needed. If it is really cold out, a much thicker band is needed.

Nevertheless, for the current price of $15.99, this comes to a competitively priced $3.20 per band. For that price, I consider this a reasonable purchase.

title: Lightweight socks w/ mild compression; I ordered one size larger; easy to get on w/zipper
text:
Periodically I wear compression socks to help me with my plantar fasciitis. However, I find it incredibly difficult to get those socks on my feet and they tend to be uncomfortable over time. I ordered these in the XL because I wanted to make it easier to get on even though I take a large. They were very easy to get on and that was made easier because of the zipper but I did have to use two hands to close the zipper. The heels are where they need to be, it's just that these are a tad looser on me than they would have been had I ordered the correct size.

Closing the zipper requires me to squeeze both sides together but I still found that easy to do. See the photo of the fit on my leg.

These are comfortable especially since the compression is mild both as a result of the design of the sock and also the larger size.

There are two pairs in this package. These socks are of medium thickness and they are decent quality for the $12.99 price, which comes to a cheap $6.50 each pair.

I wash all my compression socks in a lingerie bag in the washer and then lay them flat to dry or tumble dry on low. These recommend hand washing, however.

In summary, these are decent compression socks for a cheap price. If one is looking for better compression, then the price would be double this if not more. They are true to size and offer enough compression over the calf area and just a moderate amount in the foot and arch area. The material around the zipper is sometimes felt as it is worn.

UPDATE: I wore these a couple of times and they are very comfortable. Of course, there are zipper marks on my legs after use.

title: Excellent leather case for keys w/o caps, some cash, cards, etc.
text:
This is an excellent leather coin/cash purse as long as one does not put in thick car keys inside. The jacket-type zippered pocket in front contains hooks for six keys. The center zippered compartment has three credit-card-sized folder pockets and the central compartment itself. I put a thick wad of bills in there along with three credit cards and they fit perfectly. Of course, with such a wad of cash, it makes it difficult to add the keys because it was "one side bulky." The back side has a zippered compartment for coins. In addition, this comes with a wrist strap that I hooked on to this side.

This is definitely genuine leather and the one I received is well made. All three zippers glide easily. This is an excellent leather case for those who will use this to store flat keys (not bulky car keys. I love it. If one needs to store car keys that have alarms, etc. in this, pass on this.

Another thing I forgot to mention is that the photo on the front of the package shows the heel guards going into the ball of the shoe and the instructions are in broken English. For instance, one instruction says "Remove the mucous on the back."

title: Sturdy shoehorn that will last a lifetime; an absolutely worthwhile purchase
text:
This is the third one of this brand of shoehorn that I purchased. In January of 2016 I paid $29.99 for the 21" version and loved it so much that I wanted the same one but longer so that I could put my shoes on standing up. Therefore, in June of 2020, I purchased the 26" one for $25.99 which is perfect for use standing up. However, my smaller 12" shoehorn of a different make and model got bent and I wanted one that I could use sitting down also. The 21" and 26" are too large for that. Therefore, this 15" one that I purchased in July of 2021 for $22.99 is PERFECT.

I love how sturdy this is and how easy it is to use. Also, the three gripping ridges on the underside of the handle provides a great grip and the hanging loop is useful for those who want to hang this up. This is so durable, it will outlive me.

I really only need two shoehorns--one for standing and one for sitting. Unfortunately, I did not know about the 26" one until after I purchased the 21" one. Had I known, I would only buy the 15" and the 26" because one is perfect for sitting (12" would have been better) and the other is perfect for standing (the 26").

In summary, this brand is the best and I have never come across any that are as strong as these. Note that this one also comes with a shoe shine cloth; the others did not.

title: Stunning overnight bag; truly high quality; colorful & large
text:
I ordered this [[ASIN:B08TPHL58Y Makeup Brush and Pencil Case]] a couple of weeks ago and love it so much that I had to order this matching overnight bag.

This bag is larger than I expected and is absolutely stunning. I love the colors and the quality is superior as I expect from Vera Bradley.  All the zippers glide open and glide close easily. The entire bag is thick and feels padded. The central compartment is cavernous.

On the exterior front, there is one zippered pocket and a folder pocket behind that. There is one folder pocket on each side of the bag. The interior has two mesh folder pockets; one that is more like a bottle-sized pocket and another that is a little bit longer. The rest of the central compartment is just wide, open, undivided space.

There are two handles for carrying and also a padded shoulder strap if one prefers to carry it that way.

This is made from recycled cotton yet I would never know it. The current price of $100 is typical of Vera Bradley prices and it's high quality all the way and very large. If one is a minimalist, I can see this being sufficient for a week's vacation in the summer depending on the thickness and size of the clothes and number of shoes carried. For me it is plenty sufficient for a weekend.

title: Beautiful looking; very comfortable; perfect for the boardwalk or as slippers
text:
Several years back I purchased a pair of [[ASIN:B01IIQ20BE Skechers Performance Women's On The Go 400 Tropical Flip Flop]] at DSW and wore them as slippers in the house. They were the most comfortable sandal slippers I have ever worn. Unfortunately they wore out and I needed a new pair. I decided to order these as they are also the "GO WALK" style.

These are very comfortable. They look like my old slippers except they have a hot pink top sole and pink floral fabric. However, even though they look the same, they are not the same five-star comfort as the old ones I threw out but they come very close.

I've been wearing these now for a couple of weeks as my slippers and I love them. They would also be perfect for the boardwalk or beach. Note that I purchased them in the "white flower" color but they no longer have that style in stock.

title: Very comfortable to stand in but not that comfortable to walk in
text:
When I first tried these on I was impressed. However, after walking a little bit with these, I would never purchase them again.

LIKES
- They are very comfortable to stand in because it feels like I am standing on a soft cushion of air.

DISLIKES
- When I walk with them I feel like I have to exert a lot of foot muscle strength just to keep them on my feet and my feet get tired.

- The arch support is good but not great.

- Because they feel airy, it feels like these will wear out rapidly.

- They make my feet sweat like clogs.

- The red color I ordered comes off on my feet and/or socks

In summary, I would not purchase them again had I known what it would feel like to wear them for a few blocks. They claim that these are machine washable but what good is that if the color runs. They are very comfortable as slippers but not really good for me for outside wear.

title: Heavy fanny pack made with quality leather; hole for ear plugs
text:
This is a quality leather fanny pack. the only thing not leather are the zippers and the waist strap. As a result, this is heavy when empty and weighs over 10 ounces.

This is a slim profile pack, so there is only room for a wallet, phone, keys, and some small incidentals like chapstick and tissues. There are four pockets in total. There's a small front pocket and then another pocket behind that that has a hole through which an ear plug wire can be threaded to a phone. Then there is the main compartment. Behind the main compartment is another exterior pocket the full length of the bag.

All zippers glide easily on their track. The waist strap is adjustable. Overall, this is a beautiful fanny pack that is heavy and small and holds just enough items.  The current price of $39 is competitively priced.

title: The size of the tip of a pencil eraser; I almost need a magnifying glass to see this
text: This is cute but super tiny. The coffee cup has a heart image on top. It can be hooked through the center or via the cup handle. Although it is sterling silver, this is just way too small for an adult. This looks like a child's charm. I also feel the current price of $12.99 is too much for this. I would not expect this to be priced at more than $6.99.

title: Heavy attractive pendant w/heavy chain but lousy clasp ring
text:
The wolf tooth pendant is attractive and heavy. The wolf looks a bit angry but it is exactly as pictured on the Amazon site. The problem I have is with the chain. I actually like the chain itself but not the circular fastener on the end. There is a little tiny and dinky circular loop on the end of the chain that the clasp hooks onto. This is total garbage (see photo). I doubt it will last because both the chain and wolf tooth are heavy. It is like trying to hold the pendant by a thread.

The current price of $12.95 is reasonable considering the quality of the pendant but they need to attach a good loop onto the end of the chain before I give this 5 stars.

title: This turtle ring is just gorgeous; it’s truly a statement piece, there were no sharp edges on mine
text:
This ring really makes a statement. It is unique, big, and stunning. I read that some others had sharp edges on their ring. I decided to take a chance and order it anywhere and am glad to report that there are no sharp edges on the ring I received.

I just love this. This is perfect for animal or reptile lovers or someone who wants some interesting bling. The current price of $9.49 ($9.99 minus 5% off) for a size 11 is reasonable for this. In fact, they didn't have the discount when I ordered mine.

title: Beautiful head wraps with plenty of stretch
text:
There are six beautiful headwraps in this set. The three solid colored ones are super soft. The three multi-colored ones are made of a more slippery type of material. These look great on (particularly the solid blue and black one), are lightweight, and versatile. The knot can be worn on top (or in the back, if desired). This can be used as a covering or even to contain an updo or just wet hair.

Also included is one black scrunchie and a plastic bag with a pink ribbon which I suspect is to store these wraps.

The current price of $28.99 comes to a slightly pricey $4.83 per wrap.

title: Only for masks with thin ear elastics; not for eyeglasses
text:
These chains have two purposes. They can either be worn as chain jewelry or to hook onto a mask that has a very thin elastic. The clasp is not easy to get around the elastic as I had to be careful to make sure the elastic was inside the hook. At one point I got it caught at the end of the hook simply because there is not much "hook" room to play with.

Nevertheless, I like these two chains. They come with a carry pouch as can be seen in my photo.

The current price of $7.41 is a reasonable $3.70 per chain. Note, however, that my absolute favorite mask chain is [[ASIN:B08HQZ1D1Z the Luxure Store Chain]], which is almost four times the price.

title: Substandard quality; one side doesn’t stretch; label crooked; threads hanging off
text:
This is a pretty headband with reflective stitching. However, the quality is substandard. Mine arrived with loose threads I had to cut off. The label on the headband is crooked. In addition, the top part of the band does not stretch because there is a thread that goes all around preventing that. The lower part of the band stretches a lot and does not fit snugly around my ears. If I want this to fit snug around my ears, I have to turn the headband upside down (meaning the label is upside down) and put the opening with the non-flexible stitching over my ears.

In summary, I love the color and reflective stitching but the band itself does not stay in place because it is overstretched on one end and rigid on the opening of the other end. It is also not very warm. The current price of $14.99 is too much for such a low quality product.

title: Shockingly wonderful socks; moderate compression in arch; loose around ankle area; too $$$
text:
These socks feel great on. They have moderate compression in the arch which helps with plantar fasciitis. However, they are loose around the ankle area which is perfect for those who have diabetes. They are rated for neuropathy, plantar fasciitis, diabetes, vaular conditions, cold feet, edema, and arthritis.

I have plantar fasciitis and it moderately helps with this. These also keep my feet warm and they are very comfortable to wear. These socks are also moderately thick, which is a plus. I have no idea how these will hold up over time, but I love these socks more than I expected to. I wash these in a lingerie bag in my washer and lay them flat to dry. 

Unfortunately, at the current price of $24.99, their pricing is outrageous for one pair of these. If they priced these at $10.95 or less, I would have rated them 5 stars.

title: This is a great set but mask is NOT INCLUDED; 4-in-1 design is a stretch (SEE UPDATE)
text:
SEE 3/22/21 UPDATE AT BOTTOM:

I ordered the large clip chain and it is very pretty. They call this a 4-in-1 design because this can be worn as a necklace. Yes it can be worn as that but it's misleading in my opinion because the usefulness of this is really about the 3-in-1 design as described below.

FUNCTION 1 - The chain has a lobster clasp on either end. This is great for hooking on to the ear loops on masks with thin elastics. What is even better is if the ear elastic has a silicone adjustor that falls off, this will prevent that because the chain clasp is in the way. See photo where I hooked it into my mask elastic. This will only work on masks with thin elastics.

FUNCTION 2 - Also included in the package are the silicone loops needed to hook onto glasses. The loop has two sides and one side hooks onto the chain's lobster clasp and the other threads through the ear arms of the glasses.

FUNCTION 3 - There are magnetic pieces used to thread onto earbuds as shown in the Amazon photos. The lobster clasp on the chain hooks onto the tiny metal loops of the magnetic white pieces (see photo) and then the ear buds thread into the holes in those white pieces.

In summary,  I love the design and look of this set. It is very functional. The current price of $14.99 is competitively priced as well.

UPDATE 3/22/22 - I have had the opportunity to try several more lanyards or mask holders and by far this one is the best so far. I love how long it is and how much more functional it is than the others I tried. I have been using this almost daily and prefer this one over any of the others I have. As a result, I am changing my rating from 4 to 5 stars.

title: Beautiful keychains for a girlfriend that is like a sister
text: There are two engraved (Not Sisters by Blood but Sisters by Heart) keychains in two velvet drawstring pouches, each with a tiny wing trinket. It is a beautiful saying, nicely done keychains, and very functional. This is a perfect gift to give to a treasured girlfriend. The current price of $12.24 comes to a reasonable $6.12 each.

title: These pants fit great and make me look thin; remind me of Gorilla Wear of yesteryear
text:
In the 1990's I purchased over 15 pairs of Gorilla Wear Pants from GNC  that were very much like these pants. I loved them but could not find those pants on their site anymore. Therefore, I decided to purchase these. 

These are very comfortable and have two generous side pockets in front at the waist. The waist is elastic and there is no elastic or restriction around the ankles. The sizing is perfect. This are just a tad big on me but that makes me look skinnier than I am.

I love the comfort, color, and design of these pants. In addition, these wash well in cold water. I do hang them to dry but sometimes I will put them on delicate for a few minutes in the dryer. These should not be tumble dried at all really. They are expensive but I love these pants so much that I ordered four pairs of Crazeewear on Amazon and six more pairs on the Crazeewear website. In addition, I ordered a pair of similar pants from TipsyElves on Amazon.

One negative about Crazeewear is that when I ordered on their website, the pants I ordered differed slightly in design than the pants I received. For instance, I ordered a purple pair on their website and got purple with stripes. I ordered a two-tone pair with a logo that was supposed to have neon green in the logo. Instead I was shipped a logo in gray. I ordered a pair with the word love emblazoned in pink on the side and received one with gold lettering instead. In addition, I tried contacting the twice and they never responded back. The pants themselves, however, are wonderful!
