title: Eclectic and comfortable workout pants; sizing runs large
text:
In the 1990's I purchased over 15 pairs of Gorilla Wear Pants from GNC  that were very much like these Tipsy Elves pants. I loved them but could not find these pants on their site anymore. Therefore, I decided to purchase these.

These are very comfortable and have two side pockets in front at the waist and one pocket in the back with a Velcro closure. There is a drawstring front and elastic at the ankles. Unfortunately, the sizing is larger than what is listed on the sizing chart. I normally take a large (or sometimes medium) in pants like these, but I trusted the chart. As a result I ordered an XL and even though it fits, it is huge on me. I should have ordered a large for a better fit.

I love the comfort, color, and style of these pants. I have to be careful to pair a black or complimentary solid color with these pants or the effect is hideous visually.  I will update my review if these do not wash and dry well.

The current price of $27.95 is reasonable for these workout pants as the Crazee Wear brand charges $12 to $15 more for similarly styled bottoms.

UPDATE 2/12/20 - I decided to only wash these and let them hang dry and they launder perfectly. Usually pants like these should not be dried in the dryer unless on low.

title: I hate this mask becauseheadband tie does not work for me but mask works if tied in back
text: I really hate this mask. It is two ply and comes all in one piece that is more like a scarf than a mask. There is a long tie that flows out the back. It is impossible to tie this as a headband on my head. Instead for this mask to work, I have to tie the long scarf-like strips in the back of my head and let it hang down. The mask is functional but disappointing. The current price of $10.99 is outrageous for this. I suppose if a woman has long hair, then this might work because the hair will allow the tie to have something to hold on to on the bottom. I have should length hair.

title: Attractive & comfortable spring-hinge reading glasses; frames are attractive
text:
These black tortoiseshell reading glasses are very attractive. The frame is solidly built and I like the spring hinges that allow me to bend the ear arms out a little when putting these on. Also, the arms snap lightly back in place when folding.

These work well for reading. What I particularly like about these frames is that there is no nose guard, so the glasses sit comfortably on one's face.

Each pair comes with a cinch strap cloth sack (a.k.a. case).

The current price of $15.19 ($15.99 minus 5%) is pricey but competitive as it comes to $7.60 per pair.

title: My boyfriend loves these socks; they’re not too thin & are loose on the legs
text:
My boyfriend prefers diabetic socks over regular ones because they do not leave marks on his ankles. These socks are thin but not too thin. Most diabetic socks are super thin and these are better than that. There is also a little bit of cushioning in the heel and toe box. Also, they do not leave marks around his legs. They are very comfortable and the grip surface on the bottom ensures stability when walking on a bare floor in his stocking feet.

He takes a size 13 shoe and these fit him perfectly. He highly recommends them.

title: Not a sweatsuit (made of polyester) & looks more like PJs but comfortable
text:
This jogger is not sweatshirt material at all. It is made in China of 95% polyester and 5% spandex. Had I known it was polyester, I would have never ordered it as the title indicated this was sweatshirt material, which is deceiving to the buyer.

Nevertheless, this is very comfortable. The pants have a drawstring front and angled pockets at the waist as is typical of most joggers. They also have two pockets in the back but since there is no structure to these pants, unlike jeans, there is a risk of losing whatever goes in those back pockets. The top is a pullover with a drawstring hood. This is true to size and fits me well; however, it looks like pajamas on me.

In summary, the two negatives are the material and the PJs-look. Other than this, these are great to lounge around in. I wash them in the washer but hang them to dry as I avoid putting polyester/spandex items in the dryer (even on low). The current price of $35.99 is a bit steep for these. Also note that the top is not short. I am 5'5" and the top comes a few inches below the pants waist which I prefer over the bare midriff pictured on the Amazon site. If I were 30 years younger, then the bare midriff would be preferred.

title: Small, nondescript keychain pill holder; holds 6 of my tiny supplements & is waterproof
text:
I love this tiny keychain pill holder. This is small and holds three of my Vitamin D3 50 mcg (2000IU) softgels and three of my Vitamin B12 500mcg microlozenges. It does fill the container to the very top. This will not hold any horse-size pills but is sufficient for my needs.

It comes in a box with a keyring and two extra gaskets. It is the gaskets that make this waterproof. I did submerge this in a cup of water for a few minutes and it was airtight--not a drop of water inside. I love the motorcycle with rider etching on the front.

The current price of $9.99 is competitive for this. It definitely serves my purpose.

title: Nice soft headbands; but they sent 2 yellow instead of the purple
text:
These headbands are soft and very nice. There are nine of them and they are all supposed to be different colors. Unfortunately, I was sent two yellow (which is a color I'm not fond of) instead of the purple one.

These feel soft and are not tight around the head which is great. When a headband is too tight, then it usually pops off but this one does not. In general, I actually love these.

Not only am I disappointed that one of the colors advertised was not included, but they put in a note to rate the headbands five stars to get a $1 coupon on the next order.

title: Electrifying Hawaiian shirt that is very festive; 100% Polyester
text:
This is a fun and vibrantly colored Hawaiian shirt that I consider extremely festive. It is made in India of 100% polyester.

I got this for my boyfriend and it fits him well. The buttons are sewn on well and are easy to fasten and unfasten. There's one half-height chest pocket on the left side. There are also 4" slits on either side of the bottom of this shirt to allow for movement.

This is not a high-end design as can be seen from the mismatched way the front comes together. In a high-end shirt, both sides match so that it looks like a seamless transition from the left to right sides. Nevertheless, this is typical of most touristy Hawaiian shirts available at stores like Walmart and such.

title: The large is more like a women’s size 9-10 and not a men’s 9-12; otherwise nice socks
text: I ordered these in a large for my boyfriend because he wears diabetic socks even though he is not a diabetic. He likes the looseness of socks like these. Unfortunately, these are too small for him. They do have some stretch and they are very comfortable and not constricting. However, they fit me. He takes a 12-13 shoe and I take a 9-10 shoe. If this was true to size, they would have gotten 4.5 stars. The current price of $13.99 is steep for one pair of socks like these as they are thin on top. Nevertheless, they do have more padding in the sole of the foot area.

title: Super comfortable, “barely there” bandeau yet perfect for light post-surgery compression
text: I tried this in a large to extra, extra, extra large and all the sizes in-between and these bras fit me perfectly in any of those sizes without much difference in feel or tightness. I got these to help reduce swelling after surgery and this is working perfectly for me. I also love the lilac color.  They also wash well in a lingerie bag but I lay them flat to dry.

title: Supremely comfortable, “barely there” bandeau yet perfect for light post-surgery compression
text:
I tried this bandeau in various colors in a large to extra, extra, extra large and all the sizes in-between and these bras fit me perfectly in any of those sizes without much difference in feel or tightness. I got these to help reduce swelling after surgery and this is working perfectly for me. These bras are just so incredibly soft and comfortable and they are my favorite bandeau so far.

This washes well in a lingerie bag and I lay it flat to dry.

In summary, I tried this in a large to extra, extra, extra large and all the sizes in-between and these bras fit me perfectly in any of those sizes without much difference in feel or tightness. I got these to help reduce swelling after surgery and this is working perfectly for me. I also love the lilac color.

title: Supremely comfortable, “barely there” bandeau yet perfect for light post-surgery compression
text: I tried this bandeau in various colors in a large to extra, extra, extra large and all the sizes in-between and these bras fit me perfectly in any of those sizes without much difference in feel or tightness. I got these to help reduce swelling after surgery and this is working perfectly for me. These bras are just so incredibly soft and comfortable and they are my favorite bandeau so far

text: I tried this in a large to extra, extra, extra large and all the sizes in-between and these bras fit me perfectly in any of those sizes without much difference in feel or tightness. I got these to help reduce swelling after surgery and this is working perfectly for me. These bras are just so incredibly soft and comfortable and they are my favorite bandeau so far.

title: Arm width/length is weird; material is slinky; bodice is too short
text:
I purchased several different front closure bras (including this set) to try to reduce post surgery inflammation. First of all, the design of this is not the quality I expected. The sleeves are both too narrow and too short for the size specified and fit me weirdly. Secondly, the bodice is too short for my body type. I also do not like the slinky material. The entire bra is completely unattractive. The only good thing about it is the ability to adjust the compression based on the hooks in front.

I was so utterly disappointed in this bra, that I returned this as a result. I really loved the [[ASIN:B07GV8LSG3 this ohlyah bra]] the best and that is the only front zip bra I kept because it fit me well in the same size compared to the others I tried.

title: Quality is mediocre & sizing is one to two sizes too small; I returned this
text: I purchased several different front closure bras (including this set) to try to reduce post surgery inflammation. There are two bras included. First of all the quality is not as good as I expected. Secondly, the sizing is about two sizes too small.  I returned this as a result. I really loved the [[ASIN:B07GV8LSG3 this ohlyah bra]] the best and that is the only front zip bra I kept because it fit me well in the same size compared to the others I tried.

title: Good bra to reduce swelling after breast surgery
text:
I recently had breast surgery and had a lot of swelling. My therapist recommended a Ballisee compression bra (bra that zips up in the front and is similar to a life preserver) or a bandeau (more like a tube top). I decided to buy both types. The actual Balissee compression bras are in the hundreds of dollars so I purchased this teal one instead. It works well and is helping to reduce my swelling. It is also comfortable to wear--all things considered. I am not one to wear bras ever - PERIOD. However, I have to for about six months, so I am pleased with this one.

I ordered the XXL and it is true to size. Note that the arm straps are NOT adjustable. I would have preferred a half inch more clearance under my armpit, which means it would have been better if the arm straps were about a half inch longer than they are for my body type. The current price of $12.79 is very reasonable considering the Balisse bra is around $192.00.

title: Comfortable mask, nice brown color, adjustable nose clip & ear elastics
text:
I am not sure why the truffle color is advertised for dark skin tone as it looks great on me and I have an almost ivory complexion. This mask is very comfortable and fits well. It has a nose guard for a close fit and the ear elastics are adjustable but the silicone adjuster can fall off if adjusted too much. There is an inner pocket for a PM2.5 charcoal filter if one is desired but that filter has to be purchased separately. This is comfortable to wear and very attractive.

The current price of $11.95 is very expensive for this mask. Even though it is comfortable and of reasonable quality, it is priced about $6 too much comparative to other cloth masks I tried previously.

title: I love the warmth, feel, comfort, and the various fall colors of these socks
text: My first reaction to this set of three socks was WOW; how nice they look. The fall colors are certainly enticing and appropriate for the season. In addition, the socks are thick, warm, and comfortable. They are short and come up a little over my ankles (i.e. just below mid-calf).  The Amazon site says they are wool. I usually itch with wool, but these do not itch me so that is another plus.

title: I love the inscription but this is a thin cheap shirt with a patchy inscription
text:
I love the inscription but this shirt is thin like a men's undershirt and the inscription is patchy in the sense that it is missing ink in spots. I love the saying but they could have at least made the inscription a solid black and not make it look like it was thrown in the wash several times and worn off.

It is true to size and fits me well. The current price of $9.95 is on the high side for the quality provided.

title: Fuzzy, warm, and pillowy soft pullover but does shed fuzz
text: I just love the pillowy softness of this pullover. It is also very warm. There are two small slip pockets in the front and a zip up neck. The only negative is that there is some fuzz that comes off of this onto the layer I have below the pullover. Other than this, I love this. The current price of $28.99 for an extra-large is competitive for this.

title: Simple no-frills medium to lightweight hoodie
text:
Gildan is a good brand and I always loved their shirts and sweatshirts. This hoodie is simple with no frills. It is medium tending toward a lightweight hoodie. It is true to the size chart specified; however, I feel it runs small compared to other men's large hoodies I tried before. Had I read their size chart, I would have ordered an extra large.

Note that there is no drawstring on the hood to cinch this tight, but that is not needed due to the design. It does have the normal kangaroo pouch in front.

Overall, I really like this garment.

title: Style rec’d differs from what I ordered; these are loose and thick
text:
I ordered the black red elk socks style and I received the black and red checkered style socks. These are made of 91% Acrylic, 8% Polyester, and 1% Spandex. They are thick, warm, and loose. They feel comfortable but since they are so thick, I have to wear them with my large boots. Overall, I like these socks but the style one orders may not be the one received.

I do not feel these socks should cost more than $10 and the prices on Amazon are all over the place depending on style.

title: Style rec’d differs from what I ordered; these are loose and thick
text:
I ordered the black socks style and I received the navy socks. These are made of 91% Acrylic, 8% Polyester, and 1% Spandex. They are thick, warm, and loose. They feel comfortable but since they are so thick, I have to wear them with my large boots. Overall, I like these socks but the style one orders may not be the one received.

I do not feel these socks should cost more than $10 and the prices on Amazon are all over the place depending on style.

UPDATE: After more washing these socks have strings that pull apart inside. I personally do not like that so I lowered this from 3 to 2 stars.

title: Absolutely gorgeous & substantial bull with 20” chain; LOVE IT!
text: I love unique and bold jewelry that act like statement pieces. This arrives overly packaged in the sense that the chain and pendant are wrapped inside several zip lock bags and have to be assembled. The chain is 20" long and complements the thick bull's head skull. This is an incredibly gorgeous piece at a super reasonable current price of $13.99. Of course, I am taking Amazon's word that this is indeed stainless steel. It certainly looks and feels like it.

title: Leg holes are too wide for use as workout shorts but I still love their comfort
text:
These shorts are super comfortable and almost sweatpants thick. They have an elasticized waist with a drawstring cinch. I ordered a large but should have ordered a medium as they are a bit big on me. Nevertheless, even if I ordered the medium, the pant leg opening is wide, so I do not consider them "safe" for a workout because my underwear shows if I bend over. Nevertheless, these are perfect for bed or just for wearing outside as long as one is bending over.

The current price of $17.86 is reasonable for this for a size large. A medium goes for $29.93 which is expensive.

title: Pretty bracelet; a bit difficult to close; due to its stiffness, creases do not go away easily
text: This is a very pretty bracelet that comes in a drawstring jewelry bag. It looks very attractive and elegant. I found it a bit awkward to cinch close evenly. Due to the stiffness of the cord, the creases in the cord from shipment do not go away easily. The creases have to be worked out to get them smoother. Overall, I really like this. The current price of $18.99 is competitive.

title: One pair of children’s socks only; these are not for adults & it is not a 2 pair set
text: I ordered this for me because it says there were two pairs of Christmas socks that would fit adults. Instead, what I received was one pair of children's Christmas socks. These socks are festive and thin as expected. They seem nice for the season. Nevertheless, they are a complete zero to me because the product received is not the product described on Amazon.

title: Looks frumpy with the knot in the center; material too thin but it’s soft – 2.5 stars
text:
Unfortunately, I do not like this. The first issue is my problem. I ordered an XX-Large and should have ordered an X-Large. That is not their fault. However, I did not realize there is a knot in the center of this. That is what creates the scalloping in the center. That knot looks horrible to me. It is the knot that is driving me crazy and making this not lay the way I want on my body.

The material is thin but very soft and comfortable. It is made in China of 30% cotton, 55% polyester, and 5% spandex. My boyfriend likes it but I personally wish I never ordered this. It is not worth the price I will wind up paying. The current price of $19.98 is reasonable for this if it looks good on.

Note that I washed this in the washer in a lingerie bag. It came out fine; no color bleeding. I also hung it to dry.

title: Attractive and a bit large but stays on my face and ears
text:
I tried their [[ASIN:B08F7QQ11T colorful version]] of this mask and it was so large it would not stay on my face or ears. However, this one is a little snugger. It does stay on my nose and ears but I have to be careful it does not fall down during use because it is still larger than I need. It is a comfortable and attractively designed gaiter.

The current price of $12.99 is expensive but still competitive for this.

title: Very pretty but disappointing because this is so loose it falls off the nose
text:
This is like a shirt for the face. It is so wide and large that it falls off my nose and the ear loops come off my ears. There is absolutely no way I can use this. I supposed someone who has a super wide or round face would benefit from this gaiter but it is a disappointment to me. I do love the colors, however.

The current price of $12.99 is expensive but still competitive for this if it were not so large.

title: Warm, thick, well-insulated gloves but hard to use touch screen with such thickness
text:
There is no question that these gloves are well designed and well-insulated for warmth. However, the insulation makes them very thick. With thick gloves, one loses dexterity so the ability to operate a smartphone or tablet is fraught with frustration. I found it difficult to operate my tablet with the thick-gloved index finger on either hand. It can be done but takes many tries.

As a side note, I wish there was a way to hook the gloves together (a feature ski gloves have) when not in use.

The current price of $18.99 is excellent for these gloves but just beware that the thickness reduces dexterity.

title: Hat is too small; gloves will stretch to size; scarf is itchy
text: This is a gorgeous hat, glove, and scarf set until I tried it on. First of all, the hat is small. I have a small head and it fits over my head but feels like it is going to pop up. I do love the fleece lining inside. Second, the gloves are on the small side but they will stretch to fit. I love how the fingertips are touch screen enabled (i.e. three conductive fingertips) for use with a smartphone or tablet. The scarf is long and generous and overall very nice, except it itches me. I also love the two-tone color of gray and black. This set is thick and definitely deep winter warm. The current price of $25.85 is even competitive; however, this set does not work for me due to the small hat size and the itchy gloves and scarf. The Amazon site says this is made of acrylic and polyester. I suspect the itchiness comes from the acrylic.

title: Absolutely gorgeous form-fitting sweater; very comfortable and very warm
text:
This is an absolutely gorgeous and form-fitting sweater. If one has a nice chest and great figure, it will highlight it in all the right places. It is also super comfortable and very warm. Some sweaters are itchy and this one is not. The trim (cuffs and collar) and back are gray and the front and arms are navy blue. This combination is super attractive, particularly with jeans. Unfortunately for me, I can't wear this because I was sent a medium instead of the extra large size I needed. I was also supposed to get the black one and not the blue one; nevertheless, that is not the sweater's fault.

This is made of 64% polyester, 30% cotton, and 5% spandex. Since that only comes to 99%, I am not sure what the other 1% is made of. I suspect it was supposed to be written as 65% polyester. It also should be hand washed and laid flat to dry. It should not be dry cleaned or tumble dried in the dryer. I personally would wash this in a lingerie bag and air dry it and then use a cool iron.

The current price of $26.99 minus an extra 15% off for the medium size is reasonable for this. The extra large is $28.99 minus an extra 15% off.

title: Beautiful, light, comfortable top; feels so soft; is form fitting
text:
I ordered this top without knowing the size because the size was not posted. I figured it was going to be a small size, so I had a girlfriend in mind to give it to. I was correct that this does not fit me because I received a small size. Nevertheless, this is a beautiful top. It is light, comfortable, form fitting, and is incredibly soft. I did try it on but it is too form fitting on me since the size is too small. Women who do not want their assets showing will have to wear a bra with this.  The back has a nice eyelet opening. Overall, this is very nice. If it had fit, I would have kept it even though I knowingly ordered it for a friend totally expecting it to be too small.

I wash tops like this in a lingerie bag and then lay then flat to dry.

title: Look like bras for the face but are still elegant; colors are unexpected; more like 2-ply
text:
These masks look like bras for the face. However, they are still elegant if paired with an evening gown that is similar.

There are three masks in the package. Even though my package had red, white, and black lace masks pictures on it, the masks inside were black, sand, and nude. It says these are 3-ply masks. They are 3-ply if the lace is being considered the first-ply layer. I personally think that is deceptive because the lace is just decorative and not protective.

Despite the above, these are very comfortable to wear. They are a cotton/polyester blend and are made in the USA. When I wash mine, I will be putting these in a lingerie bag and air drying them.

The current price of $39.99 is a bit outrageous for this as it comes to $13.33 per mask. I do not feel these should cost more than $8 per mask or $24 for the three.

title: Soft and comfortable gaiter; love that the edges are hemmed
text: The current price of $6.99 ($7.99 minus the $1 off coupon) is very reasonable for this gaiter.  It is lightweight, soft, comfortable to wear, and I love that the edges are hemmed. It is great to use as a mask for the fall.

title: Very attractive headband-type scarf with limited coverage; reminds me of the 1960s - 3.5 stars
text:
This is a very colorful head scarf. However, the Amazon picture looks like it provides full coverage for the model but that is deceiving.  It only has a depth of 8 inches and it is not enough to cover the head. Therefore, this only wraps around my head like the headband of the 1960s. It is very attractive and made of Polyester without any stretch. It is also very colorful.  This would have gotten 5 stars if there were more material as pictured on the Amazon site.

BTW - one cannot beat the price of $5.60 for this, which is a great buy in my opinion as long as it is understood it does not cover the entire head.

title: Stylish, attractive, double wrap bracelet; a statement piece that is simple
text:
I was on the fence about ordering this because it is costly for a "piece of leather." Nevertheless, I am so glad I did. I wear a brown men's watch daily and this bracelet goes so well with it. It is double wrapped and very easy to get on. All I had to do is pull on the magnetic end until it came apart and wrap it around my wrist. I then snapped it into place with the magnet. I also love the red, white, and blue pieces in the middle that are both the color of the US flag and indicate the Tommy Hilfiger brand. The current price of $45 is expensive but one is paying for both the jewelry and the brand combined.

This bracelet is suitable for both a man or woman, in my opinion. I'm sure it will look fantastic on a guy.

title: Triangular gaiter with ear hooks; works well as a mask
text: This is a colorful, patriotic, lightweight, triangular gaiter with ear straps that can be used as a mask. Since it is a gaiter, I have to put my head through this to use it and in the summer, it means I will have a wrap around my neck and feel warm. It washes well in a lingerie bag and hang dries in a couple of hours. I have no idea how much this will cost but I personally would not pay more than $8 for this although it will probably be sold in the $18 range.

title: Soft comfortable leggings that are see-through and lack any tummy control
text:
These leggings are true to size. They feel soft and comfortable and are made of a slinky feeling material. However, they are see-through and there is absolutely no tummy control. There is a one-inch elastic band for the top of the waist that sort of floats in the high-waistband pictured. The small elastic band actually helps accentuate any tummy bump.

These wash well in the washer in a lingerie bag but I hang them to dry.

Note that if these were not see-through and it did not highlight my stomach but instead offered the control it claims, then I would have given this five stars. I do love that the leg part comes past my ankles and not above the ankles like most leggings of this type.

title: Well-made and slightly stretchy shorts; wrinkles if hang drying
text:
These shorts are very nice. I ordered the extra large but I really take a large as these are a bit big on me. However, they have a drawstring front that allows me to cinch the waist. They are super comfortable and are made in Bangladesh of 98% Lyocell and 2% Elastane. They have a slight stretch to them.

There are two side pockets in front and two pockets in back. They are a bit heavy and the Lyocell material feels almost jean-like and very smooth. They wash well in cold water. I did try to hang dry them but they dry more wrinkled than when machine-dried on low (which is what is recommended). I tried to machine-dry them and there is less wrinkling. However, they do take a while to dry on low because they are on the thicker side. The waistband itself takes very long to dry.

Overall, I love these shorts. They are good quality, do not shrink if the instructions are followed, and are super comfortable. They are roomy but do wrinkle just a little bit. However, no iron is needed as long as one is using the dryer.

title: Perfect as favors and have many other uses; lace is super decorative
text:
There are 36 organza bags with 6 each of 6 colors (hot pink, white, red, pale pink, bluish teal, and black). The ones I ordered were the small ones of 4" x 6" but they are still large. These are the type of bags that people use for storing candy or other favors for weddings and parties. If one is a jeweler at a craft fair, they can be used as a jewelry storage bag. I use these to tie up blind cords, which is totally not what they were designed for. However, these bags make my blinds look elegant.

I have three cats and the cords on my blinds are tantalizing as play toys to them and they also pose a safety risk. Fourteen years ago I purchased a much smaller sized organza bag for each cord. However, those bags were ripped and ratty and had to be replaced. These are even better because they have a lace collar that looks like a garter. I used three of the white ones already and they work perfectly even if they are double the size of what I had. In addition, the look dresses up my window. I would have taken a picture but Amazon is no longer allowing photos due to COVID-19; I suspect the reason is that their India people are working from home and do not have the bandwidth to review photos.

Note that the size of 4" x 6" is for the organza part of the bag. The lace appears above that by about a half inch. The lace collar is about 1-1/2" because there is 1" that comes below the organza top.

These are perfect for my purpose and I would definitely order these again if I needed more.

title: Watch is adorable but time is hard to read and fastening the clasp is difficult - 2.5 stars
text:
This watch arrived in a paper envelope in a smashed box. Inside the box was a watch wrapped in a plastic bag and the cushion that the timepiece should be fastened to was thrown off to the side. There is also no manual.

However, this timepiece is adorable. I really love the cute owl face and the ears. The second hand is red and very visible; however, the minute and hour hands are the exact color of the watch and the watch face. It is practically impossible to see those "gold-colored" hands against the "gold-colored" background.

In addition to the above, the clasp is incedibly difficult to fasten because it only opens halfway into a V. The watch is too big on my wrist by a few links. Nevertheless, I have to keep it long beause if I did not, I could not fasten the clasp. The current price of $19.99 plus a 15% coupon is reasonable for a watch. In order to make this worth the purchase, however, it needs to have darker minute and hour hands and the clasp should open all the way or at least 3/4 of the way.

title: Medium-sized crossbody bag in stiff leather & gorgeous orangey/brown color
text:
This is a medium-sized crossbody bag. The leather is stiff and strong. The zippers glide easily and the stitching is good throughout. There is a full-height zippered pocket on the back of the bag and two zippered pockets of various heights on the front of the bag. The central zippered compartment has one internal zippered compartment along the back wall and two folder pockets of various size. There is enough room for a full-sized wallet, phone, keys, tissues, and some small incidentals. This will not hold a tremendous amount but it holds enough. The leather is very strong and the shoulder strap is adjustable. There is no awful leather tanning smell to this, which is very nice. This purse looks and feels like it will be long lasting.

Although there is currently no price listed, I would expect this to be priced in the $38 range.

title: Huge, strong, canvas duffle bag from the military days
text:
This is a huge canvas duffle bag good for the military, camp, or going away to college. It is well-made and typical of the type of canvas duffle bags from the military days and yesteryear. The zipper glides easily and has a double ring for a small lock. On each end of the long side is a handle (see photos). There is also a handle along the length in the middle ( see photo). In addition, it can be carried via the adjustable shoulder strap.

This is awkward to walk with and not something I recommend taking hiking unless it is just used in camp. There is only one compartment where everything goes. Since it is canvas, it does attract lint. Cat hair from my cats stuck all over this. However, this is all to be expected.

Overall, this is exactly as designed--a sturdy, well-made duffle bag. I also love the cute name in front.

title: At the current price point, this is a decent shoe horn
text:
I was originally going to rate this 3 stars. However, for the current price of $7.99, I think this is a decent shoe horn. It is metal with a silicone covering on the upper part. It is also perfect for young children or adults who do not mind bending down to use a shoe horn.  It is certainly better than plastic.

This is packaged with a big cheap cinch-tie bag. I have no idea why this is included as probably 30 of these shoe horns could fit in that bag.

This horn has the potential to bend because it is not super sturdy. I have a similar one with a wooden handle and that one is all bent just from use.  

My recommendation if you want a great shoe horn that is sturdier and can be used standing up, is to get this [[ASIN:B01M154SED 21" heavy duty one]] for the current price of $20.99 plus 5% off. I own one of these and had I purchased that one first, I would have never ordered any other. Do note, however, that it is very large and comes up to one's knees but it is fantastic.

In summary, this one is decent and functional at the low price point but for something more sturdy and that will last longer, look into the other one I recommended.

title: Sturdy & adjustable holders for eyeglasses but cord is a bit short & might not fit everyone
text:
I really like these eyeglass holders. It is a bit tough to thread them through my frames, but once I got it on, I was able to maneuver them in place. They hold my glasses well and the cord allows them to stay put. Also, I can adjust the "cable" to the middle of my frames so that the cord does not get caught on my ears.

There is a little bit of expandability at the end by pulling on the black cinch at the other end of the holder. However, these just do not seem to be long enough for a very large or muscular man or large or musclar woman. I believe they need to add a few inches onto the cord length to make these perfect.

For my purposes, they are excellent. There are four holders - blue, green, black, and rust. In addition, one eyeglass cleaning cloth is included.

title: Spacious wallet w/9 card slots & a double billfold but this anthracite black shows all scratches
text:
This is a tri-fold wallet with a center ID window. On the left and right folds there is room for four credit cards on each side if counting the slot behind each bank of three slots and a center ID window. There is also adouble billfold.

The front of the wallet has a nice lion's head embossing on it.

The wallet also comes with RFID protection to protect the credit cards fromscanners. However, I have no way of verifying if this works or not.

It also comes in an attractive giftable box.

In summary, the slots in this wallet allow for the easy retrieval of all cards. What I hate about this wallet is that the anthracite black color shows all the fingerprints and scratches as the surface making all imperfections visible. The leather is stiff but also on the thin side. I feel any price more than $10 for this version of the wallet is too much.

title: Spacious wallet with enough slots for 9 cards & a double billfold
text:
This is a tri-fold wallet with a center ID window. On the left and right folds there is room for four credit cards on each side if counting the slot behind each bank of three slots and a center ID window. There is also adouble billfold.

The front of the wallet has a nice lion's head embossing on it.

The wallet also comes with RFID protection to protect the credit cards fromscanners. However, I have no way of verifying if this works or not.

It also comes in an attractive giftable box.

In summary, the slots in this wallet allow for the easy retrieval of all cards. I love the rustic style of this wallet in the distressed brown color. The leather is stiff but also on the thin side. Although there is no price listed, I think a cost of $12 and under would be reasonable for this.

title: Spacious bi-fold wallet but this anthracite black shows all scratches
text:
This is a bi-fold wallet with a removable ID window. On the left fold there is room for three credit cards and behind that bank of slots is a removable leather ID pocket that can hold one ID and two credit cards on the back side. On the right side is room for four more credit cards and one more behind that. This means 11 cards can be stored inside. There is also a double billfold.

The front of the wallet has a nice lion's head embossing on it.

The wallet also comes with RFID protection to protect the credit cards from scanners. However, I have no way of verifying if this works or not.

It also comes in an attractive giftable box.

In summary, the slots in this wallet allow for the easy retrieval of all cards. I do not care for this anthracite black  leather because it shows every scratch and finger pass on leather. The wallet is also thinner than some other men's wallets. I have no idea how much this will cost but if it is priced in the $10.99 range, then that would be reasonable as long as one does not mind how this style shows every blemish.

title: Spacious bi-fold wallet; this vintage brown is gorgeous and feels great
text:
This is a bi-fold wallet with a removable ID window. On the left fold there is room for three credit cards and behind that bank of slots is a removable leather ID pocket that can hold one ID and two credit cards on the back side. On the right side is room for four more credit cards and one more behind that. This means 11 cards can be stored inside. There is also a double billfold.

The front of the wallet has a nice lion's head embossing on it.

The wallet also comes with RFID protection to protect the credit cards from scanners. However, I have no way of verifying if this works or not.

It also comes in an attractive giftable box.

In summary, the slots in this wallet allow for the easy retrieval of all cards. I love vintage brown leather which feels strong even though it is thinner than some other men's wallets. I have no idea how much this will cost but if it is priced in the $12.99 range, then that would be reasonable as a result of this vintage brown style.

title: Spacious bi-fold wallet; leather is thin but this smooth brown is soft
text:
This is a bi-fold wallet with a removable ID window. On the left fold there is room for three credit cards and behind that bank of slots is a removable leather ID pocket that can hold one ID and two credit cards on the back side. On the right side is room for four more credit cards and one more behind that. This means 11 cards can be stored inside. There is also a double billfold.

The front of the wallet has a nice lion's head embossing on it.

The wallet also comes with RFID protection to protect the credit cards from scanners. However, I have no way of verifying if this works or not.

It also comes in a super attractive giftable box.

In summary, the slots in this wallet allow for the easy retrieval of all cards. I love that this smooth brown colored leather feels soft but what I do not like is that the leather is on the thin side. Because of this thin leather, I do feel this will wear easily.  I have no idea how much this will cost but if it is priced in the $10.99 range, then that would be reasonable.

title: Lovely tri-fold wallet; room for 9 cards; love the textured leather
text:
This is a lovely tri-fold wallet. On the left fold there is room for four credit cards. An ID pocket is in the centerfold. On the right side is room for four more credit cards. This means 9 cards can be stored inside. There is also a double billfold.

The front of the wallet has a nice lion's head embossing on it; unfortunately it is crooked.

The wallet also comes with RFID protection to protect the credit cards from scanners. However, I have no way of verifying if this works or not.

It also comes in a super attractive giftable box.

In summary, the slots in this wallet allow for the easy retrieval of all cards. The textured Samsonite Black is super attractive and feels great in the hands. It also makes the leather feel thicker than it is due to the texture. What I do not like is that the leather is on the thin side and the embossing on my wallet is slightly crooked. Because of this thin leather, I do feel this will wear easily. As long as the price is $12.99 and under, I think this is a good price but anything over that is expensive simply because the leather is too thin.

title: Spacious bi-fold wallet but leather is thin
text:
This is a bi-fold wallet with a removable ID window. On the left fold there is room for three credit cards and behind that bank of slots is a removable leather ID pocket that can hold one ID and two credit cards on the back side. On the right side is room for four more credit cards and one more behind that. This means 11 cards can be stored inside. There is also a double billfold.

The front of the wallet has a nice lion's head embossing on it.

The wallet also comes with RFID protection to protect the credit cards from scanners. However, I have no way of verifying if this works or not.

It also comes in a super attractive giftable box.

In summary, the slots in this wallet allow for the easy retrieval of all cards. What I do not like is that the leather is on the thin side. Because of this thin leather, I do feel this will wear easily. As long as the price is $10.99 and under, I think this is a good price but anything over that is expensive simply because the leather is too thin.

title: Cards are difficult to remove from slots; extreme minimalist wallet
text:
This leather wallet is super minimal and stiff. The front has an ID pocket with room for two more cards. The back has room for four cards and the center can hold some folded bills. I found it difficult to remove the cards from the card slots.

There's a metal loop on top where keys can be clipped on. The color is a deep forest green and the leather is textured.

The wallet also comes with RFID protection to protect your credit cards from scanners. However, I have no way of verifying if this works or not.

It does not come in a giftable box.

Personally, I feel the current price of $11.99 is too expensive for this. It is super minimal and difficult to extract the cards out of some of the slots. When it is full it is even tighter. Although it is functional, this would not be my first wallet choice.

title: AWESOME presentation; all around nice portfolio wallet w/room for 16 cards, some coins, & cash
text:
When I opened the outside box this came in and saw the giftable box the wallet is in, I was blown away at the presentation. This is well wrapped and looks like a wonderful present.

The wallet itself is very nice. It is a portfolio style wallet with room for three credit cards in the front, back, and interior on each side with one more slot on each side on the interior. In the centerfold there is an ID pocket and another credit card slot including a tiny zippered area for change. In total there are 16 areas for cards if I include the two pockets behind the credit card slots on the interior. In addition there is a billfold.

The leather is thin and not super soft but it feels reasonably durable. The slots are easy to get cards in and out of. The only trouble area I had was the center zippered pocket. It is small and will fit a few coins but not much else. I love the smell of the leather, the snap closure, and the color.

There is a piece of leather in another color inside one of the slots and that leather actually feels softer than the leather of this wallet. That is the buff-colored daisey-type cutout shown in one of my photos at the top of the wallet.

This comes with RFID protection to prevent scanner access from prying eyes but I have no way of verifying that.

In summary, this is a small-footprint portolio-style leather wallet with RFID protection that holds about 16 cards, some coin, and some cash. The current price of $29.99 is on the expensive side.  I wish the leather felt softer, the wallet had a larger footprint, and the price were a bit lower. Other than this, it is fully functional, attractive, and feels moderately durable.

title: Very pretty rose with bling; chain is thin and will tangle easily and get caught in rose
text:
This necklace arrives in a ratty box with bubble wrap inside and on a folded/creased card (see one photo). I would not call the box giftable.

The pendant itself is gorgeous. The rose design is intricate and the added "light pink colored gems" and "gold-colored knobs on the backdrop really make this pop. The chain, however, is thin and will tangle. It also easily gets caught on the ridges of the rose. The chain is 18" long with an addtional 2" extension for a total of a 20" chain. I like that I can choose to wear either length.

This is a nice piece of costume jewelry where the pendant is the star of ths show. I have no idea how much this will cost, but anything over $10 I would consider expensive. It is giftable only if one puts it in another box. The current packaging setup is cheap. Even the card it came on was folded so that there were distracting creases which reduces the presentation.

title: White romper is completely see-through & feels like 100% polyester; comes w/broken jewelry
text:
I am so sorry I ordered this. The romper itself is loose fitting and generously sized for an XL. An XL on me would normally fit perfect or tight depending on the cut. However, this fits nice and a bit loose. It feels comfortable on and has a front tie and two generous side pockets. HOWEVER, this is totally see-through. In addition, it has that terrible polyester feel. It is made in China of 65% polyester and 35% cotton but I would never know there is any cotton in this garment.

This also came with a broken piece of jewelry that does not open. It has a clasp that is permanently affixed to the end of one of the loops on the chain and the piece that hangs down has a broken link that is just permanently twisted in place. I suspect this is supposed to be a wristlet where the attached clasp attaches to the broken link but I cannot test that because the link does not exist.

Although the jewelry should be thrown out, the romper can be worn if one does not mind baring all their essentials. My rating of 2 stars is only for the romper as a result of being see-through and having an awful polyester feel. I did not add my rating of the jewelry because it seems some people got a wristlet and others did not. If I had added this into the review, I might have rated this 1 star.

This romper is not what I expected. I suspect the other colors are a lot less revealing. It is an attractive outfit, otherwise. I will not be wearing this no matter how comfortable this is.

title: This suit looks terrible on because of the massive bra cups which looks more like an obstruction
text:
I admit that I do not have the body for a bathing suit anymore; however, this otherwise colorful and attractive tankini is made horrible by the awful bra cups.

The bottoms are like shorts and have a tiny pocket on the left waistband to hold a key or perhaps some folded cash. The top drapes over the bottoms but in a form fitting sort of way. I would have preferred a looser drape. However, the bra cups are horrendous. It feels like someone took two cereal bowls and inserted them into the cloth. My chest is super large to begin with and wearing this creates a massive obstruction in front of me.  In fact the white of the cup lining sometimes even pops up above the bra line. The top is absolutely hideous and there is no way I am wearing this suit.

title: Attractive swimdress but skirt is irregularly cut & unhemmed; static cling is awful
text: This swimdress is very colorful, flattering, and attractive. It goes on easily and covers any problem areas. The bra pads are not too thick. My main disappointment stems from the skirt.  The skirt is irregularly cut as if someone just arbitarily cut out a flap of material to hang down around the waist. Also, it is not hemmed and has a few strings hanging. In addition, the static cling in the skirt area is awful. It just clings to the legs.  If they hemmed the skirt, this would be an almost perfect swimdress. However, I am disappointed that an otherwise perfect garment is slightly ruined by this imperfect detail and extreme static cling.

title: Stretchy, soft, form fitting, and gorgeous thermal shirt -- one of the best I own
text:
I love men's shirts like these. I normally order a men's in a medium if I want a snug fit or large if I want a loose fit. This only came in an XL and I figured it would be loose. However, it fits like most large shirts on me but I never reviewed the size chart before ordering. If I had reviewed the chart, I would have seen that the XL is fits a 47" chest, so it is actually my size in this cut.

It fits perfectly and feels "oh so great" inside. The inside has a thin fleece layer that is both soft and warm. This thermal is thick and although it looks great on me, it would look fabulous on a muscled guy. It stretches to fit in a very nice way.

I absolutely love this and will be ordering one in gray. This is one of the best men's thermals I own. Also the current price of $12.15 for an XL is excellent for this.  I wash this in the washer but I hang dry it. It is made in China of 91% polyester and 9% elastane.

title: Very comfortable pants with a little bit of stretch
text:
These pants are very comfortable. They have a little bit of stretch to them and are thinner than jeans but feel great on. There are two large pockets in front and two large seat pockets in back. The blue color also goes with almost any casual wear shirt.

They also wash well but I prefer to hang them to dry as I am afraid of shrinkage. Overall, these are very nice pants. The current price of $25.49 for a size 33W x 32L is reasonable.

title: These are not as soft as trouser socks but they are thin like them; they’re fun socks
text:
The pair of socks I got has horses (specifically unicorns) on them and I love that.

These are very much like knee-high trouser socks because they come right up to the knees, do not fall down, and are thin. Howerver, they are not as soft as trouser socks but they feel comfortable enough. I love the cool factor of these. It is fun to wear something wildly different and that is where these shine.

They wash well but I lay them flat to dry as they appear to be made of a material that would not do well in the dryer.

title: Lovely man’s or woman’s wallet with a few minor issues
text:
This is an excellent leather wallet. It is super soft and stylish and has room for credit cards, cash, and memory cards (such as one micro and one regular SD memory card or a SIM card instead of the micro SD).

It is a bi-fold wallet. On the left fold is where the memory cards can be stored with room for three credit cards and one more behind that. On the right side is room for three more credit cards and one more behind that. This means eight cards can be stored in this section.

There is a triple billfold. The double billfold are open and there there is a zippered billfold in the back with a nice zipper that glides in its tracks. In the front of the first billfold is room for three more cards on each side. This means six cards can be stored in this section.

The wallet also comes with RFID protection to protect your credit cards from scanners. However, I have no way of verifying if this works or not.

It also comes in a giftable box.

There are only two issues I have with this wallet and they are minor. First, the six credit card slots in the billfold section are a bit difficult to work with. The reason is that the slots do not have a fold over collar on them. They are just cut into the leather without any fold over hem as is typical of the front slots. As a result, it is hard to pull them out for card insertion and I had to use two hands. Second, there is a "tail" of leather in the first billfold that is not stitched down--this can be seen in the bottom center in one of my photos. Other than this, I think this wallet is lovely and soft and has ample storage for what most men or women need. The current price of $15.99 is competitive.

title: Soft 100% acrylic "fur" ear warmer; it comfortably stretches to fit almost any head size but loosens
text:
I purchased a [[ASIN:B07ZTXS8XP Futrzane Womens Faux Fur Ear Warmer]] on Amazon priced at $23.99 and this one for $9.95. The Futrzane is made of 100% polyester and this one is made of 100% acrylic. However, in my opinion this cheaper one is better in almost every respect except for the size. I attached side-by-side picture of both for comparison.

What I like about this one is the price, the fit, and the comfort. There is an elastic in the back that stretches to fit almost any head. This is unlike the other headband where the elastic is internal and the headband can only stretch so much. Obviously, this one will have a space in the back where there is only elastic and not fur if one's head is large. I have a small head and there is only about a 1-1/2" inch gap of elastic for me. Unfortunately, over time this headband loosens a bit too much on my small head and that is my only disappointment.

I love the comfort of this band better than the other one because it does not ride up on my head. I can also pull it lower around my ears if needed. Although this band is a tad narrower than the other one and not as luxuriously soft, neither issue matters to me. I just wish this did not loosen over time during use. If one has a bigger head, it might be fine. It keeps my ears warm when I do not want to wear a hat.

title: Super rustic wallet; not minimalist; shows every scratch; ID window too small for ID visibility
text:
Clifton Heritage normally makes great leather wallets. However, this is not the quality I have come to expect. First of all, I did not expect this to be so rustic. It is made of a hard leather and every nail scrape or pressure smudge shows. It is also not minimalist. This is a regular man's tri-fold wallet that has 11 card slots (if counting the ones behind each bank of slots) and a double billfold. One of the slots is an ID window but that window is so short that the ID must be removed from the slot in order to show it fully. This is a big negative to me.

It supposedly has RFID protection to protect credit cards from scanners, but I have no way of verifying that. It does come in a giftable box but mine came slightly smashed as can be seen in one of the photos.

The leather of this wallet is strong so it will last. The reason I am rating this two stars is because it is not advertised as rustic, it shows scratches, the ID window is too small, and the wallet is not minimalist. It is certainly a useable wallet that feels like it will last a long time and the price of $12.99 is acceptable. Nevertheless, I am disappointed.

title: Super soft polyester "fur" ear warmer but a little tight on my small head at the beginning
text:
This is a super soft faux fur ear warmer made of 100% polyester in Poland. If it gets dirty, it should be hand washed only.

This green color looks more like a deep forest green that is hard to see in pictures but is visible in person. The interior has a little bit of stretch to it due to the elastic inside which is underneath the black lining. It is a bit tight on my small head at the beginning but loosens up over time due to the elastic.

This is a lovely accent headband that acts like earmuffs and keeps my ears warm. It is perfect for when I do not want to wear a hat.

title: Attractively styled wallet; leather is thin; some card slots are too tight
text:
I have several men's Clifton Heritage leather wallets which I really love. This woman's wallet is just okay. The pebbled red leather and style are beautiful. However, the leather is thin and some of the card slots are so narrow that it is very difficult to add and remove the cards; particularly on the left fold out side.

It is a tri-fold wallet with a tear drop shapped snap closure. There are three picture ID windows; one on the left and two on the right side. In total, there are 14 card slots and 5 billfold-sized long slots. The larger billfold-sized long slots are in the center and is where the cash would usually go. On the exterior is one zippered pocket the length of the wallet that can hold small change.

It supposedly has RFID protection to protect credit cards from scanners but I have no way of verifying that.

Although I like this wallet, it is not the quality I have come to expect from Clifton Heritage. I think it is just okay; nothing specatcular due to the thin leather and selectively tight card slots. This gets 2.8 stars from me rounded up to 3 stars.

title: Works great as either a thin undershirt for women or outer shirt for men
text:
I buy men's shirts to wear as undershirts or as outshirts simply because they fit me better than a woman's shirt. I ordered this as an undershirt. It is a perfect loose fit. If I wanted a very snug fit, a medium would have been appropriate. Therefore, this is true to size in a men's large based on the way it fits me. The sleeveless design would look great on a muscled physique.

The shirt is a bit thinner than some of the other muscle tees I have. It is also a tad less silky feeling. Nevertheless, this does not take away from the functionality and it certainly looks and feels great on me. It is made in Vietnam of 100% polyester. The interior tag is a bit long, so I had to cut it out.

I wash this in a lingerie bag and hang it to dry.

title: This "sweatshirt" is “So Freaking Thin,” which explains why she’s so cold
text:
This is more like a misses shirt which is why I sized up to a 2XL. I take a woman's large to XL and based on the sizing chart, I selected the correct size by sizing up two sizes more.

I love the saying, the color, the contrast, and the fit of this shirt. However, it is definitely not a sweatshirt. It is a spandex inspired thin long sleeve shirt made in China of 70% cotton and 30% polyester. It is only because I love the fit and shirt so much, that I gave this 4 stars. However, it is not as advertised which explains why she is "So Freaking Cold" and that is because the shirt is "So Freaking Thin."

I wash shirts like these in a lingerie bag. It should be washed in cold water and is best if washed inside out. Although the label says it can be tumble dried on low, I will only hang dry this.  

Overall, this is a very attractive and form fitting shirt, but if you are looking for a sweatshirt, then do not buy this.

title: Pretty pullover with a very soft bodice; wrist opening is large; dry cleaning is recommended
text:
This shirt gets 3.4 stars from me rounded down to 3 stars. I orderd this in an XL which fits me comfortably and loose enough to look great. The sleeves are nicely designed and the key-hole opening in the back is a nice touch especially for women with shorter hair. I also love how soft the torso area is which feels very sweater like. 

This is made in China of 95% polyester and 5% spandex. Although, it says to wash separately and has a wash label for cool water, the label says dry cleaning is recommended. Had I known this, I would not have ordered this shirt. 

Also, the cinching at the wrist is way too loose. When I fasten the button, it is almost as if it were not buttoned because there is a lot of space between my wrists and the wrist collar. On another note, there are loose threads around those buttons as can be seen in in the attached photo.

Other than the dry cleaning recommendation, loose button threads, and the large space at the wrists, this is a very nice business-like shirt that is comfortable to wear.

title: Battery connectors are WRONG, sizing is 1 size TOO SMALL, and power connector DOESN'T WORK
text:
This vest could not be more wrong.

First, the vest itself is nice but way TOO SMALL. It is Asian sizing; so an XL fits like a large in women's even though it says it is a USA XL. That is untrue.

Second, it comes with a battery pack, cable, and wall plug. The cable supplied looks like a micro USB cable that is the larger USB A-Type connector on one end and the smaller Micro USB B on the other side. However, the battery pack and the wall plug are both the female ends that take a USB A-Type connector. There is no place to put the Micro USB B end of the cable. This means this battery pack cannot be charged since I do not have any cable that has USB A-Type on both ends. I think it needs a cable like [[ASIN:B07KJ96M2W this one]], but with such a shoddy product (see third problem below), I am not willing to buy that cable to try it.

Third, the battery pack came charged already with three bars (instead of a full charge of 4 bars) - see last photo. I decided to try it and plugged it into the vest. The cable plug is located on the inside vest pocket. Nevertheless, when I pressed the on/off button that is at the top of the vest, it did not work. The on/off button is supposed to turn red for high, white for medium, and blue for low heat.

The vest itself is nice if one can fit in it. It has two tiny outside pockets at the waist level and one inside pocket for the battery pack. It is lined with fleece on the inside and feels nice and is warm just by itself without a battery.

In its current condition, this is not worth anything to me because it neither fits right nor does the battery pack work with the vest and it cannot be charged. If the vest fit me without having to squeeze into it, I would say it is worth $20. If the vest fit and the battery pack worked, it might be worth $45. The battery pack is going in the garbage since it will not work with the vest even if I got the right cable. This is an utter disappointment. My recommendation is to run from this product.

title: Great tights for underneath pants in the winter; they are see-through
text:
These footless tights are super soft and feel lightly fleecy on the inside. They are great to use underneath pants in the winter. They can even be worn underneath pajamas. I would not wear these underneath a skirt or dress because they might ride down in the crotch area.

In my opinion, these are not tights as I know them. They are see-through and act more like thick stockings. The picture on the Amazon site makes them look like they can be worn like regular pants and they should not be.

They are 92% polyester and 8% spandex and are made in China. They are harder to get on than regular tights and take the effort of putting on stockings. It is not super easy to pull them up all the way as they appear to be longer and thinner in the leg. However, once I get them on, I do love how silky and soft these feel and how warm they are.

These wash well in a lingerie bag but I hang dry them. They can be tumble dried on low according to the package; however, I would not do that. One other thing that is important to note is that these will "pill" easily if touched by Velcro or something clingly like that--for instance by rough skin. It is the type of material that will show every pull or fray.

At the current price of $15.99 these are a little pricey. I like these a lot as "stockings" and not tights, but they could be better.

title: Beautifully designed floral super sheer scarf
text:
I was not sure I woul love this when I placed my order. However, I am pleasantly surprised. It does not look as large as in the Amazon photos but it is a typical long scarf that can be tied around the neck or head. I was wearing a shirt that complemented the color (photo 2), so I immediately put this on as soon as it arrived.

Note that it is super sheer. It is made of 100% recycled polyester. The design is floral and super attractive. I would expect a scarf like this to be competitively priced between $8 to $10. Currently, no price is listed. This is very, very nice and 5 stars if priced in that range.

title: Attractive, soft, comfortable, and stretchy shirt but it’s see-through
text:
I would not have purchased this had I know it was see-through. It is a very attractive tunic and is extremely flattering and form fitting. The material molds and stretches with my body and is very soft and comfortable. It is made in China of 35% polyester and 65% cotton. If it were not see-through, this would have gotten 5 stars. Although I like this design very much, I prefer a shirt with less visibility of my body.

I wash this in a lingerie bag in the washer (since it is so delicate) and hang dry it.

title: Attractive adjustable felt hat but buckle trim falls off easily
text: This is an adjustable (see ribbon tie in first photo) felt hat that is made in China of 65% cotton and 35% polyester. It is comfortable to wear and is attractive but not as attractive as I had hoped on me.  What really annoys me about this hat is the buckle trim keeps falling off. I expected it to be secured in some way and it is not. Had I known this, I would not have purchased this.

title: Beautiful, soft almost knee-length sweater in a tawny (neutral) color
text:
This open-front sweater feels luxurious, soft, and warm. I am 5 feet 5 inches tall and it comes just above my knees. The tawny (or what they are calling khaki) color goes with almost anything. It is one size fits all and since I am on the larger side, the front remains open. There are no front closures. There are two slit pockets that are spacious enough to slip my hands. In the first photo, I am wearing this over sweats. It is really best if worn over a thin blouse so that it looks more streamlined.

The material has a nice spring/stretch to it. This is made in China of 15% nylon, 57% anti-pilling acrylic, and 28% polyester. Per the label it can be machine washed on cold but I would put it in a lingerie or other mesh bag to prevent it from being pulled. It should be laid flat to dry.

I wish this sweater were longer and came down to at least my mid-calf. However, it was not designed to be that long.

UPDATE - I attached another photo wearing thin clothing underneath (last photo) and this actually comes together in front and fits better as I originally mentioned.

title: Gorgeous form-fitting, warm athletic shirt but pricey
text:
Had I not tried the [[ASIN:B07THMC2RX Truity Tiger Head Athletic Shirt]] before this, I probably would have given this Under Armour shirt 5 stars. However, both shirts feel the same quality to me but are made from different material. Therefore, for some people, it will all come down to price and that other shirt is not priced yet.

Under Armour is a great brand and I love their products. I particularly love these type men's shirts as they fit me well and this one fits me perfectly.  It is form fitting in a super attractive way and would look great on a guy with muscles.

The shirt feels very high quality because it is thick compared to most athletic shirts. It is also moisture wicking, comfortable, warm, etc. The material does attract some lint but not as much as the other shirt I mentioned above. Also, one has to be careful not to go near Velcro with this shirt as it will pull easily and be destroyed because of the type of material this is. I wash this in a lingerie bag and then hang dry it.

This is made in Vietnam of 100% polyester.

The current price of $68.83 for this in a large size is a bit pricey but one is buying the brand and the quality. I took off one star only because of the price and because I suspect the similar shirt I mentioned above will be much cheaper than this one. Other than this, this is a high-quality, sexy, gorgeous, and form fitting athlethic shirt that is thick in a wet-suit sort of way.

Note that mine arrived with the box smashed (see first photo). Lucky I was not ordering this as a gift but they need to correct their shipment packaging.

title: More like underwear in legging form; very thin but super comfortable; best as PJs or for layering
text:
These leggings come in a canvas bag. There are two leggings included - one in gray and one in black. They have a waistband like men's underwear and are thin and see-through. However, they are SUPER comfortable and are perfect as PJ bottoms or for layering underneath snow pants or sweats in the colder weather.

I personally would never wear these "as is" due to the thinness and "underwear look." So far I wore the gray pair under my PJs for warmth and was super comfortable.

These wash well but I hang dry them due to the fabric. These are made in India of 84% cotton, 11% polyester, and 5% spandex.

I personally love these but they are not for use as regular outer leggings as one would expect. I have no idea what this would be priced at, but a price between $18 and $20 for the two would be reasonable. Since these are so thin, I would expect them to pull apart at the seams after months of regular use.

title: Colorful, comfortable, thin ankle (crew) socks that run large
text:
This is a 5-pack of very colorfully designed socks. They are really comfortable for such thin socks. They also run large, in my opinion. I am a size 9 to 9.5 in a woman's shoe and the heel on these socks comes up to my ankle. They stay up when I am wearing shoes but, due to the large size, fall down when I am wearing boots. However, I do like the feel and the fact that the elastic does not "bite" into my legs but not that they move when wearing boots. Note that these are more like crew socks because they come up to my lower calf/ankle area.

These wash well but I hang dry them. Although there is no price listed, I would not pay more than $8 - $10 for these if they were sized appropriately.

title: These feel like uncomfortable tugboats on my feet
text:
To me these are not worth the current price of $28. They feel cheap and are a bit oversized. I take a size 9 to 9-1/2 in women's and this large is for a 9-10. However, it feels like a wide width and are swimming on my feet. They fit better if I wear thick socks with these.

Because my feet move around in these slippers, I often find my heel hitting the top of the low back and that is uncomfortable. In addition, if I do not wear socks, the tag in each slipper irritates my arch because it sits directly underneath it. Of course, I could try cutting that out, but I do not know if the "nub" left behind will be even more irritating. Had I tried these in a store, I would not have purchased them. I would have liked them more had they had a full back and were easier to keep them on my feet (meaning were more narrow in width).

title: Feels like a “performance-wear” type vest; attractive, lightweight, and warm
text:
This is an attractive vest with the contrasting red interior with gray exterior. It is lightweight and thin, yet warm. It feels like performance-wear type clothing. It is also a bit breathable with what looks like mesh venting on each side for part of the torso area. The center front of the torso where the zipper is does not have this venting which is just a piece of material that has strategic holes throughout.

There are three very spacious zippered pockets - one on the left chest area and one on either side of the waist. The zippers glide easily.

I originally ordered this for my boyfriend with the knowledge that he might not fit into it because he takes an XL. However, I inherited it because it is a bit tight on him. We both love this vest and he was impressed. He wants to lose weight just so that he can fit into it.

title: Awesome form-fitting quality (a.k.a. thick) long-sleeve athletic shirt
text:
Boy do I love this shirt. I know it's a man's shirt but this fits great on me. It is not loose as I expected but extremely form fitting in a super attractive way. This would look great on a guy with muscles.

The shirt feels very high quality. What I mean by this is that it is thick compared to most athletic shirts I have tried before. In fact, it is thick in a wet suit sort of way. It has a raised dot-matrixy image of a tiger head on the front. Because of this, I have to wash this inside out in a lingerie bag. This shirt has to be hung dry due to the material or it will be damaged.

This is made in China of 86% Nylon and 14% Spandex.

There is only one negative about this shirt and that is that it shows lint easily. I have three cats and hair attaches easily.

I have no idea how much this will cost as a price is currently not listed; however, I would expect this brand to be in the $30 or under range.

title: Very soft leather wallet with room for 12 cards and a double billfold
text:
I know this is a man's wallet but I use them too. I have several Clifton Heritage wallets because they are good quality compared to other brands I have ordered previously.

This one is as good as all the others. The wallet is made of soft leather and looks like quality. It has a double billfold. In the center is one window ID slot and behind that are three more slots for cards. On both the left and ride sides of the wallet are also three more card slots including one slot behind each of the three-card slots on both sides. In total, there are 12 credit card or ID slots.

This has RFID protection to keep cards private from scanners but I have no way of verifying that.

This comes packaged in a nice box suitable for gifting. Overall, this feels like quality and although no price is listed, I feel this would be a reasonable buy at $16 or less.

title: Lightweight board shorts with mesh liner; my boyfriend loves them
text: My boyfriend loves these board shorts. They are lightweight, colorful, and the right length and have a drawstring strap on the inside. They also wash well but are best hung to dry.

title: Lightweight board shorts with mesh liner; my boyfriend loves them
text: My boyfriend loves these board shorts. They are lightweight, colorful, and the right length and have a drawstring strap on the inside. They also wash well but are best hung to dry.

title: Lightweight board shorts with mesh liner; my boyfriend loves them
text: My boyfriend loves these board shorts. They are lightweight, colorful, and the right length and have a drawstring strap on the inside. They also wash well but are best hung to dry.

title: Warm, thick holiday PJs that fit like thermals but too $$$
text:
I ordered these PJs in a large and at the current price of $88 plus 25% off with coupon, these are still very expensive.

They fit me perfectly but I have an odd shape. I normally take a medium or large bottoms and an XL or XXL in a top because I am very chesty. The bottoms on these are smaller than expected comparable to the top. However, they still stretch to fit, so that should not be too much of an issue. These fit me perfectly. I love them. They are warm and thicker than some other PJs I wear. They also appear to be good quality. They fit like thermals since they have the ribbed collar around the ankles and arms. They also loosen up to fit my body during sleep and keep me very comfortable. I also love the holiday tree design.

These are made in India of 100% organic cotton. They wash well and tumble dry on low without shrinkage.

If these PJs were $45 or less, then they would have gotten 5 stars from me.

title: Keeps me warm in the cold but a bit long and baggy
text:
I normally take a large in bottoms and sometimes a large to XL to XXL in tops depending on the cut (since I'm big on top). I ordered this in an XL and the bottoms are huge on me (long and loose) and the top is loose as well. I am 5'5" tall and length-wise things usually fit fine.

We have been having cold weather in the Northeast this week, so I wore these on one of my two-hour 6:30 a.m. walks when we just had a frost and it was around 30 degrees. This definitely kept me warm--in fact, I became a bit too warm as the temperature creeped up.

I washed and dried them last night and they came out fine. I do not detect shrinkage and if it has shrunk, I cannot tell.

These thermals are definitely comfortable and warming. However, due to the sizing, they are more suited as PJs on me. In fact, I might have to pin them closed on the bottom when not wearing pants over them because the bottoms are incredibly big on me. Nevertheless, I really like these.

title: Stunning Poodle but get out your magnifying glass
text:
This review is for the rose gold poodle.

This is a stunning poodle but is really designed for a very young or very thin girl. It is so tiny that it is practically impossible to see on my neck. The chain is 18 inches and thin but easy to fasten. I personally would not pay more than $8 for this pendant due to the size. Unfortunately, this is not for me because of its diminutive appearance. Nevertheless, it is lovely--if only I did not need a magnifying glass to see it.

Note that I zoomed in and cropped photos 3 and 6 to enhance the detail of the photo that comes before it. For example, photo 2 is what it looks like and photo 3 is the same photo zoomed in on the necklace (same with photos 5 and 6).

title: I thought the outside was fleece; my mistake; it is still a very nice jacket
text:
The picture on the Amazon site makes this jacket look like fleece and that was the only reason I ordered it. However, it is not fleece. Instead it has a hard (raincoat like) water repellent shell with a bonded fleece (once again not soft and fluffy) lining. It is very warm and defintely comfortable; however, it is NOT breathable to me. I actually sweat in this.

There are several nice features. It has two exterior zippered waist pockets for my hands. There is also a zippered left chest pocket for small incidentals such as a cell phone. On the interior right side there is a tiny zippered pocket large enough for coins or rolled up cash. It has a media port so that headphones or wire can be passed through from a tiny iPod or MP3 player. The arm cuffs are adjustable so they can be tightened around the wrists. There is an adjustable drawcord at the waist.

This is made in China. The shell is made of 97% polyester and 3% spandex and the lining is 100% polyester.

This can be machine washed and air dried.

In summary, this is an excellent all terrain or trail coat and it is very attractive. I know it's a man's coat but I like wearing those type coats because they fit me better on top. It is also true to size as this is spacious on me. The zippers glide easily and the coat feels good on. It comes with a one year limited warranty.
