The only reason I rated this 4 stars is because this jacket is not breathable and I actually thought it was a fleece jacket based on the Amazon picture. Other than this, it is excellent.

title: Looks like a jailhouse PJ top
text:
The fit is as expected on me (snug because I ordered a large instead of XL). This would be perfect with leggings except that it looks like a pajama top with jailhouse stripes. I will be using it for bed because the color and design are not appropriate as a blouse.

I love the feel of the fabric. It also stretches to fit. It is made in China of 50% polyester, 45% rayon, and 5% spandex. It machine washes well in a lingerie bag and I air dry it.

This would have been a fine top if the look were not so "pajama-like." It is an utter disappointment as designed.

UPDATE Nov 3, 2019 - I washed this top and it came out very wrinkly. I had to dry it on low in order to get the wrinkles out and it looks fine. However, after the first wash it does not look as good as when it was new but it does not matter to me since I am using this as a PJ top.

title: Nice wallet but holds only credit cards, IDs, or wallet-sized photos and not cash
text:
This is an attractive blue leather zippered wallet that holds only credit cards or wallet-sized photos. It actually holds 22 credit cards or IDs or wallet-sized photos. There is room for 20 cards in the center plastic sleeves and then room for one card in the ID window on each side of the wallet. It can be a bit tricky getting the cards into those two slots as the zipper gets in the way; however, that is typical of any zippered wallet of this style.

It has RFID protection but I have no way of verifying that.

Overall, this is a nice wallet but should really be called a credit card holder or portfolio than a wallet. I suppose one could fold their cash into the card slots but that is not what this is for.

title: Good peds that stay put, grip the floor well, and are comfortable but thin
text:
I previously tried these  [[ASIN:B07X7M8VPQ Toes and Feet Peds]] and loved them so much that I purchased another set. When these Gmall peds came up for review, I just had to try them. However, these are a little thinner than the [[ASIN:B07X7M8VPQ Toes and Feet Peds]] and I also prefer the black color to these gray ones.

These fit like ballet slippers because they are form fitting, snug, and stay put. In addition, they are very comfortable and grip the floor very well. I actually ordered these to wear to bed after moisturizing my feet. These stayed put all night without being restrictive. They also kept me balanced during those nighttime visits to the bathroom simply because they do not allow my feet to slip on the bare floor as sometimes happens when wearing socks. I really like these but I do like my black ones more because of the thickness and color.

These wash well in a lingerie bag but I lay them flat to dry. 

Note these come in a three-pack and the current price of $16.99 plus 5% off is competitive but not as good a deal as the others I purchased.

title: Gorgeous blue floral scarf that is very warm and partially covers my shoulders
text:
This scarf is beautiful. I love the gorgeous blue color with the super attractive floral pattern. It also partially covers my shoulders and is very warm and cozy. It is also super soft and comfortable to wear and does not itch. It is made in Germany of 100% acrylic.

The current price of $26 is on the high end but it truly is a beautiful scarf and feels high quality even though it is thin. I absolutely love this.

title: Wonderful form fitting long-sleeve crew neck; great as base layer or outer shirt
text:
This crew neck is made in  Bangladesh of 100% cotton (or so the label says). However, it is very stretchy and actually feels like elastane or spandex.

Nevertheless, I love this. I usually take a men's medium if I want a snug fit and a large if I want a loose fit. Since I wanted to use this as a base layer, I ordered a medium which fits perfectly and is not super snug but is very form fitting. 

This washes well in a lingerie bag in the washer. I prefer to hang dry this and not use a dryer.

Overall, this is a fantastic shirt and I wish it came in a royal blue because I would order another one. It may be a man's shirt but I love it. A man can either wear this as an outer or base layer shirt.

title: Beautiful shirt that is true to size; looks and feels great on
text: This is a gorgeous short-sleeve shirt made in China of 100% cotton. The fabric is actually thicker than I would expect a summer shirt to be and is very nice. My boyfriend loves it. It is also true to size and fits him loosely in an XL. Note that an extra button is sewn on to the interior label on the shirt (see second photo) which is atypical of where these buttons are usually sewn. The current price of $29.99 is competitive. Overall, this is a 5-star shirt in my and my boyfriend's opinion.

title: Incredibly stylish and attractive hat; looks great on me
text:
This hat looks fantastic on me. I am totally in love with it.  The outer head cabin is made of 92% polyester, 6% viscose, and 2% spandex. The interior lining is made of 46% cotton, 28% linen, and 26% viscose fiber. The visor is made of 100% polyester and feels like fake leather.

There is a cinch strap on the interior (2nd photo) which can be pulled tighter for a snug fit. However, I take a size small (meaning a hat which is around 6-3/4 or 7 in an adult size) and this fits me snugly already.

This is perfect for a small-sized head. I am not sure if someone whose head is larger will be able to wear this without getting a headache. Nevertheless, it is perfect for me.

title: Has spacious “head cabin” but most likely not merino wool & visor is too curved
text:
This hat fits me well but does not look as great as I had hoped because the visor is curved downward like a C on my head. It is warm and has a large enough "head cabin" to allow me to pull this over my ears. Note that I normally take a size small hat which is around 6-3/4 or 7 in an adult size.

As for the claim that this is merino wool, I cannot be sure. There is no tag saying it is wool and it just feels like typical knitted cotton but I cannot be absolutely sure. My rating is based on how it looks on me and not on whether it is or is not merino wool as advertised.

title: Beautiful deep blue jean shirt but sizing is way too small
text: This is an incredibly beautiful jean shirt but the sizing is 2 sizes too small. This large fits like a small. I usually take a medium in a men's shirt if I want a snug fit or a large if I want a loose fit. This shirt just stays open like a jacket on me and there is no way I could ever close it even if I were flat chested. This is not typical of other men's shirts I wear. I am so incredibly disappointed because there is no way I could close this even if I lost 70 pounds. The sizing must be "Asian inspired." Another disappointment is that the button holes are too small (or tight). It takes a tremendous amount of effort to open and close this shirt. It is best if it is pulled over one's head, providing the sizing were appropriate.

title: Very comfortable crew socks but be careful of sizing listed
text:
These are very comfortabl crew socks. They feel great on, stay put, and mold my feet well. This pair is made of 80% merino wool, 15% nylon, & 5% elastane. They wash well in a lingerie bag and I lay them flat to dry.

My only complaint is that the sizing listed on the Amazon site is all wrong. I should have ordered a medium but instead ordered a small. I take a size 7.5 in a men's shoe or a size 9 in a women's shoe. The small was rated for a 7.5 men but that should have been the women's sizing.  A man's size is typically 1 to 1.5 sizes smaller than a woman's size. For example, if this fits a women's shoe size of size 6 to 8.5, then it would fit a men's size 4 to 7.5. The Amazon site has the men's and women's sizes switched as there is no way it fits a larger shoe size for a man than it does for a woman. Fortunately, this small fits snugly because these socks stretch.  

Below is the INCORRECT info currently posted on the Amazon site:
"Wide-ranged Sizes & Colors Available - 3 sizes: SMALL (fits women shoe size 4-7.5; men shoe size 6-8.5) /MEDIUM (fits women shoe size 7-9.5; men shoe size 8-10.5) /LARGE (fits women shoe size 9-12; men shoe size 10-13) in multiple colors to suit your personal needs and styles."

title: Beautiful but terribly oversized; more like a 3X than 1X
text:
This is a beautiful velvet drape coverlet; however, it is incredibly oversized in my opinion. I ordered the 1X to have a loose fit but this fits like a 3X on me. I am incredibly disappointed by this. Other than this, it is gorgeous. It is perfect to use over evening wear. The front comes to a point and drapes down at an angle, hanging lower than the back. There are two pockets, one on each side for inserting my hands. There is no front closure.

If this were not so large in the 1X size, I would have given this 4.5 stars. It only looks attractive on me if I have my hands in the pockets and am holding it close to my body from the inside.

title: Excellent peds; they stay put, grip the floor well, & are comfortable
text:
These fit like ballet slippers because they are form fitting, snug, and stay put. In addition, they are very comfortable and grip the floor very well. I actually ordered these to wear to bed after moisturizing my feet. So many of my socks fall off and these stayed put all night without being restrictive. They also kept me balanced during those nighttime visits to the bathroom simply because they do not allow my feet to slip on the bare floor as sometimes happens when wearing socks. I love them and just placed my order for another set.

Note these come in a two-pack and the current price of $9.99 plus 30% off is excellent. Note that the 30% only applies to one order. My checkout price was $6.99. Of course if I wanted more than one pair, I would place two separate orders to get the $3 off to apply to both orders. If the orders are combined, meaning two sets are ordered at once, only $3 will be taken off that one order. This only works well with Amazon Prime members where no shipping charges are added.

title: Love the shirt; perfect for fall; it does shrink length-wise just a tad
text: I purchased this shirt in blue after I saw another style shirt with the same saying (but much more expensive) in a local store. I love the inscription on the front as it is perfect for fall. It is very comfortable on and is attractive. It washes and  dries very well but I feel it shrinks in the length just a tad but not enough to make a difference on me. Overall - 4.5 stars.

title: Nice green fuzzy scarf with fringe; feels so warm and comfortable; hand wash only
text:
This is a really nice, warm fuzzy scarf. It is super soft against my skin. I also like the fringe and the green (a.k.a. Khaki) color. It does attract a lot of lint. I have cats and I have to constantly pick off fuzz. It is made of 100% Acrylic and should only be hand-washed which I consider a drawback. Of course, I could always try to wash this in a lingerie bag in my washer but I am not so sure these threads will hold up.

Overall, this is one of the better scarves I have ordered.

title: Soft and spacious leather wallet but mine arrived with imperfections
text:
This is made of 100% leather and it certainly smells like it. However, it feels like it is made of PU leather. It is very soft and has one billfold, a mesh ID window and room for four more cards behind that. It also has room for eight cards in the centerfold.  In total, there are enough slots for 13 cards if we include the ID window.

At the current price of $48, one is paying for the Calvin Klein name. However, at that price, this wallet should have arrived in perfect condition. Instead, there are scratches and imperfections on the front of the one I received (see last two photos).  

It comes in a giftable box as shown in the first photo.

Overall, I like the wallet but I do not love it due to the plasticky feel and the imperfections.

title: Warm, soft, and comfortable winter hats
text:
These two hats are really nice. They are fleece lined and feel great on. They look good as well. The dark grey is a bit larger than the lighter grey with the pom pom. This means the dark grey hat is more slouchy but both fit well. These are perfect for winter and I am very tempted to order the white and red set.

UPDATE - Since I liked these so much, I just purchased and received the red and white beanies. Once again, the white one is larger than the red. On the package I received the red is smaller than I expected but still fits. I wish both their beanies came in the same size as it is always the one with the pom pom that is smaller by a few inches.

title: Socks are rough on the interior and they slouch and move around in shoe
text:
These socks are for a size 6-12.5. I take a 7.5 in men's and 9 to 9.5 in women's, so since these do not fit my boyfriend, I ordered them for me. I also usually go for a wide width in shoes for comfort and expect my socks to be roomy but still elasticized enough for snugness.

I really like the colors of these two pairs; however, that is where my like ends.  Unfortunately, I do not feel the same way about these socks as other reviewers.  I walked in them and find that the interior is not soft at all. It feels very rough on my feet; almost as if I am wearing a linen or burlap sock. 

These socks are also very thin and they do not stay up on the calf and tend to move around. After having tried these, these are only socks I can wear to bed or around the house. 

I wash them on cold and hang dry them.

In summary, these two pairs are very disappointing in the feel, thickness, and fit and I doubt it is because I am a woman wearing these and not a man.

title: SEE UPDATE - Description & picture are wrong for this hat; makes my head look like it’s full of air
text:
I ordered a fake leather hat as shown in the picture on the Amazon site. However, what I got was a felt cloth type hat with a butterfly pin along the rim. The visor is short and the top of the hat is so large that it makes it look like I blew up my head with air and am about to take off. Not only is this hat unattractive but it is not at all what is advertised.

UPDATE: I changed this from 2 stars to 3 stars because I finally got the correct hat (see last picture). The hat is adjustable via a buckle in the back. However, even though it is fake leather it feels cheaper than that--almost like plastic. It is made in China of 100% polyester with the lining 93% polyester and 7% spandex. I normally look great in these type page boy hats but this one looks so so. Due to its cheap feel and less than attractive look, I am rating the correct hat I received 3 stars. NOTE that there is a chance purchasers will get the wrong cap because the packaging and label on the packaging is the same for both hats I received.

title: This shirt looks great on my boyfriend & he loves it; but it wrinkles
text:
This shirt is made of 100% linen. Although I do not like the feel of linen, my boyfriend loves how it feels. It also looks fabulous on him. In fact it looks better than any shirt I have ever seen him in.

Note that this works as both a casual and non-casual dress shirt. It does wrinkle, however.

It can be transformed into a shorter sleeve shirt by rolling up the sleeves and buttoning the loop to the outside button located in the elbow area.

This should be washed on cold. My boyfriend loves the wrinkles but if that look is not desired, then an iron is needed.

title: Very comfortable, long socks that stay up and wash well
text:
I love the bright blue and red colors of these socks. Since these are soccer socks, they are supposed to be long and do come a little bit above my knee, so I fold them over.

They have a light compression and stay up. I cannot stand socks that slouch and fall down. They also feel comfortable on. In addition, these socks wash well but I choose to hang dry them.

title: Waist is a bit big but otherwise it’s a nice light rain jacket w/interesting features
text:
This is a very thin windbreaker-type waterproof raincoat. I ordered an XL but the bottom of the waist area is big on me but it fits fine on top. There is no cinch around the waist.

It has two side pockets at the waist and the left pocket is zippered with a hook inside. The zipper is there so that the raincoat can be stored and zippered inside the pocket and then hooked onto a purse or backpack. There are also two large inside slip pockets on the interior of the jacket. The hood is located under the Velcro collar and is elasticized but does not have cinch straps. Water does run off this rain jacket.

Overall, this is very nice light rain cover but it is super thin and very similar to a light windbreaker.

title: Super comfortable, just-above-the-knee shorts with four deep pockets
text:
I ordered these pants for my boyfriend and he loves them. They are comfortable and fit him perfectly falling just above the knee. They also can pass as dress up shorts and are not only casual. They are made of 97% Cotton and 3% Spandex.

There are two deep front pockets and two back one-button closure pockets that hold his larger sized zippered wallet.

They also wash and dry well on low.

title: So dainty and small that it gets lost on my finger; band color is darker than shown
text:
There is no way this is worth $49 in my opinion even though it is 14K rose gold plated over 925 sterling silver. Nevertheless it is attractive but also very, very tiny and impossible to see on my finger. This is best for young, super skinny fingers and even then, I consider this too dainty to be noticeable.

The band looks thicker in the Amazon picture than on the ring I received. This is a pretty ring but does not have the WOW factor I was looking for. It looks much nicer in the picture on the Amazon product page than in person. I also asked my boyfriend's opinion and he said the same thing.

title: Very warm with soft fleece interior; my boyfriend loves this set
text:
There are two hats; one that is a lighter marbled grayish black and another that is all black. The all black beenie has a nice emblem sewn on top but the other one is all plain.

The interior is super soft and warm as it is lined with fleece. My boyfriend absolutely loves these hats. They are roomy and slouchy. The extra material can be molded the way one wants to wear them.

title: This watch is stunning, elegant, and easy to set once I figured out how
text:
When I first opened the box and saw a burlap sack, I was disappointed. However, once I got to the real treasure underneath, I was blown away. This watch is absolutely stunning. I love the chocolate brown alligator patterned leather strap with the gold-color-outlined faceplate with night blue interior. The only thing I do not like is having to remove the blue gunk from the crown to display the emblem and the marginally written instructions.

Setting the time was simple. I just pulled out the crown and turned clockwise to set the time as is typical of most watches. However, I originally had a difficult time figuring out how to set the day (Mon - Sun), date (1-31), and month (Jan to Dec). I had to use a metal toothpick to depress the associated nodules that are located on the side of the watch. In addition, these features have to be set via a pumping action which is not mentioned in the instructions.

For example, when looking at the watch, at 8 p.m. is a nodule for the month on the side of the watch, at 11 p.m. for the date, at 4 p.m. for the day. To set, press a toothpick into the depression and pump once for each turn of the appropriate dial. It reminds me of pumping up a bicycle tire - push in, release, push in again, release, etc. until the desired selection is reached. Once all the dials were set, I was able to wear and enjoy.

Since this is an automatic, it needs to be worn daily as the clock is wound based on the movement of the wrist. I had an automatic watch in the 1970's and loved it. I did not even think they existed anymore.

This watch is supposed to be water resistant as well.

Since I just got this, I cannot attest to the longevity of this watch. However, so far I really love the look of it and the fact that it is an automatic. It also comes in a giftable box. I know this is a man's watch but I ordered it for me as I like the beefiness of a man's timepiece. 

The only things that would make me love this watch more is a crown that is not covered in plastic gunk, a faceplate with letters instead of Roman numerals, and better instructions. Other than this, this Survan watch (made in China) is a beauty!

PS I will update this review if it fails in any way.

UPDATE October 1, 2019 - I have been wearing this daily and it is working wonderfully. However, there is one point to note that I noticed today. Since September had 30 and not 31 days, I had to set the date to the 1st manually. Therefore, the date will always have to be reset in any month whose number of days are 30 or less.

title: BEWARE - Coat is 2 sizes too small but is an excellent jacket otherwise; perfect for arctic weather
text:
I ordered this in a size XL for my boyfriend with the understanding that if it did not fit him for some reason or if he did not like it, that I would wear it. Unfortunately, we both love it but neither one of us can use this coat because it runs two sizes too small if one wants a roomy fit.

My boyfriend takes a size large in a men's and sometimes an extra large depending on the cut.  I take a large in a men's if I want a loose fit and a medium if I want a snug fit. Although both of us can squeeze into this coat, there is no room for movement of the arms or torso (back / lats area). We both look like stuffed sausages in this coat. It almost feels like it fits as a medium on me and a small large on him. I had a hard time zippering my boyfriend into this jacket (photo 7).

Nevertheless, this is a wonderful coat. It is warm, puffy, has ample pockets, and a stylish hood. It is perfect for arctic weather. These are its features:

- It has a fur-trimmed hood. The hood is not removable but the fur trim can be unbuttoned and removed. Photo 2 shows one button on the left side of the fur trim.

- There is one very spacious zippered inside pocket on the left side (photo 1).

- There are two large zippered breast pockets and two straight spacious snap closure pockets on the bottom (photo 4).

- There is a tiny zippered pocket on the left arm (photo 3) and room for two pens in the sewn sleeves right next to that pocket. 

- There are also cinch cords at the waist (photo 5) and for the hood to pull them tighter (photo 6).

- The coat has a full-length zipper that goes up to the chin and snaps over that (photo 5).

In summary, this is an incredibly beautiful and warm coat. I am more than upset that the sizing is too small. A men's XL in a coat usually swims on me and I can wear a thick hoodie or sweater underneath and still feel comfortable. Instead, it is like a straight jacket on both of us and we both wore short-sleeved shirts. It is two sizes two small if one wants to feel comfortable in this coat. We would have to have ordered a 3XL for a beautiful fit that would be equivalent to an XL. For this reason only I took off 2 stars but the coat itself is 5 stars if it were not so small.

UPDATE October 5, 2019 - I had a friend try this on who takes a size medium and it fit him perfectly. This confirms this coat is two sizes too small.

title: Very soft, comfortable, & true to size; theystay up all day
text:
I ordered these socks for my boyfriend. He is a size 13 and always has trouble finding socks that fit him appropriately. He really loves these socks. They are also true to size and fit him well coming up to his mid-calf. They are very soft and comfortable. In addition, they stay up all day.

I love the rich black color and feel of these socks and they wash well but I prefer to hang dry them. Only tumble dry up to medium if using a dryer.

title: BUYER BEWARE --> This is NOT Cashmere; it's Polyester but is supremely soft, thin, and luxuriant
text:
I normally give a product a one-star rating for false advertising but did not do that in this case simply because this blanket scarf is wonderfully soft and luxuriant but thin. It is also warm and large. However, it is made of 100% Polyester and is not Cashmere like the product title states. I have never felt Cashmere nor do I own anything Cashmere but if it feels like this, then I can see why it is a sought after material.

I love the scarf, just be aware that it is Polyester. The current price of $13.89 is very reasonable for what this feels like.

title: Beautiful large non-leather tote that carries everything
text:
This is a beautiful large tote that fits my purse organizer as shown in the third picture. It also fits a computer and other incidentals instead of the organizer. It has one tiny interior zippered pocket and two small interior slip pockets on the opposite side that are only wide enough to fit some tissues or a tiny phone like a flip phone or a small iPhone without a case. The exterior has two side pockets on the front side. They remind me of sweater pockets in the sense that they are half sized. They will fit a Smartphone. The zippers also glide easily on the internal enclosures as well as the external pockets. This bag has a full zipper enclosure.

Even though this bag is PU leather (meaning fake leather), it is really nice. I love it due to the feel that looks like leather, the two carry handles (arm and shoulder), and the spacious interior. It also looks expensive. Overall, this is a wonderful tote.

PS - It also comes with a plastic Moda backpack type bag shown in the last photo.

title: Full-sized wallet with many compartments
text:
This is a full-sized faux (fake) leather wallet with zipper closure. There is room for eight credit cards (four on each side). There is also a double-billfold in the sense that there is a billfold on each side. There are four separate compartments in the middle--one of which is zippered.

The zipper on the center compartment is tough to open but still works well. The outside zipper glides easily.

During use I noticed when extracting a credit card on the right side that it gets caught underneath the zipper lip. However, that is still not too much trouble as all I have to do is pull the lip back to remove the card.

Overall, this is spacious enough for most people's needs. I know it is spacious enough for what I carry.

title: Thin sweater good for when layering but too pricey
text:
The current price of $47.99 is outrageous for this thin sweater. I would not pay more than $15 for this because it is very thin. Nevertheless, it is good for layering due to its thinness. There are two front pockets--one on either side. It also has a button down front. I like the look but not the paper thin texture.

Note that it comes in compressed packaging (see first photo).

title: Very  comfortable & super soft; wrist stitching too tight for sizing & also over 100% too pricey
text: These gloves are somewhat true to size except for the stitching around the wrist which is too tight for the sizing specified. They are super comfortable and soft and are made of felt-type material and fake leather in the palm area. The felt material is extremely thin even though it is double-lined. After having tried these, I really like them but the price of $35 is about $20 too much. Since they are so thin, they are good for mild winters and not for super cold temperatures. They also need to make the wrist stitching elasticized or at least larger.

title: Beautiful crossbody wallet; fits everything I need except for my keys
text:
This is a beautiful crossbody wallet. It fits my cash, up to eight credit or ID cards (4 on each side), Chapstick, my flip phone, and a couple of tissues. A small writing pad and a pen also fits in the outside pocket. Only my bulky keys will not fit. I have to use the clasp on the strap to hang my keys off of on the outside of this bag.

What I love is how it feels. It feels like buttery leather but it is fake leather. The Zebra design is also super attractive. Overall, I really love this.

title: For mild winters only; comfortable; soft; but over 100% too pricey
text: These mittens are true to size and just slightly snug on me as I usually take a large. They are comfortable and are made of felt-type material with some faux fur around collar and fake leather in the palm area. The felt material is extremely thin even though it is double-lined. After having tried these, I cannot recommend them at the current price of $50. In my opinion, these are not worth more than $20. Also, since they are so thin, they are good for mild winters and not for super cold temperatures.

title: Sizing runs a tad small; look is beautiful; there are no pockets
text:
I usually take a large in pants and sometimes a medium depending on the cut. These pants run on the small side and are more like a medium. They fit me snugly and feel great on but they feel very warm to me since they do not breath which is typical of leggings type material. Note that they do not have any pockets like some yoga or other pants.

The design of the black, white, and gray color combination is highly attractive. I wash these in cold water and hang dry them since they are 83% polyester and 17% elastane and they wash well. One weird thing about these leggings is that they have four tags inside and one is written in what looks like Arabic. I have never seen a garment with so many tags at the waistline all on top of one another like a deck of cards. Nevertheless, these tags did not bother me during wear. However, I may eventually cut them out of the waistband.

Overall, these are very nice leggings. However, if you are on the borderline for size, I would recommend sizing up.

title: Clasp is terrible; tangles easily; not sterling silver but gold plated
text:
This chain is a complete disappointment. Although, it looks pretty in gold, I ordered sterling silver. Also, the clasp is horrible. The head of the clasp gets caught in the "door" of the lever that opens. It is practically impossible to open and close. I personally cannot recommend this due to the clasp.

In addition, the chain crimps up easily. It tangles in a way that it has to be un-crimped in order to lay flat. This is not as big a deal as the clasp issue but it is another disappointment.

Other than being pretty, it has nothing else going for it. I personally do not care for the clasp end being the showpiece. I think it is best to use as a charm necklace if one can open and close the impossible to work clasp.

title: A lovely blouse that is so elegant and makes one look slender
text:
This blossomy blouse is gorgeous and goes with jeans, work pants, etc. It is perfect for an evening out.

The way this falls on the body makes one look more slender than they are--especially me who is very chesty and big on top.

At first I had trouble figuring out which is the front and back of this blouse. However, the front is lined and that was the only way I could tell. The waist has a light ribbon of elastic and the arms and neck line have a full 2-1/2 inches of elastic that helps make this stay put yet produces a flowing look.

This is made of 95%Polyester and 5%Spandex. Polyester is usually uncomfortable but I find this top very comfortable and cooling to wear. The off-shoulder design requires that a strapless bra be used with this unless one is wearing this over a turtleneck or using pasties.

Included in the package is a silk-like bandanna (see last photo) that can be used around the forehead or to tie back long hair.

It can be washed on cold but must not be dried, ironed, or bleached. I put delicate items like this in a lingerie bag and then hang dry them.

Overall, this is a stylish top that is elegant yet ordinary enough for any occasion. I absolutely love the style, design, and look of this slimming blouse.

title: Ratty, see-through, thin, ugly pinkish brown pullover sweater
text:
I own their [[ASIN:B07TTQ6PS3 Actloe Women Open Front Hooded Long Sleeve Fleece Cardigan]] which I really like. Therefore, I am incredibly surprised at how ratty, thin, see-through, and ugly this pinkish brown pullover is. It has no warmth and is really unattractive. It is still useful in that it can be worn over something else. However, I personally hate this. Their cardigan I mentioned above is thin but at least it looks nice and feels warm, super soft, and comfortable.

This sweater looks like it has been worn for years and is on its last leg. I am so utterly disappointed.

I attached three pictures. The first photo is how shrink wrapped it is for shipment and the last two photos show the see-through quality and what they call a "brown" color that looks like a washed-out pink to me.

title: Very nice tank tops that I use as undershirts but they are too short at the waist
text:
I really like these tank tops. If one has the shape, they can even be worn as an outer top. There are two tank tops in this package with a nice racer back cut.

I use these type tanks as undershirts and my only disappointment is that they are about one to two inches too short at the waist. They are true to size in that they are attractively form fitting on me. However, I like to tuck the edge into my underwear and I can barely do that with these because they come just a tad below my belly button. Nevertheless, they are still good for my use but beware that one's belly is likely to be exposed in these short tops.

title: Very soft and stylish stretch jeans but about 2 sizes too small; zipper is a bit sticky
text:
These jeans fit me but they are definitely about two sizes too small. This size 37W x 33L fits like a 34W x 32L.

I ordered these for my boyfriend with the understanding that if they did not fit him that they would at least fit me. They do not fit him but they fit me. He takes a size 36W x 30L. He does sometimes take a 38W. I take a 34W-36W depending on the cut. However, these did not fit him around the waist even though they stretch. I then tried them on and they snugly fit me. Therefore, I am able to wear these, which is a plus.

Another thing I do not like is that the zipper is sticky. I do not have any confidence that the zipper will last long. In addition, these are not really carpenter pants. They have two generous back pockets and two front pockets with a coin pocket on the right. There are none of those extra leg pockets typical of carpenter pants.

Other than the sizing, sticky zipper, and not really being carpenter pants, these are a beautiful pair of dark blue jeans. I love the color, the feel, the softness, and the stretch. They also wash well.

title: Nice, warm, hooded cardigan but sheds initially; a bit too pricey
text:
This is a wonderfully soft, yet thin hooded cardigan. It does shed some fuzz balls initially (see second photo). The two side pockets are spacious for keeping my hands warm. There is ribbing at the wrist area which is very nice. The rest is just a soft thin fleece. There is a large hood in back but there is no drawstring. Also, there are no closures in front. It has an attractive appearance in front which is very stylish (see last two photos). The first photo shows how incredibly shrink wrapped this is but one has to be careful when cutting open the package.

The current price of $40.99 is way too costly for this. In my opinion, this should be priced around $25 to $30 maximum.

title: These are nice to use as undershirts and are form fitting
text:
I ordered these in a large for a snug fit as undershirts and they fit me perfectly. I love the black ones, then the gray, and the white the least. There are four tank tops in this package with two black, one gray, and one white.

The only thing I do not like is the smell. I had to wash them first in a lingerie bag and I tumble dried them on low and they came out fine. Other than the initial bad aroma, these are good as undershirts. I personally do not wear tanks like these as outer shirts. These are elastic and slinky feeling and are made of 95% Modal and 5% Spandex.

title: Stylish watch but the band clasp is lousy
text:
I ordered this for my boyfriend. The watch itself is very attractive and comes in a nice gift box. I like that the clock face is simple even though it does not have numbers on the face.

What my boyfriend and I do not like is the clasp. The band is self-adjustable by pulling it in another direction. There are no instructions but I finally figured out how to make the adjustments. Nevertheless, the clasp itself is awkward to work and then it sometimes does not stay closed. It opens from left to right on one side and then right to left on the other--meaning it opens like a double door. The inside "door" hooks onto to the band, but the outside door just flaps around. When moving around it is easy for the clasp to come undone.

Overall, my boyfriend and I are very disappointed in this design.

title: Luxury belt that measures 46 inches from base of buckle to tip
text:
I own several Clifton Heritage wallets and their products just scream luxury. This belt is no different and comes in a nice gift box with extra screws.

It is all leather and is super attractive in a variegated brown. There are five "belt holes" at the end. My boyfriend takes a size 38 and this fits him perfectly. I measured the belt from the base of the buckle all the way to the tip and it measures 46 inches. Based on my research, the belt size from base of buckle to tip should be 7" greater than the pant size. Therefore, this belt is suitable for a size 39 inch waist or below.

This is definitely a high quality leather belt. I have no idea how much this will cost but I feel $22 and under is appropriate.

title: Very soft and stylish stretch jeans but about 2 sizes too small
text:
These jeans would have gotten five stars from me had they fit but they are definitely about two sizes too small. This size 36W x 33L fits like a 32W x 32L.

I ordered these for my boyfriend with the understanding that if they did not fit him that they would at least fit me. They do not fit either one of us. He takes a size 36W x 30L. He does sometimes take a 38W. I take a 34W-36W depending on the cut. However, these did not fit him around the waist even though they stretch. I then tried them on and got them up fine but could not close the waist no matter how much I stretched them. Other than this, these are a beautiful pair of jeans. I love the color, the feel, the softness, and the stretch. However, these are definitely not true to size. At least the pair I got is not true to size. Even the length is wrong. A 33L on me usually hits the floor, this fell just a little bit below my ankle which is what a 32L fits like on me.

title: Attractive leather belt with cross weave but they need to list sizing
text:
This belt is all leather and is super attractive. I love the cross weave braided design. Since this is an open weave, there is a "belt hole" everywhere along the entire length. My boyfriend takes a size 38 and this fits him well with minimal room for growth.

Unfortunately, there was no sizing listed when ordering and no sizing on the website. Amazon told me this is an XXL but that is nowhere to be found--not even on the box. I measured the belt from the base of the buckle all the way to the tip and it measures 45 inches. I do not recommend anyone over a 38 inch waist buy this belt because I could see where it would be too small. I believe a belt that measures 45 inches is for a waist that is 38 inches or below. Based on my research, the belt size from base of buckle to tip should be 7" greater than the pant size.

This would have received 5 stars from me had the sizing been addressed. Other than the lack of sizing, this is very nice. There is a slight smell to the leather but I did not find that too offensive and my boyfriend cannot smell it because he does not have a sensitive nose.

I have no idea how much this will cost but I think a price in the $18 to 22 range would be reasonable.

title: Cleans as good as water but with less fuss; goes on like whipped cream
text: I attached before, during, and after pictures of cleaning my boyfriend's dirty sneakers. It took some dirt off as can be seen by the dirty paper towels. This dispenses like whipped cream and cleans like water. I do not feel this is anything special; however, it cleans in a pinch when no water is available. I am skeptical if it will clean scuff marks. I have over 15 pairs of sneakers and do not have scuff marks on any of them. My boyfriend's dirty sneakers only have black bottoms and the one that has a white bottom has no scuff marks.

title: Very comfortable shirt; very thin and cooling; however a bit too thin
text: I love Life is Good shirts and I purchased this same shirt in an XL in the Night Black color (Item #55784-XL) from their website when it was on sale. It is extremely comfortable and cooling; however, it is very, very thin (see second photo) and not as high quality as their other shirts I ordered. I have 11 Life is Good Shirts and this is the thinnest of the bunch. I will have to wash this in a lingerie bag and hang dry it. Other than this, I love the inscription and the shirt. Note that they run large as this is like a dress on me. I could have ordered a large and it still would have been loose even though I typically take a large in a male size if I want a loose fit.

title: Gorgeous necklace for a young girl, teenager, or twenty something
text:
This is a stunning necklace, especially against a dainty bare neck or a black turtleneck. The chain is very thin and easily knots if one is not careful. It is also 18" long with the clasp. I love the heart / tiara design.

Unfortunately, this gets lost on my neck. Because it is so dainty, this necklace is more suitable for a young slender female. It is perfect as a gift for a girlfriend and comes in a highly presentable box.

Besides the price not being posted for this (I suspect it will be under $50), I have one other disappointment. The necklace is secured well with glue and a clip inside the box. The interior compartment in the box that holds the necklace is not removable. As a result, one has to be careful to dislodge the clip and glue holding the necklace chain with bag in place. If one is not careful, the box will be destroyed. I had to do "delicate surgery" in order not to destroy the box as I like to keep my necklaces with their packaging. I hope the vendor fixes this issue as the extra glue and clip are unnecessary.

title: Relatively soft navy-blue leather wallet that holds 12 cards & has 2 billfolds
text:
This wallet is made of a relatively soft leather and is dyed a navy blue (almost black) color. It is a full-size men's wallet and feels substantial in my hands.

There is room for 12 cards and a double billfold for cash. In the centerfold there is enough room for 10 credit cards and 2 ID card slots with picture window that flips out from the left side (see photos 2 and 3). There are four slots on the left and four on the right and one slot on each side behind each bank of four slots. There is also a double billfold.

Supposedly this has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that. It also comes in a box that is giftable.

In summary, this men's wallet is very nice and offers a lot of storage. The current price of $14.99 is priced right for this wallet. I would have expected the price to be a few dollars more, actually.

title: Stunning Crocodile Embossed Leather Wallet w/room for 10 cards & double billfold
text:
This wallet is STUNNING. It feels great in my hands and the crocodile embossed leather is supremely attractive. In the centerfold there is enough room for 10 credit cards. There are four slots on the left and four on the right and one slot on each side behind each bank of four slots. There is also a double billfold. The billfod interior feels like it is made of soft suede. Note that it does not come with an ID window like some wallets do, but I do not care about that.

Since this wallet is larger (4.5" x 3.75") than some other wallets, I can see where it might not fit easily in all men's back pockets. Supposedly this has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that. It also comes in a box that is giftable.

In summary, this wallet screams nothing but quality to me. I have no idea how much this will be priced at but I feel anything between $18 and $25 is competitive.

title: Beautiful, attractive, soft long-sleeve shirt
text:
This shirt is made of 52% cotton and 48% polyester which provides for a nice soft and warm shirt. It is super attractive and comfortable. It also washes well inside out. I choose to hang dry it.

The only disappointment I have is that the color on the website of heather forest green looks more vibrant than what I received. The shirt I received looks more like a steel gray (see photo) than heather forest, which is supposed to be green. Although, the color is not spot on, I still love it. In fact, I ordered another one in maroon.

As per the Amazon site, "With every sale at The Wanderheart Project, $1.00 is donated to families of a child in the hospital with a congenital heart defect." I will take them at their word.

title: Soft and comfortable men’s tee; wash inside out & hang dry
text:
I ordered this men's shirt for me in an XL. I normally take a medium men's for a snug fit and a large for a loose fit. This is extra loose on me. The neck hole is a little bigger than expected. Nevertheless, this is super comfortable. It is made of 95% cotton and 5% elastane. It is definitely a breathable fabric as I was totally cozy in this all day and I tend to sweat a lot.

I turn this inside out when washing this due to the "plastic" logo on the front. I also hang dry this. It should not be tumble dried.

As of this writing, this XL version is listed on Amazon for $20.79 minus a $9 coupon, which makes the price of $11.79 an extremely reasonable buy.

title: Design makes extracting coins difficult & zipper is sticky; there's room for 4 credit cards
text:
I am not crazy about the design of this slick leather coin purse. The purse is longer than a regular wallet. The zipper is also very sticky. When I put coins in this, the dimes get stuck in the corners and it is hard to extract the coins. On the back side of the purse are slots for four credit cards or IDs which is a nice feature. It does come in a giftable box.

In summary, I like that this is leather and that it has room for four credit cards. However, I do not like that sometimes the zipper is sticky and that fact that the coins get stuck in the pointed corners. I wish I had not ordered this as it does not suit my needs.

title: Love the leather and the color but the design limits what this can hold
text:
This leather wallet only has room for four cards. Of course, one can stuff two cards in each slot but that is still not enough, in my opinion

I love the caramel color and the feel of the leather. However, the center section is the only place that has slots for cards. There is room for one card on either side and for one card behind each of those slots. One slot has a pull-tab to make it easy to remove the ID.

It has RFID protection but I have no way of verifying that.

I have no idea how much this would cost but I expect this to be priced around $7. It is stylish but the design is not minimal even though what can be held within is. It comes in a giftable box.

The only reason I took off two stars is because of the limited amount of cards that can be put in what is a thick wallet.

title: Beautiful, soft, purple wallet in pebbled leather; really slim
text:
Purple is one of my favorite colors so this leather wallet really appeals to me. This is a nice textured minimalist wallet in a purplish blue leather. It has an ID window in front with room for a credit card behind that. In the center is a pocket for folded cash or another card. On the back side are three credit card slots and another slot behind that. Therefore, there is room to squeeze in about five credit cards, an ID, and some folded cash.

I love how soft this is and the pebbled texture feels great and provides a good grip. Overall, this is a very nice wallet but is priced a couple dollars high at $9.99 minus the current coupon of 10% off.

It has RFID protection but I have no way of verifying that. There is no gift box with this, so that is a disappointment. The color, feel, and minimalist design are 5 stars. However, the price is a bit much. Overall, I give this 4.5 stars.

title: Nice textured leather minimalist wallet and comes with a LOVE note
text:
This is a nice textured minimalist wallet in black leather. It has two pockets in front and one is an ID window. Behind that is another pocket for a credit card. In the center is a pocket for folded cash or another card. On the back side are three credit card slots and another slot behind that. Therefore, there is room to squeeze in about six credit cards, an ID, and some folded cash.

I like that the back has a thumb hole that makes it easier to push up the bottom credit card. Overall, this is a very nice wallet but is priced a couple dollars high at $9.99.

It has RFID protection but I have no way of verifying that. It is sort of giftable as it comes tightly wrapped. An envelop is provided and a love note. Therefore, if giving this to someone, I would suggest unwrapping the wallet and inserting it in the envelop with or without the love note depending on who it is for.

title: Wonderful, light, cooling shirt with SPF protection – LOVE IT
text:
This shirt fits me like a dress; it's huge on me because I ordered an XXL and I usually take a medium for a snug fit in men's and a large if I want a loose fit. This is super loose. Nevertheless, I love it.

This shirt is a gorgeous gray and blue color. It is cooling and feels wonderful on. It is made of 88% polyester and 22% spandex exclusive of decoration. It is also tag-less so there are none of those annoying fabric tags inside. It is supposed to protect my skin up to SPF 50 but I have not been long enough in the sun to verify that. I will take their word for it.

Hi-Tec is known for good quality performance garments and this certainly meets that standard. The cut and fit are fantastic in a moisture-wicking fabric. It also washes very well in a lingerie bag. Although, I could tumble dry on low, I choose to hang dry garments like this.

I also feel that the current price of $30 is reasonable for this quality shirt.

title: Great as an outer shirt or undershirt for a woman but it runs a size too small
text:
There are three shirts in the package I received - black, white, and gray. All the shirts are 100% cotton and they are super soft and somewhat stretchy. I actually wore the black shirt as an outer shirt and plan to wear the gray one as that as well. The white shirt I will wear as an undershirt because it is on the see-through side.

I know this is a man's shirt but I order men's shirts like this for me. If I want a snug fit, I order a medium which I will then use as an undershirt. If I want a loose fit to wear as an outer shirt, then I order a large. However, this large fits almost like a medium on me. They are a bit snug but not super snug. It is actually shapely, form fitting, and looks good on me. The bottom of the shirt falls down to my upper thigh. Since I really like how they look and feel, I rated this 4 stars even though it is slightly snug.

However, these ARE NOT true to size and at $29.95 they are expensive at $10 each. All the shirts I received were sewn correctly and the only thing wrong with these is that they are not cut correctly for the size specified.

I already wore and washed the black shirt and it washes well. I choose, however, to hang dry it as I am afraid it will shrink.

title: Attractive, soft, comfortable underwear but they ride up
text: This is a 5-pack of very soft and attractive underwear. The colors are black, black striped, gray, dark purple, and light purple. Unfortunately, I can only use these for bed because they ride up easily. If I wanted thongs, I would have ordered them. This is what these underwear turn into.

title: Rustic minimalist wallet that is a bit thick when empty; has pull-tab & RFID protection
text:
This is a rustic minimalist wallet but it is a bit thick compared to other minimalist wallets I have. That is because there is an elastic band sewn in-between the layers so that the folded cash compartment can stretch.

It has an ID window on the back side and a credit card slot on the front side that has a pull tab for easy access. That is a great feature except that it requires one put the card back in the wallet in order for the pull tab to be out of the way.

The center compartment has two compartments for two credit cards. A couple more credit cards can be slipped in the slots in the center behind the elastic. Therefore, there is room to squeeze in about six credit cards or four credit cards, an ID, and some folded cash.

It has RFID protection but I have no way of verifying that. It is also made of leather and is definitely rustic looking and cowboy style as the title claims. The box it comes in is also giftable. No price is listed for this wallet, but I would expect this to cost around $8.

title: Thick, beautiful sweatshirt but runs on the small side
text:
I usually wear a medium to large in a men's shirt. If I want a snug fit, I go for a medium. If I want a loose fit, I go for a large. Therefore, I expected a loose slouchy fit with this hoodie since I ordered it in a men's XL. However, it fits me like a large. Basically, it fits me perfectly but I was looking for a looser fit.

Nevertheless, this sweatshirt hoodie is hefty and so soft on the inside. The logo on the outside is attractive to me. The current price of $94.97 for this Light Grey Denim Heather hoodie in a men's XL is a bit expensive for what it is but one is paying for the name. I expect a sweatshirt of this caliber to be sold in the $50 or $60 range.

Overall, I am pleased. I just wish the fit were larger.

title: Comfortable shorts with excellent fit but salmon colored (not pink)
text:
These shorts fit my boyfriend exceptionally well. They are comfortable and have four generous pockets. There are two deep pockets in the front and two generously-sized pockets in the back that have a button closure. In fact, the back pockets are large enough to fit a larger wallet he has that is difficult to get into other pants.

There is a one button closure with zipper in front and an inside drawstring. I do not consider these a seashell pink; we feel it looks more like salmon. They also wash well but do wrinkle a bit as expected.

My boyfriend absolutely loves these shorts.

title: Great organizer for the right boxy purse; also provides handbag with interior stability
text:
This is my fourth purse organizer. I already have this [[ASIN:B07QM6Q7LM OMYSTYLE FASHION Large Purse Organizer]] in black and some other organizer I bought a long time ago for one of my other large boxy purses. I rated both of those four stars. Since I liked these type organizers so much, I decided to order [[ASIN:B07SCKZ4DC this one]] in a large and in a rosy color that really looks like hot pink. I also ordered a medium in the exact same style in this [[ASIN:B07SBKN9YX red color]]. I ordered both for some similarly sized totes I have that I can now use as a purse as a result of this organizer. Note that the last photo is of the handbag I am using this in just to give you an idea of the girth of the type of bag it fits in.

I actually prefer this type over the first two I mentioned above because instead of a center three pocket cavity there are more pockets typical of a purse. This is one of the reasons this style is five stars to me.

FEATURES:
- This is made of felt and is pliable.

- The main cavern has a removable section that has a center zippered section and two small pockets on one side and a large pocket on the other. This section is held together on each side by two Velcro strips which have to be realigned during initial use. The second photo shows a close-up of this center section.

- There is storage on either side of the center organizer. There are also two other pockets along the inside interior wall on both sides.

- One the outside wall on the one side are two pockets enough to hold a cell phone.

- On the outside wall on the other side is a full pocket for a tablet or large Smartphone. This can be barely seen at the top of photo 6 where there is just the black of my small tablet peeking out.

- In addition to the organizer itself, a small photo or card wallet is provided as can be seen in the bottom of photos 1 and 3.

In summary, this enables me to organize items in my big boxy totes or handbags of similar size. It also gives those purses some more stability. I like taking a color tote and turning it into a handbag this way. Note that the purse needs to be large (at least 13.5" long, 7" wide, and 8" tall) in order to handle this type organizer in a size large.

title: Minimalist leather wallet that holds 2 credit cards & folded cash in the center
text:
I love the pebbled texture of this minimalist wallet but am not as crazy about the maroon color as I am of their [[ASIN:B07S9D8WBL aqua version]]. It is extremely thin and low profile and stylish.

There is room for one credit card on the front and back sides of the wallet and some folded cash in the center. It has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that.

Overall, this is a very nice minimalist leather wallet. The box it comes in is giftable (see first photo); however, I wish that they did not tape the box shut. If I had ordered this as a gift, I would have wanted to open the box to look at what I am giving. The only way to open this box is to cut the tape which then makes it not giftable. The price is not currently posted on Amazon for this, but I feel a cost of around $5 to $6 would be reasonable. It is 4 stars only because the box is taped but the wallet itself is 4.5 stars. It would have gotten a 5-star rating if the color was more to my liking and the box was not taped.

title: Minimalist leather wallet that holds 2 credit cards & folded cash in the center
text:
I love the pebbled texture and gorgeous aqua color of this minimalist wallet. It is extremely thin and low profile and stylish.

There is room for one credit card on the front and back sides of the wallet and some folded cash in the center. It has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that.

Overall, this is a very nice minimalist leather wallet. The box it comes in is giftable (see first photo); however, I wish that they did not tape the box shut. If I had ordered this as a gift, I would have wanted to open the box to look at what I am giving. The only way to open this box is to cut the tape which then makes it not giftable. The price is not currently posted on Amazon for this, but I feel a cost of around $5 to $6 would be reasonable. It is 4.5 stars only because the box is taped but the wallet itself is 5 stars to me.

title: Awesome stacking ring that I can change to suit my mood or outfit
text:
I was sent a size 7 ring that only fits on my pinkies. There are eight pieces total (photo 3) but the ring only holds six pieces together. To change or alter the location of the pieces, all I had to do was unscrew the base and adjust the ring to my liking. I received a blue and red ring that I could add on by removing the black rings on the sides or even the diamond-like ring in the center. Of course I could leave the black rings on and remove the double-sized etched ring and then add on the blue and red rings.

This is super attractive and stylish. It can be a little tricky to unscrew and re-screw the band holder, but so far it is working perfectly for me.

title: 5 stars for looks, 4 stars for comfort, 1 star because they run one size too small & narrow
text: These athletic shoes are super attractive and have a breathable top. They are also comfortable. I ordered these for my boyfriend, who can only get them on without socks and he agrees with my assessment. He is a size 12 to 13 depending on the shoe. However, this size 13 is way too small and narrow. Unfortunately, he cannot wear these which is a huge disappointment.

title: Luxurious bi-fold wallet except for smudge on inside & scratched ID window
text:
This bi-fold leather wallet is gorgeous and the leather is buttery soft. It screams luxury all the way and comes in a giftable box (see first photo). On the left side inside is room for three credit cards. In the center is an ID window. Behind the ID window is room for three more cards and behind that a pocket for another card. On the right side is also room for three cards and behind that one more card. In total there is room for 12 credit cards or IDs. There is also a double billfold.

It has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that.

My only complaint is that the wallet I received has a black smudge on one of the credit card pockets (see top slot in photo 5) and the plastic ID window is scratched / filmy (see photo 6). This wallet would have received five stars from me if it were not for those minor imperfections.

Overall, this is a luxurious leather wallet even with the flaws. It also feels great to hold due to the buttery soft leather. It is a great man's wallet but can be used by women too. The current price of $16.99 is reasonable.

title: I do not know how in the world a guy can fit into this; it is not for muscled bodies
text:
This is super attractive and very nice as a hooded-type blazer over a nice dress. I know it is a guy's cardigan but it fits somewhat like a woman's. I like the slanted design and length and the navy (almost black) color. The two slit side pockets are not too generous but they are good enough for resting one's hands.

Nevertheless, I do not know how in the world a guy can wear this because the arms are too skinny on top and the back does not allow for developed lats (latissimus dorsi muscle). The arms are straight up and down and the top part is tight on me. Second, I feel like the incredible hulk in this because if feels like the back is going to rip apart if I cross my arms in front of me. In addition, the arms are super long and I have to fold up the sleeves. The hood is also super over sized and the kind of style I would expect Justin Bierber to wear.

This is made in India of 100% fine yarn (whatever that means). It is machine washable per the tag.

Personally, I feel this is freakishly cut and unless a guy has super skinny long arms and no muscle, I cannot see how this will fit him well. I feel it will fit most flat to moderate-chested women, however, and look stylish on them. It looks good on me but the arms and back are too restrictive for me to be able to wear this.

UPDATE July 2, 2019: I had my girlfriend, who is super skinny but muscular and about 65+ pounds lighter than I am, try this on. She said that she found the arms and back restrictive and agreed with me with regard to the cut. This is more like a skinny non-athletic woman's tunic than it is for a muscular man. It is definitely freakishly cut.

title: Super soft & comfortable; form fitting; outside stitching is odd
text:
These yoga pants fit me perfectly. They feel great to the touch and wonderful on. I also love how comfortable they are. In addition, they move with my body and fit like a good glove. They also have three pockets--one on each side of the outer thigh and one small pocket on the left side directly on the waistband. I have no need for these pockets but it is a nice touch for those who can use them.

I only have one issue with these tights. I do not care for the look of the stitching in the butt area. I always wear shirts over my pants, so this stitching is hidden by my shirt. However, if I did not cover that area, the upside down double stitched smile highlights the top of my butt which I do not like. This is the only reason I took off one star; otherwise these are five-star yoga pants.

These tights wash well in a machine but I hang dry them.

title: Super soft & comfortable; form fitting; outside stitching is odd & ripping sound when putting on
text:
These shorts fit me perfectly. I love how they feel to the touch and how they feel on. I also love how comfortable they are. In addition, they move with my body and fit like a good glove. They also have two pockets--one on each side of the outer thigh. I have no need for these pockets but it is a nice touch for those who can use them.

I do have two issues with these shorts. First, the moment I opened the waist to put my feet through the legs, all I heard was a ripping sound in the waist area as if the stitching in the waist was ripping apart. However, I cannot see any ill effect with the garment.

The other issue is that the look of the stitching in the butt area is weird. I always wear shirts over my shorts, so this stitching is hidden by my shirt. However, if I did not cover that area, I would be embarrassed to wear these because there is an upside down double stitched smile which highlights the top of my butt and with the firmness of the shorts, it makes it look like my posterior is being squeezed through that area of the shorts. It is not very attractive and is the reason I rated this three stars.

If these shorts did not have either problem, they would have gotten five stars from me. BTW, they look orange and not wine red, so be aware of this before purchasing.

This washes well in a machine but I hang dry it.

title: Beachy necklace with a wonderful slipknot closure
text:
This is very beachy and looks nice with T-shirts or sundresses. Although the shells do not all face the same way, I do not care about that. I just like the vintage style and relaxed look. I also love the soft pink pouch it comes in. The slipknot is easy to slide open and closed. I had no problem getting this over my neck and cinching it up choker style. Of course, I had to be careful not to catch my hair in the knot on closing. I think the current price of $10.99 is very reasonable for this.

BTW, my cord was black and not off white like is pictured on Amazon. I actually prefer a black cord.

title: Good organizer for the right boxy purse; also provides handbag with interior stability
text:
Note that this review is for the large black organizer which they do not seem to have available on the Amazon site.

I ordered a purse organizer a long time ago for one of my other large boxy purses. Since I liked it so much, I decided to order this one for another large boxy purse. Note that the last photo is of the handbag I am using this in just to give you an idea of the girth of the type of bag it fits in.

FEATURES:
- This is made of felt and is pliable.

- The main cavern of this organizer has a removable section that has three center holes. This section is held together on each side by two Velcro strips which have to be realigned during initial use. The third photo shows a close-up of this center section where I put my pill bottles.

- There is storage on either side of the center organizer. There are also two other pockets along the inside interior wall on one side only.

- One the outside wall on the one side are three pockets with the center pocket being small enough to hold a couple of pens only (photo one).

- On the outside wall on the other side is a pocket for a tablet or Smartphone (photo two).

In summary, this enables me to organize items in my big boxy handbags and also gives those purses some more stability.

title: Minimalist leather wallet that holds 6 credit cards & folded cash in the center
text:
I ordered Louis Pelle wallets before and never liked them because they arrived stained and just shoddy quality. However, this leather wallet is extremely thin and low profile and, since it looks black (even though it says classic blue), looks very nice.

There is room for three credit cards on the back and front of the wallet and some folded cash in the center. I do worry that the center will split apart because it is sewn halfway down (see last photo) and is easy to rip apart if it gets caught on something.

It has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that.

Overall, this is a very nice minimalist leather wallet. The box it comes in is one-use only but it is still giftable (see first photo). The price is not currently posted on Amazon for this, but I feel a cost of around $6 to $8 would be reasonable.

title: Thin, scratchy, wrinkly material that is long but not wide; very colorful
text: This arrives looking like a dog toy as can be seen from the first three photos (particularly photo three). It has to be untied and unraveled, which is relatively easy to do. However, the shawl is very thin, very scratchy feeling, is extremely wrinkled, and not wide enough to use as a shawl. It is colorful, which I like but is not something I will be using. Also, a few threads fell off during the unraveling.

title: Soft like butter, stylish, & spacious leather wallet with RFID protection, 10 pockets & a billfold
text:
This is an attractive tri-fold leather wallet. On the outside center back of the wallet is room for one credit card. On each side of the fold out is room for three credit cards plus room for one more behind those pockets. In the centerfold is a clear ID slot. Then there is a billfold. In total there are 10 pockets (slits) for credit cards or IDs and one billfold.

It has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that.

Overall, this is a very nice leather wallet and it feels great to hold due to the buttery soft leather. The price is not currently posted on Amazon for this, but I feel this is competitive in the $18 to $20 range.

title: Too wide and loose; comfortable once I removed the tag & wear socks or arch support
text:
I take a size 9-10 shoe in women's and a 7.5 to 8M in men's. These slippers are good in the length but they are entirely too wide making them very loose. They also have a tiny tag at the arch, which I had to cut out (see third photo). This tag is super irritating if not wearing socks. However, socks or some insert is required since they are too big. Otherwise they are very comfortable and warm.

The instructions (first photo) says that these can be spot cleaned or machine washed in cold and either line dried or tumble dried on low.

If these fit better and did not have that irritating tag right at the arch, I would have rated these 5 stars.

title: IMPOSSIBLE to get on & hosiery is scratchy; I can’t use these
text:
This review is for the extra-tall size compression pantyhose. I attached a photo of the sizing.

I use a lot of NuVein socks which are usually exceptionally good. However, I absolutely HATE these pantyhose. First of all, I found them impossible to get on. I spent over 10 minutes just getting them up to my ankles. I felt like I was playing tug of war. In addition, the material feels like burlap and is very scratchy. After about 15 minutes of trying to get these on, I gave up.

I would never order these again. They are absolutely impossible to get on and the material is terrible.

title: Small, lightweight, & versatile enough for daily travel or as a rolling work briefcase
text:
This is a lightweight, high quality, rolling 15" travel bag that is good for daily or weekend travel or for use as a weekday rolling work briefcase. It is also designed as a carry-on luggage for underneath the seat in an airplane.

I got this for both storage and to use periodically as a briefcase. It is very small in the sense that only about two changes of clothes can fit in here with a tiny bag for toiletries. The padded electronic sleeve that faces the main compartment is very small and useful only for a tiny iPhone or tablet. It's best for tablets 9 inches and under but will hold a 12" as long as there are enough clothes in the main compartment so that it does not fall out of the pocket.

THE POCKETS:
- One main compartment with a center Velcro pocket (that's the padded electronics sleeve) and a zippered pocket on the other side of that (photos 6 and 7).
- The front cover has two interior zippered pockets (photo 8).
- Each side has a couple of mesh pockets (photos 9 and 10).
- Photo 12 shows two zippered pockets in front of the bag with the one BELOW the logo being the pocket with RFID protection.

The handle locks in place and is easy to expand and contract. The spinner wheels roll easily even on carpet. It gracefully glides across a bare floor. This comes with a 10-year warranty.

Overall, I am very happy I ordered this. I do wish the padded electronics sleeve was larger but that is about it.

title: Hoodie runs a tad small & waist comes up to belly button; I prefer it much longer
text:
This is a nice pullover and feels super soft on the inside. It is all black with white hood ties. However, there are a few things I do not like about this particular hoodie.

First, there is no center pocket to rest my hands.

Second, the waist comes right up to the belly button. I prefer my pullover's to go below the waist. In fact, this is my most hated element of this item.

Third, the sizing is just a tad small. I expected the XL to be a smidgen looser.

I own their [[ASIN:B07PT8X99F tri-color hoodie]], which is almost wonderful. That one also runs small but the hoodie comes a little below belly button and it has a center pocket and partially zippered front. Instead of being as nice as their other one, this hoodie is like a mini-sweatshirt with a hood and is more for a younger girl.

title: Comfortable lounge around wear; will show one’s silhouette in the summer light
text:
I really like this dress even though it is not shapely. It is a straight design with two side pockets. The dress is long and falls just above my ankles but has slits that come up to my knees.

I like the coffee color. I am also surprised that the XL fits me loosely as I could have probably gotten away with a large in this cut.

I machine wash items like this in a large lingerie bag. It must be air dried and not tumble dried. it is made in China of 85% Polyester and 15% cotton and feels a little heavy but shows my silhouette in the summer light which is why I will pair this with leggings and an undershirt or bra.

The attached photo does not do this dress justice as it looks better on, in my opinion.

title: Colorful, spacious wallet; holds many cards; zipper can be sticky
text:
This is an attractive tri-color (light pink/white/beige) wallet that is perfect for summer. It is not leather but instead made of the typical cheap faux leather materials Americans have become use to. The front fold-out section includes six credit card slots (one of which is a full ID slot). Behind that are two full sized billfold slots. Opposite that section is room for another six cards. The zippered section contains a double billfold. As long as the billfold is full enough that the zipper does not collapse in on itself, then the zipper opens and closes smoothly. However, if the billfold is not full, the zipper is sticky. The tassel is a nice touch but can get caught on things found in an ordinary purse.

In the pictures I attached, a blue plastic film covers the clasp and should be removed to expose the rather imperfect golden embellishment. I have since removed it (see last photo).

Overall, this is a decent wallet for the price. It feels cheap but is functional and holds a lot. The zipper is sticky if the billfold is not full.

title: Gorgeous Hoodie but runs a tad small & I would have preferred a longer waist
text:
This is a beautiful pullover and looks better in person than I expected. It is a marbled black with gray and white hood ties with a partially zippered front. The center pocket is spacious to use for resting or warming hands. It is super soft on the inside and very comfortable and warm. The sleeve length is perfect but I would have preferred a longer waist. I also feel the sizing runs just a tad small as I expected it to be a bit looser on me.

Overall, this is extremely stylish and comfortable even if it runs a tad small.

title: Super comfortable underwear in french cut but I do not like threads
text:
I absolutely love the microfiber french cut Jockey underwear and actually have over 50 pairs of them in all colors. However, recently I decided to order them in the strip version and I am upset that there are threads on the left an ride sides. It is necessary because that is how the white and associated colored stripe is worked into the underwear. Nevertheless, I would not order these colors because I like a completely thread free underwear.

Note that the threads do not come undone (at least they have not so far). I also do not feel them when wearing the underwear. They are still super comfortable and look great on. They wash well in a lingerie bag and hang dry well or for a few minutes in a low dryer.

title: Bangle has twisted design and it’s super easy to get on
text:
At first I did not like this because of the twisted design as it looked bent. However, the design has grown on me. This is a very attractive bangle and it is super easy to get on because it has some "give" to it. Normally, I have trouble getting bangles on my wrist but not with this one.

Currently, there is no listed price; however, I would pay up to $6 for this.

title: Two stylish PJ shorts that are super comfortable & true to size
text:
This is a two pack of pajama shorts in navy blue stripe (which looks more like black striped) and heather light gray stripe. I ordered these in a large and they are roomy and fit perfectly on me. When paired with a loose shirt, these can be used for bed or one can even get away with wearing them (particularly the navy blue one) outside like by a pool, on a deck, etc. Both pairs of shorts also have generous side pockets.

These washed well in my dryer; however, they should be tumble dried on low. I forgot to do that and accidentally put them in on high and they did shrink a bit but not too much. Overall, I love the style and comfort of these PJ shorts.

title: Super soft interior fleece; the black color looks great on
text:
This is a gorgeous black sweatshirt that is super soft on the inside. It is made of 60% cotton and 40% polyester. Note that this has to be washed in cold water only, inside out and should not be put in the dryer or it will shrink.

What I do not like is that there is a warning label sewn into the fabric that says "This product can expose you to chemicals including lead and cadmium which are known to the state of California to cause cancer, birth defects, and other reproductive harm...." Why they would have such known substances in clothing is beyond me.

The sweatshirt I got is a large. I normally take a large to XL to 1X depending on the cut of the fabric. This large fit me perfectly; not loose but not too snug either. Overall, I love everything about this sweatshirt except for the warning label.

title: Large rustic-looking handbag of simple design
text:
This review is for the burgundy-colored bag.

This bag does not WOW me. It is fully functional with two outer pockets, a central compartment with one tiny zippered compartment inside. The strap is large enough to be worn crossbody.
