It is larger than I expected and a bit on the rustic-looking (used) side and is simply designed. I think the current price of $44.99 is competitive for a leather bag.

The straps are stiff and sides are a bit rough which makes wearing this crossbody for a long time when full a bit uncomfortable if one is wearing a very thin garment. Also, the card that came with the bag (last photo), says that "contact should be avoided with light colored fabrics as color transfer might occur..." which is disappointing to me.

Overall, I do not feel this is a great bag; however, it is extremely functional. I would not have ordered this had I been able to touch, feel, and examine this purse prior to ordering as it really is not "stylish" enough to me and has too much of a used look for my taste.

title: Very nice & very large scarf that’s extremely versatile
text:
This scarf or dare I say shawl, is very large at 6 feet tall by 2-1/4 feet wide. I did not expect how large this is. However, this makes it very versatile. It can be worn as a scarf, shawl, wrap, etc. The tassels are decorative and the paisley design is attractive. It is made in India. It has to be hand washed if needed.

Overall, I am very pleased with this scarf.

title: Nice tank; definitely for a guy due to open sides; good for summer
text:
This is a nice tank top. It is good for summer. However, due to the open sides, this is definitely for a guy. It is perfect for the guy who wants to show his arm muscles.

I usually wear men's shirts but with this one I have to wear a woman's tank underneath in order to be presentable. It does not really look as I expected on me but that is not the fault of the product. This is one that most women should not buy.

It washes well in a lingerie bag and I hang dry it.

title: There’s nothing luxury about this wallet to me
text:
I am not impressed at all by this wallet. It feels cheap and the center section where a folded bill or two can be kept looks like it can easily be ripped apart.

This is a super minimal design. It has a front ID window with room for one card behind that. In the center, there is an opening on two sides where a credit card or few folded bill can be stored. On the back side is room for four more cards. In addition, it has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that.

This feels super cheap to me; like cardboard cover in cheaply designed leather. The leaf logo on the back is nice, however. Currently, there is no price on the Amazon site; however, I do not feel this is worth more than $3 to $4. Overall, I am disappointed because most of the other Auliv wallets I tried are really nice and some are super impressive.

title: Nice leather wallet that’s a hairline larger that other wallets
text:
This is a nice leather wallet in a dark blue color with a caramel-colored tip and tree embossing. It does look slightly better in person than what is shown on the Amazon site. The leather feels soft and it is roomy enough to hold 12 credit or ID cards and has a double billfold. It is a bi-fold wallet. On the left is room for three credit cards and then an ID to the right in the centerfold. Behind the centerfold one can fit three more cards and then another card behind that and one more card behind the separator that is behind that. The right section has room for three more cards and one card behind that. Then there is a double billfold. In addition, it has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that.

Overall, I feel this leather wallet is a good purchase. However, one must keep in mind that it is a hairline larger than most other wallets, so there might be some difficulty fitting it in a back pant pocket or front pocket. I think it is stylish and although it is made for a man, there is no reason it cannot be used by a woman. It also comes with a nice gift box. Currently there is no price listed, so I suggest one does some comparison shopping to ensure it is competitively priced for the style.

title: Just gorgeous, soft tri-fold leather wallet in a rich caramel color
text:
My first impression and last impression of this wallet is WOW. The caramel color is rich (even better looking than the Amazon site's picture), the leather feels soft, and it is roomy enough to hold 10 credit or ID cards and has a double billfold. It is a tri-fold wallet and each section has room for three cards (two cards upfront and one card behind the section). There is also one ID window. In addition, it has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that.

Overall, I feel this leather wallet is a great purchase. I find the color and style super attractive and love the tree logo on front. It is made for a man but there is no reason it cannot be used by a woman. It also comes with a nice gift box. Currently there is no price listed, so I suggest one does some comparison shopping to ensure it is competitively priced for the style.

title: Very soft, stylish leather wallet for men (or a woman, in this case)
text:
I really love everything about this leather wallet. It is roomy. It has a flip out ID window with three credit card slots behind that and another slot behind those slots. To the right is another set of three credit card slots with another one behind that. Then there's a billfold behind the slots and a top piece to the wallet that has an additional four credit card slots. In total, there there are 13 slots and 1 billfold. It is also a nice slate bluish grey color. In addition, it has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that.

Overall, I feel this leather wallet is a good purchase for someone looking for more than a minimal design with some style to it. It is made for a man but there is no reason it cannot be used by a woman. Currently there is no price listed, so I suggest one does some comparison shopping to ensure it is competitively priced for the style.

NOTE that I also got the [[ASIN:B07QD2W6CY blue wallet]] that they call "classic navy." It is the exact same wallet in a different color; however, it is NOT true to color as shown on the Amazon site. It looks more like a dark grey or a smoke bluish grey.

title: Form fitting, stylish, comfortable, and gorgeous top
text:
I love this green top. Too bad I am so fat that it does not look as great on me as I would have liked. Nevertheless, that is not the fault of the product. This is super comfortable and is form fitting. It moves easily with the flow of the body, so it is perfect as a yoga top even though I do not do yoga now but have done so in the past. I also love how stylish this is. Note that I normally take a large to extra-large in shirts depending on the cut and make. Sometimes I even need a plus size. However, this large fit me perfectly and I am chesty and have a big back.

Overall, I highly recommend this. I also love the attractive green color.

title: Substandard workmanship with defective and stained leather
text:
My first impression was that this was a nice coin purse because it feels cushiony and is all leather. However, after I started examining this, I became highly disappointed.

First of all it arrived stained and with a divot on one side. In addition, the zippers are sticky and the main compartment's zipper does not even zip fully (see last photo). Overall, once inspected it obvious it is highly shoddy workmanship.

Obviously, it is still usable. There is a small front zippered pocket for coins. The center pocket is the only one that will hold credit cards or folded bills. There is also an internal keyring that can be hung outside the top zipper. In addition, it has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that. It is made in India.

If the zippers worked and the leather was not stained and pockmarked, I would have rated this five stars. However, in the condition I received this, it is a two star product.

title: Nice, stiff leather wallet with double billfold
text:
I have a couple of Auliv wallets and really love the almost buttery soft feel of their leather. This wallet is a bit stiffer than their others, but that is because it needs more support.

I personally do not care for the contrasting blonde stitching on the exterior but that is the extent of my dislike besides the stiffness.

The interior has a flip out double ID picture window and underneath that is room for four credit cards. On the opposite side is room for another four. Behind each set of four slots is an additional slot providing enough room for two more cards. It also has a double billfold.

It has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that.

There is currently no price listed on Amazon, but I would pay up to $14 for this wallet. Note that this comes in a giftable box (see first photo).

title: Stylish hat that is perfect for summer; looks great on me & is adjustable
text:
This review is for the [[ASIN:B07PWWY2D5 grey pageboy cap]].

I adore hats and have many of them. The pageboy / bakerboy style is my absolute favorite style. This hat is thin and thinly lined on the inside, which makes it a perfect summer hat. It has three snaps in the back for adjustment. I have a small head and this one fit me perfectly on the middle snap. I could also get it to fit tightly on the last snap.

Overall, I am pleased with this cap and will be wearing it periodically along with my many other hats. I also feel it is competitively prices at $15.99 and as of this writing, there is also a coupon for 10% off the purchase.

title: Nice minimalist leather wallet; love the contrasting color of the pull tab; cash MUST be folded
text:
This wallet is extremely minimal. There are two credit card slots on the interior with room for another two behind the original slots. There is also a billfold and that is it. The billfold is NOT full size, so cash has to be folded.

I love the soft leather and the wallet looks very stylish. On the Amazon site, the pull tab is brown but on the wallet I received it is green. I like the green better as it contrasts nicely with the brown leather. Note that there is only one pull tab on the left and it does not exist for the right side of the wallet.

It has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that.

There is currently no price listed on Amazon, but I would pay up to $6 for this wallet. Note that this comes in a giftable box (see first photo).

title: Not true to size; leg openings too small for size specified; otherwise comfortable
text:
I take a size 6 in underwear which is otherwise known as a medium. However, I ordered these size unknown and they came in a large. I thought these would be too big but lucky they are a large.

The leg holes on these are too tight. Had they been a medium they would have cut off my circulation. The waist, however, is loose like a large is on me so that is correct. These do not ride up and they are comfortable. They wash well in a lingerie bag and I hang dry them.

In summary, I personally prefer more of a high-cut waist in underwear and a little bit more coverage in the stomach area. These just come up to my hips and they do not have as high-cut a waist as I prefer. Nevertheless, the leg hole is not suitable for the sizing specified. Someone who always comfortably wears a medium should not feel like the legs are tight on a large.

title: Super soft, super comfortable shirt perfect for summer
text:
I love Under Armour shirts and this one is no exception. Even though this is a man's shirt I ordered it for me because these type shirts fit me better. The large is true to size.

It is super soft and super comfortable. It is made in Egypt of 60% cotton and 40% polyester. I was hoping it said Egyptian cotton but it did not as that type of fiber is luxuriously soft. Nevertheless, I was in heaven all day with this shirt on.

It washes well; however, I hang dry this since it has polyester in it. The label says not to use fabric softener so be mindful of that.

title: Thin profile leather wallet w/8 pockets, money clip, & RFID protection; love the style & color
text:
This is a very stylish leather wallet that has a total of eight credit card slots and one money clip in the center fold. There is one credit card slot on both the front and back side of the wallet. On the inside there are three pockets on both the left and right sides.

It has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that.

I love the smell of the leather and the color. Although this is typically a man's design, I ordered this for me and one of my many purses.

There is currently no price listed on Amazon, but I would pay up to $12 for this wallet. Note that this comes in a giftable box.

title: Looks utterly hideous on me but it is pure perfection in the rain
text:
I am so embarrassed to wear this rain hat. However, when it is raining, I wear it anyway. I paired this with a raincoat in a terrible downpour and I did not get wet at all except for the exposed part of my legs. I actually had three nails in one tire and spent 15 minutes putting air in all my tires to find the one that was leaking in a heavy downpour and I stayed completely dry. Since I wear glasses, it is especially important because this keeps the water off my lenses better than a regular hat does.

Although this looks atrocious on me and I am paranoid that people are talking behind my back as I pass by, I still wear it anyway. "Looks" wise this is a complete zero but functionally it is 10 stars!

PS --> There is a yellow sticker on the clear visor that says "open." What that sticker means is to peel off the clear film on both the inside and outside of the visor -- see second picture that shows the film edge being peeled off.

title: My boyfriend likes this shirt; it's comfortable & perfect for summer; be prepared to iron
text:
My boyfriend likes this shirt. He says it is very comfortable and perfect for summer. Although the lemon color is not his favorite, he still likes it. The XL fits him perfectly; so it is true to size.

Unfortunately, this does wrinkle and will be wrinkled out of the wash. It is for that reason only that we rated this 4 stars.

title: My boyfriend likes this shirt; it's comfortable & perfect for summer; be prepared to iron
text:
My boyfriend likes this shirt. He says it is very comfortable and perfect for summer. He even loves the orange color and checkered design. Since I ordered an XXL instead of an XL, it is a bit big on him which is to be expected since he takes a size smaller.

Unfortunately, this does wrinkle and will be wrinkled out of the wash. It is for that reason only that we rated this 4 stars.

title: Very basic travel passport pouch with questionable zippers - 3.5 stars
text:
This is a very basic passport holder in the sense that it is not high quality. Nevertheless, it is still nice and still functional. I love the pea green color.

It has a neck holder that can be expanded to wear cross body. There is a cheap carabiner for a key. There is also a pocket where the neck holder hooks into. There is a Velcro main pocket and another pocket in front of that. In addition, there is a zippered photo ID pocket in front of that and even another pocket on the side. In total there are five pockets to this holder.

The zippers glide easily but when I received this, both zippers were apart on either side of each other. However, I was able to get them to work and they are fine now.

This has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that.

In summary, this is not super high quality. I do not feel this will last long for a frequent traveler. However, for the occasional vacationer, this is suitable, functional, and versatile. This also can be used as a minimalist purse and not just to hold passports or for vacation.

title: Super slender, synthetic wallet; highly minimal
text:
This wallet is super slender and is synthetic (not leather). It feels like two pieces of cardboard covered in material. I like the two tone color of the black exterior with caramel interior. There are four potential credit card slots on the left and five on the right because there is a slot on either side of the front credit card holders. In addition, there is an elastic band on the right to hold cash; this is what is meant by a money clip (no clip, just elastic). When cash is in the "clip," it is difficult to get to the cards behind it without moving the cash (photo two). On the outside of the wallet is another slot as can be seen in the last photo.

What I do not like is that the bi-fold does not fully close (photo three) where there is too thick a wad of cash in the "clip." That is to be expected, of course.

The Amazon site says it has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that. This wallet comes in a giftable box.

There is currently no price listed on Amazon, but I would pay up to $6 for this minimalist bi-fold wallet. This is of acceptable quality and function.

title: Thin profile coin purse w/2 pockets, key ring, & RFID protection; like the leather & color
text:
This is a very attractive leather coin purse that has two pockets. The outside pocket held four credit cards of mine easily. The inside held my cash and coins. I did not use the key ring but that is a nice touch when one wants to just carry this and hang their keys outside. As long as the zipper is closed, the key ring can hang outside the wallet with just a tiny leather strip exposed through the zipper.

I love the smell of the leather. I have many purses and use these type of wallets for when I switch among them. It has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that.

There is currently no price listed on Amazon, but I would pay up to $11 for this coin purse. I love the forest green color.

title: Very soft leather; numerous card pockets; screams quality
text:
This Auliv wallet exceeds my expectations. The pictures on Amazon do not do it justice. It not only arrived in a giftable box (first and second photo) but the leather has an almost buttery soft feel to it. The stitching is beautiful and so is the tree logo.

Inside is a flip out double sided ID pocket; one picture ID can fit on either side. There are eight credit card slots in the centerfold (four on each side) with room for two more credit cards behind that. There is also a billfold. See last two pictures. I had to set it up in a triangle to demo that it has that double flip-out picture ID pocket.

The Amazon site says it has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that. Also, the card that comes with the wallet does not say this.

There is currently no price listed on Amazon, but I would pay up to $22 for this minimalist bi-fold wallet. This feels like quality. Although this is more of a man's style wallet, I feel it is usable by a woman too and I ordered this for me.

title: I was able to get my thin profile 17" HP Omen in this; just barely
text:
The Amazon site advertises this as a 15-inch laptop bag and then an 18-inch and a 16-inch. See last photo. After measuring it, the bag is 18" on the diagonal, 16" across, and 3" wide on the side

This fits a 16-inch laptop or notebook or less. For the fun of it, I tried to get my 17" Dell Inspiron in this bag but it would not close. However, my 17" thin profile HP Omen fit; just barely and I was able to zip it up. This fits my 14" LG laptop perfectly with room to spare for paper, pens, magazines, etc.

The zippers are not sticky. Many times I get bags and the zippers take force to open but these almost glide open. There is one zippered pocket on the front outside of the bag. Inside the main compartment is one full-size pocket with a Velcro tab and one zippered pocket. The bag is roomy enough to add a few items along with the computer. The leather is vintage looking and the cloth interior is basic. The handles are sturdy and very comfortable to hold. The shoulder strap is not padded but as long as I use it cross body, the contents stay light enough to carry around without aching. Personally, I like to use the handles over the strap. Note that the strap is adjustable. To me this bag is for either sex and not just women.

Currently, there is no price listed on Amazon for this messenger bag; however, I would expect this to be priced $35 and under even though it is leather. This is made in India.

I took five pictures but Amazon REFUSED to post my review because they said "We couldn’t perceive a connection between the image and the product you reviewed" and they were referring to the pictures of the laptop in the bag and the one I took outside of it to demonstrate what laptop would fit in the bag. Therefore, in order to get this review to post, I had to remove them and now only the following three pictures are attached.

- Photo 1 shows the front of the bag.

- Picture 2 shows the back.

- Photo 3 shows the inside.

Overall, I like this leather bag. It works well and is sufficiently large for most laptops and notebooks with room for about a half a ream of paper.

title: Stylish summer hat that looks great on me; love it
text:
This hat is beige with a complementing chocolate brown bow and black interior rim. It is made of 100% cellulose fiber with the outside band made of 100% cotton. It is also made in China.

I love hats; I really, really love hats. This one is very stylish and the brown bow makes this stand out. The rim curls back on itself and there is a Velcro strip underneath the rim that can be "Velcro'd" tighter for a snugger fit (see third and fourth photo).

The cellulose texture of this hat is softer that some others I have which feel more like straw. Overall, it looks stylish on me and I love it. However, I do not feel it is worth more than $12, so that is the only reason I deducted one star.

title: Sized for a skinny girl and the material is very thin and transparent but my friend likes it
text:
This is sized for a skinny girl even though it says one size. Sure it fits me like a stocking fits the head of a bank robber and it is see through too. In addition it is very thin. I like the red wine color and it does act like a mock turtleneck but it is not something I would ever wear because one size really means for thin girls only.

Nevertheless, I DID NOT order this for me. Instead I ordered this for my friend because she is very slender and I felt it would look perfect on her and I was right (although I was skeptical after I received it).

She tried it on and likes that the fabric is forgiving in band-width because she has a wide back. She is unsure if there will be chafing at the armpits when wearing this for an extended period due to the feel of the material; however, she likes the "tissue-paper fabric" which contours her body nicely. She plans to pair this with a nice white denim jacket and pants and perhaps apply a bold burgundy lipstick to complement the top. This is "definitely good happy hour material." She may also pair this with a simple "beachy" necklace that hangs chest level and "pops" against the burgundy.

Since she has the "smoking body" for this top, it looks great on her. It gets two stars from me and four stars from her--hence the three-star rating.

title: Stylish thin profile wallet w/5 pockets, a magnetic money clip, & RFID protection; love the leather
text:
This is a very attractive leather wallet that has five snug pockets and a magnet money clip. On one side is an ID window pocket. On the other are three credit card slots and in the center is another pocket for cash or more cards. There is also a magnetic money clip on the outside. However, I personally do not like to put money under the magnet clip.

I love the smell of the leather and it appears good quality. The center pocket is a bit tight. Although this is a man's minimalist "pouch," I have many purses and use these type of slim profile card holders for when I switch among them. It has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that.

There is currently no price listed on Amazon, but I would pay up to $11 for this minimalist wallet. It also comes in a box suitable for gifting as can be seen in the first photo.

title: Wonderfully soft and comfortable briefs for both a man or as PJ bottoms or briefs for a woman
text:
I ordered these for my boyfriend but since I was not going to see him for a couple of weeks, I decided to wear these to bed and then wash and dry them. I wore all three over three nights. Since they do not have a fly (opening), the are like pajama bottoms and are super soft and comfortable to sleep in.

They wash and dry well. The pictures are after they are washed and dried. Since I love the teal color, I am going to keep that one for bed. I will update my review with how he likes the remaining two. I think these are absolutely wonderful and wished they had more eye-popping colors like purple, canary yellow, hot pink, electric blue, electric green, etc. and they would have me as a customer.

UPDATE April 30, 2019 - My boyfriend says these are 4-star comfort but the missing flap is important enough to pass them up. Therefore, for him undies without the fly are not something he will buy.

title: Thin profile coin purse w/2 pockets, key ring, & RFID protection; I dislike the color
text:
I already own this wallet in both the [[ASIN:B07P984C4Z purple color]] in the "pebbled" looking leather and the [[ASIN:B07P99N5GQ parrot green]] color. Since I loved the purple and really liked the parrot green, I ordered this one thinking it was also parrot green. However, this color is [[ASIN:B07P6Z8Q7T pista]], which is equivalent to a light yellow green or pistachio color. Basically the color shown on the Amazon website is exactly what I received--a washed out yellow green. I really am not partial to this hue and find it very unattractive.

This leather coin purse has two pockets. The outside pocket held four credit cards of mine easily. The inside held my cash and coins. I did not use the key ring but that is a nice touch when one wants to just carry this and hang their keys outside. As long as the zipper is closed, the key ring can hang outside the wallet with just a tiny leather strip exposed through the zipper.

I love the smell of the leather. I have many purses and use these type of wallets for when I switch among them. It has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that.

There is currently no price listed on Amazon, but I would pay up to $10 for this coin purse as is; $11 if I loved the color & $12 if it were also pebbled. This is just okay visually. I would have preferred the leather be pebbled as the pebbled leather looks and feels more substantial. I would have also preferred a more richer color than one that looks so washed out.

The first three pictures show only this wallet and the last photo shows this one to the left and the [[ASIN:B07P99N5GQ parrot green]] one to the right for color comparison purposes.

title: Thin profile coin purse w/2 pockets, key ring, & RFID protection; like the leather & color
text:
I already own this wallet in the [[ASIN:B07P984C4Z purple color]] in the "pebbled" looking leather and loved it so much that I decided to order this [[ASIN:B07P99N5GQ parrot green]] color.

This is a very attractive leather coin purse that has two pockets. The outside pocket held four credit cards of mine easily. The inside held my cash and coins. I did not use the key ring but that is a nice touch when one wants to just carry this and hang their keys outside. As long as the zipper is closed, the key ring can hang outside the wallet with just a tiny leather strip exposed through the zipper.

I love the smell of the leather. I have many purses and use these type of wallets for when I switch among them. It has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that.

There is currently no price listed on Amazon, but I would pay up to $11 for this coin purse since it is not pebbled. I like it but would have preferred the leather be pebbled as the pebbled leather looks and feels more substantial.

title: Heart sparkles brightly like diamonds but chain is thin
text:
The heart on this necklace is gorgeous. It sparkles brightly as if it were lit up. The chain is a bit thin as is typical of necklaces like this. Apparently everything is sterling silver. The chain is 18 inches with 2 extra inches that have larger links. I find this difficult to fasten on my neck because it is so small. Nevertheless, this is best for a younger person and would look beautiful against a black or navy blue turtleneck.

Although no price is currently listed on Amazon, I would consider this competitively and acceptably priced between $18 to $22.

I attached some pictures. Note that this comes packaged in plastic and I removed that and cut two lines in the foam so that I could hang it inside the box. It does not come displayed as shown; one has to set that up. However, a decent box suitable for gift giving is provided as can be seen in the first photo.

title: Wonderful shirt - soft, comfortable, form fitting but hand wash recommended
text:
This is a wonderfully soft shirt. I wore it all day and was super comfortable in it. It is form fitting also. Hand washing is recommended but I prefer to wash this in a lingerie bag in my washer and then just hang dry it. So far it washed well that way the first time.

What I am disappointed about is that there is no size listed anywhere on the shirt I received. I ordered this through Amazon Vine and took a big chance because no size was posted there either. Therefore, I cannot really say if this is true to size. I know this fit me perfectly and it stretches to fit just like a muscle shirt.

Other than this annoying detail, I absolutely love this garment.

UPDATE April 16, 2018 - I see after this review posted the size is now listed for the shirt I received. It appears I received a medium. I usually take large to XL to even 1X in a woman's, so this medium fit me snugly and perfectly. I'd say it is true to size based on that.

title: This leather is like butter; a multiple-pocket wallet made for a man but loved by a woman
text:
This men's wallet is made of super soft leather. I absolutely love the feel of this. It smells, feels, and looks like a good quality wallet.

This wallet has a double billfold and the interior has a centerfold ID window. There is room for three credit cards on the left, one ID in the centerfold, three credit cards behind the centerfold and one more behind that, and three credit cards on the right and one more behind that. In essence, there is room for 12 credit cards or IDs.

It has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that.

Overall, this is a wonderful wallet. It may be made for a man but I love it for me. I have many purses and use these type of wallets for when I switch among them. This certainly will be one of my "go to" wallets. Currently no price is listed on Amazon; however, I personally would pay no more than $30 for this wallet.

title: Alligator design wallet w/11 credit card slots & 1 billfold
text:
This is an attractive alligator design wallet. I love the caramel color. It has 11 credit card slots; 5 on the left and 6 on the right. There is also one billfold. It smells and looks like leather

I have many purses and use these type of wallets for when I switch among them. It has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that.

Three of the credit card slots on the right are a bit too tight. In fact, that is the only thing I do not like about this wallet. Other than this it is a sturdy and firm leather wallet.

title: Thin profile coin purse w/2 pockets, key ring, & RFID protection; love the leather & color
text:
This is a very attractive leather coin purse that has two pockets. The outside pocket held four credit cards of mine easily. The inside held my cash and coins. I did not use the key ring but that is a nice touch when one wants to just carry this and hang their keys outside. As long as the zipper is closed, the key ring can hang outside the wallet with just a tiny leather strip exposed through the zipper.

I love the smell of the leather and the purple color is one of my favorites. I have many purses and use these type of wallets for when I switch among them. It has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners but I have no way of verifying that.

There is currently no price listed on Amazon, but I would pay up to $12 for this coin purse. I love it.

title: Moderately spacious, canvass-style fanny pack with one tiny interior pocket; very $$$
text:
I love the patriotic colors of red, white, and blue and this is one of the reasons I ordered this pack. The other reason is that I want to use it to carry dog treats and my keys and tissues with me when I walk around my condo complex. This definitely serves that purpose well.

The pack is moderately spacious with a two-inch gusset. The interior is lined with what feels like cheap plastic or vinyl. There is only one tiny extra pocket inside the pack as can be seen in the second photo. I store my flip phone in there or my Chapstick with a few tissues but not both. The exterior belt is adjustable on both sides and the clip functions well but feels a bit sticky at times.

At the current price of $44.50, one is paying for the brand name and not the quality of the pack. To me the material is substandard for the price. I do not feel this is worth that cost. In fact the taxable amount I will have to pay for this pack is a bit more than I would choose to buy this for. Nevertheless, it is functional, colorful, and serves the purpose I ordered it for. I took off one star for the exorbitant price and one star for the quality.

title: True to size; feels partly like a thin sweater; very attractive and comfortable
text:
I really like this shirt. I order men's shirts in a large or XL to wear as outer shirts. This one is loose on me as is typical of most men's XL shirts. It is very thin and made of 50% cotton and 50% polyester. However, it has the feel similar to a very light sweater. It is very see-through if I hold it up to light.

I wore this all day and found it to be extremely comfortable. It is also very attractive. It washes well in a lingerie bag. Because of the type of material this is, I choose to hang dry it.

Overall I really like this shirt. Currently no price is posted on Amazon but I would pay $30 and under based on having tried it. Of course the cost might be more due to the team association.

UPDATE May 9, 2019 - I have been wearing this a lot lately and love it more each day. I wish this were available for purchase in different colors (particularly blue) because I would love to buy another one.

title: Gorgeous, heavy-duty reversible scarf; dry clean only
text:
This scarf is made in China but it feels and looks wonderful. I am actually impressed by how hefty this feels as it is not made of tissue paper type material. It has a nice orange/white/blue print on one side and orange/white on the other. The first picture shows it doubled up on my neck. If this gets stained, it needs to be professional dry cleaned which is the only negative.

This really dresses up a white, black, red, or navy blue solid colored outfit. Overall, I am truly awed with the quality, material, feel, and look of this infinity loop scarf. It may wear like a choker necklace when double looped around my neck but I still love it.

title: This white shirt is very light, comfortable and true to size
text:
This review is for the white shirt which, unfortunately, is not a color listed on the Amazon site.

This shirt is very light, comfortable and true to size. It has a nice weave pattern to it and two generous front zippered pockets. The sleeves can be rolled up and secured with the internal strap and button. This is definitely cut well. I always order a men's large when I want a loose outer shirt for myself and this fits perfectly. It supposedly has UPF 50 sun protection but I have not worn it in the sun enough to be able to say how well that works. I am not a person that likes to be in the sun.

The Columbia label is really on a Velcro flap which I assume can be used to hang one's glasses if needed.

This also washes well in a lingerie bag but I hang dry it.

The current price of $55 is expensive but one is paying for the brand name here and it is competitively priced.

title: Comfortable pants; love the color, stretch, & pockets; waist is lower than expected
text:
I really love these pants and they fit me perfectly. I cannot tell that they are men's pants. The only issue I have is with the waist height. These are more like hip huggers and ride lower than I prefer. I would have preferred them to be an inch or two higher in the waist.

The pockets are generous. There is a change pocket on the right side and two slit pockets. There are two pockets in the back as well and they are generously sized. I like the two leg pockets as they are very roomy for a wallet and phone. These are the only two pockets that have button fasteners on them for security.

They wash well and dry well on low. Overall, I love these pants except for the low waistline.

title: Gorgeous sun protection shirt but cut is all wrong and it is see through
text:
I was so awed by this shirt in the package that I could not wait to try it on. It is a gorgeous variable blue color and feels soft. Unfortunately, when I put it on, the torso was way too tight and short (above the waist) and the arms were long and loose. I take a large to an XL in women's depending on the cut. However, I could have used a 2X in the torso and a large in the arms. In addition, it is see through. I even decided to put this on over two other base layers and it was still see through in the sense that one could see every body outline.

This is such a gorgeous shirt and is rated for 50 UPF for sun protection but I am going to have to wear this as a base layer due to the sheerness and odd torso sizing. If this fit me perfectly and was not see through, I would have given this 5 stars.

title: Runs two sizes too small but it fits me perfectly and is very attractive & stylish
text:
My boyfriend takes an XL and I take a large in a men's jacket . Since this is an XXL, I ordered this for him. However, after receiving it, I had to make it mine. The jacket fits me perfectly as if it were made for me which tells me this runs about 2 sizes too small. My boyfriend cannot fit in this comfortably.

I love, love corduroy because of its look, heft, and longevity when it comes to wear and tear. This is a gorgeous deep blue corduroy that looks great on me. There are two square snap front chest pockets with two slit pockets for the hands behind them for a total of four front pockets. There is also one inside left pocket with no closure. The jacket is lined and waist and wrist are ribbed. Everything is as shown in the picture on Amazon. There is a certain elegance to this piece and I consider it a steal at the current price of $32.99.

This would have received 5 stars from me if it were true to size. This must have been sized in Asia. I took off 1 star due to the sizing being wrong even though it fits me just perfect.

title: Bottoms are nice but flouncy top makes a large chested woman look like the flying nun
text: Surprisingly the medium size in this suit fits me making me feel that this bikini runs large.  The bottoms cover the belly button and are not really all that tummy controlling; nevertheless, they are very attractive on. However, the flouncy top's ruffles makes a large-chested woman like myself look bigger and the ruffle sides stick out like some sort of flight suit about to take off. This is extremely hilarious and unappealing. It is mostly for this reason, I will never wear this suit.  Obviously this looks fantastic on the Amazon model and the ruffles hang down in front as if it were a skirt top but when someone is big chested, the ruffles ride up and out.

title: Beautiful Tunic that is stretchy and soft, but unflattering on a big chested woman
text:
I ordered a size larger than I needed (XXL, otherwise known as 1X) because lately every woman's item I order in a large or extra-large does not fit me. Unfortunately, I should have ordered this in just an XL. Nevertheless, when I took this out of the package, I immediately loved the soft and stretchy feel of this fabric which is 95% rayon and 5% Spandex.

The open shoulder design is attractive and the bodice drapes to the upper thigh. However, what ruins this tunic for me are the pleats in the decolletage (neck / chest) area. I assume that is done for big-chested woman; however, I hate the way that looks on me. My chest expands the pleats and makes this tunic pop out more so that it gives the presentation of an over-sized muumuu that is terribly unflattering. If I were flat chested, this would lay flatter without that accordion-type expansion that I experience in the middle.

It is true that because I ordered too large a size only increases the effect; however, there's no question the pleats are not a good feature for large chested women; at least in my opinion. This is another article of clothing I cannot use. If it were not for these pleats, I would have rated this 5 stars.

title: Thin, cooling, & very comfortable shirt; I hate the hole & am not crazy about the orangish red color
text:
This is a thin and very cooling shirt. I felt very comfortable all day wearing this as one of my base layers. It washes very well in a lingerie bag but I hang dry it. This would have been a great shirt except that it arrived with a hole in it (see photo).

I will be using this regularly as an outer shirt in the summer until it disintegrates. Since I take a medium for a snug fit as an undershirt and this is an extra-large, it is plenty big on me and true to size.

Overall, this is very nice even though it is thin but I detect an orange hue to the red color and that I do not like. What I hate most is the hole.

title: Tiny, slanted heart ring for dainty fingers; perfect for a young girl; not stackable
text:
This is a super attractive heart ring that is perfect for someone with dainty fingers and manicured nails. It gets lost on my pinkie because I have stubby fingers and no nails. This is definitely not stackable to me. I tried it with another of their rings and the heart gets in the way.

I can see this being used as a promise ring or even a temporary wedding ring for someone who does not have any money for the real thing.

title: Thin and cooling shirt that feels very comfortable to wear; love the green color
text:
This is a thin and very cooling shirt that I find very comfortable to wear. It is also moisture wicking, which is great. I wore this as one of my base layers and it felt great on. It also washes very well in a lingerie bag. I hang dry it.

I will be using this regularly as an outer shirt in the summer. Since I take a medium for a snug fit as an undershirt and this is an extra-large, it is plenty big on me and true to size. Overall, this is very nice even though it is thin; I just have to be sure to wear something underneath.

title: I love how these cushion and stay in place on my feet
text:
These are anit-odor, sweat wicking, breathable, and YES - very comfortable. I love how these cushion my feet and actually stay in place when I walk fast. I am not a runner but I like running socks and these are wonderful. These mediums are a perfect fit on my size 9 foot.

They also wash well, however, I prefer to air dry them than tumble dry them on low.

title: I love how these cushion and stay in place on my feet
text:
These are anit-odor, sweat wicking, breathable, and YES - very comfortable. I love how these cushion my feet and actually stay in place when I walk fast. I am not a runner but I like running socks and these are wonderful. I did try them in their [[ASIN:B07NC9GT7C medium size]] also and that is a better fit on me than the large as I am a size 9 foot.

They also wash well, however, I prefer to air dry them than tumble dry them on low.

title: Vibrant, dainty pendant that is super attractive but chain is thin
text: This is a super attractive pendant of a crescent moon with some bling in the top center. The chain is thin but is also vibrant looking. This would look great on a slender young girl.

title: Heart is attractive but chain is so thin that it knots easily
text: The pendant itself is really attractive. Unfortunately, the 18" chain is so thin that it knots easily. It almost knotted taking it out of the box. Also, since the chain is not comparable to the pendant in size, this gets lost on my neck. It is a tiny, pretty heart with a barely there chain that makes it look like a heart decal is stuck to my neck.

title: Very attractive, small silk scarf from Italy; if stained, professionally dry clean only
text: This is a very attractive silk scarf from Italy that would go great with a black or navy blue turtleneck. Since it is small, it can be worn only as a triangle in front of the neck or as a kerchief on the head. It can also be used to spruce up or decorate a purse by tying it around a strap on the bag. If this gets stained, it needs to be professional dry cleaned.

title: Way too tiny a necklace to even have an impact; more for children
text:
This necklace is so tiny I can barely see it. The chain seems to be around 18 inches but the pendant is so small that this is perfect for a child who is wearing a black turtleneck or a very young and super skinny teenager.

Also the packaging is problematic. They put tape around the paper sleeve that goes over the box. When removing the tape, a piece of the box pulls off with it (see second photo). If I were giving this as a gift I would have been extremely upset by this.

In summary, this necklace is pretty, but I need a magnifying glass to see it.

title: Attractive and large enough for my pinkie finger but packaging has issues
text:
Lately, I ordered several of these type rings and felt that they were too dainty or small for adult fingers. However, this ring is very pretty and I actually love it. It fits perfect on my pinkie fingers and looks great on even though I do not have the slender digits of a young girl nor do I have manicured nails.

The one HUGH NEGATIVE is that they put tape around the paper sleeve that goes over the box. When removing the tape, a piece of the box pulls off with it (see second photo). Also, the word "jewelry" is written upside down on the box. Since I ordered this for me, I can throw the box out. However, if I were giving this as a gift I would have been extremely upset by this.

title: Unflattering, little small, but works well as an undershirt
text: I usually order men's shirts similar to this or with short sleeves as undershirts. I order them in medium for a snug fit and in large if there is a chance I want to wear it as an outer shirt.  However, this one is very unflattering. The white rim with the black actually does not look good and makes the shirt look cheap. Also, this large feels lie a medium and a half.  Normally when I order a men's large it is loose on me. This one is not tight but it is not very loose either.  Overall, this is fine as an undershirt but I cannot picture this as super attractive as an outer shirt.

title: Gorgeous watch with delicate necklace; wish watch band were adjustable
text:
My pictures do not do this ensemble justice. This is a beautiful watch set with an iridescent looking clock face. My only complaint is that the band is too big on me and I had to pay a jeweler to remove four links. I wish they had an adjustable band like some Anne Klein watches that have several removable clasps.

The pendant necklace is very attractive with a delicate chain that is slightly adjustable by hooking the clip onto the second ring--see third photo.

title: Attractive ring that is best for dainty fingers; it does not appear stackable to me
text:
This is an attractive ring with a very thin band. It would look best on a person with dainty fingers and manicured nails. I love the teardrop design and the rose color. This is perfect as costume jewelry. Although, it says it is supposed to be stackable, it does not appear stackable to me because of the gem at the top. I just do not see how another ring can be worn next to this one.

My picture does not do the ring justice but if the price is right (around $10), it might be worth the purchase. Currently, there is no price listed.

title: Flexible, adjustable, attractive, & comfortable sun hat but the band is not pink to me
text:
I love this hat much more than I expected to. I would not call the leopard band pink but it has a slight pink hue. It looks more tan than pink, however. This is why I love it more than I expected as this goes with more of my outfits than if it were pink.

I love hats but have a small head, which makes finding a good fit difficult. A string sits inside the band that can be used to cinch it tighter. I tied mine in a bow as can be seen in the second photo.

I also love that this sun hat is pliable and not stiff. I bent the rim and it just bounces back nicely.

Overall, this is a fantastic low-end sun hat at the reasonable price of $10.97. The only reason I rated this four stars is because the band is more tan than pink.

title: Attractive ring that is best for dainty fingers;  it does not appear stackable to me
text:
This is an attractive ring with a very thin band. It looks best on a person with dainty fingers and manicured nails. This is perfect as costume jewelry. Although, it says it is supposed to be stackable, it does not appear stackable to me because of the square gem at the top. I just do not see how another ring can be worn next to this one.

My picture does not do the ring justice but if the price is right (around $10), it might be worth the purchase. Currently, there is no price listed.

title: I love this rain parka; water runs right off; I received several compliments already
text:
I love this rain parka. It fits loosely on me because I ordered it about one or two sizes too big. Nevertheless, it is very attractive. After I put it on my boyfriend commented on how it looked slightly big but he really liked the style and loved the feel of the parka. My friend also commented on it and how she liked it. I went over her house to test some dog products and she said that it was a nice jacket. She also said she would give it five stars because of the fact that it has an inside pocket.

There are four spacious pockets on the outside. One set are slit pockets for inserting my hands and on top of those pockets is another snap pocket. This turns one pocket into two on each side. There is also one zippered pocket on the interior on the left side as can be seen in the last photo.

I love the feel of the coat and water runs right off of it. The hood is spacious and even though it can be pulled tight, I was unable to get that to stay because there are no typical cinches to hold it in place. I do not care too much for the smell of the rubberized exterior but that will wear off. One thing I do not like is that the slit pockets are straight on. This means that when I insert my hands to keep them warm or dry, my hands have to go straight in and not down. I would feel more comfortable if the slit pockets were angled downward. This is my only major complaint. Other than this, it looks stylish and feels great on. Since it is rubberized, it is easy to sweat in this because the material does not breathe but that is to be expected.

title: Nice, stretchy underwear but rolls over onto itself periodically & runs small
text: I usually take a medium (size 6) but this large (size 7) fits me perfectly which tells me this runs small. This feels very comfortable on and has a "barely there look" but  it does roll over every now and then. On the plus side it does not ride up. If the waist did not sometimes ride down, this would have gotten four stars. If it were true to size, it would have gotten five stars.

title: Ultra slim dainty ring that is best for a female with long slender fingers with manicured nails
text: This is a super slim ring that looks very dainty and is attractive. Since it is so slim it is stackable with other rings or even two or three of these same rings. It got lost on my hands because my fingers are more stubby looking especially since I do not grow my nails. This is  best for a female with long slender fingers and well-manicured nails. It could pass for a wedding ring.

title: Attractively designed with lots of pockets; love the fleece plaid interior; but feels a tad small
text:
I ordered this men's jacket for me. I usually take a large in men's unless I want a snug fit, in which case I take a medium. I ordered this in a large but it fits me like a medium and a half. I LOVE the plaid interior.

There are four exterior pockets. Two are fleece-lined to keep one's hands warm. There are two zippered pockets in the chest area.

There are two interior pockets; one Velcro one on right and one zippered one on the left.

This is relatively warm and feels very comfortable on. It is a typical bomber jacket with a ribbed material waist and wrist .

I would have given this five stars except for two reasons. First, I feel it is just a tad small. It fits me fine but it does not feel as roomy as my men's large in a Carhartt jacket which is actually loose on me. Second, they attach the tags with those plastic ties but do not push them all the way through the fabric. As a result, one end of the tie gets stuck permanently in the fabric. Although, I cannot see or feel this, this is a pet peeve of mine.

title: Sizing is form fitting; shirt is comfortable to wear and feels soft
text:
I ordered this to use as an undershirt. I normally prefer men's shirts in a medium as that provides a snug fit. However, this large is a form fitting fit on me which tells me it runs about a 1/2 size smaller than I expected (like a medium and a half).

It is very soft and is made in Egypt of 90% modal and 10% elastane. It does feel slightly like polyester. I was super comfortable with it on. I do feel the current price of $30.60 for a large is a bit expensive for what this is and is the only reason I took off one star.

It washes well in a lingerie bag. I hang dry it. Note that there is a long tag on the inside right of the shirt that I had to cut off because it was bothering me. Also, the cardboard tag that came with the shirt labeled this as sleepwear.

title: About two sizes too small but a nice shirt otherwise; looks like it wrinkles
text:
I ordered this for my boyfriend and he could barely get this on. I normally order men's items for me but figured he would like this. When it did not fit him, I tried it on. I could get it on but could not even come close to closing the shirt. I usually take a men's medium if I want a snug fit and a men's large for a loose fit. These was fit me like it was a men's small.

This is a big disappointment because it looks like a nice shirt otherwise. It is made of the type of material that would wrinkle when washed. Definitely size up about two sizes.

title: High quality racerback sports bra with adjustable straps and removable padding
text:
I took a chance and figured this would be too small for me and I was right. Nevertheless, this is a beautiful sports bra. I am highly impressed. The bra padding is removable through a tiny hole. The straps are also adjustable. This is super soft and somewhat stretchy but also is the type of material that will hold things in place. It needs to be hand washed.

I will see if my girlfriend is willing to try these who is super skinny (like 60-70 pounds lighter). However, I think this might be too big for her unlike the [[ASIN:B07MG9BH3C Mavour yoga pants]] which run exceptionally small.

Overall this is an impressive sports bra with a nice racerback; I just need to size up.

UPDATE Feb 27, 2019 - My girlfriend (who is 60-70 pounds lighter than me) tried this and she said she does not like bra padding at all. I must mention that neither do I and tend to avoid padding. However, the option to remove the padding is definitely a plus. She would have liked this more if it were designed without the padding. Without the padding, this is a nice sports bra.

title: Thin, not as soft as other shirts of this type, true to size; tag is annoying
text:
I got this for me to wear as an undershirt. It is a nice shirt but is thin. It is imported from Argentina and is made of 100% polyester. The tags on the internal left side of the shirt are super annoying. I had to cut them out as they are about 6 inches in length and kept bothering me. Other that the lack of softness and annoying tags, this is a nice shirt.

I wash this in a lingerie bag and hang dry it.

title: High quality sports bra with adjustable straps and removable padding
text:
I took a chance and figured this would be too small for me and I was right. Nevertheless, this is a beautiful sports bra. I am highly impressed. The bra padding is removable through a tiny hole. The straps are also adjustable. This is super soft and somewhat stretchy but also is the type of material that will hold things in place. It needs to be hand washed.

I will see if my girlfriend is willing to try these who is super skinny (like 60-70 pounds lighter). However, I think this might be too big for her unlike the [[ASIN:B07MG9BH3C Mavour yoga pants]] which run exceptionally small.

Overall this is an impressive sports bra; I just need to size up.

UPDATE Feb 27, 2019 - My girlfriend (who is 60-70 pounds lighter than me) tried this and she said she does not like bra padding at all. I must mention that neither do I and tend to avoid padding. However, the option to remove the padding is definitely a plus. She would have liked this more if it were designed without the padding. Without the padding, this is a nice sports bra.

title: Absolutely beautiful tights but sizing is definitely too small
text:
I almost always take a large in tights and on rare occasions a medium. This is my first pair of tights I can barely get on. I ordered a large and these are way too tight. These are really nice pants with a pocket on either side of each leg. However, they are useless to me because they do not fit.

I will see if my girlfriend is willing to try these who is super skinny (like 60-70 pounds lighter). I bet they will fit her fine. These pants may be one to two sizes too small.

UPDATE Feb 27, 2019 - My girlfriend tried these and she is about 60 or 70 pounds lighter than me. She said they were even tight on her but do fit. They are also very posterior defining in a flirtatious way--meaning extremely form fitting. She takes a small in pants but sometimes orders a medium if she wants a more roomier fit. However, she agreed with me that these are two sizes too small and could not believe they were a large.

title: Simple scarf; great with black turtleneck; wish it were just a tad larger
text: This reminds me of the kerchiefs of the 1950's where women would put this over their head to conceal their hairdo. This is a small polyester square of fabric that can be used as a kerchief, accessory scarf (see third photo), purse accessory piece, etc. I do wish it were a little larger so that it fell lower on my neck than it does. However, this is a very simple piece and works as designed. I would expect the price to be under $7 for this. Currently the price is not posted.

title: One image is not as pictured; these itch me a bit; & edges are unfinished but they work as designed
text:
As the description says, there are many different ways to wear this. I got this to wear as either a neck gaiter or one on each wrist when I walk to soak up the sweat. I also may use these as a headband. There is nothing stopping me from putting this at my ankles either. When wearing on a wrist, the "tube" has to be doubled over because it is too wide just to slip on the wrist without twisting it into another loop.

There are six individually wrapped wraps in the package. Five of them are skull teeth designs as pictured on Amazon (photo 3), but the white one is a full skeleton of the head and upper neck (photo 2). Had I wanted just skull teeth for all of them I would have been disappointed.

There are two things I dislike about these. First the edges are not finished. Nevertheless, they do not need to be hemmed as they do not fray. They do; however, roll into themselves a bit. Second, these itch me slightly. There is no label on the material but the Amazon website says they are made of polyester. I do not expect polyester to itch and that is my biggest disappointment. Other than this, they work as designed and I plan to use them periodically. I already wore the white one as a neck gaiter.

I would wash these in a lingerie bag and hang dry them because they are thin and stretchy.

title: Nice thin sweater that is perfect for layering but it is super itchy on me
text:
Even though this is a men's sweater, I ordered it for me. It is a bit large on me because I normally take a men's large for outerwear or medium for undershirts when I want a snug fit. This is an extra-large. Nevertheless, it is perfect for layering. However, I find it to be very itchy. I do not feel it as much when I put it on top of additional layers but it itches more than other sweaters I have tried recently. As a result, my boyfriend is going to inherit this.

It is made of 100% Merino Wool in China and it has to be dry cleaned.

If it did not itch me, I would have rated this 4 stars.

title: Soft and warm turtleneck; has a lot of static cling and shows lint easily (SEE UPDATE)
text:
I really like this turtleneck and am surprised it fits me perfectly. For years, I have been ordering clothing items and the women's sizes never seem to fit me. I take a large to extra-large in women's but rarely are the clothes true to size. This large fits, so I am ecstatic.

What I love about this sweater is that it is warm, thick, soft, and very comfortable. What I do not like is that it picks up lint super easily and is prone to static cling.

This is made of 50% Merino Wool and 50% Acrylic and is from China. I wash this in a lingerie bag but hang dry it.

I would have given this 5 stars if the static cling and lint pick-up was not so prevalent.

UPDATE March 7, 2019 - I have worn this about three times now and noticed that it pills up a bit and there is now a string hanging out on the right arm. I do not like this as much as I did before. See photo.

title: Love the warmth, fleece lining, & packaging of this hat but not crazy about the snap-on poms
text:
I love fleece-lined hats and this one is no different than the Page One hats I am use to. However, the snap-on poms are difficult to affix to the hat. I had to put all my weight into the top of the hat to snap each one on. The tan pom barely goes with the gray color that is flecked with gold because those specks are almost too small to see. It would have been better if a violet or purple pom or a black pom were supplied instead. Also, I do feel that the snap will come away from the top of the hat over time.

I have a small size head and this fits me perfectly. It is also very warm and feels great on. In addition, I love the packaging that is perfect for gift giving. I also love the hat itself. Unfortunately, I do not like the snap on pom pom design. It would have been better just to have the gray pom permanently affixed; but then if it were, there would be not much difference than any other fleece-lined hat. Beautiful hat but poor execution on the pom.

title: I have several Page One hats that I love but this is not one of them
text:
I do not like this hat at all for two reasons. First, it looks terrible on me. The back hangs loose and it just does not frame my face right. Two, this hat is not lined. I love the Page One hats I ordered previously which are fleece-lined.

Since this is knitted and unlined, it is also not as warm as my other hats. Nevertheless, the knit is a tighter weave than other knit hats I tried. If this looked good on me, I would have rated it 4 stars.

title: A little bit itchy but a very warm super soft sweater; must be dry cleaned
text:
I ordered this for my boyfriend because he takes an XL but he does not want it because it has to be dry cleaned. Instead I wore it all day but it is a bit large on me and the ultra-suede-like elbow patches do not line up with my elbows; but that is not the fault of the sweater.

I honestly did not realize this was cashmere; I thought it was made of something called cashmeren. Cashmere is wool and I itch with wool.

Nevertheless it is not overly itchy as long as I wear something underneath, which I always do with a sweater like this. It is also exceptionally warm and very soft. In fact so warm that I kept opening the window to let some fresh cold air in. I would have given this 5 stars if it did not itch me and if I could have machine washed it.

PS I am beginning to wonder if this really is 100% cashmere as my boyfriend sent me a quote on the Internet that states it should not itch. I did a Google search and found this same quote by Googling "will cashmere itch":

"With wool, the itchiness is a byproduct of thr [sic] fact that it's woven sheep or goat wool fibers with loose ends. Cashmere on the other hand should not itch. It's made of goat hair, which is much finer and softer. If you have something that's cashmere that itches, it's very likely not 100% cashmere."

title: A little bit itchy but very nice richly colored turtleneck; must be dry cleaned
text:
I ordered this for me even though it is a man's turtleneck. I did not realize this was cashmere; I thought it was made of something called cashmeren. How stupid of me as cashmere is wool and I itch with wool. Also, this has to be dry cleaned and cannot be machine washed.

Nevertheless it is not overly itchy as long as I wear something underneath. It is also exceptionally warm; in fact so warm that I kept opening the window to let some fresh cold air in. I would have given this 5 stars if it did not itch me and if I could have machine washed it.

PS I am beginning to wonder if this really is 100% cashmere as my boyfriend sent me a quote on the Internet that states it should not itch. I did a Google search and found this same quote by Googling "will cashmere itch":

"With wool, the itchiness is a byproduct of thr [sic] fact that it's woven sheep or goat wool fibers with loose ends. Cashmere on the other hand should not itch. It's made of goat hair, which is much finer and softer. If you have something that's cashmere that itches, it's very likely not 100% cashmere."

title: I consider this a thin zip-up sweater & not a jacket; it's very stylish
text:
I really like this zip-up "jacket" but it is more like a thin sweater to me. It is extremely stylish and pairs well with their [[ASIN:B073QQ3GGD navy ribbed sweater]] that I wore with it. Even though it is a man's sweater, I ordered it for me.

This is not warm but it is perfect as a top layer. This is made in China of 100% cotton. It is machine washable on cold and laid flat to dry. Iwill use a lingerie bag to wash this but I want to wear it a few more times before I do so.

The navy color does show lint easily, so be mindful of that. If this were really a jacket, I would have rated this 5 stars. It is extremely stylish and pairs very well with their [[ASIN:B073QQ3GGD navy ribbed sweater]].

The first photo shows this "jacket" and the second picture shows it paired with their ribbed sweater.

title: Gorgeous light ribbed sweater that is stylish; does shed a bit
text:
I love this sweater. Even though it is a man's sweater, I ordered it for me. I wore it all day and paired it with their similarly colored [[ASIN:B073QQDD1T navy and white "jacket."]]

This sweater is not warm but it is perfect for layering. I did wear a white undershirt underneath and noticed that the blue fibers do shed a bit. The navy color also shows lint easily as can be seen in the photo, so be mindful of that.

This is made in China of 55% acrylic and 45% cotton. It is machine washable on cold and should be laid flat to dry. I use a lingerie bag to wash this.

If it did not shed, I would have rated this 5 stars. Nevertheless, I love the color and the style and how it pairs with their similarly colored [[ASIN:B073QQDD1T navy and white "jacket".]]

The first photo shows this ribbed sweater and the second picture shows it paired with their "jacket."

title: Extraordinarily comfortable lounge pants, but I could have sized down one size
text:
These lounge pants are made in Indonesia of 97% viscose and 3% elastane. However, the weave is French Terry which is a knitted fabric according to my Internet research. This one has loops of soft pile on the inside (almost like a terry cloth towel but not really) with a smooth exterior surface. It is heavier that most stretchy garments I tried and is extraordinarily comfortable.

I wore this with leggings. I was in extreme comfort all day. The only thing is that I probably could have taken a large or even a medium as this is very stretchy and runs large with relatively wide legs. I washed this in a lingerie bag and hang dried it and it came out well. I personally would not put this in the dryer. Another thing to note is that this easily shows pet hair. I have three cats and I have to keep using a lint roller.

title: Warm, soft, comfortable, fleece-lined hat;  fits me but does run small
text:
I already own several of these type hats in different colors. This one fits me perfectly but I have a small-sized head.

It is super soft on the inside with the furry fleece lining. It fits me comfortably and stays on even during my brisk walks. In addition, it keeps my head and ears incredibly warm. I thought some of my other hats were great but this one is terrific. The fake fur pom pom is a nice embellishment and the gray color compliments my coat. I just LOVE this hat; especially the soft interior. However, if my head were larger, this would not fit. So for me this is 5 stars but for someone else with a larger head it might not be so fantastic.

title: The material is not as soft as I expected & this shirt really holds odor if one sweats
text:
This is made in India of 95% Polyester and 5% Spandex. The feel of this shirt is not as soft as I expected. I have ordered other men's shirts that feel better than this. Also, I usually order a men's medium for a very snug fit as I usually wear these as undershirts. However, since this is an XXL, I can wear it as an outer shirt. I do feel it runs about a 1/2 size too small as I expected this to be very loose on me and it is just loose.

I cannot vouch for its sun protection; however, it works well as either an under or outer shirt for me. Nevertheless, it does stink easily if one sweats, especially in the armpits. I sweat a lot so I know even though I use the strongest deodorant with aluminum. My other shirts do not do this but this one does. It washes well in a lingerie bag and I hang dry it.

In summary, this is not a shirt I would order again. This is just okay.

title: Holds enough clothes and shoes for a winter weekend & I love its backpack feature
text:
This bag is touted to be 27.6" by 13.4" by 11.8" which was able to hold enough winter clothes and shoes for a weekend for me. That's about two to three changes of clothes depending on thickness such as sweats, sweaters, etc.

WHAT I LOVE
- The center carrying handle is sturdy, padded, and is one of the bag's best features. I absolutely love this handle.

- I also love that this can be carried as a backpack. Just unzip either end on the bottom of the bag, unclip the backpack straps and reclip them on the exterior of the bag, and then hoist onto the shoulder. I found this to be very comfortable despite that fact that there is no shoulder padding. I think this design is ingenious.

- Below the central handle is a compartment for paper with a lanyard to hook on keys for easy access.

- The two end handles (one on either end) are also padded and sturdy.

- The zippered compartment on either end can be used for shoes or dirty clothes; however, there is no aeration.

- The central compartment is spacious enough for weekend clothing or a full week of very thin, short summer clothes.

- The bag also comes with a shoulder strap. It is only padded a little bit and I never find using shoulder straps comfortable, so this is no different but it is a nice to have.

- I love that the bag has additional straps along the girth for cinching it closed. Also, the front flap Velcros in place over the central zipper.

WHAT I AM NOT CRAZY ABOUT
- I wish there was padding on the backpack shoulder straps.

- There are no internal pockets in the central compartment.

- I wish there was aeration vent for the pockets on either end so that shoes and dirty clothes can air out.

- At the current price of $59.99, it is a bit expensive.

Overall, this is a very nice weekend travel or gym bag. My biggest loves are the central padded handle and the fact that I can carry this like a backpack.

title: Fits okay but sometimes rides down a bit on fast walk; also had stitching pulls  after one wear
text:
I wanted to really like these but they get 2.5 stars from me. First of all, they fit well and feel comfortable. They also have one pocket on the other side of each leg for cell phone, cash, etc.

What I do not like is that they periodically ride down when I am doing my fast walking. Also, I rubbed into several things the first time I wore them and I developed two pulls in the stitching on either side of the legs.

They wash well in a lingerie bag and I hang dry them. If they did not have that creep in them and I did not develop the pulls, I would have rated these 4 stars instead of 2.5 stars.

title: These fit better on me than on my boyfriend
text:
Both my boyfriend and I take size 36 pants, which is what these are in a large. I originally ordered these for him but when he tried them on, they were to small in the leg area. However, these fit me great and I LOVE THEM. They are made of 95% cotton and 5% spandex.

I find them so comfortable to wear and they are soft too. They also wash well but I do not put them in the dryer as I am afraid they will shrink. Unfortunately, they do wrinkle, so ironing is recommended.

They have two generous slit pockets at the waist and two (non-buttoned) back pockets. There is also a tie in front which is unnecessary since the waist is elasticized. I personally love these but I really feel these are sized for a woman's legs and not a man's.

title: I am seriously impressed with this gym bag even though it smells like a shower curtain
text:
There are only two negatives that I see with this gym bag and a whole host of positives.

POSITIVES
- The inside is large enough for a change of winter clothes.

- There is a vented sneaker / shoe compartment on one side; but I prefer to use this for dirty clothes.

- There are numerous pockets throughout the bag. On one side is the sneaker or dirty clothes compartment. On the other end is room for a scarf, hat, etc. and two mesh pockets for toiletries, etc. On one long side are two other zippered pockets for accessories. I prefer to put one sneaker in each pocket (see picture). On the other long side is a water bottle pocket and another small zippered pocket.

- Each end has a handle to easily move the bag around when packing.

- The two handle straps that can also be Velcro'd together can be used as backpack straps with a front cinch. The cinch comes above my breast line so I do not care for that much, but it is VERY COMFORTABLE carrying like a backpack. Note that these handles are NOT removable. When using the backpack feature, I had to take my shoes out of the side pocket so they did not accidentally fall out. I did find the water bottle easily accessible in backpack mode as long as I had the straps on correctly.

- There is also a carry strap. I found it very comfortable to carry the bag either this way or as a backpack. This strap is removable if using in backpack mode.

- This gym bag looks elegant to me with the black and gray coloring. I also like the feel of it; to me it does not feel cheap.

NEGATIVES
- The bag smells a little bit like a new vinyl shower curtain, but this does not bother me and I expect this will eventually wear off.

- The zippers on the side compartments on either side of the bag are a little bit sticky when zipping around the corners. This is annoying but acceptable and really does not bother me much either because if I just push in on the material, I am able to close those compartments.

Overall, I am seriously in love with this bag. I think the quality is good, the sizing generous, and the $34.99 price competitive. Only time will tell how long this will last.

title: Warm, soft, stylish winter hat but it is a tad loose on my small head (3.5 stars)
text: I love this hat. The gray color almost goes with anything. The soft pom pom is stylish without being overbearing and the knit hat is super soft and warm. I take a size small in most hats and this beanie is just a little loose on me.  I noticed that others says it runs small but for some reason it fits like a medium or large on my small head that I have to keep it affixed by putting ear muffs over the hat, otherwise it will ride up. I wish it were a bit tighter on my head so that I do not need to do this.

title: These are gorgeous muffs and keep my ears warm in the cold
text:
I love the purple color and the soft feel of the faux fur against my ears. I wore them tonight and they kept my ears warm in the cold.

I actually like these better than my other muffs because of the thin headband. Being that the band is so thin, it does not look like I have anything around my head. All that shows are the muffs themselves. Even though they do not flex like some of my cheaper muffs, my hood and coat collar do not cause these to fall off as with the muffs that have a thicker band. I was also pleasantly surprised that the faux fur did not shed.

Overall, I really love these. One other positive is that they do not give me a headache. Some other muffs squeeze my brain so tight, that I get head pain. I feel the current price of $12.99 is a good deal. I cannot find anything I do not like about these. I even love that the tag is removable as can be seen in the third picture.

- This is made in China.
- Faux Fur is 54% acrylic, 40% modacrylic, and 8% polyester

title: Attractive, warm, medium-length BLACK & WHITE not navy & cream scarf
text:
I did not expect to love this scarf but I do. First of all, it is not navy and cream as advertised. Therefore, the product listing on Amazon appears to be wrong. However, black and white (see photo) is a better match for me. It was cold enough to wear today and it kept me warm. The length is medium, so I am able to cross it in front of my neck and have it come almost to my belly button. In addition, the scarf is soft and comfortable. The only negative is that the knit size is big which makes it easier to develop a pull in the stitching easily if it catches on something like a cat claw.
