I almost developed a pull when removing the pinned on label. Nevertheless, I really love this scarf and I did not expect to. I also think the current price of $12.99 is reasonable.

UPDATE 1/11/2019: I also ordered the corresponding [[ASIN:B07HV9YL8K hat]] to this scarf and I give that 3 stars. Whereas I love the scarf, the hat is knitted the same but has no lining. Due to the large knit of their beanie, without a lining, it is only good to use on 35+ degree days without any wind. With wind, I cannot use the hat because there is little protection. Note that the beanie is also black and white and not navy and white.

title: Simple watch that is very comfortable to wear; perfect for the holiday season
text:
I have yet to be disappointed with an Anne Klein watch and this is my fourth one. The other three I have are more elegant and more expensive, but this one is a vibrant red and the silicone band makes it very comfortable for me to wear. It is a simple watch in that it only tells time; no date; only a clear secondhand dial. The stem of the watch feels like high quality and the time is easily adjustable. Normally watch stems are "sticky," but this one is not. This watch comes with a limited lifetime warranty.

This vibrant red color is perfect for Christmas or any other time of year. I love it. At the current price of $34.99 it is competitively priced; however, I would never pay the list price of $55 because I feel that is just too expensive for a silicone banded watch.

title: Very attractive sweater that is thin enough to layer beneath other layers or wear on its own
text:
I really like this sweater and I do not feel it is only for a man. It looks stylish on me. I wore Peak Velocity Men's Sleeveless Tank underneath and it complemented this sweater perfectly as it is also gray and black.

Although this is thin and made of 50% Viscose and 50% Acrylic, I was still comfortably warm. The neckline is attractive. The sweater comes just at my hips which means it looks great when rolling the end underneath itself. The sleeves are also perfect and come right below my wrist. The large definitely fits me well. I normally wear a large to extra-large in a woman's and take a medium in a men's for a snug fit. If I want to wear a man's shirt or sweater as outerwear, I then order a large. This large fits me as expected--not snug and not too loose either.

After I wear this a few more times, I plan to wash this in a lingerie bag in the washer and then hang dry it. I expect it to come out perfectly as I have other sweaters of a similar type that wash well this way. If it does not come out perfectly, I will update my review.

title: I like this shirt as a base layer underneath a similarly colored sweater
text:
I ordered this similar type shirt (but with sleeves) in a medium at the same time I ordered this sleeveless one in a large. I felt the other shirt was not as soft as I expected. Nevertheless, this sleeveless shirt which looks exactly the same as the other one (but without sleeves) feels a bit softer and the neck hole appears to stretch more. Perhaps this is because this is a large when the other one is a medium. As a result I really like this shirt. It fits just right and I wore it underneath the [[ASIN: B07HP62FN6 Genuine Assembly Men's Crew Neck Sweater]]. The collar rarely showed below the sweater.

It washes well in a lingerie bag and I hang dry this since it is polyester. Overall, it is perfect for a base layer for me. Yes, I know it is a men's shirt but they tend to fit me better than the female shirts

title: Sizing is not suitable for "chesty" women; this blouse has a bit of elegance to it
text:
I am very disappointed that this is not a good fit on me. Although I can get it on fine, it is too small in the chest area. I normally take a L to XL in women's depending on the cut of an item. I ordered this in an XL thinking that for sure this would fit; it fits but not comfortably.

This blouse is really nice. It looked good on me except for the tightness around the chest and for this reason I can never wear it. I would have preferred that the waist be a little lower on this blouse as it came just below my belly button. It is very thin with a 100% polyester body and 100% nylon lace detail in the upper back. It can be washed in a lingerie bag but should not be tumble dried.

I realize that in a way, I am sort of an anomaly. Not only am I chesty but I lift weights which results in a wide back. On top of all this, I still have a layer of fat. That makes for difficult sizing on my part. I often buy men's shirts simply because women's clothing does not fit right on me and it is always hit or miss.

I rated this 3 stars instead of 1 or 2 stars because I think this blouse is very attractive and would look great on the right woman. I do wish they designed a bit of give in the chest area and that they made the bodice a bit longer, but other than this, I see this as a shirt that can be used for both business and pleasure with a bit of elegance to it.

title: Absolutely wonderful high-rise leggings / pants; incredibly soft and comfortable
text:
I love these leggings / pants. They feel wonderful on. The pants feel double lined. They fit perfect on me and I even probably could have gotten away with a size medium. They do not roll down at the tummy like some pants I have worn before. I also love the length. I am 5'5" tall with a 32" inseam and they come down to the floor which is my preferred length. The tummy control is moderate and comfortable and not at all restricting.

They wash well in a lingerie bag and I hang dry them even though they can be tumble dried on low per the label. Unfortunately, I have cats and the color does show cat hair.

The one thing I do not like is having their logo on the bottom of the left pant leg. Other than this, these pants get 10 stars from me.

I love these pants so much that I ordered them in this [[ASIN:B072HHQC38 midnight blue]] and [[ASIN:B071DPNRPP heather black]] and [[ASIN:B01GTVU2JC black]] which look almost like the midnight blue. Note that the darker colors show cat hair, unfortunately.

title: Absolutely wonderful high-rise leggings / pants; incredibly soft and comfortable
text:
I love these leggings / pants. They feel wonderful on. The pants feel double lined. They fit perfect on me and I even probably could have gotten away with a size medium. They do not roll down at the tummy like some pants I have worn before. I also love the length. I am 5'5" tall with a 32" inseam and they come down to the floor which is my preferred length. The tummy control is moderate and comfortable and not at all restricting.

They wash well in a lingerie bag and I hang dry them even though they can be tumble dried on low per the label. Unfortunately, I have cats and the color does show cat hair.

The one thing I do not like is having their logo on the bottom of the left pant leg. Other than this, these pants get 10 stars from me.

I love these pants so much that I ordered them in this [[ASIN:B071DPNRPP heather black]] and in [[ASIN:B072HHQC38 midnight blue]] and [[ASIN:B01GTVU2JC black]] which look almost like the midnight blue. Note that the darker colors show cat hair, unfortunately.

title: This shirt is not as soft as I expected; neck hole also does not stretch much
text:
I ordered this in a size medium and it fits like a medium and a half because it is slightly loose on me instead of being snug like most men's mediums are on me. I usually love men's shirts like these to wear underneath my other clothes in the winter. I wore this but the material feels a bit rough and not soft like most other shirts of these types that I tried before. Also, the neck hole does not stretch much. I prefer some stretch when putting a shirt on.

It washes well in a lingerie bag and I hang dry this since it is polyester. Overall, this is just okay and I would never order this again.

title: Nice thin sweater but putting it on gets interesting since the neck does not stretch
text:
I ordered this sweater for me even though it is a man's sweater. I can't tell the difference. It looks and feels good on me. The only problem is that the neck does not stretch, so the "stationary" hole attacks the head like a vice grip. Once it is on, it's fine.

I washed this in a lingerie bag and hung dry it. It did not appear to shrink but it comes out wrinkled. Overall, it's a nice, warm, yet thin sweater but the neck hole needs to be given some stretch.

title: Cushiony low profile socks that just barely fit me
text:
There are two attractive pairs of low-cut peds in this package. I love both the gray and the blue. The entire sole of the foot is padded and feels so wonderful to wear. The socks come just a little over the bottom of my sneaker. Also, they do not ride down when walking, which is very nice. The only issue is that they just barely fit me. They are rated up to a woman's size 9 and I am a size 9.

They also wash well in a lingerie bag but I choose to lay them flat to dry. Overall, these are super comfortable.

title: Very thin profile leather wallet with RFID protection in a nice butterfly design
text:
This is an attractive leather wallet that has one front clear window ID on one side (see second photo), one credit card slot behind that, one center pocket, and three credit card slots on the back side. It has an attractive butterfly design on one credit card pocket only (first photo). It feels and smells like genuine leather.

This is extremely thin profile and holds just the minimal necessary. It apparently has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners.

I have many purses and use these type wallets for when I switch among them. This would make a nice stocking stuffer for someone that wants a slim profile minimalist wallet. The one negative is that the wallet is about 1/4 inch wider than I expected compared to a standard wallet (see last photo with standard wallet on top and this one peeking out below). Also, the light cream color will show dirt and pen marks. in fact, mine came "pre-soiled" on the butterfly portion of the pocket; luckily I was able to wipe it off.

Overall, I like this. It gets 3.5 stars from me.

title: Attractive warm turtleneck; it itches me a bit and sizing is a bit small
text:
This turtleneck is very attractive in a gorgeous burgundy / purple. I normally take a size L to XL in women's depending on the cut. I ordered this in an XL and it fits me like a L. The sleeves are generously long and the turtleneck cuff is adequate. The problem I have is that the waist area is high. The bottom of the bodice falls about four inches inches below my belly button and I would have preferred it much longer.

This is made of 70% Merino Wool and 30% Cashmere. Wool normally itches me but I understand Merino Wool is not supposed to itch. I wore a base layer with the turtleneck over that. I noticed that the neck area itched me a bit but not so much as to be overly bothersome. Had I tried this in the store, I would not have purchased this because of the slight itch, not to mention the shrunken waist.

The label recommends that this be hand-washed and laid flat to dry. I washed this in my washer on the "wool setting" in a lingerie bag. I then air dried it. It came out just like new. Also, the color did not bleed onto the white towel I put with it to test if the color comes off. It also did not shrink.

Overall, this is a very nice turtleneck that is moderately soft with a slight itch and a shrunken waist. It is very warm for such a thin sweater. Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this for long-torso people who are allergic to wool. I will wear this but it is not my favorite piece due to these shortcomings.

title: Another absolutely stunning watch ensemble from Anne Klein with sparkling Swarovski Crystals
text:
This is my third Anne Klein watch set and I love them all. It is an absolutely stunning watch ensemble with sparkling Swarovski Crystals. This one and the [[ASIN:B07FTC4Z4T Anne Klein Women's Swarovski Crystal Accented Watch and Bracelet Set]] are my absolute favorites with the [[ASIN:B071ZH6WZR Anne Klein Womens AK-3082RGST 4-pc Set]] a close second.

The rose colored watch face goes well with the burgundy turtleneck I was wearing. This set has three pieces; one watch and two wristlets. The watch has no numbers but does have a line at 12, 3, 6, and 9 hour position. I usually prefer my watches to have every hour numbered and a set such as this with that feature would even be more perfect for my taste.

This set fit me perfectly right out of the box. My wrist circumference is around 7". Since the bracelets and watch are not as flexible as my other set, it was a little bit easier to fasten the clasps by myself. Note that the hanging trinket on the bow bracelet does turn over when wearing, so periodically I had to turn it right side up so it could be seen. Other than this, I experienced no other issues.

The size can be reduced by removing the extra clasp on each piece; however, I am unclear as to how well the size can be increased. I think if one has a large wrist, this might not fit unless a jeweler can help expand it or if more links can be purchased, which I am unsure about.

Overall, this is just gorgeous and would make a fantastic gift as would most of their other sets. It is all a matter of personal preference.

title: Soft Pocketed Tee Shirts that holds a full sized wallet
text:
I ordered this men's T-shirt to wear as a top shirt. I normally take a size medium in men's if I want a snug fit. However, I ordered an XL so that they would be loose fitting on me. Unfortunately, they are a bit too loose fitting, so I am now wearing this as an undershirt underneath a sweatshirt in the winter. Despite being over-sized on me, I prefer the [[ASIN:B07F1KGJPS ones]] without the pocket over these. However, I think some men will prefer a pocket; I know my boyfriend does and I expect him to be borrowing these on me.

I attached a picture of the size wallet the pocket fits (first photo). The second photo shows the wallet partially in the pocket. I did not put it all the way in because it is difficult to see the gray on gray pocket without having something stick out of it.

These also hold up well in the washer. I hang dry this and other shirts that feel stretchy like this and do not put it in the dryer. They are made in Pakistan of 60% cotton and 40% polyester.

title: Comfortable summer shirt with form-fitting fit; looks like a jailer's shirt
text:
This shirt is super comfortable but it is more for the summer since it is short sleeved. It is also form fitting and stretchy. I wore this underneath a hoodie because this is not the season for it. This does look like part of a jail outfit with the black and white stripes, however.

They do recommend turning it inside out when washing. This washes well in a lingerie bag in the washer. I hang dry it because this is not the type of material that should go in the dryer.

This is made in China of 50% viscose, 45% polyester, and 5% spandex. Overall, this is a very nice casual short-sleeve blouse.

title: These are awesomely soft T-shirts but they run a size too large
text:
I order men's T-shirts to wear underneath my clothes and sometimes as a top shirt. I normally take a size medium in men's if I want a snug fit. However, these medium shirts fit like a large on me (meaning they are loose fitting) so I am not disappointed at all. Nevertheless, I absolutely love them. They are a perfect undershirt in the winter for me. I can even wear them as an outer shirt.

They also hold up well in the washer. I hang dry this and other shirts that feel stretchy like this and do not put it in the dryer. They are made in Pakistan of 60% cotton and 40% polyester.

title: Sexy lace briefs with mild tummy control
text:
I usually take a size 6 (meaning medium) in briefs but decided to try these in large because I am always afraid any control-type undies will feel too restrictive on.

The brief portion is lace and the high waist band is solid and where the control is. Until I wore these, I thought the cut would ride up; however, these are wonderful. They provide full coverage and the control is very subtle and not restrictive--which is what I prefer. Only time will tell how long these last. The lace portion looks like it might wear out easily after regular use. I will update my review if it does.

I washed these in a lingerie bag in my washer and air dried them and they came out fine. Overall, I am impressed.

title: Very attractive zip-up hoodie; CK logo is on front only; sizing is a bit small for a man
text:
I usually take a size medium in men's if I want a snug fit, so I ordered this in large. However, this fits like a medium on me, which means that this appears to be a sized on the small side.

Other than this, this is a very attractive zip-up black hoodie which, unfortunately, shows all my cats' hair and lint. The hood is generous and not over sized, which I like. There are also two generous side pockets. This hoodie is of medium thickness, so it does offer me some warmth. The large is currently priced at $53.53 which is a tad high but still competitive.

This is made in India of 72% cotton and 28% polyester. I have not washed this yet, but I would tumble dry this on low.

Overall, the only big negative I see is that the sizing runs a bit small. Other than this, it is a very nice zip-up hoodie, especially for Calvin Klein fans.

title: These fit me like regular knee-hi socks; hardly any compression and loose in the toe
text:
These are comfortable socks and I was able to get them on easily like regular socks. I take a size 9 shoe and selected these in a medium. I did not feel much compression (if any) at all. After wearing them all day, the toe area was loose.

These wash well but I choose to lay them flat to dry.

Overall these are nice socks but since they do not feel like there's much if any compression, I rated them 3 stars. As regular socks, they are 4 stars.

title: Attractive scarf, covers shoulders, but it is a bit thin and a tad scratchy
text: This is an attractive pashmina shawl wrap. It is a bit thin and fragile. It is also a tad scratchy. If it was not so scratchy and fragile, I would have rated this 5 stars.

title: These are soft, vibrant tees, that run 2 sizes too small & logo is on chest of blue shirt only
text:
I wear men's tees underneath my regular shirts or sometimes as shirts themselves. I usually take a size medium in men's or a size large to XL in women's.

There are three tees to this package. Only the blue shirt has the logo on the chest (first picture). The fuchsia and gray shirts only have a tiny logo on the "hem" of the left arm as can be seen in the second photo.

The size I ordered was XXL because that was the only selection for review. What is very interesting is that the 2XL fits like a men's large on me. That is fantastic for me but not so fantastic for a guy that is 2XL and is expecting these shirts to fit him. However, if the fella were chiseled (super muscular), then this might be true to size but the tee would look like it is painted on.

The fit is form fitting on me and very attractive. These tees are super comfortable and soft and because they look so great on me, I can wear them as an outer shirt.

They wash well but I choose to hang dry them as I am afraid they will shrink. However, the tag says they can be tumble dried on low.

title: Thin, comfortable mid-calf socks that stay put but they are not soft
text:
There are two pairs of mid-calf socks in this package. These are thin but comfortable and they stay put in the shoe. Unfortunately, they are a bid scratchy material in the sense that they are not soft at all. Personally, I prefer the softness of their [[ASIN:B07H8MRRYP Gold Toe Women's Ultra Soft and Cozy Crew Socks]] compared to these; however, those soft socks fall down.

These wash and dry well.

title: Gorgeous bikini but top is way too small for the size indicated, in my opinion
text:
This is a gorgeous bikini. Unfortunately, it does not fit me appropriately. The size large top appears to be for a size medium to small woman, but then again I have a wide back and ample chest. The fact that the bra is padded does not help.

The blue is super attractive and the bottoms are semi-high cut which is very nice.

I would wash this in a lingerie bag and hang dry it. The bra padding is not removable.

title: These moccasin slippers seem to run about 1/2 size large
text:
This are nice moccasin slippers and feel comfortable on my feet. They are also warm inside. I take a size 9 in shoe and have even taken larger sizes. However, these in a size 9 are loose on my feet. Since they are slippers it does not matter much because I can wear a thicker sock or just deal with it.

The other thing is that I always have to bend down to slip these on because the top round part of the slipper curls underneath and I have to use my finger to uncurl it.

Also, if one is thinking of giving this as a gift, they do not arrive in a box. I got mine in a plastic bag.

In summary, these are nice slippers but do run large. Only time will tell how well the inside lining will last.

UPDATE Dec 12, 2018 - I have been using these slippers every day since I got them and they are great. The fleece on the inside is as plush as the first day, which is impressive.

title: This runs a bit large but otherwise it is very nice tee & it is moisture wicking
text:
I had no idea what size this was going to be when I ordered this because the size was not posted. Since I take a medium in a men's shirt, I figured I would chance it. What I got was a large. A medium in men's usually fits snug on me and I like shirts like this to fit snugly because I wear them underneath another garment. However, this large fits very loosely on me, especially around the waist area. I suspect this is more like an XL.

Nevertheless, I love it. It is moisture wicking and very comfortable. It also washes well in a lingerie bag. I prefer to hang dry this. This came with two wrist guards which I will never use. They are just wide bands of elastic and not useful to me. In fact I consider them gimmicky more than anything and I doubt they absorb moisture.

For those that run with this, there are only three reflective strips that I can see. They are on the back of the neck, in front of the crease of the left arm, and the logo on the left chest.

Overall, this is a very nice tee. If it were more proportioned in the fit, I would have rated this 5 stars.

title: Gorgeous light tapered fitting shirt; needs ironing
text:
I actually ordered this shirt for me even though it is a man's shirt. I usually take a medium in men's if I want a snug fit and a large if I want a looser fit. However, since this is slim fit, I decided to order the XXL and am glad I did.

It fits perfect on me and looks great worn as is or layered over another shirt. I did have to roll up the cuff on the sleeves because it is too long on my arms. The baby blue is just super attractive. It is 52% linen and 48% cotton. I machine wash this on cold but hang dry it or tumble dry it on low. It does need ironing. If it did not need ironing, I would actually order a few more in different colors in the same XXL size.

title: The arms appear to run small on this SUPER SOFT robe
text:
I take a large to extra-large in robes. For instance, I ordered two [[ASIN:B00GJAV8YW Monarch/CypressPlush Lined Microfiber Spa Robes]] in large (one in charcoal and one in white) and they are super roomy and spacious on me. They are also high quality robes.

However, I know that new products such as this robe tend not to be sized correctly. Therefore, I ordered the 3X size so that I would be sure it would fit. It does not matter to me if a robe is big. However, this robe is generously sized for me around the torso and mid-section, although I do not feel it is 3X sized in that area. In addition, the arms fit just perfectly on me. If I were an actual 3X body type, I do not feel the arms on this robe would fit. The sleeve also just comes down to my wrist and I feel that should be longer as well.

The material is super soft and plush and the robe feels so warm and cozy on. There is a reversible tie (satin-like material on one side and soft plush robe material on the other). There is an internal ribbon tie as well. There are two front slit pockets that are not too roomy. There is also a loop in the interior for hanging on a hook. I would only wash this robe in cold water and hang dry it even though it says it can be tumble dried on low. The reason is because it is made of the 100% polyester that tends to melt in a dryer.

In summary, I rated this robe 3 stars because I feel comfortable in it and it fits me fine in the arms and big in the torso. However, I would have rated it 2 stars if this robe, which I sized up 3 times for me, did not fit. Personally, I think the sizing is off by one in the torso and off by several in the arms.

title: Legs are super baggy and waist band is not stretchable; otherwise these are attractive & comfortable
text:
I usually buy a medium to large size pants and wear anywhere from size 8 (stretchable) to size 10 or 12 in pants. Unfortunately, these do not fit me around the waist yet in the legs they are super baggy. There is ZERO stretch around the waistband and just a smidgen of elasticity elsewhere.

They are very soft and are very thin. They would be great for the summer. They are very attractive as I was able to get them on fine but could not close them. They are also 100% polyester and are the type of 3/4 length (Capri) pants that really do not wrinkle much. I personally would wash these on cold and then hang dry them.

I am thoroughly disappointed that these do not fit me. On the other hand, even if they did, I do not like super baggy legs. Perhaps it is just my sizing that is the problem, but then again, perhaps not.

title: Very thin profile leather wallet with RFID protection in a nice burgundy color
text:
This is an attractive leather wallet that has one front clear window ID on one side, one center pocket, three credit card slots on back side with another slot in center behind that. I do not personally care of the detail stitching in the center of the back side credit card slot (see second picture) because it looks like the wallet is scratched or cut.

Other than this, this is extremely thin profile and holds just the minimal necessary. On Amazon, the color looks a reddish brown but in person this looks more like a rich burgundy. It apparently has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners.

I have many purses and use these type men's wallets for when I switch among them. This would make a nice Christmas gift for someone that wants a slim profile minimalist wallet.

I attached a picture of both sides of the wallet.

title: Very attractive swimsuit but front is a bit low for my taste
text:
This is a very attractive swimsuit and looks pretty good on me. The bra is padded, which I dislike because I am top heavy. The top is also a bit low as well but not exceedingly so. The bikini line is not high-rise. Personally, I prefer high-rise sides. Nevertheless, this is still very attractive at the bikini line.

This swimsuit is also not constricting; therefore, every curve is visible.

It ties in the back and I have to make sure it is tied correctly before pulling this on. Once the suit is on, it is impossible for me to tie the back by myself.

The padding is removable. I wash this in a lingerie bag with the padding removed and then lay flat to dry.

Overall this is a nice suit for the right body type.

title: Very soft and very thin top; feels great on
text:
I ordered this in a size large. I normally take a large to an extra-large in a woman's size. I sometimes even go for the plus sizes depending on how I want a top to drape.

This top fits me perfectly and snugly. An extra-large would have worked as well. The material is soft and feels great against my skin. The V neck allows me to accessorize with a nice necklace.

There is no tag inside saying what this is made of. The only tag says to either hand wash or dry clean. The paper tag that came with the sweater says to use professional cashmere detergent (even though this is definitely not cashmere).

I personally will wash this in a lingerie bag and lay flat to dry.

title: Comfortable leggings but dislike the lettering & top rolls down periodically
text:
When I first put this on, the lettering (which says "Rezag Rats") that is on the side of the left leg was stuck together. I actually had to pry it apart because it was like the letters melted onto themselves. Lucky it was not damaged. Nevertheless, I have no idea what that saying means.

These yoga pants are very comfortable. They did roll down periodically at the waist. They wash well inside out but I hang dry them. If they did not have this nonsensical lettering and the waist did not roll down periodically, I would have rated these 5 stars.

title: The fit is form fitting and snug & they feel great on
text: These are really nice cotton tank tops. They have a little bit of stretch to them but otherwise they are true to size. They are very form fitting and mold to the contour of my body. Also, they feel so comfortable on. They machine was well but I hang dry them.

title: I like briefs that hug my outline; these ride up a bit
text:
I wanted to love these but they are a bit loose and do not hug my outline as I expected. Instead they ride up a bit as if they are going to become a thong. They are a nice low bikini cut but are too loose fitting style wise. Also, I dislike the long tag on the side.

They wash and dry well, however.

title: This hoodie is thin and shrinks a bit, otherwise it is fine
text:
The large fit loose on me as I expected. The hoodie looks good on and has a generous sized hood that can be drawstring tied. The center pocket is spacious.

I did not expect this to be so thin. When I think of hoodies, I think of the heavy sweatshirt kind. This is made of thermal like material (like a thermal knit undershirt). Also, after I washed it on warm and tumble dried it on medium (as recommended), it shrunk. Now it fits perfectly but I did not want it to shrink.

Had I known this was so thin and that it would shrink, I would not have ordered this.

title: These briefs are slinky and low cut; but they ride down a bit during use
text:
I wanted to love these but they only fit great until I move, then the waist tends to ride down a bit on the sides and in the back. Also, since this bikini is really low-cut and thin on the sides, I cannot stand the long tag. Usually I find it is sticking out of the bikini. If they stayed put, I would have given this 4 stars. As they are I can only wear these to bed because if I wear them anywhere else, I'm highly uncomfortable as the panties start to fall off.

They wash well in a lingerie bag. I hang dry them.

title: This athletic shirt fits like a biker's shirt or swim tee; I really like this one
text:
I love the black and red color of this athletic top. It fits just a tad loose on me. I ordered the XX-Large and I normally take a large to X-Large. I prefer a looser fit, so I find this very comfortable. In the winter, I like to wear this under a hoodie or other shirt. However, it looks good enough to wear as a top shirt simply because I ordered one to two sizes larger than usual.

I machine wash this in a lingerie bag and hang dry it. Overall, I am very pleased that I ordered this.

title: I see and feel no arch support with these socks, so I am disappointed
text:
I ordered these because it said they have arch support. I feel and see no support with these. They are thin but comfortable and they stay put in the shoe. However, because there is no support, I consider these only okay. I am a woman's size 9 and they fit well.

There are six pairs of white ankle socks with gold toe. They wash and dry well.

title: My boyfriend likes this shirt and the XL fits him as expected
text:
I ordered this for my boyfriend and he really likes this shirt. Pink is a color he does not usually wear but since it is a pale pink, it is perfect for a guy. The XL shirt fits as expected and it is slim fit (more tapered in the lower waist). I personally do not like the gauzy feeling of the material but my boyfriend likes that and that is all that matters.

This shirt is made in China. I machine washed this on cold and tumbled dry on low but it does wrinkle.

title: Very soft socks but a bit too loose fitting
text:
These socks are super soft and comfortable but the they are a bit loose and move around a bit. I prefer socks that are a bit more fitted.

They wash and dry well.

title: Thin profile wallet perfect for a man or a woman's purse but only has money clip
text:
This is an attractive leather wallet that has one front clear window ID or credit card slot, a slot behind that, six credit card slots in the interior, and two extra slots in the centerfold. It also has a money clip on the interior for cash. It apparently has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners. It also has a buttery soft feel to it and the black color goes with anything.

I have many purses and use these type men's wallets for when I switch among them. This would make a nice Christmas gift for someone that wants a slim profile wallet and does not mind a money clip instead of a billfold.

I attached a picture of the profile with front partially visible and the interior.

title: Cheap, thin, gauze-like scarf that has to be dry cleaned or hand washed
text:
I am surprised that this scarf has such positive reviews. The material is very thin and cheap and feels like it will fray easily. The scarf also holds wrinkles. It has to be dry cleaned or hand washed. In addition, I do not like the smell of the material.

Once I wear it above a black turtleneck it looks okay, but overall I am disappointed.

title: This is a super soft tank that I use as a top shirt
text:
I love the material of this tank top. It is super soft, comes down below my waist, and is extremely comfortable to wear. Since I ordered the 1X size, it is big on me as I take a large and sometimes X-large. However, I wanted it big.

This is made in Vietnam of 95% viscose and 5% elastane. I machine wash this on cold and hang dry it, but it can be tumble dried on low if desired.

title: These are wonderful tank tops; very soft, slightly stretchy, and super comfortable
text:
I am impressed with these tops. These are so super comfortable and great for layering. They also machine wash and dry very well but can be tumble dried on low. Some people wear these as an outer shirt but I prefer them as an undershirt. This pair is 58% cotton, 39% modal, 3% elastane.

I love the comfort and colors of these undershirts so much that I have since purchased more.

[[ASIN:B07757PX1P Red/Navy]]
[[ASIN:B07FDM52B3 Navy/White Stripe/Light Grey Heather]]
[[ASIN:B07FDM5GQZ Yellow/White]]
Two Pairs of the [[ASIN:B07FDHTZG2 Aqua/White]]
[[ASIN:B0775M7SVK Bright Pink/White]]
Two Pairs of the [[ASIN:B07FDRQLD2 Dark Purple/Charcoal Heather]]

title: Very soft and comfortable turtleneck that is true to size
text:
I love this turtleneck. It does not itch me and is extremely soft and comfortable. The sizing is perfect too. I ordered an X-large and it is a tad loose on me as it should be.

It is made of 56% cotton, 37% modal, 7% elastane. I machine wash this but choose to hang dry it because of the stretchy material. The tag does say it can be tumble dried on low, however.

title: Gorgeous shirt that does need ironing after washing
text:
This deep red shirt is absolutely gorgeous in a Country Western sort of way. I know it's a man's shirt but I ordered it for me because I like wearing these type shirts with an open front over a black turtleneck. It is large on me as I expected it would be. The material is roomy, thicker than I expected, and very comfortable.

This shirt has only one button at the neck. All the other closures are snaps. There are two snap closure breast pockets. If I were too rotund for this shirt, I suspect the snaps would come loose when I sat down.

I machine wash this on cold and tumble dry on low but it wrinkles and needs ironing. I hate ironing. Other than this, I love the shirt.

This shirt comes with a limited one-year warranty guaranteeing it is free from defects.

title: Absolutely stunning watch ensemble with sparkling Swarovski Crystals
text:
This is an absolutely stunning watch ensemble with sparkling Swarovski Crystals. I am blown away by the beauty of this set. I have another Anne Klein set that is similar and has four pieces, but it is not as beautiful as this.

This set has three pieces; one watch and two wristlets. Luckily it fit me perfectly right out of the box. My wrist circumference is around 7". I did have some trouble fastening the clasps by myself but I eventually got them secured as you can see from the second photo.

The size can be reduced by removing the extra clasp on each piece; however, I am unclear as to how well the size can be increased. I think if one has a large wrist, this might not fit unless a jeweler can help expand it or if more links can be purchased, which I am unsure about.

Overall, this is lovely and would make a fantastic gift.

title: Regular profile wallet perfect for a man or a woman's purse with a double billfold
text:
This is a super attractive leather wallet that has 10 ID or credit card slots and two extra slots in the center that flips down from the billfold. It also has a double billfold for cash. It apparently has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners. It also has a buttery soft feel to it and is a beautiful rust brown (what they call Delta Brown) color.

There are four credit card slots on either side of the wallet's interior and two other clear inserts for photo IDs. I do love the blue and red plaid material that peeks through the ID slots and that is on the interior of the billfolds, in the photo ID slots, and on the interior of the centerfold slots.

I have many purses and use these type men's wallets for when I switch among them. This would make a nice Christmas gift for someone that wants a functional and beautiful wallet with a double billfold.

I attached several pictures of the wallet's interior.

title: Thin profile wallet perfect for a man or a woman's purse but only has money clip
text:
This is an attractive leather wallet that has 8 ID or credit card slots and two extra slots in the centerfold. It also has a money clip on the interior for cash. It apparently has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners. It also has a buttery soft feel to it and is a beautiful rust brown (what they call Delta Brown) color.

There are two credit card slots on either side of the wallet's exterior and four slots inside with one of them being an clear photo ID slot. I do not care for the crooked plaid material that peeks through the ID slot and the only reason I knocked off one star is because it is crooked.

I have many purses and use these type men's wallets for when I switch among them. This would make a nice Christmas gift for someone that wants a slim profile wallet and does not mind a money clip instead of a billfold.

I attached a picture of both sides of the wallet and the interior. The last picture shows a wet spot on the wallet front. I got water on the front and it discolors the wallet temporarily until it is dry.

title: Absolutely wonderful high-rise leggings / pants; incredibly soft and comfortable
text:
I love these leggings / pants. They feel wonderful on. They are made of 86% Polyester 14% Spandex / 82% Nylon 18% Spandex. That is an odd combination of material but the pants feel double lined. They fit perfect on me and I even probably could have gotten away with a size medium. They do not roll down at the tummy like some pants I have worn before. I also love the length. I am 5'5" tall with a 32" inseam and they come down to the floor which is my preferred length. The tummy control is moderate and comfortable and not at all restricting.

They wash well in a lingerie bag and I hang dry them even though they can be tumble dried on low per the label. Unfortunately, I have cats and the color does show cat hair. I wish this came in other colors like blue and red.

The one thing I do not like is having their logo on the bottom of the left pant leg. Other than this, these pants get 10 stars from me.

UPDATE Dec 4, 2018 - I love these pants so much that I ordered them in [[ASIN:B072HHQC38 midnight blue]] and [[ASIN:B071DPNRPP heather black]].

title: Thin profile wallet perfect for a man or a woman's purse
text:
This is an attractive leather wallet that has room for 10 ID or credit cards and two extra slots in front of the billfold. It also has a single billfold for cash. It apparently has RFID protection that provides unwanted prying from RFID Scanners. It also has a buttery soft feel to it.

I have many purses and use these type men's wallets for when I switch among them. This would make a nice Christmas gift for someone that wants a slim profile wallet.

title: Thin felt hat with a tiny leather like bow; can be cinched to fit; perfect complement to a winter coat
text: This is a nice hat. It's thin wool felt. There is a thin leather-like bow on the exterior brim. I take a small hat and this was big on me. However, there is a lace strap inside that can be used to cinch the interior rim lining. It is somewhat functional but not perfect. Nevertheless, I got it to feel less loose on my head. It is very attractive and a perfect complement to a winter coat even though it is not overly warm.

title: These are very comfortable boots but buy half size down because they run large
text:
I love Kenneth Cole Gentle Souls boots because they have a very comfortable insole and the leather is pretty supple. I already own several other pairs. These are very nice but since the other reviewers said they run large, I ordered a half size smaller than I normally take. I normally take a size 9 medium and ordered these in 8.5 medium.

These fit me perfectly and I felt comfortable wearing them all day. My calves are pretty large and I did not have to loosen the two buckles. However, if I had to cinch them tighter, I would have to punch a hole in the straps because there are only two holes available for each buckle. The leather is somewhat supple as well. Overall, these are very nice.

I only rated these 4 stars because they run on the large side and are not true to size; however, I really feel these are a 5-star boot.

title: Very tiny but holds 8 credit cards on the exterior face & 3 more cards/bills on the interior pockets
text:
This is a bare minimum wallet for a man's front pocket. I ordered it for me because I have small purses that I like to slip something this thin into with few credit cards and some folded cash. According to the website, this has RFID blocking; I'll just take their word for it.

It is a nice brown leather and is stitched well. I also like the interior striped cloth in the center. This is exactly the small size and thin profile I expected.

title: Excellent cushioned low cut socks for men (or women)
text:
I have plantar fasciitis and am always looking for compression socks that help keep my feet from becoming painful again. I do put arches in my shoes and even wear strap-on arches with flip flops around the house. However, with these socks, there was enough compression that I did not have to strap on my arches all the time. Note that there is only light compression but that was good enough.

They are anti-odor, wick away sweat (and I sweat a lot), breathable, and "cushion" comfortable. I machine washed these in a lingerie bag and laid them flat to dry and they came out fine. The instructions say they can be machine washed on cold in the gentle cycle and tumble dried on low. Since I do not do a gentle cycle, the lingerie bag provides the gentleness that is needed.

I know these are listed for men but I have no idea why. This size M fits me and I take a 9 in a woman's shoe and 7.5 to 8 in men's boots.

title: Bathing Suit bottoms that fit like a nice pair of shorts
text: These bathing suit bottoms are attractive and fit like a nice pair of shorts. There is an interior brief on the inside, small slits on either side of the shorts, and a blue tie. I'm not one for ties at the waist but it does add a pop of color. They do have a polyester feel to them; I prefer cotton or parachute-like material. I'm normally a large in pants but ordered these in an extra large.Overall, these are very nice and fit well.

title: Very nice slim profile wallet with enough room for ID, cash, & credit cards
text:
This is a really nice men's wallet. It is ultra thin and has a dual bill compartment. There's enough room for eight credit cards or other store cards, a double window ID pocket good for holding two IDs (one on either side), and two other hidden pockets behind the credit card slots.

It comes with RFID blocking but I'll have to take their word for it.

The leather smells great, the outside feels soft and padded, and overall it is stylish. Even though it is made for a man, there is no reason a woman cannot use this in their purse. Overall, it is both lovely and manly at the same time.

title: This pullover is warm and attractive
text:
I purchased this for $89 at a fishing store in Lafayette Village in Lafayette, New Jersey. I love it. It is warm and very attractive. I have not washed it yet but if I did, I would wash this in no hotter than warm water and would hang dry it. It is the type of material that would melt or get ratty in the dryer.

There are five snaps at the neckline and one snap flap breast pocket that is generously sized. The zippered side pockets are also spacious. Overall, I feel this is wonderful investment. Even though it is a man's pullover, it looks good on a woman too.

title: Quality checkbook cover for the price
text:
This is a very nice leather checkbook cover. I purchased an expensive embossed leather cover for my checkbook years ago but it is too snug. This cover allows for single checks with deposit slips, the check register (if desired) or cash instead. A photo ID clear slot and enough other slots for five more credit cards. It is also roomy enough to lay a pen in the crease. This also supposedly has RFID blocking; I just take their word for it. For the current price of $12.99, I feel this is a good deal and attractive and functional leather checkbook cover / credit card wallet combo.

UPDATE: I ordered this in [[ASIN:B07FBMVR82 brown]] as well and it is very nice and just as snug as an expensive checkbook cover I purchased. Except these covers allow for credit cards and photo ID.

In addition, I also ordered one in [[ASIN:B07FBMKX2R crazy horse brown]] (the 7th & 8th picture) and that one I am disappointed with because it has scratches on the cover. Other than this, it is as good as the others I ordered. I lowered the rating to 4 stars because of this.

My favorite checkbook cover, however, is the [[ASIN:B07FBNK6RF red pebble]]. That one goes with all my red and burgundy purses and arrived in pristine condition. See last two photos.

title: Gorgeous denim shirt but the cut from the armpits to behind the lats is awful
text:
This is an absolutely gorgeous denim shirt that can be worn by both a man or a woman. It looks extremely attractive on me and is a rich denim blue. There is one upper left pocket but since it is small, it would only fit an iPhone halfway.

It fits perfect on me except the area extending from under armpits to behind the back where the upper part of the lats (Latissimus dorsi) muscle sits. That area does not have enough material for any movement. If I make any subtle gesture like the Incredible Hulk, I would bust the back of the shirt. I lifted weights for years and my lats are pretty developed underneath a layer of fat. This is why I often gravitate towards men's shirts and jackets. However, I cannot picture a man ever feeling comfortable in this shirt.

I can wear this comfortably if I leave it open, but as a shirt it is unfortunately poorly tailored. The XL is like someone else's large or medium in the upper back area.

UPDATE - I had my boyfriend try this shirt and he likes it but did say the armpits are cut weird and it is tight in that area. However, the shirt does not bother him to wear. He wore it all day today. My assessment still stands. They need to redesign the armpit / upper back area to be more roomy.

title: Fits 6 or 7 credits cards and is perfect for the top pocket of a shirt or small bag
text:
This wallet is small and fits 6 or 7 credit cards in a tight wad. There are three pockets on either side and one in the middle. I would actually use the middle pocket for some small folded bills; although they do not need any RFID protection. This is small enough to fit in a top shirt pocket or a tiny purse. I cannot vouch for the RFID claims, but will take their word for it.

What I do not like is that the surface shows every imperfection / scratch / crease as you can see from the first two photos. The leather is also very thin. However, this is still functional, attractive, and perfect for when a tiny wallet is needed.

title: Attractive full coverage swimsuit with bra padding and a side tie
text:
This swimsuit is very attractive. The spaghetti ties in the back make it easy to expand for a good fit and are easy to tie. I personally do not care for bra padding; however, it stayed in place when putting the swimsuit on. One thing I really did not like is the tie in front. I could not get it to tie in a way that was flattering on me.

The material is thick and not see through. Overall, this is a quality suit. I just really do not like those ties nor the bra padding.

title: Warm hooded fleece-lined jacket of excellent quality; does not limit movement; SHOWS PET HAIR
text:
I absolutely love Carhartt products because they are quality, rugged, and last a long time. This jacket adheres to the same high standard I have come to love. Yes, I know this is a men's jacket but I ordered it for me because I like the roomy feel men's jackets provide.

FEATURES of this ZIPPERED FRONT JACKET:
- Fleece-lined hood with bungee cord cinch
- Fleece lined interior
- Zippered left vest side pocket
- Two roomy side pockets at waist level
- One inside Velcro square pocket (suitable for a smartphone) on interior right side
- One zippered pocket on interior left side
- Gusseted in the armpits for good range of motion
- Ribbed cotton waistband (no bungee cord cinch--would have liked that also)
- Internal rib-knit cuffs to keep the cold out
- Apparently machine washable but since the jacket is heavy, I doubt all washers could handle this.

Since this is the big and tall jacket, the sleeves are a bit long and the waist comes below my waist. I expected this since I am only 5"5' tall. Nevertheless, I love my jackets big. This allows me to layer my clothing underneath and also provides room for a lot of movement.

This is made in India and the shell is 100% Cotton and the body lining is 100% Polyester.

The one negative of this jacket is that it shows pet hair but because it is chocolate brown, it does not show it as bad as their black jackets.

title: Absolutely stunning swimsuit for the right body type
text:
I do not currently have the correct body type for this lovely swimsuit. However, it is gorgeous. It is a bikini one-piece. The bikini is in the back and one-piece in the front. In order to do this justice, one really has to have a very flat stomach as the sides are a bit exposed. The tie in the back is a nice touch but it is impossible to tie when it is on, so I tied it prior to pulling it on.

The only negative for me is that this has padded bra cups. I absolutely loathe padding in that area and these do bunch up a bit when putting on the bathing suit. However, the padding is very light.

I wash my bathing suits in a lingerie bag in the washer and always hang dry.

title: Warm jacket of excellent quality; does not limit movement; EASILY SHOWS PET HAIR
text:
I absolutely love Carhartt products because they are quality, rugged, and last a long time. This jacket appears to adhere to the same high standard I have come to love. Yes, I know this is a men's jacket but I ordered it for me because I like the roomy feel men's jackets provide.

FEATURES of this ZIPPERED FRONT JACKET:
- Corduroy-trimmed collar with snaps that I assume could be used with a removable hood (but I am not sure)
- Fleece lining
- Zippered left vest side pocket
- Two roomy side pockets at waist level
- One inside Velcro square pocket (suitable for a smartphone) on interior right side
- One zippered vest pocket on interior left side
- Gusseted in the armpits for good range of motion
- Adjustable closure; meaning bungee cord cinch for waist for a more tapered look and to keep the cold out
- Internal rib-knit cuffs to keep the cold out
- Apparently machine washable but since the jacket is heavy, I doubt all washers could handle this.

Since this is the big and tall jacket, the sleeves are a bit long and the waist comes below my waist. I expected this since I am only 5"5' tall. Nevertheless, I love my jackets big. This allows me to layer my clothing underneath and also provides room for a lot of movement.

This is made in India and the shell is 100% Cotton.

The one negative of this jacket is that it easily shows pet hair. I have three cats and their hair is like a magnet to this material. Nevertheless, this is high quality and I love the pockets, warmth, and ability to move freely in this jacket.

title: Great sock liners to wear alone or under other socks
text:
There are six pairs in size 6-9. I take a size 9 shoe, so I am at the extreme sizing limit for this liner. As can be seen from the picture, these liners are small. However, the heel pocket is deep and the material stretches, so it fits perfectly and stays on. The stitching on the toe is seamless making this a very comfortable wear. Overall, I really like these.

I machine wash these in a lingerie bag and I lay them flat to dry. They also can be tumbled dried but I choose not to do this.

They are made of 75% cotton, 20% polyester; 3% nylon, and 2% elastane. Supposedly, these socks have an anti-pilling finish but only extended wear will determine this. I also walked around on my rug with these on and it did not pick up as much cat hair as I expected, which is another plus.

title: Comfortable pants with roomy pockets; zipper is of poor quality
text:
I ordered this for my boyfriend but I wanted to wear these first. They are very comfortable.

There are four gusseted pockets (two on the seat and two on thighs) with snap closures. The material is soft and the legs are roomy. The stitching around the front of the thighs can be felt when walking, so that is a bit of a negative. I think I would get some chafing if I walked long distances in these due to that. The one big negative for me is that the zipper is sticky. Also, the zipper sometimes comes down on its own during wear. Only time will tell if the front zipper will last. At the current price of almost $46, I expect better.

They wash and dry well. I did not detect any shrinkage. They are a bit big on me but I really like them except for the substandard zipper.

UPDATE October 2, 2018 - My boyfriend likes these; although he is not partial to the color. He has to wear a belt with them because they are a little big on him as they were on me. He also likes the gusseted snap pockets because they are room and hold more than just a wallet.

UPDATE October 7, 2018 - After wearing these a few more times, my boyfriend rates this 4 stars. He said he also does not like the wrinkles in the gusseted pockets; other than this and his slight dislike of the color, he likes them.

title: This swimsuit will be attractive on small-breasted women
text: I am large up top and since the cups on this swimsuit are padded, the top makes me look like a sumo wrestler. The design is very attractive and both the bottoms and top fit perfectly, if not a tad loose. However, the padding just kills the look on me and for this reason only, I do not like this.

title: Shirt runs a size small but it is attractive and my boyfriend loves it; it does wrinkle
text:
My boyfriend really loves this shirt. Even though I think the material is a bit scratchy, he feels it is nice against his bare skin. It appears to have a gauze feel to it. He said had he seen it on the rack at the store, he would have purchased it. However, it does run a bit small. I ordered an XL for him when he normally takes a L. The XL fit just like a L would, so I would suggest one size up.

According to the symbols it can either be washed with water that is 40 degree or below. It cannot be bleached and it should be ironed. However, the label also had P symbol meaning it can also be dry cleaned with any solvent except for Trichloroethylene. I washed it on cold and tumble dried it for a few minutes on low. It did come out wrinkled but those wrinkles can be steamed out instead of ironed out.

What is nice is that this shirt did not shrink after washing. Of course, I mostly hung dried it except for the few minutes in the dryer to get off some of the moisture. It is a high-maintenance shirt because it wrinkles. If it did not wrinkle so much, I would have given this 5 stars. My boyfriend feels it is 5 stars but I personally do not like ironing, so this is a 4-star shirt to me.

PS I also had to look up the care symbols on the label to understand them and I put a link to that guide in my review.

title: Attractive and very comfortable shirt with side-button design; I use it as a base layer
text:
I really love this shirt. I always buy men's shirts like this for me to use either as a base layer or outer layer. Since I got the medium and I am a large to extra-large in women's, this is form fitting on my torso and what I consider a perfect fit for a base layer.

It looks attractive on. The side buttons especially make this shirt stylish should I ever decide to wear this as an outer layer. The material is soft and comfortable next to the skin. The sleeves have thumb holes in them. Personally I only use these thumb holes to keep the sleeves in place when I am layering over the shirt or inserting my arms into a jacket. It can also be used to shelter part of the hands from the cold. Otherwise, I do not need this feature but it is nice to have.

The tag says it is made of 100% cotton but also says the material is 60% cotton 40% polyester, so I do not really understand that. I believe it is a cotton/polyester blend because it does not wrinkle much.

I machine wash shirts like this in cold water inside a lingerie bag and then hang dry them. Overall, I love it and would purchase a couple more if they came in other colors and the price was right.

title: Absolutely gorgeous & stylish trench coat that is not proportionately designed in the arms to fit the size mentioned
text:
This is an absolutely gorgeous and stylish double-breasted woolen trench coat with waist belt. However, unless I am a freak of nature, this coat is not proportionately cut correctly in the arms to fit my size. I ordered the XL and the coat fits my frame snugly but is still good but the arms are very tight. As a result I cannot wear it. I am so disappointed because it is super attractive in the red.

This arrived well packaged in a basic blue garment bag (see picture) made of the material typical of shopping bags that can be purchased at a local supermarket for 99 cents.

LOVES (see 2nd and 3rd picture)
- I like the double-breasted look with has a one button closure but two buttons across.
- The two slit side pockets are spacious and comfortably angled.
- The stand-up collar is super attractive.
- The robe-like belt cinches the coat attractively around the waist, almost like a robe but better.
- The button detail and the half sash on the wrist is stylish.
- The coat feels sufficiently warm.
- The interior lining keeps the wool away from the body so that one does not itch.

HATES:
- The arms of the coat are not proportionately wide enough for the size of the coat. It seems that an inch or two more girth is needed in that area. This is the only reason I rated this coat two stars.

At the current price of $139.99, I do feel it is about $20 to $40 above what I would pay for this type coat. Although it is sufficiently warm, it is still thinner than a coat of the same type I can buy at Burlington. If the it fit in the arm area, then this would have received a 4 star rating from me at the current price. It would have received 5 stars if the price were between $99 and $120 and it actually fit.

P.S. I am sorry the pictures are on their side. Every time I upload a picture, Amazon changes the orientation even though my orientation is correct. I even tried changing the orientation on my end to be the incorrect way to see if Amazon would self correct to the right-side up view; however, Amazon still turned it into a side image. I spent hours in the past trying to get Amazon to help with this and they cannot seem to correct the issue.

UPDATE: I had my super skinny girlfriend try this on. She said this coat is beautiful and she considers the color crimson, which is a more accurate representation of the color in my opinion. Since the coat is an XL and she takes a small to medium, the arms fit her well but the coat was super huge on her. In conclusion, the girth of the arms are truly not sized correctly for the stated size of the coat. At least they were not sized correctly in the coat I received, so it is off to recycling.

title: Attractive shirt that shows every curve and which I use as a base layer in the winter; material feels too polyester
text:
I really like this shirt. I use these type men's shirts as base layers in the winter because they are comfortable and warm. This looks great on and feels relatively comfortable. It is form fitting, so it shows all the curves or muscles (if you are a man). It is made in China and is 84% Polyester and 16% Spandex.

The material feels more polyester than typical and is the reason I rated this four stars. For instance I prefer [[ASIN:B07F9SVTMT RADHYPE Men's Polyester Men Short Sleeve Bodybuilding Tshirt Training Top]] over this one simply because the material feels more sleek and is much softer against the skin than this one even though that other shirt is almost all polyester. Other than this, I love the shirt.

I machine wash this on cold in a lingerie bag and then hang dry it.

title: Long scarf that is best worn outside outerwear due to the tick pompoms
text: This scarf is long, comfortable to wear, and wraps two times around my neck. The pompoms on bottom make it impossible to use this under a coat or sweater. This is a scarf that has to be used outside outerwear. Also the pompoms feel and look like dyed human hair in various colors of brunette to burnt orange.

title: Attractive, warm, non-itchy wool beret hat that is just plain gray and nothing else
text:
This is a very nice and very warm wool beret hat. I usually itch with wool but this hat does not itch me. It is not as attractive on me as I expected but it is definitely a hat I will wear with the right outfit.

Note that there are no labels inside the hat; so I assume it is wool because it feels like wool and the Amazon description says it's wool. Also, there is a discrepancy in the description on Amazon with regard to the color. Amazon says "*Color:Two classic colors for you to choose, black with gold metal and grey with silver metal." There is NO gold or silver metal anything on this hat. It is just straight grey with the tiny stick tassel on top. It is possible that the black hat comes with some gold trim but the grey hat I got is unadorned and is as pictured on Amazon.

title: Very soft, comfortable, and attractive on  - I love this shirt!
text:
I absolutely love this shirt. It is very soft and comfortable on, form fitting, and very attractive. I buy a lot of men's shirts of this type because I like wearing them underneath other shirts in the winter. It is also super attractive as an outer shirt, even for a woman, as long as the body type is well-proportioned and trim. I tried this on my boyfriend and it did not look good on him because he does not weight lift. However, for a bodybuilder this shirt is perfect whether a man or a female (despite that it is marketed for a man)

I machine wash this on cold in a lingerie bag and I prefer to hang dry. The tag says this can be tumble dried on low but I personally find that this increases wear on these type of shirts. At the current price of $17.99, I feel this is a good purchase. I would definitely order this again if I were in the market for another one.

title: Simple watch with simulated leather band that feels great on but does not look as great on me as I had hoped
text:
This is a very nice watch. I love the simplicity in that it just tells time and has no date. Although, I would prefer the entire dial to be numbered, every other hour is numbered. The band is soft but is made of fake leather with a genuine leather backing. There are seven adjustment holes on the band, making this perfect for most wrist sizes.

My only reason I rated this 4 stars is because the watch does not look as stylish on me as I had hoped; therefore, I only like it and not love it. The band is attractive but the paleness of the clock face looks washed out against my skin tone. Other than this, it is perfect.

title: The length, thickness, warmth, and softness of this scarf is outstanding; however, it is too thick to wrap into the design shown
text:
I honestly did not think this would be so nice but I love it. This is like a tiny shawl since it is 20 inches wide and over 6 feet long. The material is just like a blanket and it is very soft. It is also not itchy which is great because I have sensitive skin. The only negative is that because it is so thick, it does not wrap easily around the neck without bulking up. The Amazon picture is deceiving as it does not show how bulky it gets when one tries to wrap it into the same design.

Overall, I love the feel of this scarf, the length, thickness, and warmth. I can use this as a blanket wrap around my shoulders if I want a touch of warmth in the winter. However, for those looking for a lighter and more easily maneuverable scarf, I suggest looking elsewhere.

title: I expected a high-grade fleece jacket; this has no "fleece" on the inside;  the pockets are sewn fully shut, etc.
text:
The peach color of this jacket is more like an electric pink or reddish pink. There is nothing peachy about it. Also the jacket is thin and made of 100% polyester. The outside feels "fleecy" but the inside has that flat polyester feel that is uncomfortable against my bare skin. The large fits snugly on me. However, it does stretch to fit even if it looks like a sausage skin on (my fault for choosing a large).

The sleeves are a good length. Oftentimes I find sleeves come above my wrists but these sleeves sit at the base of my hands as they should. The zipper easily opens and closes without the sticky feel of some zippers I have tried before. There's a "Casual Grey" logo embroidered on the front left side of the jacket. The "Casual" word is very hard to read; I only knew it said that because of the product label on Amazon.

The pockets are sewn almost completely shut and it was practically impossible to remove the stitching to open them. I had to perform "surgery" for about 15 minutes so that I could safely release the pockets. Besides this, the big negative for me is that this jacket is thin, feels cheap, and does not have that "fleecy" feel on the inside. This is the type of jacket that collects static cling in dry weather and that is not desirable in my opinion. Had I tried this in the store, I would have left it behind on the rack.

As for care instructions, this can be machine washed on cold and hung to try.

title: This "sport" bathing suit is designed for an evenly proportioned svelte female or woman bodybuilder with zero fat
text:
I am surprisingly disappointed in this swimsuit. Based on the way it looked on the model, I figured it would be flattering and athletic looking. However, this is extremely unflattering. Any tiny or large tummy bump or body flaw is accentuated. Also, the chest area has padding that rolls over onto itself even when putting on the suit. I personally do not like padding but if it is secured well, I can accept it. In addition, I had a lot of trouble getting this suit over my shoulders. I felt like I was putting on a straight jacket. Once I got it up, however, it was loose on the bottom and comfortable on top after I unrolled the back that curled up.

Another disappointment is that the front part of the suit is lined and this lining moves around and bunches up in spots. It is only secured on the outer perimeter of the bathing suit, so I have to constantly readjust.

The dark blue and black colors with the yellow trim is very attractive but this suit is designed more for an evenly proportioned svelte person or woman bodybuilder with zero fat.

title: Nicely styled leggings that appear to be true to size but they tend to ride down on me as I walk & are warm
text:
I ordered an XL in their other style, which is [[ASIN:B07D46ZKXH Halina Athletics Mid Waist Engineered Panel Mesh Inset Workout Legging]] and did not like them. These leggings are a better fit (in a large) and a better style (in the sense that they do not have the mesh panel that goes around the entire leg). Note that there is some mesh behind the calves but that is fine. However, as with the other ones, they do feel as if they are sliding down as I walk and the waist area keeps rolling over.

There is a tiny pocket in the waistband area that can fit a key or rolled up bills. I consider this a plus.

The tag that was attached says this wicks away moisture, but I do not feel that is the case because I feel warm and sweaty in these.

They wash well on cold in a lingerie bag and dry easily hanging up.

Overall, I like the style much better than the other pair I tried with the full-leg mesh inserts. Since these are warm on me, I would reserve them for cooler weather. However, the fact that I have to keep picking them up because they ride down lower and lower as one walks means I would not purchase these. I like leggings that have "sticking power" and these are just too slinky to stay completely around the waist.

title: These leggings slide down my waist, they are too warm, and do not feel as if they are made of breathable material in my opinion
text:
I thought I would like these leggings but I do not. I ordered the XL and they fit fine on me. However, as I walk with these, the leggings feel as if they are sliding down. I keep having to pick them up. Also, the waist area keeps rolling over. There is a tiny pocket in the waistband area that can fit a key or rolled up bills. I consider this a plus.

The mesh wraps around the entire leg and is obviously a bit see through. There is some sex appeal to this but it is not for me. Also, even though the tag that was attached says this wicks away moisture, I did not feel that was the case. I felt too warm and sweaty in these.

They wash well on cold in a lingerie bag. I hang dry them.

Overall, after having tried these, I would never purchase them simply because the style is not for me, they slide down, and they make me feel hot and sweaty.

title: Full coverage swimsuit that stays put and looks attractive on
text:
I have not been this excited over a swimsuit in a long time. Although this is about one size too big, it still looks great on. It does have padding in the cups, which I do not need. However, because the lower half has a bow-like front, having the padding balances out the bottom. The straps are adjustable and the suit is designed in such a way that it stays on. The center mesh panel provides a sexy peek-a-boo type look. There is no tummy control, so what one has one flaunts in this suit. Nevertheless, it feels great on and the style is flattering on a full-figured woman.

This must be hand washed. If I get up the nerve, I might machine wash it in a lingerie bag one day. This must be hung to dry. Overall, I'm impressed--finally.

title: This is a very nice blouse, very soft, and very comfortable but size appears to run large
text:
I am not sure why this is called a muscle tee; perhaps it is because it has very short sleeves.

The XXL I ordered is big on me. I never know what size to order. Sometimes I take plus sizes in blouses due to being top heavy but it depends on the shirt. Obviously in this blouse I take either an XL or large.

This tee is really nice and soft. I wore it all day and felt very comfortable in it.

It is made of 97% Viscose and 3% Elastane, neither material of which I ever heard of.

My Internet search turned up that " Viscose is a semi-synthetic fiber" and is known as Viscose Rayon. Another website mentioned that this material loses strength when wet a (see comments section of review for source) According to the dictionary, Elastane is " an elastic polyurethane material, used especially for hosiery, underwear, and other close-fitting clothing."

The label says to machine wash on cold gentle cycle and dry flat. I washed it in a lingerie bag and then dried flat. After one washing it did not shrink and kept its shape.

Note that this is a very nice blouse, very soft, and very comfortable. The material is the type that has the propensity to stretch out a bit. I can see this tee losing its shape over time. It also picks up pet hair and lint but that is easily removed with a sticky tape roller and any lint that existed when I put it in the wash was laundered out.

title: Expansive, high-quality, lightweight luggage with supreme mobility and easy handling
text:
I am highly impressed with this suitcase.This comes in a 21", 26", and 30" expandable spinner. The one I ordered is the 26" which is the medium. When fully expanded I was able to fit 10 long-sleeve sweatshirt-type hoodies in the front compartment and 7 thick long-sleeve sweatshirts in the back zippered compartment.

This luggage is super lightweight, it rolls easily even on carpet, and the handle is a cinch to expand and collapse. The zippers on this suitcase are high-quality as they open and close with incredible ease. There is a tiny hole on the "double-handled zipper" to insert a small luggage lock. There is no pre-defined slot for a luggage tag but one can be easily hung off the handles.

There are two handles--one on the top and one on the side. The placement of these handles made it easy for me to grab the luggage in its packed state and remove it from my bed and place it on the floor. The color is gorgeous and what I call a rich glossy crimson.

FEATURES (see pictures)
- 8.9 lbs (4.0 kg) - Its lightweight feature is great now that one has to pay baggage fees.
- There is a multi-compartment interior with a place for shoes, laundry, etc. The zippered organizer is great for smaller items.
- The larger compartment has elastic tie-down straps to keep clothing or other items secure.
- The smaller back compartment can be zippered shut to keep items in place.
- The case is expandable; which is the mode I used it in.
- The handle is ergonomically designed and is easy to expand and collapse.
- Even though the pamphlet says it is "carry-on" friendly, I disagree. I feel this is too large for that but perhaps it is possible on some airlines.
- The wheels have a 360-degree turning ability which provides for supreme mobility.
- It comes with a 10-year limited warranty for the workmanship and any defects.

In my opinion, this luggage is a powerhouse of features. There is not one thing that disappoints me. The quality of construction is astounding and I feel the current price of $136.04 is competitive. I hope this lasts me many, many years.

title: No frills wallet that is well constructed and holds bills and four cards
text:
I actually love this wallet. It is simple and provides only four slots for four cards and a billfold for cash. It is stitched well and is genuine leather. There is space on either side of the billfold as can be seen in the picture. It fits in a back jean pocket perfectly. Also, I found the card slots to be snug on the wallet I received so that I am not concerned with my cards falling out unless I turn it upside down.

However, since this is a bare bones no frills wallet with limited space, I do feel the current price of $26.99 is about $5 too much for this.

title: Beautiful tee that is a puppy / dog lover's dream
text: I ordered the men's extra-large and it is big on me but I wanted it loose. I love Mountain Tees and have about 25 of them. They are so colorful and fun to wear. They also do not wrinkle too much and wash well without shrinking. This one is a puppy / dog lover's dream tee! Their furry mugs are totally realistic.

title: Beautiful tee that is just an animal lover's dream
text: I ordered the men's extra-large and it is big on me but I wanted it loose. I love Mountain Tees and have about 25 of them. They are so colorful and fun to wear. They also do not wrinkle too much and wash well without shrinking. This one is an animal lover's dream tee! The images are almost totally realistic.

title: This is a well-made wallet but is limited in its storage ability and lacks a picture ID window
text:
I ordered several Filgate leather products and really like them because they are stitched well and feel sturdy, like a leather belt made into a wallet. I like the quality of this wallet but it is not for every man. I got this for my boyfriend and he feels the way I do about this with regard to quality.

It is larger than a regular men's wallet and not as long (see comparison picture--this wallet is shown on top). There are only two vertical pockets on either side for cards; several cards will fit in each pocket. There is also a side pocket on each side as well that is behind those vertical pockets. Then there is one billfold which is small but does fit the bills comfortably although it may be difficult to get them to slide in easily do to the leather.

The reason this wallet may not be for every man is because there is less room and fewer pockets for cards than a regular wallet. In addition, the wallet is a little bit larger. Although it did fit fine in my boyfriend's back pants pocket, I think it depends on the pants pocket size and it might be a tight squeeze in other pants. Also, there is no picture window insert for a driver's license which means any ID has to be removed from its card holder. Nevertheless, my boyfriend said he would use this. If he was not going to use it, I would use it for when I switch purses and want something to put a few cards and bills into. This is why I ordered several Filgate wallets, so that I can have one in each of my different purses even though this is a man's wallet.

Overall, this is a well-made wallet but is limited in its storage ability and lacks a picture ID window. Note that top edge of the wallet is also unfinished (meaning there is no seam; it's just a cut of leather).

title: Beautiful jacket that is warm and has a spandex-like stretch with a polyester-type feel but runs on the small side
text:
I know this is a men's jacket but I ordered it for me because I wear men's jackets, boots, T shirts, and hoodies because they fit better on me.

This jacket material (very "polyester-like" and stretchy) is not what I expected but I still love it. It is heavy and form fitting and stretchable.
