It is made in Indonesia of 68% rayon, 28% nylon, and 4% spandex. I got the XL size even though normally I take a large or medium in men's. Most men's medium fit snug on me and the large usually fits perfect. However, this XL fits perfect which means this jacket does run on the small side for a man. I would recommend that a man size up one, otherwise it will look like a sausage skin on.

The hood is a generous size and is easily cinched. The pockets are large for a man's hands and slit at the right angle so that it is comfortable to wear my hands in the pockets. The blue color on this tri-color jacket does show lint easily (I have cats) but the lint is also easy to remove. The "Hilfiger" name is written vertically down the full length of the left sleeve and it is impossible to miss.

The label says this can be machine washed cold and tumble dried on low. However, I would never put a jacket of this "spandex" type in the dryer.

Overall, I love it even though this was not the material I expected. I thought this was a typical windbreaker-type jacket I was ordering but it is not. The only reason I rated this 4 stars is because the sizing runs on the small side for a man.

title: This is a well-made leather bound passport holder that also holds some credit cards in the extra pockets
text:
This all leather bi-fold is well made and feels substantial. The passport can be inserted into the left and right inside sleeves to act like a "book cover" or inserted on one side only (see pictures). Because the U.S. passport is no longer flimsy as in years past and the cover is more cardboard-like, I found it very difficult to insert both left and right sides into this holder. I actually had to bend the cardboard a bit. Nevertheless, I can use one side only to make it easier for me.

There are also two side pockets for credit cards. I am not sure what the "smiley slit" is for on the right side of the passport holder but I suspect one could fold up a customs form and insert it into that slit.

Overall, this is perfect and offers good protection for my passport.

title: Soft comfortable jeans with a little bit of stretch; color bleeds in wash and when wearing; are a bit expensive
text:
I originally ordered these for my boyfriend but decided to try them on before giving them to him and wound up wearing them all day. Neither my boyfriend or I like slim fit jeans but these are very soft and look great on and are not as restrictive as regular slim fits since they stretch.

I will eventually give these to my boyfriend to try and will update my review with how he likes them. I found them comfortable to wear. I guess because they are a men's jean, I did not care for how the back pockets came to the bottom of my butt cheeks as I could feel the pockets with each step I took. What I really hated is that I was wearing a new pair of light pink underwear and these jeans discolored them black.

They wash well and did not appear to shrink when tumble dried on low; however, the black color does run, so be careful. They are a bit expensive at the current price of $79.

UPDATE June 24, 2018 - My boyfriend tried these and calls them "compression pants" because of the straight leg. He loves the color but hates the straight leg design. He hates them, so he gave them back to me.

title: Well made visor with exquisite stitching
text: This visor is well made and the stitching is exquisite. The back is adjustable. It looks great on my boyfriend and not as great on me because I have curly hair. I originally got this for me but my boyfriend is inheriting it since it looks so good on him.

title: Extremely comfortable camisoles that are slimming yet not constraining; LOVE THEM!
text:
These camisoles are incredible. I got the extra large and they fit perfectly. Of course they do come below my waist but that is typical when ordering a larger size. The straps are adjustable if needed. These are thick and slimming yet not too constraining as to be uncomfortable. They are warm enough for the winter yet not too warm and can be used in the summer--just perfect. What I love is that they do not have a bra insert; it's just a camisole (no bra needed). I would definitely order these again.

They wash well in cold water in a lingerie bag. I prefer to hang dry them but they do dry wrinkled. I have no idea if they would come out wrinkled if I put them in a dryer. However, it does not matter because once worn, the wrinkles stretch out since this is form fitting. On another note, this material does attract lint so do not wash with lint producing clothes.

title: The insoles are comfortable on these flats and the sole provides for good traction
text:
I take a size 9 medium in a shoe; however, I ordered these in a size 9.5 and they fit perfectly. There is only a little room in front so I think a size 9 would have been a bit snug.

The memory foam insoles are so soft and breathable. There is a very small padded arch on the insole. The underside of the sandal has good traction. There is a thin Velcro strap that goes over the front of the ankle and which keeps my foot securely in the shoe. Overall, I like these shoes for their comfortable insoles and its ability to stop me from slipping. The thin strap over the ankle is a bit constricting and does leave a mark on my ankle if I do not wear socks with these but so far they are holding up well.

As per the box, they are made from partially recycled rubber and are supposed to be odor free but I cannot tell if that is true or not.

title: Can be used as a regular shoulder purse or crossbody bag; it has lots of pockets for storage; zipper quality is below par
text:
Black goes with everything except cat hair. This bag really shows up pet hair easily and attracts it like a magnet too. However, I love the design of this crossbody and the fact that it has many compartments. I already own one in the [[ASIN:B078H6MF2M Indio color]] which is about 1/2 inch to 1 inch smaller all the way around.

This is almost like a spacious full-size purse. On one side there is a zippered pocket and one regular pocket. On the other size is another zippered pocket which can be used for a battery pack to charge a phone. There is a grommet in that pocket through which the cable can be snaked through to the inside of the bag.

The main compartment has two slip pockets on one side, the main center pouch, and a larger zippered pocket on the other side with a tiny sleeve that can hold any extra cable that snakes through the grommet from the outside pocket. If not using it for that, the tiny sleeve can hold Chapstick and other small items.

I am able to use this like a regular shoulder bag by leaving the strap doubled up. When I want to turn this into a crossbody bag, I just pick up one section of the strap and it expands out to a longer strap for the lazy person's way of crossbody use. However, if I want it to be permanently crossbody without the odd strap across the zipper, I just adjust the buckle until I have a long shoulder strap.

Unfortunately, I am disappointed in the quality of the zippers on this bag. This one has the same problem the other one does in that the zipper to the main compartment is a bit "sticky" on the one end because it is bunched up and hard to get going again if I unzip it all the way. In addition, for one compartment, the zipper does not close all the way. See pictures for both issues. If it were not for these two issues, I would have rated this 4 stars. If it did not attract so much cat hair and had flawless zippers, I would have rated this 5 stars.

title: This turns from a regular shoulder purse to a crossbody bag in a second; it has lots of pockets for storage as well
text:
I love the color and design of this bag. It is larger than I thought it would be; almost like a spacious full-size purse. On one side there is a zippered pocket and one regular pocket. On the other size is another zippered pocket which can be used for a battery pack to charge a phone. There is a grommet in that pocket through which the cable can be snaked through to the inside of the bag.

The main compartment has two slip pockets on one side, the main center pouch, and a larger zippered pocket on the other side with a tiny sleeve that can hold any extra cable that snakes through the grommet from the outside pocket. If not using it for that, the tiny sleeve can hold Chapstick and other small items.

I am able to use this like a regular shoulder bag by leaving the strap doubled up. However, when I want to turn this into a crossbody bag, I just pick up one section of the strap and it expands out to a longer strap for the lazy person's way of crossbody use. However, if I want it to be permanently crossbody, I just adjust the buckle until I have a long shoulder strap.

Overall, this is a pretty bag. The only reason I gave this four stars is because the zipper to the main compartment is a bit "sticky" on the one end. It's sort of bunched up and hard to get going again if I unzip it all the way. Other than this, it would be a five star purse.

UPDATE April 28, 2018 - The zipper pull on one of the pockets fell off as the stitching came out. It is too difficult for me to sew together so I used a stapler to staple it in place. This is obviously a disappointment. Other than this and the other sticky zipper, the bag is working fine.

title: I love the buttery feel of this leather "card wallet"; it is well-made and holds 20 cards easily
text:
This is a beautifully-styled card wallet in very soft and supple 100% genuine leather made in India.

There are four card pockets in leather on the left and right sides and 12 plastic center card holders for a total of 20 slots overall. The snap latch in front is in a slate blue as is the second leather pocket on each side of the fold. The rest of the leather is in black. Nothing in this "card wallet" is removable. Even the plastic holders in the center are stitched into the wallet.

Although, this claims to be RFID protected, I have no way of knowing that. Nevertheless, it does not matter to me. I ordered this for me even though it is marketed to a man. I feel it's perfect to pair with a change purse when I do not want to carry a fully packed wallet around in my smaller handbags. For the men out there, this fits perfectly into jean pockets just like a regular billfold.

Unfortunately, there is no price listed on Amazon for this card wallet. I would pay $30 easily for this and feel like I got a good deal.

title: Super soft and comfortable but too see-through, thin, and expensive & the waistband elastic does not stay in place
text:
These leggings are definitely true to size. I take a large in bottoms like this and they fit perfectly. I love how soft and comfortable they are and the tapered leg is best for inserting into boots or wearing sandals. However, that is where my love stops.

First, they are way too thin and see-through. I have to wear a shirt over these to cover my bottom in order not to expose myself to prying eyes. Second, there is a 4 inch elastic waistband on top and the elastic is not sewn into the channel which means that just the process of pulling these up or down causes the elastic to fold over on itself. This is my BIGGEST HATE. I could not straighten out the elastic easily but when I did, it just did it all over again. Third, the current price of $42 is insane, especially because these are so thin and will probably wear out almost as quick as hosiery.

Since these have a logo on the leg, they look best when paired with a solid-colored shirt. I consider these more of a pajama bottom than a legging I would go about town with.

They wash well in cold water and I prefer to hang dry them due to their thinness.

title: I love the look and feel of this compression tee and it is moisture wicking as well
text:
I absolutely love this as a base layer. Even though it is made for a man, it looks great on me. I take a medium in a men's in these type shirts even though I'm a large to extra-large in a woman's.

This shirt is thick, soft, warm, and wicks away sweat and I sweat a lot. I wash this in a lingerie bag in my washer but I always hang dry spandex items and this is no exception. It's made of 87% polyester and 13% spandex. To me it is competitively priced at $24.99. I'm actually considering purchasing this in blue.

This long-sleeve mock neck light compression tee in black looks a little bit like a wet suit on top. I absolutely love the look and the feel.

UPDATE March 26, 2018 - I purchased this in [[ASIN:B076JXWMR2 Navy]] since I love this one so much. These shirts are great. In fact, I wore the black one as an outer shirt also.

title: These are great as a base layer because they are see-through; they also wash well but they run on the small side
text:
The sizing is on the small side. I normally take a large in a base layer. These are just a tad loose and they are XX large and look and feel good that way. However, if I actually took an XX large in a base layer, these WOULD NOT fit me. They do stretch but I like my undergarments loose.

I really like these. The black one can be used as an outer layer if a bra is underneath but the white one is a bit too see-through for my taste even with a bra. They are both see-through but with black it is hard to tell except if in the light.

They wash well. I hang dry them but they most likely can be tumble dried on low.

title: These leggings are heavy, thick, shiny, opaque, and comfortable to wear
text:
These leggings are heavy, thick, shiny, and opaque (not see through). They are very comfortable to wear and true to size. I normally order a large bottom but sometimes I order an extra-large when the item stretches. This fits perfectly on me in an extra-large. I also feel I could have fit in the large as well.They also wash well. I chose to air dry them to avoid fabric degradation.

On the other hand, the waistband is not as reinforced as I would like and I would have preferred a more matte instead of shiny sheen but those are my only disappointments.

Overall, I like these.

title: Jeans that are more for a child than an adult with a sticky zipper and minimal stretching
text:
I am very disappointed in these jeans. The first reason is my fault as I did not understand the sizing. Unfortunately, I could not even get these beyond my calf.

As a result, I had a very, very skinny friend who looks like a size 3 try these on and she also could not pull them over her thighs. Mind you these are stretch jeans. These are definitely not true to size because 26 is the waist size and she is less than that.

In addition, even if they were my size I would not like them. The zipper is a bit sticky and does not go up and down smoothly. Also, they are more like boot pants because they come above the ankles. I do not think these are worth the price and that is mainly because of three reasons. First they do not stretch much, they are not true to size, and the zipper is flawed.

title: Super comfortable and lightweight sandals; part of the purchase price is donated to Best Friends Animal Society in Utah
text:
These sandals are true to size and have a super comfortable foot pad. They are also very light. The elastic has a lot of give to it like an ace bandage. The Velcro ankle strap is also adjustable. I wore these for two days already in utter comfort.

According to the box, for every purchase made a donation is sent to Best Friends Animal Society in Utah to help with their lifesaving initiatives as it concerns shelter animals. However, it does not say exactly how much of each purchase is donated. There is a free package of five stickers included in the box - a cat face, dog face, Arf!, Woof!, and the biggest sticker of the bunch in the shape of a bone labeled BOBS for Dogs.

These sandals were designed in Los Angeles, CA.

Overall, I love how comfortable these are. Since the elastic is loose, they will stretch out more over time. I do not feel these would last more than a year or two of regular use because of the light material. However, I love the feel.

title: Worth the purchase for drying hiking boots, shoes, gloves, etc. but drying time varies based on the extensions used
text:
My boyfriend purchased this because he works outside for a living and many times comes home with wet boots. I wanted to try this as well. What I found is that this dries shoes well with a little heat but for boots it will only lightly dry if the extensions are used and will take longer.

INCLUDED IN PACKAGE
- Dryer
- Two 14" extension tubes for drying boots
- Two drying anvils that clip on top of the extension tubes to extend the drying tubes for 16" tall boots

FEATURES
- Up to 3-hour (180 minutes) drying time
- 105 degrees Fahrenheit heat
- A fan is on the entire time with light fan noise
- 1 year warranty against defect in material and workmanship

LIKES
- It dries smaller shoes well with low heat
- It dries gloves
- Boots can be dried with the extensions
- Shoes feel toasty because no extensions are needed

DISLIKES
- Tall boots do not get the full benefit of the heat and drying ability due to the extension nozzles and drying anvils.
- All four nozzles work at once, so if drying only one pair of boots or shoes, the fan is wasted. I wish there were a way to turn off the unused nozzles.
- There's a burning smell during operation but that did dissipate after the initial use.

Overall, this is effective when using without the extension tube. It is certainly worth the purchase when one comes home with wet boots and gloves. Drying time does vary based on the level of wetness and if the extra extensions are used. This has a smaller footprint than I expected.

title: Beautiful lightweight sweatshirt made for a man but loved by a woman EXCEPT for the major shirinkage
text:
These are two beautiful lightweight, soft, and comfortable men's sweatshirts that look beautiful on. As a woman, I love the color and ordered these for myself. I take a size large to extra-large in women's and ordered these in a medium. The medium fit was snug but loosened up as I wore it. Unfortunately, after washing one of these on cold, hang drying for several hours, and then tumble drying on low for ten minutes, the sweatshirt shrunk about two inches all around and even more in the sleeves. The label says wash on cold and tumble dry low; I barely tumble dried it. If I ordered a large or extra-large, this would not be a problem as they are big to begin with. However, since the medium just fit, this is a disappointment. Other than major shrinkage, these sweatshirts are gorgeous and at the current price of $20 for the pair, they are competitively priced.

The attached photo shows the new sweatshirt on the bottom and the washed one that I wore once on top.

title: Soft full-zip hoodie with ample pocket room for female hands but probably not a man's hands; hood is also tall
text: I really like this hoodie. The sweatshirt material is soft and the pockets are perfect for a woman's hands even though this is a men's full-zip jacket.  The hood is tall and has ample room; in fact, the hood is half the height of the torso. I normally take a size large to extra-large in women and this men's medium fits me snugly without being too tight. Overall this is perfect and I think the $19 price is reasonable. I do think that a man might find the front slit pockets a little small, but other than this it is a good deal, particularly for a woman.

title: These pants attract so much lint  it is annoying; also the material is scratchy
text:
These pants seem true to size but I wish the regular was about a 1/2 inch longer. There are two small pockets in the front that will fit 3/4 of my hand in each pocket. There are also two tiny pockets in the back. They have a little bit of elasticity that is nice. They wash and dry well.

I wore these all day on the weekend and I found them to be a bit scratchy (not itchy but not totally smooth either). In addition, they attract oodles of lint and pet hair. Even after I took them out of the dryer, I still could not get off all the lint with a lint roller.

Personally, I find these pants disappointing due to the lint issue and the scratchy material.

title: Small, light backpack that can be used as a combination purse / laptop or iPad carrier
text:
I really like this backpack. The color is a rich burgundy as pictured on Amazon. The straps are comfortable around my shoulders and adjustable. There's a top handle for carrying the backpack, if needed. There's one small zippered pocket against the lower back that will fit a Number 10 business envelop or passport or some dollar bills and change. The main compartment hooks to a loop on the back of the pack to keep it in place.

The main zippered compartment has a pretty cavernous interior with a laptop compartment that will fit a 15" laptop or 12.9" iPad Pro. There's a Velcro strap that keeps the electronic secure. There is also a tiny inside pocket that will fit lip balm and folded up bills or change. Although, there are few compartments in this backpack, it is perfect for using as a combination purse / laptop or iPad carrier. It is lightweight and ergonomically designed. Overall, this is a win for me.

This would have been 5 stars for me except that I prefer more pockets in my backpack and the back panel is a bit abrasive, so it picks up lint as you can see from the attached picture.

It comes with a 5-year limited warranty related to the workmanship of the product and not normal wear and tear.

title: My boyfriend loves this shirt; it fits well and looks good on him
text: My boyfriend loves this shirt. He says it is a beautiful fit. It is true to size and looks great on him. I washed and dried the shirt and it did not shrink. It did come out a bit wrinkled but it smooths out when worn or with a light iron.

title: This jewelry ensemble with watch is gorgeous
text:
This jewelry ensemble with watch is gorgeous and perfect for business or evening affairs. The embedded Swarovski crystals against the beautiful rose gold-tone of the bracelets look rich. I found it relatively easy to fasten all four pieces on my wrists without any help. Of course, removing them was much easier.

The watch and two of the bands have fasteners that can be removed to reduce the length. The instruction pamphlet pictures a watch with a date but this watch does not have the date feature, so that could have been better. It also could have come in a richer box. Nevertheless, I still feel this ensemble is reasonably priced and most people will be fooled it is not real. Of course only time will tell if this holds up for years.

title: Extremely comfortable, easy to slip on and cinch closed, but these are more like a sneaker than a hiking shoe
text:
I purchased these in a Size 9 on sale in DSW and it looks like I got a great deal. They were marked $99.94 with 50% off and then I had two $10 coupons and a 10% offer and wound up getting these for $24.97.

They are extremely comfortable to me and I have foot problems, which is why I am always purchasing shoes. They feel like they have light arch support, although I insert [[ASIN:B00J1FOOVQ Dr. Scholl's DreamWalk Hidden Arch Supports]] when needed. Walking in these is like wearing slippers. I also love how easy it is to cinch the laces. The upper is thin and breathable so that I do not sweat too much. There is no hiking support, however. I would call these sneakers and not a hiking shoe. Overall, I am highly satisfied.

title: Well constructed bag good for a half-week's worth of clothing but design is too awkward to carry by shoulder straps
text:
Thule is an exceptional brand but I find the ergonomics of this bag disappointing.

THE GOOD:
- It is exceptionally well made and the color looks like a rich burgundy to me which is attractive.
- The bag has wide-mouth access for the main compartment with internal compression straps to secure clothing to the bottom.
- There are two slightly expandable gusseted pockets on either side to store shoes or other items.
- In the main compartment, there is a front mesh pocket for storing papers, keys, etc.
- In the back of the main compartment, is another mesh pocket. This pocket has both inside and outside access.
- There's a mesh ID slot in the back of the bag; it would have been nice if Thuile provided a blank ID card with it.
- The main compartment zipper pulls have loops through which a small lock can be placed.
- The shoulder strap has two possible positions depending on where it is affixed.
- There are also two handles on the side and two handles on top for carrying if one does not want to use the padded shoulder strap.

The shape this bag reminds me of my former Mazda Miata trunk shape and looks like an X-cargo roof storage container similar to this [[ASIN:B0000WZYF4 Thule Cargo Box]]. However, when fully packed it turns into the image you see on Amazon, like a large football without the pointy sides. If not fully packed, its shape is more flattened and trunk like.

This is a well-constructed bag but what I do not like is that it is awkward to carry by the straps because the design is odd. In addition, it is too bulky and large as a carry-on and will need to be checked baggage on an airplane. It is also not large enough for more that a few days clothes. The main reason I rated this 3 stars is due to the awkward design and how uncomfortable it is to me to use the shoulder straps no matter where I place them.

title: This is too thin and small of a jacket; I personally do not feel it is worth the $65 price tag.
text:
I wanted so much to love this full zip hoodie, but all I like is the color.

MY DISLIKES
- It runs on the small side.
- The sleeves are made of very cheap fleece; I would not even put this in the dryer on low because it seems like this fleece would melt.
- The knitted cuff feels weird on me around the wrist.
- Overall it is very thin.
- Lastly, the suggested retail price of $65 is insane for what this is. Even at the discount I am required to pay, I think it is too much.

I believe this is more a "missy" type garment for teenagers and I can see teenagers loving this. I do not feel it is worth more than $25 or $30 tops. Overall, I'm very disappointed. However, the color combination is attractive and the torso part of the jacket is a little better than the rest.

title: Great as a base layer in the cooler weather but material has a scratchy texture and the fabric pulls easily
text:
I ordered this for me even though it is a men's shirt. It fits perfectly. I like these type shirts as a base layer. I find this to be warm and it does wick away moisture. It also washes well in a lingerie bag. I hung it to dry.

There are three things I do not like about this shirt:

- It pulls easily. Mine arrived with a fabric pull in it just from the paper tag that was attached. Therefore, I have to make sure I avoid Velcro and cat claws when wearing this.

- The shirt feels scratchy and not soft. I expected it to be silky with a slinky texture and that is not so.

- The price of $39.99 is about $10 too bit steep because of the above two dislikes of mine.

Overall, this is great as a base layer and looks form fitting on. It dries fast and does wick away moisture. If it were not for the dislikes above, I would have rated this five stars.

UPDATE Sept 17, 2017 - My boyfriend really looks good in this shirt. He said it reminds him of his silk PJs and does not feel scratchy to him. I have sensitive skin, so I guess that is the difference. He said it is an excellent fit and rates the fit at 5 stars but the price is high. He said he would pay $20 for this shirt. Therefore, at the current price, he rates this 4 stars (one star off for the price).

title: Delicate and dainty chain with an attractive heart; great as a subtle accessory
text: This open heart pendant is delicate and dainty. It comes in a black box with royal blue background that makes it look rich. The clasp is tiny and a bit hard to close as a result of the thin chain. It looks nice on but because the chain is so thin, it is less than a statement piece. This is great for when I want to subtly accessorize without a lot of bling.

title: Nice form-fitting underwear that are a bit pricey and run a size too small
text:
These are form fitting and stretchy. My boyfriend finds them to be comfortable and slightly tight because these run on the small side. He normally takes a large and I would have chosen an extra-large had I known they run small. These are supposed to be "moisture wicking" but since my boyfriend does not sweat, he said he did not notice any difference in that area. They also wash well and do not seem to shrink.

Overall they are nice but my boyfriend said he would not pay $20 for two pairs of underwear so to him and me they are a bit pricey and run on the small side.

title: Extremely high quality swimsuit that is geared more for a taller woman; mine arrived with one minor defect
text:
This one-piece swimsuit is high quality and for the most part is well-made. The straps in the back are adjustable. The extra large size I ordered is a bit too large for me. I take around a size 12, so I should have ordered a large. I had to gather the material in front a bit. Also, this seems like it is made for taller women. I am 5'5" tall and had to make the straps in the back as short as possible because they were sticking out in front since I was not tall enough.

The bra area is lightly padded, which I could have done without. The strap design is very attractive. The one flaw in the suit I received is that the left strap is sewed on backwards as you can see from the picture. It is impossible to straighten out and is the only reason I did not rate this 5 stars.

Although this suit should be hand washed and air dried, I washed this in a lingerie bag in my washing machine and then hung it to dry and it came out fine.

title: This feels like a girdle on my upper body and is as unyielding as a straightjacket to me
text:
I buy a size large in most of my tops and sometimes an extra-large. When it comes to tank tops (which I use as undergarments), I fit in a large and sometimes medium depending on the product.

This tank top is well-made and feels thick like a spandex girdle. I tried to get it on over my head but wound up getting all tangled in it that I could barely remove it from my head and arms. I was almost to the point of panic. I then stepped into this and got it on. However, it is way too tight and reminds me of my mother's girdle that I use to try on when I was seven years old. Despite being tight, it does have a lot of stretch. When I stepped into it, it stretched down to my thighs even though the straps were on my shoulders.

I hate this so much. If I knew this was like a straightjacket, I would not have ordered it. I suspect runners would love this because it will keep everything on top in place. Items like this wash well in a lingerie bag and should be air dried. This tank top is definitely high quality and perfect for the right person; it is just not for me.

title: This PJ top is soft and comfortable to sleep in but it is a bit see-through
text:
I ordered the [[ASIN:B01N2NRKNT Mae Women's Short Sleeve Notch Collar Pajama Set]] in a large and the top was not designed correctly but the pants were fine. Therefore, I ordered this top to pair it with those bottoms.

Do not be fooled by the picture on Amazon as it is only the top that is being sold and not the entire PJ set pictured. Nevertheless, this is soft, is comfortable to sleep in, and washes and dries nicely. The two negatives for me are that the top is a bit see-through and $20 is overpriced for this very thin PJ shirt.

title: I both love and hate this style depending on the color; the white top is thinner than 1-ply toilet paper & see-through
text:
This review is for [[ASIN:B01N2NRKNO Blue Tie Dye]] style of these pajamas. In the [[ASIN:B01NBEH7EC Navy Stripes version]], these PJs are soft and are wonderful. However, in [[ASIN:B01N2NRKNO the Blue Tie Dye color]] the top is white and extremely see-through and it appears thinner than 1-ply toilet paper. If I had wanted to expose myself, these would be perfect but I prefer to cover up. The pants in this style (both this version and the navy stripe version) are superb. The only issue with them is that I am 5'5" and I have to roll them up once at the waist because the bottoms are about 1-2 inches too long.

These also wash and dry well when tumble dried on low. If the white top was not so see-through, I would have rated this 4.5 stars. However, in its current state, I absolutely hate the transparency of the top. Their [[ASIN:B01NBEH7EC Navy Stripes version]] in this style gets 4.5 stars from me. Both these PJs would have gotten 5 stars if the pants were not so long and if the top on this one did not remind me of a wet T-shirt contest.

title: Very soft & comfortable to sleep in but not worth the current $40 price tag in my opinion
text:
I have their [[ASIN:B01N2NRKNT short sleeve version of these PJs]] and am not pleased with them due to the cut of the top. This long-sleeve version is cut a bit better in the top.

I normally take a size large in all my PJs but since the Mae PJs tend not to fit correctly on top, I ordered an extra-large. In this set, the shorts are very big but still stay on. The top fits loosely except in the chest area. In that area by the top button, it wants to stretch just a bit though no skin is displayed. I'm glad I ordered a size larger than I take because I'm sure the top would be too small for me in a large based on how they cut their PJs.

The yellow piping detail on the PJs is very attractive to me. The PJs are very soft and very comfortable to sleep in. I do feel the $40 price tag is outrageous bu if it were $24.99 or less, it would have received 4 stars from me.

I washed and dried these. The only shrinkage I found was in the height of the top (which I find strange) and the jersey material looks a bit worn after one washing. My biggest gripe is with the price and the way they cut their top; although this top's cut is much better than their [[ASIN:B01N2NRKNT short sleeve version of these PJs]]. If they cut their top correctly, these would fit better on me in a large.

title: Top is way too small but the bottoms are perfect; cannot recommend unless they redesign the top or the woman is flat chested
text:
These would be great summer PJs if only the top was cut correctly. I take a size large in all my PJs but these just do not fit properly on me. The shorts are a perfect fit and look great. However, the top is way too small. The shirt has four buttons but it really should have seven because it opens up at the chest area and between the other buttons. It was apparently designed for a size large woman with an ironing board chest. In addition, the white piping that is located two inches up from the bottom of the sleeves cuts into my arms and acts like a rubber band.

I also ordered these in an extra-large and the bottoms are swimming on me and so is part of the top except for the arms and the chest area. In addition, I also ordered the [[ASIN:B01MYTLPUN Mae Women's Short Sleeve Notch Collar Pajama Set, Pink, X-Large]] and it has the same problem. It's obvious the top on these PJs needs to be designed differently. Had the top been designed correctly in the chest and arm area, I would have rated this 4 stars. If the price were $24.99 or less and the top was designed correctly, it would have received 5 stars from me.

These do wash and dry well. There is some shrinkage but not much after washing and the material is soft and stretchy but thin. Overall, I am very disappointed in these only because of the top. I wound up stitching the top permanently together just so that I can wear them for the season even if they are too tight.

title: Extremely comfortable and soft; the cotton will shrink a bit in the dryer and the price is a bit steep
text:
I got these for my boyfriend and he loves them. I personally like how soft they are and so does he. He says they are comfortable as well and better than any other underwear he has tried.

There are only two negatives. First, I washed and dried one pair so that I could compare it to the new pair. The pair that was washed and dried shrunk an inch from top to bottom and a half inch from side to side. Second, at the current price of $29.50 ($14.75 per pair), they are expensive. He would never pay $15 for one pair of underwear. Nevertheless, these are higher quality than his typical briefs. If the price were cheaper, we would have rated this 5 stars as some shrinkage is expected for cotton underwear.

title: Colorful bag with eight separate compartments; it does attract lint since it's cloth
text:
For years I have been admiring Vera Bradley bags but never purchased one because paisley is not my style. However, after reading Barbara Bradley's book ([[ASIN:1250121914 A Colorful Way of Living: How to Be More, Create More, Do More the Vera Bradley Way]], I decided I had to have a bag of hers (since the company branched out beyond paisley) and purchased this at my local "The Paper Store" for $68.95 plus tax. I love it because it is colorful and has eight separate compartments (pockets), one of which I did not discover until after I was using the bag a few weeks. The design is also attractive.

The only negative is that this attracts a lot of lint and since I have cats, I am forever using the lint roller on the bottom. Other than this, I love it.

title: Nice skirt that is more casual than business like and very short on me
text: This is a really nice high quality skirt.  I do not like wrap-around ties and the tie on this is short; more like a bow tie size which I like. However, the skirt is way too short and not something I will wear. It also is made of a stretch material that makes this look more casual than business like. Unfortunately, this is not a skirt I will wear because it comes about three inches above my knees.

title: The extra padding, short shoulder straps, and the sizing is just not for me; but it would be nice otherwise
text:
I don't like this bra for several reasons.

- First it is not true to size, so a large is more like a medium.

- Second I found it difficult to get the shoulder straps on because it's too short. I guess the short straps are what causes the "push up." It would have been great if the straps were longer.

- Third, there is extra padding in the cups. I already have a big chest and was not expecting the padding.

Since this does not fit me, the straps are too short, and it has padding I didn't expect, I will not ever wear this. However, if it were not for the negatives, I would have loved it. It's made of nice material, is strong, appears it would be comfortable, and I like the lacy look on the straps.

title: I love the quality and attractiveness of this hat and I usually prefer Page Boy types over baseball cap style
text:
I am impressed with the look of this cap. The puma in embroidered blue on the front (also on the back) complements my blue eyes and makes this hat look rich. The loose blue cable accent across the front of the rim also enhances the look.

I usually take a small size so I only had to let out the plastic fastener in the back by one notch. The front sides of the cap felt a little tight but loosened up after wearing this a couple of hours.

The hat is 100 percent polyester and made in China. I believe the current $20 price tag is reasonable. I love this and that says a lot as I usually prefer "Page Boy" style hats over baseball caps like this. This is a great summer cap.

title: This is an exquisitely designed watch that exudes an elegance far surpassing even pricier watches; made for a man but I love it
text:
This is a STUNNING watch in rich black leather with iridescent red clock face. It exudes pure elegance and even though this is a men’s watch, I got it for myself. It looks great on me despite its large size.

POSITIVES

- The packaging is stylish enough for gift giving. The watch is fastened around a cushioned black pillow and angled for display.

- Besides keeping the date and time in both AM/PM, it also acts as a chronograph. There are three sub-dials on the clock face in an upside-down triangle. The chronograph minutes counter is on the left and the chronograph seconds counter is on the bottom. Use the minutes and seconds counters in conjunction with the top and bottom buttons on the side of the watch for counting brief intervals of time up to 59 minutes and 59 seconds. The sub-dial on the right is the 24-hour hand that automatically synchronizes with the AM/PM time and the date. The numeric date is angled between 4 o’clock and 5 o'clock.

- It is water resistant up to 50 meters. However, the included manual warns not to get the leather strap wet.

- Setting the watch is simple. Follow the online instructions online for the “(10) QUARTZ ANALOG CHRONOGRAPHS 1/1 OF A SECOND – TYPE C with small chronograph minutes/seconds counters, 24-hour hand and date” watch. The one error in the instructions is that to set the date one has to wind the crown COUNTER CLOCKWISE and not CLOCKWISE as stated.

- The leather band is a rich charcoal and is beautifully embossed on the underside with the Ferrari emblem and numbered.

- I LOVE horses, so the yellow and black Ferrari emblem on the watch face is supremely attractive to me.

- It comes with a 2-year limited warranty.

- A sticker on the back of the watch indicates when the battery needs changing - mine says Nov 2019.

- The watch is comfortable to wear, although it is a bit large and loose for a woman’s wrist. The dial fully covers the top of my wrist.

- The watch hands fluoresce in the dark as long as it has been exposed to light during the day.

- The crystal is so clear that the minute and second hands appear to be 3D.

NEGATIVES

- Only two authorized watch repair locations exist in North America - one in Illinois and the other in Canada.

- The price is a bit steep for most people; however, it does exude quality even beyond that of higher priced watches.

- The watch is heavier than any watch I have ever owned.

- The enclosed pamphlet only provides the most basic instructions but for true operation of the watch, one has to look up the manual online. In both the online manual and provided pamphlet, the date setting instructions say to turn the crown CLOCKWISE (which is incorrect) instead of COUNTER CLOCKWISE.

In summary, this is an exquisitely designed watch. The band is a brilliant black leather embossed with the Ferrari emblem and numbered. The iridescent red face screams RICH. To me the “Ferrari Men's 'PILOTA' Quartz Stainless Steel and Leather Casual Watch” exudes an elegance that far surpasses even pricier options.

I will update this review if this watch fails to keep time perfectly or malfunctions in any way.

In the comments section of this review, I put a link to the Scuderia Ferrari site and the manual.

title: Thin but warm outer garment that looks great on a man and wicks away moisture
text:
I have one other Under Armour men's shirt that I purchased and wanted another. Obviously, this is a men's shirt and it looks great on my boyfriend who takes a large. It's true to size on him. It looks okay on me but definitely not as good as it looks on my boyfriend; but he's not getting it because I got it for me. I use it as an outer shirt but will use shirts like these as an undergarment also when I don't want to wear too much clothing in colder weather.

It's polyester and thin but is also very warming to me. It does an excellent job of wicking away sweat to keep me feeling drier than usual. It also washes well and the color does not bleed when washed in cold. I hang it to dry.

title: A beautiful watch that one must guess how to set due to absent instructions
text:
This is a truly gorgeous watch and it tells time. However, that is where the positives end until the wearer can figure out how to set it.

NEGATIVES

- The watch packaging is not good enough for gift giving. Mine arrived with the flimsy and junky box smashed and the watch already running even though the plastic piece on the crown was still in place.

- Instead of a user manual, a 75-page booklet in every language under the sun tells the user to go to the Timex site and search for a manual. The TW2R29100 is apparently not the correct model because the manual that comes up does not match the watch. When I looked at the specifications on the Amazon website, the model says it is TW2R291009J. However, there is no such manual on the site. Nevertheless, using the manual for TW2R29100 gave me some guidance and I was able to GUESS the rest but it took me over four days of trial and error before I GUESSED correctly.

- The manual says there is an indigo night light on this watch and that is not correct. Only the hands fluoresce in the dark.

Below are the dials and watch features not mentioned in the manual.

- There are three internal dials on the clock face in an upside-down triangle.

- The top left dial is for the day of the week (Sunday, Monday, etc.).

- The top right dial is for the day of the month (1-31).

- The bottom center dial is for AM and PM on a 24-hour clock. Therefore, if it is AM, the dial should be in the 1-12 range and for PM in the 13-24 range.

- Once the watch is set correctly, all dials move at the same time as time progresses. It only needs to be reset when there is a battery change.

The problem I needed to solve was how to get all three dials to synchronize correctly.

- To set the watch, it is important to know the three positions on the crown. The three positions are a full pullout, half pullout, and fully closed.

- When the crown is out all the way, turning CLOCKWISE moves the clock forward in time along with the values of all three dials. However, turning COUNTER CLOCKWISE turns back the time and both the AM/PM and day of month dials. The day of week dial DOES NOT move.

- When the crown is in the middle position (meaning halfway out) and turned COUNTER CLOCKWISE, it moves only the days of month forward. Turning CLOCKWISE does nothing.

- If the watch is already set correctly, just pull out the plastic on the crown and press it in to start the time. If the time is not correct, try the below.

This is the way I was able to set this watch after four days of trial and error.

Keeping the above in mind, as a test I set the time to WED the 1st at 6 p.m. by performing the following steps.

- Pull crown out all the way
- Turn dial CLOCKWISE until the day lands on Tuesday and the AM/PM is in the AM range
- Push crown in partway until it is halfway out
- Turn dial COUNTER CLOCKWISE until the day of month is 31
- Pull crown out all the way
- Turn dial CLOCKWISE until the day lands on Wednesday, the month lands on 1, and AM/PM is in the PM range, and the hands are set to 6 p.m.
- Push crown all the way in
- The watch is now set to WED the 1st at 6 p.m.

What this means is that I had to wind the watch to the day before (Tuesday) in the AM range and then set the day of month to the day prior, before I could wind the watch normally to the correct time, day of week, day of month, and PM range.

If this watch came with instructions and came in a decent gift-giving box with crush-proof packaging, I would have rated this 5 stars. When I wrote Timex for help, they said they would look for the manual for me and I have yet to receive one as it is not online. I will update the comments section of this review if the manual comes online.

In summary, this watch is gorgeous and the band is a moderately soft leather. As per the manual, it is water resistant up to 30 meters and also comes with a one-year warranty. The watch is comfortable to wear, although it is a bit large for a woman’s wrist. It is loose on my wrist and the dial fully covers the top of my wrist. The watch hands also fluoresce in the dark. It keeps excellent time and overall this watch looks better in person than pictured here. The royal blue of the clock face complements the tan band perfectly.

In the comments section of this review, I put a link to the Timex site and to the manual of the model referenced on the back of the watch label. However, that manual is practically useless and references a watch face that looks nothing like the watch here.

title: Nice bag but for such a high price I expected softer leather, a longer strap, and a zipper that closes effortlessly
text:
I love leather bags so much that I have over ten of them, including one other beautiful one by Fossil. Over the years I purchased most of my leather bags at craft shows with the average bag ranging in price from $95 to $160 (although I have paid more for several). As a result, I have a certain expectation of what a leather bag in this price range should feel like, look like, and function like.

In my opinion, I give this bag 3.4 stars. It is nice but the leather is not buttery soft.The card insert that came with the bag says it's "incredibly soft leather" and that simply is not true. Also, the zipper closure is on the sticky side--meaning it takes a little effort to close. I also would have liked the strap to be about two inches longer. When wearing this as a cross body bag, it comes above my waist even when the strap is expanded fully and I am of average weight and build. As a result of the shorter strap, this functions better as a regular shoulder bag.

On the plus side, this holds a lot of stuff. I am able to get a full half-size wallet, a heavy set of keys, my flip phone, Chapstick, eye drops, tissues, and still have room to spare for a couple more items. I also like that it has one folder-type pocket and one zippered pocket on the inside. It's fully lined and the color is a nice brown. There's also a fake key accessory which hangs off the strap loop that adds a nice touch.

I do feel this is a nice bag but it is not my favorite bag. For the current price of $146.91, I would expect buttery soft leather, a zipper that closes effortlessly, and a strap that is a tad longer than it is. Overall, this gets 3.4 stars from me. If the price were $99 or less, in its current condition, I would have given this a full 4 stars.

title: WOW, these jeans look fabulous on, feel great, are soft, move with my body, etc........LOVE THEM
text:
WOW, I really love these jeans. When I was younger I use to own over 60 pairs of jeans. The reason I had so many pairs is because they would not stretch and eventually my body would change and I'd grow out of them. I've since stopped buying jeans because of this and also because jeans tend to feel restrictive.

These stretch jeans take care of those issues. They move with the body, look GREAT on (even my boyfriend commented on how great they look), do not feel restrictive or uncomfortable after eating like jeans can, are soft, etc., etc. I ordered a size 12 because I like a looser fit. I normally take a size 10 and these are true to size. The 12 fit snugly but loosened after a few minutes so I could tell the size 10 would have been fine as well but completely snug. What's interesting is that they don't look like stretch jeans on; I suspect that was because I ordered one size larger than I normally take. They looked like the regular thick denim jeans of yesteryear on me that I so loved.

There are a total of five pockets; 2 back ones, 2 front ones with a change pocket inside the right front pocket as is typical of many jeans. I'm 5 feet 5 inches tall with abut a 32 inch inseam and these come just above my ankles. To me they are definitely boot jeans. I personally do not like wearing ankle jeans with flip flops or shoes because they remind me of the taunting of my childhood where such jeans would be called "floods." However, they would look nice even without boots; it's just not my preference.

They do wash well in cold water and dry on low without any detectable shrinkage -- at least I did not notice any shrinkage after I washed, dried, and then wore them again.

There are two negatives that I found. First, sometimes the zipper has a tendency to creep down and open. I noticed this two times only when wearing them. I would expect this if the jeans were too tight and did not fit but this was not the case. Second, the price is obviously high at the current cost of $89.50. Nevertheless, I love these jeans so much that I consider them almost non-issues. Price is what anyone is willing to pay for an item given the potential benefits. Also, periodic checks of the zipper told me it stayed up 90% of the time. The reason I'm not too bothered about the zipper issue is because I always love my shirts to come over the top of my pants so it's unlikely to be an issue for me. If the price on these jeans comes down to $49 or less, I would actually buy all their colors. This is how much I love them. However, at the current price, one pair is sufficient.

title: Great hat to keep the sun off my face & rain/drizzle off my eyeglasses; strap is useful in windy conditions; magnets have issues
text: I saw this hat at my local REI and fell in love with it but was concerned about the high price (around $48 or $50). However, after I got home from the store, I decided to buy it anyway. I bought it on AMAZON for about $3 cheaper than REI. It's soft, comfortable, and waterproof--good enough for keeping straight down drizzle off my glasses.  I love the strap for cinching it on when driving a convertible.  There are also magnets on either side so that I can easily flip the brim up for a different look. The magnets do pose one potential problem, however. If the wind is too strong, the hat lid will blow around and as a result "self-magnetize" to the sides of the hat when I don't want it to do that. Nevertheless, this problem is not one I encounter often. Overall, I love this hat.

title: The side slits and back hole are very stylish and cooling; material is see-through so base layer is needed
text:
I love the electric coral color, the fit, the side slits, and the ventilation cut-out in the back. This top fits loosely on me because I ordered one size up. It's cool for the summer, moves with me, and has an extremely comfortable fit. I also use it as a base layer underneath a heavier shirt during colder weather; however, it's more suited as an exterior garment.

I love everything about it except that it is see through. A bra is definitely needed underneath and depending on what bra or base layer is used, it will be seen through the peep hole in back. I had tried their [[ASIN:B01N1MBVI3 tank top]] and absolutely hated it because it looked so horrible on me. However, this version of the top looks great. It looked so great that I ordered two more; one in [[ASIN:B01N59DAXO black]] and one in [[ASIN:B01N6AUA30 teal]].

I wash this in a lingerie bag and hang it to dry. The garment says it can be tumble-dried on low but I never would put a thin, slinky top like this in the dryer.

title: I love the neon coral color but hate that it looks horrendous on me; it also needs a bra if wearing as a tank shirt
text:
The only thing I love about this top is the electric coral color. I like to order tops larger than I need them and picked this one because I wanted to use it as a base layer and not as workout wear as advertised. Lucky that was my purpose because a bra is definitely needed if using as an outer garment. It was loose on me as expected because I normally take a large to an extra-large.

I like that the top moves with me and fits smoothly but it looks hideous on and it's not due to the size. I do not feel the two side panels are very attractive at all and actually makes someone who is top heavy look even larger. I'm glad I'm wearing this underneath clothes. I love the color but the look is atrocious. I would never buy these because of how bad they look even though they aren't going to see the light of day.

I wash this in a lingerie bag and hang dry it. The garment says it can be tumble-dried on low but I never would put a thin, slinky top like this in the dryer.

title: This boot has a high arch support, is a bit stiff, and bit narrow but helps alleviate my plantar fasciitis pain
text:
I have plantar fasciitis and am forever changing around and buying new shoes to help with this condition. What I absolutely love about these boots is that they have a high arch support so it's a perfect fit for my high arch and this condition. I also love that these boots are a deep forest green as I have enough brown and black boots.

The insole is stiff but comfortable. These boots are also true to size but are a bit narrow. I normally take a size 9 but I decided to order a 9-1/2 and although it's a tad loose, with thick socks I don't even notice it since the foot pad area is a bit narrow. The high sides are all stiff and that took a bit getting use to. I felt as if I was getting bruised around the ankle.

Nevertheless, I wore these a couple of times already and went on one several hour walk to break them in with no ill effect to my feet. I did not have to put in any arch inserts or pads in this boots, which is unusual as practically every shoe I own has some sort of insert in it. Overall I'm satisfied with my purchase. I do wish they were not as stiff or narrow as they are but it's the arch that made it worth the purchase for me.

title: I love this umbrella's design, strength, and ease of use
text:
I'm impressed with this umbrella so far. What I love is that it is small enough to pack away. It is strong and has several more ribs that the standard umbrella making it more sturdy in the wind. Also, it can be opened and closed with the push of a button. Of course, to fully close the umbrella, I have to push the top and bottom together to "collapse" the handle, which is typical of most umbrellas of this type.

One thing I did note when I was using it is that if I press the button temporarily to collapse the umbrella, I cannot reopen from that position. I have to collapse the umbrella to its smallest size as if storing it. This may not be important to many people, but it's important to me because when commuting in New York I sometimes collapse my umbrella when walking under scaffolding. Once I exit the scaffolding, I re-open the umbrella. With this automatic umbrella, I cannot just push the button again to open it; I have to collapse it down first and then push the button to re-open.

So far, I used this once in heavy rain and it protected my upper body as most umbrellas would. I love its design (small size and extra ribs), strength, and ease of use.

I will update my review if the opening and closing mechanism fails in any way or it it does not reasonably hold up in the rain as one would expect. One time I reviewed an umbrella that worked twice and never worked again without manhandling it.

title: Wonderful tank that moves with me & provides light support; I use it as a base layer since a bra or pasties are needed otherwise
text:
I ABSOLUTELY love this top but I use it as a base layer and not as outerwear. This is see-through making it more like a camisole than outer athletic wear. Of course it can be worn as a tank but a bra is desperately needed underneath.

It is somewhat true to size without being too restrictive and is very comfortable. I normally take a large but ordered this in a medium and it is very form fitting on me. Since the cut is not very restrictive, I can get away with a smaller size. It also dries easily and keeps me warm underneath my clothes in the winter. I also detected no odor after hours of sweating. If I wore it as an outer garment in the summer, I suspect it would cool me.

This is made in Vietnam of 44.5% Patented 37.5 Polyester, 44.5% Polyester, and 11% Elastane. I machine wash this in a lingerie bag and although it can be tumbled dried on low, I prefer to air dry garments such as this.

I'm glad it doesn't have a shelf bra insert because I ordered this to use as a camisole. To me this top is 5 stars and I would order more if the price is under $25. However, because this is being marketed as outerwear I'm giving it 4 stars as a result of it being see-through. A bra is definitely needed unless one does not care about subtly exposing their chest. Of course another option is to wear pasties in front, which is what I would do if I were wearing this as an outer garment. A bra underneath takes away from the lightly form-fitting sexiness of this garment and also a bra would partially cover the breathing hole in back.

title: Comfortable, soft, warm, and waterproof snow boots; I purchased a 1/2 size up
text:
I purchased these on sale at REI for $109.93 (a little more than the Amazon price) in a size 9.5. Lucky I tried them on in the store because I am a size 9 but to me these run a bit small especially if one wants to wear thick socks. These come up to my calves, have a nice soft interior with a faux fur upper, and are supposedly waterproof (although I have not stepped in a puddle yet with these). They are also rated to keep one warm down to zero degrees Fahrenheit. They are made in Vietnam.

They are very comfortable and great when shoveling snow or even snowshoeing. I love Sorel boots because they are warm and usually waterproof. I have been buying them for years. I even talked my boyfriend into buying Sorels but he is not as enamored with the brand as I am so he only purchased one pair a long time ago which he has since thrown out. This is my fourth pair in the last 30 years. I only had one pair that ever sprung a leak which I threw out. I still have two different pairs from about 20 years ago but both have boot liners. I wanted another pair that did not have a liner because the boots with liners tend to be not as stable for walking as these are, nor are they as warm. Overall, I'm very satisfied with my purchase. .

title: Superb base layer which wicks away moisture and does not itch even though it is made of 11% merino wool
text:
I purchased six of these. Three in this color and three in the [[ASIN:B01C8DBWOY Black Mix]] color at Costco for $6.97 each one. I usually buy a size large in a base layer but since this zips up to the neck I purchased XL and I'm glad I did.

This is true to size and just a tad long but still form fitting. The neck area is snug which is why I'm glad I got an XL. It's lightweight, very soft, doesn't itch even though it's made of 11% merino wool (also 84% polyester & 5% spandex). It wicks away sweat and the fresh guard does control odor.

I use these on my long sometimes 2-hour plus walks where I sweat profusely and then go about my day until evening and this did not develop any odor. There are thumb holes in the sleeves to keep the arms from riding up and it dries fast. In addition, it supposedly protects the wearer from UV rays although there's no chance of verifying that for me because I only wear it in the winter under other clothes.

It can be machine washed in cold water on the gentle cycle and should be air dried. I put mine in a lingerie bag so that I don't have to worry about the cycle. The purple astral has a pink zipper outline and the black mix has a teal zipper outline; both of which are very attractive. There's a "Paradox" label in writing on the left sleeve and a tiny logo on the shoulder area.

When the zipper is part way down, dare I say that it looks sexy when worn. I absolutely love these and am amazed how such a thin base layer performs so many functions.

title: Soft, warm, cozy, pretty, and half the price of the almost comparable North Face Osito 2 jacket
text: I purchased this in black for $39.99 at TJX in a size large which is form fitting on me. The sides are made of stretchy material and the rest is a soft fleece. This is very similar in feel to the North Face Osito 2 jacket but is little thicker and not as warm and cozy feeling as the North Face. Since I couldn't find a North Face Osito 2 jacket in black, I chose this Columbia as a runner up. I'm very satisfied with my purchase. It keeps me warm on my evening walks. I usually wear this under a lighter jacket although it can get a bit hot after a long walk. This is definitely worth the purchase especially if you can find it at Marshalls or TJ Maxx for cheaper.

title: This vest is perfect for when I want to put another layer underneath their Osito 2 jacket or just under any other jacket
text:
I love the North Face [[ASIN:B00HV4RT98 Osito 2 Jackets]] and actually own three of them in different colors. When I found the Osito Vest on sale at TJX for $49 in white with the high rise gray sides, I bought it. I like the vest but it is not as warm or cozy as the Osito 2 jacket. The sides are a different color and made of stretchy material. The lack of arms allows me to cool down a bit and sort of allows the garment to breathe through the arm holes.

My favorite are the jackets and I would not have purchased this if it were not on sale. I can also use this to layer underneath their jacket if needed.

title: The extreme softness, relaxed fit, and warmth of this jacket is AMAZING for such a thin outer layer
text:
I own two of these jackets in different colors. I purchased one at TJX in [[ASIN:B010GS3TJO Neon Peach (which looks more like an orange coral]] in XXL and one at Marshalls in [[ASIN:B00PVBZRJM Starry Purple]] in XXXL. The jackets were $69.99 each and they are worth every penny.

To me North Face is synonymous with quality performance-wear clothing. These are my first North Face garments because I just never found items that fit me the way I liked in the electric colors I wanted. Most performance wear is form fitting and these have a relaxed fit that is very appealing to me.

I LOVE, LOVE, LOVE the extreme softness of each jacket. Even though they are thin, the polyester (fleece) is high-pile and supple. I feel extremely cozy in them. I've worn them several times already and feel warm and toasty when walking even in 35 degree weather and I was wearing one of these as my only jacket. If the temperature were lower than 35 or very windy I would wear a coat or vest over this jacket.

I am so glad this is not form fitting as the relaxed fit of this jacket design enables some air circulation to a garment that is not really breathable. I purposely chose these jackets in sizes both two and three times larger than I needed. Normally, I would buy a large to an extra large in a jacket but I wanted a looser fit. Neither garment looks over sized on me because of the cinch straps on the bottom. There's also room for me to layer garments underneath. In addition, they are also thin enough to wear underneath a winter coat.

I would actually buy two more of these if I found them in a color I liked such as this black or perhaps a teal. (I do not think it comes in that color.)

Overall, it was an expensive buy but worth every penny. I'm glad I actually discovered them cheaper at TJX and Marshalls. It was the color that attracted me to them like a hummingbird to a flower and it's the coziness that makes me want more.

I attached two pictures of the jackets. The purple is really electric and the peach is like an neon coral. The lighting in the photos can wash out the colors a little bit. Even the neon peach photo on the Amazon site looks faded and is not a good representation of the color. That is the beauty of finding these in a local store.

UPDATE Dec 13, 2016 - I bought another one of these in [[ASIN:B00L2IPX1K Green Ash]] in an XXL size at another TJX. I wanted a deeper color like the original two, but this are so wonderful that I bought what I could find in my size. I've been wearing these regularly and LOVE THEM.

title: These slippers are comfortable, sturdy, warm, and super plush inside but are ugly
text:
I needed a pair of winter slippers so I bought these in a size 9 at BJ's for $100 ($99.99 to be exact). I originally was interested in the [[ASIN:B001HX7SKE UGG Australia Women's Scuffette II Sheepskin Slipper Chestnut 9 M US]] that they were selling for 69.99. However, even though the Scuffette is a lot prettier as a slipper and more stylish, these coquette slippers have a higher sole that is better for someone like me with plantar fasciitis.

I love the chocolate color because it doesn't show dirt. The slipper is also extremely sturdy and rugged for indoor footwear. The interior is extremely plush and keeps my foot very warm. Also, the higher sole reduces the heel pain I have from plantar fasciitis. I also wear all my slippers with the [[ASIN:B00850VJVQ Strutz Cushioned Arch Supports]] to eliminate my pain completely. The fact that I can quickly slip these on and off is also a plus.

Overall, I love these. They are expensive and it was more than I wanted to pay for a slipper; however, they are cheaper than elsewhere. They are also ugly to me compared to the Scuffette but I believe this was the better purchase. If I didn't have plantar fasciitis, I would have gotten the [[ASIN:B001HX7SKE UGG Australia Women's Scuffette II Sheepskin Slipper Chestnut 9 M US]] instead because they are more pliable, not as stuff, and a lot more stylish.

I've only been wearing these a short time so if they develop problems, I will update my review. Note that the slippers I purchased at BJ's are made in Vietnam. According to the UGG website, the coquette slippers are either made in China or Vietnam.

PS I own more than 10 pairs of UGG boots, shoes, and sandals and these are my first UGG slippers. To me UGGs are high quality all the way. I have one pair of boots I have worn regularly since 2005 and they still won't wear out. The only UGG I ever wore out was an UGG driving shoe. I just live in UGGs in the winter. Of course, when it snows or rains, I won't use my outdoor UGGs.

title: Although this has slight heel and ball of foot cushioning, this is an average crew sock to me
text:
I purchased a 3-pair pack of these copper fit crew socks in both [[ASIN:B01BJNSRE2 black]] and [[ASIN:B01BJNSRAG white]] because I have been trying many socks that have cushioning in the heel. Each 3-pair pack was $9.88 at Walmart.

I have plantar fasciitis and find that wearing socks with heel cushioning in addition to using [[ASIN:B00J1FOOVQ Dr. Scholl's DreamWalk Hidden Arch Supports]] in my shoes are one of the many things that are helping reduce and even eliminate my pain. Originally, I purchased [[ASIN:B00W470PRU Thorlos Unisex Micro Mini-Crew Socks, Spearmint, Small]] because they are very cushioned; however, they are also extremely expensive.

These copper fit socks have some cushioning on both the ball and heel of the foot, but overall I'm not impressed with them. For me, it's worth buying the Thorlos over these because I found their sock to be thicker in the heel. Even if I didn't have plantar fasciitis, I still would not rave about these as they are average quality and nothing special.

title: Beautiful, comfortable, and waterproof high quality rain boots with a soft poron insole, full leather upper, and zipper side
text:
I first became familiar with Gentle Souls boots when I purchased their [[ASIN:B018RG7Q46 Gentle Souls Brooklyn 2 Women Round Toe Leather Boot]] in burgundy and feel in love with their comfort and quality. As a result, I knew I wanted another pair of Gentle Souls and reviewed their entire line of boots.

I came across these rain boots that are totally waterproof and purchased them in Saks Off Fifth for $140 ($139.99 to be exact). I absolutely love them and they kept my feet dry when I wore them in the rain. They have a side zipper so I can put them on easily and I can cinch them with the buckles on the side. They are also as comfortable as my other boots, are made of a soft leather, and look and feel much better than those plastic rain boots that are all the rage these days.

The poron insole (which is so cushy and soft) has a slight bump for arch support. I have plantar fasciitis and a shoe with arch support and a little bit of a heel helps tremendously. However, because these are rain boots and they don't fit as snug as their Brooklyn 2 boot I purchased, I did add the [[ASIN:B00J1FOOVQ Dr. Scholl's DreamWalk Hidden Arch Supports]] and [[ASIN:B0039NN19C Dr. Scholl's Massaging Gel Heel Cushions Men's 8-13]] to give me a little more support.

In addition to walking over two miles in these the first time I wore them, I also wore them all day in the rain and felt they were very comfortable for rain boots and they kept my feet dry. I did not expect these boots to be that comfortable and I love them. In fact, my girlfriend who was with me kept saying how beautiful the boots looked and how soft the leather felt. She would have ordered a pair but she wants an even wider more boxy toe box even though I certainly think these are wide enough.

I now have two pairs of Gentle Souls and am extremely satisfied.

title: Expensive crew sock but the cushioned heel helps soften my step and reduces my plantar fasciitis pain
text:
I purchased one pair in a size small for my size 9 foot because I wanted a sock that had heel cushioning. This crew sock is cushioned in both the heel and ball of the foot and really feels great during my 2-mile walks.

I have plantar fasciitis in my right foot and have been purchasing all sorts of inserts, socks, braces, etc. after going to the doctor and physical therapy didn't work. Besides the daily stretches I do and the compression socks and arch supports I wear to bed, I find that a combination of [[ASIN:B01BODZEY8 Dr. Scholl's DreamWalk Hidden Arch Supports]] and [[ASIN:B0039NN19C Dr. Scholl's Massaging Gel Heel Cushions for men]] in a supportive shoe works better than 3/4 or full inserts with arch. However, putting in anything more than a tiny arch insert into a shoe sometimes makes the footwear tighter or brings the heel up high enough to give me heel sores. It is in these cases, that socks like this that have a cushioned heel take the place of a heel insert. These work great for me and I would have rated them 5 stars if they weren't so expensive. I also love the spearmint color.

I purchased these on Amazon for $13.95 because in one of the sporting goods stores near me they were $14.99 per pair. If they were $7 or less I would have purchased more than one pair.

UPDATE Oct 22, 2016 - I found several other colors of these crew socks at Marshall's today for $6.99 each and bought four more pairs since these are so comfortable.

title: Nice shirt that is too thin for a flannel and shrinks about a half size after washing as instructed
text:
I love flannel shirts and especially ones for men since they are usually larger and oversized. This fits as I expected it to and is true to size when unwashed. I also had my boyfriend try it on even though I got this for me. He liked it but both he and I feel it is very thin for a flannel shirt.

It's made of 100% cotton in Bangladesh and should be washed in water no hotter than 40 degrees Celsius (104 F) which I consider warm. It can be tumble dried on medium and ironed on medium as well.

After wearing this for a while and washing and drying it, my take is that this is cheaply made as a flannel shirt, especially for the current price of $18 which I consider way too expensive. I washed it in my LG machine on warm and tumble dried on medium and it did shrink about a 1/2 size. Since it was oversized for me, the shrinkage was okay but it would not be for anyone else. It did not wrinkle very much in the dryer and the color did not fade or bleed onto the white cloth I washed it with.

In summary, I feel there are better flannel shirts on the market. I like it but would not be inspired to purchase this due to the price / value relationship.

title: These are light, comfortable, and have a nice heel; I needed to add an arch insert to make these work for me
text: I take between a size 8-1/2 and size 9 shoe. I ordered these in a size 9 because I needed to put an arch insert (specifically the [[ASIN:B01BODZEY8 Dr. Scholl's DreamWalk Hidden Arch Supports]]) into this sneaker since I have plantar fasciitis. The gel insoles of these sneakers are comfortable, the shoes are light, and the height of the heel are perfect for me with the arch support I added. I am very happy with my purchase. These sneakers are on the stiffer side compared to some other Skechers I own but that stiffness provides me with a little bit more support. In fact, I liked these so much that I ordered another pair of the D'Lites (specifically [[ASIN:B00T7D8BKM Skechers Sport Women's D'Lites Gold Dust Fashion Sneaker, Gold/Multi, 9 M US]]).

title: Beautifully designed shirt that can be worn by a man, woman, or child
text:
I purchased this in large at a Bershire store near me for $20.90 because I love tie dye and the cute and colorful bears on the shirt caught my eye. I did not understand how this was in the man's section of the store but when searching on Amazon, I discovered it's a Greatful Dead shirt. I had no idea. My friends think it's a kid shirt.

I washed this and it only shrunk a little and not enough for me to care. Overall, I love the design and color and am unconcerned that this stands for a rock band I know nothing about.

title: Exquisitely designed "tree of life" checkbook cover
text:
This checkbook cover is beautiful. It serves one purpose only and that is to hold a checkbook register and the associated standard-sized checks with deposit slips. There's no room for anything else, although I could slip a $20 bill behind the register or checks. Anything additional would make this impossible to close.

I am extremely pleased with this purchase. It's made of good quality leather and the design is exquisite.

title: Gorgeous boots that I find very comfortable as long as I put in an arch insert
text:
I love these boots. They look great with jeans or leggings. I purchased these for a $160 at my local mall. Although they don't have arch support, I use an insert to provide that. There are only two negatives I see with these boots. First, they can get real "staticky" and second I found it hard to tell the right foot from the left. When I first tried them on in the store, I put each boot on the wrong foott. Other than this, the cobalt blue is beautiful and I find them to be comfortable as long as I put in an arch insert for my high-arched feet.

Personally I always prefer UGG boots over Bearpaw for comfort but Bearpaw boots have a bit more style, flare, and beauty. I did not realize these were made of real fur but according to the tag on the boots, the fur is real sheep fur from China which is bleached and dyed. The boot has a wool lining and the manufacturer is Romeo and Juliette.

title: This light pink heart ring looks stunning on me and glitters
text:
This light pink heart ring looks stunning on me. It also glitters on my finger. The inside inscription reads "love you." The heart is a clear light pink and there are two simulated "diamonds" on each side.

It comes packaged in a sturdy black box with black interior. The box is made in China but once I removed the "China" sticker, the box and ring together looked more expensive than it is.

title: Roomy and attractive pants with lots of flair and color and which look great paired with a white or cream blouse
text:
I ordered these in large in the [[ASIN:B00J3B0NY0 coral]], [[ASIN:B00J3B0RZ0 royal blue]]. and [[ASIN:B00J3B0LQU mint]] colors and I love them. They are comfortable, expand or contract as necessary, and look great when paired with a plain white or cream blouse.

The large is pretty much true to size leaning toward a bit roomy. I would have loved to have wear pants like these in my ballroom dancing days.

title: They run a size small, especially for someone with large hips, but they are very comfortable despite this
text:
I usually take a size 10 but these appear to run a size small. I’m lucky they were stretch so that I could squeeze into them. Once on, the leg size was perfect.
