I had trouble getting it over my hips and it’s a bit snug around the waist. Nevertheless, even though these are on the smaller side, they feel so comfortable on. I wore them all day without feeling restricted in any way.

FACTS

- Two side front pockets

- One back pocket on right side

- Stretch material

- 96% cotton

- 4% spandex

- Made in Kenya

- Size 10 regular comes down to bottom of my heel on my 5’ 5” height.

- The waistband is thick (meaning 2 inches in height).

- The dark color shows lint terribly; I have cats and started to look like a walking fur cushion by the end of the day.

- There’s a tiny red Dickies label on the back pocket. Personally, I never like this but my blouse falls over the pants covering this unsightly tag.

- They also wash well in cold water with non-chlorine bleach (if needed), can be tumble dried on low, and ironed on a medium setting. I washed these with soap only and tumble dried on low with a dryer sheet. I did not need to iron them and they did not shrink.

These are the type of pants I would wear in cooler weather.

In summary, I feel they run a size smaller than expected but are very comfortable and are also perfect as work pants with a nice blouse.

title: Mid-sized casual backpack that offers enough room and pockets to be extremely functional but the straps need padding
text:
I have two other Baggallini shoulder bags that I purchased years ago. They are known for their many pockets, good quality, and casual design. This mid-sized backpack is similar and offers enough room and pockets to be extremely functional. My only disappointment is that the straps are not padded.

What I love:
- It’s lightweight and water resistant
- The deep grass color (looks like a Jaguar British Racing Green) of the exterior is attractive.
- The pink zippers give it some colorful pizzazz.
- There are 11 pockets besides the main backpack opening itself--see THE POCKETS section below.
- All the zippers open and close fluidly.
- The straps are adjustable.
- The carrying handle is sturdy and securely fastened to the bag.

What I really dislike:
- The straps are made of a thin cloth that is uncomfortable even when the backpack is not full.

THE POCKETS:
- There are 2 water bottle pockets that snugly fit my standard-sized water bottles
- There are two zippered slanted outside pockets that can be used for a cell phone, tissues, lip gloss, and other small incidentals.
- There’s an outside cinch pocket that easily fits a 7” Nexus tablet, a steno notebook, or small book.
- Between the handle and the cinch pocket is another pocket that will also fit a 7” Nexus tablet and other odds and ends like a medium-sized book. This pocket is limited by the fact that the covering for it is sewn into the handle. Therefore, there’s only a 6” gap on either side into which things can be slipped into the space.
- The zippered backpack opens into its largest compartment that can fit many personal belongings including my 15” laptop.
- There’s an inside zippered pouch that is removable and is also large enough to fit my 7” Nexus tablet with a couple of inches to spare.
- There’s an inside zippered pocket that runs along the length of the bag and which fits my pocket calendar and other odds and ends.
- There’s one see-through mesh screen divided into three pockets. Two pockets are large enough for a small cell phone and one pocket is for a pencil or pen.

In summary, this definitely looks and functions like a backpack but it is mid-sized (smaller than a standard backpack) with enough space to be incredibly functional. The style is casual and fun. I would have given this five stars if it were not for the lousy cloth straps that cut into my shoulders. They need to pad those to make the pack more comfortable.

title: Comfortable shorts with a tiny bit of stretch that I find so comfortable to wear
text:
Surprisingly, I really like these. They are true to size and have a tiny bit of stretch just in case. They are also so incredibly comfortable. There are two front and two rear pockets and the pant cuffs can be unrolled for a longer look. Personally, I like the cuffs. It came with a very thin and flimsy pink belt with embroidered design that I don't like. The belt is too cheap so I wear the shorts without that because I wear my shirts outside my pants.

These also wash well in cold water. Non-chlorine bleach is okay but I don't use that. They don't shrink if tumble dried on low. These are made in Lesotho (which is apparently in Southern Africa according to my Google search). They are 76% cotton, 23% polyester, and 1% spandex. At the current price of $16.98, I think these are a good deal even with the thin "breakable" belt.

title: These are light, roomy, and super comfortable; they also feel, wear, and wash like Polyester
text:
I usually take a size 10 and select pants that are large when no numerical sizes are listed. However, these run a little larger than expected, but the fit is super comfortable. The length is excellent too as they come just above heel on my 5'5" frame.

There's a barely noticeable zippered pocket on the back right side of the pants which I would not use for anything more than a dollar bill because it would create an unsightly bulge.

These pants expand (stretch) comfortably and the waistband is not restricting. They also wash well. According to the label, these are 75% polyester, 24% rayon, and 4% spandex and are made in Kenya. They can be machine washed in cold water with non-chlorine bleach (if needed), tumble dried on low, and ironed on a medium setting. I washed these with soap only and tumble dried on low with a dryer sheet. I did not need to iron them and they did not shrink.

Although these are thin, I prefer to wear them in cooler weather. They obviously feel like polyester which personally I'm not crazy about wearing in warm weather. When they were advertised as knit, I did not realize they were polyester. The dark color will hide stains but will show pet hair easily.

These pants have a bright pink Dickies label sewn on the outside of the waistband. Since I wear my shirt outside my pants, this is not an issue for me; however, for those who tuck their shirts in, I feel the label is unattractive and cheapens the look.

Nevertheless, these are very comfortable, very roomy, and do not shrink after washing. They are also perfect as work pants with a nice blouse.

UPDATE: I also have these pants in black in extra large. The extra large is way too large for my size 10 body. Also, the Dickies label on the outside of the black pair is in red instead of pink.

title: This Monarch Cypress lined microfiber robe is thick, super soft, and feels luxurious to me
text:
My local hospital had provided the a Monarch/Cypress Unisex Chamois Microfiber Kimono Robe in white and I was so impressed with the quality of it that I contacted the company and ordered two robes. I ordered the [[ASIN:B014V9REUE Monarch/Cypress Unisex Chamois Microfiber Kimono Robe]] in charcoal and this lined one in white.

I use the thin charcoal robe in the summer and this lined white one for when I want a little extra warmth or plushness. This robe is so super luxurious and much better than any of my terry robes. The super soft lining combined with the soft outer shell makes me feel supremely comfortable and pampered.

They run on the large side which is the way I like it. The large fits like an extra-large and feels roomy. For me, this robe is worth the price.

title: This Monarch Cypress chamois microfiber robe is light, super soft, and feels luxurious to me
text: My local hospital had this type gown in white (not the charcoal I ordered) and I was so impressed with the quality of it that I contacted the company and ordered two robes. I ordered this one in charcoal and the [[ASIN:B00GJAV8YW Monarch/Cypress Unisex Plush Lined Microfiber Robe Large, in White]].  I  use this charcoal robe in the summer and the lined white one for when I want a little extra warmth or plushness. These robes are more luxurious than my terry robes in the sense that this chamois robe is a lot softer even though it's thinner than my terry robes. They run on the large side which is the way I like it. The large fits like an extra-large and feels roomy to me.

title: These look and feel like a stretch pair of jeans, are so comfortable, and wear and wash well
text:
I wear a size 10 average but chose a size 12 average because others were saying these pants run small and indeed they do. The size 12 fits me snugly, is comfortable, and is the right length for my 5'5" height falling to about 1/4" above my heel. They feel nice and look crisp and clean. They also wash well in cold water and tumble dry on low without any shrinkage. However, these pants do look very much like a pair of stretch jeans.

These are made in Mexico and are 79% cotton, 20% polyester, 1% spandex. Since these are very dark denim, they show lint easily, especially pet hair.

I wore these pants several times already and they feel great on. Since they are made of stretch material, they expand without being too constricting and they do not restrict movement. They have 2 front pockets, 2 fake pockets in the back, a 2-inch elastic waist band, and a 3/4" hem that is barely noticeable.

I machine washed these in cold water in a High Efficiency (HE) machine. I also added some white garments to the washer to see if the color bled. In my LG HE machine, which uses less water than a standard machine, I had absolutely no color bleeding. However, I recommend washing with like colors just to be safe. Although non-chlorine bleach can be used, I did not use that. I tried “hang-drying” them but they take too long too dry (about a day), so I decided to tumble dry them on low. I did not feel they needed to be ironed after the tumble dry as they were barely wrinkled. Had I air dried them, they would have needed ironing. They also did not shrink at all.

To me these are five stars since there’s no fading, no shrinkage, and they feel comfortable and look like new after washing. At the current price of $18.99, I also feel they are competitively priced. The only reason I rated these four stars is because the title of “Chic Classic Collection Women's Easy Fit Elastic Waist Pull On Pant, Dark Shade” does not make it clear that these look exactly like stretch jeans / dark denim. Based on the title, I thought these were suitable as casual work pants and that is not so. Other than this, I love them. If I had super large unsightly bulges in the stomach or rear, then these jeans would not be flattering because of the thick waistband. Luckily, they work for my moderately full-figured shape.

title: The garnet in the center of this ring's love knot really pops
text:
This is a very attractive ring and one that looks nice on me. It is substantial (meaning not too dainty) enough to display well on any finger except for maybe the thumb. The garnet really pops in the center of the love knot. The love knot also looks like it is made of diamonds but it is actually a pattern around the ring that reminds me of paw prints. For costume jewelry this is a pretty ring at a reasonable price.

It comes in a nice black and blue box as shown in the photo. A removable label on the underside of the box says "made in China."

title: This ring would complement elegant evening wear and look best on slender and young-looking fingers
text:
This is a very dainty and attractive ring. Since I am a middle-aged woman, I would prefer something more substantial. I feel due to its thinness, that it is more suited to someone with slender and young fingers (meaning fewer wrinkles). Although this looks nice on me, it is a bit too thin for my aging and dry hands and gets a little lost on my ring finger. However, that does not take away from its attractiveness.

It comes in a nice black and blue box as shown in the photo. A removable label on the underside of the box says "made in China." For costume jewelry this is a pretty ring at a reasonable price.

title: Soft, supple, all leather quality men's wallet with a flip out clear-windowed section for two IDs
text:
This is a bifold wallet with a flip out two-picture ID "envelope" and eight ID inserts as well as one bill fold. The leather is soft and smells like a recently shined paired of leather shoes in a nice chocolate brown color.

My boyfriend absolutely loves this wallet. He particularly loves the color and the flip out section that contains two picture ID windows covered by clear plastic. His previous Levi's wallet had the ID section covered in mesh. The only other difference between this wallet and the one he had was that there was a separate zippered compartment in the bill fold of the Levi that this one does not have.

It is thin, yet soft and supple. This wallet, because of it's thinness does not feel as sturdy to me as the other men's fossil wallets my boyfriend purchased in the past but he loves it. It gets 4.5 stars from me and 5 stars from my boyfriend. It certainly feels like quality.

title: I can put my shoes on standing up;  sturdy; will last a lifetime; an absolutely worthwhile purchase
text:
For years I've been looking for a shoe horn I could use from a standing position that was not plastic. I'm 5' 5" tall and this shoe horn enables me to put on my shoes standing up with only a slight bend in the knee and torso. It's heavy at 13 ounces (weighed on my food scale) and just 3 inches shy of 2 feet long. I love the three gripping ridges on the underside of the handle as well as the hanging loop. This is sturdy and will outlive me. It will probably be the last shoe horn I'll ever own. It was worth the $32.09 purchase ($29.99 plus tax) to me.

UPDATE June 18, 2020 - I've been using this 21" shoe horn regularly and loved it so much that I ordered the [[ASIN:B07VVTNNFQ 26" one]]. In fact, the longer version is much better for me because I do not have to bend down at all. The extra 5" does make an absolute difference. Had I known that, I would have ordered the 26" only. These are great shoe horns and sturdy. I have another metal one by a different vendor and that bent but these have not.

title: This bracelet is stunning and delicate and complements evening wear
text:
I'm impressed with this Rhodium Plated Sterling Silver Cubic Zirconia Cluster Marquise Tennis Bracelet. It sparkles in my eyes.

This is sized for an average wrist at 7-1/4 inches in length. It fit me perfectly. I particularly love the clasp which took me a minute to figure out. The clasp has to be "flipped" opened from both sides and then the center “knob” must be pressed down to pull it apart. I found it both easy to secure on my wrist with one hand and easy to remove as well.

It comes packaged in a sturdy black box with blue interior that holds another sturdy black box containing the jewelry in a plastic zip bag. Although the box is pretty, it would look more presentable if it were secured in the type of box watches come in that have a hard band upon which the jewelry can be wrapped around. There is no way to secure this bracelet in the current box without the plastic bag or some pins, so it flops around inside.

I feel the current purchase price of $40.67 is reasonable even though it is made in China.

Time will tell if this will last with regular use. I'll be sure to update my review if there are any changes but so far I'm extremely pleased.

title: This bracelet looks expensive, is stunning, dainty, and perfect for an evening out
text:
I'm impressed with this white/black pearl bracelet and did not think I would be. This cultured pearl wrist wrap comes packaged in a sturdy black box with blue interior that holds another sturdy black box containing the bracelet. It's a very nice presentation.

This jewelry is dainty and perfect for evening wear or business attire. The silver mesh wrap is stunning as are the pearl settings. The dyed black pearl is more of a deep gray black than onyx black but it complements the white pearl nicely. The wrap is also easy to affix on the wrist. I was able to stretch it open with one hand and then secure it on my opposing wrist so it snapped in place.

Had I purchased this at the current price of $50.97, I would have felt I got a good deal even though it is made in China. If giving this as a gift, I would remove the "China tag" that is affixed to the wrap and the bottom of the inside box.

Time will tell if this will last with regular use. I'll be sure to update my review if there are any changes but so far I'm extremely pleased.

title: Warm, rugged, heavy, and roomy pants in a nice caramel color and good for women too
text:
I purchased men's fleece and flannel lined pants years ago. I love them for their warmth,. ruggedness, and the roominess of the cut. I have a pair of thick fleece lined jeans by Alaska Bay Outfitters and a pair of Carhartt flannel lined jeans. Since I can no longer fit in either pair, I wanted to try these Wrangler pants.

These pants have the usual two slit pockets in front and two pockets in back. There's a hammer loop on the left to hang a hammer, axe, mallet, or even hook on something. There are also two slender pockets in different sizes on top of each other over the right pant leg for holding additional tools, collapsible rulers, etc.

Although the fleece lining is thin (much thinner than my Alaska Bay pair), they are still heavy. Based on the way they fit me and my boyfriend, they are definitely true to size. I had my boyfriend try them on and they look great on him.

Because lined pants are heavier that regular pants, they can throw off a top load washing machine with agitator during the wash cycle. I tend to put them at the bottom of the basket when washing them. Be sure to wash in cold water and I recommend following the label that says to air dry or tumble dry on low.

For those who want thicker fleece lined pants search out Alaska Bay Outfitters or Carhartt but they'll cost lot more for those. In addition to being a sturdy and warm pair of pants, I think these Wranglers are a bargain for the current price of $29.99.

title: Stunning amber colored earrings for an elegant night out
text:
These "18k Gold Plated Sterling Silver Two-Tone Cushion Shape Orange Sapphire Lever Back Dangle Earrings" are gorgeous. The picture does not do it justice.

They look nice on and only dangle about 1-1/2 inch below the ears. These are the type of earrings that can be worn for an elegant evening out.

I expected the color of the earrings to be like the orange fruit but they are not that light. To me they are a gorgeous amber / copper color.

The reverse side of the earrings are hollow. The clasp is a lever that opens and closes and is easy to insert.

They are made in China. Although Amazon has not posted a price for this product, I would consider between $30 and $35 to be a fair price.

title: My boyfriend loves these wonderful silk pajama pants
text:
I selected this for my boyfriend. He is around 190 pounds and 5 feet 11 inches tall and wears the large size very comfortably. The fit is pure perfection. The pajama pant drapes on my boyfriend the way it is shown on the fellow in the Amazon picture.

It has two side slit pockets and an opening in front secured with one center button. An extra button is provided in case that one falls off and gets lost. The waist is elasticized with a tie in front that can be cinched or left untied without the risk of the pants falling down.

The silk is satiny feeling, soft, and cool to the touch; overall this "lingerie" is just wonderful.

Although it says to hand wash only in cold water, I washed the pants in cold water with Tide in a washer while inside a lingerie bag. I then hung them to dry. The pants, although a bit wrinkled after coming out of the washer, looked as good as new. I feel very few people will hand wash this but using a lingerie bag in the washing machine is a good compromise.

In addition, 100% of the NET PROFITS from these pants go to the Geoffrey Beene, LLC fund. On their website, it says describes the fund by saying --> "All net profits from Geoffrey Beene, LLC together with the Geoffrey Beene Foundation fund philanthropic causes that support initial-stage, out-of-the-box revolutionary research for treatments and prevention across all cancers as well as awareness and research for Alzheimer's, heart disease, scholarships, programs for veterans, protection of women and children and protection of animals."

In summary, he loves this pajama pant. Although it is expensive because it is 100% silk (made in China), the quality, style, and fit are great.

title: Umbrella failed on 3rd use; it won't auto open or close; it's highly unreliable
text:
SEE BUYER BEWARE section at the end. UPDATED review posted at the end.

This umbrella is heavy at 1.22 pounds according to my food scale. I'm impressed with how it sheds water and that opening and closing the umbrella is as easy as the press of a button. However, collapsing it to put it in its fabric case requires a bit of strength when pressing the top and bottom together with both arms. This is not the kind of umbrella I'd give to someone who is frail.

I'm actually surprised that the umbrella comes with a lifetime warranty for normal use and freedom from defects and workmanship. Of course, if this is stored wet, the warranty states the frame could rust. Nevertheless, to get the warranty, it would have to be mailed into to the company in Oregon at the cost of postage. Although the company is in Oregon, this product is made in China.

Below are the PROS and CONS from my perspective.

PROS

- This is medium size for easy carrying and has a full handle which is nice.

- It opens and closes with the touch of a button. I did have it stick once on the automatic close but I just had to press the button again to get it to work.

- The Teflon fabric protector protects from stains not that that matters on a black umbrella. I believe this is what also allows the rain to just run off the fabric.

- When expanded it is full-sized but not super-large like a golf umbrella.

- This comes with a lifetime warranty

- The company has been in business since 1947.

- The fabric includes Scotchlite reflective material which enhances visibility at night and with low light. I have yet to observe this. Apparently, the Scotchlite material "returns light back to a light source such as vehicle headlights creating an image that motorists are more likely to see from a distance."

CONS

- This umbrella is heavy at 1.22 pounds. It appears most of the weight is in the handle. Also, the handle is a bit big (wide).

- Collapsing the umbrella into its small size after it's automatically closed requires a bit of strength with both arms pushing together.

- It's unclear if this umbrella is a good value as the product and its cost (as of May 10, 2015) is not listed on Amazon.

In summary, I really like this umbrella. I consider this the 2nd best of 5 umbrellas I currently own (including this one). My favorite umbrella is a Windbrella collapsible that I purchased at a flea market for $15. That one is my favorite only because it's very large like a golf umbrella, is just a little bigger than this one when collapsed, and is not as heavy. However, since I can't get that particular Windbrella anymore, I would consider purchasing this if the price were right (like under $40). I'm waiting for a good windswept rainstorm here to test this out further. I will update my review with the results when we have such weather.

BUYER BEWARE - This review is for the umbrella with ASIN:B00UBNL4EW that has a thick RED handle and not ASIN:B00UBNL97O (which is where this review is showing). I've tried for over a week to get Amazon to rectify this issue and have been unsuccessful. Therefore, until Amazon corrects the product page be careful that you are ordering the same umbrella that has been reviewed by the Vine Reviewers. Personally, I could not find this umbrella on the Amazon site as of this post. A link to the Amazon picture of the umbrella VINE reviewers received is in the comments section of this review. Just copy the link to your browser to view it.

UPDATE May 16, 2015 - The umbrella worked until my 3rd use when it failed to open and close. The button got completely stuck and my boyfriend even tried it. Although, it has a lifetime warranty, I refuse to pay to have it returned only to get a replacement umbrella that will probably fail. We decided to unscrew the handle to see if we can figure out how to make it work; but the handle won't even come off when the screw is removed even when trying to pry it off. I see another reviewer had the same problem opening his umbrella except his never worked right. He used a hammer so we decided to try that. We got it to open and close once; then it got stuck. After trying for 10 more minutes, we got it to open and close one more time and then it stuck. My boyfriend finally figured out how to get this to work but it requires effort and is unreliable. First we used all our strength to push the umbrella toward the handle while pressing the button down at the same time. Once the button depresses, we safely pointed the umbrella in the direction we wanted to open it. This usually works. My boyfriend's recommendation to me is carry a spare umbrella with me because this is so unreliable. Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this particular umbrella.

title: Excellent backpack for carrying my laptop and purse to work
text:
I see others selected this for their children; however, I selected this for me to use. So far I'm very impressed with this backpack. It holds everything I need to bring to work including a book, my purse, and my laptop with an external mouse and other incidentals. There's also room from two water bottles in the side pockets. The shoulder straps are padded for a softer feel on my shoulders.

It has three full-sized zippered compartments; one is padded for my laptop (there's also a separate smaller padded one for a tablet), another for my purse, and the outermost pocket for my incidentals. There's also a tiny zippered pocket on the top where I store my bus tickets and ID. What I also love is the looped ribbon in the center of the backpack where I can clip on my four bike lights similar to the [[ASIN:B00SSQGKUM LED Safety Light (2-Pack) | Clip On Strobe Lights | High Visibility for Runners, Dogs, Walking, Bikes at Day/Night ]]. In the summer I walk on a lonely road for about one hour per day (30 minutes in early morning and 30 minutes in the evening) and having the ability to clip on my bike lights to this backpack increases my visibility to cars.

Besides the pockets, I also love the color which looks more like a deep teal (or deep blue depending on the lighting) with fluorescent lime green trim. It is too soon to tell of the longevity of this backpack; however, I will update my review if I encounter any problems with it. It does come with a limited 3-year global warranty for manufacturing defects and workmanship. I'll be using this four to five days per week.

UPDATE March 19, 2015 - I'm really loving this backpack. The padding on the lumbar region, the lats (latissimus dorsi muscle in the back), and the shoulders makes this very comfortable for me to carry on my back. So far I'm extremely pleased. I can't believe I actually paid $89 for a laptop backpack several years ago that is no better than this.

title: Trousers that are true to size and do not wrinkle
text:
I wore these to work. They were comfortable and have large front pockets. They also resist wrinkles which is very nice. I washed them and dried them on permanent press (although label says low). I removed them from the dryer immediately and they came out looking new without any wrinkles.

What I did notice is that there are only 5 belt loops on the pants but only 1 of them is in the back. I feel it needs two more belt loops in the back so that the pant waist does not ride under the belt.

According to the label, this is made of premium ring spun fabric for added strength and comfort. It also has dual action stain repellent and stain release. I did not get any stains on me so I can't tell you how well that is. It also says it has a tapered leg (slim fit). I did not find this to be the case. Tapered to me means the pant leg narrows as the fabric gets closer to the ankle. I personally do not like tapered nor do I consider these tapered. The pants seem to be an average type cut, which was nice.

There are 4 pant pockets in total. There are 2 large front pockets whereby I can sink my arms in up to my forearms and 2 back pockets of standard size that can fit a man's or woman's half-wallet. I really love the front pockets. These pants are also true to size. I've worn this size before.

In summary, outside of the need for 2 more belt loops, the only other thing I didn't like was the polyester feel. The reason is that it feels more plastic like and is on the warm side. I looked at the label and the pants are made of 65% cotton and 35% recycled polyester. The paper label that came with the pants, says Repreve fiber contains recycled materials including plastic bottles. Other than this, they are a nice pair of pants and they wash well with no ironing required.

UPDATE: My boyfriend and I are the same size and he tried these pants. He does not like that there is only one belt loop in the back but he said the waistband did not go outside of the belt when he bent down while wearing a belt. He did not care for the polyester feel but overall he thinks these trousers are fine. He definitely likes the large front pockets. He rates these khaki's 4 stars; if it did not have the polyester feel he would have rated these 5 stars.

title: Large, easy-to-read face and backlight
text:
I love this watch. I purchased this on a whim on Amazon's "Today's Deals." What I love is:

- The large face is easy to read.
- The face acts as both the 12 hour and 24-hour clock.
- The watch band has a nice "fire-engine red" thick nylon strap that buckles easily.
- The face lights up when the winding dial is pushed as a result of its Indiglo night-light.
- This Timex feels like a a good quality watch and feels very sturdy when winding.

It is a large watch which would more typically be found on a man but a woman can wear it too. What promoted me to purchase this was the 24-hour dial. There is nothing I don't like about this Timex. It's a perfect casual watch.

title: Pretty-faced watch with a contradictory style
text:
This Invicta Women's watch has an interesting style. The big face is the size of a 50-cent coin or slightly larger. The dial is surrounded by "crystals" and is very easy to read. The "crystals" give the face of the watch a look that would normally be found on a smaller-sized elegant watch. However, the rest of the watch is very sporty and the band is made of very cheap feeling navy blue plastic.

I like that the watch is very sporty and the color goes exceptionally well with blue jeans. I love that the dial is also very easy to read. It is easy to set the time by pulling out the crown fully. To set the date, I just pull out the crown 1/2 way. According to the underside of the watch it is also water resistant up to 30 meters, although I did not test that as water resistant is not the same as waterproof.

The instructions supplied are for many Invicta watches (the quartz, automatic, and manual watches) of many different types (watches with chronographs or ones with just time and date, etc.). As a result, this made reading the instructions very confusing and a little bit of a treasure hunt to find the information I wanted. This one is a quartz watch but I could not find anywhere in the instructions what type of battery it takes nor how to get the watch band links off.

There are two things I dislike immensely about this watch besides the fact that it has a big face that is more of a style for a man than a woman. First, the band feels like it's made of dollar store plastic. Second, the band is way too long. I used an eyeglass screwdriver to loosen the first pin on the watch so that I could move the band down inside the clasp as far as it would go; however, the watch is still too big on my wrist and I have what I consider a normal-sized wrist. I'm going to have to take this to a jewelers to remove about 2 more links. I think I would have to have about 4 links removed if I wasn't able to move the first pin to a lower position inside the clasp (similar to the way you would move a belt).

I really think the manufacturer should reduce the links by 2 and supply an extra set of 2 links in the package so that someone who is extremely oversized could have them added on. I think most women would have to go to the watchmaker to remove links rather than add them which adds on to the cost of the watch. Also, if they supplied instructions on how to adjust the links to inside the clasp (like I guessed how to do) it would help most women from having to make any trip to the jewelers at all.

In summary, I love that the face is very easy to read and I find this to be a sporty watch that goes well with jeans. However, I feel the band is a little too cheap feeling for the current posted price of $79.00. If I had purchased this watch, I would feel I paid too much at that price. Personally, with the large band and cheap plastic, I wouldn't pay more than $30 for this watch and even at that price it's a lot.

December 26, 2011 Update - I had a jeweler remove 4 links today at a cost to me of $8. The jeweler also undid my handiwork of moving the links down into the clasp.

January 4, 2012 Update - I've been wearing this for a week and sometimes the band comes undone because the clasp isn't very strong. This is another disappointment. I also showed a colleague of mine this watch and she said the Invicta watches have a good name. However, she was very surprised at how this watch resembled junk or something a kid would purchase. She said she probably wouldn't pay more than $20 for it as it looks like a street vendor watch. However, she did say that it looked pretty from a distance and the band is a nice color blue; both of which I agree with wholeheartedly.

January 12, 2012 Update - I lowered my review from 3 to 2 stars because this watch has too many negatives such as the cheap band, high price listed, wide face, and now the winding screw on the watch has been pinching my wrist. When I bend my wrist the face of the watch is so large that the screw digs in and pinches the skin on the upper part of my hand. On another note, I also showed another colleague of mine this watch and she said she wouldn't even pay $5 for it. In her words, "It's just junk."

UPDATE July 2, 2014 - After 2-1/2 years, this watch broke. The watch has a new battery but it is not keeping time accurately and the second-hand fell off so that now it's floating in the watch. Since I never cared for the cheapness of this watch, I personally do not feel it's worth fixing.

title: HG
text: CK Invisibles has become my holy grail for pretty much all work outfits. I love how the bra's seams just blend into my figure and there aren't any bra lines through my blouses. Also, the scoop neck bras can be worn under button-up blouses with a deep, skinny V and look like I'm wearing a camisole underneath. They'll never know! This was my 5th CK invisibles purchase; after a year of alternating through 4 beige pieces with different necklines, I got a black. 36C erring toward 38B and a large fits like a dream.

title: Hubby loves
text: These make my husband look sexy and he likes how they fit and feel. We got two colors.

title: Hallelujah, a push-up that fits! Thank you for extended sizing!!!
text: This is my new favorite push-up bra. I've always struggled with finding a push-up that didn't gap in the cups. I have a really wide rib cage. I always thought it was because I was overweight, but now, I've lost weight and cups were still gapping. 36C has been fitting me well lately for regular bra styles but I started doing research on how push-ups could fit me better and I wondered about trying a 38A or 40A. This 38A is the perfect push-up for me. When I bend over, the cups are actually full. If anyone else struggles with a wide rib cage or smallish-boobs-far-apart syndrome, I really recommend this bra. I sent two other brands of 38A push-ups back for being too large in the cups.

title: Wait... what? $15???? The best bra ever
text:
This is the best bra I have ever worn. Mic drop. I've tried on a lot of bras. I've done two Prime Wardrobe bra orders in the past few years. I remember trying on different brands of bras in mall stores as a teenager. My go-to had been Maidenform bras for years until they discontinued the style I liked. Side by side, this Amazon bra is so much better than the Maidenform bras I have currently. The weight of the material, the feel of the material, the comfort, and the fit are all incredible. The only competition this has for holding my girls is the Calvin Klein invisibles bralettes, which work better with fitted high-rise shirts.
5' 4", 140 lb, 36C. I have a wide rib cage and depending on the brand and bra style I also wear 38B or 38A.

title: Price, sizing, and style on point
text: I did a lot of searching for a water resistant Chelsea boot. After considering boots priced thrice as much as these Thursdays, I did go with this one. They are incredibly sleek and stylish, easy on/easy off, didn't need a break-in period. I believe these are resoleable too. I am comfort snob and most of my shoes are from Clark's; I found that these aren't as comfortable when walking longer distances, but I have been satisfied with the comfort for shorter distances. I might add a supportive insole when I bring these on trips. For the frequency with which I plan on wearing these, I am completely satisfied with my purchase. If you are on the search for a good/"BIFL" Chelsea boot too and plan on wearing it for most of the year, I would invest in a higher-quality pair. For those of us that live in a four-season climate where this shoe is only applicable for a few months a year, I am thrilled with the quality I received. I am actually watching sales so that I can get a brown one in this style too.

text:

Original review:
I am really pleased with this sandal. Clark's is my favorite. I am a short woman and I was looking for a casual but not too casual sandal with a nude top and nude sole so that I could look taller with bare feet. Comfort was an important quality too; why get something I wouldn't want to wear? Surprisingly a nude sole was hard to find. After searching far and wide I found this sandal and I am so glad I did. I haven't worn it for long walks yet but it seems quite comfy. It isn't the most stylish shoe ever but it does what I want it to.

title: (Size .5-1 sz up) I wish I purchased these 10 years ago!!!
text:
I've been doing Zumba workouts weekly for 12 years now. I always went for regular trainers with pivots on the bottom because they were more stylish than these basic black (and kinda chunky) Capezios. The Zumba brand was good for several years, but I don't like the high top styles that they've been selling exclusively for the past few years. As soon as I put on these Capezios I knew that I should have been wearing these all along. Dancing is SO much easier!!! Also, the only sneak I could find with a pivot now is Ryka, and they really really suck even worse than they sucked 10 years ago. The sole started coming off within 4 wears. Disgusting. Don't throw your money down the drain, get these even if it means you need to buy another pair of sneakers for other athletic activites; it is worth it. You will be thrilled you did.
Sizing: I am usually a 7.5 sneaker. After reading reviews I got an 8.5 and they fit perfectly. Maybe a little extra room in the toe box than I need but it has not been bothersome at all.

title: Super pleased. Good height for short boots.
text: I bought the Rtzat and the Zealwood wool ankle socks to compare. From just one try on, I found these to be significantly higher quality, but I can't comment on long-term use. I returned the other brand and bought more of these. Looking forward to wearing them under short boots in early spring and fall.

title: Perfect! Fixed a potentially big problem with ease.
text:
I custom ordered rings online using a ring sizer. I was a little generous and the rings weren't falling off my knuckles but they were slipping around my lower fingers. The band I have is pretty thick and wide and I was afraid these wouldn't work. I was wrong! The thickest spiral was perfect. I "installed" in on my ring in a matter of minutes.

Do *go* *slow* when you're applying these IF you are using a gold-plated item! My item is 18K gold plated and I think I nicked some of the plating off when I tried to shove the ring between the silicone spiral. I don't really mind, because it was at the bottom of the ring, and now it can't even be seen because of this item. The solution: If you use two people and hold the spiral open, you can simply place the ring inside the spiral; when the spiral is no longer held taut, the first spiral wraps itself around the ring. After the first spiral, the additional spirals are easy to place onto the ring by gently wrapping through.

I wish I had known about these things all my life. They're amazing.

title: Beautiful fit, runs small in waist
text:
I ended up ordering 10 pairs of lounge pants from Amazon. I swear, it wasn’t intentional. I was looking for a lightweight lounge pant for fall and late spring in the northeast. I ordered 4 pairs at first and was disappointed by all of them, so I ordered more. Thankfully my next batch had winners. Here are my reviews and rankings.

(1st Place) Ritiriko Women's Joggers with Pockets, High Waist Yoga Capri Pants for Running Workout Lounge: My favorites! I pulled these out of the bag and I thought they would be too tight and small. The waist was the perfect fit and it managed to be fitted without feeling tight. The material isn’t cozy or super soft but it is smooth and very comfortable.

(2nd Place) SPECIALMAGIC Sweatpants Lounge Wear for Women Ankle Length Loose Fit Casual Pants Baggy Workout Active Cropped: My second favorites! I am 5’4” and these hit me right at my ankle but could also be pulled up. These were SO SOFT and the waistband was comfortably loose. These are a lower-quality dupe for Boody Eco Wear lounge pants. I actually returned the Boodys because for $60+ I expected something softer. Something like this! Of course, Boody’s lounge pants are made of bamboo and sustainable, whereas these are rayon, so, of course not ideal, but so dang comfy and only $20. Also, I think these look a little better on than pictured. I got it in black.

(3rd Place) Yogipace Petite/Regular/Tall Women's 7/8 On The Fly Pants Drawstring Casual Lounge Joggers Travel Sweatpants: I reaaaally liked these. At 5’4” the 27” length was perfect. These had a little more weight than most other pants. Very sturdy waistband. If you don’t like cozy soft and prefer a smooth, heavier soft (hope that makes sense), these will be good for you. These are nylon. The waistband on these was pretty loose and there’s lots of slack in the drawstrings for adjustment. You might want to consider sizing down, and you definitely want to if you have a small waist.

Amazon Brand - Core 10 Women's Yoga CoreCloud Fleece Jogger: These were a great, comfy, cozy, fleece-lined lounge pant but were too warm for what I was looking for. These would be great in the winter. I didn’t keep them because I already have winter lounge pants. Very similar to the Ann Taylor LOFT Outlet Super Soft line. The price point is about the same if you watch LOFT Outlet sales. I prefer the LOFT Outlet style because they are cozier and the waistband is thick and high-rise.

KEEPBEAUTY Womens Active Yoga Sweatpants Loose Workout Joggers Pants Comfy Lounge Pants with Pockets
AND
DIBAOLONG Womens Yoga Pants Wide Leg Loose Drawstring Comfy Lounge Workout Sweatpants with Pockets Cameo M
^ These are the same! The exact same, folks. Lol. So the material of these was suuuuper soft and cozy, lightweight, loved it. The catch was the waistband. I found it a little tight and uncomfortable. And it didn’t have a drawstring to loosen. This wasn’t a sizing issue, because the legs were loose even on my thick thighs. If you have a slim waist you should def get these. If you don’t you might want to avoid.

CRZ YOGA Women's Stretch Lounge Sweatpants Travel Ankle Drawstring 7/8 Athletic Track Yoga Dress Pants: These seemed to be high-quality and were very comfortable without being cozy soft. I definitely wondered if I could get away with wearing these to the office; they were very flattering. These would be perfect for wearing over short shorts or a bathing suit in the winter on the way to the gym or studio. I am not keeping them for lounge purposes.

Sarin Mathews Womens Yoga Pants Pleated Wide Leg Loose Comfy Lounge Pants Workout Sweatpants for Women with Pockets: These are a really soft, comfortable material and fit beautifully. You could totally get away with wearing these to the office. If you practice yoga and don’t like how fitted typical yoga pants are, these are a great alternative. I don’t think the model photo does these pants justice. Watch the product video to see how they really look. Again, though, they were tight in the waist for me. I don’t mind this amount of tightness when I am out and about but I wanted something looser for lounge. I could have sized up but the pant legs were already a tad too long on me.

BALEAF EVO Women's Skinny Cotton Joggers Sweatpants Tapered Casual Lounge Jogging Pants Fitted Yoga Workout Pocketed Pants
AND
BALEAF Women's Cotton Sweatpants Cozy Joggers Pants Tapered Active Yoga Lounge Casual Travel Pants with Pockets
^ Again these are the EXACT same thing. Even though I ordered these in the same size, one arrived with an inch larger waistband than the other. I don’t know which one is which because other than that they are identical, so, sorry, can’t advise as to which one you should get if you want the larger waistband. Lol! I would wish you luck in figuring it out, but honestly, these aren’t great. The material is rough and the seams are unattractive. The Amazon joggers are a much better buy.

title: Attractive coat, well-made & high-quality
text: I really liked this jacket. It was not the most slimming style, but it certainly would keep you warm. It is very well-made. I was looking for a coat for super cold weather and I ended up going with a different coat from a different brand (Eddie Bauer), which was significantly heavier and warmer. 5’4” 140 lb and a small was a snug but good fit while the medium had lots of extra room.

title: SO wonderful, soft and warm! This is a steal!
text:
This review is for the CRZ Brushed Light Fleece Leggings and the CRZ Fleece Lined Leggings Winter Warm Full Length. Prior to this purchase, almost all of my athletic leggings were exclusively from Old Navy, though I’ve also tried out Fabletics and Athleta.

COMFORT/QUALITY: I was super impressed by the inner brushed fleece and overall comfort! The Light Fleece felt a little stiffer than the stretch I’m used to in Old Navy and Athleta leggings but the compression is excellent. The Fleece Lined Winter Warm had lots more stretch but sacrificed on compression. Both pairs are softer, inside and out, than the standard Old Navy or Fabletics athletic legging.

WARMTH: As a New England girl, for light activity I think the Light Fleece is best fit for 40-50 degrees F and the Fleece Lined for below 40. If you’re running, you might want to hold off on the Fleece Lined until it is below freezing. That said, the Light Fleece holds up well to cold temps. I went on a walk the other night in 40 degree weather, humid (felt colder), 10 mph winds. I thought I put on the warmer pair and I had the Light Fleece on instead. My legs definitely weren’t WARM but I wasn’t cold either!

SIZE: The 25” Light Fleece is a perfect full-length legging for the shorties among us. I wish the 25” size was available in the Fleece Lined. Buy your normal size for the Light Fleece and size down for the Fleece Lined! Trust me. Old Navy and Athleta petite mediums fit me like a glove (5’4” 140 lb, carry most of my weight in my butt and thighs). The medium in the 25” Light Fleece was the perfect fit. The medium in the 28” Fleece Lined was absolutely huge in the waist. The small fits much better and I have never once purchased a small in leggings.

Overall I am super glad I have these and didn’t dish out triple the price for something pricier! Not gonna lie, I do have a pricier fleece-lined athletic pant in my arsenal for super cold temps, but these two will be perfect for 20-50 degrees F. Since this temp range lasts for 4-5 months of the year up here, I will definitely put these to use!

Note on the color for these- I got the gray first in these and they had a sheen to them which was not slimming. I went for the Arctic Plum instead which was more matte and much more slimming.

title: Perfect tank for when ya can’t bother with the sports bra
text: I LOVE this workout tank. I have been working out at home more and I love being able to just throw on one top without a sports bra. The design is stylish, the material is comfortable and sleek, and the bra has enough support for my smallish boobies. I am 5’4”, 142 lb, 38B and the large fit me very well, fitted but not too tight. It definitely would have fit me better if I was taller. I could have used a petite size, but this is fine. If you have a smaller chest than me and are shorter but similar/lighter weight, I would size down to a medium.

title: One star off for soo small sizing
text: I bought my husband the "Midweight Classic Thermal Base Layer" and it fit him like a glove. He looked sexy in it and we wanted to try out other Carhartt shirts. This "Midweight Tech Thermal" was softer but much more fitted. This one definitely fits like an undershirt whereas the other one fits like a normal shirt. But, this one has a zipper on the chest, so how could you wear it under another shirt? We're returning and getting another of the "classic thermal."

title: Dad jacket
text: I bought this for my husband, looking for a lightweight, breathable athletic jacket. This was a heavier jacket than we wanted for this purpose. The jacket was not very soft and felt plastic-y. Also, my husband has a very broad chest and is a typical large or slim fit XL. This jacket in size large fit fine on his chest but was oversized and boxy in the waist and hips. It was a total dad jacket. We'll be returning.

title: Underimpressed
text: Given the high reviews for this item, I expected better quality. The quality of these gloves aren't much better than what you would find at a Walmart. I really doubted they would keep my hands warm in below freezing weather. I returned these and found Heat Holders instead, which I am so impressed and thrilled with. Spend another $10-20 for something of better quality that will actually work and feel comfortable.

title: Super lightweight
text: This was such a lightweight jacket that it was no use for my spouse. We wanted something breathable but with some warmth. This jacket provides no warmth at all other than protection from the air on your arm. I imagine it would be good for long-distance running or misty days.

title: Eh... for a lounge tank with a built-in bra, this one is good
text:
Update: After 1 season of use, I donated these tanks. It is just too tough to find a comfortable, practical lounge tank with a built-in bra. The neckline was too low and gapped and it wasn't a practical item. I invested in comfy lounge bras and tees instead for this summer.

Original review: Okay, so I understand why reviews are mixed. I didn’t know exactly what was going on when I tried on this tank for the first time. For reference, I am 5’4”, wide frame, 145 lb, very short torso, B cup. I was yanking the tank down so that the pads would get under my boobs. If you’re looking for push-up padding, this ain’t it. The padding is very thin at the bottom and thickest at the upper top. The thickest part of the padding is above my nip, which is strange. However my girls are small and perky so this actually kind of works for me. I can imagine this might be uncomfortable or unflattering if your boobs are larger or if you aren’t looking to fill out more on the upper boob.

The fabric is super soft and silky. I am a shortie and I am really happy with how the material clings but bunches at my tummy; there’s extra material but it doesn’t make me look bigger than I am. The fit is very flattering. Also, the elastic of the bra is not super tight and comfy enough that I forget it is there, and I am usually pretty sensitive to that type of thing.

I ran these tanks through the wash and even though the tag says not to put in the dryer, I think you have to. I tested one in the dryer and not only did it not shrink, but the bra part was still wet when every other item in the load was dry. I had to put the tank alone back in for longer.

Overall I am super happy that I got this three pack. These tanks are perfect for WFH in the summer.

title: Cooling & breathable
text: My hub is an excessive sweater and humid summer days are just the worst for him. He loves these tanks! Says they are very cooling. Wife gives stamp of approval as soft and snuggle-able as well.  It is a win-win.

title: Meh. It is soft.
text:
Edit after 1 season of wear: I donated these. Don't waste your money.

I bought these as a lounge bra. A huge pro is that I have a wide frame and at 38B the large was not too snug, which can be hard to find. However I am not sure if I love it. The area where all the straps connect in the upper back digs into me sometimes. The fabric is very soft but after a few washes already shows signs of beginning to pill. The girls look good in this bra but I can't wear the bra without a top because the pads are clearly visible through the front. Don't get lured in by an Amazon deal, keep looking.

title: The white color is see-through
text: The fit was nice but I returned because the exterior material was so sheer that you could see the outline of the inner shorts very clearly. I imagine that colored undies would be very obvious as well.

title: Husband loves them
text: After years of trying to convince my stubborn husband to try out Chacs ("why don't I just wear a sneaker?" he said), he fell in love with him after I picked these out for him through Prime Wardrobe. These are an attractive style. He likes the fit and support. I've had my Chacs since 2013 and mine are still holding strong. I expect these will last him for a decade.

title: Attractive hat
text: I've used it a few times and it is very comfortable, lightweight, and cooling. The white is very eye-catching and cute. Love it.

title: Less than flattering fit and too "in between" for my needs
text:
This jacket has a lightweight exterior with a soft, cotton lining. It feels "in between" a lightweight and midweight jacket for me. I first bought it in late spring, hoping for a lightweight, breathable athletic jacket for the warmer months. The cotton lining was too warm for this and to boot, I didn't like the fit. So I returned it and wrote a review here saying that it would be nice for keeping warm. The fall comes and now I'm looking for a midweight jacket, something that will keep me warm in the 50s and (with layering) 40s. I reorder this jacket in the next size down, since I found it too big before. Not warm enough and I still didn't like the fit and the quality of the manufacturing (seams mostly) just seemed under-impressive. I dunno, I just wouldn't recommend.

ORIGINAL REVIEW:
This jacket had a boxy fit. I followed the review recommendations and sized up. It was comfortably loose. I don’t think a smaller size would have helped with the fit all, it just would have just made the jacket tighter. I am returning for this reason. However, the material was nice quality. Be aware that there is a soft, cottony lining, which would be nice for keeping warm. This isn’t a lightweight, breathable athletic jacket, which is what I was looking for.

title: Poor quality - the fabric is ribbed
text: The model photo is really misleading IMO. The fabric of this top is very flimsy. It is ribbed, which is not pictured. The fit was great but I couldn’t get over the poor quality. I feel like I could just rip it, or that it would quickly degrade in the wash. Disappointing, since I tried Core 10’s yoga pants and fell in love. Returning.

title: Neckline was a dealbreaker - Comparing Amazon’s UPF tops
text:
TLDR: I *loved* this top but the neckline was too wide to give me the sun protection I wanted. So sad.

I bought four Amazon UPF long sleeve tops from sellers RlaGed, KPSun, Willit Sports, and isnowood. This review compares the four.

For fit information, I am 5’4”, 150 lb, muscular, wide frame, 38B. I usually wear M or L. After following the advice of the reviews I ordered a L in all tops. All fit me somewhat loosely.

The KPSun and isnowood were my favorites in terms of softness. Very soft and comfortable. RlaGed was a close second.

For fit, RlaGed and KPSun took the lead. Both skimmed my body and still showed I had a figure. KPSun has a more pronounced boat neck which unfortunately disqualfied it from the running for me. I am trying to protect my upper chest from the sun’s rays, hence why I ordered a UPF shirt, so showing the extra skin on the side of my neck was not worth it for me. It was a very flattering cut, but did not suffice for my needs.

The disadvantage to the fit with the isnowood top was baggy arms. My arms are muscular and toned. The RlaGed and KPSports fit like a glove and skimmed my whole arm. The isnowood had a somewhat baggy bicep/upper sleeve in relation to the fit of the rest of the top. If you have larger arms, the isnowood might be a good choice for you. Ultimately, I liked the softness of the isnowood so much that I wasn’t too bothered by the baggy arms and kept it.

The breathability of all of these tops is incredible. I have never owned a UPF top and I was so surprised. In the shade, I actually felt cold. Very impressive.

If you’re noticing I haven’t mentioned the Willit Sports top, it is because it came in dead last. The fabric was by far the scratchiest of the four. But the biggest dealbreaker was the fit. While the other tops skimmed my figure, the Willit Sports top was strangely tight on my lower belly — ladies, what area do you NOT want a top to be tight, am I right? The tightness on the bottom of the top was unflattering and emphasized a boxy figure. Also, the sleeves were way too long.

I ended up keeping the RlaGed and isnowood tops. If I was going to buy another, I would go with the RlaGed. And I really hope KPSports makes another top that is exactly the same but with a true crew neck, because that top might have been my favorite if it wasn’t for the neckline.

title: Scratchy fabric, nice design, great fit
text: I was not happy with the quality of the fabric. It was a little scratchy and not very soft. I did like the ventilation provided by the open back but the scratchy fabric outweighed this benefit. I usually wear a medium in U.S. brands and a large in Chinese brands and I followed other reviewers advice to get a large. It fit great on my torso but the arms were way too long. I am 5’4”. Returning.

title: WAY too small
text: I am really disappointed. The XL was skin tight on me. I am 5’4” and a muscular 150 lb, I usually wear a size 8 in tops. You could literally see the outline of my navel through the top it was so tight. I understand these sizes were meant for Chinese women but this is outrageous. A size 6 should NOT be considered an XL in US-targeted retail.

title: Super soft & lightweight, my new fave lounge tee
text: This tee is super lightweight and very cozy. The hub loves it. I got it for wearing around the house. Based on reviews I went for a medium instead of a large and I was glad I did. It is VERY loose- it skims my chest and hits just at my hips. I liked it so much, I got a second. It is really perfect for the hot weather because the deep V lets you ventilate but the sleeves provide a little warmth when the AC is on. I've washed both tees multiple time and I've been surprised by how well they've been holding up. Usually I would expect pilling by now, but very minimal signs. Definitely a winner.

title: Very soft and comfy, order 1-2 sizes up
text:
Edit: These PJs just went in the donation bin. Hub doesnt like them and his complaint was with the pants— too long (XL and he is 5’10”), no pockets, and the waist could not be tightened with a tie. Oh well.

WEEN CHARM! Okay, my hub and I had a good laugh over the name of these... anyway... I bought these for him for Christmas. They are super satiny and very lightweight, he loved how comfortable they are. However, they run super small!!! My husband always wears a large in tops and medium in bottoms. I bought him a large in these and they were super tight in his whole hip area! I mean, it was very fun to look at, but he couldn't be seen in them by anyone but me, lol! My husband is NOT a large in bottoms by any means, his bottom half is naturally very slim... And what's funny is, he has a very large, broad chest, and the Large was fitted on his chest, but not nearly as tight as "down there"! I guess there's a reason they're called Ween Charm LOL. I ordered him an extra large and they fit much better. So, order two sizes up?

title: Husband's favorite in the land
text: These are my husband's favorite boxers among many brands- Hanes, Tommy Hilfiger, Kayizu, Izod. The waistband is very soft and stretchy without feeling too elasticy, which can make him sweat in hotter weather. The short material is super soft, a little clingy without being fitted, not too tight, a little longer than the standard short boxer short. These wash well and the quality holds up over time. David Bitton, please never stop making these.

title: Really soft but loose for smaller heads
text: I love how soft this headband is. It is very comfortable and a good quality. I've washed it with my clothes (cold, delicate cycle) and it still looks brand new. My only issue is that it is not very tight on my head. I am a woman and I thought my head was on the larger side for a woman, but maybe I've average. Anyway, when I'm walking and it's windy, the headband is not tight enough on my head, and the wind whips underneath my headband, which makes my ears cold. The headband is not loose enough to shift or fall off though.  I really like it but I wish it came in a smaller size. If you have a smaller head perhaps pass on this.

title: Amazing beautiful perfect AND THEY DON’T DRAG!
text: The quality is excellent and oh my goodness it is a yoga pant that comes in short (!!!!). No more dragging my yoga pants on the ground!!  I am 5’4”, curvy and muscular with a booty, and the pants come one perfect inch off the ground. There is NO dragging! The V waistband is very sexy and flattering. The pants fit like a glove. I was not anticipating spending over $40 on yoga pants, since I don’t wear them that often, but these were just so nice that I couldn’t send them back once I tried them on. (Yes, creators of Amazon Wardrobe... I fell into your trap. Congratulations.)

title: Very sexy, shortie needed it hemmed
text: I originally bought a large and it was WAY too long on the bottom and sleeves. I am 5’4”, a muscular 160, 38B. I ordered a medium and it was WAY too tight—> returned. I liked this shirt so much that I brought it to the tailor and got the arms and bottom shortened. I am wearing the large in these pics post-tailor. I’ve gotten a lot of compliments wearing this shirt. It makes me feel very sexy even though I am not showing off too much. Definitely recommend.

title: Worked perfectly as Spirit personal item
text: I packed this thing to the brim for my 3-day weekend getaway to Ft Lauderdale. I was amazed by how much this holds. 3 blouses, sweater, dress, shorts, 2 bathing suits, all my makeup, liquid bag, 2 pairs of sandals, my crossbody purse, snacks, a hardcover book... I could barely zip this and it still fit under the seat in front of me without a problem. Threw it in the wash (cold, medium spin) when I got home and it held up fine. What a steal!

title: Warm, cozy, cute
text:
This dress is surprisingly warm. Very nice for a casual day at a friend’s. I would NOT recommend the white, the raised knit reminds me of my 90-year-old grandmother’s sweaters. If I would order again I would choose the tan.

The sizing is strange. I am wearing a Large, I am 5’4”, 160lb, muscular. The arms are a little baggy and long and the dress is a little shorter than expected. If someone was tall and slim the arms would probably be way too big.

I don’t LOVE the dress but it is comfy and easy for casual so I think I will keep it.

title: Very thin material. Flattering fit.
text:
This dress is cute and fairly flattering. I thought the material might be thicker, since it is a long sleeve dress. It is very thin and not warm at all. I bought this to wear with a scarf, leggings and boots in the winter. It is way too thin for winter, at least in New England! Although it is really cute I’m not sure if I’ll be keeping it. Long sleeves and paper thin material doesnt make much sense. You can see how sheer it is in the first pic, you can kinda see my beige bra through the material.

SIZING: I am 5’4”, 38B, muscular 160 lb. Based on reviews I ordered both a M & L. I am wearing a Medium in the pic and it fits great.

title: Flannel NOT as soft as cotton!
text: I bought these flannel pj pants Christmas of 2017. I was optimistic that they would be as soft as the CYZ cotton lounge pants which ai purchased and loved. No such luck, and they haven’t softened up much after a year of wash and wear. Stick with the cotton pants!

title: Surprisingly good quality. Runs small.
text:
Update, one year later: I LOVE this jacket. It has held up so well. I lost some weight and at a muscular 150 lb the large fits perfectly. It is the perfect athletic jacket in cool weather and it functioned as a perfect layer when hiking in 20 degree weather. Highly recommend.
———————————————————

I am impressed by the quality of this jacket. Very breathable (many mesh panels) but still warm. Soft as well.

I was looking for a jacket to wear walking or to/from the gym in 40-60 degree weather. This jacket was the only reasonably priced one I could find that had a hood. The thumb holes are a big perk; I love them.

This jacket runs small. I am 5’4” and a muscular 160 lb. I usually wear M or L and I got a Large in this. It is tight. I would be embarrassed to wear this with a normal (non-sports) bra. I wanted it snug but not this snug. However, it is slimming. I am hoping it will stretch out a bit. I won’t be putting this in the dryer.

I’m looking forward to wearing this! It will make a great shell in colder weather as well.

title: Love this
text: This is super classy! I was so happy that this hat did not give off the "old lady" look when I tried it on. My husband's first reaction was to roll his eyes and say "what a hipster," lol. The fitted brim is very snug and warm. The beret, when pushed back, does not look over the top or strange, almost like a rounded beanie from the front. I plan on wearing this with my black flared pea coat. Definitely fashionable and would recommend!

title: Works well for above freezing weather
text:
I intended to buy this for myself (F) for walks outside in the cold. I couldn't find Mission Women's Midweight on Amazon so I thought I'd give these a try. I have a larger build for a lady and I'm not super skinny so I thought a men's S/M would work OK. Not so much. Too big. Extra .5-.75" in each finger. Gave to my husband and it fits him very well. However, I did wear them on a walk even though they were too big on a windy, 35-40 degree day and they certainly are windproof and my hands barely felt cold - and I am always cold. Would definitely recommend these gloves!

Edit after 1 year of use: 35-40 degrees is as low as you can go for these to still be useful. Any colder and my hands freeze off. Windproof, maybe, but not cold-proof.

title: Fashionable and practical but not too warm
text:
Love my new bun beanie! I love wearing a high bun when I’m just bopping around and I hate having to take my hair down in the winter to put a hat on when going for a weekend grocery trip, going out on a walk, etc. Perfect solution! Fits great and is warm. Recommend putting the bun through the hole first then pulling the brim down, looks better that way for me.

Also, I have thick Irish hair that goes past my shoulders and I had no problem getting my bun through this hole. My hair isn’t super duper long so I can’t attest to that, but it is very thick.

Update- went on an hour long walk in 40 degree weather with a wind chill that made it feel like 35. This hat does NOT protect from wind that well but it is pretty warm. My ears were cold when the wind was strong but when the wind died down I was very comfortable. Moving forward I plan to wear this with a windproof jacket's hood and I will be good to go.

title: White #2 not flattering on wider hourglass figures
text:
I bought White #2 and it was not what I expected at all. Returning. The material is fine but the fit is not flattering. This is a “one size” item. I am 5’4”, wide build, very muscular with slim, strong arms. The sleeves were almost tight, definitely form-fitting, no drapiness whatsoever. The sleeves looked like a fitted blouse.

The body of the kimono was not drapy enough and the way it hung around my body was loose, but not loose enough. Curvier ladies, you understand, shawls either need to be be form-fitting/very slightly drapy or very loose to flatter the curves. It was not flattering at all and made me look larger than I am.

I wouldn’t recommend this product to anyone who isn’t slim and petite. Honestly a slim, taller lady with curves would probably still have trouble. I imagine it would be beautiful on someone who is slim, minimal curves, and maybe 5’1”ish OR if very slim, boyish figure, taller ladies if you want it to hit above your hips.

title: Fashionable AND comfortable
text: These boots are fantastic.  I love wearing them with a tunic and leggings for a night out or under a long skirt at work.  They are very fashionable and attractive.  I ordered these in particular because I went into a brick and mortar shoe store, tried on several pairs of black heeled booties, and found these the most comfortable by far.  These will be a fall/late winter wardrobe staple for quite some time.

title: Exceeded expectations
text:
Perfect! Beautifully soft material and the lace waistband feels so nice (for a change). I thought this slip was expensive when I bought it but it was worth every penny. Will be getting another.

FYI, for sizing: the 18” M looked long when I took it out of the package, but as all things do, it is shorter on you b/c it hugs your hips. I am 5’4” 155 and wearing the waistband at my navel it hits just a little longer than the model, maybe 3” above my knee. Perfect for work dresses!

title: Comfy, perfect coverage for around the house
text: I bought these in the dog days of summer out of frustration of being too hot around the house.  The windows which we keep open for air circulation have curtains, not blinds, so when the windows are open, in the heat, we don't draw the curtains.  I asked myself, what is the least amount of clothes I can be spotted in inside the house where I wouldn't be embarrassed for a neighbor to see me?  Bingo.  These boyshorts are my answer to that.  The bottom totally covers my bum.  In the front, the bottom hits my thighs lower than my crotch.  It is high rise to me, reaching the midpoint between my pelvic bone and navel.  Love it for this purpose and would buy again to have another pair next summer.  Very soft as well.  For sizing suggestions, I am usually a M or L and I bought L for the purposes outlined above but if I wanted a hip-hugging fit for under tight jeans I would have bought M.

title: Fantastic bras for around the house and beyond
text:
I really love these casual bras. They are the first around-the-house bra I feel comfortable wearing under t-shirts and even loose work dresses. No nipple peeks here! (Only noticable when cold and without a shirt.) The padding is just enough. They keep the girls looking perky and in their natural shape with only the smallest amount of support. Also, without a shirt, the neckline keeps the cleavage looking good.

I read reviews saying to sew in the bra cups... I sewed in 2, didn't sew in 2 others, and I like the non-sewed ones better. Also, none of the pads have fallen out at all through multiple washes. I have lots of sports bras where the pads fall out all the time - I'm wondering if the women who wrote the prior reviews just aren't used to removable padding. I wouldn't recommend sewing.

Last note- I am a 38B/36C and almost always have trouble with the band being too tight. Not on this one! Its comfortably loose. Ladies with wide rib cages rejoice.

I love the colors on these and I'm definitely buying the neutrally colored ones to wear under some work outfits.

Update after a year of wear: these are starting to pill from washing/drying. I'm not terribly upset about it given the price but the quality is not tip top.

Update after a few years of wear: lots of pilling, so much so that they are scratchy and I don’t want to wear anymore. I washed these in bra bags on cold and air dried. Disappointing but I guess you get what you pay for. Lowering my review.

title: Great fit but see through
text:
I was looking for a staple skater skirt to pair with small tops for *hot* summer days. I wanted a billowy skirt to make the look cute and sexy more so than erring toward trashy, like if paired with short shorts.

The waistband was slightly snugger than expected, but not bothersomely so. Hem longer than expected - but again, no big deal.

Material wasn't as expected. Polyester and kind of rough, but not uncomfortable. Hoping it will be breathable on hot days.

Skirt is very cute. The reason for the 4 star reviews is because it is see through. Definitely plan to wear a slip under this. I was bummed about this initially, but then I realized I always wear bike shorts under skirts like this anyway, so I suppose a slip isn't a big deal.

Even with a slip, you can still see the curve of my legs and booty if you're staring. See in the first picture how when I pull the skirt to the side, you can still see the slit of my slip. But just glancing at it, or if the lighting is dim, it will be fine with a slip - which is what I'm banking on.

title: SO comfy and flattering; buy a size down
text:
These are WONDERFUL. They looked deceptively slouchy, like "I've given up on life" pants when I pulled them out of their original packaging. However, I soon noticed how soft they are to the touch and cozy. I don't overheat with these; they were perfect for cool nights in early New England summer on the couch. I look forward to seeing how insulating they'll be in the winter. Also, these are fairly flattering for being lounge pants and accentuate my figure as well as lounge pants can. These did run large. I usually buy a M/L pant, size 10/12 jeans. I bought a medium in these and they slip off of my hips if I don't have them tied. Definitely buy a size smaller than usual.

Post-winter add: These are warm enough for cold nights! I will opt for my sweatpants instead when its freezing but I feel perfectly cozy in these when its 30 outside and the heat’s set to 60. This from someone who is always cold.

title: Skirt unhelpfully snug
text: I returned.  I normally buy a medium/large in stretchy pants and after reading customer reviews I decided to go with a large.  The leggings themselves fit fine; the quality was not what I am used to, but still decent.  I really disliked the skirt; it did nothing for me.  I do have a pretty round booty, so perhaps that is why, but the skirt hugged my bum so much that from a distance, you could not tell that the leggings were even skirted at all - which is the whole reason that I bought this item in the first place.  Maybe these bottoms work well for slimmer ladies, but if you have curves and a booty and bought these skirted leggings for a reason, you may find yourself out of luck.  At least the returns were free!
