title: Would best serve a charm or pendant
text:
Simple and dainty.. feels a bit delicate and IMHO, naked without a charm. Just does not have a lot of substance on its own.. definitely a simple and classic look all by itself.

Style of chain that is usually paired with a pendant or charm- chain that could hold x1-2 smaller charms without a lot of weight. *Note: included photos of both ends of the clasp- One just needs to be certain that a jump ring used will fit over the smallest end of clasp. I used a 6mm and had no prob.

Very pretty without creases or blemishes in metal.. higher priced for light and simple. Wears nicely- would be best with a charm add-on. Hoping info helps decision.. stay safe everyone.

title: Boxy cut- built for bustier and fuller women.
text:
Using measurements provided I received a solid fit through bust area.. problem is… It left everything else big and boxy. Pleats don’t help to accentuate a feminine silhouette as one would expect. It may offer extra room for a fuller figure woman- however, not marketed in this capacity… Has left me with excess material to swim in- very disheveled in my too big top!!

Also, it is important to note.. white fabric is thin and see-thru! Far more than the norm. expected. If using for a work shirt, it needs a lot of extra effort to feel appropriate- not something most would want to take on. I do want to add fabric feels smooth, and for the most part it releases the wrinkles. It will need a lot of prep to be a “go to” everyday at work shirt! Something most would like to avoid.

For reference: I’m 5’2”, 147lb, 38C, 40+yr old who’s had to accept gravity post x4 kids.. ordered in L white- I have a solid fit through the bustline.. with everything else feeling big, boxy and downing. I would recommend trying if built with a fuller figure straight thru bust and mid section and avoid solid white or think camisole!? Hoping info helps decision- stay safe everyone!

title: Perfect spring/summer outfit.. softest fabric, total comfort + quality!!
text:
Soft as can be! These are a lightweight cotton mix.. I’ve included photos of tags to provide exact %. Fabric has an inviting and comfy feel, the type that lets little one move around in nothing but comfort.. a fabric that just gets better with wash/wear. The trio of style, design and color all appear as if extra effort is put in- even though it takes none! Even with the elevated appearance the outfit stays toddler friendly with its easy elastic waistband- makes it simple to change a diaper or provide independent potty capabilities.. no buckles, buttons etc. with the slide on/off style! *note: knot the ends of tie waistband- otherwise, they will slip into hole be lost into the elastic abyss!!

I chose the washed out salmon tshirt + true navy short- a perfect spring and summer color. Sizing seems right on point without excess wiggle room.. ordered sz.4 for 3yr. old to wear in summer. Washed on cold and dried on low heat avoided any shrinking issues. (I’ve washed and put away till weather warms up..)

In true Tommy Bahama brand fashion.. it is quality and comfort- and priced perfectly at $20. A great addition to child's wardrobe or gift worthy. Hoping info helps decision- stay safe everyone.

title: Can be worn if fan of music group or not.. best shade of purple I’ve found!!
text:
Unfamiliar with the musical group.. I still find sweatshirt connotation unique and fitting for other purposes just the same! With daughter graduating university from a school who’s colors happen to be a royal purple/gold.. it was perfect- the positive quote is apropos! Planning to attend a bonfire at the beach on grad night.. this is a perfect way to keep warm while sporting grad spirit and sentiment!

Created in an oversized/boyfriend style.. I suggest ordering standard size.. this will achieve a relaxed/comfort fit with ample wiggle room- one that feels “supersized” everywhere but length, as that falls in line with a standard women’s cut.. covers cheeks but doesn’t drown like a dress in a sea of fabric! Sleeve has length and drop shoulder gives a solid roomy look + feel. Embroidered lettering elevates look and wont peel or crack.. tbh, it’s not my fav. aspect bc it can feel a bit odd worn against skin. (A Tee or tank underneath can help!)

Not a fan of purple.. this is by far the best shade I’ve ever seen!! A warm undertone makes it far more appealing (dare I say a hint of raspberry-) and trust me, after x4yrs. of supporting a purple hue.. this is actually pretty! Bc of vibrant color- wash on cold inside out, with like colors to preserve brightness so no color bleed or pilling. Line dry to avoid any shrinkage- fabric arrives a bit thick/stiff but should relax with wash and wear.. after x3 cycles I’ve seen improvement!

Would make a great gift or a spoiler for any who prefer a purple shade or, or a fan of the music group from Korea! Priced at the top end.. they’ve given attention to detail. Hoping info helps decision- stay safe everyone.

title: Option to pair or wear solo.. beveled edges not for every look!
text:
Appears to be a solid band- expect a darker silver hue more in line with a stainless color- not the expected shiny lighter sterling silver. Could be worn separate on its own- or paired with another ring. I’ve included photos with varied looks.. you can see depending on the different style bands- bc of bevel, it looks better with some styles more than others.

Fit is comfortable no complaints.

Definitely priced appropriate.. but I prefer the whiter silver color and I realize now, the beveled edge is not for me! Arrived in jewelry pouch if wanting to gift. Hoping info helps decision- stay safe, everyone.

title: Perfect for your athlete.. Instant solution!!
text:
Ideal for those who must “superman into different attire..” from day clothes to athletic gear without going home in between! Aka- my daughter who plays varsity collegiate sports.. races from class to field without time to stop at her dorm- And bc she loves to accessorize during with her day attire.. she needed safe storage solution before getting down and dirty on the field!!

Bc capsule clips to a bag there’s no need to remember an extra item- providing the user a much safer solution then dumping items into the dreaded pocket abyss, leaving in drink holder of a car which is never wise.. or setting in a “safe“ place not to forget!! This is a specified and contained option that solves issues instantly. Ha! even if it’s hours later you panic where you left your jewelry.. ha! they’re right there attached to the bag! (Yes, I am reviewing as it happened- a solid endorsement for a real scenario!!)

Smaller in size- it can easily hold rings, earrings, bracelet… Even a necklace but I don't recommend more than one for tangle reasons! The built in jump ring offers more security along with thicker, “solid” plastic body. At end of day and bc this ultimately is plastic material.. **clip jewelry capsule securely ON THE INSIDE OF PURSE, backpack duffle!!! That way, if it ever were to be compromised and break or loosen from the jump ring and falls off.. it’s still safe. Item would still be found inside at the bottom!!!

A great spoiler or gift for those athlete, gym connoisseur’s or even wanting to travel with a few options! This is perf. Wish we found it years ago.. hoping info helps decision- stay safe everyone.

title: Trendy and fun.. has plenty of pros!
text:
A fun and trendy appearance.. overall, feels like shoe has substance- this provides a solid durable fit and PLU exterior is easy to wipe clean.. being 99% white- it’s a good thing! Ordered blue accent which is perf. as it wears as a solid white.. but, with a little pop of color flare.. it can be played with to stand out/blend- whatever you choose!

Not a lightweight design like many new athletic shoes that feel like air.. it isn’t clunky!! More of a substantial fit including a platform heel of 1” .for shorter peep like me, I love it! At 5’1” I’m a fan of the extra height without appearing awkward!

I found fit to be on point- ordered size 8 and usually wear 7.5-8, and this allows plenty of room for athletic sock without feeling constricted. Shoe is designed with more of a fuller/boxier style and bc it lacks any real taper toward the toe area.. it may have excess room that over time shows creases at the bend by toe area it may appear more prominent over time- not fault of shoe as much as its part of the style and overall look.

For a $40 option this has potential to be a respectable option for a season.. a shoe you’ll get plenty of wear from. Only it may look the part after that! Hoping info helps decision- stay safe everyone.

title: Steal of a deal.. Velcro adjusting size sewn into hat.. child/adult capacity!
text:
Wowed! Receiving a 24pk. for $5.97.. it’s too perfect for group cooking course, a young chefs academy program, imagination play or even classroom career day! Themed birthday party- have participants bake or frost own cookies or decorate cupcakes as an activity.. endless options!

Not only fun aesthetic.. hat also provides the function to keep hair, free and clear from any food prep. Ha.. A huge perk..!! Fact these are “use and lose” is nice, if soiled- Otherwise, they have plenty of integrity for more then x1 day of play.

A 1.5” adjustable velcro strip closing an A-frame cutout on back that offers a custom fit to various head sizes.. smallest setting fit our 3yr old- on flip side largest setting fit an adult parent! I’d deem a universal fit for majority.. For any interested.. hats can be personalized and decorated with fabric markers (fine tip Crayolas work as well.. but, careful as they may bleed a tiny bit.) Hoping info helps decision- Bon appétit everyone!

title: Teeny little shapes.. sized so sweet!! Appropriate for all ages..
text:
These are teeny- perfect for an “add-on” piercing where space may be a bit limited.. a nice option if you want ‘no muss-no fuss’ wearability! Small and universal to match any ensemble.. i’ve had quality results with the metal. No irritation after wearing 24/7 over x1wk.

Be careful as Sterling silver is softer and can bend creating stress point that could break metal.. bc so tiny, these aren’t thick or robust - tiny enough to be appropriate for little girls ears as well- and not cause any weighted pull on earlobe!

X4 pair of fun, geometric shapes received in velvet pouch. Note: mine arrived without earring backs- so, must provide your own. Makes a fun gift or a spoiler! Hoping info helps decision- stay safe everyone.

title: Slippery soft- forgiving size and style.. feminine touch for sure!
text:
Unbelievably soft.. truly, this material slips thru the fingers with a slick feel! Loose crochet design had no snags or pulls.. but bc of larger open spaces, top may be a bit prone to catch on things if not careful.

Scalloped edges ooze such a feminine vibe and dare I say, bougie heiress feel! The stark white sheen just adds to the bougie! Wide open neck has peek-a-boo shoulder effect.. ulala! Length grazes the thigh so, it offers some bum coverage but not much else below. Classy with a flirty, feminine Feel!!

Wash is personal preference. By hand is preferred.. I chose inside a lingerie bag (to avoid any possible snags..) and used delicate/hand wash cycle on my machine in cold/woolite. Flat dry only- to preserve size + life!

Pretty and feminine swim cover with a bougie vibe! Fun option that you just feel pretty in. Paired with a thong, pool slide or strappy sandal- you’re summer or vacation ready! Hoping info helps decision..

title: A nice summer option for casual comfort.. flows free + whimsical!!
text:
Designed “paper-bag” style.. the cut is perfect for a fun and whimsical flow! What it lacks without offering a feminine silhouette it recaptures in the length.. an alternate way to still create a beautiful and feminine feel while worn. All without losing comfort in a casual fit!

Choosing XL in khaki.. I found a solid/forgiving fit without restricted movement. Would be ideal cruise or vacation dress- packs small taking up zero space! A solid option post sunburn where loose clothing is vital. Nice in hot/humid climates.. nothing clingy! Pairs well with a heel to increase femininity factor or strappy sandal, open toe wedge for casual fun feel. could even wear pool side.. it has options!

Dress will wrinkle but, loosens while worn.. which matches “unfinished” edges/hemline.. hem does shed strings with a raw finish- just so aware. Sleeves have an oversized bellow which oddly seem to work!? Elastic wristband can help manipulate them! Take note: in certain light dress shows see-thru silhouette bc of light gauze fabric.. worn with spankies underneath helped to offset its sheerness issue.

A fun option that brings a bit of personality and flare to a vacation or warmer summer weather! Hoping info can Help.. Stay safe everyone.
For reference: 40+yr old, 5’2”, 38C, 32x29. Trouble spot in mid section thx to x4 babies and gravity! Chose xl for bust size- could prob fit the L.

title: Pants like Ive never seen- posted many photos and info. to explain..!!!
text:
Different than expected in a unique way?! Odd to say.. I know! Ordered to shake up standard ‘mom uniform’ aka- white tee with leggings or denim! Pants looks as if you put in more effort then you actually did.. I love that! Blue is far more slate gray/bluish (umm no!?) hue.. match up is versatile- a lot like denim! I posted photos with color accuracy and everything else too!! “Dress cut” = slanted pockets with a good hand placement and room for expected items. Hidden zip pocket secure keys or $. Solid feature if active- I mentioned bc, hard to notice in listing!

Pant suited for casual outings, errands, leisure outdoor activity/work/ or play, lunch date.. AM walk, camping, travel pant, or Disney day! Fabric’s lightweight with some flex.. but no expected stretch or extra warmth in winter temp. *But, pant can get sweaty at waistband! Like PLU material is one sided, so is this!? Think heavier windbreaker- nylon feel is sleek (but no sheen!) these do ‘swish’ some noise in motion. Ive posted pic’s of pant leg inside out! Not itchy or irritable but, definitely a different feel than most.

Using POSTED size chart online..i matched measurements NOT normal size. The length almost 2” longer than posted! Ok.. craziest waist band ever seen!! Has 2” elastin swatch built in band and then for real- it has a double layered section of waistband at both hips! I don’t get it and hard to explain, it seems to work- just not sure if better than normal design?! Wish had more forgiveness for cozy comfort. A wild concept maybe I don’t get? Belt loops can help secure and dress up look a bit! For ref: Im 5’2”, 148lb, 32x29, 40+yr old with trouble thru middle thx to 4kids and gravity! xXL fit- besides length I must roll. (Pant fit bc, I used inches measurement listed- and not my normal Size..!)

Very long winded- I felt pants lacked thorough description and want to make you aware. At $42- I want an informed purchase!! Unique perks and quirks.. but, these aren’t a love or “go to” pant for me. Hoping info helps decision- stay safe everyone!

title: Surpassed my expectations!! Great for Yellowstone fans.. and great $!!
text:
Wow.. I love to be pleasantly surprised and this cowboy hat did just that! Far better constructed than I was expecting for under $20. I LOVE its not a brittle fall apart straw used in the construction.. You know, the wildly obnoxious summer concert type cowboy straw hats bent and decrepit yet, worn anyway..at least by 80’s metal guitarists?!! This has finished edges with nice movement and doesn’t leave a trail of straw along the way!!

Interior strap is awesome.. allows you to tighten/loosen for a custom like fit! Easy to adjust.. the only trick is in one’s ability to tie off a short tiny bow- bc that’s how it stays in place to one’s chosen size!! Really appreciate interior fabric wrap that runs the circumference of hat.. it keep itchy material off of the skin itself.. dare I say it can help keep one’s sweat at bay? (We’ll have to see what summer brings but, I’m sure it couldn’t hurt.)

If wanted- one can also remove “fancier beaded band” found on the exterior.. tbh, I do this! Not glued on permanent or built in as part of the actual structure- so, option is yours. Hat is lightweight and easily universal for male/female alike. Definitely adult sizing.. even with custom feature- it would be hard pressed to get small enough for a child. A fun find and one my Yellowstone fan is going to love to wear with full Costner attitude! Hoping info helps decision- stay safe everyone.

title: More like skort appearance- very feminine, appropriate.. just shapeless silhouette!
text:
As one who appreciates a free flowy short that appears like a skirt but with ease and convenience of shorts- I was hoping these would be a bit more flattering! Adjustable waist tie, one can cinch up the top paperbag style for personal fit. However, top band has ripplely/ruffle edge so it doesn’t lay or appear smooth at the waist line.. Something I need all the help I can get in this department! I don’t need the extra rumple around the midsection… NoPe!!

Material feels a bit like crepe paper.. NOT linen as it states- just been manufactured to visually resemble. Different from what I expected but not itchy or irritable. These wrinkle while worn as one probably expect.. but, flowing movement helps loosen up. Pockets provide natural hand placement and hold items but not 100% secure!

Fit is on point with use of chart provided. Material isn’t stretch worthy but cut/style is more forgiving.. length is modest and hits the sweet spot for a feminine feel! Khaki hue is a bit of an apricot.. and depending on light- one can see a silhouette thru fabric at least on lighter (khaki) color. A fun way to dress up casual wear and look like you stepped up your game without any extra effort.. as a mama, I love/need this- just wish end product was more flattering to my build.

For reference: 40+ yr old, 5’2”, 148lb, 32x30, 38C.. with trouble spot thru middle thx to gravity and x4 kids! Hoping info helps decision- stay safe everyone!

title: Perfect for those who Carry less or lose wallet often..!!!
text:
Perfect for teenage son who constantly misplaces wallet! Mine usually carries ALL his cash, license, plastic and multiple gift cards bc it’s a great storage spot.. and they fit.m!! Yep, It’s a disaster if lost- only he’s too stubborn to see the issue.. This minimalist small wallet is a solid solution- use with simple activity is at hand.. or even just a need ID on you- BooM!! It solved our problem perf. and keeps solo ID from accidentally going through the wash!! (Yep, we’ve done this too!)

Keeping main wallet safe at home- he can snag ID, amount of needed cash or debit that can turn off/on if lost!! All items fit without issue.. nothing slips or feels loose. Great visual ID window- so, no need to be removed each time.. and with x1 empty slot.. mine tucks receipts or lists inside if necessary.. Best of all- it’s very manageable in front/back pocket! He’s adopted this as a constant.. without ever admitting, I was right- typical!!

Pros: no need to “origami fold” $ to get it to fit!! Card slots hold steady and minimal thickness lets YOU choose preferred pocket. Solid stitched edges.. price on par for product.

Cons: no coin holder for those who prefer. Not micro mini sized but.. I’d actually list as a pro for some substance/protection! So, heads up if Über tiny is most important to you-

Sure there’s smaller.. but, one can expect a solid mix of functionality made in a minimal design! Makes a great gift or sidekick wallet for any.. male/female alike! Hoping info helps decision- stay safe everyone.

title: Expect quality with the brand name.. but also, a higher price point!
text:
Definitely a shirt made to last.. no details overlooked in stitching and/or construction- it lives up to the hype and expectation of Mr. Tom Brady, the fashion extraordinaire! But, I think it’s safe to assume.. Brady knows workout attire!!! Paying a higher price point- one piece of comfort to fall back on is the fact.. this should last for multiple seasons. The rest I feel is due to notoriety of the brand!

Everything about fit is on point- sizing as expected to US standards. I really appreciate the length being that of a happy medium. The type I refer it to as “the goldilocks effect..” not too long/short just right in the Sweet Spot! Mine really appreciates the generous length in sleeve as well. For reference: my son is 6’5”, 198lb, 34x36 with a wingspan to match! We chose XXl to ensure a solid length in body/arm.. Surprisingly, this fit without excessive bulk thru the mid section. So, happy with our size choice. (for a comparison my son wears an xl/xxl in adidas brand..)

Take note: this is a shiny, slippery fabric I didn't anticipate from online photos. Ordered in black.. pictures don't quite capture amount of sheen -so just be aware. However, as slippery as fabric is- it has an oddly, different texture and I’m not sure as to the why..?! Not discomfort when worn but, definitely noticeable! Would be perf. playing rugby or, sliding belly up into first! Best guess it’s the 75% cordura in fabric blend? Fact- cordura is used to make luggage, backpacks, etc.. So, makes sense for the rougher feel!? Apprehensive breathable gusset under arm may feel awkward but, a total non issue. Brady branding is subtle and located at lower waistband- cool enough if wanted to be seen- but not overdone!!

Overall, a nicely constructed shirt made to last.. its unique fabric would be most important aspect to be sure it suits your likes/needs. At a higher price point you want to be sure you love it. Hoping info helps decision- stay safe everyone. *Sorry, so long winded- I try to be overly thorough on pricier options!

title: Love everything about the hat- except it’s sized for men yet, velvet..??!!
text:
This is a great find and one I was just hopeful would fit more unisex bc of its velvet finish. At the very least I was hoping for a more universal fit in size of the hat itself. Size doesn’t run overly big with adjustable strap -but it’s definitely the cut and style of a men’s ball cap- wider, bigger brim sort of a cross between 5 panel/trucker style?!

Not sure many men would like.. unless it becomes the hottest new trend?! Let’s face it- it only takes one rapper or bad boy band member to top off their style with an accessory like this and then, watch out- BooM.. it will be velvet for men everywhere!!!

All finishing detail looks on point- it’s just a quirky velvet that feels feminine (sorry- it’s true!) but definitely made and styled for a man. Hat gets 5 stars.. awkward letdown gets 3 star. Hoping info helps decision- stay safe everyone.

title: not sure what defines pickle ball socks.. but these are a solid athletic style!
text:
It’s true.. I am uncertain what defines a “pickle ball“ sock officially- Ha!! Other than one you wear to play that provides the comfort you’re after during athletically rigorous activity! These have fat cushioned heels and toe edges, to help avoid blisters caused by rubbing or chaffing. It also helps reinforce the material to prolong sock life from holes caused by rubbing. Expect solid padding infused without sacrificing shape or just slapping on bulk!

Ample compression thru arch/toe area to provide support yet, isn’t excessively tight that you have to “Cinderella” your way into just to get it on!! (ordered Lg. for sz.11 mens- fit as expected) The top band stays put during activity.. and “padded ring” adds comfort so band won’t cut off circulation like some socks can do!! Loving solid white- with small gray logo on the rear cuff- you won’t look like a walking billboard or advertisement.. very sleek look plus, a universal match!

What sock offers is still created with a thinner design- feels breathable with moisture wicking. Washes up well.. no beading/fuzz. I liked everything but price for one pair! Sold in a x2-3pack would be far more in line.. Hoping info helps decision- stay safe everyone.

title: Soft and stretchable waistband- a bit baggy in seat and length is off!!
text:
Anticipating these for winter as a fun way to switch up every day casual pants…corduroy is a great option in cold weather to do so! To make note, although a soft corduroy this is thinner material overall- they deliver plenty of softness and the similar warmth like a pair of heavrier stretch pants would- just don’t expect a a very thick fabric! These have a nice, stretchable ability with a waistband that is forgiving…

However, these are a little baggy in the seat and front pocket arena! They do tend to add “more” in appearance- meaning: a little excess bulk to the silhouette, just a looser cut/fit.. unfortunately, that’s not something I need any help adding onto!! In photograph these do appear a bit casual vs. form fitting- only not as much as when I tried them on. Not to mention these loosen as worn and will need washing to regain their shape- Yep! Expect that kind of material!

Measurements appear accurate with the exception of inseam!! One of the things I was most excited about, was not having to tailor or hem and yet, even if I roll the leg cuff up twice.. these are far longer then the 27.8” as stated. In fact, my pant will need to be hemmed approx. 6” if I want to wear them without a cuff! Something to keep in mind for shorter heights. I believe inseam measurement must have been done after they’ve rolled the cuff bc of such a large discrepancy! Tbh, I wasn’t planning on rolling them at all- so, i’ll have to hem for certain. For reference: I’m 40+yr old, 5’2”, 147lb.. with an inseam of 27” on my tippy toes!!!

These have potential to be a very casual and comfortable pant that brings a unique and refreshing look to the norm. It’s just making certain you are aware of the style: a bit baggy in the drop seat and front pocket area.. and also, the excess length! Hoping info helps decision- stay safe everyone!

title: Beautiful option from a trusted brand.. only it’s not sterling silver!
text:
Ring is very pretty and has a BoHo free spirit vibe about it! I love the design with the look of the free floating stone.. very unique. Ordered in a size 7, which would be my regular size- Only, we had to exchange smaller.. the size 6 was a far better fit. I do wish it came in half sizes- but keep in mind it does seem to run big vs. small…

The only disappointment is in the fact this doesn’t possess solid sterling silver- and for this quality brand, I would appreciate S.S. as its solid plated metal for its longevity..(this is listed as either gold/silver plated.) After wearing a week- I’ve had no skin irritation or discoloration. However, I suggest removing prior to any prolonged water or chemical exposure to preserve life of the metal itself. Cleaning products can damage finishes on any metals.. so, be aware and take precautions.

Makes a great gift for anyone who loves the sea or the sun… Or even a spoiler for yourself! Comes gift ready in a jewelry pouch and definitely a sweet, beautiful, option and very unique. One that could be enjoyed by young or old just the same. Hoping info helps decision- stay safe, everyone.

title: Soft as silk material- made for a full cup size otherwise it may gape!
text:
Ordered in my regular size which is 42C.. I prefer a bigger width and ability to secure it tighter as needed. I hate any constriction around the rib cage, so I always choose a larger width!! (I measure a 38/40) and this fit me solid around width when hooked on 2nd tier clasps. I appreciate room for error so if any shrinkage or discrepancy, I can adjust it big or small as needed.

As for the cup size I do measure a solid C and find this is made for a full cup and not any less! If not measuring to a true cup size ie, full C or D.. or whatever your cup is… it might gape a bit. This is not usually a problem I have when using this method of going to a bigger size width. But, I noticed it with this bra and mention so others are aware.

Material is soft as silk! Feels smooth on skin- clasps easily lock in place and underwire isn’t overly exposed or protruding.. but, yes! It does have a wire! As for coloring- I ordered darker tan and love it. It’s ideal under shirts where white can stand out a bit too much..I’d suggest washing on cold inside a lingerie bag on delicate and air dry only. Doing so helps prolong the life of the bra and its integrity.. it also helps keep its shape! Hoping info helps decision- stay safe everyone!

title: Higher price for trendy style and plenty of user friendly perks!
text:
If luggage can be pretty… This is! Very sleek looking, it surprised me how much I liked the look and exterior feel.. not to mention it has plenty of built in creature comforts for packing. All zippers move smoothly and create compartments for smaller items such as socks, swimsuit, panties, toiletries, ties/accessories- and larger zip compartment for clothing with an entire second side to hold via bungee strap.

Wheels itself move smoothly- however, I wish these were rubber vs. plastic.. plastic wheels have history of breakage when checked thru TSA- so, x1 disappointing option chosen for this higher price point. (why I deducted x1 star.) I appreciate x2 handle options: built in solid handle for lifting and the other for maneuvering and holding carryon which tucks away nicely. Lock isn’t fullproof but is a great deterrent- and ordered is sand color.. it can mix/match well with other pieces.. tbh, i’d love to add on to the set this has been designed with! Outside wipes easily clean when it showing signs of marks/dirt, etc..

This would be an ideal spoiler for any or great gift for a recent graduate or one who loves travel.. even for a retirement gift! This offers optimum interior space and extra pieces to add-on as needed. Nice creature comfort and usability. Hoping info helps decision.. stay safe everyone.

title: Doesn’t have solid exterior to hold items in place as expected- too soft sided!
text:
Order to use specifically as a duffel- I needed a solid platform/bottom in a bag to have items ride safe/secure/upright so they could travel as such.. Only this does not offer that type of interior!! A bit frustrating to even create the duffel shape from the optional backpack- with all the straps etc.. The cut of bag also compromises and cuts into the interior room so it is less than expected- not what I needed.

Overly soft sides also cause a bit of stability issue for solid protection. I wanted something to hold items in place and let them transport in that fashion while I carried like a duffel- without firmness overall this did not offer enough support. Instead, this provides backpack style packing so, something to keep in mind for the end-user.. and its purpose! May work for things like clothing, towels or such- but, not 100% ideal to carry items needed to stay upright and in place.

Ordered in mint green I received the wrong color- I got a tan/brown! It’s not offputting- but quality control in sending correct item is a must.. especially if intended for a specific male/female user- simply put, it should be as buyer ordered!! At $42 I expect a lot more in terms of the integrity of a capable duffel bag.. This fell short in that dept. Bag best serves a purpose for one who needs a convertible option for items that won’t be affected by the soft sidedness overall.. unfortunately, it couldn’t help my needs. Hoping info helps decision- stay safe everyone.

title: Unisex- size bigger vs. smaller.. great one handed on/off ability!
text:

title: Great for those between a man/teen body…!!!

title: Many pockets- compromised main compartment- satchel handles don’t fit!!!
text:
For a higher price point, I expect a lot.. wanting to use as my everyday purse- I needed one that could handle the rigor and wear/tear of mom life! Appears built with integrity and reinforced design so not to wear prematurely. Brown carries orangish hue.. just so you know what to expect- tbh, it grows on me!

Ample exterior pockets were the key feature that sold me on this.. only front flap/magnet pocket is hard to open and gain any real access nor provide usable space.. best to store papers or receipts- possibly thin cell phone?!! View photos included- side pockets have a crease that makes zip mechanics a bit tough to open/close.. hoping they’ll relax with time.

Main compartment issue comes in lack of ability to access or maneuver content freely as well as, visually see into purse at same time!! Having a checkbook style wallet (full length) it barely fits and must be inserted at angle.. x1 end at a time! Note: smaller space without visual to find what looking for- or easy access.. title: Hmm.. a few perks and quirks to know..!!!
text:
Top is billowy online and looks amazing! Only I’m afraid it’s one of those that looks better there! The fabric is not as light/airy in feel or look. Ordered in white and take note- a bit see thru.. not showing all details but definitely silhouettes! Do not size up- use online guide and you’ll be fine. title: Great price for a quick and cool costume!!
text:
$8- makes such an easy costume and for such a good deal. Pair mask with black hoodie and pants- pulling hoodie overhead and tying down.. You've got an instant costume for under $10- BooM!! We did just this for teen “must dress at work” halloween and it was easy, comfortable, affordable… and a big hit! Hack: If you tie hoodie string it helps secure mask in place

Not the best vision.. wish better solution- the neon X crosses through openings.. but openings are also small. Plan accordingly.. and don’t drive with mask on..!!!

Batteries are needed- it takes x2AA and x1 button cycles thru different settings ie., blink, solid lit, etc. Costume needs a pocket to tuck battery pack into. We ran cord down inside hoodie and into kangaroo pocket on front.. cord had just enough length for this! Could also run down back side and place in back pant pocket.. trick is easy access to controls!

Overall.. a solid and simple costume solution- could be fun cosplay the rest of the year. No light failures- worked as it should. Adjustable strap held in place with help of “hoodie hood!” Hope this helps- stay safe everyone.

title: Looks like the trending brand- just not as much squish!!
text:
Sandals look the part for sure… This style was a late summer craze made to emulate walking on a cloud which was made by a company of the same name. A few $ cheaper version that’s look is spot on. Only the material used varies from original-

So, if you want the same look.. Boom, here you go!! If after the same feel- these have a far firmer base, almost like foam that’s been compressed without bouncing back- like a compacted foam that’s harder?!! Where originals are all about the squish into.. these are more like walking on top of- if that makes sense?!

Size is on target without any wiggle room. I’m a 7.5-8 and ordering 7-8 fit left no room to spare. Yes!! You feel the “ripple” raised up bumps on the instep and takes a little getting used too.. Not discomfort as much as you feel it!

Depending on what your after look/feel- these emulate originals for a bit lower price. If choosing just bc you like this sandal.. it’s ideal for beach, pool, shower shoe, or indoor/out slippers. May not be the best for all day wear- hoping info. helps decision.. stay safe everyone.

text:

Working for a largely known corporate company- pants were not allowed bc of the waistband!! So, be sure prior to ordering $50 docker pant these will be appropriate for work attire.. what’s crazy with that shirt tucked in you couldn’t see the waistband anyway.. Oh well!

As for the pants themselves: these are made of a durable fabric.. not easily to rip/tear. Length and waist is forgiving and can be adjusted for personal fit.. material is a heavier weight and has a dullness to the black- no sheen. Able to be worn with a slip on “athletic dress or work shoe” even a boat style top-sider but doesn’t look ideal with dress shoes! Pockets have ample room but can look a bit bulky thru the mid-drift.. definitely a more casual work environment vs. fullblown dress attire. title: Great for working on your feet all day!

Sock does shrink some in wash- see before/after photos above! Ordered largest available size for mens 11m. (13-15) If unsure- I’d suggest bigger vs. smaller.. and cold cycle can minimize shrinkage. title: Great for overnight or carry-on use…!!
text:

Ordered for a x4 day getaway to be my main stay luggage.. BUT, bag was far to small to do so. Don’t get me wrong- bag has room for plenty of items.. it’s just far more conducive to an overnight stay in the realistic woman’s travel world!! Wknd getaway needs x3 outfit minimum, swimsuit/jacket, hoodie pj.’s, shoes, toiletries, makeup- and what about hair dryer, flat iron.. possible gifts or a few souvenirs..

Depth is far less then expected bc of the separated shoe compartment on bottom- note: bottom space can be used for things other then shoes if desired. Bag also has an oval cut!! This takes away space on top level bc of its rounded edges- basically, NOT as big of an interior as I need for wknd gear.

I love the creature comforts in multiple pockets + specific spaces made to hold boarding pass, wallet, keys etc.. *Side drink holders are NOT as deep as bag itself either! Cant fit a 32oz hydro as depth is only the top layer of the bag deep. Photos included of bag in REAL time use and you can see, a small plastic bottle barely fits.

Bag still served purpose in smaller size- used as a carryon it was ideal.. I just put purse inside! Fits under plane seat like a glove.. In hotel- I used this to go to gym and as pool bag, it was a Chameleon with ability to adapt. No water seeped in and material wipes clean. For under $30 a bag I’ll find plenty of use for and have! title: Option for that “cant breathe bra feeling!”
text:

Prob. best feature with this bra and one I’d not hesitate to recommend to any who ever feel overly confined, constricted.. or just plain miserable while wearing a bra!! For this reason alone- i’m so using it!!

Having breast reduction surgery 15yr. ago.. the amount of scar tissue and discomfort I have is so exacerbated with a wire bra.. the Vinfact option has eliminated a lot of my angst!!

Without wire I find it’s a must to provide a “shelf“ under the actual breast for support (or is it really a bra?!).. This bra does step up in the shelf dept. BiG!! This provides the lift I need as a 38C, 40+yr old who is currently in a heated battle with gravity.. and losing!! Cups are my least favorite part.. and if made in larger sizes my question is… Why would we want to pad these and increase the already busty bust!? title: Smaller vs big- A great hybrid hiking/river shoe!!
text:
Ordered for our camping adventure and river float trip where hybrid shoe for land/water were a must and these were ideal. 2 points of contact to fasten strap (over arch + ankle back.) Both help keep shoe in place and provide stability. Note: when buckled up in a solid fit.. sandal wasn’t able to slip on/off for easy access. Straps need to be undone each time.. bummer! Also- bring half sizes!! It’s tough if barely a 10.. do you risk to at edge? Or go full size too big?? Hello- we need 1/2 sizes too!

Arch support is there with a soft yet firm insole. The footprint is odd in the insole- yet, it softens as worn. Note: these also have a thicker sole! Great for avoiding sharp rocks while hiking, river rafting, etc. but it does add height to overall stature- this can be weird or disliked by some! So take note, you’ll be almost an 1” taller!

One last quirky thing mine had to report- he did loves width and placement of “front toe strap.” Why you ask? Ha.. well, bc it actually helps cover up the “ugly knuckle” on a toe!!! Yep, feet can be ugly and these have an athletically pleasing placement of a front strap for the goofy toes! Go figure…!!

Ordered in a 10 when usually wear a 10.. I wish we had a 10.5 as toe is AT THE EDGE!! Best to size up if unsure which way to go.. at least till they realize 1/2 sizes are people too! Hoping info can help make your decision- stay safe everyone.

title: Heavier 100% COTTON (yay!) - wider and longer..!!
text:
This is the real deal!! 100% cotton fabric with drop shoulder design. It’s wider width and longer length, finally! With a 19yr old son who is 6’5”- it is tough to find enough length in a casual T-shirt.. this has it and then some.

Made of heavier cotton.. it feels raw! Tee’s not spun or prewashed. You’ll definitely get a “new fabric” look but, expect material will need washing + wear and tear to loosen and soften up over time.

With longer length comes wider width- which is trending these days.. mine is tall but more slender so, it can look a bit disheveled- its not the crisp white T-shirt vibe- so don’t necessarily expect clean lines when worn. Drop shoulder also adds to that “I just dress for comfort look” (again, all trending!!) One should just consider the style when ordering- think features matched with your body type.. then, size accordingly to keep from drowning in a sea of fabric!!

Washed on cold cycle, I actually machine dried as well.. something I rarely do! Overall shrinkage was minimal but be aware- 100% Cotton will shrink up. (Best guesstimate is .5”x.5” lost in length/width..)

Priced at higher end of $25- it is definitely quality and weight in fabric you’re getting. A fun addition for an overall casual and relaxed look. Hoping info can help make your decision- stay safe everyone!

title: We loved these.. perfect activity pant for summer!!
text:

text:

title: A bit polished- simple tips help keep it slim!
text:
Used as a men’s wallet this has a high polish sheen and finish I find more conducive to a woman’s accessory. Having said that- I take full knowledge that’s a blanket and unfair statement!! Good news- it’s sized proportionately for a man’s pant pocket! My concerns of this being too bulky in a pair of Levi’s were put to rest.. including the concern it may not feel comfortable while sitting. Let’s face it… A mans wallet is only as good as it’s comfort and usability in the pocket!! For a coin/catch all included with a flip envelope closure- it actually surprised me.. this is far thinner than even some bifold wallets.

Card slots are secure and yet not difficult to pull a card out- adding x6 cards won’t add bulk- folding bills in half will also keep bulk to a minimum. Coin/catchall pocket is something I’d recommend emptying.. just leave the magic combo for exact change inside- that’s it!! (for any who do not know use the “4321” rule- include: 4 Pennie’s, 3 qtrs, 2 dimes, 1 nickel..!!! this lets you always make exact change- and eliminate getting coins back in return! Ha.. you are so welcome!) coin pocket will stay slim.

Quality leather and solid craftsmanship is used. Oh great starting point for a first time wallet user or a minimalist. Hoping this info can help make your decision- stay safe everyone.

title: Different fit then expected-
text:
Looking for a top to take me spring into summer.. I wanted something that moved freely, feeling casual and lightweight and with a fun amount of movement to feel feminine. This fits that look and idea- however, movement is less than expected and the excess material seems to create a bit of bulk in the most inopportune places- like the waistline!! Possibly due to my build? But top can make one feel a bit large.. and disheveled! For certain you’ll want to pair with a more form fitted bottom to avoid looking thick thru the middle..

Material softens over wear/washings.. it has a crepé paper type feel but it loosens and softens up. Wash on cold/gentle cycle- line dry to avoid shrinkage, iron on low heat if needed. Ordered in white this is a “silhouette see-thru” but not sheer or transparent and nude/beige colored bra will help camo the underlayer.

Top could also be used as a swimsuit cover- but it is not overly long in length! Being a shorter height length falls about the crotch and not longer. For reference: 5’2”, 149lb, 38C, 40+yr old with my trouble spot thru mid section (thx to x4 kids and gravity!) nicely constructed without loose threads or sloppy finishing.. this may be right for some it just missed the fit and look I was hoping for. It may be build + body bias!!? Hoping this info can help make your decision.. stay safe everyone.

title: 100% quality all the way around..
text:
Loving the quality as this is 100% soft and inviting cotton that is comfort on the skin.. its lightweight with nothing synthetic in the mix at all.. thank you!! The tee is cut in a flattering, casual style -nothing looks too boxy or disheveled in appearance.. a real flattering appearance.

Silk screening is on point to stay in place.. no worry of it peeling or cracking. Nothing in artistic design choice is overdone or too gimmicky- tee can be worn by teens and adults alike. It’s a timeless look that could be enjoyed by water or land lovers alike! Tshirt washes up well without fading. Used cold cycle and line dried to avoid shrinkage.. especially in the length! Post x6 washes tee has kept both its shape and softness.. this is one of those items that will only soften and better with age as it’s built to last awhile.. hence $26 price point. You’re buying overall authentic quality..!!

Ordered in XL for reference: my son is 6’5”, 190lb., 33x36, 18yr old- has active but not overly athletic build.. sort of between teen/man body!! Fit is solid and length is “just right” for taller height- but not an inch to spare.. so, definitely line dry. Hoping this info can help make your decision- stay safe everyone!

title: A solid 4 star.. if planning to use for 2 night..!!
text:
This is a great bag with a solid look and style! Not just for women, it is every part unisex. Dare I say almost a bit rugged + worn in from the stone wash and heavier material! It’s a total classic using the 2-tone leather vibe!

Designer used intelligence in the storage capability and solutions… Who doesn’t love their shoes kept free and clear of clean clothing?!! Ha.. how about- who doesn’t love “realistic size” shoes kept free and clear of their clean clothing.. Am I right??!! The zip compartment is very compatible with adult size shoes as entire base presents like a fliptop lid via its 270° zip around opening! One can easily store whatever desired on the lower deck- shoes, dirty clothes, make up + hair tools, wet swimsuit… souvenirs- whatever!!

Bag offers great organization and a semi sturdy structure. No!! It’s not a hard rigid suitcase per se’ but.. opened taut to capacity it works hard to hold shape.. and once x1-2 items find their place inside- you’re home free! The added pockets are perfect creature comforts..letting you tuck something little inside you’ll need to locate easy-medication, phone cord, etc. Outer zip pocket is ideal for a boarding pass, key fob, chapstick- and so on. Pockets aren’t deep.. just convenient!

Personally, I prefer the 2 carry handles option as they offer enough drop to ride on shoulder vs. the long X-body strap.. A bag this size can be a weapon for shorter peeps where it constantly smacks our knees!! Besides.. I find weight feels distributed far better when using FIXED carry handles. (less worry of a strap breaking off if it clips on!)

Why not 4 stars..?? This was a tough one- and even a bit subjective but, weekender bags must fit all the items needed for the actual getaway! I find this just a bit too small for the timeframe and is more compatible with a x1-2 day vs. x3-4 day getaway..!! Might be better sized for men with less gear? Or, a child?! *If a winter wknd is planned- this would be hard pressed to fit sweaters, pants, coats, boots etc inside especially for multiple days. Otherwise, a fun bag for $55- would make a great gift or spoiler for yourself. Hoping info can help make your decision.. stay safe everyone.

title: Flawless Friendship bracelets made to last..
text:
Tis the season for summer jewelry.. Yipee!! This is universal- it’s more then perfect for male/female just the same! And depending on color.. these have a thicker width of braid so they can almost give off a more masculine vibe. Slip knot closure provides ease and one-handed on/off capability that is sizable for almost any adult wrist. Best intended for the tween/adult… Not sure it would close small enough to fit a childs wrist.

I love these style bracelets in summer because of the wearability as they can truly be left on 24/7 accompanying you right into the pool or ocean! No need to remove or worry about fancy or expensive jewelry becoming lost or ruined.. these will dry out in the sunshine or fresh air no problem.

Created in solids these are made to mix/match and make a subtle statement vs. those made with wild patterns. One can wear as a single or stacked set.. Depending on size of the person- these could even be worn as an anklet! I’ve found no loose threads or knots.. closure is secure along with the finishing knots at the ends. Made in the same fashion as homemade friendship bracelets.. these offer the same look and vibe but in a tight and professional waxed finish. (wax is used to protect embroidery thread.) Sold at a higher price point of $16, I find it a bit hard justifying the price- without a charity or organization benefiting from the sale. However, being handmade- you can see the amount of craftsmanship that one has put into each piece.

Overall, would make a fun gift heading into summer or even a great spoiler for yourself! Hoping this info can help make your decision.. stay safe everyone.

title: Solid pair of “go to” shorts-
text:
These women’s hiking shorts make a great lightweight, warm weather option for the daily grind- something I reference as a “mom uniform“ where to qualify- item must be easy to wear, bring comfort and be a no-brainer to pair with a Tee or anything in between… these are just that easy!!

LOVING the pockets! As a mama they are vital to catch/carry everything along the way- But, don’t get me wrong… some moms appreciate fashion trend! Well constructed and easy to wash and care for- I wouldn’t hesitate recommending to any looking for a short that equally provides fashion and function. Hoping this info can help make your decision- stay safe everyone!

title: A bit littler and less than expected..
text:
Loving the beautiful colors- and the price point of $10… unfortunately, these didn’t live up to expectations. Not only do they run a bit smaller in length and width- they also run a bit short!! I realize they are cut and made to be short.. however, it’s almost a bit hard to notice the various colors even peeking out from a low-cut shoe! This sort of defeats the purpose..
material is soft and if you can get it on the foot.. which we could, however I mentioned the smaller size because of the range.. we’re at the lower side and barely got this on! Be aware smaller feet are best. These would be a good option for someone who truly does not want to see the top of the sock in any capacity.. crazy! As tight as they are getting on the foot- they tend to slip and wiggle down just at the ankle.. even though there’s barely any material to move!?

Washing will also affect the size. Definitely looks prettier in the picture than they are functional on the foot.. ** all good things to keep in mind prior to purchase. Would definitely order for smaller or preteen young ladies. Hoping this info can help your decision- stay safe everyone!

title: Comfy as a flip flop- with a bougie look!!
text:
This is the icing on the cake to any outfit.. its the cherry on top- it can be easily paired with denims or dress slacks.. shorts or skirts- it’s just that universal..!!! Comfy as can be and quite the sturdy wedge heel- no need to break in.. it’s wear ready right out of the box!

Sizing does run 1/2 sz. Small… BUT, if you order up accordingly you’ll be happily Cinderella with the perfect fitting shoe! Usually wearing 7.5-8 I chose 8.5 and it kept toe/heel from hanging over the edge yet, still provided the ideal fit with the thick band across the top. Would recommend to any who love the extra height.. This will bring it and at 5’1” I’m one who appreciates this in every capacity!! A very sturdy and solid wedge slip on… one I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend. Hoping this info can help your decision- stay safe everyone!

title: A unique alternative to rain jacket-
text:
I’m loving this find- my 18yr old will forgo a jacket all bc he hates the sounds they make!!! Of course, we all know the infamous “jacket sound” of waterproof material.. but, it drove me crazy- he’d rather be cold then noisy.. and in Utah cold no less!!!

Here in lies my salvation- a perfect alternative and about as warm- not rainproof but, the solid cotton twill was a good layer of warmth, keeps out the wind and the heaviness brings its share of value.. and looks quite stylish over whatever style shirt it is paired with underneath- Ive yet to see a combo that I don’t care for! Mine loves to layer with a hoodie… BUT, take note: if planning this type of style- we found this ran a tad tight thru the shoulders and arms!! Yes.. tightness was still present even with a regular T-shirt, he still felt it a bit constricted. So, I wouldn’t hesitate to suggest.. if unsure of size- you would be best to err on a bigger vs. smaller size.

Otherwise, this is great. Construction and finishing looks on point.. I’m impressed top/bottom- collar lays as it should- This has sturdy buttons that are fastened nice and secure to jacket and match up with adequate room to close up against elements as needed. I find this has a bit of “military” vibe- But, Im sure it depends on the color choice and of course, what you choose to pair it with. NO.. it can’t double as a sport coat- but, it has ability to look the part for nicer dress and is definitely work worthy! Without a hood- it’s a bit less practical for keeping your head dry… however, it creates a nice sleek look appearing anything but casual or disheveled! Not a bad thing for teens that think messy is a style- and a really good look.. ugh!!

Overall, priced at $32- this jacket will step up and meet plenty of needs-dressed up/down. Not winter worthy.. but, ideal for transition weather or when you need that finishing piece for an outfit.. this is a total go to! Keep out of dryer- 100% cotton will shrink.. where it already runs smaller- be sure to only line dry! Hoping this info can help make your decision- stay safe everyone.

For reference: ordered XL for 18yr old, 6’5”, 190lb, 33x36, active but not overly athletic build- would have been fine to size up for wiggle room.

title: Missed on what matters most!
text:
For a pair of $20 socks.. stash pocket or not, I want a solid fit and quality pair for my purchase. The fact you’ll be holding some sort of weight inside the pocket tells me- the elastic and height must be adequate and able to hold sock in place.. Well, sad to say these come right up to the “flex” of lower calves so, with any physical movement they naturally want to slip down with the movement in calf muscle! Then, you add anything in the pocket- albeit cash or a key fob- and boom! Sock is soon drooping around ankle in just a few minutes!!? This in itself sort of defeats the purpose- if you have a need to stash something- most likely it means you’re active and on the go.. So, the sock must have enough height to stay upwards and enough elastin to hold it there..

Pockets are small! You can fit folded money in if done in fourths- nothing larger then a credit card or, ID. The zipper doesn’t boast reinforced integrity and I’m afraid if manipulated to fit anything besides a single item in each side.. zip may come off its track. A key fob will fit inside however, it’s too much weight to keep this sock from slipping out of place- however debit card/ID had the same outcome with almost zero weight added!!?

As for sock itself and its build through the base- it has nice compression, arch support and reinforced toe and heel.. things appreciated for comfort and physical wear/tear. This provides snug fit without causing issues with circulation.

Love the idea and had no issues with the foots fit and features. However, where this is marketed for its stash ability.. it was a bit disappointing as it’s the one place it fell short in being affective- Others may have better results with different size and stature.. Hoping this info can help make your decision- stay safe everyone!

title: Thin and stretchy- not really guy friendly!!
text:
These are interesting to say the least! They are a very thin material (a lot thinner then they appear in photos) and also highly stretchable- except for a stern 1” stiff waist band!! For some reason its all an odd combination.. These do have a string tie for a personal fit at the waistband but if ordered to your size- it wont be necessary as the waist is the only part that is a bit snug.. with the wider band, it wears a bit tighter then most would prefer in sweats- especially for pure comfort!!

Material can stretch and be stretched out! Problem is these become baggy afterwards- ie. bending at the knees can make material sag one upright again. These will easily find their shape.. but, only after the wash cycle. I find material is more conducive to a casual female stretch pants or lounge wear.. as it’s thin and pliable- something seen on women's looser style leggings! I definitely feel these pants would be most appropriate enjoyed for lounge or sleepwear- not outdoor wear!! Their very shape revealing.. ulalá!

Also note because of the relaxed fit and flow in the pants material down length of the leg and then the tight banded ankle cuff like the waist- these tend to “balloon or parachute“ at the bottom.. Hmm, sort of 80’s parachute pants style!!?

Overall, personal choices make these a possibility for some preferred styles. It’s not as if anything “wrong“ but, rather hard to find anything that feels really right..! For reference: purchased gray XL for 18yr old, 6’5”, 188lb, 33x36, active but not overly athletic build. Hoping this info may help in your decision- stay safe everyone.

title: Received wrong item- without snaps!!?
text:
Looking forward to this snap in the crotch tank top to use as a base layer under jacket/blazer for work.. unfortunately, it arrived without the built-in snap option. Due to the cut at the mid drift- it wasn’t to work standards and unfortunately unusable for ur needs!!

Just note: it appears the seller has 2 options- So, upon delivery.. be certain you get the one you’re looking for. That way any error can be addressed if necessary-

As stated we received a wider strap tank top cut at the mid drift or waist line. This fit was tighter with a minimal stretch in the spandex leaving it to feel a bit tight/small for a medium. Material is soft, all stitching and seams are finished straight and even without any loose threads. From sizing.. it appears to run a bit small so I’d suggest erring on larger vs. smaller. Bc of tighter fit- I wouldn’t hesitate to size up! Hoping this info helps your decision.. stay safe everyone!

title: Perfect for shorter gals..!!
text:
At 5’2” in heals.. yet built with a bigger bust size- I constantly struggle to get adequate fit through the chest without drowning in a sea of material bulging at the waist. Hallelujah to this champion sweatshirt- made with a shorter overall length.. and although not cropped, it sits just below the hipbone. Goodbye excess material thru the midsection.. which never need me any favors!!! This creates a sleeker/slim fit but still in a casual vibe. Nothing seer-sucking or belly showing.. IF you’re a shorter height- it is a happy medium!

Material is soft and made as expected with all the Champion quality/standards. Light weight.. this is not the reverse weave. This is ideal for transitional weather, predawn workouts or, sunburned summer nights in an A/C chilled room, etc. Without a hood- its not too heavy/bulky. Take note: this does NOT have standard kangaroo pocket- which adds to the slim streamline.. although cuts out the carryall convenience!

Sizing is ample- I found measurements to be a bit forgiving.. however, these will shrink in the wash!! So, be sure to line dry and wash on cold. After x6 wash cycles I’ve had no issue with letters lifting or any pilling- Note: I do what inside out to protect outer layer!

Overall, this is a solid sweatshirt for lighter needs and ideal for shorter women. For reference: I’m 5’2”, 150lb, 30” waist, 38C, 40+yr old and XL fit with ample room. Hoping this info can help make your decision. Stay safe everyone!

title: The perfect waterproof slide..
text:
Made for ease and comfort- two things we all want in the summer months!! I love the dual straps.. it’s just the extra support needed to keep foot and fit as expected- size is true to standard US shoe chart. I wear 8med. and these were a perfect cinderella’s slipper kind of fit!

Ordered in blush- and for any interested in the color… It’s absolutely perfect!! Exactly as it appears very light- almost not there kind of pink.. it’s very feminine and pretty. No bubblegum or, orangish tacky hue about it- they will look complementary on tanned feet.. I cant wait!

I intend for these to become my summer “go to” in leui of the standard thongs- I find these have just a bit fancier vibe then a flip flop.. all with equal or better comfort. These feel as nice as a slipper but without the excess fuzzy heat. Nothing rubs or pinches and the only downside to blush color- is marks from dirty feet! These leave a foot mark from sweat on the interior.. But good news: they are beyond easy to clean.. I’ve wiped free of foot marks with a simple Lysol handy wipe.. these can also be washed by a dab of liquid dish soap + sponge.. being plastic they dry in an instant with a paper towel and look good as new! So far I’ve had no stretching or tears.

A great warm weather option to replace standard flip flop- they’ll offer comfort and style.. for a price point under $30. Very universal as they pair up perfectly from your swimsuit to skirt, Capri, shorts.. and so on! Hopefully this info can help make your decision- stay safe everyone.

title: Comfort with added height/style- made for indoors!
text:
Reminds me of a wedged open toe sandal.. Almost too cute and comfy to be worn just as a slipper- if it weren’t for the trademark fluff! Note: these have a solid 1” platform heel that shorter peep may really appreciate- measuring 5’2” on a tall day.. I love the lift !!! Keep in mind this may be a tripping hazard for any who aren’t sure footed (be cautious with elderly.) *Height compresses as worn and after 2wks- my foot has made a deep imprint 1/4” into cushioned height.. being this is so thick it has not affected comfort in any way!

Sizing is on point and offers up a bit of forgiveness. I usually wear 8 med. See photos above.. and find this fits comfortable without heel/toe in jeopardy of hanging over the edge! Bridge across top of foot offers a comfortable fit-not too tight or loose.. One could wear hours on end without discomfort yet, have ability to keep this securely on the foot. It’s a Cinderella slipper! Safe to order your true size.

Blush pink is beautiful but will get dirty especially worn outdoors. Although rubber soled.. I don’t recommend outside use. The fluff of actual slipper wraps the sides and tucks underneath vs. rubber sole coming up sides to meet fluff! As slipper is broken in it naturally will push material downward to brush along floor. For obvious reasons- this is far better on carpet and hardwood/tile surfaces vs. outside concrete.

For under $20- it’s a fun style of slipper that makes feet look and feel so pretty! So, “if the shoe fits” your criteria.. wear it!! Hope info helps to make your decision easier- stay safe everyone.

title: Unisex and solidly made- complete quality..
text:
My 2nd Rastaclat bracelet in a year and my original is still going strong! Love the fun colors and fact these are simple to use without a clasp on/off.. nor, any worry about ruining in water. These can be worn to the pool, beach..or the moon! (with so many taking flight these days- thought I should mention that one too- ha ha..!!)

Totally universal and the wider/thicker paracord they are completely acceptable for men or women. Nothing “dainty” ..don’t expect embroidery floss bracelet- these aren’t those!! Some with smaller wrist may find these wider then expected- not bc of sizing fit.. but, thickness in the cord. I chose black, blue, white for 18yr old son.. I wear rainbow colored as 40+ yr old mom! Truly can be enjoyed by anybody-

Besides the total quality in materials and design.. the message of Rastaclat is one positivity.. “Doing good for self and others.” Something we all could embrace.. and by far my favorite feature! Sold at $25 you’ll definitely have this last for quite some time- these make a great thank you, bday, stocking stuffer, just because gift. Wouldn’t hesitate to order again in the future. Hoping this info helps your decision- stay safe everyone.

title: Makes the most of all its space!!
text:
Solidly made from a quality brand- this has a reinforced stitch on a versatile strap style bag that’s made for the minimalist!

Love the various zip compartments as it keep things organized and easily accessible.. No matter the size- Most of us want a bag you know where to find things! (I truly choose/lose a bag all by ability to keep content right where I want it!!) This feature is even more helpful in a purse with a small footprint! Fits iPhone 13 in a zipper safe pocket without issue.

However worn.. bag has outer loops to move and connect strap to- creating preferred style securely!! Loving Western Black Print offers zips, pulls and paracord accents all in mix/match colors- such a fun flair!! *By far my favorite part aesthetically..

Shoulder strap is solid + comfortable which makes it a great option for outdoor hiking and adventure. Being small- no worries you’ll weigh it down with too much excess gear! Adjustable length option is a must… allows ideal length for us shorter peeps- I’m 5’2” and this wasn’t smacking into my knee while hiking 1.7mile trail-

Overall, solid integrity and very useful/practical for the price of $25. Wouldn’t hesitate to recommend. Hoping this info can help your decision- stay safe!

title: Perfect summer option- much more then pool use!
text:
Absolutely adorable… And better yet, these will be useful for more than just water activity! Although they are completely bendable- The thick rubber sole allows for plenty of protection for day to day use.. they can be worn like a makeshift sandal!

By far the easiest childs shoe I’ve ever placed on a tiny uncooperative a little foot- ever!! I can’t think of a better endorsement than that.. Except maybe the fact- bc they’re so straight forward.. the little peeps can practically help put on their own shoes by themselves.. Boom! Mic drop and good night Salt Lake City..!!! (sure, it also means they can take them off at the wrong time too! But, I’ll take my chances..!!)

Easy adjustable velcro strap help to secure the fit over bridge of tiny feet. As for shoe sizing.. order the size your child currently wears- we did and had a solid fit. *one place you never want to size up (no matter how fast they grow..) is in sandal type shoe! little feet have enough of a job learning to walk and keep balance- no need to make a trip hazard or obstacle by ordering too big..

Rubberized bottom actually curls up in a lip around the entire base helping to create solid footing and these create amazing grip- these are perfect for playing in the yard, running errands with mom.. going to the pool or beach- The prints are bright and fun for kiddos.. made sturdy these should last an entire summer season- worth every bit of $26.. for sure. Hoping this info can help your decision- stay safe everyone.

title: Great if wanting destroyed look!
text:
What can I say… Back in the day we had to “earn” the rips/tears in our denim- somehow it was like a badge of honor that you could break in a pair- it made you cool!! Fast forward a few decades and you pay for ripped jeans..its crazy!! I know- we used to talk on the phone connected to a wall but that’s for another story..

These denims are the real deal of ripped. They’re not patched on the underside.. IF, you see a tear below that is your skin. (Some place patches so you get look but also more longevity..) these don’t have any backing on the rips- just so you’re aware.

These have ample stretch and give!! Especially with skinny jeans it’s a perk- these can semi shapeshift and move with you.. and in denim of all things! I find the stretch to be more forgiving in sizing as well- it doesn’t have to be exactly spot on to make it fit..

In-between 2 sizes we chose to size up and it was a smart move! We chose 36 knowing these had belt loops to help hold things in place. Although my son’s waist is a 34.. he likes to wear them riding lower- (ughh!) downside to the stretch- these need to be washed often to regain their shape.. these can become baggie of the knee with bending!! Of course washing ripped pants shortens the lifespan. Glad they were not more then $32-

Washing: Cold/gentle cycle and low heat or line dry to avoid shrinkage. Ordered 36 in straight black for son who’s: 18yr., 6’4”, 188lb, 34x36 active but not overly athletic build- he’s not quite filled out his man physique just yet.. Shss!!

Overall, a trendy look and one he’s happy with.. and should get plenty of use from. Hoping this info helps your decision- stay safe and hip everyone!

title: Can become a bit disheveled..
text:
First impression had me a bit concerned bc I saw how material can wrinkle into such a mess.. I know it’s one of the downsides to linen! This actually is 70% cotton and 30% flax!! (Flax is cultivating the linseed.. so, this combo may have something to do with heavy amount of wrinkling?) Either way.. this won’t be low maintenance. Something to keep in mind with your personal needs and expectations!

Purchased in L according to size chart- top fits but not quite as free flowing as photos display. If you are in between sizing.. I’d size up to ensure the free style and fit. For reference: 40+yr old, 5’2”, 151lb, 38c with trouble spot thru middle thx to x4 kids.. and gravity!!

Found out I wasn’t a fan of the oversized loose but capped sleeve.. cuff kept wanting to unroll except where the tacked stitch was. I think its the contact under the arm that causes friction to rub this to unroll- and for record.. I dont have big/heavy arms!

Washing/Upkeep: option to professionally clean is there but, for the price point of $21.. I personally chose not to invest the effort/$ to doing so. I washed on delicate cycle and line dried. DO place on hanger completely buttoned up to help regain its shape.. trust me, you’ll thank me later! As mentioned, it wrinkles so this obviously needs ironing- and this will help. My top came with a crease/bend in collar which I hoped to relax while wet/washing.. Only, I found the issue is x1 of the “shoulder to collar” seams has a twist or pull where it’s stitched together. This should be an isolated incident- but, it may be the culprit that’s helping to cause some of the messiness..??!!

Overall, there are some aspects that some may appreciate. very light and has the potential to be worn unbuttoned over a tank top so, does offer some versatility. It wasn’t the best fit/style for myself. I don’t feel price point should be any higher then it is.. hoping this info can help your decision- stay safe everyone!

title: Pants Cut/measurements feel a little confused…!!?
text:
Sold as an athletic pant these have a tapered cut that starts at leg and continues into a gathered jogger style ankle. I refer to these as confused simply bc.. the leg fit is inline with solid physical activity and wouldn’t be cumbersome or obstruct any of one’s sport. Yet, from crotch to waistband- these are a bigger, looser and bulkier fit?! It’s as if the 2 chosen measurements don’t compute with one another. IF a slim jogger pant then you don’t stop the “slim fit line and design” 2/3 of way up the pant.. For my 18yr old son- leg of pants fit him on point. He officially found out he’s not a big fan of a cuffed ankle as they tend to “parachute pant” over the material… yes! 80’s style!! But, the mid section just had too much loose and bulky room. See, a bit confused! Only way to keep pants on is the drawstring waistband..

Pockets are ample and secure with zippers- By far his favorite feature.. can fit adult size hand at a comfortable angle and also secure cell phone or ID confidently. He won’t be using for school attire as the fit is just too odd. He plans to make these a hangout, play, lounge pair. A bit unfortunate so, do be aware of the style and fit prior to ordering.

As for fabric these are a light-midweight poly. It offers stretch but not overly excessive due to its slim cut design. Not warm enough for outdoor use in winter unless you can fit base layer underneath!
Overall, I’d like to find a better universal fit that he feels more comfortable/confident with. Hoping this info helps your decision- stay safe everyone.

For reference: son is 18yr old- 6’4”, 188, 33x36. Chose XL as he usually wears in similar Adidas brand Athletic pant.

title: Solid for tween growing into “man/boy” sizes..!!
text:
Anticipated this solid white T-shirt.. as one can never have enough being they’re so universal! Ordered for my son who loves to layer a solid and decent T-shirt under an open flannel, zip up hoodie etc. This doesn’t vibe like a drug store undershirt and could be worn confidently on its own- as nothing is thin or disheveled about it! Quality construction throughout.

T-shirt has a mid-weight fabric that’s actually made in a slim fit cut.. not too clingy or seer sucking with this style- just offers a slimmer fit to eliminate the overly boxy look! I find this style ideal for young men transitioning from tween “man/teen” bodies who are in between!! If you find an adult T-shirt a tad big- a slim fit may provide a better option.

My only complaint- is the the lack of length at the waist!! This hits at belt line making it impossible to stay tucked in. For reference: 18yr old, 6’4”, 185, 33x36.. most height is in leg. He’s got an active but not overly athletic build. XL was solid everywhere but length.

title: Light as air- functional zipper pockets!!

title: Take note of waistband quirks and features..!!
text:
Excited to try this forgiving and adjustable waist on wrap around skirt.. I was hoping to personalize the fit. Ha! after x4 kids and the laws of gravity.. I was counting on this one!! Unfortunately, with a ribbon tie waist band.. you lose any support from standard elastic band. A band which I’ve come to truly appreciate in its offering 1” of belly support! This fabric ribbon has nada is support dept.. made without any batting/interfacing it creases over and actually creates a more “piled up” look right in the mid section- imagine the horror!! I may as well put neon lights around my trouble spot.. Oh, it was just not good!! For reference: 40+yr old, 5’2”, 151lb, 38C, 30x30.. carrying my extra at the waistline.

Definitely recommend for those who have a nice fit or taut, teen or smaller waistline.. One could try with a pair of spanks but- I find it defeats the light and airy feel.. So, a personal choice for you to be aware of prior to ordering.

Fabric is soft and print is beautiful- I wanted this to work so much.. Even if I tweaked waistband into looking less bulky- (and trust me I’ve been trying!) The next issue comes from the lack of weight with this thinner fabric… The wraparound slit also poses an issue bc- THIS FABRIC WANTS TO CLIMB UP FREELY!? Not weighted by any layer or built in liner it is a struggle to keep material from clinging and creeping as you move. Again, issue that may be rectified by a pair of spanks or mini slip.. options may give skirt less friction/momentum to move.. but, we’ve now come full circle to the issue of being light and airy. (it may also prove tricky to conceal a slip underneath with the full length slit.)

Although this isn’t the right item for myself.. on a different figure it may have solid results. It may be an option as a swim cover but, that’s a bit of a stretch! I love both look and feel.. even stitching appears on point- just lacks what I need personally. Hoping this info helps your decision.. stay safe everyone.

title: Great casual item that can swap out the daily T-shirt!!
text:

title: Nice quality, comfort and aesthetic’s for the price..

title: Bungee fits skinnier ankles with a snug/secure fit
text:

I find shoe runs quite standard to athletic shoe sizing. These must stay snug around ankle!! Overall.. a perfect choice for any toddler- boy/girl alike. Used in leuí of sandal but offers far more versatility and protection. Makes a great gift- for the $ you can’t go wrong.. trust me, you’ll thank me later! Hoping this info helps your decision- stay safe everyone.

title: Boxy! Misses the female curves..
text:
Wanting to like this women’s blazer I was really excited to try… it seemed like a perfect solution for dress up, business attire, interviews.. even a funeral event. The problem I incurred was getting the right fit..

Not to be “old school” and have any gender bias but a suit jacket or, blazer is more in line with men vs. women apparel.. Therefore, I feel its important that this be designed with a female figure in mind- An item made to complement the curve of the female body.. not box it in. Otherwise we end up looking like little girls who tried on their daddy’s sport coat.. drowning in a man’s jacket!! So not the look I’m after!

The issue I have is all with the fit itself.. it’s as if there is a mismatch? Ordered in large- it lacked room for real movement through chest and shoulder reach. Moved to XL and now, I have excess material throughout the entire body- feel I could fit 1.5 of me inside!? My concern for others is: i’m not very big! 5’2”, 150lb, 38C 40+yr old. who wears L or XL… With this, there was no in between.. Feels the body measurement doesn’t fit shoulders which doesn’t fit chest and so on.. creating a problem in the actual sizing at the cut!!?

As for construction: From online description we all should be aware- this isn’t a hand tailored blazer! Made casual… to be dressed up or down. The polyester fabric is what you expect for around $30-$40 price point. For me It’s very reminiscent of high school dance jacket ordered for young men only.. in the woman’s version. Which brings me to my next issue- this isn’t cut to be a flatter or silhouette the female curve, it’s far too boxy. When on, it fits like wearing a cardigan..

Realizing others may have more success with a different body type… I deducted x1 star for fit issues and x1 for it lacking the female niché. After all, that’s who it’s made for am I right..?!! Not knowing price- if sold at a “too good to pass up” price point.. one may have more success then myself! Hoping this info helps your decision- stay safe everyone.
