title: A keepsake ring- step above costume jewelry!
text:
For a casual/whimsical ring this packs a very rich statement. Of course, this ring has more important meaning to us.. Since “sunshine“ has a special meaning for us (and seems to be a term of endearment for many.) For myself and 2 daughters we have always made reference to mama = Sun.. her 2 baby girls are the rays of sunshine she produces! So this was beyond perfect to have 3 etched suns..x1 bigger in middle where ring and 2 smaller on each side.

Sized accurately.. made in whole sizes. The widest part of the band makes stacking a little difficult- but, this is actually a perfect cut for comfort when worn standard or, on the thumb! (see photo included..)

Ordered in gold- I appreciate this is a sterling silver base that’s is dipped in gold finish.. No issues to date with tarnish or skin discoloration on finger. Note: We are extra careful to remove before excessive water exposure, it’s not worn in pool or tub.. and washing hands while wearing has been without incident. *Hack: no don’t wear while using cleaners- past experience caused damage to similar ring when wearing while using Lysol wipes..

After wearing daily 24/7 (less showering..) since it’s arrival the past few weeks, I’ve noticed a few knicks/scratches in the surface along with a ever so slight distorted bend to its 360° circle. I believe that’s due to sterling silver being softer.. so, take note it’s 100% indestructible. *The thicker band does help protect this ring far more then you’d expect.

I’d categorize as a keepsake ring.. a step above costume jewelry! At a price point of $27… with proper care one can expect this to last- this is a ring any recipient I’m sure would enjoy. This can easily shine up with a polish cloth as needed over time. Hoping this info can help your decision- stay safe everyone!

title: These are the official “traveling pants!”
text:
Light weight and soft. A very flexible material fit loosely to the body.. these are non-constricting and make a solid traveling pant!! Great for road trips and airports alike, with the deep functional pockets one can secure items as needed with both, velcro and zipper security. Cell phone, car keys, boarding pass, coin wallet, etc. all can fit inside.. These are great at giving you a hands-free option while navigating your adventures!

Perks:
•Quality usable pockets provide safe keeping
•Soft/light fabric and moveable material
•Adjustable ankle bungees to create a personal fit
•Elastic waist offer forgiveness and wiggle room
•Belt adds finished touch along with help in fit
•True to size- use chart provided.

Quirks:
•Belt is permanent and can become or feel twisted
•Material is not conducive to colder climate
•Lightweight fabric.. material it does wrinkle
•Taper at ankle- leaves bungee strap excess

Overall, a solid casual style pant that is ideal for lounging and running around- it has a lot of perks for the $29 price. Best for warmer temp. and leisure or, easy on the go needs. For reference: I’m 5’2”, 154lb, 38C, 31x30, 40+ yr. with trouble spot thru middle/waist area (thx to having x4 kids and gravity..!!) Hoping this info can help your decision- stay safe everyone.

title: Love the buckle- totally on trend..
text:

We chose small messenger bag that offers x2 exterior pockets with zip closures and x2 interior bungee pockets. Options for those who like to compartmentalize items inside a purse and the I do prefer at least x1 interior pocket(s) zipped closed.

Outside pockets are a convenience for easy access and retrieval of things.. Go to items ie. cell phone, car keys, etc. are easily located. For a smaller bag this makes use of every ounce of space available.. -and a 2” width base it helps provide adequate room. (Visuals of all angles included in photos provided..)

The highlight to the bag is its unique “buckle clasp” which encompasses the exterior and functions to actually close x1 of outer pockets. I love the fun mechanism.. it’s easy to use and a style I’ve not seen before!

Branding.. hello!! This particular is a bit overboard.. (reference photos above..) Both front/back have been tagged with a 2-tone colored brand along with the shoulder strap, the zipper poles and even clasp buckle closure! Ha.. its a little much!! I will say, the strap/clasp are at least “black on black” print which is a bit more subtle and although it’s not uncommon to have a logo on the zipper pull- its usually more discrete being a symbol or initial.. Overall, a solid option with several design choices. This is a very functional bag- even with a few quirks! Hoping this info. helps your decision- stay safe everyone.

title: Bigger then standard wallet-
text:

Photos dont quite show the actual width like this has- btw, that’s with nothing inside it! If you view photo’s I included- you’ll see width along with the fact it’s a tad larger overall when stacked atop a standard trifold wallet. I include photo of 3 wallets side by side- just to show size variations.

Wallet is 100% functional used with or without the little insert.. In fact, the insert creates a mini wallet in a wallet! Just not sure why this needs x3 coin pockets.. when x1 on each would have sufficed and cut down on width..!!??

Chain nicely attaches to exterior of larger wallet. But, tell me WHY couldn’t they have made it possible to attach it to just the insert portion only as well?!! Note: you cannot use chain on interior ID wallet and still have peace of mind it’s safe and secure.. bummer!! (bummer- bc, this is exactly what I wanted to do!!!)

Overall, it is a solid wallet made with nice material and quality. Do take note it’s wider in angle that isn’t shown well online. It’s all personal preference but, I find it may be big for what many expect with mens pocket wallet. Hoping this info helps your decision- stay safe!

title: Great for college kiddos- all inclusive!
text:
Love this is an all inclusive kit including the storage bag to keep all moving parts together.. as shown in photos- I used this on dirty, stinky woven athletic running shoes and an all white casual athletic slip on.. both had seen better days- from photo you’ll notice- the foam cleaner breathed life back into both pair!!

Foam is far more manageable to use then any liquid soap I’ve tried.. it can be applied like mousse to shoe directly or, dispensed onto brush as needed -The trick to this working- is ALL IN THE BRUSH ITSELF!!! The small bristles can penetrate thru a weave or into tight knit fabric.. it also does well on crevasses or designs in rubber soles- Make tiny circular motions till shoe is covered in a thin foamy layer.. it is necessary to add a bit of water to help move the soap and spread it out across entire surface. Once clean.. Use watered down brush to dilute and dissipate the soap- then, use hand towel to blot and absorb any residual soap or excess water left over.. and finally, air dry. (I suggest NOT using dryer- it can alter glue causing permanent damage!)

4oz kit is perfect size for college kiddos in dorm- being all inclusive and of smaller scale.. this easily tucks into dorm room supplies. On the go wipes are best for spot cleaning or traveling- it’s always best to remove a stain ASAP and these will allow one to do so. Having a college athlete go is very particular about ALL her shoes/cleats.. this is a must have for her investment of footwear! I also ordered the 8oz size to have at home for family use! Everything‘s the same with the exception of an 8oz foam cleaner- Hoping this info can help your decision.. stay safe.

Only when it arrived- it appears to have a lot less bulk… But, my bigger issue was the gray ribbed material that is sewn onto the black fabric interior- it takes away this hats ability to be stretchable in any real capacity. So, for any with a larger/adult head circumference- this can cause that dreaded compression/tension headache.. Trying to wear for morning errands- I didn’t last an hour!! (Any who know the ponytail is too tight headache.. know what I’m talking about!)

Material is soft and non-irritating. Unfortunately, if you’re wanting to flip the rim upward.. this looks a bit awkward! Not bc of the 2 tone- But, bc of the variation in materials used.. trust me we tried it flipped up and it looks like beanie is on inside out! Not a lot of versatility to the style like I hoped.

If you are one of the lucky ones and this fits your head just right… The above shouldn’t be issues you encounter. However, with this being smaller in person then it appears online- I would say this is best sized for the tweens and teens- or, those that have a smaller Head circumference or are not bothered if beanie has a tighter fit. Hoping this info helps your decision.. stay safe and warm!

title: Dainty.. delicate and 100% whimsical!!
text:
What’s not to love.. this dainty sterling silver daisy ring is too sweet! If you have one who exudes a soft feminine vibe- this is perfect. (In theory this could be worn as a toe ring- But, I think edges may not wear comfortable?!)

The detail in the rings edge is created by flower petals.. and to do this, it needs a very precise and intricate cut.. Wow! They did a fantastic job. One can clearly identify shapes bc of this clean cut. So far, zero issue turning finger an unwanted shade. At a $14 price point the ring surpasses my expectations.

With an open back band.. ring allows for adjustable and personalized fit. Just be gentle when bending SS as not to over tweak! Sterling can actually get a weak point and break or shape-shift never to return to original state!! This is best suited for ring size between 6-8 (+/- half a size!) *aesthetically this is a perfect idea for children.. BUT, I feel closing the gap to fit those smaller fingers- the edges would have to overlap in order to become small enough.. (which obviously doesn’t work.)

Can’t say yet how color will wear over time..!!? Painted white petals/yellow interior- I see a protective coating over the paint.. To be safe and not damage- I would definitely remove before water activity or, using of cleaners.. In all honesty, I think with this rings detail, it would still be fun if it lacked color.. *I just mention to those who may feel different.

Overall, a great find! A fun and feminine edition for any who like the floral touch. Great gift idea or fun summer addition.. Hoping this info can help your decision- stay safe.

title: Perfect amount of stretch and still maintains shape!

title: If you want the oversized look… Size up!!
text:

Needing an oversized sweatshirt for colder pacific north west weather in September- this was NOT as I expected. Photo appears as sweatshirt material in boyfriends style cut. Only this top is more in line with a long sleeve shirt- So, be aware.. it’s not as big, thick or bulky as it may photograph! Top is also not as “oversized” as they show online.. In using chart provided on website- we chose accurately yet, the top fit more standard in sizing without the baggier effect. **IF you want the bigger/baggier- I DO recommend sizing up!! Otherwise, it can appear sloppy.. not the look I had in mind.

Material is soft enough but it’s a poly synthetic mix that I find to be of lesser quality- both, in visual appearance and wash ability.. seems to show wear and tear much faster. Material does have a slight sheen.. although effect is probably dependent on which color you chose! Wash on cooler temp. and line dry to avoid shrinkage!

For reference: ordered M for 5’6”, 126, 34b, 25x30 athletic build.. this has long enough sleeve and torso length (hits below cheeks) but, body wasn’t as bulky as shown in photograph.

Overall, if ordered sizing correctly this is a fun, gimmicky top that could be enjoyed for specific event or around the house.. title: Solid statement piece.. fun for current trends!

title: Fun with function… Im loving this!!!
text:
I’m in love…welcome to the latest craze since the lanyard..!! All that “twirling” and wearing like a badge of honor to show the world who had their license and was the coolest kid ever!! Well, here’s to natural progression.. whew!! Worn on the wrist; its a very convenient way to carry keys and do so with ease. No need to drop into bottomless backpack or purse, hand carry, overfill a pocket or, worse yet.. set down and lose them! You can also hook ring to outside of bag in leui of wearing-

Designed in the happiest colors under the sun.. these are just as colorful in person. Fun to match to outfits, purse, color of car, personality etc.. and although more feminine in the fact it’s a silicone beaded stretchy bracelet with a flashy tassel.. men can use them too- I’m just not sure they’d want too!!? (Note: tassel is removable!)

Beads are threaded onto a 5mm elastic string and permanently tied off with a knot and connection seems secure enough for the normal wear and tear.. NO!! These don’t come in sizes (not sure why?!) I’ve ordered x4 from different vendors (x1 for each set of car keys!) they all seem to measure approx. the same size with no more then a slight 1/8” variation.

The shiny “gold clasp” is a coating over metal so, it looks swanky.. but, scratches quite easy. TBH, the inverted lobster clasp is NOT the strongest.. so, I highly stress using the “jump ring” thats included but, connect it directly to the bracelet. This ensures the hinge wont break over time, keeping keys safely connected. Let the clasp be the extra flare for the tassel!

Overall- such a fun way of keeping keys on your person while adding flare!! Sold at a great price of $10 they make perfect sweet 16, thank you, stocking stuffer, just because gifts- Great to have on hand for a last minute need.. I’m certain they’ll be gladly received! Hoping this info. can help your decision- be safe!

title: Amazing..!! Softest material ever.. these are adorable!
text:
Truly the softest material ones ever felt.. these are absolutely TO. DIE. FOR..!! Not only do they turn your little one into the sweetest snuggle bug- they’re are so practical- a total hybrid pajama!! Built romper style with a 2-way zip and snap flap protection.. Let’s face it, different variations can change the temperature on our little ones- whether it’s a winter dorm outside or AC in the summer.. babies are tiny and exposed piggy toes get cold. These let you flip the rib material over the feet and know they’ll be as comfortable as can be… Peace of mind for the parents that’s for sure.

In photos above you will notice the soft as butter material (don’t mind the color yellow backs up my butter analogy!) also brings a see thru sheerness to the material.. don’t get me wrong- I love it! But, for $28 a pair and thinness such as this- I’m wondering how durable these will be? How long can they withstand washing after each use.. or, baby knees who crawl?? For us- our little one is a walker so knee issue won’t apply! I feel compelled to mention for any of those who may encounter this early wear/tear.. especially at a higher price point.

Overall- well-made and thought out infant romper. Hybrid options and quality.. sure to be a favorite in bright unisex colors!! Hoping this info can help your decision- stay safe!

title: Has some limitations.. But, can be helpful  in a move!
text:
We chose to use for a unique need… to help move our kiddo into her college dorm! Looking for an open top item that could carry all those quirky odds and ends you didn’t want/need to box up.. Something with structure, carry handles for convenience and adequate space to hold a good handful of odd shaped things and not rip.. and this worked great!!

We found this to be the perfect add-on tote for moving day!!! Easily loading 8-12 pair of women’s shoes.. just long enough to transfer them from point A to point B. Bc, it’s not boxed up and sealed.. We made quick work of emptying the load and returned to do the same maneuver with bathroom gear and even small kitchen accessories appliances! (the harder items to safely pack otherwise. It’s just the carry by hand idea but, lets you hold a lot more items!!) Although this tote is not a structurally stiff with 90° angles..NO metal/plastic structure built under the fabric- it has ability to loosely hold shape on its own. HACK: placing a few shoeboxes open style inside tote gives this a flat bottom structure! Doing this was perfect for bathroom toiletry bottles not to spill from point A to point B.. Something about physically seeing into the bag incentivizes easy and instant emptying?!!

Material is water resistant nylon that is mid weight. It has solid reinforced handles that are easy size for carry. This has both an internal zipper pocket and external zip pocket as well- Nice to throw car keys or cell phone in if you’re carrying loads and have your hands full.

Water resistant but, not waterproof… So, careful items are not ruined if bag becomes wet if left in wet conditions. *Water does seep in slowly- so, it is a bit forgiving!

Overall, a $10 purchase that helped our situation. Not as big as the IKEA tote but, it has more of a rectangle structure. This is helpful in specific needs such as ours… less of a daily pool bag option. Tote folds up in a bulky square but is easily condensed. Hoping this info can help your decision- stay safe.

title: A hybrid of two classic styles- Loving the Quality cotton!
text:
Imagine a hybrid between a regular long sleeve T-shirt and a pullover 3 button Henley.. all this topped off with a hood- and Boom! This is the outcome. By using a few tried and true shirt styles as the base this creates a unique spin while still playing it safe.. it’s just a refreshing way to switch it up a bit.

The tumbled enzyme/stone wash technique is used to break in any stiffness without wearing out material leaving the 100% cotton feeling overly soft and inviting- not to mention, this light/medium weight fabric makes the shirt a nice option for transition into fall weather. This has a streamline cut to eliminate any baggy or boxy appearance.. 2” slats at each hip let this drape naturally down the torso and easily move with you.. If, wanting a bigger oversized look/fit- order up x1 size. Otherwise, this runs true to expectations. My son normally wears an XL and this fit as such. For reference: he is- 6’4”, 186lb, 33x36, active but, not super athletic build.. 18yr. old caught between a man/boy body!

3 button collar lays nicely on the neckline (all working buttons-not just decoration!) Extra buttons are included if needed for replacement. The hood continues in the same soft material on the exterior but, interior is lined as well for added warmth… Hood can be fixed in place with a slide string tie. **BUT, I recommend either adding a knot or clipping ties together prior to wash! If not, the slick tie string will be lost and swallowed up into the abyss.. trust me on this one, you’ll thank me later! As for washing: I’d suggest doing so on cold and then, line drying. Made of 100% cotton.. you’ll want to be careful with dryer heat to avoid shrinkage!

Overall, this is a fun variation of a classic style shirt with a hybrid twist! This has an overall casual and slightly athletic vibe.. The quality of cotton and craftsmanship are inline with the price point at $29- Hoping this info. can help in your decision.. stay safe!

title: Wow! Totally cool concept.. and look/feel is crazy cool!!
text:
As a high school senior.. your kicks matter! Not my rule but, one I respect for my son!! Finding RENS brand shoes was just a happy happenstance.. and one I’m proud to have come across!! Wish there was more U.S. marketing to get the word out- As, these have a story and can back it up!

Pro’s:
•Saving the planet- huge bonus and should be given all the kudos in the world.. especially from the next generation.

•Unisex- In every sense of the word.. nothing differentiates besides x1-2 color choices.

•Waterproof and vented..

•Slips on for ease and convenience yet, holds the foot nice and snug in place.

•Lightweight! See photo above- you won’t even know they’re on your feet- Hello 4oz!

Quirks:

•A bit pricey- shoe is inline with top brand names.. these are quality shoes but, when paying higher $$ you’re also buying the famous branding this one lacks right now..

Overall, would love to see these get recognition they deserve.. They can run with the “big boys” made in the same style.. Only, these serve a greater purpose and are 100% unique! Worth the holistic investment- Now, let’s get the word out peep!! Hoping this info can help your decision- stay safe.

title: Not as flowing in person- material hangs heavier.
text:

Construction: sewn confidently with straight stitching, no loose threads, working buttons- hemline has option to be shortened/altered if necessary. Pleat’s at the drop waist create a swing when in motion. (my favorite feature.. it was most becoming!)

Fabric: this is a poly synthetic mix with spandex which offers stretch. Although this may appear light and billowy, it is far heavier then expected thru the top section down to the drop waistline. All zip and clasps feel solid and easy to open/close.. this bag definitely has potential to be a favorite if, you can fit your creature comforts inside. title: One of my best buy’s all summer.. Love it!!!
text:

title: Better for loungewear/active wear vs. athletic sports..
text:
More of a loungewear walking pant… These are a poly blend which offers ample stretch but not my favorite combo for moisture wicking capabilities.… Too much cotton in mix can cause struggle to maintain shape after wearing for a minute!! I am certain this issue is more prominent with bigger exercise rigor vs. light activity…

These are jogger style pants that gather at the ankle. For those who haven’t tried style before, these are surprisingly quite flattering and a welcomed change from the standard yoga/stretch pant! Tie waist allows for a personalized fit.. pockets are functional and can fit a cell phone or, minimal ID wallet (no they don’t zip shut!)

Material is soft on skin and I found no loose threads or flaws in stitching. Caution: blended fabric shrinks with washing! Be sure to wash on cold and line dry to avoid. IF fit is too big take note: dried on higher heat these lose 1/2” in all areas.

At a price point of $20 these pants offer plenty of use.. I find these built for enjoying not necessarily longevity. These would be ideal in a dorm setting.. perfect for sleep or loungewear and totally appropriate as cafeteria attire! Hoping this info can help your decision-

For reference: ordered small- 5’6”, 122lb, 25x30, 34B, 23yr old with her collegiate athletic frame.

title: Butter soft! If fitted correctly this will be a favorite!

Plunging V-neck isn’t too revealing- surprisingly! This has easy pullover access and ability to adjust depth with workable buttons. Looks nice paired with 16” pendant.. Has ability to be dressed up or down. Quality matches the price point at $25.. made for current trends to carry thru a season or two. No loose threads or flaws noted. Overall, a fun edition to the wardrobe. Hoping this info can help your decision- be safe!
For reference: I’m 5’2”, 154lb, 31x29, 38C, 40+ yr. old with trouble spot thru the middle (thx x4 kids and gravity..) I ordered top in XL and should have done Large- hope this provides comparable idea..

title: I’m in love and I don’t care who knows it..!!
text:
Finally a short designed to workout with you, not against you!! A pair you’ll actually look and feel flattering in while wearing! Shorter in length with a solid amount of stretch.. making them perfect for any athletic activity- nothing to get caught, bulk, or be uncomfortably in the way. How about a 5k test run in these?! Well, we did this and they were amazing- the extra panel on outer thigh is key.. it’s not only unique looking to set them apart from other shorts.. but, it provides 4 way stretch- probably a favorite feature! Tie string waist gives you the personal fit to stay secure.. And pockets are the cherry on top!

Ordered in small these fit as expected.. for reference: 5’6”, 122lb., 34B, 26x30, 23yr old collegiate athlete with athletic build- says these rival team gear in function and fit of a major brand. Yet, at a price point of $15- these are a total deal!

title: Really fun top- note: color isn’t pink.. it’s tangerine!!
text:
Frustrating when photos are so off with their color.. this isn’t a blush pink- it’s closer to tangerine!! Not an unattractive color but, definitely not what I was hoping, needing or expecting to receive.. so, be aware! Pink will be different then expected!!

Measurements provided are accurate. Ordered XL and it fit with a bit of room to spare.. for reference: I’m 5’2”, 154lb., 36C, 31 waist 40+ yr. old- sleeves are ample long and length hits below the bum cheek! Material is soft enough gauze fabric which makes it lighter weight. This can be worn fully buttoned or open style over a tank top. Dressed up/down.. softness continues with wearing in. title: Better then the “old school” lanyard.. so much fun!!
text:

title: CK’s higher standards are something I can depend on.
text:
True blue Calvin Klein underwear fans for both men and women alike. I’ve raised 2 college age daughter‘s in nothing but Calvin Klein bras and panties.. and this one is another great addition to their signature bralette which we love so much! CK’s been branching out into new designs and this is x1 of the latest. (Note: this particular bra is lightly lined however, they make this bra unlined as well..)

You’ll never find softer fabric then this bra- softer than butter- it’s amazing..!! We love CK without underwire as, they’ve single handedly perfected the shelf support system. This means using elastic a support band under the breast to provide comfort and create natural lift in both, look and feel- it’s perfect for all day comfort. Lined bras are better for my daughter who’s a 34B and unlined work best for my other who’s a 36C.. both tell me they get confidence in support and creature comfort in wearability. When CK creates a bra one can usually expect it’s available in lined/unlined option.

Known to run a tad small… I suggest if between sizes or unsure.. size up! This has adjustable back so one can loosen/tighten as needed- (btw, love that this isn’t a slip over the head like the bralette style!) This offers adjustable shoulder straps to help with amount of lift you want or need.. Oh, did I mention this was softest material ever.. !!! (well, it’s worth saying twice!) The ribbed fabric also adds non-constricting support… its a perfect balance of compression and stretchability.

Love the buff color- this is actually better under white tees then a white bra would be! This naturally blends into many skin colors, all without outlining your bra!! The only angst had was with the 1/2 seam stopping right at the nipple itself- this isn’t a dealbreaker but, be aware.. worn under tighter clothing this isn’t completely smooth. (In fact, it can accentuate the nipple itself!) A personal preference I know! Mine just choose to pair with non-constricting top!

Overall, I am a believer in all things underwear by CK- I love I can trust the brand after 2 solid decades.. At a higher price point, I know I’m buying the best quality at higher standards which translates to comfort and longevity. Hoping this info in your decision.. stay safe!

title: Loved everything.. BUT, the fit!! X1-2 sizes too small!
text:
Loved everything about these from their overall aesthetic‘s to soft material and solid construction- A solid price for what you’re receiving all around… Yep!! Everything was good except one big problem- Ugh, the sizing issue!!! Ordered an XL for one who usually wears L/XL and I’m telling you- these were wicked small!! With these already designed to be tight fitting- it was impossible to actually wiggle into the pant to try on the fit both, in width and length- such a let down and bummer..!!! For reference: 6’4”, 180lb, 33x36, a very tall slender high schooler caught between a man/boy body- so, if on the edge of any size- you may want to jump at least x1 full size.. maybe x2. All depending on how tight you want these Athletic pants. If not, you best prepare for a fit that’s inline with ladies “leggings or spandex!!”

As mentioned- these have quality construction. No loose threads or strings and looking over pant, I see nothing but nicely stitched straight hems. Material feels soft and light to mid weight. These would be great workout attire as, they hug the body close so not to interfere with your sport. Pockets adequately sized with ability to fit a cell phone.. best of all they zip shut!

The style in photographs is totally latest trends I’m certain these would be well received by any- if the fit was accurate. Hoping this invoking your decision- stay safe!

title: Great quality t-shirt- BUT, made only in men’s SMALL!!!
text:
Anticipating this shirt for the color and graphics.. it was completely unfortunate upon arrival.. Listed as “men’s size” but, not allowing you to choose a specific- it was assumed this would be universal one size fits all and large enough.. it wasn’t. Not even close!!

This is the equivalent of a men’s small or a women’s medium/large.. I have included photos to show the discrepancy measured against an adult XL T-shirt. As you can see.. there is no way anyone larger then a “men’s small” could fit into this.

As for the T-shirt itself… The color is just as great as it appears! We absolutely loved the jade and the graphic is unique however, there are two lines of script we cannot even decipher the language?!! Personally, this just added to the uniqueness! Purchased for an adult male.. this was given to my daughter who wears women’s small and it fit her perfectly!

Note: this also shrunk quite a bit in the washing cycle.. One photo over that shows pre-wash and the other post. You can see the vast difference yourself.

Sold under $10 in such a fun color… This would be a great find because it’s a quality T-shirt that feels soft and inviting. In order for this to happen the sizing issue (or, the lack there of..!!) must be addressed and listed as accurate in men’s small- either that or available in varied sizes. Hoping this info can help you with your decision- feel free to let me know!

title: Take note: blue is not as airy/icy- it’s more of robin egg hue!!!

Of course, softness adds to it’s comfort and likability… I appreciate the form of this Tee- it’s nicely cut and streamlined to the males natural contour but, it does so without being overly fitted. My favorite feature is the breast pocket… It’s a nifty little feature- it too brings up the dressy level. As for the fit, this does not offer a lot of stretch so, be sure to order accurate size and if unsure- id suggest to size up!

Wash on cold only and line dry- and be careful, this will shrink! You can steam press or dewrinkle in dryer after it’s 100% dry- trust me on this one.. otherwise, this will shrink in width and length.

Note: The blue is not icy air blue as its portrayed on monitor!! Blue has a robin egg hue- and it’s not my favorite- i hate when this happens, as this color does nothing for me.
