For reference: ordered XL for 18yr old, 6’4”, 185lb., 33x36- and size fit him as expected.

title: Tried + true rocksolid Calvin Klein- we use nothing else!
text:
100% tried + true users and believers in Calvin Klein underwear both, men/women… These boxer briefs are a standard staple in our home and this newest set doesn’t disappoint. Sold at a higher price then the unbranded bargain deals- these always pay off in their quality which translates to comfort and longevity. Our house usually has 8-12 pairs in rotation at any given time.. some reaching 2yr. mark and still going strong! I never worry about those “rogue strings” unraveling the waistband or, frays in elastic that cause an early demise.. RIP! Its nice, bc whatever tweak takes place to the latest styles- I know I can confidently expect CK standards in quality construction and fabrics.. And as the mom who does the purchasing, I appreciate that!

Made of breathable material that is soft like butter and smooth on the skin, these provide plenty of stretch to create comfort without being constricting. Yet, on the flipside- there’s the perfect balance of compression that’s made to keep all things safe and secure and stay in place without causing angst!! Sounds like a trifecta of wins in my book! Both my guys love CK waistbands! Measuring over 1” wide it provides a bit of tummy control which my husband appreciates (thx you curse of turning 50yr- life can be cruel!) My 18yr old so appreciates the “Marky Mark“ effects while he wears pants at the hip bone/drop waisted.. and the signature waistband is such a cool thing to have peek out.. ugh, whatever!! **I must mention these have a plethora of tags that must be cut- good news they give you a “cut line” to do so easy enough!

Both my guys really appreciate the fly pouch vs. the open flap.. and although these are not “shelved“ as some styles will refer to with the hefty, reinforced pouch.. I’m told this provides just enough support to give everything a specific place to be.. Hmm, I’m going with the “don’t ask, don’t tell“ philosophy on this one and just going to pass on this little tidbit for you all..!!!

Overall, these are right on point with my Calvin Klein expectations- as usual, I am happy with the purchase and will order again when needed. I hope this info can help in your decision… Stay safe!

For reference: ordered XL for both guys in our house!
X1- 6’4”, 210, 35x36 50yr old
X1- 6’4”, 185, 33x36, 18yr old
With the amount of stretch.. both with slight differences still wear the same size- these are that adaptable!

title: Solid lighter weight hoodie option- comparable photos!
text:
This is a solid and relaxed/oversized, light weight hoodie- perfect multi seasonal options. The only season it’s not ideal for is- winter.. Not enough substance to keep one winter warm! This is best for The temperamental spring, sunburns in A/C, a cold day beach coverup. and so on!

A 60/40 cotton/poly blend- with material so overly soft and inviting! Best of all this doesn’t have that synthetic sheen to its appearance.. hallelujah! That sheen makes clothing look/feel so cheap- yuck!! Kangaroo pocket is a good size.. easily holds iphone and wallet no prob! Adequate length and forgiving fit through the mid section. Although sold in men’s sizes, this is totally unisex.

Ordered XL for my 18yr. old who for reference: is 6’4”, 185lb, 33x36, active but not overly athletic build- He’s caught between a man/boy body! This fits his structure really well.. length and room in body is ample, wider sleeves skim his wrist bone- the hoodie itself has a relaxed design- it surpassed my expectations in both fit and appearance.

Care: I recommend washing on cold and line dry only!!! Doing so will avoid any unwanted shrinkage.. Life Hack: turn all hoodies inside out before washing- this helps keep material from excess pilling!! After our 5th wash cycle so far, so good.. we’ve had no pilling. Yay us! Also, hoodie string has nice end cap (photo included) however, knot strings prewash.. without it they will fit through eyelet and be gone!! Our 1st washing we lost a string but, lucky for us it was easily retrievable!

Sold at a higher price point of $35- you want solid fit and quality.. To help, I’ve included photos comparing this to an XL Champion hoodie to give a better idea in sizing. Hope this info can help you in your decision- stay safe!

title: Totally trendy- quality surpassed my expectations!b smmn
text:
Totally trendy right now… A fisherman style hat or workman's cap- a few different names for same style cap! The Gen X kids love these- mine turned 18yr. old and received his as a gift.. Pretty sure it’s not left his head since?!

Why this hat? Besides looking totally hip and cool- dare I say, even fashion forward.. ha ha!!! This is great for those who love their baseball hat worn backwards but get annoyed with the brim getting in the way in back (especially while driving if you want to put head on headrest!) This gives the same look and aesthetic’s as the reverse baseball style cap- just without the bill! Convenient way to keep hair off the face- it’s ideal for anyone growing their hair out.. even nice to throw on while driving around in a convertible. Worn like a beanie close to the head it wont allow wind under the bill giving leverage to blow off head.

This has nice mechanics with the adjustable strap… Very straightforward to use- just like one would on a baseball cap! (NO!! not a snap closure! its a slide mechanism.) Sizing seems best for tweens to adults (12yr. and up) adjusting feature eliminates compressing that causes discomfort + headache bc it’s too tight. FYI- ok for small/large heads.

Made of quality material this is solid with reinforced stitching.. the 100% cotton feels a bit like a denim but, is actually moldable and its soft lined interior gives this breathability and plenty of comfort. The permanent flipped up rim lends the cap structural support and 2 tone frays, stitching, patches all lend to give this a fun “scratch and dent..” almost weathered look about it.

Priced at $10- Quality surpassed my expectations.. it’s just a personal preference if you like this style or not. Mine did so much we’ve gone back for a 2nd color! Probably the best endorsement I can give! I hope this info can help you in your decision- Stay safe!

title: A hybrid material to look like denim but, more functionality!!
text:
Ordered for my teen son who likes the “look” of being fashion forward yet, the comfort/ease of little effort.. Ha! we have found that combo to exist in jogger pants!

The actual material with these pants is a bit different then expected.. these arrive a bit stiff and feel almost coated or treated with something? As if material needs to be broken in..?? It takes away from the aesthetics of a dressier/classy appearance- but, still liking the look!! It works bc, joggers in general have a more casual presents about them.

This has an overall relaxed cut which is a bit more forgiving for many body types and elastic waist is wider so, definitely a plus to have tie at the top of waistband! Ordered for teen who’s 17yr old, 6’4”, 33x36, 180lb., and pool active but not overly athletic build- sort of that phase- “caught in midst of a tween/man body!” The length hits nicely at his ankle.. Washing on cold and line drying 90% dry then, using dryer to soften the last bit on medium heat has kept the length without shrinkage. *Stay away from hot/high heat to avoid unwanted shrinking. For a price point under $25- these have a unique style that can prove a fun addition to one’s wardrobe! I hope this info can help you in your decision..

title: Lightweight and wearable for the different seasons!!
text:
Really like this slouch beanie because its light weight and wearable for more than just winter season.. this is a good thing when you have a teenager who wears a beanie as part of his daily ensemble 365 days a yr!! Even during summer in 100° weather -ha! I didn’t say I had a smart teenager..!!

The beanie has a solid amount of stretch which I noticed through the opening so, it allows for this to fit even the largest of heads.. and do so without causing a nasty compression headache (aka- the ponytail headache!) that’s another bonus if you have a big noggiń! In fact, the material gives plenty so it wont cause that imprint into the hairline- really nice if you like to take hat off
during the day.

Only downside I found was if you choose to roll the brim- this is lined with black material you can only flip 1” and then, fleece material hinders the process. Any who like to adjust their slouch beanie with a flip/roll keep this in mind!

Wash in machine on cold- dried on cool setting.. This washes up really well and regains it’s shape. Doing the above we noticed zero shrinkage- overall, it’s a solid multiseasonal beanie and one that is good for those who need a lot of stretch! I hope this info can help your decision- stay safe.

title: Different in person- has 3 smaller main compartments!!
text:
I really wanted to like this purse and was excited to order.. upon receiving- the material is very deceiving. Photographs show us a weathered suede look and in reality, it feels like a plastic fabric!!? It doesn’t have the marbling of color in any way- this was a let down as it was my purpose for choosing! Reason for deducting x1 star.

I find the bag itself almost feels a bit cheap.. however, the construction is very well-made. All zippers function well- The stitching and seams are reinforced and the mini pockets are very useful. My favorite is the Velcro cell phone pocket on the front! It makes for such easy in/out access- a bonus for a ringing cell phone!

The main compartment is divided into 3 separate zipper spaces.. something I don’t care for and didn’t see in any of the photos. It’s described as having various storage compartments- I assumed without a photo of inside main compartment that must be referring to all the excess pocket externally.. NoPe! I deducted a star for this issue. Purse isn’t truly wide enough for this design.. so, The separate spaces struggle to fit even have my wallet into one of them.

Overall, this may be a suitable bag for some however, I was wanting the marbled suede look with one main compartment. I love a great deal but, I want it to look classier in appearance. This could be great for anyone who likes to compartmentalize and organize every little thing in their bag- it just didn’t work well for my taste or needs. I hope this info can help your decision.. happy shopping!

title: Great for minimizing what you carry- or 1st time users!
text:
A fun wallet for the minimalist! The size is thin and small. I have an iPhone 8+ and this is just about the equivalent size to give you a relatable reference.. I like the fact, size makes it easy to grab and carry both by hand since, the 2 items match up really well!

Available in varied colors- I chose sky blue.. it adds a fun flare to an otherwise boring wallet world! This is a simple card friendly option- knowing its not meant to compete with the expensive “classy/high-end“ options, this is more of a simple solution for use “on the go” when less is more. Yet, this still feels of solid construction in both stitching and cut.

Offering 9 card slots and 2 ID options.. The outside ID is really convenient- no need to open wallet etc. to flash ID. One dislike: I’d rather just X1 side of slots be made as a “tuck pocket” for a shopping list, receipts, business cards, etc.. tiny things acquired along the way! Having a tuck pocket would make wallet all inclusive for all user.. Zip portion opens/closes easy enough but, due to size- dollar bills must be folded to fit.. NOTE: pocket isn’t big or bulgy- it’s made just to hold paper bills and any coins accumulated as change.. To access smaller coins one must unzip and tip out content to get them!

This is a fun option for minimizing what you carry.. even an option as a first use of a wallet-. It’s nice to have something specific to hold and store items organized and safely- and this does exactly that! I hope this info can help you in your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Amazing colors- fun to incorporate into your outfit!
text:
Absolutely beautiful! Ordered in orchid pink and it’s just to die for in softness and color. Everything about this is feminine from the double spaghetti straps that crisscross in the back and the soft dipped neckline. Definitely could be worn on its own- or, with a cardigan.. or opened button shirt- this is a longer drop down on the rib cage so, It fits more like a tank-bra!

This doesn’t provide strong shelf support built into the bra as it relies on holding chest in place by elastin in material and compression. Yet, somehow with the fabrics softness and thinner spaghetti style strap.. it doesn’t feel overly constricting. Not sure how- but, it may be witchcraft?! This was our experience when ordering in medium for a 36B (full size B!) for a 23yr. old with a collegiate athletic build.

This is a pullover style and no, it doesnt have an adjustable option on the straps. This bralette seems to fit a bit forgiving; if too tight or compressed one can remove inserts to create a bit of room.. On the flip side- leave these in IF, too much wiggle room is present bc the inserts do help to hold things in place! Definitely made for fashion and daily wear.. not a good or solid option for Athletic support. At $16- I find this to be a fun option in addition for sure. Hoping this info can help your decision.. feel free to let me know!

title: Fun add-on to polish off any outfit.. can be worn many ways!
text:
Received this set in a size 5.. So, I’m having to review as a midi/pinky ring- the 2 thinner styles work well in this fashion.. the Celtic knotted band would look best if placed traditionally on actual finger.. IMHO!! (Just bc of the wider width.)

All 3 designs are truly very simple- even with the full circumference design. These are cut pretty precise for the level of costume/add-on jewelry they are. I usually prefer sterling silver however, this being stainless is nice to give ring merit so, it wont misshapen so easily! Coated with a bright shiny silver… These really stand out! I wouldn’t recommend swimming/shower with these on- to help keep their shine and newness.

Described as stackable rings.. these can also hold their own just fine! Definitely, they are a fun add-on to wear and top off any outfit… Certainly not an investment piece but, a fun set that can be enjoyed just that same! I do not have a price point but would consider $12-15 to be a reasonable amount- hoping this info can help in your decision.. feel free to let me know!

title: A great set to create so many fun looks.. love it!
text:
A solid set of gold plated rings.. this is a lot of fun to mix/match and tbh, it’s a great way to mix metals!! When dabbling in both silver and gold.. adding a small subtle band of x1 color is a brilliant way to do so… It can come off very tasteful!

These have squared edges but, surprisingly… These are really comfortable. I definitely recommend you remove before lifting anything heavy- as these are thin and can misshapen quite easily.. Of course, this is to be expected over time as they’ll eventually conform to a fingers radius that’s not symmetrical- better to play it safe for longevity.

Sized from 4-9 you have so many options (I shared a few ideas we’ve done in photos above!) you can stack, add-on, knuckle or midi wear with all these sizes- there are endless options to switch it up.. I like it!

I recommend removing during excess water exposure to help preserve color and tarnish issues. Overall, a great set of rings to give plenty of options and/or, split up and share with another..
I definitely recommend without hesitation. Hoping the info. can help your decision- good luck!

title: Not the same structure as the signature CK bralette!!
text:
As a Calvin Klein loyalist- I’m a total fan and have stood behind CK’s “signature bralette” for almost 2 decades. This past year + exciting new additions have been added to the line up with material so inviting- I had to try!

Unfortunately, this one was more of a miss than, hit!! Material is truly one of the softest ever felt.. It has ample stretch that’s so inviting- but, it’s also the Achilles’ heel! Problem: it’s lacking much of any support- material has a lot of give/go so, it doesn’t compress to produce results expected with the actual purpose of wearing a bra! This does have a shelf band for lift but, compression is minimal- even with ribbed material.. it’s just not enough. As for the tag insert ha- it is sewn in iron clad!! Ive cut it to the quick.. yet, can’t remove the smallest corner without compromising the bra itself- so, this piece just irritates.. Why??!!!

Note: bra’s description is unlined! So, depending on skin color- this may just be see thru.. even in buff color. This may be a dealbreaker so, I want to mention. On a positive note- the bra is seamless and produces a silky smooth finish.. I believe it’s the intended purpose!?

Overall, this best serves those who still have their own natural lift.. any smaller chested or, those who want lazy day coverage or, a sleep in bra. Definitely not supportive for most as an everyday bra! Ordered medium for 36C and fit was as expected just lack results expected in a CK bralette. Hoping this info can help your decision.. feel free to let me know!

title: FUN way to carry keys.. it’s like a lanyard with flare!!
text:
I’m in love…welcome to the latest craze since the lanyard..!! All that “twirling” and wearing like a badge of honor to show the world who had their license and was the coolest kid ever!! Well, here’s to natural progression.. whew!! Worn on the wrist; its a very convenient way to carry keys and do so with ease. No need to drop into bottomless backpack or purse, hand carry, overfill a pocket or, worse yet.. set down and lose them! You can also hook ring to outside of bag in leui of wearing-

Designed in every color under the sun these are just as bright in person. Fun to match to outfits, purse, color of car, personality etc.. and although more feminine in the fact it’s a silicone beaded stretchy bracelet with a flashy tassel.. men can use them too- I’m just not sure they’d want too!!? (Note: tassel is removable!)

Beads are threaded onto a 5mm elastic string and permanently tied off with a knot and connection seems secure enough for the normal wear and tear.. NO!! These don’t come in sizes (not sure why?!) I’ve ordered x4 from different vendors (x1 for each set of car keys!) they all seem to measure approx. the same size with no more then a slight 1/8” variation.

The shiny “gold clasp” is a coating over metal so, it looks swanky.. but, scratches quite easy. TBH, the inverted lobster clasp is NOT the strongest.. so, I highly stress using the “jump ring” thats included but, connect it directly to the bracelet. This ensures the hinge wont break over time, keeping keys safely connected. Let the clasp be the extra flare for the tassel!

Overall- these are so fun and great for keeping keys on your person while adding flare!! Sold at a great price.. they make great sweet 16, thank you, stocking stuffer, just because gifts- Great item to have on hand for that last minute need.. I’m certain they’ll be gladly received! Hoping this info. can help your decision-

title: Solid sports bra in fit and performance.. love it!!
text:
Rock solid find.. love this breathable material- both, in the softness and quality of the fabric it’s perfect. Ha! the mesh “venting“ plays with the psyche to create a true feeling of breathable fabric.. it’s wild!! Love the moisture wicking capability and so far zero chaff/rubbing at tender points of contact on the skin! (uh.. under the arms where sport bras like to go rogue and rub your skin raw- no issue thus far..!!)

This has a decent amount of compression to do it’s job as a sports bra from any light - med.+ rigor. Ladies am I right.. x1 of the best tests for support is jogging..?! Well, this steps up to the task- we ordered a Med for 36 full-size B and this offers support thru chest not only in spandex but, also the design.. it doesn't just rely on confining elastin!! Translation: one can actually breathe while wearing and that’s such a novel concept! I would categorize this running to the size and one can rely on measurements provided.. this has washed well and purchased in the blue- it has a nice heathered look to its appearance.. putting out a hint of gray as well.
This is a solid sports bra that could be used and appreciated for fashion and function. I recommend without hesitation- I do hope this info can help your decision..

title: Calvin Klein mastered the boxer brief- and it continues!!
text:
As a true blue Calvin Klein fan of underwear both for male/female… These are similar to those purchased in the past and have never been disappointed. As the female who buys all the essentials for the men in her life.. haha! (a husband and teenage son!!) i’ve always loved the quality of fabric and above standards in attention to detail that CK provides… Yes! You do pay a higher price point when choosing this brand but, they can outlast all others.. Easily! If you purchase a 3 pack and put them into the “boxer briefs rotation” these will surpass the others a year or more down the road. This is where paying the price for quality pays off!

I’ll admit, my husband appreciates the extra “tummy support” received from the thicker (1.5”) waistband- at 50yr. old that matters a lot! He is smitten band doesn’t roll down under pressure- again, all due to quality!! My teen (unfortunately!) is part of the generation that believes wearing their pants down on the hip bone is actually cool.. So, for purely aesthetic‘s.. he too loves the bold, wide, visual waistband!! (He’s in high school what can I say.. ugh!)

Material is soft like an undershirt.. it has nice stretch to the body- wears like a boxer, hugs like a brief! And these just become softer over time.. Tags etc are eliminated so no rubbing/chaffing. The fly is sewn shut so take note if this matters- instead it’s designed with a semi pouch.. I will say, these are very flattering on- but, of course it’s a personal preference.

Overall, this is another release of the standard boxer brief that Calvin Klein mastered long ago.. we are believers in the brand and quality and have yet to be disappointed.. so of course I recommend without hesitation. I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

For reference: ordered in XL- for both men.. 36x36 and 33x36.. both fit as expected!

title: Sports bra/bralette hybrid!! (material=sport/fit=bralette!)
text:
Blown away at the price point for how absolutely pretty this is.. at $6.99 it has such fun color options- if the fit is accurate, you may want to get more then one.. I don’t think you’ll ever beat the price!! Ordered in purple/white tie-dye and this exceeded all expectations in appearance.. This is more lavender and lets just say.. Wowza!! (Makes ones sun-kissed skin look amazing!!!)

As for the fit: this tends to run a tad big and contradictory to anything said, this cannot be adjusted on the straps.. it’s the one item missing from what could be the perfect purchase and why I deducted x1 star. This is far too fashion forward to use just as an “under the shirt” bra.. it’s more of a “sports bra/bralette tank top hybrid!” Our color choice wasn’t see thru.. and found this has enough of a modest structure to its design to be a stand alone top if wanted.. I feel it’s due to the long torso.

Ordered medium (although small would have sufficed!) This has light/med support. Made of sports bra material but not as compressing- more fashion then function. In leui of using for rigorous activity it’s more in line with day to day active running around! Hoping this info can help you in your decision-

For reference: 5”6”, 127lb., 28x32, 36B- active but, not overly athletic frame.
**for the record- loved so much by my college girls.. I am officially order 4..!!

title: Über moisture wicking capabilities.. love this top!!
text:
Such a great top.. looks very sporty and on point while wearing! Made for working out and exercise activity but, this can transition nicely into “day clothes” with just one caveat… you’ll need a T-strap bra to wear with it! Knowing even then, this may show bra bc of the gaping arm openings. Don’t worry, this is done in an appropriate manner.. If that makes sense?! Top doesn’t appear shady or sexy.. it just screams athletic vibe! Besides, so many sport bras/bralettes are fashioned to be seen these days anyway- I just want to make buyer aware!

Material is soft as can be- nothing scratchy or abrasive. No point of contact that irritates the skin with any friction. It is however, completely unique in the fact this material is moisture wicking unlike any I’ve ever seen!! Any rigorous work done to produce a good sweat.. this shirt soaks it up off of the skin.. a fantastic perk for a workout! TBH, jury is still out on whether I love this or not.. when material presses against the skin afterwards it almost feels “cold” bc of moisture it’s holding in!! On these intense workouts- bringing a dry option to change into is probably a good idea and problem solved!

As for the fit: sizing is accurate. Ordered small for 5’6”, 118lb., 36B.. length hits at bottom of bum cheek.. arms gape to show about 1-2” of bra when leaning forward. **I find weight of T-strap keeps top from falling forward all the time- it sort of works as a ballast! Note: Material is thin enough to be twist-tied at the waist if so desired. Overall, it’s definitely a solid workout top that not only looks great but performs at the top of its game.. I would recommend for any with a need. I hope this info can help in your decision.. feel free to let me know!

title: Cuts out the bulk but, can leave cash vulnerable..!!
text:
Great wallet for the minimalist!! If that’s not you then, I’d say a better option may exist. Having a son in his mid-20s who spends many hours a week on a board @ the skatepark… He’s always looking for a safe way to carry his necessities in a wallet.. but, causing minimal bulk to deal with.. this wallet fits that criteria.

With an outer quick-pull pocket.. this lets a user gain easy access to their top 5-6 items, whether it’s a debit car, school ID or work access card.. this has the ability to fit an odd # of items into this pocket- (makes sense to fit 2-3 items but, not sure why so many?) I recommend you do not overfilling this pocket space- just to avoid stretching and causing cards to slip out involuntarily.

ID window is convenient and allows ones license to be in full view if needed- at least that’s so with the utah state license! This also has cutout to allow user to gain a good finger hold of ID.. The interior also provides card slots for excess plastic.. its a great place to keep medical and/or, insurance cards- any items not used often!

The only downfall we had came in way of the money clip built into the fold at mid bend.. Unfortunately, it can’t be removed- as mine hoped to eliminate the clip altogether!! (Mine who carries minimal cash wanted to just slide it into designated card slot.) He doesn’t appreciate how ones cash is exposed every time you open the wallet.. If not careful; at worst this could be a bit pretentious in certain undesirable situations.. or, with this expose each time one opens wallet.. it could cause bills to become loose and fall out.. (yes! we knew it had the clip when purchased- just thought it could be removed if needed..)

Overall, this is made sturdy with durable leather and in a great color! In order to stay slim this isn’t overly built with major reinforcement. So, for the price point it levels up but, I’m guessing.. it will also be up for replacing as wear/tear takes place- For under $20.. one can definitely get there $ worth from this! I sure hope this info can help in your decision-

title: Lightweight! Great seasonal pullover to use/abuse..!!
text:
Ordered in XL white- I wanted to use for a warmer weather pullover.. those sunburn summers after boating, etc.! This meets that thinner criteria and with its unfinished edges, it gives this a nice chić summer vibe! However, the thinner material does lack that “extra” softness we all crave and expect.. I’m hoping over time this just gets softer with wash and wear!!

If you’re looking for a relaxed pullover appearance that’s full of creature comfort.. I recommend sizing up- and I’d also refrain from using anything but, cold wash cycle and line drying- just to avoid any shrinkage!! (being a cotton/poly mix- I wouldn’t take any chances!)

This technically fits everywhere but, without any stretch in the fabric… This tends to get a little twisted, its as if it doesn’t have the ability to naturally move with the body- I notice this most down the arm and around the forearm. Not a dealbreaker but, something I feel I must mention.

Overall, being at a lower price point.. it does feel a little less than substantial in all the higher qualities. Having said that, I was actually looking for a thinner, unfinished, minimal effort pullover that I could use during the season for sunburn nights- without worry of wear/tear while off camping or boating! So, this is a pleasant surprise that actually met my needs and with the 2 tone hood and highly functional kangaroo pocket.. it has been a fun and functional addition!! I hope the temple can help you in your decision.. feel free to let me know!
**For reference: I’m 5’2”, 154lb, 38C, 31x30, 40+ yr. old with my trouble spot thru middle/waist area (all thx to my x4 kids and gravity..!!)

title: Finally- an aviator made in a women’s size!!
text:
Finally!! A throwback to the 80’s fad of the aviator sunglasses but, one that is actually sized for the female.. and it’s amazing!! I am loving these are designed for smaller facial features- keeping the user from looking like a flying wasp! These eliminate the bug eye vibe that usually covers half the users face when sold in “unisex sizing!” I appreciate the refined and thinner circular angles of the lens which definitely help those of us with fuller/rounder facial features! I’m telling you- this is total spot on hit for those who can’t find what shape is best for a rounder face.. it’s crazy!! (In this same sunglass hunt- We also found a rectangular shape works well..)

Ordered in the pink and gold… These leave the eye fully transparent through the lens which I prefer but, that is a personal preference- (so just take note: the pink is transparent..) these do have a layer of UV protection for the eye- so, I find them to be the best of both worlds! Little extra perk.. with the lighter tint- these can be worn earlier and longer.. ha!!

The overall mechanics of the glasses are as expected for the price point of $15. Definitely say these are a step up from any quick add-on grab at the checkout counter of your favorite clothing chain! As far as symmetry and balance… These are 97% on the mark! (see photo included- x1 arm is ever so slightly off the counter when both should be touching.. but, it isn’t noticeable while wearing and not a dealbreaker.) all hinges are fastened tight and glasses stay in place while wearing.. Save the matchbox style box you will receive (photo to show how great it is!) This will protect glasses in backpack, purse, car, traveling, etc.. it’s perfect!! You receive a soft bag as well for those who prefer- so, all the bases are covered! Overall a great find in style and quality for the price- I hope this info can help your decision.. feel free to let me know!

title: Super comfortable + stylish!! Missing filter pocket..!!
text:
A solid four set of masks at a 4 star rating… these are something I’m sure intended for Covid protection but, come without a filter pocket- I deducted a star!! I had too.. We need filter pocket options in order to combat the spread of covid-19. I realize with any masks- claims have to be very carefully stated or even avoided when advertising.. and therefore, it does no such thing! But, everyone shopping for a mask the past 18 months, I believe have the same agenda in mind! We need more then a pretty mask- we also need the safest options to stay protected..

Moving forward with the mask mandate lifting.. (some places masks have even become obsolete- like my home state!) There are still situations that exist requiring a mask bc of the inability to know who else has followed vaccination orders. This mask may be a good choice if: not in close proximity to any with flu like symptoms, user has both vaccination on board.. and social distancing can be respected.

This mask is larger than most providing FULL facial coverage over nose and mouth so, these areas are fully covered from external exposure.. and this is on an adult face!! Due to the larger size- these wouldn’t be a good fit for children.. I’d recommend these fit the young adult if larger facial features and up. I do appreciate the slide mechanism that allows for a more customized fit- surprisingly, these are not uncomfortable on the ear bc, the mechanism is made of a softer rubberized material and not hard plastic!! (Note: these are large enough to cover the standard disposable mask giving you a prettier and more fashionable look- and the protection needed for safety… just so you know!)

Material is really soft.. and has matching elastic so, entire mask is truly all one color! The earthy, monochromatic tones are very universal… These are unisex however, softer/silky material does give a bit of feminine vibe. From photos shown- you can see up close the materials solid exterior with mesh breathable interior.. making these most comfortable to wear for a longer period of time!

Overall, this is not the strongest line of defense against the Covid vaccine.. yet, they do provide a very comfortable layer of informal protection and can also be used against other variants we come in contact with. Hopefully this info can help you in your decision- stay safe!

title: Best material ever- just be aware of waistband..!!!
text:
I’m in love with this material and quality of these shorts!! Top that off with a price point of under $20 and you have a trifecta of fabulous…!! Woot-Woo!!!

IF, these are so stinking awesome why not 5 stars?? Simply because the waistband is 1.5” tall of an “industrial elastic!?” Or, maybe it’s just elastic where there isn’t the appropriate or expected amount of stretch when it comes to wearing these with a relaxing and comfortable fit!! Yes! They will help with tummy control- however, if they feel constricting and borderline uncomfortable around the waist.. it’s sort of defeats the purpose! I appreciate everything about the shorts from construction to the material used.. and even the details in finishing work. I just I want elastic that has some give!! I realize this is only going to be an issue for those who are packing a little excess around the middle and unfortunately, that’s me. So, take note: these fit everywhere as expected with stretch- just as you would hope.. except the waistband!!! If a fuller waistline is not an issue then, you just hit the motherload of an awesome pair of shorts- and you’ll love them!

The reason for deducting x1 star is due to the fact, I DID follow measurements posted on the website and actually took a specific measurement to be certain my sizing choice was accurate.. with a 2” window, I felt I couldn’t miss. However, I found the pair I received to be 1” smaller then what is listed for the waist size… TBH, I feel this wouldn’t or, shouldn’t be an issue IF only the elastic had any give.. So, take this into account when ordering.

Ordered XXL- For reference: I’m 5’2”, 154lb, 38C, 32x30, 40+ yr. old with excess thru the mid/waist section (thank you to my x4 kids and gravity.. ugh!) Hopefully this provides solid info for you to compare! I hope the above can help you in your decision..

title: Very fun and colorful.. keeps a wallet organized!!
text:
WoW..!! For $10- I’m absolutely surprised to find this is such a handy, well thought out, and nicely constructed little unit.. Color me impressed! Oohh.. Speaking of color, the options ARE so much fun.. we chose rose gold- aka: blush! I am loving the fact these can be mixed/matched with any purse or ensemble.. bc, there is no “rule” that says- wallets must be black, brown, white.. ha!! I love the colors!

This is a great find for those who are deliberate with their wallet and content.. everything has its place. No room for anything else- not even a hidden “tuck under” pocket.. But, what this does have is a “filing system” for your cards! It holds nothing back in that department.. I love ample slots for cards, don’t get me wrong- but, really 14…?!! I think I’d rather have just one of the 4 sides be a slit, tuck or flap pocket for receipts- even then, this would still allow for ample card slots.. but, You would have a more practical day to day working wallet option- or, at least offer a little variation of the options to reach more users. This was my reason for deducting x1 star. Using it about 2wks. now.. this is the one shortcoming I found in the design- I want a place to put a receipt or a business card and not stick it in my pocket which only becomes lost!

I do love the sleek size- it’s actually compatible measurements to the iPhone 8+ making the 2 very easy to carry in my hand when running a quick errand without my purse.. these stack nicely atop each other with no added bulk!

For The price point I find this to have solid enough craftsmanship to withstand a bit of wear in tear. Being synthetic, it can wipe down easily and not cause any damage. Definitely stronger construction than I was even expecting. The zipper pocket holds both coin and paper money if folded- it isn’t overly big so if a fan of “old-school“ currency… just note, this would have to be folded in order to fit inside the pocket-which of course, makes removing cash from Wallet necessary in order to see/use. (i’m guessing with all the card slots most users prefer plastic and won’t mind!)

Overall, this is a solid option and a great price for anyone looking to minimize and organize wallet content. The fun colors make it worth it’s view idiosyncrasies and shortcomings! I hope this info can help in your decision…

title: Nice top- do take note of the line thru the middle!!
text:
A fun summer tank top made from a soft, inviting fabric that actually has a nice amount of stretch. If using measurements found on the webpage one can expect a fit that isn’t sloppy or disheveled in appearance nor, will it be too tight and constricting …it is a good happy medium! Just follow the measurements provided- I found them accurate!

Ordered in cream … and don’t be fooled by the word choice. This color appears to have warmer tones (blush/apricot) mixed into making a more buttery wheat color- its not as it appears in photos bc, it lacks the marled (sometimes referred to as oatmeal) fabric look you see in photo!! I included photo of fabric appearance to show actual item.

Stitching and construction seems on point. Made without sloppy finishings or loose threads- **BUT, do take note: This has a seam that runs right up the front of the tank top- just like the photo shows!! Problem is, there isn’t a seam running up the back!!?? So, when wearing… I had multiple people tell me my top was on backwards- facts!! I’ll be honest, I wasn’t certain if I did or not! When putting on the top, I was truly confused. There is no tag/marking in the top itself.. nothing to show front/back- I had to go back and look at photo! (With the flowing cut this might be getting worn backwards by some? And that’s causing it took fit awkward for some.. Just a thought?!) I took photos showing the natural neckline and this does have a front and back and line is up the front!!! I mention in case this feels awkward for some.

Overall, its a bit higher price point for a tank top that appears a bit different from photos- having said that, it could certainly be one people like.. just note the differences. I hope this info can help you make your decision- ordered in XL. For reference: I’m 5’2”, 154lb, 38C, 40+ yr. old with a trouble spot thru the mid/waist (thx to my x4 kids and gravity..) My chest measurement is 42” and therefore, I paired that # with measurements provided.

title: 80’s flashback! Loved the retro look and vibe!!!
text:
Welcome back to the 80’s and the decade that was owned by “Marithe Francois Girbaud” aka Girbaud jeans and shorts.. for any familiar- you know these were the bomb!! For those unfamiliar.. these were worn baggier (welcome to the beginnings of bagging your pants..!!) these of course are the short style!! Just like Girbaud’s summer line.. it’s truly a total flashback!

Ordered in x36.. they fit as expected! The loose fit is just that- loose! These have a baggier fit all throughout- waist, thigh and leg.. these are definitely a relaxed style of shorts. Created to resemble the standard 5 pocket denim jean- they have a lighter weave but, aesthetically look the part of “cut-off jeans!” all pockets function and these have belt loops.. Which is a good thing bc, you should plan on needing a belt for sure! For reference: ordered for my husband who’s 6’4”, 205lb., 35x36.. we chose 36 to insure the fit. The fact he was in his 20yr old prime decade during the 80’s… and he loved everything about these the 1st time around.. ohh, the power of nostalgia!!

As for care- wash on cold with similar colors.. these did bleed a tiny bit the first few washes. Bc, of roomier fit- we machine dried on warm and had no issue with shrinkage! So, it’s something to keep in mind if ordering.. do your best to get your exact match in size- bc, they won’t shrink near enough to change sizing.. Ohh, and no need to size up! Shorts have same aesthetic’s as a pair of denim jeans.. just simply at a shorter length! Im told these are comfortable and expect the more wash/wear.. the more that keeps improving.

Made with attention to detail I appreciate the solid product and feel if you’ve worn and/or, like the look of denim shorts these are a great option! I hope this info can help your decision.. feel free to let me know!

title: Perfect defense against sun- love the childproof strap!
text:
Such a sweet sunhat for your little one.. different patterns make this unisex 100%. We chose this style heading into summer with a 11 mo. old for a little boy who doesn’t like to keep hats of any sort on his sweet little head..

Ha! The dual bungee straps are so helpful and an absolute must- at least for us!!! x1 under chin and x1 to perform like a bandana around circumference of the head. The bungee around the head is SOO helpful to eliminate this coming right back off by your child's doing! For obvious reasons.. it doesn’t need to be cinched overly tight- just a snug enough fit that confirms its holding.. Then, you double fix the under chin strap and you’re good to go!

Sure, babe may grab hold and try to maneuver this off their head- but, with the 2 part defense.. you’ll stand a better chance- trust me!! Note: I found once secured, grabbing onto babies hands and while holding them, distract by something in the complete opposite direction! ie, splash in the water for them to try and mimic- or, hand them a toy to hold with both hands. Doing this even a few seconds can truly get them to forget something is on their head at all!! (No! It’s not full proof but, doing x1-2 they will tire from grabbing at the hat.. especially if there’s something much more exciting to entertain them!)

The hat itself is lightweight, made of a comfortable and durable fabric. Seams are lined to eliminate any potential sore spots. Under chin strap is of the softest nylon.. and the breathable design helps keep head from overheating. Hat can get wet without worry- In fact, this became a game with our little one.. after we got it wet to cool him, he loved putting on the wet hat over and over.. ha ha!! This dries within minutes in the warm sun.. it’s just that light! Tbh, I haven’t done so but it says machine washable. I chose to hand-wash as it was just too easy.. no bleeding of bright colors. Nor, any fading thus far in chlorinated water.

Ordered in 12-24 month.. I’m loving the fact, I can loosen bungee as he grows- giving longevity and maybe a 2nd season of use!? A rare find in any baby item!! At a price point of $10- this is too perfect of a deal.. and a necessity to have as it helps keep baby safe in direct sunlight.. win, win all the way around! I’d recommend without any hesitation. I hope this info can help in your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Timeless classic.. tote style option was a solid for us!
text:
After seeing some had issue with this bag.. I was a tiny bit skeptical of what to expect. However, with there being 9 styles- I’m thinking maybe that must play a part to the outcome!? Simply because, I absolutely love the tote bag… It exceeded my expectations with zero issues or complaints!

We ordered the large tote/bookbag- and it’s every bit the style I was hoping and expecting it to be!! This is a true timeless classic. With 2 longer shoulder straps and a zip top opening (think old school book bag made of cloth with open top!!) With a taller and thinner body and added weight of shoulder straps note this naturally slouches- I’m sure it will continue to do so even more over time.. which I find just adds to its vintage look. Take note- content inside this bag is necessary to help this style bag keep its shape.

Ordered for my niece graduating PA school in August.. Becoming a professional but, not needing any “official briefcase..” this style bag is absolutely perfect! Riding a train to work… this offers easy in/out of items and is large enough to carry an extra change of clothes, along with any charts or paperwork. Wearing scrubs to hospital for her 12 hour shift, she tends to hit gym after work.. this will be ideal to take both her necessities and extra clothing if needed. Note: this is large enough to fit a laptop but, does NOT have built-in sleeve.. I do suggest investing in a protective sleeve for added safety if carrying inside the tote.

Outer pocket is perfect placement for transit card and cell phone- keeps it handy for easy access. This bag can also be used in leui of a purse and inside zip pocket can keep wallet + keys in a safe and in easy “go to” spot.. the body is sized enough in length/width to add your extras and I love they can be zipped closed to keep ones things securely inside.
All seams and straps have reinforced stitching and the leather feels smooth and soft to the touch.. no smell present from time of arrival and with this bags wipeable ability to keep clean.. Whats not to love?!! At a price point of $36- I anticipate this just get better over time and I’m hoping it will do just that! Hoping this info. lends help from sharing our experience-

title: Old school charm and quality!!
text:
Modern style meets a total classic!! This is an old school style boat neck on the top through the shoulders and neckline with a trendier boxy middle that pulls itself in to be quite fitted at the waist line with a cuffed trim! Made of solid a “true blue” navy which color runs deep in this blend of cotton fabric and I love the material btw.. it too is old-school in the fact, it’s made without unknown synthetics in the mix.. this is a true cotton/poly blend!! For any unfamiliar with 75/25 fabric- it translates to a heavier weighted material. Again, old school charm.. as sweatshirts were once made for the purpose to use in colder temps (imagine that!) and this type of blend is what made them warm and cozy!! This has a comfort and softness that’s truly inviting..

All quality stitching and finishing detail is present as you would expect for this price point. If spending $40 on a sweatshirt, I want this to have the needed substance to go the distance for seasons to come.. this boasts just that! This was made without cutting any corners and backs up the price you are paying. After washing 6+ already.. there are no signs of pilling- it looks brand new still! Albeit, I always wash sweatshirts inside out for this very reason. I recommend washing with darks to avoid any bleeding.. Ive not noticed an issue but, I’ve also washed with like colors on cold! I line dry to avoid shrinkage- especially at the waistline.

Fit: this runs true to size everywhere but the waistband- ugh!! So, for any with a trouble spot through the middle… This may pose a bit of a problem?! Ordered in XL where its perfectly fitted through the body length, chest, shoulders and sleeves- the only misfit is the gathered waistband!! For reference: I’m 5’2”, 154lb, 38C, 32x28, 40+ yr. old with bigger then should waistline (thx to my x4 kids and gravity..) Hoping this can provide solid info to compare. My ONLY reason for deducting x1 is the fit issue. A womens XL usually accommodates a 32” waist- if not, it isn’t helping those who need an XL size!!

Overall, this sweatshirt has high quality written all over it! Just the x1 angst with the fit.. and yet- I still love it! I’ve made two cuts into the band to eliminate the issue.. because I love it that much!! Hope this info. can help your decision- if ordering, enjoy it!

title: Perfect for extra protection from just the sun!!
text:
A perfect option for a little ones first experience into the water.. pool or beach! I love the “semi-full” protection this offers their delicate skin. Not only does it provide more coverage from sunburn but- it also lends protection to any rubbing or chafing caused by pool floats, life jackets.. or, climbing out on the edge of the pool itself. Our little one wanted to hug the edge/wall.. and this suit protected his belly from scrapes while doing so!

For reference: our user is 12mo old 19lb. who’s in 65% for height. Ordered in a size 1-2T and this fit quite well regardless of the x1 year span in sizing! With its stretchable spandex (aka- swimsuit material) the leg/arm openings fit with plenty of stretch left- lending confidence this will be adequate in size to take him through to the next year.. a total bonus since babies always grow out of everything so fast! The mock turtleneck collar was a bit of an awkward fit.. with the weight of the zipper- it seems to pull this down a bit and not stay upright in place as intended. I’m assuming bc he’s at the smaller end of the 1-2T sizing his neck wasn’t substantial enough to tighten the material?! Not a deal breaker but, might matter to some. Tbh, Our little guy didn’t mind the loose fit!

*Zipper up the spine is designed wetsuit style and makes for easy on/off access.. that is IF, one can lend assistance when child needs to use the restroom. For older kiddos (in the 5-6T sizes!) this may prove a bit difficult for them on their own.. The zipper most likely needs a helper to undo.

Overall, a great find for any wanting a bit more coverage than the average swimsuit has for their little one. For a price point of $15- this is a solid deal! All seams and stitching are on point and finishing details are present without loose threads.
I recommend without hesitation- hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Great brand- thinner material- styled more for girls!!
text:
I’ve enjoyed a few different styles and variations of clothing from Zanie Kids the past few months and since my interactions with them the consensus is: positive and happily impressed! However, liking a brand doesn’t mean they hit the mark 100% of the time and TBH, this was one of those items that missed for me. In full disclosure this was ordered for 10 months old boy- Although it describes romper as unisex with some of the prints.. The balloon sleeve was a no go! With the tuck and pleat gathered seam.. these are very sweet and look every bit the part for little girls- not so much for boys!

specifically looking for something lightweight I was anticipating this could meet our needs.. only material is quite thin with a stiff feeling- not soft as cotton usually is, especially for infants.. almost feels as if material has been treated? In photo included- held to light, you clearly can see my entire hand inside of the romper. I imagine this will soften up over washing and Could be a fun romper for little girls if so!

All attention to details is there in stitching and finishing and something I find universal on all of their items- it’s what draws me back to the brand. The snap front is a fun detail to give this a bit of flair- But, the reinforced 4 snap crotch gives one easy diaper access for changing.. (those x4 snaps are the only needed to open when changing baby!) the Zanie Kids brand is good this way- they make Smart, well thought out and practical designs.

Although I won’t be using this romper for our little guy- I see where it has merit + a few shortcomings. If ordering, I recommend doing for a girl (if sleeve style feels feminine to you!) If between sizes- order up! These tend to have shrinkage- it’s minimal but, all over.. Plus, the fact this style romper can be worn a bit looser without looking sloppy- it’s worth going bigger vs. smaller, you’ll get more mileage for sure!

I hope this info can help your decision.. feel free to let me know! Sizing for reference: we ordered 18-24mo. for little guy turning x1yr who weighs 21lb. He is in 65% for height and this romper fit him with little room to spare!

title: No excess tummy control with wider waistband!!
text:
A solid pair of athletic shorts built with a yoga waistband top- a combo I’ve never tried but, why not! My thought was focused on the excess tummy control being one who could use it! But the reality was different.. although this appears to be a solid 1.5” of extra support, it’s not! This is in appearance only.. as the 1.5” is just stretchable material and only at the very top of the waist an elastic sits no more than 1/4” wide. (The kind that tends to twist as time goes on simply bc, it has 1.5” of space to flip over!!) TBH, this band almost makes my waist appear larger- which not what I was wanting! *Something to keep in mind if the tummy/waist line is your trouble spot!! For those without a midsection issue- I don’t see this an issue and these would prob. look and fit much more flattering..

I found measurements to be accurate as listed in the description and shorts fit as expected in sizing.. they just neglected to fill my hopeful wish of tummy control/support! I realize- it’s something I assumed when visually seeing the design..!! For reference I ordered XL in black- I’m 5’2”, 154lb, 38C, 40+ yr. old with trouble spot thru the middle (thx to both my x4 kids and gravity..) hopefully this can provide solid info to compare.

As for the fit through hips and thighs.. I have no complaints, these are loose enough for movement not saggy or baggy- and nothing overly tight fitting. These are a nice, modest length and cover all the places you want while leaving you the freedom to still move around. Material is made with some stretch capacity but nothing tight like spandex- stitching and seams are on point with no loose threads. Best perk of all are the zippered pockets!! With a flap like covering the outer appearance is still nice and neat but, items zipped inside pockets lends the user peace of mind to their security. I hope this info can help your decision.. feel free to let me know!

title: Solid pair of sweatpants with trendy tapered cut!
text:
WOW!! A solid pair of sweatpants If there ever was one… Made from heavier weighted cotton, these have substance no doubt about it- nothing cheap or synthetic by any means.. which I expect nothing less with CK brand! TBH, the price point is marked as such, all for the designer quality..

Purchased for my 17yr. old stuck in a man’s body… We chose the black XL and they fit his 6’4”, 185lb., 33x36, active but not excess bulky frame quite well. Glad these do have a tie string at the waist to gain a personal fit.. My son is mostly legs with a slender waist. At 17yr. he loves the jogger style.. in fact, it’s a requirement! So, if worried about the length just know- these can be a bit forgiving since joggers are cuffed at the ankle and can be worn 1-2” shorter without looking like “floods!” for any parents needing teenage approved sweatpants- these will fit the bill.. The tapered fit begins subtlety at the thigh and continues evenly down the leg to the cuffed ankle- although these are cut/style perfectly for looking hip in gym class.. I feel the weight of the material is not conducive to active exercising, as I’m afraid they would create too much heat and bulk.

Pockets are deep! These hold keys/cellphone and have perfect hand placement but, take note- they do not zip closed!

These are a perfect pair of sweatpants for casual day at its finest… Ha! The sheer quality will actually kick casual day up a notch! Mine used for regular school attire- paired with a hoodie and they were perfect.. he looked almost better dressed then those in “real” clothes.. note: we did end up calling him sporty spice for the day but, the teasing is optional!! Yes, these are “those kind of sweatpants” very upscale and trendy! These are perfect for weekends and lounging around and best part of all, as I’ve found with most CK attire.. it will last for years to come.

Careful to wash with dark colors ONLY and do so, inside out to avoid any pilling.. we chose to 50/50 line/machine dry and had zero shrinkage. These are such a quality and soft material- you get what you pay for. I hope this info can help in making your decision.. I recommend for anyone looking for a solid, in trend cut who are wanting quality above all else.

title: Subtle statement to show unwavering support..
text:
Such an amazing way to show support and pride for the GTBL community.. and hoorah! I am so proud to do so!! I love the fact it creates a “subtle or secret symbol“ letting even a total stranger know that you are an ally and they have your love and support.

As a parent who is new to this subject on a personal level- I had never given it much thought. But, I cannot tell you the deep need for endless love and understanding of all, for all.. by all. This is a way to show just that- No! It doesn’t make you gay, it doesn’t even mean these may be your own personal belief, it doesn’t translate to you looking for other gays in the crowd nor, does it say you have all the answers.. But, what it does say to the world; is that you have a capacity to accept, to not judge with arrogance, ignorance or opinions and that you DO have a capacity to love others unconditionally.. Yep!! It says all that symbolically twisted into a string message...!!!

Bracelet is such a fun bright addition that is made unisex and can be enjoyed by any. With a wider width it is more then size appropriate for men and tbh, I wish there was a smaller (thinner width) version for women.. but, it’s not a dealbreaker. This uses a slipknot so it can be put on and fastened into place one-handed and tighten/loosen and even removed as needed. ** to keep vibrant color, I suggest not wearing while swimming and to clean the white.. use a dab of clear liquid soap and just give a little scrub then rinse thoroughly and air dry.

As for the fit.. my card states it’s a medium/large however, choosing a size was not an option. This would be most helpful for the company to add options- if not, always error on the side a bigger!! For such a great cause and to be more universal to all who want to purchase- a few varied sizes would be amazing!

I recommend for the simple reason- The company supports the cause and this is a true blue way to show your similar support. As for the quality of the bracelet and its integrity.. it’s there in spades. But, those who purchase should understand the higher price point is for the nonprofit and worthy cause.
I hope this info may help make your decision.. and remember- The world needs more love!

title: A trifecta in a sports bra- compression, support, lift!!
text:
Wow!! Sports bra designed to do more than just compress.. what a novel concept! This provides all the expected compression and so much more- as it has been rethought and designed in an intelligent way.. Hmm, probably designed by a woman?!!
Compression holds but, it can lack support and lift- two of the things we want and expect from a bra sports or otherwise..!! With this new tweaked design you are getting a trifecta of goodness- compression, lift, support.. Boom- mic. drop!!

If you look at the photo included of the back straps, these pull together and connect giving added support. Then, if you notice the bottom structure- it provides a shelf to lend lift.. it’s like Christmas morning in a bra!! The fact you can adjust the circumference to provide a personal fit.. is the sprinkles on top!

Ordered/modeled in a size medium (chose and received a true navy) for a 20yr old who is a 36C.. we found this to fit quite perfect. No excess spillage out the sides or top and yet, her favorite feature is the fact that she can breathe without feeling constricted- breath.. ha! A novel concept I know! Overall, this is just been amazing!!!

The only reason to deduct a star is the effort to get into this! With the straps sewn together- it makes for a bit of a struggle. I understand the necessity to create these straps connected but, it seems using another set of hook/eye attachments could have eliminated this issue.. Even so, this is worth the wiggling to get in it bc, the effects of the trade-off are so great! It’s just worth mentioning for any who may not realize this are permanently connected.

Would definitely order again without hesitation. I hope this info can help in your decision… Feel free to let Know!

title: Fun jeans.. but, probably not daily denims!
text:
Wow! These are skinny jeans!!! For any in the market I would suggest sizing up. These offer stretch but they seem to start off with a smaller frame and overall measurement. Take note: these most likely will not be the users every day “go to” denim jeans per sé but, these are great for a fun outing, special occasion or just switching things up.. I say that because they do take a little bit of effort to wear and don’t come with the creature comforts of the normal relaxed and lived in denims! Although a bit more eclectic in style… For being skinny jeans I’m told they’re actually quite comfortable-

Bought these for my 17-year-old son who usually prefers jogger style pants so, he’s already custom to a slimmer/skinnier fit. For reference: he is- 6’4”, 182lb, 33x36, active but, not super athletic build.. 17yr old caught between a man/boy body in any bulk! We actually chose XXL which seemed crazy but, I’m grateful we did! With his longer leg these hit at the ankle. Thru the thigh and leg- he has no excess material or, gaping. The waist has approx. 1.25” excess space but, teens love this (and it still baffles me??!) all so they can wear their pants drop waisted- ugh! Mine does need a belt to keep these in place (lowered or not.) ordering in XXL is 1 size bigger then normal.

I suggest washing on cold and line drying at least 90% of the way.. The last 10% i did use low heat in my dryer- just so to regain elastin tightness and shape. I took photo of an XL Adidas jogger pants to compared to XXL denims- notice.. these are pretty comfortable to each other in size. To give you some idea of the stretch- we get 2 wears out of these before needing to wash again to regain shape.

For an overall fun and different pair of denims in the pant repertoire.. these are a welcomed addition and if priced appropriate ($30+/-) these should not disappoint! I hope this info. can help in your decision.. feel free to let me know!

title: Great find for warmer months- thinner no show sock!
text:
A great sock made for the upcoming summer or warmer climates… Low cut/no-show style- this is all but visually obsolete, so be certain you prefer the look of NO sock top showing!

Made with an impressive amount of stretch and unlike some brands… This can encompass a longer narrow foot just fine. In fact, I find this material to provide more give then most others I’ve owned. I think we all know of that “sock struggle frustration..” after washing, some socks don’t keep that initial stretch? Soon you become a character from the Cinderella story trying to shove your foot inside an impossible fit?? Ha! these WON’T cause that same angst- I credit that to the material used...

Take note: material is light weight and thin yet, still surprisingly comfortable- especially when used with a solid Athletic shoe. The thinner material is a”a perk in warmer climates.. it actually helps the moisture wicking process. These will provide a slight compression to hug the foot and not gape or become loose.. which is totally necessary when running!!

A few obstacles I foresee: thinner material may tend to wear out quicker at its pressure points.. (for us that is the heel/big toe!) although so far, we’ve had no issues after using almost a month- But, I just want to mention. Total truth, for a price point of 5 pair for $12- I still find it totally respectable if these were to last thru x1-2 seasons of use.. the value is still there simply bc of price point and the comfort one gets while wearing!

The only other tidbit of advice is to make certain- your shoe doesn’t end higher up the ankle then, the actual sock! Especially if shoe has a tendency to rub.. socks won’t provide any ankle cushion higher up then, a “no show” sock!

Overall, this Fila sock bundle is a great find- A perfect option for warmer months. If it helps to know.. i’ve ordered a 2nd pack to put away for future use- just in case these are only seasonal! I hope the info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Love these... Best sandal find of summer 2021..!!!
text:
One of the BEST summer sandal finds of the year..!! A title I don’t give out freely- and It’s crazy to think I stumbled upon these by happenstance- lucky me!

Not only are these super hip and fashionable but, they’re practical on every level- imagine the teva style with adjustable top, toe and ankle velcro straps. These have all the same adjustable points that allow one to create a custom fit for a thinner or wider foot and everything in between- this is such a perk..!! A custom fit will not only help keep sandals snug and secure in place but, it will give you added stability which is usually missing in most sandals. These fit true to size: for a 7.5 size foot.. we chose an 8 in white (sold in whole sizes only..) see photos included for Visual on the fit.

These are perfect amphibian sandals as they transition so great from outdoor activity and in/out of water staying securely on the foot! These are a great option to use boating, hiking, camping, river running.. you name it- along with wearing and looking stylish in the latest trend!

I love the straps are made of a treated nylon (approx. 1” wide) which is thick and sturdy. These sandals won’t cause rubbing or sore spots where connections touch the foot (if they do, just adjust the fit!) we took off on 5hr. biking activity- and not a single blister!! Also, the nylon straps are anchored into the sole of the shoe- Im not sure how but, its so securely fastened it boasts confidence these are made for some serious use/abuse.. no! These are not like flip-flops, no plug through the bottom of the sole-

I know, I know- I’m a little excited and long-winded.. BUT, I’m just excited to share highlights of these in action..!! listed for under $30 a pair- these are a solid deal and should not disappoint. Hoping this info can help your decision.. feel free to let me know!

***Hack: if these get dirty- place on top rack in your dishwasher.. it does an amazing job cleaning brand new again!!

title: Solid short but, lack Wow factor! Not Über flattering-
text:
Solid shorts for the price.. but, they don’t jump out as a WoW or, make the lineup for a favorite pair of shorts in any way!! Not that I find anything wrong with them- it’s really more like, there isn’t a lot of things right! If that makes sense..??!

When I get a fun pair of shorts like this- I want something that looks/feels flattering.. I would describe these as standard or, basic in both look and cut.

Sold in the “5 sizes can fit all” (S-XXL) it sort of sets the tone for the fit- this sizing method for casual and/or athletic shorts. The paper bag stretchable waistband is the one place to create any type of a personal fit by tight/loosening the ribbon belt included but, thats pretty much it. Pockets are larger in size, very functionable and add a dressier touch. The backside of these have a looser, boxier cut- making the back side of your bottom (aka bum!) look a bit flat and saggy.. ha!! at 40+ Yr. old I don’t need any excess help in that dept. thank you very much..!! That boxiness continues down through the leg and bc, of a boxy lines this has an ever so slightly flow with any moment. Length is about mid thigh- so, appropriate and modest. Ordered in XL I found these to just “hang” on the female figure… Nothing overly exciting or accentuating- but, a straightforward slip on shorts with a fancier waistband. For reference: I’m 5’2”, 154lb, 38C, 40+ yr. old with a trouble spot thru the mid/waist (thx to my x4 kids and gravity..)

Fabric is a cotton/linen (85-15%) blend which gives the aesthetics of linen but, feel has more cotton creature comforts- and it wrinkles a bit less than pure linen! I don’t recommend drying when washing… Personally, I used hand wash cycle on cold and then, line dried. For a price point of under $15.. these could be a basic or meet needs, depending on the look you’re going for. I hope this info can help your decision- feel free to let me know!

title: Fun group of fashion jewelry.. great for teens!!
text:
A lot of bang for your buck! I see these best suited for the teen/twenty something girls who love to accessorize with the ability to switch things up. Yet, to use, lose, abuse as they are prone to do- will not cause added angst as these are just fun and fashion pieces at a steal of a deal.. (price comes to approx. $2 a ring!)

No worry about the fit- these are open ended and adjustable. However, be gentle when adjusting as not to create unnecessary creases.. if so, these may break in two! These are not .925 silver so, it’s in your best interest to remove in water.. otherwise, they may tarnish prematurely.

I find the rings that are more simplistic in their design actually look of higher quality. Some of the finishing and edges on the busier rings lack a little bit of a finished and polished look.. But, excepting these as fashion/costume jewelry it’s to be expected. I hope this info can help your decision- feel free to let me know!

title: Less comfort/support then CK’s classic bralette..!!!
text:
As a tried and true Calvin Klein bra/panty girl for decades… I’ve never been disappointed when I’ve purchased any of their underwear products- and still that record holds true! However, expecting more of the same signature hold, support, comfort from their classic style- this was definitely different!! I cannot fault CK.. as, I've seen they’ve been branching out into new styles and designs- But, for any who are expecting their signature bralette or, Tshirt bra fit.. this is less hold and support by its structural changes. So, good to know for future finds-

For any unfamiliar with CK line. The 2 mentioned above truly are their signature bras (bralette/Tshirt style) and are most widely referenced by any who are CK fans! These 2 styles offer pure simplistic comfort that stems from its classic design. Best of all, it does so without over compressing the chest.. or, adding excess bulk like a lot of sports bra can do. This is what makes these great for everyday wear..!!! Crazy to think- Women I want support but, also want to breathe!

This is still created using the softest quality cotton- leaving out that excess padding/bulk that can drive us crazy and make us look heavy chested in all the wrong ways! This still uses the “shelf method” with their famous elastic band underneath.. TBH, this is where majority of support comes from. With this style you get a natural look through the breast that actually allows for the female curve to be what it is.. beautiful! The shoulder straps provide one the needed lift. So, I appreciate the adjustable mechanism that this design has- it allows you to tighten/loosen up as needed.. bc, let’s admit it- gravity is not our friend always!!

With this styles deep and wide V neck design- it works against some of the natural laws of support. For those with a larger bust-line.. you may not feel confidence in the support as you’d want/expect. It almost fit as if the cups/triangles were spaced too far apart..?!!
As with any bra it is a personal preference and although this design has some of CK’s signature features..I prefer the classic bralette. (for reference: this was bought in medium for 36C, 135lb., 5’6” stature.) I hoped to provide enough detail for comparison for those who are interested… I hope the info can help make your decision!

title: View all angles- not a lot of coverage! Sized smaller!!
text:
Sexy and sleek in style… Although tastefully done, this does not provide a lot of coverage on top- especially for larger chested women and take note, this is a cheeky cut (not a total Brazilian but, this presents seeing about qtr. of the cheek itself!) So, its something to keep in mind.. IF you feel confident in a swimsuit- I’m sure you’ll be fine. I’d say this runs a bit small.. however, I think partially due to the cut in the neckline, it seems to run a bit wide!!? Because of this wide stance strap placement, it exposes a qtr. of ones cleavage on top as well. ** if one takes the time to look over all angles in photographs- this gives a sense of how the swimsuit fits.. then, visualize all your wonderful curves in this same cut.. and you’ll have a good indication of just what will show!
The waistband is tide on both hip bones- this allows for a personal adjustment.. but take note there is no tummy control if needed. For mine this wasn’t an issue- see photos included.

Ordered for 22 year old daughter who has active Athletic build and wear a medium. For reference: 5’6”, 34B, 120lb., 27” waist.. ordered in medium- it was a fit all-around!! My daughter does possess an athletic build due to her collegiate soccer team.. so, she has zero body fat and minimal curves. Otherwise, this may be hard to fit on some of us with realistic female curves.. if I’m just being honest- if you note photos included (forgive the baby playpen in the background! we had a 10mo. old visit who needed a quiet place to sleep!)

Material is straightforward- it’s a swimsuit! No loose threads/sloppy seams.. ordered in blk., we had no issue being see-through! Ordering swimsuits online can be hard so, I tried to give details where it mattered- my daughter did inform me, this is one of the best fitting swimsuits she’s ordered online.. having said that, I know she’s not the norm! Most of us are blessed with a female figure at least those who have devoted their life to a sport!! I hope this info can help make your decision.. good luck!

title: Perfect infant/toddler solution!! Careful with sizing!
text:
Although absolutely adorable- these are perfect in every way but the sizing!! These were over an inch too big for our little one and therefore, i’d suggest you error on the side of smaller vs. larger. (We ordered the 3.5-4.5 for a 10 mo. old for reference.) Trust me- You are going to want these to fit. Shoe length itself is 5” in this size- see photo. This item NEEDS a size chart bc, without it it’s just a fat guess!! One can google a “ how to“ measurement chart if needed-

I understand wanting to size up and give you a little usability since infants + toddlers grow out of everything so quickly!! But, don’t do so with these- it defeats the purpose!! In order to meet the need for balance, protection, support, stability.. snug and correct sizing is a must!! If not, they won’t stay on.. and your little one will be tripping over their feet.. trust me on this!

the idea of a simple slip on approach to a shoe for an infant- is amazing! There are literally no laces, buckles, clips..a lifesaver in both, the frustration and time arena!! If fit snuggley these will add awesome stability and support for any infant getting ready to stand, toddle and walk- its so great and cuts down on the bumps/falls! These have a slim and bendable rubber sole.. they are NOT heavy or cumbersome in anyway- (truly, they weigh next too nothing!) Best yet, these protect a tiny foot walking outdoors or, at a playground.. such a HUGE bonus!!

Although these can be worn in winter… They are not winter/waterproof- these are best suited for all seasons indoors- and any dry weather outdoors. No! Although similar in style to the aqua sock… These are not solely intended for swimming (aqua socks usually have a thinner and incorporated sole and body is constructed of neoprene to hug foot and not come off with the pull of water.. just like a wetsuit!) These are constructed from a nice, solid, durable material and the slats provide airflow allowing breathable comfort for those tiny feet when worn.. one can use with/without socks, it’s a personal preference. *As a child grows.. this style is the perfect option to give Independence- as a child can learn to put shoes on by themselves!

Overall- I love the concept of this infant shoe! For under $15 these will be a lifesaver to any parent needing to put a shoe on a little!! I deducted x1 star for size issue only... I hope this info can help in your decision- good luck!

title: Very age appropriate couples gift- nicely done!
text:
These are really sweet.. a set of his/her (or, any couple combo for that matter) But, I say his/hers bc x1 is sized a bit bigger to fit a larger size wrist.. These have the face of a blank ID bracelet tag but, they are made without any written script. title: Tastefully done set of sterling silver toe rings-
text:

Once ring is on securely.. it will mold into shape by simply walking and wearing around- if any point is causing discomfort.. you can easily adjust as needed. Both styles are tastefully done! One a solid band with a minimalistic look.. The other is a classic repeated flower.. almost giving a island/Hawaiian vibe. Nothing obnoxious and both, very tasteful.
