title: Solid option- a few included ideas for infant sock buying!!!
text:
A fun set of a dzn. socks which include 6 varied colors (2 of each..) and trust me, you’ll need this many pair at least! The tiny size alone makes them prime candidates to fall victim to the washing machine abyss... not to mention, if a looser fit- they’ll go MIA the moment you turn your head! Its definitely a sock conspiracy-

Material is a soft and breathable cotton with an elastin stretch. These have minimal shrink when washed, although its mostly seen in the foot area and not tightness around ankle/leg opening like I’d hoped. *Hack: I suggest placing socks inside a lingerie bag to wash and this will help to avoid losing due to their tiny size! Socks have rubber bumpers on the bottom which are both, helpful and necessary for stability with infants learning to stand/walk (NoPe! No sock sliding “Risky Business” action going on here..!!)

Sized in 6 month increments it baffles me no one’s created a “radial ankle measurement chart“ which would provide a more accurate fit for tiny baby legs!! It’s true, not all babies are created equal even if the same age… Go figure! For reference: we ordered 6-12 month size for 9.5 mo. old (19lb.) and although sock fit thru length in foot- the looser fit around ankle makes these a bit frustrating to stay put- and this is after washing on warm!

I recommend NOT trying to gain extra opportunity when ordering- Yess!! I do realize, little ones grow so fast that items are being replaced prior to wearing out. But, socks are NOT an item you want to size up or, go bigger with.. If so, you’ll never keep them in place. Trust me, even when fit snug.. you’ll still have issue with socks as, babies have a fascination with finding their toes! And- if they can give socks a tug… They will- and if loose, they’ll give way! If at lower age of 6 month span- I might even suggest sizing downward to hopefully gain a fit that will aid in keeping socks on

Long winded I know but, one last hack!! IF, using socks to wear along with shoes- you’ll want to invest in a set of socks without the “rubber bumpers!” This will help foot slide into the shoe as it should and NOT get stuck or grip onto the rubber on bottom of “walking socks!” Just a suggestion to help avoid extra resistance when trying to place a shoe onto a tiny and uncooperative foot!!

Overall, these socks have plenty of merit and are listed at a great price point.. its unfair to fault them for the never ending angst found with infants and sock wearing fandango!! I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

These are solid trio of under armor socks in monochromatic colors… Perfect for universal pairing. Note: these are low cut but, not no-show socks.. which means- sock will most likely peek out from the edge of the standard cut tennis shoe. Also note: these are not a quarter cut… And will not reach up to the ankle! Personally, I prefer this height so top rim of shoe does not rub sore spot on skin!

These offer a nice amount of compression so, they keep feet warm and comfortable by creating circulation… and the compression provides nice arch support. Not sure how it’s done but, this is a thinner style sock- with all creature comforts of a thicker version… its Voodoo maybe?! As for the sizing, I was not struggling with the fit. Even post washing and drying… These retain their shape without shrinking. I mention because, I love Adidas athletic socks yet, they shrink quite noticeably. So, kudos to UA For getting this right!

I also appreciate the ankle reinforcement. Not that it gives you any extra magic while wearing… But, rather it helps keep sock from rubbing and prematurely ripping a hole in the dreaded sock “death spot!” (Again.. a problem I have with Adidas brand.. but, so far not with UA.)

As for moisture wicking- I am not sure I’m noticing anything monumental… On the flipside, i’m not taking off wet stinky socks- so, is this helping.. I’m thinking so! Although, wouldn’t moisture wicking mean I have wet socks?! Hmm..

Overall, for the quality and value I would definitely recommend and purchase again. This is a first time trial with this brand in their socks.. I’ve always appreciated Under Armor compression body layer during winter workouts and the socks did not disappoint. I will definitely look for UA socks in the future. I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Solid run around town- active shoe!
text:
Purchased these for a fun trendy shoe to transition out of winter and into spring... love the color combo- mostly monochromatic gray they will match plenty… The mint green is so subtle yet, fun! I like the idea of easy on/off- although, these have laces… If tied loose, one can slide foot in and out easy enough without untying each time!

Fit was solid in the length but, a bit wider through the top toe section.. giving me an extra bend and crease in material- not my favorite as, I feel like I have clown feet but, husband promises they look completely normal?! Not enough to be a dealbreaker but, something to keep in mind if you have a narrow foot.

These are very light weight and by light, I mean it feel like almost nothing on the foot!! As a dancer for 20 years I have flat feet! So, a high arch support something I’m not used too.. I can only wear for a few hours at a time. Hoping this gets better as my foot adapts... for those who don’t appreciate arch support- keep this in mind.

Lastly, the tongue Is stitched in such a way.. that these don’t have a lot of movement for repositioning. Most the structure comes from tying the lace- another caveat a lot of running shoes are going to but, it may take a bit getting used to.

Overall, for the price point of $36… They are solid shoe. Not something that would be used for a rigorous workouts but, more conducive to being active and run around town shoes! I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Decent price but, missed on the fit- bc, roll is stitched!!
text:
Wanted to like bc, so many people recommended it! But, it just doesn’t fit.. not even close?! The hat does unroll- but, only once!! The second roll is stitched in so, it wont undo..!?? That was a bummer to find out as, we have a big head to fit!

Material is soft enough but, not to die for soft!! Not when we have so many options of soft fabrics these days- The only way this could fit my 17-year-old son’s head (and yes! It is a big head!)! What is the role of the fisherman cap style- so, take note.. if you have a larger noggin- this may not be for you!
There is stretch to the material because of the ribbing- however, the last 3 inches closest to the crown of the head -do not give in anyway!!

Overall, I felt it was a decent price point but unfortunately, it just didn’t do anything for our needs and realizing… Not all heads are created equal and so, I give this 3 stars. I deducted x1 star for not having the softest material… and x1 star deducted for the last roll being stitched in. I’m sure this may work for some… It just didn’t for us!
I hope this info can help your decision.. feel free to let me know!

title: LOVE THIS BRAND!! Just size up for best fit...
text:
This is a solid brand I stumbled onto a few months ago and haven't looked back since!! I love the softness of material and find it present in all their products. I do love the brands motto with the environmental impact- especially when we’re saving the planet for the very babies were caring for!!

These fit in theory but, without a titch of room to spare! So, I recommend you order at least one size up- if not more. Personally, I try to order bigger so I can get more bang for my buck but, with this brand it’s not only doable it’s, almost necessary! (by ordering up- I’m truly jumping up at least 3 - 6mo. on an item.. and with these, you can get away with it no problem!) To give size reference: little guy is 7mo old and 18lb. In 70% for height and weight.. I chose to order a 5pk. in 12mo. (I would’ve gone up even x1 more size but, it was unavailable at that time!) these 12mo fit him now- with only a little room to spare! So, be generous when it comes to sizing up- just to give you insured fit and longer use. Trust me they won’t gape or hang… They just won’t be stretched out as taut!

This style of onesie is a great idea and find- I’d recommend for anyone heading into summer months with a little one. Since, we must protect their tender infant skin.. but, also want climate control so, not to overheat the little beans! A subtle difference of a sleeveless style helps surprisingly well in this arena! TBH, when it gets completely hot outside- i’ll even let a Onesie double as at home “hanging out” attire- these are perfect for those hot days! The tank strap is just enough to cover shoulder without any sleeve- included photo above.

As for construction: these are tagless so, no itchy scratch.. they have 3 snap crotch.. all reinforced so, they stay secure-see photo above (I've owned 30 diff. Sz. and styles in Honest onsies- and not x1 of them has ever lost or, ripped a snap!) Edges have been reinforced in same soft material to help these keep their shape and I LOVE THIS!! All openings: arms, legs, neck are all edged.. this keeps onsie from a stretched out, bunched up or.. disheveled gape- So, it’s perfect! I included photo showing reinforced edges.

These make great baby shower gifts- while giving you confidence in the product they’ll receive. I’m thrilled with both, the quality and price point. Just be sure to size accordingly when ordering. I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Socks to last and do the job one expects!!
text:
As a nice thinner pair of wool socks- these do provide comfort and warmth in all the right places… Socks are not overly constricting but, give added compression for support and seem to be at positive counter points for circulation.. the stitching and elastin combo also helps keep socks in place while wearing during any activity. (It was nice not to have continuous slippage with socks while doing some spring hiking!)

I appreciate getting the benefits of a wool sock without all the bulk.. it makes the fit doable with any style shoe (Athletic, tennis, hiking-) it doesn’t compromise the actual fit by taking up space In the shoe and making things too tight! All this and one gets the perks of wool- which, we cannot forget one of the biggest bonus points is moisture wicking itself- that of course helps with bacterial issues and the side effect of stinky feet!! Ha.. a sock that keeps on giving!!!

These are made to fit the most common sizes in womens feet and they seem to measure up right on point. I wear 7.5m shoe and had plenty of room with this sock. No “Cinderella moment” was had in trying to get this sock on! (And that’s even after I’ve washed/dried a few times!) Keep in mind..
**If one has a larger size foot- these are wool! So, you may want to machine wash on cold and only line dry just to avoid any issue with shrinkage.. tbh, I do this with my husbands wool socks- and they dry rather fast but, because he has a larger foot… its a necessity to keep expensive wool socks from shrinkage.
Overall, $10 on a single pair of socks is hard to swallow! I realize that’s the price for solid performing socks these days… But, it doesn’t mean I have to like it! If looking for a pair of socks to last and do the job expected- these are solid! I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Looks whimsical on model.. but, not my body type!!
text:
This is another case of.. item looking fabulous on the model but, not on me!! Seems I’ve been duped into a fun trendy look a few times lately.. Only, this top has fallen short of all expectations! I will say.. it could be, I don’t look the part in any way of the model -but, do any of us?!

This is a babydoll style top that appears to have a whimsical flow.. and as I was looking for something that could hang naturally along my curves and have ample movement in the fabric to move with me.. I found this is not that top!! The material used is not rayon and instead, it’s a synthetic poly mix. Sure, it’s a disappointment when descriptions are not 100% accurate bc , different fabrics do preform differently.. I was specifically wanting the rayon material for this reason. Note: correct fabrics must be listed for those who may have allergic reaction to certain materials.. so, this needs to be adjusted accordingly.

Ordered an XL in khaki- and I’ve received more of a Cream colored option.. I was hoping for a darker color so, fabric would not be sheer and see-thru but, take note.. at least lighter colors are very see-thru! For reference: I’m 5’2”, 154lb, 38C, 40+ yr. old with trouble spot thru the middle (thx to x4 kids and gravity taking their toll..!!) now you see why I wanted fabric with a loose draped fit to silhouette the female figure and not accentuate flaws! At least it was my goal.. but, this top doesn’t want to cooperate- not with my body type! Note: the empire waist did not do my chest line any favors either.. the tiny ruffle stitching added bulk where I didn’t need it- and that’s not fair!

The material feels thin.. almost as if it could tear. I had a few hanging strings I had to trim that were left at the end of a seam almost like quality control was skipped. Keep in mind- a body tank or cami underneath may be necessary just to create appropriate security when wearing… At least with lighter colors. (I do know, sometimes to achieve Color variations in the same style of an item- designer must alter fabric mix..) So, it may be possible- others received different fabric content? Let it be known.. that the khaki-cream-apricot is a poly fabric and NOT rayon base material!)

Depending on the look ones trying to achieve, this would be best suited for those who have a more slender build and even a bit of height. If sized and styled right- this may have big potential. But, standing tall at 5’2” with a troubled mid section.. I felt like a squished umpa-loompa! Not an attractive or, confidence building top for my wardrobe.. that’s for sure! Be sure to measure against these specifics to avoid disappointment or, a need to return. I hope the info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Love lightweight fabric- but, total miss on skinny fit!!
text:
These are the sweetest pair of full frontal zip infant Pajamas- complete with gripper feet and snap protection cover over the zipper to prevent scratching.. these are soft material that is very light weight- A great find for spring and summer.. so, why only 3 stars?!!

Unless, you have a skinny limbed infant without any happy rolls… You’ll be hard-pressed to get your baby zipped in!! This was so disheartening, I wanted to snuggle our Little guy into these and heading into spring- I was loving the lighter weight cotton fabric. Problem is, there is no stretch no give and no forgiveness… I realize, jammies made for babies have flammable criteria (and must be worn snug!) but, it won’t help anyone if you can’t get your little baby bean into them!!

Order a 12 month sz. for an 8 month old who weighs 18lb. And this was a struggle- were talking before washing so, it was without any added shrinkage.. So, if you’re wanting to try then, I suggest sizing up.. and doing so in a larger increment than I did!! The feet were also a tad smaller- but, I’m not sure if our little guy has big feet (so, it may be our own issue there?!)

Sold at a price point of $15- this is a great find.. IF, only your little one is a slim, skinny-mini! Note: I have onesies packs in longsleeve and sleeveless style in this same brand- and both packs of onesies fit him perfect?! I’m wondering if this is just a miss on the slimness with this particular fabric?

Be aware to order up in size if your baby has any healthy substance to arms, legs, mid section.. it may be only way to get your infant into this item!! I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: A few caveats to know- prior to ordering!!
text:
OK! When I see the words “tummy control waistband“ I expect that item to help do some of the heavy lifting.. apparently, these pants did not get the memo! Albeit, they are high waisted and do reach ones naval- this is just an extension of the regular pant material.. no special reinforcement or, band to aid tummy troubles- and with the gift of having x4 babies and that wonderful thing called gravity.. not having extra support is a fatal flaw!!

Material used is soft and made with a stretchable thickness. Ordered in cyan blue- it color matches photo in description. All stitching and seams are on point, no loose threads and pants have a reinforced crotch for extra security, movement, comfort. At a $20 price point these are made well. My favorite feature are the outside pockets which hold anything from ones chapstick to car keys or, cell phone.. The pockets also help transition these pants into carpool and errand running attire- again, total bonus!

As for the fit: I found these run small… If between sizes, I suggest sizing up! They are a skinnier fit through hip and waist area- But note: the length is longer vs. shorter so, if you struggle to find yoga pants in full length.. these meet that criteria! For reference: 5’6”, 140lb, 36C, natural waist 28.3- ordered in Medium.. I feel large would have offered for more comfort, wiggle room and been a bit more forgiving. If, one has zero room to spare in the fit.. I would recommend washing on cold and line drying! Doing so will avoid shrinkage yet, it still allows pants to regain their shape.

Overall, these yoga pants have ability to perform well for many- Just be sure to realize the details prior to ordering.. Make certain, these will be a right fit for you! I hope this info can help your decision.. feel free to let me know!

title: Aesthetically the same as others.. but, has comfort differences!!
text:
Ordered for summer and trips to the pool or, boating at the lake because of the simplicity I want in these surroundings. Aesthetically these look the part of the big brand that debuted this style design last summer. So, to find the shoe at half the price was exciting... After seeing these in person, I can share the similarities and differences I see!

The look is on point! However, these are made with a thicker, heavier plastic material which may help them hold up better.. but take note: because of their thickness, these are less bendable and a bit stiff- making them almost uncomfortable. I’m hoping this improves after breaking them in.. But, the soft creature comforts one wants right out of the package is not necessarily present! So, leave time to break in before you wear all day! (its not just the sore spot between toes.. but the strap over the top of foot that gets rubbed sore!)

Sizing: done in whole sizes.. and they run smaller vs. big! So, if you wear a 1/2 sz., of course size up with this shoe!! But, for someone who is a true 8m as, I am.. my feet are right at the edge of size 8..!! (Not over but, at the edge!!) Problem is, if I ordered a 9m- I feel it may be too big in it’s entirety.. **IF, it bothers you to have the toes right to the edge of a flip-flop then.. this may not fit you well? The good news is- for anyone with a narrow foot.. This has a working buckle that can adjust to tighten the fit and help your your foot stay put in the shoe more securely. This is a perk for any who have a struggle with flip-flops staying on their feet!!

Color ordered was black and it’s a straightforward as the photo. Craftsmanship seems on point with the pricing- these are not indestructible for multiple seasons per sé... as, they're a rubber type flip flop! But, they do have substance to handle plenty of wear and tear!

If, you’ve actually worn this flip-flop from the original designer/maker… You will most likely notice the differences. Mostly in softness/thickness of material used and also, the weight is a bit heavier. However, if you’ve only visually seen this shoe style and liked- then, it may not be as much of a discrepancy.. I will keep and use as, pool/lake slides- for the price point I think I will appreciate and definitely get enough use out of them to justify. I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Great pockets + material.. solid pair of leggings!!
text:
This are a solid pair of leggings that can be used from rigorous workouts to casual walks.. These easily transition into casual wear on the go and give one the feeling of confidence as, they are not see-thru or, too risky and revealing.. material used is thick and solid while still offering complete movement in your daily routine.

Material is warmer then, others owned in the past.. but, a welcomed surprise during winter and early spring morning workouts outdoors!

The waistband is nice and adds a bit of a bonus in the tummy control dept- always a perk! The crotch is boxed to create natural movement which keeps these from pulling and causing the crotch to drop and ride low. The pockets (Photographed above..) are the deepest I’ve ever found in this style legging -ever!! These angle into a point so they’ll naturally blend seamlessly into the bodies own curves and lines- witchcraft? Possibly.. !! The pocket is capable for carrying even a larger cell phone, keys, ID, Chapstick or, whatever you need to take along.. and yes! There is a pocket on each side.

As for the fit: these are pretty standard to regular sizing.. we ordered medium and although, no room to spare… They did fit! Has a very active but, not extreme athletic build. Ordered in Medium- a large may have been better for length and a bit of forgiveness.

I recommend washing on cool and line drying. If, between sizes I’d definitely contemplate sizing up. But, this is personal preference on how restrictive you want leggings.. overall, for a price point of under $20 these are solid find. The quality in both, material and stitching gives confidence these will last for some time- we’ve used for x3 wks and washed x6-8 in machine. So far, we’ve had no piling or, snagging of fabric where material rubs or, is vulnerable. So, happy us! I hope this info can help your decision.. feel free to let me know!

title: Hybrid trunks to take you into/out of H2o with ease!
text:
So, going out on a limb I ordered a color I’d never considered.. And happy I did!! Green is the new black or, whatever is trending today!! If, unsure of a color to choose.. This absolutely hits the spot even if you don’t like green and TBH, I don’t!! Crazy I know! This swim trunk offers a perfect blend of greenish blue which gives a unique look to all the other swim trunks at the pool.. Not to mention, this jade hue only accentuates your tan- So, that’s a bonus all on its own!!

Ordered for husband who is a true XL in sizing. With a waistband of 34” and his comfort fit of 35-35.5” the size should have been spot on according to chart provided. Only, when receiving.. these fit without any room to spare. So, take note if between sizes or, hesitant according to chart provided- error on the side of bigger.. Size up! This will save a lot of hassle in return. Note: these offer a drawstring waist that can hold trunks in place along with the elastic band. Plus, it can provide a more personal and secure fit. As for the length this seam is 9”...although height can vary the results, these hit a few inches above the knee. Sort of the happy medium length- (for reference: husband is 6’3”, 210lb, 34.5” waist, pant 36x36. he has an active but, not athletic build.)

These trunks have added creature comforts that have come to be known in swimwear the past few years. They have mesh lining built in- and for those who prefer otherwise, net can easily be cut out along the seam line.. Lastly, the material is soft and made of the hybrid or, amphibian quick dry fabric that wear’s like shorts when outdoors and dips into/out of water as you go.. drying in minutes. It’s pretty much like witchcraft!!

This is a decent pair of swim trunks at a price point of $20- this offers a few extra in whistles and bells if that’s important to you, while still keeping a classic look, style and overall performance in swim trunk dept. Overall, these were well received and looked good in action.. I hope this info can help your decision- feel free to let me know!

title: Close enough to perfect in every way..!!
text:
Talk about awesome- I am loving this baseball hat! The charcoal heather gray is the perfect option to pick up white, gray, black.. whatever?! Matching your hat to items in the closet is a breeze.. and better yet, this heathered fabric keeps ones hat from showing off sweat and dirt easily!!

The Velcro is so awesome! Bless the day they found an alternative to the plastic tab fit option- hallelujah! Seriously, with hat on head one can easily adjust fit while wearing.. it’s just that easy. Material used offers a surprising amount of stretch which also keeps this from creating that annoying tension headache that comes on after wearing a hat that’s just too tight- The inside rim has a band sewn in that helps keep the hats shape and also, absorb sweat.. The band is finished with a quality tight stitch leaving no sharp/scratchy edges- and as we all know, this can make or break any hat wearing experience!

I love the bowl of this hat actually reaches down over the top of the ear- it’s a pet peeve of mine when hats are short and push the ears out.. so, I’m smitten with this depth. I can confidently recommend this hat 100%.. it has great aesthetic’s, an amazing amount of comfort and for the price you can’t go wrong! I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Solid craftsmanship and timeless style.. Wow!!
text:
Ulala... and Boomshakalaka!! This is a beautiful ring created in sterling silver .925 which is a must for giving any type of longevity to a “cocktail ring or, costume jewelry..” The sizing is spot on, I measure just under a size 7.. and this fit perfectly. The fact this has 2 bands also helps Secure the fit. I appreciate these are not soldered together so, it gives user options- this can be worn separately or, as a set and looks amazing either way.. see photos included. (I did include a small army of photos- I know! I wanted to show all varied options wearing this ring.. single, double, 2 stacked options etc!) I’m smitten with them all- I also compared this to my actual wedding ring to show sparkle and shine.. tbh, The CZ-sterling silver combo shines more than my platinum and diamond wedding band- just to give you some idea of this rings luster..!!

Personally, I ordered this to wear in situations where it’s not practical or, possibly dangerous to wear expensive jewelry. To give some context.. I never wear wedding ring to the pool yet, since I wear it 24/7- a replacement was needed to feel normal plus, cover tan line and keep it from burning!! On a trip to Mexico the resort advised my husband/I not to put ourselves in any vulnerable situations by wearing expensive watches and jewelry.. so, again I used a replacement. What I found out was.. doing so, WAS SO MUCH FUN!! Since then, I’ve always kept an eye out for quality options when needed or, when I just want a little change- this can be a lot of fun- with or, without a purpose!

As you can tell by the photos.. the stones are nice and securely set. They have a high sheen and are securely set and aligned. Heres a little hack: if one uses a tiny bit of toothpaste on a toothbrush.. just give your ring a little scrub and rinse- this will safely bring a sparkle to any ring! A ring cloth can polish .925 silver back to its original state in just a quick second.. So, when buying- choose an option that is made with quality. It may cost a little more up front but, it will pay off years down the road. Also, “less is more real!” I found a CZ. stone sized larger then, 2kt. just looks tacky and fake.. so, there’s another hack for you as, size matters! Also, if buying a wedding band set- IF, not soldered… You double the options for wearing!

This comes in a nice simple jewelry box.. it is lined in soft black velvet and includes a makers card, making this gift ready from arrival. This wedding set I could recommend without hesitation. I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: The comfort of thickness but, in a thinner sock- wow!!
text:
These are quite amazing.. I’m impressed at the comfort one can gain in a sock it, when the right quality material is used. To gain comfort one does not need excess bulk- and this sock is proof of that all day long!! the crew cut style and height is perfect.. it provides me ample coverage for any style shoe- from running shoe to hiking boot and the top band on the socks keep these in place like a dream. I would love to replace my entire sock drawer with various cuts and styles of this exact sock.. If, that tells you how much I loved their performance!

As for the color.. these appear almost a bluish gray blended over white- letting you match easily to any monochromatic colors or, solid hue just the same. No worry about sizing- these run true to the chart provided. These may feel a bit snug when putting on the fist time but, you will want and appreciate that support once you’re on the go..!! These are truly like sock science- it’s crazy! I hope this info can help in your decision.. feel free to let me know!

title: Rocksolid bra- has ability to be worn as tank as well!
text:
Ordered for my daughter who has gotten big into a workout routine and is walking daily 4+ miles.. Being a college student in southern Cali. she wanted the option to take the top layer off if/when needed - she likes to walk in bra with jacket or hoodie over top- but, this top allows options- as, It can stand alone on its own and look appropriate, thanks to the drop torso!

title: Know the details prior to ordering..
text:
This seems confused as to what it is or, would best be used for? A cover-up, oversize shirt, mini dress?! But, It’s far too big as a shirt.. too short/see thru as a dress.. And material feels wrong for a swimsuit cover-up??!! So, confused is a good description..

The fit runs big as one would expect in a cover-up.. light and billowy just like this is. But, material isn’t conducive to being absorbent of water in any way.. AND/OR, when this material meets heat and humidity (2 things usually found when wearing a swimsuit/coverup.. ha ha!) the material becomes wrinkled, sweaty and clingy... So, keep in mind if using at the pool. Material is cool but, can become a wrinkled mess!

As an oversized top.. this is rather large- almost too big to be taken seriously. Maybe if, sized and fitted thru the shoulders- worn over a slim legging- it wont look as disheveled..? Otherwise, this might make one appear larger then they truly are! (Never a good look..!!)

As a dress.. at least in white, this would be see-thru front/back- top to bottom and a disaster as, the length alone would be questionable for anyone over 5’0”... So, I wouldn’t recommend!

As for the pros: material is lightweight for warmer weather.. and it feels soft on skin without any irritation. The seams and stitching appear on point with no loose buttons or, threads. I recommend washing on cold-delicate cycle and steam press- (regular iron may be too hot for poly/rayon material..) Fit runs bigger so, if between sizes no need to order up. For reference: I’m 5’2”, 154lb, 38C, 40+ yr. old with trouble spot thru the middle (thx 4 kids and gravity for that.. ugh!!) I ordered an XL in white.

title: SS.925 toe rings.. gold overlay seems to strengthen!
text:
Loving these toe rings (or, midi rings for those who prefer!) this designs allows one to adjust them for a perfect fit. The fact these are sterling silver .925 can help make this happen but, you need to be careful as well...

As most know, SS.925 is a softer metal that can shape shift and help you get a more customized fit- which can be necessary with a toe ring! If, this type of ring doesn’t fit correctly.. it can be painful at best to wear, walk on and forget using those toes for balance (Yep! like toes were intended..) if, you’ve got a misfitting toe ring it can like walking with a pebble in your shoe just stuck right under or between the toe.. ouch! So, the adjustability is helpful.

On the flip side- these also have the ability to become distorted in their shape for all the same reasons! And any excess undo pressure on the foot (rigorous exercise, dancing , close toed shoes..) can cause misshapen bending to the ring.. I definitely recommend removing prior to any of these activities. I find- It’s easy to bend a circle out of shape but, impossible to bend it back! Be careful bc, too much bending of .925 can create weak points in the metal itself- leaving a ring to break in two.

The fact these have a gold overlay seems to make them stronger which is a perk in my book. TBH, if wanting gold color- I’d much rather have Sterling silver as the base. For those with sensitive skin, i’d recommend nothing but SS.925 and so far, these are kept their color without tarnishing- even when forgetting and wearing x1-2 in water.. Although I see some have received 3 rings.. my package included 2- just as shown in the photograph. Thus far, for a price point of $15.. I’ve been happy with the results. I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

To me these present as a hinderance.. and a bit of a design flaw. I mention just so all can be aware.

title: Solid mid road winter activity- on the scale provided..
text:
A really nice go to glove in colder weather.. and a solid option for “snow play..” A pair of gloves capable to suffice a winter dog walk through the park, a heavy shoveling of the driveway and sidewalks.. sledding or, building a snowman!

After living in Utah now 4 decades… I put gloves into 3 different type categories.

1. Mitten/liner in fall not using in moisture, 2. Winter activity gloves for few hrs of fun!
3. Snow sports!! All day outdoor events!!!
..And Trust me, there is a difference!

These are a suitable layer of protection for winter activities. They are decently priced, solidly constructed and can do the job of the mid level protection.. If, needing hands to go the distance for all day outdoor activity- I’d choose differently. (at the very least, I’d be pairing these with glove liners and handwarmers if trying to make them an all day winter sport glove.)
Great thing about these- they included a zip pocket where one can easily slide a warmer inside it to extend the length of time these will keep the hands warm. Because, a day of winter fun.. is ONLY as good as, the gear you use- if cold, it will make user miserable and hands/toes are the most important to protect!!

A glove intended for all day snow activity… Where hands will be in moisture (aka- snow!) should be better insulated and fully waterproofed. These have great ability to stay that way but, only for limited amount of time.. and I would recommend for that type of use. If so, I think you’ll be pleased. I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Know what overall look you’re wanting...
text:
This is nice enough and is visually more appealing and much better quality then other metals, stainless or, any costume jewelry.. and the cheaper things that turns a finger green!

Regardless of where this ranks on the quality scale… I found, I prefer sterling silver over titanium. With that being said, I prefer sterling silver for women- I appreciate the shine and feminine touch that S.S. gives you and I find that is missing from titanium. However, for a mans ring.. I definitely prefer titanium over sterling silver! It has a more masculine quality and I love the colors it can be made in.. (my fav. Is matte black!) Best of all, it is a strong metal for wear/tear and made to endure. Titanium doesn’t easily scratch and with a thick enough band (2mm +) I have yet to see it lose its shape while being worn.

Without a softened, rounded, beveled edge- this can be uncomfortable to some while wearing.. (especially when tightening hand/grip or, lifting and carrying things while wearing.)

Sizing: For reference I wear 6.75 ring -and ordering a sz.7 was a good fit. With a thicker width band, I had zero issue with it sliding off. This ring is good for stacking. **Hack: if necessary put it behind a perfect fitting ring and there will be no issue of it sliding off accidentally.

Overall, a solid product. But, one I feel that has a more masculine look/feel. I hope this info can help your decision… You’re free to let me know!

title: Looks fab! but, lacks comfort + long term warmth!
text:
Wanted to wait for snow before reviewing and here in Utah we finally got hit with the motherload of a storm!! So, let’s start by saying… I had the most fashion forward feet in the family, ordered in burgundy color size 8- (for reference: I wear 7.5-8m) these are to die for on point with fashion if, anyone must look the part of a snow bunny and trendy when in snow gear! The contrast between black/burgundy is great-

Wearing with a thermal insulated sock.. one made to add comfort, heat and wool moisture wicking..I found feet stayed warm in boot for about 2.25hrs. Afterwards, the cold began to creep in.. at a rapid pace. I did noticed the outer rubber around the toe itself began to feel hard/frozen as well. (As if it was freezing from the outside -if that is possible?) no, I wasn’t in knee deep snow either... but just enough snow to round the sides + front of toe itself. As this happened, the interior began to lose heat rapidly. So, this seems to lack adequate insulation on the sides/top of boot itself? Anyone familiar with snow gear and performance knows.. Snow gear is only as good as the warmth it provides! *keep in mind your need- how long do you plan to be in the elements? And how severe are your storms- as this provided warmth for a few hours and at certain depths.

As for comfort- this was my biggest disappointment- at a price point of $50-/+ I expect boot to be comfortable. It’s true!! Not all boots wear like your favorite running shoe- growing up in Utah, I know this! However, the bottom of boot is flat with very little if any cushion.. and lacks arch support. The sock you choose can make this better.. BUT, again for the $ I do expect more built-in. I chose to purchase a separate cushion insert.. and it helped a bit. Tbh, it’s hard to fit a separate support into a boot! Boots tend to have wider base and struggle to contour to the insert itself.. just something to keep in mind.

From one who’s a “lifer in the snow” and is now, 40 something yrs. old- I have tried it all! Higher price does not always equate to better performance.. So, it’s important to start looking early enough for a quality fit/function of your winter boot- just so you find your right fit- before the snow flies and depending on how much use your boots will get.. boots should last you a few seasons for sure. Especially when foot has stopped growing! These seem to boast quality construction and that is definitely a perk. I realize comfort is a personal expectation.. but, warmth is not! So, for those reasons I’ve deducted 1 star each. Use rule of thumb listed above: where you will use and how long- before deciding if this is right for you! I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: 3 dainty toe rings.. that meet the criteria!!
text:
After keeping an eye out in the “toe ring market” for a while.. I will admit I’ve made wrong purchases in the past and now, I know exactly what it is I’m looking for… And this is it!

I realize, these are not specific “have too” wear as Toe Rings.. But, I’m reviewing from that perspective because, that was our purpose for ordering! With a daughter in college in Southern Cali. She is in sandals 99% of the time and thus, she’s been searching for the perfect toe ring- I’ve been hunting since August and failed twice before with wrong purchases.. Ha! But, finally- I got it figured out!

1. You want to work with sterling silver .925 and I am hoping that’s what this is. It is soft and pliable- however, this almost feels as if, the ring is coated in sterling silver vs. being solid! Problem with other metals, they can be too rigid and not form as well to the toe, making them uncomfortable to wear/walk around on.. like a pebble stuck in your shoe on purpose!! (not to mention, foot sweat will turn most toes green with cheap metal- yuck!) so far- this has worn like sterling silver.. Let be honest and I’m sorry- But, toes are weird shape and therefore don’t be afraid when you remove the toe ring.. and see it’s probably conformed into a weird shape like your toe!! Ha.. just embrace it! When you want a comfortable fit.. sterling silver will conform to create that.

2. As much as I did not realize, you do want open ended ring. This will allow the ability to get the toe ring actually on the toe- to begin the molding process! Trust me- it will save you that “Sisti-ugler” moment of trying to cram on an item that just won’t work! The open gap allows small stretch.. so, it can fit AROUND the toe vs. solid circle that must slide OVER the top- simply bc, there is no other way to get it on. (** if wearing close toed shoe, I recommend removing ring- it will help avoid undo pressure from all sides to misshape the ring!!)

3. Rounded edges along the outer side of ring and specifically at the open ends- are a must! Unless, you want metal to feel as if it’s faux-piercing the bottom of toe with every step- be sure the open edges have a rounded curve.. just like these do!

4. Lastly- you do not want a width to be too wide.. funky as they are- your toes have a purpose and to do their job well, they need freedom to bend!! If too wide of width, it may not allow for necessary range or, bending motion- and trust me, after one day use of the wrong fit.. you’ll discard it and be done- and that is a waste!

If you use these above steps- it will give you the best odds of ordering the right toe ring on your first try! For a price point of $18.. you’ll receive 3 rings- easy to split up among others or, keep all 3 for yourself! I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Fun pjs with fun wearable option twists!!
text:
Super fun pair of relaxing lounge pj’s..!! I’ve included the verbiage “lounge” bc, these could morph into an outdoor ensemble if necessary.. they are perfect for dorm life where kids need to walk in the halls to/from bathroom and laundry room- bc, these are just that cute!

Material is light and airy, soft and flowing.. feels great against the skin. Being synthetic, they are a bit warmer then expected while sleeping.. material has a smooth almost slick sheen finish to the - I don’t love that.. (personally, I prefer cotton) but, it’s not a deal breaker. This has a really fun vibe to them- one that makes you want to crawl into PJ’s and stay in them all day..

As for the color this is a marbled pre-dyed material and not authentic tie-dye if, that matters to any? The perk with this… They do not bleed onto other clothes or, fade when washed. I do not recommend machine drying- if item fits as it should or, snug.. these will shrink! Which brings me to sizing- top seems to run a bit big vs. bottoms a bit snug! So, choose size accordingly. Personally we chose size by the bottom measurement.. if they’re not comfortable- I know they won’t be used.. ever! But- a larger top is manageable! This is my reason for deducting x1 star. Again, not a dealbreaker- but, I do feel sizing should be more compatible with one another- when sold in a set!

This is a fun set of PJs/loungewear that will look the part of adorable and be enjoyed by those who order. At a price point under $30 I just recommend.. be certain to size accordingly to the fit! I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

For reference: bought for my daughter in her dorm whos 5’5”, 140lb, 36B, with an overly athletic build.. (she is a varsity athlete in college!!) we ordered Medium.

title: Warmth, compression, cushion = trifecta of goodness!
text:
Wow! Never underestimate the power of warm feet.. this will make/break ones outside experience and make all the difference in the world!! Cold feet can make one miserable in any winter activity- and we found that out the hard way... my 17-year-old son took a winter job doing snow removal from driveways- in Utah, that could be a lot of outside time and cold feet!
My research led me to RTZAT Thermal socks and tbh, we haven’t looked back sense! Obviously, it’s necessary to have insulated footwear/boots but, the next layer is of equal importance.. and it’s the sock!! These are easy to get on/off and for reference we doing so, on an 11.5 foot size.

After washing, we’ve had no issue with shrinkage- these have kept their elastin integrity and structural quality. No loose rubber threads that one begins to pull- you know, the thread that unravel the entire sock but… when it appears we just can’t help but pull on it🤦🏼‍♀️?!! Yep! That kind- these socks have not had any as of yet.. and I’ve washed over dzn. cycles already.

I love the “Goldilocks” amount of compression that keeps circulation flowing and that provides heat to the foot as well- these are not too loose/tight.. but, just right! Made from thicker materials- the padding is such an added perk when wearing boots- these are crewcut and help provide padding mid calf, where his boot tends to rub.. I don’t think winter snow boots are the most comfortable things to begin with.. so, yay for comfort!!
With a price point of $12- I feel will get our moneys worth for certain.. definitely will last 1+ winter season for sure. I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Hard to decipher when to wear this..??!
text:
Soft long sleeve top that feels confused at to what it’s trying to be!! With a long sleeve and a premier debut in the fall.. one can assume, this is made for colder months- However, material is lighter and thinner and doesn’t produce a lot of warmth.

Material is soft don’t get me wrong… It’s that cross between rayon poly model..?!! (Its the material that is solid white on inside and only outside has color?? I still have a hard time figuring out.. how that even works?!) It has a very smooth feel to the touch. Truth be told the synthetic would be hot in warmer climates yet, with an absence of sweater/heavier material it’s not considered a warm winter staple either. Now, you can see why I call it confused!

As for the sleeves..?!! These have a finished cap end! Its not elastic- NoPe! So, no raising sleeve if hot.. these have non stretchable material as a finishing edge found on the gathered sleeve. One can get this over the hand just fine but, it doesn’t have amy elasticity to push up and fit or, stay at the forearm!? So, the capped end is purely a cosmetic look only.

The V-neck is nice and not too low- it is a nice design to show off a necklace or, even a tank top underneath (I paired with white tank myself- and liked the white contrast stripe stood out much better..) The length is just enough to cover the bum- not too long.. being shorter, I appreciate that i’m not swimming in excess material like a dress!

This is a very unique piece and it may fit into someone’s closet nicely- depending on the weather and purpose you need it for.. it could be a nice “extra” addition. I definitely don’t see this becoming a closet “staple!” I’d categorize this as a step above a long sleeve Tee- this top can be a fun way to change up ones standard look- At a price point of $16- it’s an inexpensive way to do it. for reference: I got XL. I am 5’2”, 152lb, 38CC, 40+ yr. old with my trouble spot carried through mid section (thx to having x4 kids and gravity!) I also ordered bigger to insure the fit thru the chest.. and this did just fine. I hope this info can help your decision… feel free to let me know!

title: These are a snug slumber party for your feet!!
text:
These are like a snug little slumber party for the feet.. they are just that great!! Material feels thick like a quality crew socks should.. Colors are bright and festive and do not fade while washing- Best part of all, these are unisex and capable of fitting a wide range of adult size feet..!! These fit female sz. 8, men’s sz. 10.5, men’s sz. 9W.. truly, one set covered the 3 sets of adult feet.. So, a great $ price point and very convenient to do a one stop shop/order to get 3 pair that fit a wide range!

These feel warm and inviting- totally have stretch which, makes it easy to get these on/off.. But, best part of all- when on the foot.. these are not loose and actually give you a secure snug fit! They have good compression in both, the ankle and foot.. which I love and yet, its not too constricting. It gives you a feel of wearing more then, just a sock when you have them on alone... crazy nice!

Only downside to be aware of- don’t plan on wearing with shoes.. the rubber bottom treads don’t like to let your foot naturally slip into a shoe.. The grip does it’s job and grabs onto inside lining. TBH, stepping into a boot would be only way to wear with a shoe.
I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Oversized fluff of goodness...!!!
text:
Ordered this for winter months in Utah.. and I’m loving the oversized fluff in comfort that this provides! I’m noticing some reviews show a button down sweater- My order was the open front cardigan in blush.. and I cannot believe how perfect the color is! (Tbh, it’s totally out of my wheelhouse and that makes me like it even more?!!) This is the lightest hue of champagne blush and its easily matched with everything- love this with white T and denims underneath.. A warm version of the “mom uniform!”

As mentioned material is beyond soft and has a higher loop/pile (i’ve heard this is referred to as popcorn weave?!) all I can say, is its soft!! Washing instructions make this a bit more technical.. it calls for hand washing but, I plan to have it professionally cleaned.

Length of sweater drops down to top of thighs.. and front is open without buttons, **which I prefer it had @ least 1-2 of them for when you need to keep the chill out.. it would be nice to have the option to button up. Sleeves are 3/4 length and only issue l’ve noticed is sleeve is loose around the forearm.. those with shorter arms can expect this to hit just above the wrist bone. (hoping after I wash- it will tighten?!) Sold @ price point $30.. this is a solid cocoon style wrap around sweater. It provides both, fashion and function- and its a fun addition to any fall or, winter wardrobe.
I ordered XL and this fit a bit large- but, I was unsure if this would in chest- so, I ordered but.. For reference: I’m 5’2”, 154, 38C, 40+yr. with my trouble spot thru the middle.. (thank you x4 kids and gravity!)
I hope this info can help your decision.. feel free to let me know!

title: Sporty slipper with athletic shoe perks!
text:
Love these so much this is my second pair.. A new season, a new slipper! These are a blend of real slipper comfort mixed with Athletic shoe integrity and support.

I see some listed concerns with sizing but, I tend to disagree! I’m a true sz.8 and ordered as such… Upon arrival of first pair- my toe was at the end so, I kept them for my daughter but, chose to order up a size for myself... While waiting for the bigger pair to arrive, I kept slipping her size 8 on and found, it just took a minute to have my foot find its comfort spot amid all the fluff!! So much so.. I sent back the larger size when it arrived! Take note: these may feel short upon arrival but, the fluffy cushion will give way a bit! You decide.. if you want this to hug your foot and stay securely put if so, don’t order too big!! (I can wear mine with regular sock and it fits just fine as well..)

I wear shoes 24/7 but, can slip these on while in house.. so, I am not tracking intense dirt from outdoors while wearing in the home. A little secret- these are great for carpool running, pull garbage cans to the curb, entering the storage cellar- all bc, the bottom is a rubber sole athletic shoe.. these wont let water in- and I love it!!!

A pair will last a good slipper season- I do wear in house for 7-8 months.. just until I can switch to flip flops! (Utah cold- ugh!) So, I suggest replacing each year/season.. for solid integrity and support. Another great perk- we bought pair for grandma.. she loves ability to get on/off on her own! We love she has rubber bottom support to help her footing.. kids hate she wears now, 365 days a yr. Ha! Its function over fashion!
These have at least a 1/2” rim to give more side support and help them stay on.. see photos included.

Aesthetically these are quite sporty! Think winter puffer jacket meets an athletic shoe and has a baby.. this is it! These provide warmth and waterproofing like no other slipper I've owned- all with the assurance of an athletic shoe.. a great concept and at a price point approx $25 - you’ll get your $ worth for sure! I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Fashion over function in this Henley..!!!
text:
Roomier in size then expected.. feels almost like this has excess material compared to my experience with Henley style tops- this isn’t “baggy” but, has a more roomier fit- don’t expect a contoured fit or, close worn warmth one usually receives with that famous “waffle woven material” of the Henley top... Growing up in the heart of the Wasatch/Rocky Mtn.‘s Henleys were worn with a purpose- and warmth was all about layers.. starting with thermal base layer, the Henley came next to top it off. Best translation for this top would be, this is aesthetically Henley style- as you have the long sleeve, cuffed collar and famous 12 button down neck! If you know that going in, it will save cold disappointment- this is fashion overflowing for sure!!

Material is very soft. It has a light/medium weight and wears/fits quite nice- original style should hug the body and this is not as much. Very forgiving for any trouble spots!

I chose the maroon washed color and the hue is as photographed with a bit more pink than purple. Attention to detail seems to be on point, I have no loose buttons or seams- overall, it feels like a solid made top.. as instructed and I would agree, do not machine wash/dry- use delicate cycle and line dry.. (this may matter to some so, I pointed out..) I ordered XL- for reference I am: I’m 5’2”, 154, 40+yr old, 38C, with my trouble thru the middle (thx- 4kids and gravity for this!) in order to get ample room in chest I must order up in size!

I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: All round perfect choice- total classic!!
text:
Classic Adidas.. One of the most consistent brands, I find myself returning to year after year- there is just something about going back to the classics when you’re tired of the latest trends.. LOVE this hat! It fits the solid standard of what a baseball hat should be and looks good doing it..

Sizing: spot on! bought for my 17yr old son who’s head has the oddest of shapes! I love him dearly.. odd shaped head and all!! He has a large head- ans its “square in back” and also.. elongated?!! (Facts!) I appreciate the snapback as it can adjust- but, I find Adidas 5 panel baseball hats have a great depth.. truly, After purchasing many of baseball hats over the decades for my x4 avid sport playing adult kiddos.. I can tell you, hands-down.. Adidas makes one of the best 5 panel caps out there! Mark my words- the material used is solid and holds up to the rigor you may put it through-
So much so, one can plan on owning it for quite some time. Only, as I mention its solid structure this also has the unique ability to mold and conform to ones head- like magic!! I think this is the best part..

Color: we chose black/white as, this is Adidas “signature color/look” making it compatible with so many Adidas athletic pants, hoodies, travel uniforms, jackets, etc.. (all of which my kids live in with their competitive sport teams) this accompanies the clothing and even creates a finished and/or, polished off look!
The only downside to black.. is the sweat mark, aka-salt!! When sweat dries on black, it can leave a “white wash” on the brim.. and with black, its very noticeable. After much trial/error I’ve found the best way to remove it- HACK: wash immediately especially if, salt stained!!! Easiest way- put on top shelf of dishwasher with a bowl inside the cap (helps hat to keep its shape..) then, run washer on regular cycle using regular soap! **its best to pretreat stain with baking soda by lightly scrubbing a circular motion with an old toothbrush- trust me, this entire hack is priceless if, you jump right on the stain!

Possible issue: rope across the bill is not 100% sewn in place- its only tact stitched so, if this gives way- I’ll just clip off completely and remove. (just something to make you aware of..)

For any who are looking for a solid baseball hat that has universal ability… One that is unisex- 100% on trend with teens and adults alike. Made to wear in athletic activities but, can deviate to casual wear just as well.. a total classic and all round perfect choice- I recommend 100%! I hope this info. can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: High maintenance and questionable sizing..
text:
Not sure why but for once… Something fits perfect in the waist but, too tight in the thighs?? I never had that issue- if the waist fits then, the leg/thigh fit.. and these, I can get them on but when I sit/bend- I feel the pressure on the leg opening..? I’m guessing it’s the inseam length. (These are meant to hit at the upper thigh- by default thats the largest point of the leg..) For reference: Im 5’2”, 154, 38C, 40-ish yr. old, with my trouble spot is my waist- (thank you to my x4kids + gravity for that!) and never have I struggled with thigh width..?!!

I’ve seen other reviews had “fit issues” with being too large/small... So, it appears these might be tricky to figure out.. **something to definitely keep in mind when ordering. Trust me, I really wanted to like these- And although it lists having stretch/spandex in the mix.. I didn’t see it! Other than the elastic waist band, which is totally different -I didn’t feel stretch in the material- which is probably due to the finish stitch at bottom of leg- the material cant stretch, the finishing thread will pop!

The waist itself is paper bag style, slips on/off even though these are equipped with a zipper.. it’s just to dress it up-but, not necessary to the function when taking on/off. I will say the pockets are great and plenty big to fit even the larger size cell phones in… they’re also strategically placed- and comfortable to put ones hands inside.
I suggest washing on delicate and line drying to avoid excess shrinking and/or, distorting of shape. These will obviously wrinkle and be very careful with ironing- i’d recommend steam pressing as an alternative. For these reasons, these aren’t very practical- but, this is a personal preference. I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Classic.. universally loved- great “go to” gift!!
text:
Totally iconic Adidas, in providing a complete classic style- the one we all know and love!! This doesn’t try to add some unique twist nor, want to reinvent the wheel.. This is just a sleek, straightforward, 100% purely classic style beanie! Something so many people have come to expect and appreciate!! I’ve ordered 2 of their beanies the past 2wks... I’m stocking up for Christmas gifts- trust me, these are perfect for my college kids stockings stuffers or, that friend gift your kiddo forgets to tell you they need until the last second!!!

Material used is soft and does not create the dreaded “hat head” itch when worn- and I'm talking, even when worn all day! My 17yr old opts to wear a beanie in leui of when most would adorn the baseball hat- Yes! 24/7 -365 days of the year! (365 even includes summer!! Which btw, drives his dad crazy!!) I’d like to say it’s a hip trendy phase- but, we’re coming up on 3+ years of this now- and still going strong! And mind you.. My son is the type to complain about a pea under his mattress…(you know that type…the youngest with that golden child attitude?!) So, IF this made him too hot, itchy, uncomfortable or, not stylish.. it would be a no go and yet, he religiously wears this. That is the best endorsement if there ever was one!!

So, this may make you wonder- can this breathable hat actually keep you warm? Yes sir!! Made from acrylic, this will help keep anyone’s head retain the heat as needed, even in the cold Utah winters- Keep in mind: This does not have heavy wool or, fleece liner.. but, this isn’t snow hat peeps, it’s a beanie! Every day where in my book is different then, Snow gear!

This is a perfect blend of elastin which is used to maintain the shape of the beanie itself.. And to help keep the hat on top of the head! Surprisingly, this has ample stretch and can fit the largest of heads- Yet take note, this isn’t the slouchy style trend.. NO!! This is the classic “night watch cap” by definition -Best part of all, it is a beanie that can mold to the head and as we all know, not all head shapes are created equal- but, with this hats ability to shape shift.. it really can be a “one-size-fits-all!“ And then, with a run thru the machine wash/dry cycle as needed.. it can fall back into shape- like magic! (Note: as with any beanie.. avoid heat drying if, concern for shrinking. I tend to avoid this at first and use dryer when beanie becomes worn in and seems to become too loose- boom! Doing this, Beanie will be back in action..!!) **Also, with the folded edge this is adjustable! One can adjust hat size by less/more of the fold- A total bonus in getting the right fit!

As you can see I’m a total fan and true believer Adidas makes the best beanie by far 100%- at a slightly higher price point it is worth it.. As, this will last you seasons to come! With a child who wears a beanie as often as he wears underwear, I’ve tried every version on the market and hands-down this is our “go to” every time! I hope this info helps your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Solid quality - really impressed!
text:
Ordered for my new brother-in-law.. Who left Ghana 18 months ago, seeking refuge from the disruption in his country-

Now, living in U.S. with so much turmoil, he speaks of hope and how speeches by MLK + MalcolmX have inspired his way of thinking so, this felt appropriate. The past x6-8 times I’ve seen him, he’s had it on- and it makes me happy!

The hat itself is solid, top to bottom -No cheap, gimmicky, gas station quality at all! Many times when trends sweep through.. sellers rush to find the cheapest product they can slap their slogan upon.. and sell it while the moments hot, hot, hot!! You’ll be glad to know, this ISN’T that caliber at all-

The very bold, thick, stitching on the front makes the X stand out clear and prominent in it embroidering that is reinforced nicely. On the reverse side- in a smaller, more complex space there is embroidery print as well only- this is done in thinner lettering detail then, “X” ...For obvious reasons, it’s not as thick or, bold. But, the smaller space + many letters would be very hard to read unless, done thinner and on print.

This has a Snapback for adjustable width in sizing. The only thing noticed: this hat seems to have a shorter drop! It doesn’t have a very deep bowl.. I dont have biggest build/head but, most adult male hats fit me just over the top of the ear and this hat does not. Note: ** I tried this on prior to giving just for review purposes. On most adults, this hat will most likely end above the ears.. and I mention In case this matters to anyone. If this sounds confusing..?? I attached photos to show in detail. Overall, this is solid quality and priced accordingly @ $15. I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Great in theory- BUT, these have a way short inseam!!!
text:
Ordered this item as we were hoping to try unique style a boxer briefs. In leui of an open fly this has a pouch style front that is created to offer a different option and lend support, comfortable room for ones “package.” In all honesty I’m trying to provide a respectful and thorough review but, being it was my 17yr old son who was the one to give these a “test drive” ..lets just say he is not (in any capacity!) wanting to have this chat with me about fit and function- go figure!! (TBH, I Purchased these for my husband however… They were too small!) husband is 36x36 and these fit son who’s waist is 3” smaller. For reference: 182lb, 6’4”, with Active but, not athletic build. In between man/boy body.. he is 33x36... with most of his height in the leg.

These have a softness to the material that is noticeable from when they arrive and are free from an itchy tag! Waistband is thick and appreciated… Neither activity nor, sitting in class cause the waistband to roll down. However, these struggle to stay in place on the legs. There is no extra elastin or compression to support leg openings from becoming stretched out and riding up. Basically, they end up bunching all the material in the groin area- not a good feel, I’m told!! Take note: The inseam is short!! This may be a compounded issue due to the height? But, for any who are in the same size category.. just be aware! Before removing, my son showed me the leg openings after a day of wearing.. you can loop 2-3” of material in on itself- So, yes! These stretch out!!

After washing dzn. + cycles in washer/dryer we have had no loose elastic fray, tear or folds creased into the band. These do shrink about a solid 1” so, again be aware of sizing issues. For the price this is a decent deal for the 5pk. If not for construction sliding up in the legs- this would be a nice pair of pouched boxer briefs.

title: The perfect really beanie… But, It runs small!
text:
This had me from hello… I looked forward to the arrival of this beanie, like a kid waits for the 1st day of school to wear their brand new shoes!! Upon receiving, the burgundy wine color was just as smooth as it looks online- beautiful!

And then, the moment of truth… Yes! this hat is amazingly awesome in every way with one major caveat.. it’s way too tight!! (you know… When hair is in a ponytail all day and the tightness will cause your head to pulsate kind of tight?! This hat did that.) it’s made for adults, in adult sizing and I am one of those, so why.. Why?!!

Material is soft as butter… construction is totally on par with major brand competitors- no loose, pulled strings or, threads (CUT not PULL off any attached tags people!! Spare yourself a new hat faux pas!) The colors/dyes used are spot on- Ha! I even like the little tag on the edge which is weird bc, usually I don’t! All this needs is to adjust sizing or, offer in a larger size? Maybe sell I semi adult and large head adult?! Truly, I don’t think I have a big head (and I’m not talking metaphorically!) it’s only the sizing that makes this a no-go for me.

Tightness seems to be caused by the elastin in the material and I understand why its used- to keep its shape and to keep beanie in place on the head. But, it does not offer a lot of give nor, realistic amount of “empty space“ for your head to comfortably snuggle inside. **This would be a perfect hat for any older child, preteen- and I’m sure they’d love it!

In honor of giving this a full test drive… I wore beanie while shoveling our 1st snow of winter in Utah- If I was able to keep in place over the ears.. this will provide plenty of warmth. This hat was not itchy in any capacity. (And that’s even while snow was making it damp- which is the true itch test and this passed!)

Overall, I just deducted one star- only bc.. nothing about this beanie is wrong. The sizing that accompanies it, was my issue. If made in a larger size- this would be perfect. I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Great for those with larger head- and picky taste!
text:
A great find! “heads up” (ha.. no pun intended!) For any with a larger head or, who can find discomfort after wearing a beanie a few hrs. bc, of the elastin in most beanies (this is used to help a hat keep its shape + stay in place..) In smaller or, tighter knit hats this can compress ones head circumference.. and give that pulsing feeling after wearing too long- (like wearing a ponytail too tight all day!) Best thing.. this hat doesn’t cause the pain!!!

The beanie has ample give and yet, if it becomes too stretched out… A quick run through the washing machine will reshape this perfectly! No need to machine dry, just my flat- this is my sons favorite feature! Not only does he have a large circumference head.. he has a lot of curly hair to go with it.. and bc, at 17yr old, it’s all about wearing a beanie 24/7- The hat is perfect. It doesn’t cause discomfort and re-shapes as needed! Not to mention, it does help and a great price point of under $10... loving that!

Might I add 2 other great features as well as the fit; First- the material is not itchy and for obvious reasons, that is huge- Trust me, it would be a dealbreaker without softness and this has plenty!! Second- if you do not like the slouch style beanie, which translates too.. the excess room of nothing, found at the top of the hat.. you know, the material that gives it “the bulldog wrinkle effect!?” Well, one can easily adjust and situate the cuff on the rim of the beanie and eliminate that poof on the top! It stays roomie- but, a lot less and that’s a winner if there ever was one.. !!

Bottom line, if you have a larger head take it from a semi professional beanie connoisseur… (bc, I’ve tried so many- it makes me a pro!?) This is a pretty safe bet to try! For the price, quality, style you will get a trifecta of goodness. I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Great addition to the standard “mom uniform!”
text:
A great hooded sweatshirt that is a perfect addition for your everyday wear- love how easy one can throw this on with a pair of yoga pants and have it look great! This takes casual and kicks it up a notch to a look that is just more “on point” with both, the cut and style!! This top blows away the look of that oversized worn in hoodie sweatshirt.. bc, this gives off the vibe that makes you look as if you put in a lot of effort -all without even trying!!

I love the thinner material. Don’t get me wrong, this is cozy… But, I tend to run a bit warm and love if I’m cooking, cleaning, running carpool- working up a good heat.. I don’t feel totally encumbered by a bulky sweatshirt- and yet, if it is colder weather- just pop a long sleeve T underneath, no problem! it’s such an easy fix.

I ordered XL in black (Love this with black yoga pants… It’s my mom “ninja“ uniform ha ha..!!!) for reference: 151lb, 5’2”, 38C, trouble spot is my mid section (thank you x4 babies and gravity for that!!)
This top has ample length in sleeve, it has plenty of breathing room for the “girls!” and length hits bottom of bum-

I love the zippered neck.. allowing you to pull it on without causing major static electricity that drives me crazy when dragged over your head (especially in dry winter!) This opens and slides over with ease AND.. it’s this same zipper that makes it look like you’ve put in a lot more effort and changes the hoodie look completely. You go from “raggedy sweatshirt to a hip and trendy outfit!”’

I love the amount of stretch this provides- its ample to move so you do not feel as if, you’re tangled or, constricted. This is also very forgiving it doesn’t show every lump or bump- and it can be used for workouts.. woot-woot!! (imagine athletic clothes used for athletics ha ha..) material washes up nice- I’ve both, washed/dry in machine and have no issue with shrinkage. *I have noticed, there is a bit of pilling around the sleeve openings after 6+ washes.. i’m not too disappointed because of the price point @ $21... But, I’m hoping it lasts at least a full season of winter.. to prolong life, I’m going to scale back on washing to only when needed vs. every time I wear it. For this reason I deducted one star-
I hope this info can help your decision.. feel free to let me know!

title: Perfect- worth $ and will actually work comfortably!!
text:
After keeping an eye out in the “toe ring market” for a while.. I will admit I’ve made wrong purchases in the past and now, I know exactly what it is I’m looking for… And this is it!

I realize, these are not specific “have too” wear as Toe Rings.. But, I’m reviewing from that perspective because, that was our purpose for ordering! With a daughter in college in Southern Cali. She is in sandals 99% of the time and thus, she’s been searching for the ‘Goldilocks’ of toe rings- which translates to… One that fits just right! I’ve truly been hunting since August, I’ve failed twice before with wrong purchases.. Now, I got it figured out!

1. You want to work with sterling silver .925 and that is exactly what this is. It is soft and pliable. Problem with other metals, they were rigid and did not form as well to the toe, making them uncomfortable to wear/walk around on.. like a pebble stuck in your shoe on purpose!! (not to mention, foot sweat will turn most toes green with cheap metal- yuck!) TBH, I’m sorry, toes are weird shape and therefore don’t be afraid when you takeoff the toe ring.. it too is probably conformed into a weird shape too!! Ha.. That’s because it molds to the funky toe- So, just embrace it!

2. As much as I did not realize, you do want open ended ring. This will allow the ability to get the toe ring actually on the toe- to begin the molding process! Trust me- it will save you that “Sisti-ugler” moment of trying to cram on an item that just won’t work! The open gap allows small stretch.. so, it can fit AROUND the toe vs. solid circle that must slide OVER the top- simply bc, there is no other way to get it on.

3. Rounded edges along the outer side of ring and specifically at the open ends- are a must! Unless, you want metal to feel as if it’s faux-piercing the bottom of toe with every step- be sure the open edges have a rounded curve.. just like these do!

4. Lastly- you do not want a width to be too wide.. funky as they are- your toes have a purpose and to do their job well, they need freedom to bend!! If too wide of width, it may not allow for necessary range or, bending motion- and trust me, after one day use of the wrong fit.. you’ll discard it and be done- and that is a waste!

That’s it!! Follow the few easy steps and you are good to go- do so, gives you the best odds at getting this right with your 1st order. Select any print, style or, design that floats your boat!! For a price point of $15… It may feel a little high but, do NOT forget.. This is a set made in sterling silver and in actuality- you get a great deal- $7.50 for ea. ring!! I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!
