title: Soft as can be- But, disproportioned measurements!
text:
Imagine the most inviting blanket of softness and someone makes you a comfortable lounge set of clothing out of it- this is just that! This is one of the softer materials to snuggle up too- Only, when you put this on are you met with an outfit of issues and disproportion- And try as I might, like Cinderella’s sister to make this softness fit- it didn’t work for myself!! Just be aware of what to expect with this little number..

The material is so inviting! You feel a warm, worn in goodness in this synthetic fabric.. it has enough fuzzy to be soft- without any feeling of fake fur or, a matted mess. It is made of a thinner material so, it’s not too heavy and easy to move in.. The synthetic fabric itself contributes to it’s ability to stay warm. You’ll find the bottom edge of pants are cuffed, keeping them in place and waist line is elastic with a tie feature to fasten for a personal fit...

Only, the fit is my problem!! The top is a hooded cropped pullover style that has left bottom edge 100% raw! The shorter length and thinner material combined with this unfinished edge- let’s this top begin to roll up when wearing.. and not in a good way!! this took place with the outfit in the largest size possible.. Now, the pant has a high waist (as shown in photo..) and unless, you are Barbie herself- I am unsure how these pants would ever fit?! As the legs are plenty long- they offer some room for the hips and thighs before they taper down to the bottom.. but, it seems the roominess is placed in the wrong spot- disproportioned? The problem starts in the waist with it being really narrow and maybe too high? *appropriate curves placed in specific areas on these pants just feel off.. the width for the hips feels out of line for the high waisted effect- Yes! I’ve worn high waisted before- Ha! I am one who DID live the 80s fashion in the 80’s..!! and these measurements don’t seem realistic- unless you’re without female curves it the appropriate places- being these are adult sizes, they should account for at least some hourglass shape. **NOTE: Part of the problem can be MY lack of height.. and therefore, this may fit some incredibly taller, long torso’d person a bit better?! I will try on my college age “ tall drink of water when she arrives !!” It just didn’t seem to match up on any level for myself or, what I would consider the norm. or, expected.. average!?

•I deducted 1 star for the raw edge that causes the material on this top to roll.. it needs weight to keep top raw hem in place and has none.. I deducted 1 star as well for the pant construction issues as well. If you find yourself interested in this top/bottom set.. you’ll need to be prepared to mix/match/find sizing that may work for you- bc, of this dilemma… I do not see or, recommend this as a good gifting idea! TBH, this seems hard enough to match fit for oneself… Let alone, guess for another person. I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

UPDATE: because these were such a wrong fit for my short/squatty stature- I gave them to daughter who was home for holidays.. she fit in them so so well!! 5’6”, 140lb, 36C... 32” inseam, athletic build. She loved how soft and comfortable these felt. **Only- after wearing about 3hr. I noticed as she was lying on floor in front of fireplace- she had a tear in the material.. But, she had a lot more than that going on!! Christmas lounging and nothing else was the cause.. Wow! TBH, she’s devastated by the outcome since, these are single-handedly the softest most inviting pajamas she ever remembers putting on. I’m not certain if the stitching missed the edge of the material? It’s almost as if the loose fabric cannot hold together the actual stitching of two pieces?
I have included photos and keep in mind this is after wearing for a few hrs. And not washing at all... sad to say, with better quality construction- these would be knocked out of the park..!!! I looked and saw another review had the same issue on a sleeve seam? Maybe this is hit or miss… But, before I endorse I want to make certain it is something you all are aware of!

title: Use standard sizing NoT size chart provided
text:
Not going to lie… I was so looking forward to these!! The extra large size chart states everything I was after in every capacity especially the length- But, The icing on the cake was the measurement in the waist: it states a 37-39... this was the comfort with extra room I was hoping to get.. (personal measurement is 34.25 ) Knowing the measurement would be bigger had me excited to wash and dry these in the machine with ease, not worried about shrinking.. BUT, that was just not the case!! This is the difference- we all know, that XL should most likely translate to a waist size of approx. 30-32 and that is just what these are in actuality!! So, when seeing others list these are accurate size… That’s not wrong!! **So, accurate sizes if, thinking normal expectations vs. posted sizes on the site!

As for structure and build- they are totally on point! Right down to the details in the “box crotch” stitching.. these are comfortable to wear, sit in and workout. The perks keep coming in the fact, they have a doable length.. with these not being actual Capri or, 7/8 length style, they are still not too long! (This matters for any who are vertically challenged!) All seams seem finished with detail and no loose strings or, loose craftsmanship- and what is crazy awesome about this, these are sold at a Price point under $20 a pair!! (that is the steal for how well these have been constructed!!) material used is not too thin- it offers A great amount of support, compression.. and coverage!

The pockets take the cake!! The pockets are beyond useful if needed.. and lay flat practically out of sight if not in use, no gaping or sagging!! The size of actual opening can easily fit cell phone, car key, debit card/ID.. and when washed up, these little gems find their shape again really well!

If looking for a solid yoga pants that you will get plenty of mileage out of- and pick them up for a great deal.. these are a perfect option! Just be sure to use reviews and size comparassions for reference and not the website chart.. you won’t be disappointment. I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

Bc, of my inability to wear with size/fit.. these were for person who is for reference: 150lb. 5’4”, 38B, carries thru mid/thigh section, Pacific Islander decent.

title: Had to hem length almost 3” for a 5’3” person..!!
text:
Scrubs are just one of those things... that are necessary in the medical world and yet, they still have not made them very fashion forward..!! Having said that, one way to add a little flair is by fun colors and design. I chose to order these in black and use for the Halloween festivities at the office- what works quite well with a solid color idea… They can be used for other regular day scrubs as well! I suggest getting colors vs. holiday prints! With color matching you will definitely get more bang for your buck and will not be limited to one small holiday window.. just a helpful hint to pass along! Hack: add a fun printed lanyard in holiday theme.. its so economical and a way to add flare to your scrubs.. giving an easy holiday touch. Ha! keep in mind, accessories just “pop!” on the black background..!!

Fit: scrubs have no stretch.. across-the-board in design, this just is not a thing Ive ever found. These are no exception.. Tops: cut is a bit more fitted (silhouetted) and therefore, run a tad smaller then expected or, standard. If between sizes I suggest- sizing up. The top has a piping seam leading off the neck opening.. My concern was this would feel awkward but, I was pleasantly surprised.. it is this line that helps give the “female figure appearance” and no! not a sexy ulala vibe… Just overall feminine feel.. if that makes sense?! The pockets are perfectly placed right off the waist line- making them very useful, ample big and easy access to hold all your expected items. Bottoms: pant offers plenty of length- being worn by 5’3” person.. these had to be hemmed in order to fit a shorter rounder thru mid section person. But, waist, hip, thigh all on point with fit.. some brands offer a taper at the ankle, these do not. So, expect “boot cut.”
For reference these were fitted to: 5’3”, 154lb, 36c, 3mo. Post partum from having a new baby!

Material has the standard pre-treated expectation scrubs should have.. the scotch-guarding for stain resistance is there! I see the attention to stitch and detailing- with no loose seams/threads. These have an overall feel of quality.. and confidence that they will step up to the task of a “day in the life in scrubs!”

At a time when covid is raising havoc worldwide.. these are a staple for first responders- they not only need something easy and durable to wear each day but, an item made to keep to keep up and perform without issue.. these feel solid. With a price point of $28 a piece, is on par with solid scrubs and as long as these have the ability to go the distance- they should be a good investment. I hope this info can help your decision.. Feel free to let me know!

title: All inclusive small footprint- made for Younger audience!
text:
This is a small “all in one- mini wallet center!!” Meaning... it can be all inclusive if carried alone and I believe that is the idea behind this. This wallet is meant to take up very little space and does not disappoint in that arena. It’s very thin, can fit a few (4) credit cards, plus a small see thru ID slot which is convenient.. the window shows all needed info. on ones license.. it doesn’t cut off viewing edges or complete #’s on the front (at least on the utah version!) This is a perk bc, it allows you to leave ID inside wallet when verifying (and extra helpful bc, this is not an easy slot to get item in/out of it!) With ID window on interior of wallet- one would show their ID in same fashion.. as flashing an FBI badge!
I appreciate no credit card/ID is exposed or, stored on the exterior… A small snap closes up all your important items on the inside, and secured by just fastening this snap.. I included photo to help explain.. In the interior section is also where you’d find opening for physical money- and any hidden (4) pockets! *Note: I do not consider hidden pockets actual card slot- these are the spaces found on the underside of slotted card holders.. I refer to them as such- bc, this is where you tuck in your emergency $20 or, any personal item, note, photo, etc.. you prefer to keep out of sight.

Zip coin holder.. this is made to catch coins handed back in any transactions- remember, since this is made to have a tiny footprint and carry easily.. the coin section is flat against wallet and doesn’t hold “bulk coin!“ All just to help keep it sleek and small!

This has fringed tassel key chain clip or, “bling accessory” and in keeping all inclusive idea in mind- One can hook their car key or, ID badge to the hook so, again.. it’s all in one! (tassel can be removed if wanted.. not fringed but, spiraled- look at photo included.) tbh, I haven’t decided if I like it or, not just yet!?

The aesthetics is meant to give you a refined leather look- but, tbh- I ordered in light blue.. and it does give A bit of the impression that it is fake leather.. So, keep this in mind- depending on color you order in.. leather usually isn’t light blue, and I’m ok with that!
Overall, this reminds me of a younger girls wallet; teen, college or otherwise.. of course, it can be used by any- I’m 40+ yr. old and will use it for when I’m traveling and need an “all in one” hand held option vs. wallet purse. But, for daily use- I feel it has a more.. Younger/beginner wallet vibe. Something used before adulting into that “upper level” real, sophisticated and grown-up wallet! I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: You’re paying for sentimental meaning- but, its sweet!
text:
Such a clever idea.. a fun, simple design that offers a twist on matching jewelry made for two- Ok.. so, the logic behind this: it’s a “keep + share” gift.. But, more then just giving matching items- This set is accompanied with the sentimental “pinky promise“ bond card that tells recipient the meaning behind the bracelets themselves. This is meant to be a special reminder of the promise to have each other’s back.. and it takes the sentiment a step further by including both, giver/recipient initials on each bead. So, when worn.. its a hidden or, subtle reminder of who it is that has their back!

As stated this is very simply constructed.. made on quality embroidery floss, It has a simple heart shape bead threaded onto the floss. That bead is secured by a basic knot in the string on both sides. This is a slide closure.. so, it can be adjusted big/small and is made “one size fits most.” Loving this so, that it can be taken on/off vs. tying and having to cut off (rendering it useless..) **I also love fact, it can be put on using one hand- this is a huge perk for any who struggle to get jewelry on otherwise!!

Issues/cons:: not all men want to wear a heart shaped bead on their wrist! Sad but true… This needs to offer a more unisex shape to be more giftable to males.. (ie. my 17yr. old son gave to his girlfriend amid crazy covid time.. he appreciated giving her the sentimental “promise” but, struggled with the heart he will wear now!) The Price point for embroidery floss and metal bead is $15- is at the higher end and although, it is really unique and a great find… it is a higher price for the actual constructed item. The value seems to be all in the unique sentiment behind it.
This could be given as a gift to: boy/girlfriend, BFF, spouse, son, daughter etc.. just keep in mind the heart shape and recipient! I hope this info can help in your decision… Feel free to let me know!
(Photo included is my son wearing his bracelet..!!)

title: Best Van Heusen we’ve ever purchased!!
text:
U-lá-lá.. and yes, i’m talking about a men’s dress shirt go figure!! This is a nice solidly crafted Van Heusen button down that is every bit the part of business attire and made to hold its own in the corporate world.. yet, I came home to my husband who had this untucked and looking even a bit disheveled- and I can say the button down was every bit impressive as a casual dress shirt of sorts as well! Giving the hybrid a business/don’t care business casual attitude all rolled into one..!!!

This button down holds up to the standard expectations we expect with Van Heusen brand.. it measured up in all departments on cue; sleeve, neck, shoulder and body length just fine. This is a regular/slim cut- but, do not let that deter you.. as that just equates to eliminating a bit of the excess bulk of material- All while still providing ample room for comfort.

This is great for a solid staple in the businessman’s closet.. The minimal color, pattern or, design these offer are made just to enhance the closet staples.. they are not statement pieces or trendy in anyway- allowing this to be worn 1,2,3+ yr. from now.. and that is a total perk! A little variation adds a subtle difference to the solid colored closet a business shirt.. but, won’t scream trendy if worn x2yr from now!
How do they do it..??? The fabric is pre-treated with some magical Voodoo to help keep this stain resistant and yet, it’s all done without feeling like one is wearing a tent tarp or, canvas?! It’s amazing and I would like to pre-treat my entire home with this magic.. my husband works in the white collar end of security but, it’s not uncommon for him to adorn a hardhat and steel toed boots to visit his physical job sites which takes him to places such as; military bases, Universities, FBI gun ranges, underground bunker, oil pipeline and oil refineries.. you get the idea! His job has him dealing in blueprints and conference room meetings so, he must dress the part But, transcends to a job site just as fast- A shirt capable of keeping up and standing against dirt and grim is a godsend to us.. and I’m shook how well this can avoid stains!

Personally, we professionally launder shirt only bc.. $ is covered by his company! Still I wouldn’t hesitate to machine on cool temp.’s and touch up with an iron as needed. For a dress shirt- this feels solid an not in need of delicate handling.. and for me that boasts solid craftsmanship. When used in a rotation with other dress shirts- this has ability to last for quite a while.. for reference: my husbands 6’4”, 205lb, 36x36, neck 16.5, sleeve 35+. I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: A rocksolid onesie that can double as long sleeve T.!!
text:
Wowza for the onsie!! First off, longsleeve onesies are harder to come by then one may think.. and if you live in colder climates- you know the value of having the long sleeve.. Well, this Honest brand is absolutely a top quality made onesie sold in a 10pk. **And it should be quality at just under $40 a pack! Ok, once over the $ shock.. remind yourself this is for 10 undershirts which actually equates to $4.00 a piece- and “honestly” (ha-ha!) that’s beyond a great $ for this solid product.

For any who don’t know: A onesie is an undershirt worn by infants usually throughout their first yr. It is snuggly fit to hug the body by the use of the snap in crotch fasteners.. these are worn under clothing for extra warmth and comfort. Most come short sleeve but, colder winter climates call for a long sleeve variation.

These are made from a thicker and physically feeling solid organic cotton.. both, by sight and touch you feel the quality! In fact, these could stand alone as a long sleeve T-shirt.. they do not look out of place if worn as such. We paired one with infant sweatpants.. and baby was snug as can be- however, I will use these most often under baby rompers to add that extra layer of warmth in Utah winters.

These have a fold over “shoulder tuck” allowing ample room for babies head to slide through with ease and then, all folds in material naturally lay formed to the body. This design makes it simple to put on without stretching out the neck, causing any gaping.. if looking at product photo itself, you will notice their shoulder tuck design- its perfect for keeping a snug fit! Washing/drying on cooler temp.’s will eliminate issues with shrinkage.. yet, give you the expected reshaping to wear again and again.. These run true to size- and even a tiny bit forgiving. So, trust the size chart provided by seller for sure.

Compared side-by-side to a Carter’s brand onesie I have, these are twice the solid item as other brands.. no loose thread or, thin materials at all. Onesies are definitely a staple for all new parents.. and these are so worthy to go the distance- trust me when I say, baby will outgrow before wearing out of this item. These onesies can be used over multiple pregnancies.. and/or, make solid “hand-me-downs” no question!! The fact these are earth friendly and give back is just icing on the cake! If contemplating the purchase I assure you- this will live up to expectations. I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Mixing fashion and function- warmest/cutest ever!!!
text:
Wow! Equal amounts of cuteness and function in this little number.. and you can see how absolutely adorable this is! Put on top a babies head, I have no words- it’s to die for in cuteness factory!! (I don’t feel comfortable sharing the photo bc, it’s not my own baby...) But, let’s just say- this was part of a sweet newborns “coming home Outfit” from hospital- which happened to be during the 1st snow of season in utah ...and OMG!! Baby girl was snug, as a bug in a rug- or, should I say.. snug as a unicorn in pink fluff!?!

Material: it is beyond as soft as can be! The knitted yarn surpasses all levels of expectation we set when it comes to our newborns.. and from the one who’s cheek snuggled up against the tiny ‘hatted head..’ its soft from the outside as well. On inside this hat has a soft/warm interior liner as well. Allowing, not only for comfort and peace of mind against any itchy material but, it is made to be Warm!! And.. that’s the reason a hat is to be worn in the first place, right?! This little beanie has the aesthetics of cuteness 100% but, don’t be fooled… It is also, a completely functioning knitted cap and will hold its own in cold winter climates. Each time we pulled this off babies head- she had smallest moisture of sweat.. So, keep in mind this is not to be used as a summer or, Floridian accessory!

No worry about the uni-horn.. it’s stitched on tight! The bit of sparkle doesn’t shed or, interfere with baby whatsoever and surprisingly, it isn’t scratchy. None of the unicorn facial features are detachable.. equating to no loose pieces for baby and choking hazard.

Size: as I mentioned we used out of necessity to bring an 8lb. newborn home in an impromptu snowstorm.. Yesss, we had to flip up a brim to do so to make it fit... But, sizing is for infant 3-12mo. (is my guesstimate!) At time of my order.. only x1 size order was available and interior liner doesn’t allow for much stretch, constructing size ability. keep this in mind when ordering for appropriate fit. **creator/seller -if made in bigger sizes, it would be a total hit for toddlers, etc.

The mittens are mitts- aka: fingerless! And just what you want and need them to be for a baby!! It’s impossible to thread fingers into fittings and let’s be honest, most babies find it comforting to keep hands in fists.. therefore, you just slide over the whole hand- sort of, “one and done!” The small amount of elastane at the wrist keep these in place.. The mitts are constructed same as the hat.

Overall, this set makes for a perfect winter hat and provides ample warmth.. it’s a great baby shower gift and makes hat wearing a bit more fun. For a price point of $15.. you can’t go wrong! I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: More of a long sleeve hooded t-shirt!!
text:
This is a fun twist to a hooded sweatshirt! Material is a very soft, thinner and semi stretchable fabric.. one that laces up the front of the low V-neck cut. It is a trendy vs. classic look.. not necessarily a solid staple for the wardrobe for years to come. In my opinion, this is more of a trendy top that is fun and keeping in line with current styles-made for a “seasonal amount of time” and priced, constructed as such.

The fabric has a little bit of stretch- more then expected from a “regular” hoodie made of 100% cotton. This material feels smooth, soft with a slight sheen to the fabric- this is definitely not a thick fabric at all!! Think of a heavier T-shirt made into a hoodie- that is what this is! Washing instructions: I’d definitely suggest washing on cool temp. and line drying as well- this will help eliminate any shrinkage.. with the bit of stretch in this fabric, it can shrink!

For any afraid of the low plunging V-neck, fear not!! This is only a “peek-a-boo style..” IF, you choose not to lace up the opening accordingly! Sizing listed on the website is accurate.. No need to worry about international size adjusting or, off sizing.. I chose XL in white and was grateful for the ample room.. I struggle with some style tops being tight thru the chest- and this had adequate room for sure! For reference: I’m 5’2”, 152lb, 38C (full!), 40+yr. old mother of x4 kiddos.. and carry my trouble spot in the waist (thx you, to kids + gravity!) FYI: White is see thru as I didn’t realize, this was a much thinner material- so, be prepared if ordering white.. most likely you’ll need a tshirt/tank underneath. I hope this info. can help your decision.. feel free to let me know!

title: Looks amazing! Comfy as wearing a tshirt!!
text:
Nice top- I am liking the overall look and feel.. This is a dressier button down but, has the feel of casual clothing! If you have to get dressed up… May as well do it with comfort! And this is a beautiful top to do it in..

Material is loose and hangs in a natural way. This has a classic vibe with straight line finishing across the bottom hem.. it has a business fit if need be, and a bit dressier casual if not- and I like that!! This has a silkier feel when worn and gives you that effect (softer flow vs. crisp cotton) all without the need to be 100% pure silk.

The length of shirt feels good, not too long.. if tucked in, this is not an issue and untucked, this hangs approx. at the butt cheek- for those of us who are short, it may feel just a tad longer. As for the sleeves they are plenty long in the length and have the ability to roll but, note with the softness of material.. they don’t like to stay rolled in place!

As for the washing instructions.. You’ll need to make your own decision.. You can professionally clean. But, I felt confident in using my machine on delicate/hand wash cycle and had no issues. Line dry and if necessary, you can dewrinkle on dryer setting.. I chose not to use an iron- as, I didn’t want to burn any of the material. I realize there are ways around this but, I didn’t take the time or, effort.. So, it’s a personal choice for sure. title: A true blue working purse backpack.. and I’m in love!!
text:
The perfect purse-pack for the organized and OCD! This absolutely meets and exceeds my needs for compartmentalizing everything- it is a true blue working purse backpack.. aka: purse-pack!!

I switched to carrying a backpack style purse when I had little kiddos and needed hands free for holding onto them, car seats, diaper bags etc... Fast forward more then a decade and Ive never gone back to the old school Purse style- bc, it’s just too easy. After becoming a “purse convert” I’ve come to look for specific creature comforts in choosing the right type purse pack and this surpasses all my expectations-

I’m a mom! I need real space to hold the Mary Poppins content I am expected to have at a moments notice.. which includes: my own staples ie. wallet, keys, phone, sunglasses- and the extras of a mini med kit, emergency girl products, wet wipes, Advil, phone accessories, paper/pen, lip kit.. any MacGyver gadget so, when somebody needs something chances are- I have it!!

Size: I do not want something mini… Let’s be honest, they look cute and dainty but, have the equivalent of a rhinestone beaded clutch as far as, room capacity! So, I’m loving this MultiSac sizing- it’s not a mini nor, oversized to fit my college school supplies- it’s happily in the middle.. What I refer to as the Goldilocks effect.

Style: this is a fun whimsical striped print with matted color. It’s neither obnoxiously loud nor, subtle.. ha! I get compliments everywhere I go with this bag. Looking at it, you can see it’s just a happy bag! And possesses the ability to match anything!!

Organization: from the list above you can see I try to carry it all and save me from those frantic- “if we only had a..” moments! This features so many pockets to keep things compartmentalized and organized so, my bag has order and everything has its place! This by far is my must have favorite feature. (wouldn’t buy it otherwise!) These are pockets made with a purpose that are well placed for easy access and weight distribution so, it helps balance out the pack itself!

Material: This is made with a thicker fabric.. it has the durability of burlap but, feels like soft fabric!!!
The straps have reinforced stitching onto the bag itself- securing both strap nor, bag should give way or rip under normal weight. The interior is lined in a solid fabric **and the only thing to make this better.. would be an interior nylon lining that allowed for any mess/spill to be wiped out vs. absorbed into the material itself. However, my love for this bag will overlook this missed feature.. So, just be aware when packing, if an item could leak it will unfortunately be absorbed into the fabric of the purse itself. Not a dealbreaker for me bc, I am past the stage/phase of needing to carry sippy cup or, juice pouches! I do recommend using a fabric protector prior to using.. it will just help create a barrier to spills and stains.

title: Great T-shirt for tween bodies between boy/man!!!
text:

title: Fun set of hoop earrings.. be sure of sensitive ears!!
text:
Order the set in black.. it is a fun set a hoop earrings done in various versions of just the standard classic hoop. None of the six pairs are too big nor, too gaudy or obnoxious.. these all run approx. the same size in circumference- So, they could be suited for young adults.. without appearing too “big or, inappropriate.”

The stainless steel metal can be a bit of concern for those with sensitive ears and the fact, the post itself is also coated in black..?? I ordered black stainless earrings in the past- but, the post has been stainless and not coated in coloring.. and this does make me a bit nervous. 4 of the 6 pairs are x2 the thickness.. and translates to a heavier earring. By the end of day- these can pull a bit on the earlobe itself.. I’ve personally found the x2 thinner hoops have been my “go too’s” if wearing all day- if, wearing a pair for only a few hours.. I’ve used the thicker pair. Love the bling included on a few of the hoops.. this is a fun addition and can dress up a look with just a few accessories! The rhinestone stand out really well against the black.. it’s a nice look!

Overall, this is a set of six hoops of the same diameter with some variation to the thickness or bling included... they come in choices- gold, silver or black. These are what I consider costume jewelry and priced accordingly. These are not made to last forever but, certainly can be a fun addition..
I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: A fun trendy sweatshirt- really fun to wear!!
text:
This is a nice oversized sweatshirt and by oversized, I mean- it is big!! If you think you need to size up.. you don’t! Personally, I find the measurement description very accurate for an “oversized“ sweatshirt look- after all, the description tells you this is plenty big!!

text:

title: The Perfect beanie for the larger size heads!!
text:
When looking for a Beanie I’m in a predicament everytime.. I am tasked with pleasing a picky teenager and let’s just say, 4-5X.. i’m sending back what I ordered and back to looking for a better fit!! So, the fact I’m giving this high marks should tell you something- this has the ability to please the pickiest of users!

For the record… Our pickiness is due to the fact, the majority of beanies do not fit my sons head as, they’re too small.. all leaving him with a headache bc, of the tightness factor!! Most beanies are made using elastic, elastane or, spandex- obviously, bc it is easiest way for a cap to maintain shape in.. Oh, and stay on you head!! But, if you’re looking “old school” knit creation to do this trick- Ha! you better have a grandma who knows how to do homemade- and we don’t!!

I consider this beanie a hybrid of sorts! It’s a cross between a slouch style and a knitted fold over cap! (Yes! I realize photos and description show ample slouch when worn ..) Think of this as : If a slouch beanie and knitted cap had a baby.. this would be it!! Hence, the hybrid title! This is great because of its loosely knitted stitch used to create a slouch style. Yet, this doesn’t have all the excess material in the back to make that style a must when wearing. The other piece to the equation is, this fold is not stitch-tact into place letting the user get the proper fit on top they desire and adjust the fold accordingly! **NOTE: this is the perfect answer for those who have a bigger head.. aka, my son!

Material used feels soft and non irritating to the user. Yes, this definitely has shape to it.. with the minimal elastane.. and the small amount helps so, ones brain doesn’t feel likes it’s in a vice- Then, if beanie becomes too stretched out and loses its shape, this can tolerate being machine washed on delicate… And just line dried! Doing this is enough to help fibers return too and retain their shape.. As for staying in place, the type of knitted stitch used and the pattern placement of the stitching all help to keep this from falling off your head!

My only reason for deducting x1star.. many similar caps/styles were being sold at a more reasonable price point- For someone who has issues find a beanie at all and is faced with limited options- we don’t have a choice but, pay a premium! However I understand… many others do have options. If this holds up overtime, which it feels solid enough- it will be worth $ spent. Right now, it’s too soon to know longevity.. I hope this info can help make your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Rock solid romper… Sold at a rockstar price!!
text:

At a price point of $20 per single romper, I suggest making certain of size and choice prior to ordering.. although, I really am impressed with the romper- babies grow so quickly… and baby you sure to outgrow before this wears out- A common theme with a lot of baby clothing! I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Not my favorite.. know your “likes” before ordering!
text:

Don’t be fooled as, it has tiny flecks of black/olive in the mix and paired with a said various colors, it can match.

Fit: So, my model was forced to try this on while walking in the door from work.. and I don’t condone his fashion statement! But, if you notice photos included- I wanted you to see the fit! With arms to the side you can see the sleeve length is ample long, the front buttons close with plenty of room and length in back hits just below the waist. Loving the box cut so, the length is great not leaving tails to appear as if they should be tucked in or, creating a sloppy, disheveled appearance- This is why I state it’s a hybrid!! This could be worn as an open button shirt placed over a Tshirt, turtleneck or, just wearing the shirt buttoned up all on its own-
The collar is winged without button tacks- so, this may need extra care after washing to keep these from flipping up. I did include washing tag.. it is rather big/annoying on the side- in our house this would definitely be cut out yet, I got to it first! For any who jumped the gun and remove washing info. -You’re welcome! Also, take note: a replacement button is sewn onto tags at the hip, Be sure to save. HACK: any buttons cut out this way can easily be saved/identified.. Just write with sharpie on the tag itself what item it belongs too- then, we have a pant hanger holding a small plastic bag. We keep buttons like these inside bag, labeled! And when items missing a button, I know right where to find the replacement- This saves my life more then you know- and only took 1/2 of 28yr marriage to figure it out!! (trust me, if you think you’ll remembered tucking in a “safe place” you’re wrong.. this one hack is worth it!)
Overall, you have heard of comfort food.. well, this is comfort clothing! It is soft as can be, wears so well and looks good doing so- a total trifecta!! I hope this info can help your decision, feel free to let me know!
For reference: husband is 6’4”, 210, 35x36, 18yr old trapped in a 50yr old body!

title: Nice heavier weight sweater.. love the cut!
text:
Very nice sweater top that looks fantastic. There are no loose snags or, loops in any way.. It’s an eye catcher for sure and If, looking for a sweater that has both, cozy comfort and style.. this is it. This is a heavy knit and made for colder weather for sure, you can feel the weight from the moment you pick it up and put it on. It has what I would call a reverse loop on the shoulder.. So, the seams where the arm connects to the body has about a dzn. outward/reverse loops that follow the seam like little “bumps.“ I wouldn’t be too focused on this- except for the fact, the rest of the loops are inside of the sweater itself.. Any of the looping presents on the interior.

No judging my description- I know my dialog is not “Technically correct“ and I’m sorry! I’m not one who knows the specific terminology with knitting! What I can tell you, this feels ‘cable smooth‘ all over the sweater... with the exception of these “outward loops/bumps” along the arm seams!? No, it doesn’t look like dragon spikes or punk/goth studs. These are just something you can FEEL.. Because of the multi color of fabric, the bumps aren't noticeable by sight, instead they blend like camouflage.

Love the cut- this isn’t cropped at all but, has a boxed waist where the sweater tapers in just a tad below the natural waistline, it’s very flattering! Personally, I find a lot of heavier knit sweaters tend to be baggy and carry excess bulk.. making them appear to add extra weight to a person when wearing. With this cut, it doesn’t have extra bulk or, added material so, it allows the sweater to follow ones lines and silhouette the body in a positive way.

The color is a great tri-blend mix and can be paired with anything.. black, khaki, white, denim- honestly, I’m loving that it’s so universal. This sweater runs true to size and if anything.. a tad big. I ordered an XL and could have gotten away with an L for sure. Problem is, I usually struggle with tops being tight thru the bust line so, I ordered up. (I’ve been on the wrong side of this so many times.. I err’d on bigger- but, truly you don’t need too!)

This is definitely a nicer sweater, made of a heavier gauged knit. It packs in the warmth for sure.. it has plenty of style for sure. I hope this info helps your decision… Feel free to let me know!
For reference: I’m 5’1”, 153lb, 40+yr, 38 full C, mom of 4- with mid section trouble spots.

title: Classic style that has ample room and lots of fill!!!
text:
This is a solid “puffer jacket” with plenty of fill to keep you warm in cold weather. I’ve been looking for the “perfect” one in this type jacket for over a year- and this is almost it! My criteria: finding a filled coat that keeps you warm, fits well and looks good doing so! Let’s face it- we shouldn’t have to substitute fashion for function-

Living in Utah the winter feels like a curse- truly bc, it is.. I hate to be cold!! So, i know the importance of solid warmth… I tried 2 similar jackets last season that were subpar and minimal fill- this is double the insulation which is great! I would say you could use this for winter warmth no prob. But, I’m guessing you need something warmer if you’re living in Arctic sub zero temps… and I’m not, It just feels like it- Ha Ha!! Yes- I would wear this out in a snowstorm in January for certain.

Fit: this runs big! For any who are in between sizes don’t size up! I usually fall between L/XL and I went up in size.. I wish I hadn’t!! This has plenty of room thru bust- which is usually my trouble spot. I could fit layers of winter clothing underneath and still have plenty of room to zip the jacket- I tried this on over a bulky fitting hoodie and still had 4-5” of excess material that I could grab in the hand after zipping... (see why sizing up isnt necessary..?!!) The length hits just about the waist and doesn’t ride up with movement.. which is a perk- I wanted a cut that could perform all the fundamentals yet, still allow for a female figure silhouette and this has that potential.. IF, sized correctly!! sleeves are plenty long enough as well, the edge of sleeve rests over the back of my hand- like an Athletic shirt with the thumb cutouts do! (i’m sure it would be shorter sleeve, in smaller size.. which I’d prefer) But, this is definitely designed to cover all potential cold spots-
No, I have not washed the jacket- but, this have a straightforward washing instructions attached on the tag- so, it should be easy enough when the time comes. I ordered black and love the color- I just want any Who are investing to be certain to size correctly… Doing so, I can assure you this is made of quality. This has the ability to last through plenty of winter seasons.. and the style, cut, fit is classic… It won’t be a trend that becomes obsolete by next year. I hope this info can help in your decision… Feel free to let me know!

For record: I’m 5’2”, 153lb, 38 full C, 40+yr old, mom of 4- with mid section to prove it.. I tend to wavier on L/XL for top sizing.. usually due to bust size. This, particular item allows room for curves… That is for certain. No need to size up!

title: The perfect top-  One you just feel better when wearing!!
text:
Fabulous top.. with some wow and U-lá-lá!! Best endorsement for all- I wore as my “birthday shirt!” ..That should tell you, this has to be pretty flattering to get the honors- and it is! Loving this style and how the material hangs in a nice outer shaped silhouette of the body and does so, all without being too clingy..

The V neck is cut just about perfect. It doesn’t reveal or, show too much. Nor, compromise ones comfort level- And it adds a great feminine touch, keeping it classy, sophisticated and it’s the perfect way to showcase a choker, necklace or, statement piece of jewelry! Ordering this in black, is exactly what I chose to do and I paired with a pop of color/contrast around the neck- it was perfect. **so, keep this in mind as it’s a really fun option!

Sizing is pretty spot on and if anything, it errs on the bigger side. So, if in between sizes stay with your regular size… I ordered a large and it could not have been better. For reference, I’m 5’1”, 153lb, 38full C, 40 + yr old, mama of 4-(with the excess middle to prove it! My trouble spot is mid section.. and aging doesn’t help it!) Note- this isn’t long in length- which I personally like. A lot of times, a top like this can drown a person with tails…This however, is cut perfect to hit just below the waistband but, not cropped style. This boasts a tapered boxy look.. You know, those 1-2 items in a wardrobe that can make you feel better just by wearing them?! Ha.. this is that top! Yess!! You can pair this with slacks or, skirt with just as much success.. it handles itself just fine, its just that great! I hope this info can help your decision.. feel free to let me know!

title: Pants have great versatility- and look fantastic!
text:
Pants with versatility- they can be worn for casual wear, weekends or, dressed up for office and business attire- I am loving the fact these hybrid styles pants are allowing one pair to serve many purposes and wear many hats! And yess- Im talking about pants!

My 26yr. old son has a pair of peak velocity pants ordered from amazon.. they’ve become his all-time favorites! With the many similarities to this pair, we had to give these a try. Any who are familiar with Peak Velocity, these have similar fit and sizing. Amazon Essential pants have a crisp and stiffer feel to the fabric even though- both pair have the same composition of cotton and elastin 97/3 %.

**Note: when ordering these pants pay attention as they have varied cuts and styles.**

These are the standard SLIM FIT CUT giving a natural taper from the thigh to the ankle. These are not seer sucking in anyway- as they just remove a lot of excess bulk in the material. **Note: this is my sons fav. feature to these pants.. he loves the look and the physical appearance. The fabric has plenty of give for ample movement/comfort and do not feel cumbersome in any way- but, they look fantastic. (it’s like movement in athletic pants blended into big boy pants!) So, if wanting a baggier look you will want to size up or, choose a loose or straight leg vs. the slim fit.

Material is a heavier weave of cotton.. So, it tends to wrinkle with sitting etc. expect to have “whiskering” at the bend in the groin and knee. But, these also have plenty of give - 3% elastin is quite a lot of stretch.. and they do give while wearing. (So, remember this with sizing as well If, feeling a little snug- they have give!!)

Washing: wash on cold and dry on low heat. Doing this will reshape pants perfectly! If worried about shrinkage.. line dry for sure. These do not need dry cleaning which is great for work pants- we ordered in Navy and after 6-8 washings.. colored has not faded. Note: these are an off navy color.. not true navy blue, like one expects with uniform navy. I didn’t deduct a star bc, the only disappointment with the pant was the off color. Otherwise, these are nice quality pant with solid craftsmanship and will be around for a while.
I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Casual look that can be taken to a whole new level!
text:
Unfortunately, mine arrived in the wrong size! I was expecting L and got M. So, feedback shared is for overall product not wearability…

Material used as soft as butter… Attention to detail in stitching is there. We have no lose threads or, buttons- which is quite nice to know. It’s hard to trust whenever ordering from a new/unfamiliar brand- Not to mention, this rayon type material which is difficult to work with.. and the maker has done a fine job.

As for style… I love it!! I’m loving the squared off tail- The back of the shirt is such a great length. Doesn’t appear like ones drowning in material.. and gives a cleaner look/line to a casual appearance. This could easily be worn in business setting.. if paired with appropriate accessories and pants. Yet, this can also be dressed down… Creating a casual look of the best kind- it appears as if, you’ve put in a lot of effort when you haven’t!! These are great for moms who need casual, comfort yet, the ability to step into parent conference or, Dr. Appt. and look good doing it!

As for the fit: unfortunately, the buttons up the front were far too tight across the chest. I can pull off a medium in this style 70% of the time.. title: A vintage vibe with a newness quality..

title: Created for certain body types..
text:
This is a new, hip vibe that I wanted to like.. and in theory I thought we were onto something great. In reality.. it just didn’t take the way we had hoped!

Love the idea of a short sleeve hoodie. However, the material is honestly… A bit cheap. Feels thin and has a bit of the sheen that some materials have- to me, it a sheen found on cheaper fabric.

The cut is larger and wide through the shoulders- obviously, it’s made for bulk! But, the body is tapered (I’m sure some may like..) But, It’s long!!? title: Wanted to like- it just didn’t like us!
text:

title: Great deal for 2 quality masks... Worth it!!
text:
These made the final cut while trying to find the perfect mask for my teen who’s returning to in person high school- during the chaotic COVID-19 pandemic…The price point is awesome… for the quality you get- 2 for under $12, I am loving this!! Especially, since teens tend to set these down in a car.. at a friends.. you get the idea!

OK! So, this is a great adaptation to a neck gaiter! This little number functions like a baklava/gaiter (which is basically a fully enclosed circle of material worn around the neck, pullover style.. Think, turtleneck just without the shirt attached!) However, this has an extended function created into the material (like a face shield) which is made to cover the face. Best part of all, this has ear loops to hold mask in place in leui of being held by the compression from the material. The configuring also allows the person wearing, to speak and breathe without feeling too confined.. This is a huge perk!!

This hits the mark on providing another option and variation for COVID-19 facemask. I realize, we are all getting creative to find ways to keep both, ourself/kiddos safe. This may not be foolproof but, it definitely is an option for any who are still practicing safe distancing and want to utilize the suggested face covering protocol.
Seeing this “one size fits all” best applies to the teens and older sizes. 12-14yr old and up. The shape of actual item is smaller.. but, these have stretchability in order to function. As an example: the x3 head circumferences I tried this on were: 22”, 18.2” and 23.11”... all 3 fit the mask without any issue.
The material is soft and stretchable.. has a slight sheen and comes in fun prints as statement pieces or, just fun ways to make the need for masks more bearable.. tbh, some prints may not be appropriate for school or, work place- but, there are several to choose from that are.
Knowing I’ll need plenty on hand and different styles for a picky, moody high school boy! With masks being the new normal- this will at least provide a safer and hopefully fun way to embrace what we don’t want to do.. in the end, we all must do our part to be safe!

I wash these in the machine on cold/delicate- I place all masks inside in lingerie/laundry zip bag and recommend doing the same. This protects any straps from being caught or tangled- NOTE: these do have shrink capability if placed in dryer… Which can help or hurt! line dry if you don’t want these to shrink.. and vice versa. (A laundry/wash bag can be found for a minimal price on Amazon or, most grocery store isles.. I cannot stress enough the need to use to extend the life of your masks. They are worth the investment for sure..!!)
** Update: my sons high school has a rule… All masks must pass the “light test!” Basically, if you can see holes/mesh or, light through the material then, it is not acceptable for School District standards. I wanted to make those aware that may have the same restrictions- and I’ve included photos..** Good luck everyone and stay safe!

I hope this info helps… Feel free to let me know!

title: We had great success and loved the trendy style..
text:
Was a little unsure what to expect due to a few reviews… Personally, I am happy with my order. TBH, I have a teenage son with a piercing who wants to look hip and fashionable and this is a fun style to do just that- it’s not over the top but, does have its own unique flair!
Most important for me was choosing something appropriate and sterling silver.. i’ll admit, his dad is not his biggest fan of the earring- Yep! Old school ways. So, I’m constantly trying to find a good balance between, just a boring stud earring and something trendy that could be appreciated by both! This seemed to do the trick on both ends..!!!

If, reading the description one will see the sizing of these “bars“ are meant to be different. But, I could see how this wasn’t clearly understood if you didn’t actually notice the details in description.. it could be stated a bit clearer. We are only wearing one earring at a time as, we only have one ear pierced! So the sizing difference doesn’t look unusual or, off in our situation.. but, for those who may be confuse these are 2 different lengths on purpose.

Personally, we haven’t had issues with bending or, breakage at the point of the soldering T.. things look pretty solid- So hoping, our luck holds! I could see the longer bar possibly getting the wrong amount of counter pressure at a weak spot causing this to bend and of course, the counter maneuver to straighten it out may cause breakage.. (these follow laws of physics being strongest at the midpoint.) So, I suggest when putting these in piercing- try to always apply pressure at the strongest point which would be the solder- Doing so, can Only help from creating any weak spot or, bend in the metal. **In the end: these are sterling silver… And for all familiar, we know .925SS can be a soft metal at best. It doesn’t help these are listed as “tiny” earrings- which makes them delicate to start. But, if my 17yr old son can be successful with wearing without breaking- It should tell you, these do have some strength.. BTW, he wears 24/7 swim, sleep, sports.. it’s been x1 month and so far, so good!
I’m hopeful whatever “bugs” these had, now have been worked out.. I see these as a fun gift that would be happily received by many.

I hope this info helps… Feel free to let me know!

title: Classic throwback to “days of the week underpants!”
text:
Such a cute twist to the throwback of the “ Days a week underpants!!!” Way to go Calvin Klein- keep in mind, those with OCD may have issues wearing on the wrong day- just saying...!!!

My college girls love these! They have been a favorites since their Catholic school uniforms khaki pants always show panty lines… I know a “thong in Catholic school” seem to be blasphemous… But, these Calvin Klein panties helped keep the girls feeling comfortable in their day-to-day uniforms. No one likes ugly panty lines, no matter where you go to school!!
Best part of all – is the thick waist band. I have a daughter with the most athletic build and not an ounce of fat on her body… And she likes the feel of the thick waist band. I have another daughter who’s also got an athletic build but, actually has developed her amazing female curves… she loves the thick waist to give a little more support around all of her curvy lines!!
These are trendy and spot on with fun colors, They have soft colors to blend and hide under every color… The monochrome staples of white, black, gray… Made to go with everything and all the fun color/prints to wear. I wash our bras and panties on delicate/hand wash setting… And I personally NeVeR dry. Old as time hack: if wanting to prolong the life of bras, panties, swimsuit etc. NEVER put these items in the dryer- the heat will take major life off of the spandex and elastic as plastic/elastic + high heat = don’t mix!!
Not going to lie- my girls are not as disciplined with this wash method as I am, and they toss all their panties into zipped lingerie bag (found on amazon or, grocery isle for a few $.) and then, toss the whole bag into the dryer on LOW heat. This too will also help items hold their shape and keep a lone pair from that wild tangle that can happen in the machine- So, i definitely recommend!

If uncertain of sizing, I would suggest going up versus down- as these tend to run right on size or, even a tad smaller after washing… I always purchase their CK sizes on the larger end so, not to create problems in comfort!! And figure if ever too large- these have a tad bit of shrinkage in washing process.. So, error on bigger vs. smaller- especially, if in between sizes!
Bottom line you get what you pay for- these are sold at a higher price point but, are built to last.. I would hands-down recommend best panties ever purchased for my girls.. worth the investment for sure!
Hope this info helps... feel free to let me know!

If you’re in the market, I strongly recommend you give this a try… you won’t be disappointed! Most importantly- stay safe everyone, we can do this!!

title: Good in theory but, see the flaws we found below..
text:
Really liked this in theory but, using this for a face mask/cough cover against covid and all day or, extended period of time wearing… is not really feasible. This still has a way to go to make it truly workable-

I’m like every other mom… searching for the right Covid face mask for our family and especially, for our kiddos. With a high school teen, who’s less then, happy about “our new normal…“ I’m spending time this summer searching for different options. I am hoping with some trial/error, to find the best solution prior to the return(?!) of in class high school- whenever that maybe.. ha ah ha!!

This is a neck gaiter that functions like those commonly used in winter.. It is a solid sewn circle, (think turtle neck- without the shirt attached!) of stretchable fabric (11”-15” height) this is pulled over the head and bunched up around the neck. As needed in cold (or, in this case.. germ exposure) you slide up the bunched material from around the neck to properly cover the nose/mouth area.. this also has a filter pocket sewn in, which I like and is my favorite part! For obvious reasons, the pocket section is to be aligned over mouth/nose to keep virus and partials out.. or, let anyone else’s germ particle in..!!
The materials stretch allows you to adjust mask into the comfortable position.. and due to the spandex, the mask will stay in place. These state appropriate use for warmer weather… (can even be used to block the sun.) Only, Im not sure that is entirely possible with this. The use of synthetics fabric alone by default, increases the temp/sweat produced. The only way I see this style being truly possible- is using a linen/gauze… Something thats breathable- only then, we are defeating the purpose..?!! (See- good idea theory just has a long way to go still.. Or, save for colder weather.) Unfortunately, it looks like we may need to keep searching-
Upon trying the gaiter mask myself, I noticed how much bigger issue… The fact I wear prescription glasses, this would not allow me a comfortable fit with the glasses stem over the ear. The mask material kept tweaking and re-positioning my eyeglasses.. and not in a good way! If, I pulled it down to leave enough room on the ear, I found the mask wanting to roll in that position.. making it more of a hurt then, help! Something to keep in mind for those who are looking at these who also use eyeglasses!!
Over all, the idea is there- it just needs to be tweaked and therefore, I don’t recommend for use as a cough/germ cover. The protective inserts that came with the mask are the most valuable part of this set in my opinion.
Good luck everyone in their search to be safe.. you are not alone! I hope this info helps- feel free to let me know!

title: Best pregnancy invention... ever!! Is a BELLY BELT!! You decide which is best brand for you ..!!!
text:
Ordered for a first time mom… 28 weeks pregnant and beginning to feel those “un-fun effects” of starting the third trimester!!
Having a Stanford Grad. OB/GYN for a dad- When I was pregnant myself.. he’d explained the simple physics of what the female body endures while morphing thru the varied stages of pregnancy!! (anyone who’s been there.. Knows just what I’m talking about!) In short.. he explained what pregnant women needed to gain comfort/reprieve, was “bionic-underbelly support” to aide, the ever growing uterus and the stretched ligaments.

However, since that type of “magic” didn’t exist in medicine, the next best thing was a bellybelt..!!! These were designed to do just that job and provide that magic support/reprieve as our body stretched and grew to epic proportions.. amazing! Pregnant women are warriors..!!!!
All hail the belly belt.. Worn securely around the bottom half of the uterus (a tad under bellybutton) this has the ability to help lighten the load. Constructed of a wide elastic strap that encircles the waist.. it has a mesh front section for heat ventilation and can be adjusted/sized accordingly to stages in one’s personal pregnancy.. (if any doubt or concerns, I advise you to purchase and take to doctors appt., allowing him/her to show correct use- although it’s truly as simple as can be!) **I would also recommend getting the largest sz. and then, just loosening as needed- that way, you should only need one belt during pregnancy! Best part of all, the support is immediate… and Wow! It’s like the holy Grail of pregnancy tools. The ability to wear under your clothes descretely lets you use this every day if necessary.. FYI- try to buy in skin tone color for best discrete results.. if, that matter to you?!
For any who are pregnant, don’t wait till you can’t stand it any longer… order a belly belt now!!! Order and enjoy the perks throughout.. Trust me, you will find yourself breaking down, giving in and ordering one in the long run. Why miss out on having any extra comfort and support all along..??!!

I’m an advocate for any bellybelt as they help so much.. and so many women could benefit. The recipient of this let me know… She’s used it every day since receiving and it’s helped her immensely! Being she works 40 hours a week, she said the back support is key!! (As with any product used during pregnancy external or otherwise, call dr. Office and ask for the green light to use- if they haven’t given their blessing already, I’m certain they will!)

title: Might be feminine in color but, not in size!..!!
text:
COVID-19 brought the need to order this item… And an a-ha moment made me realize.. I may not be alone in my discovery and this info. just may be able to help someone else-

First off- we are not some pure, holistic family who rarely used tech gadgets.. Nope! We are guilty of looking at a screen thru-out an entire day.. (Yes! enough to get phone anxiety if, our device is not a stones throw away -Ha!) Not proud, just realty..

Being mid covid19 crisis, ALL interactions (work, school, social) must be done on computer. The time that once was broken up a bit with carpool runs, business meetings, lunch hr., kids soccer, grocery shop, on-sight visits, business travel and so on- has come to a halt!! We are stuck onscreen with no means for escape..!! Problem is, we found physical side effects to these changes. One of the biggest- were the headaches my family began to have. Oh yes! Confined in a house with hubby, children, siblings, roommates, etc. can give any of the best a headache! But, these headaches were described as a deep pain behind the eyes- with an urge to want to relieve pressure by pushing in or, rubbing eyes.. which seemed only to make it worse. pulsing, foggy vision.. and a sense of nausea if, this kept going w/o reprieve ..and tbh, Ibprofen wasn’t the answer, it masked not cured..

After doing research; I found out hue, light, screen brightness from computers could be causing a lot of these physical issues. These also can get worse and without altering/limiting screen time. Only, with 2 college kids, 1 high-schooler,1 husband all working online- less time is not a viable option. Info. also said- increased stress and anxiety will amplify these symptoms and that applies to all of us in this situation!! (This info. was from research collected from Harvard, Johns Hopkins and Baylor. All pretty trustable sources!)
Suggested solutions were a Light blocking film to cover entire screen (my family hated- as they found it hard to see screen clearly from all angles.) So, the other suggestion was wearing Blue Light Blocking glasses and it led us to these!

•So, these are listed for women- besides the look in color/shape- there is nothing female about the actual size of the frame.
•The glasses fit universally- like buying sunglasses from the store.. theres is no personal fit. These run bigger vs. smaller and could even be worn over an RX pair if needed (like 3-D glasses.)
• The look is a bit goofy, I won’t lie.. and it feels a bit awkward if you see yourself in a mirror! But, these are feather light and don’t pinch or, add any pressure- you can honestly have these on and forget after a few minutes that you’re wearing them!
•Fingers crossed, we keep up the improvement with the headaches.. there surely are days I wonder, is it a placebo effect? But then, if you wear these while working on screen for 1-2hr. When you remove them- you can see/feel a big difference. So, these are hard at work doing something.. maybe some voodoo or, crazy magic?! But, they have an effect and it seems to be a positive one- If, these keep bringing the same positive results.. I will be happy with the Positive physical changes.
•Downside, I wish these were made with my RX in the lens so, only one set of glasses is necessary..

Overall, these are definitely worth giving a try if, anyone is noticing the side effects of increased on screen time and headaches. I can only imagine these could also help improve in the Ophthalmic health and well-being of the eye itself.. and better be safe and do what we can to protect ourselves.
Price point seems fair for the results one may receive...
I hope this info helps.. feel free to let me know!

title: Such a unique/one of a kind gift- but, only buyer knows it’s secret!!
text:
What, What..?!! A necklace that actually says “I love you“ in 100 different languages, are you kidding me.. This is such a unique feature + talking point- SO.. WHY IN THE WORLD DIDN'T THE COMPANY MARKET THIS BY USING THAT AS THEIR LEAD..??!?

I read description- so of course, I knew what to look for. But, trust me NO ONE would ever find this on their own! If, this is a gift.. HOW DOES THE RECIPIENT KNOW?? 100%, this definitely needs a tag, card.. anything explaining what an incredibly unique gift it is!!

The charm has a small transparent crystal (about size of pencil eraser) connected to the choice of zodiac symbol- I’m Sept. 5 so, I ordered Virgo.. the charm is very sweet, sized appropriately. It’s length sits just below collar bone- but, it’s adjustable. The chain itself is my least favorite part, I feel it’s a bit cheap/delicate yet, it’s built into the necklace on both sides so, it cannot be replaced.
16k white gold is new to me- I suggest not getting it wet.. being unsure of how this will wear/tarnish- AND because of, delicate issue. The connections don’t have a solder fusing the jumprings together- and ladies.. we all know what this means, the chain can pull apart if too much tension!! Tbh, for $27.00 I want this to be more rock solid- Either sterling silver or, solder connections..
This comes in a brown jewelry box- mine had the description sticker placed right over Center/top of box.. this definitely needs to be changed- so, it can be “gift giving” ready.
I’d love to see this made into a sterling silver charm that hangs vertically from the top and has ability to be placed onto any chain.. making it that much better and versatile. But, with this being so clever- I do feel it’s worth It for a unique/one of a kind gift.

title: Nice for travel but, I struggle to get the polish out!
text:
I really wanted to like and have it work well. I chose this for the ease and the convenience it provided. It would be nice to travel and also, use at home just the same. Upon receiving I polished both, my husbands black/brown work shoes… As he’s the one who needed the product for work!

I found it was less than easy/convenient to get polish out… And yes, I was pressing down very firm as instructions explained. Plus, as a 40 something-year-old… This isn’t my first rodeo! Upon inspecting the issue, I found one tiny 1/8 slit in the sponge for the polish to come through and if you don’t press exactly at that spot, it’s not the easiest to get polish to release. This would be a lot better if there was maybe 1-3 small openings to allow polish to come through..??
I’m not certain whether or not these have expiration date? However, this felt as if it was maybe it was drying up… And that could’ve played a part in the difficulty releasing the polish. For the size of the sponge, the tiny opening just seemed far too small.
The black color matched up quite nicely- only, after about 7 to 10 days… They already looked as if they needed another polish? No, he doesn’t wear these daily so… It did seem odd that the polish had worn off as quickly as it did. Maybe I should put on a second coat? But, it’s not as if the shoe I was polishing had major issues… Just a handful of scuffs that I hoped to cover.

As for the brown- I did polish 2 different pairs and TBH, one of the shoes was a tad lighter than the other. Yet, this brown didn’t seem match either..?? In fact, I polished both pairs and ended up changing the color of the shoes- not in a good way! It almost left the shoe with a reddish tint in the brown. However, the brown has lasted longer in staying power then, black.
Overall, I’d like the concept and the ability to use while traveling. I just wish the product was easier to release and had a better overall result on the shoe.

title: I wanted to like.. just not sure what is going on with this!!?
text:
Without having access to any description, I wasn’t certain what exactly to expect.. I love rubies and the using of mixed metals... I was excited and expecting this to be a fun, cocktail ring. One I could use going out or, dressing up!

However, when this arrived it was much bigger than the photo provided leads on… It takes up almost one “link” or, at least 1” of my finger!! It is also a tall dome shape, easy to catch on things. I have never seen anything like this. It reminds me a bit like “steampunk” jewelry where they created a style using mixed metals, gears and objects to create a piece of funky jewelry.. only, this feels completely unfinished..?? (The word that comes to mind.)
Sizing is not an issue- as it comes on what I refer to as a “childs” adjustable band.. which is a thin and overlapping circle- It’s literally attached by a weld on the underside of the hollowed bell...?? And the ends of the adjustable ring, aren't finished and have sharp squared corners-
If you didn’t know this was metal.. you would think this was non-existent, that is how light the material is. Yet, because of the shape.. the ring is top heavy. The use of ruby colored stones is nice.. however, they become lost in the enormity of size with this ring.. honest, I’ve never seen anything like it!

I do however appreciate the box this came in. It is a smaller plastic flip lid box that has secure tab closures.. it would be nice to use for travel as, it’s able to fit a few different pieces of jewelry inside.

I’m sure this description is hard to understand.. But, if I’m being honest- that “hard to understand” describes this ring perfectly!! I did include x3 photos to give some idea of what I’m trying to describe.. As you will see, this is at best- uniquely different and at worst, completely unfinished.

Yes!! This would be a conversation piece of epic proportion‘s only, when they ask to see it for further inspection… I feel it would be almost comical?!

title: A pull string/rucksack bag on steroids.. super bag!!
text:
I’ve been a tried and true fan of the Adidas brand and seldom find any of their basics that don’t hit the spot for me... I love both a blend of their signature style and quality- This bag is a pull string/rucksack style and was no exception to that signature expectation!! Like most bags we like them to meet our OWN comforts- the bag itself has its pros and ehh’s.. Being a parent who has a child that’s grown up in the comp. Soccer world.. l share from that perspective:
Truly, it’s rare to find a day your player doesn’t need their full backpack of gear- but, in certain situations.. those times happen, making this bag great for the “lesser/tweaked” practice days.. ie, indoor practice or, conditioning- a day where less gear will suffice.. that is when we find ourselves reaching for a rucksack!

Pros: The bags main compartment boasts a larger then normal rucksack space and the top seems to have a wide, “easy to access” opening at the top- Making it convenient to load items and remove them as well.
The bag is made with a thicker, padded material on the back wall of bag giving structure/integrity to the bag itself… Again, this lends aid and offers better accessibility to the interior of the bag.
Padding in back also gives this a firmer capability to hold its structure and does not end up a crumpled pile on the floor when empty.
My favorite feature is the front zip pocket- And this was actually.. the #1 reason for choosing the bag! I appreciate one can toss keys, ID, money securely into the bag and know where they are without effort!! this being separate and secure and easy to access is awesome.
This bag is made of thicker material.. not thin nylon like a lot of these are. It adds to the weight a tiny bit.. however, it is a lot more durable- worth the few extra ounces!
I really like the straps made of a thick/ribbed material and not made of rope. IF.. wearing backpack style, this will lend comfort/adjustability which is nice.
I appreciate the hanging loop at top of bag.. these are a must have and come to be expected- it makes ease to store or dry.. I expect these on all packs!
Different use of lettering adds a unique flare to bag- let’s be honest, bags can only come in so many styles/colors. This helps one stand out from the other… And Yess!!! We have come home with someone else’s matching team bag before..!!!

Ehh’s: not sure this needs all the excess padding as, I don’t think style of bag should carry computer or, tablet inside. However, padding gives a feeling of security that IF a tablet/device is carried, it would be safe. ie, without a zipper closure (top of bag is just pull string closure) this cant keep out wet elements- but, can create the confidence it might?! Extra set of handles to carry on top of bag- Could be good/bad. At our house they were just in the way.. Too much on too little of space!

Overall, the bag has perks and integrity. I’ve paid upwards of $20 for similar style and brand. This being listed for $24 is probably due to the padding and extra whistles and bells. They all may not be needed but majority seem to be fun or added creature comforts..

title: Unisex butt pack that is perfect for public venues..
text:
This is a fanny pack/butt bag that is made to get you into concerts/festivals/sporting events Without the need of a bag search.
