title: Awesome super hero Batman type belt...
text:
This is a classic straightforward belt that is truly ANYTHING but, straightforward!! For real...

Available in black or brown, we chose black.. the belt has a finished/polished sheen on a nice quality leather, which feels sturdy/strong in shape and not already broken down or, without merit. The sheen makes this feel a bit dressier then not and added with the contrast against the shiny silver buckle- it really stands out and offers a dressier vibe..

So, what sets this “straightforward belt” APART.. and what I also feel, is it’s best feature? Its the awesome ratchet system used to tighten the belt and ability to cinch It to the perfect size. It can be set approx. 1/8” apart from each setting to tighten/loosen to your need and all without putting any strain on a belt hole or, needing to create more holes due to the sizing may be off. This will keep the belt looking fabulous for a long time.
How great is it, you can use as you grow or, gain/lose weight, even adjust to diff. pant styles where you may wear belt at a different height level on the hips. Bam! This belt adjust with you.. (think back to high school science class and learning about how a ratchet System works.. this is that! Simple analogy; on the inner side of the belt you’ll find imprinted grooves that run through the teeth type mechanism, built into the buckle... as the slack of belt is pulled through, the teeth catch in the grooves- allowing you to tighten/loosen belt, depending on direction pulled- Then, the magic happens by pressing a fun little button on side of your belt- and it releases the tension completely!! Super cool, It’s a gadget of sorts.. definitely boasting some Super hero Batman techie style stuff..!!

Maybe this has you wondering, how this is a “one size fits all??” AnD... good question! **BEFORE you cut, adjust belt size- be sure to read this over carefully. Most likely you will have approx. 10-12” of excess length.. Well, we almost made the error of cutting off the length from the finished end- this would make belt obsolete as you would cut the ratchets out.. not to mention, eliminate the quality finished end!! Instead- flip over to back of buckle, find the release on the end holding the leather... lift up flap and cut according to desired size- slide cut end back under flap and firmly close.. Boom! You have a belt to fit you forever more!! **always cut too little then too much, You can remove more but , never add back on once you’ve made a cut!!

This is a great belt with fun features and Quality to go with it… This is a belt one could plan to use for years to come.
If this info helped you.. feel free to say so!

title: If I would give it a 10* I could.. the presentation is amazing!!
text:
If I could get this at 10 for a presentation, I would!! If, in the market for a gift wallet… This is it! This arrives in a fitted flip lid box. Inside of that, is a high-quality decorative box… Open that and you’ll find, a soft cloth sleeve surrounding the wallet itself. Remove from there.. And you will see, cardboard inserts to keep the shape and a soft plastic wrapping to avoid any scratches.. AND THAT'S ALL BEFORE OPENING THE WALLET ITSELF!

This wallet is amazing and made out of soft but, durable leather- all the stitching and cuts are totally on point! We ordered in brown and this is a rich and classic color. The wallet is no bigger then, a dollar bill and then, folds over on itself very thin and sleek. This does have the ability to put coin in a small zipper pocket which may effect the overall size… So keep that in mind. But, I personally love the fact it has a coin pocket! The snap flap is such a great idea… It allows for extra cards to be stored on the outside of the wallet however, keeping them safe by snapping them securely in. This has one clear window and it’s placed on the natural fold to the wallet so, easy to present inside the wallet, sort of FBI style!

I would say this holds 12 cards and one photo ID. It states 13... but, just to clarify the one spot in discrepancy is for your photo ID. There’s also has a divided bill slot- I like this: x1 for $ and the other for receipts. There is a hidden compartment under the credit cards.. and this is the perfect place to put your hidden/emergency $20 bill...!!! (My mama always said, hide a $20 and forget it’s there- and when that time comes trust me, the one day you need it- it will be there!!) Funny, how some lessons stick!
This is definitely unisex and could be used by either without hesitation. This could also be placed in front pocket for men if they prefer.. this is a solid, sexy, sleek wallet- I’m a total fan hands down. The presentation is just the icing on the cake.. the cherry on top.. the sprinkle and the whip cream- If you want a wallet that will fit your needs and look good doing it... this is it!

title: Awesome socks.. incorrect sizing description, double check!!
text:
I’m struggling with this package of socks- and the results are totally bumming me out. I ordered for myself (Womens shoe sz.8) Because, these are listed as WoMeNs SoCkS.. Yet, these are not a set in women’s sizing..?!! these are actually mens 9-11. The package itself isn’t even clear if men/women’s product/sizing. So, I’m stuck with a pack of socks that are huge on me.. ugh!!

Having said that, I’ll pass on what I do know- these appear to be a very nice sock made with quality material and a sock that has been made with a lot of attention to the details.. The sock feels thinner then most but, these have such a cushioning to them.. it’s like magic! I love the stretch, it is found in all the right places- it’s not too tight, but has the perfect needed compression to offer the support and stay in place?
WHAT..?? How do I know this if they don’t fit? Well, you can just ask my teenage son who I’ve forced to wear these the past 7 hours… Yep! He is acting as a specimen in a “science sock test project” for me!! The joys of being the only child at home.. Ha!!! (He’s a teenager, he deserves to be tortured a bit for all the angst he causes me!)

While wearing these, they’ve stayed perfectly in place... and after taking them off- he doesn’t have the dreaded imprint from the elastic being too tight. His feedback: he loves the compression that circles the arch of his foot, he loves the softness and NOT bulky or, bunched up feeling.. he likes these are quarter length covering the ankle.. But, he hates the stripes on the top! Well- The last comment is obviously just a personal preference!!

I like thread combo as it gives these such a bright white look to the sock- they are “white” white and this is nice- especially, since so many pairs of socks get to that dinghy blah so fast! Personally, I like the stripes and as the mom who does the laundry, it makes things easy to match when pairing back up.. But, I will admit- the stripe does tend to give the socks a more feminine look.
At the end of the day- I hate to admit it.. the socks are pretty awesome! The only issue I have is with packaging/description and the need to make certain the information on website is accurate so, the right size gets received- and therefore, I deducted a star. As for the socks.. they’re pretty awesome!

title: This is the real deal.. and accurate sizing!!!
text:
If you’re like me- You may be hesitant in ordering this item and for one big reason.. it is a known fact, ordering items made overseas tend to have these awesome and amazing photos and yet, items tend to have major sizing discrepancies then US. Well, let’s just say- Order, order, order!!!

Deciding to take a chance, I ordered this sleeveless romper in size large- in navy/white stripes. Upon arrival.. The first thing I noticed, was the absolute softness in the material..!!! No! I mean it was absolutely S O F T..!!! The material has a bit of stretch and I found fabric to be of a nicer (not too thin) quality. For reference: 5’2” 145lb. 38C+ ***And if anything, this runs true to size.. If not, even a tad big in a forgiving way!!***

When I tried this on.. It dawned on me, this will be the need to be the take on/off process every time you use the restroom- WHAT?!! So, keep in mind if wearing someplace that is compromising or, hard to do (concert, school, air travel, etc.) The stretch allows you to step into romper feet first and at back of the neck, is a small x1 button to allow extra room to get in and over hips/chest/shoulders- The large gave me plenty of room to step into and slide on. **But, using the restroom the entire romper comes off each time- yikes! (The things we do for fashion..?!) Which leads to the next feature…

The tie strap at the waist! This is a sewn in tie with an elastic feature and therefore creates the soft needed line at waist- You do have the ability to adjust tightness/tension, and slightly select the perfect location (within limitations of a few inches of positioning either way!) As for the tension around waist- you set that.. and I love this feature!! It is forgiving with the flow of material, and allows a small amount of “blousing” at the waist-basically, giving one the look of a tucked in tshirt. It has a solid amount and right amount of material through the bodice (not excess..) trust me, being only 5’2” with my shoes on.. it isn’t too much material through the torso!
The length is a tad long. Personally, I wish this was just a bit shorter (wasn’t above ankle and this will be, for those who are taller !!)For myself, it aligns below the ankle so, I plan to roll the cuff x2 to shorten. The leg has a nice fit that tapers down to the ankle.. I do appreciate that the taper is gradual providing a nicer clean line/look.. and not, that potato sack appearance these rompers can have!

Having an ample chest myself, is why I chose the large- and glad I did! There was a more liberal ft everywhere but, the bust line! It isn’t tight but, let’s just say it’s “right there” on the no room to give in the fit!! I’m glad the material has the stretch.. and I won’t dry this for sure. (Wash on cold and line dry.) * Let’s just say- after trying on this is the exact size I would order again with my body tight/size! I do love the shoulder strap and that it is a wider band- it lets you wear a bra without having to pin, tape or reconfigure.. This is an overall good fit- (the XL wouldn’t make sense just to get a tad more room through the chest - it would prove far too big everywhere else.) I suggest ordering size you normally would.
At the price point offered this is definitely a good purchase if you like the romper style. The quality and fit is there no doubt… being a 40+yr old, I did worry the style may be too juvenile/trendy and TBH, I don’t see that as a problem. In fact, I’m looking forward to getting into warmer weather and pairing this with such a fun pair of sandals!

title: Can contend with name brands and offer as much or more..!!!
text:
These fit like a glove.. Ha!! Or, an awesome boxer brief! Either way- they seem to be a very nice, soft quality and my husband/son both Prefer wearing boxer brief style and nothing else.. Both wear, XL - So, I had gifted them each with a pair to get the feedback- My own science lab of men’s “trunks and junk!!”

I’m told by the older gray haired participant- for reference: 6’4” 210lb. 36x36... 2 thumbs up!! He likes the integrity of the waistband most of all, it doesn’t seem to roll and better yet, it provides almost 1.5” of an added hidden belly support..!! Something he can (and others might?) appreciate! Here’s the report from my other (not, better half!) “The crotch is nicely stitched so, you don’t feel as if.. you’re sitting on a stick stitched in like some pair of briefs tend to do.. this provides no seams in the wrong places! The support for “the junk” is there.. with appropriate reinforcement sewn into the under side construction it keeps “the goods” in order and where they should be!!?” Im being told- if I supply this info. In my review... (Although, it means very little to myself as a female..) this info. will be beneficial to the men who want to know these things..?!

For the younger participant in the boxer brief experiment.. he was one of lesser words! Possibly bc, talking about underwear with his mom as a 17-year-old is not high on his priority list?!! For reference: 6’2” 189lb. 33x36- muscular build but, in the tween manhood stage of life. He too, liked these boxer briefs and tbh, he said his favorite part was they were black!!! When I inquired about the fit he said he appreciated they didn’t ride down and also, they didn’t ride up.. all my adidas briefs ride up my thigh- so, I like these way better. ” translation, as loose as teenagers wear pants these days, ones underwear can tend to pull down and he hates that.. Only, these stayed firmly in place on the waist. On the flip side, he really liked the leg band was compressed just enough to stay in place on the thighs and not bunch up! Hmm.. I never realized our guys had such tricky needs with their “personals” and truth be told, there is a small sense of justice in knowing this.. it feels a bit satisfying in a #girlpower sort of way..!!

To sum up findings on my case study- it appears that Goodthreads boxer briefs offer a quality soft material with plenty of attention/stretch to the details, in all the right places!! From waistband to leg compression.. and “everything“ in between, this hits the mark and offers support. Oh, and black is a great color ha-!! The $ is on point to contend with name brands yet, it offer equal or, even better creature comforts. Overall, a quality purchase!

title: Look of a bomber jacket without weight of leather!!
text:
I ordered for my 17yr. old son who most often wears athletic style pants/tshirt/hoodie (a walking adidas billboard!!) In cold months, he throws on the zip up jacket that goes with the athletic bottoms - But, this is all part of “the specific casual athlete” look... which leads to another issue for us-
He hates pairing jegging/jeans.. with the athletic jackets, this drives him crazy.. so, instead he goes without any jacket.. and as the mom, it drives me crazier!! I thought I found the solution and gave him a leather “bomber” jacket for xmas.. he loves the look only, hated the heaviness/weight of wearing the jacket itself. (TBH, I feel his pain.. I too, love leather jackets just not the weight.)

So, after the high $$ xmas gift ended its short run by hanging in the closet- I’ve been looking for a “similar vibe” and this jacket was it..!!!! This is a bomber jacket in cut and style.. but, it’s made of a slikery jacket material. There is NO weight involved with this in any way.. yet, you get a similar bomber appearance.
Ok, Slickery.. What?!! There is a slight sheen to the material that is present w/ rain repellent material.. However, this is not a stiff material in any way. It has a softer, silky feel.. It is very nice and is a rich olive color with a contrast of hunter orange! To some this combo may sound iffy.. but, it’s smart and classic resembling a military/paratrooper flight jacket. I’ve seen this with aviation patches sewn on- yet, for the older age bracket.. they seemed a bit juvenile or, costume like! Remember, he’s in high school and can’t commit fashion suicide ha ha! This entire jacket is unmarked with any gimmick, patch or, paraphernalia (if your in the adult arena and haven’t earned these marks being a pilot yourself.. then, they are gimmicky!) The only accessory item this jacket has- is a “red tag” zipper pull that is found on the bicep pocket.. But, FYI- the pull is 100% removable by an easy on/off clip!

The collar, wrists, waist are nicely finished with a thick banding, which gives overall fit a streamlined and polished look.. A silver zipper runs the front of the jacket and 2 hand pockets are found with a flap secured with a snap closure.. As mentioned, on the left bicep is a small zipper pocket.. I love this and it adds just a touch of uniqueness- but, best part of all.. it is useful!
We ordered a 2XL and I’m so glad we did. Jacket seems to run a bit small- but, 2XL fit perfectly. For reference: my son is 17yo, 6’3”,189lb., 33x34- he has a muscular build but, NOT bulky- he is in that tween growing into a grownup man body phase..

So far, he has love the jacket and paired it with denims both light/dark.. and even a pair of khakis! Honestly, this olive color complements them all quite well- No, this is not a jacket for winter use… it doesn’t have the layers or the bulk. Being we were looking for a lighter wearing jacket- this is perfect!

title: quality base layer for cold and winter months...
text:
Received the eve before a 48 hour blizzard…whew!! Ordered an XL in black for my husband and for reference, he is 6’3” and 210lb. Waist 35x36. These fit everywhere as expected… With exception of length being a tad short (just like we are used too!) They do have ample amount of stretch while still maintaining compression… Length hits him right above the ankle. TBH, This is not an issue for our need- as he wears thick winter crew style socks, Which covers any gap between bottom layer and skin!

My husband incurred a terrible accident a few years back… And with multiple fractures, X4 in his back alone- add in a broken leg, wrist, hand bones, X4 ribs and skull fracture and he has pretty much been “Humpty Dumptied” back together! Great doctors mended him by fusing and using ample amounts of titanium during the many surgeries it took to get him this way! In the end, he’s found circulation post these multiple infractions seems to be subpar. Ugh.. Cold weather acts like a catalyst for arthritis, stiffness and pain…

He prefers to wear a base layer during cold and winter months.. doing something as simple as, wearing a compression pants/under armor style base layer- has made an incredible improvement on his physical symptoms. So much so.. not only does he wear these when outdoors in colder elements. But, in these colder months- he uses during regular ‘day to day’ activity ...and does so to keep body, muscles, and circulation warm and flowing- it’s like manna from the sun gods!!

Wearing daily means wearing underneath his dress slacks (as well as, athletic/ denim pants..) and therefore, he prefers the tighter fit of synthetic or spandex. This way the style hugs body and bends with curves, keeping any possibility of bulk/extra Thermal material below top layer to a minimum! Trust me the difference of less bulk has an impact on comfort!! Comparing these to his pair of hot chili’s, under armor, and cabbala brand.. He said he sees no difference... other then, some waist bands are thicker vs. others. But, as far as warmth they seem to compare similarly.
I do wash these on cold and then, line dry… Any stretching that occurs while wearing can resume it’s shape.. and line drying helps prevent any issues with shrinkage. So, if needing a base layer to help keep warm- this pair will hold up to the big name brands at a comparable $ and do a fantastic job, all while being comfortable wearing- a win/win for sure!!

title: More then just a simple sock...
text:
OHHH THE STRETCH!! Who knew how one could perfect a sock to feel amazing.. bc, in the end- I think most (ok, at least I do!) go by the philosophy- it’s just a sock!!? Something you must spend $ on but, don’t get a lot of frills for your buck! Well, I found out that isn’t alway the case... and this sock IS the proof!!

I’m in a constant battle to find a stretchable sock that doesn’t create a fight to get on.. I realize, not all share the struggle to put on a sock unless, you’re like my teenage son who has size 13 foot. (Yes, I do buy socks according to his shoe size..) Yet, a sock is either slim/tight or, the total opposite and a large/loose fit- becoming useless, losing all the support needed to stay in place and most of all, becomes a nuisance all day long! Ahh-hmm.. with this purchase- I’ve struck the mother load!!

A few years back... I took notice, socks got crazy by adding the support thru the middle of foot/arch area- and boom! It was like manna from heaven and proved effective with added comfort in such a positive way. Raising the question- why couldn’t the same creature comforts be applied to the heal and up into the calf? Well, ask no more- This sock seems to provide the universal compression one could only hope for.. All in a stretchable way to get it on without a fight.

This sock has a smooth soft finish to the material creating a slide/glide ability when putting it on. It has been created with plenty of compression, support and reinforcement in arch heel and calf by the simple attention to detail.. these worked so well, I kept the sock wrapper/label so when buying socks online or in person- I could mimic the purchase.. trust me, I can honestly say I’ve never done that before!
This sock provides the all day wearability of staying in place and when removing.. there is only the small expected imprint of where the sock line was. I see zero signs of swelling in the ankle or water line that is sometimes found with removal of some compression socks. After washing/drying a few times- we haven’t had issue with shrinking.. if anything, my son tends to “stretch them off” when removing.. and once washed, these regain their composure nicely!
Love these and will be in the market for more, I can promise you that! Definitely a great find and worth ordering.

title: Rock solid trifold without excess bulk
text:
Love it!! Classic, sleek and sexy but, most of all- totally has some awesome creature comforts covered and the attention to detail is spot on! Received in brown and wallet has a weathered vibe giving it a vintage look yet, all this with a spanking soft, new leather!

In a world going towards a cashless system, it’s easy to obtain a plethora of cards.. Cards add up quick- with ones own personal banking cards, add on any corporate credit/gas cards, throw in an employee access card.. all bundled with maybe your gym membership and Costco (big box) card, etc.. You can created the perfect storm of way too many “plastics” and not enough slots!! (sounds like just a rich peoples problems -but, nope! trust me sound and reality are two different things- Ha Ha!) The next best feature to love is 2 ID windows.. we have the obvious drivers license window and then, one more for either a student or, military ID or otherwise- But, with 2 ID windows- both ID’s have the ability to be viewed in wallet without removing or issues.
This wallet hosts 9 cards slots and due to the card abundance issue mentioned above, this was a total perk for us. We needed a wallet constructed not to feel bulky- yet, hold it all! This trifold is designed with solid integrity yet, It has trimmed the fat making this thin and comfortable enough to slide in a rear pant pocket and/or, depending on pant style- some front pockets as well. Credit cards fit in every slot without room to spare. Trust me, I filled the wallet then, tossled it around “trying” to make a card fall loose- but, all remained in tact! In fact, I noticed if putting card back at a slight angle… They wouldn’t fit. You must slide card straight down in/out to fit, giving peace of mind to the hold on the card- (I believe a tell tale sign one needs a new wallet is when cards become loose and won’t stay put.. And as with any leather after daily use and wear/tear, it begins to soften and eventually become worn making looser fit on cards. So, this is nice to not start out that way..)

Love the two hidden slide pockets- These are great for the hidden emergency $20 bill.. or, important info. one must carry with them- slide pockets are under both sets of credit cards adding to these being hidden and out of sight. Love the creature comforts I tell you!

The middle section of credit cards is created on a flap and when lifted, both picture ID windows are easily visible. This could also be a place to keep an electronic door key- we tried this exact option and it’s awesome! One does not have to remove the card Key from Wallet to unlock door- total bonus!! But No, the card flap does not have ability to be removed completely from the wallet… this is just a flip style option.. The flap is stitched tightly at the top- So, no worry that it may come loose or, separated from wallet itself.

The cash section runs the length of the tri-fold and itself is very slim, split with a divider made for keeping receipts or punch cards. Easy to access and nice to keep hold of important “must have receipts” (too many can make this a tad hard to fold with ease- but, avoidable if emptied every few days.. eliminating any problem.)

The look of worn leather makes this appear far richer then the actual cost- it ultimately has a high dollar vibe! This has no excess sheen to it too.. it’s has all the comforts one would expect and surpasses the quality I expected for the price. I plan to gift one to my son who’s just stepping up from a “minimalist style” wallet and needing one to keep more Cards associated with his new job. If contemplating this to purchase- you can do so without hesitation!!

title: Great for casual Friday paired with a turtleneck for warmth..
text:
Really like this sweatshirt- just take note, there is no hood on this style... I say this bc, I’ve done it x2! (placed order thinking I purchased hoodie- without ever taking notice, it wasn’t- ugh!!) Ha, this time.. I meant to get an actual sweatshirt style! Personally, I think its a nice way to add a bit of diversity from the standard hoodie- The style can dress up the usual sweatshirt- What?? Not overly bulky- this looks great paired with turtleneck underneath or, pulled over a nice collared shirt.. Something NOT easily done with the bulk of hood. The body of sweatshirt has a slight taper that creates a straight, clean line and with a waistband that’s not “tightly gathered..” it looks smooth- not bunched like bulky sweats!

We received a men’s XL in heathered navy and description is on point and as described on website. The color is smart! As some have figured out.. Navy can be a tad tricky to match with other navy colors. (ie. if one’s trying to match 2 navy’s from different brands/material- matching the shades exactly, is not always easy!) The heathering makes this a bit more forgiving to match colors and I welcomed that. Note: this is a more faded/lighter hue of navy, almost hints of a bluish gray in color (FYI, if trying to coordinate with something.)

I got this for my husband to wear to work on those “cold and casual” Utah Friday’s! It offers comfort yet, can still look presentable for meetings at the office! This is the perfect example when having a sweatshirt vs. hoodie is best. Get all the yummy creature comforts but, don’t look like you’re swimming in a bulky pile of endless material!!

For size reference: my husband is 6’4” 205lb. and all legs! 36x36... This sweatshirt has a nice overall fit- *Note: the length is one place that tends to run short!! length hit him at the belt line- I wouldn't describe this as a small but, rather shorter fit. Keep in mind when ordering if that is a concern. I recommend washing on cold and line drying (avoid risk of shrinking in length/otherwise.) This has washed up nicely and so far- no signs of pilling.
I would ordered this brand again w/out hesitation. I like the quality and attention to detail.. at a fair and decent price point.

title: Quality minimal wallet.. That works like magic!!
text:
This is insane!! I didn’t know what to expect- I’m mean really, “a magic wallet!?” And then, I tried it.. now, I’m thinking of becoming a part time birthday magician.. ha ha!! This wallet really IS magic- it is just that simple!!
Well, this does what it says it will- and craziest part of all.. I’m baffled at how it does it! This can tuck your $ (bills) into the elastic band by closing the wallet and opening it again from the other side.. WHAT..??!!!

Let’s cover all that matters:
•this is a nice, slim, quality leather.. it stated I would receive navy blue- however, the color I did receive was black and, I’m thrilled with the black color actually.. This leather is so soft and smooth. It definitely feels like quality.. it does have the ability to scuff I noticed. But, I’m guessing a bit of leather protector can help keep that to a minimum.

• the card holders are found on what would be the outsides of the wallet- each side holds 3... So, 6 in total. NOW- before you think I counted wrong- it does have 2 side entry slots.. it says they can be used for 2 more cards and they are cut to fit the size.. Personally, I would use these pockets for either receipts or stamp/point cards- (not that they would fall out. But, for some reason.. I’m a tad skeptical with these being on the ‘edge’ of the wallet? This wallet has a nice solid hold on the cards inserted and the amount of slots are best for anyone who’s a minimalist, younger without a lot of cards to carry, or.. Just when you need a simple ‘go too’ wallet and want to leave the purse behind! As an everyday wallet.. it may be hard for some of us to use. I will admit, I took this skiing with me to the resort just today- and it was just about perfect!!

• this easily fits inside a pant pocket- either, back or, front, no problem! I personally slid this inside the breast jacket pocket of my ski parka.. it fit with room to spare. The wallet is so light- even with a cards/bills inside.. I didn’t even realize it was there! In fact, I had to keep double checking- bc, the pocket felt next to empty!

• and now, we’ve come full circle.. we’re back to the **magic*potion*part.** The straps inside somehow (and no! I can’t figure out how it’s done.. as it all happen inside the wallet while closed- or, as one may say, behind the curtain!) But, the outcome is there.. The bills will be held in with two parallel straps on one side or, a x-cross strap on the other.. Since the rule is, a magician never reveal their secrets- it is about that mysterious. But, I did open/
close x100 and every time, the $ is securely tucked under the strap.

This is a really nice pocket ”minimalist” wallet.. the magic trick offered is just a fun bonus! This would be a great bar wallet… You know, pay for a drink and you have a built-in cheesy line, “anyone want to see a magic trick” ..ha! Cheesy? Yes. Only as a 40+ yr. old mom- I am still totally impressed! (And.. it’s a far better trick then.. the nickel behind the ear!)
•this is delivered in a cardboard type jewelry box. It has the information card included in the wallet.. and it is gift giving ready! The price point seems comparable with the quality leather and craftsmanship.

title: Buttons are amazing- sleeve/chest so under sized..
text:
Love this jacket it is absolutely beautiful. Love the style and the larger buttons on front- they are my favorite and add such flair to a classic coat.. my issue is- THIS DIDNT FIT.. AND I WANTED IT TO SO MUCH!! The quality and craftsmanship are there no doubt. So, it’s a bit frustrating to know… when expecting to get a regular size chart to be somewhat comparable to other brands- Everything is was on point except, sizing..!! Ugh-

To have an idea of size issues. We ordered sz. large in gray and length was perfect. But, my 22yr. old daughter- 5’6” 123lb. 34B (if being nice!!) who’s a varsity college athlete = -0% body fat.. tried this on and liked the length, she could even button up the front snug (I personally could not and I’m a 38C..) However, lifting arms and/or crossing as you do in front of body- this was a “no go!” In fact, I feared if she kept straining the material… She would rip it under the arm.. also, lifting arms up above head (sun salutation..) was also a no go- not good!! You would not believe the obnoxiousness to the way these are sewn? Or, is it just the miss guided have a size?? The problem is, I couldn’t order in XL with confidence- if I chose to button this I would have the same arm issue as well as ,not enough room I fear through the chest.. I’m saying this bc, the large (which I normally wear with ease and daughter is usually a small- we’re struggling like stepsisters to make this fit! If this was the case in my normal sz. Then, One size up- wouldn’t do the trick!)

I’m sad and disappointed, as I would have worn this everywhere.. for those it does fit, this would look so fab. paired with leggings/jeans/skirt.. you name it! This can be dressed up/down and look good doing it! If you don’t have sizing angst- then, you will be the happiest we’ll dressed chic on the block!

title: Great quality.. a bit tight in the waist.
text:
These are a nice quality and solid bike short and the leg length is approx. 3.5”... ordered size XL in black and TBH, the waist feels a tad tight.
These were gotten for lounge purposes and my sizing is 5’2” and 138lb.. I’m a 40+ Yr old mom.. who wanted to find a bike short that would have thick waist band and not be skin tight... these work nicely, I just wish the waist was a little less snug! I’m hoping they will give a little bit. Usually a L/XL fit me more then fine..
The material is nice and the attention To stitching and reinforcement is great as well. I love the “box seam” style, let’s face it.. they’re a lot more comfortable then straight line middle seam. These definitely have the ability to hold up in the exercise arena and is like to use for biking in spring weather! (Just want the waist to be less irritating!)

Comparing these to a style of Nike compression short I have- I saw very comparable material/ stitching/ and overall look..that helps me to understand what I’m getting with newer product line- maybe it will help you with a comparassion or, just to give you an idea of what to expect. If sizing is correct And my issue was the tighter/higher waist, I feel these are made to be a quality pair of bike/compression shorts.

title: Love the quick release key ring this has!!
text:
These are such a clever way to keep important keys attached to without losing… Not to mention, a very stylish way! Remember the lanyard era? Well, these seem to be replacing that fun feature...

I loved the soft color we ordered this in. We got a pinkish/pearl that is subtle yet, sophisticated and with gold accent- don’t worry if you’re not usually into wearing gold… This just makes the key ring stand out. Better yet, the gold is a contrast with the silver of most keys. The added tassel is a fun feature and blings it up a bit..

But, The best feature is the quick release clip. This is great to have if leaving your car at the valet or, giving a house key to someone. With the quick release- you can take off a key with ease (not having to remove a key from the dreaded jump ring.. that can be difficult at best!!) All of this lets you hand over just the one necessary key and lets you keep the remaining keys with you.

The only difference I would suggest with this key ring would be to add a few more of the quick release mechanisms! Maybe 1-2 more and it Would be perfect. That way, your most often used keys could be easily removed as you needed too- I think a car key/house key/mail key... and then, this would be absolutely perfect. For a solution, I’m going to personally look for a few of these quick release clips and add them.. then, I can get the use out of this I’m wanting.
Nice bonus, you can slide this on your arm and keep keys from becoming lost/misplaced. Or,
hang the loop itself on a backpack/purse.. it’s a fun key ring without being too obnoxious and has a lot of nice creature features.
This would be a great gift for someone turning 16.. a fun way to display the keys, and hopefully help not to lose them! The various colors these come in are as fun as one can imagine...

title: Read “how too use” below.. Save a headache!!!
text:
These are like 3 little shoe deodorizers from the future!! I spent the better part of 30 minutes just trying to understand how to use this tricky little contraption!! I read warning not to let it spray in the face- Only, it had 2 nozzles to release spray set 180° apart- So, no matter what I did.. if I held like normal aerosol bottle in the “natural position” in the hand- one nozzle would spray in the shoe and then, the other.. right back at my face.. ??!!
OK!! I FIGURED IT OUT… This dispenser works “upside down“ and if only instructions mentioned that BY DIAGRAM, it would’ve saved a lot of time. (but, it would have robbed me of the ah-ha moment!) So, when using this- rather than waste time as I did… Instead of trying to manually press the button with the finger, like all aerosol sprays… Instead, you place aerosol dispenser inside the shoe. Then, just press down.. Boom!! Solid gold- and as for the two nozzles, this will dispense the deodorizer 2 directions at the same time! Wow, who knew.. right!!?
Basically, the end of the bottle that has the funky shape, well that goes inside the shoe.. From there- all you do is push down and you will hear/see/ smell the deodorizer releasing. I gave shoes 1-2 bursts and left them to dry and let the deodorizer go to work! I’m not 100% certain if this eliminates
or, masks stinky smells- but, living in Utah we fight the endless battle of wet shoes during winter and I’m hopeful… IF, we’re using this post getting wet shoes/boots from being out during the day- then, at least it may help the overall stink of nasty wet boot smell!!? What I’ve decided using this… It cannot hurt.
The smell is nice, not overbearing and seems to dry very quickly. It’s sort of fresh/almost baby powder smell but, It does not leave any white residue. I set one of these bottles out by our “shoe dump” at the Front/back door. I plan to have people use once they remove their wet shoes.. I feel it’s best to not let the order dry into the shoe if possible.

title: Solid black quarter zip pullover!!
text:
Really nice material and well sewn with nice finishing and straightforward details. This isn’t a fancy pullover- I’d refer to it as “standard” used for colder climate, no frills, great for a workout or, cool down afterwards.. and just what one expects to have as a “go to” black pullover.
The quarter zip is nice if pulling on over layers or, sweaty workout- sometimes trying to shimmy into Basic style hoodie can feel a bit confining- and this quarter zip makes on/off a breeze! It is also nice to be able to adjust and keep cooler by loosening the fit just a little bit.
Sleeves are a nice tight finish so, they can be pushed up and stay in place.. and that is nice as well. The bottom fit is more of a tapered straightedged and is flattering to the female figure. This doesn’t have extra length/bulk and can be versatile and worn for work out as well as every day sweatshirt style.
The only issue I could see with this top.. it may run a tad small! We ordered a medium and it fit my daughter who is 22yr, 5’6”- 123lb. 34B if wearing a padded bra! (she is a college athlete -0% body fat… So, you get idea, she is a size small for sure!) Only, this medium fit her without any room to spare- I did wash/dry and it tightened up but, didn’t shrink down (if that makes any sense?!) So, if you are in between size and wanting a little wiggle room… I suggest sizing up- don’t be afraid that this not being “athletic name brand” is any less quality.. i’ve been completely impressed with Amazon taking the time to get the quality of a product right.. and in athletic gear, where I feel it matters a bit more to get the benefits of all those good creature comforts.. this holds up to expectations for sure!!
I would not hesitate to purchase this style/brand in the future if the need was there- I’m completely content and feel this is a staple that will easily integrated into the wardrobe and serve its purpose completely.

title: fun shirt that makes you feel whimsical..
text:
Love the shirt and it is very flattering! As a 40 something-year-old mom I was looking for something fun but, age-appropriate and not total “marmy/forever 21” looking and this hit the mark!!

The material is soft and sure, It’s not the highest Quality shirt I’ve ever owned… But, it was great for the Christmas work party. My favorite feature was the sleeves… The style is loose yet has shape so, it’s very forgiving- and like I said… The sleeves capture all the attention with the bell cuff, it is hard not to feel a bit whimsical!! I paired with black satin leggings and boots and longer trench coat jacket- The entire ensemble was comfortable and yet, totally on point!

For size reference- I’m 5’1” and 138lb and 40+yr old.. it’s a great shirt and the weight and style of the material.. this could carry over to all seasons- nothing about it screams winter/summer or anything in between… It is definitely Season universal and would look great paired with sandals or boots. Leggings or, mini skirt..
If you’re looking for a fun shirt to add to your wardrobe this is a great buy and find.

title: Great deal- but, bra runs really small-
text:
This is the fourth style of this brand we have tried in the past week. This was smallest all Iris and Lily bras and it barely fit my 22yr old 34B college athlete! (She has 0% body fat and giving her a B is being generous… 5‘6“ and 125lb.) I worried this might be too big and yet, she was struggling on the loosest setting… It was just too tight!

Love the fact that it came in a set- one black/white and would be easily used as an every day bra if, the fit what is better... the cup was also not shaped to fit her and not sure why? It was as if these were to perfectly rounded and rarely does one truly fit that build.
These are trimmed with lace on the edges and although it felt soft to the touch.. But when she was wearing, it scratched/rubbed in all the wrong ways. Maybe it’s due to it fitting too small? Unfortunately I’m not certain what caused this issue… The shoulder straps are nice- they can adjust and the back is an eyelet style with 3 levels of tightness to get desired comfort. I suggest if ordering- order bigger… The width is where I would say its definitely off and I’ve found overall, these consistently run small with this brand. Knowing this may help others choose and more appropriate sizing – and if in between sizes, 100% size up!!
Pricing is very reasonable, especially for two bras. Just be sure to adjust and read feedback on size before you order your appropriate choice-

title: LIFT.. SQUISH... PAD...!!!
text:
This is a good bra.. !! We needed A push-up bra for a specific outfit… And this worked! Trust me after trying half a dozen others that didn’t fit.. we were thrilled with this!
LOVE the color it is gorgeous! At first glance, it may appear black but, Nope! This is darkest Navy and it’s really such a sexy rich color! (we received a Navy 34B...) and love the material used. This is soft as skin quality and feels as such when on- there are no scratchy or, lacy edges and the construction is on point. We find this brand to run a tad bit small and if your unsure or, in between sizes- I’d suggest you size up. Not to mention, this creates the push-up effect by some serious “squishing“ of the girls together- So, if claustrophobic in anyway you’re better a bigger size so that you can adjust looser if/as needed!

Having said all that- this is a push-up bra that creates this illusion by padding…(at least for those who aren’t packing any heat!!) My daughter needed this and she is a 34B if we’re being generous! (Picture a varsity college athlete with -0% body fat and you see why we just give her the “B” to feel better… Ha!) When putting this bra on, it gave her a full bust- but, best part of all.. the bra did not gap/gape which was really nice.

The effects of this bra are created in a 3 part process: lift/squish/pad... So, if you’re needing a little help to create the illusion- this bra can do it.. even if you don’t have much to work with! I’m guessing this will just enhance a fuller breast- and in fact, this gives another reason to size up.. if you don’t want to spill over the edges!! (I’m saying this in theory.. Just by seeing what it did for someone without a fuller bust line..)

The back is eyelet style with 3 Adjustment levels for tightness and the shoulders have slide adjustment as well, letting you tweak this to the comfortable fit possible. Keep in mind the padding is not removable as, it is completely inclosed and sewn in.
This is a great bra giving lift and for those who need, the illusion of a fuller bust line. For the quality and design I feel this is reasonably priced.

title: Love the pockets zips 100% shut...
text:
This wallet is nice and ordered for the purpose of using when an entire purse just isn’t necessary! This can be taken with you with such an ease.. allowing just the vital items to go with you.. Let’s face it, sometimes you need to go without an entire bag weighing you down or becoming encumber-some!!

This allows one view of the I.D. inside the pocket And also, gives easy access for when it must be removed from the wallet pocket itself- (if it’s happened to you then, you know the perk of getting ID in/out and being able to do so in an instant- especially when a line of people are waiting behind you!!)
Wallet has 3 credit card slots on the opposite side of the ID and a bonus slot above the picture window (I use it for receipts or my list.. but, it can double as an extra card slot if one desires.) Leaving the zipper pouch for $$ and coin/medicine or chapstick.. whatever you choose. (Mine held all 3 perfectly while still closing just fine!!)

The no.1 reason I chose this style wallet vs. a different brand- is due to fact: key ring/lanyard attachment is sewn on the outside edge of the wallet!! It is a simple reverse “U” yet, it holds with integrity. Meaning one can safely attach to whatevr they’d like and not worry if it will hold and stay put. The opposite style sews the ring attachment inside the pocket- So, if you want to use.. it comes out of the pocket itself, making the zipper stay open a bit for that to happen- this translates to NOT getting to zip pocket 100% securely shut!! After I purchased a wallet of this style- I didn't get the peace of mind needed. Bringing me to get the minimalist wallet and it does the trick.. allows the zipper to shut completely and does it’s job really well!!
The only negative I found in the minimalist wallet was the over all outer look/feel and the coating to material used. Maybe it’s the pattern imprinted on the outside of the wallet- it’s cross hatched?
Truthfully, It isn’t 100% working for a real quality look...it almost makes it look cheaper or, less then, what it could. We received this in deep red color.. and possibly the color adds to the plasticy look of the material used.. (I’m not certain- it says leather but, appears like a coated/treated Vinyl or canvas that is used- leather is nice, wish it looked More like leather!!) Now, this may look less shiny or, plastic coated in a different color..?? And if imprint was not stamped into the material it might be a lot better- just be aware when you order. It’s not bad, just could look better!?
As for the detail/quality of the minimalist wallet-
It’s all there and nice. Only drawback, is wanting it to look like it too.. for that, I deducted a star.

title: Perfect hidden inspiration..
text:
Love this and love the personal message shared between the giver/receiver. Got this for my daughter who was taking her first set of finals out of state in college… And and a time when things can feel a little impossible and the doubt creeps in, she could wear this to remind herself… That she has what it takes!!
The quality in the metal is there and yet it is soft enough to adjust the sizing. The engraved inner message is done by black imprint and quite easy to read. From the outside this looks like a silver cuff bracelet which adds a nice element of- secrecy or personal empowerment… And that’s exactly what I was wanting!
We have ordered a few of these and never been disappointed. Our bracelets have arrived in either a jewelry bag or cardboard jewelry box. Either way, making it gift ready-
If your looking for a quality and unique gift this is fantastic.. at the price point I feel you won’t be disappointed!

title: Finally, a bra without inches thick padding!!!
text:
I give this a fantastic rating… Especially since we’ve been on a bra hunt for the past few weeks. Nothing has measured up to expectations until we received this… And I’m talking 6+ different bras purchased and some of them- I’m the same style just different sizes and all without success!! So, I feel that hitting the mark while all these others didn’t, deserves a shout out...

As for material used, it is incredibly soft with plenty of stretch and I love the fact, there is plenty of support.. all without the excess padding!! (Trust me- this isn’t the easiest to find..) The “support strap” underneath the cups is made WITHOUT an underwire. But, with the integrity and material used, it creates a functional “shelf“ to hold the girls up and in place..sorry to sound blunt, its just the reality- And exactly what we were hoping for.

This was ordered in a Black SIZE L... and for any who’ve ordered a bra before.. this is odd Sizing at best!! At least for grownup young ladies, this is something seen in training/sports bras only. **there was NO size chart offered and we were left to guess on sizing- that should be fixed by the seller for sure!! Our goal was trying to find a good quality bra at a decent price to fit my 19yr old- she usually wears a true 36C and has the expected curves of that age- but, definitely not mom (child bearing) curves- as she is young and not had the Privilege of gravity’s cruel life lessons!! This bra fit better then, any of the numerous bras we had ordered, attempted and tried ad nauseam!

Best part of this bra... is they haven’t tried to compensate getting a good fit with padding!! I’ve noticed this more and more- instead of putting in the effort to create a quality fit when designing.. it seems as if more designs now, just seem to stuff padding in to compensate and fill in any gaps and gapes in the empty places. Only, why in the world… If you’ve already have a full C size cup, would you want to add heavy/thick padding to the bust line?! Now, don’t get me wrong… I know why padded bras exist! But, if you’re packing your own heat- this can actually make you look top-heavy (in a weight gain sort of way!!) and tell me what 20 something girl- let alone any of us want that?!!
The material used has substance (without being too thick in the cup) but... it does have enough so, not to be too thin, either physically/visually to see-thru and this thickness adds to the feeling of support as well.. there are no ruffles and lacy frills with this- which also means, there is no place for this bra to rub/scratch/irritate as the edges of the lace can tend to do. The shoulder straps have slide adjusters and can be fit to size, the strap itself feels quite nice on the shoulder and stays put with ease. The back has a double level of eyelets for closure and adjusts at 3 different tightness settings- (we found this to fit best on the loosest setting... so, keep in mind- this may run just a bit on smaller size- it really is hard to say with the quirky SMLXL sizing!? If unsure about which size to get, I would suggest to go with larger of the two- it worked for us- again, we had no size chart!)

Overall- This is definitely a quality, comfortable and reasonably priced bra and one that I don’t feel you’ll regret buying... it’s got a lot of good qualities and attention to detail/materials used- A bra that could be a staple in your day to day wear and one of the better designed bras- after seeing as many as we did!

title: Super cute bra.. excess padding that doesn’t come out!
text:
This is a really fun bra.. and material is so soft and has a lot of stretch. The style is unique and we were hopeful the fit would be on point.. however, it didn’t workout that way.
As mentioned the quality of material used is nice and the attention to detail is there. No extra scratchy lace or, parts to rub your skin raw and that is a perk with a bra- as any of us who’ve ever had the opposite, all know!
This style has underwire and then, again.. below the bottom of the cups- there is an additional band that adds to support and the lift.. it has a peek-a-boo cut out in the front that is fun- (after all, if we wear a bra- it’s nice to make them a little more stylish from time to time.. just bc, we can!) I feel this added band is what fits a bit tight.. and on the loosest eyelet it still felt a tad too tight. (This may be due to the lower level of the strap? But, none the less it created/did feel a bit tight.)

To give an idea on sizing comparables: we received a 34B in black and my 22yr old daughter who’s a 34B (being generous!) and also, a college athlete with the body to back it up (0% body fat and let’s face it.. if your in that great of shape, being chest endowed is not something you usually get with that rockiń body!) She didn’t need the underwire support and yet, didnt mind- but, the extra strap below seemed to cause her angst and the tightness on the rib cage made her feel claustrophobic. I truly knew this may actually be tight- as she usually wears Nike sports bras that are very restrictive and confining.. and Yet, with those bras she has no complaint- So, I would say it runs a tad small/tight and suggest to order accordingly- Especially if a tight bra tends to drive you crazy!!

As for the padding- this is a little excessive or, maybe better described as “obvious!” If one doesn’t pack a lot of heat through the chest area then, wearing a bra that doubles ones cup size, seems a little much. Also, take note… The padding is NOT removable- this would have been much better if it was!
I see this being a great bra for those who are a full size B or, smaller C. This would be a good fit for a bit fuller cup but, not big/bigger- if that makes any sense?! I realize that is very limiting and unfortunate- But, on the heels of the #metoo movement.. we are shouting from the rooftops that we all should embrace our curves and I agree. However, The need to create a false/padded bust line could also go against being confident with what you were born with! If you want a bra to add the look of a bigger bust line- this will definitely do that.. yet, if it’s not what you’re looking for- keep in mind, that is what you’ll get!
Ladies be you and be true- and if, your best is to find something a bit more enhancing then.. this may be a good option- just keep in mind the feel can be a bit tight and may be best to size up! I can say, the material used is spot on soft.. So, it’s just pairing the right look/body type/style you’re after!

title: Way too much padding- not a good look!’
text:
Well, Taking a chance on this bra without much information, I was hopeful it would be a fit when received…having said that- The item itself is made quite well and appears to have all the expected attention to detail one would hope. The material, including the lace feels soft and the inner layer on the skin has a satin feel and is quite nice.

Be warned- the padding in this bra is a tier down style and so, the top has minimal padding- BUT, the bottom.. is almost ridiculous at how much or, thick The padding is!! I can tell the concept - and that is to create a “shelf like platform” to place what little/a lot god gave you.. giving you the push-up effect! This may work for some smaller breasted females- but, If you’re already packing a little bit of heat in the chest area… This makes your breast line look huge- and not necessarily in a very becoming way!! It creates the effect of being heavy set through the chest. Again, I only see this workable for a specific breast size shape- if you’re lucky enough to have a thin figure with a B size cup, this may work well. If not, you may want to give it some serious thought... I know, the #metoo movement is to embrace what curves you have.. and you should. I guess that’s my issue with this, it is creating a false shelf out of almost 1/4th+ inch of padding… Not very “me too“ if you ask me!!!

Sizing was bought in a 36C and my 19yr old fits this spot on- The band itself felt a little tight around the girth on the loosest eyelet offered..
I would describe this as running a tad small. The strap over shoulder is adjustable.. and we were able to get a comfortable fit with this aspect of the bra.
This bra is black with the padded inlay sewn in and that is in a satin nude/slightly bronze color. NO!! You cannot take out the padding in any way like some bras..the lacing up the front pulls the “girls” together and creates a “busting Out cleavage“ as you’d expect- (think wench costume!)
Overall, I would highly recommend that YOU fit the bill- for this type of bra.. or, that its the look you’re going for- if so, you may be happy with the purchase.. If not, this may be a disappointment and highly possible this may need returning!

title: Bigger pendant size then expected it to be
text:
These arrived as expected and on time. TBH, they look like the photo only… They are much bigger in size opinion than I thought. I was hoping for a smaller look- but, giving as a gift and hoping the recipient doesn’t mind the bigger pendant size!?
Very simple straightforward and nice product up bro

title: Great “rock solid“ pant...
text:
Surprised at how much i liked these pants...these are a quality pair of pants that Goodthreads has definitely put an active effort into the construction, detail and craftsmanship of their product- it’s refreshing to try an article of clothing you buy online and one that actually fits and is not miss marked. Goodthread tactical pants fit the bill..!!

These come across more like a “bluer” hue of denim jeans rather then, pure Navy - a shade of darker denim just made of a different type of material. The pants are a bit heavier possibly hot in summer (like wearing jeans) although, the color would look fab.!!?

The pockets are lamb-chop style- if you’re wondering if this is offputting to the normal five pocket style… No! Pockets are deep and hold front wallet or cell phone nicely. These are a tight fit tactical pant not to be confused with cargo style pants… Just keep that in mind. Even though it has large front pockets, they’re not baggie!!

The pants list elastine in the material and this was the only possibility of issue with this pair.. If you think you’ll get full/easy range of motion bc, of the stretch in material- the answer is, No! We wanted the skinny/straight fit for a work pant… But, a pair with a little bit of give and why we chose this blend. They aren’t tight- just a tad more restrictive then we expected.. waist has a good stretch to it and the added bonus of a draw string.. if a tad big in waist, one can tighten with/without a belt. The last pant we got with same material offered much more free movement then, this skinny style..(they were relaxed fit) and these fit skinnier- that’s for sure! If you’re not needing the ability to “wiggle” (climb up ladder for stock items.. cleaning/bending over/etc..) these are great. If, you need to do more active duties while at work- then, I’d suggest getting the relaxed fit- they’ll offer you a bit more range of motion yet, look just as nice/not sloppy.

We got these in size 34x32 for my teenage son- He is 16yr old, with an athletic build (but, not bulky in muscle) he’s 6’3”, 185lb and he wears pant lower on hips.. (you know, the stupid-cool thing to do?!!) Because he likes pants worn lower on his waist- The length seems to be fine. However, Ive refrained from drying just to avoid shrinking. Waist has approx. 1/4” excess give- and the waistband stretches out over a day’s worth of wearing.. drawstring can make this a non issue. Washing reshapes pants with such ease... (just a tip for Anyone to remember that doesn’t normally wear pants with a little elastine..)

These dressed up/down and with the varied colors offered theres is plenty of versatility. I love the Goodthreads brand for quality/attn. to detail- I do wish they were price just a tad bit less… Or, Even offered flash sales!

title: hard to find quarter zip... with a hood!!!!
text:
Love this!! I probably have purchased about a dozen in varied color/sizes...Of the regular hoodie! This is a unique twist on the regular hoodie- as it has a 1/4 zip pullover Style.. as well as, the hood!!! To say the least- it’s fantastic and in case you all didn’t know a hard combo to find… Hood with a quarter zip!!!
The material is lightweight and yet, not too thin it causes instant show of wear/tear. Keep in mind this is not the heavy weight high $$ champion hoodie we all know and love- I believe this is a nice happy medium!
Price point is $25-$30 and worth it… It runs a little big and has small amount of shrinkage, I personally line dry all my hoodies to avoid this issue. There is ample room to begin with so size accordingly. if wanting a tighter/sleek fit.. get exact size and if wanting comfy/roomie... maybe up just one size!!

For anyone interested in a classic hoodie with a unique twist i.e. quarter zip/hood… This is awesome. Definitely would buy again in the future. (Ordered this in small men’s for daughter who’s 5’7” and 128lb. Fit nicely with bit of room to spare.)

title: Greatest color and softest shirt.. EVER!!! Love it-
text:
In love with this shirt, the softness and most of all… The black currant color! It is so unique and sharp looking, it is such a fun addition to any man’s wardrobe.
