title: Bracelet is HuGe.. concept is nice!
text:
Not what I expected.. The issue I have with this item, the bracelet ring is huge!! I was under the impression this fit more in line with a bungee bracelet… And that is not the case!

Pros: this has the easiest access to releasing a key if, needed.. ie, if you lent your car to a friend – you don’t have to give them your entire life on a key ring! Or, a valet only needs your car key- and this simple release clip makes that so doable!!

I love the color and we received an aqua blue. The accent of gold is actually really fun… Being most keys are silver, it’s sort of set the hardware apart- just adding a fun pop of “flare” to the key ring itself. Along those same lines, the tassel adds the same affect… Without it, it’s just a large circle. (However, one can remove Tassel if desired..)

Cons: as mentioned the bracelet it’s self is way too big for even a man’s wrist- sure, you can place the circle bracelet on your arm… You just don’t have a security of it stay in there.
This would also be more of a benefit if it provided more than one easy release clip. It would be nice to have a car key on one release clip and house key on another. Making easy access for more than one standard key… Because, we all know life happens and we are all about ease and Convenience!! Not to mention, I don’t think there’s anything worse than getting keys on and off I split key ring! (Trust me… How many nails and/or, curse words have been said or broken?!… Am I right?!)

Overall:
I would probably rate this 3.5 stars but, that isn’t an option. If my expectations we’re different- Maybe I wouldn’t have been so disheartened?! However, I reread the description… And truly lead you to believe this is a nice solution to carry in/keeping track of keys. For that reason, size does matter!!

title: Inside text is perfect hidden empowerment message!
text:
Love these bracelets! I’ve ordered a few different bracelets from the company and in a few different styles… I love to wear them “stacked“ and they are such a fun way to send yourself a secret mantra or, Hidden inspirational message. Let’s face it… We all have those days and empowering do you know something no one else does. True, simple things like that have the ability to go along way!

This cuff bracelet has a hidden message written on the inside for only the one who wears it to see!! The silver is bright/brushed and the writing is imprinted as states on the inside of the bracelet. Perfect for inspiring those who may need a pick me up.. but, want to keep it to themselves. Great part of ordering a cuff style bracelet one can be assured sizing will fit as, it can bend/adjust if needed. Some of these Ldurian bracelets print the text message on the outside or in morse code.. or, like this it’s on the inside of the bracelet keeping the message completely hidden- some of the sayings use a few F-bombs, such as this one.. and that is the perfect way to wear these- hidden! (You wont offend others and/or, be inappropriate with children!) BUT, as the one wearing this.. you have the empowerment of the words to make you feel supported!! Try it, it’s a crazy fun thing..

Wearing one or, multiples of these looks great! Trust me- depending on the day… I go back-and-forth! These make fantastic gifts and are the greatest pick me up for anyone in need.. I have sent them to my girls in college and they’ve adored them just the same. I feel these are made for any age.. these arrive in a simple cardboard jewelry gift box- and if, you order a message in Morse code… It will have small notecard with the saying imprinted on it. Yesss!! We have looked up the Morse code alphabet online and these are accurate..

If interested in a fun addition to your own jewelry collection.. or, in need of a fun/perfect gift- you have found one in these bracelets! personally, I don’t get these wet- I take them off to swim/sleep/ shower/cook.. it will help keep them looking nice and new!

title: Bright, fun comfortable sock.. with arch support!!
text:
Loved these socks... SOO soft and vibrant! The colors seem brighter than the photo shows and I loved it. My husband wore these for a warmer, more supportive work sock…he wears a size 12m and said the fit is perfect!! Not too tight and yet, the elastic top stays up just right- His favorite feature is the arch support/compression and when you’re on your feet most of the day… It can make all the difference, especially in dress shoes!! Both, the toe and heal have nice reinforcement in the stitching as well.. the attention to detail seems to definitely be there- and all in a pair of socks!!?

So far, my husband has worn these with denims and also, his khaki’s.. These have the ability to match either color and dress up/down. He has this thing for liking to wear a pair of colorful/louder socks when he’s feeling blah... bc, why not?! Hence, liking the brighter hues..

These are definitely sized more for a mans foot or, if anything a larger Womens... but, other then the sizing- they could be unisex if one desired. Personally, I feel they have a masculine look about them (probably bc, of the brown?!) The quality of fabric is fantastic and the softness is felt from the moment you open the package.. SO dang soft. I’ve washed these already a few times… And have noticed zero fading or, pilling of the material!

These would definitely be a good investment and fun addition to add to your sock drawer- they are nice quality and should last for quite some time! I would definitely purchase in the future..

title: Blending sport comfort with work attire perfectly!!
text:
Happy as a clam.. as usual with the under armor brand and these do not disappoint. I needed socks to transition through Utah winters for my husband that could be utilized for work and actually keep his feet warm and comfortable. Love, love the colors used… As not everything in the world is gray, black, white!!
Colors are going to be fantastic with various khakis, tans, black and olive color work/dress clothes- yet, you will get the warmth and comfort of a quality sport sock... just what we wanted!
The reinforced toe and heel are fantastic the elastic at the top is snug but not tight and the art support is fabulous. For a husband who had a terrible accident a few years ago… Fractured skull, leg, broken back, broken ribs and wrist- he has struggled postop with circulation and overall comfort of a long workday. These little gems will help ease some of those issues by adding creature comfort and that is worth the purchase in gold!!

Best part of all these blend easily with work attire and do not appear to be sports related… Doesn’t get better than that!

title: Could be made for a princess.. their gorgeous!!
text:
Wow!! These are absolutely beautiful… The detail in the filigree is dainty yet, completely detailed. I cannot believe how perfect these small spaces are cut and edges are made to show the actual detail of the style.. the small stones are NoT gaudy and blend perfectly with the metal. I’ve sat and studied them, they seem like perfect pieces of “jewelry art!”

As for the length, they drop down from ear just over an inch.. I’m completely pleased with the ability to still see these with a hairstyle- That does cover the ears. Somehow these little gems make their way to be noticeable! Not bc, they are long.. as mentioned they’re just a classic subtle drop.

Best endorsement ever: I stopped the proverbial carpool line with a curb monitor who is loading kids in/out at school- for any of us carpool moms, you know.. this is NOT an easy thing to do! This is no nonsense loading/unloading/no talking zone.. but, She had to stop and tell me- she could see my earrings sparkling as I pulled along the loading curb! Dang.. who knew?!!
These are plated in a white gold letting them still have the sheen of silver but, should wear/last longer. The Only piece I’d like different, is the width of the hook to go into the ear.. it feels it’s a bit wide. These do not have backs and they just slip into earring hole With the hook style. Bc, these are such high quality and plated- it doesn’t feel easily pliable/bendable to “squeeze” this opening to less And no, I haven’t had a problem with them falling out. However, if I did I would be so sad… So, I think for safety reasons and peace of mind I will use a rubber back stop from a different pair of earrings and fix the issue myself. NO! I haven’t had a problem with them falling out as, they seem to be calibrated and weighted to stay in place. However, if I did have one fall out at this $, I would be so sad… So, I think for safety reasons and peace of mind- I will use a rubber backstop from a different pair of earrings and fix the issue myself. Just FYI if buying these..!!
Overall, these are beautiful- they remind me of something you’d see the princess easily wear (prob. On her dress down Barn days!!) But, for common folk- you could dress this up or down as they are just a classic, timeless and No matter one’s preference in style… These will make any recipient happy.

title: Exceeds expectations for bifold wallet in quality and capacity!
text:
Sleek looking wallet for men! I was trying to find.. a nice multi purpose wallet for my husband who must carry several cards both, personal and work related... The issue is- he must have all cards with him at all times!
Problem is- my husband doesn’t like a large bulky wallet in the pocket- yet, he wants all the nuances that a bulky wallet allows... Ha!! Such a man mentality.. this particular wallet does solve the issue in both departments.
The card holding capacity is 9 total.. plus, x1 front plastic viewing slot for ones ID. This wallet is a bifold with an extra flap sewn in... (no, the flap is not removable.. in case you wanted less card slots!) there is also, what I’d refer to as a hidden slot behind the ID... and the top does have 2 roomie slots for bills and/or, receipts.
Wallet arrives nicely wrapped and protected from scratching ability in a protective foam layer and is tucked perfectly into the exact size jewelry box- it makes this 100% “giftable” right out of the amazon box! The leather is soft and of excellent quality yet, it has the sturdy ability to hold things safe and secure. All angles are finely finished and pockets are perfectly sized to fit cards with ease and let them stay out as well..
Only thing That may pose a problem… If usually a trifold wallet user, the width may be a little bigger then, your liking. Especially if carrying Wallet in a front pocket. Otherwise, this fits nicely inside any standard back pant pocket! (The varied size for anyone making the switch between the bi/tri-fold wallets. is approx. 1/4+ inch wider.)
We chose this wallet in black- color and texture are both, of great quality and this exceeds expectation of daily wallet for the $ point.. has everything a trifold can offer, without the extra bulk! If interested, I would recommend trying without hesitation.

title: Can be dressed up/down with ease!
text:
Did not receive the actual product I requested... I ordered the silver cuff bracelet- yet, I received the morse code “Loved” bracelet on a string!!
No, this is not what I was expecting/wanting but, the error was made and what arrived was a different style of the same idea! This was reason for giving a lower review-
I have ordered the string style bracelet in the past and they are fantastic… They are such great gifts and even a great way to wear a personal mantra- I love that you have a “secret” and unique way to send a sweet message to self/others.. I personally love the look of stacking a few of these bracelets and wearing them at the same time-
The black embroidery floss matches everything and helps the shiny gold beads to stand out with a pop! Although these could get wet and come out unscathed… I DO recommend taking them off before shower and/or, swimming- this will help with the longevity and the overall newness of the entire bracelet.
As mentioned, these are built on embroidery string…But, in no way does this appear cheap or, sloppy. They have been made with all the attention to detail and have no loose ends- a knot nicely finishes the edges.
These are easy to put in/off and can be done so, by one person no problem... which is very convenient. These are a fun addition to any jewelry grouping and can be dressed up/down with ease.

title: Not what I was expecting.. and small!
text:
Ohh, how I wanted to love this sweater and anticipated it’s a arrival- only to be disappointed. The description was a bit vague and I was expecting a nice fitting “sweater..” Only, The material, cut, style.. were more seer sucking and off in all the wrong places!!
This reminded me of a sweater from Forever 21- it is definitely made for the Jr. young ladies vibe.. I didn’t feel it had any style, class, or adult look one would expect from the description/photo. So, I think maybe I definitely missed the mark with this... IF, you are larger in the chest and soft at all thru the middle- this is NOT flattering! Being in the 40 something yr. old bracket.. life happens (or, I should say- kids happen to you!!) and you want something cut to help you look good with your battle scars of life.. and this just didn’t do any of that or, flatter in ANY way!
The actual quality of the construction is fine… There are no loose threads or, pulled lines in the construction- it looks nice and yet, I can’t get over the fact that..even the very feel of this just screams teeny-bop high school store.. how is that possible?!

As I already spoke of the fit feeling off- I do feel the overall sweater runs small. With the sleeves at a 3/4 length and the tighter fitting ribbed material (especially on top- through the chest area..) it naturally feels like it small and from instant i put this on- i found I’m pulling at it from every angle trying to make it fit better- When, a lot of sweaters in size L are ample big on my frame.. I’m 5’1” 138lb.

If ordering keep in mind.. this isn’t a classic style fit in any way and has a teen vibe to it for sure.

title: Throwback with such ease...
text:
Wowza..!! Talk about a throw back to old school days and why not!?? Who can’t use more sexy and sleek?!! I know- some may cringe using “sexy = suspenders” in an image- BUT, imagine with me a moment.. Richard Gere in a fine pressed white shirt and suspenders, acting out some “Lawyer” scene... Maybe now, you can see the timeless sex appeal?!

As for the suspenders and function themselves- well: First of all- these had NO tags or, printed info. but, from seeing in person and $ point- looks like faux leather, nylon/elastic and plastic/metal hardware. Straps measure 1.5” wide- and feel a perfect width on the shoulder I’m told! **Hack: if rubbing/cutting into skin on shoulder.. that should tell you- length is too short..let a bit of slack out!!! (advise from g’pa who's 89yr + faithful suspender wearer!! shoulder strap should snap back when pulled out.. like a tight firm rubber-band, not letting it be too tight/loose!! ) ps. He’s in awe that his “hack” was just shared with the worldwide web.. So fun to include his rule of thumb!
These have a few key mechanical parts- adjusting straps, anchor bands, and snap-clips. (FYI- loop connecting anchored arch are not adjustable and are permanently fastened with metal rivet.) all other attachments are moving, adjustable and easy to use!! There is a “bar flap” along the actual elastic suspender that goes over the shoulder.. with a quick “pop up” of the flap- one can lengthen or, shorten straps-pressing flap down to hold desired length chosen securely in place.
As for the actual clip that grabs hold of pant keeping them in place.. and your pant up! this pair has 6 vs. 4 “grabs” for added security of doing the job! clips have plastic disks inside of the clip, and sort of a metal hood that covers the fronts of the clips. With those teeth, the clips grip on your pants, BUT.. because the teeth are plastic, it is less likely to damage pants- that is a nice touch as diff. Materials may be more delicate to ripping or puncturing a hole!
The logo is embossed into faux leather on the back side where the straps come into one and form a Y in back.
Overall, look is nice- depending on color combo.. you can pull off timeless, trendy or, edgy look. Best part of all is the ease and adjustability of these suspenders.. and the peace of mind, they give a firm grip X6 over!!
My son plans to wear these to his Jr. prom this winter.. and I’m thinking it will be a fab. look for sure!!

title: Size chart provided ruined the purchase.. fix it..!!!
text:
I have been looking for this exact type of jacket for better part of the year and wanted to love it so much!! Following the size chart provided ordered a large that I am 5‘2“ 140 LB and is 38C. Hesitating a large would be too big… I aired on safe and I am so disappointed!! Measurement given lead me to believe.. I would have 1.5 inches excess but, I felt over a sweatshirt etc.. it would be best! Well, how can a product be SO off on sizing??! This won’t even come close to zipping up the front- it misses the mark by 2+”... like I said, SOOO SAD!!

Minus sizing issues- this would be a fantastic warm and functional jacket. The sleeves fit perfectly and Velcro at the bottom allows one to adjust. The length is perfect and hits exactly at the waist… Not too short/long. I love the material- and that is what I’ve been searching for exactly!! The inside feels lined with soft sweatshirt/flannel material. It is beyond soft and divine… Letting you know the interior will be warm. The outside is not slippery rain jacket material. The unique woven material yes made of substance and feels constructed perfectly to keep out the elements. FYI- Photo shows hot pink zippers…yes! It added fun flare yet, I received all black on black. Funny though, it is what I’d prefer to begin with! The outer material does not have a lot of give- if any at all. This would be a sleek and stylish and flattering fit- if it only fit..!!!

The jacket is made of quality material and you can See the attention to detail. I feel this will more then suffice in warmth and do its job well. This is more then a windbreaker and along the lines of winter wear- maybe not in sub zero temps! But, it will keep you warm in plenty of cold weather situations!
I urge the seller to fix sizing chart- it’s a must! If you’d like to receive 5 star reviews.. you could totally get with confidence based on the product. But, without workable sizing chart- buyers will be dissatisfied with the buy/exchange/return because of it.

title: Dressy/respectable pant..as comfy as “play clothes!”
text:
These are a WoW! Great and awesome find in a pant!! Who knew? It appears to have a tad more dressy/respectable look.. yet, comfort, function, mobility of “play clothes!” Sorry, I can only think of “Pitch perfect” movie line.. “the look is- reserved in the front and a party in the back!!”
Sorry... back to serious mode- - -

What can I say- these look nice and work worthy... 100%. But, they are as comfortable of a pant you’ll ever find! I’m certain this is attributed to the trio of cotton, polyester, elastin fabric combo… the trick is doing this mix in the perfect amount of each-

We received Black, 33X 32 and got these for a 25yr old, 5’11” 190lb. We have found a 33 is not always the easiest size to track down… So, a bonus they scale pant sizes in 1” increments vs. 2”.. The fit is FaBuLoUs!! After trying for a few days I'm told- Pants are true to size and my son who is a true 33” waist- said best part about this fit, is it’s a very clean look and without excess stress on the fabric, they keep shape very well.. (some clothing with stretch gets too loose- far too fast!) Then, on days you’re feeling a bit bigger in the gut or, tucking things into an already fit waist-the give is fantastic! He loves to wear these to work 8-5pm and then, without having to change.. stop by the skate park and do a little mental therapy… Said these pants go right along with him and provide plenty of stretch/movement. Of course, he said after this type of stressing on the fabric- a quick toss into the wash brings shape/tightness back to where pants began. Ha..!! Where else could you find dual acting clothes for such two extremes!!?
Once pants become available.. hands-down we’ll add more to the wardrobe in a few colors. Why would you- Unless, price is absurd… These are a perfect staple and made with quality material and the all attention to detail.

title: Most incredible fitting hoodie.. EVER!!
text:
Not what I expected and wow!! Best word to describe this hoodie… Is wow! I ordered size large in black for a teen who is 6‘3“ and 180 LB. I was worried about the fit and had no need to be. This item has ample stretch… As much stretch as spandex yet, material feels nothing like it. I’ve never seen a hoodie made this way and hands-down… It is such an incredible feature. Don’t get me wrong and think spandex mentality = tight fit! As this is opposite! The hoodie has plenty of width through the shoulder and body and length hits about the waist. (If you notice my sons size.. he is NOT small build.. i’ll be at he is a teen, not fully grown into mans body- but, rather a very athletic build.) my son refuses to wear things that feel constricting and with this, that’s obsolete!

The color is pure black… Which, buying black could be numerous shades as we all know. The quality and attention to detail is there 100%, no loose thread or lack of craftsmanship. String on hoodie has ample length and is made secure (although, I added extra knot to end to keep it that way!)
Hack: amazon sells plastic clip to place on hoodie strings.. keep them from coming loose in wash. Cost is nothing for 25.. OR, tie in slip knot helps..
But, you can use a little girls clippie to do this trick as well.. if it helps and you’ve been a victim of the dreaded hoodie/pant string coming out in the wash! 2nd Hack: if this does happen.. one can tape string end tightly to a disposable chopstick… Break chopstick in half and thread like a wooden needle through string opening. It’s so much easier to slide along and then when reaching the other side- remove tape and boom! Back in business..

The hoodie is everything one would want and more- with the quality materials and attention to detail.. I feel it’s a staple that will last for quite a long time.. making it a worthwhile investment! I do suggest- not drying if you’re liking the fit you get when it arrives.. we did- and didn’t want anything to change.. so, my washing on cold and air drying didn’t change a thing!

title: Not the best detail...
text:
This was ordered as a gift for my daughter who left in August to California for her freshman year of college! In the photo it looked perfect And I was excited to mark her “out of state“ move with an offical California!
However, this actual charm is a lot smaller then, I’d ever expected. It measures just over an inch long and guesstimate about 1/4” wide. I would be all right with the size if, the edges and detailing were actually crisp and precise. The way this is cut, it’s hard to tell what it is.. unless really looking at it and you know what it’s supposed to be!! The heart stamped clean through is adequate enough and you can tell it’s a heart. But, due to the size of the actual state- this just doesn’t seem to appear as clean and nice a the item photographed. It may look different bc, it’s displayed on a solid black background.. helping the item to stand out and appear better then it does in reality.
The edges of the cut out also leave an unfinished and almost rough feel to this.. As this charm is attached to the split circle key ring- the ring itself feels much too big and takes away from the smaller size charm and it’s dangled on 4 links of a chain. I realize some may find this nice being small in size and honest, I wouldn’t mind if the detailing was much better. if better detail in the cut- I could see this being a more adequate zipper pull vs. a key chain.

This I believe is made of polished stainless steel as it should be for the durability and strength factor-
(nothing with the product stated this for certain.) If used on the key ring I see this just becoming lost in the keys attached to the item itself. At first glance, it could pass as a key itself!
Overall, it is not what I was expecting... if I’m getting this- its most likely going to be for a gift and I’d like something to have an better and overall appearance.

title: Perfect way for daddy’s girl to show her love..
text:
Hands-down… This was made to make any dad weak in the knees and cry some emotional tears!! My daughter who is also the sidekick/BFF/baby girl to her daddy, left for college this past August and she even went out of state!

So, what a perfect find in these memorable words- for her to give him as a sweet reminder of how much she loves, adores and misses him!

I’m telling you- when I saw this I knew she’d touch his heart and trust me, when hooked to his car keys everyday, It will be a treasured reminder of how much she loves him! (Come on.. I live with the guy- it’s a bit obvious Ive seen a titch of his happy shelved away till she comes back for Xmas break..)

This is a shiny high polished silver- I’m guessing stainless- as it isn’t marked but, imagine for longevity and engraving purposes. The letters are actually done in black making this much easier to read- (which is appreciated to any who have harder time reading smaller text these days!)

As for the actual style and shape- think military dog tag. and I’m guessing pretty darn close in size as well. It’s nice because, it doesn’t have a long dangle change- just one link and it’s a thick “jump ring” attached to a split circle key ring. Of course, it could be attached to anything really.. gym bag or, the likes- But, Im certain it’s most common use is on a key ring. Bonus: this comes in the cutest little wooden box- And just like a 2 part cardboard jewelry box, this replicated the same style. Only it’s made out of a very light weight wood. On the inside lid of this sweet box- you’ll find the words: -just for you- imprinted Into it.. to me, the box is the icing on the cake and takes this gift to another level! This item ready for gift giving from the moment it arrives.. Bonus, this box could be kept on a dresser or night stand, like a trinket box. Letting you keep the engraved piece inside to insure/preserve.. as some may choose they don’t want to cause wear/tear to item?

Over all: this is fantastic- great message and easy to read. This presents itself as a very nice, sentimental and quality gift.. and if you have someone you’re thinking of getting this fo- do! I’m sure you’ll be as please as I was...

title: Great for so many occasions- perfect!
text:
Love these and I’ve posted for these bracelets on more then one occasion- this was given to my freshman in college who is so unsure on her feet! When we saw her at parents weekend – and BTW, she is in college out of state… I gave this to her as a reminder, she is a fighter, capable of chasing her dream.. bc, she is a “warrior!”

She’s just in the beginning of meeting/living with new friends/roommates and adjusting to college courses… She has sent me a half dozen photos of just her wrist, showing me she has her “warrior” armor on- everyday! No, she doesn’t want the world to know.. she is afraid on her feet and she also wants to feel the invisible support from her mama a few states away- well, this is a perfect way to do just that! Her and I found a secret message because, this is written in Morse code. Perfect!

These are simple and easy to use with a single hand application slipknot and she told me, the only time she takes it off is to shower. I highly recommend due to the beads being gold plated versus 14 karat… But, regardless of the wear of the bracelet – I am getting so much more from this than just a little bling!

These are so great for so many Occasions.. with the choices, I am 100% certain you will find one to fit your need. Overall, you cannot go wrong with such a clever and on point bracelet. I’m certain I will be getting more in the future..

title: Not your average wool sock- but, warmth of wool!!
text:
Love these socks and can’t believe the warm they give off... and all without the itchiness of wool!

I gave these to my son for a recent trip we took to Seattle in the fall. Of course, we visited during a unseasonably cold/wet weekend… And refused to that cold weather detour or fun! We received a three pack in charcoal gray men’s size med. and due to the fact- these worked so great for my 25yr old son when we headed outdoors on a 3mile hike into the outskirts of the Tacoma Mtns.. he wore and never once complained of his feet getting cold, even with the ground/shoes etc. being wet.. where I was the opposite- the coldest part of my body once returning, we’re my poor feet!

After griping about the cold- he lent me x1 of the 3 pair of his new socks.. and from the moment I put these on in the hotel room- I was sold!! (I wear women's sz. 8- and these fit quite well.. I had a minimal bit of extra room at the toe. so, keep in mind- ladies you can make these work if you do the sz. adjusting!)

What I noticed right off… These were not too tight to get on and yet, they seem to hug your feet with a perfect amount of compression and counter pressure. Arch support is great and there seems to be a unique stitching at the heel, giving support I haven’t had in a sock before! Crazy… But, it’s true!! Who knew that an appropriate sock could make all the difference – obviously, I didn’t! I just don’t pay enough attention to the importance of socks and their ergonomic ability! (I’m sure avid runners/hiker are more acutely aware of these benefits…So, pay attn. as this is a fabulous feature to look for when looking into new socks.) I will say, these socks also stayed in place at the top of the ankle- no slipping down into the boot! these are what I’d call a 3/4 cut and don’t cut off circulation or indent above ankle after hours of wearing.
Being made with wool I had a bit of concern they might itch- not only did they not itch, they’re actually very soft.. VeRy soft indeed!! And total bonus- I did not have any of the “yucky weird wet wool” smell- And yes! In Tacoma/Seattle things get wet..and no, odd wool odor. Super bonus: A+ for the warmth of wool, without wool characteristics.. itch/smell- yay!!
This claims to be moisture wicking only, I am not certain in our situation I could confirm- we had overall lightly damp clothes head to toe from the sprinkle of Tacoma rain- and as for blister blocking- I feel most blisters come from the wearing of the wrong shoe/sock together- but, keep in mind I am a Lament at these things.. but, neither myself or my son had blisters at the end of two days of hiking!!
Color is great that you could easily dress this up or down and pull off with winter office wear no problem.
I would definitely recommend and personally, be keeping an eye out for the same socks in women’s

title: Perfect message between 2 people..
text:
What a perfect little bracelet and a unique, special, private way to share a message- I gave this to my daughter who just played her final game of college soccer on senior day. It was the end of an era she started chasing when she was four years old… And as a natural athlete, she’s feeling a little lost. What fills that void will be her venturing into a new and foreign place.. and brace for it, “a new beginning.”
When I saw this i felt …It couldn’t be more perfect!!

It is a very simple, easy one hand application to put on and tighten. It is not gaudy or blinged out which is quite nice, as her personality is not fuffie-girlie. But, more subtle, delicate, and minimal feminine. The black string is perfect to keep simplicity and the tiny size of the beads is perfect-

For someone who is truly at a cross roads of “new beginnings“ this will be a perfect reminder between her and I. That makes me love this even more.. If, you know someone who needs a tiny reminder of encouragement or, just a little personal inspiration- there are so many themes to choose from and creating this message in Morse code, keeps it “secret” and there’s something empowering about that!

I suggest not to wear while showering or swimming. The small beads are gold plated vs. 14k and as much as like to say they won’t tarnish, I believe it just might do that! Also, the string is a very nice embroidery thread and, will stay that way longer when it hasn’t been worn day in/out in showers/swim etc.

This comes boxed and ready to gift- I did change the silver cardboard glitter box I received it in, as I don’t care for it at all. I do feel at price point.. the
Presentation it’s received in- could be a lot better.

Overall, these are sweet and perfect gifts for self or, others. I personally have a few and wear them “stacked” at the same time.. creating my own mantra as I too, have days I need little incentives to remind me of positives.. Especially in today’s world!

title: Perfect pair of simple earrings- love them!!
text:
Wow! What a fun pair of earrings and the easiest pair to use and operate.. and yes!! They stay in- which was my biggest concern. Being a 40+Yr.old who has a-line cut hairstyle- I was searching for something that could be dressed up/down and could be used with such versatile ease… Something you could see with hairstyle and yet, not come across as teeny bopper or, vegas gaudy!!

These earrings are such a simple stream line and nice Sterling silver. They are so easy to use and weighted perfectly to stay put One in your ear. Yet, they are so light.. I find myself checking to make sure they’re still there. For reference, there is less than an inch that hangs below the lobe. Earring hack: on daylight savings I had to reset my watch and needed something to put the tiny pin on the side in… Boom! I pulled out an earring push in the button and put it back in successful on all fronts- multi functional!!

title: Best waterproof winter jacket - I’ve seen in years!!!
text:
I am so impressed there are no words!! I needed WARM rain jacket for a fall trip to Seattle and hoped this would keep me both, dry and warm. Seems you can find one or the other in this style anorak and I hit the mother load!!

Details: ordered a large in yellow and as 40+yr old who’s 5’2” 138lb. With large chest size.. this fit perfect with about an inch of room to spare! No, it was not too long (at my height, I was worried!) I could zip it up over a hoodie and not feel constricted, especially in chest/arm area.. A major plus in my book! The sleeves are plenty long and have Velcro to adjust perfectly to your fit.

Every pocket it’s perfect… The large front Velcro pockets fit electronics iPhone 8+ and made it so easy to get in an out yet, kept all content dry from the rain. There are bonus slat pockets to side of Velcro pocket.. easy to slide hands into without any Velcro to open up or, mess with… Kept my hands there, throughout 2 soccer games in outdoor stadium in the rain!!

Honest- I hate the cold!! Wearing this, I felt so warm and comfortable while others around me were wet and cold!! I felt bad for others trying to wear the pullover rain poncho on top of jackets.. you know, the garbage bag look- And let me tell you, being it was our daughter senior weekend with 100’s of photos being taken- I looked SO on point!! Not that it fashion show but, these photos will last a lifetime for our daughter… And it’s good to know her mama did not look like a trash bag!

The zipper up the front is solid and has added Velcro over zipper to keep everything covered from elements. This zipper does not catch the material in anyway and is made almost like “industrial“ zipper in strength. Feels like no expense was spared in details of this jacket and it’s construction.. With winter layers as well as, the top shell of waterproof material- you need a zipper like it has to contain and function with ease. Plus, I love the fact the zippers bright yellow! After describing many layers of this jacket… You may be wondering if one feels like an “Oompa Loompa” while wearing? NO..!!! This also has drawstring at the waist and you can cinch it in/out and I did so to define the little person inside a big jacket by tying a loop knot where I wanted waist to stay (The ONLY thing missing on this, would be the mechanism to hold waist string in place… But, a loop knot seemed to worked fine.)

Yes!! The hood is removable and done with a very nice, easy to use zipper- I did remove and use a different beanie and with the flip up collar, it did not take away from the overall look of the jacket.

List price for jacket is $65 and worth every penny and then some!! I truly could not believe how much quality this jacket had in materials/construction/ attention to detail/overall performance/style and function… if you’re thinking of purchasing, you will not be disappointed.

100% - I‘ll keep this jacket for years to come as I can say with confidence.. it is built to last and so user friendly! This is not an endorsement I give freely very often. I’m lovely the fact- if you need to bundle up in yucky weather.. you can do it with a splash of fun color and look good well staying warm. The yellow/navy gives a classic nautical or, university type vibe. I could see this being a hit for both, younger and mature women alike!

title: Good Mix between pants and jogger!
text:
Much bigger than anticipated! My teenage son 16yr. 6‘3“ 185 lb. Was hoping these would be a good fit. love the pockets they’re slant cut and useful enough to hold actual items.

title: If only sizing was accurate...
text:
Perfect idea for a sport short... BUT, problem is- they’re just too small! I realize these are made to fit snug- and let me tell you.. I was totally anticipating getting these and putting them to good use.. so, I must tell you- it’s disappointing! These are listed as Large/14... bummer is, they fit my daughter who usually wears a size 7/8. So, if this gives you some perspective to the off-sizing issue..

For sure, I wouldn’t get these again unless, this product goes the distance To include in description a list of a usable size chart: which includes actual inches/cm comparable measurements. Those are key pieces of information, especially when you need to order things to fit as precisely as these shorts!!! It would save all the guess work- and hassle with returns. Because, as I found out today.. one mans L/14 is another mans size-8.. Ouch!!

Enough about the sizing issue- let’s move past that an onto the actual shorts.. Wow!! They’re pretty slick- what can I say... these are such a great pair of “useable” bike shorts for women, starting from the thick waistband- I love how the extra support is there thru the tummy area... and let’s just say post baby having era- that can never be a bad thing!? The stitching/cut/seams/lines have all been handled with Quality and reinforced detail.. the crotch is actually sewn with the box detail which makes the fit nice and actually pleasant to sit in and comfortable to wear. But, best part of all- are the side pockets!!! This is what makes these so user friendly. If you can transition from workout to carpool world by just pulling on a hoodie and keep the bottoms you got on to work for you- pockets and all! It just makes things really nice and the best part of these pockets- they can hold a cell phone, keys, debit card... pretty much anything you may need- and it does so, ALL without pulling or, sliding the shorts down by the weight!

So, if you can get the accurate size needed- I’m sure you’ll be pleasantly surprised and pleased with the shorts.. If the fit it correct, I 100% feel confident that you’ll be happy with the purchase!

title: Classic and a must have for men’s wardrobe!!
text:
AmAzInG!! What a good-looking and classy men’s V-neck sweater. This is such a great find and will be a total asset to any mans wardrobe for so many reasons.. This style and fit is rocksolid. The sweater can hold its own with a pair of khakis and be worn to work, looking every bit the part business for sure. This can also transition to be worn with a pair of jeans And you are going to look amazing without needing/trying hard!! Trust me we know this is a plus when it comes to the guys getting ready.. I know in my house, we like to look good without all the extra effort!
We ordered an extra large in the classic navy and the Navy IS a true navy blue. My husband is 6‘3“ and 205lb. This particular sweater is not big and bulky and yet, not seer sucking/younger mod looking either! it has a great balance of finding and defining shape with the same ability to be forgiving- i’m not sure for certain but, this sweater may hold magical powers?!! TBH, I’m a little jealous I cannot find this same magical sweater for myself in the female version!
The quality of the material is spot on- trust me, I’ve looked it over top/bottom and the stitching, cut, craftsmanship is all there- better yet, with this being of such quality construction, I am certain it will be a staple in his closet for years to come. It’s sad to say- but, when buying a classic addition to the wardrobe a lot of items these days lack that longevity quality. this material is such a nice/soft top quality feel- I think it will get use in both spring/fall on its own...And winter it will be added into the layered look for warmth.
The one concern I had was the “V neck” as my husband usually does not prefer.. and I can say, this is just a small nitch into the neck line- maybe just enough to show a contrasting Colored t-shirt worn underneath- personally, my husband paired it with solid white.. to give him the classic navy/white combo and it looked fab.! Yet ,I’m sure it would look good with just about any color. Better yet, he actually spoke the words “he not only didn’t mind the V neck.. he admitted he sort of liked it!” Ha! wife-1 hubby-0 I love it!!
As far as washing the sweater it can be done in the machine (instruction tag sewn inside!) I personally washed on delicate/handwash in cool and then, I FLAT dried.. with this wet and placed on a hanger, I could see the possibility of it stretching the length. After washing as stated, I didn’t have any issue with shrinkage and so, for preservation I’ll prob. just continue to wash the same way!

If you’re looking for a sleek, classic sweater that does nothing but, flatter- this is just that! definitely one can add this to their wardrobe with confidence knowing- they’ll be getting a solid staple that looks to last for years to come.

title: Sizing is not forgiving.. at all!!
text:
I’m so sad!! The look on the model is a nice size sweatshirt that doesn’t look huge… But, would fit with a little extra room. That is not the case!
Worse yet, the material has zero stretch like one would expect with a sweatshirt – and I mean zero!! However, it’s advertised as adult women’s sizing. So, keep in mind if wanting this sweatshirt that you will need to be certain you are very thin and straight through the middle or else, you need to size up.
I was not a fan of the Material itself. It feels smooth and has that sheen to it… My feeling with this, it appears a bit cheap. I love the ribbing on the cuff, neck as waist- and that is the overall feel I thought the entire sweatshirt would have... NoPe!
I ordered this in the dusty blue and it is a beautiful color. It is refreshing to add a subtle color that still matches with all the staples- denim, Black, white, khaki, gray.. The color is very true to what you see online.
I would not prefer to order this again due to the material and sizing. For both of those reasons I took a star away for each- I’m now back to looking for a solid Sweatshirt that can be worn with ease and convenience and be comfortable through the cold or, transition weather.. and even could be used if needed, for a work out cover up. Sad to say this one just wasn’t it.

title: Quality T-shirt that teenage boys love!

title: Solid thong panty the college girls LOVE...
text:
My college girls love these! They have been favorites to them since Catholic school uniforms khaki pants always show panty lines… I know a “thong in Catholic school” seem to be blasphemous… But, these Calvin Klein panties helped keep the girls feeling comfortable in their day-to-day uniforms. No one likes ugly panty lines, no matter where you go to school!!
Best part of all – is the thick waist band. I have a daughter with the most athletic build and not an ounce of fat on her body… And she likes the feel of the thick waist band. I have another daughter who’s also got an athletic build but, actually has developed her amazing female curves… she loves the thick waist to give a little more support around all of her bends bends!!
These are trendy and spot on with fun colors, They have soft colors to blend and hide under every color… The monochrome staples of white, black, gray… Made to go with everything and all the fun color/prints to wear. We always wash our panties in delicate/hand wash setting… And I personally NeVeR dry. Old as time hack: if you want to prolong the life of bras, panties, swimsuit etc. NEVER put these items in the dryer- the heat will take major life off of the spandex and elastic as plastic/elastic + high heat = a big no no!!
My girls are not as disciplined with this wash method as I am, and they toss all their panties into zipped lingerie bag (found on amazon for $2-4) and then, toss the whole bag into the dryer on LOW heat. This too will also help items hold their shape and keep a lone pair from that wild stretch or tangle that can happen in the machine- So, i definitely recommend!
NO.. they’re not cheap to buy- and I’ll be honest, I only buy sale price! i’m always keeping an eye out for sales to pick up extra pair. If I can add a few pair every 3-4 months.. it seems the entire “fleet” of panties lasts a lot longer- we have some pairs staying new like over a year+ before needing to discard- YESS!! You are buying the brand name when you’re paying the high price… But, you do get a decent product. And if you can find these on sale ($6-8 a pair) then, I’d say, it’s more then worth your $... paying full price? That is a tougher justification!

title: Solid and college girls love them!

title: Perfect high school dance jacket!!!!
text:

title: Flashback to the 80’s in a good way!!
text:
Being a teen in the 80’s I love the Fanny Pack! This is a fad that has a purpose to come back around… And one I think that will be embraced by the next generation due to its ease/convenience. A lot better than high waisted jeans, that is for certain…!!
Fannypack makes a great alternative for towing gear you need around with you, without angst or inconvenience of carrying a backpack/purse. These are so helpful when jogging, hiking, visiting amusement park, concert/sports venue, etc.. it lets you have vital items at your fingertips without loading up your pockets! (Although a fanny pack is unisex – unlike a purse! This is made with feminine details in mind..)
I love the zipper top opening “fliptop lid” it lets you see and get two items very easy. Using mine I had: cell phone 8+, wallet, Chapstick, keys, sunglasses, small tube of sunscreen inside and felt there was ample room. The interior has a small zipper pocket as well… Which one can place “girl products” discretely or, a credit card or cash w/o worry it could fall out. However, the size of this pack feels proportionally small when wearing.

The belt has an adjustable strap to get a custom fit and belt can be completely removed but, I’m not certain the benefit of this feature? There are 2 clips at both ends of belt that easily connect to the ring on the actual pouch. The issue I had was when I put items into pack.. the weight kept pulling this forward and not staying in place and where I wanted it to be. This was reason for deducting a star.
We received the gray color- and in photo it’s more “black” but, you do definitely get a gray hue for sure- and the zippers were more silver in color then photo showing gold- and this is actually preferred better!! The overall size, construction and material used in making this... is spot on. Just know, with the ring attachment/connection, this will move and adjust as IT wants too- as you put items/weight into the pack.. it may not be issue for some, It just became annoying after a bit!
Even with its Idiosyncrasies I’m certain we will get plenty of use out of the Fannypack!

title: Duster sweater  with potential ..
text:
This is a great throw over the top of any outfit sweater.. if you put this on top of your jeans and T-shirt it takes entire outfit to a whole new level! I even put it on over athletic pants, T-shirt and tennis shoes… It just replaces old zip up hoodie with such ease - it’s hard to NOT look like you’re trying to dress things up!
This material was different than expected. It is ribbed with spandex stretch.. and not the normal thin cotton as expected- it was nicer and more substantial as far as warmth! The ribbed look- even brings up the fancy a wee bit- i got the almond/tan color and it’s great- matches everything, including denim, blacks, khakis… and this is a perfect weight for transition seasons or, throwing on when it cools in the evening or, when a/c is too cold!!

The fit may be a tad tighter then looser due to the Stretch so, I got a 2xl, because of it.. these always seem to run tight thru the chest. I was worried it may be to tight – and surprising it wasn’t. To give comparison.. I usually wear L/XL and sure, I could have fit into XL- But, I think I’m more comfortable with it a little looser, at least when washing-i’lI have a little room for forgiveness! My favorite feature with the sweater, is the buttons running all the way up/down the front- (I’ve seen this with the buttons halfway down.. But, these run the entire length- and look great.) I also LOVE the big pockets, they're adequate in size and perfectly placed.. sort of perfect “catch all” pockets!!

What I didn’t like with the sweater is the length- it’s too long!! I’m only 5’2” and sure.. I expected this to be worn like a “duster”, but- I feel I’m going to need to hem it about 3-4” to make it look proportional. The other thing I am not a fan of is the “duck tail”/extra length in the back.. it only adds to the length problem- and I think it looks way out of place this style. Again, if I hem this.. I’d will definitely have this cut straight across.

Lastly, after wearing twice, I feel like this IS missing the tie around the waist… If this had one-it would definitely increase the look/use all the way around!! Yes, I love that it has buttons but, if you want to wear it open it’s nice to have a tie at the waist as needed-
The material seems to be a nice quality and not too thin. Note it does have a slight sheen to it? Stitching, attachment of buttons, lines all seem clean and straight with a good attention to detail.

title: Quality athletic sock for price point!
text:
These are some pretty great athletic socks!! My 25yr son works for outdoor world wide trekking company- and considers himself an expert of needed equipment for outdoor activity in both, comfort and necessity! I had him try these on an easy day hike that was approx.7miles round-trip… Of course, Color shouldn’t matter with an athletic sock- bc, it’s not a fashion show, ha!! But we received charcoal gray/black color option… And a little tidbit of advice, color matters!! Always get heavy duty athletic socks in dark colors- they will not show every ounce of outdoor grime. *A hack we learned and live by… Even when clean, a lot of dirt can leave a stain, especially with sweat + for events with limited washing, such as using in the outdoors (It tends to let dirt set for life.. Ha! dark colors.. you will never know!)
These athletic socks seem to run true to size- they have med. stretch to help you comfortably get sock onto your foot (even after washing..) and yet, they have enough shape and Elasticity to stay put and not slip around. Best part of these socks is the amount of compression and support sewn in- and seems to be done in all the right places... never did they feel like cutting off circulation- and the tie seems really enforced without a lot of bulk. For those OCD- that may matter! The added padding at the heal tab is just that- extra cushion for wear a tennis/hiking shoe like to rub.. and as far as anti odor material- I can’t say I did/didn’t notice a difference. But, I’m told when removing they didn’t seem “Excessively wet“ so, that’s a plus for moisture wicking!
Overall, I’m told this is a really great price for a really good pair of athletic socks. The material and attention to detail gives confidence that the socks will have longevity- and you can’t beat that!!

title: Be sure of waistband style before buying!!
text:
Welcome to the softest pants you’ve ever felt! I love the look and feel of velour, who doesn’t.. and these are made with quality material and sewn well. All seams and stitching look to be completely on point… no loose threads or stitching.. and what a great look, I love a velour pants in an athletic style fit! It’s something you can dress up or down, depending on the need- these could easily be worn to spice up your daily routine and pair with a sweater/sweatshirt. Or, out for a night on the town! There is just something about a tighter velour like this that lets you be (or just feel!) a bit sassy!! Best part of all- you get the creature comfort of wearing athletic pants… with the comfort of looking u-la-la..!!!

When it comes to the actual fit, keep in mind- these do not have a thick elastic waistband (this waistband is appx. only 1/4” wide) and not the wider style most of us love. You know, the type that helps keep the tummy tucked in and provides added security! This was a BIG disappointment to me. (I realize there are some little twigs that exists -and god bless! Some of them may appreciate this thin band- if so, these would be perfect for you!) I just feel the overall fit would be much better if it were wider waist.. and it would appeal to more people.

The other issue I noticed with the fit… these are very high waisted. This is a style that has made a comeback in recent years- Trust me I did it during the 80’s and have NO desire to revisit anytime soon! Not being a fan of high waisted- I really don’t like the look in athletic pants at all..
when putting these on, it fits well in all places and I LoVe the 7/8 length! Being only 5‘2“ these hit me right at the ankle – which is nice because most standard lengths are far too long. So, I truly love fit with exception of waistband, its up above my navel??!! I wouldn’t consider myself a short “torso” person- I’m missing height in the leg!! So keep in mind if, I high waist would bother you in athletic pant.
IF- These had a thick with waistband and not one that went above the navel, I would definitely say these were five star quality. I took 1star for thin flimsy/unsupportive waistband (reminds me of the type that twist/roll after a few wash/wears…) and 1 star for the excess material that makes these so high waisted and hit about the navel when wearing...

title: Love these bracelets!!
text:
These bracelets are fabulous- I can’t help but, love the small simple, dainty size and the classic color scheme of the gold and black.. The ease and convenience of putting this on/off with one hand is beyond helpful- with the slip knot bead closure.. it makes sizing adjustable for anyone.

I have reviewed a few of these different worded bracelets and I’m certain as stated previous.. you won’t be disappointed in the product. If you don’t soak the bracelet (swimming or bathing..) i’m sure you can preserve the life of and keep it looking like new for a long time! **wearing a few stacked together makes this stand out- giving a little bit bolder statement...*
I personally wear 2 bracelets and have the mantra of those two messages with me.. i am not saying their provide you with secret super hero powers.. but, I’m pretty sure- I personally feel a little more empowered wearing these! (truthfully, there is a tiny power boost knowing… No one knows what your bracelet says but, you!) have fun and get one-

title: Temporary mantra tattoo one can wear anywhere!
text:
This isn’t the first bracelet I’ve ordered nor, will it be the last! This sleek and simple style bracelet is a statement piece more than anything else!

I’m surprised how many people ask and take notice inquiring, “what does the beading mean...?” It begins to tell a story without saying a word and it makes this really fun! About a dzn. times I’ve explained what/where I got this.. So, it’s a great icebreaker/conversation starter..!!

With this order, i was hoping to try a few of these bracelets and looking to wear them “stacked..” Right now, I have 2- and worn together, it does make them stand out more.. not a bad look at all!
