title: Personalizes love/inspiration in a clever way!!!
text:
I’m in LoVe..!! In this day and age when gimmicky bracelets seem to take over the world…Friendship Knotted Strings, Live Strong, Lokai, Alex/Ani.. you get the idea. Wow! But, this one.. hands down is the most clever, unique and down right sweetest bracelets ever. I love this simple but, dainty look.. and what a clever conversation starter. Or, on flip side- what a personal way to give someone/self a private message.. I’m loving this!!!

I’ll start with the 14k gold beads.. Personally, I don’t wear gold on a regular basis, If ever! However, the dainty size of these sweet little beads, contrast against the black string.. is very crisp/classic looking. I wear with platinum wedding ring (looks silver) and this doesn’t look out of place at all.
Another perk of the bracelet is the “one hand” application. It closes with just a slip “bead knot,” making it possible to put on by yourself.. and ladies, if you’ve ever struggled with a lobster claw- Ha!! This will mean a lot to you.. The sizing is adjustable again with this slip mechanism.. and ends of embroidery floss are finished in a simple knot. My only concern; if these will stay tied?

Best part of all- if you go online, you’ll find the dot/dash alphabet of Morse code... trust me, we all checked it to see if it was accurate (it was!) **suggestion- I would enclose a small note card with the Morse code alphabet on it- it would be so easy and make this a lot more fun to receive!

As with any jewelry threaded on embossed string, I would always say- it’s best for longevity, not to Let it soak ie., swimming or bathing. But, since this is easy to slip off/on.. it shouldn’t be a problem! Of course, I wash hands a handful of times.. and it got a bit wet, and it was fine!! Just a suggestion, if you want it to stay looking new.

I’m wanting to try and get a few of these and “stack” them together while wearing.. I’m thinking it will be a really fun look!

title: Great fitting beanie-
text:
Beanie passes teen approval!! With the past few I’ve bought not making the cut.. How great to hear, this was spot on!
We chose color: black smoke and love it. At a 1st glance it looks to be black.. but, no! (And this is what we were wanting to avoid- find a black hat that didn’t replicate one of a “burglar”..) I love the wool is marled with a few different hues of gray/black and specks of almost a white. REALLY!!! Tasked with finding this, who knew the struggle.. it took 4 tries to get it right! This black has a good offset of color to make it look like anything but standard shiny burglar cap! Color approved...

So far so good.. hat does not feel itchy- and this is made of wool material! my son wore to outdoor concert in utah.. and the smooth interior kept his head warm and no complaints of itchy after he took off 5 hr later. In fact, he fell asleep with beanie on all night!! I did toss it in washer and personally chose to air dry. Shape/material looks exactly like it did when it arrived. This beanie is fitted and not loose to begin with- but, as these are worn they tend to stretch and lose shape.. So, I love that a quick wash can tighten it right back up!

Note: this is NOT the slouchy style beanie. I’d describe this as a fitted/relaxed look. We wanted a nice clean sizing without that extra inch or so, of empty material on top! Yay!! this doesn’t have that.. I think you all know the fit I’m referring too- when you have ‘excess beanie at the top point..’ it may not look odd to see it- but, it is an awkward feeling/fit to the person wearing the hat. This Just fits nicely to the contour of person wearing- and can be easily adjust with the cuff roll.. that gives you a little room to adjust and customize the exact feel/comfort to the look you want. All the finishing touches on this hat have been done really well- we had no loose threads/strings and signs of carelessness.

For someone who usually shops Neff brand beanies- I liked this so much more. Neff tends
to lack shape and stretch out without even wearing... NOT THIS!! This is a great fitting beanie that has younger generation approval!

title: My “go-to” sweater for those transition seasons!!
text:
AmAzInG..!! I cannot tell you how much I love this. The past few years, I’ve been trying to find the “perfect” go-to sweater.. And I think I just did!

Ok, where do I start.. I ordered the sweater in a black Med. and being I’m a 38C,140lb.,5‘2“ - I was worried about the fit being too small. However, the photo displayed showed this sweater tucked into the waistband on the model- I usually don’t pay too much attn. to model/photo.. but, it suggested this may be bigger vs. smaller and yesss!! I’m so glad I got Med., it FiTs LiKe A gLoVe! (Usually, I wear a size Lg.) Having said this runs a bit big, do not get the wrong impression and think this: sweater + big = bulkie. Nope!! Let me explain-

This sweater is the truly the softest thing ever.. I love the feel- it is so light.. the overall weight is like a feather, and the ribbing on this sweater is perfect- the edge of sleeves/waist are ribbed just enough to hold the shape.. but, in no way does it take away from the overall smoothness/softness. Best part of all, this isn’t a heavy/bulky fit at all..(what I’ve been searching for.. Yay!) to say this lay’s perfectly and hugs your curves in a soft flattering way, is not exaggerating. The stretch is ample to make you feel comfortable/confident throughout and yet, in no way is it seersucking.

This is a soft black hue- in case trying to match it with another black.. it does not have the matted nor, shiny look some sweaters can give off. You can easily dress this up and it suggests being a bottom layer- However, I don’t get that vibe. I feel this will pair perfect with jeans, slacks, skirts.. as it has enough style- it can stand alone!! I wore this out with jeans/short boots and consensus from friends and family said, it looked fabulous!! This will definitely take the standard “mom uniform” and kick it up a notch.. I love that!
**The best part of this sweater is how easy it is to pull into your wardrobe and BoOm! Give you all the comfort of a classy, great fitting, quality sweater, while you enjoy how it feels and look good wearing it!**
So, If looking for a perfect in between seasons sweater that checks all the boxes... I think this is it!

title: Great belt- great concept for perfect fit!!
text:
What a smart concept!! This belt lets you custom fit it to the perfect size you need... the best part of all- it comes with a measuring tape paper attached to the back.. helping to not only know your exact size to trim this belt down too- but, cut in a clean straight line!!
The belt material itself is thick- FOR SURE: I recommend to error in side of a bit bigger AND a good quality pair of scissors to make the cut, if you do so, it will keep the end from fraying or being cut at an angle. I would also suggest when taking the finish clamp off of the end of the belt, only open a slight amount- Just enough to wiggle it off. Then, when replacing the finishing clamp to the cut edge.. It is easier to get back on, and stay secure.

The actual buckle is a sort of crosshatch Pattern and my son love this… He hates the belts with a shiny silver buckle! This crosshatching is black and brushed metal- and it is a really nice look that gives a unique classic look.. not, a polished “fancy” work belt!! It complements the black belt material perfectly.
Anyone looking for quality that will last for a long time, this belt has that ability. It is very above grade material and created using great attention to finishing detail and stitching.
**just a suggestion- if you want to use this belt as you grow and/or, sizes change.. leave 1-2” so, you will have the ability to adjust size as needed in the future.. If looking for a great belt, this is definitely just that!

title: Great work out sock!
text:
I had the chance to try these out in a yoga session and I’m always hesitant not to wear a sock with a grip bottom when exercising on mats… However, these socks did a fabulous job! I did not have any issues/feeling of slipping at all. I must mention I absolutely love the compression in the socks! This provides support in all the right places- who knew a bit of compression at your achilles’ heel could feel so good..?! The breathable mesh like material on top of foot is an added bonus.. it lets your foot breathe/cool from a workout. However, inside a shoe it doesn’t leave top of foot to feel barren.. truly, this is like a magical sock!! Honestly, the first thing I want to do post ANY workout is strip off my sweaty misshaped socks and sweaty clothes ASAP… That was not the case with these socks. In fact, I had these on from morning till night- (not trying to put sock to the test either..!) IT WAS AN ERROR THAT PAID OFF...!! I had to run carpool and was short on time to change.. so, as one thing led to another- by end of day- I realized, I had worn the sock all day post working out. Normally, the shape has been lost to exercise, along with ability to feel clean.. Yet, it wasn’t until I removed this in the evening- that I took stock in how nice the sock felt snug/supportive in every way.

I haven’t used enough to vouch for the material that eliminates odors wash after wash… But, one thing I did do is wash my pair overnight and replace them on my feet the next day- these seemed just like new from dryer to my feet again! I will say, (humble brag!) I’m not one who usually has stinky feet.. and so, probably not the best judge of how they wick odor… But, for what it’s worth- these seem to do their job as described. I noticed if I’m willing to seek a specific pair of socks from the sea of others in the dryer- they must be doing something right and are, a dang good sock..!!
The only advise I can add- is they seem a tad small or tight to begin with.. this is most likely due to the necessary compression but, after watching I took note again that they tend to look smaller then normal size medium sock for women’s. Keep in mind I did not have any problem with them feeling too restrictive as they have plenty of stretch/compression where needed but, if you are on the fence about your sizing.. I’d suggest maybe going with a tad larger size then normal.
These are made of high Quality materials and the attention to detail is not overlooked at all… And the best bonus ever, you get two pair with this purchase!!
If you’ve never had a good pair of compression socks and are interested in trying some for support and circulation, hands-down these are such a good product to try… I feel you’ll be pleasantly pleased. Love these and will buy in the future for certain!!

title: Nothing but love- Adidas tried and true!
text:
I have nothing but love for this good looking Adidas jacket! We received a men’s XL in the charcoal gray and let me tell you, it is slick!! First of all the material is not thick, overbearing, or heavy and this makes it perfect for spring/fall or, using as a warm-up jacket on the field. The material is 70% cotton – 30% polyester and it gives the perfect mix of softness with substance to it. I love the “blacked out“ look… The strings on the hoodie as well as, the stripes on the sleeves are black and really look great with this dark charcoal gray. Something I was hesitant about before seeing it in person.

The Jacket is very fitting, without being tight… My 16yo. son Who is 6’3”- 187lb. With a muscular build but, one that is not too bulky in muscle- he can wear this and it fits like a glove!

The finish on the outer material does have that ever so “sleek” feeling of rain repellent… I am not certain if this is just me? Or, if it may actually help deter water from soaking in.. but, my experience in the past with this same type of material has been perfect to use during rainy days as well. The two side pockets are lamb chop style and can hold a large cell phone adequately… However, keep in mind these pockets do not zip and this may matter to some..??
I did wash the jacket prior to wearing and did not notice any shrinkage in any place that would affect the overall integrity of the nice, close fit- in fact, as tall as my son is.. this jacket still has plenty of length and that is after a wash and DRY on warm.

My favorite feature with this jacket is the fact that it can be paired with both, black or gray items and match perfectly. Being these seem to be the teens preferred color choices these days.. (or, should I say lack of color- ha?!!) it will be nice to have something with the versatility and yet, being it isn’t the universal white… it won’t show every stain they come in contact with and with as much use as this will get from my highschooler, that will be a lot of dirt and wear/tear!!
This is a perfect light weight jacket to add to any athletes closet or, even nice to use as just a Pre/post winter zip up jacket.. Adidas definitely came through again for me!

title: Great belt- perfect for school uniforms.
text:
This is the perfect mix between causal and business! The braided belt gives a more relaxed and casual look.. The buckle is nice and gives off more of a dressy/professional vibe. The shiny silver and the leather closure definitely can take this to a more defined finished look.
We got this to wear with school uniform and it’s perfect! Most days it’s paired with a polo shirt- but, on “chapel days”… This dress is a very nice with sweater vest or blazer- with this, one belt serves both days!
The stretch allows it to adjust and feel comfortable while wearing and being an ever growing teen, you need room to grow all year. I’ll admit, the ability to stretch- allows them to keep their shirts tucked in with ease! Probably an over share… But, my son loves the fact that with the stretch- he doesn’t always have to undo the belt as he can get enough give and slip his pants down in bathroom...
The quality of the braid feels great- and very thick. It appears thick enough not to leave stretched peg holes after a few uses- (this is our problem with a previous leather belt.. and it’s hard to keep “tongue” of belt in place once too much of that stretch happens.)
The finish of overall product is nice. Feels like a very durable quality and the dye of the actual braided material is all the way through. No loose stitching and very forgiving with sizing. I would recommend this belt to anyone looking and would definitely get this belt again in the future, hopefully one in brown?!
My son who’s wearing this is 16yr old, 6’3”, 185lb. He has plenty of support and room to grow thru the waist and still fit the belt, no problem!

title: Taking trip to Egypt- I’m hopeful they’ll travel well?!
text:
Seem super great! Very thick and squishy and love the mountains on the ankle.. I like the color combo, they’re perfect for the staples of matching things! The sock feels firm and supportive.. and stays in place.. but, it’s not too tight that it cuts off the circulation- they feel really comfortable in athletic shoes.. Bought these to take to Egypt and will be doing X3 weeks of walking- I hope they hold up and are as comfortable as they seem. We’re also counting big on the moisture wicking.. we may need to wash in the sink x1-2 Times and I’m hoping a capful of Woolite will clean them well enough, that is till we get to washing machine..!!
I’m pleased and hopeful these socks (got 2pks. both, in crew and ankle..) will be versatile in boots or athletic shoes- and do the job to keep feet happy and odor free on vacation!

title: Quality T-shirt.. but, misses the mark!
text:
OK I received this top yesterday… And I really wanted to like it! I love the material it is soft and almost has like a “hacking/oatmeal look” to the color of the material..
I received an XL and the color is that of a dusty blue or cornflower. The color is one of my favorites ... it’s so soft and pretty, such a natural looking hue that could match so many things.
What I like: the shirt can be dressed up/down and the nice feel of the material would look great in a work setting with slacks/skirt/blazer. Personally, I was hoping to pair this with walking shorts and/or, denim jeans.. sort of a deviation from the standard “white Tee” mom uniform!
Not my fav: the neck is far too wide. I had to do a double take to be sure it wasn’t a V neck. The shirt tends to run a bit larger than most extra large women’s t shirts... and that doesn’t help with the neck opening! The finished stitching around the neck seems to make it “heavy” or, twist a bit and not let it lay straight, giving it a bit of a disheveled look- making it appear even more of a large opening. This may be better if I were to size down. (But, due to chest size.. I usually wear a women’s XL T-shirt.) So, keep in mind- if between sizes, I’d suggest ordering smaller. Also, Note- these are stitched rolled sleeves! Something I did notice in photo... but, didn’t realize was permanent and not just styled that way.
Over all, this could be a great addition to a wardrobe if you don’t mind the wider collar and you like the rolled sleeve look. I’d just be certain to get a smaller size in general- knowing that it runs a bit large. If ordering the light blue.. you won’t be disappointed with the color. Just personally, I didn’t get a quality finished look/fit and feel, with a lot of options out there- I’d rather purchase a T-shirt that gives me that!
The shirt looks to be of quality material and finish. Just lacks the tailored finish..

title: Sexy, Slim wallet...
text:
Wow! Sexy minimal wallet.. is that even possible? I cannot tell you how incredible the deep chocolate and weathered effect looks on this wallet, it’s got the wow factor!! I almost hesitate to get this scuffed up...
Truly, the wallet is the thinnest a wallet can get and still have the ability to be functional. The item arrived wrapped in a small cloth (protecting the leather and I can see why! Also included was a small card with instructions suggesting how to help prolong the life of the wallet by caring for the leather- and that’s something, I’ve never thought of doing till now.)
On front side there is a window for ID which is large enough, it lets the entire license be seen if it is left inside the case (at least the Utah version!) It also has the handy ”cut out finger slide” to help remove your ID. This is helpful as the wallet wears in and/or, becomes warm While using. There is also a small extra pocket behind the ID window- I’d say it’s probably best for any extras/receipts... On back side there are x3 designated card slots.. and another extra slot like you have on the front.

On the top- is a nice, well stitched, reinforced opening made to hold your cash inside. (personally, I use one of “extra pockets” to hide my emergent, always faithful, hidden $20 bill...the, “use only in case of emergency” money.. This is great to be able to keep a stashed $20 completely separate from all other spending money... the other “extra”’pocket is perfect for receipts, punch cards or school ID.

I worried the integrity of the wallet may not be as strong- as it was truly, so thin.. but, it’s great! The leather and stitching is high quality and the snug fit gives you added peace of mind. You can smell the leather as it just smells brand new..

I used this at our last night of summers “back to school carnival” (where carrying a purse is a total burden..) and I slid this inside my side short pocket. I rode on rides without feeling like a had a jumbo brick in my pocket.. in fact, its barely half the size of my iPhone 8+. It felt so comfortable, I had to keep double checking the wallet was still there!

Proving 2 things: it can definitely be unisex- bc, there are truly just days that a mom doesn’t want to carry a purse and she needs something reliable to hold her wallet items in. And.. the second thing-it is slim and comfortable in a small pocket so much so.. you may forget it’s there! So, basically doing its job and looking good while doing so!!

title: Fabulous swim trunk and/or, summer short!!
text:
Received and used in the same day!! I wasn’t sure if this would be a hit or not, as my son doesn’t like the “tightness” with most swim/board shorts. This product is like receiving a pair of loose, light, free flowing shorts… BUT, it is made for a dip in the pool! The best part is these will definitely be a pair of swim trunks that will perform double duty… a great swim suit and/or, summer short!!
We received an extra large in the olive color and it is pretty spot on to the photo provided. String at waist seem extra long and will help with the dreaded de threading that sometimes takes place in the washing machine- (you know, when you remove clothes to find.. “someone” must have punked you and pulled it out on purpose.. and it’s probably the same person who steals the sock!!?!)
FYI- strings are sewn to show on the outside of the suit.. again, giving the feel that these could be worn as summer attire. The entire waistband is elastic and therefore, if you were to order and end up on the bigger size of waist Measurement… A simple cinch and tie of the drawstring will have a secure/snug fit which is peace of mind when jumping into a swimming pool!
Love the cargo pockets and the Velcro closure- good to keep things secure like wallet or cell phone… If you are wearing around town. The side slit pockets are a total bonus for use as shorts, one hardly know they are even there, being they are cut so well.. and No! they Do not cause a gaping issue when in the water at all.
The material is not see through when wet or, dry and the quick dry fabric, as expressed hangs a bit loose- ONLY when you get this wet, can the shorts momentarily become a bit seer sucking in the groin area… But, once out of the water the material falls back into place. These DO come with a “built in” mesh underwear net to help keep modesty in tact while wearing.. No need to use your own boxer briefs underneath (which is my son’s solution to male issues with other swimsuits in the past!) He was pleased with the fit of the mesh lining and said it didn’t feel too tight around his leg/thigh. My son is 16yo, 6‘3“ and 190lb. with a strong but, not overly muscular build if that gives you a reference.. He probably could have gotten away with a Lrg. but, he loves the fit... just like it is. Ugh, seems everything these millennials wear tend to be a bit baggy!
If you’re hesitant about purchasing… I cannot tell you enough good things about the swim trunks. Most of all they look and feel good and offer more then one use. These are very rich in the color and all stitching seems to be on point. There is NO feeling of carelessness or, poor quality in the construction of these swim trunks... Overall, the product gives off a vibe that is still cool with the teens and yet, classic enough for the adults to appreciate.

title: Classic weathered belt- love it!!
text:
Love this belt- I love the look and texture. This belt gives off the complete feeling of a new belt with the quality and support. All without looking like you’re wearing a bright and shiny new pair of white sneakers!! You know what I mean-

This portrays a bit of what I’d call, a weathered look and personally I feel it is a bit more business casual.. Yet, without any effort one could dress this up and it would not look out of place. I love the fact that this belt does not have the waxy sheen like some new belts start off with.
The width of the belt is thicker then, most men’s business style or, female style belts.. and I love it!! No worries, as it still fits inside a standard belt loop perfectly and the classic buckle is simple and straight forward..it is not the polished silver either so, it matches the overall weathered look. The stitching is a nice, tight quality and edges are finished in great quality and not left raw.
The best part of all- this can be unisex, no problem! Just follow the size guide and you can match it to your appropriate waist size- they offer smaller sizes that could fit most women. Keep in mind, with this being quality leather.. you can easily punch another hole to make a smaller fit. (Note: if you don’t have the ability to do this yourself- any key cutting or, knife sharpening store can provide a perfect professional looking hole cut into your belt- without causing any ripping/damage.. and my local store will do it for free, as I stand there and wait!) In fact, I’m planning to use this myself and can’t wait to pair it with jeans and tall boots!
The overall quality and look of this belt is fabulous- I would definitely recommend or, get another product from this brand/seller without hesitation. This belt arrived in a unique classy box and inside of that, it’s placed into a soft protective bag- This belt could be given as a gift exactly how it arrives (no excess wrapping is needed!) and It would look as if you went above/beyond.. that is always a good thing!

title: Adorable bag- I really wanted to love..
text:
I absolutely love the Adidas brand-so, I know I always have high expectations. I saw this purse and loved it in the photos- my daughter actually has this bag in clear.. I wanted one too!! I was hoping the color- being iridescent, would be see-through as well and come with those extra benefits. **The bonus of a clear bag is getting into/thru security at concerts, sporting venues, etc.. and a lot of such places are only permitting the use clear bags or, none at all. (Yess!! It’s a sad day/age when this is what we’ve become- a society who must use only a transparent bag so, we cannot conceal our weapon.) But, I believe this bag has too low of visibility.. instead of being clear it has the same effect of looking through a pair of sunglasses!

CONSIDER THIS: As far as the size- you can see it in the photo.. what you see, is what you get! There is NO stretch to this bag what so ever.. Being the material used is actual plastic- there is NO stretch/give so, you can only fit what actually measures up to the actual size of the bag. Also, bc the bag is made of a thicker plastic material.. it feels if you were to really try to overfull- you could run the risk of separating the stitching from the plastic. The bag seems to be sewn a bit “top heavy” and therefore, it tends to tip over, which is a nuisance- especially if the zipper is open and the purse content falls out (make sure to keep the zipper shut tight!)
PERKS: If you are looking for a bag that is minimal in size, and you just need it to hold your basics: pen, wallet, cell phone, chapstick, pressed powder, keys.. This is a really stylish bag and will serve the purpose just fine! I will say- the straps are sewn onto this bag nice/tight and done so, exceptionally well. The outer material is stiff and helps keep the purse from slouching or losing its shape. The trend right now seems to be small size purse- and the mini backpack style carry straps this has is great! The loop at the top is nice for hanging it up and giving the same features- just like a backpack!
I love the small front zip pocket.. its a perfect place to keep your keys or, tiny size items- and spares you digging thru a bag.. a total perk!
Overall, a similar style bag without the brand name is less of a hit on the wallet.. and may be better option, if you only plan to use for special occasions. However.. if you’re a minimalist in purse content (I only dream of this, as a mom of x4.. I don’t have the luxury!) and wanting to use a smaller sized bag day/day then, I’m certain the cost of the bag will seem worth it.

title: Great for teens who hate carry wallets!
text:
Awesome wallet for minimal carry- and most of the time, when you find “front pocket” wallets- they don’t have the viewing window for the drivers license... this one does!
This is a really sharp looking, well made, good quality leather and looks like it would be more expensive then it is. The box it comes in, is also “gift giving ready..” and that is such a perk, if buying as a gift.
My purpose for getting this, is to help my teenage son who’s just turned 16yr old- and never used a wallet.. transition into carrying one! Now, it isn’t a choice- he has the need and must be responsible to keep his license, insurance, debit card and few $ cash with him.. Not only must he have these things- he must keep them safe, keep from getting lost and most of all, keep from going through the wash! Only, after trying a regular wallet- did we find out- he was not liking the big/bulk of the whole thing...

This slim minimal wallet is just perfect for our teens needs! I like that the construction is well done and will help to keep important items safe. I love that it feels comfortable in his front pocket so, he’s not taking it out and then, leaving or losing it someplace.
The best part of this really sleek wallet- is the ability to view the license thru the “window” and if used by an adult- this would be a big bonus at a bar, you can show ID without having to continually remove it from the case.
The one drawback I don’t like- Is the “opening” to store your cash.. is open on 2 sides and not just 1...
it’s not a dealbreaker at all, just wish it only opened on 1 side- like a pocket.

title: Love the sock- wish the heal could improve!!
text:
These are a great quality sock and the built in support around the mid step is so nice, it is why we use them above others. I’ve bought several adidas socks for my entire family.. and we love the comfort and breathable material. The best part of the sock is the ankle construction.. you never have to worry about adidas socks slipping down..which is fabulous for an active person! I have found consistently the adult men’s lg/xlg run small- and small, I mean short in length. Always order up a size is my suggestion-
My only complaint with the adidas sock.. is the back heal. When pulling the sock on- this is the point of seeing the material actually separate .. and I feel for the $ and quality of brand- this needs to be fixed or reinforced. I’d say 90% of all pairs we own have this barren thread at the heal issue and it happens quite quickly.. no brand should wear in one place consistently.. without it being a flaw!
Other than this, I am completely happy and satisfied and wish nothing more than this not to be. Maybe if enough people have concern or complaint it will improve?

title: Great minimal wallet- read below about attachment!
text:
This is perfect minimal wallet for on the go.. in situations where less definitely is a perk- concerts where bags must be searched.. hands free needs, hiking, school when you’re not carrying purse, and the bonus is it can be hooked on a lanyard.. etc. The ability to have a small but, very functional alternative to a bulky wallet is key! This I found to be perfect size for ID, credit card, hotel key and cash... the leather is soft and color was spot on to the photo online.. (we got a black color!) the best part of all- the zipper pouch is necessary.. especially if you’re given back loose change and have no where to put it. I personally liked I could slip a chapstick in the zipper and still keep the integrity of wallet while it closed no problem.. this is defiantly something that could be used for yourself or, given as a fun gift! The envelope box itself that it arrives in is perfect.. You don’t need to add anything else too it, if gifting away! Could be a gift for any age- teen or, adult would appreciate. The price point is also nice, looks like a personal and unique idea. Gives the vibe that you spent extra time to find a really nice “different” gift of quality.. Yet, the item doesn’t break the bank nor, take any extra effort and that is helpful in a pinch!! (You could alway add a gift card to the wallet to up the giving.. easy and clever and loved by all, at least at my house?!)
The only reason for not giving 5 stars.. is the construction/attachment of the “jump ring.” I LOVE it has this feature and chose it accordingly- However, with the ring being attached inside the pocket... when you pull it out to use, the zipper must stay a tiny bit open at the end. So, anything small could technically slip out through that small opening. This would not be a problem if you don’t plan to use the jump/key ring- or, put small items in the zipper pocket. But, it’s worth mentioning as, I did purchase for the key ring factor and will use it for loose change etc.
Overall, I’m pleased with the wallet and would definitely purchase in the future. My daughter is going to Ariana Grande concert this weekend and plans to borrow so, she can skip the bag search line... it will be easy for her to keep all items she needs to take with and have them safely contained into one small wallet.

title: Love the shoe- BUT, buy your actual size!!
text:
Keep in mind when you put these on.. they may feel too small.. but, they’re not!! The padding is super fluffy in the toe area... and if you wear it an hour or so.. it will fit perfectly and you won’t need, not want to size up!!
Having said that, they are perfect for wearing in or outside.. I love the fact that the bottoms are as sturdy as shoes yet, comfy as slippers- they’re overly warm.. so, keep in mind that’s great for the winter and maybe a bit hot in the summer!
The fact I bought these for $5.99- I couldn’t go wrong.. but, love them enough to pay double that! The item is sized accurate, came on time and if recommend to anyone unsure!

title: Added details made this a perfect gift!!!
text: Perfect gift and personalized so, that added bonus looks like more effort went into getting the gift then actually did! A good price point for when you need- grad or, obligatory gift… It’s the truth, sometimes you need to give a recognition gift and this is it. One-size-fits-all (and it truly does) and the box was perfection!! All added touches made this a total hit- all for less then, cost of basic gift card.. it’s a no brainier!  We got more compliments on this gift then those who spent countless hours and money trying to find the perfect present. Would definitely recommend. Wish they had a box just as clever… That didn’t involve graduation theme..  hands down it would be a hit for so many occasions.. the extra details are what made this above the rest!! (No, the box details etc. do not give the essence of “cheap” either.. I know some gimmicky things like this can do that..) this looks like a lot of effort- and yet, it was all inclusive!

title: Great sweatpants and pockets!!
text: Perfect for teenage son who is 16 years old and 6’3.. he used for PE and lounging and loves them! Pockets are a plus.. $ was great and would definitely buy again.. they have cuff at bottom which hits him about ankle or slightly above- more like jogger style- but, in comfy pants!! They washed well without pilling -and due to length, I hang dry! Don’t want to take the chance of making culottes out of them ..the color we got was heathered blue, which seems really versatile with anything- not that he cares! But, it’s nice to help him not look too dorky as a freshman..!!

title: Cute and LoVe the cord it’s on..!!
text: Love the rubber cord, especially if not removing in summer!! Wish charm was better quality- but, it is cute! My adult daughter Received in a college care package and hasn’t taken it off since! It’s a good length for an adult fit and arrived on time as expected!

title: Cheap child necklace in look/quality!!
text: Had to remake myself… It looked like a child play jewelry and was built about the same. Keep in mind the size of the beads were big and the extra adjust rings are a must… If you want to wear for an adult size neck! It does show a ladies neck in the photo… However, they named it girls necklace? It’s definitely for little girls and won’t last long. I’d recommend and different necklace if you’re serious and actually wanting a beaded necklace that you’d actually wear as an adult!!

title: Trust me, it’s purple!
text:
Not as maroon as I’d hoped and wish it was a bit less cropped in the front.. not same cut as other cropped Calvin hoodies.
But, super soft and I like the quality and the look is different then, usual black or gray standard hoodie! Got a deal with sizing. I hate the hike in $ for random sizing game.. and seems to be no rhyme or reason.. not just xxs/xxl are discounted. This is purely random.. and I won’t give anyone who does that 5 stars!!

title: Perfect 21 bday gift
text: Gave to our daughters girlfriend who turned 21 and  it was priced right and perfect type of gift for the birthday. Nice unique idea and made well…

title: Wedding must have!

title: Something blue wedding panty..!!
text: Holds things tucked in, in all the right places! Gave to baby sis’ for her wedding day..  she’s a bit bigger and wanted a little help through the middle and these provided just that! But, was still pretty and not trashy and even sexy enough for wedding day panties. A great way to provide “something blue” for the wedding.. and make bride feel sexy and classy.. and supported! Gave as a shower gift. It worked out great.. especially if you need function with elegant and classy!

title: Fun gift BUT, runs small!!!!

Love these and for $10 +/- a dollar or two.. the only problem. I have son with regular size teen feet and they We a snug fit- even before washing!!
Fun for your gamer kiddo and the winter cold toes they get. Arrived on time and would be thrilled if they were sized more appropriate! (Ex. I wear sz.7 women’s.. and it fit me with zero room to spare!) so, definitly off for men’s sizing!!

title: UPDATE- 06/19.. must see!! Even more perfect in person!!
text:
UPDATE: I am so disappointed and embarrassed… I gave the ultimate review on this ring, as we adored it and gave it as a gift to our daughters partner, and an important gift to say the least! Upon her returning home from out of state for summer… I saw her ring for 1st time since purchase- it is brown/discolored and like children’s play jewelry!! I wanted to let you know, as well as the seller… If this is a fluke, I’d at least feel some relief. Only right now, I feel as if we gave a gift to someone special… And it wasn’t of any value!!? The intention- she could treasure this for years to come and wear and polish as needed. Yess, I did inquire about her getting wet, using with Cleaners or, even make up remover and she states; it’s kept in a box and put it on when she goes out . So, it sounds like we have some issue with the metal? Since, she was away at college- I have missed allotted 30day return window- and will gladly update post if seller chooses to help rectify a solution? (Worst part is, she said it was about 10 days post wearing when it started to look bad.. and it only got worse.) I hope to update you good news- but, I won’t hold my breath! So, maybe I can spare this happening to you.. Giving a gift you want to be a treasure, only to find out the recipient was ultimately put in an awkward position To tell us of the failed gift. I’m sure it’s hard not knowing what to say/do about the way the item failed.. So, just know it’s amazing to receive- but, the silver failed when it shouldn’t have! I’ve been loyal as a repeat customer, this is 5 ring purchased.. yet, this was the first time this happened to us. Maybe it has something to do with the stones? I just don’t know..
FIRST POST- January: Is even more dainty and adorable in person!! We actually gave it to our daughters partner.. and the rainbow has special meaning, I feel it’s done in such a subtle way for her to wear, support and appreciate the meaning.. Or, just enjoy as a fun colorful ring. I’d definitly buy it again as a gift for anyone.. the tininess of it, ohh.. makes it that much more angelic! Arrives perfectly sized.. and on time. It’s my 4-5 ring purchase from seller this past year. Ha! wish they had a punch card for loyal customers!! Buy 5- get 1 free- one can suggest!

title: Feminine daisy thumb ring!
text: seems to run smaller then most size 7’s.. very cute band and daughter plans to wear wear this in her thumb!  Very simple and for price it’s cute ring.. looks of good quality.

title: Quality tshirt
text: Basic T-shirt seems well made/printed and true tonsize. Material of shirt is heavier cotton- not those found in light weight of same style. My 15y old is happy tonhave received. Pairs it with denims or adidas workout pant.

title: Way way too small..
text: Purchased and could not get over son’s thigh and no! He’s not a bodybuilder.. at all! In fact,  he’s a prepubescent 14yr old… who hasn’t even reached “man hood” maturity! Sure good quality material in the pants yet, that means very little when we can’t even put on pair in our correct size?! Had to return. I I can’t write an honest review..due to the above issue. So, hopefully others have better luck? RVCA is a good brand too.. Guess it surprised me that our exact sizing was SOO off. I did order 2 other pants on same day (all in the same size 34x34) The other two fit him.. so, problem was with pant/brand we received.

title: Great LBD... little “berry” dress!
text: My 20-year-old daughter fell in love with this and wore to a wedding with the 2 inch strappy sandal.. it looked absolutely great!  You could easily dress this up or, down depending on the event you wear it too. It is a little shorter versus longer if that is an issue for anyone? And it definitely needs a creative bra option!  We used a sticky bra that doesn’t have any straps on the backside at all and actually found this type bra on Amazon (I call them prom bras!!) just know, the style of a low hanging crisscross back makes regular bra obsolete. The way the dress fits a young girls figure is spot on.. it SO accentuates and highlights without being overly klingy, the dress is very forgiving as well and is not tight in any of the wrong places. The pockets are an added perk! The color is beautiful and almost purple, muted berry and the photo doesn’t due justice for the actual color. I reviewed  dress was somewhat small and that is due tonight as far as body of the dress it is room he was out looking like a Denny’s sack. Best part of purchase, post the wedding wear- it could now be used as a fun summer day out option paired with sandals or, even swimsuit cover-up worn w/ a pair of flip flops.. definitely a great dress with options! Quality of brand is spot on- I’ve bought many items from them with zero complaint!

title: Great find for a great pant!
text: I would give five stars for the price I received… Just about $10 for the pair, color, size we need it. Been a one time use I have zero complaints! We ordered 34x34 for a 15yr old: 6’2” 170lb prepubescent adulthood build. The waist was good as he like to wear it lower on hips.. and length was fine as well. Only snug part was through groin and top of thighs.. but, hard to find good pant to nix this issue! He doesn’t want pleated “man pant” and so, I make best attempt and a more fitted flat front.. these seem to work just that way.. with acception of the “one tight spot!” Quality is great and material thicker vs. thinner.. if you’re trying to fit a more straight, clean look- this does the trick.

title: Perfect for a basic yet, dressy boat shoe look!
text: The shoe is just fine and did what we needed for our 15-year-old son to wear to a wedding with dockers! Only concern the photo shows the beige/tan/cream colored a little lighter then, it truly is! It’s not enough to look funny- just note the shoe is a bit darker in person..  A nice argyle sock along with the light blue accent on the shoe helps offset the color difference. For the price, it was a good purchase and comfortable sale for the event that lasted eight hours long! Not sure we would have received the same comfort result if we chose a dress shoe?! Bonus, my son can use again if needed.. keep this boat shoe nice for needed events. It’s not hip enough to want to wear everyday for our 15yr old and that is fine with me!!

title: Found a Margaritaville T-shirt on sale!!
text: Finally a buffet shirt for a deal!! The 2XL was on sale and I snagged.. the material is lighter vs. heavier as some  Margaritaville shirts can be. Perfect for summer evenings or sunburn coverage. Best thing about these shirts is they last a long time and are always a hit for the recipient in our house… I am happy  due to the fact I got a great deal! On a quality T-shirt!

title: Great lyrics on this shirt!
text: Buffet shirts tend to run big.. But, shrink over time quite a bit! Anyone who’s owned one of these shirts- knows it gets soft as can be over time!! I didn’t get a deal and often wonder if margaritavile shirts are worth too $... the quality answer is no. But, the graphics and lyrics are a yes!! And I’ve got men who love their jimmy wear, leaving me no choice but.. pay top $ for gifts when they want..

title: Great alternative to standard khaki shirt!
text: LOVED THE COLOR!! We got the jade/green and it’s not too feminine for a guy (it was my sons worry- didn’t want to look like he had on girl shorts!)  you will not believe how soft the material is and so late! Looks like a wrinkle or two will be our only struggle… The fit was spot on (wear a 36 and 36 was perf. The material feels as it has some give.. the type you tighten back up with washing) and length errors on longer vs. shorter leg .. but, definitely above the knee. Good natural bermuda short length. Color is nutural enough to be used like a tan or khaki... could definitely match a lot of different things. Would reccomend if you’re looking for good quality short with a twist of color... this is it!

title: Classic Calvin’s!!
text: 17 and 20yr old girlies love these.. love the thick waste band as it doesn’t roll or bunch like we all know panties can do! Fit is nice in workout and regular pants alike.. they love the added “middle” support and no it doesn’t cut into them like some thicker bands will.. classic colors. I always wash with bra/panty/sock load and just hang them to dry.. (it takes just minutes to do so!) Ha! Then, you never worry about them tangling up in dryer that way and elastic lasts forever without the heat!

title: Perfect hat... Ever!!
text: The search is over!!!!  Anyone looking for the perfect beanie, knows the power of those 4 words. I’ve been looking for a daily, “I don’t want to do my hair and yet, I don’t wanna look like an idiot beanie..” this did the trick!  It is simple in the fact there are no extras to poke out cause lumps and bumps where you don’t want them and most of all, cost three times as much as some! I’m an adult  Who doesn’t suffer from large or tiny head issue, so it fits very sleek… Without looking like a skullcap! Material and construction look great , I live in Salt Lake City and it does job to keep heat in as well!!  I’m all round pleased and will look into 1-2 more… I’m stripping hair color from my locks next week and this was no.1 reason to get the hat..  I need a good fit I can use multiple days in a row and hide the hair transformation.. This is it!  ps. If ever beanie loses shape, toss in washer with your clothes.. I just keep eye on while drying.. So far, it’s kept it shaped perf.! Overall, quality construction and in the best of ways- it seems  ergonomically designed and up to the day/day task to be a “go to” staple!

title: Unfinished prong, otherwise perfect ring or teenage daughter!
text:
Beautiful for my daughters 16 birthday! Perfect for this age to do a ring in S.S. so she can wear it with school uniform, out on weekends or slip it into backpack at her sports game...w/o too much worry, "what if I lost it?!!" Very decently priced for the age....looks appropriate on her finger. It doesn't cross the fine line of gaudy, obnoxious, and it does not scream cheap...Im 100% certain you ALL know that fine line I'm talking about!

Only reason I gave this ring 3 stars; three of the four prongs were "finished, rounded and set against the stone perfectly." The fourth one was almost spliced off and had a sharp jagged edge that cut (scrapped down to blood!!) her other finger. So, happy bday...ouch...take it off/send it back...get it to post office...bah, blah...this is where FULFILLED BY AMAZON SHOULD UP THEIR EXPECTATIONS OF COMPANIES...OR, IMPLEMENT BETTER INSPECTIONS, BEFORE MAILING. If not for this COMPLETE LACK OF CARING ABOUT THE DETAILS...this ring is perfect. Needless to say, 2nd ring arrived in much better shape! **to be safe- Inspect prong before you put on.

title: Be Very Aware!! Amazon..step up the standard!!
text:
B/c I can't chose zero stars!! Try getting your brand new handbag that is much needed and sought after, only to have it arrive with 1/2" rips where it's handle has been attached to the main body of the bag?? Ohhh, how about 3 handles are sewn in at matching heights and the 4 is not? I'm talking a different height by 2+ inches..impossible to miss? I thought so. Maybe that's to match the 1 piece of hard wear that's different on one end of the handle...While the other three are the same?
I'm not sure who to be more disappointed in, the product + the company who sells it? OR, fulfilled by Amazon and they do a product check before shipping...seriously? Don't admit this out loud Amazon! This is 3rd item in a row full filed by amazon that's been broken or wrong item. I'm hoping I don't have to find a new favorite "go-to online hot spot?" Amazon makes these right, but effort up front saves us all a lot of extra work!! Don't waste your time...worthless item!!

These fit GREAT! They feel a bit snug for the firstt hour or two and then they stretch out to the perfect size ( I wear a size 5, I ordered a 6 and they were snug). My problem is that the fabric does not breathe at all, and being the winter I wore these a bunch the first week I had them. One day it was a bit warmer (50 degrees out) and I noticed my feet were literally squishing in the slippers from sweat. Because these are synthetic fabric they DO NOT breathe, and my poor feet were drowning in sweat ( and I'm a person who really doesn't sweat normally).
My feet are not happy right now. If these are something you'd wear for an hour or two a day, these are perfect for you. However if you have plans to wear these as house shoes, don't do it.
I really want to love these, I sort of do, but I also don't want stinky sweat soaked feet.

title: Soft and warm, good quality socks
text: I am very happy with these socks, they are thick and warm and soft. I've worn them every day and washed them, and so far they're holding up well. I really like the available colors and patterns, as well. The price was excellent for five pairs, and the socks don't feel cheap. This is a great value.

title: As always I love thier shoes
text: This shoe, in particular, is very comfortable for an Oxford and look beautiful. I have never had a complaint with any ECCO shoes I've bought. Maybe I just get lucky, but it's about the only brand I would put my name behind saying it.

title: These shoes are a steal
text: Seriously, I was skeptical for the price but was pleasantly surprised. They are good looking, comfortable, and so far durable.

title: Wheels break off and forget about using the warranty
text: I have bought two of these Samsonite 28" bags, both within 9 months had a wheel either just break off entirely or partially fall off. When this happens, you're stuck in a very bad place. They are too big to hand carry, and dragging them makes them flop around painfully. Samsonite warranty and quality used to be the "go to brand." Every bag I've bought from them breaks within a year and just read the NEW WARRANTY!?! By the time you pay all the shipping fees, parts, and potentially labor it's cheaper to buy a new one. When on a trip that is what you will have to do. The good ole days of walking into a Samsonite vendor and exchanging a damaged bag ARE LONG OVER WITH. I hate to say this because I've bought their baggage for decades, but now it's all just JUNK.

title: ok
text: just ok

title: Perfect, flattering, comfortable
text: I'm 5'6 with short legs and after reading reviews I expected to need to hem these. I ordered my regular size and they are perfect. I expected to need to hem them after reading reviews noting many people mention them being too long. I will be ordering again and a size down for a snugger fit and the length will be fine. They are buttery soft and not at all sheer. The pockets are big enough for my phone with no worries about it falling out. The waistband doesn't roll and they stay up without slipping. Overall I highly recommend these.

title: So many compliments!
text: I was looking for a jacket for a special event and found this. I received so many compliments all weekend! It's comfortable she not too heavy so I'll be able to transition it from winter into spring then again into fall.  It's well made and the embroidery is beautiful.

title: Awesome bag!
text: There are some reviews that talk about it's not standing when packed but I found if you place your heavy, larger items on the bottom, packing it with it standing in mind, I have no problem with that. The zippers all work well but a bit sticky unless you hold the tabs designed for that purpose they work fine. This bag was in the bed of a truck, in the rain and snow overnight and all the items remained dry. It holds up to being put in and out of the bed with no rips or tears.

title: Sneakers
text: Awesome!!

title: Lenses Matter
text: Awesome! I have gotten so many compliments on the look of the glasses! Only complaint is that they are non-Polaroid lenses!

title: The call me mellow yellow
text: Love the look and color

title: Won't fit
text: Ordered my size. Won't fit, too loose. Can't compensate

title: Excellent customer service
text: Watch had small problem. Customer service quickly resolved to my satisfaction.

title: Thin, but very strong
text: Very thin, but very strong.  I was looking to replace an old necklace that carried a pendant from Alaska.  Actually I preferred this this chain as the focus was on the pendant.  Discreet and yet did the job.

title: Thin, holds a lot!
text: Nice thin leather feel and seems strong. We have a number of similar wallets and love it for both male and female.  Holds a lot of cards, ID, other cards.  Much better than a purse.

title: 100% cotton, but waist band was tad tight.
text: 100% cotton…not many clothings can claim this anymore, and I prefer them made of cotton.  The only thing I didn’t like was the waist band as it was tighter than it should be, so if you have a bit of a tummy roll, it might be a tad uncomfortable.

title: Reliable brand, Uber light to carry. Will handle a good shower.
text: Great umbrella to slip into your large handbag, backpack- so incredibly light and small.  That said, it still opens up to decent size to cover one person.  Will it hold up in strong wind or lashing rain, probably not.  However, it’s great if you are suddenly caught in a shower.  The open and close mechanism works great, but I splash a bit of wd40 on the stem as it was a little stiff.  Love the color and design, great for spring!

title: Love the flat storage option!
text: Wow, I love that you can store this flat! Ample of space once zipped together and great for long weekend get away or as overhead baggage.  The quality of the bag is very good, and note that if you place more than 2 winter blazers, it does take away some of the inside space, but if you need to switch into work jacket - hey presto, it stays well flat, few wrinkles.

title: fabric is little thicker than I like for summer wear.
text: the fabric is thicker than I would like for a summer/humid wear.  that said, the product is well made and designed.  Fits well without upsizing.  note the neck line is closer to the neck if you prefer otherwise.  Good length to the hips.

title: Better coverage and support than I though
text: Great for C cup coverage.  Very comfortable, especially as it is all one piece and stayed put even in the humid summer days.  Stretches very well and yet gives great support..I thought it was going to be too small.

title: good quality t-shirt.
text: Nice thickness and stretchy.  Comfortable to wear.  the design is slightly huggy, but you dont feel the tightness.  nice design and something that should not loose shape and color.

title: great design and plenty stretchy
text: thin material and very comfortable.  Plenty of stretch and great for the humid summer.  love the design and actually could be dressed up with some jewelry or dress down with trainers.  I like this item a lot.

title: Perfect fit. Good feel.
text: Plenty of stretch and hence no need to upsize.  I am too heavy and probably will wear a strapless bra.  Otherwise, great feel and perfect for summer ahead.

title: Solid, but heavier as a result.
text: This is large and ample for 2 people without cumbersome of a golf umbrella.  Strong frame and although heavy in weight, it served the purpose we were looking for: one strong framed umbrella that covers 2 medium framed adults.  Perfecto.

title: Nice design, tad tough to take off.
text: The design lends the top to be worn outside of a class, I like the look and it is a medium to light hold.  the thing is taking it off after a sweaty workout the lower band is not as stretchy as another amazon brand I tried.  A bit of a workout to take it off.  Fit was as expected.

title: Easy to take off after a sweaty exercise class
text: Medium hold and I love that he lower band has a very good stretch so it is easy to take off after a sweaty workout; yet it still has a great hold whilst you are working out.  Love the design and use it for yoga and light spin classes.  Another great product from Amazon.

title: Beautiful bag - recycled plastic bottles!
text: It’s hard to believe this is made from recycled plastic bottles: 15x 500ml.  It is very light and yet very strong to hold a lot of books, for example.  I love the design and it’s a fun anytime bag, kinda trendy in a youth way.  There is a key clip in the zipped side pocket, which is essential for me.  It sits well.  Not sure how comfortable the strap will be in summer months when I am wearing tank tops and hopefully, no rub.  Love the osprey brand.

title: Supports wide feet.  Stylish and comfortable
text: Very comfortable and took them out for corner shop outing: no rub on the skin - any issues normally manifest very quickly.  I have wide feet and the shoes accommodated with comfort and I could have gone down half a size if that were offered.  Lovely pink color.  Felt support on arches.  Noticed these can be washed in washing machine!  These are my first totes and so far, stylish and not clumpy at all.

title: Great environmental material.
text: It’s very similar feel to their pajamas set, and thus I am happy!  It is slim fitted as opposed to the loose fitting seen in the pics.  But the feel is good and not cotton, but happy that this brand supports environment.  Material is thick in a good way, so not transparent.

title: Full size up - wide feet and thick socks people
text: I haven’t tested them yet, but after the rubber fell off my last boots in the last snow storm..it was time for new snow boots.  I went from 8.5 to 9.5 based on the reviews.  I also have wide feet - and I am glad I upgraded by a full size.  The fit was comfortable even with thick socks, and my wide feet was accommodated by larger size.  That said, it was snug with hiking socks, but might be okay once my feet are cooler.  Very easy to put on as there is a side zip and Velcro strap.  Ample space to tuck in the trousers.  Comfortable as I walked around my living room.  Whilst I love spring, I would love. Snow storm to test them before the winter is done with us for another year.

title: Light support, but so comfortable that I don’t know I have it on.
text: Feels comfortable and on the skin.  Great stretch so you aren’t contorted to get it on or off.  Very light support, but gives enough tee-short coverage and light.  Sometimes, I forget I even have it on that it is that comfortable.

title: Plastic version appears as strong as the original metal ones
text: Hub loves this brand for collar stays.  Although it is no longer possible to buy the metal stays, but these plastic ones appear to be just as strong, and function the same way.  Magnets are stornfm but small; so take a little care when you remove.

title: Compact and all you need.  It’s what we use in our household.
text: Both hub and I use this design now, so this is to replace one he has used for over 2 years.  Beautifully stitched and holds not only credit and banks cards, but also your licenses.  Compact and no bulge in pockets or take much space in a handbag.

title: Everyone should get them.
text: My husband loves this brand.  Although they have moved from metal to very stiff plastic.  That aside, the plastic stays work just as well as the metal ones.  They act like if you have buttoned down collars.  The magnets are very strong no stay all day.  Only be careful as the magnets are small and not fun looking for them on the floor!

title: comfortable softness
text: very stretchy and comfortable.  definitely a lounge feel as support is low.  then again,  I'm less of a fan of underwired bras these days.  material feels very soft and comfortable against the skin with no running.  size was perfect and no need to size up.

title: Very comfortable
text: The top is fitted, but very comfortable.  Material is thick, which is great for colder weather.  The bottoms are made of much thinner material, which I hope doesn’t tear as easily through wear and tear.  Lovely combo and great for winter wear.  I am looking at getting another combo.  Nice job for the price.

title: not stretchy enough for large cranium
text: the material is stretchy polyester.  easy to cold wash and does not shrink.  that said, if you have a large cranium - it is too small without feeling overwhelming constriction.  colors of material is decent, but not anything 'fancy'.

title: lovely sweater for coming cold spell
text: i love baggy sweaters.  a medium is a gentle fit, a large is loose. but the  XL is perfectly baggy without looking whelming.  Looks great with any bottoms be they be jeans or leggings.  Love the color of the item.  washing is cold water, gentle spin and of course use fabric softener.  did not need to iron it after air dry.  very well made and does have softness even though it is not made from merino wool.

title: 4.5 - absent a loop handle
text: For the price point: shockingly good umbrella. It has a super strong frame and tackled a blustery day that often kill cheap umbrella.  This umbrella held up.  Thumbs up.  Only thing that we wished it had was a loop handle.  Whilst it is compact-  2 small people.  Otherwise, it does provide amble coverage and contracts into a compact size.  Appreciate the button pops open and closes the umbrella.

title: Good stretch
text: Not as soft as some others, but still soft enough.  Nice big stretch even for large cranium.  I love wearing these when I am working out whether aerobics, yoga or strength training.  Also when I am having a bad hair day.  Love that they are wide as well.  Cold wash keeps the stretch and strength.

title: Great support - more firm. Comfortable and easy to take off after a sweaty workout.
text: I love this cooperation.  The sports bra gave great support - more than medium in my opinion.  I tested it on a treadmill run and really had no issue as it was comfortable and did the job.  In fact it was more comfortable than some of my high support and running bras.  Very thick material and just enough stretch - easy to take off after a sweaty workout.

title: Stretches and stays comfortable with large cranium.
text: Stretches well that it remains comfortable with a large cranium.  With so much working out from home from spinning, strength and yoga: does it what I was looking for - sweat and keeps my hair away from my face.

title: unisex and comfortable
text: These are unisex and were comfortable to walk around in.  none of the material rubbed against the skin to cause any blisters.  love the straps are adjustable for the size of the foot.  Stylish and flexible enough to allow for some bend as you walk.  very happy with these sandals.

title: unite wear - even works for us shorties
text: We were pleasantly surprised that this robe was a great fit if you are 5 feet and 5inches... both length [length was not dragging on the floor for us shorties] and the no need tp roll up the sleeves.  It was thin enough not to bulk up your frame and still provide adequate warmth for non-humid seasons.  soft, but not luxury soft.  What a great value for everyday wear.  unisex wear.

title: Love the material, the fit, no riding up the thighs.
text: No need to upsize as the material is very generous around the tummy.  Didn’t cling tightly on my thighs: very comfortable and it didn’t ride up my thighs when I am exercising on my bike.  Very thin material, just throw into cold watch and dries super fast.

title: Comfortable and great quality material
text: I discovered CK’s bras in past 12 months: super comfortable and love the softness of the material.  This bra is light support and great for C cups.  Just impressed with the quality of the material, which I hope they will not compromise on in the future.  Just love.  Cant go back to wired bras ever.

title: Comfortable, great material. Light support.
text: It does stretch and still does the light hold.  I thought it was too small, and to my surprise, the material dis stretch Ning I am going to break the strains, and then the material retracted to hold.  It is. Light hold and provides no coverage for the N.  So be aware what you wear on top.  Very comfortable. The lower band didn’t fold under my babies.  I have recently started buying a bunch of CK’s bras, and I am impressed with the material, design and overall comfort.  Fit to size.

title: bitter effect, perfect fit even for wide feet
text: The material has 'glitter' effect - so not plain.  That said, as I have wide feet and usually have to up a size - NO need here.  the fit was perfect and accommodated my wide feet too.  as with any wedged shoes ,these are meant for a lot of walking.  great for the summer and probably last me a few seasons.  seems like a sturdy made shoe, but wear and tear will depend on how much walking you do.

title: Supported, no bunions after 40 mins walking on concrete pavement
text: More comfortable than I expected.  Walked around in urban jungle of concrete pavement for over 40 minutes..no blisters, good cushioning, and the buckles allow you adjust for feet width.  With bunions, still supported.  For fun summer comfort shoes, I recommend

title: Less slippage with yoga poses even when using a yoga mat.
text: I am a size 39/8.5 US..and these socks were comfortable and soft.  Tried them in a yoga session at home, along with a yoga mat..certainly less slipping around in doing the poses.  Easy cold wash and no shrinkage.

title: Perfect for lounging in the summer
text: Summer wear: thin material.  Length is long and we had to put in a little sewing to shorten the length.  Very comfortable fit and feel.  With 45% polyester, no need to iron after wash and we expect a bit more durability than if 100% cotton.  Feels like cotton though.

title: fab for the colder weather run.
text: These gloves are for the colder weather as it has added padding.  The touchscreen works and it will stop me having to take my hand out in the cold.  I like there is a clip that holds both gloves together - wouldn't be lost in the running drawer!  I have a number of this brands products, especially for yoga: love their quality. always.  you can also use these gloves outside of running too - very sleek and stylish.

title: Very comfortable and good support
text: Love the thick straps.  Very comfortable overall, and ample support. Very easy to stretch and out on.  Stylish and quality is excellent .  I have moved away from underwired bras, and this one is by the best in terms of comfort and style.

title: Extremely comfortable, plenty of support.
text: Very comfortable in deed.  I moving towards comfort as my primary criteria for choosing bra. Love this gives me enough support without discomfort of underwire. Ample coverage.  Nice thick shoulder straps.  I may indeed to buying more of this bra.  Fit as described.  Definitely good for C cup wearers.

title: The best brand on the planet for quality.
text: My favorite brand, home from home. Great to see this brand on amazon.  The quality of their underwear and sleepwear is excellent, and much I have tried the local brands: I revert back to this brand.  Thanks to family who can gift me my annual refresh batch!  Love this sleepwear, comfortable and I should have down sized as it was ample.  Looks smart and thin, great for spring and summer weather.

title: Great running shorts
text: Great running shorts and very much in line with other brands I have.  Very comfortable. I would say size wise, it is closer to smaller than comfortable.  Double lined. Love it.

title: Great brand, perfect for running shoes
text: Quality of the laces and applications: fab.  I hav eco vetted all my running shoes with these no-tie laces. Super easy to apply and to use once on.  I no longer have to worry about loose laces during a run, or workout.  A great brand.

title: Will be great for long runs
text: Another brand of socks, much more expensive that I use for running.  These are literally identical and tad more affordable.  Took them out for a little jog, comfortable.  The long runs will tell how well they handle blisters and broken toe nails!

title: Fun, good quality socks.
text: Decent thickness - in between dress socks and thermal socks.  Very comfortable at 80% plus cotton.  Love the fun pattern. The elastic is strong.  Will last a few seasons!

title: Solid and fun dress socks
text: Love them.  Dress socks with fun design and colors.  Like that it has high percentage of cotton.  Very comfortable with dress shoes and trainers.  The knit is quite tight and don’t expect any loose tags or bubbles forming.

title: Cooozzzzzy.
text: Oooh I love the cozy softness of the material.  It is large, I would recommend down sizing by one.  I am 5’ 4” and length is well below my knee.  All ready for a cozy winter season and those early mornings when I will feel the cold the most.  Cold wasj]h to void any shrinkage.

title: Looooove the cozy softness.
text: Omg...this is gorgeously soft. For me winter is about flannel aNd soft leggings.  I am so excited for the colder weather.  These fit with little give.  Cold wash to avoid strinkage.

title: Very comfortable, gin like dress socks
text: Sooo cute. Nice, soft and very comfortable with such a high percentage of cotton. Cold wash - kept it shape. Fun wear for Christmas season, my favorite holiday.  It is thin like a dress socks for men..but I am uncertain if I am gonna let hub have all the holiday fun!  Hard to tell,how long the elastic will keep the sock up, but if it lasts a few christmases, I will be happy.

title: Nice looking cosmetic jewelry
text: Jade is a prized Jew;dry wishing upon many with luck and joy.  I was nicely surprised on how large the beads were [often they look big in the pics and ending up being 1/2 the size upon arrival].  The bead is 1/2 inch in diameter.  There is stretch in the bracelet elastic . It comes with a ‘certificate’, but really, real jades are sole in jewelry stores, not on amazon.  Hence, you are buying an item for an aesthetic look. The beads largely have a nice marble look with varied marbling.  One of the nicer beaded bracelets I have seen for a while.

title: Okay if you are more flat chested for cup sizes A and B.
text: There is no support.  The material is thin, and I wouldn’t recommend it to anyone who has cup size of C and above.  Comfortable to wear, but won’t last as long as a high street brand I have [more substantial in terms of the elastic and firmer material].  No coverage for nipple as material is that thin.

title: Favorite brand
text: Favorite favorite brand for men underwear, which I love to borrow from hub [great as summer indoor shorts].  The material is tad thicker than other street store brands.  Love the cloth/patterns.  Very comfortable.

title: Our favorite brand.  Unisex wear!
text: We love this brand and the cotton material is a tad thicker than other street brands.  Yes, I wear my hub’s boxer shorts in the summer, as they are perfect [indoor wear].  Very comfortable and the quality is excellent.

title: Roomy!  Not known brand, but best yoga socks I own.
text: Oooh very comfortable and as a size 8.5 [us] - I do not feel the pinch at the toes even though many of those one size fit all socks.  I have wide feet and getting wider as I get older, and these socks have so much give.  Great grip as I am doing my yoga.  Not a named brand, but it is my most comfortable yoga socks to-date.

title: Great for day to day activities.
text: The body strap has ample extension length for how far you want the bag to lie, or if you have a long body. I only wished it used with softer material.  That said, there is amply space in the main pocket, and I used it to put my compact shopping bags. The putter front pocket is zipped and you can place keys [wished it had a keys hook] or credit cards.  What I love was an open back pocket for a large phone.  I love the cross body bags right now with functional pockets during lock down as I don’t have to keep touching the bag when I go shopping.  Yes the bag is fashionable looking.

title: Grips and grips!
text: Even at home with a yoga blanket over my mat, I am still slipping.  I love these socks with the little grips - feel so much more stable with them.  Feel comfortable whether you are doing an active yoga program or a slow yin yoga.  Happy to be wearing these socks for my practice.  Material seems strong as with one size fits all - the bigger the foot the bigger the stretch!

title: Nice frames, no so much the lenses.
text: These are fun. The frame is what sells it.  I wasn’t into the Lenses themselves - just didn’t seam that clear to me.  You could use the frame for proper lenses.  These will be my fun through it in the beach bag glasses.  Very comfortable and I have a big head.

title: Very pretty, ample wrist space.
text: So pretty, and nice stones and bracelet design. Note that the stones are small, about 0.3 inch in diameter.  Ample space, and I have a small wrist, and i have still have 1.5inch of space without even stretching the bracelet.  The stones are closer to midnight black.

title: minimal and very pretty with the orange color.
text: Very pretty and they are tiny in a good way.  If you like minimal items then these earrings are for you.  They add a lovely pop to my usual soak clothings without making a huge statement.  I changed the back for something a little more substantial to hold the earring.  Very pretty and just what I was looking for.  I have-not noticed any irrational with wearing these earrings for a whole day and in humid conditions - and I am normally sensitive to mental.

title: Best sports related face covering thus far.
text: I like the drawstring adjustment.  The cloth is breathable. Great for running outside or inside.  The material is soft against the face.  What a little negative is that the covering around the neck, I felt too much heat. This will be in nine summer/humid months.  One of the better face covering for sports right now. And I have been trying so many forms so far.

title: Decent for running
text: Whilst protection is decent if you keep a good 6 feet apart...it is one of the better face coverings for running.  I love that it is 100% cotton, although breathing Is aided by the gaps around the lower jaw; just more comfortable when you are sweating and running in humidity.

title: Tubular spandex. Large heads might feel tight.
text: A tubular spandex with no adjustments.  Definitely for adults.  Breathe ability is fine, but the item moved around without some allowance to,adjust.  Not sure what I was quite expecting, but I think I could have made this myself.  And certainly I will need to add adjustment for my running.  I can’t speak to UV protection, but any covering provides some degree.  Useful for walking, but running, not so sure.  If you aren’t sewing this simple cover can work, but I wished there was adjustment.

title: High end and comfortable
text: A medium is more for size 10 feet.  A small is more for 8.5 to 9.5 men size.  Very comfortable and hub was super happy that he has something to wear in the summer.  The buckets are easy to adjust for narrower or wide feet.  Very good product and has a high end feel and look to the women’s Birkenstock.

title: Lovely pop of red.  Not cheap looking
text: It’s pretty and the beads are tiny. I am looking forward  to wearing it with my summer dresses.  Definitely adds a nice bright color and focus when I am wearing black all the time! Nice design, and well made.  Doesn’t look cheap or plastic like.

title: Good enough for indoor wear- size up.
text: Size up if you have wide feet.  For the price point, these made great indoor shoes.  The insole is cushioned and comfortable.  For the amount of walking I do now that we are in lock down, I didn’t get any blisters or rub from the faux leather straps.  Overall comfortable.  And actually quite stylish and nice design for casual wear.  The cushioning gave me good support as I am baling and cooking, constantly on my feet.

title: Comfortable and good stretch.
text: Love the amount of stretch and very comfortable.  We do separate hot wash for the whites and these shirts did not fall out of shape after repeated wash.  Look forward to buying this brand going forward.

title: Super comfortable.
text: I love the comfort of this bra. I have been wearing a similar style from same brand ‘without the bra strap attachment.  Generally, a super comfortable bra, and as a 36C the large is ample.  Great material, design and comfort.  Definitely will get more of this brand/style.

title: Great for general and gym use.
text: These are snug fit and I am not comfortable using these for long distance running Re toes.  However, the snugness is great with gym and spin use.  My feet did not move around in my trainers/spin shoes.  They are very comfortable.  Great brand and quality material.

title: Recommend a down size, still baggy for comfort.
text: Normally wear a medium, and I down sized and still comfortable without over bagginess.  The quality of the material  is great for ambling around at home, so something I wouldn’t wear outside.  Feels comfortable and soft.  Easy cold wash and stays largely in shape.

title: walking and spinning - nice socks.
text:
at first thought the polyester component was concerning, but once I wore it and walked for over 2 hours - it was comfortable with no rub/blisters. these type of socks are supposed to be best for hot/humid weather as cotton will hold onto moisture/ I dont have sweaty feet so can't comment on this aspect.
I also used this for spin classes and it was noticeable more comfortable than my older cotton sports socks. The socks stayed around my foot and didnt notice it sliding in the sock as I am spinning - nice.

title: fit is great and super soft.
text:
for a largely non-natural based fabric I was super surprised how soft this felt to the touch and on my skin. I would not recommend sizing up or down - fits perfectly. I am 36C with average fat content and medium still had ample flow and space.
I love it better than I thought as some items are hot and miss. this one is a keeper - thank goodness.

title: quality is fab and super comfortable
text: strong compression and works for running in 50F+ temperature.  I am not sure where the heat aspect comes into effect.  However, I love the brand and have used many of the running gear.
