Quality is assured and I loved working out with these pants in the gym and in warmer temperature.  Also stays put and does not slide down when I jog/run - critical feature.

title: great quality, strong arms needed
text:
This is a heavier weight umbrella. Hence, the mechanism to open automatically is super smooth. However, final step of pushing the umbrella back was tough if your upper body isnt strong; recommend you use a carpeted floor to help you! That said, the umbrella was sturdy and hence would handle strong winds - not a throw away item!

Very good quality umbrella! maybe more for men and women with strong arms!

title: delivered a lot more than I thought
text: Hands free and I wear it across my body with the strap fully extends [I am medium/36in] and it is total comfortable over a puffy-soft jacket.  there is two main compartments with back pockets with a long extension for keys, and the front has two split pockets that I use one for credit cards.  I wished the inner mesh pocket had an adhesive to close it as I am worried in my haste the credit cards slip out.  Otherwise, good place for key, credit cards, a phone, and compact shopping bag. I love it and I no longer have to carry a shoulder bag/backpack for simple errands and light shopping.  love the color blend - nice shot of spring and trendy in a good way.

title: Solid brand
text: I love the little rubber grip at the back of the socks.  You don’t notice it there, but you notice that it keeps the sock in place!  I wore it all day in my trainers and totally felt comfortable.  Yes, the socks for spring and summers!  Love this brand for quality material.

title: solid quality
text: size up one as it is tighter at the waist.  Otherwise, great pants for active wear/yoga/gentle jogging.  The stretch is great and you hardly feel the material and still get a decent compression.  The material feels good and notably as good quality as some of the big brand names.  Not thick, but a really decent thickness that keeps you snug.  I was impressed overall and would use this for my day to day errands.  I'm a runner, so these wouldn't work for the long runs re wicking the sweat.

title: for kids
text: the title was deceptive and I thought they were for adults.  They are quite thick and soft. definately winter wear.  cold wash did not distort the shape of the socks.  the design is very holiday festive - just wished they were adults sized.  fun to wear as indoor socks too.

title: keeps shape and super soft
text: Thick, but super soft.  Hot wash retained the shape of the undershirt.  Hub loves it as it has a nice stretch and creates a good form under his shirt.  loves the soft feel against the skin, and certainly provides a nice protective layer in the winter months.  This may become the go to undershirts.

title: Super comfortable- not for cold weather activities though
text: Thick and very flexible material. Great for indoor or mild weather outside activities; I tried wearing them for below 32F running- and my legs were frozen for the whole 7 miles run.  That said, very comfortable for most form of activities, and whilst thicker in feel, you don’t heat up in them.  Washed them a few times, but did snag a tiny hole in washing machine, but the hole never expanded.

title: decent leggings
text: I would like to say these are great material, but it did snag in the washing machine and a hole was found.  Otherwise, great workout leggings.  Felt very supported and the waist band held in place and did not roll down during high impact exercise.

title: great design for low impact/yoga
text: great for low impact/yoga type of workout.  I would not recommend this for high impact as it would cause chaffing.  otherwise, very comfortable and the material feels soft to wear.  The fit is comfortable and i like the design as it holds my assets well.  Very solid design and not flimsy at all.

title: Get organized for your trips
text:
We just tried this for our family vacation and whilst I wasn't normally a fan of 'organizing' my clothes - these cubes were super helpful in organizing how much clothes I really needed to bring with me, and upon leaving - it was so much easier to pack. I am converted. There are various cube sizes to meet your clothes packing needs, and amply of shoe bags, which were big enough to hold 2 to 3 pairs of small shoes. I like the TSA clear/thick case.
I am thinking these bags may be useful for organizing my gym gear - I am a convert!

title: good value and will last.
text: Another great collaboration - the material has a nice stretch to give you a fitted but yet comfortable look.  Cold wash and retained its shape and the feel of the material will keep this item is functioning order for many years - good for the environment.  Great day to day wear or for light exercising.  simple, classic and good value.

title: very comfortable and stretch/fitted look
text: Nice fitted product - cold wash and retained its shape.  It has a soft feel and great for day to day wear.  It has a nice stretch to the fabric that gives you a fitted look.  No need to size up.

title: nice beanie for winter
text: Nice slouchy effect even for those with a LARGE head.  Cold wash recommended and it has a soft feel and it is 'thin' [not bulky] even though the beanie has an inner lining.  This beanie is great addition to winter clothings and it looks good.  happy with it.

title: some safety concerns
text: love the top part of the slippers: super soft and the lining keeps my foot warm and not uncomfortably so.  however, the sole is 'inflexible' and sometimes you feel you are shuffling along rather than have a natural flex in your foot as you walk. For safety reason, I would not recommend for elderly and for those who down have strong walking abilities.

title: awfully small for a large.
text: The sizing is so off that the large is more like an extra small.  The material was not soft and dont recommend for the value.  definitely returning this item.

title: Fit for long torso body.
text: Very long- covers your bottom.  I guess it is for a very tall person. Hub is 5’6. Didn’t like the long length.  That aside, decent material and well designed. Shame the length wasn’t detailed as most mediums have worked in the past.

title: Size up.
text: Recommend you size up as I am an 8, and this just fitted-can’t wear socks in them for sure.  Otherwise, very comfortable and nice fleecing to keep your feet warm.  The sole is thick and provides adequate cushioning to walk outside or hard floorings.  Nice material.

title: fun, cheap costume addition
text: I love the Indian's costume wear.  Whilst close up: these earrings are definitely cheap, but from a distance - they are great for fun event.  If you have sensitive skin then these will cause a little irritation if you wear them for more than 10 hours.  They look heavy, but are super light as it is plastic sprayed with gold paint.  I can only assume this will not last that long once the rubbing of the paint will tarnish the final product.

title: effective and nice product
text: slim and we liked the money clip that does hold the notes well.  the material is good, and the minimalist functionality works really well for people who dont like to hold too much in their pockets.

title: hmm, not a good edition to their product line up.
text: we love this brand, and we were curious to try this new product.  hmm, a little disappointing as it was larger and the material was not as good as its other crew t-shirts.  the new under arm feature: basically a cotton based material with some small holes.  Not overly impressed with the new cut - down size one.  We washed it before wearing it and it fells out of shape - baggy.  A little disappointed with this one, and we wouldnt be buying this one again.

title: fun positive mantra.
text: it is a fun bracelet with a positive mantra to remind you that life should be enjoyed, and try not to be taken to seriously. the band is thin threads and the clasp is a small tightening clip.  I would say this is something you wear and not take off, and would last a few months, but not a permanent item.  I gave it as a gift to my family as a little positive reminder.

title: decent hat
text: it is fun hat  and it keeps some warmth but dont count on for winter colds.  The material is decent and after a few cold wash - still holds its shape.  it is a nice looking cap and it is big enough for large fitting head.

title: luxurious and enough flex to get your cards out with ease
text: Hub has started using this product a few months back, and he loves it.  He is super neat as a person and this item just adds neatness to his money pocket!  The leather product is very nice: still hold form and yet has a luxurious feel to it too.  There is enough give/stretch to get your cards and money out.  Great for women too, if you only want to carry a CC/ID or a little money on a quick trip.  This design is so much better than the wall : so less bulky.

title: Super comfortable and flexible.
text: Definitely geared for cold weather, the material is thick, but very flexible.  I ran with this on tread for an hour, and then spinned for 30 mins.  Totally comfortable and material totally removed the sweat without any discomfort. I am looking forward to wearing this in cooler weather of 50F and below.  My inseam is 28in and it reached my ankle.  I am 145lb and medium was a good fit.  Loved these new workout/compression pants.

title: Fun
text: Great for supporting a friend or yourself. The silk band is super thin, and I didn’t love the simple catch to hold the bracelet on.  Could be used as ankle bracelet, which may hold better.  I bought this for myself as a mantra to support myself.  I just need to remember the word! Fun to wear for a period of time you need this support.  Choose the positive mantras/words.  Words are powerful.

title: Hmm, not for running, post run compression-possible
text: For running, no. I am a distance runner, and having tried many socks, these Wouldn’t be great for your feet. To advertise anti sweat- not sure this is accurate.  They are like compression socks, and I would use this post a run, or for errands.

title: nice little gift for young girls: mantra inspirations
text: once you put this one - it does not come off!  but it is is great mantra to were for a marathon or a reminder for you going through something in your life.  I like the idea, and it is a gift that lasts until the thread wears down.  Fun and could be inspirational in some of the messages.  Great little gifts for your girls.

title: functional and beautiful
text: love this new purse - although the coins purse is tighter than my current kate spade purse.  However, it has all the slots for credit cards and notes.  i love the wrist handle and can double this purse as a 'clutch' purse during a casual evening out.  the leather is beautiful and I am very pleased with the purse.

title: great for long walks.
text: there is super cushioning at heal and toes.  i wore this during 3 hours on my feet - walking around doing errands.  total comfort as i have wide feet and toe issues.  i wouldn't wear them for running if you have toes longer than your big toe.  however, given my runner's toe conditions - these socks were comfortable!

title: Active walkers: good support/comfort.
text: The synthetic fleece does not make the feet sweaty at all.  There is some cushion and support on the feet, but if you are active walking around - the support declines.  However, I am a fan of these supported slippers.  The sole of the slippers are easy to clean.  Most of these slippers last about a year before the shape falls apart.

title: Tallest is 2nd toe? Pinched after long run?  Black toe nails?
text: OMG...training for my first marathon and it is mammoth process of trying gears to make sure you minimize pains/body injuries during the long runs.  My 2nd toe is the tallest, and after the number brands of socks to rid of pinched toes/aka black toes/falling off toe nails...THESE SOCKS SAVED my toes/nails.  My 2nd toes are so much happier and I am a happier runner.  As a female with bunions and wide feet- I recommend the men/unisex option.  And if you are running more than 10 miles I recommend medium weight or ultra run socks.  I love these socks.  Now I can focus on the running/training and not the poor toes.

title: Size up one whole size.
text: Runs small, and I ordinarily size up to 8.5Wfor running. Now I just bought 9W for the long distance running.  This is the first time I am trying this brand: I have wide feet due to bunions and your feet widens as you grow older.  I needed to feel supported and comfortable during long runs.  These were great for distances below 11 miles...then the feet expands further in the heat, and I needed some more space.  I wish shoe makers allow for older runners whose feet changes and need shoes to support them.  Otherwise, I am happy with them, and look forward seeing a comfortable difference by sizing up one whole size.

title: size up.
text: size up as this was tight to put on.  That aside I did a run in them and they were comfortable through out, and being white in color, it didnt absorb the heat from the sun, a plus.  also my feet were 'compressed' and that supported not too much rubbing of my toes/damage to nails - which is a runner's delight (not).  This is probably not the brand I would continue to use as an athlete. but i would switch them to use them for traveling and recovery from a long run.

title: Great quality, a tad long though.
text: Love the colors, the comfort, and its 100% cotton.  It was a tad too long, shave off 1 inch then it would be perfect.  The material is really solid and beautiful.  The elastic is strong without being uncomfortable.  Ha, I share them with my husband, it makes a great indoor summer shorts for women!  Impressed with this brand, as we were cautious on the quality.  Yup, we could get more of these in the future!

title: quality is there and a good fit.
text: The material is soft and thick.  it holds its shape after multiple cold wash, it is fitted without being scratchy.  i like the quality of the material and its is very smart looking that works well in informal settings too.  This is one of Amazon's higher quality brand.  very pleased.

title: Compact, small Nd not boxy. Love this gym bag.
text: The quality, design and color are just lovely.  I use this for swim, and it holds an awful lot without bulking up.  Very comfortable to carry on shoulders with shoulder strap or the over body strap.  There is enough pockets- 2 inside [small], one zipped on outside and two at either end on outside.  This aren’t handbag..very functional for the gym. The material is gorgeously thick.  I love this gym bag. If you are looking for something that is ‘small’ and compact..this is the one, and I love the shape, not boxy.

title: Compression running socks
text: Has compression , but not comfortable.  Great grip with my running shoe. Ran a 6+ miles and no rub.  Cold wash recommended to keep its shape.

title: Wow. Love it
text: I love these shorts ! Super comfortable and has some give in the sizing.  Quality is excellent.  Now my new favorite for my runs.

title: quality material.
text: love this new workout top.  Fits as expected and quality of material will ensure multiple washes without looking like it is older than it should be.  takes the sweat off as expected from a HIIT workout.  I am a fan of the quality of Under Amour workout gear.  the material is thin, and hence will air dry super fast.

title: Quality and easy to clean.
text: There is generosity in the stretchy material, but the material is thick and very good quality. Love the design and cut- very professional look or for smart casual event.  This is one of Amazon’s higher quality brand, and I wasn't  disappointed.  Very easy to clean: cold wash and low heat iron.

title: Pretty impressed on so many levels.
text: Love it.  I tried this out on travels and had many deep pockets for travel documents, my e-reader, cell phone, charging wires, tissues.  The center body has a zipper and inside there are another smaller zipped pocket and 2 sub divided areas. On either side [outside] and deep pockets to keep the boarding pass.  I simply loved the look and how many sections.  It hung nicely and because the slight waxed of the material- quick wipe if needed.  Looks lovely too.

title: Great for runs. No rubs/blisters.
text: Oooh, I love these socks. Light compression and super good grip within the shoe that you don’t slip.  Ran a 10K race in them and no blisters or rub: love.  Easy cold wash and retains its shape.

title: smart enough for most activities and light/thin enough for additional layering for running.
text: i would size up if want a slightly looser fit.  However, Marmot is a great and reliable product.  the cut and material are top notch.  I have worn this for both day-to-day activities as well as running outdoors when I need a little layering. This is a smart looking jacket with so many places that you can wear this.  it is super thin and stretchy.  in addition to two deep side pockets there is an inner pocket as well that you can keep your keys or phone.  i love it.

title: best brand for male socks, these are tad softer.
text: love this brand.period. however these are little fancier and feels a tad softer even after a number of washes.  Very comfortable and did not slide about in footwear.  These socks are great for both formal and casual wear.

title: quality was remarkably good.
text: Compression without an issue getting them off and on.  I run and spin regularly and looking for items that are comfortable, takes the sweat and holds its shape with numerous wear.  Love them.  very soft and yet flexible in all leg motions.  Cold wash and retains its shape.  This one is a big thumbs up for Starter Women's brand.  the quality was good.

title: nice design, but material was a little too thin
text: the material is thin and is a loose fit, and given its design, i would down size one for a slightly fitted look.  the material is thin and a little see through.  washed well in cold water, but I am not sure this top will last more than one year.  very casual look and I would rather use it for my indoor workouts and general tasks: not for anything fancy.,

title: day to day low impact activities - no issue
text: very comfortable with a slight rippling effect - two tone of the mesh and opaque material.  i like that the length of the top covers the rear end - but i do have a short body relative to others.  it is comfortable and naive design that I am happy to wear it as part of my day to day low impact activities.  as a running top - not so much as it is not fitted unless you down size.  there are other better tops for running than this one.  this is another of Amzon's brand, but at the lower end compared with Amazon essential.  i rather go with the essential brand.

title: short legs didn't stat put.
text: I got these for spinning classes - and whilst they sweep up the sweat that is coming from all over the place - what was a tad annoying is that the shorts curled up my legs.  I had crafting of my skin.  it happened a couple of times during the 45 minutes high intensity ride.  that aside, I love the material, design and fit of the shorts.  Maybe better for running.

title: the grips at the bottom - a winner
text:
i love the grips at the bottom of the socks - minimizes any slipping in your shoes. these are greta for running and totally comfortable. i never thought some grip with the show would make a difference - it has.

solid design and material, and cold wash keeps the socks in shape/elasticity. I love them for running.

title: best quality product out there.
text: this replaced another non-branded and this is slightly bigger for the cards and hence it was easier to pull out the cards.  the material was better than the other non-brand and it kept its shape better and longer.  We have noticed of late that Amazon brands are very reliable and we have been impressed with this item.  we noted that the plastic overing the cards area provides protection against any mobile scan of the cards.  we couldn't test if this was true, but we like to hope that Amazon does not make these alias likely.

title: great with slim fitted shirts
text: ha, this feels silky smooth and not the usual cotton version that hub wears.  it was very comfortable and he loved the smooth feel against the skin.  it is a great brand, that was washed in the hot wash with his other cotton tees, no shrinkage and kept its shape.  it is pricy, but it was a good addition to other cotton tees, especially if you wear slim fitted shirts

title: Fabulous leggings that kept it shape
text: Wow.  The material is quality and solid.  Not thin at all, and not overtly thick.  Very comfortable and well made.  I was surprised how well the leggings kept their shape with all day wear.  Very smart pair of pants.  Washed in cold water with no stretch and no loss of shape.  Super soft and comfortable to wear.  Size wise is completely on point.

title: Love the rain cover!
text: Plus plus.  I,love this bag, as it is super light.  Whilst it has two main sections like another other backpack:  I love the thoughtfulness of the pockets, both inside and outside, the ability to hold a yoga mat on the outside that I use for holding the walking sticks, the extra key holders, the bottle holders.  I looove the rain cover as it keeps your contents dry at all times! And it is conveniently stored in its own pocket.  Not only great to use for day hikes, I am using for my errands.  Super comfortable on the shoulder blades, even though the shoulders pads are not that thick.

title: Couldn’t be happier.
text: Amazon has been coming out with their own branded workout wear, and this is probably their higher end one.  I love it. The material has enough compression to support my workout, holds enough sweat that I don’t notice when I am working out.  Great to wear outside of workout too.  Highly recommend this product and great value from Amazon.

title: Soft, cozy and comfortable
text: Super soft and comfortable.  Great for weekend wear and especially with the cold winter weather.  Did not rub against the feet, no blister after a long walk [4+ miles].  Washed in cold water and retained elasticity.

title: Great product!another amazon brand
text: Competes well with known running pants.  Fits well, material is solid and well constructed.  Running with them was very comfortable and I love them.  Wash well in cold water with no lost of elasticity and stretch.

title: Quality is up there with those high street brands
text: I have tiedm numver of Amazon essentials and this t-short does not disappoint in terms of quality of the fabric, design and cut.  Very comfortable to wear and soft to the touch.  Just great for day to day wear and cold wash keeps the shape.  Genuinely impressed with the product.

title: Quality is great
text: The quality of the product is pretty good. It is a heavier jacket and does buffer the cold winds.  A little too heavy for running jacket, but in some extreme cold this jacket will do the trick.  Enough room to wear a thick sweater.  Ease of arm mobility is great.  Never thought an Amazon product could be this good.  I took this on a sea trip, and it did a better job than a thick wool coat.

title: Very practical and can take a hit with cold/winter weather
text: These pants have ample of slack at the thigh area, and then tapers below the knee to the ankle.  The inseam is 32 inches, but it is very easy to helm it up [which I had to], and the side zippers still work.  The material is thin , but was able to withstand the cold windy winter weather.  Definitely will be great for running, or any other door pursuits.  The one thing I didn’t love about the design is the front is split with a diagonal panel.  Because I have short legs, the panel/stitching hits my knees, and it becomes a focus as I am walking around.  If you are tall, this panel will hit your thighs and you will unlikely to notice it.

title: Comfortable.  Quality
text: The material is high quality and thin that I love to wear with my flats.  I wore them all day when I knew I would be on my feet.  My feet loved me for them.  Comfortable, no rub and definitely felt the calves were supported.  Look forward to trying these on air travel.

title: Great pants.
text: Love.  Material is soft, stretchy and design gives you a slim profile.  Very comfortable and I am not aware of any bulkiness around th epocket area.  Cold water wash and pant still holds it shape, and I didn’t have to iron afterwards.  Amazon essentials are great value in the clothing line,,this is not my first item.

title: Really nice time for price point.
text: I am impressed with many of Amazon Essential products.  The design and fit are pretty good.  The material is stretchy, soft and confortable to wear with decent thickness.  I really like this top which I can wear for workouts or just as active wear.  Washes easily in cold wash with no strinkage.  Thumbs up from me.

title: Slim fit look and super comfortable
text: Love these pants!  The material is soft, stretchy, strong, and not thick,  Washed not in cold water with no strinkage.  I didn’t even have to iron.  Very slim fit and comfortable.  There are are packets,but they don’t show.  I am really surprised with the quality of these pants.  They fit to size.

title: Impressed with the quality of this Amazon basic!
text: Love the color and the material is so soft.  I love the quality.  I would downsize to small if you are a comfortable medium.  But if you like layers then this jacket will comfortably accommodate.  I wished they offer ‘petite’ as the sleeves are long for me.  I purchased this in Black Friday sale: great value at that price point.

title: Loved it for indoor spinning
text: Love this basic shorts- long enough not to get chaffed on a spin bike.  I sweat heavily when I spin, and the material takes care of the sweat thta I don’t notice until I peel it off me.  The material is similar to compressed pants at gap.  The fit is comfortable all around and noticed no tightness around the stomach area.

title: Perfect for running shoes.
text:
Perfect to try on my new Reebok running shoes [voted best for long distance running]. And I love them! Why? The coaches always tell you to make sure your laces are tight before a run, so these were tight through out my training. The elasticity was perfect to allow for my feet to expand as it warmed up and expanded during the run. So easy to adjust and I am still readjusting to get my perfect fit.
Whilst the instructions on the web site were perfect, the laces were a wee bit large for some of the holes, I had to snip the shoe hole, a bit to allow the lace to come through.
I am all set for my runs now without worrying about the laces or stopping to tighten them up.

title: Wow, super impressed for outdoor running.
text: I am training for a marathon, and the winter weather is severe and often outdoors training is often a miss for indoor treadmill.  So I tested this pants during a 32f cold winter morning and went for a 3 mile jog.  Hugely impressed with how much it cutout the wind chill and yet I was very mobile to run/jog.  The knees are not fully sealed so allows for air/heat circulation tat kept it very comfortable to run in.  The pants are light and Craft is a hugely popular brand for extreme weather sports.  I am so grateful to find something I can wear for my legs, which previously were the reasons I don’t run in cold weather.  Now there is mono excuse.  These pants are also great for commuting if you live in cold cold cold temperature.  I can see myself trying these if I had to trek out for any reason other than for running.  Hell, it may be time to head out to the ski slopes sooner than later.  Very versatile pants.

title: For the price point: great value and works as designed.
text: Very comfortable and material is closer to the compression material in Gapfit’s goods.  It does not have a cotton feel. Absorbs sweat well and it is continues to feel dry as you work out.  I can work out for over an hour [spinning] and you don’t realize the sweat until you take it off.  I note that the medium’s inseam is inch shorter than the large size!

title: Oooh so soft and functional
text: Super soft. Washes and retains its shape and softness.  It is not itchy at all.  I love this wrap and I wear it with coat or a smart casual suit.  It can be used formally or informally as it is thin, not heavy, yet effective.  The color is pretty and warm.  Impressed for the price point.

title: Simple basic shorts for daily use.
text: For this price point : the short does the job.  It does not have a soft rayon feel, but smooth enough to hold its form.  The material isn’t thick and the legs did rise a little when I used it for spinning.  Not compression shorts, but did the job I need it for.  Nice design and certainly comfortable and no need to,size up like other brands.

title: good Conception, poor execution
text: Hub loved this minimalist wallet. He never carries a wallet as it just adds to the bulk, and since he does not carry that much cash on him this worked brilliantly.  Carried most of the cards he needed from credit card, atm, medical and ID.  Could have done with an extra slot.  Took a couple of days to get used to, but since he is super organized person: this did the job well!  The material is surprisingly strong and the stitches holds the form well.  Definitely expected this wallet to last a while:  well, it doesn’t.  After a few weeks in, hub noticed the wallet was starting to warp a bit.  Disappointing, and hence star reductions.  Good concept, poor execution.

title: Love them for my runs.
text: These socks run up above mid calve.  The compression is a plus for any runners or walkers.  I noticed how comfortable my feet were held during the 3 mile run.  Held a good grip to the trainers, no slippage.  The material is comfortable on the skin.  My feet doesn’t sweat so I can’t commnet if the socks provide adequate support in that area.  With all active wear, I wash in cold water to avoid deterioration of the material.  I am inclined to start running with compression socks in the future.

title: Decent skirt and adequately cover the bottom!
text: I am not a big on bikini wear person and have always found the bottom part a little more revealing than I like.  This is a great alternative!  The fit is comfortable and the skirt provides decent amount of coverage.  I am a medium in most of my ‘active’ wear.  The color is vibrant and not neon light flashy!  The material is good and not untypical of any beach wear material.  With the color, I wouldn’t be unnoticed by hub!

title: Super flexible.
text:
What I love about this legging is that it is super flexible for running, spinning, floor exercises. The material,is not what I am used to, but it dries super quick. It definitely removes the moisture and you don’t feel it. For treadmill running, I noticed the legs were warm, which would only assist in cold weather running. I wouldn’t wear these in the summer when I am running outdoors. Good for indoor exercises.
It was a very comfortable large, as I am 155lb, and it was little loose around the thighs. I would go down one size if you like them closer to the skin.

title: Super soft, something to bring on plane/cinema.
text: Super soft and it isn’t heavy or thick [even though the description indicates thick].  Washed in cold water and softness and shape were not compromised.  I wouldn’t wear it without a coat unless it is a light coat.  Decent length to have a good wrap around with out falling off the shoulder all the time.  Definitely pack it on a plane or cinema/theatre.

title: Smart and beautiful design.
text: I have wide feet and it often means I have to size up by half or one.  I didn’t need to size up here.  I love the brand, the shoe is comfortable.  The design is posh and I love the shine on it.  Wears smart with thin black trousers and a blazer.  So comfortable to,wear for hours.

title: Female with big head- perfect for sports/running
text: I am female with a big head, and this cap fits comfortably and with an adjustable adhesive holder to keep the cap on.  I use this when I am running and when I don’t want to wear shades.  The quality of this cap surpassed my expectations- good design and quality material.  And no sports team logo! Ha.

title: Great shape and softmaterial.
text: The shape is perfect in where it hangs, and I am a little busty for my body.  The marterial is super soft and washing in cold water keeps the top’s shape.  The length is just below my hip-can be worn out or in, either way it looks great.  Pretty impressed with the overal design and material. Recommend.

title: Great socks!
text: I am really impressed with many of the amazon branded products.  The brand is moving into clothings and I love my socks t be thick and support my feet as I walk a lot and run as well.  I like to have pairs of socks that are multi functional.  These socks are yummy and I love the cozy feel.  Washed well and hold their shape.

title: Impressed with the quality and softness: unisex.
text: I take 29 inch inseam and these were bout 31 inches, not a huge drag.  I LOVE the feel of these sleep pants, are for me, they re pretty unisex as far as I was concerned.  I would size down if you are a female purchasing for self.  Super soft fabric and I just love lounging in them.  For the value these are the best lounge pants.  Washing them they do not loose their shape or softness.

title: Good quality socks.
text: The material and comfort are undisputed.  I tried these socks on a hike and there were no blisters!  However, the way the socks are designed they are ‘fitted’ and my feet didn’t fit the shape completely and noticed my feet slipped in the socks a little.  I would have preferred a snug fit.  Otherwise, the socks kept their shape after multiple wash.

title: totally reliable and great quality.
text: material is top notch, and retains it shape after wash.  These are long socks!  super light and comfortable for even humid weather.  very classy look and great for work.  We have so many Gold Toe socks and they are totally reliable.  a family stable!

title: Thin material, but decent cut: younger person wear.
text: Not a high end shirt, the material is one the thin side, but as to cut and fit, it wasn’t bad.  this shirt is for more younger men, and not for business casual unless you wear a tee underneath.  I wanted to mark this higher, but the thin material did speak of the quality of the clothes offered on this site.

title: Wide fit, don’t need to upsize!
text: If you have wide feet like me, you probably need to upsize by half for any trainers.  This brand and this trainer need not upsize, and there was plenty of toe room,  totally comfortably for my wide feet.  I broke these shoes on a 4mile run...and I love them!  There was definitely cushion as my thighs were not aching as much!  New balance is a great brand, he material is solid, no complaints.  Seriously moving my brand loyalty for my running.

title: Lovely socks,
text: These are thick socks, and if you are looking for cushion then these are it.  I am used to high impact exercises, and these socks provide great support.  Also, if you have cold winters, these socks are terrific too. The quality of the material is very good too. I have machine washed them a few times now, and they retain their shape and elasticity.  Love them, and note there is a little logo on top back, but it is hardly noticeable as the thread is dark grey.

title: Quality waterproof, and comfortable
text: Marmot is great brand for outerwear, and we have a few heavy weight coats.  The design and quality of material do not fail to do the job.  We used it in heavy rain and snow: trousers were kept dry.  It did not cause any condensation/sweating when in use.  Very comfortable.  Definitely fit was as described, not too big, but room to fit in jeans.  Super happy for the snow ridden winter!

title: Great product.
text: Comfortable, feels like cotton with spandex stretch!  The material is very good, as is the design, the fit is great.  The collar is button down and a little loose, but not noticeable.  Pretty impressed with the overall product!

title: Great leggings.
text: Surprisingly comfortable, good design and no loose areas.  Inseam is 30 inches,and easy to hem.  Material has a little texture that feels like jeans.  The leggings hugs the body nicely, and I love it.  For this price point, this is a decent buy!  The material does not feel cheap, and it is not thin either, so nice for cooler weather for sure.

title: Great comfy socks..
text: Super comfortable and super soft.  Was surprised given the price point.  Hub loves them for weekend wear.  He is a fussy dresser, and quality is key.  The material is thick, good quality, and no itchy feel.  The color/pattern is much better in the flesh, so to speak.  Impressed.

title: Simply love.
text: For games of throne fan, my husband loved it.  Perfect fit, washed well (cold wash) with no shrinkage and no peeling of the print.  Great gift for any male fans.  The material is good quality, and held its shape.  The print is nice too, and not gaudy.

title: Very pleased.
text: So well designed, made, and great quality material.  I was impressed, and it fits so well, as I am a busty 36, 5 foot 4. Sleeves slightly long, but not a deterrent or unsightly.  It is quite thick, so I am not sure I would wear this as running jacket in temperature above 65F, but I have been wearing it in between my gym classes, and home.  Love the design of tucking in the hood in the neck of the jacket, and I have large head, and found the hood very functional.  Decent pockets with depth and can hold keys, and 9 inch cell phones.  I look supper chic with this jacket.  One wish would be a double zipper.

title: Beautifully made, for many seasons.
text: Ha, I am female, and ordinrilynwear size medium and large as bust is relatively larger.  The small fitted perfectly.  Love the design, the material is gorgeous with sheen/soft feel, but does not show up as ‘shiney’.  The quality of the workmanship is solid, not cheap. There is decent amount of layering in it that it would work well in spring/fall season, or cooler evenings.  You put it on, and you feel I am wearing something well made: something you will keep for years, not a few season.

title: Comfortable.
text: Not thick. Good elasticity and nice liner for every day trainers/shoes.  Very comfortable, kept feet cool, and no sweats.  No rubs on feet. There is a little show, but not huge amount.

title: Love totes
text: We are veterans of this brand, and no strangers to the auto open next close functionalities.  Wide and strong material, ample of,one person,and certainly can squeeze in two people if in emergency.  Great product.

title: Great design and love the material
text: Super comfortable, and did the job.  I felt no pinch, and material is decent quality, soft and pliable.  I really like this one, as the cup was generous, and well sized.

title: Super comfortable.
text: Would recommend half size up, otherwise, these shoes are super comfortable, good material, and good design.  I have few pairs of different brands, and I am super happy with it.  I have wide feet, and there is plenty room and didn't feel any tightness.

title: Beautiful sleek  design.
text: Design wise, completely sleek, bold and sleek.  I love it.  The leather is little tough, but I expect it will soften over time.  Time keeping is prefect.  I have never heard of Skagen, now I consider them upfornt with many of the high fashion brands.

title: Love this organizer
text: Amazonbasics keeps surprising me on how functional the product is, and keep the quality of the item high.  Love this organizer, and ample for two people.  I have been looking high and low for something functional.  Finally, the search is over.  Ample of pockets for various documents, and credit card slots, pen holder, and outside pocket deep enough for plane tickets/docs.  Great zip to keep every thing secure.  There is Lao finger loop that keeps it in your hand as you travel though security.  Should last me this lifetime. ;)

title: Wished we knew about these earlier!
text: Great product, love that shoes have their own bags, we previously used plastic carrier bags.  Can slip in two small shoes or flip flips in one bag.  Quality is good!

title: Great idea, little execution issue.
text: My husband uses a magnetic collar stay, which pulls the collar to the shirt.  He missed that with this one, and he noticed that if you push too hard to put the collar stay into the collar, then it collapses and shortend, defeating the objective of this collar stay for every occassion.  Great concept for sure, but need a little adjustment in the design?

title: Pretty amazing support for tired feet. Cozy
text: I would recommend sizing up. I am ordinarily 8, and the 8.5 to 9 fitted prefectly lengthwise.  The material,is good quality, and there was a lot of give on the width as I have wide feet.  The cushion afforded on these slippers was pretty good, especially on hard flooring like tiles and wood.  Felt more drag when walking on carpet.  Cozy in the winter, but doesn't heat the feet up during long wear.  The bottom is rubber like , which is great for me when I cleaning the kitchen floor.

title: Wish they kept the TSA in built lock.
text:
We love the Delsey brand. We already have the previous generation of carry on, and although the design is very similar there were few changes, and one not for the better..where did the TSA built in lock go? This means if you end up checking in this piece of luggage, you will need your own lock, or have nothing in there that you value like dirty laundry! Hence, my one less star.

Otherwise, love the smooth movement of the wheels, 360 degrees turn, love there is soft cover over one side, and there is an expansion zip. Although I wouldn't recommend if treated as carry on. Very light in deed, and nice design.

title: Nothing fancy, great for work.
text: Not supersoft cotton fee, but comfortable,  elastic was adequate, not tight.  Thin material, and yet comfortable in shoe.  For the price, these are decent dress socks for work.

title: Love tote, great addition, great quality.
text: Definitely great coverage for compact umbrella of this size, and highly recommend.  Tad heavy , but the auto open mechanism is great.  Love tote for its quality and we expect this umbrella to last a while.  Easy for two people to sit under in, which is important for us>..and easier to handle than golf umbrella...

title: Great coverage, and love the auto mechanism...
text: Love the tote brand.  This one did not disappoint at all.  Very large surface area, which I like the coverage.  The auto pop open and close works great. The umbrella is a tad heavy versus another tote umbrella.  Love the material too.  Faminine and practical too.

title: Super soft
text: Surprisingly loved it, very soft even though it doesn't advertise it as such.  Wash under hot water does not shrink material.  For orce, great value

title: slimming, material was comfortable enough to be breatheable.
text: They do not cling, and have decent space that during these humid and hot summer months that I was not feeling uncomfortable in them.  Still very slimming.  the material is little odd, not necessarily in a bad way: not quite polyester-cotton.  I like the zip at the ankle as it helps to pull trousers over any footwear!  washed in cold water and did not shrink and the trousers kept their shape as well.

title: the qaulity is great.
text: great quality and nice clasp, you never know these days. Very pleased when it arrived and fast delivery.

title: great quality piece of jewellery.
text: solid heart, good material, and nice design -not at all gawky and cheap.  the chain has two length settings one at 18 inches and one at 20 inches.  for the price and not being sure about the quality: I was nicely surprised.

title: Super light, super design, looove the brand with the expansion zip.
text: Love this brand, and it has extra zip expansion to give it a wee 1 inch plus extra stretch! Plus plus are the great 360 wheels, which just makes moving around with a full case a joy! The case is incredibly light so it is not weighing in heavy before you put your clothes in.  Both sides are equal in depth, before expansion.  One side has a net cover and the otherside has the braces to hold in the clothes/items.  Love the color and design and makes it super easy to spot in the luggage claim in the airport.  No denting so far. Has tsa locks

title: Perfecto.
text: Beautiful piece,and great size..not too small and not too big.  Quality is very good too.

title: Soo pretty and sure sparkles.
text: So pretty and so full of sparkles. I love it!  Delicate and lovely design. It is not tacky looking at all. I love these drop down diamond ear rings.  The picture does not do these earrings justice.

title: great product and roomy
text: great for a james bond theme party with replacing the flag with a British one.  very roomy.  we will use it again for another party, not cheap materal and very sturdy.

title: Love the face and design of this watch
text: the face of the watch and the size are beautiful.  Sharp and bold design, which I love.  the leather strap is okay, wish it looked less 'plastic-like' and I hope once it gets worn in that it looks more authentic!  some new fossil watches requireid new battery replacement, but not on this new watch.

title: Great buy
text: Love these shoes, super comfortable and looks great with jeans!

title: Great for support when running.  Firm support.
text: I am a 36c, and it was more of a snug fit with the medium, and not loose looking like the picture.  The material is a lot firmer and thicker and the bra hold is very good.  For use with yoga and running are both great.  There is a lot of flexibility with the top with yoga stretches.  Very comfortable.  Actually, I like the firmer feel of the whole top and not flimsy.

title: Bold and light. Deceptively light.
text: I expected a heavier and more weighted watch, I was surprised how light it is.  Nice to see that straight out of the box, the battery was working.  AdjustING the wrist band was horrendously hard with a watch kit.  You will need to go to a watch shop to get some help there.  Esthetically, it is not a bad looking watch, with the face moderately large, but not the large trendy sized one.  It is bold enough to stand out and looks great at work.

title: Beautiful watch, quality feel and boldy unique
text: Love the style of this watch.  It was working out of the box as there was a small plastic that was placed in the Crown that u have to pull off for the watch to run.  Simple to change the time, with an inner second dial.  Have good heavy feel, not flimsy lightness.  The quality of the watch feels good for the price point.  Very beautiful face and lovely links, which was fairly easy to adjust with a watch kit.  I am ordinarily a big fan of Kate spade and fossil, now this is a new brand than I will follow.

title: great watch if not for the back piece ..
text: i like kate spade's design, and the wrist band can be adjusted.  the only annoying thing, but big is that the battery arrived dead, and whilst I have changed batteries before, the damn back will not go back in easily.  otherwise, I would like to say this is a nice watch with a large face without the bulk or loosing the feminine touch.

title: lovely stones and off setting the 'blackish' metal
text: the metal is actually more 'blackish' than silver.  none-the-less, love the firmness and flexibility of the metal at the edge, coz if you have a small wrist like mine, you will need to bend the metal around your wrist to make it work.  the stones are opaque and beautifully off sets the metal.  great piece to wear with dark and simple dress.  lovely piece and not overtly heavy looking ,or too delicate.  [the picture does not give the correct metal coloring].

title: Quite a little travellers bag
text: Great for travelling.  There are three zipped compartments, two at the front and one tucked to the side.  The sling strap can be adjusted so you can either sling is across either shoulder.  I wished the main compartment had double zips like the small front pocket.  I like the side pocket where u can put in your important documents like passport and travel papers.  The sling can be adjusted for length.  Very sleek design, and beautiful material.  In busy metropolitan cities, I have the backpack in front of me, and it still looks fine.  Helps to be flat chested to carry this bag well.

title: nice simple and small faced watch, love the rose color option.
text:
The watch is pretty on its own or with a combo of the two bangles. the color rose is actually a very pretty medal alternative to silver or gold. the watch actually worked on arrival [past eperiences with watches that the batteries are often dead and have to be replaced before you can even us it!]. in fact the time was set correctly for our time zone! all three items have simple extension bands that you can manually remove a few links if you need a tighter fit. there is no need for any watch tools to remove the links. if you like a delicate small face watch this is defiantely an option and Ann Klein often have simple and yet nice designs. nice to have the options to combine many of the different bangles and watch together.
also excellent as a gift, as i was impressed with the presentation box, as many modern brands come with poor presention option if you wanted to gift a watch. [fossil: poor; kate spade: good]

title: tight around the crotch ...
text: surprisingly, the slim line and cut were pretty good, and the material was solid, not thin at all.  The only negative is that the waist line sits low and a little tight about the crotch that from the back, the material pulls in and up.  hmm, not attractive.  if the bottom area was a little looser or a little more material then this would be a super pair of khaki.

title: Love my new dressy watch
text: In person, this is a great watch, love the large watch face and very classy.  I had to buy a watch repair kit to adjust the straps, which was an easier process otherwise.  Looked at a very simliar wath as Kate spade, but really happy with the large roman numerals.

title: Feminine, delicate and beautiful design and stones.
text: Very pretty with the stone design.  It is larger than I usually wear, but the stones are beautiful against the silver heart frame.  The chain is decent, but I wish they have a larger clasp and not these tiny clasp that can be frustrating to put on.  Otherwise, a very delicate design and feminine.  The length is not long and falls just 3 inches below my neck, worked well with a low  neck line dress/top.

title: pretty and practical.
text: love the quality and that it is a bit thick as it cushions my feet all day whether for walking or running.  love this brand too.

title: Well designed compartments and good for check in or overhead.
text: Zips and compact mens galore.  It took a wee moment  to figure out all the zips and compartments.  All compartments are well thought out.the main  compartment has ample space for some serious 3 to 4 days of light clothings.  Second main compartment is for lap tops and pencils etc.  Two side pockets that I will find handy for an umbrella. The straps for the backpack can be hidden away behind a zipped section, very helpful if u check in this  backpack.  Yes,there is a little backpack that you can zip off and use for holding monies and travel documents.  Very well thought through and very comfortable and padded shoulder straps.  Size will work for overhead too.  Material appears string with good and strong stitching.

title: Wonderful support and very comfortable
text: Amazing comfort, the support was great for a strapless.  The elastic was ver comfortable and did not dig into the skin.  In fact, the built was so comfortable that there were no rubs on the skin.  The cup is larger in that it covers the twins a lot more, about 80%.  I like that especially if you are wearing not so opaque tops and shirts.

title: Smooth contours, and super comfortable. .
text: Very comfortable.  There seems to provide ample support and at no point on this bra did it rub into the skin.  The support is great and provides fine contour with no bulges.  Definitely fits as expected.  I was surprised how comfortable it was as a strapless and it did not slide or not support.  Coverge is more like 65%, and did not show overage!  I tried the bra on a sticky day, and totally comfortable.

title: decent dress socks for feel and quality
text: Just the right thickness for dress socks.  The feel is not bad, not super soft, and not rough. not bad value for 5 pais of socks.

title: delicate and beautifully crafted.
text: These are beautifully structured and the clasp is solid too.  I wasn't expecting the great design, both back and front of the drop earring.  They are  not large and look delicate, and sparkle nicely against the light.  Not dull in appearance.  I surprised how nice this jewellery looked.

title: Super modern look, well made, good material, to be expected from Kate Spade
text: I am already a big fan of Kate Spades hangbags, wallets and delicate jewellery. .and an opportunity to try this modern watch was atreat.  Very light, the bling is not too overt as the face is large that covers the span of my wrist, which is small.  The leather strap is decently soft and does not look cheap.  Very tasteful that works well with both my casual weekend wear and work wear.  I love the big face of the watch, and it does not look cheap.  I love it.

title: delicate, stylish, and beautiful.
text: These are beautiful. .delicate and now gawdy.  Very nice size loop and gem stones.  Would go nicely with black, my go to clothes colour.  Only thing to watch out for is that the clasp is not tight and could come off easily. I am thinking of using pliers to gently tighten the back piece.otherwsie, thsee ear rings are delicious.

title: Good quality. ,.
text: Love them, the elastic worked well.  But didn't hold up if u r doing a lot of walking.  Good quality, and if u r like me who don't like tights..Worked well with knee length skirts.

title: Great bling and beautiful design.
text: Replaced a similar ring..Beautifully finished.  Great quality ring, love it!

title: Durable and well made.
text: Great sizes umbrella..large for sure, but not huge like a golf umbrella.  Wide enough for two people...and handled the wind gust!  Durable and well made.  Happy with the brand.

title: Pretty nice looking for the price.
text: A pretty nice watch for the price.  Elegant and works!  It was easy to adjust the wrist on your own.  I had no problem, no need to go to a watch dealer.  No wind-up required.  Accurate time.  I was surprised I was going to like it as much as I do.

title: Super light and super wheels
text: Gosh, we purchased delsey aero and fell in love with it, and prompted us to replace another suitcase!  This is great value for a very sturdy case, easy wheels and takes a lot of the strength off the arms, and onto the wheels. Not bad on carpets, but loved it when we were in the airport.  Storage wise, plenty of room for one person, love the lock and just so light now that we are not carrying the heavy weight of a suitcase frame.  We are fully converted to this new travel luggage!  Compares just as well as all the more expensive versions.

title: Sooo light and compact
text: We can't get over how light the case is, and minimalist style. No waste and built for just packing clothes for travel.  Expansion is available.  What we like so that there is. TSA lock, which we hope will reduce hot sticky fingers other those who absolutely has to have access to it.  Wheels can rotate a full 360, easy to maneuver, and just love the new case..no more going over the limit.

title: Great for and comfort
text: Smart and yet casually comfortable to wear.  Quality of the material is excellent.  Love the little accent of color, and love the choice of colors.  Great grip at the sole..quality.

title: Great value
text: We purchased this for a PJ party, and was surprised the quality of the PJ for this price!  A keeper for the next PJ party.

title: For length wise-fits great
text: But if you have wide feet then it fits just right and not good to wear thick socks.  Although the leather will soften once worn in.  The design is beautiful and elegant for jeans and casual wear and a nice change for boots.  Love the color and well made.  Very happy.

title: Fits comfortable, and sooo stylish with jeans and formal trousers.
text: I love the additonal trim around the boots.  The whole construct of the boots is sooo well thought through and it fitted comfortably with a pair of thin socks.  Didn't feel my toes being squeezed or feet slipping around.  I just love this brand ..and feels so comfortable walking some distance too..i normally give up on wearing too much heels these days..now I can come back with a bit of height!  Great material.

title: nice size and consistent in coloring and size for both ear rings and necklace.
text: both the pearls on the ear rings and necklace are about the same size: nice!  i noticed that the pearl for the necklace is a little 'flat' in shape, but it makes it sit better on the body!  i like the quality and the size, but wished the chain had a few additional loops to allow me to shorten the length of the necklace.  the chain is a decent quality.  I like them both. I am not an expect on the quality of pearls, but they did not have a dull sheen to them.  the pealrs are not huge: i would call them 'dainty' and ladylike in size.

title: Bought for my mom.
text: Very warm and thick!  It has good rubber grips, which was very important for me as I needed to make sure it was safe.  Great for elderlies where their feet is a little snarled and nolonger find traditional slippers comfortable.  Just happy. We bought 2!

title: Gift for my mum too!
text: Very warm and thick!  It has good rubber grips, which was very important for me as I needed to make sure it was safe.  Great for elderlies where their feet is a little snarled and nolonger find traditional slippers comfortable.  Just happy. We bought 2!

title: Very soft, and warm
text: I bought it for a 80's theme party, and I was surprised at the quality and the warmth!  I think I am going to wear this for the winter now.  Quality was very good and washed under cold wash, held its shape.

title: Good fit and it works!
text: Terrific fit to size and the touch works!  Materials quality is not bad and works for most cold weather,,but not extreme cold.

title: Not the real deal .
text: Bought this bag from way fair, no logo on the inside, and i suspect this is not real leather.  The interior looks okay, but not professionally put together.  There are finishes you expect from a reasonable and decent brand like Kate spade, for example. This is not such a bag.  Hence expensive for what it is.

title: Pretty, small and dainty
text: I wanted something small to match a black beaded necklace. This is nothing fancy about these earrings, but small enough from a distance they look quite elegant.

title: Just love it
text: As usual another tasteful and delicate piece of jewelry!  Not overtly complicated, nice Olof combination. Classy.  I love their peces, must have bought the lot!  Almost.  Works well with a tee shirt to a nice simple black dress!  Love it.

title: Good support and true to size
text: Without the added height, the cushion provided by the flip flop is excellent!  I ordered one size based on a few reviews below, and I would add it is not necessary!  I wil live with my extra shoe size.  Very comfortable overall.

title: Love love love love love!
text: I am a huge fan of Chuvora pieces.  This piece was no exception, beautifully designed and delicate pieces:  all making of a great piece of Jewelery that worked with dark pieces of clothing  like a deep purple, brown and black!  Formal or casual, it is a stunning piece!  I love it.  I wore it with a deep purple top and it was stunning.

title: So delicate and beautiful contrasting colored pearls
text: These pictures do not do this piece justice at all, so delicate and the colors are contraring yet complementary with each other.  I love warning with a light pastel top or just black (keep the patterned shirt for another day!) and wi this piece, it just stands out so beautifully.  Made my boring balck scooped neck top look so sophisticated.  I just love all the pieces of Chuvora I have, and for the price, quite unbelievable. Love love love.  .

title: Very comfortable and opaque!
text: Thanks for offering Prime! The material is fairly soft and true to size.  Not loose around the legs, and plenty opaque enough that your underwear does to show through; quite thickish material.  Pretty good quality material.

title: Love Geox flats
text: I have had purchased previous Geox flats and they last a long time!  So I was happy to see this new style and snapped them up.  I purchased them half a size up than from my usual leather shoes, and the fit was perfect.  Great value and very comfortable.

title: Return Customer
text: We are returning with our purchase of a second pair of shoe tree for my husband's purchases at the Allen Edmonds' store.  Great fit and I recommend you go to their site that provides better fitting information.  We have only tried these shoe trees with their shoes, and we love them for the value.

title: Love it!
text:
My Hubbie is an avid Bear Gryll's fan and after spotting this jacket on one of the shows: we were on the hunt. Thankfully, Amazon stocked this and it was on prime, otherwise the delivery would have taken 10+ days from Europe (Bear's own clothes website does not have any US stores as of yet).

The jacket is light and not bulky, has a hood that is actually functional! There are a lot of pockets to store essentials and are well designed that does not bulk out the jacket. Very stylish and although the sleeves were long for him, there is a velcrose to fix the sleeve and we dont have to roll it up! The medium size had plenty of room for a sweater, if need be. I dont think there were any discrepancies between a European size medium and a US medium - dont need to get a larger size (unless you are in denial!).

title: Great value:you get what you pay for.
text: Although there is no discount in the price, this is a great product especially for the Allen Edmond's shoes, fitted beautifully.  We recommend you go to the Allen Edmond's website as they have a much better shoe size grid for you to determine which size to buy.  Perfect fit on first purchase and we'll probably get more.  Made of cedar, very well made and smelled nice out of the box!

title: Perfect Gift
text: I purchased this for my Aunt for Mother’s Day. She is a huge cat person and these were the perfect gift!! The are super comfy and cute. Will definitely buy myself a pair as well.

title: Great looking sandals!
text: I love these sandals so much!  I ordered the large size, as I wear a normal size 10 shoe, in both navy and beige. I was afraid they’d be too big, but they are just right and they look terrific on my feet.  I only wish the soles were a bit sturdier, but for wearing a short time at a time, these will work beautifully. The elastic is STURDY, contrary to some of the posts!  I have LOTS of sandals for summer, but these are my favorite!  I’m ordering more colors!

title: Extremely Comfortable and Flattering!
text: I am 79 years old, 5’5” and 160  lbs and wear a D cup, so I ordered an XL in this bra.  Honestly, I would go without a bra around the house because, at my age, I choose comfort!  I had looked for weeks for the perfect fit bra, but anything I chose just did not work for me!  Finally, I found this bra, tried it on, and instantly loved the fit and how comfortable it is to wear; it’s like not having a bra on, yet it gives a “bit” of of a lift and it looks great under t-shirts!  Also, like a lot of women, I am a bit smaller on one side, but this bra definitely hides that fact!  I could easily sleep in this bra!  Today, I ordered a second one!

title: Great headband at a great price!
text: These headbands are FANTASTIC!!  They are beautiful, lightweight, sturdy and do not interfere with the arms on your glasses (sunglasses or regular).  The rhinestones are so sparkly and the teeth help to hold my hair in place without being painful.  No headaches after a full day of wear. title: GoBros seller review
text:
I am writing a GoBros seller review. But first, a little about the socks. I love Sockwell socks. I wear them all the time for work. The only negative comment I have about the socks is that they don’t last very long. My socks tend to get holes in the toes. Albeit, I still buy and wear Sockwells. If you are on your feet all day, I would recommend you try these socks.

Now for the seller, GoBros. I bought two pairs of Sockwell from Amazon. One came from GoBros and the other from another seller. The GoBros seller sold me a, not advertised, pair of used socks at full price. Yes, these socks were completely used. It would not surprise me if the person who packed them also took them off of her own feet. It was quite disgusting to open a package and see a used pair of socks. So disappointing and frustrating to get a used pair of socks, then have to waste my time sending them back and writing a review. BUYER BEWARE OF GoBros seller.

To end, I do highly recommend Sockwells.

Pros:

Cons:

Overall, I love the top and will order more. I wish there were more patterns instead of so many solid colors.

Cons:
The fabric has a weighted feel, which sucks in the summer heat. It is heavy and thick, not cool and lightweight. The bottom of the top is not hemmed so it looks unfinished and cheap. The straps are not adjustable. This wasn’t much of an issue due to the appropriate fit, but it may bother someone who needs to adjust the straps.

title: Didn't fit right.
text: The item was too tight in thigh area but fit everywhere else.

title: Great buy
text: Love it

title: looks great
text: looks just like a regular prayer bead necklace but is very heavy and solid. Love it!

title: Good looking shorts
text: Fits good, looks good and most importantly,  well made. Need them for work, so need good quality  stitching.  Great shorts

title: great mala bead bracelet
text: looks great! Tigers eye style is the best

title: Really liked this sweater
text: It is much heavier than I was expecting which was nice. A little itchy at first but better after I washed it. Thinking of buying again in a different color because I like the grey one I got so much.

title: Awful Q.C.
text: 2 fit and 2 were too small

title: Oversized and Adorable
text: This oversized onesie is adorable! I have got a chunky little lady and this is still oversized on her. It doesn’t get saggy in the bottom. But it is wide and adorable. The fabric is more thick t-shirt than sweatshirt.

title: Super Soft
text: This fabric rivals the super expensive brand. They’re really soft and stretchy. The ankles don’t unsnap all the way. The cuffs on the ankles stay closed.

title: Cute, but Flawed
text: These baby rompers are super cute. The fabric is super soft. It stretches out just a little too much, to be honest. The real issue is that the seams aren’t well sewn. The seams are too close to the fabric edge, so they get holes in the seams really quickly. (Like on the first wear.) If it wasn’t for that, I’d love them.

title: Perfect
text: My 5-year-old asked her older brother for a “red vampire shirt” for her birthday. This perfectly fit the bill. She loves it. The shirt is good quality. Print is good quality.

title: Cheap Shoes
text: These shoes broke at the worst time. In the middle of a store and the ankle strap just rips off. Had to finish shopping barefoot.

title: Awkward in Public
text: I’m a very experienced breastfeeding mom. I did not like this nursing bra at all. While it is comfortable, it is so hard to get res napped once you’ve finished feeding the baby. It isn’t a one handed ordeal because the cup kind of stretches when it is on and the way the fabric is, it is just super awkward trying to resnap it. After a couple very public problems with this bra— I tossed it. Definitely not functional.

title: A Little Big
text: These socks are a little big for newborns. But once they are about 6 weeks old, they fit perfectly. They don’t slide off, though they do move around a bit. They wash okay. The little no-skid bottoms do seem to attract color in the wash. So some of the lighter ones have picked up blue only on the No-skid part.

title: He Loves It
text: My seven year old loves this set. It is very comfortable, and it washes really well. The color is bright and vivid. Other kids always comment on how awesome his outfit is when he wears it. Every single time it comes out of the dryer, and immediately goes back on his body.

title: Comfortable Shoes
text: These shoes are very comfortable. Unlike the name brand version, you don’t have to waste time trying to stretch them out. There are the stretchy. They also hold up well, and look nice. A great casual shoe

title: Fit Very Small
text: The fit on these is very small. The fabric doesn’t have a ton of stretch to it either. You can get into it, but it does look like you’re wearing a shirt to size is too small.

title: Label on the Outside
text: These nursing bras are OK. They aren’t fantastic, but they are awful either. They do have the label on the outside, which is very weird. It was also very big and thick lettering, which starts to peel off as soon as you wash them.

title: Outfit is Cute
text: The outfit was appropriately size for a newborn. It fit my 8 pound baby without any issues. However, the headband is more of a one size fits all situation, which did not fit a newborn at all. It is Sizemore for a one-year-old. Which was a bummer, because the outfit without the headband isn’t necessarily as cute.

title: Wide Shoe
text: My toddler does not like shoes. She usually refuses all she has. She likes these though. These have a wide toe box, that doesn’t squish her little toes. They stay on well. They also have a little pebble like texture on the bottom of the foot bed. She really likes them. So that is a win for us

title: Comfortable
text: These are very comfortable sandals. They fit well, and they mold to your feet well. My only complaint is that they do look a little bit cheap. The faux leather is not quite like leather.

title: Nice Shorts
text: These shorts are great. You can wear them in the water, or just on a hot day. They dry really quickly. They also have some stretch to them. They are massively oversized. I would say they’re very true to size

title: Love These
text: These are so great. I wear them over spaghetti strap dresses, and it makes for a perfect maternity or breast-feeding outfit. Extra large fit perfectly.

title: Super Cute
text: I did order a size up. Because I hate things being tight. But this is an adorable jumpsuit. So cute. Got so many compliments wearing it.

title: Size of a Pencil Case
text: This oil case is the size of a pencil case. It is pretty large for holding essential oils. It has little elastics around the "walls" of the bag to hold smaller bottles. But the big middle portion is really large for bottles to just be rolling around. And bigger bottles won't fit into the elastic holders. But it is the perfect size for a pencil/highlighter case. You can even put the little plastic lead holders in the elastics around the edges and erasers. I think it works better in a pencil case capacity.

title: Great Shirt
text: This is a nice lightweight flannel shirt with a hood. It is really comfy. I’d say it runs pretty true to size. The sleeves are a bit on the short side, so if you’re taller, you may want to size up.

title: Super Soft
text: These pajamas are super soft. They do run a little bit on the small side. So I would size up for a looser fit. They aren’t fitted, but the elastic is a bit tight for the size.

title: For a 10-Year-Old
text: This hat was perfect for my 10-year-old. He loves the look and style of the hat. It is really good quality

title: Great Shorts
text: My teenager loves these shorts. He wears a 28x29 and the xsmall fit him perfectly. They also have an inner drawstring, so you can tighten them if needed. The color is like a neon pastel.

title: He Loves Them
text: My teenager wears a 28x29 and the x-small fit him perfectly. He absolutely loves these shorts. They are thicker, sweatshirt material. It also has a functional drawstring.

title: Size Down
text: These run on the big side. I got an 8 for my toddler who is just starting to wear 8s and they were too big. But the 8 fit my preschooler who wears a 9 perfectly. The toe space is also quite short. The proportions are just slightly off in that area. But they seem pretty well made with a thick sole.

title: So Comfortable
text: I sized up because I’m very pregnant, but I honestly didn’t need to. It is made oversized and would have accommodated my belly. Though the larger size isn’t to the “too large to wear” point. It is so soft and comfortable. It comes down to just above my knee.

title: Fun Glasses
text: These sunglasses are a lot of fun! They are comfortable and stay on pretty well. They come with a cloth bag for storage. They are a unisex fit, so they likely wouldn’t work well for a large headed person.

title: Good Glasses
text: These aviators are good glasses. They are comfortable. They work well. The tint is not too dark, but dark enough to be effective. They come with a little cloth pouch for storage.

title: Comfortable Shorts
text: The shorts are very comfortable. They fit well. I like the other belly design because they don’t fall down as much. The legs aren’t super tight and they aren’t super tight to the hips either.

title: Super Warm
text: This coat is so warm! It is long, but doesn’t restrict walking. It is pretty thin. Not the thinnest I’ve had, but thin for the amount of warmth. It also looks great.

title: Lined Clogs
text: These are great in cooler weather. They don’t have much “give” on the top, so they can be a little constricting when wearing them for gardening with all the bending and squatting. They are very cushioned. They don’t breathe at all.

title: Thick
text: This shacket is super thick! It is a little oversized without needing to size up. It is super warm. It feels almost like felted wool. It looks cute and somewhat holds its shape as you wear it because of the thickness. Not great for tying or tucking.

title: All Labeled Backwards
text: These underwear fit well. They’re perfect under dresses! They’ll fit the entire pregnancy. However, they are all labeled backwards. The “tag” is on the front of the underwear. Because of this, I have put them on backward far more than any adult should.

title: Fun Glasses
text: These glasses are so much fun! And they’re really well made. They’re sturdy, even though the frames are thin. I really like them. They come with a soft storage bag.

title: Comfortable Glasses
text: These glasses are really comfortable. They fit my face nicely without being too tight. They have a soft glasses bag that you can use to clean the lenses. The hard outer container isn’t great for storing the glasses.

title: Very Tall
text: This is my preferred style of underwear during pregnancy. These are just very long in the torso and I find them falling/slipping more than other brands I own. The material is very slippery. They’d be comfortable if they’d stay up.

title: Great Dress
text: Got so many compliments on this dress! It is looser in the fit without needing to size up. It is a thicker material than is appropriate in all seasons. It comes down to about the knee. So comfortable.

title: Sort of Comfortable
text: These shoes are sort of comfortable. The fuzzy slipper interior is very soft and warm. But the fixed outside doesn’t move well with your foot, so the top rubs and presses on the top of your foot as you walk. I’ve relegated them to garden shoes, but even then I can’t bend down a lot while wearing them or I’ll bruise the tops of my feet.

title: Oversized Cardigan
text: This cardigan is oversized. It is super adorable. It is a looser weave, so more prone to pulls. My daughter loves it.

title: So Cute
text: My four-year-old loves this sweater dress! And she looks so adorable in it! It is machine washable, which is a must for her age. Paired with black tights and a pair of booties and she’s just the cutest!

title: Plush Sweater
text:
This sweater has a typical top fit. It comes to about
the top of the hip. The sweater is super plush and warm. It looks great, too.

title: Fit is Terrible
text: The fit on these leggings is terrible. I’ve had a dozen or so pairs of maternity leggings and these are by far the worst. The cotton fabric is not as stretchy or comfortable as others. The belly area it’s just awkward and weird. Definitely only fit in the third trimester. They run super huge.

title: Great Cardigan
text: This cardigan is super soft. It isn’t very itchy at all. I also wash as well in the regular washing machine, which is a must for little boys clothing. My son loves it.

title: Runs Small
text: The sweater runs small. However, it is excellent quality. My boys love it. It isn’t at all itchy. It washes well in the washing machine, as well.

title: Okay
text: This cardigan is okay. The color is not tan or brown at all, just straight dark peach/orange. The quality is okay. I do like the length. And it machine washes just fine.

title: Lightweight Kimono
text: This kimono is very lightweight. It fits well. It looks nice. I’ve only had washed it because it seems far too delicate for the machine. Really my only complaint is the tag. Because of the lightweight material, the tag just feels and looks wrong.

title: Why the hooks?
text: This would’ve been perfect if it did not have the hook and eye closure on the back. The closure is the size of it stretched at its largest. It doesn’t make the band any smaller. So it is completely pointless, other than to stab you in the back if you’re sleeping in it. It does run a little bit big, as well.

title: Adorable
text: The fit is a little on the big side, but it is super cute and adorable. Paired with some tights and some cute booties and my preschooler was looking better than me. Also, good quality. Washed well. A little bit scratchy, so if you have a kid with sensory issues that might be a problem, but it wasn’t bad enough that my four-year-old noticed.

title: Cozy Cardigan
text: The sizing is very generous on this cardigan. The length is almost knee-length on me (5’4”). It is comfortable. It goes with plenty of outfits.

title: Comfy Undies
text: These underwear fit true to size. They are comfortable. Not very generous in the back. The seams lay flat.

title: His Favorite
text: This is my 10-year-old’s favorite item of clothing. He’d wear it every day if I let him. It is warm and cozy. It looks nice. And it is holding up to all the washing it gets from being worn all the time.

title: A Little Long
text: These shoes are pretty comfortable. I would size down half a size if I got them again. They just seem to run a little bit long. They look nice.

title: Squishy Slides
text: I am a comfort slide lover. These are nice and squishy. I will say the tops leave a little to be desired. They work well indoors and out. You can also clean them super easily.

title: Runs a little big
text: This hoodie ran a little big. It fit my four-year-old more like a dress than a tunic. She does love it.
