title: Comfortable Jackets
text: This jacket is super comfortable. It is on the light weight sign, but it is warm. It is comfortable and it’s kind of a fun hybrid look.

title: Oddly Shaped
text: When I say this is small, it isn't really small. The back panel is cut small, so the pockets are almost behind my back. The front waterfall part and the sleeves seem true to size, but the back seems small. It is cozy and comfy. It doesn't look super great quality in person, but it feels nice on and is warm. But the fit is really weird.

title: Great Tote
text: This is such a great tote! It is great quality. The inner fabric is contrasting. The material is soft. It has a few pockets, so it isn't just a straight up grocery tote or anything. The straps are the perfect length. Great for traveling or to even use as a purse or diaper bag. It also fits notebooks and books well, so it would make a nice work or school bag, as well.

title: Best Bag
text: This is a fantastic bag! It is great as a carry on for traveling, or as a diaper bag for a longer trip or more than one baby. There are so many pockets and places to stash things! The fabric is so incredibly soft. And it has this nice contrast fabric inside. It is perfect!

title: Looks Cheap
text: In person, this tank looks super cheap. It looks worse than tanks you'd find at the local big box store. I wasn't impressed at all. The fit is on the small side. The tank part doesn't hang very well. I feel like I'd need to size up significantly to get the shirt part to hang nicely, but then the bra part would be too big. Didn't work for me at all and the quality wasn't good enough for me to make any effort to make it work.

title: A Little Thinner
text: These are a little thinner than other leggings I have from other brands in this style. That could be good or bad for you, depending on what you like. They're compressive, but because they are thinner, they have a little more wiggle room than thicker sport leggings. I like the mineral wash and the look. They aren't so thin they are see through.

title: Oversized, Thick Shirt
text: This isn't quite a shacket. I feel like a shacket needs side pockets and this doesn't have them. But it is very thick and is oversized. It isn't super long, though. Below the hip, but not as long as the width would suggest. Very cute.

title: Great Grandpa Cardigan
text: This grandpa cardigan is great. It is plush, but lightweight. It has an acrylic feel, but is over half cotton. It is dense without being heavy. Very warm. It hits right about the hip and has nice pockets for butterscotches, or your hands.

title: Nice Cardigan
text: This cardigan is nice and fluffy. Super warm, but also lightweight. It isn't acrylic entirely, but it feels like an acrylic sweater-- that lightweight but plush feel. The buttons look great. It hits right about the hip.

title: Fluffy Sweater
text: This sweater is fluffy and light. It feels like acrylic. It is very warm despite being light. It is also on the thicker side. It also has a nice stretch to it. Hits right about the hip.

title: Fluffy Henley
text: This sweater is very fluffy. It is thick without being heavy. It feels like acrylic. It fits well. Good stretch with movement. Buttons look nice. Very warm.

title: Fun Hoodie
text: This hoodie is unusual and I love it. It has like a sweater and a hoodie together. It is well-made. It was comfortable. It is very true to size. Size up if you want a looser fit

title: Fit is Good, But Has Issues
text: I wanted to like this bra. It fits well. The straps are not too tight. But there are two big issues. (1) The straps are not adjustable. They happen to fit me fine. Not too tight. Not too loose. But I’m not sure they’d fit every body type— you know? (2) The bottom rolls up when I sit down. While standing and keeping my upper body straight, it is fine. But when I bend or sit, the bottom rolls up and gets very uncomfortable. Maybe it would stay out better on less curvy figures, but for me it rolls and is very uncomfortable.

title: Didn’t Like This One
text: This mask was just not very comfortable. The nose wire in the shape and fabric of the mask is just uncomfortable and awkward. It does the job, but I’m not a fan.

title: Comfy Bra
text: This is a comfy bra, even for breastfeeding. The top of the racer back does come up a bit higher on the neck than a standard racer back. I don’t think it is uncomfortable, but I don’t like to sleep in it for that reason. But it is comfortable during the day. Easily adjustable. Fits perfect. The removable pads, like all removable pads, are trash.

title: Nice Hat
text: My teen boys are hat guys. They love this hat. They argued over which of them would be the fedora guy and which would be the pork pie guy. He gets lots of compliments on this hat. It looks great. Very good quality. The band is nicely sewn down.

title: She Loves Them
text: My soon to be four year old loves these socks. They are a little big on her, but she doesn’t mind at all. They are on the thicker side, so they’d also be boot appropriate. They have the little slipper stuff on the bottom. So cute. So cozy.

title: Comfortable
text: I’m super picky about sunglasses and I like these. The frames are oversized without being heavy. They work great in protecting my eyes from the sun. They fit well, but aren’t overly tight. I like them.

title: Small Bag
text: This small bag is great for those that don't need a massive purse. It is perfect for a teen. The fabric is soft. It has a lovely contrast lining. The strap is adjustable. It has convenient little pockets. Really, I have no complaints.

title: Cute Dress
text: This is a really cute dress. It has a tie in the back so you can tie it as tight as you need to keep the shoulders from slipping off. It is nice a flowy. A size 8 fit the large with plenty of room. Could have probably done a medium, but didn't want to lose length or the flowyness.

title: Great Phone Wallet
text: My iPhone 8+ fits in this phone wallet with no issues. It has a clip to hold your phone in. There is space for cards and cash. It also has a spot for your license with the license facing out, so you don't have to remove it for the dates and things to be seen. It is comfortable to wear on your wrist. You can remove the wrist strap if you want.

title: Fun Hat
text: My teenage son is a hat guy. He loves this hat. He gets compliments on it all the time. It is well made. There is an adjustable strap inside to make it tighter, but it fits him perfectly as is. The ribbon is sewed on well, so it doesn't come off like some cheap hats will.

title: So Comfy
text: This is such a comfortable cardigan. It is a thin sweatshirt material. Not fuzzy on the inside. It is warm without being super hot. It is like a combination of a hoodie and a cardigan. It is almost to my knees. It has no front closure and the sizing is generous.

title: Fantastic Shoes
text: These are fantastic shoes for a kid. They are comfortable. They are durable. They are easy to put on but don’t easily slip off. They’re fantastic.

title: Comfortable Jammies
text: These are really comfortable baby jammies. They snap up. It is very durable while still being very soft. The color is good for a boy or girl. I’m not crazy about the brand name being all over it— I’d much prefer a solid color.

title: Comfy Socks
text: These athletic socks are very comfortable. They are squishy and soft. They don’t move around on you. Maybe not as super dense as you would need for distance running, but for everyday wear or basic working out— these are great.

title: Good Athletic Socks
text: These are good athletic socks. Nice and cushiony. Don’t slip down under your foot at the exact wrong moment. I will say that Gold Toe socks do have odd toe seams, so if you’re sensitive to toe seams on socks, maybe skip these. Most of the time I don’t notice but then once in a blue moon, I’ll notice the toe seam and then I can’t unnotice it.

title: So Soft
text: The cotton on this bag is so soft. The color is vivid. It is a very comfortable backpack to carry and it looks really nice. It has inner floral lining that makes it just a little more special.

title: Weird Material
text: I don’t like the material for this style of pants. It is a thick swimsuit material that is slightly shiny. It just feels uncomfortable and lays weird— not to mention how bad it looks.

title: Soft and Comfortable
text:
This is an excellent shirt. So soft and comfortable. The fit is unisex sizing. The graphic is screen print, not vinyl, so it is soft and doesn’t crack in the dryer.
I absolutely love this tee.

title: Zero Stretch
text: These jeans have no stretch. They’re very thin. But very difficult to size because they have no stretch at all. If you carry your weight in your tummy or thighs, definitely want to skip these. Sizing up can help a little, but they’re definitely more difficult to size due to the lack of stretch. (Also odd to be sized small, medium, large when there is no stretch or give to the fabric at all.) They can be cute if you can find the right fit. (Normally a size 8 and the large fit, but are tight through the thighs.)

title: So Comfortable
text: These shoes are so comfortable. They are snug, but have plenty of stretch. They have a casual look to them but could also be dressed up a little, too. They have molded cork insoles, which are really comfortable.

title: So Comfortable
text: These glasses are so comfortable. They are light, they don’t squish your head, they don’t pinch your nose. They look nice, too.

title: Small
text: I wear a size 11 or 12 in jeans and the large was definitely too small. I carry my weight more around the middle (thus needing a shaper), so maybe I should have sized up for that. It also seems a little short in the height. I’m not tall, but could barely get this to stretch tall enough for me. (I’m 5’4”.)

title: Slippery
text: I did not feel like I could walk in these. They’re super soft, and super comfortable. However, they are very slippery. I feel like my foot was just sliding around on the fluffy for. They fit well, but they were just slippery. So they’d be great if you’re putting them on and sitting still. But I just don’t trust myself walk around the house with the baby wearing these things.

title: Fit Well
text: These are really comfortable shorts. They are cut me, I’m very stretchy. I would say they run true to size. The fit is not oversized, but also not skintight either. Just great basic shorts. They’re not quick drying, so when you sweat in them or get them wet they do act like a cotton T-shirt and don’t drive for quite a while. But they are great basic short. And I have pockets

title: Cute Shoes
text: These little tennis shoes are so cute. They are pretty comfortable, but offer much in terms of support. They are very cute. They fit true to size. Even if you have a water foot, I think they’d still be all right.

title: Stretches Out
text: This little cotton shirt for baby is cute. It does stretch out, though, as the baby wears it. The neck is plenty wide enough for their big heads.

title: Plain Camisole Tank
text: These camisole tanks are great. They are a thicker cotton, so they aren’t see through at all. I like them as undershirts, but they could be worn as a shirt. The straps are not adjustable at all. The round hem is really cute.

title: Look Ratty After Washing
text: These shorts aren’t the most flattering or the best quality. After washing, they look pretty ratty. You do have to iron them to wear them. I think they run a tad on the small side, mostly because they have no stretch to them.

title: Small Cups
text: While I like this bra, the cups are a little on the small side. I feel like I’m always popping out of the cup, even though the band fits perfectly. If you’re under a C cup, it’ll probably be fine. But above that, this is not the bra for you.

title: Good Sandals
text: These are as good as the name brand version of this style. They’re really comfortable. Completely adjustable to fit your foot. They run true to size. They’re a great summer sandal.

title: Flip Flops
text: These are great flip-flops. My teenage son loves them. They’re comfortable and have decent arch support. They’re holding up really well. The bottom foam is more of the thick/dense style than the super lightweight cheap stuff.

title: Great Quality
text: These shorts are made of a great quality sweatshirt material. It isn’t this thin, silky junk. It is the thick, cottony fabric of years gone by. Nice, vintage quality material. I really can’t describe how much different this is from the typical off the rack sweatshirt material. The fit is loose, but I think that is intentional. They feel like they fit how they are supposed to fit.

title: Fun Shirt
text: This shirt is cute and super soft. It does have a bit of a slim fit, like a girl shirt, through the sides. It fits as expected. If you carry weight in your tummy, you may want to size up unless you like a snug fit.

title: Vivid Socks
text: These socks keep their color perfectly. They are on the thick side without being athletic socks. But definitely thicker than novelty type socks. They are more ankle socks than no show, I would say-- which I happen to like. They don't fall down under my heel like no-show socks tend to do.

title: Great Socks
text: These are great socks. They are comfortable. They are the perfect thickness for wearing with dress shoes. They fit snugly and stay up. They also keep their color well with washing.

title: Undershorts
text: These shorts work really well as undershorts for dresses. They lay very flat. They looked like they were going to be way too small, but they fit perfectly fine. They're high enough that they suck in that lower belly area a bit, but not so much you can't breath. High enough that you don't muffin top over them. The bottoms are a little on the short side. They hit right in the middle of my inner thigh area that rub. Like, 1/2" longer and they'd be perfect.

title: Fun Romper
text: This is a fun, comfortable romper. I prefer to wear a t-shirt underneath. I think it looks cuter that way. The material is thin, like a t-shirt. The straps are adjustable, if you need a little more length or a little less.

title: Fishing Hat
text: This is a great fishing hat. It is 100% cotton. It is comfortable to wear. It is on the small side, so if you had a larger head it wouldn’t fit as well. It also has an adjuster inside. It does not have a chinstrap though.

title: Swim Bottoms
text: These swim bottoms are good. The fabric is a little on the shiny side, which makes them look a little cheap. Other than that, I like them. They’re right at knee length. And come up just below the belly button

title: Cute Shirt
text: The shirt is super cute and comfortable. The fabric is nice. Wash as well and holds up well. I really like it.

title: Fine Undies
text: These underwear are fine. The boys like the fit of them. They do stretch out a bit over time, so they don’t hold up all that well.

title: Great Shirt
text: The standard fit of this button up is great. The fabric is a great quality and the shirt looks really nice. It has a slightly relaxed fit, which I prefer in a button up.

title: So Soft
text: This bag is so soft! It is a brushed feeling cotton. The bag is plenty big enough for a gym bag, weekend bag, or even a week trip if it is somewhere warm where you could pack lightweight dresses. The inside is lined in a beautiful floral cotton. There are several mesh pockets on the inside to keep shoes, hats, makeup bag, etc. from wandering around inside the bag. It has straps long enough to put over your shoulder. Or it also has a long shoulder strap that you can clip on or remove as needed. This is a great bag!

title: So Soft
text: The cotton of this bag is so soft. It is like a brushed cotton feel. So nice. The inside has a nice printed cotton lining. There are plenty of pockets for all the things. The straps are padded and curved for extra comfort. This is a fantastic backpack!

title: So Cozy
text: These shoes are so cozy and warm. They are a little bit on the narrow side, but the leather loosens up as you wear them. So before long, they fit your foot perfectly like they were made just for you. They’re excellent shoes and I absolutely love them.

title: Very Uncomfortable
text: The sandals are eye-catching but very uncomfortable. The plastic is very hard and digs into your foot. The beads are tight on with like a fishing wire that’s attached underneath the plastic parts of rubs on the top of your foot. Definitely not a sandal I would want to wear for any amount of time. Trying to convince myself to wear it even just for an hour or two is an event. They’re just really uncomfortable. But they look so cute.

title: Not As Comfy
text: I had been eyeing this style of slide for quite a while, so I was excited to try these. They just aren’t as comfortable as my Adidas slides. They fit true to size. The bottoms are quite squishy. But the material is just not the most comfortable. It is a little stiff and feels very plasticy on the skin. They’re wearable. But they aren’t awesome. Mine also have some minor defects along the seams that make them look a bit cheap.

title: Boy’s Muscle Tank
text: This shirt is super cool according to my 9-year-old son. It is super comfortable and soft cotton. It seems pretty durable, too. The fit is really true to size.

title: Women’s Sized
text: The size 4-10, I had assumed was toddler sizes. I was wrong. It is a 4 in big kids to an adult women’s 10. So, these are essentially adult sized socks. They are nice and thick and really comfortable. They don’t slip. They do have a little seem issues around the toe, so if you or your child has sensory issues about socks, these may be problematic for that. But otherwise, they’re nice durable socks.

title: Fun Socks
text: These socks would make an excellent gift. They’re packaged perfectly for giving. My 12-year-old is llama obsessed and he LOVES these socks. They’re pretty thick and nice for novelty socks. They’re definitely more of a casual/dress sock as opposed to a sport sock. They’re really great!

title: Not Super
text: These run a little big. They're also not super well made. There is a wrinkle in the leather upper on one sandal where the leather was pulled incorrectly while being sewn. It made a big ripple in the leather, which cannot be worked out because there is too much leather on that piece. They are pretty comfortable, though. But they don't look the best.

title: Comfortable
text: These boy short underwear are really comfortable. They don't fall down in the back, which is my usual problem with boy shorts. They're super stretchy. They aren't shape wear in any form. They will not slim you or hold you in. They'll accommodate you and be super comfortable. But they aren't slimming or anything like that.

title: Cheap and Oddly Sized
text: First, these bracelets feel super cheap. The beaded ones don't have any weight to them. They feel lighter than plastic beads. The beaded ones are the proper fit for my wrist, which is on the small side. The chain ones are significantly too large for my wrist. It is like the chains are made for large wrists and the beaded ones are made for small wrists. They're just not cute and wrong.

title: T-Shirts for Baby
text: These baby t-shirts are super soft and comfortable. The edges are raw, so they will roll a bit with washing. They fit well and hold up well to washing. I really can't complain.

title: Sizing is Normal
text: I have similar shoes in a plastic type material and needed to size down. Not so with these. These fit much more true to size. The "leather" is super thin and cheap. It doesn't at all feel like real leather. I also didn't like where the strap across the width of the foot hit on me. They look fine. They are adjustable in the width. But the straps are extremely cheap and thin feeling. Definitely wouldn't hold up well to frequent or "hard" wear.

title: Summer Shorts
text: These are great summer shorts. The "paint splatter" effect is really vinyl on the shorts. They are super stretchy and comfortable. The length is great. Not too short, but also not too long either. The high waist makes them super comfortable. For a size 8, the medium fit perfectly. Could have sized up for a more relaxed fit, but they aren't in any way tight.

title: Baby Muscles
text: These little baby muscle tees are true to size. They have raw edges, which do curl a little as they wash. The material is a nice, soft, thick cotton. My only problem is that the thickness around the arms makes the fabric around the arm holes ripple. They just won't lay flat. They're still wearable and I'm perhaps the only one who notices. But I do notice and I cannot get the arm holes to lay flat.

title: Great Dress
text: This dress is fantastic! Great stretch. It feels like butter soft leggings- but in a dress. It has pockets! And it comes down to just past the knee (5'4"). It is a perfect spring and summer dress! If you're bigger in the best, you may want to size up. Because it is more fitted through the bust. It would stretch just fine, but if you don't want it tight in the top, size up.

title: Raw Edges
text: These little tank suits have raw edges around the neck. They fit pretty well. The fabric is nice and thick, but stretches with the baby. My only issue is that the arm holes tend to look warped because the stitching on them is so thick. I feel like it just sits weird, even when I take the time to smooth it out. It isn't unwearable. But it is a little bulky and gets twisted around the arms.

title: Cute Glasses
text: These are great kid glasses. They fit my 7-year-old and 5-year-old perfectly. (They're a little snug for my 9-year-old. And a tiny bit big for my 3-year-old.) They look great. They come with little bag cases and cleaning wipes. They're holding up well to rough and tumble play.

title: Great Kid Glasses
text: These glasses are great for a kid. They are the right size and the finish is like a matte rubber feel. They also come with little tips for the arms that are silicone and can go down behind the ear to help hold the glasses on when you're playing and running about. They can be put on or off. My 9-year-old likes them on.

title: Teenager Loves Them
text: My teenage son will only wear flip flops. He has expressed that he would like closed toe shoes at times, but typically finds them too constricting or hot. These, he loves. They are lightweight and wide enough to not feel constricting. Super comfortable. They don't slide around, either. There is a slight lip on the back of the shoe that holds it in place a bit. They look nice, too. Nothing fancy, but definitely a nice look.

title: Size Down
text: I usually wear a size 9 in women's. I ordered the size 8 and they fit perfectly. They are so incredibly comfortable. I want to wear them all the time. I absolutely love them.

title: Sweatshirt Skirt
text: I really like the feel of this skirt. I like the material. I wanted to love the skirt. But it really just isn't very flattering on me. It adds bulk and is a bit on the short side for my taste.

title: Simple Sandal
text: These sandals are cute and simple. They're pretty comfortable for what they are. I mean, you can't go hiking or anything in them. They're not that type of sandal. But they are cute and fit well.

title: Easy Shoes
text: These are cute and easy shoes. Throw them on with jeans and they instantly elevate an outfit. They're comfortable and stay on well. They do crease a bit with wear, but I don't see any way around that.

title: Modest Swimsuit
text: This is a very comfortable and modest swimsuit. The shorts have about a 2" inseam. The top is well lined and has a layer look. It is also longer and comes down to the hips. It is comfortable to move around in and keeps coverage as you move about.

title: Baby Shirts
text: These are made in India. They are slightly larger than other baby brands. Not so far off that I would necessarily say to buy a size down. But the 18 month size is generally the size of 18-24 month in other brands. The edges of the shirt are also unhemmed at the neck. They are hemmed at the arm and leg holes, but have raw edges around the neck. The colors are great. They seem nice and comfortable for baby. And they don't seem to stretch out oddly or anything.

title: Comfy Socks
text: These socks are thicker than novelty socks. They are a nice, thick-- but not overly thick-- material. Stretchy and they stay up well. Great socks. Each pair came individually wrapped.

title: Soft but not very durable...
text: They are very soft, but they aren't very durable. They could use some support, even though they're slippers. The stitching has come undone, so half of the sole is falling off on one of them. Also, one end of the "lacing" separated from one of the slippers.

title: Great value and comfort!
text: They feel great, fit well, and are very reasonably priced. They look alright but could look better. They are also a bit "fluffy" (so to speak)— the fabric looks very padded. They are quite comfortable, though.

title: Very Comfortable!
text: These socks are great. They are super comfortable and fit great. They are extremely soft, are quite thick, and seem durable, yet they breathe well.

title: Perfect lounge pants!
text: These are perfect. They are very comfortable and fit perfectly. They are super-stretchy but don't look bulky. They are also extremely soft.

title: Prone to Pulls
text: This cardigan is very comfortable and it looks nice. It is already oversized without needing to size up. The looser knit is a lot more prone to pulls. So, depending on your activities, this may be okay for you or awful for you. I have a baby who thinks pulling at the knit is fun, so it hasn't been the best for me. The pockets are large enough to hold your phone.

title: Comfy
text: I sized up for a more comfortable fit and I am glad that I did. These do have a polyester feel to them, but ti isn't uncomfortable. I wouldn't want to be wearing this out and about, but for around the house and sleep wear, it is a great set. It does pill a bit when you wash it.

title: Softer Than Expected
text: I expected this straw bag to be tough and stiff, but the straw is really very soft and moldable. It has a nice feel to it. The edges have a nice binding so they don't get all scuffed up on the straw. The interior is fully lined with adorable fabric with jellyfish on it. It does have one interior pocket for keeping small items. The straps are narrow and the perfect length for the size of the tote. It puts it at just the right spot on the body. The turtle is also super adorable. This is a great bag for summer.

title: Tote
text: This is a well made tote. The lemon color is more of a tennis ball yellow than a lemon. The fabric is fantastic and the finishes are really nice. Leather pull tabs on all zippers. Inside, there is a small zippered pocket on one side and an open zipper pocket on the other. I would have really liked a water bottle pocket either inside or outside, but that is really the only thing this bag lacks.

title: Narrow
text: I like the fabric of this bag and the exterior finishing details. It perfectly matches my backpack from the same brand. However, for a "weekender" bag, it is a little small. Slightly wider than a tote bag. Interior pockets are the exact same as they would be on a much smaller bag. Small zipper pocket on one side of the interior, small open pocket on the other side. Bigger pockets inside would be nice. And then the actual width of the bag from front to back is really narrow. It doesn't have side gussets at all, and the width of the leather strip on the bottom is so narrow. The back is practically flat. It would maybe hold enough clothing for a day. It would hold a pair of flat sandals or flip flops, but not actual shoes. I'm just disappointed with the interior pockets and the dimensions.

title: Waistband Issues
text: I like these pants. However, the waistband is very wide elastic and it got all out of sorts in the wash. That means that after the first wear, these pans just never laid flat like they should again. The elastic got twisted and folded in various places.

title: Such A Nice Dress
text: This dress is so comfortable. It feels like you're wearing pajamas. Yet it looks so nice! It is like a slightly nicer version of a t-shirt dress. It would be appropriate for work, but it also works well for a lazy Saturday at the park. Great dress.

title: His Favorite
text: My 11-year-old lives in this sweater. It looks nice on him. He would wear it to bed if I let him. It is that comfortable. It holds up well to washing, too. He wears it every time it is clean. It is the shirt that goes from the dryer straight onto his body every time.

title: A Little Short
text: I wish this tank was just a little longer. It barely hits at the top of my waist. With leggings, I just wish it came down a bit longer. If I was smaller on top, it would likely be fine.

title: Love
text: I love this tunic. It is so soft and looks "put together" even with just plain black leggings. It is on the roomy side, which is intended. I wouldn't size down because it'd look weird if it were fitted. Washes well. I get lots of compliments. This makes a great addition to a capsule wardrobe.

title: Runs Small
text: My boys liked this shirt. It did run small. But it is a comfortable, almost sweater material. And the contrast cuffs and collar just give it an extra something. Holds up well to regular machine washing.

title: Comfortable Footwear
text: These loafers are really comfortable and have a nice casual look. They are more ideal for indoor wear, as the sole does not protect the upper against wear and tear much. But overall, I like the look and feel of these shoes.

title: So Clever
text: These are clever little sandals. You can wear them as slides, sandals, or sling backs-- depending on where you place the back two straps. They're really cute and comfortable. I'd say they run true to size. For a size 8, the size 8 fit perfectly. They make really nice shoes to wear with summer shorts or dresses.

title: Fit is Slim
text: This is a nice feeling and looking flannel. They aren't kidding about the slim fit. I anticipated it being less busty. I didn't anticipate that is would also be narrow through the shoulders. It is a cute shirt, though.

title: I Like These
text: I like these workout leggings. They have light compression. I'm between sizes and sized up. If I had sized down, they'd still fit, the compression would have just been intensified. They are squat proof and don't move around while you're working out.

title: Cozy
text: These pants are so cozy. They are much more of a lounge or sleep pant than an exercise pant, in my opinion. But they are super cozy. You don't really have to size up to get a nice loose fit. They're cut oversized. I mean, if you wanted them SUPER oversized, then sizing up you can still cinch the waist down.

title: Vinyl Is Thick
text: I like this shirt. The fabric of the t-shirt is that super soft cotton/poly blend feel. It is a women's fit shirt and while I usually prefer a unisex fit, I did size up to make up for that. The only issue is that the vinyl used on the shirt is rather thick. It makes it lay heavy on the graphic area and doesn't feels as nice as a screen printed design. But the shirt looks cute and I like it.

title: Sized Up
text: Just based on the fact that these were stretchy denim, I had an inkling that they might run a bit smaller. And I was right. I'm glad I sized up. They're really cute and comfy, but I prefer not to wear tight overalls. Glad I went up a size.

title: Comfy
text: I purchased similar leggings for twice the price and I like these more. They are not very snug compression— definitely more of a medium hold. I do have to work and wiggle a bit to make sure the lines are hitting me in the right spots. But these are comfortable leggings. They are great for working out. Definitely have more of an athletic look and feel, so not so great for lounging. They’re also squat proof.

title: Good Workout Shorts
text: These workout shorts are nice and snug. They work well under skirts and dresses, too. They are closer to mid-thigh on me. (I’m 5’4”.) The waist is nice and high and doesn’t roll down while wearing. The bottoms do ride up a little in the inner thigh area, but nothing too bad or too annoying. They just don’t stay put all day.

title: Leggings
text: These aren’t compression leggings, but they are snug leggings for working out. They look like athletic leggings. They feel nice and comfortable and are squat proof!

title: Not As Bright
text: These pants aren’t as bright in person as they are in the picture. They are comfortable. They fit well. They are thick and cozy for lounging and hanging around the house. Great quarantine pants. No need to size up, either. But they are more on the pastel side than the neon side.

title: Sweatshirt
text: This is a fun tie dye sweatshirt. It isn’t cotton. It has more of an athletic dry fit feel to the fabric. I sized up for a roomier fit and am happy with that fit. It makes it work better for leggings.

title: Leggings
text: These leggings are cute and comfortable. They have more of an athletic fit and feel. They aren’t full compression leggings, but they do fit snug. They’re also really cute.

title: Comfy Boots
text: These comfy boots fit true to size. No need to size up. They’re warm and toasty. My teenager loves them. She wear them with almost everything.

title: Chunky Cardigan
text: This chunky cardigan is great. It is great winter and into the spring. It is very warm and has the nice knit pattern going on. Pockets on the front are big enough for your phone. Looks cute. Fits well.

title: Great Kid Boots
text: Zippers on the side of kid boots is pure genius. These fit well. They’re comfortable and hold up well to rough and tumble play. They are easy for my kid to put on himself, since he can keep them laced and tied and just zip them on and off. Perfect boots for an active little guy.

title: Size Up
text: These run small, so definitely size up. The elastic bottom band keeps them from being too long. They look best on a more athletic figure as they are more “gym” looking than hanging out on the couch looking. They do have pockets! And they are comfortable.

title: Comfy Shoes
text: These are super lightweight and comfortable. They’re nice looking. Definitely not “dressy” but a little above your basic casual. These work well with jeans. They feel like you’re wearing your house shoes around.

title: Not High Impact
text: This sports bra offers light to medium bounce hold. I feel like I’d get slightly better hold if I had sized down once. They are comfortable. They’re super stretchy. Easy to get off, even after arm day. But they don’t hold you very tight.

title: Runs Small
text: Size up to get a nice oversized fit like the picture. It is cozy and flattering. It is a nice sweater— just doesn’t run oversized when it is meant to look oversized.

title: A Little Sheer
text: This dress is super cute and light for summer. It looks nice. The only issue is that it is a little thin. It definitely requires a slip or slip shorts and a camisole underneath.

title: Teenagers
text: My teenage son was insistent that he needed toe socks. He really likes these. They’re thin enough that they don’t feel awkward between your toes, but thick enough to provide some cushioning. He thinks they’re perfect.

title: Okay
text: These necklaces are okay. They’re a little cheap looking. From a slight distance, they look fine. But up close, they do look a little cheap.

title: So cute
text: These earring are so cute! They seem to be well made. The hoops don’t close. It doesn’t appear that they are supported to. They stay in fine without closing.

title: Run Small
text: These do run about a size small. They are super soft. They have adjustable straps, so you can customize the fit. They’re nice and thin, so they don’t add heat. These are good camisoles— they just run a tad small. And they didn’t seem that small until I washed them, so maybe they shrunk?

title: Trash
text: These are awful. They came with backs that don’t fit the post. The post is so soft and flimsy that it bent completely in trying to put the back on it (that didn’t fit). Straightening out the bent post didn’t go well. It resulted in a Completely squiggly post. These are just poorly made. Horrible quality. Not worth having. Do not recommend.

title: Love These
text: These bracelets are stretchy. They are on the small side, which I like because I have smaller wrists. They are heavy bracelets, as well. You can layer them or wear one at a time. They look nice on.

title: Nice Quarter-Zip
text: My 9-year-old loves this pullover. He wears mostly 8s, but some 10s. The medium fits him perfectly, but it is a snugger fit. If he was a true 10, it would be small. He loves it. It is well made and warm. I’m happy with this purchase.

title: Boys’ Favorite
text: These are my older boys’ favorite shirts. They love wearing them to bed and under sweaters and button-up shirts. For whatever reason, this particular pack was apparently superior to any other pack they’ve ever had and they requested that I stock up on them.

title: Sort of Not Swim Trunks
text: These shorts are super soft. The fabric is thin and they pack nicely. You can wear them in or out of the water. They’re comfortable enough to be lounge shorts. The fabric dries quickly. It is also very cool in hot weather. They do not have swim trunk mesh inside.

title: Soft and Stretchy
text: These shorts are super stretchy and comfortable. You’re able to move around like you’re wearing gym shorts with the look of typical chino shorts. Very comfortable. Very nice looking.

title: Cute Boots
text: My toddler loves these boots. They match a large variety of her wardrobe. They’re comfortable and easy for her to put on by herself. And they look cute. She tells me they are “comfy, cozy”. They look cute with dresses or pants.

title: Cute Shirt
text: This is kind of a cross between a sweatshirt and a long sleeve T-shirt. It is soft and comfortable. It does not have a name brand tag in the collar. The actual image on the shirt is vinyl though. Which isn’t as nice as a screen print image. The vinyl image is small enough that it doesn’t make too big of a difference.

title: Why With The Removable Pads?!
text: These would be perfect bras. They’re cute. They’re comfortable. But why do they put removable pads in?! What ever happened to bras with the padding made into the cup?! Is it so hard to do? Removable pads always suck. They flip around oddly and shift as you wear them. So, you remove them and don’t have enough padding for modesty. So you put them back in and fight them some more. Then you lose one in the laundry and just remove the other one and figure the lack of padding is just how it is now.

title: A Little Too Scuffy
text: The slippers are super comfortable. They aren’t very cute in my opinion, but they make up for it in comfort. The inside for is sewn down oddly in places making a little uncomfortable on your toes sometimes. Also, they start to get looser as you wear them, and that makes them slip off easily. You end up having to walk around with them like scuffs. It just isn’t very comfortable. If you were only wearing them for a small amount of time, or wearing them when you’re sitting down or some thing it would be fun. But if you’re walking around your house and going up and downstairs, they’re a little too loose to be safe.

title: Retro Socks
text: I really like these retro looking socks. They have the look of tube socks with the fit of decent athletic socks. It is a little bit of a bummer that only two pairs have the stripes. I would have liked more stripes and less plain, boring solids. But they fit well. They’re comfortable. A great anytime sock.

title: Mixed Feelings
text: I have mixed feelings on these leggings. On the one hand, they fit well and they’re cute. I like these a lot better than the typical faux leather look. The distressed look just adds something for me. However, they’re not as comfortable as regular black leggings. So I always hesitate to wear these over my plain black leggings. They’re a little more fancy, but also a little more like real pants. That’s the problem. I do like them. They fit well. But they aren’t as stretchy and comfortable as regular leggings. The fabric has a weird feel that takes some getting used to, as well. I think I’m maybe just not that into faux leather leggings. These are great for what they are. But they are not as comfortable as wearing your butter soft lounge around leggings.

title: Cozy
text: These are super cozy slippers. My teenage daughter love them immediately. They have a soft bottom, so they’re not great for going outside, even to check the mail. They are great for wearing around the house. They’re super cozy.

title: Cute
text: These are super cute. They fit an average female face well. They work well to protect your eyes from screens. And they look super cute.

title: Nice Jacket
text: This shirt/jacket is really nice. It is thick and warm. It has a soft interior. My teenage son loves it (and you know how teenage boys are about wearing jackets!). My husband was jealous of my son’s jacket, so now I may have to buy another one for him.

title: Cheap
text: The material on these is very cheap. It is thin and polyester. The drawstring holes are not finished. The drawstring is loose in the massive top casing. It just isn’t a well-made pair of pants. They’re lower quality than what you would expect.

title: Fit Small
text: I think these run a full size small. But they are super soft and cozy. They are really warm and cozy. The cut is also pretty unisex. They don’t have a feminine cut of look at all. Just make sure you order a full size (or even two) larger than what you would normally wear. The medium is closer to a small or extra small size.

title: Cozy Matted Cat Jacket
text: This jacket is very soft and comfortable. It is plushy and feels like I’m wearing a blanket. The grey with darker base does look a bit like a matted cat. But it feels soft and warm. People do tend to pet me when I wear it. No one can resist the cat jacket.

title: Love These
text: These bracelets are stretchy and they are varied sizes. I really like them. They are quite heavy. And they do make a light clinking noise when you wear them. (Not so long as solid metal bangles, but they aren’t completely silent either.) They look nice. You can wear one or two or you can wear them all.

title: Baby Rocky
text: This little baby sweatsuit is so soft and cozy. The inside is soft and a little slick. The outside is velvety. It fits really well and the baby seems happy and comfort in it.

title: DIY Keychain
text: These are super fun and easy to make your own keychains. You can use a picture. My kids have enjoyed making little works of art and putting them into the keychain. You could also print off something and put it inside. We tried, but you can only get one piece of paper in. Fabric also doesn’t fit inside.

title: Great Tote
text: This bag has lots of pockets and secrets. I really like it. You can use the handles or it has backpack straps in a back pocket. It is a little deeper than I prefer, but that is really my only complaint. The zipper pulls are leather. The bag works well as an overnight bag or even as a diaper bag.

title: Cute and Comfortable
text: This bra is cute and comfortable. It comes with removable pads. The fit is comfortable and flattering.

title: Small Cups
text: These bras are a mixed bag. On the one hand, I like the pullover racer back style. The band around the ribs is stretchy and very accommodating. I found it true to size. The cups, however, run very small. If you’re above a D cup, they probably aren’t going to work out for you— even in larger sizes. (For reference, I’m a 36 DD. The XL fits perfectly in the band, but the cups are very small on me.)

title: Jersey Maxi Skirt
text: I don’t know why I expected this to be woven cotton and not knit cotton. But this skirt is Jersey cotton like a t-shirt. It has a nice flowey fit. However, the fabric makes this a casual skirt. It can only be dressed up so much. It looks cute with a graphic tee or a fitted t-shirt. It also looks cute with an oversized sweater. It is long. At 5’4”, this skirt has to be pulled up a little above my natural waist (an inch or two above my belly button) for it to not drag the floor.

title: Comfy and Stretchy
text: These are comfortable undies. They have good coverage in the back. They are very stretchy and comfortable. The fit is similar to high end running underwear I’ve had. Definitely like these. Would definitely buy more.

title: Fit Was Weird
text: The fit on these was super weird. I was hoping with the high waist, they’d be like the super expensive postpartum leggings. The top was too big. The fabric was super unforgiving. These were the most unflattering leggings I have ever put on my body (and I wear leggings all the time). The fabric wasn’t really compressing— it was like it was slightly no stretchy or something strange. In some places they were too big and in other places they were too snug. Maybe they just weren’t made to fit my body type or something. (Weight mostly in the belly after having a baby.) Whatever went wrong with these, it was very wrong for me.

title: Cute, But Lack Quality
text: These are cute shoes. I like the look of them. But they lack quality. The footbed is very flat. The interior is that felt fuzz stuff. They’re just not made for comfort. They do take some breaking in, as well, for the outer part to get comfortable. They also run about half a size small.

title: So Comfy
text: My son would wear this sweater every single day if I let him. He loves it. It is super soft and comfortable. Very warm without being too fluffy or cumbersome. It is a well made sweater and has held up well to constant washing since it is his favorite shirt.

title: Sized Up For Fit
text: I sized up to give it the fit like pictured. It is a thick t-shirt material-- not quite a sweatshirt but thicker than a normal t-shirt. It fits well and it super comfortable. The writing seems well adhered. It is a vinyl lettering and not a screen print.

title: It Is Okay
text: This is a wearable sweater. I think it runs a bit small based on the image. It is very wide but cropped in length. I think the length is a bit shorter than pictured. The neck opening is also a bit snugger than pictured. It is pretty comfortable. The color is the same as the picture. It is a nice seed stitch, which isn't too airy but also not super dense. Decent sweater. Just a little weird on the sizing.

title: Tight Waist
text: The fabric was much thinner than I expected. More of a thick t-shirt material and not a sweatshirt material. The waist is also really tight. Much tighter than was really comfortable. The length was fine. The legs were fine. It was just the waist elastic was too tight.

title: So Comfy
text: These look like grandma slippers. However, the comfort you feel while wearing them makes up for their looks. They are so soft and cozy. The footbed is a memory foam material that forms to your feet. I almost don't want to wear real shoes! These are a definite must for your quarantine wardrobe.

title: Very Small
text: I have a dress cut similarly to this from a boutique. This shirt is a clear knock-off of similar shirts at boutiques. It is not even close to the same. It runs very small. The XL was closer to a medium if you take the model picture to be how it should fit. The fabric is cheap and thin. It just doesn't look nice at all. There is no front or back tag and the fact that the front and back are cut the exact same should show you there are some problems with this shirt. The triple straps don't lay in any way as they should. Considering that I didn't pay all that much for a similar product from a boutique, I'd definitely skip this one.

title: Favorite
text: We (my 14 year old and I) tried out a couple different kinds of pierce-less (I prefer that term to fake) nose rings. This set was the best! You get a variety of options. The hoops on the nostril bother me the least. I can’t really feel them at all. The septum options tickle my nose way too much, but my daughter prefers those. These stay on pretty well.

title: Nice Hat
text: My tween loves this hat. He recently destroyed his favorite hat and was looking for a replacement. He considers this an upgrade from his old favorite! It looks nice. It appears well made. And he loves it. (He is quite sensitive to discomforts, and he says this hat is super comfortable.)

title: Thin!
text: I love this style of dress. I purchased two very similar ones recently for the same price from a boutique that are much better in terms of quality. (Zenana brand if you’re curious.) I like the color of this one, but it leaves a lot to be desired. The thin fabric is more like pajama fabric. It isn’t lined at all. The elastic around the waist is wavy in certain places and not others, so the gathering falls weird on me. It is also not completely straight in the hem. Mine is a tiny bit shorter in the center back when on the hanger, so when wearing, that little flaw it exaggerated. It would be a decent length without the little evenness problem.

title: Good and Bad
text: This set has some good and some bad nose rings. They’re all pierce less— but they all look good. The larger, fancier ones tickle like crazy and are unwearable due to that. (One of mine came with the crystals fallen out, as well.) But the solid ones are definitely more wearable and they stay out really well. Once you get used to it, you don’t notice it is there.

title: Super Soft
text: These leggings are so super soft. They’re like a cross between a butter fabric legging and an athletic legging. They have a mid-weight compression going. Nothing super compressing, but enough to really be considered an athletic legging. The color is so soft and perfect. I really like these.

title: Great Swim Bottoms
text: My daughter had been asking for Capri length swim bottoms. She thought that they didn’t exist. We’re so glad we found these. She likes the coverage, and also like how they fit. They are super functional, and don’t get in the way. But they also cover your whole backside. The black matches her tankini top perfectly.

title: Classic Denim Jacket
text: This is a classic denim jacket. You really can’t go wrong. It works well for all types of looks. Wear it all the time.

title: Snug Fit
text: This sweatshirt is awesome. It looks great. It just fits a little snug. If you want a properly oversized sweatshirt fit, you'll have to size up. If you go with your regular size, it'll fit, but snugger. I also think it runs a tad short. If you're tall, that would likely be a problem. But it looks awesome. The quality is superb. And the feel is great. Just be aware of how you'd like it to fit and size around accordingly.

title: Not My Favorite
text: These are not my favorite. They're not shaping enough to really be shapewear. But they're too snug to not be shapewear. That just means they're regular underwear that are uncomfortable. I also found they run a little small. I wear this brand in other styles and got the same size and these are a bit smaller. They're tighter around the top elastic and leg elastics than other styles. I'm just not a fan. They're also not cute. I can deal with ugly undies if they're doing a good job or they're comfortable. When they're neither, I just don't know why I'd bother.

title: Long Shorts
text: These shorts are pretty long. They come almost to my knee. They're a nice cotton feeling short. They're pretty thick and they hold everything in pretty well. I wouldn't say they offer firm compression, but they do hold things snugly. Under skirts and dresses, the pockets are a bit noticeable. So, if you're buying them for that, these might not be the best.

title: Cozy Pullover
text: This pullover is super cute and cozy. You kind of get the sherpa look and the buffalo plaid look in the same shirt! It is soft and cozy.

title: Great Bra
text: I've been pregnant or breastfeeding non-stop since 2005. That said, I've gone through more than my fair share of nursing bras. These are great! They provide a bit more support than a sleep bra, but they're also comfortable enough to wear as a sleep bra. Definitely more of a medium support. The fabric is stretchy and holds everything in. You don't have issues with the bra not holding everything in place when you lay on your side at night. But you can also easily wear this bra during the day. Super comfortable. And suitable for all the time wear. Well, maybe not when exercising because there is definitely not enough support for that.

title: Laughably Small
text: This sweater is so laughably small. I don't even know what to say about it. It had no tag, so there was no way to know front and back. We determined that it didn't matter. But it was a good 2-3 sizes smaller than it should have been. I think the large might be sized for X-small to fit how it fits the model. It was skin-tight, and short! It was very wonky. Definitely not a great sweater at all. It did provide some great laughs.

title: Runs Small
text: This skirt is cute, but it runs very small. I ordered a size up from my regular size and it was too small. The XL fit my daughter who wears a medium (size 8) perfectly. So, be aware of the sizing! Order two (or more) sizes up. Other than the sizing, it is really cute.

title: Sweet Necklace
text: If you're into dainty necklaces or layering necklaces, this is a great one. It has multiple length options on the chain. It is very dainty. It looks really cute on. I'm happy with the look and quality of this necklace.

title: Horrible Shoes
text: These have got to be one of the worst pairs of shoes I've ever seen. If gas stations sold shoes, this would be the shoe they would sell. They are completely floppy and don't hold their shape at all. The sizing is a joke, I'm pretty sure they make one size and stick random tags in them. They have nothing holding the leather shape. They're awful. The price tag and materials made them tempting-- but they're awful. I've never seen a worse quality shoe. They're like baby shoes for grown-ups with a sole stuck on. They're like shoes made for a cheap Halloween costume. They're really, really bad.

title: Comfortable, But Weird
text: These are legging-jogger hybrids. They're tight in the tummy and butt, but then loose in the thigh, and then snug again just below the knee. They're a slick almost swimsuit-like material. They're really comfortable and I love them for working in the yard or hiking. Not such a fan of wearing them for exercise or lounging. The length is a bit weird. I think if they were a 7/8 length, they'd be better for my body. But the just below the knee fit is weird for me. It hits the upper part of my calve. They do have pockets, like normal pockets. But they aren't flattering on me. And the fit is weird. At first, I hated the fabric, but after wearing it a couple of times-- the fabric doesn't bother me much. It is light and breezy while still feeling covered.

title: Super Soft
text: These were so super soft out of the package. However, they lost a little bit of that kitten-belly feel in the wash. They work fine. They're not a lot of compression. If you're looking for sturdy compression, these aren't that. They do come up just above my belly button. They're a 7/8 length, which hits me right at the ankle. They're not bad leggings. They're just a little between exercise leggings and comfort leggings, so I'm not ever sure what to do with them. They're a little tight for loungewear, but a little loose for exercise. Maybe that is exactly what you're looking for, though.

title: Love
text: I absolutely love this gown. It is so soft. The length is perfect. So many nursing nightgowns are so short and this one hits right at the knee. The buttons are easy to unbutton and rebutton. It is easy to feed the baby, even in a side-lying position. It is such a nice, soft fabric. Thick enough to not feel exposed. But not so thick it feels like a sweatshirt or is hot. This is one of my favorite nursing gowns.

title: Duck Boots
text: My son loves these boots! The tongue is made onto the boot, so there isn't an opening except for the top. But they can be tightened with the laces. They're very warm and great for wearing outdoors.

title: Perfect Baby Sock
text: These are the perfect socks for baby! They are so tall that they can't get them off easily! They also don't slip down and fall off. They do have little rubber grippy dots on the bottom if your little one is already standing or toddling around. They are really snug on my little one's legs, but she is quite the chunker. They keep their feet and legs warm. They're also great if you're a babywearer. Because as their little pants ride up, their little legs are still well covered.

title: Love
text: This sweater is so thick and soft. It is a plush dream. I absolutely love it. It fits well. It is super cozy. It has a cute buffalo plaid woven in. It looks great with jeans, skirts, or dresses. Very versatile for getting your summer wardrobe through the cooler months. I absolutely love it.

title: Arms Are Weird
text: I have a similar sweater in a different color from another brand. The overall fit is great. Love the oversized fit. Love the popcorn look and feel. Love the color. However, the arms in this one are pretty thick and snug, which is weird. The arm portion from the wrist to just above the elbow is very thick, tight, and doesn't stretch well. I don't have large arms, so it fits fine, it just looks a bit off. If you have bigger arms, this sweater won't work at all. I really would just prefer the arm area to be looser and have more give. If it weren't for the weird arms, this sweater would be perfect.

title: Fit Like The Name Brand
text: These do run a little snug, like the name brand. However, just like the name brand, if you wear them for a few days, they'll conform to your foot and they'll be super comfortable. These do not have the leather inner lining. But they are super comfortable once broken in. The sole is pretty wimpy, but they always are on this style of shoe.

title: Top Is Short
text: This is a decent lounge set. I think the size is true to size. It is comfortable. But the top is a bit short. The shorts aren't really overtly high rise, but the top is a bit short for the shorts. And a cropped hoodie isn't my idea of good lounge around the house clothes, but that is just my opinion. The fabric is ribbed, but on the thicker side.

title: T-Shirt Hoodie
text: This hoodie is a t-shirt material. It is not thick, sweatshirt material. It is well made. It fits really nice and cozy. I sized up to make sure I got a comfy fit, but that wasn't really necessary. It would have fit fine without sizing up.

title: Cute But Poorly Made
text: These little tights are adorable. However, they are poorly made. The little bows are barely stitched on and they start coming off in the first wash. These will not last long. The bows are tiny and just poorly put on. The tights themselves are of decent quality. They're not super thick, but thick enough to be opaque.

title: Toddler Shoes
text: My toddler loves these shoes. They are normal width, so little ones with fat feet will have a difficult fit. These are really comfortable for my little one. She loves them. They're easy for her to put on by herself-- a vital part of toddler shoes.

title: Cozy
text: This is a cozy cardigan. The chunky knit and mid-length make it a great layering piece-- especially with jeans and a graphic tee. I find it to fit exactly as pictured.

title: Fit Is Smallish
text: I think the fit on this dress is a little small. I sized up and it fits snug. It is a great dress for breastfeeding. It is a flattering fit. And the length is nice for the fall/winter. The color is unusual. Like a very deep espresso. Not quite black but not quite brown. I paired with some basic tan flats for an effortless slightly casual look. You could probably dress the solid colors up a little more. The length is good for me. If you're very tall, it'll likely be more of a ballet length.

title: So Soft
text: A ruana is basically a blanket that you can wear in public and get compliments on. They are essentially a fancy, publicly acceptable Snuggie. This ruana is so soft. You just want to stay wrapped in it. The weave is pretty dense, but it is lightweight. It keeps you nice and warm without being super bulky. This would be an excellent gift. Since it is essentially a wearable blanket, it would fit a person of any shape or size.

title: Runs Narrow
text: I have several nursing pajama gowns. This one runs super slim compared to others. It definitely doesn't fit like a maternity fit. I also hate the zippers. They're cold and you can feel them on your sides when they're zipped. They're really uncomfortable. At night, I usually feed the baby while lying in bed. This gown is very awkward to use while lying down. I'm just not liking the fit or function of this at all.

title: Cute Little Sock Boots
text: These little boots are more fancy socks than boots. They do run a tiny bit large, which I appreciate as the mother of a fat baby. They're pretty cute. And they're very soft and very warm.

title: Upgrade!
text: This hat is like the usual knit hats you can buy anywhere in the winter. But the patch gives it something extra. It is reasonably warm. You can’t really wear it uncuffed without hiding the patch or having the patch upside down.

title: Teenager Approves
text: My teenage son is a hat guy. He wears hats all the time. This hat was very much immediately approved and went into his “wear often” pile of hats. It is pretty warm and thick. And the patch makes for a nice addition.

title: The Cat is Cute
text: My teenage daughter likes to wear socks with her Mary Jane style shoes. I thought she’d love these. While they are super cute with the cat sticking up out of the back of the shoe, the socks are just not the most comfortable or best quality. The sheer parts are very uncomfortable on the foot. You can see the strings and things from the heel area all in the sheer part. They just have a messy look to them. The bottom colored parts aren’t much better in terms of how they feel. It is a little thicker in those parts, but have this weird polyester feeling to them. Definitely look cuter in the picture than they do in person.

title: Runs Small
text: These pajamas are really soft. The fabric is like a slightly thicker, plushier t-shirt material. I also like the wider strap on the tank. I do feel like they’re about a size smaller than labeled. I got the XL for a slightly roomy fit like the model, but they’re much tighter. The top fits like a large. The bottoms are about the same size as my large athletic shorts. If you want them to fit like they do in the photos, you need to size up.

title: Teenager Loves It
text: My teen son loves this jacket. It is plain enough that it doesn’t scream little kid. But it has some nice details and cozy flannel interior. He also likes all the pockets. It fits him well. I’d say it’s pretty true to size.

title: Runs Small
text: This sweater run small. I’ll definitely size up. I would have loved it, but it puckers oddly at the bottom of the way. If it fits skin tight, it doesn’t do it. But when it fits normally, it sticks out oddly. It just won’t lay flat.

title: Itchy
text: These socks are very itchy. They aren’t soft touch finished or anything. They feel very scratchy and itchy. Each sock pair is individually wrapped— which seemed like a waste of packaging. I like the colors. But my toddler won’t wear them because they itch and I honestly don’t blame her. I wouldn’t wear them. They look fine. They just feel pretty awful.

title: Fit Snug
text: These shoes are much more silver than grey. The heel and tongue feels like kids’ craft foam. They fit on the snug side in terms of width. They aren’t narrow, they just feel like what they are— elastic bands around your feet. They are surprisingly comfortable for what they are. They make pretty decent walking shoes. The quality is just not that great.

title: Fit is A Little Small
text: I love the color and the length. The fit is a bit snug. I’d say it fits true to size, but is intended to be a snug fit on top and in the arms. I wish I had sized up because I’m not a fan of tight clothing. It is a great length, hitting me right at the knee. It is also a good breastfeeding friendly dress. The fabric feels like butter leggings fabric and is a little bit clingy.

title: Nice “Extra” Bag
text: This is a giant bag that you can stick into your regular bag when not in use. The bag it folds into isn’t attached. Folding the big bag into the little bag is really easy. The little bag then snaps into the big bag as a side pocket when your using the big bag. It is very sturdy. The fabric is a little loud with rustling. It is great for shopping, particularly at the farmers’ market. It also makes a good bag to take to a picnic or something where you’ll use what is in the bag and then you don’t have this massive bag full of nothing to deal with. It is super convenient. The small bag is about the size of a makeup bag.

title: Runs Small
text: While I love that this shirt is made in the USA and I love the cut of it— it is super small. I’d definitely recommend sizing up! It is a little on the thin side, which I’m not too upset by. Just wish it didn’t run so small!

title: Runs Small!
text: While I love that this shirt is made in the USA and I love the cut of it— it is super small. I’d definitely recommend sizing up! It is a little on the thin side, which I’m not too upset by. Just wish it didn’t run so small!

title: Pockets!
text: You know dresses with pockets are the best! This dress is fitted on the top, but not skin tight. The bottom is more roomy. It comes down several inches past the knee, which is perfect. It is super comfortable. The neckline is high. It is super modest without looking frumpy.

title: Run Small and Short
text: These jeans are high waisted. They run a bit small through the waist and hips. They fit, but very snugly. The length is perfect for being 5’4”. They would be too short if you’re much taller. They’re nice quality. I like the wash and the fit is flattering— just snug.

title: T-Shirt Material
text: This shirt is t-shirt material. That isn’t really a problem. The fit is much more narrow, especially through the body. If you want it to fit as pictured, you’ll likely need to size up once or even twice. The arms are a little baggy, but the torso is cut more narrow— like a fitted t-shirt. It does stretch. I just would prefer an oversized fit to something more fitted.

title: Cute
text: This is a rather cute, but thin sweatshirt. Really the only problem I have with it is that the White part is a bit thinner than the other areas and is a bit see-through. Other than that, I really like this shirt. It comes to about the hip in length.

title: So Fluffy
text: This jacket is so soft and fluffy. The zipper is nice and smooth. It comes right about to the hip level. It has pockets! I absolutely love it. So soft and cozy.

title: So Comfy
text: These cropped sweatpants are so comfy! They have nice big pockets. The material is more like a thick t-shirt than sweatshirt material. They come mid-calf on me. The cuffs aren’t too tight. They’re really comfy for working out or lounging on the couch.

title: Great Kid Glasses
text: These are great blue light blocking glasses for a kid. They are appropriately sized for about a five-year-old. They will work up to about 10 or 11 years old, or down to about three years old. But they fit ideally for a 5 to 7-year-old. My son loves them, and wears them while he plays his Nintendo switch.

title: A Little Small in the Waist
text: These pants are a little small in the waist. The fabric is also a bit synthetic feeling. They’re okay, but they definitely look cheaper in person than they appear in the pictures. The tie dye doesn’t look dyed, it looks more printed on the weird fabric.

title: Not Entirely Practical
text: This is not nearly as convenient as a normal throw. If you’re lounging on the couch, it is just too much junk behind you. It is nice though for bonfires, football games, and that sort of thing. Things where you’re not leaning back. It is super soft. It is super plushy. It is also pretty heavy. Again, not super practical.

title: Cozy Slippers
text: These slippers are super cozy. They fit well. They have bottoms that allow you to walk outside to the mailbox or whatnot. Really, the only drawback is the quality. The material certainly feel cheap.

title: Shiny Leggings
text: These are shiny. I’m not a fan of shiny leggings. Not my thing. These are also a bit on the big side. They’re long on me, but the fabric scrunches up in weird ways on my legs. I probably should have gotten a smaller size. (I just had a baby and all my extra weight is in my tummy.) If they weren’t so shiny, I might try and like them more.

title: Good Shoes
text: Looking at the photos, I was pretty convinced they were styrofoam inside. However, they aren’t. The pictures are deceiving in that way. These are decent shoes. They have medium support. The fit is spot on. They also look pretty nice. Really, they aren’t as good of quality as name brand sneakers, but they are about the same as off brands you’d find elsewhere.

title: Water Shoes
text: These water shoes are okay. The fit is spot on, though you may want to consider sizing down since you wear them without socks. The only issue I have with these is in the metal mesh on the bottom. On the one hand, the metal mesh will keep small sticks or rocks from stabbing your foot. And it is lightweight. However, the mesh came rumpled in places and I couldn’t get it smoother out. It just seemed like the quality was a bit lacking.

title: Sized Up
text: I sized up on this sweatshirt because I hate closer fitting hoodies. This sweatshirt is pretty standard sweatshirt sizing. It isn’t made oversized or fitted. It falls a bit between the two. It has metal aglets. (Is that what you call them on a shirt, too?) Nice quality. Very cozy. Good screen print job.

title: Soft Cardigan
text: This cardigan is not super oversized. It is on the long side, stopping a little above mid- thigh. It also has two nice pockets. It is very soft and plush. It is super comfortable and makes a great addition to your fall wardrobe. I would not size down, as it is a bit more fitted than some other fluffy cardigans.

title: Amazing Sweater
text: This sweater is amazing! It is so well made. I love it. It looks awesome with stretch colored jeggings. It is oversized in a really nice way. No need to size up for the oversized look.

title: Boot Sneakers
text: These boot sneakers are pull on. They are comfortable. They look nice. They’re a little loose in the ankle, but they don’t move around when they’re on. My teenager thinks they’re awesome.

title: Comfy Sweater
text: This is such a comfy sweater. It is oversized and chunky knit, which makes it just feel like a cozy fall. It is almost like wearing a blanket. I absolutely love it.

title: Super Comfortable
text: These pants are really cozy. I think they run a tad bit small, so if you’re on the larger end of a size, I’d definitely order up. I love having pockets, too!

title: Funny Tee
text: The shirt itself is decent quality. And I like the image. However, the vinyl they used is really thick. I really hate that thick vinyl feel on shirts.

title: Oil Slick Earrings
text: These earrings are super cute. They come in a really nice box. However, the earrings are each pair in a plastic bag, so it isn’t very giftable in my opinion. They’re really neat looking. Like an oil slick inside of a crystal . My teenager thinks they’re awesome and promptly stole them.

title: Bad Idea
text: These shoes themselves are super cute. However, it was a bad idea to get them for a toddler who is potty training. As you can imagine, the first time she had an accident wearing those shoes, it was a complete disaster. However, I can assure you that they are machine washable.

title: Not As Oversized As I Expected
text: This shirt is the length of a tunic. It isn’t nearly as oversized as I thought in the width though. It is really well-made. It is very soft and slinky fabric. It is cotton but has a good fluidity to it. It isn’t very thick, but isn’t see-through at all.

title: A Bit Small
text: These underwear are a bit on the small side. They don’t have a lot of stretch. The top band is especially non-stretchy. They don’t have any compression at all. These are not Shapeware. They have little dots, like they are mesh, but they aren’t. They come up to about 2 inches below my belly button. These are my favorite. They’re fine. But I don’t reach for them unless I have nothing else clean.

title: Super Oversized
text: This sweater is the perfect cozy sweater for lounging around, we’re hanging out. It is very oversized. The only sizing, seems to be in the length of the arms. It can wrap completely around me. I love the softness and the nubby texture.

title: Small and Short
text: These pants run a little small. The double elastic waist, would be very tight if you’re on the larger side of your size. They are super soft buttery fabric. They are also on the short side. At 5‘4“ these hit just at the ankle.

title: Thin Sweater
text: This is an excellent transition sweater. It is very thin. It is well-made. And perfectly oversized. I really like it. It can be worn with shorts, or with jeans. It isn’t very warm.

title: Outside Is Soft
text: The outside of the shirt is so soft. However, the inside is a bit scratchy and weird. It feels like a cheap costume. Fit is true to size.

title: So Cute
text: This Halloween set for a toddler is adorable and comfy. They print on the shirt is screen printed with ink onto the shirt— it isn’t vinyl. It is a lot better quality than I expected. My daughter loves it.

title: Shorter
text: This waffle fabric hoodie is really comfortable. In width, it is appropriately oversized. Really, I just wish it were a bit longer. It hits right at my hips, but raises up when I raise my arms. It is on the thin side. It isn’t super warm.

title: Cat Necklace
text: This necklace is very small. It is super cute. My teenage daughter loves it. The pendant does come off the chain.

title: Adorable
text: My two-year-old loves this outfit. It is comfortable, yet super cute. It fits her really well. I think the pants are a tiny bit on the long side, but you can always roll them up or just tuck them into her boots.

title: Very Boxy
text: This dress is super comfortable. However, it is pretty shapeless and is cut very wide— like a big box. It is well made and good quality.

title: Nice Shirt
text: This is a very comfortable shirt that looks nice dressed up a bit. It is a large waffle knit. The twist at the bottom gives it a bit of shape and interest. It isn’t tight, but is a little loose fitting. It hits about at the hips.

title: Plush
text: This long cardigan is very well made. It is plush, but not heavy. The colors contrast nicely. It looks very nice on. And it has pockets!

title: Super Thick
text: This is a dense sweater. It is super soft and super warm. It is also pretty long. It is really well made and I’m impressed with the quality.

title: a bit tight but otherwise good
text: I'm not the biggest fan of this style of shirt, but I tried to give this one a chance. It was quite tight, even more than I expected. If you're looking for a snug fit, this might be the shirt for you. It was so snug that I just couldn't get comfortable in it.

title: Light Sweater
text: This sweater is nice and light. It is thin enough for comfortable wear all day. But it is high quality. My teenage son loves it.

title: Well Made
text: This is a well made sweater. It isn’t super thick. It is comfortable for everyday wear. My teenage son loves it. The quality is great.

title: Comfy!
text: I love these slippers. The bottom is like a rubbery flip flop bottom. It has arch support. You can wear them outside to get the mail. The fur part is super soft and cozy. These are great to wear around the house.

title: Basic Socks
text: These are decent basic socks. They are low. If you’re running, they slip down into your shoe. But for everyday wear, they’re fine.

title: Great Shoe
text: This tennis shoe is a great shoe for walking, or any type of cardio or gym activity. They fit really well. Super comfortable. They do have a bit of a rock to them, so you always step onto your heel. However, it isn’t as significant as some others that I’ve tried. Overall, there’s an excellent shoe. Excellent for walking.

title: So Cute
text: These shoes are my two-year-old’s favorite shoes. She loves them. They fit well, I’d say that they’re an accurate fit. My two year old  has rather tiny feet and these are a little loose on her but she can still wear them with ease.

title: Fun Sneakers
text: These are really fun every day sneakers. They work well shorts or jeans. They’re pretty comfortable, and they work well. They aren’t for running or athletic activity, but they work fine for walking and wearing around. From the side, it looks like you’re wearing two different colored shoes. Which is pretty fun, because people think you’ve lost your mind. But you haven’t lost your mind, you just have on wide striped shoes. And they’re awesome.

title: A Tad Narrow
text: These shoes are a tad on the narrow side. That said, they’re really awesome. I like the thicker bottoms. The colors are very bright and vivid. I think with where, the loosen up a bit.

title: Scary At First
text: At first, I was very concerned I was going to roll my ankle. These are very tall. That’s taller than I was used to. I tentatively put them on, and hoped for the best. They are surprisingly comfortable. They made walking much more comfortable. Instead of feeling pain in the sides of my legs and ankles I felt it in the back of my calf much more centrally. I like these. Also, my teenager says they’re cool.

title: Thneed
text: When I first saw the sweater, I thought it was a thneed the thing nobody wants and nobody needs. However, upon closer inspection, realized it was just a sweater. A very cozy and comfortable and oversized sweater. It looks really nice on. The fit is very flattering. It is very cozy and well-made. But it does really look like a thneed.

title: Oversized Cardigan
text: This cardigan is the perfect addition to your fall wardrobe. It is soft, and super light weight. It is acrylic, which makes it light and makes it dries super fast. It is very plush feeling. The black is true black and the white is super white.

title: Poor Quality
text: This pullover is amazingly soft. It is super plush. It is super cozy. However, the quality is just not there. It came with holes in both sleeves where the seams or not sewn completely shut. I would not buy this. Do not buy this.

title: Works
text: This swim diaper is pretty basic, but it works. It does not prevent liquids from leaving the diaper but does prevent solids from escaping (this is the same as every swim diaper, even paper ones). It seems comfortable on baby.

title: Okay
text: These are pretty good leggings. I think I prefer some cheaper leggings, but these aren't bad. The fit just isn't the best for someone with curves.

title: The Details
text: This shirt is the perfect fitting white button-up shirt. It is perfect in the thickness. Not too thick, but not paper thin either. Tommy nails it with the details.
