The buttons on the sleeves and collar are perfect. You really can't beat the quality of the shirt. It is just perfect in every way.

title: Too Hairy
text: This sweater is just a little too fuzzy. It has an angora like yarn that makes it super hairy. The print doesn’t stay nice and crisp looking because of all the fur.

title: Oversized Sweater
text: This sweater is super cozy. It is a very chunky knit and very warm. It is great for lounging around the house or going out. Not sure why it is always shown off shoulder, It is just a normal sweater cut.

title: A Little Narrow
text: These glasses are a little narrow. But they feel amazing, and they look awesome. The Lindsey’s are nice and dark. The side arms are wood.

title: Super Cozy
text: These slippers are super cozy. They are warm. They have no slip bottoms, so you can wear them to grab the mail. My 7-year-old commented that it looked like I was walking on hamsters.

title: T-Shirt Material
text: This hoodie is a thick t-shirt material. It is not a sweatshirt. It fits true to size and my teenager loves it. It is really stretchy and comfortable. The fit is like a standard unisex sweatshirt sizing.

title: Not Cotton
text: These are not standard cotton handkerchiefs. They are a polyester feeling fabric, more like a scarf fabric than a handkerchief fabric. Since we use handkerchiefs as handkerchiefs (for nose wiping and blowing) these are not even close to ideal. They came with two filters and elastics to make them into masks.

title: He Love Them
text: My five-year-old is quite odd when it comes to shoes. He loves puddles, so tennis shoes end up very smelly. But he is too rough and wild for sandals to work. (His last pair of “hiking” sandals lasted a month before he ripped one of the straps off. These are that perfect in-between. A water shoe tennis shoe. Comfortable enough for daily wear. Easy for him to put on by himself.

title: Loose Fit
text: The cardigan has a very relaxed and loose fit. I think you could easily size down, though I do like the looser fit. It has a looser weave, which is still pretty warm, but not super heavy. Great for casual wear. Perfect quarantine comfort.

title: Looser Fit
text: This cardigan has a looser fit. I wouldn’t size down, it looks great in the relaxed style. But you could easily size down if you needed to. It is super comfy and can be worn buttoned you or unbuttoned.

title: Cute Nursing Dress
text: This dress is really comfortable and cute. It is great for breastfeeding. I wouldn’t wear it without a cardigan, but it looks great with a cardigan so I’m okay with that. The strap are adjustable so you can make the neckline/waist higher or lower as needed.  There are no tacks or anything on the crossover neckline, which makes it perfect as is for breastfeeding. I sized up from my regular size since I recently had a baby. It hit me at the knee.

title: Graphic Too Thick
text: I like the fit of the tank. It is just really a shame that the graphic is so thick. The entire mountain range feels multiple layers thick and sits like a block on the shirt. It is really uncomfortable having a thick sheet of plastic across your chest. I imagine it will crack with washing.

title: Run Big
text: These sandals run big. Not wide— long. I probably would have ordered a size down. They’re pretty comfortable. I wouldn’t say they’re equal at all in comfort to the name brand version, but for the price, I’m pretty okay with that.

title: Fit is Small
text: The fit is a bit on the small side. The XL fits like a large, which is fine because I wear a large— I just order a size bigger because I prefer a much looser fit. This sweater is great. It is thick and warm. It feels like the perfect cozy sweatshirt when you’re wearing it, but looks like a nicer sweater. The quality on this is really good. I’m surprised at how nice it is.

title: Not as Pictured
text: I did not get the necklace as pictured. I got one plain chain, no dots on it. And the second was the dot necklace. The quality is also not very good. They look like bubblegum machine necklace quality. Wearing them, I guess the look okay if you aren’t too close.

title: Almost Perfect
text: I love everything about these flats except for the heel. The fit is excellent. It is snug, but I expect that is intentional. The rose gold color is beautiful. The color of the sole is a bit odd, but I expect that is to make them look like knock offs. The only problem is the heel. It makes it feel strange under the foot, like you’re stepping on something. It isn’t awful, but it is noticeable. They’d be perfect without that tiny heel.

title: A Little Narrow
text: These are great shoes. They’re very comfortable. They look nice. They are a bit on the narrow side, which worked out for me since my son has narrow feet.

title: Thin Cardigan
text: This is a nice thin cardigan. It is great for wearing with a t-shirt. It is super comfortable. There are no buttons or closure. It does have pockets.

title: Huge!
text: I always order everything a size bigger than I actually am. I hate tight clothing and have learned that I’d rather it be oversized than form fitting. That was entirely unnecessary with this top. In fact, I probably could wear a size smaller than my usual size and still been happy. That said, I love it. It is such a cozy sweater. It isn’t super bulky. If you want it to fit like the model, order your usual size.

title: So Slippery
text: These slippers are super comfortable and cozy. However, they are super slippery to walk in. Not the bottoms— the bottoms don’t slip. You foot slips and slides on the furry inside of the slipper. Even though the top is snug, every step is like waking on a soaped floor. So you can wear them sitting down, just not walking around.

title: Not Small
text: The larger of these is a little bigger than a quarter, which isn’t that small. The hinges are a little tight at first, but if you open and close them a few times, they become less tight. The smallest set aren’t ear hugging size. The finish is nice. They look good on. These are decent quality, very similar to much more expensive hoops that I own.

title: Long Sweatshirt
text: This shirt is a nice cut. It is really long. Long enough for leggings. It looks pretty good. My only complaint is the fabric. It is a dri-fit type athletic fabric, so the tie-dye looks a little weird on it. It has a slight shine to the fabric. I know many people don’t mind that type of athletic fabric, but I really prefer old school cotton. It would have looked better with the tie-dye on cotton. Otherwise, the shirt is really comfortable and a nice oversized fit.

title: Loose Fit
text: This is a fantastic shirt for fall. The quality is similar to boutique style tops. The sleeves are a bit longer on me than on the model. The fit is nice and loose without looking like a tent. I really like it.

title: He Loves Them
text: My 7-year-old loves these shoes. They are casual enough for everyday wear, but also nice enough when he needs to dress up a bit. They fit and feel like sneakers, but look like loafers. Great shoes for an active little guy.

title: Oversized and Perfect
text: This turtleneck is oversized in the best way. It is so cozy and comfortable. The fabric is a wide waffle knit. It is a little thin, so it isn’t super hot/warm. It adds a perfect amount of snuggle to your outfit. The neck slouches perfectly without any fussing with it. Great shirt.

title: Cozy
text: This oversized cardigan is perfect! It has a weight to it, but the knit is airy. It doesn’t pull as much as other loose weave cardigans I have. It is the perfect cozy addition to my fall wardrobe.

title: Cozy Sweater
text: This sweater is a little longer on me than the model. It falls to my knee. I’m on the short side of normal (5’4”). It is nice a cozy, but has lots of open weave spaces. It does feel more acrylic than cotton. It is super lightweight and fluffy feeling. The blue is a deep only blue color.

title: T- Shirt Cardigan
text: This cardigan is t-short material. It is on the thicker side or jersey and is super stretchy. But it is not sweatshirt material and is not very thick. The pockets are large enough for my iPhone (which is plus sized). It is a really perfect transition cardigan. It looks awesome with jeans and a t-shirt.

title: Cozy
text: This cozy cardigan is so comfortable and perfect for the upcoming transition to fall. However, it is prone to pulls. The weave is really loose, which is comfortable, but it does pull. Mine came with a couple pulls. A couple of them were fixable, one was not. I decided it wasn’t a big deal since it won’t be the last pull on this sweater and the coziness makes up for the loose weave issues.

title: Thick Leggings
text: I know these are lightweight, but the material is thicker than regular cotton leggings. They have a bit more structure to them. They really have a pants feel, though they are leggings. They are comfortable.

title: Flattering Dress
text: This dress is a really comfortable and flattering dress. The material looks nice, but has stretch to it. It would be great for work or church.

title: Maternity Shorts
text: These are a good length for maternity shorts. I do find Levi’s maternity pants run a bit on the small side. These easily fit in my first 2 trimesters, but they were too small come the third trimester. Not because of the belly panel, which is awesome, but because of the thighs. I had the same problem with jeans. I needed one size for the first two trimesters and a bigger size in the third because there wasn’t enough room/stretch in the thighs and hips. I wore a size 12 pre-pregnancy and a large in these shorts.

title: Cut Weird
text: This shirt is cut like a scoop neck rather than a crew neck. It is just a really weird fit on a boy.

title: Not Comfortable
text: This skirt is well made. It is just very small for the sizing, which I’m realizing is a thing with Columbia brand. It has no stretch. I wanted a casual skirt to wear while doing kid activities— park, amusement park, zoo, walking trails, etc. But this just wasn’t comfortable enough and didn’t move enough. It also was not flattering to my chubby mom bod with extra weight around the middle. I felt like I needed shapewear to make the skirt work aesthetically, but that defeats the purpose of a comfortable, casual skirt.

title: Good Bra
text: I've tried many, many nursing bras. I've been pregnant or nursing for the last 15 years. So, I know nursing bras. This one is pretty good. The fabric is on the thicker side. I think it is cut a little bigger. It doesn't have the best support because of that. But it does work well for sleep and lounging around the house.

title: Weird Cut
text: This is such an oddly cut set of shirts. The neck is more of a U-neck than a crew neck. It is definitely a bit low. So, while it says "unisex", it definitely has more of a girl fit and look to it.

title: Love
text: I love these pants! They're pants that fit and feel like leggings! They aren't thin like leggings. The fabric is definitely pants fabric. But they pull on, so you don't have buttons or zippers stabbing at your squishy bits.

title: Super Soft
text: This jumpsuit is super soft. It feels so comfortable. However, the neck area has a tendency to stretch and drop a little lower than I would like. I feel like I have to wear a t-shirt underneath.

title: Stay Put
text: These socks have a "mesh" upper that makes them a bit cooler than other athletic socks. It also provides some gentle arch compression. These stay put pretty well.

title: Not Super Cushy
text: These are thinish athletic socks. They aren't the cushy padded kind. They're comfortable for walking or normal wear. Not so much for running. But they fit snugly and stay put.

title: Runs Smallish
text: This dress is cute, casual, and comfortable. It does run a little small. I hate tight clothing, though. I’d get a size up.

title: Little
text: This backpack is small. But it is really cute and fun. My teenager loves it.

title: Look Pretty
text: This earring set looks great on. The variety of sizes mean you’ll definitely have something for a variety of looks. The packaging isn’t fancy at all.

title: So Comfortable
text: This dress is like wearing pajamas in public. It is so soft and the flow is really nice. It isn’t tight, but the material will show rolls and such.

title: Love the Shirt
text: Love the shirt, but this material is a bit flawed. It seems to unravel really easily at the seams. It is such a shame because the fit and feel of this shirt is exceptional. It just isn’t very durable.

title: Great Tank
text: This tank is comfortable. It hits a little below the hip. And it is loose through the body. You can wear it alone or with a cardigan. It is a wardrobe staple.

title: Slim/Athletic Fit
text: This is not your standard old guy linen shirt. The fit is a bit trimmer and more athletic. It does wrinkle something awful. But it is comfortable and well-made.

title: Nice Pants
text: At 5'3", these pants hit right at the ankle. The fit is flattering and comfortable. They wash well and keep looking nice wash after wash.

title: So Comfortable
text: This tank is so comfortable! It is also pretty flattering. The fit and feel make it a frequently reached for shirt. It isn't very long, so it isn't a shirt I'd wear with legging or anything. But it is a good basic tank.

title: Not Very Stretchy
text: I wanted to like this tank, but the lack of stretch makes it the last tank I reach for. It just isn't very comfortable when it doesn't stretch. It is thick and seemingly well made. But it isn't very comfortable.

title: Great Basics
text: Tommy is outdoing themselves with these modern cut basics. The fit is just so much better than anything else out there. The sleeve length always flatters the muscles in the arms. The quality is great.

title: Don't Ride Up
text: These boxer briefs are very comfortable. They don't ride up or move about. They aren't too hot or constricting, even in hot, humid weather. They are a little longer, which I think helps with the not riding up bit.

title: Socks
text: Gold Toe is my favorite brand of sock for casual socks. These remind me of socks I wore as a kid. They are soft and comfortable. And they wash well.

title: Nice Black Dress
text: This is a nice black dress. It is on the thicker side, so you don't show every roll and dimple. Wearing shapewear isn't necessary to look nice. It does fit a tad on the small side.

title: Adventure Pants
text: My son loves these pants. He wanted to look like Dr. Smolder Bravestone (Dwayne Johnson) from Jumanji. These pants are apparently perfect for that. They are a little long. They are comfortable and my son has requested more of them.

title: Comfortable Bras
text: These are great everyday bras. They are on the low to medium side of support. They work well under t-shirts. They are super stretchy and really comfortable.

title: A Little Big
text: The fit on these dresses in the baby sizes seems a bit large. Similar to Carters in sizing. They also don’t come with bloomers. That works for us, since we use cloth diapers. But if baby was in paper diapers, I’d be more upset about the lack of bloomers and would probably buy some. The neck holes on the baby sizes are a bit large. It makes it so their head fits through, but then makes the neck look a little weird on baby. They’re still really soft and really comfortable for baby. I’d definitely buy more.

title: Comfortable
text:
These undies are really comfortable. And the fit is good. The leg openings are perfect. They don’t move around at all. The rise is well above my belly button.
They have no hold whatsoever. They don’t hold anything in at all. They aren’t sold as shape wear, but to be clear— they are not at all shaping. They are very stretchy and will just accommodate whatever rolls or pooch you have. They won’t disguise or tame anything. You should just know that going in. I’m postpartum and they fit the flabby belly, but they do nothing to tame it.
My real main complaint is that two pairs had the name made into the fabric while one pair had reflective vinyl or something with the name. The reflective brand name started peeling off immediately. As soon as the fabric was the tiniest bit stretched, the name was peeling. I went ahead and peeled the entire thing off so it wouldn’t be half on and half off. I don’t know why they didn’t weave the name in on all of them. I couldn’t care less if they had the logo or not— but having a massive logo peeling off shouldn’t have happened and is a clear design flaw.

title: Great Gown
text: I wore this gown for the birth of my baby. It completely closes, so you feel really covered while wearing it. Electronic fetal monitoring was easily accessible. Shoulder unsnap to provide skin to skin after birth. The snaps up the back are not at all uncomfortable to sit or lay on. The gown was really soft. The sizing is generous, so it isn’t at all tight. I found it perfect.

title: Love It
text: I bought this gown to wear with the matching delivery gown while delivering my baby. This robe is super flattering and comfortable. It easily fits around a big belly, but doesn’t look crazy big after birth. It also has pockets! And the belt is sewn on so you won’t lose it.

title: Perfect
text: Nursing sleep bras are either awesome or awful. For something so simple, they are easy to get wrong. These get it right. I was worried about the seams, but they have not been a problem. These bras are truly comfortable enough to sleep in while still offering support. I highly recommend these and would buy them again.

title: Extend Your Belly Bandit
text: I had purchased a bamboo Belly Bandit a few kids ago. I purchased it on the small side and found that it didn’t fit right after delivery. I really didn’t want to buy a new one in a bigger size. Then I found this! It doesn’t extend the size of the Belly Bandit significantly. It gives you a couple inches. However, if you already have a Belly Bandit and find it *almost* fitting, this handy little addition will save you from having to buy another wrap. It is mostly a felted feel to the whole panel— not the soft bamboo on the bamboo Belly Bandit. And it can be tricky to get it adjusted just right. But I’m pretty happy with it.

title: Perfect
text: This hat fit my newborn perfectly. It is so soft. It is a little tall. There is plenty of stretch so it fits beyond the newborn days and into the 0-3 month size range.

title: Run Small
text: These shorts are awesome. Thin and very comfortable. However, they do run a bit small. Usually wear a size 36 in pants, but needed a 38 in these, even with the stretch.

title: Great Gowns
text: These gowns are so nice and soft. The fabric is thicker than standard jersey material and holds up well. The sizing does run a bit small, which I really appreciate. I have fairly small babies and finding clothes to fit them during the first months can be a challenge. I really love the quality of these and would buy them again.

title: Newborn Is Tiny
text: The newborn size of this gown is very tiny. The length of the gown is the same for the newborn and 0-3 month size. The width of the newborn is much more narrow. I actually like the newborn size for my newborns. I have such a hard time finding clothes small enough for a 6/7 lb. baby. These are actually newborn sized. The 0-3 months will also fit a newborn, just with a little more roominess in the width at first.

title: Not Great
text:
There is a reason these come with extenders. They are significantly shorter than they should be. I have purchased comparable bras from other companies with similar sizing and the bands are a couple inches longer on the other brands.
Also, the fabric on these is super comfortable— except for around the hooks. They are melted together around the edges and are sharp and uncomfortable. There are sharp edges on the extenders (which you have to use unless you’re under a 34 band). They just aren’t finished well. Which is a shame because the rest of the bra is comfortable and functional.

title: Nice Pants
text: These pants are really great quality. They hold up well to regular wash and wear. The fit is pretty spot on and I’m happy they make shorter inseam lengths— that can be really hard to find.

title: Large
text: These dresses are super sweet and soft. I love the style. They do run a tad on the large size. The fit is similar to Carter’s brand. They are well made.

title: Super Undies
text: My two year old is 23 lbs. The 2T size fit, but a little loosely. They aren’t absorbent enough to actually hold a full-on accident. But they can protect clothes from a tiny leak. My daughter really likes these.

title: Big Sizing
text: This little set is adorable. The fabric is so soft and snuggly. I bought the newborn size, which is on the larger side. It is about the size of a Carter’s newborn size rather than a Gerber newborn size.

title: Lace less Tennis Shoes
text: My son really loves these shoes. They have permanently attached elastics instead of true laces. This does make them a bit more snug and they need a few wears to break in. They seem to run a tad bit small, so I would order a size up if I purchased again. I went by the size chart and ordered the half size bigger than the chart indicated, and while they fit, they are a bit snug and he could have used a slightly larger size.

title: Run Big
text: These run a bit on the big side. They have no padding or anything on the inside, so that could contribute to the size issue. They are great play shoes! They skip on easily and are comfortable to run and play in. If they get muddy, super easy to just hose out.

title: Best Leggings
text: I had purchased Felina leggings at Costco in the past and was super upset when Costco decided to carry the wideband top instead of the comfortable ones. I decided to look on Amazon and find some. Here they are! These are the soft, buttery fabric like they had a Costco. These are more of a cotton blend-- at least the dark grey ones are. They fit the exact same. Pretty high rise. Super stretchy. Not see-through at all. Perfect leggings. Even massively pregnant, these leggings still fit really well!

title: Adorable
text: This is the perfect little summer play set for a little one. The shorts are more bloomers than shorts. But the fit was perfect. And it is really soft and cute!

title: Cute
text: This bra is cute, but it isn’t the best for activity. The crossover front style is perfect for nursing a baby. Not so perfect for running or yoga. I find it comfort to wear. And it looks cute. The crossover front just makes it less than ideal for exercise use.

title: Very Small
text: This skirt is very small with zero give. It is very unflattering and uncomfortable. The fabric is not stretchy at all. The rise is between mid and high rise. It makes your butt look awful. I hate this skirt.

title: Perfect Shirt
text: I love this shirt! It is so soft and breezy. It is a loose fit and is just so perfect. I absolutely love wearing it!

title: Loose Fit
text: I live this shirt! It is so comfortable and breezy. The fit is loose, which makes it perfect. It looks great every single time I wear it!

title: Best Jeans
text: These are the best maternity jeans! I got two more pair because they are awesome. The full rise keeps them from slipping down. They fit really well. The legs are snug, so I do wish I had sized up because I know they aren’t going to fit comfortably toward the end. I’ve had many, many pairs of maternity jeans and these are hands down my favorite.

title: Perfect Fit
text: This polo is cut very different from other polo shirts. It is like it has athletic cut sleeves and shoulders, but not torso. It is a perfect length to leave untucked. The sleeves are a bit shorter, which make your biceps look better.

title: Sporty Flip-Flop
text: These flip-flops are sporty and comfortable. They look nice and hold up well to constant wear. They are comfortable with a molded footbed. They offer a lot more support than typical flip-flops.

title: Comfortable
text: These are like sweatpant shorts. My boys love them. They are thick, stretchy cotton. They hold up really well.

title: Comfortable
text: These shorts are very comfortable. They feel like a nylon type material, almost like swim trunks. My boys love them.

title: Comfortable
text: These shorts are very thin and silky. My boys love them. They would wear them year round if I let them.

title: Comfy Shorts
text: These shorts are nice and thick cotton shorts. They hold up well to boy shenanigans. My boys like them.

title: Excellent T-Shirt Dress
text: I love the fit of this t-shirt dress. It isn’t super snug. It it loose and so comfortable.

title: Love
text: I love this bag organizer! You can keep all your stuff organized and switch between bags really easily. It is a bit short, which means some things like to fall out when switching bags. But overall, this has been great! It works especially well in the diaper bag to give me extra organization.

title: Comfy
text: These shorts are comfortable. The problem is the roll cuff. It is tacked on the sides, but the front and back won’t stay rolled. I just found they bothered me too much.

title: Comfy
text: These shorts are super comfortable. They are elastic waist and have lots of give in the denim. They look and fit great.

title: Stretchy
text: The fabric is super comfortable. The cut is okay. The problem is that the super stretchy fabric is also a little heavy, so it stretches as you wear it. The neckline and under the arms just pulls down more and more as the day goes on. By the end of the day, the neckline is under the bra line. It just doesn’t work at all. My daughter wore it for the first time, not realizes it would be such an issue. Luckily, I had a hoodie in the car that she could cover up with as the jumper just got lower and lower through the day.

title: On The Small Side
text: These run a bit small. The fabric is super soft and the ruffles are adorable. They are so comfortable and cute.

title: Shifty
text: This romper looks cute and is comfortable, however, it shifts around like crazy. The fabric is super stretchy, so it starts to sag in places you don’t want it to smash and you spend the day adjusting it over and over to make sure nothing is hanging out.

title: Jumper
text: The fabric of this jumper is awesome. My daughter really likes it. It fits her well. If she were taller, it wouldn’t work at all.

title: Size Up
text: These robes are really small. I think they had some sizing troubles, because the tags had stickers over the sizes to change them, but the new sizes were still off. The best thing about these robes is that the belt is sewn to the back center of the robe, so they can’t lose it! That is perfect. The sizing is just a bit off.

title: Great Quality
text: The thickness of this shirt is perfect. It is slightly thicker than a regular t-shirt, so you can wear it in warmer weather without an undershirt. The quality is really great.

title: Great Tie
text: This tie fits my 8, 10, and 12 year olds perfectly. It holds up really well and looks great. Even when you wash it, it still looks great.

title: Great Tie
text: This tie fits my 8, 10, and 12 year olds perfectly. It holds up really well and looks great. Even when you wash it, it still looks great.

title: Real Tie
text: This is the perfect real tie for a little boy. They are a bit large on my 6 year old, but fit my 8, 10, and 12 year olds without any trouble. It looks really nice and holds up well.

title: Shorts
text: My 12 year old loves Underarmor. He loves these shorts. They are o the thin side, but seem to hold up fine. They have a drawstring in addition to an elastic waist for a secure fit.

title: Great Shorts
text: These are great shorts. They are really well made. My boys thought they were awesome. They do have the elastic tabs inside to cinch the waist down if needed.

title: Great Dress
text: I’m glad I got a size bigger than I normally would have. I could have fit into the smaller size, but I like the looser fit. This dress is so comfortable and cute. The fabric is so soft. I do have to iron it before wearing because it does wrinkle significantly in the wash. It comes almost to my knee. Great summer dress!

title: Fall Apart
text: These are smaller that I feel they should be. Definitely order a size up. However, the real problem is that they come completely apart at the side seams. A couple washes and they had a large hole on the side where the mesh side panel detached from the front. I hand stitched it back together only to have more of it split the next wash. They are completely unwearable after only a few washes.

title: Great Blazer
text: This is a great all cotton blazer. It works well for a more casual look. It is faced, but not lined— so it isn’t very hot when you wear it.

title: Soft
text: These loafers are really nice and soft. They are so comfortable. The sole has a little bit of give, so they really move well with the foot. The arch support is there, but feels pretty minimal. But the shoe is comfortable.

title: Small and Super Stretchy
text: This little bodysuit is small for the tag size. It fits more like a 12 month. The fabric is really soft, but it stretches out easily and doesn’t snap back all the way until you wash it. It is really cute, but it just always looks a bit of the mess by halfway through the day.

title: Cute Socks
text: These are really cute socks. They fit well. They are not thick, as they are more of a novelty style of sock. They work well with loafers.

title: Super Small
text: This jumper is very small for the size. I also found the rise to be quite short, and I’m not tall. I did realize jumpers are just not my thing and I’m going to not try to wear them anymore.

title: Size Up
text: These are really cute shorts, but I did need to size up from my usual pant size. They are a basic summer essential type of short. Comfortable.

title: A Little on the Small Side
text: I did need a size up in this dress from my usual size. This fit and cut of this dress is flattering, though I did need spanx for smoothing under the dress. The fabric has a slight texture that makes it a matte look, which I like.

title: Nice Dress
text: This is a lovely work or church appropriate dress. It is comfortable. The fabric has a bit of stretch to it. The small pattern keeps it from being too busy, but not plain. The fit is very flattering for a mom.

title: Cute Sandals
text: These sandals are very minimalistic. They don’t provide any support or foot protection, really. You can tell that by looking at them. But they are cute and comfortable. I’ve been happy with the quality.

title: Very Flattering
text: This dress is very flattering. The fit is good. I like the small print pattern, it adds interest without being overwhelming. It is a work-appropriate dress and is very comfortable.

title: Love Them
text: I was a little hesitant to buy these because I can be a shoe snob. I was also concerned that they’d be too narrow. I have normal width feet. I purchased the size I usually wear and they fit perfectly. Snug enough to stay put and not rub, but not so snug they leave marks on my feet or make me feel like my feet are being strangled. They were comfortable enough to wear 8+ hours on the first day without breaking them in at all. They have no arch support or really any support. They really feel like walking around barefoot, which would be my personal preference. I’m really impressed with these shoes.

title: Bad Fit
text: The arms of this jacket are made too tight. Even sizing up the sleeves were still snug. The chest area is big, so you can get it to lay flat, but he second you life your arms, it buckles and looks awkward. The collar sits oddly away from the neck, even with a collared shirt underneath. The front pocket has a contrast lining, but the interior of the jacket does not. All in all, the jacket looks nice until you put it on, and then the fit is really awkward and wrong.

title: Great Suit
text: My daughter was looking for a bathing suit that was modest and comfortable. This one was a bit hit. The over tank has no lining and is a bit looser. The under bikini top can be worth with or without the over tank. The shorts fit well and cover the entire bottom well. The bikini top and bottom shorts are lined. It is a great versatile swimsuit.

title: Mailman Shirt
text: The cotton version of this shirt is slightly smaller than the polyester version. My son begged for this shirt so he could look like a mailman. Pretty sure I’ll have to buy him a new one when he outgrows this one. I like the feel and the way the cotton one washes better than the polyester version. You can also iron the cotton version.

title: Comfortable
text: These have a lot of stretch. The leg openings are a bit loose for me. I think the issue is they come up too high and the fabric isn’t very firm. They do have a nice rise. They are comfortable, but the seat does shift around a bit too much. Maybe if I had purchased a smaller size I wouldn’t have that issue. They don’t offer any support of any kind.

title: Great Fit and Comfort
text: These come up nice and high over the belly and do not roll down. They are a bit more firm than the cheaper versions, but have plenty of stretch in the belly for the full nine months. They have tons of stretch and are very comfortable. I’m really happy with these.

title: Not for Maternity
text: These are not very stretchy at all. I ordered a size up and found they were too tight around the middle. The fabric just doesn’t have much stretch in any direction. If I wasn’t pregnant, it’d be okay. But they just weren’t what I expected or needed.

title: Nice Tank
text: This tank is super comfortable and hold up really well in the wash. It quickly became a summer staple. It is basic, but in a good way. My husband wanted one in every color.

title: Nice Jeans
text: My 12-year-Old loves here jeans. He likes the color. He likes the fit. They really seem more straight leg than slim fit, only because they aren’t like jogging skinny or anything. They just look like regular jeans.

title: Nice Watch
text: My husband gets a lot of compliments on this watch. It looks great and is comfortable enough to wear everyday. It is easy to adjust the band to get a better fit. This is a great watch.

title: So Soft
text: I absolutely love theses socks. They aren’t super thick or thin. They are really soft. They fit really well and they hold up nicely in the wash. These are excellent basic socks.

title: Quantity over Quality
text: These were exactly what we needed. The end pieces were not glued down evenly. It did make the edges a bit scratchy. We used these to divide kids into color coded teams at camp, so for that they were perfect. Quality could have been a bit better, but for the price I’m not terribly disappointed.

title: Sport Bra
text: The fit on the bra is true to size. It is very smooth and comfortable. I’d say it is more of a medium hold. I really like it.

title: Dress
text: This brand’s numbered sizing runs on the small side. I have to consistently get a size larger than I wear in other brands (two sizes larger than vanity sizes brands). The tencel feels amazing. It is so soft and smooth and cool. I am 5’4” and it comes about down to the tops of my knees.

title: Hoodie
text: The fit of this is on the snug side. It is a bit short, as well. It is comfortable and well made. It it just snug and short, so if that is what you’re looking for, then this hoodie is for you. I personally prefer a bit more of a relaxed fit, which you can sort of get by sizing up.

title: Dolman Dress
text: I find the fit of this dress to be a bit smaller than my t-shirt dress from the same company. The fit is just a bit more narrow. I really like the fabric. The fit is more of a shift than an a-line style. It is very effortless.

title: Dress
text: This brand’s numeric sizing is on the small side. I have had to get a full size up for things to fit correctly. I really like this dress. The tencel is super soft, but not at all stretchy. The drawstring waist does work. It also has pockets! I’m 5’4” and it comes right to my knees.

title: Neck Wallet
text: I use this bag for going to theme parks. It allows me to have my phone with my person and allows me to carry my meal pass cards and such in an easy place. My iPhone 8+ fits with no problems. I can actually fit two phones in here. It can get pretty heavy, as the strap is just a nylon band. It isn’t waterproof. And for some reason it always twists around when I wear it. But it does hold my phone so I don’t have to keep it in the stroller or my large bag. So, it does makes things convenient.

title: Linen Shorts
text: These run very small compared to standard women’s sizing. This brand, the small-medium-large sizing is normal, but the numbered sizing is a full number size or two smaller. These shorts are really thin, but not see through. The only problem I have is that the back wrinkles up and makes the back of my shorts shorter than the front.

title: Fleece Joggers
text: These are on the large side for a boy’s medium. They are about the size of size 12 pants. They are thick and plushy feeling fleece. My son really likes them. They are very warm, so probably better winter pants than summer.

title: Fun Socks
text: These are on the thin side and they shrink considerably in the wash. They do stretch back out to fit your foot. They are really cute and I love the patterns on them.

title: Basic Pouch
text: This is a pretty basic bag. It fits my iPad Pro (I don’t have the massive one— I have the normal size one.) And it holds my Apple Pencil and a few other random things in the pouch. It isn’t a case, but it does give you a place to put your tech stuff so it isn’t floating around your bag.

title: Athletic Socks
text: These socks are super comfortable. They are very padded and offer a lot of cushion for exercise activities. They really help pad the feet. I love them.

title: Novelty Socks
text: These socks are so fun. They are on the thin side without any cushion to them. These are summer prints and a couple solids. These are really cute and comfortable. I love them.

title: Athletic Socks
text: These socks are super soft. They are super padded and squishy. They are perfect for working out or running. They offer a lot of cushion for the feet. I love them.

title: Socks
text: These socks are so soft and comfortable. They are not thick, so they are not really fit to be socks you work out in or run in. They are casual socks. They feel super nice. I love them.

title: Keep The Sun Off Your Neck
text: This is a buff-style neck warmer thing. The fabric is really thin and light. I was expecting something absorbent for holding water, but this is more of just a super thin fabric to keep the sun off your neck. The fabric makes it a bit difficult to wear it any way other than as a neck cover. It slides off when you use it on your head or whatever.

title: Great Socks
text: These are cute kid socks. They are a bit thicker and better made than typical novelty socks. These are definitely comfortable and hold up well.

title: Comfy Dress
text: This is a super comfortable dress. The fabric isn’t thin at all— zero see-through issues. The jersey is a bit silly, like modal. The length is nice. At 5’4” the dress hits the ground when I’m barefoot.

title: Tank
text: This tank is pretty fitted. The jersey material isn’t super stretchy. It holds its shape really well. It is comfortable and not at all sheer. It feels like standard cotton and doesn’t have a slick or silky feel like dry-tec.

title: Small Bag
text: This is like a fanny pack for someone who doesn't want to wear a fanny pack. It isn't huge. Just a small cross-body bag for some essentials while you're at a theme park, festival, etc. It is big enough to hold your ID, phone, chapstick, and cash. It isn't going to hold a ton. But it also isn't going to be in your way. It does go small enough to fit a kid, but large enough to fit an adult.

title: Silky Boxers
text: These boxer briefs have a very silky feel. They are a microfiber type material. They are comfortable and have a lot of stretch. The length of the legs is pretty short, which works well for summer. My son has no complaints.

title: Comfy Tank
text: Although the tank is a little shorter in length than I would like, I do like the shirt. It is pretty thick jersey material. It is comfortable. The straps are not adjustable.

title: Love
text: This dress is so cozy. I’m 5’4” and it comes down to the floor. I can make the length work— it isn’t so long I need to alter it. I love the rooms fit. It is super comfortable and cute.

title: Small and Weird Sleeve
text:
For some reason, this brand runs extremely small on numbered sizes but not on small, medium, large sizing. I got the size 14, though I wear a 12 in most brands, even a 10 in some. The 14 is pretty snug.
This dress is really hot. It is fully lined and the fabric isn’t very breathable.
The length is great. I like the length of the sleeves, but I don’t like the weird elastic key hole on the sleeve. It makes not sense and doesn’t look very good. I cannot figure out that design decision. It just looks weird.

title: Decent Bag
text: This backpack is decent. It has the front pocket, plus inside the large zippered area are two smaller pockets. Really my only issue is the straps. They are leather (the bag is nylon) and they crease wherever the adjustable slider is on them. It doesn’t easily come back out, so there is this unappealing ripple in the strap. Even after multiple uses and weeks, the crease from shipping is still in the strap. It is just taking a lot longer to break in the straps.

title: Fits Perfectly
text: I tend to dislike removable padding. It never stays in the right place and I usually end up tossing it after fighting with it once or twice. However, this padding is still hanging in there. The fit on the bra makes it stay put much better. So, yes, it is removable padding, but the padding will stay in place if you want it to. The straps on this bra are pretty wide. I like the fit and the comfort of the bra. I'd say it has medium to strong hold. You don't have to double up, but it isn't completely bounceless.

title: Cute Hat
text: This hat is really cute. It is super soft denim, like you’ve had it for years. It is really adorable on. It fits my 12 year old really well.

title: Adorable Hat
text: This fits my 18 month old a little loose, but still reasonably. She is on the tiny side, wearing 12 month clothes. The hat is adorable. It has a metal wire around the brim, so it can be shaped and not flop in their face. The hat is soft and floppy. It really looks adorable on.

title: awesome!
text: Awesome jacket! It fits perfectly, feels great, and looks sharp. It works as a great jacket for Spring, and I'm sure it'll work just as well in the Autumn.

title: Nice shirt!
text: Wow. This shirt is well-crafted, 100% cotton, and perfectly-fitting— everything I want in a button-up. It is cut perfectly— not too baggy, not too long, not too cumbersome. The fabric is thick, soft, and rich. Perfect.

title: Comfy Socks
text: These socks are adorable. They are comfortable. The colors are really awesome.

title: Good Shoes
text: These are great tennis shoes for daily wear. They fit well and are super comfortable. They are pretty neutral on support. They aren’t super structured, but they do provide pretty good support.

title: Good Socks
text: These are good kid socks. They are on the thick side, offering plenty of cushion for little feet. There are 4 sock varieties- 2 black and 2 white. The kids like them.

title: Wow!
text: Awesome jacket! Extremely light-weight. Incredibly rain-resistant. Sleek. (Of course, it doesn't stretch at all, but it fits perfectly.)

title: Super Soft
text: This t-shirt is so super soft. The fabric is thick, so it holds its shape well. It has a brushed texture to the fabric. It fits well. The pocket isn't super visible, the pattern kind of washes it out. But the fit is good. And the style is good. And the fabric is so super soft.

title: In Person They Look Cheap
text: In person, these look very sloppily made. They look like plastic unevenly glued onto a silver base. They just don’t look very nice in person. They come with a velvet bag and certificate of authenticity.

title: Boy’s Underwear
text: These are made to be short and tight. The fabric is an athletic feeling stretch fabric. A little on the silky side, but very stretchy. The fit is pretty much as expected. They aren’t super high waist. No opening in the front.

title: Roomy Dress
text: This is a t-shirt style dress, but much more oversized than a standard t-shirt dress. The sleeves are kimono style. It fits really well and is a super comfortable dress. You can dress it up or down. The blue color isn't bright, but more of a subdued navy.

title: Cozy
text: This cardigan is so soft and comfortable. It is such a cozy sweater. It looks great. Fits great. The length is about to my knee. (I'm 5'4".) The hood makes it a little more casual looking, in my opinion. I love it.

title: Super Thin
text: This is a super thin athletic fabric hoodie. It is excellent for running or activities where you might want to take the long sleeves off, but don't want to be left with bulk. The fabric is super soft and silky in hand. It isn't super warm, but it is enough to keep the wind from blowing across your skin.

title: Just A Tank
text: I like this tank top okay. However, there is nothing "breastfeeding" about it. It is just a loose fitting tank. The worst part is that the back straps are spaghetti straps that cross. This is made for breastfeeding moms. Breastfeeding moms wear breastfeeding bras. This shirt is made where it will show your entire breastfeeding bra. The fabric is soft. The fit is fine. But there is nothing breastfeeding about it-- no double layers, not hidden easy access. And it is made where your entire bra is on display. Why not make a built in nursing bra if you're wanting to have a showy back of the tank?

title: Why So Long
text: My son loves Under Armour clothing. I have no idea why they make children's pants so long! They are seriously the tallest pants on the market. They are a good 4" longer than Levi pants in the same size. I cannot figure out why UA does this. They definitely need to work on their sizing or start selling short versions. There is no good way to roll these up, either. The slick fabric won't hold. So you either have to cut and hem (which is a nightmare on the slick, stretchy fabric) or just let the kid walk all over their pants all the time.

title: Comfy Shirt
text: This shirt is like a sophisticated version of a t-shirt. It is soft, stretchy material. The neck isn't too tight or constricting. It fits and feels like a t-shirt. The fabric is thin enough not to be hot, but thick enough not to need an undershirt.

title: Perfect Fabric
text: These pants are so ridiculously soft! The fabric has no give. It is woven. But it is so soft and fluid. It just moves with you so well. The pants are easy, but don't look like sweatpants.

title: Super Soft
text: These shorts are so unbelievably soft! They have an easy fit to them, nothing fussy about them. The fabric is woven, but it is so super soft and fluid. It just moves and fits perfectly.

title: Narrow
text: This shirt is excellent in length. It hits a little below the hips. The torso is very narrow, though. The boatneck fits well. Sleeves are appropriately sized. I'm just wishing it had a little more room in the tummy, as I'm not a fan of clothing wearing tight around the middle.

title: Runs Small
text: This top is a bit on the small side, but it is wide. It is closer to a 12-month size in other major brands. It is super cute, though. I love this styling for babies. Roomy, soft, and plenty of space to move.

title: Nice Scarf
text: This is a small sized scarf. Sized like a large handkerchief. You can tie it diagonally around your neck one time. I love the look and feel on it. It is very thin and soft and a bit silky feeling. It is definitely more of a spring scarf.

title: Thin
text: These are tall cowl things. These are not quite the same as the more expensive name brand version. These are much thinner, they aren't nearly as warm and wind resistant. These aren't finished on the top and bottom edges. These have more of a novelty feel to them. They essentially work the same. You can wear it as a headband, a scarf, a hat-- they really are versatile.

title: Thin Jacket
text: This is a thin spring jacket. It isn't thick. It isn't super warm. It is perfect to put over a t-shirt for those chilly spring mornings. It is thin and can then fit in your bag easily. I'd say the fit is right on. My 11-year-old loves it.

title: Compliments
text: My husband uses this passport holder while traveling. He gets lots of positive comments about it. It keeps his passport looking decently nice and it makes it feel a bit special. The quality of the leather is good. It feels nice and soft in hand.

title: So Comfy
text: This shirt is so unbelievably comfortable! I absolutely love it. The fit is slightly slouchy. I wish I had sized up for a roomier fit. The length is just past the hips. This is such a perfect shirt. The thickness is perfect. It isn't super thick but is definitely thicker than a t-shirt.

title: Adjustable Fit
text: The fabric of this dress is like a matter polyester feel. I think the width of the dress is a little on the narrow side. I'd say the large is about a size 10. Yes, it will fit a size 12, but you show a bit more leg. It comes just below the knee. It is a very easy to wear dress. It doesn't wrinkle or pill.

title: A Little Short for a Duster
text: This open cardigan is lovely. I love the fit and fabric. It is on the thin side. It is a little short to be considered a duster. It is barely past the knees, which is just a long cardigan to me. A duster should really be calf length at least.

title: A little narrow
text: This dress is a little on the narrow side. It is a shift, so I expected a little more width. The linen fabric is completely unforgiving. So, order up if in doubt. The colors are beautiful. The length is great-- to the knee, not too short. I really like the dress. It is just a little more narrow than I would have hoped.

title: Runs Small
text: These shorts run small. An entire size smaller than listed. They are super comfortable and my little guy absolutely loves them. He'd live in them if I let him.

title: Runs Small
text: This hoodie runs really small. An entire size smaller than listed. The fabric is very soft, but on the thinner side of sweatshirt material.

title: Excellent Duffle
text: These bags fold up pretty flat for storage. They fold into their own side pocket, so when storing them they don't take up much space at all. Opened, they have so much space! These are great for kids to take to camp, or to take to the gym, or to pack when going camping. They are awesome bags.

title: Fluffy and Soft
text: This jacket is like your favorite hoodie and favorite button-up flannel had a baby. What you now have is a flannel hoodie that is as fluffy as your favorite hoodie and as soft as your favorite flannel. It is so comfortable. It isn't going to keep you warm in super cold weather, but cool spring days and cool fall nights-- this guy is perfect!

title: So Soft
text: This shirt is so soft! It is the softest button up shirt ever! It is so soft and cooling. The toucans are cute and make it fun. It is a pretty standard fit.

title: Stretchy Pants
text: These are a bit on the small side. The fabric is a little on the thin side. They are really comfortable and fit a skinny, but not tall, kid really well.

title: Tiny, Beautiful Scarf
text: This scarf is so unbelievably soft. And it is so adorable. It is on the small side. It is handkerchief sized, so one diagonal tie around the neck is all you’ll get. It is so light and airy. Just lovely.

title: Cute Socks
text: These soxks are so incredibly cute! They are comfortable. I’d say they are a medium weight— pretty standard novelty sock thickness. The colors are fun. The puppies are cute. My tween daughter steals them from me!

title: Tiny
text: These are so small. They barely cover any of your foot. Definitely don’t add warmth or even much cushion. Really, they are only helpful for peep-toe shoes that rub in some spot that might be covered by these. But they are so low, the heel of the shoe is higher than the sock, so it is still going to rub.

title: Skip This One
text: I usually love Daily Ritual clothes. This shirt was just off the mark. First, the fit isn't great. It is very wide and short. Very boxy. The v-neck is wonky as soon as I washed it. It almost seemed like the fabric was cut slightly off bias. The fabric is thick, but just warps and wears very oddly. I've definitely had worse t-shirts, but this is not close to the quality I've come to expect from this brand.

title: Relaxed Fit Tee
text: I absolutely love the cut of this tee. It is relaxed and roomy and so comfortable. Really, the only part of the shirt I dislike is the fabric. The fabric is this tissue type of cotton jersey. It isn't thin, but the fabric just doesn't quite wash and lay just right. It has thicker and thinner places in the fabric and it just doesn't behave properly. In this particular shirt, the fabric doesn't misbehave quite as poorly as other versions with the same fabric.

title: Nice Dress
text: This dress has a relaxed and roomy fit. It is flowey and pretty long. It is to the knee for petite folk and slightly above for average height. The fabric is soft and it swings and hangs beautifully.

title: Great Shoes!
text: These shoes are great. They look great, they fit great, and they wear great. They are casual, of course, but are not too casual. Yes, they have some arch support but not all that much really.

title: Great Socks
text: These are great socks. They are thick, soft, and very comfortable. I'm impressed.

title: Outstanding Pants!!!
text: I'm typically not a jogger-wearer; in fact, I often find them uncomfortable. However, these pants are awesome. They fit remarkably well and are extremely soft. Outstanding pants!!!

title: Awesome Hat, a Bit Big
text: This had is very soft, very comfortable, and very warm. The lining is so soft, and the layers make this hat a bit different than other beanies I've worn. Overall, it's an awesome hat, but it's a bit big.

title: Strong, Soft Socks
text: These socks are as advertised. They aren't flashy or patterned at all. They are surprisingly strong and soft. Very comfortable and seemingly durable.

title: Looser Fit
text: This racerback tank has a slightly looser fit than most. I like it. I don't think it fits like it is too big, but just gives you a little room to move. It is really thin. I actually wear it more as an undershirt. But it isn't see through, so once summer gets here, I'm sure I'll wear it alone, too.

title: Cute
text: My daughter fell in love with these. She loves the mismatching style and the cute cupcakes. They are extremely overpriced, though. The quality isn’t consistent with the price.

title: Leggings
text: I like the length of these leggings. They are comfortable. They fit well.

title: Leggings
text: Decent leggings for working out. The look isn’t quite right for casual black leggings. But for workout leggings they are comfortable and fit well.

title: Basic Shirts
text: My boys love these basic t-shirts. They fit well. They don’t stretch out. They are comfortable. They work well as a base layer or alone.

title: Jeggings
text: These are really comfortable and fit true to size. They are a bit on the long side. The fabric is pretty thin and stretchy. Very similar to Hue jeggings.

title: Socks
text: These are nice, thick ankle socks. My daughter really likes the fit and feel of them. They aren’t so thick that shoes fit weird, but the do add some cushion to the feet.

title: Comfy Jeans
text: These fit really nicely. The jean material has a good amount of stretch to it. They also have the adjustable elastic inside the waist band. They have no exterior labels. My son really likes them.

title: Black Leggings
text: I am 5’4” and while these didn’t gape, they certainly aren’t tight under my feet. I feel like the fit is a bit big. They were a little roomy through the butt and thighs on me. They are not shiny at all. Pure matte black, which is why I love them. The rise is high, with a wide band to keep them up.

title: Baby Shirts
text: These baby shirts are decent. I like the colors. The fabric is super soft, which feels nice, but stretches out a little too easily and then looks loose and weird.

title: Cardigan
text: This is a very classic fit cardigan. It is a nice knit and is really comfortable. It looks really nice.

title: Cardigan
text: This is a slightly oversized cardigan. I love it. It is super comfortable and it looks nice. I like the way it fits. I like the fabric. No complaints at all.

title: Toddler Jammies
text: These pajamas are adorable. They fit well. They are on the snug side, since they are cotton. My little guy loves them!

title: Awesome Tee
text: I really love this tee. I like my shirts on the looser side and this one is just barely loose enough for me to be happy with it. I love the stripes. The curved hem and longer fit make it a good shirt to wear with leggings. It does have a small logo on it that makes it look a bit more athletic.

title: Leggings.
text: These are a tiny bit shiny. That is really my only complaint. They are super high waist. The pockets work, but I find I don’t like my phone on my hip.

title: Tight Fit
text: This blazer is a women's cut. Skinny. Short. Narrow through the shoulders. I feel like it is a good size smaller than the tag says, maybe even bordering two sizes. I'm not a fan of the overly girly fit. If you have a larger chest, the girly fit is overemphasized if you button it. It just looks like something out of the junior's department.

title: Kid Set
text: This set is fine. It is mediocre quality, much like the super cheap ones you'd pick up at a big box store. The scarf is on the small side. It is fine. Just not awesome or amazing. Entirely adequate.

title: Nice Bag
text: This bag is pretty. It looks really nice. I find the leather a little dry and stiff. I also find the size to be slightly wrong. It is about 5 inches too deep. The length of the straps means you can't wear it on your shoulder. The depth is just a bit too much. I mean, you can put a 3 ring binder in there and still have 5 inches above the top of it. There is no good way to use that top space. If it was just a touch shorter, carrying it would be less awkward and it would just rid it of wasted space.

title: Cozy
text: This pajama set is a little on the big side. Definitely more of a 24 month size than an 18 month size. However, the velour is super soft and cozy. The hat is cute and I do sometimes use it, but I don't need a hat for pajamas very often.

title: Socks
text: These socks are pretty nice. The arches are nice and tight and provide nice support. The heel and toe are pretty cushy to absorb impact. The only thing I find odd is that I would prefer them to be taller in the back and lower in the front. They are cut opposite of my preference.

title: Not Mesh
text: I usually love Goldtoe socks. These aren’t quite as awesome as others I have tried. The “mesh” top is just thinner cotton material that is kind of waffle weave. I just don’t like how stretchy and thin the top of the sock is. It isn’t awful, but I’d like it a little thicker and less of this waffle material. It isn’t really mesh at all.

title: Wallet.
text: This wallet feels really nice. It is very soft leather. The interior is laid out really nicely and it is convenient. My only complaint is the placement of the design. It just annoys me how it is set where the center is slightly above the bottom fold line. It just aesthetically annoys me.

title: Scarf
text: This isn’t a super high quality scarf. It is very large. And the colors are great. Very neutral, but not too boring. I just find it a bit itchy and tickly with the fuzzy and fine acrylic yarn.

title: So Comfy
text: These leggings are a tad on the large side. They seem more trouser like than leggings like. They are super soft and super stretchy. I usually wear a size 12 short in Levis and the Large in these leave some extra room in some areas. They aren't skin tight like legging normally would be. They are also on the short side. I know these are petite, and I am on the tall side of the petite spectrum at 5'4". These hit my ankles, but just barely. Did I mention that these have pockets? Like, real, usable front pockets! The burnt ginger color is a soft orange. I really like the feel of these. And even though they are a little baggy for leggings, I still really like them. They are cozy and different.

title: Super Soft and Luxurious
text: These socks are so soft. They are luxurious. I absolutely love them. They aren’t very thick, so they aren’t boot socks or anything. And with the super soft feel, they do slip around a bit, so they aren’t great with tennis shoes. But for average daily wear, they are awesome.

title: Perfect Fit
text: I really like these jeans. They are pull on but don’t look like leggings. The waistband is nice and wide so it stays in place really well. I think the fit is perfect.

title: New Favorite
text: I absolutely love this sweatshirt. It is so soft and cozy. It fits really well. Just the right amount of roominess. The length is perfect. This is my new favorite.

title: Terrible
text: This cardigan is just wrong. The cut and fit is extremely awkward. The fabric is cheap and uncomfortable. It doesn’t lay as it should. It is pretty small and a bit on the short side, as well. I just really don’t like it at all.

title: Roomy Fit
text: This shirt has a roomy fit, which I love. I'm just not entirely a fan of the fit. The ruffle portion wraps around from the back and just lays a bit weird on me. It isn't awful, but it certainly isn't the most flattering. I'm also not extremely happy with the fabric. It is very thin and almost has a paper quality to it. Like it feels like a disposable garment, even though it clearly isn't. It isn't see through, but it isn't comfortable.

title: Roomy
text: This cardigan does have a more relaxed and roomy fit. The fabric is comfortable. The best feature is probably the large pockets. It is a little long, which I really like. There are no front closures. It has more of a draped look to it.

title: Beautiful
text: This romper is so lovely. The skirt part is on the long side. On the small, it is about 3 inches too long for me and I'm 5'4". It just makes a romper look so much more elegant. It is very low cut in the front, but looks fine with a tank underneath.

title: beautiful but tiny
text: This sweater is beautiful and soft, but it does NOT fit like a large. It is tiny.

title: Great Shirt
text: This shirt is nice and nicely built. I love it. I typically wear a large, but it being slim-fit, the XL fits perfectly. The fabric is nice and soft, and I'm impressed.

title: I love it!
text: I love this shirt! It is soft and the fabric looks unique. I washed it the day it arrived, and I wore it as soon as it was dried and ironed. It looks nice enough to pass as a dress shirt, but it can also pass as a casual button-up. I love it.

title: Great Shoes!
text: These shoes are very nice, especially for kids. I'm impressed. They are soft and impressively built.

title: Good Shoes
text: These are good shoes. They are very plain and minimalist, but they are also sleek and hip. They are comfortable enough but don't provide the greatest amount of support, which is not surprising, considering the style. I found, though, that the size ran a bit bigger than expected.

title: Great Bag
text: This bag is as advertised. It's a good bag, and it does the trick. I especially like that I'm able to increase or decrease its size with a simple zipper, which keeps me from unnecessarily having "too much bag". Great product!

title: Super Shiny Pants
text: These are an awkward fabric and fit. The fabric is super stretchy, like very thick swimsuit material. The cut isn't quite leggings, but not quite pants. So they are tight in some places, but loose in other places. The bunch around the backs of the knees. They aren't comfortable at all for any type of activity. I do like the waistband and the side pocket, but those minor perks pale in comparison to the awful fit and feel of these pants.

title: Terrible
text: These are quite easily the worst pants I have ever put on my body. The fabric is weird. It looks like a scuba type material. It feels very slippery. It is shiny. The zipper on the front will do you zero favors. While the pants are very stretchy, the waist around the top of the zipper isn't stretchy at all. They aren't tights, but they aren't quite pants. So they are snug in random places, like the butt and the knees. I cannot express how much I hate these pants.

title: Weird Fit
text: The fabric of this shirt is perfect. However, the fit is terrible. The front is a cropped length, coming to just below my belly button. The back is a lot longer. The boxy fit and the length of the shirt is just not flattering on me. I'm not a fan of the cut at all.

title: Structured, But Comfy
text: This coat is very structured. It is still comfortable. It does have very pronounced shoulders. It almost has a look like you're wearing shoulder pads. The coat is very comfortable. I do think it looks a bit more on the casual side. It can be a little dressy but is mostly just functional.

title: Scratchy
text: The fit on the cardigan is fine. It is a decent length. The waterfall opening means that it doesn't need to close to fit. However, I find this sweater scratchy. It just isn't as buttery soft as I would have expected.

title: A Bit on the Small Side
text: These jeans are pretty nice. They run a bit on the snug side. They don't have much give, so you may need to order a size up.

title: Great Kid Shoes
text: These kid shoes are super nice. They are pretty structured. The leather is really nice quality. The fit and feel is excellent.

title: Fancy Socks
text: These socks are a bit silky. Like fancy socks. They look a bit shiny, as well. They aren’t the warmest socks. And the arch support isn’t tight enough to really be supports. But they do not get loose throughout the day. They stay snug. And they look pretty.

title: Novelty Christmas Socks
text: These Christmas socks are so fun and cute! They are packaged perfectly for gifting. So, if you’re wanting to gift some fun socks- these are perfect!

title: Low Rise
text: These run really small. They are very low in the rise. The fabric is fine. Silky. Nothing special. But the fit was very small.

title: No Effect Noticed
text: I was so excited about these socks! I was expecting something like an electric blanket for my feet. The didn’t noticeably warm at all. They felt more like thick socks than anything. No extra warming effect noticed at all. Definitely not worth the discomfort of wearing a huge battery pack and having wires in your socks. I’ll just stick to warm wool socks over these.

title: Perfect Tee
text: This relaxed fit tee is completely perfect. I cannot find anything I dislike about it. The material is comfortable and high quality. The fit is perfection. Perfect basic tee.

title: Nice Shoes
text: These are ridiculously great quality! I was so shocked at how nicely made they were! They look great. Fit is a little on the narrow side, but not too much for my kid. He loves how comfortable they are.

title: Bag
text: This bag expands to hold a lot of gear. The bag itself is super lightweight. It only has one strap, and I think that strap should be a tiny bit shorter. But other than that, it is an excellent quick bag.

title: Don't Work
text: These gloves are pretty basic. Just woven gloves. They are a little large on me, since I do have smaller hands. The touch screen finger tips don't work consistently at all. For every 10 taps it might pick up one or two of them. Definitely not consistently usable.

title: It Fits!
text: I am a little bit busty, so I usually get button up shirts and wear them unbuttoned with a shirt under because I can never get them to fit properly in the chest. This shirt fits! Not only does it completely fit in the chest, it has a little snap in the bust area to keep the shirt closed. I'm so surprised and how it fits! The fabric is a little on the thin side. The length is great, too.

title: Performance Isn’t Great
text: This luggage looks nice and the wheels roll really well. However, there are a few issues. One was that when it was packed a little tight, as in it zipped but it was pretty full, the zipper failed and exploded my luggage everywhere. I mean, that is partially my fault for sticking that last item in there, but it definitely didn’t hold up to the situation. The other issue is that the handles take up interior space. And since you can’t overpack it, removing space from the interior isn’t a great idea. It is super lightweight. It has decent pockets. But the exploding clothes fiasco kind of overshadows any positive it might have.

title: Socks
text: These are a little on the small side. They don’t have a ton of stretch, so if you have wide feet or are on the higher end of the size range, you may find them too tight. I wear a size 9, but have narrower feet and I feel like they are a tight fit. Just a little tighter and they’d be too tight. They look nice.

title: Love
text: I love this Sweatshirt. It is so long. And I absolutely love the side slits. You can wear it with leggings or jeans. It is so cozy and warm. It is the perfect a lounging sweatshirt.

title: Very Skinny
text: These jeans are very skinny and on the small side. They seem to run in size about like Levi's, which seem to be on the small side to me. They have a little stretch. Not a lot. Definitely jeans and not jeggings. The rise is medium, I would say. Not super high. The length is about average.

title: Chino Joggers
text: My boys love the jogger style pants. These are regular dress pant fabric. They aren't super soft or anything like that. But they are pretty roomy and the boys seem to like them. I think Levi small, medium, large sizing tends to be a little on the bigger side. So the medium size is a roomy size 10. The large ends up being closer to a 14.

title: Not For Me
text: This dress is not flattering at all on me. It is just boxy and awkward. The fabric is really soft and I love the way it feels. Super comfy. But it looks awful.

title: Weird Fit
text: These lounge pants are super thin and soft material. I like the material. It is super comfortable. However, the fit is so off. The rise in the crotch is so long. You either have the crotch of the pants hanging to your knees, or you have to pull them up to you bra line. The fit makes what would be the world's most comfy pants into the world's most awkward pants. The waist band is kind of wide and tight, as well. They just overall don't work as well as they should. If the fit was better, they'd be awesome.

title: Good Socks
text: These are really good, basic socks. They are all the same. They are pretty cushy. There is really nothing fancy going on here. Just good, basic, black, ankle socks.

title: Not Adjustable
text: These camis are pretty nice. They are on the tight side, which you'd expect. Really, my only complaint is that the straps are not adjustable and I very much prefer adjustable straps on a cami.

title: Dry Clean Only
text: This pocket hankies is fine. It is on the thin side, which you would expect. The edges are a little sloppy. It looks pretty good. Not cool about it being dry clean only, since I actually use hankies and don’t just want them for looks.

title: Tall Socks
text: The socks are super tall! I mean, really tall! They don’t fall down. They fit really snugly. They are comfortable dress socks. They look nice. And did I mention how tall they are?  They are quite tall. Sometimes it feels ridiculous to wear socks so tall, but they don’t fall or sag throughout the day.

title: Sorting Hat Keychain
text: This sorting hat can find its way to a variety of places. It is a keychain. You can put it on your keys, your bag, you jacket- whatever. My daughter loves it. She has no keys so she uses this key ring as backpack decor.

title: Soccer Socks
text: These socks are made a bit roomy to fit your shin guards. They are nice and y’all. They are super stretchy and fit really well. They also look cool, according to my son.

title: Toddler Socks
text: These little socks are too precious. They are just so dapper on little guys. They are well made and comfortable. They are really great quality. No complaints from me or the toddler about them.

title: Dad Hat
text: This is such a comfortable hat. It is very old school. I swear I remember kids wearing these when I was in middle school. The hat is really well made. It fits well. It is very soft. There is nothing about it I do not like.

title: Sarcastic
text: I really like this sweater. The quality is much better than I anticipated. I expected it to be super uncomfortable and cheap, being a novelty sweater. But it is really not. It is comfortable and nice. Can't wait to get to the season I can wear it all the time!

title: Nice Shorts
text: The shorts are nice. They look good. They wear well. The pull on style is always preferred by my younger boys. These are not soft pull on shorts, though. So, the fabric is still a bit rough and stiff. They seem pretty durable, as well.

title: Not Adjustable
text: This barrette is cute, however, it isn't adjustable. The straps are pretty long and there is no way to make them shorter without taking it apart and doing some sewing. I really wish they could have made it where you could adjust it.

title: Best Leggings
text: I love these leggings. The black are a tiny bit shiny, so they do look a bit more athletic. I love the high waist fit of these. I do have a bit of extra length, being 5'4", but that is pretty normal for me. These leggings don't move around during the day. They stay put. They are comfortable enough for sitting on the couch or actually working out in them.

title: Stays Put
text: This tank is a good tank. The racerback is on the thin side, but it stays put and allows full range of motion. It isn't too very tight and doesn't really provide any type of compression or support. It works well on its own, though bright colored sports bras clearly show through, or as an undershirt. It has a slight silky polyester type feel to it. It doesn't stretch out over the day.

title: Basic Socks
text: These are great basic socks.I'm not entirely sure why they would label these as "girls" when they are just basic white socks. That doesn't seem like a gendered product to me. But the quality is really nice and my kids like the fit of these.

title: Son’s Favorite
text: These pants are very shiny. They look cheap. I would have given them a lower review, but my son loves them. He thinks they are the best pants ever. They are comfortable for him. He loves them.

title: Good Socks
text: These are very nice socks. They have extra padding in the heel and toe area, so if you are on your feet a lot or jogging- they offer plenty of cushion. They offer a very minimal amount of arch support. Honestly it isn’t enough to really be considered support- so if you need that, these maybe aren’t the best choice.

title: Super Soft
text: This shirt is a really nice fabric. I love the feel of it. It is so comfortable. I’m not a big fan of the fit. The drawstring bottom is not flattering on me at all.

title: Warm and Cozy
text: This is a great jacket. Very comfortable. Very easy for the kid to move around in. Very warm. My son loves it. The zippers work really easily. Very nice jacket.

title: Tiny Shoes
text: These are a perfect fit. The soles are flexible for tiny newly walking feet. There are no ties. The width does have a little stretch to it. They are really well made and cute.

title: Best Shirt
text: This is a great t-shirt. The fit is great. I love the looser body. I want all my t-shirts to fit like this. The fabric is super soft and stretchy without being too thin or too hot.

title: Cozy Pants
text: These are really loose, comfortable pajama pants. The fabric is so nice and soft. The fit is on the loose side, but intentionally so. These are really cozy.

title: Nice Fit
text: This is a nice, comfortable hat. It is super stretchy. It is really comfortable. It looks nice. It is deep in the rise, but not too deep. It makes it fit really well.

title: Just Okay
text: These are okay toddler shoes. The bottoms are not flexible at all. The polka dot pattern on the jersey fabric also makes them look a bit cheap. Like, they look worn brand new because of the color combination. The fit is okay. The inflexible sole makes it harder for tiny feet.

title: Good Shirt
text: This is a good long sleeved T-shirt. To get it realized fit like the model, you do have to buy a size larger. The length is really good. The fabric is good and stretchy but not too thin.

title: Tankini
text: The top was expected size, but the bottoms were much larger. The top has adjustable straps, so you can adjust it to fit. Good swim suit material and lined.

title: Cozy Sweater
text: This oversized sweater is amazingly comfortable. It is just so perfectly cozy. I absolutely love it. Bring on the sweater weather because I am ready!

title: Nice Tank
text: This is a nice, basic tank top. The white is a little see through on its own, but it makes a really nice under layer. It is comfortable. The length is good.

title: Leggings
text: I love the fit of these leggings. The fabric is a bit on the athletic side, which makes them less wearable for the every day. But they fit so well. They come up high and you don’t have to tug or adjust them at all during the day.

title: Bad Fit
text: I love the fabric of this dress. However, the cut of this dress is not flattering at all. If you get it to fit, it just makes me look wide and shows off curves I’d rather not show. (Lumpy.) If you size up, you end up with a giant shapeless sack. Neither is really flattering. I like the sleeves, but the combination of the shift dress plus the sleeves just does no favors for women with curves.

title: Nice Sweater
text: This is such a fun sweater. I expected it to be worse quality, but it is actually nice and comfortable. I’m not going to lie- I’m actually going to enjoy wearing it!

title: Swim Shorts
text: These shorts have no swim bottoms made into them. They are just shorts. They are a little on the small side and don’t have any stretch or give. I do love them as swimsuit bottoms- though I still wear bikini bottoms under them. They are comfortable and the cut allows you to move without them moving around on you.

title: Best Leggings
text: These are my new favorite leggings. They fit like a dream. Tight enough to hold stuff in. Not so tight you can’t lounge around in them. They are so comfortable.

title: Loud Shorts
text: These do not look like normal chino shorts. They are an athletic material, like a windbreaker, that makes that swishy noise as you walk. They do have some stretch to them. I’m just not a fan of the dry fit material they are made of.

title: Nice Shoes
text: These do take a little bit of a breaking in time. And they look a little big out of the box, but then fit well once you try them on. They look nice. Classic, but with a twist. Once they are broken in, they are really comfortable. Nice shoes.

title: Scarf
