text: This scarf is cute and cozy. The material is a super loose weave fuzzy type of fabric. It feels pretty cheap. I do love the colors. And it does keep my neck pretty warm, so it is functional.

title: Super Comfy
text: This dress is on the relaxed fit side. I like the fit and wouldn’t recommend sizing down. The fabric is so soft. It is sweatshirt like, but much stretchier. The length is also great. It can be worn alone or with leggings.

title: Adorable
text: This is an adorable little romper. It fits really well. It is a cute print. It has washed well. She seems comfortable in it.

title: Best Play Shoes
text: These Jambu Mary Janes are so convenient for little girls. They fit well. They look cute, but function like a tennis shoe. The soles are pretty flexible, but they do protect the toes really well. The black does have silver glitter going on, so they look more grey than black.

title: Socks
text: These are really nice socks. They have cushions in the heel and toe. They fit really well. They aren’t quite as tight as some of my running socks through the arches, but they are comfortable.

title: Comfy Sweatshirt
text: This is a really comfortable sweatshirt. It is slightly over sized. Super soft and cozy. My 9 year old loves it.

title: Awesome Bra
text: This bra is amazingly comfortable. It is super smooth. Really, the only improvement could be if the pads in the cups were not removable. Removable cups always run away on you. This is comfortable like a sleep bra. Super stretchy. I had no problem breastfeeding with it on. But it has enough support to be a daytime bra.

title: Very Small
text: The tunic itself is really pretty. I love the fabric and the length. However, it is very small. And the fabric has zero stretch or give at all. It does not fit loose like the pictures show at all. It was especially tight through the chest.

title: Worst Leggings
text: These leggings are awful. I loved the color and wanted them to work, but they just don’t. They are made out of athletic drive-fit material like running shirts. There isn’t enough of the right kind of stretch to make this fabric workable as pants. They are thin and they don’t like to stay put. In addition to the terrible fabric choice, th cut is entirely wrong. It has no room for your bum. The back slips down off your bum every single time you sit down or squat. These are just terrible.

title: Big Hat
text: This hat is cute. It is oversized, so if you’re wanting to tuck all your hair in, you have plenty of room. It looks handmade. The colors are great. It does have a bit of a scratchy feel because it is acrylic.

title: Boxy
text: The fit is a bit on the boxy side. It is loose fitting, which I like. However, it is just boxy looking. And the fabric is soft, but has a kind of cheap quality to it. The yarn is really thin and fine and slightly fuzzy. It just feels a little bit cheap. It is fine, but definitely not my personal favorite.

title: Cute
text: This duster is a little on the slim side and it is a little on the long side. It looks nice. The waist is a little lower than I would like for it to be. It looks good with a plain tee or tank and legging or jeans. Or you could wear it as a swimsuit cover up, though the material would not feel very nice when wet. It has a single button closure with an elastic loop. It does have some give in the elastic loop, but it kind of pulls that loop instead of pulling the gathering around, so even not tight it looks a bit pulled tight because the elastic loop is more easily stretched.

title: Soft Pants
text: These are super comfortable pants. The waist is stretchy, but the fabric of the pants is not. They are a woven cotton that is very soft. They lay really nicely. And I love that they have front pockets! The hem along the ankles is a bit curved- it is a really nice detail. They look nice but are amazingly comfortable. They are not cut tight, but rather have a slightly relaxed fit. I wouldn’t say they are made big, just not skin tight and form fitting in their cut.

title: Kid Belt
text: This is a nice looking belt for a little guy. My son wears a size 8 pants and the medium fits him well. My son who wears a size 10 can get the belt on, but it is on the last hole. My son who wears an 8 uses a middle hole.

title: Best Sandals
text: These are awesome sandals. The footbed on these is so ridiculously comfortable. You can wear them all day and your feet are still happy. If you have wide feet, the band might be a bit tight at first, but it does loosen up with wear. I love the fit and ease of these. Best sandals ever.

title: Cute
text: This umbrella is cute. And it works well. Really, my only complaint is how shallow of an umbrella it is. You don’t get much domed coverage. But it works really well. One handed button push closer. Two handed open.

title: Comfy Pants
text: The pair I received look nothing like the product in the image. The do not have a drawstring at all. The waistband is a thick exposed (on the inside) elastic. I really like the fit of these. They are roomy and comfortable. I usually hate girl sweats, but I like these. The terry is really thick and soft. Nice big pockets. The ankle elastics are the same thick elastic, and don’t have much stretch at all. I hate doing them when I first tried them on, but wearing them, I got used to the ankles and they didn’t bother me as much as anticipated. The rise is mid rise. They are pretty short. I am 5’4” and the ankles hit at my ankles without the leg scrunching up. I usually wear a 10 and the large fit perfectly with plenty of lounging room.

title: Good Shoes
text: This is a really comfortable shoe. It doesn’t really need any breaking in time. I do wish they had sent a pair of lilac colored laces. The shoe is comfortable and appropriately sized. I’d say they are a neutral to a neutral/minimalist fit in terms of support for your feet. They are very lightweight. The back of the shoe does come up higher, but they don’t offer any real ankle support. The arch support is decent, though.

title: Love This Shirt
text: I love this shirt. It is thicker than T-shirt material. Thinner than sweatshirt material. It has a modal feel to it. Very stretchy. I love the fit. Not too tight, not too loose. I think the sleeves are very flattering. I love it.

title: Fit Comfortably
text: These are very skinny fit jeans. The rise is also on the low side. They do have a bit of stretch. And the color is very dark and pigmented. They are comfortable for skinny jeans. They do have an obvious branding on the right front pocket. It is just the color TH bar, but it is noticeable.

title: Nice Oxford
text: This shirt is really nice. I feel like the sleeves are a bit on the short side. It is slim fit. I found the XL fits like a large, so I would recommend ordering a size up. The color is a nice green color. Collar is button down. Fabric is nice and thick.

title: Swim Trunks
text: These trunks look really nice. The fabric is thick and almost looks like chino shorts. But they do dry pretty quickly. They do have the mesh underwear inside. And they have pockets! They look pretty classic. They have no stretch, but they are comfortable.

title: Joggers
text: These are on the small side. They have that Under Armor polyester feel to them. Slick outside and fuzzy fleece inside. They are comfortable, but seem pretty small. I'd definitely order a size up if you're not into tight pants.

title: Silky Soft Socks
text: These are great socks! I'd classify them as dress socks, but they are nice and thick. Not padded like athletic socks, but not the typical thin dress sock either. They almost have a silky feel to them. So, they are thin, but don't feel cheap at all. More of a modal feel than anything. The pops of color on the top keep them from being old and boring. They are great socks.

title: Neutral Running Shoe
text: These run a bit small. They are medium support, leaning towards the pretty neutral side for a shoe. They look nice. They just run a tiny bit on the small side. I'd say definitely order a size up, especially if you plan to wear socks or run in these.

title: Comfortable and Soft
text: This bra is really comfortable. The high neck gives the look of an undershirt under lower cut tops. The fit is pretty accurate. The fabric is just so soft and comfortable. I'd say it is light to medium support. The fabric is also really cool in the summer, which has been really nice.

title: So Comfy
text: The fit on these is great. They are very stretchy, so they are size forgiving. Not see through at all. They are quite short. I am 5’4” and they hit mid-calf (maybe a tiny bit higher), so the crops are a true crop size. (Sometimes “crop” means ankle length for us shorter gals.) Thr fabric is really soft and comfy. I also didn’t find them too very hot. They move with you and I didn’t have to adjust them at all. Comfortable for exercise or just hanging out watching Netflix.

title: Cozy Shorts
text: These are really comfy pajama pants. They have a very roomy fit, which I really like. They are comfortable. They are on the thin side, but not see through. They are a bit shorter than I prefer, but the coziness makes up for that.

title: Bralette
text: The lace on this bralette is really soft. It does have slight padding in the cups. Nothing too substantial, just enough to keep everything smooth. The straps are adjustable, so you can adjust the fit a bit.

title: Rubber Jacket
text: This is a surprisingly warm jacket. I expected it to be rain coat-ish, but it is more of a fall/winter jacket. It doesn’t have much going on, justvthe outer layer with an inner liner. The length is really nice. The look is really nice. It doesn’t really look like leather at all. It looks rubber, which I think is even cooler. Pleasantly surprised with this one. It does have a rubber smell, which isn’t very surprising. It is also very heavy.

title: Not Good
text: This shirt looks so cheap in person. It looks Very homemade. (Not hand made, there is a difference.) In person, it looks like a home eco project gone very wrong. The fabric just looks cheap. The styling is not quite right. It fits fine, perhaps a little on the large side.

title: Nice Shoes
text: These look really nice. However the size is about half a size smaller than it should be. So, definitely order half a size up. They are also a tiny bit narrow. I just always expect this style to be wide, but these are not. They are really well made. Just the sizing is a little off.

title: Horrible Fit
text: This shirt is the least flattering item I have ever owned. It runs small, so you don’t get the nice oversized fit like the picture. I got a size up and it still doesn’t hang/flow quite right. The material is a perforated athletic material, like a dri-fit type fabric. It has a pretty large screen print on the hip of the company’s logo. The long side has a slit, making the practical length much shorter. The crew neck is very high. I like a good crew neck, but this one is bordering mock turtleneck territory. The sleeves have a slight drop shoulder. It is close to a dolman, but not quite. Unfortunately, the sizing seems off and the sleeve is a bit too tight for the size of the shoulder and the overall shirt. It looks completely ridiculous. It is not at all comfortable. The sizing seems very wrong.

title: Dinosaur
text: The hat doesn’t match the set. It is really strange. The dinosaurs are completely different. I would think solid black would work or if the shirt didn’t have the oversized dinosaur cartoon. The size is pretty spot on. They seem decently made. I’m just bummed at how poorly matched the fabric is. I’d also consider this unisex, not just for boys.

title: Baby Outfit
text: This outfit is cute. It is really well made. It wears and washes well. I think the sizing is right on. The shirt and shorts are both stretchy material. It is cute and comfortable. Love the black, pale pink, and gold.

title: Baby Shirts
text: These are really well made baby body suits. Two of them look pretty unisex, but the “cutie” shirt looks girly. They are thick cotton. Very stretchy, but not easily stretched out. They are really well made. Sizing seems right on. They are cute and comfortable.

title: Cozy Flip Flops
text: These are really comfy house slippers. They are super fuzzy and feel awesome. The bottom is like a memory foam that your feet sink into. These are a really good house slipper for summer or people who don’t like their toes covered.

title: Good Yoga Pants
text: I feel like these yoga pants run a little small. They are super stretchy, so they’ll accommodate, but I feel like they run small. I wear a size 12 and the 1X fit me perfectly. They aren’t super tight on me, but they fit. They aren’t see through at all on me. If you stretch them more, they do have that weird shine you get from stretchy fabrics. But on me, without them being super stretched, the shine is pretty minimal. They have a really long rise. I’m 5’4” and I felt like they were a bit long on me, but not to the extent that I couldn’t wear them. So, average to slightly taller women will likely find them perfect. The fabric is comfortable. I feel like I can move easily in them. But I am also comfortable enough to hang out in them. They are a dri-fit type of material.

title: Run Small
text: These are pretty basic cotton shorts. They are really short and on the small side. The medium fits like a small. If you like your shorts really short and tight, then maybe buy the correct size. If you want them to fit comofrtably, buy a size up.

title: Good Fit
text: This is a good fitting sports bra. It is pretty. The fit is really nice. The neck is a bit higher than your average sports bra. Really comfortable. Medium impact coverage. Good fit.

title: Great Hat
text: This is a really comfortable hat. The mesh back isn’t overly stiff. It is airy. It fits really well. Not too shallow. I really like it. It is adjustable. My preteen is always trying to steal this from me.

title: Uhhhhh
text: I love this little keychain. It is big enough that my keys don’t get lost. But small enough that I’m not being bashed in the knee with something giant while I drive.

title: Love
text: Bob’s Burgers Socks!!! What is not to love? So, they are pretty thin and pretty cheap feeling. But they are novelty socks, not running socks. So, I’m pretty okay with that. Each pair of socks features a different Belcher. The height and size is pretty perfect. Plus, Bob’s Burgers Socks!!!

title: Good Shoes
text: These are great summer shoes! They are a sneaker and sandal hybrid. You don’t need to wear them with socks. They are easy for little hands to put on themselves. They offer good support for little feet. They are great summer shoes for toddlers and preschoolers.

title: Excellent Socks
text: Excellent socks. Very cushiony in the heel and pads of the feet. They fit well. They have a tiny bit of arch support. Very comfortable,

title: Comfortable Hat
text: The height of this hat is a little on the short side. If you like a deep hat, this is not for you. The back adjustable band is leather. It is a little difficult to adjust, but once you get it right, it stays in place really well. The hat is really well made and very comfortable.

title: Jeans
text: These jeans are great. They have stretch in them, so little boys being little boys have plenty of give to their jeans. The stretch does affect the durability of the jeans a little, but not so much that I don’t like it. I like the fit on these. It looks and feels like a straight fit jean. These look nice. My son likes them.

title: Cloudy
text: This is a good sized umbrella. It works really well. I love the retro styling of it. However, the clear portions aren’t really clear. They are cloudy. I figured once it was rained on a time or two it would be clear. Nope. Still cloudy. It has a plastic shower curtain smell, but I think that is pretty expected.

title: Casual Denim Shirt
text: This is a 100% cotton, casual shirt. The fabric really is denim feeling. Some chambray shirts feel more like shirting cotton, but this one definitely feels like denim. Because of the denim, the collar likes to curl a bit. It also has a slight western feel because of the front shoulder stitching. It has a rounded hem. It is a nice shirt. A little on the thick side for a button down, but it is really thin denim. (But thin denim is still a thick shirt.) It is really well made and I like it. Made in China.

title: White Shirt
text: This is a really nice, comfortable shirt. It is more casual in the styling thanks to the pockets. It is well made. The standard fit is great. It fits exactly as I think it should. The quality is really nice.

title: Nice Shirt
text: This is a really nice, well made dress shirt. I have no complaints about the fit or stye. It looks nice. It is well made. It is comfortable.

title: Shiny Shirt
text: This is a 100% cotton dress shirt, which is awesome. The fit of this is great. It is really well made. I really only have two issues with this shirt. The buttons are a dark pearl gray with a white base. The white under the buttons sticks out very visibly against this black shirt. I just wish it had solid black buttons. My second issue is that the fabric is pretty shiny. It is just not a flat black. It looks silky and shiny in person. I'm not a fan of that.

title: Nice Shirt
text: This is a really well made men's dress shirt. It is comfortable. The fit is exactly as expected. It has a button down collar. The fit on this says slim, but I would describe it more as athletic. My husband is really picky about dress shirts and he really enjoys this one and all the ones he has from this brand.

title: Comfortable Shorts
text: The size on these is a little small when compared to other athletic brands. My son wears a size 10 in structured pants. These are 10/12 and they fit him well, but seem much smaller than his other 10/12 athletic shorts. These are pretty thin for shorts. They are t-shirt material. They are super stretchy. They are pretty slim in the cut, which may be why they seem smaller. My son loves them. He says they are super comfortable and doesn't want to take them off long enough for me to wash them.

title: Just Okay
text: The height of this hat is slightly off for me. It doesn’t fit like an adult hat. It is like a midway range between an adult ball hat and a kid ball hat. The height is just a little off so it always feels like it is going to fall off. It never feels like it is on well. I love the ponytail hole idea, but the problem is that you tend to have to put the hat of back to front. I have bangs and always put a hat on front to back. It is hard to get your ponytail in there front to back, but hard to get my bangs tucked under back to front. I feel like the quality could be a little better. There are loose strings all over mine.

title: Super Soft
text: This pajama set is so soft! It is on the relaxed fit side, which is part of what makes it so nice and comfy. The main problems is just that you eventually have to take it off and put on daytime clothes.

title: Nice Shirt
text: Beautiful shirt. It is so well made. It looks and feels nice. My husband is super picky about dress shirts and he really likes this one. The fit is right on, exactly what you’d expect it to be.

title: Nice Fit and Geel
text: This is really good quality. It is a basic, but above basic quality. The inside is so soft. The fit is great. I’m really happy with this jacket.

title: Nice Shirt
text: This is a really nice shirt. I love the color. It can be worn dressed up more with a tie or casual. The fit is somewhere between a classic and slim fit. I really like the fit. It isn't big and baggy, but I'm also not popping buttons it is so snug. It just looks a little more put together. The shirt is really well made.

title: Nice Shirt
text: This shirt is really well made. It looks nice. It feels nice. The slim fit makes it more athletic fit, like shirts sized in small-medium-large sizing and not the balloon sizing of numbered dress shirts. This shirt has a nice fit and a nice look. I'm very happy with it.

title: VERY Slim
text: These are so small and tight! Honestly, when I got them, I had to double check the order to see if I ordered women's pants by mistake. The legs are seriously tight. Yes, they button, but they fit like women's pants- complete with muffin top. It is really ridiculous. The legs are so tight, average male calves fit in them like leggings. They aren't flashy and if they fit, I'd be so happy. But they are very slim fitting. Like skinny jeans. Low riding skinny jeans. I'm shocked I got them buttoned. The rise is really low. I guess some guys really like this fit. They gave zero room in the rise for man parts, thus my thinking they had to be women's pants. I'll admit, it was pretty funny to see just how comically tight these pants were. Everybody would be talking about my tight pants.

title: Textured Shirt
text: The pattern on this shirt is awesome. It is very textured looking. Like a wide hand woven type look. The feel is that of a cotton dress shirt. It looks a lot more textured than it feels. It is a very unique pattern. The shirt fits well and it well made. Very happy with this shirt.

title: Tight Pants
text: These are stretchy, comfortable pants. They button and zip. They are ankle length. They are like wearing dressed up leggings. Skinny, but not tight enough to be considered leggings. Definitely in the pants category. The Black is nice and deep in color.

title: So Comfortable
text: These are so comfortable. They are a relaxed fit, and when you get your correct size, they fit in the relaxed way they appear in the picture. The fabric is super soft. The shirt is a tiny bit see through, being pretty thin. It isn’t a paper thin, but a silky soft thin.

title: Well Made
text: This is a nice Shirt. Wear it dressed up or down. The fit is more slim or athletic fit. It has a textured look, but feels smooth. It looks really nice. It washes well. Well made.

title: Summer Shirt
text: This is a really well made shirt. I am continually impressed with this brand. Their clothes are so well made. It is really comfortable and fits really well. It looks nice. Great summer shirt,

title: Nice Wallet
text: This is a nice wallet. It is on the small side, but if you don’t have a ton to keep in your wallet, it is perfect. It is made of real leather and is really nice and soft. Fits well in the pocket,

title: Comfortable Dress Shoes
text: These shoes are a little on the long side because of the shape of the toe. It adds a bit of length to the shoe. Size wise, the size of this shoe in fit is the exact same as other shoes, but they look longer due to the toe shape. These ar very comfortable and they look really nice. Very nicely built and comfortable.

title: Great Shirt
text: This is a really nice Shirt. The XL slim fit is slightly bigger than a standard large in terms of fit. The fabric is nice. The thickness is perfect. This shirt is really well made.

title: Nice Shirt
text: This shirt fits nicely. The thickness of the fabric is perfect. The shirts looks really nice. It washes really nice, as well. It is a really great shirt.

title: Great Socks
text: These are really comfortable socks. They have support and cushion in all the right places. They are left/right specific, which does take a little getting used to in a sock.

title: Basic Sweats
text: These are pretty standard sweat pants. They are soft and comfy. I think they are a little on the snug side through the butt and crotch area. Not sure why anyone would want fitted sweatpants. I’d order a size up to avoid this issue, since you don’t really want your sweatpants to fit like your jeans.

title: Nice Shirt
text: This is a really nice dress. Shirt. It can be worn casually or business. It has a button down collar. The fabric is on the thinner side, so great for warmer weather.

title: Not A Good Fit
text: I don’t know what made me think this swimsuit would be even the slightest bit flattering, but I was wrong. The swimsuit is double layered and it has removable padding in the top. I cannot keep the padding in the top and smooth. It likes to fold in half and escape during the wash. The arms being off the shoulder do not work at all if you have any type of bosom. I can pull it up and have the sleeve go over my shoulders, more like a cap sleeve, and that does keep it from completely falling off. This bathing suit feels both too big a too small all at once. I am 5 months postpartum. I wear a size 12 and I am 5’4”. This suit feels very loose on me. Like, the fabric doesn’t even try to hold any amount of me in. The fabric just feels very loose. But then the height is really short. Again, I’m 5’4” and it is barely tall enough to cover my chest. If I were a couple inches taller, you could forget it. The top of the suit hits me exactly where it hits the model. However, I have a DD chest to hold up, so it is VERY barely covering. It does have a shelf bra, but without straps, exactly what good is the shelf going to do for you? Even wearing it cap sleeve, which is very barely comes up high enough for that, it just doesn’t offer enough coverage. Smaller sizes, smaller ladies will likely have entirely different experiences. But this is certainly not the suit for this mom. I do love the floral pattern. I do love the inner pink lining fabric. It is fully double lined, but it doesn’t feel like it when you have it on. Maybe I needed a smaller size? I’m not entirely sure where it all went wrong here.

title: Comfy Pants
text: These pants are slightly oversized. I wear a size 12 and the large pants are loose on me. Like, plenty of room. The fabric is super soft and light. These are more capri length. I am 5’4” and these come above my ankles. They also have pockets. I’d categorize them more as lounge pants than pj pants because of the pockets, but either way- they are super comfy for relaxing around the house or wearing to bed.

title: Basic Hooded Sweatshirt
text: This is a basic hooded sweatshirt. It is thick and super soft. Very warm. The size is as expected. My son wears a size 10 and this sweatshirt is about a size too big, which is what I expected and what we were going for in terms of size.

title: Good Kid Hat
text: My four year old loves this hat. He got it so he could look like Woody from Toy Story, but he looks more like Carl from The Walking Dead. It is a little big on him. In fact, it fits my ten year old. It holds up to plenty of abuse. However, the decorative band lasted about a month before the glue on it just gave out. So, now it has no band because I couldn’t get it to stay by gluing it back.

title: Comfortable Kid Sweater
text: This is an excellent sweater. I don’t know why it is labeled as “girls” as it is clearly unisex. In fact, my son wears this sweater all the time. It is really well made. A little on the thin side. Very comfortable. Not itchy at all.

title: Hearts
text: Bra fits well. The size is based on shirt size. So, if they wear a large in girls, order the large. There is some room to stretch and tighten a bit, so the sizing is pretty flexible. The heart strap adjusters are cute. Well made. Padding stays in place well through washing.

title: Stripe Oxford Shirt
text: This shirt fits as expected. The fabric is an oxford type weave. It is thick and really well made. It does look pretty casual with the stripes, even if you starch and press it nicely. Good quality shirt. I’ve been very happy with the quality of this brand.

title: Just Okay
text: These shirts are fine. They are very basic. I think they run a little small. I’m not a fan of the fabric. It is a medium weight jersey, but the kind that tends to pull and shift throughout the day so it doesn’t hold its shape really well. It also accentuates your curves, so you’re muffin top becomes well known to everyone.

title: Perfect Tunic Tee
text: This is an awesome tunic/tee for leggings. It is really roomy and plenty long enough to cover your backside. I would say to buy your regular size so it fits like the photos and so it fits in the arms.

title: Awesome Tunic
text: This tunic is true to size. The body is roomy. Great to wear with leggings. Buy your proper size so the arms fit. I also found it longer in person than it appears on the pictured model. Love this top.

title: Basic Hoodie
text: This is just a basic zip up hoodie. The inside is cozy and soft. Very plain and basic, which is exactly what I needed.

title: Great Shorts
text: I would say these are exactly as expected. The medium would be about a size 7 or 8, which seems perfect. A size 10 could fit into the medium, but it would be a tight fit and these shorts are really best a little loose. The fabric on these is amazing. It is like a super lightweight canvas type of fabric. Not heavy at all. They have the perfect drape. The pockets are nice. These feel so soft and comfortable on. The color is great.

title: Gold Teeth
text: In a freak accident, my 10 year old broke half of one of his front teeth. He was really disappointed when the dentist didn't put a gold cap on the tooth. So when these arrived, he was thrilled! A little weird to fit, but certainly not difficult. I wouldn't wear these daily or eat with them on, but for "dressing up" they do the trick.

title: Nice Shirt
text:
This is a really nice shirt. It feels like an Oxford weave. The collar buttons down, as well. It does wrinkle like crazy, so you definitely have to press it.
The slim fit is about half an inch slimmer through the shoulders than the standard size. It is also about half an inch on each side slimmer. But the length and the sleeve length are the same. And the neck circumference is the same.

title: Nice Shirt
text:
This is a really nice shirt. It feels like an Oxford weave. The collar buttons down, as well. It does wrinkle like crazy, so you definitely have to press it.
The slim fit is about half an inch slimmer through the shoulders than the standard size. It is also about half an inch on each side slimmer. But the length and the sleeve length are the same. And the neck circumference is the same.

title: Basic Tee
text: These are on the small side. The material is thin, but not that paper thin jersey that doesn't hold its shape. They are thin that I feel like they need an undershirt. They are also very fitted. I feel like they are a full size smaller than labeled, but I do like my shirts really roomy. I wear a size 12 and the XL fits snugly without being steched out at all. The black is deep black and is holding its color with washing. Good, basic t-shirt.

title: Comfy Jacket
text: This is a nice, thin hoodie. It isn’t super thick, but is warm enough for most of our southern winter and spring. The color is really nice.

title: Nice Pants
text: I really like these pants. They are a little longer than ankle length on me, since I am 5’4”. They come up to the belly button and kind of smooth everything in the tummy without being too very uncomfortable. The fabric is nice and thick. They aren’t skinny like jegging  or anything, but certainly have the stretch to them like a jegging style pants would. These have no button or zipper closure. They are pull on. The upper elastic is very wide and flat and comfortable, but it stays put.

title: Cozy
text: This is such a cozy sweater. I love the look of the stitches. And it is super cozy. My only complaint is the length. I wish this was just a tiny bit more oversized than it is. It hits just as the hips, which is fine, but a little longer and it would be perfect for wearing with leggings.

title: Comfortable
text: The fit on these is snug. They are 100% cotton, so they are a little less stretchy than some briefs, but a little thicker and more secure feeling. The legs are a little long, not super long, but on the long side. They do loosen a bit and don’t pull back in as you wear them, but not so much that they get overly saggy as the day goes on. Very comfortable.

title: Comfy
text: These are really soft and stretchy. They are on the big side. I can easily fit my baby in them without squishing her in there even though she wears a size above what these are marked. But they are so soft and nice. And very secure. The wrap parts secure in multiple places for a really secure fit that you don't always find in crossover wrap style baby shirts.

title: Nice Shorts
text: These are really nice looking swim shorts. They do have some give in them. They are on the short side, but I feel like that is obvious from the pictures and is what you would expect. They colors are neat.

title: Small
text: These are super soft and bouncy feeling jersey. They color is awesome. But they are really small. The mediums are a small at best. So you should definitely order a size or two up if you don't want them skin tight.

title: Cute Shirts
text: This set of large shirts fit my 8 year old who wears a size 8 in boy’s clothing. He really likes them. They are well made and bright and fun. These would be appropriate for any kid. My daughter was bummed they were too small for her to steal from him.

title: Comfortable Training Bra
text: These are really great bras for younger girls. They are pretty without being too grown up. And the color is a nice neutral color so it doesn’t show too much through clothes. Very comfortable on, so I am told.

title: Great Sweatshirt
text: This is a hooded sweatshirt. It is super nice. It is nice and thick and warm. It looks really nice. The body is striped and gives it a little more than just a solid black hoodie but isn’t loud. Great sweatshirt.

title: So Cozy
text: This shirt is so comfortable. It is thick and warm. The inside feels like brushed fleece. It is so cozy. The black is super dark. It washes well. I do think it runs a little small. The XL fits me like a large. Not very flowey. Much more fitted than it looks on the picture. I like my clothes loose, though.

title: Nice Visor
text: This is a really comfortable visor. It does absorb sweat. It being winter, I’m not quite sure how much, but it does the trick. Really, my only complaint is the velcro on the back. They did try to make it a softer type of velcro that wouldn’t be quite so grabby, but it does still attack my curly hair and pull when I’m trying to get it off. (And sometimes when I try to put it on.) I’m not sure there is really a way around that and it still be adjustable, but it isn’t something I enjoy. The rest of the hat is super comfy and soft. Just not a fan of the attacking velcro.

title: Nice and Long
text: For the price, I like the shirt. It is a little on the thin side. You definitely need an undershirt. It is on the big side. I always order up a size or two because I like my shirts really loose. It was completely unnecessary on this shirt. I like the bottom hem. It is longer in the front and back and shorter on the sides, which I really like. It does have a seam straight down your back. It doesn’t annoy me on this shirt. Great shirt to wear with leggings.

title: Banded Sleeves
text: This shirt is just okay. I bought it a couple sizes bigger than I wear because I like my clothes very loose. It wasn’t really necessary on this shirt. I like the length. It works well with leggings and covers your bum. The fabric is very soft but a little on the thin side, so it shows lumps and bumps a little too well. My only complaint about the cut of the shirt is the sleeves. They are banded and I just don’t like the look of them.

title: Good Beanie
text: This is a good quality beanie. My eleven year old absolutely loves it and wears it all the time. It is adult sized, but fits her just fine.

title: Comfortable Casual
text: This is a real we made linen shirt. It is on the relaxed side in terms of fit. It has nice little V cut outs on the sleeves. It is a very casual shirt. Really well made. Really comfortable.

title: Nice Jeans
text: These are really nice looking jeans. They are a bit small for their size because they are intended to suck everything in a bit. The denim is stretchy, but thick. This isn’t a pajama style jean with an infinitely forgiving stretch material. The short are appropriate length for me. (I’m 5’4”.) So, they are on the longer side for short jeans. The wash is really nice and dark.

title: Hybrid Watch
text: This is a really pretty watch. It is a hybrid watch. It isn’t fully smart, but it is sort of smart. You get an analog watch it’s some modern perks, which I really like. It isn’t going to be great to wear for working out or anything. But if you want to count your steps at work or just durning the regular course of your day, this watch is going to look nice while working harder than your average watch. The fossil app is pretty basic and isn’t as good as other fitness watch apps. But it does work. This is a great watch solution for someone on the fence about smart watches. The band on this is excellent. Fossil does make an excellent watch. I wish the watch had a second hand and I like a date function on my watch.

title: Slim Fit Oxford
text: This is an excellent quality shirt. 100% cotton. The fit on this one is slim. The shirt looks really nice and the quality is fantastic. I am always really happy with Goodthreads quality. And, of course, very happy it is 100% cotton. My husband is usually very picky about brands, but even he loves the Goodthreads clothing.

title: Very Juvenile
text: I like this backpack for what it is. It is a small (toddler/preschooler sized) backpack purse. The outer is nylon. It is really well made. I have no complaints about construction, comfort, or functionality. It is very 90s, which I really like. However, the stripes and vinyl star detail make it very juvenile. As an adult woman, I just can’t carry this bag around. My tween absolutely can. She can pull it off really well. I just look like a lost tourist with it. My sons are all convinced it is a Captain America backpack intended for toddlers. My 2 year old might claim it as his own soon if we aren’t careful.

title: Just Doesn’t Work
text:
This backpack is made of a weird nylon type fabric. The pocket flats and buckle details are leather. The buckles and snaps are shiny gold. The straps are canvas. I like the size and cut of this backpack purse. It is very 90s, with the cinch pull and rounded bottom. It is a generous size, but isn’t a standard backpack size- it is still purse sized. The pockets inside are great.
My two problems with this purse: the materials just look “off” in person. The nylon, leather, canvas combo is just not working in person. The shiny gold and leather give a “not casual” vibe and the nylon and canvas give a “utilitarian” vibe. It just doesn’t all seem to work together like it should. Like wearing heels with sweatpants. In the pictures, it looks nice. In person, you just see the oddities and it does not work.
My second problem is the front pockets. While the square pockets are very 90s. A more usable look would have been to make them cell phone size. Because that is where you’d want to put your cell, but you can’t. A pager might fit if you’ve still got one of those lying around. Pens don’t fit. I guess I could fit a lot of lip balm in those pockets or something. They are just quickly accessible pockets that will hold almost nothing you need to be quickly accessible.

title: Great Jeans
text: Levi jeans hold up really well for active boys. These are not a slim fit blue jean. They are slim, meaning the waist size is smaller, but the actual cut is a standard straight leg cut. These have the elastic pull tabs inside for an even better fit on skinny kids. The color is great. They look really nice. My 10 year old loves them.

title: Love This Backpack
text: This is such an adorable little backpack. I love it. Now, this is more purse sized backpack than school sized. The main fabric is a canvas twill stripe. Love it. The hardware is shiny gold. It is cute and comfortable. I love it. Very casual. Very functional. Very cute. It is very obviously marked Tommy Hilfiger, which I don’t love because I hate obvious labeling, but I’ll deal.

title: Great Socks
text: These are excellent socks for plantar fasciitis relief. The compression through the arch is just wonderful. They aren’t too tight all over like some compression socks can be. So your toes will not go numb while you run or whatever it is you do in your socks. I think I do prefer the knee high version more, but these provide very localized support while your working out or walking about.

title: Soft
text: These are really awesome long sleeve tees. My son thinks they are awesome. They are soft. They fit really well. I honestly wish they were all plain, since plain clothes are hard  To come by. They do have a bit more of a slim athletic fit than other t-shirts.

title: Great Jacket
text: This jacket looks and feels like real leather. It does run on the small side. I guess it is intended to fit tighter. It seems a bit short, too.

title: Nice Jacket
text:
This jacket is very nice. It is fluffy and warm and looks really great. I think it is a little on the small side. Like, about half a size small, not a full size smaller.
**edited** This Jacket is super warm, even in snow. So warm! My reason for the decreased rating is the stupid zipper. After less than a month, I’m having zipper issues. It keeps getting stuck. I have to fight with it all the time. No sense in wearing a warm jacket that won’t zip! The zipper is warping from getting stuck and having to unstick it so many times. It is such a bummer because the jacket is so awesome!

title: Advent Shoelaces
text: My husband actually uses these in his dress shoes. He likes his laces to be liturgical colors, so the pink and purple set are perfect for Advent. They look nice in his dress shoes and are appropriate length for them.

title: Great Bag
text: This backpack can be a backpack or duffle bag. I like that because sometimes one is easier than the other for whatever reason. It has multiple pockets to use. The main pocket area has a strap, like a suitcase, to hold all your stuff in place. This is on the small side, so would only be appropriate for packing for a day or two, unless you are a phenomenally light packer.

title: Cozy Pants
text: These are comfy joggers. They run a bit big. Usually wear a 36x30 and he medium fit. If you want a hipster type fit, size down. If you. want comfy room, size up. The length is pretty good. They'd probably be a bit short for taller guys. I mean, with joggers the length isn't super important. They have pockets, as well. Comfy, durable, awesome.

title: Comfortable
text: This is an excellent shirt. It looks awesome. It fits really well. It is a slim fit. The colors are great. The best part is that this shirt is 100% cotton. I also like how this brand puts the back pleats on the shirt wide behind the shoulders instead of narrow behind the neck. That makes so much more sense in terms of how you move. Very comfortable shirt.

title: Notebook Paper
text: My son joked that this shirt reminds him of notebook paper with the royal blue and red plaid on the white. This shirt fits as expected. I’m really impressed with the quality. It is just as nice as very pricy department store brand shirts that cost a fortune. And the best part is that the shirt is 100% cotton! This shirt is easily dressy or can go more casual. The tail isn’t too long to leave it untucked.

title: Great shirt
text: Great shirt. It is really comfortable. The fit is pretty on size. It also has the back pleats over the shoulders, instead of in the middle of the shirt, which makes so much more sense. The shirt is 100% cotton, which is really hard to find. Great shirt.

title: Excellent Compression Socks
text: These are wonderful compression socks. Nice and snug, like they should be. They are unisex, so the large fits a men’s shoe size 10 very well. The stripes make these more fun. Great socks.

title: Very small
text: These shirts run small. A girl’s large is the equivalent of a boy’s small. It is the size of a girl’s medium in most other shirts. The large would roughly be a size 8 in other girl’s clothing. They also have cap sleeves. I’d like the shirts if they weren’t so very small.

title: Pusheen
text: This shirt is very soft. It is a little bigger than I would expect a men's medium to be. It is the size of some large's I own. The print isn't plasticy or thick. It is really fun.

title: I Like Them
text: I have been nursing for over a decade (7 kids), so I have gone through quite a few nursing bras. My favorite have been the Bravada bras, but I don't like paying that much money for such a simple bra. I saw these and figured, why not try them out? I am a 36 DD, but since I am about to have baby #7, I went ahead and got the XLarge to have some room for engorgement. The large would fit fine, but the XLarge also fits and gives me a little more room for those first few weeks after having the baby. The fabric is stretchy and it has removable padding in the cups. Really, my only complaint is that the clips are really loose. They don't snap as firmly as other clips. They don't pop open when wearing them because they have to be flipped up and lifted. But they don't feel very secure when you close them. Other than that, I really like these. They are comfortable, look good under my clothes, and are very functional.

title: Love These Pants
text: I like these pants. They are nice and flowy, not tight through the thighs at all. The waist band is on the short side for my liking. (I like it taller so I can fold it down.) But I did order a size up because the waist band looked smallish. However, the sizing up wasn't really needed as these are slightly bigger through the rise than the Frumos brand ones. I'm enormously pregnant, and these pants fit well. They'll also fit when not pregnant thanks to the super stretchy fabric.

title: Comfy
text: I ordered a couple sizes up because I wanted the shirt to be really oversized, and it is. The neckline isn't finished on mine, but it looks intentional. It is still a deep V, but the layers of fabric are open around the top. The pocket is really low for where I think it should be, but that is likely because I ordered mine really big. The fabric is stretchy and comfy. It is on the thicker side, so not super thin and dainty or anything, which I like. I also like the length of the sleeves. They aren't tiny cap sleeves so many women's shirts seem to have.

title: Awesome Shirt
text: This shirt does run a bit small, but I anticipated that and ordered a size up. It is really soft and I love the feel of the shirt. The graphic is nicely done. Not too thick or weird. I also love the color.

title: Awesome Pants
text: These pants are super wide and the roll down top is really big, which I like. The exterior sides of the pants are not longer, I'm not sure why it looks like that in the picture, but they are cut straight across. The fabric is super stretchy and bouncy. The legs are really, really wide. I did buy a size up because I didn't want them to be tight, but I realize now I didn't need to do that. Also, I'm very pregnant and these pants fit over my pregnant belly! They will also fit when not pregnant. (When pregnant, I just don't roll the waist band down.)

title: Just Okay
text: These camisoles are just okay. They are not the best quality. They work, but they aren't well made. The straps are super cheap and not well sewn on. They do have adjustment rings, but they are on the front instead of the back. The material is thin and stretchy. I won't be buying these again, but I'm not upset enough with them to return them. They'll work. They are longer than some camisoles, but not nearly as long as H&M camisoles.

title: Activity Tracking Watch
text: This watch is a little more athletic looking. It has an activity tracker and syncs with your smart phone. It also has some other features, like the ability to control the volume on your phone or take a picture with the phone pressing a button on the watch. The time aligns itself with the phone. It looks really nice. Wears extremely comfortably. It is an analog watch with some digital capabilities. This is not the touch screen version. This one has actual watch hands and operates more like a watch and a Fitbit melded together with a couple other perks. It is branded across the band, which I thought looked really dumb at first, but when wearing it, the branding isn't too noticeable.

title: Flannel Shirt
text: This shirt fits really well. The hood is thick terry and the shirt is a soft, brushed flannel. It isn't thick enough to be considered a jacket- it is definitely a shirt. But it is a nice, cozy warm shirt. My 8 year old thinks it looks awesome.

title: Cozy Shoes
text: These slippers are so cozy. They have an outdoor sole on them, so you could wear them indoors or out. They are very similar to my Minnetonka moccasins. The lining is fluffy and soft. They are a little wider than Minnetonka and Sperry moccasins. I usually need a 9 in Minnetonka, but with these, the size 8 fits. It is a little snug, but I find this style of shoe loosens up as you wear it, so starting out a tiny bit tight is usually fine. I'd worry the 9s would be too big and would slip.

title: Comfy Pants
text: My son loves these pants. They are lined in jersey cotton material, so they are really soft on the inside. The outside is loud nylon material. They have an elastic waist band and a drawstring. They are really comfortable. They are durable. They also have zippers on the ankles to unzip over boots or bigger shoes.

title: Cute
text: These are different from the original Hatchimals. If you're looking for those, this won't make you very happy. These are a smaller, simplified version. The eggs can be reused. They don't hatch themselves. It has smaller animals that have a keychain attached to them. They are really cute. My kids think these are awesome. They are just different from the original, so don't expect the original in miniature form. These are great for a smaller gift or stocking stuffers. Or younger kids who just don't have the patience to hatch an original size Hatchimal.

title: Big
text: This is an adorable little romper. However, the sizing is a bit off. It came and it was a size 70, which roughly correlates to about a 3-6 month American size. So, baby isn't going to be able to wear it right away, but it is super cute and fun and comfy anyway.

title: Maternity Use
text: I'm very pregnant and had a hard time finding a swimsuit that fit, covered everything up, and didn't cost an arm and a leg. I decided to give this one a try. It was very flattering. The underneath portion is all connected. The shorts fabric is the same as the top. But from the waist to the bust, it is a thinner, super stretchy white fabric. So, even though my enormous belly the fabric wasn't tight or constricting feeling at all. It is a little difficult to get on, since it just pulls on. With the belly, I had to work in stages. Get the suit completely up over my butt. Then work to get the entire thing over my belly. That is really the hardest part, since the bust part has to be pulled over your belly to get the suit on. Then the last stage is getting the top situated. It is really supportive in the bust. I got tons of compliments on this swimsuit. Not sure how it will look when I'm not pregnant, but I will certainly try it out next summer and see.

title: Shiny Camo Shirt
text: This shirt fits really well. It is a standard sized large. The dri-fit material is a little more slick than other dri-fit shirts I have had. This one is a little shiny in how it looks, almost wet looking. That is the only reason I gave it 4 stars, the shine just looks pretty weird on the shirt. Otherwise, really well made and comfortable.

title: Cool Jacket
text: This jacket is pretty much true to size. The fit is tapered around the wrists and waist. The polyester material is a bit shiny. And it is really loud. The inside lining polyester is soft, but the outer stuff is more rough and makes a lot of noise when you move. The construction of the jacket is good. I feel like it will hold up well. Everything on this jacket is polyester. 100%. And really, the noise of the fabric is the only real downside for this jacket. It is pretty lightweight, so it won't be a good winter jacket for folks in actual cold climates. But here in the south, this will work fine.

title: Quality Bag
text: This is a very nice backpack. It is very plain, but very well made. The zipper pulls are black leather. Inside the large pocket is a small milky lined pocket for a laptop or tablet. The size is great for the average student use. It is a classic design, a basic look, and good quality in a bag.

title: Super Duper Ligth Weight
text: This suitcase is huge. It is also ridiculously light. If you're needing something super light, this is it. My only negative of the suitcase is that the exterior feels flimsy. So far it is holding up fine, but it just feels very thin and cheap. It rolls well. Very functional. I also love that the handles are gel on the underside, so you don't hurt your hands carrying it. It does come with a peel off sticker all over the exterior to protect it. It doesn't peel off smoothly or easily, but you'll eventually get it off. It looks nice.

title: Comfortable Undies
text: These are comfort waistband underwear. They are cotton, but the fabric is a bit perforated looking. Like a cotton version of athletic mesh. They are just standard little girl undies. Comfy. Cute colors.

title: Pure Cotton
text: This is a great shirt. It can easily be dressed up or down. It is a regular fit, not athletic or anything, so it fits true to size. The best part is that it is 100% cotton. It is on the thinner side, so it is a great shirt for summer or the warmer fall and spring months. It would also be a great shirt to layer under a sweater, since it isn't too thick and hot. The colors are a little rustic. It matches both black and brown. Great shirt.

title: Good Shoes
text: These shoes have a decent amount of arch support. I mean, not crazy strong, but more than a minimalist shoe. It falls somewhere between the extremes. The sizing is right on. They are really comfortable on. The inner soles are really nice and cushy feeling. The laces don't leave much room for adjustment or crazy lace patterns. These are good, basic running shoes. And they aren't a thousand neon colors.

title: Great Kid Pants
text: These are a little big for a boy's medium, however, they still fit my son who is on the smaller/leaner side. They are just more of a relaxed fit than a true slim fit. My son loves these. He has had them in several colors. No zippers. No buttons. Just an elastic waist with a drawstring to customize the fit. The gathered ankles mean they fit, even if they are a little long. They have front and rear pockets and look like "regular" khakis. They don't really have an athletic look to them and can easily be worn with button down shirts for a "nicer" look. The fabric feels like regular cotton twill, only textured. It isn't soft like athletic pants. There is no stretch to the fabric at all. They do have belt loops all around for wearing a belt, though it isn't needed, but you could if you wanted to.

title: Nice Daily Bag
text: This is a great backpack! The straps are not padded at all. The buckle on the front is decorative, it actually opens with a magnetic snap. The top of the bag has a drawstring. Inside, you have so many pockets! You have a big laptop/tablet pocket at the back that is padded. You have pockets on each side. The front pocket opens and has several smaller pockets inside. Plus, it looks really cool. This is a really awesome backpack. It would be suitable for a diaper bag, school bag, or just a daily bag.

title: Good Hat
text: This hat is super adjustable. It easily fits my 4 year old with just a pull of the cord. It could still easily fit my 10 year old. The color is much lighter than I expected. It is much more of an off white than khaki color. Side vents help keep the kid cool. A neck strap helps keep the hat on. The brim is slightly padded and soft. He thinks he looks like Dr. Grant on Jurassic Park, so he thinks the hat is amazing. The fabric is board short type nylon, so it dries pretty fast and stays cool. A good kid's hat.

title: No Slipping
text: These are very similar to Sperry's, but more functional. The fit is right on, exact size. They are more arch support than boating shoes and flats tend to have. The laces make them very adjustable. The toe box area is a bit more like a tennis shoe. Deep grooves in the soles make them much more stable on slippery surfaces. The bottoms are very sturdy and don't have much bend and give to them. Really good shoes.

title: No Slipping
text: These fit as expected, right on the correct size. There are deep grooves in the sole for keeping your step even on wet and slippery ground. They are pretty stiff. They have very nice arch support for being a flat slip on shoe. Tabs on the back make it easy to pull on and off. It feels like a cross between a slip on loafer and a boot. Very comfortable.

title: Sturdy
text: These are really great, really sturdy work boots. They run a tiny bit big, but with wool or other thick socks, which you'll likely be wearing, they fit perfectly. So, they fit does account for the socks. They are fluffy neoprene all the way around, which is like having padding all around the shoe. They are waterproof. They are comfortable. The tops are soft so they won't rub on your legs and rip your leg hair out. Good boots.

title: Awesome Glasses
text: These are really cute and comfy glasses. I'm also pretty happy they came with a hard case and a lens wipe. I'm really happy with these. I think the tint is perfect. The fit is great. They are a great weight, not too light or too clunky.

title: Not Leather
text: This belt looks nice, but it isn't leather. The description is wrong. The leather is "imitation leather." The fabric is a navy blue canvas like fabric. It has a wide weave and starts pulling and wearing in places. The top stitching looks nice. The buckle is polished silver on the side that shows. (On the underside of the belt it is just shiny silver.) So, overall, it looks good, but it isn't very durable and it isn't what is described.

title: Work for A Big Kid
text: These shoes are really sturdy. I was a little concerned about them looking too toddler like for an older boy, but they look fine and he thinks they are awesome. They are a canvas outer with a rubber sole and an almost memory foam insole. The bottoms are very sturdy, they are not flexible at all. They are a little on the wide side. No arch support at all. But the insole is really cushiony and soft. If it matters to you, these are made in China. They seem a little on the big side, but not a full size big. They are good kid shoes and my son thinks they are awesome.

title: Good Board Shorts
text: These shorts are like board shorts, but they still have the swim trunk net thing inside. They seem a bit large for their size, but they are highly stretchy, so they'll fit quite a range of sizes. The pockets are really large. They have a board short style drawstring at the waist. I like the color. Good shorts. Comfortable and roomy.

title: which is really nice. They fit my daughter really well
text: This suit is really cute. On my screen, it looks pink and yellow. However, in person, it is actually pink and orange. (There is a little yellow and white in the floral print.) The entire bottom and entire top is completely lined, which is really nice. They fit my daughter really well. The shorts do have a small bit of ruching at the sides. My only wish is that the straps were adjustable because they are the tiniest bit long on my daughter. She can still wear the suit, but has to fuss over the armpits being a little on the loose side. But a really good swim suit.

title: Awesome Shoes
text: These are really good shoes. They are more of a purple/burgundy with very bright orange. They are like replacements for tennis shoes. The inserts inside are like tennis shoe inserts with good arch support. They are great for running around the park, hiking, walking around an amusement park all day, and bike riding. These are not water shoes at all. They woukd feel like walking around in wet tennis shoes. The soles are a bit flexible while still being thick and rugged. The soles cover the toe a little so dragging feet wont completely ruin the shoes. Velcro closure for easy on and off. I'm really happy with these shoes and my daughter loves them.

title: All Activity Shoe
text:
These shoes fall somewhere in the category of tennis shoes, sandals, dress shoes, and water shoes. They are great comfortable shoes for summer. The inside foot bed is textured and offers good support. The bottoms ar rally textured to prevent slippage. The heel part makes for a really great fit and no slipping on the heel. The sole of the shoe covers the toe a bit, so if your kid drags their toes,they won't ruin their shoes. The top straps keep the shoe secure, but are easy on and off. These shoes are great for hiking, alking around a theme park all day, or running around the neighborhood and riding bikes all day. They really are an all activity kind of shoe.
A note on sizing- while I do say they fit as expected, I do think they are a tad bit long for the size. However, they still fit. So, if your kid is kind of between sizes, you can really go up or down and still get a really good fit. The way they are cut and the straps make them easy to tighten or loosen for a little bit wider span of wear than say, a tennis shoe.

title: Awesome Flips
text:
These are really high quality flip-flops. The bottoms are dense foam. The footbed does have an arch to it for goo arch support. The inside of the strap is lined for added comfort. The part that goes between the toes is backed in fabric webbing for durability. The bottoms have a deep texture to them to help prevent slippage. My boys think these look awesome. If it matters to you, these are made in China out of all man-made materials. I'm very happy with these shoes.

**Updated- I had initially given these shoes 5 stars. However, now that my son has worn them for a little longer, I can tell you how they are wearing. And I am changing my rating to two stars.
The bottom foam on the sole is really sturdy. However, the three layers are apparently not held together very well. He managed to rip the entire bottom layer of foam off one flip-flop and half off the other. He is really hard on shoes, but I expect them to last longer than 2 weeks. I'm pretty surprised since I have always experienced such good quality from Jambu.

title: Great Kid Shoes
text: These are so adorable and functional! They are like a cross between tennis shoes and dress shoes for a little girl. Perfect for summer. The footbed is soft, but supportive. The soles have a moderate amount of flexibility. The upper fabric is thin and breathable. I love that the soles cover the toes so they don't tear them up dragging their toes. I also love that the velcro band on the top has a little rubber end that is easy for a kid to pull for them to put their shoes on or off by themselves. Good tread on the bottoms. These are really great kid shoes. Plus the colors are great. The ribbon has an iridescent sheen in it, which makes them a little extra fancy.

title: Good Bottoms
text: These bottoms are a little small. They don't run as small as the tops, but still a good 2" smaller around the hips than other brands I have in the same size. The bottom is completely lined in contrasting fabric. It also has a drawstring in the waist to keep them from falling down on you. The legs have no slip grip stuff on them, so they stay put. I found the bottom to be *almost* full coverage in the back. They are cut pretty low and sit right on the hips. The fabric is really good quality. I found the bottoms have more give and stretch than the tops. Overall, really good swim bottoms, just run a bit on the small side. (Compared to underwear, these were the same width as my medium/6 underwear.)

title: Cute Vegan Sandals
text: These are pretty adjustable, but not completely. They are comfortable dressy casual sandals. They aren't going to be good for walking around a theme park all day or anything. But the foot bed is comfortable and the straps are moderately comfortable. The straps are both Velcro. I'm kind of between sizes, so I went with a size down since they are sandals, and that worked for me. If your foot is wider, you may want to do the opposite and size up. There is decent arch support, as well. Really, I have had other JBU by Jambi sandals and have had the same minor problem. The areas of attachement (where the Velcro is sewn in and where the hardware is) are uncomfortable for constant wear. Wearing them in not harsh conditions, they're fine. Wear them when it is hot, sweaty, wet, or sandy- and you have small minor irritation spots.

title: Comfortable
text: These are just basic little girls' crop bralettes. My daughter prefers these to camps, because they aren't as hot. There have adjustable straps, which makes them an easy fit. No closure. They just pull over. They do have small satin bows, but they are easy to remove if you don't like them. These are basic cotton jersey feel. Comfortable.

title: Good
text: These are just basic microfiber undies. I like microfiber under things like jersey because they smooth everything out and just seem to work better. I like the prints, they are cute. I like the fit. Just not 5 stars because they aren't like the best undies ever. I have others that are similarly priced that I like a lot more.

title: Awesome
text: My 10 year old loves Hunger Games. She has a Mockingjay pin, but finds it hard to wear with all her outfits. The necklace is much better. It can be worn with anything. She gets tons of compliments on it.

title: Great Boots
text: These boots are very comfy. They fit as expected, though the foot height is a little on the narrow side. So, if you have wider feet, these aren't going to work for you. I do love the lace up function. If you have wider calves, you can loosen the laces. They are very sturdy and the bottoms don't slip at all. Great rain boots.

title: Strong
text: These are really nice, sturdy boots. Since they are very strutted and reinforced, they are really heavy. And they look huge out of the box, but they fit exactly as expected, which is nice. The bottom tread is very stable. The toe is very strong. Great fit. Very comfortable.

title: Colorful
text: This is an excellent quality belt. It is very casual and very durable. The colors are great and match with almost anything, really. The width of the belt is ideal. Good quality. And looks good. It is a little on the hipster side, but if you can pull it off, you should.

title: Awesome
text: My husband doesn't want to take them off. He has been wearing them non-stop since I bought them. He wears them to the store and around the house. They are extremely well made. They keep your feet cozy and warm, but not sweaty. Wear them with or without socks. He has plantar fasciitis and doesn't have to wear his inserts with these because these have such good arch support.

title: Love It
text: This is surprisingly more flattering than I expected. The cut doesn't make me look pregnant, which is a plus, since I am not. It does run small, so I am glad I got one size larger than I normally wear. So comfy. The neckline is nice and high. It is so comfy. Love it!

title: Perfect
text: This is the best tunic. It is soft. The neckline is nice and high. It covers everything. It is super flowy. And it is a great color. Wear it alone when it is warm or with a cardigan when it is cool. Perfect tunic! I want them in every color!

title: Lovely
text: This is a lovely wallet. It feels great in your hand. I can fit my phone in the zippered pouch easily. Plenty of places for cards, change, cash, etc. Good size, but not too big.

title: Almost Perfect
text: They were so close to being the perfect undies. The perforated fabric is perfectly stretchy and breathable. Cotton lining inside the crotch area. Perfectly unpinching and unmoving leg holes. And then you have that small detail on the front where they put a different sheer fabric to make a design. The more sheer fabric in the lines isn't stretchy and it is kind of scratchy. It makes the waist not entirely stretchy. It also isn't as comfortable against your skin in those areas on the front of the hips. Without that small design issue, they would have been completely perfect. The rise is not too high, but not so low you booty hangs out the back.

title: The Best
text: These are my 9 year olds favorite underwear. I've tried several other brands and styles, but these are his perpetual preference. The fabric is just a thin woven cotton. They are tagless, but the tags are noticeable, especially at first. They are kind of screen printed in, like a thin silver vinyl tag. Once you wash them half a dozen times, this softens and it doesn't feel quite so noticeable. The ones I got are different colors than the picture shows. Not that the color really matters to me. My pack was more orange, teal, and blue themed plaids.

title: Nice
text: These are really nice, comfortable slacks. They don't wrinkle too horribly. They have a little give in the fabric. Comfortable. Well made. There are some Little finishing touches that make them even nicer. Some red binding through the inseam. Nice fabric in the pockets. The color is true navy. Very dark. Looks like a little grey in with it.

title: Love it.
text: This is an amazing tunic. The neck is high, which is really difficult to find on women's tops. The neckline is my favorite part of this tunic.  I love the cut. The length is perfect.

title: Different Fit, But I like Them
text: These are a little smaller in the waist than other palazzo pants I own. They are also longer in the legs. I love the color. So soft. I did have to remove about 3" from the length of the legs. The rise is also shorter than my Leggings Queen palazzos.

title: Beautiful
text: This watch is lovely. Very weighty, but not bulky. It feels nice on the wrist. The rose gold is fantastic. The band was big on me, but I do have fairly small wrists. You can have the band altered, though, without much fuss. Simple to set. It is rated at being water resistant, but not for being submerged in water. (5 ATM) The clasp is easy to work with one hand. Pinch to open. Flip closed to shut. Simple. It isn't too very flashy, either. I mean, we are talking about a rose gold with crystal surrounding. But it seems simple and tasteful. (Though the branding is a bit much for my taste.)

title: Cute
text: These shoes are great. They are a little darker than the picture, but still what I would consider mint. They do take some breaking in. At first, you can only wear them a little at a time. Just have to get the suede to soften up a bit. The tie does actually work in tightening the shoe. I found them to be a little on the narrow side. The soles are very sturdy and flat. They aren't as flexible as Sperry's, so that takes a little getting used to for me. But cute shoes. Love them.

title: Nice Casual Pants
text: These say slim fit, but I wouldn't necessarily consider them slim. They seem straight fit to me.  The fabric is 100% cotton. It is on the thicker, kind of casual side. It does have dress pant back pockets, but the pants have a casual feel.

title: Silky with Slight Stretch
text: They may fit a little on the bigger side. Not that they are cut bigger, but they have some stretch to them so they seem bigger, if that makes sense. The fabric is pretty thin and a little on the silky side. They do stay pretty wrinkle free. They are a tiny bit on the scratchy side, but I think it is the weave and the fact that they are 100% polyester. They are really decent dress pants. I think the Kirkland brand from Costco are better (and half the price), but these are good. They are definitely dress pants, not at all on the casual side.

title: Nice Jeans
text: These jeans fit extremely well. The back pockets are placed just right. Not too high or wide. The fabric is stretchy and a little on the thin side, but not like leggings stretchy and thin. Just thinner denim with some horizontal stretch. (Meaning you can actually sit and bend over in these.) I would like the ride to be a little higher, because it is somewhere in the middle. Like, not to the belly button, but also not low rise. Like, halfway between the two. I also feel like they were a little more worn looking through the thigh than the picture appeared. But they are really nice fitting jeans and they look nice.

title: Good, One Complaint
text:
This is really good, durable luggage. The caster wheels roll easily in all directions. The handle lifts to two different heights. The zippers lock into place. (There is a keyhole on the lock for some special TSA key.) The lock is simple to reset. It will expand. It is completely lined on the inside, with several pockets and things to separate your things. Again, I will say, this is a really great set of bags. Now, for my only complaint.
My only complaint is that one of the pouches on the inside has velcro to hold it down to one side. Like, velcro running along the entire length of one side of the bag. Velcro is evil when combined with clothes. This one little detail means that I have to be obsessive about which side I place certain items. No sweaters, satin, or leggings on the velcro side! You'll be a very unhappy traveler if you make that mistake. Velcro may not bother you in the slightest. But it is my personal nemesis. I have lost one too many clothing items to it's unyielding clutches.

title: Great
text: I really wasn't sure about the sizing. I usually wear a size 10 or 12. So, I would think, based on that, a large would be what I would need. And a large would definitely fit. But the medium makes them fit me like the pic of the model. So, if you want them to fit a little snug, like a slim fit jogger, order down. If you're just wanting loose and comfy, then order the size up. These are cozy, fleece lined pants. They hit me just below the belly button. If I wanted them lower on the hips, I could easily roll the wide waist band over. They have pockets! I love pockets, so that is a major plus for me. The drawstring does actually work. As far as the length, they are a little long on me (I'm 5'4"), but with the tapered jogger bottom, you can just pull them up to your ankles and let them scrunch. I would think they would look good even if they were a little short. Super cozy classic sweatpant feel, with a much more modern cut.

title: Really Like These
text: These jeggings fit true to size, in my opinion, but are slightly smaller than other Lee Jeans I have tried. I found the fit to be great. Not too tight in any area. They are a little long on me, but that is usual for me. (I am only 5'4".) They have a good amount of stretch without looking like leggings. The butt pockets are very well placed on me. The rise comes up to almost my belly button, but I am on the shorter side. I love the inner lining in the top of these. I hate tags and such in women's pants. These are so comfy. I only wish the lining went all the way down the legs. (It stops at the pockets.) That would just make them the perfect winter pant. The front pockets are lined with the super soft fabric, too. I figured I would just wear these under tunics, but the pockets are well placed and the fabric is thick enough for these to be legit pants. I really do like these.

title: Good, But Fit Is An Issue
text: These leggings fit like compression leggings, not like you're one size regular wear leggings. They don't have much stretch, so they feel on the small side. I wear a 10 or 12 in most clothes and the medium fit, but are very tight. A large would likely be a lot better for me. So, definitely size up if you are between sizes. Also, the cut is interesting. The hip and booty area is wide but the waist is small. So, if that is the way you are built, they'll be perfect. I am not. I carry my extra weight in my tummy, so the waist is the area that was problematic for me, while the butt, hip, and thigh areas fit really well. They do have a small waistband pocket, as well. They are more on the shiny side than a flat black.

title: Fabulous Bag
text: I am in love with this bag. There are so many pockets for various items. Keep your shoes away from your clothes. Keep your water bottle held but accessible on the side. Even a wet bag inside for wet stuff. The color is even better in person. The should strap has a nice padded area for comfort. Outer pockets on the front and back. Inner pockets to keep things separate. Shoulder strap plus shorter hand carry straps. This is an amazing bag. It would also make a great diaper bag. (I have six kids, so I always look for perfect diaper bag potential.) Can carry on one shoulder, across the body, or by the handles. Love it.

title: Beautiful
text:
This bracelet is beautiful. Really, this activity tracker is all about the looks. You are not going to want to wear it running or anything. The leather watch style band is just not going to work well for things like that.
Set up was not fun. I downloaded the app, followed the directions, and still had tons of problems. It took me dozens of tries to pair the device.

title: Comfortable
text: Really comfortable shoes that you can wear all day without any issues. Even with a history of foot issues, including plantar fasciatis in both feet, these sandals are comfortable for hours walking around town or the amusement park or the zoo, whatever that day holds. The molded foot beds are super comfy. The adjustable straps make every bit of the shoe fit perfectly. Highly recommend these shoes.

title: Pockets!
text:
There are pockets on this thing that I didn't even know I needed! This bag is super functional. It comes with a changing pad and a wet bag. There are so many pockets and compartments inside. It easily keeps everything nice and neat even if you aren't a nice and neat person. The side pockets easily hold bottles, water bottles, sippy cups, or Sophie the giraffe. The inside is a cute green print with orange accents. The straps are comfortable. The hook is durable. It also has convenient stroller clips on the top so you don't have to figure out how to stretch the handle over the stroller or worry about the Mommy Clip. Just clip it onto the stroller bar. This is a great bag. I easily have room for all my toddler and baby's things.

UPDATE: After a little over a month of use, this bag is not wearing well. One the side pocket with the drawstring, a grommet popped off. Around the straps and the top loop, the fabric is pulling and fraying at the seams. I wouldn't say it has been heavily used. It is a diaper bag, but we haven't had any big catastrophes. It is just wearing very poorly.

UPDATE 2: It has now been six months, and the upper loop completely broke off on one side. The grommets in the side pull things are all completely off now.

title: Looks Awesome
text:

You have to fully charge the watch on the included charging cradle before you can use the smart aspect. It was a little confusing because the watch was working, so you assume it is charged, but the watch always works, even when the back notification part is dead. Charging took over an hour. And you can't pair or sync at all until charging is complete. The setup beyond that is really simple.
The watch band is adjustable. You can remove links to make the band smaller to fit. The typical watch features are just classic Fossil watch. This watch is also pretty heavy.
It comes with the charging cradle, cord, and plug.

title: Love These
