The straps only adjust on the front of the ankle. So the toe either fits or it doesn't. Lucky for me it fits. These are super comfortable. I can wear them all day long walking around the zoo or Six Flags. They did rub a small blister on one ankle when I wore them all day gardening. Something to do with them being wet and in dirt. Usually, they are perfectly fine. I love these shoes!

title: Great "Everything" Sandal
text: My eight year old loves these shoes. They are the perfect hybrid of a sandal and a tennis shoe. He can hike in them, run around a theme park all day in them, stomp through a creek in them, play a game of tag in them. Really, this shoe is the perfect "everything" shoe. They adjust easily. He wears them with no socks and says they are really comfortable. The shoe feels very structured, but very comfortable.

title: Great Sandals
text: These are really great shoes for a kid. They have perforations along the bottom that help them dry quickly and also keep their feet from getting all sweaty. They adjust at the toe box, ankle, and heel for a really good fit. These have been great walking around a theme park all day (with zero complaints and zero blisters or pressure points) and running around playing outside. He also says "the arrows" are pointing the correct direction on these, whatever that means for a four year old.

title: NOT Great Shoes
text:
Shoes fit great, exactly as expected. They are able to be tightened for more narrow feet at both the toe box and the ankle. Great for walking around a theme park all day or running around and playing at the park.

**Update** In less than a month, these shoes are falling completely apart. The upper webbing is just frayed into a mess. It is awful. (This is the Dark Earth color. We also purchased the Black/Purple and they are perfectly fine and wonderful and get 5 stars.) Teva does have a warranty, but you have to mail them the shoes back, they'll decide if they'll uphold their warranty or not, and then they'll send you either your damaged shoes back or new shoes back.

title: Love It

I'm not even sure sizing up two sizes would be enough for adult women wanting to wear it. It is well made. The royal blue is very purple. I would say size up three sizes. This shirt is tiny.

It works fine with leggings, but doesn't quite cover my entire bum. The arms fit snugly. And the rest is loose. It has a seam up the center back of the shirt. title: Poor Quality

title: Awesome Shoes
text:
I love these shoes! First, I usually wear a 9 in tennis shoes, so I ordered both a 9 and a 9.5. Because of the way the shoe is made, the 9 was just too snug. They seem a little on the small side. So, I went with a 9.5. That is a full size above what I wear in other shoes (8.5) and a half size bigger than I usually wear in tennis shoes.
The tongue on these is all one piece with the shoe. It doesn't move. So the shoe doesn't open as much as it would with a traditional tongue. The loop on the back is helpful to get the shoe on without crushing the heel. The shoe is super light. The insoles feel fabulous. I am really happy with these. They don't have a lot of structure in the top and sides of the shoe. They feel pretty neutral in terms of support.
They look great. Love the teal color. Well made shoes. I am happy with them.

title: Extremely Small
text: These are extremely small. I usually order a 9 in tennis shoes, which is already a half size bigger than what I wear. I like a little extra toe room in tennis shoes. These were super small. Ordered a 9 and my toes touched the ends. They are also very narrow. They are super light weight and provide no support. I could feel the pattern on the soles through the shoes. Now, another half size up (so a full size above what I usually wear) and I would have likely been fine with them. However, I didn't care for the colors when I saw them in person. The black and pink white the marbled bottom just looked a little cheesy in person. I was hoping to be able to swap in some black laces, but in person, they just looked very mall walker to me. (Other colors are fine, I am sure.) So be aware that these have no support and they are extremely small.

title: Beautiful Watch
text:
I have 6 kids, so I needed a watch that can stand up to, well, anything. I find that I usually worry too much to wear a watch. It needs to be able to get wet (toddlers like to flush things), be able to get hit by a scooter, hold up to being abused a little. I finally found the watch!
I have three complaints. One, the light looks so stupid. It glows this cheap yellow/orange. You can barely see the hands of the watch with the light. Forget seeing any of the digital display. For a nice watch, they should be able to fix that. It really would be better to have no light than the one it does have. Second, the digital display can be very hard to read in some lighting. It is a magenta color, that just, for whatever reason, isn't good contrast in shadows. And because the watch face is so deep, lots of shadows. So, right now, sitting at my computer with my watch on my wrist, I have to turn the watch in a certain way to see the digital display. I considered returning it for this reason alone, but decided it wouldn't be that big of a deal and I was basically choosing aesthetics over function. Third, no second hand on the analog display. I know this sounds weird, since there is a digital second countdown. But as a former nurse, I am just so used to looking at the second hand, it takes some adjustment to get used to a watch without it.
Now, they good stuff. It fits perfectly. Not too big. Not too small. Substantial but not cumbersome. The buckle on the wrist lays completely flat so it isn't stabbing me or cutting off circulation. Comfy band. The colors are awesome. Very unique and pretty. The white matches most outfits. It is unbelievably easy to set up. Just set your time zone and it automatically sets itself. The signal feature is perfect for me! I have zero concept of time. This watch will beep twice every hour on the hour. That really helps me keep up with how much time I am spending doing something. It has 5 alarm spots you can set! 5! One alarm spot is snoozeable. (It will go off every 5 minutes 7 times.) The other 4 alarm spots are one time alarms. You can alarm to wake you. Alarm to remind you that dinner should be started by now or you'll be in trouble later! Plenty of alarm spots! It has other features- world time, stop watch, timer- and I'm sure I'll use the timer and stop watch at some point- but I am not as excited about those features. I love being able to look at my watch and see the day and the date. It is such a little thing, but I don't have to take out my phone for those simple things and then get distracted because, well, phone!
This watch is beautiful, functional, and keeps me productive.

title: Love These Boots
text:
I love these boots! I can wear them all day and still be completely comfortable. Wear them in rain and my feet stay completely dry. Wear them in cold and my feet stay nice and warm. I've even worn them to a theme park a couple times and they were completely comfortable!
As far as fit, they are Keens. I always order a half size up in Keens, or my tennis shoe size. (I usually wear an 8.5, I always get a 9 in Keens.) Keens also run a tad bit narrow. Not a ton. But a little more narrow than your average shoe. I find that having a half size up and I can still wear cozy boot socks with no issues. I have no rubbing or blistering issues with these boots. They are pretty structured, which makes for comfortable walking and hiking. Plus they are really nice looking for comfy boots.

title: Joker
text: The necktie seemed a little short. The vest seemed a little wide. We got these for our son to dress up as the Joker for Halloween. They are pretty cheap quality, but since they were for one day and a costume, it was fine. It is weird to have both a bow tie and a neck tie, since they can only wear one of those. The necktie is a clip on. The vest does have a slide adjuster in the back, but even pulled as tight as it would go, the vest was still loose. I'll admit, my kid is on the slender side, but we also bought a size smaller than he usually wears and it was still pretty wide.

title: Super Adorable
text: As sleepwear, these are snug. I expect that from kid's sleepwear. It is just what they do for safety or whatever. I bought these for my 2 year old to wear on Halloween and then as PJs after. It was so adorable. Of course, no cape included, but he didn't notice. Good quality cotton pjs.

title: Loose Weave
text: The weave on this thing is quite loose. Is it not very good quality. In the picture, you don't really see that it is kind of see through and thin with a super loose weave. Because of the weave, you'll loose strands when you wash it and they will shift on you if you aren't careful.

title: Classics
text:
I am 5'4" and the petite is the perfect length. I find that many petite sizes are just too short on me, though regular are always too long. The fabric is stretchy and forgiving.
My only real complaint is the rise. It.isn't really short enough to be considered petite to me. Like they shortened the legs but not the rise. It was just a little too long. But the trouser pocket style does help hide the rise issue a little.
As far as size, I think it is right on, I really don't know. I just had a baby 8 weeks ago, so my size is a little up in the air. It seems right to me. Plus the stretch in the fabric helps them fit on a broader size spectrum.

title: Great Glasses
text: This is the second pair of Peepers we've owned. The fit is great. They work really well. And they look much more interesting than just standard reading glasses. These get compliments all the time!

title: Great Flip Flops
text:
I bought a pair of these for each of my kids. They are well made and Reef is a great company that backs their products. (I have had to have Reef replace a pair of flip flops I purchased and they did so without any issues.) I purchased these for boys and girls.
The toddler sizes run big. My youngest sized to a 7, so I purchased the 7/8 and they were way too big. If your toddler sizes to the smaller of the two sizes, order down.
The kid sizes run small. My 5 year old sized to a 12, but actually fits a 13/1. So, on kid sizes, order up if they fall into the larger size and order on size if they fall into the smaller size. (So, if they measure a 1, go with a 2/3 but if they measure a 13, go with the 13/1.)
They have back elastic straps through the 9/10 toddler size. Above that, they do not have back straps.
The bottom is dense and durable. No worries about kids biting through them (I had shockingly had this happen multiple times with other flip flops) or them tearing up quickly. If you do have a problem, contact Reef and they will help you out. They want you to be happy with their shoes. These do have flat bottoms. Some of the other Reef flip flops have a kind of lip around the bottom of the shoe to kind of cup the foot- these do not.

title: Not Too Flashy

He didn't want old man jeans, but also didn't want stitching all over his butt. These jeans fit perfectly in fit and style. A true straight leg, not too tight in the thighs. Not too flashy, just a good pair of jeans. I did have to hem them a bit shorter since they didn't have his length in stock, but that wasn't a huge ordeal. The denim does have a good bit of stretch to it, but doesn't get stretched out too much with wear. Great jeans.

title: Slouchy, but Comfy
text: The heel and ankle are pretty roomy, but the toe box is a bit snug. It ends up being okay with tucking in your pants, wearing thick socks, etc. But you'll probably want to buy a size up. They are also more slouchy than I anticipated. They don't look slouchy in the picture, but in real life, they are. They are plenty wide enough around the calf for me. (I have average sized calves.) They are pretty grippy on the bottom, which I like. The fabric around the upper portion of the boot is felt. I'm not sure how that will hold up.

title: Good Quality Shoe
text: My son measured a size 7, so that is what I ordered. They were pretty big on him. Not so big that he cannot wear them, but he could have used a half size smaller, at least. On the plus side, they will definitely last all summer this way. He also has pretty fat little feet and these fit really well. They are adjustable in the toe width and ankle width, so they fit really well. He loves them. They have support, which is great for a toddler. (They have enough trouble staying vertical without the added difficulty of bad shoes.) They are very durable. He'll have to try very, very hard to destroy these. Well worth the money.

Yes, they are better than cheapo plastic flip flops, but they are not quite the quality expected of DC flip flops. The colors were spot on. The fit was spot on. title: Nice Gym Shoes
text: I bought these shoes to wear at the gym. They run a little small, so I bought a half size up. They fit great. I have narrow-ish feet and they fit really well. I love the odd colors. I also really like the bottoms. They have a foot print on the bottom and the traction is great. They came with two sets of laces, one the crimson color and one the bright yellow. What confused me is they also came with color things so you can change the color in the outside clear part. None of the colors particularly matched the shoe, so I opted not to use them.

title: Cute, But Impractical
text:
These are cute, well made baby shirts. The side tie design is perfect for new babies with their delicate umbilical cords. They are very soft. The main problem I have with these shirts is the ties. It is just highly impractical to have two ties on a baby shirt. There is one tie on the inside left and another on the outside right. Not only are the ties impractical, but then you have little knots pressing onto baby's skin. The ties are 1/4" twill tape. They are durable, but they are impractical. I much prefer side snapping newborn shirts.

These shirts are about the same size as a 3 month Carter's shirt. Which means, if you have small babies, these shirts will be quite large on them. I would say these would ideally fit a 10 lb. baby. They are much, much bigger than the Gerber infant shirts. In fact, these are closer to a 6-9 month Gerber shirt. (Gerber tends to run very small and is the smallest baby shirts I have ever found. If your baby is on the smaller side (under 8 lbs.) you'll probably be better off with Gerber shirts than these.

I am also not a big fan of the Disney label on the outside of the shirt. Typically newborn clothing does not have exterior tags. These do have a lime green tag on the outside left seam of the shirt. It isn't big, but it is there. If it matters to you, these are made in China.

title: I found my dream lounge pants
text:
I love, love these lounge pants. I work with my husband in real estate needless to say we are on the road all day long, After a long day of work I look forward to coming home and throw on something comfortable. These are the perfect lounge pants for me just wish I can find something with the same material to go with it. The bottoms feels like a soft hug and so relaxing. Yes they are thin, but to me they are warm without overwhelming hot. I live in the mountains where it gets rather cold and we keep the house cool so yes I plan on wearing these all year.
I plan on ordering more as soon as I finish this review.
I'm short 4'10 so everything is long on me, the waist fits perfectly.

Linda
