title: Big but comfortable
text:
this is the second time I have ordered these pants. The first time they were way too big I ended up giving them to my daughter. I decided to give it a second go around and ordered them again, this time I ordered 2 sizes smaller than the last time. These are still big on my like a size maybe 1 1/2 too big.
If you were to order these my suggestion is go 3 sizes smaller than you normally wear unless you like them baggie on you.
I like mine big and comfy so these aren't too bad. I don't wear them out of the house.. just to lounge around in.

title: way too small and very thin
text: I ordered a size up ater reading the reviews.  I was looking forward to a nice little driving jacket since I drive all the time.  It wont work for me at all.  Its too small in all areas and way too thin.

title: Too thin
text:
I was excited to get these leggings until I opened the package and seen how thin the material is.
I wore one day and one of the legs tore.
Yes, they are soft, they do stretch but a huge disappointment.

title: Great slippers
text:
I loved this slippers so much I bought a second pair.
Very comfortable and well made

title: Kind of a Good Idea, Too Thin
text: As someone who has a pretty bad reaction to Nickel (i.e. Nearly every belt buckle in the world) I was excited for this belt.  Unfortunately, this proves to be so thin that it is about the least you can do and still call something a belt.  The velcro holds fine, and for now, the stretch in the belting material will hold up pants, but it is supper thin and feels pretty cheap.  For nearly the price of a leather belt, I would expect more.  Make it wider and more substantial and keep the velcro and I would be willing to try it again.

title: Fun Novelty Hawaiian Shirt
text: I was super happy to get this shirt as a sample because the color is spot on for our University's colors.  This will make a great Tuesday pride shirt to wear to work in the summer.  The shirt is surprisingly light, almost weightless.  It is very sheer and works well over a tshirt.  The pattern is super bold eyecatching, fun shirt.  I have gotten a couple of these and so far they have washed well although I have not worn them much as it is winter in Minnesota... They seem to fit to size and all in all I am pretty happy with it.

title: Warm, Kind of Bulky Coat
text: Well, good news, this coat is super warm and puffy.  It seems to be made decently.  The fabric should hold up ana the zipper is no great shakes but should be adequate.  The bad news, this coat is kind of plain and a little formless.  In looks it is passable, but not overly flattering.  But in Minnesota, warmth over fashion in the depth of winter.  All in all a pretty decent coat.

title: Good but thin hawaiian Shirt
text: This is a very sheer shirt.  It barely feels like you are wearing anything at all and works well over a Tshirt.  The pattern is a fantastic tropical Santa pattern that would fit in well in any ugly Christmas sweater contest.  I really do like the look of this shirt, but not sure how well it will last repeated washings.  It made it through one and still looks good, but it is very thin.  Stitching looks good, and for my infrequent needs for a Hawaiin shirt, it should last for years.

title: Very Light Weight Polyester Hawaiian Shirt
text: This is a very sheer shirt.  It barely feels like you are wearing anything at all and works well over a Tshirt.  The pattern is bold and attractive and it is very comfortable.  I really do like the look of this shirt, but not sure how well it will last repeated washings.  It made it through one and still looks good, but it is very thin.  Stitching looks good, and for my infrequent needs for a Hawaiin shirt, it should last for years.

title: These do what they are supposed to
text: These are obviously pieces of novelty and costume jewelry.  The are somewhat cheap but look decent when put in.  They pinch a little but the connecting wire is pretty hidden when in place.  These are best as a part of a costume or prank.  Definitely a good thing to show up to Thanksgiving with.  Recommend them if they match your sense of humor.

title: Great Running or Everyday Sock
text: Our youngest loves anklet socks and is super happy with these.  They are thick and rugged fabric that should wear and wash well.  She is rather picky with her socks so it means something that she is happy with these.  They are comfortable and padded and look nice.  Bonus for wicking and copper bacteria control for smell.  perhaps not the most necessary things for her, but great to have.  Very nice socks.

title: Great Winter Socks
text: This is a great, thick sock that is perfect for winter house socks or winter sleeping socks.  They are super soft inside with luxurious brushed fibers.  They are incredibly comfortable and padded and work well in boots as long as the boots are a little big.  We have a number of pairs of these socks and they are washing and wearing well.  Super glad to have a stockpile of them.  Highly recommended from us in Minnesota.

title: Wearable, but could be better.
text: These are going to be useable, but I am not super excited about them.  First, there is a ridiculous tag sown into each one that needs to be torn out.  It seems to be fairly standard to just print tags in box briefs these days.  Also these are very tight, but what's worse, they are very short in the waist.  The fabric is ok and they waist band seems a little light weight.  These are definitely not underwear for the long run, but they do work.  So I can only give them three stars as they are just OK. Definitely run small.

title: A Little Disappointing
text: These are going to be useable, but I am not super excited about them.  First, there is a ridiculous tag sown into each one that needs to be torn out.  It seems to be fairly standard to just print tags in box briefs these days.  Also these are very tight, but what's worse, they are very short in the waist.  The fabric is ok and they waist band seems a little light weight.  These are definitely not underwear for the long run, but they do work.  So I can only give them three stars as they are just OK.

title: Super Warm and Comfortable Socks
text: We have been using these as house socks on cold days and they are fantastic.  The inside is a super warm and soft bunch of fluff that makes it feel like you are walking on air and insulates very well.  They also work very well in boots and after laundering a lot of them they seem to be holding up pretty well although I have had a few strings pull loose and fray from the top.  I have just cut them off and they seem to be doing great.  All in all, these are fantastic socks and I can't wait to see how they do in the oncoming Minnesota winter!

title: A Decent Pair of Ski Gloves
text: These are by no means premium gloves, but they are very workable.  Living in Minnesota, it is always good to have a few spare sets of gloves laying around and these will be perfect for sledding or snowman building.  Most of the family has higher quality gloves, but these will definitely do in a pinch when gloves are lost or forgotten.  Definitely glad to have another decent pair in the bin for when the need comes.

title: Amazingly Soft and Padded Socks
text: We have a few pairs of these socks and they have proven to be super warm and comfortable as house socks for my partner.  I have used them in boots on winter days and they have done well for keeping my feet warm.  They have washed well although they have not had too much wear as we are just coming out of winter, but a pair just held up well in a remote cabin with wood floors.  They kept our feet toasty after our hikes despite being just a plywood floor.

title: Perfect for our situation
text:
My partner is an endangered species lawyer and was doing some work for a local group that was trying to mitigate damage to the rusty-patched bumblebee from a proposed mountain bike trail. The park in question has held up to 6% of the world population of this fast disappearing bee so they wanted to ensure that the bee was considered in the planning and some mitigation of habitat was done to help the bee out. Luckily the city was fantastic, and only a few bikers sent threatening letters, despite the fact that they were not trying to stop the trail at all... Anyway, this design is perfect for riding the course on opening day to keep spreading the word about the endangered species in their midst, while enjoying the sport.

The shirt is made of good materials and fits as you would expect from a biking shirt. It is tight and fitted, but does run about on size, maybe a tad small. Zipper is good, back pocket is good. Cant wait to wear this on opening day!

title: Very Nice Set of Pearls
text: These look great on my partner, either casual or dressy.  They truly are a great bridesmaid gift, or a gift for any purpose.  They freshwater pearls look great, they are knotted well.  Highly recommend this set!

title: All in All, I really like these shorts
text:
I was a little worried about getting shorts online without trying them on, but these are pretty good. I think my partner would give them five stars and she thinks they look custom tailored for me. I am a little less stoked about them, but pretty happy. For styling they are pretty good. They are long and slimming. The pockets pop out a little bit and their is a strange tightness accross the top of my buttocks, but they fit well and except for the pockets, they have good lines.

The material is good, it is definitely fast driving and moves very well, not binding in motion. They will be perfect camping shorts. They do feel a little thin, so we'll see how they hold up over time, but right now i am very happy with fit and material. We do a lot of camping and I'm looking forward to trying them out in the field.

title: Finally, I can identify my fiancee's bag
text: I have a very unique bag, my partner has the same black rolling bag as half the world, using the closed black tag that came with it.  I got this to help make it stick out on the carausel and I believe it will.  At least one Covid passes and we are traveling again.  This is a lovely sky blue silicone that shows well and should hold up very well. It fits what I was looking for perfectly.

title: Good Idea, A Little Over Engineered
text: I love this idea of isolating shoes from other clothing, but this is a little too big and a little too heavy for packing as we are always trying to cut weight.  It will definitely get used, and one silver lining of its size is that it fits my hiking boots well.  I love the idea that I can put my dusty and sometime muddy boots into the suitcase fairly safely and head to the airport wearing walking shoes.  So, plus that it is big enough to fit hiking boots, minus that it is a very big bag when I'm looking to limit bag size and weight.

title: Much More Distressed than online photo
text:
Be careful if you are looking for a clean new looking messenger bag, it is actually quite distressed. It still looks nice, but in a far different way, it is gridded with worn marks on a dark gray background. It is also a fairly small bag, just big enough to hold a 15 inch laptop and some papers. It has a decent internal zippered pocket, a couple of small can shaped and a separating wall inside. Outside is has no pockets except for what looks like a waterbottle pocket on each side that are both way to small for even a can.

The quality seems very good except for the hardware. I don't have a whole lot of faith in the buckle catches, they seem a little flimsy. But the whole things is saved by a very nice and rich look of leather. It is smallish, but perfect for taking your laptop and a little more to the meeting or travelling in style.

title: Good Running/Hiking Sock
text: I like these socks, they have great cushioning, love the integrated copper.  These make for great hiking socks and I look forward to using them in the boundary waters this summer.  For now, they are proving to be warm and breatheable around the house and work.  They are all in all pretty good socks.

title: Great Boxer Briefs
text: These are very nice fitting briefs.  I love the ambiguous word afterthought written around the waistband. It is one of the weirdest name brands I can think of for underwear, kind of like you were moments away from going commando.  The fit well and snug, seem to run about on size and look great in the basic black.  Everything I would want in boxer briefs.

title: Nice, sturdy Canvas Duffle
text: Top Load is not my first choice for a travel duffle as it is hard to organize, but I got the Bear and Bark sports duffle and was so impressed by the quality that I jumped at the chance to get the top loading duffle as a reviewer product. I love the feel of this duffle, and while I don't know that I would trust TSA with it, it would make a great car trip duffle.  We are actually going to use it for a laundry bag for our oldest as he is going to college.  I am very impressed with Bear and Bark, their canvas is tough, where they use zippers, they are good and strong and all in all their quality is very good.

title: Very Sturdy Shoe Bag
text: This is almost a little over engineered and for someone who is trying to cut weight, it is pretty heavy and bulky.  That being said though, this is a nice shoe bag.  It would do a pretty good job of isolating dirty shoes from other clothes.  There is a mesh section that would allow moisture to be released, but it would also allow air movement and breathing so it's a trade off. The bag reduces down very small and opens pretty big.  The zipper and seams seem to be of good quality and all in all, this is a very nice shoe bag.

title: Interesting Chaco
text: Our last experiences with Chaco was a while ago and I was excited to get another pair, but these are far simpler than I was expecting.  First the single strap is easier to adjust than what I remembered, but perhaps a little harder to put on.  It takes a little loosening and grabbing of straps to get your feet in.  But the slide and grab action of the pull tab is very nice.  It seems so much more spare than I remember from the brand.  It feels a little cheaper, but on some levels it feels better to me.  The soles are comfortable out of the box.  The strap so easy to use, either cinching or releasing.  The toes are very free, almost like the first strap starts a little high, but otherwise, it holds to the foot well.  It matches the size well for me and it feels good and light on.  All in all, I'm pretty happy.

title: Compact, Nice
text: This is not the richest feeling wallet in the world. It would be especially nice if they had a better looking and feeling money clip.  The leather feels a little plasticky to me rather than a rich feel of leather.  I do like how compact it is and even with everything in it, it still feels small in my pocket.  I'm not sure about the always showing driver's license.  All in all it is OK, but I would prefer a richer feeling wallet next time.

title: Nice Looking Passport Cover
text: I love these leather passport covers, the make me feel a little richer in my travels and helps keep a few more things organized.  I have not really used the card slots for much more than keeping my yellow immunization card, a spare bit of cash and some tourist piece of paper they give me when I go to Costa Rica.  So that is nice.  This one is specifically for my youngest who just got his passport for visiting Canada.  I'm hoping it will be as treasured as mine is.  It is a very nice cover, the pen is an interesting addition, not sure that that will stay in the cover for long, but always good to have one.  All in all this one is well made an elegant.  I'm hoping it travels the world with him.

title: Great Basic Duffel Bag
text: This is a very basic canvas duffel, but made well and rugged.  We use a couple for flying and traveling - usually nylon but this one will probably see strong rotation as the canvas is thick and the zippers and handles are solid.  I love the basic brown which makes the logo stick out boldly.  This is truly a great duffel.  Can't wait to fill it full of clothes and such on our next car trip!

title: Love this Bag
text:
This is an elegant and perfectly sized bag for carrying my 15 inch laptop and enough notebook and folder space to carry everything else I need. It has good storage organization for phone, pens, small electronics and other things in small pockets. There is also a large outside pocket and large internal pocket that is well devided and lined. All in all the manufacturing would not be considered fine, but it is decent and rugged although I have a few doubts about the longevity of the clasp. It is thick leather and should wear well. The one I got seems lighter than the images on line which appear very, very dark. It turned out to be dark brown, but not so close to black.

I really love this bag mostly for the looks which are rugged and masculine. It is larger than I expected based on dimension, but not too big. It is about briefcase sized and is perfect for taking my laptop and paperwork to meetings etcetera. Super happy with it.

title: Solid Crew Socks
text: I have gotten a number of reviewer products from Awesome 360 and they have become my favorite boxer briefs and socks.  All their products have held up well and when available in the drawer, I reach for them first.  These Crew socks are not different.  They are soft and decently substantial.  I would not call them thick, but they do have a decent amount of cushion.  They will (and other socks from them have) stand up to wear and wash.  All in all, these are some pretty decent socks.

title: Great Feeling Hiking Socks
text: I am very happy with these socks and will be put into high rotation this summer as my go to hiking socks.  I have a small collection of Forcool socks and they breath well, they are warm, but not sweaty and have worked both hiking in deserts and walking around in the frozen north woods of Minnesota. They are very comfortable and have a nice cushioned feel.  They look like military issue socks which is ok, perhaps not a huge draw by they look like they are heavy duty.  All in all, I really like these socks!

title: Solid Basic Crew Socks
text: I have gotten a number of reviewer products from Awesome 360 and they have become my favorite boxer briefs and socks.  All their products have held up well and when available in the drawer, I reach for them first.  These Crew socks are not different.  They are soft and decently substantial.  I would not call them thick, but they do have a decent amount of cushion.  They will (and other socks from them have) stand up to wear and wash.  All in all, these are some pretty decent socks.

title: Cute but Thin
text: These are nice looking socks but I wish they were a bit thicker.  They are a little thin, especially for the Minnesota Christmas season.  They seem to be good quality and fit as expected.

title: Nice Slippers, Love the Color
text: My fiancée loved these slippers.  She had been looking for something for a while and this is perfect for the cold Minnesota evenings and mornings.  The uppers are supper soft and well lined in the inside.  The insoles are memory foam, but perhaps not the most generous helping, but good enough for padding around the house.  I like that they cover the whole foot around to the heel rather than just the flip flop style.  It is everything we were looking for in an attractive pair of slippers.

title: Decent Sport Socks, Run a little small
text: I was a little disappointed that these ended up being pretty small.  Otherwise they are sort of thin, I don't know that I would call them cushioned.  They are decent anklet sport socks though.  They feel like they will hold up well, but will probably be grown out of quickly as they run a little small.

title: Cute Idea, Great Sentiment, Thin Chain
text: I really like this necklace idea.  The two interlocking rings are clean and elegant and very symbolic.  I also like the sentiment of love between mother and daughter.  This makes a great mother/daughter gift. It comes in a nice little gift box with a sentiment card. The only really down side of this is that the chain is very thin.

title: Thick Warm Socks, Totally Soft Inside
text: These are the perfect cold night in February sleeping or walking around the house socks.  They are super thick, in fact so thick that you can't depend on wearing them in tight shoes.  I would guess they would add a full shoe size to your feet, so they will only work in bulky winter boots.  The insides are wonderfully soft and it is like pulling on two warm clouds onto your feet.  They even look good, love these socks!

title: Smaller than I was hoping, Love the Message
text: My dad is in his 70's and his driving is a little scary at times.  This is the perfect sentiment for my kids to offer to him, but it is very small.  I like the overall design, but I wish it was bigger and I am suspect about the ring that holds the keyring to the fob.  I think it would separate without too much force.  I really wish the was almost twice the size it ended up being.  It is nice, I just wish it was more substantial.

title: Tight and Thin
text: If I've learned anything about dressing for the cold, textures loose layers to trap air and insulate.  This long john shirt is thin and very tight.  At least a full size smaller than I was expecting.  I do wear neoprene tight but this shirt does not have the raised waffle to trap warm air.  It does have some insulation value, and it appears to be ready to wick sweat and breath, but I ended up having to hand it down to my son who is a size smaller.  It seems to fit him ok although still pretty tight.  If it fit, I think I would definitely like wearing it.

title: Good Light Socks
text: These are decently made socks with some substance to them.  Unfortunately not quite enough for our current Minnesota Winter, but these will be great come spring.  The design and colors are nice and I like the variety of stripe colors to match clothes to.  All in all, very decent socks.

title: A nice metal key chain bobble
text: Alaska means a lot to me so I was glad to get a reviewer sample of this keychain.  I immediately added it to my ring and it is a nice keepsake and reminder of all the good times and adventures I have had there over the years.  I do kind of wish they put the star in a more meaningful place.  It is kind of on top of Mt St Elias which is fine and I suppose it is more for composition than representation of a place.  I also wish there was a little more sharpness in the the silhouette of the state, but the likeness is good enough to do the job.

title: Cute and Simple Locket, Sweet Message
text: This is a great little gift for a sister.  It has a very sweet message on the card in the box and comes in a pretty nice little gift box that is super glittery.  It has a younger feel to it, the chain is pretty thin, and the locket is simple in design and not overly finely engineered, but the whole effect is good. It is perfect for my sister who is the best sister in the world.  All in all a very nice sister gift, but could be heavier in chain and have a more substantial locket.

title: What, no clasp?
text:
I think I got a bum product because it doesn't have the pictured clasp. It just came with the chain. The chain is actually pretty nice although without a pretty long clasp, it is now long enough to make it around any but a toddlers ankle. Our youngest daughter is wearing it by using some rustic twine to join the two ends.

Forgetting the missing clasp, this is a very nice silver chain. It is simple and elegant and has a nice look to it. To be honest, I like the simplicity it has and think the clasp is a little too busy anyway. All in all a nice chain.

title: Baggy and Over Perfumed out of the bag.
text: I'm okay with the overall design, but I was a little disappointed with the cut.  It tends to balloon out in the crotch and around the thighs in a less than stylish way.  It did a little better once wet, but never really looked good on.  The banana pattern is ok, the material is a little on the thin side.  But the biggest downside is that it was heavily perfumed with something that made it seem like they were trying to overcome a bad odor.  It succeeded because all I could smell was a heavily perfumed substance that got on my hands while handling it.  Ended up washing it before trying it on.

title: Simple, Elegant, Meaningful
text:
I love how simple and elegant this design is. From the photos, the rings appear to be an organic, variable shape, but that is because of the lighting. They are actually perfect rings (kind of unfortunately because I like that organic look.) The chain is thin but in good proportion to the rings. All in all the design in wonderful.

The packaging is nice with a glittery box that is perfect for younger daughters. It comes with a great message of love and understanding. Actually it is perfect for my sister and nieces relationship. I wish the card was a little more elegant and fit the box a little better, but again it makes a perfect gift.

It just seems like a perfect mother daughter keepsake.

title: Thin and Silky
text: These are cute swim shorts.  I love the blue ice cube patterns and they look great on my son.  The are surprisingly shear, to the point that I was a little worried that it might be a little transparent.  They don't seem to be, but they are so thin and shear that it kind of feels that way.  The liner is also very thin and silky.  They fit as sized at least for large.  All in all, they are pretty decent swim shorts.  We got them and put them into instant use in the hot tub.  My son is pretty happy with them.

title: Nice Linen Shirt
text: My youngest likes to wear somewhat loud clothes and this wonderful blue Hawaiian is perfect for him.  It fits him well and I love the color.  We also love the linen fabric which should be fairly wrinkle free.  It is a wonderfully casual shirt that is comfortable and fun to wear.  I think this will be in heavy rotation for some time to come.  Love it.

title: Very Cute Anklet
text: I really like this anklet, the owl figurines are well made with some weight to them.  They are adorable little owls that hang well around the chain.  The red beads are nice looking like garnets. In total, it is a fun but classy piece.  It looks fantastic around our youngest daughters foot and was loved when she got it.  All in all, a very nice anklet.

title: Love the Sentiment and the Simple Elegance
text: I really like this necklace, it is a perfect mother daughter sentiment and perfect for a bonding gift.  The necklace is thin but I like the proportions. The images make it look like the rings are an organic shape that thicken, but they are actually perfect interlocking rings.  They are simple and elegant.  I would have liked a more organic shape, but these are very nice too, just a little too mechanically perfect.  The box it comes in is a nice gift box, although the display card could be a little better.  All in all, love this necklace.

title: Wonderful Rich Feeling Leather
text:
I should also add, rich smelling.

I'm a late comer to international travel but I have been trying to make up lost time as quick as I can. This is a luxurious feeling passport cover which I have needed for a while as my passport is showing wear. I like that it can also hold currency and papers that are needed, like yellow fever vaccine records. I don't know that it would ever become my main wallet, but it will definitely organize my papers and backup currency.

This is a great gift idea for travelers. It comes well and richly packaged. All in all, I love this passport holder, it is keepsake special. Love it.

title: Great Variety, Unexpectedly Thin
text:
We were very excited for these socks and trust the Gold Toe brand, mostly from mens socks. We were a little disappointed with how thin the socks are. Which is not a bad thing if you are a thin sock person and it is summer, but we were hoping for the thick socks I'm used in in the mens line. So I'm not knocking them, but know that you are getting a dress or summer sock thickness.

Otherwise we love the variety of colors and patterns. They are fantastic looking socks.

title: A Nice Trifold
text: I really like this wallet.  It has a nice feel to the leather, it is thin and has a lot of credit card slots which is nice.  It organizes well and sat pretty flat and thin when I transferred everything over.  In general I like everything about it except for the large Maine Coon embossed imprint in it.  That could have been a lot smaller or even missing and I would have been happier. Otherwise, it is everything I'm looking for in a wallet.

title: Perfect Message, Decent Grad Gift
text: This is a perfect message for a grad with a dream they are pursuing.  Not the greatest gift idea in the world unless you know they need a key ring.  The wooden gift box is a nice touch and all in all it was a perfect gift for our son who is following his dream of being a pilot. The ring and metal tag are both of decent quality.

title: Very Packable, Water-shedding, Lightweight Jacket
text: We do a lot of outdoor activities so you can never have too many raincoats.  This one feels and looks a little basic in fit and style, but seems effective and is super light.  It makes a good wind breaker but lacks any insulation.  The gray is shiny and nicely neutral.  It should go with just about anything.  I am happy with the sizing and hood, it looks pretty good on, but like I said, a little basic.  Decent rain jacket.

title: Nice Classic Black Suspenders
text: These are decent suspenders, they adjust well, the black looks classy and the clasps look good.  I wish the clasps were a little higher quality, but they are very passible.  The packaging is very nice and would make a nice gift. They hold up pants well without a belt and that is pretty much what I was looking for.  Decent value.

title: Big OK Duffle Bag
text: I thought I was receiving a 20 inch bag and was a little worried that it might be too small, but ended up receiving the 28 inch which turned out to be a bit too big.  Otherwise it is a decent, if somewhat underwhelming bag.  It would work ok as a gym bag, although 28 inches is a little too big for that use.  My guess is that 20-24 inches would have been about perfect.  The materials are OK, but again, not particularly overwhelming.  All in all it is an OK bag.

title: These turned out to be interesting socks
text: We got these for hiking but they appear to be more like soccer socks.  They are thick and a little rigid and a little hard to put on.  We did try walking in water to see how watertight they are and they proved to be more water tight than breathable.  They may have run a little small or it might be that they are harder to put on than other socks, but my partner thought they were too small for her and we passed it on to our daughter.  They are definitely interesting but thickness makes them a little less useful for wearing.

title: Very Cute, Good Addition to the Dress Up Trunk
text: This is a very cute head band.  the flowers needed a little fluffing when I received it, but it looks great on little heads.  We have a dress up trunk that has a lot of fairy wings and dresses and this goes well with them.  It is decent quality and I can't imagine any toddler that wouldn't want to have this on.  Very Cute!

title: Very Nice Looking, Light Scarf
text: This is Minnesota, so scarves are a good idea.  This one is not horribly thick, but could be used on all but the coldest and warmest of winter days. I really like the colors, mine is a weave of neutral naturals that should match with just about anything and definitely works with my Columbia jacket.  it is not an overly soft scarf, but no itching or scratching.  It is a good length for running around you neck and having good amount left over.  Worth the price on looks alone, but seems very functional and comfortable.  Five Stars! Love it!

title: Soft, flattering cardigan
text: This looks rather flattering on my partner and is soft enough to be cuddly.  It looks a little stiff but is nice to the touch. It looks good either open or closed.  It fits well and I like how long it is.  All in all a very nice cardigan sweater.  The green is a nice natural and neutral color that goes well with almost anything.

title: Good For Warmer, Wet Snow
text: Being from Minnesota, we respect a good pair of snow pants and these are pretty good for the right circumstances.  They are a little too loose to wear on the ultra cold days, but they are perfect for those near 32 degrees when you don't need so much insulation but more water resistance.  These are fairly tight and with the flannel lining, are warm for cooler weather.  They are wonderfully flexible and would work for active play outside.  The material feels like it would hold up well.  All in all, we are very happy with these.  But it's August and it hasn't faced Minnesota winter yet.

title: Not Overly Flattering for US, but Cute Idea
text: I think this shirt has lots of potential on the right person, but it did not fit anyone in our household in a flattering way.  We liked the waffled fabric which is soft and cuddly, but the lines of the shirt fit a little like a gunny sack and just didn't look that great on.  The basic idea looks very good, but perhaps it needs to be tailored differently for different figures.  Otherwise, liked the light sleeveless idea.  Probably one of those things that needs to be tried on to see how it works for you.

title: Nice Looking, Hard to Get on
text: Other than the fact that I can't just slip these on, I'm pretty happy with these shoes.  They look pretty nice on, but the fake leather is stiff and thin.  I need to sit down and use my thumbs to shoehorn around all the edges to get them on.  Perhaps this will loosen in time but they are still pretty stiff.  They don't feel like the highest quality shoes but they wear ok and they look decent on, so I will get use out of them while they last.  Not sure I would highly recommend them, but they are nice enough.

title: Very Happy with These Swim Shorts
text: These fit my youngest son perfectly and he is happy with them.  The material is decent, the liner is good and comfortable and the draw string is effective and overall, the quality seems pretty good.  We are just putting up the pool and looking forward to a long summer of using these.  All in all they look and wear great.

title: Nice Classic Denim Jacket
text: This is everything I was expecting in a classic denim jacket, well except the zipper sleeves.  I don't think I care for those much, but they are pretty unobtrusive. The color is a nice and it has a classy weathered color and look.  It really brings me back to the eighties and I look forward to wearing it in the fall around the house and trails.  All in all it is a really nice jacket.

title: Nice Enough Shirt, I like the arm stripes
text:
We got a reviewer shirt for my partner as it looked very nice in the photos. It fits well enough although without a tag or label, it is hard to judge the front from the back. The styling is a little less fitted and could be a little more flattering with a little more shaping, but it fits well enough and their is a nice arc of material that covers the derriere in a nice way. She is not overwhelmed with it, but she likes it enough that she will where it from time to time.

It is soft and appears to be decent quality. We washed it and it held up well with possibly some shrinkage but not horrible if it did. A decent shirt at any rate.

title: Classic Denimum Jacket, Iffy Distressing
text:
I really like this jacket, it has the classic design that you would expect and almost a nostalgic feel to it. I like the lighter, faded blue color, but I'm not a big fan of the distressing. It doesn't look like it is naturally worn and just doesn't seem quite right. This is not enough of an issue to make me not like the jacket, but I do think I would like it better if it was not distressed.

The jacket is a perfect casual spring and fall jacket. It is short, ending just below the waist and is styled a little fitted. Recommend this jacket overall, just wished they had no or better distressing.

title: Nice Socks, And in my size!
text: These are very decent socks that have a lot of stretch to them.  They are sleek and pull on and off easily.  They are not super thick, leaning more of the summer weight, but the best thing about them is that I can get them in 12-14.  That is a hard size to get in box stores and it is nice to have generous room to fit my heel into.  I have washed them once and worn them twice and they seem to be good quality and should last a while.  All in all, very good socks!

title: Decent Polorized Sunglasses at a Decent Price
text: I cant say that this sunglasses wow me in any way.  They look nice on my kids and gives them UV protection when out in the sun.  I bought them to put in the car for when we suddenly need a pair and they are perfect for that.  The kids look pretty cool in them and they have some protection and comfort on a sunny day.  The construction is on the economy side, but they feel rugged enough to last a summer or two.  Again, nothing to wow here, but they are decent for the price.

title: Super Cute, Might Run a Little Small
text: This is an adorable workout tank top.  The material is super soft and comfortable and works well for work outs.  The logo is tactful and elegant.  The styling is youthful and fun.  It looks great on, the color is great, and it got lots of compliments at the gym.  All in all a great tank top.  My only possible concern is that it seems to be a little tighter than I would have expected  it to be, but definitely not unusably so.  Love it!

title: What the Heck
text: The first thought I had when I tried this on was "How many umbrellas needed to die to make this shirt?"  Nylon is a bad idea for a shirt material.  There is zero stretch, so things like putting it on over your head or moving your arms are unyieldingly tight.  It fits well once on, and if you stand in a typical standing position, it functions as a shirt.  Although, it is not warm, it is definitely not cuddly.  One benefit that it does have is that it is noisy and rustles well and makes and interesting sound when you slap your chest with cupped hands gorilla style.  Literally, that is the best thing I can say about it.  My girlfriend said, and I quote, "There is not a single thing I like about that shirt."  And that was even after I showed her the gorilla thing... Perhaps it would be good for messy eaters as it probably would wipe clean with a rag, otherwise, why?  Do not recommend anyone ever make a shirt out of this stuff again.

title: Nice, Super Soft Tank
text: For some reason, I like this tank top.  I'm not a huge fan of them, but my oldest loves them for some reason, and this looks better on and off him than probably any that we own.  I like the simple blue with red accents, but mostly I like the fabric.  It looks kind of like a performance material and definitely does not have a cheap look when he is wearing it.  I'm not sure of the price as we got a reviewer shirt and no pricing is currently listed on Amazon, but if the price is reasonable, this is a very decent tank.

title: A well made belt
text: This is a nice belt with thick leather that should wear very long and well.  I made the mistake of getting one reviewer 38 inch belt thinking that it was for waist size 38 but it was actually exactly 38 inches long, with the option to trim  it smaller.  Careful of making that mistake, but my oldest son benefited from the mistake and he likes both belts.  The really are decently made with strong buckles.  I expect them to last a long time.

title: A Decent Leather Belt
text:
First i have to say, oops... I read 38" to be for a 38" waist and was excited to get a belt for myself to review. Turns out, this is a 38" belt from tip to tip, so it almost perfectly touched the very end of the leather to the buckle, around my waist. I was disappointed because it seems like such a nice belt. Luckily, I have a 17 year old son who is using and loving it.

This is a very nice leather belt, well built and with a nice buckle. It looks great on him and goes well both casually and semi formally (My son does not go beyond semi formal.) The leather is thick, and the buckle and belt design is simple and classic. Everything I would hope for in a belt.

title: Nice Leather Messenger Bag, But Few Niceties
text:
This is a very classic looking leather messenger bag. It is cut with lots of rough edges and sides that give it a rugged look. And because of the thickness of the leather, it is rugged, although the surface is a little easy to scratch or mar. There is not lining or finished pockets so no niceties there. The clasps that hold the bag shut are ok, not superb quality, but good enough to hold it shut. They are hidden below the false buckles.

I like the size, it will hold a bird guide, and ipad, and binoculars, although that is a little bulky. Definitely not big enough for a laptop though. So it is not a backpack replacement, but it works well for smaller items. I do wish there was a lining, but all in all this is a nice bag.

title: Nice Boxer Briefs
text: I really like these boxers! They have pretty thin so they are cool for summer wear.  The material is good and the seams are double stitched, waist bands are tight elastic that seems to be holding up well.  We have been wearing a lot of Inskentins and they have been holding up to washing well. They do fit a little tighter than other brands and perhaps I would size up if you are at the upper limit of your size.  Otherwise, I really like these underwear, and particularily like the length of these boxers.

title: Nice Boxer Briefs!
text: I find this brand to fit a little tighter that I'm used to, so be careful if you are near the top of a size range, but I have absolutely no complaints about quality and comfort.  I love the tagless design, flies work well, the material is soft and almost silk like.  I have run a number of these through the wash a few times and they are holding up well.  They are lighter weight fabric, so good summer weight, but not so light weight that I'm worried about prematurely wearing out.  They are just good basic boxer briefs. They do creep up a bit.

title: Very Cute Hat
text: We were hoping this hat would look adorable on a trip to Costa Rica, and so far it has lived up to it's adorable hopes.  It doesn't live up to the foldable as well, much less packable.  We are definitely looking forward to taking it abroad, and we love that it fits well.  There is some flexibility in sizing with some drawstrings, but probably not truly one size fits all.  My partner has an average sized head and it fit well.  The woven straw looks like it should hold up well.  All in all a decent hat.

title: A Good Price for Quality Boxer Briefs
text: We are very happy with these boxer briefs.  They seem to be very good quality and should last well until our son is out of this size.  The colors are nice, the fit is nice it is everything I would expect from Gildan

title: Wonderfully Soft But a Little Small
text: This hat is absolutely wonderfully warm and soft.  It looks pretty good on, and the color and design are pretty classic, and all in all we are very happy with it.  However, it runs a little smaller than we were hoping and it fits better on our daughter than it does on my partner.  Definitely the hightlight is the softness of the Kashmere, but I wish it ran a little bigger.

title: Nice looking snow pants
text: This pants look very nice but I have a couple issues with it.  Mostly the buttons are a little scary because it takes so much force to pry them open.  I'm afraid that they may pull out of the fabric before unsnapping some time.  Otherwise they materials look ok and should wear ok.  We took them out in our current couple feet of snow and they performed well moving through the snow.  The larges are surprisingly long and where I thought they would be used by my youngest son, the fit my 6'2" seventeen year old just fine.  We are looking forward to using them this weekend for a snowshoeing trip up north. Will let everyone know if f they fail miserably but for right now, they look pretty goodl

title: Beautiful, Large Bag
text:
We really like this bag from the amazingly soft suede to the bold but classy lining. The clasp is very nice and well constructed. The pockets are not overly numerous but well thought out and allow you to keep you keys and wallet available. Meanwhile there is more than ample room for all of a mother's necessities from Kleenex to life savers. It is the perfect size for us and looks beautiful.

All in all, everything we would look for in a purse.

title: What a wonderfully nice surprise
text:
This was a wonderfully presented product with its gift box, bow and strange and awkwardly worded tag. Inside there is a hand written card and a note, also written in quaint but grammatically challenged English. Also, there are the two knit hats and a special surprise of a pair of socks. The box seems a little worrisome in that it is not that big for two good sized knit hats, but they are tightly rolled and end up being of good size. They are not the roomiest hat I've worn, but even with my large head, they fit well and I would say they should fit any head. They are lined with faux fur which also makes them very comfortable. All in all, they are very nice and stylish hats.

If you are looking for a gift box for anyone in the cold north, consider the two hat gift box. You won't go wrong, especially for a couples gift.

title: Wonderfully Soft, Wonderfully Large
text:
I have a real problem finding knit hats that fit. The one size fits all does not work for the extra large head unfortunately, but this oversized hat works well and is just in time for the worst of Minnesota's winter. I really appreciate the roominess and the ability to flip up the band and still cover my ears with some room to spare and not slow creeping up and off my head.

The yarn is super soft and has been the envy of everyone who has tried it on (but it is mine!) It does have a bit of oiliness to the feel of the yarn, but it is extremely soft as is the fleece that lines the insides. All in all a truly great hat that stood up to near zero temps wonderfully.

title: Beautiful, Lightweight, Warm
text:
This came just in time for our first real push of cold, hovering around zero weather and it was great. It is not particularly thick, but it more that makes up for this thinness is width and length. It layers as a scarf and passes around the neck several times with plenty of room to spare, making layered protection that keeps the cold well away from your neck and collar. Definitely effective at its job.

It is also very aesthetically beautiful. I like the neutral light brown which goes well with most of our coats. The tassles again are not thick, but attractive. It has an elegant and classy look with a decently soft feel. All in all a wonderful scarf.

title: Nice Durable Gloves
text: These are perfect gloves for our 11-year-old (size womens small.) We are a very outdoors active family and these are wonderfully thick, durable and warm and are perfect for Minnesota winter snow ball fights, skiing and hiking.  I trust the Marmot brand and they have another solid product in these gloves.  I'm sure they will be outgrown or lost well before they fail.

title: Super Soft
text:
My partner suffers from rough and splitting heels and I love that we were able to get a sock that pampers her poor feet so well. They feel wonderfully soft and cushion well but are rather thin. Hopefully the Aloe Vera will help maintain her feet through the cold dry winter season. But for right now she is luxuriating in the feel of them. The are very nicely fitting and probably will be reordered.

They do have a slightly lotion like feeling that is probably the Aloe Vera.

title: Surprised it's Poly
text: These really feel like cotton.  The are soft and comfortable and have a good fit.  All in all these seem to be well designed boxer briefs. Perhaps my only beef would be that I wish there were three or four pairs in the package.  But all in all, very nice underwear.  I would expect them to wear well with use and washes.  They feel like good quality.

title: Nice Padded Socks
text: These are very nice padded socks. In fact they are so padded that they have some issues fitting into some of my partners shoes.  But she plans to use them mostly for night socks to ward off the Minnesota winter drafts.  I have read a number of reviews that say they are prone to severe shrinkage so we are going to try to remember to pull them out of the wash before the dryers.  Otherwise they have a wonderfully comfortable and thick feel to them and will be a favorite to put on at night or winter hiking.

title: Comfortable, Feel Nice On
text: My partner has some leg issues when traveling so we were hoping to try some compression socks for flights and long car rides.  These seem very nice for our purposes although she would like something more than just bright white.  The foot is nicely cushioned and is comfortable and the uppers are nicely thin and breathable.  She says it holds her calves well but not uncomfortably tight.  We are glad we got them for a number of upcoming flights.

title: These are OK Short Pajamas
text:
I like the idea of these pajamas but found them to be a little less than stellar in cut and design. I like that they are light cotton, they are perfect for our kids summer short pajamas, but I am underwhelmed with their general design. they seem a little cheap and formless and while I like the light blue plaid, the other two pairs are a little drab. I'm sure these will be in heavy rotation this spring and summer, but they just won't look as nice as some others around the breakfast table.

Love them for what they are, light summer pajama shorts. Wish they were better in the looks department.

title: Very Decent, Sturdy Sweatshirt
text: I really like this sweatshirt even though it is as about as basic as you can get.  It is decently thick and I wore it straight out of the bag on a autumn hike through the local nature center in a light and cool drizzle and it kept me warm and comfortable.  It is a nice basic but solid zippered hoodie, very comfortable.  If I had one criticism, I got a 2XL which was actually a little snug for 2XL and a little short for me at 6' 4".  I wish it was a little longer, but otherwise a very nice sweatshirt.

title: These are fantastically thick and comfortable socks. They are very snug and stretchy and ...
text:
These are fantastically thick and comfortable socks. They are very snug and stretchy and they should be good workout socks. I love the science of the silver nano fibers that kill bacteria. The socks are a little over packaged in plastic which I wish the company would reconsider, but how can you over package socks with precious metal woven right into the sock.

All in all a good quality sock that I would think will be around for a good long time.

title: Nice Cut, Looks Great
text:
My oldest son is in love with this coat. He has never owned a "leather" coat before and really thinks that he has transformed his image with this coat. I love that it is not an obvious biker jacket. I was concerned with the biker description, but it is not completely a biker jacket, it is cut in a more conservative style with biker elements. It is classy and can be warn in a lot of situations. The pleather is actually pretty convincing and I like the fleece lining. My son and I agreed that the hood is not great, but it is super easy to remove it, leaving an elegant coat that looks fantastic on him.

I got a reviewer jacket, but even at the full current price of $60 this would be a great deal. Highly recommend.

title: These are very nice performance socks that are exactly what we were looking ...
text: These are very nice performance socks that are exactly what we were looking for.  We joined cross-fit about a month ago and my partner was looking for workout sock.  These have wonderful padding on the bottom and breathable fabric on the  top making for a perfect sock for absorbing the pounding from the ground and being breathable above.  The anklet fit is very nice.  All around, exactly what we were hoping for and we have faith that they will last.

title: A Decent Cold Weather Scarf
text: This is a decent and useful scarf.  It is a rather dense knit so the acrylic does not reach its full insulating ability.  We live in Minnesota and there will definitely be days where this is not going to do it, but late fall and late winter should be perfect.  It is soft and comfortable. The colors are good and except for the pinkish color, it will mesh with most outfits well. The price is decent for adding an additional scarf in the cold weather bin. All in all a decent scarf.

title: Nice Looking Leather Purse
text:
We really like this purse, it has a vintage and rustic look to it. The stitching is not precise which gives it kind of an antique look that is overall very classy. I am not overly thrilled with the clasp. The strap does not look very elegant and the snap is hard to snap and unsnap. It is okay but is probably the best place to improve the bag.

The interior is nice and roomy and since my partner carries everything up to and including the kitchen sink. It holds a lot. It is smaller than it looks in the photo, perhaps that is a very small model, but it is pretty decently sized. Also like the internal compartments. All in all a nice bag which I would expect to wear pretty well.

One note, it came wrapped in a plastic back which held in a strong and offputting smell of the stains used to color the leather. It will need some airing out before use.

title: A Little Light in Quality and a Little Small in Size
text:
These are not very supportive. We were hoping that they might work as water shoes for canoeing in Minnesota's boundary waters. There is definitely not enough support or cushioning for that. These will probably just be used in hotel and resort pools to be keep fungus and warts away. The design is nice enough, the materials are pretty thing and they apparently run a little small as we ordered to error on the large size and they were still pretty tight.

We'll see how they wear.

title: Nice, Light, a Little Plain
text: This is a nice but rather plain, light zip up hoodie.  Our daughter likes to wear things a little baggy, so it was a little disappointing that it is fitted a little tight, perhaps enough to step up a size.  The fabric is decent and light, so perhaps this could be a layer or an early fall, late spring cover up.  It looks decent on and I expect that it will last alright.  Overall it is a little too plain in cut and color to stand out and be the hoodie one would love, but it would have a good utility role in the wardrobe.

title: Comfortable and well fitting
text: This is a decent sports type bra with more slender and elegant straps.  It provides decent support and fits comfortably.  It seems a little less formal, but my partner really liked it.  The padding is not overwhelming which is good.  It is subtle so don't expect to go from A cup to D.  Perhaps C to C+.  All in all a nice and comfortable bra.

title: Great Looking Hat, but not workable for larger heads
text:
I'm giving this hat four stars because I think it looks really sharp. But I am frustrated because it's one size fits all does not include large heads. I'm 6'4" with a proportional head and this unfortunately does not fit. But I highly recommend the hat to those who have mainstream sized heads. I ended up having to give this to my son and he is liking it.

Sure wish it came in larger sizes.

title: Adorable and Good Quality
text: These are super cute and well made. They are reasonably thick summer weight cotton blend and very soft.  I love the constellation theme and emblems.  Currently they are listed at over $25 for the three and that seems a little steep but you are getting what you pay for here, they are better than the standard Target bundle onesies.

title: Son Loves These
text: My son loves these.  They have everything that he looks for in underwear.  Tagless, soft, well fitting.  I like that they have a nice bold look and they are almost silky soft despite being 95% cotton and 5% spandex.  They are very nice.  Also price is not horrible for premium boxer briefs, currently about $6 a pair.

title: Decent, Sleek Polo
text: I liked the shirt and it's sleekness.  It has a long torso so it is easy to tuck in and stay tucked for my youngest son.  I was hoping it would work in more formal settings but it has a more casual look to it.  It will be put in to the rotation of daily shirts instead of dress clothes.  The material is nice, like I said it is sleek and kind of synthetic silky to the touch, so comfortable on warm days.  My kid and I like it but don't love it, but nice enough shirt.

title: Partner really didn't like the collar, otherwise it was nice
text: We had high hopes for this pullover, and when we got it, we really liked the feel of the cotton and the material was nice although a little sweatshirty.  Unfortunately my partner really didn't like the color that when across the front of the top.  It made funny shapes at her shoulders and just didn't look quite right on her.  the rest fit as expected, but she really doesn't care for the design.  Unfortunately, the rest of the top fit her pretty well and I liked how it worked over her hips and butt, but we both know that she will not be wearing it.

title: These are very well made anklet socks
text: My partner has been wearing these and this loves them for around the house.  They are surprisingly thick feeling for not being physically very thick.  The have a great feel and you can sense the quality in them.  They are a little impractical for Minnesota winters, but she wears them to bed and around the house and she says they really take the edge off the cold.  It will be interesting to see what the price point is for these, but I can vouch for their material and design.  These are very well made anklet socks.

title: Great Levi's Styling, Were Surprisingly Tight, or Perhaps that is the Holiday Season
text:
These ended up being tight for a standard size 16 body. Otherwise, I love the cut of the bootcut 415's and the color. We fully trust Levi and we like this enough that they are going to be the aspirational jeans for the new year. We can't wait to have them in the rotation.

Otherwise, we like the lighter thickness and a bit of stretch. I'm sure these will look great by the end of January. Come on resolution.

title: Great Looking Jacket
text:
This has earned a spot in the closet by filling the niche of fall yard working jacket and casual indoor cover up. It does have a flattering cut and nice neutral gray color. It does not work great as a jacket due to the generous venting that actually ends up cooling the back. But it worked great for a couple weekends of raking leaves and other winter preparations. It also has been working well as a layer to wear around the house.

The fabric is sleek and has a nice little stretch to it. Personally I don't like that the back is cut low to cover her butt but she say that is a good feature. She likes the pockets and she has worn it a lot around the house and back and forth to the gymn, so definitely a winner.

title: Wonderfully Soft and Wearable
text:
I would have given these slippers 4 stars right out of the box because they don't look that luxurious. But as my partner continues to wear them and rave over their comfort, I have to say that it definitely deserves five stars. They definitely feel luxurious, although they are sized for her, not me so I can only trust her and what my fingers feel. The soles do seem strangely padded in a frankly wonderful way. The material is like a soft microfiber and feels like a baby's bottom. Everything screams comfort.

At less than $25 these are a decent value. My partner works from home and these have been her "work shoes." since she's first tried them on. They seem to be wearing well and unless they fail in some great way, they are going to be her replacement when these do wear out. We are also looking for a closed toe pair for our Minnesota winter. I think that is about the biggest endorsement we can give.

title: they are thick and I would expect them to wear like iron, or thick denim
text:
These are decent pants, they are thick and I would expect them to wear like iron, or thick denim. The cut is find and they look good on my oldest son, but I am not overwhelmed by them in a fashionable sense. I do like the big Rebar logo on the inside but the Ariat label is less visually wonderful.

I love all the pockets and these will definitely get worn, but probably more on weekends than school days. I did notice that they bled a bit on the first wash (washed alone with other blue jeans and a couple socks) so be careful of first couple washes. My son is not particularly picky about clothes and he likes them well enough to have worn them several days.

title: Cost a Little More, But You Get What you Pay for
text: Great high quality underwear.  I steer away from $10/pair products in general, but I can see where the extra price is going with these.  I love the fabric and especially love the boldly marked waistband.  These really do have a feel of quality.  I can't say that I'm a big fan of the camo pair, but the plain brown pair looks fantastic on.  All in all a well designed and manufactured pair of underwear.

title: Great Looking Jeans
text:
I really like the styling and color of these jeans. They look fantastic and fashionable on our sixteen year old and the color has just the right level of distressing. They are absolutely great jeans. We have never had Nautica jeans before, but the seem to be made well and I would expect them to wear well. Our son looked pretty proud wearing them out for the first time.

All in all a very nice Jean.

title: A Very Cute Hat, but Be Warned About the "One Size" It's small
text:
I thought this hat would look adorable on my partner, but it turns out that it is rather small. So it will look adorable on our youngest. I don't know that this is an adult sized hat, so if you have even a normal sized adult head, beware.

Otherwise the hat is cute, stylish, and ridiculously soft. I am a little concerned that it has a very loose weave. Fingers can go through it easily so I am afraid (especially if worn on an adult head) that it will pull open and not look that great. The Brim is nice and feels rugged. The Yarn soft and decently thick so I don't have any fears of it holding up. Just wish it came in XL.

title: Elegantly Simple, Classy but not super flattering
text:
These are nice elegant black pants. They are a little on the plain side, but they go well with a nice top. I am holding back on giving five stars because they are not the most flattering pants, but classy enough for dressing up with a nice blouse or sweater.

The fabric and construction seems decent quality, we'll see how it wears.

title: A Decent Swim Skirt
text: This is a decent swim skirt.  It does great things for my partners back end although over all it is just nice on her.  She likes the ample fabric that keeps this from becoming a thong and the full coverage.  The fabric is OK but a little questionable about how well and how long it will hold up.  It will definitely be in the swim suit rotation for the rest of the summer for sure, but it is a more "Like" and less "Love" relationship.

title: Comfortable, Well Made and Reasonably Priced
text: These have a pretty basic design and are not premium by any means, but they are well designed, classily patterned and comfortable underwear. I guess it's the comfort that is the biggest selling point here.  They are tagless, they have a soft and slightly padded waistband and fit well.  The material is very breathable cotton that is very light weight. These are definitely what I expect from Fruit of the Loom, a decent quality item at a decent price.

title: Beautiful Shoes, Striking but a little Pricey
text:
I got the Blue and White version for my son and we both love the looks as well as the comfort. The blue striping is striking and bright, and he said they were like walking on clouds. We will mostly be using them just for walking and general day to day shoes, but he is rather particular and will reject shoes for any sense of discomfort. He reports no discomfort with these.

There is a bit of stick shock for these, but I can see that they would be good and comfortable running shoes. The materials seem good although light. They are breathable and I'm guessing the light materials are aimed at their running emphasis. I can't say enough that my son like such a nice looking pair of shoes.

title: Premium, but Probably not Worth the Premium Price
text:
Well these do seem to be premium underwear, beyond just the price (at which I would expect four or more fruit of the loom boxer briefs.) However where the FTL's would be simple cotton, these are Lyocell, which is a form of Rayon that gives a slick, silky feel to these briefs that shouldn't wrinkle much, although there were plenty of puckering when unpacked.

On, the briefs are a little luxurious, bagged out in the crotch for a little more space for your manhood. The feel well fitted and stay tight around the thighs (I am on the high end of the waistline range so may be looser on the low end, but I like that they do not gape around the legs. There is a care tag sewed into the waist band that seems a little unnecessary since there is a stamped label in the back waist band. I cut it as tight as I could to the seam and did not really notice it, but why?

I have gotten other Lacoste underwear for my kids and they had kind of obnoxiously large alligator patches on them. This one has a nice rubberized logo gator near the bottom of my right leg that blends in tactfully. For fit and style, I really like these, I'm giving them 4 stars rather than 5 due to price. But they are premium cut and materials, just doesn't have enough difference to justify the price in my mind.

title: Skimpy Design, Overly Expensive, but well made and comfortable
text: Well I got these for my oldest son, in part because we had just seen back to the future and i thought he would like to have a pair of Calvin Klein's because of the mention in the movie.  However, he is lukewarm on the banana hammock design and I am less than lukewarm about the price for a single pair of underwear.  They are well made and he says they are comfortable although he is afraid he will be hit by a bus and the ER nurses will see them.

title: Great workout shirts
text: Love the fit and functionality of under armor workout tees. This one is for my son who is in Marine JROTC. I have several for my workouts and I love them. They look great, let arms move freely and take sweat well. We love these shirts! I also wore them for layered shirts in california desert and loved the wicking.

title: Great Looking Bra
text: Never heard of a bralette before, but love the look on my partner.  Where this appears something like a sports bra, it is anything but.  It is a sexy bra that does support casually, it is loose fitting and would not give the support you would need from an athletic bra.  It truly looks great on her.  I would say that this may not be the most rugged bra though.  There were a couple small tearing sounds when taking it on and off, although we could not find any damage.

title: Hard to Get On and Off, Ran Small Compared to Size Chart
text: Cute, but unfortunately ran a little small for my typical size (and the sizing chart.) It was a wrestling match to get it on and off and with a recently tweaked shoulder it took a lot to get it both on and off for my partner.  I like the styling when on, although being a little too small made for a couple of less than flattering areas on an otherwise delicious body.  Personally, I thought it was pretty cute, but definitely a chore to get on or off.

title: Teenager approved, nice looking pair of pants
text:
These pants are OK, they fit well and look good on, but not exceptional. Pleating is nice and it worked for my oldest son's dance. The material is nice and sort of light and he reports that it was comfortable for the dance. He found them casual enough to wear day to day to school and has put them into his rotation. I suspect that he got a good response from the right people so he is fond of them.

The construction seems good and it made it through the wash and partial dry without shrinkage. All in all a decent pair of pants.

title: A Very Decent Shirt for on the Water
text:
We spend a lot of time in the summer camping, fishing and canoeing and I love these shirts for casual comfort in warm weather and especially wet warm weather. In general, I like this shirt, but I'm not convinced I really like the styling of fit. I'm also not a huge fan of the velcro on the pockets which lends a little stiffness to those areas. Also it's not the best laying collar out there. The oclor is appropriate but again, not a color that is going to gain lots of praise.

But, I love the mesh liner, i love the venting and know that it will be in rotation next May when we are back out on the water. All in all a decent shirt, but can't say I am in love with it, but it has my hardy respect.

title: a decent pair of sleep shorts
text:
I got this for my oldest son who seems to like them in general although we ended up having to cut the tag out for his comfort. I liked the softness of the material on the legs and like the wide drawstring. Can't say that I care for the waste band at all. For pajama bottoms it seems like they could have gone with something a lot softer.

I folded them after washing and the softness was still there and it seems to have help up well, no obvious shrinkage and drawstring stayed in place. All in all a decent pair of sleep shorts.

title: These are fantastically snuggly socks
text:
We love Galiva socks now. These are amazingly rich and luxurious socks, right down to the packaging. They come in such a nice box that it would make a wonderful gift idea for anyone who truly treasures getting socks for gifts.

The first time my partner put some Galiva Cushion socks on she said "Holy Cow, these are Snuggly." The cotton is deep and soft, giving lots of cushion and warmth, cuddling your foot, and rich to the hand. She has begun wearing and washing them regularly and they are holding up. These work well with shoes and give good warmth for our Minnesota climate. She absolutely loves them.

title: Rich, Soft, Warm, Thick...Luxurious
text:
These are amazingly rich and luxurious socks, right down to the packaging. I was surprised when they arrived because I could not remember ordering anything that would have come in a box like this. It would make a wonderful gift idea for anyone who truly treasures getting socks for gifts. Or even for someone open minded enough to appreciate the ruch softness when they put them on.

My partner put them on at bed time and her eyes opened wide and it drew a "Holy Cow, these are Snuggly." The cotton is deep and soft, giving lots of cushion and warmth, cuddling your foot, and rich to the hand. We'll see how they wear, but out of the box, they are amazing. She has worn them three days straight and we are waiting for their first wash, but so far, wonderfully luxurious. She loves these socks, and Large fits her size 9 feet wonderfully.

title: Casually Classy, Love this Watch
text:
An absolutely sharp looking watch. The brown leather band gives it such a wonderful classic look matching it's clean and bold face. It is a little casual but very classily so. I have worn it to work and on the town, and truly love the aesthetics of it. If I had any critical things to say about this it would be two. First, the watch does not feel as solid as most I have owned and the band is beautiful, but I am worried about how it will wear long term. The second thing is the packaging. It came in a pretty barebones cardboard box with little luxury. In my case the packaging was crushed and almost completely pulled off.

But in total, I love this watch and especially at the price point. It is definitely in the rotation, perhaps reserved for special occasions for now, when I want some casual class. We'll see how it wears, but I expect good things.

title: A Very comfortable, Well Designed Bra
text: This bra was a wonderful silky material with a nice lusterous sheen.  It has enough padding to shape but does not add bulkiness. It seems well constructed and I expect it to hold up well. Seams look strong.  The band is nice and wide with three hooks so it avoids binding and pinching.  It felt comfortable right off the bat.  Would not hesitate to order again.

title: Stylish Wallet, Found I prefer Bi Fold for thickness
text:
First, I have always used bifold and the trifold does add thickness to the wallet. It is not horrible, but definitely noticeable. This is also the only reason I am giving this four stars because otherwise everything is great. There are plentiful pockets for organizing all my cards etc. and I love that I have a new, nice looking, new leathery smelling wallet.

The RFid feature seems a little gimmicky, but it is in fact a very possible way to have parts of your ID stolen. A RF reader in a public area would be able to capture lots of RF information in short time. I can't verify that this wallet has any effect, the one thing I was concerned with was whether my bus pass would read through the wallet on the tap button and it does. So it is not complete RF shielding but should reduce the range enough.

Style wise, this is a very nice wallet

title: Nice Pendant, Overly Thin Chain, Cheap Packaging
text:
The actual pendant we like a lot, but that is about where it ends. It is more of a child's necklace than an adult one. The chain is painfully thin for surviving kid handling though. In fact it is one of the finest chains I have seen. If you look beyond that, the stones are irradescent and the pendant is stamped rather largely at 18K (plated.)

The worst thing about the necklace is that it comes in a black box that does not look like a jewelry box and has a prominent made in China sticker. There is nice velvety cardboard inside but overall the packaging is below average and not up to gift standards. Fix the chain and the box and this is a four star necklace.

title: Absolutely Beautiful
text:
My mother has advancing Alzheimers and very much lives in the moment. I was looking for a beautiful trinket for her to rediscover on her wrist and find a little beauty throughout the day. This bracelet was perfect. It is not so expensive as to be too dear to lose, but it looks like a million bucks. The cubic zirconias dazzle with as much sparkle as you would ever get from real diamonds and the platinum plating gives a rich finish to the metal components.

The clasp is not easy to work for older hands but it is also hard for it to be accidentally taken off. It seems to where well and has not been catching on things. It comes in a rich packaging that seems a little marred in that the final layer is just a plastic ziplock bag. Otherwise, the illusion of grandeur is complete.

It is elegantly beautiful and well worth the price.

title: Durable but Stiff Polyester
text:
This review is a little off because I was sent the wrong item, I got a skirt rather than a jumper, but several things are quite obvious from the one I got. These are meant to be durable uniform type apparel. The durability comes from the fact that they are heavy polyester which comes with its trade offs. First the material is stiff and not the most comfortable, but this is the price for its ruggedness. It will take a time to prove, but this skirt looks like it would wear like iron, but I don't expect it to soften up over washed.

As far as manufacturing, the seams are strong, and the entire garment shows detail to quality.

title: Amazing
text:
I got these to replace my SO's volleyball shoes and they were a total success. To put a few quotes out there "These are the most comfortable new shoes I have ever put on," "These are absolutely my favorite new shoes," and "Holy Crap!"

These are beautiful shoes and have amazing traction and support, great cushioning for the heal and totally live up to their description as seriously comfortable. They have been on a few walks and a few volleyball games now and they are holding up very well. Time will tell how they will wear, but two weeks out of the box and they are incredible.

One of the deciding factors on requesting these shoes was that I have a number of friends and family members that swear by New Balance. They can add one more loyal customer to their rolls.

title: Another Great, Bold Man's Watch from Invicta (with 7 month update)
text:
[[VIDEOID:4ffe357882246f8c168dd0718e643ee5]] This is actually my second Invicta watch and I have to say I have been very happy with them. I wear them daily and they are comfortable and great looking. I appreciate their bold, masculine size of the watch and the striking designs of the faces. The are very well constructed. I have put my original Invicta through the paces and it has held up great.

These are strikingly large watches, so be ready for that, the faces are an inch and a half across and look large on the wrist. I like the leather band on this one even more than the woven nylon of the other one I have, it is easy to put on and sits even more comfortably on my wrist, and again, impressive, bold design with those large rivets.

I don't know what else to say, I have been very happy with my first Invicta and expect to enjoy swapping between them for a long time to come.

***** Update about 7 months after original post ******

I still love the striking design of the watch, but over the last 7 months, the hour hand has gotten about 20 minutes ahead of itself so now at the top of the hour, the hour hand is about a third of the way to the next hour. I don't see any easy adjustment to correct this gradual creep, other than maybe moving the hour ahead in about 8 months are remembering that the hour hand is now a little behind. It's too bad, this is a watch I have been wearing daily.

title: A Big, Bold, Masculinely Elegant Watch
text:
[[VIDEOID:c7a166578428a5adc87c32c6da2c6bf3]] Maybe it's nostalgia, maybe it's that I got tired of carrying a cell phone but I really wanted to start wearing a watch again. So when I got a chance to review an Invicta I jumped at the opportunity. It was like taking a time machine back to 1992, and I'm liking it.

I have to admit I was surprised by the size of this watch. The watch face is literally almost an inch and a half wide with striking primary red and blue hands. It is bold and classi; elegant and visually clean, very tasteful and simple.

I'm split on whether the size is a good or bad thing. My co-worked joked that it was obviously meant for use with the visually impaired but I like the boldness of size. The band has taken a bit to get used to after going watchless for a decade, but it seems to be working out well. It is definitely a man's man's watch based on size.

The additional bands are also boldly colored, especially the blue. I love that they embedded the pins into the bands as I have lost a pin before and could not longer use that watch. The action of the time setting dial is smooth as butter. The ticking is faint but solidly watch like. I like it.
