title: Jeans that fit long legs!
text: I was overjoyed to find jeans that were long enough!  I am 5’11”. 123 lbs.  most of my height is in my legs, so any item whose length is critical (maxi dresses, pants, pajamas, etc.) is usually a no-win situation for me.  I purchased a 6 long.  While I can wear it comfortably, it is larger than I need do to the stretch of the fabric.  My subsequent order was a 4 long, and the fit is perfect.  My only criticisms are these:  the pair I am now reviewing, 6L, came with a small hole in one leg..  I was so happy to have jeans to wear that I didn’t complain or return them!  Additionally, I wish that in the color choices, there were some that were simply uniform throughout the garment.  All choices have the oh-So-popular fading/shading technique.  I have a hard time liking something that imitates aging or wear.  Another smaller issue is that the pockets are so very shallow that they are pretty much decorative only.  One could carry a key or a folded currency bill in the pocket(s), but little else.  That said, I am still grateful for finding comfortable, relatively inexpensive jeans that actually fit!

It is slow that way but you make sure that you size it right, since you cannot replace any of the links you cut out!! I used a buck knife to make the cuts and an exacto knife to do any fine trimming. I have a set of jewelers screwdrivers and included in the set is one blade that is pointed so I used that to push out the pins in the band. Once you start one pin, it comes out easily. II
The fact that it is a limited edition doesn't hurt either!!

title: If you're 5'2" or shorter, be prepared to hem these
text:
It's super annoying that the size chart doesn't have an inseam length. Another reviewer shared that she's short and the pants inseam shrunk.

However, I'm not willing to wash them to find out. With so many clothing lines offering petite or short inseams, why doesn't Amazon Essentials follow the trend? The inseam on the size 18 (straight, not curvy) is about 30". As a frame of reference, I'm a consistent size 14 in LB and NYDJ.

Lastly, the fit is weird. I'm curvy (booty, ample thighs) with a small waist, and the straight cut is too boxy (with too much space in the waist) and the Mid-Rise Skinny-Fit Chino Pants were a bit obscene.

I've given up with the Amazon Essentials Chinos.

title: The wide width is not
text:
I own two other styles of Jambu which I wore until they were no more. Comfortable and business casual enough on a college campus, these were my go-to. The wide width were a true wide, and I could walk anywhere on campus with the cushioned inner sole promising support.

However, Jambu must've tinkered wrong with this style. The shoe itself is a stiff material, even the signature inner sole doesn't feel the same. And worse, these are way too narrow to qualify as a wide width.

The champagne shimmer is a beauty, but sadly, I returned them.

title: If you're short, forget petite or short lengths, check other brands
text:
I love Lee slacks for the office. Dressy enough for the office, and comfortable because it's mostly cotton.

I'm a classic size 14, but I'm 5 ft. tall. Hips, booty and thighs are ample. The size 14 Petite fit me perfectly...EXCEPT for the length.

I previously ordered 14Short, and when I tried them on, the Lee description says the inseam is 29 inches. Back to the drawing board, I order a 14 petite, which depending what review you read has an inseam between 26-28".

Behold the pictures. I measured the inseam and they're 29 inches!!! I don't sew nor should I need to pay a tailor to hem slacks which as advertised should be petite length. Back they go to Amazon!

title: Perfect inseam for those under 5'3
text:
The taper in this Amanda jean means that for curvy ones, you'll need to go up a size. With an hourglass figure, ample bottom, hips and thighs means I'd need to go up a size.

If you're figure is straight, this will fit. Pear-shapes, depending on thighs may need to size up, and so will apples.

However, the one thing that I did learn and appreciate was finding the perfect inseam length. Approximately 25" give or take. See the pics. The inseam is nowhere near 29". ShortPetite is the length for me. The jeans, however, are too tight and going back.

title: Petite ones - either hem or take a hard pass
text:
If you're under 5'4", you'll need to hem these pants, or wear killer heels. Although I'm in love with the fit (as a curvy one with a smaller waist and ample thighs - it actually FITS), the length is too long. Since many lines do create pants that have a shorter inseam, I'm returning these.

PRO TIP: a 29" inseam is probably too long for those 5'3" and under, I'm 5'.

title: Wide width straps but narrow base?

I've got wide, flat feet and heels are generally a pain. But it's super frustrating when you find a pair of truly wide-width sandals with appropriately sized and comfortable straps, but the base is made for medium widths. Therefore, the outer edges of your feet are hanging off the sides and do not support your feet properly.

Sad and returned.

title: Comfortable and a true wide-width shoe
text:
Lovely fit, I'm a true 8W with flat feet. My chihuahua ran me around the neighborhood, and the arch support and ankle stability are legit. I've worn these with socks and jeans, tights and sweater dresses and both are perfect. They are new, so I'll update once I've had them for a while. So far, so good.

UPDATE with PHOTOS: These have held up well during the pandemic. The pictures are after a good year-and-a-half of serious wear. Hiking through national parks, check. Chihuahua walking me through the neighborhood, check. Salsa dancing prior to lockdowns, check.

The arch support isn't what it was but they still have a bit of comfortable cushioning, and for someone with flat feet, that's significant. The ribbons on the front have stretched thanks to the "Quarantine 15," but since getting rid of the added pounds they're not too bad (see pic #2). The tread on the soles are holding up nicely - I am not kind to my shoes (see pic #3)!

All in all, a wise investment. I won't deduct stars for what I consider to be regular wear-and-tear.

title: Printing off in shirt, what a shame!

title: No seamed edges makes these look cheap

Good color variety
Wide enough to cover half the head

The BIG cons:
No seamed/finished edges (see picture) means they look cheap and unprofessional. In order to hide the edge, I need to tuck both sides underneath.

And because of the unfinished edges, they also roll.

If you sew, you could probably finish the seam in a jiffy. However, I don't so hence my problem.

title: Back strap flaw. Darn

But I am sending them back because of the darn back strap. If I had a great cobbler, I'd keep them. The buckles on both straps are amazing and hold the foot quite snug. I'm unsure if there's a defect in the pair I received, or if this is a manufacturing flaw, but the back strap (on the heels) is too long and does not have a buckle in order to tighten. They are dangerously loose.

Again, I'm tremendously sad because as a woman who wears wide width shoes but appreciates some sex appeal on my feet, these would've elevated my shoe game. Darn.

text:
Okay I waited awhile to give my review because, I like to really use a product and put it through its intended purpose first.
This is a high quality, very well constructed umbrella. I used it in the rain, wind and snow and it held up beautifully. In windy conditions it does not bend and break as most umbrellas do, plus it snaps right back into place when bent. It's fully automatic with a push of the button both to open and close. It holds up very well to the weight of snow ( I have only used it in snowy conditions to and from my car) I did not use it in snowy conditions for long periods so couldn't say exactly how much snow weight it can withstand.
For the price and quality, you just cannot go wrong. I was very hard on this umbrella just to see how durable it was and it passed my rigorous tests with flying colors. Will buy again for gifts. I highly recommend this Kolumbo Travel Umbrella for the quality in design, construction and durability.

Wheat Straw: (Milan Straw, Tuscan, Leghorn),
Rye straw: Used for the traditional bryl straw hats popular among the peasants of Belarus, southwestern Russia and Ukraine.
Toquilla Straw: A flexible and long-lived fiber, which is generally made into hats in Ecuador. Hats made from the toquilla straw are popularly known as Panama hats.
Buntal/ Parabuntal Straw: from unopened Palm leaves or stems of the Buri Palm,
Baku Straw- 1x1 Woven, made from the young stalks of the Talipot palm from Malabar and Ceylon,
Braided hemp,
Raffia,
Shantung Straw: it is actually made out of a high performance paper which is rolled into a yarn to imitate straw, historic it was made of buntal
Toyo Straw: Cellophane coated Washi,
Bangora Straw: made from a lower grade of Washi,
Paperbraids: made from different paper strands from Viscose from different Plants (Swiss Paglinastraw[6]), (Silkpaper, Rice paper),
Sisal/ Parasisal (same as Sisal but 2x2 woven),
Seagrass (Xian),
Visca Straw: an artificial straw made by spinning viscose in a flat filament capable of being braided, woven, or knitted and used especially for women's hats,
Rush Straw: a thick, stiff straw, often used to manufacture inexpensive casual sun hats, made from rush grass (Juncus effesus, Juncus polycephalus), from the bulrushtypes sedge grass (Schoenoplectus lacustris, Cyperus papyrus, Typha (Typha domingensis, syn. Thypha angustata) (bulrush or cattail)} and other types seashore rushgrass (Sporobolus virginicus) or reed

Abacá: (for Sinamay hats)
Ramie,

Learning experience at age 50 for me and 35 years wearing nylons 5 days a week: Hosiery comes in a range of thickness and weight. "denier" measures the weight and thickness of yarn (density and linear).
-The lower the denier, the more sheer the hosiery is.
-The higher the denier, the more opaque the hosiery becomes.
Sheer hosiery with a higher denier, for strength and sheerness, will cost.
These tights are 80 denier
-40 denier+ "opaque" aka "tights", won't show your skin underneath unless it's too small a size and you have to stretch to fit. Keeps your legs warm in cold weather may be too hot under trousers/slacks. I have never bout wool tights but growing up in New England I wish my mother had. The other benefit is they last a super long time if you take care of them.
5 denier or less "ultrasheer" almost appears like not wearing hosiery at all. Feels great in hot weather and evening attire. Snags easily, you are lucky to get one wearing out of it.
15 to 30 denier "sheer" classic hosiery.
30-40 denier "semi-opaque" can be longer lasting then <30 denier.

title: YES, BOOTS!!!!!
text: One of my favorite things about cooler weather is boots. They can take an outfit from drab to FAB. I have purchased several pairs of pumps from this brand, so I kept an eye out for the boots. This bright, cherry red pair gives what they're supposed to give. The streamlined style is timeless. They'll be a staple in your boot wardrobe. The heel is quite high, but there is cushioning built into the sole, which is standard for this brand. The sizing is pretty true. I usually get a size 9 in boots so I can wear thick socks. These fit perfectly. Each boot comes in its own dust bag for safe storage. The finish on the fabric is somewhere between matte and glossy. You could add more shine with a leather conditioner if you prefer. If you love a high-heeled boot, this one is for you. The cute zipper up the back is the icing on the cake. Be prepared for all of the compliments you'll receive from other shoe lovers. I HIGHLY recommend these boots. ENJOY!!!

I will proudly display these shoes right next to my Louboutins. They run small and narrow, so be advised. I went up a half size and they fir perfectly. I'm now a loyal customer. I HIGHLY recommend these shoes.

title: UNBELIEVABLE!!!
text:
I'm always on the hunt for an outstanding shoe at a great price. Don't get me wrong. I love luxury, but there's a certain high that I get from a treasure hunt. This shoe is an UNBELIEVABLE find. The quality compares to Aldo or Nine West. I usually add a special insole to all of my heels because I don't believe in suffering for fashion. The best part about this shoe is that there's a built-in memory foam insole. Even though the heel is SKY HIGH, it's still comfortable and easy to wear for extended periods of time. The fit runs small and narrow. I usually wear an 8 1/2 in lower-priced brands (39.5 Louboutin, 38.5 Jimmy Choo & Manolo Blahnik). The size 9 was a perfect fit for me. I have weirdly narrow ankles, but the ankle fit me without leaving a gap. I must say, I'm truly impressed with this shoe. I'll DEFINITELY be purchasing more items from this brand. If you're a shoe lover, don't hesitate to buy this shoe. I HIGHLY recommend it!!!

title: Unique Design
text:
I'm a bag and shoe girl. I've never seen a bag quite like this before. The color is a midnight navy. It is so dark that it looks black in some light. The design in the center is the highlight. The green and orchid colors make a nice contrast to the navy. The handles are just big enough for your hand, but there is an optional shoulder strap included. There's plenty of storage space inside in addition to a pocket on the back. If you're a fan of vintage style, you'll like this bag.

Thanks so much for taking the time to read this review. I hope the information that I've provided makes your decision a little easier.

title: Soft & Stretchy
text:
This jumpsuit is as comfortable as wearing pajamas. The fabric is of good quality. It's very stretchy and soft. It's quite forgiving. There's a stitch at the bust for modesty. The legs are wide and flowy. You can cinch your waist as needed with the drawstring waistband. The pockets are a bonus. You can dress this up or wear it casually. It's a surprisingly nice piece. The fit is true to size. For fit reference, I'm 5'6", 162lbs and a 34G bra size. The medium fit me perfectly.

Thanks so much for taking the time to read this review. I hope the information that I've provided makes your decision a little easier.

title: Large & Luxurious
text:
I was looking for a new scarf to wear at night. This one is much too luxurious to waste in that way. It's extra large and comes in beautiful prints. The one I chose looks like it could be Hermes from a distance. You can use it to accessorize your favorite handbag or outfit. It's also great as a headband. Depending on your waist size, you could even use it as a belt. I'm definitely interested in purchasing more colors. I HIGHLY recommend this scarf.

title: So Pretty!
text:
I've bought a few bags that have scarves tied around the handles. I really like how it elevates the style. I tried to do it with on my own, but it just didn't work. I'm glad I found these. I originally ordered them as headbands, but they work perfectly as handbag accessories. You can easily wrap the around standard handles. I found the perfect scarf for this tote bag. The handles are a little too long to fully wrap. I just ordered a second set so I can wrap both handles of my bags with the same print. This is a fantastic bargain. I highly recommend this set.

Thanks so much for taking the time to read this review. I hope the information that I've provided makes your decision a little easier.

title: All Weather Boot
text:
Terra is an industry leader in boots that offer protection on the worksite. This one is made for any kind of weather. It's waterproof and has insulation that keeps your feet warm even in subzero temps. It's a classic snow boot with a little something extra. The fit is true to size. I highly recommend this boot.

title: Looks Better On
text:
This pump is like a dress that looks better on you than on a rack. I wasn't convinced that I would like it until I put it on my foot. I was instantly proven wrong about my initial impression. This shoe is FABULOUS!! There's a slight curve that makes your feet look amazing. The heel is truly special. I particularly like the attention to detail along the sides. The almond color is an outstanding neutral that you can wear nearly year-round. The fit is true to size. This shoe is a MUST! I HIGHLY recommend it.
